description:
When you join Verizon
  
  
You want more out of a career. A place to share your ideas freely — even if they’re daring or different. Where the true you can learn, grow, and thrive. At Verizon, we power and empower how people live, work and play by connecting them to what brings them joy. We do what we love — driving innovation, creativity, and impact in the world. Our V Team is a community of people who anticipate, lead, and believe that listening is where learning begins. In crisis and in celebration, we come together — lifting our communities and building trust in how we show up, everywhere & always. Want in? Join the #VTeamLife.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing...**
This role requires a visionary technology leader who will champion the integration of Generative AI technologies into our projects. The ideal candidate will leverage their expertise to drive innovation, enhance product offerings, and create efficient solutions that align with our strategic goals.
  
  

* AI Architecture, Agentic Systems & MLOps
* Agentic Workflows & Digital Workers: Design and operationalize GenAI-powered agents, LLMs, RAG, and multi-agent frameworks that function as digital workers—automating complex decision-making for CPQ (Configure, Price, Quote), ordering, orchestration, inventory, and service assurance.
* Process Mapping & Platform Integration: Analyze enterprise workflows to define operational logic, boundary conditions, and guardrails for agents deployed on the AI platform, ensuring high reusability and fast speed-to-value.
* Foundation Model Management: Integrate state-of-the-art foundation models (OpenAI, Anthropic, open-source via Hugging Face/vLLM) while managing model routing, latency budgets, token cost optimization, and semantic caching.
* LLMOps & Governance: Establish MLOps/LLMOps pipelines featuring real-time model monitoring, fine-tuning, safety guardrails, automated CI/CD deployments, and evaluation pipelines (e.g., LangSmith, Phoenix) to guarantee output quality, security, and compliance.
* Full Stack & Distributed Systems Architecture
* End-to-End Systems Engineering: Oversee the architectural blueprint for web applications, microservices, and event-driven asynchronous pipelines across frontend, backend, and cloud environments.
* High-Performance Frontends: Architect dynamic, real-time user interfaces capable of streaming response handling (Server-Sent Events / WebSockets) and dynamic AI UI components. NodeJS, Angular is a must.
* API & Microservices Design: Build robust, highly concurrent, low-latency APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC) and microservice layers powering critical enterprise workflows.
* Cloud, Data Engineering & Analytics
* Multi-Cloud & Streaming Strategy: Build and scale data analytics and real-time streaming pipelines across cloud environments (AWS, GCP) to handle high-throughput customer, partner, and employee transactions.
* Data Persistence Models: Architect hybrid data persistence frameworks combining relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL), NoSQL platforms (MongoDB, DynamoDB), and high-precision vector databases (Pinecone, Qdrant, Milvus, pgvector).
* Ingestion Pipelines: Design data ingestion, chunking, and embedding workflows to transform unstructured organizational knowledge into high-precision search platforms.
* Technical Leadership, Execution & Stakeholder Management
* Engineering Standards & Roadmaps: Set technical roadmaps, architectural standards, API contracts, and design patterns across global engineering squads.
* Cross-Functional Strategy: Partner closely with Product Management, Partner Solutions, Public Sector, and Technology Transformation teams to translate complex customer RFPs, migrations, and product goals into engineering blueprints.
* Delivery & Global Team Management: Direct software execution across hybrid onshore, offshore, and vendor IT teams using Agile and DevOps methodologies to maximize engineering velocity and throughput.
* Validation & Iterative Review: Lead technical reviews and demos with stakeholders to validate feature alignment against policy and operational constraints, rapidly integrating user feedback into system specs.
* Leading the technology charter for the development, engineering and solutioning using the latest technology stack infusing AI into the product development
* Innovating

+ Championing the adoption of Generative AI technologies across the organization.
+ Identifing emerging trends and opportunities in AI and propose innovative solutions.
+ Conducting workshops and training sessions to educate team members on Generative AI technologies and best practices

* Performance Monitoring and Improvement:

+ Establishing metrics to evaluate the performance and effectiveness of AI solutions.
+ Continuously assessing and optimize AI models and algorithms for better accuracy and efficiency.
+ Ensuring that AI implementations adhere to ethical standards and regulatory requirements.
+ Advocating for responsible AI practices within the organization.
+ Developing highly-available applications and service stacks in production environments.
+ Providing architectural oversight for systems and services
+ Promoting, implementing, and educating about Agile software development
+ Staying updated with industry trends, emerging technologies, and best practices to drive continuous improvement
+ Collaborating with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment of development efforts with business objectives
+ Bringing in new ideas towards unlocking the unarticulated needs of our customers in the Digital channels infusing AI
+ Delivering on the AGILE KPI’s and driving incremental improvements on Quality, Supply Demand Capacity, on time completion of milestones and positive business outcomes

**What We’re Looking For...**
You have the ability to define a vision and your ambitious attitude drives you to generate highly innovative ideas and take calculated risks. You develop positive relationships and innovative solutions, which makes you a productive collaborator. Customers appreciate that you take personal responsibility for their satisfaction, and team members know they can count on your commitment.
  
  
**You’ll Need To Have**

* Bachelor’s degree or four or more years of work experience.
* Six or more years of relevant work experience.
* Proven experience as an AI architect or similar role, with a focus on Generative AI
* Technical Skills
* Proficiency in programming languages (Python, Java, etc.).
* Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, Google Cloud) and AI services.
* Software development experience in a diverse set of areas including scalable web applications
* Experience in Java/J2EE application development including experience leading a technical team in such web technologies.
* Experience in a DevOps software development environment.
* Experience migrating web applications to Cloud (AWS, Oracle Cloud or Cloud Foundry etc.)
* Knowledge and experience of Docker/Container technologies
* Exceptional communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and a proactive mindset.
* Ability to lead and inspire teams in a fast-paced environment.
* Strong background in machine learning, deep learning, and AI frameworks (e.g., TensorFlow, PyTorch)

**Even better if you have one or more of the following:**

* A degree in computer science or computer engineering.
* Evaluate and choose appropriate technologies, design patterns, and algorithms for the development of robust and scalable software solutions
* Innovation mindset
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills ability to assimilate data from varied sources, apply deductive reasoning and scientific method, make inferences, draw testable conclusions, and resolve problems.
* Experience in virtualization and cloud platforms.
* Experience in building large scale systems-management, network monitoring systems, and monitoring applications.
* Ability to handle teams from multiple locations and working in an onshore/offshore model.
* Modify existing software to correct errors, to adapt it to new hardware, or to upgrade interfaces and improve performance.
* Develop or direct software system testing or validation procedures.

If Verizon and this role sound like a fit for you, we encourage you to apply even if you don’t meet every “even better” qualification listed above.

* Experience evaluating Generative AI, conversational interfaces, or machine learning-driven workflows.

**About The Job**
At Google, we "Focus on the user and all else will follow." As a UX Research Manager, you will help define and drive the future of Google design by clarifying strategy and conceptualizing UX ecosystems. You are an expert researcher, a visionary leader, and a fierce advocate for both users and your team.
  
  
You will be responsible for guiding the careers of your team members, helping them realize their full potential, and inspiring forward-thinking design. You are an expert in qualitative research methods—such as field studies, interviews, and diary studies—to shape product development and influence overall strategy. In this role, you will understand both the execution and business aspects of our products, collaborating with leaders across UX, Engineering, and Product Management to create innovative experiences, leveraging your passion for brand, craft, and design quality.
  
  
Cases Platform powers high-touch customer support resolution for Google representatives and agents globally across Google Ads, YouTube, Play, and Cloud. As our ecosystem transitions toward intelligent agent workflows, the Support Platform UX team is redefining how human agents and AI systems collaborate to resolve complex customer issues.
  
  
As the UX Research Manager for Cases Platform in Hyderabad, you will lead a dedicated team of UX researchers driving the insights behind this transformation. You will establish a user-centered direection for pivotal AI initiatives, partner with cross-functional leadership across global sites, and ensure our products demonstrably reduce workflow complexity and cognitive load.
  
  
Google Ads is at the forefront of AI innovation, applying cutting-edge machine learning and Generative AI models like Gemini to power a multi-billion dollar global business.
  
  
Our work directly impacts billions of users by protecting users from harm, improving ad quality, and optimizing campaigns for advertiser return-on-investment. We foster a culture of deep collaboration, partnering closely with teams like Google Research and DeepMind to solve complex challenges. Join us to work on state-of-the-art AI, take on problems at an unparalleled scale, and build the next generation of advertising technology.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Manage, mentor, and foster the professional growth of a multi-disciplinary team of UX researchers.
* Define and drive the multi-year user research roadmap for Cases Platform, aligning studies directly with product and engineering planning cycles.
* Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and UX Design leadership to shape the strategic direction of AI-assisted support workflows.
* Oversee end-to-end research programs combining exploratory user interviews, usability testing, survey metrics, and behavioral log analysis.
* Translate user behavioral findings into clear product requirements, usability frameworks, and executive share-outs to inform strategic decisions.

**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

description:

To build our future, the best energy is ours! Arabelle Solutions, part of the EDF Group, is a global leader in nuclear turbine island technologies, providing innovative low-carbon power solutions from the world’s most powerful operating steam turbine to modular SMR-optimized designs, along with generators, pumps, heat exchangers, and controls. Its technologies are used in one-third of nuclear power plants worldwide, supported by a team of 3,500 experts across 16 countries. Our cultural pillars define how we work together: Team, Expertise, Ownership. We collaborate fully and value the spirit of teamwork, where every skill is recognized to create innovative and effective solutions. Guided by safety and integrity in all we do, we take ownership of our actions and results.
  
  

* Primary Activities

Scope
  
  
Document Controller is responsible to execute Document Management (DoM) activities at project level, ensuring correct DoM implementation according to valid work instructions, monitoring relevant KPIs. He/she ensures that a common DoM Process is available to NNB projects Document controller functionally reports to DoM Project Lead and Hierarchically to Projects Head of Document Management. In case DoM Project Lead is not appointed, Document controller will report functionally to the PEM. Document controller acts under instructions and guidance of Document Management Project Lead (or PEM) who maintain the overall DoM coordination.

* Timely update of MTA system with Document related objects (Documents, comments, transmittala) and information upload (Document metadata)

* Responsibilities

title: Content Specialist
description:
About the Role

IT By Design is looking for a versatile Content Writer who can move fluidly between deeply researched, long-form B2B content and sharp, scroll-stopping social copy. You'll own storytelling across the funnel, from founder narratives and customer case studies to newsletters and one-pagers.

This role is ideal for someone who thinks like a strategist, writes like a specialist, and cares about the business outcomes their words drive.

**What You'll Do**

* Write and edit long-form B2Bassets:thought-leadership articles, blog posts, case studies, one-pagers, and pillar content.
* Craft founder profiles and ghostwritten pieces that capture an authentic voice and point of view.
* Own the newsletter end to end, fromconcept, copy, and a consistent editorial cadence.
* Produce social media content (primarily LinkedIn) that repackages long-form work into engaging, platform-native posts.
* Use AI tools (Claude) to accelerate research, drafting, and iteration whilemaintainingaccuracy, originality, and brand voice.
* Collaborate withthe Creative lead, Director of Marketing, Founders,Product,Sales, andDesignfolksto align content withthe companygoals.
* Maintain quality, consistency, and editorial standards across every format and channel.

**What You'll Need**

**Required**

* Proven experience writing B2B long-form content
  *and*
  social media copy.
* A portfolio that includes founder profiling/ghostwriting, newsletters, one-pagers, and case studies.
* Hands-on experience using AI tools,specifically Claude for writing and editing.
* Strong research skills and the ability to translate complex or technical topics into clear, engaging content.
* Excellent command of English grammar, tone, and structure, with a strong editorial eye.
* Ability to manage multiple formats and deadlines independently.

**Nice to Have**

* Familiarity with a graphic editing tool (e.g., Canva or Adobe) to create or lightly adapt visuals.
* Basic understanding of SEO and content distribution.

**Preferred Background**

Experience writing for
**B2B, MSP (Managed Service Provider) services, SaaS, or content-first platforms**
is strongly preferred. You understand these audiences, their buying cycles, and how content earns trust in a considered-purchase environment.

**Success Metrics**

* **Output & consistency:**
  Meeting the agreed publishing cadence across long-form, newsletter, and social (e.g., weekly/monthly targets met on time).
* **Engagement:**
  Growth in social reach, impressions, and engagement rate on published posts.
* **Newsletter health:**
  Open rate, click-through rate, and subscriber growth against benchmarks.
* **Content performance:**
  Traffic, time-on-page, and lead/conversion contribution from long-form assets.
* **Founder/brand voice:**

title: SPA/Programme Lead- Clean Energy
company: International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST)
description:
**Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate, Clean Energy**

The International Forum for Environment, Sustainability & Technology (iFOREST) is inviting applications for the positions of Programme Lead and Senior Programme Associate under its Clean Energy Programme.

We are looking for experienced, motivated professionals with a strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, demonstrated analytical and research capabilities, and a proven track record in programme execution, advisory and implementation-oriented assignments. The role also requires excellent communication, coordination and stakeholder engagement skills to support high-impact clean energy transition initiatives across states and sectors.

https://forms.gle/Bujd7qyMMpFB2vFY8

Required Experience for
**Programme Lead**
: 10+ years

Required Experience for
**Senior Programme Associate**
: 5–7 years

Location: Noida, Uttar Pradesh

Reporting to: Director, Clean Energy (Programme Lead) / Programme Lead, Clean Energy (Senior Programme Associate)

**About iFOREST**

iFOREST is an independent, not-for-profit research and innovation organisation established in 2019. Our mission is to identify, promote and scale up solutions for critical environment-development challenges in India and other developing regions across Asia and Africa.

We focus on regional priorities to accelerate environmental action at the sub-national level, while influencing national policies and plans to support these efforts. By drawing on our resources and expertise, we aim to address regional needs, strengthen national action and contribute to global solutions.

Our work involves independent, evidence-based research, developing innovative solutions, convening stakeholders to build consensus, and partnering with think tanks, civil society organisations, government agencies, philanthropies and industry leaders.

**The Clean Energy Programme**

The iFOREST Clean Energy Programme focuses on accelerating equitable renewable energy growth in India by supporting clean energy deployment in underserved states, especially in the eastern and northeastern regions.

The programme supports state governments through policy and regulatory reform, implementation strategies, techno-economic assessments, investment facilitation and institutional capacity building. Its focus states include Odisha, Assam, Jharkhand, Chhattisgarh, West Bengal and Uttar Pradesh. The work prioritises land-neutral technologies such as floating solar, agri-PV, rooftop solar, storage and green hydrogen.

**The Role**

The Programme Lead / Senior Programme Associate will drive research, policy advisory and implementation activities under the Clean Energy Programme. The Programme Lead will anchor delivery of the programme, working closely with the Director across research, engagement, technical support and implementation, and will manage teams and workstreams. The Senior Programme Associate will lead the execution of key assignments, particularly on industrial renewable energy adoption, demand aggregation and investment mobilisation in Uttar Pradesh and other priority states.

The selected candidates will work closely with state governments, renewable energy agencies, utilities, industrial associations, MSMEs, development partners and other stakeholders to develop and implement renewable energy transition initiatives.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Drive execution of ongoing and planned projects, ensuring timely delivery of committed activities, outputs, milestones and reporting requirements
* Design and manage workplans, research methodologies, analytical frameworks and implementation strategies for programme assignments
* Conduct and oversee primary and secondary research, techno-economic assessments and policy analysis on industrial RE adoption, RE procurement, demand aggregation and storage integration
* Lead preparation of research reports, policy briefs, technical outputs, regulatory recommendations and investment-oriented strategies, with analytical rigour and quality control
* Support the design and operationalisation of RE demand aggregation initiatives and pilot projects in industrial clusters
* Build and maintain strong relationships with government agencies, utilities, industries, MSMEs, research institutions, CSOs, media and development partners
* Lead stakeholder consultations, workshops, trainings, convenings and field engagements
* Represent iFOREST in external meetings, consultations, conferences and sectoral discussions
* Contribute to programme development, including concept notes, technical proposals, budgets, pitch materials and partnership building
* Manage and mentor programme teams, supporting work allocation, progress tracking and capacity building (Programme Lead)
* Undertake any additional responsibilities related to the advancement of the Clean Energy Programme and institutional priorities

**Qualification & Work Experience**

At least a master’s degree from a recognised institution in a relevant field, such as energy policy, public policy, economics, management, renewable energy, engineering or a related discipline.

Around 10 years of relevant experience for the Programme Lead, and 5–7 years for the Senior Programme Associate, in research, strategy consulting, advisory, programme implementation or policy engagement focused on the renewable energy sector.

A demonstrated track record of producing high-quality research and advisory outputs, such as reports, briefs, assessments, presentations and implementation frameworks.

Experience of working with government agencies, utilities, industries, industry associations, development partners or research institutions will be an advantage.

**Required Competencies**

* Strong understanding of India’s renewable energy sector, including its policies, regulations, programmes, technologies, industrial markets, open access, captive energy and implementation challenges
* Proven experience in qualitative and quantitative research, policy analysis and techno-economic assessments
* Strong programme execution and project management capabilities
* Ability to engage effectively with government, industry, research institutions, CSOs and development partners
* Strong analytical, writing, presentation, communication and problem-solving skills
* Collaborative, proactive and solutions-oriented approach, with strong organisational and time-management skills
* Experience in proposal development, programme reporting and donor coordination is desirable
* Willingness to travel as required

**What We Offer**

At iFOREST, we provide an inclusive and supportive work environment. We are committed to professional development through education, training and capacity-building initiatives.

* Opportunity to contribute to high-impact clean energy transition and renewable energy deployment initiatives across India
* Exposure to policy processes, government engagement and technical advisory work
* A dynamic and supportive work culture that values methodological rigour and innovation
* Competitive compensation in line with experience and organisational norms

**Remuneration**

We offer a competitive salary based on experience and proficiency. The final designation will depend on the qualifications and experience of the selected candidate.

**Application Instructions**

We prefer that candidates apply through LinkedIn https://forms.gle/Bujd7qyMMpFB2vFY8 or submit an online application at https://iforest.global/careers/

title: Senior Control & Protection Application Engineer
description:
**Job Description Summary**
L'ingénierie des systèmes est une discipline d'ingénierie interfonctionnelle axée sur une approche, un état d'esprit et un processus. Toutes les activités qui tiennent compte des besoins à la fois commerciaux et techniques des clients dans le but de fournir un produit de qualité qui réponde aux besoins des utilisateurs. Discipline qui exécute un processus robuste de conception, de création et d’optimisation de systèmes, comprenant l’identification et la quantification des exigences système, la création de concepts de conception de système alternatifs, la réalisation d’études commerciales de conception, la sélection et la mise en œuvre des meilleures conceptions et la vérification que la conception est correctement intégrée et exécutée. Processus allant du concept à l'exploitation en passant par la production.
  
  
Agit sur la capacité de l'équipe à atteindre les objectifs en matière de service, de qualité et de respect des délais. Ce rôle est soumis aux objectifs de la politique opérationnelle. Il dispose d'une autonomie modérée. Des niveaux élevés de discernement opérationnel sont nécessaires pour obtenir les résultats escomptés.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Rôles et responsabilités**

* Effectue l'intégration des composants et des produits. Toutes les activités qui englobent plusieurs composants et produits et concernées par l'intégration des solutions pour une performance et une opérabilité maximales. Gère les exigences, les spécifications et les flux de produits et de systèmes. Dirige les activités de validation et de vérification pour l'ensemble du produit/système, comprenant les tests au niveau du système. Responsable de la définition des exigences produits pour les équipes module/composant/sous-traitants et partenaires. Gère l'interface entre les composants et les organisations d'exécution. Responsable de la gestion des transactions de CTQ/Risque au sein des équipes chargées de la conception des composants. Gère la configuration globale du produit et le système de contrôle de la configuration.
* Nécessite des connaissances spécialisées de la fonction. Influe sur l'élaboration d'une stratégie dans son domaine de responsabilité, y compris sur le contrôle des ressources et sur la formulation des politiques.
* Interprète les enjeux commerciaux internes et externes simples et recommande des meilleures pratiques pour améliorer les produits, processus ou services. Reste informé des tendances de l'industrie susceptibles d'éclairer son travail.
* Fait preuve d'un haut niveau de discernement pour prendre des décisions, et gérer des tâches ou des problèmes complexes dans les domaines de l'exploitation, de la gestion des produits, de la fabrication, de la technologie ou de l'ingénierie. Possède la capacité d'évaluer la qualité des informations fournies et sait poser des questions pertinentes aux parties prenantes. Est capable de résoudre des problèmes avec des solutions innovantes qui sortent du cadre des paramètres établis, mais aussi d'élaborer des recommandations. Fait appel à des ressources internes et externes en dehors de sa propre fonction pour l'aider à prendre une décision.
* Dirige, s'il y a lieu, des équipes fonctionnelles ou des projets dont les besoins en ressources, les risques et/ou la complexité sont réduits. Exprime des concepts difficiles et peut influencer les opinions de ses collègues sur des sujets particuliers. Peut amener autrui à envisager une question selon un point de vue différent.

* Pour les rôles aux États-Unis - Maîtrise d'une université accrédité (ou diplôme d'études secondaires et/ou diplôme d'étude général avec au moins 6 ans d'expérience dans la fonction).

**Caractéristiques souhaitées**

* Solides compétences en communication orale et écrite. Solides compétences relationnelles et de leadership. Capacité démontrée d'analyse et de résolution des problèmes. Capacité démontrée à diriger des programmes/projets. Capacité à documenter, planifier, lancer et exécuter des programmes. title: Manager - IT Business Analysis
description:
Internal Job Posting

We are seeking a talented individual to join Marsh People & Investment at Marsh Tech. This role will be based in Noida/Gurgaon. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI
  
  
**Role Overview**
The Senior Systems Analyst is a role in our scaled agile framework POD and Squad model. As part of a POD team the Senior System Analyst will support one or more cross-functional squads comprised of a Squad Lead, Developers, a System Analyst, and Quality Assurance Engineers committed to ensuring the successful design and delivery of complex application solutions centered on the strategic roadmap for one or more key technology capabilities within MMC. The Senior System Analyst will be primarily responsible for directing the cross-functional elicitation and elaboration of requirements across squads in an Agile Team setting.
  
  
As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. As a trusted part of a team, you will coordinate activities with up to four System Analysts across squads to ensure just-in-time development of the story.
  
  
You will also assist the Product Owner in the development of personas, customer journey maps, story maps and release planning to foster insights and understanding of vision for the team.
  
  
**We will count on you to:**

* Be a highly motivated team player working within MMC Agile culture, within a specified agile framework of Scrum or KANBAN and maintain a willingness for continuously improving your agile mindset.
* Direct analysis on critical initiatives requiring significant strategic change across multiple platforms and products.
* Ensure that teams are consistently converting the business requirements to solutions, consisting of epics and features, considering technical constraints and existing technical architecture/functionality.
* Work with the Product Owner to communicate the product vision, roadmap, value, and MVP to the agile teams to enable empathy and a shared understanding thereby helping the team to formulate an appropriate solution.
* Collaborate with the Pod Leadership, Product Owner, and stakeholders to create Persona’s, Story Maps, and a Release Plan for the project.
* Work in partnership with the Product Owner and agile teams in the creation and maintenance of Product Backlog Items ensuring that Epics and User Stories are continuously prioritized and aligned to the Product Roadmap and MVP.
* Facilitate refinement sessions with the Agile Teams and Business to sufficiently detail out User Stories, to include dependencies.
* Facilitate the Sprint Review ceremony by working with the agile teams, Product Owner, Business and Customer to review, assess and adapt the latest product increment by incorporating customer insights and feedback into the Product Backlog.
* Actively work with Pod Leadership by running assessments processes for the POD and provide constructive feedback towards continuously improving the Systems Analyst function, standards and processes in Global Technology.
* Lead workshops and work collaboratively with data engineers, data architects, technical experts, and AI engineers to integrate AI solutions into a POD.
* Demonstrate an awareness of MMC and Mercer Technical, Security and Process Standards and work with the team to incorporate them in product delivery through the software development life cycle.

**What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.
* Be willing to respond to emergent changes rather than focused on existing plans.
* Familiarity with AI concepts and technologies, including machine learning, natural language processing, and data analytics, while ensuring compliance with AI governance frameworks. Leverage these technologies to enhance user experiences and improve decision-making processes within applications.
* Minimum 12 months experience as D1/D2
* Should have at least “On-Track” or equivalent rating in last appraisal.
* Should not be under any Performance Counselling Plan or had any official disciplinary action within the last 3 months.

**What makes you stand out?**

* Ability to craft effective prompts that optimize AI responses, enhancing the functionality of AI-driven applications for problem-solving, analysis, and content generation.
* Capability to work within a POD/ cross-functional squads to develop and implement an AI strategy that aligns with business needs.
* Commitment to staying updated on the latest AI trends, technologies, and best practices to continuously improve AI capabilities within the organization.
* An Agile Mindset with an in-depth understanding of Agile Principles.
* Must have prior experience as an IT Systems Analyst or IT Business Analyst working as part of an agile team using an Agile Workflow tool such as JIRA or TFS.
* Agile Certification, such as CSM, PSM, CSPO, PSPO, PMI-ACP, Certified SAFe Practitioner, Azure AI Fundamentals is desirable.

**Why join our team:**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Merchant Cloud Commercialization Support
  
  
**About Mastercard**
Mastercard is a global technology company in the payments sector. We power payments and provide products and services for individuals and industries all around the world. Our people, technology, data, and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.
  
  
**Overview**
The Global Acceptance and Merchant Solutions team is on a mission to make Mastercard the best way to pay everywhere. With our powerful suite of acceptance products, including Merchant Cloud, we are helping shape the payment experiences of the future.
  
  
The Manager, Product Commercialization Support, Go-to-Market Enablement and Revenue Tracking will play a critical role in supporting the commercialization and go-to-market strategy for Merchant Cloud.
  
  
Role
  
  
This support role focused on market readiness, commercialization support, pipeline visibility, performance tracking, market penetration analysis, and go-to-market enablement under the directions of regional stakeholders. The role is not a direct sales position and does not carry sales quotas. The support to regional teams shall be through insights, analytics, commercial narratives, business cases, pipeline
  
  
governance, and customer-facing collateral that support successful go-to-market execution.
  
  
The Manager will be responsible for supporting the regional team in developing and executing the of Merchant Cloud's commercialization strategy, accelerate product adoption and market expansion through close collaboration with Product, Services, and other internal stakeholders. This role is pivotal in ensuring that regional teams are equipped with the tools, insights, materials, and strategic needed to effectively position Merchant Cloud in the market.
  
  

* Highly organised and capable of engaging stakeholders globally to establish visibility into commercial pipelines and track go-to-market

performance.
  
  

* Skilled at solving complex business problems and developing compelling commercialisation strategies, value propositions, and go-to-

market materials.
  
  

* Experienced in tracking product roadmaps, developing business cases, and supporting investment decisions through data-driven analysis

and insights.
  
  

* Proven ability to manage pipeline reporting, commercial performance tracking, and growth initiatives that support product adoption and business outcomes.
* Passionate about enabling customer-facing teams through sales collateral, analytics, insights, and strategic narratives that enhance go-to-market effectiveness and customer engagement. We are looking for an energetic professional who is willing to jump into an ever-evolving team and hit the ground running.

The Manager will have a proven track record of working effectively in a team to drive successful outcomes, exceptional analytical skills, and a strong commercial mindset, along with impeccable communication skills to improve Merchant Cloud understanding and up take within the broader business.
  
  
**More Specifically, The Candidate Will Be Responsible For**

* Creating comprehensive commercialization packages and go to market materials for newly launched products and features. Strong

**Influencing Skills Through Visualisation Of Data And Ideas Required.**

* Partnering closely with the Services organization at regional level to support the identication and, structuring of potential upselling and cross selling opportunities within new accounts.
* Managing and continuously updating the sales pipeline across various regions for regional team’s visibility regarding the ensure sustained

growth and prioritize high impact opportunities.
  
  

* Supporting the sales enablement initiatives of regional teams, delivering training, playbooks, and resources that keep teams hyper

focused on supporting the regional teams in their sales initiatives.
  
  

* Collaborating with regional teams and client facing groups to align commercialization strategies with local market needs.
* Leading KPI tracking and measuring the commercial impact of all launch and enablement efforts.
* Preparing business case inputs and analysis to support strategic investment and initiative decisions by regional teams

**All About You**

* Proven experience working in the Mastercard Services organization including BMI, Security Services, and Customer Acquisition and Engagement.
* In depth understanding and prior experience in the payments industry with a strong grasp of relevant market trends.
* Strong knowledge and experience in the Acquiring and Gateway ecosystem.
* Prior experience in dealing with the adoption of digital commerce solutions.
* A results-oriented professional able to drive outcomes, with proven experience in developing go to market strategies for new products and delivering scalable solutions.
* Entrepreneurial and commercial mindset able to adjust to changing demands of the market, customers, internal strategies, and build partnerships across the organization.
* Excellent communications and influencing skillset to support alignment of enablement strategies with business goals.
* Ability to lead cross functional and multi-location teams effectively.
* Organizational savviness to navigate a highly matrixed organization and resilience to thrive in a high pressure, goal-oriented environment.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills, completely comfortable using data to support business cases and recommendations.
* Bachelor’s degree required
* English fluency is mandatory.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory
description:
PFI Innovation Centre India is an exciting new innovation center. We’re building a future that helps people live better lives longer – and we’re looking for bold thinkers and team players to help us do it.
  
  
Here, you’ll tackle complex challenges, collaborate with brilliant minds across the globe, and grow your career while helping millions achieve financial security.
  
  
**a Purpose Driven Company – 150 Years**
While the PFI Innovation Centre brand is new to India, you’ll be a part of the Prudential Financial, Inc. family. Founded in Newark, NJ, we serve 50 million customers across more than 50 countries. With $1.334 trillion in assets, we’re a global leader in institutional asset management. The 2nd largest life insurer in the US and the 9th largest institutional global asset manager.
  
  
At the PFI Innovation Centre India, you’ll find high-performance culture that’s flexible, collaborative, and grounded in respect. We engage with candor, take calibrated risks, and hold ourselves accountable – always focused on delivering for our customers. It’s the standard we choose every day as we grow, perform, and win as one team. We offer valuable leadership, mentoring and learning opportunities, paired with flexibility and support to help you thrive.
  
  
Whether you’re just starting out or ready to take your next step, we’ll help you grow with purpose and do the best work of your career.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, serves as a trusted partner within the First Line Information Technology Operational Risk (ITOR) group and is accountable for issue validation testing, risk and controls advisory, governance, and reporting across Global Technology and Operations (GTO). The role leads multiple concurrent validation and control reviews to assess whether remediation addresses root causes, controls are designed and operating effectively, and risk outcomes are sustainable. The individual partners with business and technology leaders identify emerging risks, shape risk strategies and remediation priorities, and strengthen risk and control inventories. The role assists with risk and control governance forums, develops meaningful metrics and executive reporting, communicates risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalates matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. The role also coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities, supports the Privacy team as needed, and provides leadership, coaching, and quality oversight to ensure work is completed in accordance with department and industry standards.
  
  
**What You Can Expect**
The Director, Issue Validation Testing and Advisory, leads the planning and execution of issue validation and control testing to confirm remediation addresses root causes and delivers sustainable outcomes. The role, as a risk advisor, partners with business and technology leaders to identify and assess emerging risks, shape risk strategies, clarify risk acceptance decisions, and align remediation priorities with enterprise standards and business objectives. The role strengthens the control environment by advising on control design, evaluating design and operating effectiveness, maintaining accurate risk and control inventories, identifying thematic gaps and trends, and driving clear ownership, monitoring, and timely remediation. The role also supports effective governance by facilitating risk and control forums, establishing meaningful metrics and reporting, communicating risk themes and issue status to senior management, and escalating matters requiring timely decisions or intervention. It coordinates regulatory assessments and responses, client reviews, and SOC/SOX activities across Global Technology and Operations, and supports the Privacy team with privacy-related risk assessments, incident response, data mapping, and privacy-by-design activities.
  
  

* Lead issue validation and testing engagements to confirm that root causes are addressed and remediation is sustainable.
* Plan and schedule validation reviews for open issues, prioritizing work based on risk, target closure dates, and validation readiness.
* Coordinate validation activities with issue owners, control design functions, First Line management, and Audit to confirm scope, evidence requirements, dependencies, and review timelines.
* Assess remediation evidence and control implementation to determine whether corrective actions address root causes and operate as intended.
* Track validation progress, resolve evidence gaps, and escalate delays or risks that could affect timely issue closure.
* Partner with business and technology leaders to assess technology, cyber, data, resilience, and third-party risks; shape risk strategies; and align risk acceptance and remediation decisions with enterprise standards and business objectives.
* Lead risk assessments, maintain accurate process, risk, control, and issue inventories, and analyze trends and control gaps to strengthen control design, monitoring, remediation, governance, and reporting.
* Coordinate responses to risk events and emerging issues with business, Technology, Legal, Compliance, and control partners; provide executive reporting and escalation; facilitate root-cause and after-action reviews; and track corrective actions through sustainable resolution.
* Remain current on industry developments in cybersecurity, cloud, DevOps, information security, third-party risk management, and resilience.
* Lead and execute engagements that meet the department’s methodologies and quality standards.
* Invest in professional development, educate others on key risks and controls, and support staff development, recruiting, performance management, and succession planning.
* Leverage data analytics and develop review programs to support risk assessments, review design, and testing of key GTO risks.
* Guide the team on continuous monitoring, year-over-year review coverage, aggregation of key issues for senior leadership, and stakeholder governance meetings.
* Support the Privacy team, as needed, with incident response and escalation, awareness activities, Privacy Impact Assessments, data mapping, and privacy-by-design engagement with Technology Product Owners.
* Lead and support regulatory gap assessments and responses, SOC/SOX activities, and client assessments in partnership with Technology, business, Legal, Compliance, and Audit stakeholders.

**What You Will Bring**

* 8+ years of relevant experience gained through a combination of information security/technology, risk and/or audit related roles, including leading complex engagements and managing multiple concurrent deliverables. Specifically, experience in cloud operations, cyber security operations, vulnerability management or other IT operation-based specialist roles.
* Demonstrated expertise in the intricacies associated with a global company and its information technology/cyber security risk profile, including expanding regulatory requirements
* Strong knowledge of emerging topics and current analytical methods and techniques used to monitor and manage relevant risks.
* Track record of supervising, coaching, and developing talent; experience with work planning, staffing, and reviewing team deliverables for quality and consistency. Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills, with experience communicating complex topics to senior management and driving alignment on issues, ownership, and remediation.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to leverage data, metrics, and analytics to inform scoping, testing strategy, and thematic insights.
* Executive level communication skills, both oral and written, and the ability to partner effectively with multiple business groups, corporate areas, and second and third lines teams.
* Bachelor’s degree related to technology, risk management, finance, or other quantitative fields of study

**What will set you apart?**

* Experience in leveraging and/or performing data analysis in support of internal auditing.
* Advanced degrees in information technology or cyber security are preferred: An MBA, CIA, CISA, CISSP and/or designations/certifications (e.g., AI, AWS Cloud Practitioner) that demonstrate proficiency in information technology, information security, and/or cyber security related risks and controls is a plus.
* PFI Innovation Centre India welcomes all applicants, even if you don't meet every requirement. If your skills align with the role, we encourage you to apply.

* Leads or coordinates development of the SPVG components of RFPs, RFIs and other proposal responses, ensuring content is accurate, complete, consistent and aligned with the proposed delivery model.
* Solicits and consolidates input from SPVG operational teams, leadership and subject matter experts, working with Proposal Management and other functions to meet required submission timelines.
* Develops and reviews SPVG scopes of work, assumptions, responsibilities, service descriptions and supporting proposal materials.
* Coordinates responses to client clarification and due-diligence questions relating to SPVG services.
* Ensures appropriate alignment between proposal content, scope, resourcing assumptions, budget and client requirements.
* Budgeting, Costing & Commercial Support
* Develops and reviews SPVG budgets and costing assumptions, working with operational teams to ensure that proposed resource models appropriately reflect the anticipated scope and delivery requirements.
* Supports achievement of SPVG financial and profitability objectives by helping to ensure proposed solutions are appropriately scoped, resourced and costed.
* Supports development of commercially competitive solutions while maintaining operational feasibility, service quality and alignment with client requirements.
* Supports assessment of changes in scope and associated budget implications in collaboration with Contracts, Project Management and other relevant stakeholders.
* Uses historical delivery experience and available operational information to support continuous improvement of costing and resource assumptions.
* Client Presentations, Bid Defence & Contracting
* Supports preparation for bid defence meetings and other client-facing discussions, including development of SPVG presentation materials, key messages and responses to anticipated client questions.
* Participates in client meetings and bid defences as required, working alongside SPVG operational and functional representatives to communicate and support the proposed solution.
* Coordinates SPVG input into post-proposal clarifications and negotiations, including assessment of requested changes to scope, assumptions, responsibilities and delivery models.
* Supports review of relevant scope-of-work and contractual content to help ensure alignment with the solution agreed during the proposal process.
* Award & Operational Handover
* Facilitates the effective transition of awarded opportunities from the pre-award environment to the SPVG operational delivery team.
* Participates in project handover activities, ensuring the operational team has a clear understanding of the agreed scope, delivery model, key assumptions, responsibilities, dependencies and client requirements.
* Identifies and communicates material changes made during proposal development, client discussions or contracting that could affect subsequent delivery.
* Supports resolution of outstanding scope or solution questions during transition to the operational team, helping to maintain continuity between the proposed solution and operational delivery.
* Pre-Award Content & Continuous Improvement
* Develops, maintains and periodically reviews SPVG proposal templates, standard text, presentation materials and other pre-award resources.
* Works with SPVG subject matter experts to maintain and enhance proposal content, incorporating developments in services, delivery approaches, processes and technologies as appropriate.
* Supports ongoing review and improvement of SPVG estimating and costing approaches using available operational experience and lessons learned.
* Identifies recurring proposal issues, gaps and lessons learned and contributes to improvements in pre-award processes, tools and ways of working.
* Promotes consistency in how SPVG services are described, scoped, resourced and costed, whilst allowing appropriate flexibility to address individual client requirements.
* Shares knowledge and lessons learned across the wider SPVG organisation to improve the efficiency, consistency and quality of future proposals.

Overall Role Contribution:
  
  
The Pre-Award Team Member provides an important connection between
**client requirements, SPVG operational expertise and the commercial proposal process**
, helping to ensure alignment throughout the opportunity lifecycle:
  
  
**Client Requirements → Solution → Scope → Resourcing → Budget → Proposal → Agreement → Operational Handover**
The role helps ensure that proposed SPVG solutions are
**client-focused, commercially appropriate and operationally deliverable**
, while supporting a smooth transition from opportunity development into project delivery.
  
  
**Get to know Syneos Health**
Over the past 5 years, we have worked with 94% of all Novel FDA Approved Drugs, 95% of EMA Authorized Products and over 200 Studies across 73,000 Sites and 675,000+ Trial patients.
  
  
No matter what your role is, you’ll take the initiative and challenge the status quo with us in a highly competitive and ever-changing environment. Learn more about Syneos Health.
  
  
http://www.syneoshealth.com

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**

**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.

We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement

* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

Manager - IT Business Analysis - AI

As part of your daily activities, you will collaborate with the Product Owner and teams to manage tactical aspects of iteration planning such as the squads’ backlog, backlog grooming, user story refinement, user story estimation, facilitating Sprint Reviews, and participating in Agile Ceremonies. **What you need to have:**

* Highly motivated candidate who is an inquisitive rapid learner that is comfortable working as part of a remote team.
* Possess strong communication skills with the capability of working collaboratively within the organization, regardless of boundaries.
* An effective communicator for both technical and business-oriented audience.
* Demonstrated requirements gathering skills showcasing the capture of customer needs and business drivers using a variety of techniques into product backlog items such as Epics and User Stories.
* Proven quantitative, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Skilled in providing process improvement and integration opportunities with other process automation tools.
* Self-motivated and ability to learn through research and self-training.
* Ability to remove impediments for squads by providing timely responses and solutions as required.
* Ability to find resolutions regarding own work methods requiring minimal direction.

title: Technical Specialist - Process Quality
description:
**Job Description**
**Daily Responsibilities**

* Perform and support failure analysis; ensure accurate documentation in IDM and update rejection data.
* Verify OES EEPROM and ensure compliance with defined specifications. Participate in Red Bin meetings, analyze red bin data, and drive corrective actions.

* Update and maintain Development Records & Quality Matrix. Prepare, review, and update Safe Launch Work Instructions (WI).
* Monitor and report Hold & Blocked Parts status. Prepare and validate Production Restart Documentation after quality issues or stoppages.

**Monthly Responsibilities**

* Drive and participate in Kaizen activities (minimum two per month). Conduct Layout Inspections and manage PPAP samples, including physical scrapping as required.
* Maintain and control NOK Master Samples. Prepare and submit SMIR reports.
* Conduct KPI discussions with QA Inspectors and shop floor teams.
* Review OPL status and training records. Support IFM / Safe Launch preparation and execution. Maintain Skill Matrix and training records for quality personnel.
* Manage Reflash Master Sample approval and physical scrap of obsolete samples.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree / Diploma in Mechanical, Manufacturing, Industrial Engineering, or related field.
* 2–5 years of experience in Quality Engineering / Manufacturing Quality (experience may vary based on role level).

**Additional Information**
**Technical Skills**

* Strong understanding of engineering drawings, GD&T, and tolerances.
* Knowledge of inspection sampling methods, control plans, and quality standards.

**Quality Systems & Tools**

* Knowledge of QMS (ISO / IATF preferred). Experience in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive actions. Understanding of PPAP, Safe Launch, and customer-specific requirements.

**Communication & Computer Skills**

* Strong verbal and written communication skills. Ability to prepare reports, dashboards, and presentations. Proficient in MS Office (Excel, Word, Outlook) and digital quality systems.

We're particularly interested in candidates who have worked with B2B SaaS products in one or more of these categories:

* CRM and sales automation
* Customer support and helpdesk software
* WhatsApp Business and customer engagement solutions
* Customer success and customer experience platforms
* Lead generation, sales intelligence, and outbound sales

**Experience with companies such as**
Zoho CRM, Zoho Desk, Freshdesk, Kapture, Kylas, SalesMax, NeoDove, or similar SaaS businesses would be a strong advantage.

We're also open to hardcore lead-generation professionals who can independently identify prospects, build targeted databases, execute outbound campaigns, and consistently generate qualified demos—even if they haven't worked in the CRM or customer support software industry.

What Matters Most

* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Hands-on experience with cold calling, email outreach, and LinkedIn prospecting.
* Ability to independently build and manage a B2B prospect pipeline.
* Familiarity with tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, email sequencing platforms, and CRM systems.
* A target-oriented mindset with a strong sense of ownership and follow-through.
* Comfort working in an early-stage startup where initiative, experimentation, and execution matter.
* Ability to understand customer pain points, communicate product value, and qualify genuine buying intent.

What Success Looks Like

Your success will be measured by meaningful sales outcomes, including:

* Qualified prospects added to the pipeline.
* Outreach activity and engagement rates.
* Qualified product demos booked and completed.
* Sales-qualified opportunities generated.
* Follow-up discipline and pipeline conversion.
* Contribution to new customer acquisition and revenue.

We value quality and conversion—not just the number of calls made or messages sent.

Why Join DexKor?

* Work directly with the founder and contribute to building the company's sales engine.
* Take ownership of the complete outbound prospecting and demo-generation process.
* Gain hands-on experience selling AI-powered B2B SaaS solutions.
* Help shape our go-to-market strategy, messaging, and sales playbooks.
* Grow with an early-stage startup where strong performance creates opportunities for greater responsibility.

Compensation & Incentives

**Annual CTC:**
₹2.4 -
₹3
LPA fixed, with additional performance-based incentives.

**Monthly Demo Incentives:**

* 20–24 qualified demos per month: ₹200 per demo.
* 25 or more qualified demos per month: ₹250 per demo.
* Minimum 20 qualified demos per month required to qualify for incentives.

**Performance Review:**
Compensation and incentive slabs will be reviewed after 6 months based on performance, pipeline generation, and contribution to sales.

**Work Location:**
Gurugram, Haryana, or Remote for the right candidate.

Interested?

If you enjoy prospecting, opening doors, starting conversations with decision-makers, and turning cold leads into real business opportunities, we'd love to hear from you.

Apply through LinkedIn or share your resume along with a brief note about your experience in outbound sales, lead generation, and demo booking.

**Let's build the next generation of customer operations together.**

🌐 Website: https://dexkor.com

💼 LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/dexkor

title: Sales Executive, F&B and Hospitality AV
description:
Every great restaurant, bar, and club is remembered for how it sounds. We design and install the audio-visual systems behind those rooms, and we need someone who can sell them.

You will own key accounts in the F&B and hospitality space: pubs, bars, lounges, restaurants, and event venues. You will build relationships, spot opportunities, pitch solutions, and close deals. This is a target-driven role with real ownership, and the freedom to build your own network and markets.

**What you will do**

* Win and manage key accounts across F&B and hospitality
* Build relationships with venue owners, operators, event organisers, DJs, and music communities
* Source leads through events, freelancers, venue networks, and your own contacts
* Pitch AV and sound solutions in person at venues and demos
* Own the full sales cycle: lead, meeting, proposal, close, repeat business
* Track your pipeline and report weekly meetings, accounts, and revenue
* Expand into new markets (we are actively building in Mumbai and Punjab)

**Who we are looking for**

* You are outgoing, talkative, and comfortable walking into a room full of strangers
* You are ambitious and want a big target, not a safe one
* You love selling: the chase, the conversation, the close
* You care about sound. You notice when a room sounds wrong, and you have opinions about speakers
* You already have a network in F&B, events, or music, or you know how to build one fast
* Age and background are open. Experience in F&B sales, events, hospitality, or music is a plus, but attitude comes first

**Good to have**

* Experience in hospitality, event, or brand sales
* Connections with venues, DJs, event companies, or freelancers
* Knowledge of audio, DJ gear, live sound, or music production
* Willingness to travel across target markets

**What you get**

* Compensation plus incentives linked to revenue
* Direct access to leadership and a say in how we sell
* A fast growth path for people who hit their numbers
* A product you can actually hear

description:
**Company Description**
Shipflux is an AI-driven logistics aggregator that helps e-commerce businesses optimize and automate their shipping operations. As a SaaS-based platform, it supports online retailers of all sizes in streamlining logistics, reducing costs, and scaling efficiently. The company focuses on intelligent, tech-enabled solutions that make complex logistics more accessible and manageable. Guided by its mission to drive efficiency, affordability, and growth, Shipflux delivers smart technology for effortless logistics. Shipflux offers a dynamic environment for professionals interested in the intersection of technology, e-commerce, and logistics innovation.

The Sales Associate is a full-time, hybrid role based in Gurugram, with flexibility for partial work from home. This role involves identifying and qualifying leads, conducting product demonstrations, and guiding prospects through the sales cycle for Shipflux’s SaaS logistics solutions. * Candidates should possess relationship-building and customer-facing skills, such as client communication, presentation, and negotiation.
* Candidates should possess analytical and problem-solving skills to understand client needs, interpret data, and propose suitable solutions.
* Candidates should possess familiarity with SaaS, e-commerce, or logistics domains, and the ability to quickly learn product features and industry trends.
* Candidates should possess proficiency with CRM tools, productivity software, and basic reporting to track activities and performance.
* Relevant experience in inside sales, account management, or customer success is beneficial.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, along with strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to work in a hybrid environment from Gurugram, manage time effectively, and collaborate with cross-functional teams is essential.

Help students make better-informed education decisions and find opportunities that fit their goals.

* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.

* Candidates who are confident speaking with people and comfortable working towards targets.
* People who are competitive, coachable, consistent and hungry to earn.
* Immediate joiners based in or willing to work from Gurgaon.

**No fancy degree or big-company background required. Your attitude, communication and performance matter.**

One Last Thing

If you want a comfortable job where nobody expects much from you, this might not be your place.

But if you're ambitious, love competition, want to earn based on performance and have the courage to prove yourself,
**MatchToCollege wants to meet you.**

You bring the energy. We'll give you the opportunity to perform, learn and grow.

*Your next big opportunity could start with one call.*

Company: RK Realtor Company Pvt. Ltd.

Location: Gurgaon

Specialization: Residential Resale & Builder Floors

Experience: Minimum 2–3 Years

Salary: ₹30,000–₹35,000/month + Sales Incentives

Employment Type: Full-Time

**Company Description**
RK Realtors is a boutique real estate agency in Gurugram, specializing in luxury residential and commercial properties. The company focuses on delivering personalized, high-touch service to clients seeking premium homes and investments in a fast-growing market. RK Realtors is known for its deep local expertise, strong negotiation capabilities, and commitment to client satisfaction. Whether clients are buying, selling, or investing, the team aims to provide a seamless experience and help them secure the right property for their goals.

**Role Description**
The Real Estate Sales Executive will work on-site in Gurugram in a full-time capacity, managing end-to-end sales activities for luxury properties. Day-to-day responsibilities include prospecting and nurturing leads, conducting property showings, preparing and presenting proposals, and guiding clients through the negotiation and closing process. The role involves maintaining up-to-date knowledge of local market trends, coordinating with property owners and developers, and ensuring accurate documentation and compliance with real estate regulations. The Real Estate Sales Executive will also provide ongoing client support, build long-term relationships, and contribute to sales targets and revenue growth for RK Realtors.

**Qualifications**

* Possession of a valid Real Estate License and strong foundational knowledge of Real Property regulations and practices.
* Demonstrated experience in Real Estate sales with a track record of achieving or exceeding sales targets.
* Excellent Sales and Customer Service skills, with the ability to build trust, handle objections, and close deals.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in presenting properties and explaining contract terms clearly.
* Ability to work on-site in Gurugram, manage multiple clients and listings, and maintain organized records of interactions and transactions.
* Comfort using CRM tools, digital marketing platforms, and basic office software to manage leads and property information.
* Prior experience in luxury real estate or high-value client segments is an advantage.
* Relevant education in business, marketing, real estate, or a related field is preferred.

Key Responsibilities

- Handle residential resale leads and clients independently.

- Make daily sales calls and maintain regular follow-ups.

- Schedule and conduct property visits independently.

- Source builder floor and residential resale inventory.

- Maintain daily lead updates and sales activity reports.

- Work with and further develop the company's existing broker network.

Candidate Requirements

- Minimum 2–3 years of Gurgaon real estate sales experience.

- Strong knowledge of DLF Phase 1–5, Sushant Lok 1 and Golf Course Road.

- Experience in builder floors and residential resale transactions.

- Self-driven, responsible and capable of managing clients independently.

- Own two-wheeler mandatory for field visits.

- Strong communication, negotiation and client-handling skills.

Joining: Immediate joiners preferred.
