title: Business Development Intern
description:
**We’re hiring: Business Development Intern**

Great with people? Curious about the business behind building brands?

At Izart Studio, we work across brand strategy, visual identity, packaging, website design and development, and content. We help businesses define what they stand for and bring that thinking to life through design and communication.

We’re looking for a confident, articulate, and personable intern to be the first point of contact for potential clients and help turn incoming enquiries into meaningful conversations.

**About the role**

When a lead comes in, you’ll call them promptly, understand what they’re looking for, qualify their requirements using our checklist, and schedule a discovery meeting with our team.

You’ll take ownership of that first interaction and the follow-ups that help a prospect move from expressing interest to attending a meeting.

**What you’ll do**

* Call incoming leads promptly during working hours and introduce them to Izart.
* Understand their business, project requirements, budget, timelines, and decision-making process using our pre-qualification checklist.
* Explain Izart’s services and approach clearly, with guidance from the training we provide.
* Schedule discovery meetings and coordinate calendars between prospects and our team.
* Send meeting confirmations and reminders, follow up with unresponsive leads, and reschedule missed appointments.
* Keep our lead tracker or CRM updated with conversation notes, lead status, and next steps.
* Give the team a clear brief before each meeting so they can take the conversation forward.
* Share recurring questions and feedback to help us improve how we engage with prospective clients.

Your focus will be lead qualification and appointment setting. Our senior team will handle proposals, pricing negotiations, and closing.

**Who we’re looking for**

* Excellent command of English and Hindi, especially in conversation.
* A warm, engaging personality and the confidence to speak with new people.
* Someone who listens carefully, asks thoughtful questions, and can navigate a conversation naturally.
* The ability to build rapport with founders, business owners, and marketing professionals.
* Strong organisation skills and the discipline to follow through on calls, reminders, and commitments.
* Curiosity about branding, design, client acquisition, and the creative agency space.
* A willingness to learn, practise, take feedback, and improve.

**No previous experience required**

We’ll train you on Izart’s services, offerings, SOPs, sales process, and prospect qualification checklist. You don’t need an existing understanding of the creative industry to apply.

Bring strong communication skills, confidence, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**What you’ll learn**

* How a creative agency operates and works with clients.
* How businesses approach branding, packaging, websites, and content.
* How to understand a prospect’s needs and assess whether there’s a fit.
* How client acquisition and agency sales processes work.
* How to manage professional conversations, follow-ups, and meeting coordination.

This role is ideal for someone who wants practical exposure to business development, client servicing, or agency operations.

**What success looks like**

Responding quickly, asking the right questions, keeping clear records, following up consistently, and helping qualified prospects attend well-prepared meetings.

If you enjoy connecting with people and want to learn how creative work becomes a business relationship, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Sales Manager – India
description:
**Job Description**
Do you have a passion for the game of Golf? Would you love to sell to and service the best Golf Coaches, Club Fitters, Indoor Facilities, and Players in one of the fastest-growing golf markets in the world? And are you ambitious, self-driven, and willing to go the extra mile? Then you should join our successful Trackman Golf sales team!
  
  
**Job Description**
The Sales Manager will be responsible for driving business growth in India by developing new business and managing key relationships in the market, working both directly and through Trackman's network of authorized resellers. This role combines channel management, market development, and hands-on customer engagement. Fluency in English and Hindi, along with a passion for golf and technology, is essential for success in this role. The role reports to the Sales Director, Southeast Asia & South Asia.
  
  
**Responsibilities Include**

* Development and continuous improvement of your territory's sales strategies.
* Onboard, enable and manage Trackman's authorized resellers in India — including target setting, joint pipeline reviews, and periodic performance evaluation against agreed criteria.
* Find, plan and deliver product demonstrations to teaching pros, club fitters, ambitious amateurs, and other client segments on a continuous basis.
* Generate leads leveraging all communication channels including cold calling, workshops, and social media activities.
* Demand generation through cooperation with the Indian Golf Union, PGTI, WGAI, the local PGA and other golf organizations.
* Product demonstrations to golf courses, teaching Pros, club fitters, ambitious amateurs, indoor facilities, driving ranges, golf academies, hospitality or real-estate developers building golf amenities and other golf client segments.
* Develop and oversee local installation and after-sales service capability, ensuring resellers meet Trackman's service and response standards.
* Ensure the highest customer satisfaction through ongoing training and service.
* Proposal preparation and order administration.
* Customer training and 1st level support
* Organization and implementation of Trackman University workshops.

**Job Requirements**
**The ideal candidate:**

* Proficiency in English and Hindi is required, including strong written and spoken communication abilities in both languages.
* 5+ years consultative sales experience, preferably including experience selling through or managing distributors, resellers or channel partners.
* Possess a strong network in the local golf industry.
* Experience in developing and applying sales and marketing strategies.
* Commercial literacy in import-driven businesses — landed cost, duty, GST and reseller margin structures.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India, including frequent domestic air travel. Valid driver's license and access to a vehicle.
* Personal drive, self-starter with demonstrated willingness to go the extra mile.
* Build and maintain relationships easily.
* Persuade others by being trustworthy and enthusiastic.
* Demonstrate perseverance and cope well with rejection.
* Demonstrate strong communication and presentation skills.
* Analyze problems and provides well-thought-through solutions.
* Consider other's views and demonstrates listening skills.

The compensation plan consists of a fixed salary, commissions based on performance, and a bonus plan. You will benefit from onboard training and continuous coaching. You will be working out of your home office in the territory and travel 50-75% of the time, with regular domestic travel across India.
  
  
**Join the home of a powerful sports brand and a one-of-a-kind technology**
Our proprietary technology is based on expert knowledge about radar, computer vision, data, and software engineering. Our solutions are developed by specialists who endlessly explore and challenge new technical boundaries. Trackman’s blend of cutting-edge technology, sports, and continued growth make our company an outstanding place to work. Our work culture is entrepreneurial, ambitious, and rewarding as you get to collaborate with inspiring colleagues and interact with the leaders of golf, baseball, and football. Based on a unique brand reputation, we are proud to work in close partnership with the top athletes, organizations, and teams that rely on our technology to stay ahead of the race. We are a Danish company founded, owned, and managed since 2003 by three entrepreneurs with a strong passion for sports. Today, we have a global footprint with our headquarters located in Denmark (Hørsholm) and offices in New York, Phoenix, Seoul, and Tokyo. We employ over 1000+ people worldwide, half of which work in Denmark, where most hardware and software products are developed, tested, and manufactured.
  
  
**Where innovation happens**
At Trackman, we know that great people make great products. We believe that teams thrive, and innovation sparks in an atmosphere where people are encouraged to think for themselves, where everybody’s voices are heard, and where the best ideas prevail in the pursuit of exceptional solutions. This mix makes Trackman an inspiring company – for our customers and colleagues.
  
  
**Share our Passion!**
Applications are continuously assessed, so please send your application as soon as possible.
**If you got what it takes, apply today and join a company with great technologies, passionate colleagues, and great opportunities to grow.**

title: Sales Lead
description:
**About the Role**

GoerOne is launching a premium membership ecosystem in Manipur. The Area Manager owns day-to-day sales execution across all three tiers and turns a small team, institutional partnerships and a variable field force into a repeatable sales engine.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will run daily sales operations, personally close high-value relationships and build the systems that let the team scale without proportional headcount growth. As the business matures, this role can grow into the dedicated Sales Head position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales execution and revenue**

* Own paid-membership targets across multiple tiers, with day 30, 60 and 90 milestones.
* Run the daily sales rhythm: the 10-15 minute morning huddle, lead allocation, route planning and EOD review.
* Manage sales funnel (named prospects, qualified, meeting, formal invitation, paid, activated, first benefit used). Support the Business Head on the top 100 prospects and personally manage the next 300 alongside the existing members Relationship Executive.
* Drive sales through invitation journeys, professional and family segments, and referrals.
* Drive volume sales through channels, events and merchant-led acquisition, with automation where possible.

**2. Channel and field sales**

* Build and manage the institutional pipeline (corporates, PSUs, hospitals, colleges, associations, clubs) and run institutional outreach and targeted group sessions.
* Plan and execute sponsored events, activation days and individual outreach campaigns.
* Recruit, train and manage variable promoters on a commission model. Scale from 10-15 to 20-30 only when the economics work.
* Operationalise merchant-led acquisition with the Merchant Partnerships Lead: counter QRs, staff scripts, member days and incentives paid only after paid and activated conversions.

**3. Team leadership**

* Lead Inside Sales on warm-lead follow-up, conversion and first-use prompts.
* Coach the team on the approved sale pitches and on objection handling, and keep scripts and FAQs current.
* Enforce discipline: routes logged before departure, CRM updated, EOD reports submitted and zero tolerance for fake visits or data.

**4. Pipeline and CRM hygiene**

* Ensure every lead has an owner, a next action and a probability, and keep lead ageing within SLA.
* Maintain source-to-payment-to-activation tracking with Marketing, and keep referral attribution accurate.

**5. Cross-functional collaboration**

* **Marketing and Growth:**
  give feedback on lead quality and campaign performance, and align on events and launches.
* **Merchant team:**
  feed back on merchant demand and offer relevance, and coordinate Member Days and co-branded campaigns.
* **Customer Operations and CX:**
  hand over smoothly for activation and onboarding, and resolve conversion and activation blockers together.
* **Business Head:**
  share the sales view of pricing, offers, objections and market response.

**6. Reporting**

* Weekly: sales vs plan, funnel conversion, channel performance, lead ageing and promoter productivity.
* Monthly: revenue and paid memberships vs target, CAC by channel, team productivity and a hiring and promoter review.
* Quarterly: channel economics and recommendations on scaling or stopping.
* Consolidate team inputs into the single Business Head dashboard.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Performance is judged on business outcomes, not activity.**

**KPI**

**What it measures**

**Paid memberships vs plan**

**Core revenue delivery (by tier)**

**Lead-to-paid conversion**

**Funnel quality and sales effectiveness**

**Sales productivity per person**

**Output per team member and promoter**

**Channel and field performance**

**Returns by institution, event and referral**

**Lead ageing**

**Speed of follow-up**

**Institutional sales**

**Pipeline value and closures**

**Activation and first-use rate**

**Quality of sales, with a target of 85%+ first use within 30 days**

**CAC vs ceiling**

**Cost discipline per channel**

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* 5-8 years in field sales, business development or channel sales, with at least 1-2 years leading a team.
* Proven results selling a high-involvement, relationship-led product. Examples are premium memberships, financial products, hospitality, real estate, education, healthcare services, insurance or luxury and lifestyle offerings.
* Experience with institutional and B2B2C sales (corporates, associations, communities).
* Strong understanding of the Manipur market, networks and decision-makers. Local relationships are a major advantage.
* Comfortable selling to HNI and senior professionals, and equally able to manage volume sales.
* Fluent in English, Hindi and Meiteilon (other regional languages are a plus).
* Graduate degree required. MBA preferred but not mandatory.

**Skills and Attributes**

* Target-driven, with ownership of numbers and a bias for action.
* Disciplined about CRM and reporting, with a habit of reporting exceptions and outcomes, not essays.
* Credible with senior clients and able to coach junior sellers.
* Able to think in funnels, unit economics and CAC, not just top-line sales.
* Integrity: will not hide a weak proposition behind aggressive selling.
* Comfortable in a lean startup where roles are broad and processes are still being built.
* Working knowledge of CRM tools, WhatsApp-based selling and basic dashboards.

**What We Offer**

* Direct access to the Business Head and strategic decisions.
* A founding-team role in a high-growth launch.
* Performance variable linked to paid, activated memberships.
* A clear growth path as the organisation scales

* **How to Apply:**
  Send your resume to hello@goerone.com

description:
**Redrob Kaabil Performance Marketing Manager**

**THE 30-SECOND VERSION**

**We have a product where 94% of users never switch the agent off and a funnel where 75%+ of visitors sign up. Now, we need someone who can scale this profitably while maintaining a strong CAC. Youll own Meta, Google, and YouTube end to end from spend and creative to landing pages, attribution, and app installs with direct**

**ownership of CAC. This isnt a media-buying role. Youll build the strategy, own the budget, and continuously optimize campaigns for growth.**

**First, the part most job posts get wrong**

**Everyone says they are building the future. So here is exactly what we are building, and exactly where you would sit in it.**

**REDROB KAABIL IN ONE PARAGRAPH**

**India has 700 million people who will meet AI for the first time on a phone, not a laptop. Most of them will meet it through an app that helps them earn more. We are building to be that app the AI screen of India and we are on the road to Series B, with the product already live with real users across campuses and cities. We are not a**

**chatbot with a job board bolted on. We build AI that does the work, not AI that talks about it. The two halves you would be marketing, selling and scaling**

**Jobs**

**An AI agent that job-hunts while you sleep. Upload your resume, switch it on, and it reaches out to recruiters daily at scale. 94% of**

**users never switch it off, and around 70% return when a recruiter replies.**

**Skills The proof layer. Real assessments, real scores, real credentials. People voluntarily retake them to beat their own score it is the only objective signal in Indian hiring that says what someone can actually do, rather than where they studied.**

**What's next One app, one login, one profile, and one XP bar. Jobs show your match percentage and the test that can improve it. Complete the test, strengthen your resume, retrigger the agent, and get better matches. That loop is the Redrob Arc.**

**Why this matters for the role you are reading about: you would be joining in the quarter where all of that goes from**

**two products to one, and from a great product to a business. Not the quarter after. This one.**

**The role in one line**

**Own paid acquisition for a two-sided AI product, from the first impression to the first payment, and prove that**

**every rupee comes back.**

title: Manager, Engineering, Enterprise Data Platform
description:
As a Data Engineering Manager within the Enterprise Data Platform team at PitchBook, you will lead a team of skilled data engineers responsible for building and optimizing data pipelines, managing large-scale data models, and ensuring the quality, availability, and performance of enterprise data assets. This leadership role combines technical depth, strategic thinking, and people management to enable PitchBook’s data-driven decision-making and analytics capabilities.

  

You’ll collaborate closely with cross-functional partners across Technology & Engineering, Product, Sales, Marketing, Research, Finance, and Administration to deliver robust, scalable data solutions. The ideal candidate is a hands-on leader with a strong background in modern data platforms, cloud architecture, and team development—someone passionate about empowering teams and improving data capabilities across the organization. A core part of this role is shaping an analytics environment that is built for AI agents as much as for people. Our analysts, executives and AI agents should all query the same governed, documented, well-described data and get the same answers. You will lead the team to make that real, with semantic layers, governed metrics, rich metadata, agent-safe access, and evaluation of agent output, and in using agents to build faster and with higher quality.

  
  

This is both a strategic and hands-on leadership role: you will guide architectural decisions, mentor engineers, collaborate with cross-functional leaders, and contribute to building next-generation data and AI capabilities at PitchBook. You will exhibit a growth mindset, be willing to solicit feedback, engage others with empathy, and help create a culture of belonging, teamwork, and purpose. If you love leading a team of passionate data engineers, building data-centric solutions, strive for excellence every day, are adaptable and focused, and believe work should be fun, come join us!

  

**Primary Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, mentor, retain top talent and develop a team of data engineers, fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement
* Define and drive the data engineering roadmap aligned with enterprise data strategy and business objectives
* Collaborate with senior technology and business leaders to define data platform priorities, architecture, and long-term vision
* Promote a culture of innovation, operational rigor, and customer empathy within the data organization
* Oversee the design, development, and maintenance of high-quality data pipelines and ELT/ETL workflows across enterprise systems and PitchBook’s platform
* Ensure scalable, secure, and reliable data architectures using modern cloud technologies (e.g., Snowflake, Airflow, Kafka, Docker)
* Lead AI learning initiatives and integrate AI/ML-driven solutions into data products to enhance automation, predictive insights, and decision intelligence
* Champion data quality, governance, lineage, and compliance standards across the enterprise data ecosystem
* Partner with engineering and infrastructure teams to optimize data storage, compute performance, and cost efficiency
Support career development through mentoring, skill-building, and performance feedback  

  

**Skills and Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field
* 8+ years of experience in data engineering or related roles, including at least 2–3 years of leadership experience managing technical teams
* Proven experience designing and maintaining large-scale data architectures, pipelines, and data models in cloud environments (e.g., Snowflake, AWS, Azure, or GCP)
* Advanced proficiency in SQL and Python for data manipulation, transformation, and automation
* Deep understanding of ETL/ELT frameworks, data orchestration tools (e.g., Airflow), and distributed messaging systems (e.g., Kafka)
* Strong knowledge of data governance, quality, and compliance frameworks
* Experience working with enterprise data sources (CRM, ERP, Marketing Automation, Financial Systems, etc.) is preferred
* Hands-on experience with AI/ML platforms, model deployment, or data-driven automation is a strong plus
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills with the ability to translate complex data concepts into business value
Demonstrated ability to build high-performing teams and lead through change  

  

**Working Conditions**

The job conditions for this position are in a standard office setting. Employees in this position use PC and phone on an on-going basis throughout the day. Limited corporate travel may be required to remote offices or other business meetings and events.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Marketplace Account Management

* Manage day-to-day business operations and account relationships with Flipkart and Myntra.
* Coordinate with marketplace category managers, account managers, and other relevant stakeholders.
* Develop account-specific business plans to achieve sales and profitability targets.
* Identify opportunities for category expansion, product launches, and business growth.
* Resolve marketplace operational issues, escalations, and account-related concerns.

B. Sales Growth & Business Planning

* Achieve monthly, quarterly, and annual sales and GMV targets.
* Analyze sales trends, product performance, sell-through, and category growth.
* Plan and execute promotional activities, festive campaigns, and major marketplace sales events.
* Identify high-performing and underperforming SKUs and recommend corrective actions.
* Monitor competitor pricing, assortment, discounts, and market positioning.

C. Catalogue & Product Listing Management

* Ensure accurate product listings, titles, descriptions, images, sizes, attributes, and pricing.
* Coordinate new product onboarding and SKU activation.
* Monitor product visibility, search rankings, ratings, reviews, and conversion performance.
* Work with catalogue and creative teams to improve product content and listing quality.
* Ensure timely resolution of listing errors and product suppression issues.

D. Inventory & Order Management

* Monitor inventory availability and coordinate replenishment with warehouse and supply chain teams.
* Maintain optimum stock levels for fast-moving products and key sizes.
* Track order fulfilment, cancellations, returns, and stock-outs.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve inventory and fulfilment issues.
* Support demand forecasting and inventory planning for promotional events.

E. Pricing, Promotions & Profitability

* Plan pricing strategies and marketplace promotions.
* Evaluate discount structures, commissions, advertising expenses, and promotional investments.
* Monitor account profitability and identify opportunities to improve contribution margins.
* Coordinate commercial negotiations and promotional funding with marketplace stakeholders.
* Track pending claims, deductions, payment reconciliations, and recoveries with Finance.

F. Reporting & Analytics

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly marketplace performance reports.
* Monitor GMV, net sales, average selling price, conversion rate, sell-through, and returns.
* Analyse campaign performance and advertising efficiency wherever applicable.
* Develop sales forecasts, performance dashboards, and management MIS.
* Present actionable insights and recommendations to management.

G. Internal Coordination

* Work closely with Marketing, Performance Marketing, Catalogue, Finance, Warehouse, and Supply Chain teams.
* Ensure alignment between sales forecasts, inventory availability, pricing, and promotional plans.
* Track key business deliverables and ensure timely execution.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Graduate in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field.
* 3–7 years of experience in E-Commerce, Key Account Management, or Marketplace Management.
* **Hands-on experience managing Flipkart and Myntra accounts is strongly preferred.**
* Experience in footwear, apparel, fashion, lifestyle, or consumer goods is an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of marketplace operations, sales planning, catalogue management, and commercial negotiations.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, sales analytics, Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and reporting.
* Strong communication, negotiation, analytical, and stakeholder-management skills.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales and GMV target achievement.
* Marketplace revenue growth and profitability.
* SKU onboarding and product assortment expansion.
* Inventory availability and stock-out reduction.
* Sell-through and conversion rate improvement.
* Promotional campaign performance and return on advertising spend, where applicable.
* Reduction in cancellations, returns, and operational issues.
* Timely settlement reconciliation and claim recovery.
* Accuracy and timeliness of marketplace reporting.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be commercially driven, analytical, proactive, and comfortable managing marketplace business independently. Candidates with direct experience handling **both Flipkart and Myntra for a footwear, fashion, or apparel brand** will receive preference.

**Key Skills:** Flipkart Seller Hub, Myntra Marketplace Management, Key Account Management, E-Commerce Sales, GMV Growth, Catalogue Management, Pricing Strategy, Inventory Planning, Promotional Campaigns, Commercial Negotiation, MS Excel, Sales Analytics.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Cell phone reimbursement
* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

title: Strategic Initiatives Associate
description:
Strategic Initiatives Associate

SVECTOR | Ahmedabad, Gujarat (On-site) | Full-time | Monday to Saturday

Experience: 0–4 years. Exceptional fresh graduates are encouraged to apply.

Reports to: Founder-CEO

About SVECTOR

SVECTOR is a technology company building intelligence infrastructure for enterprises and institutions. We develop software systems that help organizations understand complex information, improve decision-making and execute critical business processes. Our initiatives span enterprise intelligence, talent and leadership decision systems, healthcare, industrial technology, financial intelligence and defensive intelligence.

We work on problems where technology must do more than generate information. It must help people understand what is happening, decide what to do and turn decisions into measurable outcomes.

About the Role

We are hiring a Strategic Initiatives Associate to work closely with company leadership on selected product, technology and business initiatives. This is an early-career role for someone curious, capable and dependable who wants to understand how a technology business runs while taking direct responsibility for meaningful work.

You will take assigned objectives, work out a practical approach, bring the right people together and carry the work through to a verified result. You will work across engineering, product and business teams on things like investigating a product issue, understanding a customer requirement, preparing a business analysis, coordinating a pilot or moving an initiative from planning into execution.

This is not a role defined by attending meetings, preparing presentations or passing instructions between departments. The goal is to contribute directly to work that produces results. Experience in an identical role is not required.

What You Will Do

Project execution

• Understand the objective, constraints and importance of each assigned initiative.

• Break objectives into activities, deliverables, owners and milestones.

• Coordinate with engineering, product and business stakeholders.

• Spot delays, dependencies and gaps early, and resolve blockers within your authority.

• Follow up on commitments and keep progress, pending actions and open issues visible.

• Check completed work against its original requirements.

• Prepare short progress summaries and flag decisions that need leadership attention.

You are expected to understand the work you coordinate. Collecting updates or maintaining a tracker without understanding the problem is not enough.

Product and technical-business work

• Use SVECTOR's software products to understand their real capabilities and limits.

• Understand customer workflows and the problems customers expect the product to solve.

• Investigate reported issues and tell defects apart from unclear requirements and new feature requests.

• Turn business and customer needs into clear problem statements, requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria.

• Work with engineers to understand constraints, dependencies and possible approaches.

• Support demos, testing, customer pilots and implementation, and confirm delivered work meets the requirement.

You are not being hired as a full-time software developer, but strong technical literacy matters. You should be comfortable with concepts such as APIs, databases, integrations and data flows, and willing to learn what you do not yet know.

Research and analysis

• Research companies, industries, technologies and business opportunities.

• Compare competitors, products, technical approaches and tools.

• Study enterprise customers and the environments they operate in.

• Review reports, specifications and original source material.

• Prepare decision briefs and recommendations that state what is known, what the evidence is, what remains uncertain and what to do next.

We expect you to go beyond the first search result, verify important claims, check numbers and explain your reasoning. We value independent thinking over long documents full of generic observations.

Business and customer initiatives

• Research prospective customers and decision-makers, and prepare background for key discussions.

• Support demos, discovery calls and technical-business presentations.

• Turn customer feedback into specific product or business actions.

• Help with proposals and solution briefs, and coordinate pilot follow-ups.

• Join customer meetings and speak with external stakeholders when authorized.

There is no individual sales quota. Pricing, contracts and financial commitments stay subject to leadership approval.

Leadership support and AI tools

• Prepare briefing notes and short memos for important discussions.

• Record decisions, commitments and open questions, and keep actions tied to owners.

• Use AI tools and modern software for research, document analysis and repetitive workflows, and check their output against reliable sources.

Using AI does not remove your responsibility to understand your own work. An unverified AI-generated document that you cannot explain is not an acceptable deliverable. You will also follow company rules on confidential information and data handling.

Who You Are

• Curious: you want to understand a hard problem, not avoid it.

• Accountable: a task is done when there is an outcome, not when you have sent a message. You are honest about obstacles and mistakes.

• Structured: you break problems down, test assumptions and reach reasoned conclusions, even under uncertainty.

• Clear communicator: excellent written and spoken English, with precise emails, briefs and summaries.

• Technically curious: you enjoy learning how software is built and used. Coding experience helps but is not required.

• Reliable: you respect deadlines and confidentiality, know when you need approval, and accept feedback well.

Qualifications

• 0–4 years of relevant experience. Internships, independent projects, research, entrepreneurship or full-time work all count.

• A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, IT, AI, Data Science, Business Analytics, Economics, Management or a related field is preferred. Other backgrounds are considered where projects show the capability. No MBA required.

• Experience in product operations, business analysis, technical consulting, software development, strategic research or project execution is relevant.

We care about work you have actually completed: a product or technical project, an internship where you solved a real problem, a research assignment with a defensible conclusion, or an initiative where you took responsibility beyond your assigned work. Tell us your own contribution, the decisions you made and the results.

This role is not an administrative or personal-assistant job, a software engineering job focused on production code, a pure consulting role or a senior management position. It is an execution-oriented role centered on product understanding, research, problem-solving and completing assigned initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

• First 30 days: learn the products, workflows and priorities, and complete initial research and product assignments accurately.

• Days 31–60: own a defined initiative, prepare an execution approach and keep progress visible.

• Days 61–90: carry an initiative to an agreed result or a documented handover.

Hiring Process

1. Application review

2. Initial discussion

3. Practical assessment: a realistic research, product or business task. AI tools may be used where permitted, but you must be able to explain and verify your work.

4. Leadership interview

5. Offer discussion: responsibilities, compensation, schedule and joining date are confirmed before a written offer.

Working Arrangements

Full-time, on-site in Ahmedabad, Monday to Saturday. Schedule, compensation and joining terms are confirmed before a formal offer. If anything about the role or location does not match your expectations, please raise it in the first discussion.

How to Apply

Send your resume with a short note covering:

1. Your strongest example of ownership: what you did, which decisions you made and what happened.

2. Why you are interested in technology, research, product understanding and business execution.

3. Your current location, availability to work full-time on-site in Ahmedabad and earliest joining date.

Links to projects, GitHub, portfolios or research are welcome. Please skip the generic statements.

The ideal candidate is a consultative closer who excels in a fast-paced SaaS environment, possesses deep empathy for buyer pain points, and understands how to navigate the full sales lifecycle smoothly. Superlaw builds AI solutions for legal and governance workflows, with an initial focus on the insurance sector. Our products include an AI assistant, drafting engine, and an intelligence layer that integrates into customers’ existing systems.

Our market consists of a focused set of enterprise accounts, with opportunities across multiple departments, insurance verticals, and workflows. Success requires thoughtful prospecting, strong customer relationships, and consistent follow-through.

**What you’ll do**

**Build a qualified enterprise pipeline**

* Research target accounts and map relevant decision-makers, influencers, business units, and use cases.
* Generate opportunities through cold calling, email, LinkedIn outreach, referrals, and industry networks.
* Conduct initial discovery conversations to understand customer challenges and assess product fit.
* Qualify opportunities using Budget, Authority, Need, and Timeline (BANT), and prepare clear briefs for founder-led discussions.

**Develop opportunities and customer relationships**

* Participate in discovery calls, product demonstrations, and customer meetings alongside the founders.
* Coordinate proposals, proof-of-concept discussions, follow-ups, and agreed next steps.
* Build relationships across departments and identify opportunities for account expansion, upselling, and cross-selling.
* Maintain customer contact, coordinate queries with internal teams, and support renewal conversations.

**Help establish the sales function**

* Maintain accurate CRM records, account plans, and pipeline updates.
* Help develop repeatable outreach messages, sales materials, and follow-up processes.
* Share customer feedback and market insights with the founders and product team.

The founder will initially lead final commercial negotiations and deal closure. The CTO and technical team will lead technical discovery, integrations, and implementation.

**What we’re looking for**

* **3–6 years of experience**
  in B2B business development, enterprise software sales, or SaaS sales.
* Demonstrated ability to generate outbound opportunities and conduct effective discovery conversations.
* Experience engaging senior stakeholders and navigating accounts with multiple decision-makers.
* Evidence of developing customer relationships beyond booking the first meeting.
* Strong written and spoken communication, with the ability to explain a technical product’s business value.
* Familiarity with CRM systems and prospecting tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, or equivalent platforms.
* Strong organisation, disciplined follow-through, and comfort working independently in an early-stage startup.

**Experience that would be particularly valuable**

* Selling into insurance, banking, financial services, or legal teams.
* Working with legal, litigation, compliance, governance, finance, or technology stakeholders.
* Selling AI products or enterprise solutions involving integrations.
* Supporting account expansion or renewals, or working directly with founders.

**You don’t need to meet every preferred qualification. We value relevant results, curiosity, sound judgment, and ownership.**

**Why join Superlaw?**

* Work directly with the founder as our first dedicated business development hire.
* Help shape our enterprise sales process from the beginning.
* Gain exposure to discovery, demonstrations, commercial discussions, and account growth.
* Build expertise in AI solutions for legal and governance workflows.
* Grow toward independent deal ownership and, as the business scales, future team leadership.

**How to apply**

Apply through LinkedIn with your resume. Include a brief note describing the customers you’ve sold to, one opportunity you generated or account you helped grow, and why you want to help build Superlaw.

title: Medical Representative, Healthcare Software Sales (Bangalore)
description:
About MyDoctor

MyDoctor is a Doctor-led healthcare technology company in India and the United States. We make clinic and hospital management software, and we also run our own clinical, billing and tax services for the clinics and hospitals that use it. Our team sets the software up for every client, so doctors get a system that works from the first day.

The role

We are hiring a Medical Representative in Bangalore to bring MyDoctor to clinics and small hospitals. You will meet doctors and clinic managers, show them the software in a short walkthrough and help them get started. This is one of our first sales roles, and you will work closely with the company's senior management in India and founder & Group CEO's office in Austin, Texas.

What you will do

* Meet doctors and clinic managers at their clinics. Most meetings are booked for you by our calling team and by email.
* Give 10-minute walkthroughs on the real software.
* Follow up after every visit and close the sale together with our founder.
* Keep your visits and follow-ups up to date in the MyDoctor app.
* Report your numbers every week: visits, walkthroughs, follow-ups and paying clients.
* Tell us what doctors ask for, so we keep making the product better.

What you need

* 1 to 5 years of selling to doctors: as a medical representative, or in pharma, healthcare or software sales.
* Fluent English, and Kannada or Hindi.
* Your own two-wheeler or any vehicle and a valid driving licence.
* Comfort using a phone app every day.
* A friendly, honest way of talking with doctors and their staff.

What we offer

* Fixed monthly pay plus commission on every paying client. We share the pay details at the interview.
* Training on the software, on how clinics work and on how we sell.
* Meetings booked for you, so your day is spent with doctors, not on cold calls.
* The chance to grow into our founding sales team as MyDoctor opens new cities in India and the United States.

Location and travel

This is a field role in Bangalore. On most working days you visit clinics in your part of the city on your own two-wheeler or any vehicle to travel to client locations for sales. Team reviews are by video.

How we hire

* Apply in 5 minutes on our company page via this ad: your details, your CV and a few short questions. No cover letter needed.
* We review every application within a few working days and reply to everyone.
* If your profile fits, a 30-minute video interview at a time that suits you.
* A short field role-play: you give us a 10-minute walkthrough as if we were a doctor.
* Offer: if it is a fit, we send you an offer letter to sign online.

Equal opportunity

MyDoctor is an equal opportunity employer. We consider every applicant on skills and experience only, without regard to gender, religion, caste, age, disability, marital status or where you come from.

No fee is ever charged

MyDoctor never charges applicants a fee, at any stage. If anyone asks you for money for a MyDoctor job, do not pay, and write to support@mydoctor.social

Your data

* We use your details only to consider you for roles at MyDoctor. We keep them private and delete them when you ask. We never ask for ID numbers such as Aadhaar or PAN when you apply.

Gauntlet Security is an AI-powered cybersecurity platform developed by Deep Armor, designed to help organizations strengthen their security posture across cloud infrastructure, applications, software supply chains, and AI environments. The platform provides unified visibility into security risks, identifies vulnerabilities and cloud misconfigurations, supports compliance monitoring, and helps organizations prioritize and remediate threats efficiently.

With capabilities spanning Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), AI Security Posture Management (AISPM), Software Bill of Materials (SBOM) security, and secret scanning, Gauntlet enables businesses to improve security visibility, streamline compliance processes, and reduce security risks across their cloud environments. By leveraging automation and generative AI, the platform helps organizations adopt a proactive approach to cybersecurity while supporting secure and scalable business growth.

**Role Description**
This full-time, on-site Sales Business Development role is based in Bengaluru. The Sales Business Development professional will identify and qualify new business opportunities, generate leads, and build a strong sales pipeline for Gauntlet Security. Responsibilities include conducting market research, understanding client needs, presenting tailored service offerings, and managing the end-to-end sales cycle from initial contact to contract closure. The role involves maintaining relationships with existing and prospective clients, collaborating with security consultants to develop proposals, and representing Deep Armor at meetings, events, and industry forums. The individual will also track sales metrics, prepare reports, and contribute to the refinement of go-to-market strategies.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and Market Research capabilities to identify opportunities and understand customer segments.
* Candidates should possess excellent Communication and Customer Service skills to present solutions clearly and build long-term client relationships.
* Candidates should possess effective Lead Generation skills and demonstrated ability to develop and manage a sales pipeline.
* Proven experience in B2B sales or business development, preferably in cybersecurity, technology consulting, or related fields.
* Ability to collaborate with technical teams and translate complex security services into business value for clients.
* Comfort with on-site client meetings in Bengaluru and willingness to travel locally as needed.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Engineering, or a related field; relevant certifications in sales or cybersecurity are an advantage.
* Strong self-management, goal orientation, and familiarity with CRM tools or sales tracking systems.

:

● High Agency: A self-starter mindset that takes ownership and finds creative ways to solve problems and drive leads forward.

● Educational Background: B.B.A/B.COM/M.B.A

**Why Ambitio?**

● Fast-Track Growth: Join a high-growth startup where your impact is immediate.

● Intellectual Environment: Work in a culture that values logic, data, and"student-first" ethics over aggressive sales tactics.

● Competitive Rewards: Good base salary with uncapped incentives tied to your performance.

Square Yard is a real estate company with its origins in Easley, South Carolina, United States, and expanding its presence in key growth markets. The organization focuses on residential and commercial property solutions, aiming to simplify the buying, selling, and investing experience for clients. Square Yard emphasizes strong local market expertise, transparent transactions, and long-term customer relationships. Team members collaborate closely across locations to deliver high-quality service and tailored real estate solutions for diverse customer needs.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales Relationship Manager role is a full-time, on-site position based in Bengaluru. This role is responsible for building and managing strong relationships with prospective and existing clients, understanding their real estate requirements, and recommending suitable property solutions. Daily activities include meeting clients, conducting property presentations and site visits, negotiating commercial terms, and supporting the closing of sales transactions. The Sales Relationship Manager will coordinate with internal teams to ensure accurate documentation, timely follow-up, and a smooth customer experience. The role also involves tracking sales performance, reporting key metrics, and contributing to local business development initiatives.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Business Relationship Management and Communication skills to engage clients, understand their needs, and maintain long-term partnerships.
* Candidates should possess solid Sales and Sales Management skills to drive lead conversion, manage pipelines, and meet or exceed revenue targets.
* Candidates should possess foundational Finance skills to interpret pricing, assess investment value, and explain financial aspects of property transactions.
* Relevant experience in real estate sales, channel sales, or customer-facing roles in related industries is beneficial.
* Ability to work on-site in Bengaluru, maintain professional conduct during client interactions, and adapt to a fast-paced sales environment.
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with proficiency in English; knowledge of local languages is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Commerce, Marketing, or a related field is preferred, along with basic proficiency in CRM tools and office productivity software.

title: Founding Sales
description:
This is an internal role at Weekday. Not a role by a client.
  
  
  

* Role type: Full time
* Location: Remote
* Working days: Monday–Saturday
* Working with: The founders and the AE team

Weekday is an AI-native recruiting platform. We are backed by Y Combinator and Venture Highway (now General Catalyst). We have built the largest white-collar talent database in India and have built tools to run outbound recruiting campaigns to them.
  
  
**About The Role**
You will own outbound sales to Indian startups. Not support it. Own it. You find the companies, you get in the door, you run the demo, you close, and you hand over a customer who knows exactly what they bought.
  
  
We have an AE team of three today. It works, and it closes. Now we need to scale it, and you will be a critical part of that. That means two things: you carry your own number from week one, and you help figure out what the team looks like at ten. What's repeatable, what isn't, what to write down, what to throw out. The people we hire after you will run on what you help build.
  
  
We sell to founders and heads of talent at startups that are hiring. They are busy, sceptical, and have been burned by recruiting agencies before. Your job is to show them, in one call, why a talent database of this size plus outbound campaigns gets them hires faster than anything else they've tried.
  
  
If you want a clean job description with neat boundaries, this isn't for you. If you want to be one of the people who scaled the sales engine at a profitable, venture-backed company, read on.
  
  
What you'll actually do
  
  
On any given day you might be:
  
  
  

* Building your own target list of Indian startups that are hiring, and figuring out who the real decision-maker is
* Running cold outbound across email, LinkedIn, and phone, and iterating on what actually gets a reply
* Running demos that are built around the prospect's open roles, not a generic walkthrough of the product
* Closing subscription deals and handling pricing, procurement, and the "let me think about it" that never comes back on its own
* Handing closed accounts over to the delivery team cleanly, so the first month goes well and the renewal takes care of itself
* Keeping the pipeline honest in the CRM, and reporting the numbers to the founders every week, including the ugly ones
* Sitting with the other AEs to work out what's working across the team, and turning it into process the next hires can run on

You'll be measured on closed revenue and pipeline built. Not on activity, not on slides.
  
  
What we're looking for
  
  
  

* You've sold B2B before, ideally to startups, ideally something a founder had to say yes to. You know what a real pipeline looks like
* You're comfortable with cold outbound. Not tolerant of it. Comfortable. You'd rather send fifty good emails than wait for a lead
* You can run a demo that feels like a conversation and ends with a next step
* You close. You ask for the deal, you handle the objection, and you don't confuse a friendly call with a sale
* You take ownership. When a number is yours, it moves, and nobody has to follow up with you
* You've seen a sales team grow, or you want to be the person who makes it grow. You think about the system, not just your own quota
* You understand the Indian startup ecosystem, who's hiring, who's raising, and who's about to need ten engineers in a hurry
* You're comfortable with ambiguity and a Monday–Saturday pace

What you get
  
  
  

* An early seat on a sales team that's about to scale, at a profitable, venture-backed company
* Direct access to the founders and a say in pricing, positioning, and what we build next
* A product with real pull: the largest white-collar talent database in India and outbound tooling that companies actually get hires from
* A clear path to leading a team as the function grows, if you earn it
* A front-row seat to how a startup gets built and run, and the track record to show for it when you build your own

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Inside Sales - Corporate Training
description:
**About Scyverge**

Scyverge is an enterprise-focused cybersecurity partner helping organisations strengthen their security posture and build resilience against evolving cyber threats. We also support organisations in developing cybersecurity awareness, technical capabilities, and workforce readiness through corporate training initiatives.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a proactive and target-oriented Inside

The role involves identifying organisations that require employee training, cybersecurity awareness programmes, technical upskilling, and professional development. You will engage with HR leaders, Learning and Development (L&D) managers, training heads, and technical decision-makers to understand their requirements and generate corporate training opportunities.

The ideal candidate has experience in B2B sales, lead generation, or training sales and is confident in building relationships with corporate clients.

* Promote Scyverge's corporate training programmes to prospective organisations.
* Qualify leads based on training needs, audience size, budget, timelines, and decision-making processes.
* Schedule meetings and training discussions with prospective clients.
* Follow up on enquiries, proposals, and ongoing opportunities to convert prospects into customers.

* **CTC of ₹3 LPA plus performance-based incentives**
  .
* Exposure to corporate sales and enterprise client engagement.
* Opportunity to develop expertise in corporate training and professional learning solutions.

title: Account Executive - New Logo Sales, NAMER (ESB)
description:
**About Rippling**
Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.8B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Account Executive (New Logo Acquisition, Emerging Businesses segment - US) role at Rippling provides an extremely unique opportunity -- we’re looking for talented and ambitious individuals who can both
****manage a high velocity sales cycle****
while also navigating a very strategic sales process.
  
  
One fundamental belief at Rippling is that Account Executives should spend 100% of their time between engaging with interested prospects, managing sales cycles to help potential customers evaluate our product, closing revenue from SDR generated demos, and working with our CSM/Implementation team to ensure a seamless transition to our platform for new customers. No prospecting, we leave that to our world class SDR and Marketing teams.
  
  
Initially starting from North America (NAMER), you will be focused on our expansion into the worldwide markets and will be required to be fluent in English.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Maintain a pipeline of high value prospects through salesforce to forecast revenue accurately
* Own the sales cycle from initial discovery and demo, to contract signature
* Consistently attain and overachieve quota on a monthly basis. ESB team is bunch of overachievers and we consistently hit/overachieve our quotas
* Become a product expert across our entire platform and understand our competitive landscape. Rippling has multiple products, and your success is dependent on how well you learn the product
* Work closely with CSM/Implementation Team to ensure a smooth transition for new customers

**What You Will Need**

* Ability to thrive in a fast paced environment. AEs at Rippling close a large volume of deals every month and we require someone who is comfortable with volume and pace
* 3+ years sales experience, preferably in SaaS markets selling B2B. Bachelor's Degree is a must-have.
* Experience carrying a $720,000+ annual quota
* Comfortable with monthly quota
* Experience of success (top 10% of sales org)
* Experience selling HRIS/HCM software and/or selling security related products is a good to have

****Please note:****

* This job requires you to work EST/EDT hours. (5:30pm to 2:30am IST)
* This is a hybrid role and will require you to work out our Bangalore office three days a week.

Additional Information
  
  
Rippling is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive workforce and do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, ancestry, physical disability, mental disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital status, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, age, sexual orientation, veteran or military status, or any other legally protected characteristics, Rippling is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for candidates with disabilities who need assistance during the hiring process. To request a reasonable accommodation, please email accomodations@rippling.com.
  
  
Rippling highly values having employees working in-office to foster a collaborative work environment and company culture. For office-based employees (employees who live within a defined radius of a Rippling office), Rippling considers working in the office, at least three days a week under current policy, to be an essential function of the employee's role.
  
  
A variety of factors are considered when determining someone’s compensation–including a candidate’s professional background, experience, and location. Final offer amounts may vary from the amounts listed below.
  
  

* Commission is not guaranteed

title: Sales Executive

A Japanese company operating in the mechanical components industry. The organisation develops, manufactures, and supplies linear motion systems and a range of related mechanical components used across various industrial applications, serving customers through an established global network.

title: Catering Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
**The Hoxton, Bangalore**
We are looking for a
**Catering Sales Executive**
to join our dynamic team for The Hoxton Bengaluru City.
  
  
The Hoxton is opening its very first neighbourhood hotel in Asia, coming to India’s Bengaluru city centre in 2026. This is a major milestone for the brand as it ventures into a new continent entirely and we are now looking for a brilliant leadership team to help bring this lifestyle brand to the market.
  
  
Located in the heart of the city centre, The Hoxton, Bengaluru City will bring its undeniable brand DNA and guest experience to India’s “Silicon Valley”, a high-tech city filled with parks and gardens and known for its vibrant cafe and pub culture - very apt for a brand that was founded in London!
  
  
The hotel will feature 149 bedrooms in a variety of The Hoxton’s well-loved room categories and the lobby will have a vibrant all-day dining restaurant & bar. Topping off the hotel we will have a rooftop pool and bar, large-scale function rooms and The Apartment - The Hoxton’s unique meeting & events concept
  
  
**More About Us…**
The Hoxton is a series of open-house hotels, each in a neighbourhood that we love. Ever since we opened our first hotel in Shoreditch, we’ve never just been about offering a bed for the night. We want to be more than that: proving style doesn’t need to be sacrificed for good value and providing a place where guests can hang out alongside the locals and submerse themselves in the neighbourhood with vibrant, welcoming public spaces.
  
  
**What's In It For You...**

* The opportunity to work with an exciting new hospitality concept in Bangalore and have a real impact on its success.
* Join an innovative, fast-growing, international group that’s committed to not just building new hotels but building a global brand.
* The chance to challenge the norm and work in an environment that is both creative and rewarding.
* Become part of a team that’s very passionate about creating great hospitality experiences.
* Great discounts across the entire Ennismore family (which you get to keep even if you decide to leave us!).
* A competitive package and plenty of opportunity for development.

**Job Description**
**What you’ll do…**

* Managing the meetings and events enquiry process from start to finish, answering calls and emails, sending proposals, converting enquiries and taking the event through the planning and logistical stage to handover to operations.
* Negotiating meeting & events rates with clients, in line with the selling guidelines, to assist in achieving the hotel’s revenue targets.
* Following up with clients post event to get feedback and secure repeat business where possible.
* Cross-selling all global Hoxton and Ennismore properties, where applicable, to maximise revenue opportunities across corporate segments.
* Ensuring Opera Sales is up to date by putting inputting new enquiries into the system.
* Manage the preparation and distribution of function sheets on a weekly basis and present function sheets in the weekly operations meeting.
* Conducting show rounds on property.
* Building good relationships with clients for repeat business, contacting and probing repeat clients when appropriate and track year on year trends and events to support repeat business.
* Effectively co-ordinating activities related to booked meeting & event business with other departments, ensuring client’s expectations are met by maintaining team communication.
* Maintaining excellent Hoxton product and brand knowledge and upselling wherever possible.
* And yes, there’s a little admin … ensuring that daily, weekly and monthly administration is completed accurately and that all groups have necessary documentation on file. But let’s face it, we know you love that!
* Supporting the sales team in attending and assisting with in-house marketing activities, familiarisation trips, client hospitality evenings, presentations, show rounds and promotional activities as required.

**Qualifications**
**What we’re looking for…**

* Individuals. You’re looking for a place where you can be you; no clones in suits here.
* Passion for hospitality – whether that’s a drink, a meal, an event or a bed for the night.
* You’re all about having a positive impact on the people you interact with, leaving them with a memorable experience.
* You’re not precious. We leave our egos at the door and help get things done.
* You’re up for doing things differently and trying (almost) everything once.
* If we got stuck in a lift together, we’d have a good time and share a few laughs.
* You want to be part of a team that works hard, supports each other, and has fun along the way.
* You’re passionate about hotels and specialise in groups & events at an executive level.
* You are scarily organised, have the ability to multi-task and spin a million plates in the air at one time, prioritise and re-prioritise as things come in.
* A people person, great at building strong and lasting relationships.

title: Service Sales Specialist
description:
The Service Sales Specialist is responsible for driving service revenue growth and customer retention across the assigned region by selling service contracts, renewals, upgrades, and billable service solutions. The role will develop strong customer relationships, identify service opportunities, improve contract attach and renewal rates, and achieve assigned revenue and profitability targets.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Service Contract Sales & Renewals
* Drive annual service contract revenue, renewals, and win-back opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Proactively engage customers ahead of contract expiry to maximize renewal conversion.
* Identify uncovered instruments and convert them into service contracts.
* Drive contract upgrades, extended coverage, and value-added service offerings.
* Manage EOSL, aged, and at-risk contracts through appropriate customer engagement and commercial solutions.
* Maintain a healthy service opportunity pipeline and accurate sales forecasting.
* Billable Service Sales
* Generate and grow billable service revenue through repair, preventive maintenance, calibration, qualification, installation, relocation, and other service offerings.
* Identify service opportunities during customer visits, service calls, and interactions with laboratory users.
* Convert service requirements into commercial opportunities in collaboration with Field Service Engineers and Service teams.
* Follow up on quotations and ensure timely order closure.
* Develop repeat billable business from existing customers.
* Customer & Account Management
* Develop strong relationships with key customers, decision makers, procurement teams, and laboratory users.
* Understand customer requirements, instrument utilization, service history, and business needs.
* Position service contracts based on customer value, uptime, productivity, compliance, and risk reduction, rather than price alone.
* Conduct regular customer visits and business reviews for strategic accounts.
* Resolve commercial concerns and coordinate internally to improve customer experience.
* Sales Pipeline & Forecast Management
* Maintain a robust pipeline covering renewals, uncovered instruments, win-backs, upgrades, and billable opportunities.
* Ensure opportunities are accurately maintained in CRM/SFDC with appropriate stages, values, close dates, and next actions.
* Provide accurate monthly and quarterly forecasts.
* Review pipeline regularly and prioritize high-value and high-probability opportunities.
* Regional Business Development
* Identify new service-sales opportunities within the assigned territory.
* Expand service coverage across installed-base customers.
* Identify cross-selling and upselling opportunities across service offerings.
* Track competitor activity, pricing, customer feedback, and market trends.
* Develop territory-specific action plans to achieve assigned AOP targets.
* Internal Collaboration
* Work closely with Field Service, Service Management, Customer Service, Finance, and Commercial teams to close opportunities.
* Partner with Service Engineers to identify billable and contract opportunities.
* Coordinate with internal teams to ensure timely quotation, order processing, and contract activation.
* Provide market and customer feedback to leadership to support pricing and portfolio decisions.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
  

* Service Contract Revenue / Bookings
* Billable Service Revenue
* Contract Renewal Rate
* Warranty-to-Contract Conversion
* Contract Attach Rate
* Uncovered Installed Base Conversion
* Win-back Revenue
* Upsell / Cross-sell Revenue
* Price Realization
* Pipeline Coverage and Forecast Accuracy
* Customer Retention
* New Service Business Development

Weir is a welcoming, inclusive place, where each individual’s contribution is recognized and all employees are encouraged to innovate, collaborate and be themselves. We continually focus on people and their wellbeing. We believe in fairness and choose to be honest, transparent and authentic in everything we do.

* Build and maintain strong relationships with key stakeholders across large and mid-sized corporate customers within the iron ore mining sector, as well as sand and aggregate industries.

* Own the end-to-end sales process from quotation through order fulfillment and cash collection.

**Pre-Sales Associate**

* **Full-time**
* **0–2 years**
* **₹4.0–4.2 LPA**

**About Codingal**

Codingal is on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with coding.

We have empowered 500,000+ students to start learning to code through personalised 1:1 live classes with expert Computer Science teachers. Our curriculum is built on the K-12 Computer Science Framework and accredited by STEM.org, and kids find it genuinely fun. Parents and children in more than 70 countries trust Codingal for high-quality coding education. We are a global company headquartered in the US, backed by top investors including Y Combinator and Rebright Partners.

Coding improves logical thinking and problem-solving by 70% in young children, and lifts their performance in other school subjects too. Coding roles already make up more than 60% of all jobs in science, technology, engineering and maths, so kids who start early will be the creators of the future. Read what parents say about us at
codingal.com/reviews-and-testimonials
.

**About the role**

As a Pre-Sales Associate, you are the first human voice a parent hears from Codingal. You will call parents who have shown interest in coding for their child, understand what they are really looking for, and help them see the value of a free trial class. You are not pushing a product — you are helping a parent make a good decision for their child, and setting up our sales team with a warm, well-qualified conversation.

It is a fast-paced, target-driven role with a lot of conversations every day. If you like talking to people, learn quickly, and want a clear path into a full sales career, this is a strong place to start.

**What you will do**

* Make outbound calls to prospective and existing Codingal parents to generate and qualify leads for coding classes.
* Run a customer needs assessment (CNA) on every lead — understand the child’s age, interests, school workload and the parent’s goals before recommending anything.
* Book and confirm free trial classes, and follow up with reminder calls so parents actually show up.
* Prime and nurture leads across channels — calls, WhatsApp, email and SMS — so no interested parent goes cold.
* Hand over qualified, well-documented leads to the Business Development team with clear context on what the parent wants.
* Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in LeadSquared CRM and our telecalling tools every single day.
* Own your daily and monthly numbers — calls made, connects, CNAs completed, trials booked and trial attendance.
* Track your own performance metrics, spot what is working, and share it with the team.

**What we are looking for**

* 0–2 years of experience in pre-sales, telecalling, inside sales or customer support. Freshers with strong communication are welcome.
* Clear, confident and warm communication in English and Hindi, spoken and written. Additional regional languages are a big plus.
* Genuine empathy — you listen to what a parent is worried about before you talk about the product.
* The ability to ask sharp questions and qualify a need, rather than reading from a script.
* Comfort with numbers and targets, and the resilience to keep going in a high-performance environment.
* Strong multitasking and follow-through — you can hold 40+ conversations a day and still remember who needs a call back.
* A learning mindset. You should be able to understand our product well enough to speak to a parent about it within your first few days.
* Flexibility on working hours. Our parents are spread across 70+ countries, so some shifts include evenings or weekends.
* A graduate degree in any discipline.

**Why join Codingal**

* **Uncapped incentives.**
  Exceptionally high performance-linked rewards for top performers — your effort shows up in your payslip.
* **Real, fast growth.**
  We are scaling quickly and promote on performance, not tenure. Strong performers move into Business Development and then team leadership.
* **Genuine sales training.**
  You will learn structured discovery, objection handling and consultative selling — skills that stay with you for your whole career.
* **Work that means something.**
  Every trial class you book is a child who might discover they love building things. That is a good reason to pick up the phone.
* **A young, sharp team.**
  You will sit with people who are ambitious, collaborative and genuinely fun to work with, in our HSR Layout office.
* **Y Combinator-backed.**
  A globally recognised, well-funded EdTech company on your CV from day one.

**Where this role can take you**

We hire pre-sales associates as the start of a sales career, not a dead end. A typical strong performer moves along this path:

**Pre-Sales Associate → Business Development Associate → Senior BDA / Relationship Manager → Team Lead**

Movement is based purely on performance. We would much rather promote from inside the team.

**Compensation and location**

* **Annual compensation:**
  ₹3,60,000 – ₹4,20,000 per year, made up of a competitive fixed base plus a variable performance incentive. The final offer depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance.
* **Location:**
  HSR Layout Sector 7, Bengaluru. This is an onsite role and cannot be done remotely.
* **Interviews:**
  Conducted at our Bengaluru office.

**Our hiring process**

* **1. Application review**
  — we look at your CV and communication.
* **2. Telephonic screening**
  — a short call to hear how you speak with people.
* **3. Interview at the HSR office**
  — including a live mock call with a parent scenario.
* **4. Offer**
  — we move fast and aim to close within a week.

**Frequently asked questions**

**What salary can I expect?**

₹3,60,000 to ₹4,20,000 a year — a fixed base plus a variable performance incentive. Where you land depends on your experience, communication skills and interview performance. Top performers earn meaningfully more through incentives.

**What is the eligibility criteria?**

A graduate degree in any discipline and 0–2 years of experience. Freshers with excellent communication skills are encouraged to apply.

**What skills matter most for this job?**

Clear, confident spoken English and Hindi, real empathy for parents, and the discipline to follow up. A Computer Science background is not required — we will teach you the product.

**Who can apply for this role?**

Anyone who meets the criteria above. Codingal is an equal opportunity employer and we welcome applicants of every gender, background, religion, caste and ability. We do not discriminate on any of these grounds.

**Is this a work-from-home job?**

No. This is a full-time onsite role at our HSR Layout Sector 7 office in Bengaluru.

**What do the working hours look like?**

Standard full-time hours with shift flexibility. Because we serve parents in 70+ countries, some shifts include evenings or weekends. Your shift is confirmed before you join.

**Are there any charges or deposits to apply or join?**

Absolutely not. Codingal never asks for money at any stage of hiring or employment. If anyone claiming to represent us asks you for a payment, it is a scam — please report it to us.

**Ready to apply?**

Come join a young, smart team on a mission to inspire school kids to fall in love with coding, and help us prepare every K-12 student for the future.

Apply at
codingal.com/careers
or write to
careers@codingal.com
