title: Ultrasound Sales Head
description:
**About the Company**

BPL Medical Technologies is a leading Indian medical technology company committed to advancing healthcare through innovative, reliable, and accessible solutions. With a strong legacy and nationwide presence, BPL serves hospitals, clinics, and healthcare providers across India and select international markets.

The company offers a diverse portfolio across patient monitoring, imaging, and critical care, supported by robust manufacturing, service, and distribution capabilities. With a growing installed base and a focus on quality and customer trust, BPL continues to strengthen its position as a trusted partner in healthcare delivery.

Driven by innovation and operational excellence, BPL is focused on building future-ready capabilities and delivering long-term value to customers, partners, and stakeholders.

Get to know about us -
**https://www.bplmedicaltechnologies.com/**

**Role Summary**

A senior business leader to own and drive BPL's Ultrasound Business. You'll be responsible for establishing and growing Ultrasound in the market — identifying dealer partners, acquiring new territories, building relationships with direct customers, and developing KOLs for the modality — while delivering revenues against targets defined for each territory. As the business scales, you'll play a pivotal role in coaching, mentoring, and building out the teams specific to this modality, with a seniority that allows you to operate as a key business leader for Ultrasound at BPL.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Market Development & Customer Acquisition**

* Introduce the brand and product into the market, increasing reach, footprint, and visibility.
* Acquire new customers, particularly large and medium-size corporate hospital chains.
* Design and implement strategies to capture untapped but potential markets.

**Channel & Dealer Management**

* Develop new dealer partners for the product line.
* Build and nurture a network of loyal, motivated distributors to drive sales beyond hospitals directly covered by the sales team.

**Stakeholder & KOL Relationship Management**

* Act as BPL Medtech's representative, building credibility with hospital management, senior clinicians/KOLs, and industry and doctor associations.
* Develop Key Opinion Leaders (KOLs) for the Ultrasound modality.

**Business Planning, Targets & Marketing Alignment**

* Develop a thorough and deep understanding of business deliverables and set targets for all regions based on their potential and business viability.
* Involve regional teams in the target-setting exercise, building ownership and joint strategies to achieve targets.
* Keep a close watch on sales trends, analysing sales data to interpret the right product positioning, which products to introduce, and which to sustain in the market for the longer term.
* Align with the marketing team to design and conceptualise campaigns that build the right visibility for the vertical while optimising costs.

**Process Setup & Governance**

* Set up processes for the vertical, and revisit existing processes to align them with the organisation's fast-paced growth.
* Ensure the team is process-oriented and disciplined in its overall business approach.

**Team Building & Leadership**

* Play a pivotal role in hiring and retaining talent for the Regional Teams as the business scales, including monitoring the hiring of frontline sales representatives.
* Motivate and develop the team into a strong, passionate unit; coach and mentor to enhance selling and technical skills for high productivity and effectiveness.

**What We're Looking For**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* 10–15 years of proven work experience, with experience in the medical device industry a must.
* Bachelor's degree in Bio Medical Engineering / Electronics & Instrumentation, preferred.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and people management skills.
* Excellent sales strategist, with the ability to mine data, infer future trends, and shape the business's future approach.
* High on result, action, and process orientation.
* Good customer domain knowledge — understanding of hospitals, doctors, and institutional purchase decision-making.
* High learning agility.
* Good commercial understanding of the dealer business, ROI, etc.
* Ability to influence and work with personnel at all levels; professional, respectful, and courteous with colleagues and customers.

**Why This Role Matters**

You'll be the face and driving force of BPL's Ultrasound Business — with real ownership of how the modality enters, grows, and wins across the market, gaining:

* End-to-end ownership of the Ultrasound business, from market entry and dealer network to revenue delivery.
* Direct influence in shaping strategy, territory expansion, and go-to-market approach for a growing modality.
* The opportunity to build and lead teams from the ground up as the business scales.
* The chance to work in a company with real purpose — where stronger Ultrasound business performance translates directly into wider access to healthcare.

**Location - Bangalore**

title: Director of Sales

**Description**
We are seeking a strategic and growth-oriented
**Director of Consumer Sales - India**
to lead the commercial vision and execution for our consumer business in India. Reporting into senior regional leadership, this role will be accountable for accelerating revenue growth, expanding market presence, fostering executive-level partnerships, and driving competitive advantage across retail, e-commerce, and channel ecosystems.
  
  
The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of strategic leadership, P&L management, market insight, and organisational capability building, with a demonstrated ability to influence business outcomes, lead large-scale sales organisations, and shape the future growth trajectory of the India business.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
India Growth Strategy & Business Leadership
  
  

* Define and execute the long-term India consumer growth strategy, aligned with global priorities while reflecting local market dynamics, channel evolution, and consumer trends.
* Serve as the primary commercial leader for India, owning market share growth, revenue acceleration, profitability, and strategic business outcomes.
* Identify and unlock new growth vectors across geographies, customer segments, emerging retail formats, digital commerce, and strategic partnerships.
* Act as a key member of the India Leadership Team, influencing investment decisions, market expansion priorities, and business transformation initiatives.

Market Expansion & Ecosystem Development
  
  

* Develop and strengthen strategic partnerships across India's retail, e-commerce, distribution, and emerging commerce ecosystems.
* Shape the company's market presence by identifying opportunities in Tier 2 and Tier 3 cities, modern trade, digital marketplaces, and evolving consumer channels.
* Lead strategic engagements with major national partners including Amazon, Flipkart, Reliance, Tata Group, and other high-impact channel partners.
* Build long-term joint growth plans that create sustainable competitive advantage and deepen market penetration.

Commercial Excellence & P&L Leadership
  
  

* Own the India consumer sales business, delivering sustainable revenue growth, profitability, and market-share expansion.

* Drive operational excellence through disciplined performance management, commercial governance, and data-driven decision-making.
* Ensure effective execution of pricing, portfolio, promotional, and channel strategies to maximise business outcomes.

Organisation & Talent Leadership
  
  

* Build and develop a high-performing, future-ready sales organisation capable of delivering sustained growth in a rapidly evolving market.
* Foster a culture of accountability, innovation, inclusion, and customer-centricity.
* Develop leadership capability, succession pipelines, and organisational effectiveness across the sales function.
* Champion talent strategies that strengthen employee engagement, capability building, and retention.

Cross-Functional Business Influence
  
  

* Partner with Marketing, Finance, Supply Chain, Product, and Customer Experience teams to shape India-specific growth strategies.
* Influence product roadmaps and commercial priorities through deep understanding of Indian consumers, retail trends, and competitive dynamics.
* Drive integrated go-to-market strategies that strengthen customer experience and accelerate business growth.

Market Intelligence & Competitive Advantage
  
  

* Anticipate shifts in consumer behaviour, retail transformation, regulatory developments, and competitive activity within the Indian market.
* Translate market insights into strategic recommendations that inform business planning, investment decisions, and innovation priorities.
* Position the organisation to capitalise on emerging opportunities while proactively mitigating commercial risks.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* 15+ years of progressive commercial leadership experience with significant responsibility for the Indian consumer market.
* Demonstrated success leading large-scale, multi-channel businesses with P&L accountability.
* Strong understanding of India's retail, e-commerce, distribution, and consumer ecosystem.
* Proven ability to influence executive stakeholders internally and externally.
* Experience operating within complex, matrixed multinational environments and driving transformational growth initiatives.
* MBA or equivalent business qualification preferred.

Additional Information
  
  
Sandisk thrives on the power and potential of diversity. As a global company, we believe the most effective way to embrace the diversity of our customers and communities is to mirror it from within. We believe the fusion of various perspectives results in the best outcomes for our employees, our company, our customers, and the world around us. We are committed to an inclusive environment where every individual can thrive through a sense of belonging, respect and contribution.
  
  
Sandisk is committed to offering opportunities to applicants with disabilities and ensuring all candidates can successfully navigate our careers website and our hiring process. Please contact us at jobs.accommodations@sandisk.com to advise us of your accommodation request. In your email, please include a description of the specific accommodation you are requesting as well as the job title and requisition number of the position for which you are applying.

title: Sales Leader, India
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies, from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious AI startups, use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and create new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a significant amount of work ahead. That means you’ll have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
What you’ll do
  
  
India is producing a new generation of ambitious, AI-native companies built for global markets, while global businesses increasingly look to India for growth. As the Sales Leader, India, you will shape Stripe’s role in this transformation, helping businesses expand across the India-US corridor and beyond. This is a rare opportunity to build a category-defining sales organization at the intersection of AI, global commerce, and India’s digital economy.
  
  
As the Sales Leader, India, you will own Stripe’s sales strategy and revenue outcomes across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Startups, with a primary focus on Enterprise. Reporting to the India MD, you will build and lead a high-performing team of New Business Account Executives, establish the operating model for Stripe’s next phase of growth, and work directly with senior customers on their most important business challenges. You will also partner closely with Stripe’s regional and global leadership to shape our broader growth agenda for India.
  
  
We’re looking for a proactive leader who has demonstrated success operating in a high-growth environment, building and leading high-performing teams, and working through ambiguity with limited oversight. The ideal candidate has experience scaling a technology sales organization and brings strong business judgment, analytical ability, communication skills, and relationship-building skills.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute Stripe’s sales and go-to-market strategy across Enterprise, Mid-Market, and Startups segment, with a primary focus on Enterprise and India’s AI-native and globally ambitious technology companies.
* Build Stripe’s position across the India-US corridor, working with regional teams to help Indian businesses expand globally and global businesses grow in India.
* Translate customer and market insights into clear priorities and input for Stripe’s product and solutions roadmap.
* Recruit, develop, and lead a high-performing team of sales professionals.
* Set the long-term vision for the India sales organization, establish a rigorous operating cadence, and drive predictable execution against key sales metrics.
* Be accountable for revenue growth, new customer acquisition, and the expansion of Stripe’s business in India.
* Coach the team in consultative and solution-based selling across every stage of the sales cycle.
* Build and maintain enduring relationships with customers, including senior executives and C-level leaders.
* Support the development and career growth of team members while increasing their impact at Stripe.
* Work collaboratively across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Partnerships, and other teams to shape Stripe’s products and solutions around customer and market needs.
* Represent Stripe at relevant industry events and build awareness of Stripe in the Indian market.

What success looks like
  
  
In your first 12 to 18 months, you will have established a clear growth strategy, strengthened and scaled the sales organization, deepened Stripe’s relationships with India’s leading companies, and built a more predictable, high-performing revenue engine.
  
  
Who you are
  
  
You are a builder who has materially scaled a technology business, recruited and developed exceptional sales talent, and won the trust of sophisticated enterprise customers. You combine strategic ambition with operating discipline and are equally comfortable shaping a multi-year market strategy, coaching a team, and engaging a CEO on their most important growth priorities.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* 10+ years of sales experience, including 3+ years of people management experience.
* Experience leading sales teams in a high-growth technology environment.
* Demonstrated success selling to and building relationships with enterprise customers in India.
* Experience developing and executing sales strategies across multiple customer segments.
* Ability to recruit, develop, coach, and retain a high-performing sales team.
* Strong business judgment and the ability to make sound decisions in an ambiguous, fast-changing environment.
* Ability to build strategic relationships with senior executives, customers, partners, and industry leaders.
* Ability to understand and articulate technical concepts and translate them into relevant business outcomes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Experience working collaboratively across functions to deliver results.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience leading sales across Enterprise, Mid-Market, or Startups customer segments, with significant Enterprise experience.
* Experience scaling a sales organization or business in India.
* Experience in financial technology, payments, software, or another technology-led industry.
* Demonstrated interest in startups, technology businesses, and the changing financial-services landscape in India.

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

title: Sales Manager
description:
**Company Description**
VERMES Microdispensing, headquartered in Germany, is a global leader in advanced microdispensing technologies for a wide range of fluids, including adhesives, silicones, greases, and solvents. Since introducing its contact-free piezo-based MDS 3000 series in 2001, the company has continuously driven innovation in high-precision dispensing systems. Its valves support modern manufacturing processes worldwide, serving industries such as automotive, medical, pharmaceutical, consumer electronics, LEDs, and RFID devices. VERMES Microdispensing systems enable precise, contact-free dispensing of highly viscous media in micro, nano, and sub-nano liter ranges at very high frequencies, delivering unique performance. Employees are committed to providing cutting-edge technologies and services that help customers increase throughput, improve quality, and reduce production costs.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Sales Manager role based in Bengaluru, India. The Sales Manager will oversee regional sales activities, identify and develop new business opportunities, and manage relationships with existing customers in target industries such as electronics, automotive, and medical manufacturing. The role includes promoting microdispensing solutions, preparing and delivering technical sales presentations, and coordinating product demonstrations with application engineers. Daily tasks involve managing the sales pipeline, negotiating commercial terms, preparing proposals and quotations, and ensuring timely order closure and revenue achievement. The Sales Manager will also analyze market trends, contribute to sales strategies, collaborate with global teams, attend industry events, and provide regular sales reporting and forecasts.
  
**Qualifications**

* Strong sales and account management skills, including lead generation, opportunity qualification, negotiation, and closing.
* Experience in technical or industrial B2B sales, preferably in automation, electronics manufacturing, dispensing systems, or related fields.

title: Manager, Product Cybersecurity — Semiconductor IP
description:
**We Are:**
At Synopsys, we drive the innovations that shape the way we live and connect. Our technology is central to the Era of Pervasive Intelligence, from self-driving cars to learning machines. We lead in chip design, verification, and IP integration, empowering the creation of high-performance silicon chips and software content. Join us to transform the future through continuous technological innovation.
  
  
**You Are:**
You are a leader who builds trust with product teams, engineers, and the analysts you manage. You listen first, write in clear language, and take ownership of results. You work well with people in different disciplines and locations, and you help others do their best work without needing to be the loudest person in the room.
  
  
You are practical when information is incomplete. You explain complex topics in simple terms, stay calm when the design changes, and challenge unclear choices in a respectful way. You care about teamwork, growing people, and leaving work that others can use.
  
  
This is a full-time role.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Lead a team of cybersecurity analysts who support semiconductor IP products: set priorities, assign analysts to product teams, and balance workload across the portfolio.
* Set the direction for threat analysis of semiconductor IP and associated firmware, including assets, access points, threat scenarios, attack paths, and controls in the IP versus requirements for the integrator.
* Guide the team in running security analysis as part of the cybersecurity lifecycle, from planning through design, implementation, verification, and release.
* Review the team’s analysis, requirements, and integration guidance for quality, consistency, and clear assumptions before they reach product teams and customers.
* Advise product leaders and architects on cybersecurity requirements, architecture, and verification so security work is built into the existing development flow.
* Oversee customer-facing security integration guidance that describes the threat landscape, implemented controls, and how customers should integrate the IP.
* Guide the team’s support for in-field cybersecurity activities, including vulnerability assessment, incident analysis, and security advisories, working with cybersecurity architects and corporate vulnerability response.
* Coach and develop analysts: set clear goals, give regular feedback, and plan career growth.
* Facilitate working sessions with cybersecurity architects and design and verification leads; keep analysis consistent across similar IP classes.
* Plan the team’s work with product teams in agile sprints: align security work with the product backlog, adjust scope when the design changes, and keep evidence current at each milestone.
* Promote the use of Python and agentic workflows (AI agents, structured prompts, and human-in-the-loop review) so the team works faster while analysts keep ownership of their findings.
* Run team work in Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab: track work and capacity, keep documentation current, and report status to leadership.

**The Impact You Will Have:**

* Give product teams threat analysis they can trust and act on without re-deriving the work.
* Build a team of analysts who grow in skill, own their conclusions, and deliver steady quality.
* Improve consistency of analysis, risk language, and guidance across similar IP classes.
* Leave cybersecurity requirements and verification objectives that design and verification teams can execute.
* Strengthen the cybersecurity lifecycle for IP products so security work stays current as the design changes.
* Help customers integrate Synopsys IP with guidance they can follow without a security specialist in the room.
* Help the organization respond to in-field issues with clear assessment and practical advisories.
* Raise team throughput with Python and agentic workflows without lowering the quality of technical conclusions.

**What You’ll Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience. An advanced degree is welcome, not required.
* Ten or more years in product cybersecurity, embedded security, digital design, digital verification, or a closely related engineering role, including four or more years leading people or technical teams. Stronger evidence on the required capabilities can offset fewer years.
* Experience managing or leading analysts or engineers: setting priorities, giving feedback, coaching, hiring, and growing people.
* Practical experience performing or reviewing threat modeling, threat analysis, and risk assessment on real products, not only training exercises.
* Ability to judge whether threat-analysis work identifies assets, attackers, attack surfaces, and attack paths, and maps each path to a mitigation (in-product control or integration requirement).
* Comfort working without a single known end-system: analysis must cover representative integration scenarios and state assumptions clearly.
* Experience applying a cybersecurity lifecycle across planning, requirements, design, implementation, verification, and release.
* Ability to turn threat-analysis results into requirements, design guidance, verification objectives, and release evidence.
* Hands-on understanding of embedded systems: SoC or MCU integration, firmware, hardware/software interfaces, memory-mapped registers, boot and debug, and on-chip interconnects.
* Background as a digital designer or a digital verification engineer, with the ability to read and discuss RTL (Verilog, SystemVerilog, or VHDL), architecture, interfaces, and register maps with designers and verification leads.
* Ability to judge whether a claimed cybersecurity control is implemented in the design and whether it is verifiable.
* Experience delivering work inside agile product teams, including re-scoping when product content changes.
* Working ability to read and review Python used for analysis and automation, and to guide analysts on readable, reusable scripts.
* Practical experience using AI agents and agentic workflows to speed research, drafting, and repetitive analysis, while keeping the human as owner of technical conclusions.
* Hands-on use of Jira, Confluence, Git, and GitLab (or an equivalent Git forge) for tickets, documentation, and review.
* Clear written and spoken English; able to lead technical sessions and communicate with leaders across geographically distributed teams.
* Familiarity with digital design and verification languages and methods, such as SystemVerilog, UVM (Universal Verification Methodology), and SystemC, and how verification teams use them to test security controls.
* Working knowledge of ISO/SAE 21434 or a comparable product-cybersecurity standard is helpful, as is analog or mixed-signal background, semiconductor IP product experience, vulnerability handling, or applied embedded cryptography.

**Who You Are:**

* You build trust with product teams, design teams, and your own analysts, and you keep working relationships strong when the discussion is difficult.
* You grow people. You give honest feedback, share credit, and help analysts take on more responsibility.
* You own the outcome for your team. You do not hand off judgment to a tool, a template, or the loudest voice in the room.
* You write and speak clearly so engineers, leaders, and customers can use your work without you in the room.
* You work well with incomplete information and out-of-context IP, and you state assumptions instead of hiding them.
* You challenge unclear practices in a respectful way and recommend improvements teams can actually adopt.
* You are collaborative and non-disruptive with product teams, including when you need them to change course.
* You are structured and detail-oriented, and you keep evidence current as the design changes.
* You are comfortable with agile change and re-prioritize the team’s work without waiting for a late gate.

**The Team You’ll Be A Part Of:**
You will lead the cybersecurity analysts who support Synopsys semiconductor IP products. Your analysts are assigned to IP product teams and work in their delivery cadence. You and your team collaborate with digital, analog, mixed-signal, and firmware engineers, and with cybersecurity architects, to complete analysis, guidance, and evidence through the cybersecurity lifecycle. The team works across regions. Its work products are used by product teams and by customers who integrate the IP.
  
  
**Rewards and Benefits:**
We offer a comprehensive range of health, wellness, and financial benefits to cater to your needs. Our total rewards include both monetary and non-monetary offerings. Your recruiter will provide more details about the salary range and benefits during the hiring process.

We’re backed by Peak XV Partners, Elevation, Fundamentum, and other top-tier investors, and are one of India’s fastest-growing Series C consumer-tech companies.

Our flagship product, Sri Mandir, is the world’s largest platform for Hindu devotees, powering rituals, teachings, personalized recommendations, and a thriving devotional community. India’s $44B devotion economy is still largely offline, and we’re bringing structure, accessibility, and meaning to this massive market, where design and data play a central role in shaping user behavior at scale.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a results-driven Performance Marketing Associate to manage and scale paid marketing campaigns while driving core business metrics such as revenue, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), Return on Ad Spend (ROAS), and contribution margins.

This role requires hands-on campaign execution, strong analytical thinking, and the ability to connect marketing performance with business outcomes. You will work closely with category, creative, content, CRM, and product teams to identify growth opportunities and improve acquisition efficiency.

**What You’ll Do**

**1. Campaign Execution & Growth**

* Plan, launch, manage, and optimise paid campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and other relevant digital platforms.
* Own campaign execution end-to-end, from planning and setup to monitoring, optimisation, and reporting.
* Scale campaigns while maintaining efficiency across key metrics such as CAC, CPA, ROAS, and contribution margins.

**2. Performance Analytics & Business Impact**

* Track campaign-level metrics such as CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS, and connect them to business outcomes such as revenue, CM1, CM2, and baseline contribution.
* Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) to understand performance fluctuations and identify actionable growth opportunities.
* Build and maintain dashboards and reporting structures to monitor campaign and business performance.

**3. Optimisation & Experimentation**

* Run experiments across creatives, audiences, landing pages, and campaign strategies.
* Partner with creative and content teams to develop and test performance-driven creatives and messaging.
* Explore new channels, formats, and growth opportunities to improve campaign performance.

**4. Cross-functional Collaboration**

* Work with category teams to align campaigns with the puja calendar, seasonal demand, and product launches.
* Collaborate with CRM, product, content, and influencer teams to drive growth across channels.
* Contribute to branding and performance initiatives that improve overall business performance.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 1–3 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, with evidence of campaign optimisation and growth.
* Practical experience with paid media platforms, particularly Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to connect campaign metrics with business outcomes.
* Advanced Excel or Google Sheets skills for reporting, analysis, and performance tracking.
* Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and an ownership-driven approach.
* Good communication skills and the ability to collaborate across teams.

**Good to Have**

* Experience managing and scaling medium-to-large marketing budgets efficiently.
* Familiarity with Google Analytics, Looker Studio, or similar analytics and reporting tools.
* Experience in a fast-paced, growth-oriented consumer business.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work on a consumer platform serving millions of devotees.
* Take ownership of meaningful growth metrics beyond campaign-level performance.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to solve real business problems and build scalable growth initiatives.

**One Team. One Goal. Assisting millions on their digital devotional journeys**

title: Marketing Content Manager
description:
**About PRED**

PRED is a sports prediction market. Instead of betting against a house, fans trade on outcomes against each other. That means better odds, instant cashout, and winners are welcome. We're backed by Accel and Coinbase Ventures, and we're a small team that ships fast.

**The role**

You'll be the voice of PRED wherever sports fans spend their time. You'll turn live games, odds moves and big moments into content that makes people want to trade, on X, short-form video, community channels and our own site. You'll be in the conversation as games happen, not reacting the next morning. You'll be creating for a global audience across Europe, LATAM and Rest of world.

**What you'll do**

-
**Own PRED's social presence**
, starting with X. Post daily during NBA, NFL and football (soccer) seasons: match-moment takes, odds swings, market callouts and memes that actually land.

-
**Cover games live**
. Post in real time during big games, tied to what's moving on PRED.

-
**Make short-form video**
(Reels, TikTok, Shorts, X video) explaining how PRED works, showing trades and cashouts, and covering the stories behind the markets.

-
**Write ad and campaign copy**
with performance marketing. Test hooks, angles and offers, then learn from the results.

-
**Work with creators and KOLs**
in sports, betting and crypto. Write briefs, review drafts and keep the brand consistent.

-
**Build a content calendar**
around the sports calendar: season openers, playoffs, derbies, drafts and transfer windows.

-
**Track what works**
Report on reach, engagement, sign-ups and trades driven by content, and drop what doesn't perform.

**Who you are**

-
**You live and breathe sports**
. You watch the games, follow the storylines and argue about them with friends.

-
**You love making content.**
You'd be making it even if nobody paid you, and you probably already are.

-
**You're bold and experimental.**
You'll try a weird format, a hot take or a new platform before anyone else does, and you're fine killing an idea that doesn't work.

**What you bring**

- 2–5 years in sports content, social media or growth marketing. Experience at a sportsbook, fantasy, prediction market, sports media or crypto company is a big plus.

- You're deeply into sports. You know the NBA, NFL and European football well enough to have an opinion on a Tuesday night game.

- You understand odds and probability and can explain them simply.

- Native X fluency. You know what makes a post travel, and you have accounts or posts you've grown that you can point to.

- You write sharp, fast and funny without being cringe.

- You can shoot and edit short-form video yourself (CapCut, Premiere or similar).

- You're comfortable with numbers and test and iterate instead of guessing.

- You're responsible: you know the rules around gambling-adjacent and financial marketing, and you don't cut corners on compliance.

**Nice to have**

- Experience with Polymarket, Kalshi or crypto-native products

- Spanish or Portuguese (we grow across LATAM)

- An existing network of sports or betting creators

- Basic design skills (Figma, Canva)

**What we offer**

-
**Best pay in the industry**
, plus ESOPs

- On-site in Bangalore with a small, fast team (game time is work time)

- Real ownership: your content ships the same day and its results are visible

**1. Role Purpose:**

IIC Lakshya is looking for an experienced, hands-on Performance Marketing Manager to manage and optimize paid media campaigns across Indian and international markets.

The role will be responsible for executing lead generation, brand awareness (Top of Funnel) and engagement (Mid Funnel) campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, LinkedIn Ads and other relevant digital advertising platforms. The incumbent should combine advanced platform expertise with strong analytical capabilities, a thorough understanding of modern marketing technology, and the ability to improve campaign efficiency and lead generation outcomes.

The candidate will manage day-to-day campaign execution, optimization, tracking, reporting and experimentation while supervising a team of performance marketing professionals. This is a hands-on managerial role that requires the ability to independently troubleshoot campaign challenges, identify optimization opportunities and translate performance data into actionable improvements within established business objectives and budgets.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Performance Marketing & Campaign Execution:**

- Manage end-to-end execution of paid digital marketing campaigns across Indian and international markets, covering lead generation, brand awareness and engagement objectives.

- Independently manage and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads and LinkedIn Ads, ensuring effective execution across relevant campaign types and placements.

- Execute campaigns across different geographies, audience segments, courses and customer journey stages.

- Implement campaign structures, audience targeting, bidding strategies, conversion optimization and budget management in line with approved campaign objectives.

- Monitor campaign performance regularly and take timely corrective actions to improve reach, engagement, lead volume, cost efficiency and lead quality.

- Manage retargeting, remarketing and audience re-engagement campaigns to support movement across the marketing funnel.

**2. Campaign Optimization, Testing & Performance Improvement:**

- Analyze campaign performance at the campaign, ad set/ad group, audience, creative, keyword, placement and geographic levels.

- Identify performance gaps and implement optimization actions based on platform data, audience behaviour and campaign objectives.

- Develop and execute structured tests for creatives, messaging, audience segments, landing pages, bidding strategies and campaign formats.

- Evaluate creative fatigue, frequency, audience saturation and declining campaign efficiency, and take appropriate corrective action.

- Optimize Google Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display and Demand Gen campaigns, along with relevant Meta and LinkedIn campaign formats.

**3. Marketing Technology, Tracking & Attribution:**

- Demonstrate strong working knowledge of the modern marketing technology ecosystem, including conversion tracking, automation, audience management, attribution and CRM integrations.

- Manage and troubleshoot campaign tracking using Google Tag Manager, GA4, platform pixels, conversion APIs and relevant tracking tools.

- Ensure accurate implementation and validation of conversion events across advertising platforms, websites and landing pages.

- Work with CRM and technology teams to support lead tracking, campaign attribution, offline conversion imports and the transmission of relevant conversion signals to advertising platforms.

- Understand and implement appropriate server-side tracking and first-party data solutions, including Meta Conversions API and enhanced conversion capabilities where applicable.

**4. Analytics, Reporting & Insights:**

- Monitor and report campaign performance against assigned campaign objectives and approved targets.

- Analyze key performance metrics, including impressions, reach, frequency, CPM, CTR, CPC, landing page conversion rate, CPL, cost per qualified lead where available, engagement and video view metrics.

- Evaluate campaign performance across geographies, channels, audiences, creatives and funnel stages.

- Prepare accurate and timely daily, weekly and monthly campaign performance reports.

- Use GA4, advertising platform dashboards, CRM data and Excel to investigate performance trends and identify actionable optimization opportunities.

- Connect paid media performance with available downstream lead-quality and conversion data to understand the effectiveness of lead generation campaigns.

- Highlight anomalies, tracking issues, underperforming campaigns and improvement opportunities to the reporting manager.

- Maintain accurate campaign data, reporting consistency and documentation of optimization activities.

**5. Campaign Coordination & Day-to-Day Team Supervision:**

- Supervise the day-to-day execution of performance marketing campaigns by reporting executives and Assistant Managers.

- Assign campaign execution and reporting activities, monitor completion and review work for accuracy and quality.

- Ensure adherence to campaign briefs, launch timelines, optimization schedules and reporting requirements.

- Review campaign setups, tracking implementations, reports and optimization recommendations prepared by team members.

- Support team members in troubleshooting campaign issues and resolving platform-level execution challenges.

- Coordinate with creative, content, web development, CRM and admissions teams for campaign assets, landing page changes, tracking requirements and campaign-related inputs.

**3. Success Metrics (KRAs):**

The following KRAs will be used to evaluate performance. Final targets and weightages can be agreed upon based on the assigned market, campaign mix and business priorities.

**KRA 1: Campaign Delivery & Acquisition Performance:**

- Achievement of assigned lead generation targets.

- CPL and cost-per-qualified-lead performance against approved targets, where applicable.

- Campaign delivery against assigned budgets.

- Reach, impressions and frequency performance for awareness campaigns.

- Engagement, video view and traffic performance for mid-funnel campaigns.

**KRA 2: Campaign Optimization & Efficiency:**

- Improvement in campaign efficiency against established benchmarks.

- Timeliness and effectiveness of optimization actions.

- Creative, audience, keyword and landing page testing execution.

- Identification and resolution of campaign performance issues.

- Retargeting and remarketing campaign effectiveness.

**KRA 3: Martech, Analytics & Execution Excellence:**

- Accuracy and reliability of campaign tracking and conversion events.

- Timely identification and resolution of tracking discrepancies.

- Accuracy and timeliness of performance reports.

- Quality of campaign analysis and optimization recommendations.

- Successful implementation of approved tracking, attribution and platform enhancements.

**4. Experience & Qualification Requirements:**

**Education:**

- Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Business Administration, Engineering, Statistics or a related discipline.

- MBA or a relevant postgraduate qualification is an advantage.

**Experience:**

- 6 - 7 years of hands-on experience in performance marketing, paid media or digital acquisition.

- Demonstrated experience managing campaigns across multiple markets, including international geographies.

- Prior experience handling lead generation as well as brand awareness and engagement campaigns.

- Previous experience supervising performance marketing executives and Assistant Managers, with responsibility for reviewing execution and campaign performance.

- Proven experience managing significant digital advertising budgets and optimizing campaigns against defined performance targets.

**5. Functional Expertise Required:**

**A. Advertising Platforms:**

**Google Ads:**

- Search, Performance Max, YouTube, Display and Demand Gen.

- Keyword research, search-term analysis, negative keyword management and bidding optimization.

- Conversion tracking, remarketing and audience management.

- Campaign structure, budget management and performance troubleshooting.

**Meta Ads:**

- Lead generation, website conversion, awareness, reach, traffic and engagement campaigns.

- Campaign architecture, audience targeting, retargeting and exclusions.

- Creative testing, placement optimization, frequency management and budget optimization.

- Meta Pixel, Conversions API, event configuration and conversion signal quality.

**LinkedIn Ads:**

- Lead generation, awareness, website visits and engagement campaigns.

- Audience segmentation, professional targeting and campaign optimization.

- Lead Gen Forms, retargeting and relevant B2C or professional audience applications.

**Other Advertising Platforms:**

- Working knowledge of Microsoft Advertising and other relevant paid media platforms is an advantage.

- Ability to evaluate new advertising channels and formats based on their relevance to assigned campaign objectives.

**B. Analytics & Data:**

- Google Analytics 4 (GA4).

- Google Tag Manager (GTM).

- Meta Events Manager and LinkedIn Insight Tag.

- Conversion tracking, attribution and offline conversion measurement.

- Advanced Microsoft Excel for analysis and reporting.

- Looker Studio or equivalent dashboarding tools.

**C. Martech & Emerging Technologies:**

- Strong understanding of marketing technology trends and their practical applications in performance marketing.

- Familiarity with server-side tracking, conversion APIs, enhanced conversions and first-party data activation.

- Understanding of CRM and advertising platform integrations, audience syncing and offline conversion imports.

- Working knowledge of marketing automation, audience management and attribution solutions.

- Familiarity with AI-enabled advertising tools, campaign automation, creative intelligence and optimization features.

- Ability to assess new tools and platform capabilities based on measurable campaign benefits.

title: Assistant Manager SEO
description:
**Welcome to GO Asia**

GrowthOps is a marketing transformation agency, consistently awarded the top Customer Engagement agency in APAC. For over 15 years, we’ve been helping brands go to market in Asia by integrating strategy, design, technology and AI. Trusted by enterprises and high-growth innovators, we specialise in supporting media, MarTech and creative operations across financial services, telecommunications, transportation, ecommerce, energy and more. GrowthOps is part of The Applied AI Company.

***Based in India. Bangalore preferred (hybrid). You’ll need hands-on experience with hreflang, technical troubleshooting (JS rendering, crawl and indexing issues), and tools like Ahrefs, Screaming Frog and Google Search Console.***

**Overview**

We're looking for a hands-on
**technical SEO specialist**
to own the technical search strategy and execution across a portfolio of regional clients. You will partner with engineers, product managers, content leads and account teams to improve crawlability, indexing, site performance and organic growth. This role is scoped as an expert individual contributor (Senior Specialist), with or without direct interaction with the client.

**Responsibilities**

**Strategy**

* Define a pragmatic technical SEO roadmap per client, aligned to business goals and market realities (Singapore, Malaysia and wider APAC).
* Translate SEO requirements into clear, prioritised tasks and delivery plans for product and engineering.
* Champion an experimentation mindset and communicate impact to stakeholders in plain language.

**Technical SEO**

* Run comprehensive technical audits covering crawl diagnostics, indexation, internal linking, schema, canonicals, robots directives, sitemaps, pagination/faceted navigation and duplicate handling.
* Diagnose and resolve JavaScript SEO challenges across common rendering approaches (SSR/SSG/CSR) and ensure scalable solutions.
* Design for large, multilingual and multi-market sites (hreflang, regional content logic, URL design, parameter governance).
* Implement structured data at scale (JSON-LD) with robust validation processes.
* Lead low-risk site migrations and re-platforming (domain/HTTPS, CMS/e-commerce) with clear mitigation and recovery plans.

**Performance, UX & Core Web Vitals**

* Partner with engineering to improve LCP, INP and CLS using data-driven diagnostics (resource hints, critical CSS, image optimisation, lazy-loading strategies, JS budget, server timing, CDN tuning).
* Establish performance guardrails and monitor regressions.

**Analytics, Measurement & Reporting**

* Design measurement frameworks that map SEO initiatives to GA4/GSC metrics and revenue proxies.
* Build concise dashboards and exec readouts linking technical changes to traffic, index coverage and conversions.
* Set up monitoring and alerting for crawl errors, index anomalies, page speed regressions and ranking volatility.

**Automation & Tooling**

* Use and extend industry tools (GSC, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, log parsers).
* Streamline repetitive checks using preferred workflows (e.g., XML sitemap diffs, hreflang validation, orphan detection, templated schema).

**Collaboration & Delivery**

* Work closely with developers to scope acceptance criteria and validate releases; provide clear reproduction steps and solutions.
* Partner with content and digital PR teams to align technical foundations with content velocity and link acquisition.
* Contribute to playbooks and standards; mentor junior SEOs informally.

**Governance, Risk & Compliance**

* Define robots and crawl-rate policies; manage indexation at scale.
* Ensure SEO-friendly security and infrastructure decisions (HTTPS/HSTS, redirect hygiene, canonical strategy, cache headers).
* Maintain documentation for change logs, release notes and rollback procedures.

**Requirements**

* 5 to 8+ years in SEO with a strong technical focus; agency or product-side experience with large/complex sites.
* Expertise with crawling tools (Screaming Frog) and strong proficiency with GA4, Google Search Console and Looker Studio.
* Working knowledge of web fundamentals (HTML/CSS/HTTP), JavaScript frameworks (React/Next.js, Vue/Nuxt) and common rendering modes.
* Familiarity with CDNs and edge platforms and how to leverage them for SEO (redirects, caching, image optimisation).
* Practical experience improving Core Web Vitals and setting performance guardrails.
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills; able to defend a point of view with data and empathy.
* Excellent attention to detail, documentation discipline and project management.
* Client-facing confidence: run workshops, present findings, and participate in roadmap discussions.

**Nice to have**

* Experience with A/B testing platforms (Optimizely, VWO), and server log analysis at scale.
* Knowledge of international SEO nuances in APAC.
* Experience with programmatic SEO and templated content architectures.

**Tools you'll likely use here**

GA4, Google Search Console, Looker Studio, Screaming Frog, PageSpeed Insights, Lighthouse, Chrome DevTools, Ahrefs, SEMrush, SIMILARWEB.

***We appreciate your application and will be in touch with shortlisted candidates regarding next steps***

About Alttred Nexxus

Alttred Nexxus is a creative studio bringing strategy, design, development, and production under one roof. We work with brands to create content and campaigns that don’t just look good, but actually get people talking, watching, and taking action.

About the Role

We’re looking for a chronically online, content-obsessed
**Social Media Associate**

Manager who can turn random internet rabbit holes into actual content ideas.

Someone who can write a killer script, build a social media strategy, plan a content calendar, use AI tools to speed up execution, and pick up a phone to shoot content themselves.

You should understand why a reel works, what makes people stop scrolling, and how to turn a half-baked idea into something worth publishing.

Basically, we need someone who doesn’t just manage social media but genuinely understands how the internet works.

**What You’ll Be Doing**

* Social Media Strategy: Build content strategies for brands based on their audience, objectives, platform, and personality.
* Scripts & Storytelling: Write engaging reels, short-form video scripts, hooks, captions, and concepts that grab attention in the first few seconds.
* Content Calendars: Plan monthly content calendars, map out content pillars, organise shoots, and ensure content goes live on time.
* Trendspotting: Be a doom scroller with a purpose. Spot emerging trends, formats, memes, conversations, and cultural moments that brands can actually use.
* Creator Management: Discover relevant creators, reach out to them, negotiate, follow up, and get collaborations over the line. You should be comfortable picking up the phone and getting things done.
* AI-Powered Execution: Be proficient with AI tools for ideation, research, scripting, content creation, editing, and workflow optimisation.
* Basic Editing: Understand the basics of editing short-form videos, adding subtitles, getting the pacing right, and making content social-media ready.
* Phone-First Content Creation: Shoot reels, BTS, UGC-style videos, and quick content pieces yourself using your phone. You don’t need a full production setup to make something good.
* Performance & Learning: Track what works, understand why certain posts perform better, and use those insights to improve the next batch of content.

**What We’re Looking For**

* Strong writing skills and an instinct for storytelling.
* A solid understanding of Instagram, Reels, YouTube Shorts, and current social media formats.
* The ability to think beyond posting regularly and build a meaningful content strategy.
* Comfort with creator outreach, communication, negotiation, and follow-ups.
* Hands-on familiarity with AI tools and a willingness to keep experimenting with new ones.
* Basic video editing skills using CapCut, Premiere Pro, VN, or similar tools.
* The confidence to shoot and create content independently using a phone.
* Good communication, organisation, and the ability to manage multiple things without losing track.
* A portfolio, personal page, or examples of content you’ve worked on that demonstrate your thinking and execution.
* You don’t need to know everything. But you do need to be curious, proactive, and capable of turning ideas into output.

Bonus Points If…

* You’re already a content creator with a personal page or an active audience.
* You’ve built a page, grown an account, or created content that has performed well organically.
* You understand creator culture and know how to approach creators without sounding like a copy-pasted brand email.
* You can show us a reel and explain why it worked, not just that it went viral.
* The Creator Bonus
* Already creating content? There’s an opportunity to earn an additional ₹15,000–₹30,000 per month!
* If you’re an active creator who can bring your own content creation skills and audience understanding to the table, you could earn additional compensation based on the scope of creator work and agreed deliverables.

Who Should Apply?

We care more about your ideas, instincts, and ability to execute than a long list of certificates.

If you’re the person sending friends reels with “we should do something like this,” spotting trends before they peak, writing scripts in your Notes app, and figuring out how to make things happen without being told every step, we’d like to meet you.

title: Marketing Operations & AI Manager
description:
**Job Description**
As Marketing Operations & AI Manager for Asia and Emerging Markets, you run the region's marketing technology, data, automation, and reporting. You own the platforms, integrations, data, dashboards, and AI workflows that the whole marketing team depends on, and you keep them working. This is the systems and data layer underneath marketing, distinct from campaign operations, who build and ship the campaigns themselves. Your job is to keep the demand engine running reliably, the data clean, and marketing's contribution to pipeline measurable and trusted. TR is investing in AEM marketing so it runs on better systems and practical automation. Done well, this role takes manual, repetitive work off the team, gives everyone reporting they can rely on, and makes AI an everyday tool rather than a project.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Run the marketing technology stack: administer, configure, and maintain the regional marketing technology platforms and their integrations day to day, including Eloqua (or the regional marketing automation platform) and Salesforce, covering system configuration, user management, data flows, and platform migrations.
* Own the lead lifecycle and routing: build and maintain lead capture, scoring, and lifecycle management, the routing rules, and the MQL to SQL definitions and handoff into business development and sales, so leads move cleanly and fast.
* Own reporting, analysis, and insight: own the KPI and reporting framework and the data behind it, including tracking and attribution; analyse marketing and pipeline performance; and turn the numbers into clear insight and recommendations for marketing and commercial leaders, what they mean and what to do. Build and maintain reporting in Power BI and SQL, and guide the more junior analyst who produces routine reporting.
* Build AI and automation into the work: design, build, and run AI and agent workflows for repetitive operations tasks such as data hygiene, lead routing, segmentation, reporting, and localisation, turning manual effort into fast, reliable automation.
* Keep data clean and compliant: maintain data quality, enrichment and the integrity of records, and keep marketing activity compliant with data regulation across AEM markets.
* Keep marketing organised: maintain campaign taxonomy, naming, and the standard processes and templates that keep marketing consistent across markets, and support budget tracking and reporting.
* Document, train, and work with vendors: create clear documentation and run onboarding and training so marketers across the region use the tools and processes consistently, and work with external vendors and platform partners.

**Required Qualifications**

* Five or more years hands-on in marketing operations, marketing technology, or go-to-market operations in a B2B technology environment.
* Strong hands-on experience administering a marketing automation platform such as Eloqua or Marketo, and Salesforce, including automation, integrations, lead scoring, and lifecycle management.
* A strong data and analytics background: you query and join data with SQL, build reporting in Power BI, and turn marketing and pipeline data into clear analysis, insight, and recommendations.
* A foundation in business analytics or data science, comfortable working with larger datasets to find and explain what is happening.
* Hands-on experience building AI and automation, including agentic AI workflows, to remove repetitive work and speed up marketing operations.
* Practical command of the lead lifecycle and a sales and marketing reporting background, including lead scoring, routing, the MQL to SQL handoff, and funnel reporting.
* Experience working across a matrixed, multi-region organisation, ideally across Asia or emerging markets.
* A self-starter who spots and fixes problems before they reach the wider team, experienced enough to set the reporting standard and guide a more junior analyst, and a clear communicator who can explain technical work to non-technical colleagues.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Any relevant certifications will be added advantage

**What’s in it For You?**

* Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
* Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
* Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
* Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
* Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
* Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

**About Us**
Thomson Reuters informs the way forward by bringing together the trusted content and technology that people and organizations need to make the right decisions. We serve professionals across legal, tax, accounting, compliance, government, and media. Our products combine highly specialized software and insights to empower professionals with the data, intelligence, and solutions needed to make informed decisions, and to help institutions in their pursuit of justice, truth, and transparency. Reuters, part of Thomson Reuters, is a world leading provider of trusted journalism and news.
  
  
We are powered by the talents of 26,000 employees across more than 70 countries, where everyone has a chance to contribute and grow professionally in flexible work environments. As a global business, we rely on the unique backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences of all employees to deliver on our business goals. To ensure we can do that, we seek talented, qualified employees in all our operations around the world regardless of race, color, sex/gender, including pregnancy, gender identity and expression, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, disability, age, marital status, citizen status, veteran status, or any other protected classification under applicable law. We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L

* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts

* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod

* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution

Must Have

* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

.

* Drive conversion rate optimisation (CRO) on the website – define and run A/B tests, and optimise listing pages, content and checkout in collaboration with the product, digital and design teams.
* Manage the end-to-end proposition lifecycle, from ideation and validation to launch and optimisation, ensuring that propositions across attractions, tours, activities and curated experiences are customer-focused, differentiated and profitable.
* Develop and implement pricing strategies, aware of the seasonality, events and festivals, booking window, demand fluctuations and competitor pricing.
* Plan and run promotions, offers and campaigns with the marketing team, measuring their impact on conversion, revenue and margin.
* Partner with the Supply Manager, Middle East and cross-functional stakeholders, including marketing, digital commerce, product, operations, finance and customer support, translating customer demand and performance data into supply priorities and delivering propositions that meet customer expectations and business goals.

.

* A deep understanding of the UAE market dynamics and trends is a must.
* Proven track record of designing and delivering successful and innovative propositions that meet customer needs and drive revenue and margin growth.

* Strong leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence and collaborate with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams.
* Creative and customer-oriented mindset, with a passion for travel and creating memorable experiences.
* Highly motivated, self-driven and results-oriented, able to work independently and collaboratively in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

 

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and benefits
* Private medical insurance
* Family friendly work environment, we understand what’s important in people’s lives
* A supportive and ambitious team to help you grow

title: Lead Risk Manager & Portfolio Owner
description:
FairMoney is a pioneering mobile banking institution specializing in extending credit to emerging markets. Established in 2017, the company currently operates primarily within Nigeria, and it has secured nearly €50 million in funding from renowned global investors, including Tiger Global, DST, and Flourish Ventures.

In alignment with its vision, FairMoney is actively constructing the foremost mobile banking platform and point-of-sale (POS) solution tailored for emerging markets. The journey began with the introduction of a digital microcredit application exclusively available on Android and iOS devices. Today, FairMoney has significantly expanded its range of services, encompassing a comprehensive suite of financial products, such as current accounts, savings accounts, debit cards, and state-of-the-art POS solutions designed to meet the needs of both merchants and agents.
**FairMoney thrives on its diverse workforce, bringing together talent from over 27 nationalities. This multicultural team drives the company's mission of reshaping financial services for underserved communities.**
To gain deeper insights into FairMoney's pivotal role in reshaping Africa's financial landscape, we invite you to watch informative video.

**The role**

We are hiring a
**Lead Risk Manager & Portfolio Owner**
to run FairMoney's Android Quick Loans portfolio in Nigeria. Android is a mature, high-volume and strategically important lending portfolio. This is a
**mini-CEO role for the portfolio**
: you will be the delegated day-to-day owner of its commercial, economic, risk and people outcomes.
  
  
**Please note this role is remote for talents in South Africa and other countries but hybrid for talents in Nigeria and India.**

**Job Description**

**Portfolio economics and business planning**

* Own Android revenue, sustainable Gross Loan Book growth, risk-adjusted Gross Profit, economic profit and credit-risk performance
* Build and own the annual Android business plan and strategic roadmap
* Produce the monthly portfolio forecast and maintain a clear bridge between actual performance, budget and prior forecast
* Diagnose material variances and drive corrective actions with clear owners and deadlines
* Manage Expected Credit Loss, ECL/Revenue, approval and disbursal rates, Average Loan Size, tenure, exposure, FPD, roll rates, PAR, NPL, repeat value and CAC payback
* Partner with Finance and Portfolio Economics on loan-level and customer-level NPV, funding efficiency and performance attribution

**End-to-end Android credit strategy**

Own and continuously improve strategy across:

* **New-to-Bank:**
  low-and-grow origination, first-loan ticket, tenure, pricing and risk controls
* **Returning:**
  repeat eligibility, behavioural strategy, offer construction and exposure growth
* **Top-Ups and Internal Consolidation:**
  eligibility, incremental exposure, pricing, conversion and post-event risk
* **High-risk segments:**
  risk-box clean-up, pricing, short-tenure treatment and exposure caps
* **Rejected-customer re-entry:**
  controlled requalification using risk, affordability and alternative data

You will own the commercial application of PD cut-offs and calibration, pricing, offers, tenure, exposure limits, affordability, income-source treatment, fraud overlays, MBS treatments and customer-routing logic.

**Affordability, experimentation and production delivery**

* Help formalise and operationalise Android affordability using bank-statement/MBS signals, transaction behaviour, SMS-derived estimates, declared income and repayment history
* Translate affordability into amount, tenure, price, exposure, Top-Up and Consolidation decisions
* Design controlled A/B, multivariate and champion/challenger tests with explicit hypotheses, maturity windows, success measures and rollback triggers
* Measure full unit economics rather than only early risk metrics
* Translate strategy into decision-engine rules, parameters and implementation requirements
* Own replay, back-testing, validation, staged rollout, monitoring and post-implementation review
* Drive cross-functional dependencies through to production rather than stopping at analysis

**Delegated decision rights**

Within agreed appetite, budgets and authority, you will be empowered to:

* Prioritise and sequence the Android portfolio roadmap
* Approve and launch controlled experiments within agreed thresholds
* Scale, pause, modify or roll back strategies against predefined evidence and guardrails
* Reallocate team capacity across Android workstreams
* Escalate and resolve delivery blockers

You will escalate decisions that exceed delegated financial or risk thresholds, change company-level risk appetite, create material legal or customer-conduct implications, or materially affect another portfolio.

**Team and cross-functional leadership**

* Build and lead a senior Android credit-strategy team with clear workstream ownership
* Establish strong weekly and monthly portfolio rhythms
* Develop credible workstream owners and at least one portfolio deputy
* Reduce key-person dependency through documentation, controls and repeatable processes
* Work closely with Decision Science, Product, Engineering, Growth, Finance, Portfolio Economics, Collections, Fraud, Compliance, Legal, Operations and Customer Service
* Mobilise these partners around clear briefs, owners, timelines and expected economic impact

**Requirements**

* 6+ years in consumer credit risk, credit strategy or lending portfolio management
* Proven ownership of a material lending portfolio or product line, including revenue, GLB, risk and profitability
* Experience building annual business plans, monthly forecasts and corrective action plans
* Strong digital unsecured-lending experience; Nigerian or broader African-market experience is strongly preferred
* Advanced understanding of PD, LGD, EAD, vintages, roll rates, IFRS 9/ECL, pricing, offers, tenure, exposure, affordability and NPV
* Strong SQL capability and comfort with Python or equivalent analytical tooling
* Experience translating credit strategy into decision-engine rules and controlled production changes
* Evidence of building senior teams, developing successors and leading complex cross-functional delivery
* Strong executive communication and the confidence to challenge decisions with evidence

**Benefits**

* 25 days paid vacation, Sick & Public Holidays to B2B contractors
* Remote (timezone must have significant overlap with CET)
* Training & Development budget
* Paid company business trips

**Recruitment Process**

* A screening interview with one of the members of the Talent Acquisition team
* Business Case Study
* Technical interview with Global Head of Android Lending
* Final Interview with Chief Credit Officer

title: App Monetization Manager
description:
Company: Oogway Apps (oogwaysapps.com)

Function: Growth / Monetisation

Location:[City / Remote / Hybrid]

Reports to:[Head of Growth / Head of Product / COO]

Employment type: Full-time

**About Oogway Apps**

Oogway Apps builds and operates a portfolio of mobile apps across gaming and non-gaming categories. We are looking for a monetisation owner who can grow revenue across the portfolio while protecting user experience and retention.

**Role Overview**

You will own the monetisation strategy and execution for a set of apps in the Oogway portfolio, covering both ad revenue (IAA) and in-app purchases and subscriptions (IAP). You will work with product, engineering, UA/marketing, design, and analytics to design monetisation systems, run experiments, optimise yield, and improve LTV and ARPDAU, while keeping ROAS and retention healthy.

**Key ResponsibilitiesAd monetisation**

* Own ad revenue for assigned apps across rewarded, interstitial, banner, native, app-open, and MREC formats.
* Manage mediation platforms (e.g., AppLovin MAX, Google AdMob/AdMob Mediation, IronSource/LevelPlay, Unity LevelPlay) and ad network integrations (e.g., Meta Audience Network, Unity Ads, Mintegral, Pangle, Liftoff/Vungle, InMobi, Moloco).
* Optimise waterfalls and bidding setups, floor prices, placements, frequency caps, pacing, and ad-unit configurations by geo, user cohort, and app version.
* Run A/B tests on ad placements, formats, timing, and session-level ad load to maximise ARPDAU without hurting retention or session length.
* Monitor fill rates, eCPMs, show rates, latency, and ad quality, and work with partner account managers to resolve issues and unlock better demand.
* Ensure ad quality and compliance through creative filtering, category blocking, and malicious or misleading ad monitoring.

**IAP and subscription monetisation**

* Own IAP and subscription revenue, including pricing, packaging, offers, paywalls, trials, and promotions.
* Design and test store catalogues, price points, regional pricing, bundles, starter packs, and limited-time offers (gaming), and paywall designs, trial structures, and annual-vs-monthly mix (non-gaming).
* Work on conversion, payer penetration, ARPPU, renewal rate, churn, and win-back strategies.
* Manage subscription tooling and billing infrastructure (e.g., RevenueCat, Adapty, native Google Play Billing / StoreKit).

**Hybrid monetisation and LTV**

* Build the right mix of ads and IAP for each app based on genre, audience, and geography.
* Model LTV by cohort, channel, and geo, and partner with the UA team to set bidding targets and payback windows.
* Identify new revenue levers such as offerwalls, rewarded video economies, sponsorships, or premium tiers.

**Analytics and reporting**

* Build and maintain dashboards for revenue, ARPDAU, eCPM, impressions per DAU, conversion, ARPPU, LTV, and ROAS.
* Run cohort, funnel, and segmentation analysis to find opportunities and diagnose revenue drops.
* Deliver weekly and monthly performance reports with clear insights, forecasts, and recommendations.

**Cross-functional collaboration**

* Work with product and design to integrate monetisation into game economies and app flows without harming the experience.
* Work with engineering on SDK integrations, updates, QA, and release management for ad and billing SDKs.
* Work with UA/marketing to align monetisation with acquisition strategy and ensure positive unit economics.
* Keep apps compliant with Google Play and App Store policies, privacy regulations (GDPR, CCPA), consent frameworks (CMP/UMP), ATT, and COPPA where relevant.

**Requirements:**

**Must have**

* 3–6 years of experience in mobile app monetisation, ad ops, or product growth, with hands-on ownership of ad revenue and/or IAP.
* Strong working knowledge of mediation platforms, programmatic and bidding concepts, and ad network ecosystems.
* Proven track record of improving ARPDAU, eCPM, conversion, or LTV through structured experimentation.
