title: Growth Marketing Manager
description:
**Job title: Head of Growth & Operations - Marketing Agency**

**Job Overview**

The ideal candidate must have prior experience in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency, along with a strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, project management, and business development. The role requires a hands-on professional who can streamline workflows, improve operational efficiency, manage client relationships, and independently generate new business opportunities.

Working closely with the founder and internal teams, the selected candidate will establish accountability, improve client satisfaction, optimize processes, and contribute to the agency's revenue growth.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Operations & Process Management**

* Lead weekly internal team meetings to review progress, resolve challenges, and align priorities.
* Monitor client performance reports to identify significant changes in revenue, paid traffic, organic traffic, and other key performance indicators.
* Conduct sprint planning and review meetings to ensure timely task execution and adherence to workflows in ClickUp.
* Coordinate with the founder to review operational performance, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Participate in client meetings to assess service quality, review deliverables, and ensure client expectations are met.
* Act as the primary escalation point for client issues and coordinate with internal teams for timely resolution.
* Work with account managers to ensure deliverables meet agreed Scope of Work (SoW) requirements.
* Oversee client invoicing, invoice dispatch, payment follow-ups, and related coordination.
* Identify workflow improvement opportunities and implement automation using Zapier, Slack, ClickUp, or equivalent platforms.
* Prepare and circulate a weekly internal newsletter covering team updates, achievements, progress, and important announcements.

**2. Team Management & Performance Enablement**

* Ensure new employees complete onboarding, role-specific training, and assessments before independently handling deliverables.
* Develop structured assessments and evaluation frameworks to measure employee knowledge, skills, and role readiness.
* Coordinate with HR and team leads to ensure timely completion of employee performance reviews.
* Establish clear performance goals, accountability measures, and productivity benchmarks across teams.
* Identify operational gaps and implement improvements to enhance efficiency and team performance.
* Support team leads in improving coordination, resource utilization, and delivery quality.

**3. Sales, Business Development & Revenue Growth**

* Collaborate with the lead generation team to strengthen the sales pipeline and improve prospect conversion.
* Work with the founder on sales calls, prospect meetings, presentations, proposals, and business development initiatives.
* Independently identify and approach potential clients through LinkedIn, professional networks, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Build and maintain a personal sales pipeline to generate new business opportunities and contribute directly to revenue growth.
* Establish and manage structured CRM processes for lead tracking, follow-ups, pipeline management, and conversion reporting.
* Develop lead-nurturing strategies through email marketing and consistent follow-ups to re-engage prospects.
* Identify opportunities for strategic partnerships, new service offerings, and alternative revenue streams.
* Explore industry awards, recognitions, and other initiatives to strengthen the agency's brand positioning and credibility.

**4. Freelancer & Resource Management**

* Identify and engage skilled freelancers through professional networks, industry communities, Fiverr, Upwork, and other relevant platforms.
* Build and maintain a reliable network of specialized external resources to support project requirements.
* Prepare job descriptions, project briefs, and scope requirements for freelance assignments.
* Coordinate resource allocation based on project timelines, client requirements, and business priorities.
* Evaluate freelancers based on expertise, reliability, work quality, and ability to meet deadlines.

**Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Minimum 6 years of relevant professional experience.
* **Prior experience in a digital marketing or performance marketing agency is essential.**
* MBA preferred; candidates with relevant experience and strong business acumen may also be considered.
* Strong understanding of agency operations, client servicing, account management, and project delivery.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, sales, lead conversion, and revenue generation.
* Experience managing CRM systems, sales pipelines, client relationships, and prospect follow-ups.
* Hands-on familiarity with project management and automation tools such as ClickUp, Slack, and Zapier, or equivalent platforms.
* Ability to interpret client performance reports, identify potential risks, and coordinate corrective actions.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, leadership, and stakeholder management skills.
* Strong problem-solving abilities and the capacity to manage multiple priorities independently.
* Process-driven mindset with the ability to establish scalable systems and improve operational efficiency.
* Willingness to take ownership of both operational responsibilities and independent business development.
* Immediate joiners will be preferred.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Consistent execution of internal workflows, sprint plans, and operational processes.
* Timely delivery of client commitments and effective resolution of escalations.
* Improved client satisfaction, service quality, and adherence to agreed SoWs.
* Successful implementation of process improvements and automation initiatives.
* Timely completion of employee onboarding, training, assessments, and performance reviews.
* Effective resource allocation, team productivity, and operational accountability.
* Implementation of structured CRM processes, consistent follow-ups, and improved pipeline visibility.
* Generation of qualified business opportunities, improved lead conversion, and contribution to revenue growth.
* Development of strategic partnerships and initiatives that enhance the agency's market presence.

title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

**About The Role**
The SBU Connectivity Product Management Lead is the portfolio-level owner for product management, product evolution, go-to-market orchestration, and lifecycle value realization across SBU Connectivity. The role consolidates the former product-specific Business Lead responsibilities into one Product Management organization while maintaining distinct product lines for telematics and connectivity offerings and clear interfaces with the Global Business Lead for overall commercial/business ownership.
  
  
You will translate market, customer, technology, and RFQ signals into a coherent portfolio roadmap, investment priorities, differentiated product propositions, and executable business cases. Drive a product-first operating model that increases reuse, reduces bespoke development, improves R&D return, and strengthens global market adoption through close partnership with NPI, Systems/Solution Architecture, Product Engineering, Global RFQ/Early Engagement, Global Delivery, Finance, Sales, and the Global Business Lead.
  
  
You will lead a globally distributed team of product managers and regional GTM product managers and influences a broad matrix spanning engineering, architecture, delivery, finance, sales, marketing, and customer teams. Success requires enterprise-level judgment across multiple product lines, regions, customers, investment horizons, and technology generations.
  
  
Manage the global Product Management organization spanning telematics/connectivity product lines and regional GTM product management in the Americas, Europe, Japan, India/APAC and other priority markets. You

**What You Will Do**

* Own Portfolio Product Management: Drive product evolution, 3–5-year roadmaps and lifecycle decisions across Connectivity, balancing customer value, technical feasibility, and profitability.
* Lead GTM & Regional Product Management: Convert market and Voice-of-Customer signals into product priorities, positioning, value propositions, sales enablement and launch readiness.
* Partner for Growth: Work with Global Business Lead, Sales and RFQ/Early Engagement to shape opportunities around scalable products and derivatives rather than bespoke solutions.
* Own Product Business Cases & Value Realization: Establish product investment logic across market potential, pricing, revenue, margin, R&D, lifecycle cost, reuse and ROI in partnership with Finance.
* Manage Product Performance: Track adoption, pipeline fit, reuse, financial contribution, roadmap execution and customer feedback, taking corrective action when expected value is not realized.
* Connect NPI to Product Ownership: Partner with NPI to mature new concepts and technology opportunities into validated product propositions with disciplined transition into portfolio ownership.
* Drive Cross-Functional Product Realization: Partner with Architecture, Engineering and Global Delivery to translate market needs into scalable platforms, executable roadmaps and reusable production-ready releases.
* Establish Product Management Excellence: Standardize MRD/PRD, roadmap, business case, launch, lifecycle and decision frameworks while resolving cross-product priorities at portfolio level.
* Build Global Product Leadership: Develop a high-performing global Product Management and GTM organization with strong accountability, a customer-centric, data-driven, product-first culture.

**What You Need To Be Successful**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Business or a related field; advanced technical or business degree preferred.
* 20+ years of progressive experience in automotive, connectivity, technology or adjacent industries, including significant leadership responsibility across product management, business development, GTM and product commercialization.
* 10+ years leading senior, globally distributed teams and complex matrix organizations across multiple regions, customers and product lines.
* Demonstrated ownership of multi-product roadmaps, product lifecycle decisions, business cases, pricing/value propositions, investment prioritization and go-to-market execution.
* Strong business and financial acumen with the ability to balance revenue, margin, R&D investment, product reuse, time-to-market and long-term portfolio value.
* Broad understanding of automotive connectivity and telematics technologies including cellular/5G, V2X, Wi-Fi/Bluetooth/GNSS, cloud/edge services, cybersecurity, OTA and automotive-grade hardware/software platforms.
* Proven ability to convert customer and market needs into differentiated, scalable product propositions while resisting unnecessary bespoke complexity.
* Executive communication and influencing skills with credibility across customers, senior leadership, engineering, sales, finance, partners and globally distributed teams.
* Ability to make high-quality decisions under ambiguity and lead transformation across organizational boundaries without relying solely on direct authority.

**Bonus Points if You Have**

* MBA or advanced degree paired with a technical undergraduate degree.
* Experience leading telematics/connectivity portfolios spanning mobility segments.
* Experience with ecosystem partnerships, new business models, software/services monetization and global OEM commercialization.

**What Makes You Eligible**

* You are willing to travel up to 30% domestic and 15% international travel.
* Due to the nature of global teams and customer base, you understand that flexibility in working hours is required.

title: Commercial Director - Waldorf Astoria Bangalore
description:

* Align sales and marketing efforts: Coordinate on-property and regional sales, marketing, eCommerce, and public relations activities to support brand positioning and drive demand
* Adapt to market dynamics: Monitor trends, assess competitive landscape, and adjust commercial strategies to stay ahead in evolving market conditions
* Strengthen stakeholder relationships: Build trusted relationships with owners, operators, Hilton corporate teams, and external partners to align goals and create long-term commercial value
* Cultivate a high-performing team: Drive engagement and retention through performance management, professional development, and recognition programs

**Qualifications**
At Hilton, our core values define what it takes to succeed here and guide the qualities we look for in every team member:
  
  
A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

* Minimum 3 years of experience leading and managing sales or commercial teams.
* Proven Commercial Director experience in luxury hotels.

title: Senior Manager (Strategic PR, Branding & Communications)
description:
**🚀 About Joveo**

Joveo builds AI-powered recruiting technology. We are looking for someone who can help make Joveo a company people turn to for a clear, informed view on AI and the future of hiring.

You will help bring the ideas, expertise and work inside the company into the conversations that matter to our business.

**🌟 About the role**

We are hiring a communications professional with an editor’s instinct for a story and the initiative to make it happen. You can spot an angle in a customer conversation, draw a compelling point of view out of a founder, and earn attention for work that deserves it.

Reporting directly to the
**Chief of Strategic Initiatives & Global Supply Officer**
, you will lead strategic PR and leadership visibility. You will work closely with senior stakeholders to shape Joveo’s corporate narrative and advise on where we should speak, what we can credibly say and which opportunities deserve our attention.

**Strategic PR is the primary mandate.**
Creative brand campaigns are an important extension of it. We want someone who brings original ideas, understands how different channels work and can turn a strong story into a campaign people remember.

**🧠 What you’ll do**

* Develop Joveo’s corporate narrative. Get close to our leaders, customers and subject experts. Find the evidence behind the story and turn it into compelling pitches, commentary, contributed articles and briefing material.
* Build a sustained earned-media program across relevant business, technology, startup and industry publications. Develop relationships with journalists, editors, newsletters and podcasts by understanding their audiences and bringing them useful ideas.
* Strengthen leadership visibility. Develop distinctive points of view, prepare executives for interviews and identify relevant speaking opportunities. Make the message sharper while preserving the person’s voice.
* Lead communications around approved company milestones, product developments and funding announcements when relevant. Prepare FAQs, manage media enquiries and advise leadership when an issue requires a careful response.
* Originate creative campaigns that support our PR priorities. Turn customer insights, company expertise or a timely point of view into an editorial series, collaboration, event or other relevant format. Own the brief and channel choices, coordinating specialists where needed.
* Use paid PR selectively and make the budget work harder. Assess sponsored content, distribution, events and agencies against a clear audience, objective and cost. Find resourceful ways to build visibility through earned and owned channels.
* Measure whether the work is making a difference. Track coverage relevance, message accuracy, audience engagement and attributable inbound interest. Keep paid exposure distinct from earned coverage and use the results to improve the next campaign.

**🎯 What we’re looking for**

* You have personally earned relevant coverage for a technology business, startup or agency client. You can explain how you found the story, pitched it and adapted when the first approach did not work.
* You know India’s business and technology media and have relevant working relationships.
* You write and edit exceptionally well. You can understand a complex product and explain why it matters in language people want to read.
* You are comfortable advising senior leaders, questioning a weak angle and recommending a stronger one.
* You have originated a campaign, collaboration or channel idea that made an impact. You can show your contribution and explain the audience insight behind it.
* You are resourceful with a focused budget and can take an idea through execution. Experience in AI, enterprise technology, corporate milestone communications or international media is useful.

**✨ Why join Joveo**

You will help shape the story while it is being formed, with direct access to senior leadership and responsibility for how it reaches the public.

There is room to bring your own editorial judgment and pursue original ideas. Your work will influence how customers, prospective hires and the wider business community understand Joveo, with PR at the centre and creative thinking throughout.

title: Pricing Lead
description:
Job Purpose and Impact
  
  
The Pricing Lead will serve as the strategic pricing business partner to the India Managing Director and leadership team, owning and running the in-market pricing operating system. The role converts cost, market, customer, portfolio and value signals into disciplined pricing decisions that improve sustainable margin per metric ton and total material margin.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Act as strategic pricing partner and constructive challenger to the Managing Director, commercial leadership and cross-functional leaders, translating analysis into clear recommendations and navigating difficult pricing, margin and volume trade-offs.
* Own and continuously improve the India pricing operating system, including pricing committee routines, Price Build, pricing governance, decision records, escalation paths, action tracking and cross-functional cost-into-pricing updates.
* Define and govern price-realization, discount, rebate, promotion and exception frameworks, ensuring differentiated pricing is intentional, linked to customer value and segmentation, and not hidden in discretionary concessions.
* Drive local adoption and business use of enterprise pricing capabilities, including Price Build, Customer Profitability, PriceFX and scalable analytics, while identifying data-quality gaps, adoption blockers and market requirements.
* Lead the execution of multiple profitability optimization projects and deploy strategic pricing capabilities for the various business groups aligned with their strategies, market dynamics and needs.
* Define roadmaps and execute initiatives by leading new approaches for large deal negotiations.
* Develop execution strategies for the deployment of pricing as an end to end process from strategic considerations to actual price setting techniques, governance and supporting technology.
* Review business need assessments with regard to data and technological requirements and make realistic return on investment recommendations.
* Monitor trends and pricing developments and trends and ensure new thought leadership and new capabilities are introduced across business groups.
* Evaluate hypotheses for profit improvement opportunities, validate with data and facts and execute the strategy for deployment projects to capitalize on the opportunities.
* Other duties as assigned

**Qualifications**
Minimum Qualifications
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in a related field or equivalent experience
* Analytical proficiency to derive insights from large and complex sets of business data
* Financial knowledge for profit and loss, margin and price decision making
* Experienced in project and change management

**Preferred Qualifications**

The Associate Domain Architect / Solutions Architect supports the evolution of Commercial technology capabilities by partnering with domain architect, business stakeholders, product owners, engineering teams, enterprise architects, and vendors to design scalable, compliant, and business-aligned solutions.

This role serves as a bridge between business strategy, domain architecture, and solution delivery, ensuring technology investments align with enterprise standards, capability roadmaps, and target-state architecture. Join Gilead and help create possible, together.

Architecture & Solution Delivery

* Support project teams in preparing architecture documentation and obtaining required approvals.

* Ensure adherence to enterprise security, privacy, quality, and regulatory standards throughout the solution lifecycle.

* Assist with risk identification, mitigation planning, and architectural decision-making.

* Evaluate emerging technologies, vendor solutions, and platform roadmaps to provide architecture recommendations aligned with business strategy and long-term sustainability.

  

Required Qualifications:

  

Education:

Experience:

* Experience designing and delivering enterprise-scale technology solutions across applications, integrations, cloud platforms, or data ecosystems.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

  

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.  

  

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.  

  

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.  

  

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.  

  

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.  

  

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

  

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.  

  

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior BDE HORECA
description:
**Role Overview**

Bayar’s Coffee is looking for a results-driven Senior Business Development Executive to drive business growth in the HoReCa segment (Hotels, Restaurants and Cafés). The candidate should possess strong communication, negotiation, MIS, quotation preparation, and tender management skills, with the ability to acquire new clients and negotiate commercial and payment terms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business Development:** Identify and acquire new HoReCa customers, including hotels, restaurants, cafés, caterers, and institutional clients.
* **Quotations & Negotiations:** Prepare quotations and negotiate pricing, margins, commercial terms, and payment structures.
* **Tender Management:** Identify relevant tenders, prepare documentation, participate in bidding, and follow up until closure.
* **Client Relationship Management:** Build strong client relationships, understand customer requirements, and drive customer retention.
* **Commercial & Payment Management:** Negotiate credit periods and payment terms while ensuring adherence to company policies.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Maintain sales reports, customer databases, quotation trackers, tender status, payment follow-ups, and sales forecasts using MS Excel.
* **Sales Target Achievement:** Achieve assigned sales targets and develop new business opportunities.
* **Internal Coordination:** Coordinate with finance, operations, and supply chain teams to ensure smooth order execution and timely deliveries.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* MBA in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related specialisation.
* 2–3 years of experience in B2B sales or business development, preferably in HoReCa, FMCG, food, or beverage industries.
* Excellent English communication and business correspondence skills.
* Strong proficiency in MS Excel, MIS reporting, and data analysis.
* Experience in quotation preparation, commercial negotiations, tender documentation, and e-tender bidding.
* Ability to negotiate payment terms, credit periods, and commercial agreements.
* Strong presentation, client management, and problem-solving skills.

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Leave encashment
* Provident Fund

title: Spare Parts Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities

A. Spare Parts Procurement

* Identify and procure spare parts for multiple car brands serviced by the company.
* Source parts from authorized dealers, distributors, OEM suppliers, and approved aftermarket vendors.
* Obtain quotations, compare prices, negotiate discounts, and ensure timely procurement.
* Verify part numbers, specifications, compatibility, and quality before placing orders.
* Coordinate with vendors for urgent requirements, returns, warranty claims, and replacements.

B. Inventory & Stock Management

* Maintain accurate stock records in the ERP, inventory management system, or workshop software.
* Monitor fast-moving, slow-moving, non-moving, and critical spare parts.
* Maintain minimum and maximum stock levels based on vehicle inflow and consumption patterns.
* Conduct regular physical stock verification and reconcile discrepancies.
* Ensure proper storage, labeling, bin location management, and preservation of parts.
* Minimize stock-outs, excess inventory, dead stock, and inventory losses.

C. Workshop Coordination

* Coordinate with service advisors, technicians, and workshop supervisors to identify parts requirements.
* Check parts availability against job cards and service estimates.
* Issue spare parts against authorized job cards and record all transactions.
* Arrange urgent parts to avoid delays in vehicle repair and delivery.
* Track pending parts and communicate expected delivery timelines to the service team.
* Ensure correct parts are supplied for each vehicle to minimize incorrect fitment and rework.

D. Billing & Documentation

* Prepare purchase orders, goods receipt notes (GRNs), material issue slips, and return documents.
* Ensure purchase invoices match purchase orders and goods received.
* Maintain accurate records of purchases, sales, consumption, returns, and warranty replacements.
* Coordinate with accounts for invoice verification, vendor payments, and credit note follow-ups.
* Ensure proper documentation for stock transfers, inter-branch movements, and vendor claims.

E. Vendor Management

* Develop and maintain a reliable vendor network for multi-brand spare parts.
* Evaluate vendors on pricing, quality, availability, delivery time, and return policies.
* Maintain vendor rate lists and periodically review purchase costs.
* Resolve supply discrepancies, damaged parts, incorrect deliveries, and quality issues.
* Identify opportunities for cost savings without compromising quality or vehicle safety.

F. Quality & Compliance

* Ensure parts are sourced from approved and reliable suppliers.
* Verify packaging, labels, part numbers, and visible condition upon receipt.
* Follow company policies for genuine OEM, OEM-equivalent, and approved aftermarket parts.
* Ensure customer-approved parts and pricing are followed wherever applicable.
* Prevent the use of counterfeit, substandard, or unauthorized safety-critical components.

G. Reporting & Cost Control

* Prepare daily and monthly reports on purchases, stock availability, consumption, and pending orders.
* Track inventory value, stock turnover, obsolete stock, and parts-related repair delays.
* Monitor spare parts gross margin where applicable.
* Identify opportunities to reduce procurement costs and improve inventory efficiency.
* Support periodic audits and management reviews.

3. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Spare parts availability and fill rate.
* Reduction in vehicle repair delays caused by parts shortages.
* Inventory accuracy and stock variance.
* Inventory turnover and reduction in dead stock.
* Purchase cost savings and vendor performance.
* Accuracy of parts issued against job cards.
* Timely closure of returns, warranty claims, and vendor discrepancies.
* Compliance with purchase, inventory, and billing procedures.

Qualifications & Experience

* Diploma or degree in Automobile Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Supply Chain Management, or a related field; relevant practical experience may be considered.
* 2–5 years of experience in automotive spare parts, dealership stores, multi-brand workshops, or automotive distribution.
* Knowledge of multi-brand passenger car spare parts and part-number identification.
* Experience with inventory software, ERP systems, or workshop management systems.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel and basic inventory reporting.

Required Skills

* Strong knowledge of automotive spare parts and vehicle compatibility.
* Vendor sourcing, negotiation, and cost-control skills.

title: Sales Support Specialist
description:
At ABB, we help industries run leaner and cleaner—and every person here makes that happen. You’ll be empowered to lead, supported to grow, and proud of the impact we create together. Join us and help run what runs the world.

This Position reports to:

Sales Support Manager

**Your role and responsibilities:**

This is a 'Sales Support Specialist - Electrification' role in Process Industries Division. In this role, you will have the opportunity to support the assigned Sales organization (Process Industries division) and customers during the proposal process. Each day, you will serve as a key technical resource in the assigned area. You will also showcase your technical skill by preparing technical descriptions of the products and technology, determining costs, and preparing final documentation.

The work model for the role is: #LI - Onsite

This role is contributing to the Automation – Process Industries business. Main stakeholders are customers, EPCs/consultants, sales and engineering teams, product management, and project execution functions.

**You will be mainly accountable for:**

* Delivering technical consultation and optimized electrification solutions by analyzing customer requirements, reviewing specifications, and defining clear scopes with transparent cost and responsibility mapping.
* Preparing comprehensive techno-commercial proposals including bill of quantities, cost estimation, and competitive bid strategies while identifying and managing commercial, technical, and contractual risks.
* Collaborating with engineering, service, vendors, and product units to develop value-driven proposals and support sales growth through technical presentations, workshops, and customer problem resolution.
* Managing customer engagement and pre-sales activities to acquire orders, improve profitability, and meet key performance metrics including order intake, Net Price Variance (NPV), and Net Promoter Score (NPS).
* Ensuring business objectives are met, including revenue growth, volume targets, and profitable expansion across assigned product portfolios, industries, and geographic markets.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Bachelor’s degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electrical & Electronics Engineering, or a related discipline from a reputed university or institution.
* 10-18 years of experience in technical sales, bids & proposals, engineering, or solution development for large-scale electrification projects across Mining, Metals, Cement, Paper, and other process industries.
* Extensive technical proficiency in Electrical Power Distribution Systems, including HV Substations (AIS & GIS), MV & LT Switchgear, Intelligent MCCs, Transformers, Busducts, Battery Chargers, Cable Management Systems, and associated electrical infrastructure.
* Extensive knowledge of motor and drive sizing, selection, and application engineering for process industry requirements, particularly in mining equipment, metals processing plants, profile mills, cement plants, and paper manufacturing facilities.
* Hands-on experience in preparing techno-commercial proposals, solution engineering, and customer-facing technical discussions, supported by strong written and verbal communication skills with fluency in English.
* Proficiency in electrical system studies and engineering tools such as ETAP, with additional experience in E-house solutions, substation automation systems, and integrated electrification solutions considered a strong advantage.

**More about us:**

The Process Industries Division serves the mining, minerals processing, metals, cement, pulp and paper, battery manufacturing, and food and beverage, as well as their associated service industries. The Division brings deep industry domain expertise coupled with the ability to integrate both automation and electrical systems, increase productivity and reduce overall capital and operating costs for customers. For mining, metals and cement customers, solutions include specialized products and services, as well as total production systems. The Division designs, plans, engineers, supplies, installs and commissions integrated electrical and motion systems, including electric equipment, drives, motors, high power rectifiers and equipment for automation and supervisory control within a variety of areas including mineral handling, mining operations, aluminum smelting, hot and cold steel applications and cement production. The offering for the pulp and paper industries includes control systems, quality control systems, drive systems, on-line sensors, actuators and field instruments. Digitalization solutions, including collaborative operations and augmented reality, help improve plant and enterprise productivity, and reduce maintenance and energy costs.

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

**Customer & Stakeholder Engagement**

**Essential Experience & Qualifications**

* Significant experience leading Professional Services or Delivery organisations within enterprise software, ideally in financial technology or capital markets.

* **Collaborative by nature.** Builds strong working relationships across Sales, Product, Engineering, and Finance — and earns trust at every level.
* **Decisive under pressure.** Able to navigate ambiguity and make well-reasoned decisions in complex, fast-moving environments.
* **Inclusive leadership.** Creates psychological safety, values diverse perspectives, and develops people with genuine care and commitment.

* Demonstrated proficiency in coding or scripting (e.g., Python, Go) and experience with log parsing, data normalization, and automation logic.

**About the job**
-----------------

When leading companies choose Google Cloud, it's a huge win for spreading the power of cloud computing globally. Once educational institutions, government agencies, and other businesses sign on to use Google Cloud products, you come in to facilitate making their work more productive, mobile, and collaborative. You listen and deliver what is most helpful for the customer. You assist fellow sales Googlers by problem-solving key technical issues for our customers. You liaise with the product marketing management and engineering teams to stay on top of industry trends and devise enhancements to Google Cloud products.

As a Customer Engineer (CE) for Google Cloud Security, you serve as the technical bridge between our most innovative security technologies and our customers' most complex business challenges. You are not just a technical advisor; you are a strategic partner to the Sales team, responsible for articulating the unique value proposition of Google Cloud’s security ecosystem.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Act as the primary technical advisor, partnering with Sales to build and execute account strategies that win trust and drive adoption of Google Cloud Security solutions.
* Design creative, scalable, and resilient security architectures that map directly to our customers’ specific business goals and operational challenges.
* Lead technical validations, including Proofs of Concept (PoC) and technical deep-dives, proactively identify and remove roadblocks to ensure project success.
* Serve as an expert storyteller who can translate complex cybersecurity concepts into compelling, practical business outcomes for both technical practitioners and executive stakeholders.
* Partner with product development stakeholders to refine product capabilities, contributing technical insights that optimize performance and market relevance.

title: Solutions Architect | India
description:
#### **Why Cast AI?**

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don't. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

**Global team, diverse perspectives**  
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

**Unicorn momentum**  
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

**Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.**

#### **About this role:**

We are hiring a Solutions Architect to join our Customer Success team and support strategic customers across APAC.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role for someone with strong Kubernetes, SRE and DevOps experience. You will work alongside Technical Account Managers and Client Partners, becoming the escalation point when a customer conversation requires deeper technical expertise, stronger architecture guidance or support with a complex production issue.

You will work directly with customers to understand their Kubernetes environment, diagnose technical challenges, guide them towards the right Cast AI solution and help them realise more value from the platform. You will also identify and support expansion opportunities, including positioning Omni where it can solve a meaningful customer problem.

This is not a traditional post-sales support role. You need to be comfortable in front of senior technical stakeholders, able to explain complex Kubernetes topics clearly and willing to travel to customer sites when needed.

The role covers APAC.

#### **Requirements:**

* Six to twelve years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Solutions Engineering or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience. You need to understand how clusters, workloads, networking, scaling and resource management operate in production.
* Meaningful prior experience as an SRE or DevOps Engineer. This is essential. Candidates without a real operational background are unlikely to succeed in the technical interview or the role.
* Experience troubleshooting production incidents, including diagnosing root cause, resolving the issue and implementing improvements afterwards.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and modern cloud-native tooling.
* Able to communicate technical concepts in a logical, clear and customer-friendly way.
* Comfortable speaking with engineering leaders, platform teams, SREs, DevOps teams and senior technical stakeholders.
* Interested in a customer-facing role, whether you already work with customers or want to move from a deeply technical role into one.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, less structured environment where ownership and initiative matter.
* Willing to travel to customer locations for a few days per month.

#### **Responsibilities****:**

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for strategic and complex customer conversations.
* Partner with Technical Account Managers on customer onboarding, adoption, technical risk and platform value.
* Work with Client Partners to identify and support expansion opportunities within existing customers.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to understand their Kubernetes architecture, workloads, operational challenges and priorities.
* Advise customers on Kubernetes reliability, efficiency, scaling and platform best practices.
* Help customers diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving Kubernetes clusters, workloads, resource management, networking or platform reliability.
* Represent Cast AI in customer meetings, technical workshops and occasional on-site visits across APAC.
* Support the commercial adoption of Omni by connecting product capabilities to genuine customer needs.
* Share recurring customer feedback, technical blockers and product opportunities with Product and Engineering teams.
* Work closely with a team of SREs and cloud infrastructure specialists within Customer Success.

**What You'll Do:**

LogicMonitor® is the AI-first hybrid observability platform powering the next generation of digital infrastructure. LogicMonitor delivers complete visibility and actionable intelligence across on-premises, cloud, and edge environments. By anticipating issues before they strike, optimizing resources in real time, and enabling faster, smarter decisions, LogicMonitor helps IT and business leaders protect margins, accelerate innovation, and deliver exceptional digital experiences without compromise.

Our customers love LogicMonitor's ability to bring cloud and traditional IT together into one view, as seen in minimal churn rates, expansion business, and exciting new customer references. In fact, LogicMonitor has received the highest Net Promoter Score of any IT Infrastructure Management provider. LogicMonitor also boasts high employee satisfaction. We have been certified as a Great Place To Work®, and named one of BuiltIn's Best Places to Work for the seventh year in a row!

The **Customer Technical Architect (CTA)** serves as the premier technical authority and trusted advisor for strategic enterprise accounts. Acting at the intersection of Internet Infrastructure, Cloud Migrations, and next-generation Agentic AI observability, the CTA ensures enterprise clients successfully design, integrate, scale, and monitor complex digital experiences across multi-cloud and AI-driven environments. Customer Architects will work closely across Sales, Customer Success, Professional Services and Product teams to provide technical know-how, common tooling and frameworks that solve common customer problems that fall outside the current goals of the product organization and scope of professional service engagements. Customer Architects will also help to translate internal, customer and prospect requests into actionable information with clear business outcomes for the Product and Engineering organizations to be able to prioritize and address.

**Here's a closer look at this key role:**  
**Technical Architecture & Strategic Advisory**

* Act as the primary technical point of contact for key enterprise accounts, building trusted technical relationships with C-level executives, principal architects, and engineering leads.
* Understand complex business and operational requirements and translate them into robust, scalable observability architectures.
* Conduct Executive Architecture Reviews, health checks, and strategic planning sessions to align platform usage with business objectives.

**Agentic AI & Modern Observability Frameworks**

* Architect and implement comprehensive observability strategies for Agentic AI, autonomous agent networks, and LLM-backed applications.
* Leverage and advise clients on modern context protocols including Model Context Protocol (MCP), WebMCP, and tool-use interfaces to securely connect AI agents with telemetry, APIs, and data sources.
* Establish performance and reliability metrics for autonomous agents, evaluating execution accuracy, tool selection, reasoning latency, token consumption, and agent-to-agent communication paths.
* Guide enterprise clients in leveraging AI/ML insights to automate incident management, anomaly detection, and self-healing IT capabilities.

**Enterprise Cloud Migration & Digital Experience Modernization**

* Architect pre- and post-migration observability strategies for large-scale enterprise cloud migrations (on-premise to AWS, Azure, GCP, or multi-cloud hybrid topologies).
* Establish telemetry baselines to ensure zero degradation of digital experience, end-user latency, or application performance during complex cloud transitions.
* Provide technical oversight on Internet pathing, DNS reliability, BGP path health, and CDN distribution performance during migration phases.

**Network Pathing, Integration & API Architecture**

* Design end-to-end telemetry architectures across multi-cloud, containerized (Kubernetes), and edge application environments with deep emphasis on core Internet network pathing (BGP, DNS, TCP/IP, ISP routing, CDN).
* Guide clients on building custom API integrations, automation workflows, and monitoring pipelines using tools like Terraform, Ansible, and custom REST/GraphQL endpoints.
* Serve as an advanced technical escalation point to troubleshoot complex routing, latency, and digital experience challenges.

**Enablement, Thought Leadership & Product Alignment**

  

* Deliver best-practice technical workshops, enablement sessions, and product demonstrations to empower customer engineering and operations teams.
* Act as the voice of the customer internally, establishing a direct feedback loop with Product, Engineering, and AI R&D teams to influence product roadmaps.
* Author technical whitepapers, architectural integration patterns, and best-practice guides for internal and customer-facing knowledge bases and technical blogs.

**What You'll Need:**

* 6+ years in senior customer-facing technical roles (Customer Technical Architect, Principal Solutions Architect, Principal Customer Success Engineer, or Lead Technical Account Manager).
* Proven track record of supporting large global enterprises, Fortune 500, or Global 2000 accounts through complex cloud and digital transformations.
* Hands-on experience or deep understanding of building, deploying, and monitoring Agentic AI workflows, multi-agent frameworks, and LLM-driven architectures.
* Direct exposure to emerging AI integration standards including Model Context Protocol (MCP), and custom tool-calling/agentic API interfaces.
* Familiarity with tracking AI-specific telemetry: execution loops, context degradation, tool response latency, token consumption, model drift, and safety guardrails.
* Demonstrated experience leading enterprise-wide Cloud Migration observability initiatives (monitoring application & latency impact during migration to cloud-native/Kubernetes).
* Expert-level understanding of Internet infrastructure and network pathing: BGP (Border Gateway Protocol), ISP routing, DNS architectures, HTTP/3, SSL/TLS, and CDN distribution networks.
* Understanding of multi-cloud architectures (AWS, Azure, GCP) and cloud-native application deployment models.
* Strong expertise in modern integration patterns, web APIs (REST, GraphQL), webhooks, and data pipelines.
* Hands-on scripting capabilities in Python, Bash, Go, or JavaScript/TypeScript.
* Familiarity with Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) tools (Terraform,Ansible) and incident routing ecosystems (ServiceNow, PagerDuty, Jira, Slack).
* Exceptional written, verbal, and technical writing abilities with strong analytical and troubleshooting instincts.
* Ability to articulate complex technical, network pathing, and AI architectures to C-level executives and engineering teams alike.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or equivalent practical experience.
* Willingness to travel periodically for key executive engagements, architectural workshops, or onsite enablement.

title: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation
description:
Job Description

**Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**

Company: Upstox

Location: Bengaluru

Work arrangement: 5 days in the office

Function: Insurance – B2B Sales (SDR / Lead Generation team)

**About Upstox**
----------------

At Upstox, we’re building the future of investing — simple, powerful, and for everyone. We're one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms, backed by the best in the business, including Mr. Ratan Tata and Tiger Global, and on a mission to make wealth creation accessible to every Indian. From first-time investors to seasoned traders, millions trust us to power their financial journeys. We're not just moving fast — we’re moving with purpose. If you thrive in a high-energy, high-impact environment, you're in the right place.

**The Role: Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation**
-----------------------------------------------------

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you’ll own the top of this funnel — building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month.

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you’ll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management**

* **Lead management framework**: Design and own the end-to-end framework — sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads.

* **Ideal customer profile**: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data.

* **Outreach playbooks**: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events.

* **Renewal-cycle planning**: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates.

**Target Account List Building**

* **Target list**: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership.

* **Research & data tools**: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data.

* **Data hygiene & prioritisation**: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert.

**Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team**

* **Qualified pipeline**: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month.

* **Monthly targets**: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals.

* **Feedback loop**: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly.

**Team Leadership & Motivation**

* **Hiring & training**: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e.g., Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life).

* **Targets & reviews**: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards.

* **Coaching & culture**: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture.

**Individual Contribution**

* **Personal target**: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **CXO outreach**: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team.

* **Lead from the front**: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate.

**Tools, Reporting & Analytics**

* **Lead management stack**: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team.

* **Dashboards & MIS**: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement.

* **Data-led allocation**: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Collaboration**: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering.

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* **Qualified leads delivered**: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target.

* **Meetings held**: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker.

* **Funnel conversion**: Lead meeting proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel.

* **Team productivity**: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week.

* **Self-outreach target**: The Manager’s personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **Data quality**: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets.

* Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover.

* Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools — CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms.

* Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly.

* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team.

* Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS.

* Excellent communication skills.

* Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru.

**Good to have**

* Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e.g., HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS).

* Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment.

* Graduate degree; MBA preferred.

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You’ll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms.

* You’ll have high ownership and visibility — your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business.

* You’ll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs.

* You’ll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product.

* Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families.

By applying for this position, you acknowledge that you have reviewed our **Prospective Employee Privacy Notice**, which outlines how Upstox collects, uses, and protects your Personal Information ("PI"). I accept Upstox's Prospective Employee Privacy Notice.

Upstox is an Equal Opportunity Employer; all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, genetics, disability, age, veteran status, or other characteristics.

title: Senior Manager, AI Engineering
description:
**Ref#:** W183888
