**Company Description**

Ralph Lauren Corporation (NYSE:RL) is a global leader in the design, marketing and distribution of premium lifestyle products in five categories: apparel, accessories, home, fragrances, and hospitality. For more than 50 years, Ralph Lauren's reputation and distinctive image have been consistently developed across an expanding number of products, brands and international markets. The Company's brand names, which include Ralph Lauren, Ralph Lauren Collection, Ralph Lauren Purple Label, Polo Ralph Lauren, Double RL, Lauren Ralph Lauren, Polo Ralph Lauren Children, Chaps, among others, constitute one of the world's most widely recognized families of consumer brands.
  
  
At Ralph Lauren, we unite and inspire the communities within our company as well as those in which we serve by amplifying voices and perspectives to create a culture of belonging, ensuring inclusion, and fairness for all. We foster a culture of inclusion through: Talent, Education & Communication, Employee Groups and Celebration.

  
  
**Position Overview**

**Purpose & Scope -**

The Senior Manager, AI Engineering is responsible for leading the design, development, and deployment of scalable AI solutions that accelerate Ralph Lauren's transformation into an AI-enabled enterprise. This role combines strong technical leadership with hands-on execution to deliver production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and reusable engineering capabilities across the organization. This leader partners closely with AI Strategy, Enterprise Architecture, Data Engineering, Product, Security, Governance, and Business Technology teams to translate prioritized use cases into secure, scalable, and high-impact AI solutions built on Microsoft Azure and Databricks.

**The role is responsible for:**

* Enterprise AI and agentic AI solution delivery
* Multi-agent orchestration and intelligent workflow automation
* LLMOps and MLOps engineering practices
* AI integration, observability, and operational excellence
* Responsible AI implementation and governance adherence
* Engineering team leadership and capability development

This leader is expected to drive engineering excellence while enabling rapid experimentation, innovation, and scalable AI adoption across business functions.

  
**Essential Duties & Responsibilities**

**Key Roles & Responsibilities**

**AI Solution Delivery**

* Lead the design, development, and implementation of enterprise AI solutions aligned with business priorities.
* Translate prioritized AI use cases into scalable, production-ready applications and services.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to define solution requirements, delivery plans, and measurable outcomes.
* Drive disciplined execution across prototyping, engineering, testing, deployment, and production support.

**Agentic AI & Intelligent Automation**

* Design and implement agentic AI solutions using Azure AI services, Databricks, vector platforms, orchestration frameworks, and modern LLM ecosystems.
* Build and maintain multi-agent workflows, orchestration frameworks, and AI-powered automation solutions.
* Develop reusable patterns for memory management, tool usage, reasoning workflows, human-in-the-loop controls, and enterprise action execution.
* Evaluate emerging agentic AI technologies based on business value, risk, and engineering fit.

**AI Platform Engineering**

* Contribute to enterprise AI platforms, reusable services, SDKs, templates, and engineering accelerators.
* Develop and maintain APIs, integrations, and shared AI capabilities supporting multiple business use cases.
* Partner with Data Engineering to ensure AI-ready data foundations and scalable access patterns in Azure and Databricks.
* Support technical decisions related to AI services, inference, model deployment, infrastructure, and integrations.

**Engineering Excellence & Operations**

* Establish and promote standards for CI/CD, testing, release management, monitoring, and operational support.
* Implement LLMOps and MLOps practices including evaluation, prompt management, experimentation, telemetry, and runtime optimization.
* Lead production-readiness reviews for reliability, scalability, security, and cost efficiency.
* Monitor performance and drive continuous improvement through operational analytics.

**Governance, Security & Responsible AI**

* Ensure AI solutions comply with enterprise security, privacy, compliance, governance, and Responsible AI standards.
* Partner with Security and Governance teams to implement guardrails, auditability, policy enforcement, and risk controls.
* Support observability frameworks including telemetry, evaluation, performance tracking, and drift detection.

**Team Leadership & Talent Development**

* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of AI engineers and technical specialists.
* Provide technical coaching and hands-on guidance throughout the software development lifecycle.
* Foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, engineering rigor, and continuous learning.
* Support recruiting, onboarding, performance enablement, and career development.
* Drive collaboration across strategy, architecture, data, infrastructure, product, and business teams.

  
**Experience, Skills, and Knowledge**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, or a related technical discipline.
* 8+ years of experience in software engineering, AI/ML engineering, or data engineering, including technical leadership responsibility.
* 3+ years of experience leading engineering teams that deliver AI or machine learning solutions.
* Proven experience developing and deploying production-grade AI applications, agentic systems, and intelligent automation solutions.
* Strong hands-on engineering skills with the ability to architect, prototype, review, and troubleshoot AI systems.
* Deep experience with Microsoft Azure, including Azure AI Services, Azure Machine Learning, AKS, API Management, and cloud-native engineering patterns.
* Strong experience with Databricks, Lakehouse architecture, AI/ML pipelines, vector search, and scalable data processing.
* Experience building RAG solutions, vector database integrations, memory architectures, and enterprise knowledge-retrieval systems.
* Hands-on experience with frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, Semantic Kernel, AutoGen, CrewAI, OpenAI SDKs, MCP-based ecosystems, or equivalent technologies.
* Strong understanding of LLMOps and MLOps, including deployment, prompt management, evaluation, observability, experimentation, governance, and runtime optimization.
* Experience with API-first architecture, microservices, event-driven systems, cloud-native platforms, and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills across technical and business teams.

**Preferred Experience:**

* Experience delivering agentic AI and multi-agent solutions in enterprise environments.
* Ability to rapidly prototype, evaluate, and adopt emerging AI technologies and practices.
* Experience building reusable engineering frameworks, accelerators, and shared AI services.
* Familiarity with AI-native commerce and Agentic Commerce ecosystems, including UCP, ACP, and autonomous transaction orchestration patterns.
* Experience in retail, luxury retail, eCommerce, or digital commerce environments.
* Relevant Azure, Databricks, cloud engineering, or AI/ML certifications.

**About SKF**
=============

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

  

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: *www.skf.com**/in*

  

**SKF Purpose Statement**
=========================

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

  

**JOB** **DESCRIPTION**

  

**Position Title:** Business Line Manager

**Reports To:** Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:** Individual Contributor

**Location:**Bengaluru/Pune

  

**Purpose of the role**

  

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

  

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

  

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

  

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

  

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications

* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development initiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes  

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

**About the Role**

Techlance Global Pvt. Ltd. is looking for enthusiastic, ambitious, and result-oriented individuals to join our sales team as IT Sales Executives.

In this role, you will be responsible for promoting MUN-C business management software and Techlance Global's IT and software development services to businesses across different industries.

This opportunity is suitable for fresh graduates who want to build a career in IT sales, as well as candidates with 1–2 years of sales or business development experience.

**Please note: This is an active sales role that requires self-generated lead generation, direct customer interaction, field visits, and deal closure.** Candidates should be comfortable approaching new businesses, making cold calls, scheduling meetings, visiting prospective clients, presenting software solutions, negotiating with customers, and following up until a deal is closed.

You will not be limited to working on leads provided by the company. You will be expected to identify potential customers independently, build your own sales pipeline, and take ownership of your sales activities and results.

**What You Will Sell**

You will represent MUN-C and Techlance Global's software products and technology services, including:

* **School Management Software** – Solutions for schools and educational institutions.
* **HR Management Software (HRMS)** – Employee management and HR process automation.
* **Lead and Sales Management Software** – Tools to organize leads, follow-ups, and sales activities.
* **Inventory and Warehouse Management Software** – Solutions for stock control and warehouse operations.
* **POS Software** – Billing and sales solutions for retail businesses and restaurants.
* **Business Management Solutions** – Software to streamline business operations and workflows.
* **E-commerce and Quick Commerce Development** – Online shopping platforms and rapid-commerce solutions.
* **Website, Web Application and Mobile Application Development** – Custom technology solutions for businesses.
* **Other Custom Software Development Services** – Applications and digital solutions based on client requirements.

You will learn about these solutions and identify which products or services are most relevant to each prospective customer.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Self-Generated Lead Generation**

* Identify potential customers through market research, LinkedIn, cold calling, networking, referrals, business directories, and field visits.
* Research businesses that may benefit from software solutions offered by MUN-C and Techlance Global.
* Build and maintain your own database of prospective clients.
* Contact business owners, school administrators, HR managers, restaurant owners, retailers, warehouse managers, and other decision-makers.
* Initiate conversations with new prospects and identify opportunities to introduce our products and services.
* Generate qualified leads independently instead of relying solely on company-provided enquiries.

**2. Field Sales and Direct Client Visits**

* Visit prospective businesses and meet decision-makers in person.
* Identify potential customers in assigned markets and business segments.
* Introduce MUN-C products and Techlance Global's software development services during face-to-face meetings.
* Explain how the relevant software can address customers' operational challenges.
* Schedule follow-up meetings and product demonstrations.
* Maintain regular contact with prospects until the opportunity progresses toward a sale.
* Travel locally for customer meetings and business development activities as required.

**Candidates must be willing to conduct field visits and meet prospective customers in person. Field sales is an essential part of this position.**

**3. Cold Calling and Customer Outreach**

* Make outbound calls to prospective customers.
* Introduce the company, understand customer requirements, and explain relevant solutions.
* Follow up through telephone calls, email, LinkedIn, and other professional communication channels.
* Handle initial objections and identify genuine business opportunities.
* Schedule meetings and product demonstrations with interested prospects.

**4. Product Presentation and Sales**

* Learn the features, benefits, and use cases of MUN-C's software solutions.
* Understand the customer's business challenges and recommend suitable products or services.
* Present software solutions in simple, business-focused language.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product demonstrations and technical clarifications.
* Share proposals and quotations as per company guidelines.
* Follow up with prospects, address concerns, and help move opportunities toward closure.

**5. Negotiation and Deal Closure**

* Maintain ownership of opportunities from initial contact through follow-up and closure.
* Understand customer requirements, budgets, timelines, and decision-making processes.
* Communicate pricing and commercial terms accurately.
* Coordinate with the management team when approvals or technical inputs are required.
* Convert qualified prospects into paying customers.
* Maintain professional relationships to encourage repeat business and referrals.

**6. Sales Reporting and Performance**

* Maintain daily records of calls, leads, meetings, field visits, and follow-ups.
* Update the designated CRM or sales tracking system.
* Work toward agreed lead generation, meeting, pipeline, and revenue targets.
* Report progress, customer feedback, and market opportunities to the reporting manager.
* Continuously improve sales performance through feedback, product learning, and customer interactions.

**Who Should Apply?**

We welcome applications from:

* Fresh graduates interested in building a career in IT sales and business development.
* Candidates with 1–2 years of experience in sales, business development, field sales, or customer acquisition.
* Candidates interested in selling software products, SaaS solutions, ERP, CRM, HRMS, POS, or IT services.
* Individuals who are comfortable with cold calling, approaching new customers, and conducting field visits.
* Candidates who are confident communicators, proactive learners, and motivated by achieving sales targets.

Prior IT or software sales experience is an advantage but is not mandatory for candidates who demonstrate strong communication skills, a willingness to learn, and a genuine interest in sales.

**Required Skills**

* Good verbal communication and interpersonal skills.
* Confidence in speaking with new people and business decision-makers.
* Willingness to make cold calls and generate leads independently.
* Willingness to travel locally and conduct face-to-face client meetings.
* Basic understanding of business operations and an interest in technology.
* Persistence in follow-ups, objection handling, and deal closure.
* Good organizational skills and accountability for assigned targets.
* A positive attitude, willingness to learn, and a results-oriented mindset.

**What You Should Know Before Applying**

* This is a full-time, permanent, work-from-office position in Noida, Sector 62.
* The role includes both office-based sales activities and field sales.
* You will be responsible for generating your own leads and developing new business opportunities.
* You may need to visit prospective customers to present solutions, build relationships, and close deals.
* The role involves working toward defined sales and business development targets.
* Product training and guidance will help you understand our solutions and sales process.

**Candidates who are looking exclusively for desk-based sales, inbound lead handling, remote work, or non-target-based roles may not find this position suitable.**

**Why Join Techlance Global?**

* Start or grow your career in IT and software sales.
* Learn to sell business management software and custom technology solutions.
* Gain hands-on experience in lead generation, field sales, client meetings, negotiations, and deal closure.
* Develop professional relationships with businesses across multiple industries.
* Build practical business development and consultative selling skills.

**How to Apply**

If you are confident, proactive, comfortable meeting new people, and willing to work in both office-based and field sales environments, we encourage you to apply.

Join Techlance Global Pvt. Ltd. and help businesses discover how MUN-C and our software solutions can improve their operations.

**Apply now and take the first step toward building your career in IT sales and business development.**

**Employment Type:** Full-Time

Job Summary

We are looking for a responsible and experienced FMCG Store Manager to manage daily store operations, inventory, product availability, sales, customer service, and staff performance. The ideal candidate should have knowledge of FMCG products, inventory management, stock replenishment, billing systems, vendor coordination, and retail store operations.

The candidate will ensure smooth store functioning, minimize stock losses, maintain product quality, and deliver an excellent customer experience while achieving sales and profitability targets.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Store Operations**

* Manage day-to-day store activities and ensure smooth operations.
* Maintain store cleanliness, product displays, shelves, and product availability.
* Ensure proper opening and closing procedures.
* Follow company policies, operational procedures, and store standards.

**2. Inventory and Stock Management**

* Monitor stock levels and maintain optimum inventory.
* Manage stock receiving, verification, storage, and replenishment.
* Conduct regular physical stock counts and reconcile inventory discrepancies.
* Monitor expiry dates, damaged goods, and near-expiry products using FIFO/FEFO practices.
* Reduce stock shortages, wastage, pilferage, and inventory losses.

**3. FMCG Product and Vendor Management**

* Handle FMCG categories such as packaged foods, snacks, beverages, dairy products, personal care, and household essentials.
* Coordinate with distributors, wholesalers, and manufacturers for timely deliveries.
* Verify purchase invoices, quantities, product prices, and batch details.
* Maintain records of purchases, returns, schemes, and vendor payments as applicable.

**4. Sales and Customer Service**

* Achieve daily, weekly, and monthly sales targets.
* Monitor fast-moving and slow-moving products.
* Ensure correct pricing, barcode scanning, promotions, and product placement.
* Handle customer complaints and resolve issues professionally.
* Recommend products and promotional offers to improve sales.

**5. Billing and Cash Management**

* Supervise POS billing, cash handling, UPI, and digital payments.
* Ensure accurate billing and daily cash reconciliation.
* Monitor discounts, refunds, returns, and billing discrepancies.
* Prepare daily sales and collection reports.

**6. Staff Management**

* Allocate duties and prepare staff schedules.
* Train employees in customer service, billing, stock handling, and store procedures.
* Monitor staff attendance, discipline, and productivity.
* Ensure adequate staffing during peak business hours.

**7. Reporting and Performance Monitoring**

* Prepare daily sales, stock, wastage, and expense reports.
* Track sales, gross margins, inventory turnover, and stock availability.
* Maintain purchase orders, invoices, stock registers, and other store records.
* Suggest improvements in product assortment, purchasing, and store profitability.

**8. Compliance and Safety**

* Follow applicable FSSAI requirements for food products and other relevant regulations.
* Maintain proper storage conditions and food hygiene.
* Ensure safe handling of goods and compliance with fire and workplace safety procedures.

Required Qualifications and Skills

* Graduate or equivalent qualification; a degree or diploma in Retail Management, Business Administration, or Commerce is preferred.
* 2–5 years of experience in FMCG retail, supermarket, grocery, or convenience-store operations.
* Knowledge of FMCG brands, product categories, distributors, and retail pricing.
* Experience with POS billing, inventory software, MS Excel, and stock reporting.
* Strong communication, leadership, problem-solving, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage stock, staff, sales targets, and multiple operational tasks.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Monthly sales growth.
* Gross profit margin.
* Inventory accuracy and stock availability.
* Expiry, damage, and wastage percentage.
* Reduction in stock loss and pilferage.
* Customer satisfaction and complaint resolution.
* Billing accuracy and cash reconciliation.
* Vendor delivery performance.

Preferred Candidate Profile

Candidates with experience at supermarkets, grocery chains, FMCG distributors, convenience stores, or organised retail businesses will be preferred. Experience in multi-store operations or franchise-based retail management is an added advantage.

**Job Title:** Business Development Manager  
**Department:** Business Development & Franchise Expansion  
**Industry:** FMCG, Retail & Convenience Stores  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Location:** Noida / Greater Noida  
**Reports To:** Founder / Director / Business Head

1. Job Summary

We are looking for a dynamic and result-oriented Business Development Manager to drive business growth, franchise expansion, strategic partnerships, and revenue generation for My Store 24/7.

The candidate will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, acquiring franchise partners, developing relationships with FMCG brands and distributors, negotiating commercial agreements, and expanding the company's network of convenience stores operating through fixed and movable-container formats.

The ideal candidate should have strong sales, negotiation, networking, communication, and business planning skills, with experience in FMCG, retail, franchising, or organised retail operations.

2. Key ResponsibilitiesA. Business Development & Expansion

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in FMCG, grocery retail, and convenience-store markets.
* Develop strategies to expand My Store 24/7 across Noida, Greater Noida, Delhi NCR, and other target locations.
* Research market trends, competitor activities, customer demand, and potential growth areas.
* Identify suitable commercial locations, container-store placement opportunities, and business partnerships.
* Build a pipeline of prospective franchise partners, investors, and business associates.

B. Franchise Sales & Partner Acquisition

* Generate franchise leads through networking, digital platforms, referrals, and direct outreach.
* Present the My Store 24/7 franchise business model, investment structure, operational requirements, and commercial opportunity to prospects.
* Conduct meetings, presentations, and follow-ups with potential franchise owners.
* Negotiate franchise terms and coordinate the onboarding process.
* Maintain a database of leads, conversion rates, franchise enquiries, and partner relationships.
* Coordinate with internal teams to support franchise launch and initial operations.

C. FMCG Brand & Supplier Partnerships

* Establish relationships with FMCG manufacturers, distributors, wholesalers, and regional suppliers.
* Explore partnerships with established packaged-food, snack, beverage, personal-care, and household-product brands.
* Negotiate product pricing, distributor margins, credit terms, promotional schemes, and supply arrangements.
* Identify opportunities for bulk purchasing and centralised procurement to improve profitability.
* Develop long-term supplier relationships to ensure reliable product availability and competitive pricing.

D. Sales Strategy & Revenue Growth

* Develop and execute business development plans to achieve monthly and annual growth targets.
* Identify new revenue streams, strategic alliances, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Prepare sales forecasts, business proposals, and expansion plans.
* Monitor franchise acquisition costs, conversion rates, revenue growth, and business profitability.
* Recommend pricing, promotional, and partnership strategies to improve commercial performance.

E. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Analyse competitors in the convenience-store, grocery, supermarket, and franchise sectors.
* Study customer preferences, product demand, pricing strategies, and emerging retail trends.
* Identify potential markets for movable-container convenience stores.
* Prepare market research reports and recommend suitable locations for expansion.
* Track competitor franchise models and identify opportunities to differentiate My Store 24/7.

F. Relationship Management

* Build and maintain strong relationships with franchisees, suppliers, landlords, corporate clients, and strategic partners.
* Conduct regular follow-ups to maintain partner satisfaction and identify additional opportunities.
* Coordinate with operations, procurement, marketing, and finance teams.
* Resolve business-related issues and support long-term partner retention.

G. Reporting & Performance Monitoring

* Maintain records of leads, meetings, proposals, negotiations, and signed agreements.
* Prepare weekly and monthly business development reports.
* Track KPIs, including qualified leads, franchise conversions, new partnerships, sales growth, and revenue generation.
* Present expansion progress and business performance reports to management.
* Use CRM software, spreadsheets, and reporting tools to manage the sales pipeline.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, Commerce, or a related field.
* 3–6 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, franchise sales, FMCG, or retail expansion.
* Experience in franchise acquisition, channel development, distributor management, or strategic partnerships is preferred.
* Strong knowledge of sales pipelines, lead generation, negotiation, and commercial proposal preparation.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, CRM software, and business reporting.
* Excellent communication, presentation, networking, and relationship-management skills.
* Ability to travel for business meetings, market visits, and partner acquisition when required.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Number of qualified franchise leads generated.
* Number of franchise agreements signed.
* Franchise lead-to-conversion ratio.
* Number of new supplier and brand partnerships established.
* Revenue generated through new business opportunities.
* Expansion into new locations and markets.
* Value of commercial agreements negotiated.
* Cost per franchise acquisition.
* Achievement of monthly, quarterly, and annual business targets.

5. Preferred Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should be proactive, commercially minded, target-driven, and comfortable building a business from the ground up. Candidates with experience in FMCG companies, organised retail chains, convenience stores, supermarket franchises, distributor networks, or franchise consulting will be preferred.

Experience with emerging retail formats, mobile retail units, or container-based businesses will be an added advantage.

6. Compensation & Incentives

* Competitive salary based on experience and skills.
* Performance-based incentives linked to measurable business development targets.
* Additional rewards for successful franchise acquisition and strategic partnerships, subject to company policy.
* Travel reimbursement for approved business visits.

7. How to Apply

Interested candidates may share their updated resume along with relevant experience, current salary, expected salary, notice period, and details of their previous business development achievements.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

  

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.  

  

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.  

  

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.  

  

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.  

  

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.  

  

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

  

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.  

  

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior HR Business Partner
description:
**Retail HR Business Partner – Store Operations & Training**

**1. Position Details**

* **Designation:** Retail HR Business Partner (HRBP)
* **Department:** Human Resources
* **Experience:** 3–4 years
* **Industry:** Retail – preferably fashion, jewellery, lifestyle, or organised retail
* **Location:** Corporate Office - Bangalore with regular travel to stores across India
* **Reporting To:** AVP – Human Resource (People & Culture)

**2. Role Purpose**

To act as a strategic and operational HR partner for retail store teams by driving employee engagement, talent management, performance management, employee relations, and HR operational excellence. The role will also be responsible for delivering effective training and development programmes to store employees, including Store Managers, Assistant Store Managers, Sales Executives, and other frontline team members.

The ideal candidate should have strong retail HR exposure, excellent communication and facilitation skills, and the ability to work closely with business teams to improve employee productivity, customer experience, and overall store performance.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**A. HR Business Partnering & Store Support**

* Partner with Store Managers, Cluster Managers, and Regional Managers to understand business needs and provide effective HR solutions.
* Conduct regular store visits to assess employee morale, workplace culture, manpower requirements, and HR compliance.
* Support store teams in workforce planning, manpower budgeting, and deployment of resources.
* Act as the first point of contact for store employees and managers on HR-related matters.
* Support the implementation of HR policies, processes, and people initiatives across retail locations.

**B. Talent Acquisition & Manpower Planning**

* Coordinate with the recruitment team to fulfil store-level manpower requirements within defined timelines.
* Support recruitment, screening, interview coordination, and onboarding of frontline retail employees.
* Monitor manpower availability, vacancies, attrition, and hiring turnaround time across assigned stores.
* Ensure effective onboarding and induction of new employees.

**C. Learning & Development – Retail Store Training**

* Identify training needs through store visits, employee feedback, performance data, and discussions with business leaders.
* Design and deliver engaging training programmes for frontline retail employees and store leadership teams.
* Conduct classroom, on-the-job, and virtual training sessions as required.
* Develop training calendars, learning materials, presentations, and practical activities relevant to retail operations.
* Evaluate training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, observation, and business performance indicators.
* Conduct refresher training and coaching sessions to reinforce learning and improve workplace behaviour.

**D. Employee Engagement & Retention**

* Drive employee engagement initiatives, recognition programmes, and store-level team-building activities.
* Analyse attrition trends and recommend initiatives to improve employee retention.
* Promote a positive, inclusive, performance-oriented culture across stores.
* Identify people-related challenges impacting store productivity and recommend corrective actions.

**E. Performance Management & Talent Development**

* Support the implementation of performance management processes for store employees and managers.

**F. Employee Relations & HR Operations**

* Handle employee grievances, workplace conflicts, disciplinary matters, and employee counselling.
* Support investigations and documentation relating to misconduct and violations of company policies.
* Coordinate with payroll and HR operations teams to resolve employee-related queries.
* Ensure adherence to company policies, statutory requirements, and applicable labour laws.

**G. HR Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain periodic HR dashboards and reports for assigned retail locations.
* Track key metrics such as headcount, vacancies, attrition, absenteeism, training hours, and employee engagement.
* Analyse trends and identify areas requiring management intervention.
* Monitor training effectiveness and its impact on employee performance and customer experience.
* Share actionable insights and recommendations with HR leadership and retail business teams.

**4. Role Competencies**

**A. Functional Competencies**

* Help store leaders set performance goals and communicate expectations clearly.
* Monitor performance review completion and facilitate performance feedback discussions.
* Identify high-potential employees and support succession planning for key store positions through development programmes.

**Competency**

**Expected Proficiency**

Retail HR Business Partnering

Strong

Retail Store Operations Understanding

Strong

Learning & Development / Training Delivery

Strong

Employee Engagement & Retention

Strong

Employee Relations & Grievance Handling

Strong

Recruitment & Manpower Planning

Intermediate to Strong

Performance Management

Intermediate to Strong

HR Policies & Labour Law Awareness

Intermediate to Strong

HR MIS, Reporting & Excel

Intermediate to Strong

Training Needs Analysis & Evaluation

Strong

**B. Behavioral Competencies**

* **Business Acumen:** Understands retail business priorities, store productivity, sales performance, and manpower requirements.
* **Communication & Presentation:** Communicates clearly and confidently with frontline employees, store managers, and senior stakeholders.
* **Relationship Management:** Builds trust with store teams and maintains productive relationships with business stakeholders.
* **Problem-Solving:** Identifies root causes of people-related challenges and recommends practical solutions.
* **Ownership & Accountability:** Takes responsibility for outcomes and proactively addresses challenges.

**5. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

The role will be evaluated on the following measurable outcomes:

* **Manpower Fulfilment:** Timely closure of approved store vacancies in coordination with recruitment.
* **Employee Attrition:** Improvement in controllable frontline employee attrition.
* **Training Delivery:** Achievement of the approved training calendar and coverage targets.
* **Training Effectiveness:** Improvement in post-training assessment scores and demonstrated on-the-job application.
* **Employee Engagement:** Improvement in engagement feedback and participation in people initiatives.
* **New Hire Retention:** Retention of employees during the initial 90-day period.
* **HR Process Compliance:** Timely completion of onboarding, performance reviews, documentation, and other HR processes.
* **Grievance Resolution:** Timely resolution and appropriate escalation of employee concerns.

**6. Educational Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* MBA / PGDM in Human Resources will be an added advantage.
* 3–4 years of relevant experience in HR, preferably in organised retail.
* Prior experience supporting multiple stores or frontline retail teams is preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in conducting employee training, facilitating workshops, or coaching store teams.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, PowerPoint, HRMS, and HR reporting.

title: BPA Consultant, Transformation
description:
**About Northern Trust**

As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world’s most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.

  

Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.

  

With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world’s most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.

  
  

**Role Description**

The Consultant, Business Process Analysis will support Transfer Agency transformation and operational delivery. Working with operations, technology, product, risk, compliance and external vendors, the role will analyse business needs, document requirements, support critical applications and contribute to the implementation of controlled, scalable solutions. The successful candidate will support activities from initial problem definition through requirements, testing, implementation and ongoing application support, with particular focus on investor onboarding, AML/KYC and core Transfer Agency platforms.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Business analysis and requirements:** Support discovery, requirements elicitation, analysis, validation and documentation across business, technology and control stakeholders; translate defined problem statements into business requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria and traceability outputs.
* **Process and operating-model design:** Assess current-state processes, data flows, hand-offs and controls; identify gaps and define future-state requirements for investor onboarding, AML/KYC, static data, documentation, reporting and related Transfer Agency services.
* **Target operating model support:** Contribute to the definition, validation and implementation of target operating models by analysing roles, capabilities, governance, process ownership, technology enablement, controls, service delivery and organisational impacts; help translate the agreed model into practical transition activities and implementation requirements.
* **Solution delivery:** Work with project managers, product owners, operations, technology, risk, compliance and vendors to support analysis through scoping, design, detailed requirements, implementation readiness and post-implementation review.
* **Testing and quality assurance:** Develop test strategies, scenarios and plans; execute or coordinate system, regression and user-acceptance testing for Fenergo, ICON, Multifonds and other Transfer Agency applications; analyse results, manage defects and confirm acceptance criteria.
* **Stakeholder engagement:** Participate in and, where appropriate, facilitate workshops and working sessions; clarify assumptions, resolve requirements questions and support alignment across regional and cross-functional teams.
* **Risk, control and regulatory analysis:** Identify operational, data, control and regulatory considerations; assess jurisdiction-specific requirements and ensure these are documented, communicated and reflected in solution design and delivery.
* **Governance and continuous improvement:** Prepare process maps, data mappings, governance materials, training content and implementation artefacts; contribute to improvements in analysis standards, templates, controls and ways of working.
* **Change support:** Support transformation initiatives and adoption of new processes and systems, working with regional functional managers to help ensure effective communication and smooth implementation.

**Experience, Skills & Qualifications**

* Relevant business analysis, change delivery or application-support experience within funds, asset servicing, Transfer Agency, investor onboarding, AML/KYC or financial-services operations; typically 5–7 years of relevant experience.
* Strong knowledge of Transfer Agency operating models, controls, service delivery and applications; experience with Multifonds, ICON or comparable platforms is highly desirable.
* Proven capability in requirements management, process mapping, data analysis, test planning, UAT, defect management and implementation readiness.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to work through ambiguity, manage priorities and deliver to agreed timelines.
* Self-driven and accountable, with the initiative to work independently, progress priorities proactively and take ownership from problem identification through delivery.
* Ability to connect end-to-end business processes, data, systems, controls and customer outcomes, identifying upstream and downstream dependencies and translating insights into practical, scalable improvements.
* Strong stakeholder-management, workshop-facilitation, communication and presentation skills, including the ability to translate effectively between technical and non-technical audiences.
* Demonstrated ownership, sound judgement and the ability to influence cross-regional teams without direct authority.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential; experience with Visio, Power BI, SharePoint, Aha!, Azure DevOps, Jira or Confluence is beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree, equivalent professional experience

**Eligibility - Internal Partners**

* 24 Months as a Technical Coordinator /Associate Consultant to move as a Consultant
* Movement within TL and Consultant Level will be 12 months

**Working with Us**

As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.

  

Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust’s history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.

  

**Reasonable Accommodation**

Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com, or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.

  
  

**About Our Bangalore Office**

The Northern Trust Bangalore office, established in 2005, is home to over 5,600 employees. In this stunning office space, we offer fantastic amenities which include our Arrival Hub - Jungle, the GameZone, and the Employee Experience Zone that appeal to both clients and employees. Learn more.

title: Head of Workplace Identity & End User Computing
description:
Welcome to Haleon. We’re a purpose-driven, world-class consumer company putting everyday health in the hands of millions. In just three years since our launch, we’ve grown, evolved and are now entering an exciting new chapter – one filled with bold ambitions and enormous opportunity.
  
  
Our trusted portfolio of brands – including Sensodyne®, Panadol®, Advil®, Voltaren®, Theraflu®, Otrivin®, and Centrum® – lead in resilient and growing categories. What sets us apart is our unique blend of deep human understanding and trusted science.
  
  
Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.

**About the Role:**

  

The **Product Director, End User Computing & Identity** is accountable for the strategy, product direction, governance, and end-to-end lifecycle of Haleon’s workforce identity, access, endpoint, and virtual workplace capabilities. The role brings these services together as one integrated product portfolio, ensuring colleagues and partners can securely access the right applications, data, devices, and digital workspaces from the right location and at the right time.

The portfolio includes Active Directory, authentication and access services, joiner-mover-leaver enablement, privileged and conditional access integration, endpoint and mobile device management, standard device builds, application access and delivery, workplace security controls, virtual desktop and remote access services, and governance of workplace accessory policies. The role owns the product and technology lifecycle across these capabilities, from strategy and investment through design, engineering, adoption, service performance, modernisation, and retirement.

As Product Director, the role leads a multidisciplinary team of product, engineering, and service specialists and directs strategic partners. It works across Cyber Security, Enterprise Architecture, Infrastructure, Applications, HR, and business teams to deliver a coherent colleague experience, strengthen identity-led security, simplify the technology estate, and improve reliability, cost, and user experience at global scale.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Define and communicate the global vision, strategy, target architecture, roadmap, and investment priorities for Workplace Identity & End User Computing.

* Own the integrated product portfolio covering workforce identity, authentication, access, endpoints, device builds, application delivery, virtual desktops, and secure remote access.

* Provide end-to-end lifecycle ownership for Active Directory and cloud identity capabilities, ensuring resilient, scalable, and well-governed directory, authentication, federation, and access services.

* Partner with Cyber Security and application owners to embed identity-first and Zero Trust principles, including strong authentication, conditional access, least privilege, access recertification, and effective control of privileged access.

* Ensure identity and access services support efficient joiner, mover, and leaver journeys, role-based access, external-user access, and reliable integration with HR, SaaS, cloud, and enterprise applications.

* Own the endpoint and mobile product strategy and lifecycle across laptops, desktops, smartphones, tablets, shared devices, and specialist workplace endpoints, including procurement standards, enrolment, configuration, compliance, refresh, support, secure disposal, and oversight of workplace accessory policies and standards.

* Set the direction for modern endpoint management, standard device builds, operating system currency, patching, configuration, application packaging and deployment, endpoint security, and user experience.

* Own virtual desktop, application virtualisation, and remote access products, ensuring they provide secure, performant, and cost-effective access for employees, partners, specialist users, and regulated use cases.

* Create a seamless access experience across physical and virtual endpoints so that identity, device trust, application entitlement, and security policy operate as one coherent control framework.

* Maintain prioritised product roadmaps and backlogs, balancing colleague needs, security risk, regulatory obligations, resilience, technical debt, lifecycle exposure, cost, and strategic value.

* Define and track product outcomes and service measures covering user experience, adoption, access success, device compliance, service availability, security posture, lifecycle health, cost, and business value.

* Lead major modernisation, simplification, migration, and decommissioning initiatives across identity, endpoint, and virtual workplace technologies, with effective service transition and change adoption.

* Provide senior ownership of service health, major incidents, problem management, continuity, capacity, obsolescence, audit actions, and material risks across the portfolio.

* Manage strategic technology providers and delivery partners, setting clear outcomes and ensuring strong commercial control, licensing optimisation, performance, innovation, and accountability.

* Lead, coach, and develop a high-performing multidisciplinary team, establishing clear accountability, succession plans, capability development, and an inclusive product-led culture.

**About You**

  

**Essential Qualifications:**

* Significant senior leadership experience across enterprise workplace technology, identity and access, or end user computing within a large, complex, global organisation.

* Strong product and lifecycle management capability, with experience defining strategy, target state, roadmaps, investment cases, product outcomes, and service improvement priorities.

* Deep understanding of enterprise identity services, including Active Directory, cloud identity, authentication, federation, conditional access, role-based access, privileged access, and identity governance integration.

* Strong understanding of modern endpoint management, device build and provisioning, operating system and application lifecycle, patching, configuration, compliance, and endpoint security.

* Experience leading virtual desktop, application delivery, and secure remote access capabilities in a global enterprise environment.

* Proven ability to bring identity, device trust, application entitlement, and access controls together into a coherent user experience and security model.

* Experience leading multidisciplinary internal teams and strategic partners, with accountability for people development, service performance, delivery quality, and organisational capability.

* Strong commercial, financial, and supplier-management capability, including investment prioritisation, contract performance, licensing, demand, capacity, and cost optimisation.

* Excellent senior stakeholder leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence technology, cyber, HR, risk, and business leaders and make clear decisions across competing priorities.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Active Directory, Microsoft Intune, Windows Autopilot, Microsoft Configuration Manager, and the wider Microsoft security and management ecosystem.

* Experience with enterprise virtual desktop and application delivery technologies such as Azure Virtual Desktop, Windows 365, Citrix, or VMware platforms.

* Practical knowledge of Zero Trust, passwordless authentication, identity governance, privileged access management, endpoint detection and response, and security compliance frameworks.

* Experience simplifying global technology estates, modernising legacy identity or endpoint services, and delivering complex migrations with minimal business disruption.

* Relevant Microsoft, identity, cyber security, product management, architecture, or service management qualifications, with experience in regulated or high-risk environments.

Location – this role is based in: Bangalore, India Please save a copy of the job description, as this may be helpful to refer to once the advert closes.

Company: Bharat Managed Service

Department: Sales & Business Development

**Role Summary**

Bharat Managed Services is looking for a
**Business Development Executive (BDE)**
to generate new business opportunities through outbound prospecting, cold calling, and lead generation. The role involves identifying potential customers, engaging with key decision-makers, qualifying leads, and scheduling Microsoft Teams meetings for the senior sales team.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, target-driven, and confident in communicating with decision-makers across IT, procurement, and business leadership.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Outbound Prospecting & Lead Generation**

* Make daily outbound calls to potential customers across assigned regions and industries.
* Generate leads through cold calling, email campaigns, and LinkedIn outreach.
* Research target companies and identify key decisionmakers across IT, procurement, HR, and business leadership.
* Qualify leads based on business needs, decision-making authority, budget, timelines, and service suitability.

**2. Meeting Scheduling & Coordination**

* Schedule Microsoft Teams meetings between qualified prospects and senior sales leaders.
* Coordinate calendars, send meeting invitations, and share relevant meeting details.
* Follow up with prospects to confirm attendance and manage rescheduling when required.

**3. CRM & Pipeline Management**

* Maintain accurate records of calls, emails, LinkedIn activities, and meetings in the CRM.
* Track leads, follow-ups, and next steps to ensure consistent pipeline development.
* Submit regular activity reports covering calls, leads generated, meetings booked, and conversion rates.

**4. Sales & Marketing Collaboration**

* Work closely with the Sales Team to understand service offerings, target industries, and ideal customer profiles.
* Coordinate with Marketing on lead generation campaigns, prospect lists, and outreach messaging.
* Share customer feedback, common objections, competitor insights, and market trends to improve sales strategies.

**5. Sales Support & Lead Nurturing**

* Send follow-up emails to prospects with meeting summaries, next steps, and relevant company presentations.
* Support the Sales Team with account research, prospect information, and contact verification.
* Maintain regular engagement with potential customers and nurture leads until they are ready for further sales discussions.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* **Outbound Calling:**
  Number of outbound calls completed daily and weekly.
* **Meeting Generation:**
  Number of qualified Microsoft Teams meetings scheduled with potential customers.
* **Lead Conversion:**
  Conversion rate from initial contact to meeting and qualified sales opportunity.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Number and quality of new leads added to the sales pipeline.
* **CRM Management:**
  Accuracy, completeness, and timely updating of CRM records.
* **Follow-Up Effectiveness:**
  Consistency of follow-ups and success in nurturing leads into potential business opportunities.

**Required Skills & Experience**

1. 2–5 years of experience in Business Development, Inside Sales, Tele-Sales, or B2B Sales, preferably in IT services or B2B technology.
2. A bachelor’s degree in any relevant discipline; an MBA/PGDM is an added advantage but not mandatory.
3. Strong verbal communication skills and confidence in making outbound calls to potential customers.
4. Good written communication skills for professional emails and LinkedIn outreach.
5. Familiarity with Microsoft Teams and CRM tools such as Salesforce, HubSpot, or Zoho.
6. Basic proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and other productivity tools.
7. Ability to understand and communicate Bharat Managed Services’ offerings, including IT Support, Field Services (FSO), Digital Workplace, and Infrastructure Services.
8. Strong prospecting, lead qualification, cold-calling, and meeting-scheduling skills.
9. A target-oriented mindset with persistence and the ability to handle rejection positively.
10. Excellent organizational, time-management, communication, and relationship-building skills.

**Diversity & Inclusion**

* Bharat Managed Services is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace that promotes equal opportunities and professional growth. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, and women professionals with a passion for Business Development and Sales are encouraged to apply.

Braun in India, a leader in the medical devices industry, where your skills and experience will be recognized and celebrated. Take the next step in your career with us and help shape the future of healthcare!

**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead sales and marketing activities for the Interventional Therapy product portfolio at B. Braun.
* Develop and execute a channel partner strategy aligned with business priorities, market potential, and territory coverage requirements.

* Customer and Market Development
* Strategy Planning and Execution
* Channel Partner Management
* KOL and Clinical Engagement
* Commercial Performance and Execution
* Business Planning, Forecasting, and Reporting
* Team Leadership and Capability Building
* Develop and execute annual and long-range business strategies aligned with market potential, growth priorities, and profitability objectives.

* Identify growth opportunities and business risks through analysis of customers, competition, pricing, and portfolio performance.
* Lead go-to-market and market-development initiatives, monitor performance, and implement corrective actions.

* Establish annual business plans for all channel-partners, covering sales targets, priority accounts, pipeline, inventory, receivables, and market-development activities.
* Conduct quarterly business reviews with all key partners and implement time-bound corrective actions for performance gaps.
* Maintain partner forecast accuracy of sales, inventory within agreed norms, and receivables within approved credit terms.
* Categorize KOLs by specialty, institution, geography, clinical influence, academic contribution, and portfolio relevance.
* Focus activities on product adoption, procedure development, clinical education, evidence generation, new-product introduction, and access to priority institutions.
* Define criteria for clinical advocates, training centers, demonstration sites, and centers of excellence.
* Require coordination with Medical, Regulatory, Marketing, Sales, and Compliance.
* Ensure all engagements, payments, documentation, and product discussions follow applicable policies and regulations.
* Maintain accurate and timely BBC reporting, opportunity updates, and other required commercial information.
* Submit a realistic monthly rolling forecast supported by account-level assumptions, probability, timing, and key risks.

* Bachelor’s degree in Bio-Medical engineering, Life Sciences, Biotechnology, or a related discipline is required.
* Postgraduate qualification in Management, Marketing, or a relevant scientific discipline is preferred.
* 10 - 13 years of relevant sales, marketing, or business-development experience, preferably in medical devices, healthcare equipment, or pharmaceuticals.
* Demonstrated experience in channel-partner management, KOL engagement, product launches, market development, and achievement of commercial targets.
* Experience in interventional cardiology, interventional radiology, vascular therapy, cardiac surgery, or related clinical specialties is preferred.
* Experience managing complex stakeholder relationships, cross-functional initiatives, and regional or national business responsibilities is desirable.
* Willingness to travel extensively based on business and customer requirements.

**What sets B. Braun apart?**
B. Braun is one of the world's leading medical technology companies headquartered in Germany. We are proud to say that since the inception of our India operations in 1984, we have made significant strides in the Indian healthcare market. We supply more than 5,000 products and 120,000 articles in areas like anaesthetics, intensive care medicine, cardiology, extracorporeal blood treatment and surgery.
  
  
Our core values of Innovation, Efficiency, Sustainability, Trust, Accountability, and Diversity foster a performance-driven culture where we challenge each other constructively to grow personally and professionally. Recognized through awards such as 'Dream Companies to Work For' and 'Great Place to Work,' we invite you to join our team driven by a shared vision – to protect and improve the health of people around the world.
  
  
**What can we offer you?**

* Exciting sales incentives
* Mediclaim & life insurance
* Recognition & rewards to celebrate your efforts.
* Learning programs & skill development to accelerate your growth.
* Global exposure to broaden your horizons.
* Paternity & birthday leave for life’s special moments.
* Mental wellness support with counselling and mindfulness sessions.

**What’s next?**
Upon receiving your application, our dedicated Talent Acquisition team will review your application. If you stand out, you’ll be invited to engage in dynamic interviews, ranging from phone calls to video chats and in-person meetings. Throughout this process, we will keep you informed and inspired with regular updates and feedback. Finally, if you shine through and decide to join us, we will lead you into our seamless onboarding experience. Join us and be part of something extraordinary!
  
  
We appreciate different perspectives, thoughts, experiences and backgrounds. By strengthening an appreciative, inclusive, respectful and equal working environment, we create a culture in which all our employees feel free to be who they are.
