title: Market Development Specialist
description:
🇺🇸 US Market Development & Field Sales Executive

Chennai, India + USA | 6 Months India / 6 Months USA

We are looking for highly articulate, commercially driven and research-oriented sales professionals to join our US healthcare business development team.

This is a unique opportunity for professionals who want to build a long-term career in US B2B sales and business development.

The role will be divided approximately equally between India and the USA:

6 months in India: Research, prospect identification, account intelligence, pre-sales and pipeline development.

6 months in the USA: In-person meetings, relationship building, field sales, conferences and business development.

🇮🇳 Your role in India – Pre-Sales & Pipeline Development

You will be responsible for doing the detailed groundwork before an opportunity reaches the US sales team.

You will:

* Research target US healthcare organizations
* Understand the company's business model, size, locations, services and estimated revenue
* Research the organization's current business challenges and potential areas of opportunity
* Identify the right decision-makers and influencers
* Research executives and their backgrounds
* Identify verified contact information
* Build detailed account/prospect profiles
* Identify potential buying signals and business opportunities
* Conduct LinkedIn, email and telephone outreach
* Qualify prospects
* Develop relationships with prospects before the sales team engages
* Schedule qualified meetings
* Maintain detailed CRM information
* Prepare account intelligence and briefing notes for the US sales team
* Continuously build a qualified pipeline

The objective is not simply to generate leads.

The objective is to deliver well-researched, qualified business opportunities to the US sales team.

🇺🇸 Your role in the USA – Field Sales & Business Development

During your US assignment, you will transition into a client-facing role.

You will:

* Meet prospects and decision-makers in person
* Visit healthcare organizations
* Conduct business development meetings
* Attend conferences and industry events
* Build executive relationships
* Follow up on opportunities developed during your India phase
* Identify new business opportunities
* Participate in discovery meetings
* Support presentations and proposals
* Work closely with the US sales leadership
* Develop opportunities through the sales cycle
* Represent Scintillate professionally in the US market

🎯 Strict Qualification Criteria

We are looking for a very specific profile. Please apply only if you meet most of the following requirements.

* Education
  Postgraduate degree is mandatory
* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, International Business, Healthcare Management or a related discipline preferred
* Candidates with strong academic backgrounds and relevant postgraduate specialization will be preferred
* Experience
  3–7 years of relevant experience
* Prior experience in US-focused pre-sales, business development, inside sales, lead generation or market research is mandatory
* Experience selling into the US market is strongly preferred
* Experience dealing with US healthcare organizations, healthcare services, RCM, DMEPOS, medical billing, healthcare IT, BPO or SaaS will be a significant advantage
* Candidates must have experience independently researching US prospects and identifying decision-makers
* Experience using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase or similar sales intelligence/prospecting platforms preferred
* Hands-on experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Nutshell or similar

🗣️ Communication — Critical Requirement

Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.

The candidate must be:

* Extremely articulate and confident in spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with US C-level executives, VPs, Directors and business owners
* Able to conduct a professional discovery conversation
* Able to ask intelligent business questions
* Able to understand and respond to different US accents
* Able to communicate clearly without excessive reliance on scripts
* Strong in business writing, including emails and LinkedIn communication
* Comfortable presenting information to senior executives
* Able to communicate professionally in person as well as virtually

Candidates with weak spoken English or limited experience communicating with US business executives will not be considered.

🔎 Research & Analytical Skills

This is equally important.

The candidate should be able to take a company name and independently answer:

Who are they?

What do they do?

How large are they?

What is their approximate revenue?

Where do they operate?

Who makes the decision?

What problems might they have?

Why would they potentially need our services?

Who else should we speak with?

You should enjoy researching companies and people, not just making calls.

* ✈️ Mobility & Travel
  Must be willing and able to spend approximately 6 months each year in the USA
* Must be comfortable with frequent domestic travel within the US
* Must be comfortable conducting face-to-face meetings with senior executives
* Must be willing to attend conferences, trade shows and networking events
* Appropriate US travel/work authorization will be required for the activities undertaken during the US assignment

⭐ The person we are looking for

We are not looking for a conventional telesales executive.

We are looking for someone who combines:

Researcher + Pre-Sales Professional + Business Development Executive + Relationship Builder + Field Salesperson

Someone who can spend Monday morning researching a 500-employee healthcare company, understand its business, identify its CFO/COO/VP Revenue Cycle, build an intelligent outreach strategy — and six months later sit across the table from that executive in the United States and have a meaningful business conversation.

If you are highly articulate, commercially curious, comfortable with senior executives and genuinely interested in the US market, this could be an excellent opportunity to build a long-term international sales career.

📍 Base: Chennai, India

🇺🇸 US Assignment: Approximately 6 months annually

💼 Experience: 3–7 years

🎓 Postgraduate qualification: Mandatory

🇺🇸 US pre-sales/business development experience: Mandatory

🏥 US Healthcare experience: Strongly preferred

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: Senior Executive Accounts
description:
**Job Summary**

Century Flour Mills Private Limited is looking for a detail-oriented and experienced Senior Executive – Accounts to handle day-to-day accounting activities, GST and TDS compliance, and financial record maintenance. * Monitor outstanding payables and receivables.

* Prepare schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents for audits.

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

**What We Offer**

1. Fair, competitive compensation: Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability, and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.

2. Fast-track growth: You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.

3. Broad exposure: You see product, brand, events, retail, and operations, not one narrow slice.

4. Real ownership: Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.

2. You want a role with a fixed playbook already written.

3. You are not comfortable owning a P&L number.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**About Lexi:**

Lexi is an AI workspace built for Indian litigation lawyers. We bring legal research, drafting, case tracking, and day-to-day practice management into one platform, enabling advocates, chambers, and law firms to operate faster and more productively.

Headquartered in Hyderabad, our founding team focuses on high-impact execution. You will work closely with the founders to take our product directly into independent chambers, law firms, and advocate offices across the city, executing and scaling our field sales playbook.

What You’ll Do

* **Scheduled Field Demos:**
  Take ownership of warm, qualified meetings handed over by the inside sales team, conducting 3–5 in-person demos daily across law firms and advocate chambers to engage directly with chamber heads, partners, and senior litigators.
* **Hands-On Desk Demos & Trial Activation:**
  Run interactive, desk-side walkthroughs tailored to litigation workflows—setting up immediate trial access on lawyers' devices and demonstrating how Lexi accelerates their daily drafting, legal research, and case tracking.
* **Trial Nurturing & Deal Closing:**
  Follow up methodically post-demo through office visits, WhatsApp, email, and calls to address workflow questions, handle objections, and convert trials into paid annual or monthly subscriptions.
* **CRM & Qualitative Feedback:**
  Log detailed visit notes, lawyer pain points, objections, and deal stages daily in our CRM to help the founders refine the product roadmap and optimize pitch positioning.

What We’re Looking For

* **Field / Direct Sales Experience:**
  Prior experience in B2B field sales, corporate client visits, software demonstrations, or merchant/professional onboarding.
* **Domain Advantage:**
  Prior experience selling SaaS, productivity software, or business services to professionals (law firms, CA firms, consultancies), or an educational background in law (LL.B/B.A. LL.B), is a strong plus.
* **Professional Executive Presence:**
  Strong command of English and Hindi; conversational proficiency in Telugu is an advantage. You should be articulate, well-presented, and confident leading structured discussions with senior advocates and law firm partners.
* **Mobility & Route Discipline:**
  Must own a two-wheeler, valid driving license & helmet for efficient & safe daily city travel. Advocate schedules are time-sensitive; you should plan routes strategically around morning and evening chamber hours.
* **Self-Initiative & Accountability:**
  High ownership over your daily visit calendar, demo conversions, pipeline tracking, and reporting back to the leadership team.

Why Join Us

* **Full-Cycle Sales Ownership:**
  You won't simply drop brochures or collect cards,you will run live product walkthroughs, handle objections, negotiate pricing, and close paid accounts.
* **Direct Founder Access:**
  Work alongside the founders to build Lexi’s offline acquisition engine, seeing your on-ground insights directly shape the product and sales playbook.
* **Clear Conversion Path:**
  Interns who consistently hit demo volume and paid subscription targets will be offered a full-time role of Field Sales Executive position with competitive performance incentives.

Role Details

* **Location:**
  Hyderabad (On-field / In-person office visits)
* **Duration:**
  3 months
* **Stipend:**
  ₹15,000 / month + Travel & Fuel Allowance + Performance Incentives
* **Role Type:**
  Full-time internship

title: District Manager, Visakhapatnam
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  

* Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.

We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.
  
  

* Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.

We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.
  
  

* Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* Give back to our communities and people in need.

We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.
  
  
Your Background
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Must Possess The Following**

* Science Graduate with 3 – 5 yrs of work experience
* Preferred Qualifications in B.Pharma, Business, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in OR/OT surgical support experience, preferably in orthopedic
* Demonstrated sales abilities & a track record of successful selling to the medical profession

**Expected Areas of Competence (i.e. KSAs)**

* Working level of proficiency in the local language/English/Hindi.
* Product/Technical Knowledge
* Commercial Acumen
* Result Orientation
* Inter-personal and strong communication skills
* Tenacity

90% of the time
  
  
EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd. (ISFC) is an affordable housing finance company with a 12-year track record, operating across 15 states in India. The organization focuses on providing housing and small-ticket loans against property to primarily self-employed customers with informal income documentation. Its products include financing for new home purchases, home expansion and upgrades, construction on previously owned land, and loans against property. ISFC has built a hassle-free loan management process designed to serve middle- and lower-income segments and supports home ownership dreams with loans up to Rs 30 lakhs. The head office is located in Gurugram, Haryana.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Senior Relationship Manager role based in Hyderabad. The role involves acquiring and managing customers seeking affordable housing loans and loans against property, with a focus on self-employed and informally documented income profiles. The Senior Relationship Manager will meet prospective customers, understand their financial needs, explain product features, collect and verify documentation, and coordinate with credit and operations teams to ensure timely loan processing. Responsibilities include maintaining strong relationships with existing customers, monitoring repayment behavior, addressing service issues, and supporting portfolio quality and growth targets. The role also requires collaboration with local partners and internal stakeholders, regular field visits, and adherence to regulatory and company policies.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and customer service skills, including the ability to build trust with diverse customer segments.
* Experience in retail lending or housing finance, preferably handling self-employed or informal income customers.
* Ability to assess basic financial information, understand credit risk, and work with documentation relevant to housing loans and loans against property.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with proficiency in local language(s) and clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Comfort with field-based work, including regular customer visits, local market engagement, and on-site verification.
* Working knowledge of standard office and loan management systems; ability to learn new digital tools quickly.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; relevant experience in financial services or housing finance is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, attention to detail, and a strong focus on responsible lending and regulatory compliance.

title: Marketing Engineer
description:
Marketing Engineer – Social Media & Performance Marketing

Kitab · Full-time · On-site, Hyderabad · 3+ years · AI-native role

About Kitab

Kitab brings ancient wisdom into modern life. We turn texts like the Bhagavad Gita and the Puranas into clear, practical guidance for everyday problems: stress, relationships, purpose and decisions. Everything we build serves three pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself.

Kitab is backed by Sunera Group, led by founder Ravi Reddy Kaki, who has built and exited companies before. We're a new product, but not a first-time team.

Why this role exists

Our organic content shows the message resonates. Now we need one person who connects the dots: social campaigns that build a community, paid media that brings the right people into the app, and measurement that shows who stays. We call it a Marketing Engineer because we want someone who builds systems (playbooks, testing, tracking and automation), not someone who only posts or only runs ads.

Reports to: Growth Lead (Growth department)

What you'll own

• Social media campaigns on Instagram and YouTube (plus LinkedIn where it fits): themes, content calendars, launch moments and community growth

• Creator and community campaigns: creator collaborations, podcast guests, user-generated content and our WhatsApp community

• Paid media on Meta and Google: budget split, audiences, creative themes and weekly optimisation

• The organic-to-paid flywheel: spot posts that win organically and scale them with paid

• Tracking: social analytics, pixels and SDKs, Conversions API, a mobile measurement partner, Firebase, GA4 and UTMs

• Results: reach, saves, shares and follower growth; cost per install, activated users, retention and CAC

Frameworks you'll use

• Hero–Hub–Help for big moments, recurring series and everyday content

• See–Think–Do–Care to map every campaign to an intent stage

• Content pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself

• A metric tree: reach → engagement → clicks → installs → activated users → retained users

• Creative diagnostics: hook rate, hold rate, saves, shares, CTR and conversion

• ICE scoring and LTV:CAC to prioritise tests and spend

How AI fits this role

• Track trends, comments and conversations with AI and turn them into campaign ideas

• Draft calendars, campaign concepts and creator briefs with Claude, then sharpen them with your judgment

• Test hooks, captions and creative at speed with our video team using HeyGen and Higgsfield

• Get the best from Advantage+ and Google's automated campaigns with clean signals and creative variety

• Personalise messages by life problem, audience and market

• Automate reporting, comment insight and budget-pacing alerts

• Prompt engineering: keep a prompt library for on-brand, policy-safe captions, ads, briefs and analysis

• No fear-based hooks, fake urgency, engagement bait or claims to cure anxiety. In wellbeing, trust is the product.

What AI-native means here

You use AI every working day, not occasionally. You keep a shared prompt library (brand voice, caption and hook prompts, creator briefs, ad analysis), you can show us the prompts behind your best work, and you've automated at least one repetitive task. In the assignment, we'll ask for your prompts alongside the plan.

Must-haves

• 3+ years running social media campaigns and paid ads, accountable for growth and results

• Instagram and YouTube campaigns that grew reach, engagement and community, with numbers to show

• Hands-on Meta Ads and Google Ads, including app install or conversion campaigns

• Creator collaborations: finding, briefing and measuring creators

• Tracking: social analytics, pixels, SDKs, Conversions API, AppsFlyer, Branch or Adjust, Firebase, GA4

• Strong spreadsheet analysis: engagement, cohorts, CAC and payback

• Knowledge of Meta and Google policies for wellbeing and religious content

• Prompt engineering and daily use of AI tools

Tools you must know

• Paid ads: Meta Ads Manager and Events Manager (incl. Advantage+), Google Ads (App, Search, YouTube)

• Social: Meta Business Suite, Instagram Insights, YouTube Studio, a scheduler (Buffer, Later or Meta)

• Tracking: GA4, Firebase, Google Tag Manager, UTMs, AppsFlyer, Branch or Adjust

• Reporting: advanced Google Sheets or Excel, Looker Studio

• Creative: Canva, CapCut

• AI: Claude or ChatGPT, with your own prompt library

• Research: Meta Ad Library, Google Ads Transparency Center

• Workflow: ClickUp

Good to know: Apple Search Ads, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, SQL/BigQuery, social listening tools, HeyGen, ElevenLabs, Higgsfield, Zapier, Make or n8n

Nice-to-haves

• Wellness, meditation, edtech, spiritual or subscription brands

• LinkedIn and WhatsApp community campaigns

• Google Ads and Meta certifications

Who you are

Experience gets you the interview. Who you are gets you the role. We look for people who are grounded, curious, accountable, kind, humble and purpose-driven, and whose everyday life reflects what Kitab stands for:

• Know Yourself: you have a way to reflect, whether journaling, meditation, prayer, long walks or quiet time

• Grow Yourself: you read books, not just feeds, and keep learning

• Free Yourself: you love social media as a creator, yet you can put your phone down

• Conscious action: you wouldn't create content or ads that mislead or harm people

• Discipline and balance: healthy rhythms of sleep, movement and routine

• Service: you give back in some way

This isn't about religion, diet, rituals or background. People of every faith and none belong at Kitab.

Your first 90 days

• Day 30: social channels, past campaigns and tracking audited and fixed; first campaign calendar agreed; first paid tests live

• Day 60: first integrated campaign (organic, creators and paid) run end to end; weekly creative testing with the social and video teams

• Day 90: we know which channels bring people who stay; quarterly social and paid plan agreed; reporting automated; playbook documented

Compensation

Competitive, based on your experience and results. We'll discuss it openly in the first conversation.

Hiring process

1. Intro conversation with the Growth Lead

2. Work walkthrough: a social campaign and an ad account you've managed (anonymised is fine)

3. 72-hour assignment: a 30-day Kitab campaign covering organic content, one creator collaboration, Meta and Google ads, tracking, KPIs and 5 hooks, with the prompts you used

4. Culture conversation with Ganesh and Kitab leadership

5. Offer

How to apply

Apply here, then email one social campaign and one paid campaign case study (with results) to socials@kitab.com with the subject "Marketing Engineer – [Your name]". Tell us one habit that keeps you grounded.

This is a hands-on, cross-functional position that sits at the intersection of marketing and sales operations. title: Marketing Automation Specialist
description:
**We're Hiring: Marketing Automation Specialist**

**Company:**
NexBase

Hyderabad, India

Full-time

**Experience:**
2–4 years preferred

**About NexBase:**

NexBase is a recruitment services company focused on connecting businesses with qualified talent across multiple non-IT industries in the United States. We use technology, automation, and data-driven workflows to improve recruitment operations and business growth.

We are looking for a
**Marketing Automation Specialist**
to manage our email infrastructure, outbound campaigns, business process automations, and coordination with external freelancers.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Email Infrastructure & Management**

* Set up and manage company-owned Google Workspace accounts, business email addresses, and domains.
* Configure and monitor email authentication protocols, including SPF, DKIM, and DMARC.
* Manage mailbox provisioning, permissions, aliases, and account administration.
* Monitor email deliverability, sender reputation, bounces, and spam complaints.
* Maintain an organized inventory of email accounts, domains, subscriptions, and configurations.

**2. Email Campaigns & Outreach**

* Build, launch, and manage outbound email campaigns using tools such as Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, or similar platforms.
* Create email sequences, personalization rules, follow-up workflows, and campaign schedules.
* Manage prospect lists, data validation, deduplication, and segmentation.
* Track campaign performance, including delivery rates, replies, positive responses, and qualified meetings.
* Investigate campaign performance issues and implement corrective actions.
* Maintain suppression lists, respect opt-outs, and follow applicable email marketing laws and platform policies.

**3. Business Process Automation**

* Design, build, and maintain automations using Make, n8n, Zapier, or similar platforms.
* Integrate CRM systems, databases, email platforms, and other business applications.
* Work with Airtable, Baserow, APIs, webhooks, and AI tools to automate repetitive tasks.
* Identify operational bottlenecks and recommend practical automation solutions.
* Test workflows, troubleshoot failures, and implement error notifications and recovery procedures.
* Document workflows so they can be maintained by other team members.

**4. Freelancer & Project Coordination**

* Coordinate with freelancers for specialized automation and development projects.
* Prepare clear project briefs, technical requirements, and deliverables.
* Monitor timelines, review completed work, and test solutions before deployment.
* Manage project documentation and ensure all deliverables, credentials, and configurations remain under company control.
* Ensure freelancers receive only the access and information necessary to complete assigned work.

**5. Data Security & System Administration**

* Maintain appropriate access controls, multi-factor authentication, and secure credential-management practices.
* Protect confidential company information, client contacts, candidate data, contracts, and financial records.
* Follow least-privilege access principles when configuring integrations and assigning permissions.
* Maintain system inventories, change logs, documentation, and recovery procedures.
* Report suspicious activity, exposed credentials, or potential data incidents immediately.
* Ensure company systems remain accessible and recoverable if a freelancer or employee leaves.

**Required Skills & Qualifications:**

* 2–4 years of experience in marketing automation, email operations, marketing technology, or workflow automation.
* Hands-on experience managing email campaigns and automation platforms.
* Practical knowledge of Google Workspace administration and domain configuration.
* Understanding of SPF, DKIM, DMARC, email deliverability, and sender reputation.
* Experience with at least one automation platform, preferably Make or n8n.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, databases, APIs, and webhooks.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to coordinate freelancers and manage multiple projects.
* Excellent documentation, communication, and organizational skills.
* A strong sense of ownership, confidentiality, and accountability.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience with Apollo, Smartlead, Instantly, or comparable outbound platforms.
* Experience integrating Airtable or Baserow with other business applications.
* Familiarity with AI agents and AI-powered workflow automation.
* Basic understanding of OAuth, API-key security, access logs, and permission management.
* Experience supporting international B2B operations, preferably with US-based businesses.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

**Performance will be evaluated based on:**

* Reliability and maintainability of business automations.
* Campaign quality, deliverability, positive replies, and qualified opportunities.
* Reduction in manual work through successful automation.
* Timely execution of campaigns and automation projects.
* Quality of documentation and freelancer coordination.
* Compliance with company security procedures and protection of confidential data.

**What We Offer**

* Opportunity to own and improve core business systems.
* Exposure to international B2B operations and AI-driven automation.
* A role with significant responsibility, independence, and opportunities for professional growth

**How to Apply**

Please submit your résumé along with a brief description of an email campaign or automation workflow you have personally implemented.

Shortlisted candidates will complete a practical assessment covering campaign operations, automation design, troubleshooting, and data security.

**We are looking for someone who can build, operate, troubleshoot, and improve systems—not just someone familiar with the names of automation tools.**

title: Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)
description:
**Job Description — Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

Y-Axis Overseas Careers · October 2026

**About Y-Axis and the opportunity**

Y-Axis is hiring one person to build and scale a new direct-to-consumer channel: service products that customers browse, choose and buy online without a sales call.

Y-Axis Overseas Careers is one of India's best-known migration and overseas career consultancies. For years our services have been sold through counsellors and branches. We are now packaging them as fixed-scope, fixed-price products, such as Work in Europe, Work in Germany and Work in Dubai for Nurses, sold through dedicated sales pages with a self-serve checkout.

Selling a service online is harder than selling a physical product. The buyer cannot touch it, the outcome is months away, and trust decides the sale. We need someone who has already solved that problem in a service business, not only in retail or FMCG e-commerce.

**The role: Growth Lead – D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**Experience**

6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, at least 3 in a service-based business

**Reports to**

Head of Digital / Business Head

**Works with**

Performance marketing, web development, design, CRM, content, sales and operations

**Role summary**

You will own the online sale of Y-Axis service products end to end: the product catalogue, the storefront and checkout, the traffic that reaches it, and the revenue it produces. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and do much of the work yourself, while directing existing marketing, web and CRM teams to execute.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and revenue ownership**

•    Own the growth plan and revenue target for online service products, with clear goals for customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS) and payback.

•    Decide which products, countries and customer segments to prioritise, using data on demand, margin and conversion.

•    Run a weekly growth review with clear owners, actions and results.

**Catalogue and offer**

•    Turn Y-Axis services into clear, buyable products: scope, inclusions, timelines, price points, tiers and bundles.

•    Write and maintain product pages, comparison tiles and FAQs that answer objections before they become sales calls.

•    Work with finance and operations on pricing, refunds, instalments and payment options.

**Storefront, checkout and conversion**

•    Own the sales-page and checkout journey on y-axis.com, from product tiles to payment and confirmation.

•    Brief design and development on new pages and features; write clear requirements and test before launch.

•    Build trust into every step: reviews, success stories, credentials, guarantees and a transparent process.

•    Run A/B tests on headlines, pricing display, trust signals, creatives and checkout steps.

**Acquisition and retention**

•    Direct paid acquisition across Google, Meta, YouTube and affiliates for product-led campaigns.

•    Work with SEO and content teams to build organic demand for each product page.

•    Set up abandoned-cart recovery and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp and SMS.

•    Design a hybrid path where high-intent buyers can move between self-serve checkout and a counsellor without friction.

•    Drive upsell and cross-sell to related services after the first purchase.

**Analytics and reporting**

•    Track the full funnel in GA4: sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts, payments and refunds.

•    Report weekly to leadership on revenue, conversion, CAC and drop-off points, with clear next actions.

**What we are looking for**

•    6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, with at least 3 in a service-based industry: edtech, immigration, study abroad, travel, healthcare, insurance, fintech or professional services.

•    Proven record of selling a service or digital product online, with numbers to show: revenue grown, conversion improved, CAC reduced.

•    Hands-on with GA4, tag management, A/B testing tools, landing-page builders and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar).

•    Has managed paid media budgets with a clear return.

•    Understands high-consideration buying: long decision cycles, trust building and the hand-off between digital and human sales.

•    Clear, persuasive product copywriting in English; can brief developers and designers precisely.

•    Comfortable working without a dedicated team, influencing other teams to get things done.

**Good to have**

•    Experience launching a D2C or self-serve channel inside a sales-led business.

•    Knowledge of international markets (Europe, Gulf, Canada, Australia) and NRI or migrant audiences.

•    Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and WhatsApp commerce.

**How we will measure success**

**Metric**

**What it tells us**

**Online service-product revenue vs target**

Is the channel delivering?

**Visit-to-purchase conversion rate**

Is the storefront doing its job?

**CAC and ROAS**

Is growth profitable?

**Average order value and cross-sell revenue**

Are tiers, bundles and upsells landing?

**Refund and cancellation rate**

Are we selling the right product to the right buyer?

**What we offer and how to apply**

**What we offer**

•    The chance to build a new revenue channel from the ground up, with leadership backing.

•    Direct impact on people's lives: every sale helps someone start an overseas career.

•    A strong brand, an established customer base and a large existing service catalogue to package and sell.

•    Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives.

**How to apply**

* Send your CV and a short note (no more than 300 words) to [email address]. In the note, tell us about one service or digital product you helped sell online: what you changed, and what happened to the numbers.

title: VP, Product Management - Applied Intelligence
description:
**Who We Are**
Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.
  
  
We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.
  
  
**Our Values**
**Customers**
We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.
  
  
**Action**
We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.
  
  
**Team Spirit**
We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.
  
  
**Innovation**
We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.
  
  
**Excellence**
We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.
  
  
**About the Role:**
The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.
  
  
Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how
  
  
money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.
  
  
**What You'll Do:**
**AI Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.
* Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.
* Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Product Development & AI Innovation**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.
* Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.
* Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.
* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

**Organization Building & Talent**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.
* Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.
* Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

**Market Presence & Commercial Impact**

* Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.
* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.
* Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

**What You'll Bring:**
**Required Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.
* Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.
* Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.
* Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing applied AI product teams in a fast-moving enterprise SaaS or fintech environment.
* Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.
* Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence across the C-suite, board, customers, partners, and external audiences.
* Strong commercial acumen — able to connect AI product investment directly to revenue growth, retention, and competitive differentiation.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Direct experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable, cash application, collections, or B2B payments — either building products in this space or operating within it at enterprise scale.
* Familiarity with the data structures and integration patterns common in AR automation: ERP connectors, remittance data, invoice line-item detail, payment status feeds, and buyer identity resolution.
* Hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-model orchestration in enterprise production environments.
* Track record of representing product vision externally — at conferences, in analyst briefings, or in strategic customer advisory settings.
* Experience co-creating AI solutions with enterprise customers and translating those partnerships into roadmap impact and revenue.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**
****Director, Product Management****
**This role is**
**Office Based, Hyderabad Office**
**Director, Product Management — Learning**
**About Cornerstone**
Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.
  
  
**About The Role**
Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.
  
  
You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.
  
  
**In this role you will...**
**Set vision & strategy**

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
* Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
* Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
* Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

**Lead & grow the team**

* Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
* Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
* Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

**Discover, experiment & measure**

* Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
* Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
* Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
* Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

**Deliver with rigor**

* Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
* Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
* Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
* Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.

**What Success Looks Like**

* A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
* A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability. Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, anD measurable business outcomes.
* Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
* AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
* Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.

**You've Got What It Takes If You Have…**

* 10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
* A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
* Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
* Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
* Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
* Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.

**Nice To Have**

* Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
* Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
* Experience with skills-based capabilities, content ecosystems, or analytics/insights products.
* Familiarity with regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven product environments and enterprise governance models for AI and data.

**Our Culture**
Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.
  
  
**Who We Are**
At Cornerstone, we believe in AI that works in the service of people, amplifying their judgment to drive high-performing, future-ready organizations forward. Cornerstone Workforce AI™, the intelligence platform for workforce readiness, brings together workforce and labor market data into a proprietary Cornerstone People Graph™, translating signals into intelligence, targeting learning where it matters, developing critical skills, and surfacing hidden talent. Delivered as an open, enterprise platform across whatever application your people work in every day, Cornerstone Workforce AI is built for scale, security, and trust, with certified AI guardrails. As an industry leader, Cornerstone is helping approximately 7,000 organizations, 140M+ users, across 186 countries build continuous workforce readiness.
  
  
Check us out on LinkedIn , Comparably , Glassdoor , and Facebook !

Our purpose-driven culture inspires us to discover, develop, and deliver innovative medicines to prevail over serious diseases. We offer uniquely interesting and meaningful work, opportunities for growth, and a supportive environment that values inclusion, wellbeing, flexibility, and comprehensive benefits. This is work that transforms the lives of patients, and the careers of those who do it.
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

* Conduct analysis and interpretation of complex data sets to derive meaningful insights and recommendations
* Develop and maintain forecasting models and techniques to project sales, demand and market trends for products
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify business problems, goals and KPIs to develop analytical frameworks
* Conduct research & collect real-world data from multiple sources to support business strategies & decision-making
* Perform statistical analyses, data mining and predictive modelling to uncover trends and correlations
* Work closely with cross-functional teams to design and implement digital analytics initiatives and measurement frameworks to optimize marketing campaigns and customer engagement
* Prepare reports, dashboards and presentations to communicate findings, insights and recommendations to stakeholders at various levels of the organization

**Skills And Competencies**

* Strong analytical thinking and problem-solving skills with the ability to analyze complex data sets and draw meaningful conclusions
* Proficiency in statistical analysis techniques, predictive modeling and forecasting methodologies
* Strong project management skills and the ability to work independently or as part of a team
* Solid understanding of digital analytics tools and platforms
* Strong communication skills with the ability to present complex information to non-technical stakeholders in a clear manner.
* Strong business acumen and strategic thinking, with the ability to translate analytical findings into actionable insights and recommendations.

**Experience**

We hire for skills and capabilities, not just credentials – if this role excites you, but doesn’t perfectly match your resume, we encourage you to apply anyway.
  
  
**How We Work**
Where you work matters – because collaboration, innovation and patient impact happen in many settings. Our roles are structured across four work models: site-essential, site-by-design, field-based and remote-by-design. The model assigned to this role is based on its core responsibilities. Learn more at https://careers.bms.com/ways-of-working.

title: Client Analytics Business Partner
description:
**Marcus Evans**
is a global leader in business intelligence and growth partner for leading businesses worldwide, helping our clients grow by making connections, sharing knowledge, inspiring people, building relationships and creating new opportunities. Since 1983, we have brought decision-makers together through high-level summits, conferences, online platforms and performance programmes, working across all sectors and regions.

Our overriding approach is one of collaboration, and our belief that "We'll be our most successful when we work together." We recognise excellence and actively develop top performers into future leaders. Our culture promotes teamwork, continuous learning and global career growth.

**About Client Analytics**

Client Analytics is a new team in Hyderabad. It partners with the Managing Directors who lead our sales offices around the world, and helps them manage every client account to a consistent standard: before an event, on site and long after it. The team works on the data and discipline behind how we keep and grow clients, so our sales leaders can spend their time in front of them.

**Job Summary**

We're hiring Client Analytics Business Partner to work alongside the Managing Directors who run our sales offices in North America, APAC and Europe. You'll own the account management rhythm for those offices. That covers the rebook plan before every event, the results after it, the clients we're trying to win back, and the health of every active account. You'll turn client data into a clear view of where each account stands and what should happen next.

This is a partnering role, not a sales role and not an administrative one. You won't sell to clients. You will be the person an MD relies on to know whether the right work has been done on every account, to prompt it when it hasn't, and to report it clearly to our senior leadership.

This is an hybrid role in our Hyderabad office. Working hours overlap with the business day of the offices you support in North America and Europe.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Plan & Report: Build the pre-event rebook review four weeks out, covering what we plan to offer each client and how well we know them. Check that pricing has reached the sales team in time. Run a strategy update with the MD in the final one to two weeks. Four weeks after the event, report the outcome for every client.
* Win back lost clients: Own the lost opportunity list for your offices. Categorise each account, keep it current and review it with the MD every four weeks. Run the win-back programme, including the controlled use of complimentary video meetings. Track the results of reassigned accounts.
* Know the active portfolio: Keep a live view of each client showing what we know, what we plan to offer and when we next engage them. Use CRM data, AI tools and third-party sources to build the picture, and spot where the account can grow.
* Hold the standard: Monitor adherence to the account management workflow and alert the MD when a step is missed. Track KPIs and scoring, keep the dashboard current, and flag where retraining is needed. Work with Learning & Quality to train sales teams.
* Report to leadership: Present evidence-based reviews and clear recommendations to senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO.
* Work across the business: Partner with Operations, Finance, Marketing and Technology. Direct the Account Management Coordinators who support your offices. Suggest improvements to our reports and tools, including where AI can save time.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in business, commerce, economics, statistics or a related field
* Minimum 5 years in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial analytics, account management analytics or a similar role supporting sales leaders
* Experience working directly with senior stakeholders in the US, UK or Europe, and the confidence to challenge them constructively
* Advanced Excel, plus hands-on experience with a CRM such as HubSpot or Salesforce
* Able to turn data into a short, clear recommendation that a busy senior leader can act on
* Excellent written and spoken English (C1 or above)
* Highly organised and comfortable managing several stakeholders, deadlines and reporting cycles at once
* Discretion with commercially sensitive information
* Willing to work hours that overlap with North American and European offices

**Preferred**

* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification
* Experience in B2B services, events, media, consulting or financial services
* Experience with dashboard tools such as Power BI or Tableau
* Experience using AI tools for research and analysis
* Familiarity with sales intelligence platforms such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, ZoomInfo or Apollo
* Experience supporting account management, client retention or key account programmes

**Compensation**

**Compensation & Benefits**

Competitive base salary and performance base bonus opportunity, discussed in the hiring manager conversation

**Benefits**

* Work directly with Managing Directors and senior leadership, including the Chairman and CEO's office
* Join a new team at the start, and help shape how it works
* Fast-track, transparent promotional structure, with a path to Senior Business Partner and team leadership
* Opportunity to attend Marcus Evans events
* International travel opportunities
* A friendly, dynamic and vibrant work environment

**Marcus Evans**
is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity, and all employment decisions are based on qualifications, merit and business need.

title: Financial Data Analyst
description:
**Company Description**
Matrix Consulting is a contemporary financial consulting firm focused on comprehensive fundraising support for businesses across multiple industries, including Retail, Energy, Pharma, Agro, Shipping, Media, Entertainment, Automobile, Manufacturing, Trading, Hospital, IT, and Real Estate. The firm primarily serves Small and Medium Enterprises (SMEs) and large corporate institutions that drive economic growth and employment. Matrix Consulting works with a diverse range of promoters, from startups to second-generation entrepreneurs, helping them address challenges in expansion and organizational structuring. An internal Chartered Accountancy (CA) firm strengthens the company’s ability to deliver end-to-end financial services. The firm specializes in crafting tailored financial models and strategies, covering the full spectrum of fundraising from Private Equity and Debt procurement to exit strategies such as IPOs.

**Role Description**
The Financial Data Analyst is a full-time, on-site role based in Hyderabad. This role is responsible for collecting, cleaning, and analyzing financial and operational data to support fundraising, capital structuring, and strategic decision-making for clients. Day-to-day activities include building and maintaining financial models, performing variance and trend analysis, preparing data-driven reports and dashboards, and supporting due diligence for debt and equity transactions. The analyst will collaborate with consultants, finance professionals, and the internal CA team to interpret data, identify risks and opportunities, and provide actionable insights. The role also involves presenting findings to internal stakeholders, contributing to client presentations, and continuously improving data processes and methodologies.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong Analytical Skills and a demonstrated ability to interpret complex financial and business data.
* Candidates should possess Data Analytics and Data Analysis skills for handling large datasets, creating reports, and building dashboards.
* Candidates should possess Financial Analysis and Finance skills, including understanding of financial statements, ratios, valuation, and capital markets.
* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, Statistics, Data Science, or a related field.
* Proficiency in spreadsheets and data tools (e.g., Excel, SQL, BI tools such as Power BI or Tableau) and strong attention to detail.
* Effective communication skills, ability to present insights clearly, and capacity to work collaboratively in a consulting environment.
* Prior experience in financial services, investment banking, consulting, or corporate finance is an advantage.
* Professional certifications (e.g., CFA, FRM, CA, or relevant data analytics certifications) are beneficial.

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Working Days:**
Monday to Saturday

**Working Hours:**
10:00 AM to 7:00 PM

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

title: Driver Recruiter
description:
About MRK and the role

MRK (MetroRide Kids) runs safe, reliable school rides for children across Hyderabad. Parents trust us with their kids every morning and afternoon, so the quality of our drivers is the quality of our service.

As Driver Recruiter, you will own high-volume hiring of gig drivers and DCOs (Driver-cum-Owners) for MRK. You will source, screen, verify and onboard drivers who are safe, punctual and good with children, and keep the pipeline full as we add schools and routes.

Key responsibilities

•     
**Sourcing:**
Run high-volume driver hiring through referrals, driver hubs, stands, transport unions, local agencies, WhatsApp/Facebook groups, job portals (Apna, WorkIndia, Naukri) and walk-in drives.

•     
**DCO acquisition:**
Identify and onboard Driver-cum-Owners with suitable vehicles; explain the earning model, attachment terms and payout cycles clearly.

•     
**Screening:**
Conduct phone and in-person screening for driving skill, route knowledge, punctuality, communication and suitability to ride with children.

•     
**Verification:**
Coordinate document checks (DL, badge, RC, insurance, permit, fitness, PUC, Aadhaar, PAN), police verification and background checks; ensure zero gaps before a driver goes live.

•     
**Driving & vehicle checks:**
Schedule driving tests and vehicle inspections with the operations team.

•     
**Onboarding:**
Run induction on child safety, conduct norms, app usage and SOPs; hand over trained drivers to ops on time for route launches.

•     
**Pipeline & reporting:**
Maintain the candidate tracker and CRM; report daily/weekly funnel numbers (leads, screened, verified, onboarded, active) and turnaround times.

•     
**Retention & re-hiring:**
Track early attrition, collect exit reasons, re-engage dropped-off drivers and build a bench for peak demand and replacements.

•     
**Vendor & community management:**
Build relationships with driver agencies, fleet owners and local networks to keep a steady supply.

Requirements

•     1–5 years of experience hiring gig drivers, DCOs or delivery partners (ride-hailing, school/staff transport, logistics, quick commerce or similar).

•     Proven track record of high-volume, fast-turnaround blue-collar hiring.

•     Strong network of drivers, fleet owners and agencies in Hyderabad.

•     Working knowledge of driver documents, commercial vehicle permits and background verification processes.

•     Fluent in Telugu and Hindi; working English.

•     Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets and a CRM or applicant tracker.

•     Willing to work from the Hyderabad office and travel locally for sourcing drives.

•     Graduate in any discipline.

Good to have

•     Experience hiring for school transport, kids' mobility or other child-safety-sensitive roles.

•     Experience onboarding EV drivers or EV fleet partners.

•     Familiarity with Zoho CRM or Zoho Recruit.

•     Two-wheeler and a valid driving licence for field sourcing.

What we offer

•     Competitive salary with performance incentives on hiring targets.

•     Ownership of driver supply for a fast-growing kids' mobility business.

•     A mission that matters: getting children to school safely every day.

**How to apply:**
Send your CV to hr@metroride.com with the subject line "Driver Recruiter – MRK Hyderabad".

title: Talent Acquisition Coordinator - Contract Role
description:

The Talent Acquisition Coordinator (TAC) is responsible for driving efficient and consistent recruiting
  
  
operations that support the successful hiring of top talent. By partnering with recruiters, hiring managers,
  
  
and candidates, this role ensures a positive candidate experience, seamless interview coordination, and
  
  
effective execution of pre-employment processes. The TAC contributes to operational excellence through
  
  
strong attention to detail, process adherence, and exceptional stakeholder support
  
  
Job Type: Contractor – 1-year contract – under 3rd party employer (Vendor - Ascent)
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Interview Scheduling & Coordination
  
  

* Manage end-to-end interview scheduling across multiple regions and time zones
* Coordinate complex interview panels, including executive-level interviews
* Partner with recruiters and hiring teams to confirm interview structure, timelines, and logistics
* Monitor scheduling SLAs and proactively resolve conflicts, reschedules, and no-shows

Candidate Experience
  
  

* Serve as a primary point of contact for candidates throughout the interview process
* Communicate interview details, expectations, and logistics in a clear and timely manner
* Ensure a positive, professional, and high-touch candidate experience
* Manage interview reminders and day-of coordination support

Recruiting Operations Support
  
  

* Maintain accurate candidate data and statuses within Workday (or ATS)
* Support recruiters with requisition activity, interview tracking, and process updates
* Ensure timely documentation and dispositioning of candidates
* Track and follow up on interview feedback and next steps

Pre-Employment & Offer Support
  
  

* Coordinate pre-employment activities such as background checks and documentation
* Partner with recruiters and HR teams to support offer processes
* Monitor completion of pre-hire requirements and escalate issues when needed

Process Excellence & Collaboration
  
  

* Act as a key partner to recruiters and hiring managers to ensure efficient process flow
* Identify opportunities to improve scheduling, coordination, and candidate experience
* Adhere to defined SOPs, SLAs, and compliance requirements
* Support global operations in a fast-paced, high-volume environment

* 1–2 years of experience in Talent Acquisition or HR Operations
* Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to prioritize high-volume work
* Experience coordinating meetings, schedules, or logistics across multiple stakeholders
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* High attention to detail and accuracy

* Experience supporting recruiting or HR processes in a corporate environment
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems (e.g., Workday) and scheduling tools (e.g., Rooster)
* Experience working in a global or matrixed organization
* Ability to manage stakeholders across time zones

Strong coordination and problem-solving skills
  
  

* Ability to work under pressure and manage competing priorities
* Collaboration and stakeholder management
* Process discipline and continuous improvement mindset

* Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.

**Skill:** Senior Architect- AI
