The Senior Architect in Delivery leads architecture and technical direction for multi-team Azure programs across applications, platforms, and data. You connect client goals to scalable designs, guide delivery across teams, and shape modernization work so it delivers measurable results.

At this level, you influence architecture beyond a single project. You set direction across engagements, work with business and technology leaders, raise the bar on delivery quality, and promote reusable patterns. You mentor architects and senior engineers, support strategic pursuits, and turn working solutions into repeatable delivery models.

***Responsibilities***

**Solution Architecture and Technical Leadership**

* Lead architecture and technical strategy for Azure modernization and transformation programs that span multiple teams and workstreams.
* Translate client goals into scalable designs that align with business priorities, non-functional requirements, delivery constraints, and program-level outcomes.
* Drive architecture across teams so designs follow shared models, standards, and patterns.
* Collaborate with architects and engineers in other domains to integrate solutions and maintain a cohesive end-to-end architecture.
* Provide ongoing architectural guidance during implementation, including reviews of key designs and code, and define patterns and guardrails that teams can reuse.
* Apply solid engineering practices in your primary domain—modular design, clear interfaces, testability, and observability—so solutions remain robust and maintainable.
* Use AI-assisted tooling to accelerate design, code, tests, documentation, and analysis, and help teams adopt effective practices at program scale.

***Delivery and Consulting Excellence***

* Lead or co-lead discovery and roadmap work for programs or large workstreams, turning inputs into integrated, testable backlogs with clear non-functional requirements and dependencies.
* Use structured problem solving to clarify scope, dependencies, and risks at program scale, and explain options in terms of value, cost, risk, and time-to-impact.
* Communicate architecture strategy and decisions clearly to technical and non-technical audiences, including executives.
* Build trusted relationships with product, engineering, and technology leaders, and help shape modernization roadmaps in the client’s best interest.
* Provide architecture oversight so designs, interfaces, and integration points support predictable delivery and stable team velocity.
* Align multiple teams on shared outcomes, contracts, and integration points, ensuring dependencies are identified, owned, and tracked through to delivery.
* Help define delivery approaches, working agreements, and documentation practices that keep 3Cloud and client teams aligned across locations and time zones.
* Support effective use of Agile at scale by ensuring architecture and backlog structure enable incremental delivery, clear definitions of done, and data-informed adjustments based on telemetry and feedback.
* Apply a consulting mindset by anticipating client needs, proposing options, and tying solutions to clear results and adoption, and handle challenge and pushback by explaining trade-offs in simple, direct language.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI and emerging technologies to improve productivity, enhance decision-making, streamline delivery processes, and drive measurable business value. Commitment to continuous learning and adoption of new digital capabilities is required.
* Proven success operating within large, matrixed consulting organizations and navigating the scale, complexity, governance, and pace of a Global System Integrator (GSI) environment. Ability to manage competing priorities, collaborate across cross-functional teams, and consistently deliver results in a fast-paced, performance-driven setting.

***Mentorship and Team Development***

* Mentor architects, senior engineers, and technical leads, building their design skills, architectural judgment, and ability to work effectively across systems and teams.
* Provide architectural oversight across teams or workstreams, modeling pragmatic decision-making and showing when to keep solutions simple and when new patterns or technologies are justified.
* Support hiring and growth by participating in technical interviews, calibration discussions, and mentorship, and by helping shape development plans for future architects.
* Growth and Innovation
* Contribute to business development by identifying opportunities beyond the current assignment across all our capabilities and assisting the sales director in pursuing them.
* Intentionally builds relationship networks within client accounts to deepen partnership and identify opportunities to provide additional business value.
* Partner with sales and account leaders on strategic pursuits by setting the technical vision, contributing to solution strategy, and participating in client workshops, demos, and roadmap sessions.
* Create solution options, high-level designs, and estimates for programs, clearly documenting assumptions, dependencies, and risks and tying them back to business value and risk reduction.
* Build and evolve reusable assets—such as reference architectures, runbooks, workshops, starter repositories, and templates—that become standard paths for delivery teams.
* Champion adoption of modern frameworks, patterns, platform capabilities, automation, and AI-assisted tools that improve quality, speed, or reliability in a safe and secure way.
* Actively participate in enablement initiatives, share lessons from complex engagements, and help build a culture of collaboration, continuous improvement, and knowledge sharing.

***Requirements***

* 10+ years of experience delivering solutions in a primary technical domain.
* 5+ years of experience in solution architecture and leading development or engineering teams, including multi-team or multi-workstream efforts.
* Deep expertise across most of the following:
* Agents & Orchestration – leveraging Semantic Kernel, LangChain, or similar frameworks to design intelligent workflows; applying tool/function calling, planner and agent-based patterns, and workflow automation engines.
* Search & Retrieval – implementing solutions with vector databases such as Azure AI Search, Pinecone, FAISS, or Milvus; applying hybrid search methods, re-ranking strategies, and selecting embedding models for accuracy and performance.

* Data Integration & Governance – developing and managing data pipelines; applying quality controls, metadata practices, and master data management approaches.
* Analytics & Visualization – delivering insights with Power BI and other visualization tools.
* Proficiency with modern development tools (e.g., GitHub, Copilot, Cursor).
* Knowledge of analytics and data science tools, frameworks, and advanced techniques.
* Relevant Azure or Databricks certifications in AI, Data, or Architecture.

* Experience leading hybrid and remote teams and maintaining alignment, quality, and predictable delivery across time zones.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Product Management**
================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Director, Product Management — Learning**

**About Cornerstone:**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role:**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.

You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In this role you will...**

**Set vision & strategy**

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
* Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
* Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
* Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

**Lead & grow the team**

* Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
* Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
* Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

**Discover, experiment & measure**

* Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
* Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
* Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
* Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

**Deliver with rigor**

* Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.
* Establish strong operating cadences for milestone reviews, dependency management, risk tracking, and outcome measurement, surfacing risks early.
* Partner with go-to-market and customer-facing teams on rollout planning, launch enablement, implementation readiness, and feedback loops.
* Ensure capabilities are scalable, secure, compliant, and practical for adoption in enterprise environments, meeting expectations for security, privacy, and data governance.

**What Success Looks Like:**

* A clear, well-communicated vision and roadmap that leadership, customers, and the team understand and rally behind.
* A high-performing product team that ships quality work on a predictable cadence and grows in capability.
    
  Products that customers adopt and love — reflected in faster time-to-value, stronger engagement and retention, anD measurable business outcomes.
* Decisions grounded in evidence from discovery, experimentation, and metrics rather than opinion alone.
* AI-assisted and skills-based capabilities launched in ways that are trusted, usable, and outcome-oriented.
* Security, compliance, and data governance requirements embedded into delivery from the start.

**You've got what it takes if you have…**

* 10+ years in product management, including experience leading product managers, in enterprise software, SaaS, or platform organizations.
* A track record of owning product vision and strategy for a product area and translating it into roadmaps that ship and drive outcomes.
* Demonstrated people leadership — hiring, coaching, and growing product managers and setting team standards.
* Strong discovery and experimentation skills: customer research, hypothesis-driven development, metrics definition, and A/B testing.
* Proven ability to lead execution across complex cross-functional organizations with operational rigor and release discipline.
* Excellent collaboration and communication skills across engineering, UX, data science, services, sales, support, and customer success, up to the executive level.
* Experience delivering products in secure, enterprise-grade environments where trust, reliability, and scalability matter, including familiarity with security, privacy, and data governance.

**Nice to Have:**

* Experience in learning, HR technology, talent management, or skills/EdTech domains.
* Experience delivering AI-native products, intelligent agents, copilots, automation, or workflow-based AI in enterprise settings.
* Experience with skills-based capabilities, content ecosystems, or analytics/insights products.
* Familiarity with regulated, security-conscious, or compliance-driven product environments and enterprise governance models for AI and data.

#LI-Onsite

**Our Culture:**

Spark Greatness. Shatter Boundaries. Share Success. Are you ready? Because here, right now – is where the future of work is happening. Where curious disruptors and change innovators like you are helping communities and customers enable everyone – anywhere – to learn, grow and advance. To be better tomorrow than they are today.

**Who We Are:**

**Job Summary**
---------------

We are looking for a results-driven **International Business Development Manager** to lead business development and market expansion across international markets. The role will be responsible for identifying new market opportunities, developing international distribution networks, building strategic partnerships, and driving overseas sales growth for the company's healthcare technology products.

The ideal candidate should have experience in international B2B sales, distributor management, market entry strategy, and commercial negotiations, with the ability to independently develop business opportunities and establish a strong global presence.

  
  

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

**1. International Market Development**

* Identify and evaluate potential international markets based on demand, competition, market size, pricing, and business feasibility.
* Develop country-specific market entry strategies and business expansion plans.
* Identify priority countries and establish plans for market penetration and revenue growth.

**2. Distributor & Channel Partner Development**

* Identify, evaluate, negotiate with, and onboard international distributors, dealers, resellers, and channel partners.
* Build and maintain relationships with medical equipment distributors, hospitals, rehabilitation centers, physiotherapy clinics, and healthcare institutions.
* Develop partner engagement plans, sales targets, and channel development strategies.

* Generate and convert international business leads through direct outreach, industry networks, online platforms, exhibitions, and referrals.

**4. Strategic Partnerships**

* Establish strategic collaborations with healthcare groups, rehabilitation networks, medical equipment companies, and institutional buyers.
* Explore OEM, reseller, institutional procurement, and other relevant partnership opportunities.
* Represent the company at international exhibitions, conferences, trade fairs, and industry networking events.

**5. Regulatory & Commercial Coordination**

* Coordinate with internal teams on country-specific product registration, certifications, import requirements, and regulatory documentation.
* Work with operations and finance teams on export documentation, shipping, payment terms, and order fulfilment.
* Ensure that international business activities comply with applicable commercial and regulatory requirements.

**6. Reporting & Business Planning**

* Maintain international business development activities, leads, partner details, and opportunities in the CRM.
* Track market-wise performance, partner productivity, sales conversions, and revenue growth.
* Prepare periodic reports on market opportunities, business progress, competition, and expansion plans.

* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Business Administration, International Business, Marketing, Commerce, Engineering, or a related field.

* Proven experience in developing B2B business opportunities and managing international customer or distributor relationships.
* Experience in distributor identification, partner onboarding, commercial negotiations, and sales closure.
* Strong understanding of international sales processes, market research, and business development strategies.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel/Google Sheets, CRM software, and business research tools.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Experience in medical devices, healthcare technology, rehabilitation equipment, diagnostics, or medical equipment sales.

-------------------------------------

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In this position your main mission will be:**  

* Engineering mission and leadership:
* Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
* As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.
* Platform Engineering:
* Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
* Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
* Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
* Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.
* Architecture and industrialization:
* Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
* Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
* End-to-end delivery:
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
* Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.
* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:
* Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
* Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

What are we looking for?
  

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills
* Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
* Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
* DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
* Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
* Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
* Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
* MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)
* Leadership style
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
* Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
* Able to simplify without being simplistic
* Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
* Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs
* Mindset
* You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
* You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
* You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
* Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris).

What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

**Good to know:** The Recruitment Process
  
  

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

title: Inward and Outward Executive
description:
**Job Overview**

The Inward & Outward Executive is responsible for managing the complete movement of goods into and out of the warehouse. This includes handling **inward GRN**, **outward SRN**, **dispatch**, **e-way bill generation**, **gate pass management**, and maintaining accurate inventory records. The role ensures smooth warehouse operations, proper documentation, and timely coordination with logistics partners, suppliers, and internal teams.

**Key Responsibilities1. Inward Management (GRN)**

* Receive incoming materials and verify them against purchase orders, delivery challans, and invoices.
* Inspect goods for quantity, quality, and damages.
* Prepare and update **GRN (Goods Receipt Note)** accurately in the system.
* Coordinate with the procurement and accounts teams for any discrepancies.
* Ensure proper labeling and storage of all inward materials.

**2. Outward Management (SRN & Dispatch)**

* Process **SRN (Stock Return Note)** for outbound returns or transfers.
* Pick, pack, and dispatch orders as per the requirement.
* Schedule and coordinate dispatch with transporters or internal logistics teams.
* Ensure goods are dispatched on time and in good condition.
* Maintain daily dispatch registers for record-keeping.

**3. E-way Bill & Documentation**

* Generate **e-way bills** for all outward shipments as per statutory requirements.
* Prepare and maintain all necessary documents such as invoices, packing lists, gate passes, and dispatch documents.
* Ensure all documentation is accurate and filed systematically.

**4. Gate Pass Management**

* Issue gate passes for inward and outward material movement (returnable and non-returnable).
* Maintain gate pass logs and ensure proper authorization from relevant departments.
* Coordinate with security personnel for entry/exit of goods.

**5. Inventory Coordination**

* Update inventory records in the system after every inward and outward transaction.
* Monitor stock levels and report shortages/damages immediately.
* Follow FIFO/FEFO or other inventory management practices to ensure optimized stock rotation.
* Assist in monthly/quarterly physical stock verification.

**6. Returns & Reverse Logistics**

* Manage customer returns, vendor returns, and damaged stock returns.
* Inspect returned items and update the system accordingly.
* Coordinate with sales, QC, and accounts teams for return approvals.

**7. Coordination & Communication**

* Work closely with the procurement, logistics, store, and accounts teams to ensure smooth operations.
* Communicate with suppliers, transporters, and warehouse staff for issue resolution.
* Escalate discrepancies, damages, or delivery delays promptly.

**8. Compliance & Quality Control**

* Ensure all operations comply with company policies, safety guidelines, and statutory requirements.
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety within the warehouse area.

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

* 1–3 years of experience in warehouse/logistics operations (inward/outward handling preferred).
* Strong understanding of **GRN, SRN, e-way bills, dispatch, gate pass** and warehouse documentation.
* Knowledge of Tally, ERP systems, or inventory software (preferred).
* Good communication and coordination skills.
* Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with accuracy and attention to detail.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: ₹25,000.00 - ₹30,000.00 per month

description:
**Who We Are**

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

**Our Values**

**Customers**

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

**Action**

We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

**Team Spirit**

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

**Innovation**

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

**Excellence**

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

**About the Role:**

The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how

money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.

**What You'll Do:**

**AI Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.

* Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.

* Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

**Product Development & AI Innovation**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.

* Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.

* Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

**Organization Building & Talent**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.

* Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.

* Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

**Market Presence & Commercial Impact**

* Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.

* Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

  
**What You'll Bring:**

**Required Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.

* Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.

* Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.

* Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.

title: Senior Analyst, Risk Management
description:
Job Description:

**Job Purpose**

ICE Clear Europe’s Clearing Risk Department (“CRD”) is looking for a Senior Risk Analyst. The successful candidate will assist the senior risk managers in overseeing and shaping the risk management practice at one of the largest futures and options clearing houses in the world. You will be joining a very dynamic team, be exposed to a wide range of asset classes and be challenged with complex risk problems. You will be responsible for carrying out all aspects of the day-to-day risk management duties and assist in developing and implementing enhancements to the risk management tools, models, and processes. You will also participate in the design and implementation of new risk initiatives and products that benefit the business.

**Responsibilities**

* Conduct mathematical/statistical analysis to calibrate and enhance risk models

* Enhance documentation of risk processes, procedures and models
* Assist with communication with representatives from clearing members, risk committees and senior management of ICE
* Build and maintain risk management reports for the ICE Clear Europe board, various ICE Clear Europe risk committees and the regulators overseeing ICE Clear Europe
* Monitor model performance tests and assess the appropriateness of models in order to demonstrate policy adherence
* Collaborate with a group of colleagues on key policy and methodology development
* Conduct project work and run thematic or ad-hoc market research on relevant risk topics

**Knowledge and Experience**

* Bachelor's Degree in Mathematics, Engineering, Finance or other equivalent degrees
* Attention to detail and strong problem-solving skills with the ability to balance trade-offs
* Prior experience in risk management as a risk analyst or relevant professional experience (at an investment bank, hedge fund or clearing house) will be an advantage.
* Strong knowledge in financial derivatives products in multiple asset classes preferred
* Prior experience in applying risk management models and techniques such as Value at Risk models, Liquidity Risk models, backtesting and stress testing models will be an advantage.
* Ability to be a team player and to collaborate with other teams
* Ability to conduct research, analyze problems, formulate and implement solutions in an efficient, effective and independent manner
* Experience with SQL and Python
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills

title: VP, Product Management - Applied Intelligence
description:
**Who We Are**

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

**Our Values**

**Customers**

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

**Action**

We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

**Team Spirit**

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

**Innovation**

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

**Excellence**

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

**About the Role:**

The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how

money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.

**What You'll Do:**

**AI Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.

* Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.

* Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

**Product Development & AI Innovation**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.

* Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.

* Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

**Organization Building & Talent**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.

* Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.

* Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

**Market Presence & Commercial Impact**

* Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.

* Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

  
**What You'll Bring:**

**Required Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.

* Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.

* Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.

* Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing applied AI product teams in a fast-moving enterprise SaaS or fintech environment.

* Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.

* Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence across the C-suite, board, customers, partners, and external audiences.

* Strong commercial acumen — able to connect AI product investment directly to revenue growth, retention, and competitive differentiation.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Direct experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable, cash application, collections, or B2B payments — either building products in this space or operating within it at enterprise scale.

* Familiarity with the data structures and integration patterns common in AR automation: ERP connectors, remittance data, invoice line-item detail, payment status feeds, and buyer identity resolution.

* Track record of representing product vision externally — at conferences, in analyst briefings, or in strategic customer advisory settings.

* Experience co-creating AI solutions with enterprise customers and translating those partnerships into roadmap impact and revenue.

* Build relationships across plant-level and corporate-level decision-makers (maintenance, procurement, plant heads)

* Coordinate with Service Engineers to convert any SE-flagged upsell opportunities in their accounts into closed orders

**Reporting & Governance**

**Customer Coverage**

* SOM capture % at assigned customers
* M-Powered penetration in assigned accounts

title: Sales Manager for Mumbai, India
description:
**Location: Mumbai, Maharashtra, India**
Are you a results-driven sales professional with a passion for developing customer relationships and delivering sustainable business growth? Do you thrive in a technical sales environment where innovation, customer focus, and strategic thinking drive success?
  
  
At DEIF, we are currently looking for a full-time Area Sales Manager to strengthen our presence in Western India by expanding our customer base, increasing market share, and delivering value-driven power management, automation, and energy management solutions.
  
  
DEIF A/S is a worldwide leader in power efficiency, and we are on a journey to make a real difference in the world. We pursue an ambitious growth strategy and strive to be a global trendsetter in power-efficient products and intelligent control solutions. Our ambition is to be the preferred partner for efficient power management, recognized for our innovative platforms, technical expertise, and customer-centric approach.
  
  
**About The Job**
As our new Area Sales Manager, you will be responsible for driving sales growth across your assigned territory by identifying new business opportunities, strengthening relationships with existing customers, and executing DEIF's sales strategy to achieve ambitious business targets.
  
  
Working closely with customers, distributors, consultants, OEMs, EPC contractors, system integrators, panel builders, and internal stakeholders, you will play a key role in expanding DEIF's market presence while ensuring exceptional customer satisfaction and long-term business partnerships.
  
  
This position is based in
**Mumbai**
and reports to the Deputy General Manager - Sales West. The role involves extensive travel across the assigned territory.
  
  
**Working Tasks & Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute sales strategies to achieve and exceed sales targets within the assigned territory.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand DEIF’s market presence across Power Generation, Industrial Automation, Data Centres, BESS, Renewable Energy, and Marine sectors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with OEMs, EPC contractors, consultants, system integrators, panel builders, distributors, and end users.
* Promote DEIF’s technical solutions, including Generator Controllers, Power Management Systems (PMS), PLCs, SCADA, Protection Relays, and Energy Management solutions.
* Understand customer applications and provide value-driven technical solutions aligned with their power management and automation requirements.
* Prepare, negotiate, and close techno-commercial proposals, quotations, and supply agreements.
* Drive the complete sales cycle, from lead generation and customer engagement to technical discussions, negotiations, and order closure.
* Conduct customer visits, product presentations, demonstrations, technical discussions, seminars, and workshops to generate business and secure product approvals.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, customer requirements, and emerging technologies to identify new business opportunities.
* Collaborate with Engineering, Operations, Service & Support, Product Management, and Channel Partners for effective solution development and project execution.
* Maintain accurate sales pipelines, customer information, forecasts, and opportunities through the CRM system.
* Provide regular sales forecasts, market intelligence, and business performance updates to management and travel extensively across the assigned territory.

**What You'll Bring**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, or a related discipline.
* 8–12 years of experience in B2B technical sales, project sales, business development, or account management, preferably in the power, electrical, automation, or energy sector.
* Strong technical knowledge of Generator Controls, Generator Controllers, Power Management Systems (PMS), PLCs, SCADA, Protection Systems/Relays, and Energy Management Systems.
* Good understanding of power generation and DG applications, including generator control, synchronization, load sharing, power management, and electrical protection.
* Working knowledge of industrial automation, PLC-based control systems, SCADA, control panels, and system integration.
* Knowledge of BESS, hybrid power systems, renewable energy, and energy management solutions will be an advantage.
* Experience working with OEMs, EPCs, consultants, system integrators, panel builders, distributors, and end customers.
* Strong ability to understand technical requirements and convert them into practical, value-added solutions and techno-commercial proposals.
* Proven track record of achieving sales targets and managing the complete sales cycle from prospecting to order closure.
* Strong commercial, negotiation, presentation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
* Experience with CRM systems, sales pipeline management, forecasting, and reporting.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned territory.

**What Makes You Successful**
You are a commercially driven and customer-focused professional who enjoys building long-term partnerships and identifying opportunities that create value for customers. You combine strong business insight with technical knowledge and are motivated by achieving ambitious sales targets.
  
  
You have the ability to understand technical customer requirements, engage confidently with engineering and technical stakeholders, and position the right power management, automation, and energy solutions for the application.
  
  
You communicate effectively with stakeholders at all levels, demonstrate resilience when facing challenges, and excel in developing practical solutions that meet customer needs. Your collaborative mindset enables you to work successfully across functions while maintaining accountability for delivering results.
  
  
Above all, you are proactive, adaptable, technically curious, and passionate about contributing to DEIF's continued growth through innovation, customer excellence, and sustainable business development.
  
  
**Why Join DEIF?**
At DEIF, you'll become part of a global organization committed to innovation, sustainability, and empowering people. We offer a collaborative and inclusive work environment where your ideas are valued, your development is supported, and your contributions make a meaningful impact.
  
  
As part of our ambitious growth journey, you'll have the opportunity to work with industry-leading technologies, collaborate with talented colleagues across the globe, and help shape the future of intelligent power management, automation, and energy management solutions.
  
  
If you're ready to grow your career with a company that values innovation, teamwork, and customer success, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Cover letters are encouraged as part of your application.
  
  
At DEIF, we are Winning Together!
  
  
We promise you'll experience a culture based on values such as Ambitions, Perspective, and Respect, where we are Winning Together. We are a global company and work in many different locations – however, we are all united by a wish to make our customers and colleagues succeed. You'll experience a highly professional work environment where continuous learning, empowerment, and collaboration is essential.
  
  
We are in a continuous process of developing new intelligent products and solutions that can contribute to accelerating the green transition. Sustainability is central to our business, and we have recently been recognized in the EY Entrepreneur of The Year 2023, where we won the award in the ESG category.
  
  
Curious to learn more about the benefits of working at DEIF? Delve into the details by visiting our career page at
**https://career.deif.com**

title: Business Development, Partnerships & PR Manager
description:
**Folk Objects | Full-time | Mumbai (Hybrid)**

About Folk Objects

Folk Objects is a design-led home and living brand bringing together thoughtful design, distinctive objects and products for considered spaces. We work at the intersection of product, craft and contemporary living, with an ambition to build relationships with designers, architects and creative communities across the world.

About the Role

We’re looking for a Business Development, Partnerships & PR Manager to grow Folk Objects’ presence in India and international markets.

You’ll build relationships with architects, interior designers, independent creatives, design studios and relevant media, creating opportunities for our products to reach new audiences and become part of exciting projects around the world.

The role combines business development, community outreach, creative collaborations and PR. You’ll be responsible for identifying the right people and opportunities, initiating relationships, developing partnerships and executing campaigns that build both brand visibility and commercial growth.

This is a hands-on role for someone who is commercially driven, genuinely interested in design, and excited about building a globally relevant design brand.

What You’ll Do

**1. Global Business Development**

* Identify and build relationships with architects, interior designers, hospitality designers, design studios and other relevant trade buyers across India and international markets.
* Develop targeted outreach strategies to introduce Folk Objects’ products and collections to design professionals.
* Build and manage a pipeline of trade enquiries, project opportunities, bulk orders and repeat B2B business.
* Understand project requirements and connect designers with relevant products and furnishing solutions from our catalogue.
* Explore opportunities to get Folk Objects products specified in residential, hospitality and commercial projects.
* Develop relationships with international stockists, retail partners and potential distribution partners where relevant.
* Track outreach, meetings, leads, proposals and conversions to drive measurable business growth.

**2. Designer & Creative Partnerships**

* Build relationships with independent designers, artists, makers, photographers, stylists and other creatives.
* Identify opportunities for co-created collections, limited-edition products, creative collaborations and editorial projects.
* Develop partnership proposals that create value for both Folk Objects and its collaborators.
* Explore collaborations with complementary design brands, studios and creative businesses.
* Build a network of creatives who can contribute to the brand’s products, storytelling and visibility.

**3. Design Community & Outreach**

* Build and nurture a community of architects, interior designers and creative professionals around Folk Objects.
* Identify relevant design events, exhibitions, trade fairs, industry gatherings and networking opportunities in India and internationally.
* Organise or support designer meet-ups, product previews, studio visits and intimate community gatherings.
* Develop ongoing engagement with the design community through personalised outreach and meaningful interactions.
* Identify opportunities to showcase projects featuring Folk Objects products and build relationships through shared visibility.

**4. PR & Brand Visibility**

* Plan and execute PR campaigns to build Folk Objects’ visibility across design, architecture, interiors, lifestyle and relevant business publications.
* Build relationships with editors, journalists, publications, stylists and other media contacts in priority markets.
* Pitch product features, collection launches, founder stories, creative collaborations and brand narratives.
* Develop press lists, campaign calendars, pitches and press materials in collaboration with the internal team.
* Identify relevant design awards, exhibitions, editorial opportunities and industry platforms.
* Build sustained brand recognition rather than relying only on one-off media coverage.

**5. Strategy, Reporting & Execution**

* Map priority markets, target audiences and partnership opportunities.
* Build and maintain a structured database of designers, architects, creatives, media contacts and prospective trade partners.
* Manage outreach and follow-ups through a CRM or other tracking tools.
* Track key metrics, including qualified leads, project enquiries, active partnerships, revenue generated and PR placements.
* Work closely with the design, product, sales and marketing teams to translate opportunities into tangible outcomes.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–6 years of experience in business development, partnerships, PR or community outreach.
* Experience in interiors, architecture, furniture, home, lifestyle, design or another creative industry is strongly preferred.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including personalised outreach and partnership pitching.
* Confidence in building relationships with senior professionals, both in India and internationally.
* An understanding of how architects and interior designers discover and specify products for their projects.
* Experience developing partnerships, executing PR campaigns or building professional communities.
* Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple relationships and opportunities simultaneously.
* A proactive, resourceful approach with a clear focus on outcomes.

You’ll Be a Great Fit If You

* Have a genuine interest in design, architecture, interiors, craft and contemporary living.
* Enjoy building relationships from scratch and turning conversations into opportunities.
* Can balance commercial goals with thoughtful, long-term partnerships.
* Are comfortable reaching out to people across geographies and building a credible case for why they should work with Folk Objects.
* Have a global outlook and are curious about international design communities.
* Can move comfortably between a commercial conversation with an interior design studio, a creative collaboration with an independent artist and a PR pitch to a design editor.
* Are self-driven, organised and comfortable owning outcomes from idea to execution.

What Success Looks Like

* A growing network of architects, interior designers and trade partners in India and international markets.
* Qualified project enquiries, product specifications, bulk orders and repeat B2B business.
* Meaningful creative collaborations that strengthen the Folk Objects brand.
* Consistent PR coverage and increased visibility across relevant design and lifestyle platforms.
* A growing community of design professionals who engage with, specify and recommend Folk Objects.
* Measurable contribution to brand awareness, partnerships and revenue growth.

To Apply

Please share your CV and a brief overview of your experience in business development, partnerships, PR or community building. Include examples of partnerships, campaigns or business relationships you have personally developed.

Hybrid

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

Sales Manager – Robotics Division

Lead robotics sales at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. Building India's robotics market from the front line is a priceless opportunity.

Sell cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka, Unitree and Hiwin Robotics, to manufacturers across India.

Department: Robotics Division – Sales

Reporting to: Head – Sales / Business Head

Experience: 5+ years, preferably in robotics, cobot or industrial automation sales

The Role

You will own sales for Luna's Robotics Division across India. You will build the strategy, grow key accounts and a strong pipeline, and lead a team of sales engineers. Working with our Field Application Engineers and Managers, you will turn customer problems into robot and AMR solutions, from first meeting and demo to order, commissioning and repeat business.

What You Will Do

• Sales strategy: build and run the robotics sales plan, choose target industries and regions, and set the market-entry approach for new products.

• Solution selling: sell robot, cobot, AMR/AGV, humanoid and robot dog solutions to manufacturers, from discovery and application study to proposal, negotiation and closure.

• Key accounts: own relationships with major customers and grow them into long-term partnerships with repeat orders.

• Pipeline: generate leads, qualify opportunities and keep a healthy, well-documented CRM pipeline.

• Demos and commissioning: work with the FAE/FAM team on demos, proof-of-concept trials, feasibility and smooth commissioning and handover.

• Channel partners: build and manage system integrators, distributors and channel partners to extend our reach across India.

• Team leadership: hire, train, set targets for, coach and motivate the robotics sales team, and build a high-performance sales culture.

• Targets: own order booking and revenue targets, track KPIs and take corrective action early.

• Forecasting and reporting: share accurate forecasts, pipeline reviews and sales reports with management.

• Market insight: track trends, competitors and emerging applications, and represent Luna at exhibitions and industry events.

• Collaboration: share field feedback with marketing, product, operations and our in-house robot design team to shape new products and offers.

• Customer success: support customers through the sales cycle and, with service and technical teams, resolve issues quickly.

Applications You Will Sell Into

Welding, laser cutting, palletizing, material handling, machine tending, assembly, gluing, intralogistics and warehouse automation, flexible manufacturing, metal processing, semiconductor, 3C electronics and new retail.

Must Have

• BE / B.Tech / Diploma in Mechanical, Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Automation or a related discipline.

• 5+ years in B2B technical sales, preferably selling robots, cobots, AMRs or industrial automation.

• Proven record of meeting sales targets and closing solution sales with manufacturing customers.

• Strong understanding of robotics and industrial automation (robot arms, controllers, servo, drives, motion control, PLC, HMI).

• Experience managing key accounts and working with channel partners or system integrators.

• Excellent communication, presentation and negotiation skills; able to explain technical products in business language.

• Self-motivated, result-oriented and willing to travel across India.

Good to Have

• Experience selling ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV, warehouse automation or intralogistics sales experience.

• Experience leading or mentoring a sales team.

• Existing network among OEMs, automotive, electronics, FMCG, pharma or general manufacturing customers.

• Familiarity with CRM tools and consultative selling methods.

What You Will Learn

Leading a robotics sales team; selling robotic systems, cobots, AMRs and humanoids across real applications; Luna's Solution Finder and consultative selling approach; robotics and laser automation workflows; and end-to-end B2B solution sales, from lead to repeat business.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Sell products built by our own team, alongside Fairino, Yasaka, Unitree and Hiwin Robotics. A priceless opportunity.

• A product range that opens doors: cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, so you can offer every customer a complete solution.

• Real ownership: shape the strategy, build your team and make fast decisions, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the Robotics Division scales, your role grows into senior sales and business leadership.

• Strong technical backing: a dedicated FAE/FAM team for demos, trials and commissioning, so you can focus on winning business.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, national and international exhibitions, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and AI.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance-linked incentives, recognition for top performers and a friendly, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners. www.luna.co.in

description:

Role Summary
  
  
Agrocorp International is seeking a commercially driven and results-oriented Business Development Manager to grow Agrocorp Food Ingredients’ product portfolio and market presence in India. Based in Mumbai, this role will focus on driving sales and profitability, developing new business opportunities, and expanding customer relationships across the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying new market opportunities, particularly for pea protein isolates and starches, while strengthening Agrocorp’s position as a leading supplier of food and health ingredients in India. This role requires a proactive, entrepreneurial individual with strong commercial acumen, a proven track record in business development, and the ability to build long-term partnerships in a competitive market.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Sales & Business Development
* Develop and execute sales strategies to expand Agrocorp Food Ingredients’ product portfolio and market share in India.
* Achieve annual sales revenue and gross profit targets.
* Identify, develop and convert new business opportunities to build a sustainable customer pipeline.
* Explore new applications and market segments for pea protein isolates, starches and other food ingredients.
* Identify emerging market trends and customer needs to support business growth and product development.
* Customer Relationship Management
* Establish and strengthen relationships with local, regional and global customers operating in India.
* Build long-term partnerships with key accounts across the food, beverage and nutraceutical industries.
* Obtain customer forecasts, secure requests for quotations (RFQs), negotiate pricing and commercial terms, and drive business closure.
* Understand customer requirements and work closely with internal stakeholders to deliver effective solutions and maintain customer satisfaction.
* Market Intelligence & Strategic Growth
* Monitor market trends, competitor activities, pricing dynamics and industry developments.
* Gather and analyse competitor and market intelligence, providing timely insights and recommendations to Agrocorp’s suppliers.
* Identify opportunities to expand product applications, customer segments and market reach.
* Contribute to the development and implementation of business strategies to strengthen Agrocorp’s brand and competitive position in India.
* Commercial & Working Capital Management
* Monitor customer accounts receivable and ensure timely collection of outstanding payments.
* Manage inventory levels and stock ageing within acceptable business parameters.
* Support effective working capital management while balancing sales growth and commercial risks.
* Work closely with Customer Service and relevant internal teams to ensure the timely registration of customers, vendors and materials in Agrocorp’s ERP systems.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Collaborate with the Business Head, suppliers, Customer Service and other internal stakeholders to ensure seamless execution of business activities.
* Provide timely updates on sales performance, pipeline development, market opportunities and customer requirements.
* Ensure accurate documentation, systematic follow-up and compliance with internal processes and commercial policies.

**Requirements & Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Chemistry, Chemical Engineering or a related discipline.
* 5–10 years of experience in sales or business development, preferably within food ingredients distribution or related industries.
* Proven experience in the food, beverage or nutraceutical sectors, with a strong understanding of ingredient markets and customer applications.
* Demonstrated track record of achieving sales and gross profit targets and developing new business accounts.
* Experience in customer negotiations, pricing strategy, account management and commercial risk assessment.
* Strong understanding of market dynamics, competitive positioning and working capital management.

Desired Knowledge, Skills & Attributes
  
  

* Entrepreneurial mindset: Proactive hunter mentality with a strong drive to identify and capture new business opportunities.
* Commercial acumen: Strong understanding of sales, profitability, pricing and commercial negotiations.
* Strategic thinking: Ability to identify growth opportunities and translate market insights into actionable business strategies.
* Adaptability: Comfortable working in an evolving business environment with ambiguity and changing priorities.
* Relationship building: Excellent interpersonal, influencing and stakeholder management skills.
* Analytical ability: Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret market data and identify business opportunities.
* Execution excellence: Highly organised, systematic and detail-oriented, with strong follow-through.
* Initiative and accountability: Self-motivated, results-driven and willing to take calculated risks to achieve business objectives.
* Customer focus: Committed to understanding customer needs and delivering sustainable commercial value.
* Collaboration: Effective team player who can work across functions and engage with diverse, multicultural stakeholders.

Agrocorp International is a leading global agri-commodities company, connecting farmers, processors, and markets across key regions worldwide. With a strong presence in origination and destination markets, we specialize in sourcing, processing, and distributing high-quality agricultural products. Driven by innovation, sustainability, and a people-first culture, Agrocorp offers a dynamic environment where talent can grow, gain global exposure, and make a meaningful impact in the food supply chain.

title: Fire Fighting (Mechanical) Project Estimation Engineer
description:
**Job Title: Fire Fighting (Mechanical) Project Estimation Engineer**

**Department: Mechanical Tendering & Pre-Sales**

**Reports To: Head of Fire Project Estimation / Tendering Manager**

**Employment Type: Full-time**

**Job Summary**

**The Fire Fighting (Mechanical) Project Estimation Engineer focuses strictly on the mechanical aspects of fire protection. You will evaluate tender documents, review architectural/MEP drawings, and develop precise cost estimations for fluid-based and gas-based fire suppression systems. This role demands sharp attention to detail to build accurate Bills of Quantities (BOQ), run complex hydraulic calculations, and ensure all bids comply perfectly with relevant safety codes.**

**Key Responsibilities & Duties**

**1. Mechanical Material Take-Off & Costing**

**• Review engineering layouts to quantify piping networks, valves, fittings, and heavy equipment.**

**• Prepare comprehensive BOQs for fire hydrant systems, wet/dry sprinkler systems, and pre-action setups.**

**• Estimate structural requirements including pipe supports, hangers, seismic bracing, and anti-corrosive coatings.**

**• Factor in complex installation expenses such as hot work, structural welding, pipe threading, grooving, and testing/commissioning phases.**

**• Track steel and raw metal market indices to adjust pricing for piping materials dynamically.**

**2. Hydraulic Calculations & Design Validation**

**• Perform advanced hydraulic calculations using software like Elite Fire, SprinkCAD, or Pipenet.**

**• Size mechanical infrastructure accurately, including pipe diameters, fire pump capacities (GPM/Head), and water storage tank volumes.**

**• Validate heavy machinery placement, ensuring fire pump house configurations and diesel/electric pump assemblies meet hydraulic demands.**

**• Propose value engineering alternatives to reduce material weights or optimization of routing without failing pressure tests or safety margins**

**3. Special Suppression Systems Costing**

**• Design and cost gas suppression networks including FM-200, Novec 1230, Inergen, and CO₂ systems.**

**• Estimate clean agent requirements by calculating exact room volumes and leakage limits.**

**• Quantify specialized systems such as foam-water deluges for high-hazard zones and kitchen hood wet chemical suppression.**

**4. Tendering & Vendor Management**

**• Float detailed RFQs to pipe manufacturers, valve suppliers, and specialized pump vendors.**

**• Build technical compliance matrices to compare vendor offers against strict client specifications.**

**• Draft comprehensive technical submittals outlining system operational limits, pump curves, and material data sheets.**

**Required Skills & Qualifications**

**• Education: Bachelor’s Degree or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering.**

**• Experience: 3 to 6 years of pure mechanical estimation experience within the fire protection industry.**

**• Regulatory Frameworks: Strong command over NFPA standards (NFPA 11, 13, 14, 15, 20, 24, and 2001) alongside local building codes or civil defence regulations.**

**• Software Toolkit: Advanced proficiency in AutoCAD (2D), MS Excel, Bluebeam, and Elite Fire / SprinkCAD. Experience reviewing Revit/BIM models is preferred.**

**• Hardware & Component Mastery: In-depth knowledge of seamless/ERW piping, groove/thread fittings, deluge valves, pressure reducing valves (PRVs), backflow preventers, and diesel/electric fire pump controllers.**

**Salary Package**
: 6 to 5 LPA

**Benefits :**

24 Paid Leaves. (start after probation - Monthly 2 leave)

Health Insurance. (start after probation)

12 to 13 days National Holidays.

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
