Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

title: Sr Client Manager Sovereign Cloud
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Sovereign Cloud Client Manager will lead Lenovo’s growth agenda for sovereign, private, hybrid and disconnected cloud solutions across strategic enterprise and public-sector customers. The role will identify, shape and close complex opportunities where data control, jurisdictional requirements, security, operational authority, resilience and regulatory compliance are critical.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the primary customer-facing sales leader, engaging CXOs, technology leaders, risk and compliance stakeholders, and lines of business. The role will orchestrate Lenovo infrastructure, services, software, security, financing and partner capabilities to deliver end-to-end sovereign cloud outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Account Leadership
  
  

* Own the sovereign cloud strategy and sales plan for a defined portfolio of high-potential accounts and sectors.
* Develop account plans, stakeholder maps, opportunity roadmaps and executive engagement strategies.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CDOs, risk and compliance leaders, and business decision makers.
* Lead long-term transformation conversations rather than transactional infrastructure sales.

Sovereign Cloud Opportunity Creation
  
  

* Identify opportunities across sovereign private cloud, hybrid cloud, disconnected environments, data residency, regulated workloads, secure collaboration, sovereign AI and workload repatriation.
* Qualify customer requirements covering data location, access control, encryption-key custody, operational control, auditability, resilience and legal or regulatory exposure.
* Translate business, security and compliance challenges into measurable customer outcomes and compelling business cases.
* Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria and forecast discipline.

Solution Shaping Advisory
  
  

* Work with solution architects and services teams to define the customer’s target sovereignty posture and deployment model.
* Shape solutions spanning Lenovo ThinkAgile, compute, storage, networking, security, management, lifecycle services and as-a-service capabilities.
* Position hybrid and disconnected operating models based on workload criticality, regulatory needs, connectivity and operational requirements.
* Ensure the proposed architecture aligns infrastructure, software, services, governance and customer operating processes.

Pursuit Deal Management
  
  

* Lead pursuit strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder sovereign cloud opportunities.
* Orchestrate resources across ISG, SSG, product, pre-sales, security, finance, legal, delivery and business partners.
* Drive proposal development, bid governance, commercial negotiations, risk management and deal closure.
* Maintain opportunity hygiene, forecasting accuracy, review cadence and executive sponsorship.

Executive Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Create and execute CXO engagement plans, executive briefings, workshops and sovereignty discovery sessions.
* Position Lenovo as a strategic partner for secure, compliant and resilient cloud transformation.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and other cloud, software, security, networking and services partners to build differentiated solutions.
* Represent customer requirements internally and influence solution, go-to-market and investment priorities.

Success Measures
  
  

* Qualified sovereign cloud pipeline and progression through agreed sales stages.
* Revenue, margin and signings performance against assigned targets.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and expansion within priority accounts.
* Quality of account plans, executive relationships, forecast accuracy and cross-functional execution.
* Customer adoption outcomes and creation of repeatable references or use cases.

Education Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; full-time MBA preferred.
* 12-18 years of overall experience, including at least 10 years in enterprise technology sales.
* Minimum 3 years of consultative or value-based solution selling in cloud, data center, security, infrastructure, managed services or complex transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing large accounts and multi-party pursuits involving customers, OEMs, cloud providers, software partners and system integrators.
* Experience in regulated industries, government, critical infrastructure or customers with stringent sovereignty requirements is strongly preferred.

Skills Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of sovereign cloud principles, including data residency, jurisdictional control, access governance, key custody, auditability, resilience and disconnected operations.
* Working knowledge of hybrid/private cloud architectures, virtualization, containers, compute, storage, networking, security and lifecycle operations.
* Ability to connect technical and regulatory requirements with commercial value and business outcomes.
* Strong executive presence, strategic thinking, consultative selling and business storytelling.
* Proven influencing, negotiation, stakeholder management and pursuit leadership skills.
* High collaboration across functions, geographies and partner ecosystems.
* Strong account planning, opportunity management, pipeline hygiene and forecasting discipline.
* Comfort operating in an emerging market with evolving offerings, regulations and customer requirements.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

**Job Description: Operations Executive**

**Company:** Systematic Industries Limited  
**Industry:** Wire & Cable Manufacturing  
**Department:** Operations  
**Designation:** Executive  
**Experience:** 1 year+  
**Location:** Mulund- Mumbai  
**Days of working:** 6 days a week

**Job Summary**

We are looking for a proactive Operations Executive to support day-to-day manufacturing operations at our wire and cable plant. The role coordinates production planning, material availability, dispatch and inter-departmental communication to ensure orders are delivered on time, at the required quality and at optimal cost.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Production Planning & Coordination**

* Prepare and track daily, weekly and monthly production schedules based on sales orders and delivery commitments.
* Coordinate with production supervisors on machine allocation across drawing, stranding, insulation/extrusion, laying-up, armouring and sheathing processes.
* Monitor production progress against plan and escalate delays, bottlenecks or machine downtime.
* Follow up on pending and priority orders, and update sales and customer-service teams on order status.

**Material & Inventory Management**

* Coordinate with stores and purchase teams to ensure timely availability of raw materials such as copper, aluminium, PVC/XLPE compounds, armouring wire/tape, packing material and drums.
* Track stock levels of raw materials, WIP and finished goods; flag shortages early.
* Support periodic stock verification and help reduce scrap, wastage and material variance.

**Quality & Compliance Coordination**

* Work with QA/QC to ensure products meet applicable standards (e.g., IS/BIS, IEC, customer specifications) and that test reports are available at dispatch.
* Help close out customer complaints and rejections with root-cause follow-up.
* Support internal and external audits (ISO 9001, ISO 14001, ISO 45001 as applicable).

**Dispatch & Logistics**

* Plan dispatches in line with customer schedules; coordinate with packing, stores and transporters.
* Ensure accurate documentation: invoices, delivery challans, e-way bills, test certificates and packing lists.
* Track in-transit consignments and resolve delivery issues.

**Reporting & MIS**

* Maintain daily production, dispatch, inventory and downtime reports.
* Prepare MIS covering OEE, yield, scrap %, on-time delivery and order backlog.
* Update ERP entries accurately and on time.

**Safety & Continuous Improvement**

* Promote adherence to plant safety, 5S and housekeeping practices.
* Identify and suggest improvements in process flow, changeover time and cost reduction.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Diploma/B.E./B.Tech in Mechanical, Electrical, Production or Industrial Engineering (B.Com/BBA/B.Sc with relevant experience may be considered).
* 2–5 years of experience in operations, production planning or PPC, preferably in wire & cable, electrical or a similar manufacturing industry.
* Fresh graduates with strong aptitude may be considered for a junior role.

**Skills & Competencies**

**Technical**

* Understanding of wire and cable manufacturing processes and products (house wires, power, control, instrumentation and flexible cables).
* Knowledge of production planning, inventory control and basic costing.
* Proficiency in MS Excel (pivot tables, lookups, dashboards) and working knowledge of ERP (SAP/Tally/Oracle/other).

**Behavioural**

* Strong coordination, follow-up and communication skills.
* Analytical, detail-oriented and good at problem-solving under pressure.
* Ability to work with shop-floor teams and cross-functional departments.
* Ownership mindset and comfort with a fast-paced plant environment.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* On-time delivery (OTD %)
* Production plan adherence
* Scrap and wastage %
* Inventory accuracy and stock turnover
* Machine utilisation / downtime
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS reports

**Working Conditions**

* Based at the manufacturing plant with regular shop-floor presence.
* May require extended hours during peak production or urgent dispatches.
* Will have to visit plant.

1. Job Summary

We are looking for an experienced E-Commerce Receivables Executive to manage marketplace settlements, payment reconciliation, outstanding receivables, and financial transactions across online sales channels. The candidate should have hands-on experience reconciling marketplace sales and settlements, identifying deductions and discrepancies, and ensuring timely recovery of outstanding amounts.

Experience working with e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, and Myntra will be preferred.

2. Key Responsibilities

* Manage accounts receivable and settlement reconciliation for e-commerce marketplaces.
* Reconcile marketplace sales, customer orders, returns, cancellations, refunds, commissions, and settlement amounts.
* Verify payments received against marketplace settlement reports and company books.
* Identify and resolve discrepancies relating to short payments, deductions, penalties, commission charges, and other adjustments.
* Track pending settlements, payment holds, and outstanding receivables from marketplaces.
* Coordinate with marketplace support teams to raise claims and resolve payment-related issues.
* Maintain marketplace-wise receivables and settlement ageing reports.
* Reconcile sales returns, credit notes, debit notes, and other financial adjustments.
* Monitor deductions related to logistics, fulfilment, advertising, returns, and other marketplace charges, wherever applicable.
* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reconciliation statements and MIS reports.
* Coordinate with internal Finance, Sales, E-Commerce, and Operations teams for timely closure of discrepancies.
* Maintain proper documentation and supporting records for audits and month-end closing.
* Ensure accurate accounting entries and timely reconciliation of marketplace transactions.

3. Required Qualifications & Experience

* B.Com / M.Com / MBA Finance or equivalent qualification.
* 2–5 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, E-Commerce Finance, or Marketplace Reconciliation.
* Practical experience in marketplace settlement reconciliation is strongly preferred.
* Working knowledge of Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, or similar e-commerce platforms.
* Strong knowledge of accounts receivable, ledger reconciliation, debit notes, credit notes, and payment settlements.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, SUMIF/SUMIFS, and data reconciliation.
* Experience with Tally, SAP, or other ERP/accounting software.
* Strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and follow-up capabilities.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of marketplace settlement reconciliation.
* Reduction in pending and unreconciled receivables.
* Timely identification and recovery of short payments and eligible claims.
* Accuracy of marketplace-wise outstanding reports.
* Reduction in aged settlement discrepancies.
* Timely closure of month-end reconciliation.
* Accuracy of accounting entries and supporting documentation.

5. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate should have practical experience in handling e-commerce receivables and reconciling marketplace settlements independently. Candidates from footwear, fashion, apparel, lifestyle, retail, or D2C businesses will be preferred.

**Key Search Keywords:** E-Commerce Receivables, Marketplace Reconciliation, Settlement Reconciliation, Accounts Receivable, Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, Myntra Partner Portal, Payment Reconciliation, Ledger Reconciliation, Advanced Excel.

**Important screening criterion:** Prioritize candidates who have reconciled actual marketplace settlement reports and investigated deductions, returns, commissions, and short payments—not candidates with only general accounts receivable or invoice-follow-up experience.

description:
**Position:** CHA Operations Assistant Manager  
**Department:** Customs Clearance & Operations  
**Industry:** Logistics, Freight Forwarding & Customs Brokerage  
**Job Location:** Mumbai / Nhava Sheva / Navi Mumbai  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹55,000 per month (depending on experience and skills)  
**Experience:** 3–10 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

1. Job Summary

Shin Logistics Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and result-oriented CHA Operations Assistant Manager to manage day-to-day customs clearance operations, coordinate with customs authorities, shipping lines, port officials, transporters, and clients, and ensure the smooth and timely clearance of import and export shipments.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of customs clearance procedures, import/export documentation, ICEGATE, EDI systems, and port operations, particularly at Nhava Sheva.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Import & Export Customs Clearance**

* Handle day-to-day import and export customs clearance operations.
* Supervise filing and processing of Bills of Entry (BOE) and Shipping Bills.
* Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery of shipments.
* Coordinate examination, assessment, queries, and out-of-charge (OOC) procedures.
* Monitor export documentation, Let Export Order (LEO), and shipment status.
* Ensure compliance with applicable customs regulations and procedures.

**B. Documentation & Compliance**

* Verify import/export documents, including invoices, packing lists, Bills of Lading, and other shipping documents.
* Coordinate with documentation teams for accurate and timely filing.
* Follow up on customs queries, examination reports, and assessment-related issues.
* Maintain proper shipment records and operational reports.
* Coordinate with relevant agencies for applicable certificates, permits, and regulatory clearances.

**C. Port & Transport Coordination**

* Coordinate with customs officers, shipping lines, CFS/port personnel, transporters, and other service providers.
* Monitor container movement, cargo examination, delivery orders, and cargo release.
* Follow up on container detention, port storage, and CFS charges to minimize avoidable costs.
* Ensure timely transportation and delivery of cleared cargo.

**D. Team Management**

* Supervise and guide customs clearance executives and operational staff.
* Allocate daily operational activities and monitor team performance.
* Resolve operational issues and ensure adherence to company procedures.
* Train team members on documentation, customs procedures, and compliance requirements.

**E. Client Coordination**

* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding shipment status and clearance requirements.
* Provide timely updates on delays, customs queries, and additional documentation requirements.
* Resolve customer complaints and operational issues promptly.
* Coordinate with the sales and customer service teams to maintain customer satisfaction.

**F. Reporting & Cost Control**

* Prepare daily shipment status reports and operational MIS.
* Monitor clearance timelines and identify operational bottlenecks.
* Control unnecessary operational expenses, detention, and demurrage wherever possible.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for job costing, vendor bills, and operational expense verification.

3. Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; logistics or supply chain qualifications preferred.
* 5–10 years of experience in CHA operations, customs clearance, or freight forwarding.
* Previous experience handling import and export shipments at Nhava Sheva/JNPA is preferred.
* Good working knowledge of ICEGATE, EDI systems, Bills of Entry, and Shipping Bills.
* Knowledge of customs clearance procedures and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong coordination, communication, problem-solving, and team management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and operational reporting.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Timely customs clearance and cargo delivery.
* Accuracy of import/export documentation.
* Reduction in avoidable detention, demurrage, and storage charges.
* Customer satisfaction and response time.
* Team productivity and operational efficiency.
* Compliance with customs procedures and company policies.
* Timely submission of operational reports.

5. Salary & Benefits

**Monthly Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹55,000, depending on relevant experience and operational expertise.

* Salary negotiable for suitable candidates.
* Opportunity to work with an established logistics and customs brokerage company.
* Career growth based on performance and operational capabilities.

6. How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant CHA operations and customs clearance experience may share their updated CV with Shin Logistics Pvt. Ltd.

**Join Shin Logistics Pvt. Ltd. and become part of our growing logistics and customs brokerage operations team.**

Market & Network Development: Identify new business opportunities and expand the customer base by managing relationships with distributors, retailers, and key accounts.

Performance Monitoring: Track sales metrics (KPIs) like revenue growth and market share, preparing detailed reports and forecasts for senior management.

Customer Relationship Management: Resolve high-level customer complaints and maintain strong long-term partnerships with key stakeholders.

Competitor Analysis: Monitor local market trends and competitor activities to adjust sales tactics and maintain a competitive edge.

Category

Leadership

Team motivation, coaching, performance management, and conflict resolution.

Technical

Proficiency in CRM software (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), MS Office, and data analysis.

Communication

Strong negotiation, presentation, and interpersonal skills for various stakeholders.

Strategic

Territory planning, sales forecasting, and market intelligence analysis.

Education

Typically a Bachelor's degree in Business or Marketing; an MBA is often preferred.

Account Ownership & Revenue Growth

Customer Engagement & Coverage

Contracting & Upsell

Reporting & Governance

SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS
  
Revenue & Growth Customer Coverage Operational Discipline
  

* Account AM revenue vs. target (primary KPI)
* SOM capture % at assigned customers
* M-Powered penetration in assigned accounts
* Customer visits per week / calls per week (PJP adherence %)
* Customer NPS at assigned accounts
* Whitespace accounts activated
* CRM data hygiene (% complete records)
* On-time submission of weekly / monthly reports

KEY SKILL REQUIREMENTS
  
Skill Dimension What We Are Looking For
  
Technical & Commercial
  

* B2B field sales and account management in capital goods or industrial equipment
* Strong product and spare-parts knowledge (injection moulding preferred)
* Account mining, negotiation and deal closing

Analytics & Planning
  

* Account revenue analysis and visit planning (PJP)
* Sales forecasting and pipeline tracking
* Proficiency in Excel / MIS reporting, CRM and PJP / route-planning tools

Interpersonal

* Cross-functional coordination with service teams

Behavioural
  

* Customer-first mindset
* Hunter mentality and self-motivation

EXPERIENCE PROFILE

* Demonstrated record of growing account-level revenue and converting whitespace opportunities
* Exposure to spare-parts or aftermarket selling preferred

Milacron is a global industrial leader in the manufacturing and distribution of highly engineered and customized injection molding and extrusion solutions, and aftermarket parts and service for the plastics processing industry. The company’s 1,900+ associates worldwide collaborate to serve a diverse range of end-markets, such as automotive, construction, medical, telecommunications, material handling, packaging, and much more. title: Consultative Sales Executive
description:
**Role Summary:**

We are looking for a commercially sharp, empathetic sales professional who can engage with **qualified, warm leads**, including entrepreneurs who have completed a free business audit, and convert genuine business needs into appropriate paid engagements.

This role focuses on **consultative sales calls and closing high-value assignments worth lakhs**, rather than mass cold calling or selling a generic subscription.

Our work spans business growth, strategy, coaching and AI-enabled solutions for entrepreneurs and service businesses. The customer journey begins with a **free business audit** and a relevant conversation. Suitable clients may then engage us for a **paid, weekly Growth AI Agentic Model** or another clearly scoped assignment.

The role involves understanding the prospect's situation, establishing fit, explaining value responsibly, and moving the opportunity towards a signed commitment and smooth handover.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Lead Management:** Respond promptly to assigned qualified leads and prepare for each conversation by reviewing audit results, previous interactions and the business context.
* **Discovery and Needs Assessment:** Conduct structured discovery calls with founders and decision-makers to understand growth goals, bottlenecks, urgency, budget, authority and the decision-making process.
* **Consultative Sales:** Translate coaching, strategy and AI-enabled services into relevant outcomes and scopes, avoiding one-size-fits-all pitches or unsupported ROI claims.
* **Proposal and Deal Closure:** Present team-approved proposals and commercial terms, handle objections, negotiate within authorized boundaries and close high-value assignments.
* **CRM and Pipeline Management:** Maintain accurate CRM records, including lead source, conversation notes, next actions, decision-makers, proposal status, expected value, deal stage and reasons for closing or losing deals.
* **Lead Follow-up:** Follow up consistently through phone, WhatsApp and email, with permission and professional judgment. Keep promising opportunities moving forward without pressuring unsuitable prospects.
* **Internal Coordination:** Coordinate with the community help expert, founder and delivery team for deeper scoping, onboarding and a clear post-sale handover.
* **Sales Feedback and Improvement:** Share recurring buyer questions, objections and market feedback to improve the audit-to-call journey, offers and sales materials.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* Demonstrated success in **consultative B2B or founder-led service sales**, ideally handling deal values of ₹1 lakh or more. Candidates should be prepared to explain their role in recent closed deals.
* Ability to lead discovery conversations and close deals over phone or video, rather than only booking meetings or reading scripts.
* Strong listening, questioning, proposal follow-up, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Comfort discussing business growth, marketing, sales and practical AI applications with entrepreneurs. An AI engineering background is not required.
* Disciplined CRM usage, pipeline ownership and reliable written communication.
* Professional spoken English and Hindi. Additional Indian languages are an advantage where relevant to lead markets.
* Integrity in representing deliverables, fees and likely outcomes, with the willingness to disqualify a lead when the offering is not the right fit.

title: Senior Sales Executive
description:
**Senior Executive – International Sales**

**Company:** ALAN Electronic Systems Private Limited

**Department:** International Sales

**Location:** Head Office, Ambernath, Maharashtra (international travel required)

**Reporting To:** Head of Department – International Sales

**Experience:** 8 - 12 years

**Role Overview:**

The Senior Executive – International Sales owns the execution quality of ALAN's international sales administration: order processing, export documentation, dispatch, payment collection and partner support. The role leads the Executive and Junior Executive who perform these tasks and is accountable for every activity being completed within the defined timelines. The role also resolves technical issues raised by sales partners on ALAN products, prepares AOP data and presentations, plans and executes the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM), and represents ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Order Processing Oversight**

* Ensure partner POs are received, verified against the approved price list, discounts, payment terms, and booked in ERP within the defined TAT
* Review and approve proforma invoices and order confirmations before release to the partner
* Ensure country-specific requirements are checked before booking: product registration, CE certificate validity, import permits and labelling
* Review partner credit status and outstanding dues on each order; take exceptions to the HoD for approval
* Review the order register daily for pending, delayed and incorrectly booked orders

**2. Fulfilment and Dispatch Monitoring**

* Monitor order status against committed dates; coordinate with planning, production, stores and QC to remove delays
* Ensure partners receive revised dates before the due date when delays occur
* Approve order changes, partial shipments and cancellations; ensure approvals are documented
* Ensure demo unit, spare parts and sample dispatches follow approved requests

**3. Export Documentation and Logistics**

* Review export documents before dispatch: commercial invoice, packing list, certificate of origin, CE certificate, conformity documents and partner-specific documents
* Approve freight forwarder and courier selection based on quotes, transit time and reliability
* Ensure dispatch intimation and tracking details reach the partner on dispatch day
* Resolve transit delays, damage and customs queries with the forwarder and partner
* Ensure statutory export records are complete: shipping bill, bank realization certificate, export incentive and duty claims

**4. Payment and Receivables Control**

* Ensure payments are tracked against agreed terms: advance and credit
* Review partner-wise receivables ageing weekly and report to the HoD
* Follow up personally on overdue accounts and recommend order hold where required
* Ensure invoices are closed after confirmed receipt and bank documents are filed

**5. Technical Support to Sales Partners**

* Resolve partner and end-user queries on ALAN electrosurgical generators and accessories: setup, operation, settings, compatibility and performance
* Diagnose reported faults and complaints with the partner, using photographs, videos and error details; guide corrective steps remotely
* Coordinate with service, QA and D&D when the issue needs repair, replacement or design review
* Ensure complaints, returns and replacements are logged, investigated and closed with recorded corrective action
* Identify repeat issues by product and partner; report patterns to QA and the HoD
* Support partner demos, product training and technical clarifications for tenders and registrations
* Maintain product technical documents, FAQs and troubleshooting guides for partner use

**6. Partner Records and Compliance**

* Ensure partner master data is current: agreements, validity, territory, price lists, registration documents and contacts
* Track expiry of agreements, product registrations and certificates; initiate renewals in advance
* Ensure authorization letters, declarations and tender documents requested by partners are issued on time

**7. Exhibitions, Conferences and ASPM**

* Represent ALAN at international exhibitions and conferences: booth operation, product presentation and partner meetings
* Plan events end to end: selection, registration, exhibit shipment and customs, travel, collaterals and budget
* Capture leads in a standard format; share the lead list and event report and track follow-up to closure
* Report event cost against leads generated and orders closed
* Plan and execute the Annual Sales & Service Partners Meeting (ASPM): venue and date finalisation, partner invitations and confirmations, agenda and speaker schedule, presentations, travel and logistics, budget and on-ground execution
* Set the ASPM timeline with owners and deadlines; track progress weekly and ensure every milestone is met on time
* Prepare the ASPM report with action points and track follow-up to closure

**8. Reporting, MIS and AOP**

* Review and submit weekly and monthly reports: orders booked, units and value by partner, backlog, dispatches against commitment, receivables ageing, open issues
* Report TAT adherence for order booking, dispatch and issue closure
* Consolidate partner target vs achievement and forecast updates
* Prepare and consolidate AOP data for international sales: partner-wise targets, achievement, forecast, orders and receivables
* Prepare the PPT for AOP meetings and present it, with data checked and ready before each meeting date
* Record AOP meeting decisions and action points; track closure with owners and deadlines

**9. Team Leadership and Process**

* Allocate work, set daily priorities, review output and coach the Executive and Junior Executive
* Assign an owner and a deadline to every task; maintain a team task tracker and review it daily
* Hold a weekly team review on pending items, delays and next week's priorities
* Ensure every activity in the order-to-payment cycle, AOP, ASPM and exhibition plans is completed within the defined timeline; follow up on delays and escalate to the HoD where required
* Set goals, review performance and give regular feedback to the Executive and Junior Executive; identify skill gaps and arrange training
* Document SOPs, checklists and templates for each step of the order-to-payment cycle
* Ensure continuity of order and partner support during travel and leave

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Order booking within TAT
* On-time dispatch against committed date
* Documentation error rate
* Technical issue closure within TAT; repeat issue rate
* Receivables outstanding beyond agreed terms
* Event leads converted to orders
* Accuracy and timeliness of MIS
* Team task completion within deadline
* AOP data and PPT ready before meeting date
* ASPM milestones completed on schedule

**Required Qualifications**

* B.E. / B.Tech in Biomedical, Electronics or Electrical Engineering
* 8-12 years in international sales support, technical support or sales operations, with exposure to medical devices or capital equipment
* Technical understanding of electronic medical equipment: ability to read circuit-level and service documentation, diagnose faults and guide troubleshooting
* Working knowledge of export documentation, payment instruments and customs and shipping processes
* Hands-on experience with ERP/CRM and advanced Excel
* Strong written and spoken English; ability to handle international partner communication
* Ability to lead a team, deliver to deadlines and travel internationally

**Preferred**

* Direct experience with electrosurgical or similar surgical equipment
* Knowledge of product registration, ISO & CE-related documentation
* Exhibition or conference participation experience

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹70,000.00 per month

About the role

Lead Yolojet's operations team and own reliable execution across PTL, B2B, courier and appointment-based

deliveries. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role combining team leadership, vendor management, fast

escalation resolution and customer retention. You will build SOP-led ways of working, improve service

performance and help grow business from existing customers through dependable operations.

Key responsibilities

1. Lead the team and build SOP discipline

* Lead a team of 7-9 people, currently 4 customer Key Account Managers (KAMs) and 3 operations

executives, with team size varying by business requirements. Coach the team, set clear responsibilities

and daily priorities, and review performance regularly.

* Create and implement standard operating procedures (SOPs), escalation paths and checklists. Train the

team, check adherence and build accountability for shipment follow-ups, customer updates and issue

closure. Fix recurring gaps rather than relying on individual follow-ups.

2. Own customer retention and account growth

* Take operational ownership of customers after the sales handover. Understand service requirements,

maintain proactive communication and build strong working relationships with customer teams and

leadership.

* Lead service recovery for at-risk accounts, address repeat complaints and follow through on corrective

actions. Work with sales to retain customers and expand business within existing accounts through

consistent service.

3. Manage vendor relationships and commercials

* Identify, onboard and manage PTL and courier vendors. Negotiate competitive pricing and service terms,

review performance against agreed SLAs and address service gaps with local, regional and senior vendor

teams.

* Use established industry relationships to manage daily escalations and secure practical support from

vendors such as Gati, Delhivery, Ekart, V-Xpress, Rivigo and Safe express etc.

4. Lead daily execution and escalation resolution

* Oversee first-mile, mid-mile and last-mile execution, from pickup through delivery confirmation. Act as

the senior escalation point for delayed pickups, transit delays, failed deliveries and other shipment issues;

drive urgent cases to closure with timely customer updates.

* Own appointment-based deliveries, including Quick Commerce and Modern Trade warehouse

requirements. Manage slot coordination, documentation and e-way bill compliance, and take timely action

to prevent missed appointments.

Yolojet Internet Services Pvt. Ltd. Senior Manager - Operations | 2

5. Build reliable backup transport options

* Develop a network of local and regional transporters and small-truck owners across major cities. Arrange

suitable backup vehicles when courier services fail, coordinating rates, pickup, delivery and customer

communication.

6. Improve systems, reporting and service performance

* Become proficient in the internal operations portal and ensure accurate, timely data and team adoption.

Identify workflow gaps and suggest practical portal improvements and enhancements to the technology

team.

* Use Excel/Google Sheets and operational reports to track team and vendor performance, delivery

reliability, appointment adherence, escalation closure, customer retention and costs. Identify root causes

and drive corrective action.

7. Control vendor billing and claims

* Check vendor and courier invoices for discrepancies against agreed rates, shipments and service terms,

and ensure errors are raised and corrected before payment.

* Ensure damage and shortage reconciliation and credit notes are obtained from couriers in a timely manner.

Make this a standard part of the team's SOP culture, with clear ownership, follow-up and closure tracking.

Non-Negotiable Experience and capabilities

* Mandatory 4-7 years of relevant experience, with extensive hands-on PTL operations experience at

courier/logistics companies or aggregators.

* Strong practical knowledge of PTL, B2B, courier and appointment-based delivery operations, including

day-to-day issue resolution.

* Proven team management skills: coaching people, setting clear expectations, enforcing SOPs and

improving accountability and execution.

* Established relationships with PTL/courier vendors, plus a useful network of local and regional

transporters and vehicle owners.

* Strong negotiation and relationship management skills, with the confidence to engage courier leadership

and customer leadership directly.

* A track record of resolving customer escalations, recovering service issues and helping retain or grow

existing customer accounts.

* Comfort with technology, internal portals and Excel/Google Sheets; able to turn operational data and

frontline feedback into clear improvement actions.

What we value

High ownership, clear communication and calm judgment under pressure. Someone who stays close to daily

operations, supports the team and closes the loop with customers and vendors, while building processes that

prevent the same problems from repeating.

* Own Shiprocket’s overarching communications narrative, how we talk about ourselves across business, tech, logistics, D2C, and policy media

* Drive proactive media strategy: Understand the product and the solutions end to end, identify angles, pitch stories, and place coverage that goes beyond the press release

* Build and maintain personal relationships with senior journalists, editors, and bureau chiefs across print, digital, and broadcast. This is a relationship role as much as a strategy role

* Develop executive positioning and thought leadership for the CEO and leadership team, including op-eds, keynote narratives, and media briefings

**Marketing Partnership & GTM**

* Embed with the marketing team on every significant product launch, campaign, and GTM as a co-creator from the start. Take the lead on select GTMs where marketing becomes a support function

* Take the lead on earned and organic storytelling for launches; hand off to marketing where paid and owned amplification begins

* Represent the communications lens in campaign planning: what can PR do that advertising can’t, and how do the two reinforce each other?

* Build campaign-specific media plans with clear coverage targets, publication tiers, and spokesperson strategies

**Enterprise & B2B PR**

* Own PR strategy for Shiprocket’s enterprise and B2B audience across logistics, supply chain, retail, and D2C brand media

* Build narratives that resonate with enterprise decision-makers, not just startup press

* Support policy and regulatory communications, industry reports, and stakeholder engagement with analysts and trade publications, including DPIIT, logistics policy, and fintech-adjacent regulatory environments where Shiprocket operates

* Partner with Sales and Customer Success on case study development and customer storytelling at enterprise scale

**Crisis & Reputation Management**

* Own the crisis communications playbook. Build it, maintain it, and lead it when called upon

* Be the first call when something goes wrong: able to assess risk, draft holding statements, manage media escalation, and advise leadership in real time

* Monitor media and industry discourse continuously for emerging reputation risks and proactively flag and prepare

* Manage sensitive communications with the composure and speed that crisis demands — this is a non-negotiable capability for this role

**Stakeholder & Financial Media Communications**

* Manage communications with a complex and expanding external stakeholder map across financial media, institutional audiences, and industry analysts alongside traditional earned media

* Build and maintain relationships with financial and markets journalists (ET Markets, Mint, Bloomberg, Moneycontrol) with the same depth as business and tech media relationships

* Ensure all external communications in high-scrutiny environments are accurate, legally aligned, and consistent. Working closely with Legal, Finance, and IR teams as needed

* Manage the narrative transition that comes with significant corporate milestones: balancing growth storytelling with the discipline that more complex stakeholder environments demand

**Agency Management**

* Own the relationship with Shiprocket’s PR agency: set the brief, hold them to outcomes (coverage, not activity), and ensure strategic alignment

* Push agencies beyond execution into storytelling. Expect and demand ideas, not just delivery

* Evaluate agency performance on meaningful metrics: quality of coverage, journalist relationships built, share of voice, message penetration

**What We’re Looking For**

**Non-negotiables**

* Prior experience as a journalist. You have sat in a newsroom, filed stories under deadline, and understand how editors think about what makes news. Former journalists who have transitioned into communications bring a credibility and instinct that is very difficult to replicate.

* Exceptional written skills. We mean the ability to write a compelling op-ed, a tight press release, a crisp media pitch, and a leadership statement under pressure, all at a level that does not require heavy editing. Your writing should be a competitive advantage.

* A real journalist network that goes beyond the contact book. Senior journalists at ET, Mint, Business Standard, Forbes, TechCrunch India, and category-relevant trade publications who will take your call and give your story a fair hearing. Equally important: relationships with the financial and markets desks.

* Demonstrated crisis management. You have handled at least one significant reputational situation and can articulate what you did, why, and what the outcome was.

* Experience managing communications in high-scrutiny environments with multiple external stakeholder groups, including financial media, institutional audiences, and situations where legal and regulatory considerations shape what can be said and when.

* 10+ years of experience in PR/corporate communications, preferably within technology, eCommerce, consumer internet, startups, or high-growth organisations

**Strong advantages**

* Experience in B2B and Enterprise communications.

* Track record of working as a genuine marketing partner on GTMs

* Experience managing PR agencies from the client side and a clear point of view on what good agency performance looks like

* Familiarity with media monitoring tools and comfort using data to demonstrate PR impact beyond clip counts

* Experience building or managing a small PR team

**What Success Looks Like**

* Shiprocket appears in tier-1 business and technology media with consistent, accurate narrative

* The CEO and leadership team are recognised voices in e-commerce, logistics, and India’s startup and business ecosystem

* When a crisis occurs, we respond faster, more accurately, and with more control than our stakeholders expect

* Marketing and PR operate as one team on every major launch

* Financial and institutional media understand and accurately represent Shiprocket’s business, growth, and strategy

They serve as a liaison between stakeholders and team members, facilitating effective communication and managing expectations. Project managers efficiently allocate resources, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. By maintaining documentation and reporting on progress, they provide visibility into the project's status and foster a culture of continuous improvement for future projects.

  

**Work Experience Required**

* 8-10 years with at least 4 years in on HON or competitors FI product portfolio
* Proven business experience in multiple vertical markets, including field products industries. Networking within the instrumentation industry- large customers, OEM's, EPC's and Consultants will be a strong advantage.
* Supporting sales campaigns or programs in specific markets or for specific products
* Proven Presentation skills

**Specific Knowledge Required**

* Technical understanding of portfolio, competition and understanding of customer applications is must
* Moderate travel (1-2 days a month)
* Understands the value proposition of Honeywell and all the company has to offer
* From experience, a good knowledge of our customers’ businesses and drivers
* Working knowledge of Honeywell, commercial terms, contract terms, etc.

  

**Principal Responsibilities**

* **Project Planning** : Develop a detailed project plan outlining objectives, scope, resources, timeline, and budget.
* **Team Leadership** : Lead and manage the project team, ensuring effective collaboration and communication among team members.
* **Resource Allocation** : Allocate resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, equipment, and materials.
* **Stakeholder Communication** : Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and addressing concerns.
* **Risk Management** : Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project success.
* **Quality Assurance** : Ensure that project deliverables meet predefined quality standards and requirements.
* **Monitoring & Reporting** : Track project progress through key performance indicators and prepare regular status reports for stakeholders.
* **Budget Management** : Oversee the project budget, ensuring expenditures stay within limits and financial resources are used appropriately.
* **Problem Solving** : Address challenges and obstacles that arise during the project lifecycle to keep the project on track.
* **Closing the Project** : Conduct project closure activities, including final deliverable acceptance, documentation, and team debriefing.

**Skills required**

* **Leadership:** Ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve project goals.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information to various stakeholders.
* **Time Management:** Skill in managing one’s own time and the time of others to meet deadlines.
* **Risk Management:** Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* **Problem-Solving:** Proficiency in analyzing problems, generating solutions, and making decisions quickly.
* **Negotiation:** Skill in negotiating resources, contracts, and stakeholder needs to achieve project objectives.
* **Technical Knowledge:** Understanding of the specific industry or technical aspects relevant to the project.
* **Budgeting:** Ability to create and manage budgets effectively to keep projects on track financially.
* **Organizational Skills:** Strong organizational abilities to juggle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* **Adaptability:** Capacity to adjust to changing circumstances and respond to unforeseen challenges.

**Key Success Factors (Key Metrics / KPIs / Deliverables)**

* Driving sales for break through Initiatives (BTI), Core Growth Initiatives (CGI)
* Demand Generation
* Drive lock-in specifications and dilute challenging specs
* Drive regulatory approval and customer AVL
* OEM development by application selling. - infrastructure, F&B, Power, Heat treatment, Packaging, OEMs
* Identifying gaps in the current coverage and drive Honeywell acceptance
* Participate in Mutual Action Planning (MAP) discussions with our CP/SI
* Attend Pre-bid and post bid technical meetings and drive Honeywell needs
* Willing to travel 5 days in a month to SEA countries
* Improve the project margin 2% to 5% from booking.
* Control the project resources within the budget
* Revenue Recognition as per the project schedule
* Good or Improve customer experience based on customer feedback (survey)

  
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: Senior HR Executive
description:
Role Summary

We are looking for an experienced Senior HR Executive for our Corporate Headquarters who can handle every area of HR independently. The role covers HR for head office employees and works closely with plant and unit HR teams to keep policies, compliance, and reporting consistent across the organization.

Key Responsibilities

**Recruitment & Talent Acquisition**

* Handle end-to-end hiring for corporate functions such as Finance, Sales, Purchase, IT, Supply Chain, and Admin, as well as senior and mid-level roles for plants.
* Manage job portals, consultants, and referrals, schedule interviews, negotiate salaries, and issue offer letters.
* Maintain the recruitment tracker and report hiring status to management.

**Onboarding & Employee Lifecycle**

* Conduct joining formalities, induction, documentation, and background verification.
* Handle confirmations, transfers between HO and plants, promotions, increments, and exits, including resignation processing, exit interviews, and full-and-final settlement.

**Payroll & Statutory Compliance**

* Prepare and verify monthly payroll inputs: attendance, leave, overtime, and deductions.
* Ensure timely compliance for PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, gratuity, and bonus.
* Coordinate with plant HR on compliance under the Factories Act, the Contract Labour (Regulation & Abolition) Act, the Payment of Wages Act, the Minimum Wages Act, Standing Orders, and the new Labour Codes as applicable.
* Support statutory and internal audits and maintain all registers and records.

**HR Policies & Corporate HR Coordination**

* Draft, update, and implement HR policies, SOPs, and the employee handbook across HO and plants.
* Act as the link between Corporate HR and plant or unit HR teams to standardize processes.
* Consolidate company-wide HR data on headcount, manpower cost, and attrition from all locations.

**Performance Management**

* Coordinate the annual and mid-year appraisal cycle, including KRA/KPI setting, reviews, and increment processing.
* Support managers with performance improvement plans and documentation.

**Employee Relations & Engagement**

* Handle employee grievances, disciplinary matters, show-cause notices, domestic inquiries, and warning letters.
* Plan engagement activities, celebrations, recognition programs, and employee surveys.
* Support plant HR on industrial relations and contract labour matters when needed.

**Training & Development**

* Identify training needs, organize technical, behavioural, and safety-related training, and maintain training records.

**HR MIS & Analytics**

* Prepare monthly HR MIS covering headcount, attrition, recruitment, manpower cost, and compliance status for management review.

**HR Administration**

* Manage HRMS and attendance systems, ID cards, insurance (GMC/GPA), and employee documentation.
* Draft HR letters such as appointment, confirmation, increment, experience, and relieving letters.

Qualifications & Skills

**Education:** MBA / PGDM / MSW in HR or Personnel Management.

**Experience:** 7- 10 years as an HR Generalist, with exposure to a manufacturing setup (plant or corporate).

**Required Skills:**

* Strong knowledge of labour laws and statutory compliance applicable to manufacturing.
* Hands-on experience with payroll and HRMS software (e.g., [Keka / Darwinbox / greytHR / SAP/ERP]).
* Advanced MS Excel for MIS and data analysis.
* Excellent communication in English and [local language].
* Strong drafting skills for policies, letters, and notices.
* Confident handling of employee relations and disciplinary cases.
* High integrity, confidentiality, and ability to work independently.

Pay: ₹40,000.00 - ₹50,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Provident Fund

Work Location: In person

title: Manager - HR Operations
description:
**Job Description – HR Operations**

**Position:** HR Operations Manager  
**Department:** Human Resources  
**Industry:** Chartered Accountancy (CA) Firm / Professional Services  
**Experience:** 5+ years  
**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Employee Lifecycle Management**

* Manage employee lifecycle activities, including onboarding, confirmation, internal transfers and separation formalities.
* Coordinate joining formalities, employee documentation, background verification and induction programmes.
* Maintain employee master data, personnel files and HR records.
* Prepare and issue offer letters, appointment letters, confirmation letters, experience letters, relieving letters and other HR documents.
* Track probation periods, notice periods, employee confirmations and exit clearances.

**2. Attendance, Leave & Payroll Coordination**

* Monitor employee attendance, leave records, late marks, absenteeism and timesheets, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers for attendance regularisation and leave approvals.
* Compile monthly payroll inputs, including new joiners, exits, leave without pay, incentives and other approved adjustments.
* Liaise with the Accounts/Payroll team to facilitate timely and accurate salary processing.
* Address employee queries relating to salary credits, payslips, leave balances and payroll discrepancies.

**3. HR Compliance & Documentation**

* Maintain statutory and employment-related records in coordination with the relevant internal teams or external consultants.
* Support compliance processes relating to applicable labour laws, PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, TDS and other employment-related requirements, as applicable.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of employee information and documentation.
* Track employment agreements, confidentiality undertakings, declarations and other mandatory employee documents.
* Assist with HR audits, internal reviews and documentation requirements.

**4. Performance Management System (PMS)**

* Coordinate the annual and periodic performance appraisal cycle, including goal setting, self-assessments, manager evaluations and review discussions.
* Track appraisal timelines, ensure timely completion of performance review forms and follow up with employees and reporting managers.
* Consolidate PMS data and prepare appraisal status reports for management and Partners.
* Coordinate performance feedback discussions and maintain records of performance ratings, development areas and agreed action plans.
* Support the implementation of performance improvement plans (PIPs), wherever required, in consultation with the HR Manager and relevant reporting managers.
* Maintain confidentiality and accuracy of performance appraisal records.

**5. Rewards & Recognition (R&R)**

* Coordinate the implementation of the firm's Rewards & Recognition programmes to acknowledge employee performance, ownership, learning agility and professional contributions.
* Manage nomination processes, eligibility criteria, approval workflows and documentation for various recognition categories.
* Coordinate employee recognition announcements, award distribution and related communication.
* Maintain R&R trackers and analyse participation and programme effectiveness.
* Support the periodic review and improvement of recognition initiatives in alignment with the firm's culture and values.

**6. Employee Grievance & Relations Management**

* Act as a point of contact for employee concerns, workplace issues and routine grievances.
* Listen to employee concerns objectively, maintain confidentiality and facilitate appropriate resolution in coordination with the HR Manager and relevant stakeholders.
* Coordinate discussions between employees and reporting managers, wherever appropriate, to support constructive resolution.
* Maintain a grievance register, document actions taken and track cases through closure.
* Identify recurring employee concerns and highlight trends to management for appropriate corrective action.
* Escalate sensitive matters, allegations of misconduct, harassment and other serious concerns through the applicable internal procedures.
* Ensure grievances are handled fairly, professionally and in accordance with firm policies and applicable laws.

**7. Employee Engagement & HR Administration**

* Coordinate employee engagement initiatives, employee feedback programmes, induction sessions and internal HR communications.
* Support employee engagement surveys, periodic feedback initiatives and employee experience improvement measures.
* Coordinate training programmes, employee announcements and firm-wide HR initiatives.
* Assist in maintaining HR policies, standard operating procedures and employee handbooks.
* Support initiatives aimed at strengthening employee experience, workplace culture and communication across departments.

**8. Separation & Exit Management**

* Coordinate resignation formalities, notice period tracking, exit interviews and clearance procedures.
* Liaise with reporting managers, IT, Administration and Accounts for employee handovers and no-dues clearance.
* Coordinate full and final settlement inputs with the Accounts/Payroll team.
* Ensure timely issuance of relieving and experience letters, subject to completion of applicable formalities.

**9. HR MIS & Reporting**

* Prepare and maintain periodic HR MIS covering headcount, employee movements, attendance, leave, attrition, PMS, R&R and grievance status.
* Maintain accurate HR trackers and employee databases using MS Excel and HR systems.
* Generate reports and provide relevant HR data to management and Partners as required.
* Identify opportunities to streamline HR processes and improve documentation, reporting and operational efficiency.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Strong knowledge of HR operations and employee lifecycle management.
* Working knowledge of attendance, payroll coordination, PMS, R&R and employee grievance handling.
* Understanding of employment documentation and applicable statutory compliance requirements.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint; familiarity with HRMS/payroll systems will be an advantage.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal and stakeholder-management skills.
* Strong organisational abilities, follow-up skills and attention to detail.
* High levels of confidentiality, impartiality, professionalism and discretion.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with Partners, managers and employees in a deadline-driven professional services environment.

**Educational Qualification & Experience**

* Graduate in HR, Human Resources Management, Business Administration or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in HR will be an added advantage.
* Min 5 years of relevant HR Operations experience, preferably in a CA firm, consulting firm, audit firm or professional services organisation.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Timely completion of employee onboarding and exit formalities.
* Accuracy of attendance records and payroll inputs.
* Timely completion of PMS cycles and appraisal documentation.
* Effective implementation and tracking of R&R initiatives.
* Timely acknowledgement, tracking and resolution of employee grievances.
* Accuracy and completeness of employee records and HR MIS.
* Timely completion of HR compliance documentation and internal HR processes.

Pay: ₹10.00 - ₹12.00 per year

Benefits:

* Health insurance
* Provident Fund

description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)

Office

**Job Description**

As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.

**DESCRIPTION**

How you will make an impact:

As HR Director for Enabling Functions across Asia Pacific, Middle East and Africa (APMEA), you will shape and execute the people and organizational strategies that strengthen our enterprise capabilities and advance our Mission.

Serving as the strategic HR partner to five Vice Presidents leading key Enabling Functions across APMEA, you will work closely with regional and global leaders across IT, Finance, HR, Legal, Marketing and other critical Enabling Functions. You will translate business and functional priorities into forward-looking organization, leadership and talent strategies, building the capabilities required to enable growth, transformation and performance across one of our most dynamic and diverse regions.

Operating at the intersection of global functional strategy and regional business needs, you will bring an enterprise perspective, connect talent and capabilities across organizational boundaries, and help shape an organization positioned for both today’s priorities and the opportunities ahead.

What you will do:

* Partner with senior APMEA and global functional leaders to develop and execute people strategies aligned with business priorities and our 4i values
* Collaborate with country HR partners across APMEA and global and regional HR partners to drive the Enabling Functions agenda, ensuring alignment across all levels of the HR organization
* Provide strategic counsel to senior leaders on organization effectiveness, leadership, talent, workforce strategy and culture
* Translate enterprise and global strategies into APMEA workforce and talent priorities while bringing regional perspectives into global decision-making
* Anticipate emerging business and workforce requirements and proactively develop HR strategies that strengthen organizational capability across the diverse APMEA landscape
* Lead organization design and effectiveness initiatives supporting business transformation, productivity and growth across APMEA markets
* Guide organizational transformations, restructures and integrations across multiple countries, cultures and regulatory environments
* Use workforce analytics to identify organizational risks, capability gaps and opportunities, translating data into meaningful leadership actions
* Build sustainable leadership and talent pipelines across Enabling Functions in APMEA to support our Mission
* Lead talent reviews, succession planning and leadership development, ensuring critical roles have robust plans reflecting APMEA market dynamics
* Champion internal mobility and cross-functional talent movement to strengthen enterprise capability and develop future leaders
* Act as strategic people leader for major transformation initiatives, integrating people considerations early into business planning
* Develop change strategies that build leadership alignment and organizational adoption across diverse markets
* Partner with leaders to navigate ambiguity while maintaining organizational effectiveness and employee engagement
* Strengthen high-performance, inclusive culture aligned with our 4i values and leadership expectations
* Build strong partnerships across HR Centers of Excellence and HR Operations to deliver integrated solutions
* Create clarity across matrix relationships and coordinate effectively between global functional HR teams, regional teams and country organizations
* Serve as key liaison between Enabling Functions leadership and the broader HR partner network to ensure consistent messaging and execution

**REQUIREMENTS**

**Education & Experience**

* Advanced Degree plus 10 years of progressive HR leadership experience, or Bachelor's Degree plus 12 years of progressive HR leadership experience in large, complex and globally matrixed organizations
* Preferred Fields of Study: Human Resources, Business, Organizational Psychology or related discipline
* Significant experience partnering with senior executives and influencing business strategy in multinational environments
* Demonstrated ability to operate effectively across multiple countries and cultures within Asia Pacific, Middle East and/or Africa
* Strong experience across organization design, workforce strategy, talent management, succession planning and change management
* Experience supporting multiple corporate or enabling functions (IT, Finance, Legal, HR, Marketing) highly desirable
* Experience leading transformation or organizational change in complex, multi-country environments
* Proven track record collaborating with country, regional and global HR partners in complex matrix organizations

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong business acumen with ability to understand business models, financial drivers and operating strategies
* Advanced analytical capability to translate workforce data into strategic insights and actions
* Proven ability to influence across global stakeholder networks without direct authority
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills across diverse cultures and organizational levels
* Enterprise mindset that prioritizes enterprise outcomes over silos
* Strategic influence and credibility with senior leaders, constructively challenging assumptions
* Organizational effectiveness expertise to design practical interventions across structure, capability and talent
* Cultural agility to operate across diverse APMEA markets, cultures and regulatory environments
* Ability to create clarity and navigate transformation through ambiguity
* Strong partnership capability with country, regional and global HR teams
* Expertise in contemporary HR practices and employment law across APMEA jurisdictions
* High emotional intelligence with ability to maintain strict confidentiality
* Strong commitment to building inclusive culture and developing diverse talent
* Travel up to 25-30% internationally across APMEA markets as needed

title: Business Transformation & Portfolio Lead
description:

--------------

VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

**About this Role**
-------------------

We are seeking a business transformation and HR portfolio professional to connect enterprise transformation priorities with practical people-change delivery and disciplined portfolio governance.

description:

title: Field sales and Business Development
description:
Business Development & Sales
  
Department: Business Development & Sales
  
Location: Pune
  
Industry: EPC / Engineering / Fabrication / Piping & Tank Solutions
  
Experience: 3–7 Years
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
1. JOB PURPOSE
  
The Business Development & Sales professional will be responsible for driving the company's business growth by identifying new markets and sectors, generating new enquiries, developing client relationships, managing the sales pipeline, and converting opportunities into profitable orders.
  
The role will have end-to-end ownership of the business development process:
  
Market Identification → Target Sectors → Target Clients → Lead Generation → Client Meetings → Enquiry Generation → CRM Management → Quotation Follow-up → Negotiation → Order Conversion → Repeat Business
  
The position will also be responsible for coordinating and monitoring SEO/digital marketing activities with external agencies and ensuring that marketing efforts contribute to relevant business enquiries.
  
\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_
  
2. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
  
A. Business Development & New Client Acquisition
  
• Identify and develop new customers across relevant industries and sectors.
  
• Generate qualified leads through direct outreach, client references, networking, industry databases, digital channels and market research.
  
• Build and continuously maintain a healthy sales pipeline.
  
• Research companies, upcoming projects, plant expansions, capex plans and procurement requirements.
  
• Identify key decision-makers and establish relationships with relevant stakeholders.
  
• Convert prospects into enquiries and enquiries into business opportunities.
  
• Develop new accounts and increase business from existing customers.
  
• Maintain regular follow-ups until the opportunity is closed, lost or clearly deferred.
  
B. Market & Sector Development
  
• Identify new industries, applications and sectors where the company's EPC, fabrication, tank, piping and engineering capabilities can be offered.
  
• Conduct market research to identify sectors with strong business potential.
  
• Prepare sector-wise target customer lists.
  
• Identify upcoming projects and companies investing in new plants, capacity expansion or infrastructure.
  
• Study competitor activity, market demand and customer requirements.
  
• Recommend new products, services or applications that the company can potentially develop.
  
• Present new market opportunities and business potential to management.
  
C. Client Visits & Relationship Management
  
• Conduct regular meetings with existing and prospective clients.
  
• Understand customer requirements, upcoming projects, technical expectations and procurement processes.
  
• Build relationships with purchase, project, engineering, maintenance and management teams.
  
• Record all important client discussions and follow-up requirements.
  
• Maintain regular contact with key clients even when there is no immediate enquiry.
  
• Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling and additional projects.
  
D. CRM Ownership & Sales Pipeline Management
  
• Take complete ownership of the company's CRM system.
  
• Ensure 100% of relevant leads and enquiries are recorded in the CRM.
  
• Maintain accurate information on:
  
o Lead source
  
o Client details
  
o Requirement
  
o Enquiry value
  
o Quotation status
  
o Probability
  
o Expected closure date
  
o Next follow-up
  
o Opportunity stage
  
• Monitor the complete sales funnel from Lead to Order.
  
• Ensure no enquiry or follow-up is missed.
  
• Review the CRM regularly and clean outdated/inactive opportunities.
  
• Prepare weekly and monthly pipeline reports for management.
  
• Analyse conversion ratios, lost enquiries, lead sources and sector-wise opportunities.
  
E. Enquiry, Quotation & Order Conversion
  
• Understand and qualify new enquiries.
  
• Coordinate with estimation, technical, procurement and project teams for timely quotation preparation.
  
• Follow up on submitted quotations.
  
• Understand customer objections and commercial/technical concerns.
  
• Coordinate negotiations with the relevant internal teams.
  
• Track expected order closure dates.
  
• Record reasons for lost enquiries.
  
• Ensure proper handover of confirmed orders to the execution/project team.
  
F. SEO & Digital Marketing Coordination
  
• Coordinate with external SEO/digital marketing agencies.
  
• Monitor
