title: Customer Renewal Manager
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Customer Renewal Manager (CRM) is responsible for driving the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for assigned customers in a defined Unit/Area. As part of Teradata’s Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline. The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.
  
  
The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy. The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities. The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. The CRM will align the renewal strategy with the Account Executive (AE), Customer Solution Architect (CSA) and wider account team to achieve optimal results.
  
  
A key responsibility of the CRM is completing and executing preventive actions on Cancellations and Erosions, leveraging early insights and collaborating with Field Technology Management, Services Delivery Management and Customer Services Management. The CRM will be responsible for the development, application and delivery of cancel and erosion save plans alongside the Customer Services Architect (CSA), with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention; in addition to the identification of upsell and cross sell.
  
  
As an integrated member of the GTM account team, this role is primarily responsible for retaining recurring revenue across Teradata’s business through exceptional renewal sales execution. This includes building and maintaining strong partnerships with both internal and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Renewal Scope Areas Include**
:
  
  

* Basic understanding of the components that make up a renewal in order to articulate the e2e solution.
* Understanding of sales process including managing account relationships and customer interaction.
* Renewals includes any revenue in Teradata that has been previously sold and should be retained through repeat contracting on a scheduled basis, including Term, Cloud, Maintenance and SWUR.
* Turn-key Renewals: CRM will own the oversight of the renewal process, managing customer engagement supported by the process from the back-office teams.
* Upsell/Cross-Sell/New-Sell: In certain circumstances the CRM will own the sales cycle for the generation of new revenue. title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune. AI plays a growing role across TIC's delivery functions. Account Management is deliberately kept fully human, because we believe our clients deserve people-to-people interaction. AI supports the backend, but the face of TIC to every client will always be a person. 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Account Management is the backbone of every client relationship at TIC. It sits between the client and the delivery team, and between what was promised and what gets delivered. Its job is to keep clients retained, happy and growing. This is not a communication-relay role. As an Account Manager, you will think like a marketer, act like an owner, and be accountable for the health of every account you handle. You will typically own four to six client accounts at a time and work closely with the Account Management Lead, the Studio Head and the delivery team. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client management**

Take full ownership of all deliverables across your assigned accounts (typically four to six clients). Respond to client messages promptly and proactively, with clear timelines rather than vague assurances, so clients always feel valued and heard. 

Keep all client communication in writing. Document any verbal brief, revision or instruction, share it with the client for confirmation, and only then act on it. 

Take notes in every client meeting and share them with the client and the delivery team after every interaction. 

Plan as many client tasks as possible before the start of each month. Share the next day's tasks with the Studio Head by the previous evening, or by 10:00 AM the same day. 

Build personal relationships with clients, down to acknowledging birthdays and important moments.
**Reporting & strategy**

 

Daily/weekly: Update the task tracking document daily and track all deliverables against the committed scope every week. 

Monthly: Send each client a qualitative and quantitative report, built from insights gathered from the relevant delivery team members. Attend a relationship-building meeting with every client alongside the Account Management Lead. 

Quarterly: Plan each client's strategy for the next quarter well in advance. Once it is approved, get full clarity on the quarter's deliverables. 

Take part in strategy reviews at the start and end of every month, contributing as a thinking partner who understands the strategy behind each account, not just the tasks. 

Never commit a timeline to a client without first confirming it with the relevant delivery team member.
**Delivery & process**

Give the delivery team written briefs that are detailed and unambiguous, to avoid costly reworks. Make sure every deliverable is quality-checked before it reaches the client. 

Run all tasks, briefs and updates through TIC's project management tool.

**Sales & growth**

Actively look for upselling opportunities to grow the scope of every account. Upselling is a major KPI for this role. 

Support the sales team with proposals and pitches when needed, especially with account context and client knowledge. 

Track payments for each client and, working with the Accounts team, proactively follow up on delayed payments. 

**AI-first ways of working**

Use TIC's AI-powered account management processes to cut the time spent on repetitive work (briefing, reporting, task planning) without lowering the quality of client communication or the depth of relationships. 

Update your client CIDs every month, in a meaningful and detailed way. 

Fill in timesheets accurately.

**REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS**

A client-first, ownership mindset, with a strong focus on long-term retention and relationships. The ability to think like a marketer and understand the strategy behind a client's account, not just the task list. 

Excellent written communication, including clear, detailed briefs, meeting notes and client reports. Strong planning and organisation skills, with the ability to plan work a month ahead and track scope weekly across several accounts. 

Proactiveness: spotting early signs of client distress and raising flags with solutions, not just problems. An eye for quality and the discipline to follow process (PM tool, trackers, timesheets). Commercial awareness to spot upsell opportunities and follow up on payments. 

Comfort working with AI tools to make repetitive work more efficient.

Integrate email marketing effectively with paid campaigns, CRM systems and lead management processes. Team leadership & department management

Build strong client relationships through strategic input, transparency and consistent delivery. Analytics, reporting & innovation

Evaluate new tools, automation solutions, and AI-assisted workflows to improve efficiency and productivity. Drive a culture of testing, learning, continuous optimisation, and accountability.

7–8 years of experience in digital marketing, with strong expertise in Performance Marketing. Proven experience managing and scaling campaigns on Google Ads and Meta Ads. Experience with LinkedIn Ads, YouTube Ads, and other paid platforms is preferred. 

Strong understanding of media planning, budgeting, forecasting, conversion tracking, attribution, and campaign analytics. 

Working knowledge of SEO, Social Media Marketing, Email Marketing and marketing automation. Proficiency in Google Analytics 4, Google Tag Manager, Looker Studio and Excel/Google Sheets. Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication and presentation skills. 

Experience managing teams, client relationships, multiple accounts and competing priorities. Ability to connect digital marketing metrics to business outcomes and revenue objectives, with a proactive, data-driven, growth-oriented approach. 

**KEY PERFORMANCE INDICATORS**

Performance marketing efficiency and achievement of client/business targets, including improvement in CPL, CPA, CAC, conversion rates, ROAS and lead quality, as applicable. 

Growth in qualified leads, conversions, revenue and paid media effectiveness.

Social media growth, reach, engagement and content effectiveness; email engagement, conversions and retention performance. 

Client retention, satisfaction and contribution to account growth.

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**

Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

Individual Contributor

**The role**

You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

title: Manager, Product Development
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Manager, Product Development
  
  
**Overview**
We are seeking a highly motivated and strategic Manager, Product Development to drive the development and evolution of next-generation payment capabilities within Mastercard's global network platforms. This role is responsible for defining product strategy, managing product roadmaps, translating business opportunities into scalable solutions, and partnering closely with Product Management, Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and regional stakeholders to deliver impactful payment products.
  
  
The ideal candidate combines strong product management expertise, deep payments domain knowledge, analytical rigor, and the ability to influence stakeholders across all levels of the organization. This individual must be comfortable operating in complex, highly technical environments while maintaining a relentless focus on customer value, business outcomes, and execution excellence.
  
  
**Product Strategy & Roadmap**

* Define and manage product vision, roadmap, and requirements for strategic payment platform initiatives.
* Identify customer, operational, and market opportunities that can be translated into scalable product capabilities.
* Partner with Product Managers and business stakeholders to evaluate product investments using quantitative and qualitative data.
* Drive prioritization decisions based on customer impact, business value, risk, and delivery feasibility.
* Develop short-term and long-term product strategies aligned with organizational objectives.

**Product Development & Execution**

* Lead end-to-end product development from concept through launch and adoption.
* Create clear business requirements, user stories, functional specifications, and success metrics.
* Work closely with Engineering, Architecture, Operations, and Technical Product Managers throughout the product lifecycle.
* Manage product backlogs and roadmap execution across multiple concurrent initiatives.
* Facilitate trade-off discussions and drive timely decision making across complex cross-functional programs.

**Stakeholder Management & Leadership**

* Influence senior leaders, engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to align around product vision and priorities.
* Present product strategy, roadmap progress, business cases, risks, and recommendations to executive stakeholders.
* Coordinate across global teams, regional partners, and operations organizations to ensure successful solution delivery.
* Act as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert for payment network products and platform capabilities.

**Data-Driven Decision Making**

* Define and monitor product KPIs, adoption metrics, operational performance indicators, and business outcomes.
* Leverage data analytics to identify opportunities, assess product performance, and drive prioritization decisions.
* Create executive-ready presentations, dashboards, business cases, and strategic recommendations.
* Utilize analytical insights to continuously optimize product performance and customer experience.

**AI & Innovation**

* Apply AI-powered tools and techniques to improve product discovery, requirements management, decision-making, operational efficiency, and customer outcomes.
* Identify opportunities to embed AI capabilities into payment products, operational workflows, or customer-facing solutions.
* Leverage modern AI tools in day-to-day product management activities, including research, analysis, documentation, planning, and stakeholder communications.

**Experience**
Required Qualifications
  
  

* 6-10 years of experience in Product Management, Product Development, Technical Product Management, or related disciplines.
* Proven experience building and launching customer-facing digital products, payment products, or platform capabilities.
* Demonstrated ownership of product roadmaps and delivery of complex cross-functional initiatives.
* Experience partnering directly with Engineering, Architects, Operations, and Business stakeholders.

**Domain Expertise (Must Have)**

* Strong experience in Payments, Card Payments, Payment Processing, Issuing, Acquiring, Network Processing, Merchant Payments, Digital Payments, Fintech, or related domains.
* Hands-on experience building or managing payment products, payment platforms, or digital products at scale.
* Strong understanding of payment ecosystems, transaction processing, and modern digital payment technologies.

**Skills**

* Strong product strategy and roadmap management capabilities.
* Exceptional stakeholder management and influencing skills.
* Excellent analytical thinking and structured problem solving.
* Experience translating business needs into technical requirements.
* Strong verbal, written, and executive communication skills.
* Experience creating executive presentations, product decks, business cases, and data-driven recommendations.
* Proven ability to work effectively in ambiguous and rapidly changing environments.

**AI & Analytics**

* Demonstrated hands-on experience using AI tools in day-to-day work.
* Experience leveraging AI capabilities for product development, customer experience, operational efficiency, or business decision making.
* Advanced data analysis and storytelling skills using modern visualization and reporting tools.
* Ability to derive insights from large data sets and communicate findings to senior stakeholders.

Education
  
  
**Required**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or related technical discipline.

**Preferred**

* MBA or Master's degree from a recognized institution.
* Product Management, Scrum, Agile, or Payments-related certifications.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technology Commercial Support - Growth
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high-value opportunities during the pre-signature phase. This location-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market-specific Technology Account Manager.
  
  
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
  
  
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital & IT leaders and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Pricing and commercial design
  
  

* Shape end-to-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share models
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions

Bid support and governance
  
  

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi-tower bids
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business-as-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails

Stakeholder and customer engagement
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital & IT leaders
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions
* Communicate pricing strategies, commercial risks and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
* Guide commercial support colleagues working within bid teams

Measures of success
  
  

* Competitiveness of pricing and contribution to successful deal outcomes
* Protection of margin and realisation of value on signed opportunities
* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts
* On-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business-as-usual execution

**Who You Are**
Essential knowledge and capabilities
  
  

* You have expert capability in pricing, financial modelling and commercial analysis
* You demonstrate commercial acumen and a detailed understanding of deal economics, profitability and risk drivers
* You can design and communicate pricing strategies for complex technology opportunities
* You have advanced Microsoft Excel skills and can develop complex financial models, sensitivity analyses and commercial scenarios
* You apply a high level of attention to detail, structured governance and quality assurance
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally with senior internal and customer stakeholders
* You use relevant market and competitor insight to inform pricing decisions
* You can prioritise effectively and manage concurrent work across multiple customers and opportunities
* You demonstrate Vodafone Spirit behaviours
* You apply independent judgement to create tailored commercial approaches rather than relying solely on standard pricing methods

**Experience**

* You have extensive pricing or commercial support experience in IT services, telecommunications or systems integration
* You will typically bring 15 to 18 years of overall professional experience, including 7 to 10 years in senior pricing, bid or commercial roles
* You have practical knowledge of time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share pricing constructs
* Experience acting as the pricing authority for large, complex, multi-tower deals is preferred
* A postgraduate qualification in Finance, Business, IT or Management is highly desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to shape the pricing and commercial strategy for complex, high-value technology deals
* Exposure to strategic opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, as well as larger multi-tower bids
* Collaboration with senior commercial, financial, technology and customer stakeholders across Vodafone and VOIS
* The opportunity to influence deal competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* A location-agnostic role with exposure to multiple customers and opportunity portfolios
* The ability to contribute to customer engagement, solution shaping and commercial decision-making

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced pricing strategy for complex technology and telecommunications opportunities
* Commercial design across time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share constructs
* Scenario modelling, sensitivity analysis and financial risk assessment
* Pricing governance and the preparation of approval and submission artefacts
* Commercial leadership across multi-disciplinary bid teams
* Customer engagement, senior stakeholder communication and deal-shaping techniques
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails into business-as-usual delivery

**VOIS Equal Opportunity Employer Commitment**
Vodafone recognises and celebrates the value of diversity in building a workforce that reflects the customers and communities it serves. No form of discrimination is tolerated. This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.
  
  
**Join Us**
At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
  
  
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
  
  
With us, you can truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

Apply for Vodafone jobs only through the official Vodafone Careers website to avoid job scams and fraud.
  
  
#JDEnhancedByTARA

* LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/vois/

title: Advanced Systems Engr
description:
**Job Description**
The purpose of having a project manager is to coordinate all project activities from initiation to completion, ensuring that objectives are achieved on time, within scope, and budget. They serve as a liaison between stakeholders and team members, facilitating effective communication and managing expectations. Project managers efficiently allocate resources, identify and mitigate risks, and ensure deliverables meet quality standards. By maintaining documentation and reporting on progress, they provide visibility into the project's status and foster a culture of continuous improvement for future projects.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Project Planning: Develop a detailed project plan outlining objectives, scope, resources, timeline, and budget.
* Team Leadership: Lead and manage the project team, ensuring effective collaboration and communication among team members.
* Resource Allocation: Allocate resources efficiently, including personnel, budget, equipment, and materials.
* Stakeholder Communication: Serve as the primary point of contact for stakeholders, providing regular updates on project progress and addressing concerns.
* Risk Management: Identify potential risks and develop mitigation strategies to minimize impact on project success.
* Quality Assurance: Ensure that project deliverables meet predefined quality standards and requirements.
* Monitoring & Reporting: Track project progress through key performance indicators and prepare regular status reports for stakeholders.
* Budget Management: Oversee the project budget, ensuring expenditures stay within limits and financial resources are used appropriately.
* Problem Solving: Address challenges and obstacles that arise during the project lifecycle to keep the project on track.
* Closing the Project: Conduct project closure activities, including final deliverable acceptance, documentation, and team debriefing.

**Skills Required**

* Leadership: Ability to inspire and motivate team members to achieve project goals.
* Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills to effectively convey information to various stakeholders.
* Time Management: Skill in managing one’s own time and the time of others to meet deadlines.
* Risk Management: Ability to identify, assess, and mitigate risks throughout the project lifecycle.
* Problem-Solving: Proficiency in analyzing problems, generating solutions, and making decisions quickly.
* Negotiation: Skill in negotiating resources, contracts, and stakeholder needs to achieve project objectives.
* Technical Knowledge: Understanding of the specific industry or technical aspects relevant to the project.
* Budgeting: Ability to create and manage budgets effectively to keep projects on track financially.
* Organizational Skills: Strong organizational abilities to juggle multiple tasks and projects simultaneously.
* Adaptability: Capacity to adjust to changing circumstances and respond to unforeseen challenges.

**Key Success Factors (Key Metrics / KPIs / Deliverables)**

* Driving sales for break through Initiatives (BTI), Core Growth Initiatives (CGI)
* Demand Generation
* Drive lock-in specifications and dilute challenging specs
* Drive regulatory approval and customer AVL
* OEM development by application selling. - infrastructure, F&B, Power, Heat treatment, Packaging, OEMs
* Identifying gaps in the current coverage and drive Honeywell acceptance
* Participate in Mutual Action Planning (MAP) discussions with our CP/SI
* Attend Pre-bid and post bid technical meetings and drive Honeywell needs
* Willing to travel 5 days in a month to SEA countries
* Improve the project margin 2% to 5% from booking.
* Control the project resources within the budget
* Revenue Recognition as per the project schedule
* Good or Improve customer experience based on customer feedback (survey)

**Qualifications**
**Work Experience Required**

* 8-10 years with at least 4 years in on HON or competitors FI product portfolio
* Proven business experience in multiple vertical markets, including field products industries. Networking within the instrumentation industry- large customers, OEM's, EPC's and Consultants will be a strong advantage.
* Supporting sales campaigns or programs in specific markets or for specific products
* Proven Presentation skills

**Specific Knowledge Required**

* Technical understanding of portfolio, competition and understanding of customer applications is must
* Moderate travel (1-2 days a month)
* Understands the value proposition of Honeywell and all the company has to offer
* From experience, a good knowledge of our customers’ businesses and drivers
* Working knowledge of Honeywell, commercial terms, contract terms, etc.

**About Us**
Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. We serve the building, industrial and process sectors with a broad portfolio of services, solutions and products, underpinned by our Honeywell Technologies Accelerator operating system and Honeywell Technologies Forge intelligence layer. By combining the deep domain expertise of our more than 50,000 employees with decades of data from our global installed base, we are uniquely positioned to lead the industrial sector’s transition from automation to autonomy.

title: BC sector -LS-Commercial analyst-Senior

**Technology - Consulting – Commercial analytics and Forecasting – Senior Consultant/Asst Manager – Life Sciences Sector**
**The opportunity**
We are seeking an experienced Pharma Forecasting Specialist to join our team. The role involves working as a key stakeholder within a cross-functional team to deliver forecasts at the global, regional, and country levels based on business needs.
  
  
The ideal candidate will have 7+ years of pharmaceutical forecasting experience, strong therapeutic area (TA) expertise, and the ability to develop forecasting assumptions, create concept notes, and prepare impactful presentations. Basic proficiency in Python is required to support forecasting and analytical activities.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
As a Senior Consultant/Asst. Manager in Commercial analytics and Forecasting, you will work as a key stakeholder within a cross-functional team to deliver forecasts at the global, regional, and country levels based on business needs.
  
  
**In this pivotal role, you will:**

* Develop and maintain short-term and long-term brand forecasts to support strategic and operational planning.
* Conduct brand, franchise, regional, and country-level forecasting, providing actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Apply quantitative and analytical techniques to solve forecasting challenges and perform sensitivity analyses to assess risks and opportunities.
* Build, validate, and enhance forecasting models, recommending appropriate assumptions and methodologies.
* Analyze historical performance, market dynamics, and business drivers to improve forecast accuracy.
* Prepare concept notes, reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate insights and recommendations effectively.
* Present findings to internal stakeholders and senior leadership to support decision-making.
* Leverage Python and analytics tools to automate and optimize forecasting processes.
* Drive continuous improvement by adopting best practices, innovative methodologies, and emerging forecasting technologies

**Overall delivery**

* Conduct brand, franchise, regional, and country-level forecasting, providing actionable business insights and recommendations.
* Analyze historical performance, market dynamics, and business drivers to improve forecast accuracy.
* Prepare concept notes, reports, dashboards, and presentations to communicate insights and recommendations effectively.
* Present findings to internal stakeholders and senior leadership to support decision-making.

**Practice development**

* Contribute to the growth and strategic direction of EY’s Pharma Customer practice.
* Develop thought leadership assets, including POVs, POCs, proposals, and go-to-market materials to support business development.
* Identify opportunities to expand EY’s capabilities and deliver innovative solutions for pharmaceutical clients.
* Stay current with pharmaceutical industry trends, market dynamics, and emerging technologies.
* Identify and support new business opportunities within the life sciences and pharmaceutical sectors

**Stakeholder management**

* Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders, including Marketing, Finance, Market Access, MMD, HHI, and RCL teams, to gather requirements and deliver forecasting solutions.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships, acting as a trusted advisor and strategic partner.
* Translate business requirements into scalable, actionable, and sustainable solutions.
* Drive stakeholder alignment to ensure successful project delivery and client satisfaction

**Team and People development**

* Lead, coach, and mentor team members, fostering a culture of continuous learning and innovation.
* Recruit, develop, and retain high-performing talent with expertise in pharmaceutical forecasting and analytics.
* Create and execute development plans to support career growth and capability building.
* Strengthen team expertise in therapeutic areas, pharmaceutical sciences, strategic thinking, project management, and leadership.
* Foster an inclusive, agile, and high-performance team environment.

title: Channel Sales Executive

**About HydroNest India**

HydroNest India is a fast-growing company specializing in water treatment components, RO systems, water filtration products, and commercial & industrial water treatment plants. We serve dealers, distributors, OEMs, manufacturers, institutions, and industries across India.

**Job Overview**

As a Channel Sales Executive, you will be responsible for building, nurturing, and expanding HydroNest’s B2B channel network. You will actively identify potential dealers, distributors, stockists, and contractors, present our product line, negotiate commercial terms, and onboard strategic channel partners. Your primary focus will be driving secondary and primary sales throughput across your assigned territory while maintaining long-term partner relationships.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Network Expansion & Partner Onboarding**

* Identify, evaluate, and recruit new dealers, distributors, stockists, and trade partners across assigned target regions.

**2. Channel & Account Management**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for onboarded dealers and distributors.
* Regularly visit channel partners, evaluate inventory levels, collect feedback, and ensure timely reordering (secondary sales generation).
* Drive partner engagement through promotional schemes, seasonal incentives, and product marketing updates.

**3. Sales Execution & Target Achievement**

* Deliver on monthly, quarterly, and annual channel sales targets for primary and secondary volumes.
* Support channel partners in closing large B2B, industrial, or institutional orders by delivering joint client presentations or site visits.
* Manage credit limits, payment cycles, and timely collections from dealers to maintain healthy cash flow.

**4. Partner Enablement & Market Intelligence**

* Organize product training sessions for dealers and their sales teams to ensure strong product knowledge.
* Track local market trends, competitor pricing, scheme structures, and new product launches, reporting insights back to management.
* Manage conflict resolution related to territorial overlaps or price undercutting among channel partners.

**5. Reporting & CRM**

* Log daily field visits, partner meetings, pipeline leads, and order forecasts into the company CRM/ERP**.**
* Provide weekly/monthly regional sales reports to the sales management team.

**Candidate Requirements & Qualifications**

* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in BusinessAdministration, Marketing, Engineering, Commerce, or a related field (IT/CS graduates with strong sales acumen are also welcome).
* **Experience:** 2 to 5 years of proven experience in channel sales, dealer management, or field sales within water treatment, pumps, building materials, industrial equipment, or HVAC sectors.
* **Network & Market Knowledge:** Existing network of trade dealers, industrial suppliers, or plumbing/water equipment distributors in Maharashtra/Pune is a huge plus.
* **Interpersonal & Pitching Skills:** Exceptional communication, negotiation, and presentation skills with an approachable personality that builds trust easily.
* **Mindset:** Strong sense of ownership, "can-do" attitude, proactive problem solver, and eager to learn technical product details.
* **Mobility:** Willingness to undertake local travel for client meetings and dealer visits within assigned territories.

**Key Technical & Functional Skills**

* Channel Sales & Dealer Management
* B2B Prospecting & Network Expansion
* Sales Negotiation & Margin Structuring
* Territory Mapping & Forecasting
* Relationship Management & Account Retention
* CRM & MS Excel Reporting

**Company Perks & Benefits**

* **Work Schedule:** 6 days work week (Monday to Saturday, 10 AM - 6 PM, On-site).
* **Paid Time Off:** 18 Paid Leaves + 10 Declared National Holidays per year.
* **Tech Kit:** Company-provided laptop & Wi-Fi support**.**

Job Description: Business Development Executive

**Location:** Pune, Maharashtra  
**Work Mode:** Work from Office  
**Employment Type:** Full-time  
**Experience:** 1–3 years

About the Role

We are looking for a proactive, confident, and results-driven **Business Development Executive** to join our digital marketing agency in Pune. The agency works with clients across the hospitality sector, including restaurants, cafés, bars, hotels, and resorts, along with businesses from other industries.

The role involves identifying potential clients, generating leads, pitching our services, building client relationships, and converting business opportunities into revenue. Our key services include social media management, website design and development, SEO, and other digital marketing solutions.

The ideal candidate should have strong communication and negotiation skills, a sales-oriented mindset, and the ability to understand client requirements and recommend the right digital solutions.

Key Responsibilities1. Lead Generation & Business Development

* Identify and reach out to potential clients through cold calling, email, LinkedIn, networking, referrals, and other relevant channels.
* Generate new business opportunities for social media management, website development, SEO, and digital marketing services.
* Research potential clients, understand their business needs, and identify opportunities to pitch the agency's services.
* Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective clients across hospitality and other relevant industries.
* Proactively approach restaurants, cafés, hotels, resorts, lifestyle brands, and other businesses that may benefit from digital marketing services.

2. Client Meetings & Service Pitching

* Schedule and conduct client meetings, calls, and presentations to understand business objectives and marketing requirements.
* Present the agency's services, capabilities, case studies, and proposals to prospective clients.
* Recommend suitable solutions based on client needs, whether social media management, website design and development, SEO, or a combination of services.
* Coordinate with internal teams to prepare customised proposals, quotations, and service packages.
* Communicate the value of digital marketing services and explain how they can support brand visibility, customer engagement, and business growth.

3. Sales & Client Acquisition

* Follow up with prospective clients, handle queries, address objections, and negotiate commercial terms.
* Convert qualified leads into paying clients and work towards monthly and quarterly sales targets.
* Manage the sales pipeline from initial outreach and lead qualification to proposal submission and deal closure.
* Maintain accurate records of leads, meetings, follow-ups, proposals, and conversions.
* Identify opportunities to upsell additional services to prospective clients based on their requirements.

4. Client Relationship Management

* Build and maintain strong professional relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Ensure clear communication throughout the sales process and coordinate smooth onboarding of new clients.
* Work closely with the social media, SEO, website development, and client servicing teams to understand service offerings and communicate deliverables accurately.
* Stay connected with clients to identify future requirements, referrals, and opportunities for additional business.

5. Market Research & Competitor Analysis

* Research market trends, competitor offerings, industry requirements, and potential business opportunities.
* Identify businesses with gaps in their social media presence, website performance, or search engine visibility.
* Track competitor pricing, service offerings, and positioning to support sales strategy.
* Suggest new approaches for lead generation, client acquisition, and business growth.

6. Reporting & Sales Performance

* Maintain a structured database of leads, prospects, and client interactions.
* Prepare regular reports on lead generation, meetings, proposals, conversions, and revenue.
* Track progress against assigned sales targets and identify areas for improvement.
* Share market feedback and client requirements with the management team.

Skills & Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Sales, or a related field.
* 1–3 years of experience in business development, sales, or client acquisition, preferably in a digital marketing or advertising agency.
* Strong verbal and written communication, presentation, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to generate leads independently and convert prospects into clients.
* Basic understanding of social media marketing, website design and development, SEO, and digital marketing services.
* Confidence in conducting client meetings, pitching services, and following up with prospects.
* Strong networking, relationship-building, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work towards sales targets and manage multiple opportunities simultaneously.
* Familiarity with CRM tools, spreadsheets, LinkedIn, and lead-generation platforms is an advantage.
* Willingness to attend in-person client meetings and networking events in Pune as required.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

* Number and quality of leads generated.
* Number of client meetings and qualified opportunities.
* Conversion rate from leads to paying clients.
* Monthly sales targets and revenue generated.
* Number of new clients acquired across social media, website, SEO, and other services.
* Follow-up consistency and accuracy of sales pipeline records.
* Quality of client relationships and opportunities for repeat business or referrals.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to work with a growing digital marketing agency and a diverse client portfolio.
* Exposure to multiple digital services, including social media, website development, SEO, and online marketing.
* Opportunities to build industry connections, develop sales expertise, and grow professionally.
* A collaborative work environment with direct exposure to the management and creative teams.
* Performance-driven growth opportunities.

Who Would Be a Great Fit?

We are looking for someone who enjoys meeting people, building relationships, identifying business opportunities, and closing deals. The ideal candidate is self-motivated, persuasive, organised, and comfortable taking ownership of the complete sales cycle.

**If you are passionate about sales, enjoy understanding business challenges, and can confidently pitch digital marketing solutions to potential clients, we would love to hear from you.**

**To Apply:** Please share your CV along with a brief summary of your business development or sales experience.

description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Business Manger” to drive sales of pharmaceutical products in your assigned territory. You will gather market intelligence, conduct prescription audits, and implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets. Additionally, you will manage queries from doctors, maintain customer relationships, and ensure accurate territory data management.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for understanding market trends and competition status by gathering information from stockists and chemists and relaying this data to the Sales Business Manager (SBM) or Regional Sales Manager (RSM).
* You will be responsible for conducting Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) on doctors in the assigned area to identify potential high-prescribers and providing the final list of doctors likely to prescribe large quantities to the SBM/RSM for sales forecasting purposes.
* You will be responsible for attending relevant training programs and staying updated on product literature.
* You will be responsible for obtaining sales targets and promotion budget details from SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for utilizing the allocated budget to plan launch activities for different doctors, camps, or Continuing Medical Education (CME) sessions in the assigned area.
* You will be responsible for conducting regular sales pitches and presentations with doctors to promote products.
* You will be responsible for submitting reimbursement bills to SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for implementing marketing plans provided by the Product Manager.
* You will be responsible for gathering Point of Business (POB) details from chemists and coordinating with stockists to ensure product delivery.
* You will be responsible for monitoring and tracking sales of new products with chemists to achieve sales targets.
* You will be responsible for collecting queries from doctors regarding both new and existing products.
* You will be responsible for entering queries into the system for review by the Infogini team.
* You will be responsible for utilizing email responses from Infogini to address doctors' queries and increase prescriptions per doctor.
* You will be responsible for maintaining regular interactions with doctors to understand their prescription trends.
* You will be responsible for communicating prescription trend data to SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for keeping track of specific customer needs and providing feedback to Area Sales Manager (ASM), SBM/RSM, or Head Office (HO).
* You will be responsible for preparing lists of doctors for all CME events and submitting them to SBM/RSM to foster strong relationships and loyalty among doctors.
* You will be responsible for maintaining and updating data on doctor lists, route maps, retailers, and other supply chain contacts in the internal database.
* You will be responsible for ensuring accurate management of sales activities to optimize sales volume and effectiveness.

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-** Graduate with science background.  
  
**Minimum work experience-** 3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  
  
**Skills & attributes**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing.
* Understanding of key trends in Pharmaceutical Sales.
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong decision-making skills.

  
  
**Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**

title: Senior Consultant, India-Europe Projects
description:
Jain-Richter Group connects Indian and European companies with the right partner on the other side. You find those partners, run the projects that bring them together, and sit at the table with the Managing Partner.

**The practical terms first**

* ₹45,000 to ₹60,000 a month depending on experience, on a consultancy agreement
* Plus performance-based pay
* Remote from Delhi NCR, Monday to Saturday, starting by 07:30 IST
* In person with clients in Delhi NCR 10 to 15 days a quarter

**What is on the desk now**

You work across all four services, because the work arrives that way. Every project is confidential, so these are described without names.

**Technology transfer & joint ventures**

* A European biogas technology owner wants Indian EPC contractors to take its licence.
* A German engineering firm builds biogas plants for Indian clients.
* A joint venture is moving from term sheet to company.

**Investment & acquisitions**

* Indian investors are looking at German companies, hotels and real estate.
* A European pharmaceutical site needs a buyer.
* Investors want Indian greentech opportunities.

**Market entry & access**

* German Mittelstand companies are preparing to enter India.
* Indian technology companies want a way into German industry.

**Trade & sourcing**

* Trading houses want agricultural commodities and edible oils.
* New enquiries need qualifying before anyone spends time on them.

**The work**

**Find and qualify the right companies (about 35%)**

* Build the target list for each project: manufacturers, EPC contractors, investors, Mittelstand companies, suppliers and buyers.
* Check what each company claims against sources a client can verify: filings, certification registers, trade fair exhibitor lists, trade data.
* Deliver a ranked shortlist with a short case for each name, and a separate list of what you could not verify.

**Run the projects (about 30%)**

* Own the tracker for four to six live projects, so every thread carries an owner and a dated next step.
* Prepare a one-page brief for every meeting, route NDAs and keep the documents in order.
* Send minutes and follow-ups the same day, and chase every open thread to a yes, a no or a date.

**Work with clients and partners (about 25%)**

* Join client and partner calls and the meetings in Delhi NCR, and present your own research.
* Be the day-to-day contact for information requests.
* Represent the firm at trade fairs and come back with qualified contacts and written notes.

**Improve how the firm works (about 10%)**

* Fix what slows the work down: the project tracker, the CRM, research and handover templates, and the AI research workflows.
* Write down each process you improve, so the next person can run it without asking.
* Propose one improvement a month, agree it with the Managing Partner, and put it in use. Client deadlines always come first.

**How we work together**

**We work across two time zones: the Managing Partner in Singapore, you in India. A few simple habits keep us in step and make sure your work keeps moving without waiting on anyone.**

1. **Progress over perfection.**
   We work on an 80/20 basis. A clear first answer early is worth more than a perfect one late, so share what you have as soon as it is enough to decide the next step.
2. **Raise it early.**
   If something is not working after about two hours, let us know and suggest a way forward. Getting stuck is normal; staying stuck alone is what we want to avoid.
3. **Align before you dive in.**
   For anything that will take longer than a day, send a short note first: how you understand the task, how you plan to approach it, and when you expect to finish.
4. **A short daily update.**
   At the end of your day, by 17:00 IST, a few lines on what you completed, anything that is blocked, and your priorities for tomorrow.
5. **Stay connected in the mornings.**
   A short call each morning, and replies within a couple of hours between 07:30 and 13:00 IST.

"I could not verify this" is always a good answer. We value honesty over a confident guess.

**What this role is not**

* Not an executive assistant role. No calendar management, inbox triage, travel booking or errands.
* Not a sales role. You find and qualify companies. The Managing Partner pitches, prices, negotiates and signs. That boundary is legal, not a judgement about you.
* Not web development or design.

**You**

* Mid to senior level: at least five years in consulting, market research, transaction support, investment promotion, a chamber of commerce or an embassy's commercial section.
* You can name a project you ran from start to finish and what it changed.
* You write English that goes to a German managing director or an Indian promoter family with light edits or none. You speak Hindi well enough to call a company and ask a short set of questions.
* Excel or Sheets to a working standard. You use AI research tools and check every fact against its original source.
* You live in Delhi NCR, meet in person on a few days' notice, and work on your own laptop.
* German is a real advantage, and is paid as one.
* The role is open to anyone, whatever their gender, community or marital status.

**Your first 90 days**

* Day 30: the tracker is live for every open project, nothing sits without a dated next step, and the daily handover runs unasked. One ranked target list delivered.
* Day 60: you run the weekly rhythm of one project on your own, and own the follow-ups from at least two client meetings.
* Day 90: at least one project has moved a full stage, with you as the working contact on our side. One improved process is written down and in use.

**Pay**

The monthly fee is fixed and paid against your invoice. Performance-based pay is at the firm's discretion and scored on four things you control:

* Delivery: milestones met on the agreed date, or moved in writing before they were missed.
* Research quality: sources a client can check, a ranking with reasons, an honest unverified list.
* Project control: every thread with an owner and a next step, and a handover on every working day.
* Client and partner feedback: how the people on the other side describe working with you.

Performance-based pay is never linked to a deal, a commission or a transaction value. That is a legal requirement, and it keeps the incentive on the quality of the work.

**How to apply**

Apply here on LinkedIn. Then email your answers to the two questions below, in no more than 150 words each, to join@jain-richtergroup.com with the subject line "Senior Consultant, your name".

1. Describe one project you ran from start to finish. What was the outcome, and what did you personally do?
2. Tell us about a time you stopped working on something because it was not going anywhere. How long did it take you to notice, and who did you tell?

Applications without the two answers are not read.

Shortlisted candidates have one interview of 45 minutes with the Managing Partner, a two-hour case study, and a paid trial week on real work before any agreement is signed. We reply to everyone within seven days, and if we say no, we say why in a line.

Our model operationalizes leading academic research (including from Nobel-winning economists). Operating across 11 countries, our team of 900+ has reached over 500 million people, working closely with governments to scale these interventions.

* Through Safe Water Now, we've saved the lives of over 15,000 children.
* Our Accelerator explores untapped opportunities in global health, testing low-cost interventions with the greatest potential to save and improve lives.

At Evidence Action, your colleagues are your greatest asset. You'll partner with high-caliber colleagues in an environment blending innovation, autonomy, and teamwork. Our team excels in disruptive thinking and believes in rolling up our sleeves to get things done. If you're looking to work flexibly and with purpose, join a team that delivers measurable change for millions.
  
  
**The Role**
The consultant will examine two related but distinct areas:
  
  
(i) the MVS landscape, including its scale, infrastructure characteristics, operating models and existing water-treatment arrangements; and
  
  
(ii) the electrochlorinator landscape, including technologies, existing deployments, economics and potential use cases across rural water systems
  
  
The goal of this consultancy is two fold:
  
  

* Develop a detailed understanding of the MVS landscape, including its scale, major scheme archetypes, infrastructure and operating characteristics, existing treatment arrangements, and resulting gaps or opportunities for safe-water interventions particularly in Evidence Action's priority states (AP, Bihar, Odisha, Rajasthan)
* Assess the EC market and determine the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs could represent a viable rural chlorination solution - addressing ECs' fit within a broader rural chlorination technology option including tablet-based dozers and other chlorination options

The final output should help Evidence Action decide whether, where and how to invest in ECs and/or other technologies to meet the water treatment needs of MVS in rural India. This would include analysis on the minimum technical, operational, financial and institutional conditions required for this type of intervention. Specific workstreams include:
  
  
**Estimating MVS Market Size and Identifying Key Market Segments**

* Conduct landscape analysis to estimate the total rural population served by MVS; verify estimates for EvAc priority states (AP, Bihar, Rajasthan, Odisha) via qualitative interviews and/or field visits as necessary
* Building on the analysis above, analyze the MVS infrastructure landscape to determine major market segments; identify key elements of each market segment that have relevance to water treatment, including system size/capacity, number of villages/population served, source and infrastructure configuration, existing treatment arrangements, and operating/O&M models; estimate the size of major market segments in EvAc priority states

**Analysis of Water Treatment Solutions Relevant to MVS, Including ECs**

* Conduct landscape analysis to map water treatment solutions already in place to serve MVS across rural India; document best practices and key learnings from implementation to date; including functionality, operational and O&M considerations where evidence is available
* Develop a market analysis documenting currently available water treatment solutions that would meet the needs of MVS systems (whether they are being implemented currently or not). While estimates for all of rural India would be useful, a focus on Andhra Pradesh, Bihar, Odisha and Rajasthan is a priority
* Develop a comparison model to assess key attributes of each water treatment solution, including cost, consumable requirements, maintenance requirements and implementation track record. Separately, develop a deeper analysis of the EC market, documenting currently available and late-stage EC models, suppliers, existing deployments, performance, costs and operational requirements across relevant rural water-system use cases, including but not limited to MVS
* Develop analysis to identify the technical, operational and economic conditions under which ECs are likely to be viable or non-viable across different rural water-system configurations, and identify the use cases where ECs appear most promising

**Recommendations for Strategic Intervention Pathways in EA ISW Priority States**

* Using findings from all analysis areas described above, develop summary recommendations for EvAc on potential opportunities within the MVS landscape and on whether, where and how ECs could expand EA's rural chlorination technology options, including scale-up pathways, with a focus on EA ISW priority geographies. A recommendation to defer, limit, or not pursue ECs will be considered valid if supported by the evidence
* Recommendations should explicitly state which MVS segments and/or EC use cases, geographies, delivery models and risk controls are strategic for further testing or scale-up

**Requirements**

* 15+ years of experience with a focus on strategy, market shaping and/or management consulting; existing experience in the water/WASH sector preferred, but not required
* Experience assessing water-treatment technologies, including technical fit, costs, maintenance and operating requirements; chlorination/EC experience preferred
* Strong relationships or credibility with government, WASH institutions, implementers and sector experts in India
* No existing commercial relationship with any of the EC vendors being evaluated
* Experience communicating technical material to non-technical audiences, including donors, boards, or senior leadership

**Position Location**
**This is a 6-month consultancy engagement,**
with the possibility of extension based on organizational needs.
  
  
We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an Indian employment visa at this time. Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India for roles based in India.
  
  
**Consultancy Fees:**
Competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience, and previous pay scale.
  
  
**All contracting arrangements will be made through EAII Advisors Private Limited. EAII is an equal opportunity employer. Employment at EAII is based solely on an individual's merit and qualifications directly related to professional competence. EAII does not discriminate against any employee or applicant because of race, caste, creed, colour, religion, gender, origin, disability, marital status, or any other basis protected by law.**
