title: Platform Customer Engineer, Google Cloud
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 10 years of experience with cloud native architecture in a customer-facing or support role.
* Experience with cloud engineering, on-premise engineering, virtualization, or containerization platforms.
* Experience engaging with, or presenting to, technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Experience in programming languages, debugging, systems design, prototyping, demos, or customer workshops.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.
* Experience driving the entire sales cycle (e.g., defining the delivery and consumption plan and transitioning it for execution).
* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.
  
  
As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.
  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Manager - Revenue Architecture & Solutions
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Manager - Revenue Architecture & Solutions who combines marketing operations expertise, technical depth and a strong understanding of how B2B companies run programs such as Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and demand generation.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, marketing technology and revenue operations. You'll work directly with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other senior stakeholders to understand the business challenges driving their need for technology, translate those challenges into executable game plans, and partner with our technology and delivery teams to bring those solutions to life.
  
  
This isn't a pure consulting or project management role. You'll need to understand how businesses operate, how their marketing and sales programs work, and how the right technology architecture and execution can drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, designing connected technology solutions and working closely with senior stakeholders, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Business Discovery & Consulting: Lead discovery conversations with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other stakeholders to understand business goals, GTM motions, operational challenges and the underlying problems driving technology requirements.
* Solution Strategy & Planning: Translate business challenges into clearly defined problem statements, solution approaches and executable game plans, working with Solution Architects and the technology execution team to define scope, priorities and implementation plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Solutions: Design and implement technology setups across Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience (CX), ensuring systems, workflows and data connect to support business objectives.
* ABM & Demand Generation Enablement: Understand how B2B companies plan and execute ABM and demand generation programs, and translate these requirements into scalable technology solutions, workflows and measurement frameworks.
* Technology Stack & Integration: Work hands-on with marketing and revenue technology platforms, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and ABM and intent platforms such as Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level, to enable integrated GTM execution.
* Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery, Customer Success and other internal teams to translate the agreed game plan into technical requirements, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations and manage expectations throughout solution design and delivery.
* Engagement Governance: Maintain visibility into project scope, timelines, dependencies and risks. Identify gaps early, resolve execution blockers and ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop discovery frameworks, solution playbooks and repeatable approaches that improve consulting quality, implementation efficiency and client outcomes.

****What success looks like****

* Senior stakeholders trust you to understand their business challenges and recommend solutions beyond simply implementing a tool.
* Business problems are translated into clear, technically feasible execution plans.
* Marketing, Sales and CX technology setups work together to support ABM, demand generation and broader revenue objectives.
* Solution Architects and delivery teams have the business context and requirements needed to execute effectively.
* Client engagements remain aligned with business outcomes, with measurable improvements in operational efficiency, GTM execution and revenue performance.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 5–8 years in MarTech, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, solutions consulting or technology implementation, ideally within a B2B SaaS, MarTech or consulting environment.
* Business Consulting: Experience conducting discovery with senior stakeholders, identifying root causes and translating business challenges into actionable solution plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of how B2B Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience teams operate, including their processes, data flows and technology requirements.
* ABM & Demand Generation: Practical understanding of B2B demand generation and ABM programs, including how technology enables targeting, campaign orchestration, engagement and performance measurement.
* Technology Implementation: Demonstrated experience implementing or architecting technology setups for Marketing, Sales and/or CX teams, including workflows, integrations, data structures and process automation.
* Platform Knowledge: Strong hands-on knowledge of HubSpot and familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level. Experience with multiple platforms across the MarTech and ABM ecosystem is a plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Confidence working with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and cross-functional teams, translating between business priorities and technical execution.
* Execution & Ownership: Ability to turn strategy into a practical implementation plan, manage competing priorities and stay accountable for outcomes.
* How you think: Curious about how businesses work, technically sound, commercially aware and comfortable navigating ambiguity without relying on a fixed playbook.

****Why join us****

* Solve real business problems: Work directly with senior leaders to address business challenges through technology and execution.
* Bridge strategy and implementation: Own the journey from discovery and solution planning to implementation alongside experienced technical teams.
* Work across the revenue ecosystem: Gain exposure to leading MarTech, CRM, ABM and AI platforms and complex B2B GTM environments.
* Join a top-tier ecosystem: As a HubSpot Elite Partner, we work with ambitious businesses and a strong technology ecosystem.
* Grow with the business: Be part of a growing team where ownership, problem-solving and impact create opportunities to take on more responsibility.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build and the outcomes you drive.

title: AI Outcome Customer Engineer, GTM AI Tech, Google Cloud
description:
In most instances, this position requires in-person interviews as part of the hiring process.
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 7 years of experience troubleshooting technical issues for internal/external partners or customers.
* Experience leading technical delivery strategies, debugging systems, and interfacing with product/engineering organizations.
* Experience reading or debugging code in a general purpose coding language (e.g., Java, Python, JavaScript, etc.).
* Experience with enterprise integrations (e.g., APIs, enterprise content management (ECMs), identity), cloud infrastructure, or AI/ML model deployments.
* Experience in system design or orchestration frameworks.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Experience orchestrating specialized technical resources to execute complex builds.
* Experience engaging with, presenting to, and influencing technical stakeholders or executive leaders.
* Ability to dive deep into novel technical problems, decipher extreme ambiguity, diagnose bugs, and emerge with credible architectural solutions.
* Excellent executive communication skills, capable of translating deep technical integration issues into business impact.

**About The Job**
The Google Cloud team helps companies, schools, and government seamlessly make the switch to Google products and supports them along the way. You listen to the customer and swiftly problem-solve technical issues to show how our products can make businesses more productive, collaborative, and innovative. You work closely with a cross-functional team of web developers and systems administrators, not to mention a variety of both regional and international customers. Your relationships with customers are crucial in helping Google grow its Cloud business and helping companies around the world innovate.
  
  
As an AI Outcome Customer Engineer, Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE), you will be responsible as an enterprise architect, technical debugger, and engineering liaison. You will bridge the gap between pre-sales agreement shaping and post-sales execution. Entering the agreement cycle during the technical evaluation phase for strategic accounts, you will ensure that solutions are shaped strictly through the lens of adoption, rapid activation, and viable delivery. You will be the overarching Enterprise Architect and Technical Delivery Manager charting the course. You will also be responsible for technical design, systemic debugging, product and engineering integration, and strategic FDE alignment. You will architect how these technical marvels actually integrate into the customer's IT ecosystem (connectors, identity, data residency, legal constraints) and drive the technical delivery strategy from start to finish.
  
  
Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with Account teams and practice Customer Engineer (CEs) during technical evaluation phases to assess project feasibility, shape proposals for long-term adoption, and validate FDE engagement requests.
* Lead upfront technical design for enterprise-grade AI solutions, ensuring seamless and secure integration of models, agents, and connectors into existing customer data pipelines, identity providers, and compliance boundaries.
* Dive into code-level context to diagnose and resolve complex customer implementation issues, identify core product bugs, and test workarounds to clear execution roadblocks.
* Serve as the definitive liaison to core Product and Engineering teams, troubleshooting systemic deployment blockers and translating real-world field feedback into actionable feature requests.
* Steer implementation strategy through technical authority and architectural foresight while owning the technical reality of delivery alongside customer-facing teams.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

title: Manager, Solutions Architecture
description:
We are looking for an experienced and driven leader, with great energy, passion and initiative to manage a highly motivated Pre-Sales Solutions Architecture team.
  
  
MongoDB Pre-Sales Solution Architects partner with the rest of the go to market team to help our customers craft and build solutions to address their business needs. Our team is made up of top-tier software architects, entrepreneurs, and developers who take direct responsibility for customer success. As an integral component of the sales team, they help shoulder the responsibility of generating revenue, by strategically interfacing with the customer and becoming the trusted advisor.
  
  
As a leader in Pre-Sales Solutions Architecture, you will cultivate a stellar team. You will partner closely with our sales counterparts to define, improve and execute our sales initiatives in the enterprise market. You will be integral to driving the business forward, by developing both our pre-sales and sales practices and by bringing the voice of experience.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Candidate Profile
  
  

* 4+ years of pre-sales experience, with strong commercial skills
* 3+ years Management experience, ideally in pre-sales, distributed team management preferred
* Results oriented, with a track record of overachievement (Circle of Excellence, Leader of the Year, etc)
* Driven – you possess a strong desire to be successful
* Focused – you are skilled in managing time and resources and have a sound approach to technically qualifying opportunities
* Intelligent – you possess an aptitude to learn quickly and establish credibility
* Excellent presentation and interpersonal skills
* Database industry background a plus
* Experience in pre sales of AI services products would be a plus
* Software development background a plus
* The ability to travel up to 30%
* A Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience

Position Expectations
  
  

* Recruit, retain, and develop top pre-sales talent across multiple countries
* Partner with our sales teams to help ensure success in accounts ranging from mid-to-large enterprises
* Work closely with the Professional Services team to achieve customer happiness and with Marketing to conduct seminars, trade shows and other marketing related events
* Foster strong and effective relationships with customers, resulting in growth opportunities
* Coach the team to exceed monthly, quarterly and annual bookings objectives

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. title: Marketing Lead - Brand and Content
description:
Lead, Brand and Content

Fintech Cloud Pvt. Ltd. | Delhi NCR | Full-time

Reports to: Chief Marketing Officer

Experience: 6 to 10 years in content or creative roles

Team: Individual contributor initially, building a team as the function scales

ABOUT FINTECH CLOUD

Fintech Cloud is a lending technology and operations platform. We run the origination, underwriting and servicing infrastructure for RBI-registered NBFC partners, and operate the consumer lending brands they lend through. The business is growing quickly, in both partner count and marketing investment.

This role is part of the marketing function being built to support that growth. It reports to the Chief Marketing Officer and is hands-on from day one, with scope to build a team as the function expands.

THE ROLE

We operate a growing portfolio of consumer lending brands. Every landing page, ad and message is a regulated surface where disclosure requirements apply and liability sits with the lender. This role builds a creative production system that works across many brands at once, and builds the Fintech Cloud brand that helps win new lending partners.

WHAT YOU WILL OWN

• The landing page content system: templated pages per brand with compliance elements locked and populated from lender configuration, and campaign elements editable.

• Creative production at volume, using templated formats and vernacular variants written natively rather than translated, AI-assisted where it adds throughput.

• A compliance-cleared copy library, so regulatory constraints live in the creative brief rather than in a review queue.

• SEO on a focused set of priority brands rather than spread thinly across all of them.

• Social presence, consolidated for consumer brands and built properly for the B2B audience.

• Fintech Cloud's own brand: positioning, case studies and proof material that supports partner acquisition.

WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experience running creative production as a system rather than project by project, meaning templates, libraries and throughput.

• Multi-brand or multi-market background, ideally with vernacular content across Indian languages.

• Performance creative literacy, meaning creative that is tested and measured rather than simply approved.

• Experience in a regulated category where claims are constrained, such as financial services, insurance or healthcare.

• Practical use of AI tooling for content generation, with judgement about where it works and where it does not.

• Both B2C and B2B content capability, since this role serves the consumer brands and the company's own partner acquisition.

NICE TO HAVE

• Familiarity with RBI digital lending disclosure requirements and Google or Meta financial services advertising policy.

• SEO experience on content-led acquisition.

SUCCESS AT SIX MONTHS

• A landing page template system live across priority brands, with compliance components locked.

• Creative production keeping pace with brand launches without headcount growing in step.

• A compliance-cleared copy library in use, reducing creative rejection and account restriction rates.

• Fintech Cloud positioned with proof material that supports winning new lending partners.

title: Global Digital Marketing Specialist - SEO/AEO/GEO
description:
Who We Are
  
  
Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.
  
  
To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
We're seeking an SEO/GEO/AEO Specialist to support our global SEO and discoverability strategy. You'll execute across keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO, and modern search discoverability research and implementation (including AI-driven and zero-click experiences) — working directly with our Digital Content Strategy team to ensure content is findable, well-structured, and aligned to how today’s users search and find content online.
  
  
Day-to-day, this means producing keyword research, answering stakeholder questions about SEO and discoverability platforms, running site audits, implementing on-page optimizations, and supporting actionable performance reporting that can be used to inform optimizations. You’ll use tools like Semrush, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics, and more. You'll coordinate with editorial teams to translate SEO guidance into action, and flag gaps and opportunities as you find them. You’ll also identify opportunities to improve how our content is structured and understood by search engines and AI systems (e.g., extractability, internal linking, and structured data). Where relevant, you’ll adapt content to increase visibility in features like snippets, AI summaries, and other zero-click surfaces. This includes optimizing content for visibility in answer engines and AI-powered search experiences, not just traditional rankings.
  
  
What You'll Bring
  
  

* 3-5 years of hands-on SEO experience, with exposure to both content and technical workstreams
* Ability to read content with an SEO lens — identifying structural, intent, or keyword issues at the page level
* Ability to triage a site audit and prioritize fixes by business impact, not just severity
* Experience executing SEO requests and documenting optimizations in a structured, trackable way
* Demonstrated ability to execute on-page optimizations and keyword research independently
* Experience producing SEO reports with plain-language context for non-SEO stakeholders, not raw data pulls
* Experience measuring performance beyond rankings (e.g., impressions, snippet capture, zero-click impact)
* Familiarity with how AI-driven search experiences (e.g., Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, Perplexity) are changing content discoverability
* Curiosity about emerging search paradigms, including generative/LLM-driven discovery
* Working proficiency with Semrush, Google Search Console, Adobe Analytics or comparable platforms
* Strong written English communication skills for interfacing with a global team

**Preferred**

* Prior experience in a B2B or large-scale content environment
* Familiarity with site crawl tools such as Screaming Frog or Sitebulb
* A portfolio of past SEO work — demonstrated results matter more than credentials

Additional info
  
  
**YOU’RE GOOD AT**

* Working independently and delivering against defined milestones without needing close oversight — you take ownership of your workstream and follow through
* Communicating clearly across teams — you can explain SEO concepts to non-technical stakeholders without losing them in jargon
* Understanding how search behavior is evolving beyond traditional rankings (e.g., AI-generated answers, zero-click results) and adapting accordingly
* Connecting keyword intent to broader user journeys, not just individual queries
* Reading a piece of content and diagnosing why it may not be performing — thin coverage, intent mismatch, poor structure — and knowing how to fix
* Structuring content so it is easily interpreted, extracted, and surfaced by search engines and AI systems
* Staying detail-oriented under competing priorities — you're thorough in execution and know when to escalate versus when to move forward
* Spotting patterns in data and turning them into clear, actionable recommendations
* Adapting quickly in a global, fast-paced environment where priorities can shift

For this role, you will generally be expected to work from a BCG office or in person with clients on a regular basis (typically around 50% of working time), depending on business needs and in line with local policies and practices.
  
  
We aim to provide a dynamic and collaborative environment that fosters connection and teamwork.
  
  
Boston Consulting Group is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
Cura Ayurvedic & Unani Limited · Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh · On-site · Full-time

WHY THIS SEAT EXISTS

Cura is a twenty six year old wellness manufacturer that sold through trade for most of its life and is now building direct-to-consumer properly, our own store, the marketplaces, and a growing content and PR footprint behind them.

Paid acquisition has never had an owner here. Nobody currently owns what a customer costs us, or what that customer is worth after the first order. This seat owns both, and builds the measurement that makes either number trustworthy.

WHAT YOU'LL OWN

* Every rupee of paid media Cura spends. Meta, Google, YouTube, and marketplace advertising on Amazon and Flipkart, held as one view of acquisition cost rather than as separate platform reports.
* The creative testing pipeline. Not requesting ad creative and waiting. Deciding what hypothesis each piece of creative exists to test, briefing our design and video team against it, and judging what won and why.
* Lifecycle and retention. Email, CRM, and the journey from first order to repeat order. In supplements that is where the economics actually live, and it is currently nobody's job.
* The measurement framework. GA4, attribution, and one honest view of what paid is producing — including closing the tracking gaps rather than reporting around them.
* The monthly performance picture. One report to the CMO that someone outside marketing could read, with a recommendation on where the next rupee should go attached to it.

WHAT THIS ROLE IS NOT

* Not media buying alone. We are not looking for someone to execute a plan that someone else wrote. The strategy is part of the seat.
* Not organic search. Our SEO seat owns technical search, keyword architecture and answer-engine visibility.
* Not social content or community. Our social seat owns the calendar, the channels and the conversations. You own paid distribution, not the organic feed.
* Not store or catalogue operations. Our E-commerce Manager owns listings, inventory, pricing and fulfilment. Marketplace advertising sits with you; the listings underneath it sit with her, and the two of you agree the handover.
* Not creative production. We have a design and video team in-house. You brief them and you judge the output; you are not the one making it.

WHAT GOOD LOOKS LIKE BY DAY 90

* A measurement baseline everyone trusts — tracking gaps closed, attribution agreed, and a single dashboard the CMO reads without needing it explained.
* A structured testing cadence running across creative and audience, with a written log rather than remembered results.
* A first honest read on acquisition cost by channel and by product, and a recommendation on where spend should move next.

WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Three things decide this hire.

1. You have owned a direct-to-consumer paid account end to end, not a slice of one. You set the account structure, you made the spend calls, and you were the person accountable for the number — not the person reporting into them.

2. You think in unit economics, not platform metrics. You know that the ROAS inside Ads Manager and the money in the bank are different numbers, and you work to the second one.

3. You can brief creative and judge it. Most performance marketers request creative and hope. The good ones decide what a creative is testing before it is made, and can say afterwards why one ad beat another.

Also useful:

• Four to seven years in performance marketing, with D2C or FMCG experience

• Hands-on across Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads; marketplace advertising a plus

• GA4 and attribution to a diagnostic standard, able to fix a tracking gap, not only report around it

• Email and CRM platform experience, on Klaviyo, WebEngage or similar

• Hindi and English both. A large share of our customers search, read and buy in Hindi

• Wellness, supplements or another regulated category is a plus, not a requirement

THE CATEGORY REALITY

Cura sells wellness products, and that is a regulated category in India. Ad copy, landing pages and creative all count as advertising in the regulatory sense, and there are claims we will not make at any price, no disease cure, no treatment promise, no time-bound result.

Some of the highest-performing angles in wellness are simply not available to us. When that happens the answer is to find a different angle, not a way around the rule. If that reads as a constraint you would want to work around, this is not the right seat. If it reads as an interesting problem, you will like it here.

HOW WE HIRE

* A first conversation with the CMO, the accounts you have owned, what you actually decided on them, and compensation discussed openly before we ask anything further of you.
* A working session on a real Cura problem, with the numbers in front of us. A conversation, not a test.
* A paid work sample for final candidates only: a thirty-day paid plan for one Cura product, with the testing structure and the measurement you would put behind it. Paid at a flat fee agreed before you begin (Hence, you will be compensated for the same)
* A final conversation with the CMO and the Executive Director.

Four stages, usually inside three weeks. We tell you where you stand after each one.

HOW TO APPLY

* Send your CV to hr@curaayurved.com with a short note naming one paid account you owned, roughly what it spent, and one decision you made on it that you would still defend today.

No cover letter. We would rather read the one decision.

* Fareportal partners with over 600 airlines, 1 million lodgings, and hundreds of car rental companies worldwide.

**Skills & Competencies**

title: Manager / Sr. Manager Strategy and Investor Relations
description:
**Client - One of the largest players in the CoWorking space**

This role is the engine room of the company's capital markets function. It prepares everything investors see, keeps track of who owns the stock and who we meet, supports management in every investor interaction, and gives leadership timely analysis on acquisitions and promoter shareholding matters.

**Key responsibilities**

1. Quarterly earnings cycle

* Build the quarterly earnings presentation: financial and operating KPIs, portfolio updates, guidance and narrative, in line with the house style.
* Draft the earnings call script for the founders and CFO, and prepare an anticipated Q&A pack with data-backed answers.
* Draft the quarterly shareholder letter in the founders' voice.
* Coordinate the timeline with Finance, the auditors and the Company Secretary so results, deck and filings go out on schedule.

2. Roadshows and investor conferences

* Plan and run deal and non-deal roadshows (domestic and international): target lists, broker coordination, meeting schedules, logistics and briefing notes.
* Manage participation in broker-hosted investor conferences, including 1x1 and group meeting requests.
* Attend investor meetings, take notes, track the questions raised and close out follow-ups.
* Feed recurring investor questions back into the deck, script and Q&A pack.

3. Investor presentation and materials

* Keep the corporate investor presentation current after every quarter and every material event.
* Prepare tailored versions for specific investors, conferences and strategic discussions.

4. Investor database and engagement tracking

* Maintain a database of current and prospective investors: institution, fund, contacts, holdings, investment style and meeting history.
* Use it to target new investors, prioritise meetings and report engagement to management.

5. Weekly BENPOS analysis

* Analyse the weekly beneficiary position (BENPOS) data from the RTA.
* Track changes in institutional, retail and promoter holdings; identify new entrants, exits and build-ups.
* Circulate a weekly shareholding movement note to management and link it to investor targeting.

6. M&A opportunity evaluation

* Screen and evaluate acquisition, merger and partnership opportunities in flexible workspace and adjacent sectors.
* Build financial models and valuations (DCF, comparables, precedent transactions) and run synergy analysis.
* Support due diligence with external advisors and prepare board and Audit Committee material, including related-party transaction requirements where relevant.

* Review press releases, stock exchange intimations, media statements, website content and investor-facing material for accuracy, consistency and SEBI LODR compliance.
* Make sure numbers and messaging match published financials and earlier disclosures.

title: Senior Account Manager
description:
**About Upriver Ecommerce**

Upriver Ecommerce Private Limited is a tech-enabled online channel management company that partners with brands and retailers to manage, scale, and accelerate their online businesses across brand websites and leading marketplaces such as Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, Big Basket, Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto, and other digital commerce platforms. Upriver was founded by experienced professionals from the retail and e-commerce industry who identified the need for a specialized partner capable of managing the online channel end-to-end. Our services cover the complete e-commerce journey, from strategy creation to execution, performance marketing, marketplace operations, analytics, and growth management. We act as the online business arm of our clients, taking complete ownership and accountability for their marketplace performance and growth.

**Position Summary**

Upriver Ecommerce is looking for an Account manager to own a portfolio of client accounts end-to-end across e-commerce marketplaces and quick commerce platforms. Hands-on experience on Amazon, Flipkart and other marketplaces is mandatory. This is a P&L-owning role: the candidate is accountable for each client’s revenue growth, profitability, account health, and advertising efficiency — not just operations or reporting. The role combines three disciplines in a single senior owner: marketplace account management (catalog, pricing, promotions, operations), performance marketing (ad strategy, ACoS/TACOS, scale with efficiency), and client reporting and coordination on a day-to-day level. The ideal candidate has 3-4 years of hands-on marketplace experience, preferably from an agency background managing multiple brands simultaneously, with a demonstrated record of scaling revenues while holding or improving advertising efficiency. Experience: 3-4 years in e-commerce marketplace management, with direct hands-on experience on Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra and other marketplaces. Experience with international marketplaces will be an added advantage.

**Preferred Background:**
Prior experience in an e-commerce agency, marketplace management agency, or similar client-servicing role

**CTC Offered:**
Based on experience and as per market standards

**Qualification:**
Graduate / Post Graduate / B.Tech / MBA

**Location:**
Gurgaon (5 days – in office)

**Reports to:**
Team Lead

**Team size:**
2-3 direct reportees

**Responsibilities:**

* Manage the account operationally, driving growth and profitability.
* Take complete P&L ownership of a portfolio of client accounts across marketplaces (Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio) and quick commerce (Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto) — accountable for revenue, profitability, and growth targets.
* Understand each client’s brand, category, competition, pricing, and business objectives from a holistic perspective, and develop and execute marketplace growth strategies covering visibility, conversion, and account health.
* Own performance marketing end-to-end: build advertising strategies across Amazon, Flipkart, and quick-commerce retail media; manage campaigns, keywords, bids, and budgets; scale revenues while maintaining or improving ACoS/TACOS.
* Manage end-to-end marketplace operations everyday: onboarding, cataloging, listing optimization, pricing, promotions, and inventory tracking.
* Work directly internal teams and with marketplace category managers and platform teams to resolve operational, listing, catalog, pricing, and account-level issues.
* Track daily, weekly, and monthly performance across the portfolio; identify growth opportunities and remove bottlenecks with corrective action plans.

* Coordinate with internal teams (content, design, catalog, operations, finance) to ensure smooth, on-time execution.

Experience with Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, Ajio, or similar platforms is expected. Exposure to international marketplaces and quick commerce (Blinkit, Swiggy Instamart, Zepto) is a plus.
* Demonstrated record of scaling marketplace revenues while holding or lowering ACoS.
* Strong analytical skills with good command of Microsoft Excel and performance reporting.
* Good verbal and written communication skills, with the maturity to engage senior client stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple client accounts and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive, ownership-driven, and solution-oriented approach; aggressive, action-oriented mindset with hunger for learning and growth.

title: Growth Business Manager- D2C
description:
**About Nory For You:**

Nory For You is a direct-to-consumer brand that sells through its own website, Nory.com. As the business grows, we are looking for a commercially minded professional to own the website as a business and drive profitable, sustainable growth across acquisition, conversion and retention.

**About the Role:**

The D2C Growth Business Manager will own and scale revenue from Nory.com. This is not a pure performance-marketing or website-operations role. You will own the complete website growth funnel, from traffic quality and conversion to average order value, CRM revenue, repeat purchase and overall profitability, working closely with the Performance Marketing Manager and the Creative Strategist.

**Core mandate:**
own Nory.com as a business and continuously identify what is limiting faster, profitable revenue growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Website revenue, growth targets and overall D2C business performance, with monthly and quarterly revenue plans and early flags on gaps.
* Contribution margin and profitable revenue, including the impact of discounts and offers.

**Funnel and Conversion**

* The full funnel: Traffic → PDP → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase.
* Conversion-rate optimisation across landing pages, PDPs, cart and checkout, with a structured, prioritised testing roadmap.

**Acquisition Economics**

* Traffic quality analysis by channel, campaign, product and customer segment.
* Guidance to the Performance Marketing Manager on where to scale, reduce or redirect spend, based on CAC, conversion and profitability.

**Average Order Value**

* Bundles, cross-sell, upsell, multi-packs and offer architecture that lift AOV without eroding margin.

**Retention and Lifecycle**

* Email and WhatsApp journeys: abandoned-cart recovery, reactivation, cross-sell and repeat purchase.
* Customer cohorts, repeat rate, LTV and CAC tracking.

**Insight, Collaboration and Reporting**

* Joint work with the Creative Strategist to identify the messages, customer problems and creative concepts that drive high-quality traffic and conversion.
* Weekly reporting on what changed, why it changed and what action should follow, backed by a prioritised experimentation roadmap.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Website revenue growth
* Contribution margin / profitable revenue
* Blended CAC
* Website, PDP-to-cart and checkout conversion
* Average Order Value
* CRM revenue and abandoned-cart recovery
* Repeat purchase rate and customer LTV

**What You Bring**

**Must Have**

* 4–8 years in D2C, e-commerce, digital commerce or growth, with experience owning website revenue or an e-commerce funnel.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset; able to separate vanity metrics from real business performance.
* Sound understanding of paid acquisition economics, even if you do not run campaigns yourself.
* Hands-on experience with CRO, funnel analysis, cohort analysis and experimentation.
* Good grounding in CRM, lifecycle marketing and retention.
* Working command of Shopify, GA4, Meta and Google advertising data, and e-commerce analytics.
* A structured, action-oriented approach: analyse, diagnose, prioritise, execute and measure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in consumer health, wellness, beauty or other education-led D2C businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and engagement tools (for example Klaviyo or WebEngage) and A/B testing tools.

**Why This Role**

* End-to-end ownership of a D2C website as a business, not a single channel.
* A clear, measurable mandate with direct impact on revenue and profitability.
* Close collaboration with performance marketing and creative strategy on a shared growth agenda.

fueled by the energy of collaboration and creativity coming together.

Spyne is expanding its business and exploring new opportunities to drive growth, build new revenue streams, and strengthen its position in the automotive retail ecosystem. We are looking for a high-agency generalist to work closely with the VP – Business and turn strategic priorities into executable business initiatives.

As a Program & Strategy Manager within the New Business team, you will operate at the intersection of strategy, business operations, analytics, and execution. You will identify opportunities, build business cases, structure programs, and drive cross-functional initiatives from concept to measurable outcomes.

This is a hands-on role for someone who can move seamlessly between a spreadsheet, a strategy discussion, a customer conversation, and an execution plan. You will be expected to bring structure to ambiguity, challenge assumptions with data, and take ownership of getting things done.

**What You'll Do**

* **Drive new business initiatives:**
  Identify and evaluate opportunities for new revenue streams, business models, partnerships, and market expansion. Translate promising ideas into structured business plans, pilots, and scalable initiatives.
* **Own strategic programs end to end:**

* **Build business cases and financial models:**
  Conduct market sizing, competitive analysis, pricing research, unit economics, and financial modelling to evaluate opportunities and support investment decisions.
* **Enable business growth:**
  Work with business leaders to identify growth levers, improve commercial effectiveness, evaluate customer segments, and develop strategies to improve revenue, margins, and retention.
* **Drive data-backed decision-making:**
  Build analytical frameworks, dashboards, and business reviews to track performance, identify gaps, and translate insights into actionable recommendations.
* **Explore partnerships and new markets:**
  Evaluate strategic partnerships, vendor opportunities, distribution models, and market-entry strategies that can accelerate business growth.
* **Build with AI and automation:**
  Use tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Cursor, and other AI-powered platforms to automate workflows, analyse data, prototype solutions, and improve execution speed.
* **Create executive-ready communication:**
  Develop strategy documents, business reviews, presentations, and decision memos that communicate complex problems and recommendations clearly to senior leadership.
* **Build scalable operating mechanisms:**
  Establish processes, governance frameworks, and performance metrics that improve execution discipline and help new initiatives scale efficiently.

**Who Will Do Well Here**

* **Experience:**
  3–6 years in management consulting (MBB or equivalent), corporate strategy, business operations, a high-growth startup, or a founder's/business office role.
* **Strong business acumen:**
  Ability to understand business models, identify growth opportunities, and connect strategic decisions to commercial outcomes.
* **Analytical rigour:**
  Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills, financial modelling, market research, and the ability to build and defend assumptions with data.
* **End-to-end ownership:**
  Demonstrated experience taking a project or initiative from problem definition through execution and measurable results, rather than stopping at recommendations.
* **Cross-functional leadership:**
  Ability to influence stakeholders across teams, manage competing priorities, and drive outcomes without relying solely on formal authority.
* **AI-first mindset:**
  Hands-on experience using AI tools to improve productivity, automate work, analyse information, or build functional prototypes.
* **Structured communication:**
  Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distil complex analysis into clear recommendations and actionable plans.
* **Comfort with ambiguity:**
  A proactive, resourceful approach to solving open-ended problems in a fast-moving environment.
* **Commercial orientation:**
  Ability to balance strategic thinking with practical considerations such as revenue potential, cost, feasibility, and time to impact.

**Why This Role?**

* **Build what's next:**
  Work on new business opportunities that can meaningfully shape Spyne's next phase of growth.
* **High-impact ownership:**
  Take responsibility for important business initiatives, with direct visibility into decisions and outcomes.
* **Work across the business:**
  Gain exposure to strategy, commercial operations, product, finance, partnerships, and market expansion.
* **Learn by executing:**
  Move beyond presentations and recommendations to build, launch, and scale real business initiatives.
* **Accelerate your growth:**
  Develop the strategic, analytical, and execution capabilities required to grow into business leadership, general management, or strategy and operations roles.

**If you enjoy solving ambiguous business problems, building structured plans from scratch, and turning ideas into measurable outcomes, this role offers the opportunity to help shape Spyne's next chapter of growth.**

This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, marketing technology and revenue operations. You'll work directly with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other senior stakeholders to understand the business challenges driving their need for technology, translate those challenges into executable game plans, and partner with our technology and delivery teams to bring those solutions to life.
  
  
This isn't a pure consulting or project management role. You'll need to understand how businesses operate, how their marketing and sales programs work, and how the right technology architecture and execution can drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, designing connected technology solutions and working closely with senior stakeholders, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Business Discovery & Consulting: Lead discovery conversations with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other stakeholders to understand business goals, GTM motions, operational challenges and the underlying problems driving technology requirements.
* Solution Strategy & Planning: Translate business challenges into clearly defined problem statements, solution approaches and executable game plans, working with Solution Architects and the technology execution team to define scope, priorities and implementation plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Solutions: Design and implement technology setups across Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience (CX), ensuring systems, workflows and data connect to support business objectives.
* ABM & Demand Generation Enablement: Understand how B2B companies plan and execute ABM and demand generation programs, and translate these requirements into scalable technology solutions, workflows and measurement frameworks.
* Technology Stack & Integration: Work hands-on with marketing and revenue technology platforms, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and ABM and intent platforms such as Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level, to enable integrated GTM execution.
* Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery, Customer Success and other internal teams to translate the agreed game plan into technical requirements, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations and manage expectations throughout solution design and delivery.
* Engagement Governance: Maintain visibility into project scope, timelines, dependencies and risks. Identify gaps early, resolve execution blockers and ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop discovery frameworks, solution playbooks and repeatable approaches that improve consulting quality, implementation efficiency and client outcomes.

****What success looks like****

* Senior stakeholders trust you to understand their business challenges and recommend solutions beyond simply implementing a tool.
* Business problems are translated into clear, technically feasible execution plans.
* Marketing, Sales and CX technology setups work together to support ABM, demand generation and broader revenue objectives.
* Solution Architects and delivery teams have the business context and requirements needed to execute effectively.
* Client engagements remain aligned with business outcomes, with measurable improvements in operational efficiency, GTM execution and revenue performance.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 5–8 years in MarTech, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, solutions consulting or technology implementation, ideally within a B2B SaaS, MarTech or consulting environment.
* Business Consulting: Experience conducting discovery with senior stakeholders, identifying root causes and translating business challenges into actionable solution plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of how B2B Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience teams operate, including their processes, data flows and technology requirements.
* ABM & Demand Generation: Practical understanding of B2B demand generation and ABM programs, including how technology enables targeting, campaign orchestration, engagement and performance measurement.
* Technology Implementation: Demonstrated experience implementing or architecting technology setups for Marketing, Sales and/or CX teams, including workflows, integrations, data structures and process automation.
* Platform Knowledge: Strong hands-on knowledge of HubSpot and familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level. Experience with multiple platforms across the MarTech and ABM ecosystem is a plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Confidence working with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and cross-functional teams, translating between business priorities and technical execution.
* Execution & Ownership: Ability to turn strategy into a practical implementation plan, manage competing priorities and stay accountable for outcomes.
* How you think: Curious about how businesses work, technically sound, commercially aware and comfortable navigating ambiguity without relying on a fixed playbook.

****Why join us****

* Solve real business problems: Work directly with senior leaders to address business challenges through technology and execution.
* Bridge strategy and implementation: Own the journey from discovery and solution planning to implementation alongside experienced technical teams.
* Work across the revenue ecosystem: Gain exposure to leading MarTech, CRM, ABM and AI platforms and complex B2B GTM environments.
* Join a top-tier ecosystem: As a HubSpot Elite Partner, we work with ambitious businesses and a strong technology ecosystem.
* Grow with the business: Be part of a growing team where ownership, problem-solving and impact create opportunities to take on more responsibility.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build and the outcomes you drive.

title: Media Manager
description:
**Minimum qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.
* 6 years of experience in growth, performance, direct response, social, digital, cloud, events and marketing.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* Bachelor's degree and 10 years of equivalent work experience.

* Experience utilizing AI productivity tools to solve complex, multi-layered problems and streamline business or development workflows.
* Ability to communicate in English fluently to support clients in the region.

**About The Job**
The Media Manager, India, role is part of the Media Lab team, the Global Media Center of Excellence for Google Marketing, that oversees Media strategy, planning, buying, measurement, optimizations, governance, innovation and AI for Google's own marketing efforts. Essentially, Media Lab aims to be an exceptional AI-powered marketing organization that drives growth for Google through effective and innovative media strategies and execution, with an emphasis on deeper AI integration, full-funnel marketing approaches, and optimizing the operational model with agency partners and in-housing initiatives.
  
  
As a Media Manager in India, you will be part of a team of Media professionals for Google India Marketing. You will provide media expertise to shape the future of a variety of key Google products. You will be the go-to media leader for all things related to advertising online and media within Google Marketing in India, managing multi-million dollar integrated advertising programs (across Brand and Performance).
  
  
You will closely partner with Product Marketing Managers and Media agencies to build campaign strategies, tactical media plans, measurement and optimization recommendations. You will act as the primary point of contact for media agency partners (online and offline) for your Google products, ensuring compliance with best practices and guidelines. This role involves oversight of Brand and Performance advertising done by Google, for selected Google products, in India, leveraging both Google’s own platforms and off-network properties. You will manage cross-functional stakeholders and advocate for compelling creative and rich media experiences across online and offline channels.
  
  
Know the user. Know the magic. Connect the two. At its core, marketing at Google starts with technology and ends with the user, bringing both together in unconventional ways. Our job is to demonstrate how Google's products solve the world's problems--from the everyday to the epic, from the mundane to the monumental. And we approach marketing in a way that only Google can--changing the game, redefining the medium, making the user the priority, and ultimately, letting the technology speak for itself.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Serve as the principal media authority for selected Google products in India, providing strategic oversight to Media agencies.
* Guide large-scale brand and performance programs, driving holistic campaign strategies and maintaining a robust, integrated test-and-learn agenda to maximize business impact and return on investment (ROI).
* Establish rigorous processes for managing complex media campaigns across social, on-network, and off-network channels to deliver a seamless, full-funnel consumer experience.
* Provide expert media leadership through competitive assessments and benchmarking, formulating authoritative points-of-view that push boundaries in integrated advertising and digital innovation.
* Lead external media agency partners to achieve operational excellence while collaborating on forward-thinking solutions that leverage the latest Media features and ad technologies.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status. We also consider qualified applicants regardless of criminal histories, consistent with legal requirements. See also Google's EEO Policy and EEO is the Law. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know by completing our Accommodations for Applicants form .

\* Number of customers attended and enquiries generated.

\* Quotations shared and follow-ups completed.

\* Orders confirmed and sales conversions achieved.

\* Pending enquiries and the next follow-up date.

\* High-value opportunities and customer feedback.

Leadership Profile:

  

Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.

Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.

  

**Learn & Grow**

Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an advantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.

  

**Foster a Culture of Care**

Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.

  

**Adapt and Thrive with Change**

Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.

  

**Achieve Results**

Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit and Collections
description:
As the Senior Analyst – Credit and Collections, you will be responsible for managing the accounts receivable for a portfolio of customers, including collecting payments, maintaining records, and evaluating credit information to minimize credit risk. You will be responsible for contacting customers to confirm outstanding payments, obtain payment commitments and recommending solutions to remove impediments for future customer payments within the agreed payment terms. You will also mentor others with lower-level positions in Financial Services.

**Responsibilities:**

* Reviews past due invoices and makes a high-volume of collection contacts via phone, e-mail, or customer portals.
* Works with the customer to determine root cause of dispute for unpaid or short-paid invoices. Identifies and documents detailed reason and recommends corrective action to resolve current and future disputes.
* Performs customer account reconciliations, including research of unapplied cash, and credits and unearned discounts. Recommends actions for resolution and avoidance of future reconciling issues.
* Evaluates collectability of unearned cash discounts, finance charges, small dollar invoices, etc. and performs write-offs of uncollectable amounts within their level of authority. Reviews and approves write-offs escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality.
* Obtains appropriate credit information to rate credit worthiness of new and existing accounts within assigned portfolio. Reviews and approves credit limits escalated from Analysts and further escalates with recommendations to next level of approval authority based on materiality.
* Works cross-functionally with sales, operations, finance, contract administration, and customer master administration teams to gather and review documents, including purchase orders, credit applications, and loads into contract tracking tool with recommendation of approval decision by financial services management and partners.
Reviews orders on credit hold by assessing credit worthiness of customers, including financial ratings, open invoices, in-process payments, and backlog. Releases orders or escalates to supervisor with recommendation for continued credit hold actions.  

**Qualifications:**

* Associates’ Degree (U.S.)/College Diploma (Canada) - Accounting, finance, supply chain or business required; Bachelors’ Degree preferred
* Licenses/Certificates/Designations - NACM or similar preferred
* 3 years of accounts receivable, accounting, finance, supply chain or general business
* 3 years of commercial, business to business, credit and collection experience in a high-volume environment
* 3 years of working with trade credit and other third parties (e.g., D&B, Experian, Equifax, NACM, CreditSafe) to obtain credit information
* Knowledge of computer system applications: HighRadius, Microsoft Office, including Outlook, Excel, and Word, and familiarity with an ERP platform (e.g., Oracle, DAX, AS400 etc.) required.
* High level of Excel knowledge preferred including pivot tables, vlookups, etc.
* Strong written, oral communication and interpersonal skills with a positive disposition.
* Reliable with strong organizational skills and solution-oriented philosophy.
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.
* Strong attention to detail with a passion for accuracy.
* Willingness to accommodate temporary working hour changes as required by workflow.
* Ability to prioritize tasks and demonstrate a willingness to accept new challenges.
* Ability to work with all levels of management to accomplish goals and objectives.
* Willingness to travel on a limited basis (1-3 trips per year)

title: CRM Executive
description:
usiness Development & Talent Acquisition

**Employment Type:** Full-time

Role Overview

We are looking for an entrepreneurial and performance-driven **360° Recruitment Consultant** to spearhead both client acquisition and end-to-end recruitment delivery. In this dual-impact role, you will identify and onboard corporate clients who need hiring solutions, while directly managing the complete talent search and selection lifecycle to fulfill those mandates.

Key Responsibilities1. Client Acquisition & Lead Generation (B2B Sales)

* Identify, research, and prospect potential B2B clients (startups, SMEs, and mid-to-large enterprises) looking for recruitment and staffing support.
* Execute multi-channel outreach campaigns via cold calling, cold emailing, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and networking.
* Manage, update, and track all leads, deals, and communication pipelines using CRM software (e.g., HubSpot, Zoho, Salesforce).
* Pitch recruitment service offerings, negotiate terms of business (service fee margins, replacement guarantees), and close Master Service Agreements (MSAs).
* Maintain ongoing client relationships to drive repeat business, account expansion, and referrals.

2. Full-Lifecycle Recruitment & Mandate Fulfillment

* Take detailed job briefings from clients to understand technical requirements, culture fit, compensation bands, and turnaround expectations.
* Source passive and active candidates across multiple channels (Naukri, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, internal databases, and direct headhunting).
* Screen CVs, conduct preliminary behavioural and technical assessments, and prepare candidate submission summaries.
* Coordinate client-candidate interview rounds, manage feedback loops, and resolve candidate hesitations.
* Lead salary negotiations, extend offers, and manage candidate engagement up to day-one joining to minimise dropouts.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* **Experience:** 2–5 years of proven experience in an agency, consultancy, or staffing firm handling both business development and candidate delivery (360° recruitment model).
* **CRM & ATS Expertise:** Hands-on experience working with CRM systems (HubSpot, Zoho CRM, etc.) and recruitment applicant tracking systems (Zoho Recruit, Ceipal, Bullhorn, or similar).
* **Sourcing Skills:** Expertise in Boolean search strings, Naukri portal operations, LinkedIn Recruiter, and headhunting techniques.
* **Commercial Acumen:** Strong understanding of staffing business metrics, recruitment margins, contract negotiations, and client management.
* **Communication:** Exceptional verbal and written English communication, presentation, and objection-handling skills.
* **Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, Human Resources, Marketing, or a related field.

Key Competencies

* B2B Lead Generation & Cold Outreach
* CRM Pipeline Management
* End-to-End Candidate Lifecycle Management
* Contract & Salary Negotiation
* Client Relationship & Stakeholder Management
* Time Management & Mandate Prioritisation

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary with an attractive, uncapped commission/incentive structure on both client acquisition and candidate placements.
* Fast-track career growth into lead/managerial roles.
* Collaborative and high-ownership work environment.

* Experience selling technical solutions in one or more of the following: Infrastructure Modernization, Application Modernization, Data Management, Data Analytics, Cloud AI, Networking, Migrations, Security.

* Experience building long-term technical strategies to uncover new workloads with customers.
* Experience migrating applications and services to cloud platforms.
* Experience with security concepts (e.g., encryption, identity management, access control, attack vectors, pen testing).

**About the job**
-----------------

The Google Cloud Platform team helps customers transform and build what's next for their business — all with technology built in the cloud. Our products are developed for security, reliability and scalability, running the full stack from infrastructure to applications to devices and hardware. Our teams are dedicated to helping our customers — developers, small and large businesses, educational institutions and government agencies — see the benefits of our technology come to life. As part of an entrepreneurial team in this rapidly growing business, you will play a key role in understanding the needs of our customers and help shape the future of businesses of all sizes use technology to connect with customers, employees and partners.

As a Platform Customer Engineer (CE), you will partner with technical Sales teams to differentiate Google Cloud to our customers. You will serve as the customer’s primary technical partner and trusted advisor, engaging in technical-led conversations to understand their business challenges. You will troubleshoot technical questions and roadblocks, engage in proofs-of-concepts and demos, and use your expertise to architect cross-pillar cloud solutions that solve these business challenges. You will drive the technical win and define the delivery and consumption plans. You will use your acumen and presentation skills to engage with technical and business leaders, and present practical and useful solutions on Google Cloud. You will have excellent technical, communication and organizational skills.  
  
You will focus on identifying, pursuing, and winning new business workloads and driving penetration within existing ones. You will have a breadth of technical expertise, spanning infrastructure modernization, application modernization, data analytics and more. You will blend sales expertise, market knowledge and direct technical engagement to prove the value of the Google Cloud portfolio.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

**Responsibilities**
--------------------

* Develop and own the technical account plan and strategy, participating in planning and supporting targeted sales motions.
* Combine sales, programming, and solutions architecture expertise to prove the value of Google Cloud Platform across the portfolio through complex demos, pilots and in-depth workshops.
* Architect cross-pillar solutions, drive technical wins, and define initial delivery plans for customers; continue to lead the technical engagement in the solution phase.
* Facilitate the post-sales transition by supporting pricing activities and transitioning the final delivery plan to implementation teams.
* Maintain awareness of progress against the delivery plan, providing support to cross-functional teams during ramp, delivery, migration or implementation phases.

A day in the life  
  
About the hiring group  
  
Job responsibilities  
  
Key job responsibilities

Build and nurture trusted relationships with top sellers across all organizational levels, serving as their primary advocate within Amazon while setting clear expectations and delivering proactive status communications.

Day-to-day responsibilities include managing ad platforms, monitoring campaign performance, analyzing key metrics, and implementing A/B tests to improve conversion rates and cost efficiency. The Performance Marketer will also stay updated on industry trends and platform updates to identify new growth opportunities.

* Develop performance marketing strategies based on business objectives and available budgets.
* Plan campaign structures, audience strategy, creatives, messaging, placements and budgets.

**Campaign Execution**

  .

* Run structured A/B tests and document learnings.
* Identify underperforming campaigns and take corrective action instead of simply increasing or decreasing budgets.

  **GA4, Google Tag Manager, Meta Pixel/Events Manager and UTM tracking**
  .

  .

  .
