title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly Organized: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**
FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**
Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
  
  
Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.
  
  
As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.

title: Regional Aftermarket Manager(Kolkata)
description:
**ROLE PURPOSE**
The Regional AM Manager leads customer support for injection moulding machines in the domestic market. The role is responsible for maintaining machine performance and uptime, delivering end-to-end customer support, strengthening customer relationships, and generating aftermarket business to achieve assigned service and sales revenue targets.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Support & Service Delivery**

* Lead the Customer Support Team for injection moulding machines in the domestic market.
* Provide end-to-end customer support covering machine installation, breakdown calls, technical troubleshooting, spare-parts support, operator training and processing-related issues.
* Ensure timely customer communication for machine installation activities and site-readiness requirements.
* Support customers with mould trials, both in-house and at customer sites, to enable machine shipment and successful commissioning.
* Visit customers regularly to maintain strong liaison, address service needs and support repeat business.

**Revenue, Collections & Aftermarket Growth**

* Plan and achieve territorial service revenue and aftermarket sales revenue targets in the domestic market.
* Generate aftermarket business through service opportunities, spare-parts requirements and customer support interventions.
* Coordinate and follow up for collection of outstanding payments related to spare parts.
* Identify customer requirements and service opportunities that can strengthen long-term aftermarket revenue.

**Technical Improvement & Product Feedback**

* Gather structured information on product performance and recurring machine issues.
* Develop and implement corrective and preventive actions for machine-related concerns, and support deployment of actions across applicable machines.
* Coordinate with internal departments to resolve recurring issues in existing machines and provide recommendations for modifications or customisation.
* Visit mould vendors as required for validation activities.

**Market Intelligence & Cross-functional Coordination**

* Conduct competitor analysis and share relevant insights to support future business and service strategy.
* Manage key international customers for product troubleshooting or support requirements, where assigned.
* Collaborate with service, sales, engineering, manufacturing and other internal teams to ensure timely resolution of customer concerns.

**Reporting & Governance**

* Prepare service data, management information reports and required operational records.
* Ensure accurate and timely data entry in the ERP system.
* Maintain visibility of customer issues, corrective actions, revenue opportunities and pending follow-ups.

**SUCCESS METRICS / KPIS**
**Revenue & Customer Outcomes**
**Service & Technical Delivery**
**Operational Discipline**

* Service revenue vs. target
* Aftermarket sales revenue vs. target
* Outstanding spare-parts payment collection
* Repeat customer and retention outcomes
* Machine uptime and breakdown resolution
* Installation and site-readiness effectiveness
* Closure of corrective / preventive actions
* Customer issue resolution and escalation closure
* Accuracy and timeliness of ERP / MIS data
* On-time reporting and follow-up closure
* Customer visit and coverage discipline
* Cross-functional action closure

**Key Skill Requirements**
**Skill Dimension**
**What We Are Looking For**
**Technical & Service**

* Strong knowledge of injection moulding machines, installation, troubleshooting and breakdown support
* Understanding of mould trials, processing issues, preventive actions and spare-parts support
* Ability to translate recurring field issues into practical technical improvement actions

**Commercial & Customer**

* Service revenue planning and aftermarket business development
* Customer relationship management, escalation handling and payment follow-up
* Ability to identify service-led sales opportunities and support repeat business

**Analytics & Governance**

* Competitor and product-performance analysis
* Proficiency in MIS reporting, ERP data entry and follow-up tracking
* Structured approach to corrective / preventive action governance

**Leadership & Behavioural**

* Team leadership and cross-functional coordination
* Customer-first mindset with ownership and urgency
* Strong communication, problem-solving and stakeholder-management skills

**Experience Profile**

* 15 years of relevant experience in service management, customer support or aftermarket operations for industrial equipment / capital goods.
* Bachelor of Engineering / Technology in Electronics & Instrumentation, Electrical or Mechanical Engineering; or Diploma in Electronics, Electrical & Communication, Mechanical or Mechatronics Engineering.
* Demonstrated experience in leading service teams, managing customer escalations and delivering revenue targets.
* Experience in injection moulding machinery, machine installation, troubleshooting, mould trials and aftermarket support is preferred.
* Working knowledge of ERP systems, MIS reporting and cross-functional service governance.

Drive sales of medical equipment and rental solutions to large corporate hospitals, ensuring revenue growth, customer satisfaction, and compliance with regulatory and quality standards .

**Job description**
-------------------

Requisition ID: 1744385

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

  

**EY-Consulting - Data and Analytics -Consultant — Collibra Data Intelligence Platform-GIG**

EY's Consulting Services is a unique, industry-focused business unit that provides a broad range of integrated services that leverage deep industry experience with strong functional and technical capabilities and product knowledge. EY’s financial services practice provides integrated Consulting services to financial institutions and other capital markets participants, including commercial banks, retail banks, investment banks, broker-dealers & asset management firms, and insurance firms from leading Fortune 500 Companies. Within EY’s Consulting Practice, Data and Analytics team solves big, complex issues and capitalize on opportunities to deliver better working outcomes that help expand and safeguard the businesses, now and in the future. This way we help create a compelling business case for embedding the right analytical practice at the heart of client’s decision-making.

  

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

We are looking for an experienced Data Governance Consultant with deep, hands-on expertise in the **Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** to lead the design, implementation and adoption of data governance capabilities across the enterprise. You will work directly with data owners, stewards, architects and business stakeholders to translate governance policy into a working Collibra implementation — operating model, metadata, lineage, workflows and data quality — and make it something the business actually uses.

This is a hands-on delivery role with strong client and stakeholder exposure. You will be equally comfortable configuring the platform and standing in front of a steering committee explaining why it matters.

  

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead end-to-end implementation and configuration of the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform, including operating model design, communities, domains, asset types, relations, complex attributes and scopes.
* Design and build **Collibra workflows** (BPMN / Groovy) for data steward approvals, issue management, access requests and onboarding processes.
* Configure and manage the **Collibra Data Catalog**, business glossary, reference data and policy management modules.
* Implement technical and business lineage using **Collibra Lineage Harvester, Edge** and custom lineage ingestion.
* Integrate Collibra with enterprise source systems, data platforms and BI tools using the Collibra REST APIs, Edge connectors, Catalog connectors and JDBC ingestion.
* Define and operationalise data governance frameworks: roles and responsibilities, stewardship models, data ownership, policies and standards.
* Establish metadata ingestion pipelines and automate bulk metadata onboarding via APIs and import templates.
* Define and track data quality rules, KPIs and dashboards; support remediation of data quality issues with the relevant data owners.
* Support platform administration: user and group management, roles and permissions, environment promotion and release management.
* Run workshops, training and enablement sessions for stewards and business users to drive platform adoption.
* Produce solution design documents, configuration guides, runbooks and handover documentation.
* Provide advisory input on governance roadmap, maturity assessments and best practice to senior stakeholders.

  

**REQUIRED SKILLS & EXPERIENCE**

* **8+ years** of overall experience in data management, data governance or enterprise data platforms.
* **Proven, hands-on proficiency with the Collibra Data Intelligence Platform** — not just usage, but design and configuration across multiple implementations.
* Strong command of the Collibra operating model: asset types, domains, communities, attributes, relations, hierarchies and validation rules.
* Practical experience building and troubleshooting Collibra workflows (BPMN, Groovy scripting).
* Experience with Collibra Catalog, Business Glossary, Data Lineage, Data Helpdesk and Policy Manager.
* Working knowledge of Collibra Edge, Lineage Harvester and connector-based metadata ingestion.
* Solid experience with the Collibra REST API for automation, bulk operations and system integration.
* Strong SQL and a good understanding of data modelling, metadata management and data architecture concepts.
* Familiarity with data governance frameworks, data privacy and regulatory drivers (e.g. GDPR, BCBS 239, CCPA).
* Excellent stakeholder management, facilitation and written communication skills — able to work with both engineering teams and business leadership.
* Linux skills to manage the on-premise server components

  

**DESIRABLE SKILLS**

* **Collibra Data Quality (DQ)** — rule authoring, DQ job configuration, scorecards, and integration of DQ results back into the Collibra Data Catalog.
* **Python** — for API automation, metadata ingestion scripts and data quality validation.
* **Git** — version control for workflow artefacts, scripts and configuration-as-code; familiarity with branching strategies and CI/CD pipelines.
* **Snowflake** — cataloguing and lineage from Snowflake
* Exposure to cloud platforms (Azure) and modern data stack tooling (dbt, Airflow, Azure Data Factory, Databricks).
* Experience with other governance or DQ tools (Informatica, Alation, Ataccama, Great Expectations) for comparative context.
* API Development with Spring Boot
* Consulting background with experience running client-facing engagements and pre-sales support.

  

**QUALIFICATIONS & CERTIFICATIONS**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering or a related field.
* **Collibra Ranger / Collibra Expert certification** strongly preferred (e.g. Collibra Certified Ranger, Data Steward, or Workflow Developer).

Certifications in Snowflake, cloud platforms or DAMA CDMP are an advantage.

  

**What working at EY offers**

At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.

You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

  

**EY | Building a better working world**

  

EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.

Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.

Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

Nail Story is looking for vibrant, organized, and customer-centric **Studio Managers** to lead day-to-day operations across our prime Kolkata branches.

As a Studio Manager, you will oversee boutique salon operations, manage a team of talented nail technicians and front-desk executives, drive retail and service sales, ensure impeccable hygiene standards, and deliver an elevated luxury experience to our clientele.

Key Responsibilities1. Daily Operations & Studio Management

* Oversee the end-to-end daily opening and closing procedures of the assigned studio.
* Monitor appointment books, walk-in allocations, and technician assignments to maximize chair utilization and minimize wait times.
* Maintain salon aesthetics, ambient lighting, music, and pristine hygiene/sanitization standards in compliance with brand guidelines.
* Handle petty cash, daily billing reconciliation, point-of-sale (POS) systems, and end-of-day revenue reporting.

2. Team Leadership & People Management

* Create weekly rosters, manage shift schedules, and approve leave requests without disrupting salon operations.

* Act as the primary brand ambassador on the floor, greeting high-profile clients and ensuring warm hospitality.
* Efficiently handle customer feedback, service adjustments, complaints, or escalations with tact and professionalism.
* Drive customer retention programs, membership packages, and repeat appointments via phone or WhatsApp follow-ups.

4. Inventory & Stock Control

* Supervise weekly and monthly stock audits for all consumables (gels, acrylics, polishes, tools, sanitizers) and retail merchandise.
* Raise timely purchase orders to avoid stock-outs during peak seasons and festival periods.
* Monitor product usage per service to minimize pilferage, leakage, or wastage.

5. Sales & Business Growth

* Meet and exceed monthly revenue targets for nail services, extensions, nail art, and retail aftercare products.
* Work closely with marketing to promote location-specific campaigns, seasonal discounts, and festival/bridal packages.

* Strong leadership, conflict resolution, and people management skills.
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills in English, Hindi, and Bengali.
* Working knowledge of POS software, salon scheduling tools, MS Excel, and digital payment systems.
* Understanding of nail care services, hygiene protocols, and nail enhancement trends.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive monthly salary based on experience.
* Performance-based monthly incentives and service commission targets.
* Paid annual leave, festival bonuses, and employee discounts on salon services.

title: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, in the office · Monday to Saturday, Australian hours · ₹15 LPA plus bonus**

Applications close Sunday 1 November 2026.

**FROM PRIYANK, THE FOUNDER**

Before I became a broker, I worked for the lenders: Lending Manager at Bank of Melbourne and Commercial Credit Analyst at La Trobe Financial. I started Prevail Finance in 2017. Today I meet our clients and structure their loans. I need one person I can hand every deal to: someone who knows Australian credit inside out, still works files themselves, and wants to build the team that gets every loan to settlement without me chasing it.

**HOW A DEAL MOVES HERE**

1. I meet the client, set the strategy and structure, and hand the deal to you with my notes.
2. You assess it: documents, income, serviceability and lender policy. You write the credit proposal, with lender options and risks, and we workshop it together.
3. I confirm the recommendation with the client. All credit advice stays with me as the licence holder.
4. You and your team package the file, lodge it through ApplyOnline, and take it through valuation, conditions, approval and loan documents to settlement.
5. Your team keeps the client updated at every step.

**WHAT YOU’RE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

Above all, one result: every loan we write settles on time, with no errors. You will:

* assess and write up the complex files yourself: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, business and commercial loans
* check your team’s work before anything reaches a lender: documents, servicing inputs, and the identity, anti-money-laundering and responsible lending checks
* keep SalesTrekker current, so every file has an owner, a next step and a date
* work with lenders and their BDMs on policy, pricing, conditions and valuations
* train and lead the loans team, and help choose its next hire

You report to me, and to a General Manager once we appoint one.

**A DAY IN THE ROLE**

You start early, on Australian hours. First the pipeline: which files need you, which settlements are close, what’s at risk. Then your own files: a new deal from me to assess, a credit proposal to finish, a condition to clear. Through the day you review your team’s files before lodgement, call BDMs, and unblock whatever is stuck. Each week you run the pipeline review. You finish in the afternoon IST, with every client updated and tomorrow’s priorities set.

**WHY THE RIGHT PERSON WILL WANT THIS**

* Real deals, not volume: business owners buying premises, commercial property, construction and business purchases, from $400k to $10M+.
* You learn from me. I’ve assessed these loans at a bank and at a non-bank lender, and I still develop property myself.
* You’re our first credit leader. You set the standards everyone after you works to.
* Premium pay, published: ₹15 LPA plus bonus.
* Your authority is in writing from day one. By day 90 you run the pipeline and I’ve stopped chasing files.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 5+ years assessing or processing Australian loans for brokers or lenders, onshore or offshore, from application to settlement
* Experience with self-employed borrowers trading through companies and trusts: financials, tax returns, add-backs
* Current hands-on work: you still work files yourself, not only supervise
* Experience leading, training or checking other people’s work
* A degree in commerce, accounting, finance or banking
* Clear spoken and written English: you’ll talk to Australian lenders every day

Even better: commercial, business, construction or development loans. Mercury, Infynity, BrokerEngine or SalesTrekker.

Not for you if: you’ve only worked on US or UK mortgages, or you’ve moved into management and no longer work files yourself.

**WHERE AND WHEN**

Our Gandhinagar office. You live within about 30 km, or relocate before you start. Monday to Saturday, on Australian hours: an early start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email priyank@prevailfinance.com.au with your CV, current location and notice period, and a link to one video of up to five minutes answering:

1. An Australian loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, which you personally turned around: the lender, what was wrong, what you did, and what happened.
2. A time you held a colleague to a standard they weren’t meeting: what you said, and what happened next.
3. One thing in this ad you’d do differently, and why.

Record it on your phone, without a script. Send it as a Google Drive, unlisted YouTube or Loom link that anyone can open.

Subject line: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – your name

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Every applicant gets a reply. Shortlisted applicants have a 60-minute interview with me, then a working session on a real past file with every client detail removed. On appointment: a written role agreement, a police check, and a three-month window to show the role works, for both sides. Every application is assessed on the same standard, and nothing without a bearing on the work counts.

description:

Ahmedabad, Gujarat · Full-time, in-office (open to candidates across India willing to relocate)

**Reports to:**
Founder / Head of Trading

**Experience:**
5+ years in F&O dealing, broker RMS, or prop desk operations

**Compensation:**
Competitive, based on experience

**About the desk**

We're scaling our proprietary quant trading desk in Ahmedabad. Our traders are active in NSE F&O at high volume, and as we grow our in-house trading team, we need a dedicated manager to own daily operations, risk, and trader coordination - so the founder can focus on strategy and the wider business.

This is a dynamic, hands-on role at the operational core of the desk. You'll be the first point of contact for every trader and the person who keeps margin, risk, and broker records in order, every single day. We're looking for someone with the proven judgment to read a situation fast and act decisively in the best interest of the company - whether that's holding the line on risk, resolving a broker dispute, or making the call under live-market pressure.

**What you'll do**

*Margin & risk*

* Allocate daily margin across traders based on strategy, performance, and limits
* Monitor intraday margin utilisation, MTM, and loss limits — and act before limits are breached
* Track exposure and concentration across the desk, and flag risks early

*Desk operations*

* Run the daily sync-up call: previous day's P&L, open positions, and the plan for the day
* Reconcile daily with the broker: contract notes, ledger, margin statements, and obligations
* Raise and resolve broker discrepancies the same day, with a clear written trail
* Keep desk records, limits, and procedures documented and current

*Trader support & escalation*

* Be the first point of contact for trader queries, platform issues, and order problems
* Resolve routine issues directly; escalate to the founder by agreed rules (loss limits, margin shortfall, broker issues)
* Enforce trading discipline and desk policies consistently

*Reporting*

* Send an end-of-day desk summary: P&L by trader, margin use, and exceptions
* Prepare a weekly performance and risk review for the founder

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in NSE F&O dealing, broker RMS (Risk Management System), or prop desk operations
* Hands-on knowledge of F&O margining: SPAN + exposure margin, peak margin rules, MTM settlement
* Experience reconciling contract notes, ledgers, and margin statements with brokers
* Strong Excel skills (pivots, lookups, daily MIS)
* A proven track record of managing live situations with sound judgment and acting in the best interest of the desk and the business
* Calm, firm judgment under live-market pressure
* Clear communication with traders and senior management
* Willing to work full-time from our Ahmedabad office

**Nice to have**

* NISM Series VII (Securities Operations & Risk Management) and/or NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives)
* Python or SQL for automating reports and risk checks
* Experience with algo, quant, or high-frequency trading desks
* Prior experience managing or coordinating a team of traders or dealers
* Gujarati or Hindi, in addition to English

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a live, high-volume F&O desk from day one
* Direct work with the founder, with real influence on how the desk is run and scaled
* A small, fast team with no layers between decisions and action
* Competitive pay based on experience

**How to apply**

Apply directly on LinkedIn, or email your CV to “hr@guru99.com” with the subject "Trading Desk Manager - Ahmedabad". Tell us your current location, notice period, and a few lines on the largest desk or RMS book you've managed.

title: Tax Supervisor
description:
Position: Tax Supervisor

Location: Ahmedabad, Gujarat

* Bachelor’s degree is required, preferably in accounting or commerce.
* Hold an active CPA, EA or CA license. This is a client-facing tax role and the credential matters.
* High English proficiency required since you will communicate directly with U.S. clients and U.S. Podmates and leaders.

***Applicants Must***

* Hold an active CPA, EA or CA license. This is a client-facing tax role and the credential matters.
* Bring 3 to 5 years or more of complex tax return preparation in a public accounting environment, with real comfort across individual (1040) and business entity (1120S, 1065, 1120) tax returns.
* Prior experience to tax planning, tax advisory, notice resolution services is nice to have.
* Communicate clearly and confidently with clients, whether delivering a tax return, walking through a tax plan, or working a notice to resolution.
* Be comfortable with an advisory model built on annual engagements, planning, and consultation, rather than transactional, one-and-done compliance.
* Embrace AI for research, email smoothing and completeness, tax return preparation and review, and automation.
* Have strong business and rental property acumen including tax strategy beyond your garden-variety “max out your 401k” recommendation.
* Be willing to grow into review over time. You prepare first and review later, and that progression is part of the role.
* Stay current on federal and state tax developments without being asked. Intellectual curiosity must be in your DNA.
* Have at least a Bachelor’s degree, accounting preferred.

***Nice To Haves***

* Tax return signature authority, at least constructively.
* Business consulting or advisory experience beyond tax return preparation.
* Hands-on experience with Thomson Reuters UltraTax and SurePrep.
* Multi-state tax return experience including nexus and apportionment.

**Tax Supervisor Role Responsibilities**

You will work directly with other Tax Team Podmates and report to your Pod Leader, a Tax Manager or Partner. Your duties include WCG’s general Tax Team responsibilities plus, or as modified by, the following:

***Role-Specific Duties***

* Preparing complex individual (1040) and business entity (1120S, 1065, 1120) tax returns, starting at roughly 90% preparation and 10% review the first year and moving toward a 30% / 70% split as you gain reps.
* Delivering tax returns, tax plans, and payroll plans to clients, and signing tax returns on a per-client basis as directed by your Pod leader.
* Managing roughly 25 to 30 advisory engagements, plus another 25 to 50 tax-only engagements (TOEs) your first, and increasing to 100ish advisory and 150ish TOEs as you work towards being a Client Manager within the promoted role of Senior Tax Supervisor.
* Preparing tax plans and projections on a similar path, starting prep-heavy and evening out to a roughly 50/50 preparation and review split over time.
* Discussing tax strategies to reduce taxes and reviewing capitalization, participation and risk.
* Calculating salary and tax projections, entering shareholder payroll, and reviewing those numbers with clients.
* Resolving federal and state tax notices and other client issues.
* Researching complex or unusual tax questions, stress-testing with AI tools and drafting memos and conclusions.
* Handling the tax onboarding process for new clients and making sure the start is solid.
* Participating in prospect Discovery Meetings and other business development work alongside the Biz Dev team.

***General Tax Team Duties***

* Guiding WCG along the path of success.
* Promoting WCG culture and encouraging excellence and high team morale.
* Developing and implementing WCG goals, procedures, and policies in coordination with other Partners, Directors, Managers, and Podmates.
* Identifying improvement gaps and assisting with deploying corrective measures.
* Providing feedback, concerns, and recommendations to WCG leadership, including ideas that make the Tax service line better.
* Coordinating client-centric efforts across teams.
* Answering client phone calls and emails with professionalism and genuine care.
* Filing and organizing electronic documents and helping keep the workflow moving.
* Training and leading fellow Podmates as you gain experience.
* Other tasks related to tax, accounting, and consultation as requested.

Tax Supervisor responsibilities and duties will change from time to time depending on circumstances, your skill set, and the firm’s needs. They are reviewed, modified if necessary, and agreed to during Associate Reviews.

title: Social Media & Content Manager
description:
Social Media & Content Manager

Read everything carefully before apply.

**At Golden Circle**

We’re looking for someone who is smart, creative, organised, and knows how to get things done.

Someone who can come up with ideas, turn them into content, coordinate with clients, guide creatives, manage projects, and make sure things actually get delivered.

**You don't need an impressive CV. You need an impressive brain.**

We don't really care how many years of experience you have. If you're someone who understands content, thinks creatively, takes ownership, and learns fast, we'd love to meet you.

What will you be doing?

* **Managing social media:**
  Handle social media accounts, plan content calendars, manage posting schedules, and keep things consistent.
* **Thinking creatively:**
  Come up with content ideas, campaigns, reels, posts, and concepts that people actually want to see.
* **Giving creative direction:**
  Brief designers, video editors, and other creatives. Know what you want, explain it clearly, and help turn ideas into great output.
* **Coordinating with clients:**
  Understand client requirements, communicate updates, collect feedback, and keep everyone on the same page.
* **Managing projects:**
  Track deadlines, follow up with the team, handle multiple projects, and make sure nothing slips through the cracks.
* **Keeping up with trends:**
  Know what's happening on social media, what's worth trying, and what's just another trend nobody needs to follow.
* **Taking ownership:**
  Don't wait for someone to tell you every little thing. Think ahead, solve problems, and make things happen.

What we're looking for

* Someone smart, curious, and naturally creative.
* Someone who understands Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, and how content works.
* Someone who can think beyond likes and followers.
* Someone who can communicate clearly and manage people without creating chaos.
* Someone who can handle pressure, multiple deadlines, and changing priorities.
* Someone who is comfortable taking responsibility for their work.
* Someone who is willing to experiment, learn, make mistakes, and improve.

You don't have to know everything already. But you should be willing to figure things out.

A little reality check 👀

This isn't a job where you schedule a few posts, scroll Instagram, and call it a day.

Some days will be creative. Some will involve client calls, feedback, deadlines, and a lot of follow-ups. You'll need to switch between big-picture thinking and small details without losing your mind.

We expect you to take your work seriously, bring ideas to the table, and own your responsibilities.

**In return?**
You'll get creative freedom, real responsibility, exposure to different industries and brands, opportunities to learn new skills, and a chance to grow with the business. Secret words : I am the one.

Good ideas will be heard. Initiative will be appreciated. And if you're good at what you do, your growth won't be limited to your job title.

Who should apply?

A fresher with exceptional creative thinking? Apply.

Someone who's been freelancing and wants to do more? Apply.

Someone who understands content but doesn't have a fancy degree? Apply.

Someone who's tired of doing repetitive work and wants to take ownership? Definitely apply.

We care more about how you think, how you work, and what you're capable of becoming than what your CV says.

Think you're the right fit?

Don't send us a CV full of buzzwords and generic statements.

Tell us a little about yourself, show us how you think, and share something creative you've done — or an idea you'd love to execute.

Let's see if we can build something great together.

Bopal, Ahmedabad, Gujarat

💼
**Position:**
Full-time

💰
**Salary:**
Based on skills, potential, and fit

📩
**Apply at:**
ag@goldencircleindia.com

title: Trading Desk Manager - Prop Desk Operations & Risk
description:
**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat · Full-time, in-office (open to candidates across India willing to relocate)

**Reports to:**
Founder / Head of Trading

**Experience:**
5+ years in F&O dealing, broker RMS, or prop desk operations

**Compensation:**
Competitive, based on experience

**About the desk**

We're scaling our proprietary quant trading desk in Ahmedabad. Our traders are active in NSE F&O at high volume, and as we grow our in-house trading team, we need a dedicated manager to own daily operations, risk, and trader coordination - so the founder can focus on strategy and the wider business.

This is a dynamic, hands-on role at the operational core of the desk. You'll be the first point of contact for every trader and the person who keeps margin, risk, and broker records in order, every single day. We're looking for someone with the proven judgment to read a situation fast and act decisively in the best interest of the company - whether that's holding the line on risk, resolving a broker dispute, or making the call under live-market pressure.

**What you'll do**

*Margin & risk*

* Allocate daily margin across traders based on strategy, performance, and limits
* Monitor intraday margin utilisation, MTM, and loss limits — and act before limits are breached
* Track exposure and concentration across the desk, and flag risks early

*Desk operations*

* Run the daily sync-up call: previous day's P&L, open positions, and the plan for the day
* Reconcile daily with the broker: contract notes, ledger, margin statements, and obligations
* Raise and resolve broker discrepancies the same day, with a clear written trail
* Keep desk records, limits, and procedures documented and current

*Trader support & escalation*

* Be the first point of contact for trader queries, platform issues, and order problems
* Resolve routine issues directly; escalate to the founder by agreed rules (loss limits, margin shortfall, broker issues)
* Enforce trading discipline and desk policies consistently

*Reporting*

* Send an end-of-day desk summary: P&L by trader, margin use, and exceptions
* Prepare a weekly performance and risk review for the founder

**What you bring**

* 5+ years in NSE F&O dealing, broker RMS (Risk Management System), or prop desk operations
* Hands-on knowledge of F&O margining: SPAN + exposure margin, peak margin rules, MTM settlement
* Experience reconciling contract notes, ledgers, and margin statements with brokers
* Strong Excel skills (pivots, lookups, daily MIS)
* A proven track record of managing live situations with sound judgment and acting in the best interest of the desk and the business
* Calm, firm judgment under live-market pressure
* Clear communication with traders and senior management
* Willing to work full-time from our Ahmedabad office

**Nice to have**

* NISM Series VII (Securities Operations & Risk Management) and/or NISM Series VIII (Equity Derivatives)
* Python or SQL for automating reports and risk checks
* Experience with algo, quant, or high-frequency trading desks
* Prior experience managing or coordinating a team of traders or dealers
* Gujarati or Hindi, in addition to English

**What we offer**

* Ownership of a live, high-volume F&O desk from day one
* Direct work with the founder, with real influence on how the desk is run and scaled
* A small, fast team with no layers between decisions and action
* Competitive pay based on experience

**How to apply**

Apply directly on LinkedIn, or email your CV to “hr@guru99.com” with the subject "Trading Desk Manager - Ahmedabad". Tell us your current location, notice period, and a few lines on the largest desk or RMS book you've managed.

* Manage teams including, data entry operators, store personnel, and 3PL workforce across shifts.
* Monitor and improve KPIs such as stock control, service levels, and administrative lead times.
* Ensure safe storage practices and adherence to EHS standards within warehouse and stores.

\* Audit non-conformities

\* Process deviations

\* Repeated production defects

\* 5 Why Analysis

\* Fishbone / Ishikawa Analysis

\* Pareto Analysis

\* Risk Assessment

5. Customer Complaints & Quality Requirements

\* Prepare detailed root-cause analysis and CAPA reports for customers.

\* Factory housekeeping

\* Cleaning schedules

\* Waste management

\* Glass and brittle-plastic controls

\* Chemical controls

\* Foreign-body prevention

\* Material segregation

\* Storage practices

\* Employee movement and access controls

7. Risk Management

\* Identify quality, safety and contamination risks within manufacturing operations.

\* Maintain risk registers and mitigation plans.

\* Ensure preventive controls are established for critical processes.

8. Traceability & Product Recall Systems

\* Policies

\* Process Flow Charts

\* Quality Formats

\* Inspection Records

\* Quality standards

title: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – Australian Mortgages
description:
**Gandhinagar, Gujarat · Full time, in the office · Monday to Saturday, Australian hours · ₹15 LPA plus bonus**

Applications close Sunday 1 November 2026.

**FROM PRIYANK, THE FOUNDER**

Before I became a broker, I worked for the lenders: Lending Manager at Bank of Melbourne and Commercial Credit Analyst at La Trobe Financial. I started Prevail Finance in 2017. Today I meet our clients and structure their loans. I need one person I can hand every deal to: someone who knows Australian credit inside out, still works files themselves, and wants to build the team that gets every loan to settlement without me chasing it.

**HOW A DEAL MOVES HERE**

1. I meet the client, set the strategy and structure, and hand the deal to you with my notes.
2. You assess it: documents, income, serviceability and lender policy. You write the credit proposal, with lender options and risks, and we workshop it together.
3. I confirm the recommendation with the client. All credit advice stays with me as the licence holder.
4. You and your team package the file, lodge it through ApplyOnline, and take it through valuation, conditions, approval and loan documents to settlement.
5. Your team keeps the client updated at every step.

**WHAT YOU’RE RESPONSIBLE FOR**

Above all, one result: every loan we write settles on time, with no errors. You will:

* assess and write up the complex files yourself: self-employed, company and trust borrowers, business and commercial loans
* check your team’s work before anything reaches a lender: documents, servicing inputs, and the identity, anti-money-laundering and responsible lending checks
* keep SalesTrekker current, so every file has an owner, a next step and a date
* work with lenders and their BDMs on policy, pricing, conditions and valuations
* train and lead the loans team, and help choose its next hire

You report to me, and to a General Manager once we appoint one.

**A DAY IN THE ROLE**

You start early, on Australian hours. First the pipeline: which files need you, which settlements are close, what’s at risk. Then your own files: a new deal from me to assess, a credit proposal to finish, a condition to clear. Through the day you review your team’s files before lodgement, call BDMs, and unblock whatever is stuck. Each week you run the pipeline review. You finish in the afternoon IST, with every client updated and tomorrow’s priorities set.

**WHY THE RIGHT PERSON WILL WANT THIS**

* Real deals, not volume: business owners buying premises, commercial property, construction and business purchases, from $400k to $10M+.
* You learn from me. I’ve assessed these loans at a bank and at a non-bank lender, and I still develop property myself.
* You’re our first credit leader. You set the standards everyone after you works to.
* Premium pay, published: ₹15 LPA plus bonus.
* Your authority is in writing from day one. By day 90 you run the pipeline and I’ve stopped chasing files.

**YOU MUST HAVE**

* 5+ years assessing or processing Australian loans for brokers or lenders, onshore or offshore, from application to settlement
* Experience with self-employed borrowers trading through companies and trusts: financials, tax returns, add-backs
* Current hands-on work: you still work files yourself, not only supervise
* Experience leading, training or checking other people’s work
* A degree in commerce, accounting, finance or banking
* Clear spoken and written English: you’ll talk to Australian lenders every day

Even better: commercial, business, construction or development loans. Mercury, Infynity, BrokerEngine or SalesTrekker.

Not for you if: you’ve only worked on US or UK mortgages, or you’ve moved into management and no longer work files yourself.

**WHERE AND WHEN**

Our Gandhinagar office. You live within about 30 km, or relocate before you start. Monday to Saturday, on Australian hours: an early start and an afternoon finish, IST.

**HOW TO APPLY**

Apply on LinkedIn, then email priyank@prevailfinance.com.au with your CV, current location and notice period, and a link to one video of up to five minutes answering:

1. An Australian loan file that was stuck or at risk of missing settlement, which you personally turned around: the lender, what was wrong, what you did, and what happened.
2. A time you held a colleague to a standard they weren’t meeting: what you said, and what happened next.
3. One thing in this ad you’d do differently, and why.

Record it on your phone, without a script. Send it as a Google Drive, unlisted YouTube or Loom link that anyone can open.

Subject line: Senior Credit Analyst & Team Lead – your name

**WHAT HAPPENS NEXT**

Every applicant gets a reply. Shortlisted applicants have a 60-minute interview with me, then a working session on a real past file with every client detail removed. On appointment: a written role agreement, a police check, and a three-month window to show the role works, for both sides. Every application is assessed on the same standard, and nothing without a bearing on the work counts.

title: Chief Manager Safety
description:
**Job Description**

Anup Engineering Limited

Safety Lead

Odhav, Ahmedabad

15+ Years

**Industry:**
Heavy Engineering / Fabrication / Process Equipment Manufacturing

**Job Summary**

We are looking for an experienced Safety Lead to oversee health, safety, and environmental (HSE) activities at our manufacturing facility. The role involves ensuring statutory compliance, implementing safety procedures, managing workplace hazards, conducting audits and training, and promoting a strong safety culture across fabrication and manufacturing operations.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. HSE Legal & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with applicable health, safety, environmental, and statutory regulations.
* Liaise with the Pollution Control Board and other relevant government authorities.
* Coordinate internal and external safety audits, including ISO 45001/OHSAS 18001 and ISO 14001 requirements.

**2. Hazard Identification & Risk Management**

* Conduct hazard analysis, Job Safety Analysis (JSA), and risk assessments for manufacturing and fabrication activities.
* Identify unsafe conditions and practices through regular workplace inspections and recommend corrective actions.
* Investigate accidents, incidents, and near misses, maintain records, and implement preventive measures.
* Develop and implement safety procedures to mitigate risks associated with fabrication and heavy engineering operations.

**3. Workplace Safety & Permit Management**

* Implement and monitor the Permit-to-Work (PTW) system for hot work, work at height, lifting operations, excavation, and confined-space activities.
* Inspect PPE, lifting tools and tackles, scaffolding, electrical equipment, and other safety-critical equipment.
* Ensure the availability and proper use of PPE, first-aid facilities, fire protection equipment, and emergency response systems.
* Monitor safe working practices across shop-floor manufacturing, fabrication, and material-handling operations.

**4. Training & Safety Awareness**

* Conduct EHS induction training, toolbox talks, mock drills, and regular safety awareness programmes.
* Organize safety campaigns and events such as National Safety Day, Fire Service Day, and World Environment Day.
* Drive employee participation in safety initiatives, including near-miss reporting and other safety improvement programmes.

**5. Reporting & Safety Governance**

* Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly safety observation reports, accident statistics, and compliance reports.
* Conduct monthly safety committee meetings and track corrective and preventive actions.
* Monitor safety performance indicators and recommend improvements to reduce workplace incidents.

**6. Client Coordination & Communication**

* Coordinate with clients, auditors, contractors, and statutory authorities on safety-related matters.
* Prepare and deliver safety presentations, audit reports, and compliance updates.
* Communicate safety requirements effectively to employees, contractors, and management.

**Required Qualifications**

* Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Mechanical or a related discipline.
* Professional qualification in Industrial Safety, such as PDIS/ADIS, as applicable to statutory requirements.

**Required Experience & Skills**

* 15+ years of experience in HSE/Safety, preferably in heavy engineering, pressure vessel manufacturing, fabrication, or process equipment industries.
* Strong understanding of fabrication processes and associated workplace hazards.
* Hands-on experience in risk assessment, accident investigation, PTW systems, safety audits, and statutory compliance.
* Experience in managing shop-floor safety, contractor safety, and emergency preparedness.
* Strong client-handling, presentation, report-writing, and English communication skills.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

A proactive safety professional with strong leadership skills, the ability to influence shop-floor teams, and proven experience in implementing safety standards within a heavy engineering or fabrication manufacturing environment.

· **Reconciliation:** Perform regular reconciliation of customer accounts and resolve any discrepancies between customer accounts and company records.

title: Production Supervisor
description:
**1. Job Purpose**

To supervise day-to-day production activities and ensure that manufacturing targets are achieved in accordance with the production plan, quality standards, safety requirements, and operational procedures. The Production Supervisor is responsible for effective manpower utilization, machine performance, material control, product quality, and timely completion of production activities.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

* Production Planning and Execution

Execute daily production plans as per the approved schedule.

Achieve daily, shift-wise, and monthly production targets.

Monitor production activities and ensure smooth operation of production lines.

Ensure optimum utilization of manpower, machinery, and raw materials.

Coordinate with the Production Manager to resolve production-related issues.

Ensure proper shift handover and communicate pending activities to the next shift.

* Manpower Management

Allocate work to operators, helpers, and other production staff according to the production plan.

Monitor employee attendance, punctuality, discipline, and productivity.

Provide on-the-job training to production employees.

Ensure that employees follow work instructions, standard operating procedures, and safety practices.

Motivate team members and maintain a productive working environment.

* Quality Control

Ensure that products are manufactured according to approved specifications and quality standards.

Conduct routine in-process quality checks in coordination with the Quality Control team.

Monitor critical process parameters and ensure adherence to operating standards.

Identify and report product defects, process deviations, and quality issues.

Ensure proper segregation and identification of rejected, reworked, and approved materials.

Maintain batch traceability and production records.

* Machine and Equipment Monitoring

Ensure that production machines and equipment are operated correctly.

Monitor machine performance and report breakdowns to the Maintenance team.

Coordinate preventive maintenance activities with the Maintenance department.

Ensure proper cleaning, inspection, and housekeeping of production equipment.

Minimize machine downtime and production losses.

Ensure that only authorized and trained personnel operate machinery.

* Material Management

Ensure the availability of raw materials, packaging materials, and other consumables before production starts.

Verify material identification and quantities against production requirements.

Monitor material consumption and minimize wastage.

Ensure proper handling, storage, and identification of materials.

Follow FIFO/FEFO practices, where applicable. Report material shortages, damages, and inventory discrepancies to the concerned departments.

* Safety, Hygiene, and Housekeeping

Ensure compliance with workplace safety procedures and personal protective equipment requirements.

Maintain cleanliness and hygiene in the production area.

Implement 5S practices and maintain good housekeeping standards.

Ensure adherence to Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP), where applicable.

Report unsafe conditions, near misses, and workplace incidents promptly.

Ensure proper waste segregation and disposal.

* Documentation and Reporting

Maintain daily production reports and shift-wise production records.

Record actual production, downtime, rejection, rework, and material consumption.

Maintain batch manufacturing records and equipment checklists, as applicable.

Report production deviations and corrective actions to the Production Manager.

Ensure accurate and timely completion of production documentation.

* Coordination and Continuous Improvement

Coordinate with Quality, Maintenance, Stores, Warehouse, and Planning teams.

Glaring Labs is building a new commerce-linked financial product that helps large merchants drive committed customer spend and repeat purchases. We work with regulated banking and financial partners. We're pre-launch and hiring the person who will sign our first enterprise merchants.

• Existing CXO-level relationships at large Indian retailers or PSUs.

Good to Have

90 days 2 enterprise merchants at term-sheet stage

Competitive fixed pay, a significant performance variable, and ESOPs.

title: Social Media Lead
description:
**Social Media Lead**

**Location : Mumbai, MIDC Andheri**

**Exp: 12–14 Years**

**Finance is serious business. But does talking about it always have to be?**

We don’t think so.

At HDFC Securities, we’re building social media into a powerful engine for brand building, audience growth and customer acquisition across an entire family of investment brands and platforms.

We’re looking for someone who understands that every social platform needs a different strategy, every audience needs a different conversation, and great social media must deliver both brand impact and business outcomes.

**Not someone who simply manages social media. Someone who builds brands and drives growth through it.**

**What will you own?**

1. **Build brands, not social media pages:**
   Create distinct social identities, content properties and communities across the HDFC Securities family of investment brands.
2. **Make finance interesting. Really interesting:**
   Turn investing, markets and wealth creation into compelling, relatable conversations for diverse investor audiences.
3. **Different platforms. Different strategies:**
   Develop platform-specific strategies across Instagram, YouTube, LinkedIn, X, Reddit and emerging channels, tailored to their unique audiences, algorithms, content formats, consumption behaviours and distribution dynamics.
4. **Make organic social a brand-building powerhouse:**
   Drive organic reach and frequency as primary KPIs, building sustained brand visibility, audience engagement and communities through content, conversations and platform-native distribution.
5. **Make paid social work harder for the brand:**
   Lead awareness-first paid social strategies, with brand reach, frequency and visibility as core priorities, while driving measurable contributions to lead generation and customer acquisition. Think beyond traditional performance marketing.
6. **Build communities, not just followers:**
   Create original content IPs, creator collaborations, multilingual properties and culturally relevant conversations that strengthen brand affinity across India.
7. **Think like a marketer. Create like a storyteller:**
   Champion video-first content, reels, podcasts and creator-led formats that make financial brands relevant, engaging and memorable.
8. **Make AI a competitive advantage:**
   Leverage AI across content creation, creative production, social intelligence, audience insights, experimentation and workflow automation to improve speed, scale and effectiveness.
9. **Connect social to business outcomes:**
   Collaborate with internal sales, acquisition, revenue, PR, brand and content teams to integrate social into larger marketing and commercial priorities.
10. **Lead teams and reputation:**
    Build high-performing teams, manage agency partners, establish measurement frameworks and uphold brand credibility, governance and regulatory compliance.

**What will success look like?**

We believe social media should be accountable for both brand growth and business impact, with clear KPIs for each.

**Organic Social - Build Brand Presence & Audience Scale**

* **Reach:**
  Grow the number of unique audiences discovering and engaging with our brands organically.
* **Frequency:**
  Increase how consistently our brands appear in front of relevant audiences.
* **Audience & Community Growth:**
  Build engaged, relevant communities across platforms.
* **Engagement & Content Effectiveness:**
  Measure meaningful interactions, video consumption and content resonance.

**Paid Social - Amplify Awareness & Influence Acquisition**

* **Brand Reach & Frequency:**
  Maximise relevant audience exposure through awareness-led media investments.
* **Brand Awareness:**
  Strengthen brand visibility, recall and consideration across priority audience segments.
* **Lead Generation:**
  Generate qualified interest and leads through strategically amplified social campaigns.
* **Customer Acquisition Contribution:**
  Measure how paid social influences discovery, consideration and eventual acquisition, without treating it purely as a last-click performance channel.

**Who are we looking for?**

A marketer at heart. A storyteller by instinct. A strategist by experience. A leader by choice.

* **12–14 years of experience**
  , with a proven track record of building and scaling social-first brands, ideally across startups, consumer internet, fintech or digital-first businesses.
* Deep expertise in social platforms, algorithms, audience behaviour, organic distribution and paid social media strategy.
* Strong understanding of brand building, media planning, reach, frequency, awareness measurement and acquisition funnels.
* Proven experience developing differentiated channel strategies rather than replicating content across platforms.
* Hands-on proficiency with AI-powered content creation, marketing tools, social intelligence and automation.
* Strong cross-functional leadership experience, with the ability to connect brand, content, sales and acquisition priorities.

**Why join HDFC Securities?**

Because this isn’t about inheriting a social media calendar.

It’s an opportunity to build the social-led brand and growth ecosystem for one of India’s leading financial services institutions and its growing family of investment platforms.

You’ll shape how millions discover, engage with and ultimately choose our brands.

All while combining the credibility of HDFC Securities with the ambition and agility of a digital-first business.

**We’re not looking for someone who knows how to post.**

**We’re looking for someone who knows how to build brands, influence audiences and move business.**

Come build the next chapter of social media at HDFC Securities.

title: Social Media Manager
description:
Merchant Wealth is a financial education and mutual fund distribution business for Indian retail investors. We explain how investing works in plain language, without hype, tips or return promises, and we build long-term client relationships on that trust. Instagram and YouTube are our primary growth channels.

The Role

You will own the planning, creation and publishing of Merchant Wealth’s content on
**Instagram and YouTube**
, with one goal: grow a credible, engaged audience of retail investors who become clients.

This is not a generic social media job. Our audience reads closely and our industry is regulated. Good work here is accurate, clear and compliant, and also engaging.

Core Responsibilities

**Content planning and curation**

* Build and run a monthly content calendar for Instagram (Reels, carousels, Stories) and YouTube (long-form videos and Shorts)
* Turn market events, AMFI and SEBI updates and investor-education topics into content ideas
* Maintain a swipe file of high-performing formats and hooks in the Indian finance space

**Production and publishing**

* Write scripts, hooks, captions and on-screen text
* Edit Reels, Shorts and long-form videos (or coordinate with a freelance editor) and design carousels and thumbnails
* Publish and schedule consistently using our scheduling tools
* Keep all content on-brand in voice, visuals and tone

**Growth and community**

* Grow followers, watch time and inbound enquiries on both platforms
* Respond to comments and DMs within a defined turnaround time, and route genuine client enquiries to the founder
* Apply platform best practice: SEO for YouTube titles and descriptions, Instagram keyword and hashtag strategy, posting times and collaborations

**Analytics and reporting**

* Track reach, retention, saves, shares, profile visits and enquiries generated
* Send a short weekly and monthly performance report with what worked, what didn’t and what to change
* Run simple tests on hooks, thumbnails and formats

**Compliance (non-negotiable)**

* Follow SEBI and AMFI guidelines for distributors in every piece of content
* Include the ARN and the required disclaimers on every relevant asset
* Never publish scheme recommendations, buy/sell calls, return promises or personalised advice
* Get every post checked against our compliance checklist before it goes live

Requirements

**Must have**

* Strong written English; Hindi or Marathi is a plus
* Hands-on experience creating short-form video (Reels or Shorts) and basic video editing (CapCut, Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or similar)
* Working knowledge of Canva & other design/AI tools
* Understanding of how the Instagram and YouTube algorithms reward retention, saves and watch time
* Attention to detail: comfortable verifying every number before it is published

Having a public portfolio or a track record of growing your own or a client’s portfolio is an added advantage, but it is not mandatory.

**Good to have**

* Interest in or knowledge of personal finance, mutual funds or the Indian markets
* Experience with a finance, fintech or education brand
* Familiarity with YouTube Studio, Instagram Insights and a scheduling tool such as Metricool
* Comfort presenting on camera

**For the intern role:**
we care more about learning ability, curiosity and a strong portfolio than formal experience. Ongoing studies in commerce, finance, media or marketing are welcome.

What Success Looks Like (first 90 days)

* A fully planned, consistent posting schedule on both platforms
* Measurable improvement in average Reel reach and YouTube watch time
* A repeatable content workflow with zero compliance misses
* Weekly reporting running smoothly
* First enquiries traceable to social content

What You Get

* Direct mentorship from the founder, an AMFI-registered distributor working in the Indian capital markets
* Real ownership of two channels, not a support role
* Practical grounding in mutual funds, investor behaviour and compliant financial marketing

**Senior Manager — Performance Marketing**

**Purpose of the Role**
To deliver robust top-line growth and bottom-line margins through disciplined platform execution, targeted audience engagement, data-driven optimization and tight cross-functional coordination. You will treat your functional domain as a system to be architected, tested and scaled.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* First-Principles Growth & Execution
* Deconstruct complex performance funnels into measurable variables, managing full-funnel activation from new user acquisition to repeat engagement.
* Plan, execute and scale on-app propositions, digital marketing campaigns and sale event constructs end-to-end with absolute precision.
* Optimize live performance daily, utilizing conversion, traffic and margin signals to make real-time programmatic adjustments.
* New User Acquisition, App Installs & Product Sales
* Own end-to-end acquisition strategy across Google (Search, Shopping, PMax, YouTube, App campaigns), Meta (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns), Apple Search Ads and programmatic channels.
* Drive app install volume and quality — managing CPI, install-to-purchase conversion rates and post-install engagement metrics using Branch and internal measurement for attribution.
* Scale new-to-platform customer acquisition while maintaining or improving CAC targets; continuously optimize channel mix based on cost-per-retained-customer, not just cost-per-install.
* Build and manage audience strategies — lookalike models, custom audiences, interest-based targeting and broad prospecting. With structured testing to identify high-value acquisition segments.
* Identify and eliminate fraud, low-quality installs and attribution gaming across app install channels.
* Drive product-level sales performance through paid channels. Structuring campaigns around hero SKUs, new launches, category pushes and seasonal sale events.
* Own Shopping and catalog campaign architecture,product feed optimization, Merchant Center management, product set segmentation and dynamic product ad performance.
* Plan and execute media strategy for 10–15 major sale events per year (pre-sale, during-sale, post-sale), managing traffic spikes while protecting CPA and ROAS targets.
* Build performance frameworks that connect ad spend to actual product economics — contribution margin, ROAS adjusted for returns and true cost-per-profitable-order.
* Budget Management, Performance Analytics & Platform Health
* Make weekly budget allocation decisions across channels based on performance data. Reallocate aggressively from underperforming channels to high-efficiency opportunities.
* Set and track acquisition KPIs: CAC, CPI, Cost per First Purchase, D30 Repurchase Rate by acquisition channel, ROAS, contribution margin adjusted ROAS and new customer percentage.
* Present weekly and monthly performance reviews to leadership with clear diagnosis, not just reporting explain why metrics moved and what you're doing about it.
* Own end-to-end tracking of critical performance trends, identifying user cohort trends and operational gaps.
* Translate localized consumer and market analytics into actionable assortment, campaign targeting and activation decisions.
* Maintain strict focus on system stability, aggressively flagging and fixing operational gaps, pricing mismatches, or delivery supply risks.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Supply Operations
* Partner with the creative team to build a structured testing pipeline — brief creative assets, define testing hypotheses and measure creative impact on acquisition efficiency.
* Coordinate with product and analytics teams on conversion tracking, attribution setup and measurement infrastructure — own the accuracy of the data you're optimizing against.
* Collaborate with category and supply chain teams to align campaign intensity with inventory availability avoid promoting products that are out of stock or overpromoting SKUs that create downstream inventory problems.
* Collaborate with the category team on pricing, promotions and assortment decisions that affect campaign performance ensuring marketing investments align with margin targets, not just volume goals.
* Design and execute high velocity A/B tests or activation changes with statistical rigor, ensuring every modification is heavily data-backed.
* Manage a structured activation and marketing calendar that flows seamlessly alongside macro events and business priorities.

**Primary Metrics**
**What You'll Be Measured On**
Cost per First-Time Customer: What we pay to acquire a new buyer, tracked by channel
  
  
App Install Volume & Quality: Install count, install-to-purchase rate, post-install engagement
  
  
New Customer GMV Contribution:Revenue generated specifically by first-time buyers
  
  
Channel-Level ROAS: Return on ad spend adjusted for returns and product margins
  
  
D30 Repurchase Rate: Share of acquired customers who buy again within 30 days, by channel
  
  
**Secondary Metrics**
First-Order AOV by Channel: Average basket size of new customers from each acquisition source
  
  
New vs. Returning Customer Mix: Share of orders from first-timers vs. repeat buyers
  
  
Creative Testing Velocity: Number of creative hypotheses tested per week and win rate
  
  
Campaign Contribution Margin: Profit per order after ad cost, COGS and fulfillment
  
  
**What we won't measure you on:**
vanity install numbers without quality filters, platform-reported ROAS without backend validation or total order count without customer quality context.
  
  
**What We Are Looking For**
**Academic Pedigree**

* B.Tech./B.E. from an IIT or other Tier-1 engineering institute, or an equivalent degree with a strong quantitative and analytical focus.
* MBA from a Tier-1 business school is preferred but not mandatory.

**Experience & Competencies**

* 7+ years of professional experience in high-growth environments like e-commerce, quick commerce, consumer-tech or data/business analytics.
* The Engineer Mindset: Intensely logical and structured. You possess a natural curiosity to understand the "under-the-hood" mechanics of any platform, funnel, or user cohort.
* Hands-on expertise running Google Ads (Search, Shopping, PMax, App campaigns) and Meta Ads (Advantage+ Shopping, DPA, app install campaigns) at meaningful budgets.
* Proven experience driving app installs at scale while maintaining install-to-purchase conversion and post-install quality metrics.
* Strong understanding of product feed management, Merchant Center and catalog ad optimization for e-commerce.
* Technical Savvy: Highly proficient in Excel/Google Sheets with exposure to SQL, BI data visualization tools (Tableau/Looker), or automation workflows.
* Cross-Functional Fluency: Demonstrated comfort and maturity in driving cross-functional alignments with brand, supply chain and central product environments.
* Ownership You have the zeal to build robust processes from absolute zero and the execution resilience required to thrive in a high-velocity, concurrent work environment.
* Track record of managing sale events and promotional campaigns with measurable GMV impact.

**Preference**

* Experience in beauty, personal care, health, or FMCG categories — understanding of repurchase cycles, seasonal patterns and how beauty consumers discover and buy products online.
* Familiarity with incrementality testing — geo-holdouts, channel-off tests, or lift studies to measure true campaign impact.
* Experience with mobile attribution platforms (AppsFlyer, Branch, or Adjust) — setting up attribution, measuring post-install events and identifying fraud.
* Experience with AI-driven campaign tools (PMax, Advantage+, AI-generated creative) and a clear point of view on where automation helps and where it doesn't.

**Good to Have**

* Prior regional, hyperlocal, or category management experience within quick commerce, marketplace, or hyper-growth consumer apps.
* Familiarity with app CMS platforms, digital promotion engines, or inventory optimization systems.
* Experience with non-biddable channels — affiliate marketing, influencer performance campaigns, programmatic direct deals.
* Knowledge of CPAS (Collaborative Performance Advertising) or similar marketplace-brand collaborative ad products.
* SQL proficiency for pulling and analysing acquisition cohort data independently.
* Experience building or managing a small performance marketing team (2–5 members).

**About Company**
Founded in 2011, Purplle has emerged as one of India’s premier omnichannel beauty destinations, redefining the way millions shop for beauty. With 1,000+ brands, 60,000+ products, and over 7 million monthly active users, Purplle has built a powerhouse platform that seamlessly blends online and offline experiences.
  
  
Expanding its footprint in 2022, Purplle introduced 6,000+ offline touchpoints and launched 100+ stores, strengthening its presence beyond digital. Beyond hosting third-party brands, Purplle has successfully scaled its own D2C powerhouses—FACES CANADA, Good Vibes, Carmesi, Purplle, and NY Bae—offering trend-driven, high-quality beauty essentials.
  
  
What sets Purplle apart is its technology driven hyper-personalized shopping experience. By curating detailed user personas, enabling virtual makeup trials, and delivering tailored product recommendations based on personality, search intent, and purchase behavior, Purplle ensures a unique, customer-first approach.
  
  
In 2022, Purplle achieved unicorn status, becoming India’s 102nd unicorn, backed by an esteemed group of investors including ADIA, Kedaara, Premji Invest, Sequoia Capital India, JSW Ventures, Goldman Sachs, Verlinvest, Blume Ventures, and Paramark Ventures.
  
  
With a 3,000+ strong team and an unstoppable vision, Purplle is set to lead the charge in India’s booming beauty landscape, revolutionizing the way the nation experiences beauty.

title: Senior Content Marketing Specialist

Our customers rank among the who’s who in the Fortune 50. Coca-Cola, LinkedIn, Adobe, LVMH and Bayer are just a few of the 2,400+ global companies who rely on our best-in-class platform.

Our Winning Culture is the engine that drives our teams of innovators. We champion diversity of thought and ideas, we behave like leaders regardless of title, we are committed to achieving ambitious goals, and we love celebrating
our wins – big and small.

Supported by operating principles of being strategy-led, values-based and disciplined in execution, you’ll be inspired, connected, developed and rewarded here. Everything that makes you unique is welcome; join us and let’s build what’s next - together!

At Anaplan, we optimize enterprise decision-making through our leading AI-infused scenario planning and analysis platform. Acting as a trusted subject matter expert and strategic leader within Anaplan’s Integrated Business Applications organization, the
**Supply Chain, Strategy and Transformation Director**
sits at the Go To Market intersection of
**Product Management, Enablement, Sales, Professional Services, Customer Success, and Partners**
.

This role combines deep functional and process domain expertise (In Supply Chain and Manufacturing space) with technical application architecture, consultative selling, and ecosystem enablement. You will support Anaplan’s GTM Teams on all engagements that require your domain expertise, from initial demand generation programs to initial discovery and through to implementation, and expansion.

Preferred Location - Mumbai / Bangalore / Gurgaon.

**Key Responsibilities**

Partner seamlessly with Anaplan’s GTM Teams to ensure seamless integration of Supply Chain Enterprise Planning Applications into Anaplan’s GTM motion by:

* Contribute to the creation and delivery of scalable knowledge-sharing initiatives including compelling sales programs, executive presentations, ROI insights and customer success stories, and enablement assets (training materials, technical guides, evaluation frameworks) to empower internal teams and partners.
