Ensuring Supply Chain Applications presentations and demonstrations are clearly aligned with prospect and customer requirements. Support all stages of complex sales opportunities both onsite and remotely as a technical, process, and architectural expert. Act as ambassador to and advocate for application customers post-sale, driving expansion.
* Support our Platform, Application and AI Teams with application design and best practices, pre-market testing and early adopter customers. Capture structured feedback and translate field insights from customer, prospect, and partner engagements to Product Management to shape application roadmap priorities
* Support Anaplan, Analyst and Industry engagements and events as a key thought leader, including producing thought leadership content across diverse media. Contribute to market insights, whitepapers, top-of-mind and high-impact use cases for customer discovery and executive presentations.

Key Metrics

* Adoption and successful completion of enablement by GTM Teams.
* Number of presentations, demonstrations, and other supporting activities of your Domain Applications.
* Total revenue, deal volume, and pipeline value associated with or influenced by Domain Applications.
* Qualitative evaluations and ratings from our GTM Teams.

Qualifications

* **More than a decade of experience in Supply Chain Planning space**
* Demonstrable understanding of Anaplan’s platform and its applications to solve complex business challenges (Or similar EPM / Enterprise Planning / Supply & Demand Planning solutions in the market)
* **Deep domain knowledge of Supply & demand planning**
  , at strategic, operational and headcount levels, the market of Supply Chain focused - Enterprise performance management, planning and reporting solutions, required processes and best practices, and the key stakeholders and decision-makers.
* **Understanding of product management, enablement and GTM operations.**
* Proven experience in consultative selling or strategic advisory roles, preferably within SaaS or enterprise software, with the ability to ask the right questions, manage objections, and guide the sales journey from start to implementation and expansion.
* **Have background working in Manufacturing industry – preferable to have worked directly in a manufacturing company in the past before transitioning to SaaS or Enterprise Software organizations.**
* Excellent communication, facilitation, and knowledge-sharing skills, with a demonstrated exceptional ability in presenting compelling content, performing product demonstrations, leading workshops, and developing enablement programs.
* A results-driven mindset, able to collaborate across teams, with a focus on contributing deliverables of the highest possible quality and impact.

**Our Commitment to Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging (DEIB)**

We believe attracting and retaining the best talent and fostering an inclusive culture strengthens our business. Build your career in a place where diversity, equity, inclusion and belonging aren’t just words on paper – this is what drives our innovation, it’s how we connect, and it contributes to what makes us a market leader. title: Head of Marketing Strategy - Media & Entertainment
description:
Next Step HR is hiring a Head of Marketing Strategy for a
**leading digital entertainment and media company**
with a strong presence across
**original IPs, branded content, brand partnerships, OTT, series, production, distribution, music, and influencer-led content**
.

The organization operates at the intersection of
**entertainment, culture, creators, brands, and digital media**
, creating and commercialising content and entertainment properties across platforms.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We are looking for a
**Head of Marketing Strategy – Media & Entertainment**
to lead the
**strategic thinking and marketing architecture**
behind the organization's portfolio of content, entertainment properties, IPs, series, productions, and brand-led initiatives.

This is a
**strategy-first role**
. The person will be responsible for defining the
**positioning, audience, narrative, launch strategy, communication approach, channel strategy, and overall marketing direction**
for content and entertainment properties.

The role requires someone who can look at a content property from a
**360° perspective**
, understand its audience and commercial potential, and build a clear strategic roadmap for taking it to market.

The person will work closely with creative, content, production, business, sales, partnerships, and other teams to translate strategy into execution.
**Hands-on on-ground campaign implementation is not the primary responsibility of this role.**

**Location:**
Andheri, Mumbai

**Experience:**
8–15 years

**Industry:**
Media & Entertainment

**Function:**
Marketing Strategy / Content / Entertainment

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

* Lead the
  **overall marketing strategy**
  for upcoming content, IPs, series, productions, and entertainment properties.
* Develop the
  **go-to-market strategy**
  for content launches across OTT, digital, social, creator, influencer, PR, partnerships, and other relevant platforms.
* Define the
  **positioning, target audience, consumer proposition, key narrative, messaging, and communication territory**
  for each property.
* Build strategic frameworks for
  **pre-launch, launch, and post-launch**
  phases.
* Determine
  **how a property should be taken to market**
  , rather than managing the day-to-day execution of the campaign.
* Develop differentiated strategies based on
  **genre, format, audience, platform, content objective, commercial potential, and cultural relevance**
  .
* Identify the right
  **platforms, channels, creators, influencers, partnerships, communities, and cultural moments**
  to amplify a property.
* Develop marketing strategies for
  **original IPs, branded content, brand collaborations, OTT properties, music, influencer-led content, and entertainment formats**
  .
* Work closely with creative and content teams to translate strategic direction into
  **campaign concepts and communication territories**
  .
* Partner with sales and business teams to develop strategic narratives that strengthen
  **brand partnerships and commercial opportunities**
  .
* Analyse
  **audience behaviour, cultural trends, platform trends, content consumption patterns, and competitive activity**
  to inform marketing strategy.
* Develop strategic recommendations based on
  **content performance, audience insights, campaign data, and market trends**
  .
* Identify opportunities for
  **IP extensions, cross-platform opportunities, partnerships, audience expansion, and long-term franchise building**
  .
* Create clear
  **strategic briefs and direction**
  for internal teams, agencies, creative partners, and execution teams.
* Provide strategic oversight across multiple projects while ensuring that each property has a
  **clear and differentiated market proposition**
  .
* Stay ahead of developments across
  **digital entertainment, OTT, social media, creator economy, AI, emerging technologies, and evolving content consumption behaviour**
  .

**AI, TECHNOLOGY & NEW-AGE TOOLS**

* Demonstrate
  **flexibility and curiosity towards emerging technologies, AI tools, and new-age marketing platforms**
  .
* Stay updated with the latest
  **AI-powered tools, content technologies, research platforms, analytics tools, and marketing technologies**
  that can improve strategic thinking and efficiency.
* Ability to use or understand AI and technology-enabled tools for
  **research, audience insights, ideation, trend analysis, strategy development, content planning, and campaign optimisation**
  will be an advantage.
* The candidate should be
  **technology-savvy and adaptable**
  , with an openness to continuously experiment with new tools and ways of working.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **8–15 years of experience**
  in marketing strategy, brand strategy, content strategy, entertainment marketing, digital media, advertising, or a related field.
* Strong experience within the
  **Media & Entertainment, Digital Media, OTT, Content, Advertising, or Creator Economy**
  ecosystem.
* Proven experience in developing
  **marketing and go-to-market strategies for content, IPs, shows, entertainment properties, or brands**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **digital audiences, OTT, social media, creators, influencers, entertainment, and content ecosystems**
  .
* Exceptional
  **strategic and conceptual thinking**
  with the ability to see the larger picture and build a clear roadmap.
* Ability to translate creative ideas and content propositions into
  **strong audience and marketing strategies**
  .
* Strong understanding of
  **Indian pop culture, entertainment trends, digital consumption, and emerging audience behaviours**
  .
* Experience working with senior stakeholders across
  **creative, content, production, sales, partnerships, and business functions**
  .
* Strong presentation, communication, storytelling, and stakeholder management skills.
* Comfortable working in a
  **fast-paced, highly creative and constantly evolving environment**
  .
* A
  **future-facing mindset**
  with strong curiosity around AI, technology, emerging platforms, and new approaches to marketing.

**IDEAL CANDIDATE**

We are looking for a
**strategic thinker first and a marketer second**
—someone who can look beyond individual campaigns and understand the larger opportunity around a piece of content, an IP, a creator, a brand partnership, or an entertainment property.

title: Marketplace Ecosystem Manager
description:
**Marketplace Ecosystem Manager**

Business Development & Strategic Partnerships

* Manage partner ecosystem in India's wellness, travel, and nutrition sectors.
* Source, vet, and onboard partners for ARC OS marketplace.
* Negotiate commercial terms and ensure partner compliance.
* Develop B2B2C and B2B partnerships for revenue growth.
* Build and lead a partnerships team as the marketplace scales.

Key responsibilities:

Build the partner pipeline

* Map and prioritise partners across wellness services, products, wellness travel, regenerative services, nutrition, longevity, aesthetics and related categories, in line with ARC's marketplace category map.
* Source, pitch and onboard providers, brands, clinics, studios, retreats, travel operators and corporates, and bring them live on the platform.
* Negotiate commercial terms, including the partner pledge to the BIORIM regenerative pool, per-purchase redemption caps, commission and take-rate where relevant.

Run a quality-controlled ecosystem

* Set and apply vetting standards, credentials, licences and wellness-scope guardrails, so nothing in the marketplace implies diagnosis or prescribing.
* Manage onboarding, listings, content and catalogue quality with the product team.
* Track partner performance, activation, repeat redemption and member satisfaction, and act on the results.

Grow B2B2C and B2B revenue

* Develop B2B2C partners such as studios, resorts, clinics and wellness brands that bring their own members onto ARC.
* Develop B2B accounts such as corporate wellness programmes and per-seat subscriptions.
* Own targets for active partners, partner GMV and ARC's share of partner pledges.

Build the team and the playbook

* Document repeatable onboarding, pricing and partner-success processes.
* Hire and lead a partnerships and partner-success team as the marketplace scales.
* Prepare for the UAE and Indonesia ecosystems with the wider founding team.

Work with the founders

* Align supply with demand from member communities, Seasons and celebrity and ambassador campaigns.
* Report weekly on pipeline, onboarding and ecosystem metrics, and travel across India and abroad when needed.

Must have:

* 5+ years in partnerships, business development, supply or category management, ideally in wellness, health, hospitality, travel, nutrition, aesthetics or marketplaces.
* A proven track record of identifying, onboarding and activating partners at scale in India, with an existing network across several wellness categories.
* Experience with B2B2C or B2B marketplace models: commissions, revenue share, take rates and partner contracts.
* Strong negotiation, commercial and relationship skills, with comfort pitching to founders, clinic owners, resort and travel operators, and corporate buyers.
* Hands-on, self-driven and structured, comfortable building from zero without a team and then hiring one.
* Excellent written and spoken English; fluency in Hindi and one more Indian language is a plus.
* Willingness to travel within India and internationally.

Good to have:

* Experience in the UAE or Indonesia wellness, hospitality or travel markets.
* Knowledge of wellness regulation and compliance in India, including licensing and consent norms.
* Background in loyalty, rewards, referral or community-led growth.
* Familiarity with CRM and partner tools, and comfort with data and dashboards.

You will thrive here if:

* You want to be part of the founding team and take equity-linked ownership of an ecosystem you build.
* You care about regenerative health for people, communities and the environment.

title: Territory Manager

title: Demand Generation Manager
description:

As employees, we take pride in contributing to the world’s largest and only full-stack cloud communication platform. But it’s not just what we do, it’s how we do it: with curiosity, passion, and a whole lot of collaboration.

Let’s build what’s next, together.

**Demand Generation Manager**

* Experience: 8-10 years of hands-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.

* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).

* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

**Infobip is built on diverse backgrounds, perspectives, and talents.**
We’re proud to be an equal-opportunity employer and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace.
  
  
No matter your race, gender, age, background, or identity — if you have the passion and skills to thrive, there’s a place for you here.

title: Solutions Engineer- renewable energy
description:

SIFANG is a leading provider of power system protection, automation, power electronics and energy storage solutions. Founded in 1994 and headquartered in Beijing, we generated approximately USD 1.1 billion in revenue in 2025 and rank No. 2 in China and among the top five globally in power system protection and automation. Energy storage and PCS

Protection and automation solutions

title: Principal Product Specialist (Browser Security/Web Security)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.
  
  
We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.
  
  
**Role**
We are looking for a Principal Product Specialist – Browser Security to join our team. This is a Hybrid (Bangalore) role, reporting to the Director, Threat Researcher in the Engineering department. Zscaler is seeking a hands-on technical specialist to drive customer adoption and secure enterprise sales wins.
  
  
In this technical, customer-facing role, you will collaborate with Sales, Product, and Engineering to lead product walkthroughs, technical workshops, proof-of-value engagements, deployments, and live troubleshooting. * Proven experience driving enterprise engagements (POCs, POVs, deployments) and delivering technical workshops and walkthroughs to both executive and practitioner audiences

* Software engineering or product development experience with browser controls, web inspection, threat detection, telemetry, policy enforcement engines, and endpoint agents or extensions
* Prior experience in applied security roles, including security research, red teaming, penetration testing, threat/malware analysis, or application security engineering

title: Engineer - Application Engineering
description:

Evaluation of customer enquiries involves scrutinizing P&I drawings to understand the design and application intent. This assessment helps in determining the best-fit Armstrong product or solution to optimize efficiency.

Active participation and contribution to department key business metrics/KPIs are essential to meeting overall business objectives.

As a representative of the RSEC, participation in regional and national sales meetings is crucial. Assistance in the compilation and review of sales forecasts, strategic initiatives (e.g., CPDs), and key account customers ensures that our sales strategies are well-informed and aligned with the company's overall objectives.

Undertaking site/client visits ensures that the Armstrong message is articulated and understood by our client base. By integrating our offerings into their specifications and schedules, we demonstrate our commitment to their success and position Armstrong as a valued partner.

* High degree of fluency in P&I drawings in mechanical / HVAC applications with consulting background are preferred.
* Technical product knowledge of the company’s current product range
* 8-10 years’ experience in a technical sales role as an internal sales or on a customer orientated technical team is essential (desirable)
* Knowledge and understanding of the company’s internal sales systems would be desirable
* Competent in IT skills
* Excellent communication skills
* Excellent customer service skills
* The ability to collate and analyse relevant data & statistics (data/analysis manipulation – MS advanced level)
* The ability to write reports/complete paperwork accurately and legibly
* Initiative, self-motivation and commitment to achieving high standards of quality and efficiency
* A pro-active and flexible attitude
* Business systems knowledge – Configuration software / CRM - advantageous

By joining us, you’ll become part of a global community dedicated to pushing the boundaries of fluid-flow technology. You’ll have endless opportunities to learn, grow, and make a significant impact on the world. Together, we'll build tomorrow’s solutions today.

title: Brand Solutions Manager
description:
**About Us**

Barcode Entertainment is a leading influencer marketing agency, known for collaborating with premium brands and creators to deliver creative campaigns. Now part of Ykone group, a global influencer marketing network, we are expanding our reach both nationally and internationally and redefining what brand-creator partnerships can achieve at scale.

We're looking for a sharp, proactive Brand Solutions Manager who leads with thinking and follows through with action. This is not a role for someone who waits for briefs. You will identify brands worth going after, find the gap or opportunity in their current marketing, build a compelling insight-led strategy around it. And then use that strategy to open the doors. The pitch is your introduction. The relationship is what you build from there.

If you're someone who reads a brand's campaign, immediately spots what's missing, and knows exactly what to tell the brand team to get a meeting, this role is for you.

**What you'll do**

***Primary - Identify & Strategise***

* Continuously scan the market to identify brands actively investing in influencer marketing in India

* Build sharp, insight-led influencer marketing strategies tailored to the brand unprompted, before any brief exists

***Secondary - Outreach & open doors***

* Use your strategy as the hook to reach out to brand decision-makers. (Marketing heads, CMOs, founders, brand managers)

* Pitch with confidence, handle objections, and convert initial interest into a defined brief or meeting
* Collaborate with internal strategy, creative, and influencer teams to develop the full campaign proposal
* Manage the conversation through to closure, ensuring alignment between client expectations and delivery

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of experience in brand solutions, business development, or partnerships, ideally within influencer marketing, digital marketing, or a creative agency
* A strategic thinker who can spot a brand opportunity before the brand does
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube (TikTok is a plus), and the broader creator economy in India
* Excellent written and verbal communication, you can write a cold email or LinkedIn message that actually gets a reply
* Comfortable initiating conversations with senior decision-makers without a warm introduction
* Highly organised, self-directed, and comfortable working without a playbook
* Genuine passion for brands, culture, and the influencer space

**The one thing that matters most**

You should be able to look at a brand, identify what's missing in their influencer marketing, build a strategy around it, and get in front of the right person at the brand team.

All before anyone asks you to.

If that sounds like how you already think, we'd like to meet you.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer GTM
description:
**About TrueFoundry**
Every production AI system whether it's powering customer support, writing code, analyzing financial data, or diagnosing medical conditions needs the same foundational infrastructure.A way to route between models. A way to manage tools and integrate them securely. A way to orchestrate agents and enforce governance. A unified compute layer to run it all.
  
  
**That infrastructure layer is being built right now.**
We are looking for a Solution Architect
  
  
**The Problem We're Solving**
Companies are moving beyond simple chatbots to production agentic systems. These systems route between OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, and self-hosted models. They integrate dozens of tools via protocols like MCP. They orchestrate multi-agent workflows where agents coordinate with other agents.
  
  
The infrastructure to support this doesn't exist yet. You can't just duct-tape together a few API calls and call it production-ready.
  
  
**You Need a Control Plane That Handles**

* Intelligent routing with observability, cost policies, and fallback logic
* Centralized tool and MCP server management with security and lifecycle controls
* Agent orchestration with governance and guardrails
* A unified compute layer to run self-hosted models, custom tools, and agents

**AI Gateway**
is the control plane five composable components (Prompts, LLM Gateway, MCP Gateway, Guardrails, Agent Gateway) that handle routing, orchestration, and governance.
  
  
We're Series A, backed by Intel Capital and Sequoia. Companies like CVS, Mastercard, Siemens, Paytm, Synopsys, and Zscaler run production AI workloads on our platform.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Own the technical arc of the deal: discovery and the in-depth demo, the architecture discussion with the customer's engineering leaders, and the POC - all the way through to close.
* Win the POC on technical merit: Co-define the success criteria with the customer, run the execution tracker and the milestones, and write the integration glue, agent workflows, and eval pipelines that prove value in their environment. The goal is delivered impact, not lines of code.
* Make the architecture calls that decide how the customer will run AI in production. You are the technical decision-maker in the room - the CTO in the room - and the person their engineering leaders trust.
* Be the technical face of TrueFoundry to enterprise customers, and earn the credibility that turns an evaluation into a signed contract.
* Steer the product. You see, first-hand, what customers pull toward and where their first production win lands. Compile that field signal and bring structured, data-backed asks to TrueFoundry's engineering and product teams - your intuition helps shape the roadmap.

**Who We're Looking For**

* Backend Engineering Experience: 3 to 7 years of backend software engineering experience with production systems you have shipped and owned. Strong in Python, Go, or TypeScript. Comfortable with Kubernetes or any major cloud (AWS, Azure, GCP).
* Business Acumen: You don’t just question the how but also the why - discovering impact, architecture design and deal-winning opportunities.
* AI and ML literacy: You have worked with LLMs, agents, evals, or ML pipelines in production. Familiarity with the modern stack (vLLM, SGLang, LangChain, Triton, model serving) is a strong plus.
* Design and Architecture: Comfortable leading an architecture discussion with a customer's engineering leaders, then doing the work yourself. High agency and a bias for action.
* We especially welcome founding engineers and CTOs of early-stage startups, as well as engineers from infrastructure, MLOps, and developer-tool companies.

**Traits we are looking for:**
Ownership, ability to execute, hustle and think out of the box, data-driven decision-making, be comfortable with more unknowns than knowns.
  
  
Perks of Working at TrueFoundry
  
  

* Join a fast-growing Series A, Bay Area-based startup building cutting-edge AI infrastructure.
* Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family.
* Flexible hybrid work, 3 days a week in the office (Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday), with flexibility around the schedule.
* Lunch and snacks are on us whenever you come into the office.
* Work from another TrueFoundry office for up to 3 months each year, whether that's our London or Bay Area office, if you'd like a change of scenery.

title: Forward Deployed Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
Meet the Team
  
  
The Splunk Agent Resilience team is defining the future of AI resilience. Together our team provides scalable, cost-effective evaluation and guardrails that ensure AI agents behave as intended, improving reliability and reducing risks. This unified approach empowers our customers to expertly deploy and manage AI-powered applications with enhanced observability and control.
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE), you'll work at the intersection of software engineering, customer engagement, and product innovation to help some of the world's largest enterprises successfully deploy AI into production. You'll partner closely with external customers to solve complex technical challenges while collaborating with internal Product and Engineering teams to improve the platform based on real-world customer needs.
  
  
If you enjoy solving hard engineering problems, working directly with customers, and building technology that scales beyond a single implementation, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Your Impact
  
  
As a Forward Deployed Engineer, you will
  
  

* Partner with enterprise customers to understand technical requirements and business goals.
* Design scalable AI solution architectures and guide customers through production deployments.
* Build integrations, prototypes, and reusable tools that accelerate customer success.
* Lead technical workshops, architecture discussions, and troubleshoot complex production issues.
* Collaborate with Product and Engineering teams to share customer feedback and influence future product enhancements.
* Create documentation, reusable best practices, and technical assets that benefit future deployments.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science or a related technical field (or equivalent experience).
* 4+ years of strong software engineering experience building production-grade applications.
* Experience with APIs, distributed systems, cloud platforms, or backend development.
* Hands-on experience with AI tools such as Claude Code, Codex, cursor, etc.
* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills across multiple layers of the technology stack.
* Excellent communication skills and the ability to work directly with enterprise customers.
* Comfortable working in fast-paced, ambiguous environments.
* Interest in AI, Machine Learning, or developer platforms.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience deploying or supporting Generative AI, LLM, or Machine Learning applications in production.
* Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, observability, or MLOps.
* Experience building customer-facing technical solutions or integrations.
* Experience creating reusable developer tools, frameworks, or open-source contributions.
* Consulting, Solutions Engineering, or Technical Customer Success experience in enterprise environments.
* Experience with programming language such as python, Java, etc.

Why Cisco?
  
  
At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.
  
  
Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere.
  
  
We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
  
  
Disclaimer
  
  
**About**
To ensure that we hire the best talent in the right way, we follow a strict hiring process and recently, Cisco has been made aware of fraudulent recruiters claiming to be from the company. Please be advised that any communication from Cisco about careers will:
  
  

* be in direct response to an application you have submitted through the company career site
* begin with screening or an interview
* originate from a Cisco email address, and
* be conducted across email, phone, or WebEx

Cisco will never make a job offer without conducting an interview process or ask you for money in any way. If you have been requested to apply for a role or have received an offer from a site other than https://careers.cisco.com or cisco.wd5.myworkday.com, do not provide any personal identifying information, including your Aadhaar or other personal identifying number, birth certificate, banking information, driver's license, or passport.
  
  
If you are the target of a recruiting scam, consider filing a report with your local law enforcement authorities. Cisco bears no responsibility, and cannot be held liable, for any claims, damages, expenses, or other inconvenience resulting from or in any way connected to recruiting scams.

title: Senior Deployment Engineer
description:
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI. At our core is the Celonis Context Model — which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence into a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can actually understand, turning AI's operational blind spots into operational clarity. World's leading companies trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.
  
  
**Deployment Engineer**
**The Team**
Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. In the AI era, our role has elevated: as AI agents like our own Apollo take on more of the technical build, our people focus on the work that drives real impact—understanding our customers' business-critical problems, designing the solutions that solve them, and quantifying the value delivered. Our Deployment Engineers and Deployment Architects pair deep domain and industry expertise with serious platform mastery and AI-augmented delivery, directing agentic systems while owning the judgment, architecture, and customer relationships that AI cannot replace. We deliver faster and smarter than ever, and we own the outcome: solution go-live, solution adoption, initial value realization support and the long-term success of our customers.
  
  
**The Role**
As a Senior Deployment Engineer, you are the backbone of Celonis delivery. You lead the hands-on implementation of Celonis solutions for enterprise customers, combining platform expertise with AI-augmented workflows to deliver high-quality outcomes, fast. You use Celonis’s AI deployment tools as your primary instruments - directing agents to build data models, generate analyses, and configure operational solutions, while applying your own judgment to validate outputs, adapt to customer context, and ensure business relevance.
  
  
This is not a traditional consulting role where you build everything manually. You are an AI-augmented delivery professional: you specify what needs to be built, direct AI agents to execute wherever possible, validate the results, and iterate with the customer.
**You generate value by understanding the customer’s business, translating their needs into technical specifications and solutions, and ensuring the platform delivers measurable impact.**
**The Work You’ll Do**
**Initiate and Connect**

* Conduct business discovery workshops to translate customers’ strategic objectives into high-impact Celonis use cases
* Collaborate with the customer’s IT and business stakeholders to define project scope, data requirements, and success criteria
* Ensure data connectivity and extraction pipelines are properly configured, working with specialist resources if required

**Build & Value**

* Direct AI deployment agents (Apollo) to build data models, process analyses, KPIs, and dashboards - writing clear specifications and validating agent outputs against business requirements
* Build and configure Celonis solutions across the platform: Process Intelligence Graph, data transformations, process analysis, operational solutions, and AI-powered insights
* Identify process inefficiencies and root causes using Celonis technology, always in close collaboration with the customer
* Validate AI-generated outputs for accuracy, business relevance, and alignment with customer context - applying domain knowledge where the AI cannot
* Lead value creation workshops and define measures to improve process inefficiencies
* Define and build KPIs measuring the customer’s success and quantify business impact
* Design and build operational solutions to drive value, adoption and improve process conformance

**Rollout, Adoption, and Handover**

* Enable key customer users to use and extend the solution independently, setting the foundation for long-term adoption
* Manage project outcomes against timelines, scope, and customer expectations
* Train and demonstrate to customer users, guiding them on the path to sustained value
* Document solution design decisions and configurations for future reference and handoff

**Domain & Industry Depth**

* Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals
* Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage
* Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap

**What Makes This Role Different In The AI Era**

* You work with AI agents as your primary tools - your job is to direct, validate, and refine their output, not to write every line of code or build every analysis manually
* You need strong specification and context engineering skills - the ability to translate a customer’s ambiguous business need into a precise instruction that an AI agent can execute correctly
* You are expected to continuously learn and adapt as AI capabilities evolve, experimenting with new approaches and sharing what works with your peers
* You balance speed with quality - AI accelerates execution, but you own the judgment calls on whether the output is right for this customer
* You think in sustainable software solutions. While AI agents will generate first results quickly, you need to ensure that the operational solutions you build in Celonis are robust, user friendly, maintainable, and scalable

**The Qualifications You Need**

* Experience: 4+ years in Management or IT consulting, data/solution consulting, or process improvement consulting within software vendors, consulting firms, or system integrators. For Senior DE: 6+ years with demonstrated project leadership.
* Platform skills: Ability to build and configure solutions on the Celonis platform, including data modeling, process analysis, KPI definition, and automation. Proficiency in PQL, SQL, and Python.
* AI fluency: Comfort working with AI-assisted development tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Ability to write clear specifications, evaluate AI-generated outputs, and iterate effectively. Experience with prompt engineering or context engineering is a strong plus.
* Business and process domain expertise : Strong understanding /deep expertise (based on seniority level) of enterprise business processes and financial metrics. Knowledge of standard ERPs (SAP, Oracle) and process areas (Inventory Management, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, Accounts Payable) is a strong plus.
* Consulting skills: Ability to steer customer workshops, present findings to management, manage stakeholder expectations, and deliver outcomes in the face of adversity and ambiguity. Comfortable working with both technical and business audiences.
* Analytical mindset: Excellent problem-solving skills with a value-driven orientation. Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions and quantify business impact.
* Learning agility: Willingness to continuously develop expertise through experimentation. Comfort with ambiguity and evolving tools.
* Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s in Technology Management, Business Informatics, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Administration, or a comparable field.
* Languages: Fluency in English required. Additional languages are a plus.
* Travel: Willingness to travel to customer location up to 50%, according to customer requirement and project delivery phases.

**What Celonis can offer you:**

* Pioneer Innovation: Work with the global leader in Process Mining and the Process Intelligence Graph to shape the future of AI-driven business operations.
* Ownership from Day 1: Every full-time Celonaut is an owner, receiving Restricted Stock Units (RSUs) and merit-based refresh grants.
* Unrivaled Family Support: Benefit from our inclusive parental leave policy—24 weeks of fully paid leave for primary carers and 12 weeks for supporting carers, available from your first day of employment.
* Work-Life Integration: Enjoy Unlimited PTO (in applicable regions) and generous PTO globally, as well as a flexible hybrid work model that balances remote focus with vibrant office collaboration.
* Continuous Growth: Elevate your skills through our 70-20-10 learning framework, mentorship programs, and access to a dedicated learning platform.
* Holistic Well-being: Prioritize your health with subsidized Wellhub memberships, mental health counseling, and dedicated Wellness Weeks that prioritize work/life balance.
* Drive Sustainability: Participate in annual Impact Days, where you receive paid time off to volunteer for community and environmental causes with your local office, or virtually.
* Global Inclusion & Belonging: Find community through our Inclusion Think Tank and participate in our annual Inclusion Days, ensuring every voice is heard and valued.
* Value-Driven Impact: Join a mission-led organization where our core values—Live for Customer Value, The Best Team Wins, We Own It, and Earth Is Our Future—drive every decision.

**About Us:**
Celonis is the trusted platform to industrialize Enterprise AI, empowering organizations to analyze, design, and operate AI-driven processes. The Celonis Platform is powered by the Celonis Context Model, which combines process data, business knowledge, and intelligence to create a living digital twin of the enterprise that AI can understand — turning AI’s operational blind spots into operational clarity. Industry-leading companies around the world trust Celonis and its global ecosystem of partners to make their AI agents, people, systems, and processes work together, achieving transformational outcomes. Celonis is headquartered in Munich, Germany, and New York City, USA, with more than 20 offices worldwide.
  
  
Get familiar with the Celonis Process Intelligence Platform by watching this video.
  
  
**Celonis Inclusion Statement:**
At Celonis, we believe our people make us who we are and that “The Best Team Wins”. We know that the best teams are made up of people who bring different perspectives to the table. And when everyone feels included, able to speak up and knows their voice is heard - that's when creativity and innovation happen.
  
  
**Your Privacy:**
Any information you submit to Celonis as part of your application will be processed in accordance with Celonis’ Accessibility and Candidate Notices
  
  
By submitting this application, you confirm that you agree to the storing and processing of your personal data by Celonis as described in our Privacy Notice for the Application and Hiring Process.
  
  
**Use of Artificial Intelligence Tools**
We rely on an artificial intelligence tool to match the information from your resume to the relevant Celonis job descriptions. This processing is limited to the information provided in your resume or in your candidate profile. The tool produces a match score per candidate for a role, suggests preliminary ranking, and provides recommendations.
  
  
The tool is only used for support in parts of the job application process, including to facilitate the identification of the relevant Celonis Jobs for candidates and recruiters. All final decisions are made by hiring managers and the Celonis talent acquisition team. Hiring managers and HR specialists use this tool responsibly, are aware of the risk of potential bias, and are equipped to mitigate it.
  
  
Please be aware of common job offer scams, impersonators and frauds. Learn more here.

title: Senior AI Solution Architect
description:
**Description**
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is leading the next phase of AI adoption and is seeking a hands-on AI Specialist Solution Architect (SSA). AWS Specialist Solutions Architects (SSAs) are technologists with deep domain-specific expertise, able to address advanced concepts and feature designs.
  
  
As part of the AWS sales organization, SSAs work with customers who have complex challenges that require expert-level knowledge to solve. SSAs craft scalable, flexible, and resilient technical architectures that address those challenges. This might involve guiding customers as they refactor an application or design an entirely new cloud-based system.
  
  
Specialist SAs play a critical role in capturing customer feedback, advocating for roadmap enhancements and anticipating customer requirements as they work backwards from their needs. As domain experts, SSAs also participate in field engagement and enablement, producing content such as whitepapers, blogs, and workshops for customers, partners, and the AWS Technical Field.
  
  
This role focuses on converting AI ambition into programs that can be delivered, operated, and scaled in production environments.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* The AI Specialist SA team builds technical relationships with customers of all sizes and operate as their trusted advisor, ensuring they get the most out of the cloud at every stage of their journey while adopting GenAI/ML and Agentic technologies across their organisation.
* You’ll manage the overall technical relationship between AWS and our customers, making recommendations on security, cost, performance, reliability and operational efficiency to accelerate their challenging GenAI/ML and Agentic projects.
* Internally, you will be the voice of the customer, sharing their needs with regard to their usage of our services impacting the roadmap of AWS GenAI/ML and Agentic features.
* In this role, your creativity will link technology to tangible solutions, with the opportunity to define cloud-native GenAI/ML and Agentic architectural patterns for a variety of use cases.
* You will participate in the creation and sharing of best practices, technical content and new reference architectures (e.g. white papers, code samples, blog posts) and evangelize and educate about running GenAI/ML and Agentic workloads on AWS technology (e.g. through workshops, user groups, meetups, public speaking, online videos or conferences).
* Technical Leadership & Mentorship: Lead hands-on deep dives and technical workshops, contributing reusable code, reference architectures, and internal technical assets for the broader engineering organization.

**Basic Qualifications**

* 7+ years of design/implementation/operations/consulting with distributed applications experience
* 5+ years of management of technical, enterprise customer facing resources or equivalent experience
* Experience giving skills and communicating complex concepts clearly and effectively to diverse audiences across different functions
* Experience leading engineering discussions around technology decisions and strategy related to a product
* 5+ years of building large-scale machine learning and AI solutions at Internet scale experience
* Experience in developing and deploying LLMs in production on GPUs, Neuron, TPU or other AI acceleration hardware, or experience designing or architecting (design patterns, reliability and scaling) of new and existing systems
* Hands-on experience with AWS ecosystems (including Bedrock, AgentCore, and SageMaker) to set up secure, private-network AI environments, and practical experience implementing Retrieval-Augmented Generation using embeddings, vector stores, and semantic search optimization

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience (non-internship) in professional software development
* Experience engaging and influencing C-level executives, both business and technical
* Cloud Technology Certification, or AWS Professional level certification
* Experience developing solutions and executing plans on complex projects
* Experience leading and influencing your team or organization
* Master's degree or above in computer science, mathematics, statistics, machine learning or equivalent quantitative field, or PhD
* Experience with Machine Learning and Large Language Model fundamentals, including architecture, training/inference lifecycles, and optimization of model execution, or experience with PyTorch, JIT compilation, and AOT tracing
* Deep Agentic AI expertise - Hands-on experience with multi-agent orchestration, tool use, memory, and guardrails using frameworks such as LangGraph, AutoGen, or AWS AgentCore; proficiency in responsible AI tooling including AWS Clarify, Guardrails for Bedrock, model explainability, and bias detection
* Strong ability to determine solution strategy and where to simplify or extend solutions for the best outcome
* Expertise in architecting AI systems within highly regulated or security-sensitive environments (e.g., Financial Services, Healthcare, Public Sector)

title: Recruiter/Sr Recruiter
description:
We are looking for a dynamic, hands-on, and results-oriented Senior Recruiter to join our HR team in Bangalore. The role will be responsible for managing end-to-end recruitment across engineering and non-engineering functions, partnering closely with hiring managers, building strong talent pipelines, and delivering a high-quality candidate experience throughout the hiring lifecycle.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner with hiring managers and business leaders to understand hiring plans, and role requirements.
* Manage end-to-end recruitment for engineering and non-engineering roles, including sourcing, screening, interview coordination, offer discussions, and closure.
* Create compelling job descriptions and post roles across LinkedIn, job portals, internal platforms, and other relevant channels.
* Source high-quality candidates through databases, social media, professional networks, referrals, and direct outreach.
* Screen resumes, conduct initial candidate assessments, and evaluate fit against technical, functional, and cultural requirements.
* Coordinate interviews with hiring teams and ensure timely feedback, follow-ups, and decision-making.
* Build and maintain strong talent pipelines for current and future business needs.
* Maintain accurate recruitment data and candidate records in ATS, HR systems, and recruitment trackers.
* Track hiring metrics such as time-to-fill, source effectiveness, offer acceptance, and candidate pipeline status.
* Ensure a positive candidate experience through clear communication, timely updates, and professional engagement.
* Support employer branding initiatives and contribute ideas to improve sourcing strategies and hiring outcomes.

**Qualifications**

* MBA or postgraduate degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 10+ years of experience in recruitment, talent acquisition, or staffing, preferably with exposure to both technical and non-technical hiring.
* Strong experience using ATS, HR databases, job portals, LinkedIn Recruiter, and other sourcing tools.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills with the ability to partner effectively with hiring managers and leadership teams.
* Strong communication, interpersonal, and negotiation skills.
* Ability to manage multiple open positions, prioritize effectively, and deliver within defined hiring timelines.
* Strong understanding of recruitment metrics, market mapping, candidate engagement, and talent pipeline management.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience hiring for product, technology, or fast-paced business environments.
* Ability to conduct market research and talent mapping for niche and critical roles.
* Strong candidate engagement and offer negotiation capability.
* Data-driven approach to recruitment planning, reporting, and process improvement.

Currency: INR
  
  
Salary Minimum: Market
  
  
Salary Maximum: Market
  
  
Incentive: Market
  
  
Disclaimer: Where a specific pay range is noted, it is a good faith estimate at the time of this posting. The actual salary offered will be based on experience, skills, qualifications, market / business considerations, and geographic location.

title: Senior Embedded Recruiter | Semiconductor, Firmware & Embedded Systems Talent
description:
**The Role**

Some of the hardest talent searches happen deep inside the technology stack.

From embedded software and firmware to device drivers, RTOS and semiconductor engineering, finding the right talent requires more than keyword matching. It takes technical curiosity, strong market research, an understanding of engineering talent pools, and the ability to identify people whose work aligns with the role.

At CareerXperts, we work with technology-led businesses to identify and hire talent for technically demanding roles. We are looking for a
**Senior Embedded Recruiter**
who understands the embedded engineering ecosystem and can take ownership of complex hiring mandates from research to closure.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own end-to-end recruitment for embedded systems, firmware, semiconductor and related engineering roles.
* Partner with hiring managers to understand technical requirements, team structures, role expectations and hiring priorities.
* Build targeted talent pipelines across embedded software, BSP, device drivers, RTOS, Linux, automotive embedded systems, SoC and firmware engineering.
* Conduct in-depth talent research, market mapping and competitor talent analysis to identify relevant candidates.
* Source passive talent through LinkedIn Recruiter, Boolean search, X-ray search, referrals and other relevant channels.
* Assess candidate experience, technical exposure, career progression and role alignment before presenting profiles.
* Manage candidate engagement, screening, interview coordination, feedback, offer negotiations and closures.
* Maintain a strong candidate experience through clear communication and consistent follow-ups.
* Track recruitment metrics, pipeline health, conversion ratios and turnaround times.
* Develop market intelligence on talent availability, compensation benchmarks, hiring trends and competing organisations.
* Work closely with internal stakeholders to improve search strategies and deliver against hiring commitments.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 3–8 years of experience in technical recruitment, with substantial exposure to embedded systems, firmware, semiconductor or related engineering hiring.
* Strong understanding of embedded engineering terminology and role distinctions across firmware, embedded Linux, RTOS, BSP, device drivers and hardware-software interfaces.
* Experience hiring for technical roles across mid-level, senior and niche engineering positions.
* Strong command of Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, talent mapping and passive candidate sourcing.
* Ability to interpret technical job descriptions and translate them into effective search strategies.
* Strong stakeholder management, candidate assessment and negotiation skills.
* A research-oriented mindset with the ability to work on difficult-to-fill positions.
* Ownership of recruitment delivery, pipeline quality and closure outcomes.

**What Will Set You Apart**

* Exposure to semiconductor, automotive electronics, SoC, ASIC, FPGA or silicon engineering recruitment.
* Experience supporting product engineering organisations, R&D centres or deep-tech businesses.
* The ability to distinguish between adjacent technical profiles rather than relying solely on titles and keywords.
* A track record of closing niche engineering roles in competitive talent markets.

**Why CareerXperts?**

At CareerXperts, recruitment begins with understanding the talent ecosystem, not simply collecting profiles. You will work on challenging technical mandates, develop deeper market knowledge and contribute to hiring decisions that shape engineering teams.

If you enjoy solving difficult talent searches and understand what makes a technical profile genuinely relevant, this role is worth a conversation. Write to sanish@careerxperts.com

title: Talent Systems Partner
description:
What Cognite is: Relentless to achieve
  
  
Cognite operates at the forefront of
**industrial digitalization, building AI**
, and data solutions that solve the world’s hardest, highest-impact problems. With unmatched industrial heritage and a comprehensive suite of AI capabilities, including low-code AI agents, Cognite accelerates the digital transformation to drive operational improvements.
  
  
We thrive in challenges. We challenge assumptions. We execute with speed and ownership. If you view obstacles as signals to step forward - not backwards - you’ll feel right at home here.
  
  
Our Moonshot is bold: Unlock $100B in customer value by 2035, and redefine how global industry works. Join us in this venture where AI and data meet ingenuity, and together, we will forge the path to a smarter, more connected industrial future.
  
  
How you’ll demonstrate
**Ownership**
**About The Role**
Cognite's Talent team is investing in the systems and processes behind every hire and every person's decision, one of the three core pillars of our 2027 Talent Strategy, alongside a company-wide performance culture and an AI-native way of working. We're hiring a Talent Systems Manager to own and optimize the technology backbone of that work.
  
  
This is a hands-on, systems-first role. You'll spend time inside Greenhouse configuring, streamlining, and continuously improving our recruiting workflow so recruiters and hiring managers move faster with less friction. Beyond Greenhouse, you'll help build out Claude as Cognite's primary development tool for employees and leaders org-wide, extend that same rigor to HiBob's Talent module (where our performance process runs), and to SkillJar, our learning management system.
  
  
You won't manage people in this role, but you will operate at manager-level scope: owning a real piece of Cognite's talent tech stack, setting the roadmap for how it's used, and being the go-to expert whenever Greenhouse or our broader talent systems come up.
  
  
**What You'll Own**

* Greenhouse Optimization & Recruiting Workflow: Own Greenhouse end to end configuration, automation, integrations, and data integrity. Continuously improve the recruiting workflow inside it so recruiters, hiring managers, and candidates all move through a faster, cleaner process. Build and maintain reporting that gives the Talent team a clear, trustworthy read on pipeline health and recruiting metrics.
* AI Tooling & Integration for Employee Development: Help make Claude the go-to, in-the-flow learning and development tool for Cognite employees and leaders, building and refining the required integrations and Claude Skills that deliver coaching, guidance, and development in the moment someone needs it, and driving adoption across the org.
* HRIS Workforce & Talent Module: Partner with People Operations & Org Development to optimize HiBob's Talent module across the performance cycle (goal setting, talent review) and Workforce Planning tool as the operational bridge between hiring managers and approvals. Build reporting that flags stale requests by SLA, not just status, and partner with HR Tech to keep templates and routing aligned with how divisions actually approve headcount — so TA and hiring managers work off one source of truth.
* SkillJar & Learning Systems: Provide ongoing support and optimization for SkillJar as capacity allows, ensuring our learning programs are well-supported by the underlying system.
* Tech Stack Stewardship: Serve as the internal subject-matter expert across the talent tech stack, maintaining documentation, training materials, and vendor relationships, and making the case for where further investment or consolidation would pay off.

The Impact you bring to Cognite
  
  

* Minimum of 3+ years administering or optimizing Greenhouse ATS, in a recruiting or talent operations capacity with depth in their AI toolkit
* A systems-thinker's instinct for workflow design - you see the friction in a process and know how to configure it away
* Genuine comfort using AI tools to streamline HR/recruiting work, not just an interest in the idea of it
* Experience with a modern HRIS platform (HiBob or comparable) and a working understanding of how performance or talent management modules operate
* Strong written communication and the ability to partner effectively with global stakeholders across time zones
* Comfort operating as a senior individual contributor - this role carries real ownership and scope without direct reports

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with SkillJar or another LMS
* Prior experience supporting a distributed or global Talent/People team
* Exposure to workforce or recruiting analytics and dashboarding

**Why This Role, Right Now**
This role sits at the center of Cognite's 2027 Talent Strategy — the person who makes sure the tools we've invested in actually deliver for the people using them every day. You'll have direct influence over how every recruiter, hiring manager, and leader across Cognite experiences our talent systems, and a clear mandate to bring AI into the everyday workflow rather than treat it as a side project.
  
  
**Learn More About Us**

* Impact 2025
* Cognite's Industrial AI: Moonshot
* We’re globally recognized domain experts with an international presence that spans Phoenix, Houston, Oslo Tokyo, Bengaluru, and Abu Dhabi.

***Equal Opportunity***
*Cognite is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive environment at work and is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive the same level of consideration for employment.*

**LOCATION:**
India, Remote
  
  
*This opportunity is based in India and qualified applicants must be able to travel to the office in Bengaluru, India.*
**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**
Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we’re building the industry’s first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.
  
  
With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.

At Salesloft, our Senior Technical Recruiter will be pivotal to our company’s success. You will be a key member of our fast-growing and high-performing Talent Acquisition team, responsible for partnering with hiring leaders to attract, evaluate, and hire top technical talent in India. We believe that the most successful recruiting professionals have a passionate and supportive team behind them.
  
  
On a day-to-day basis, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Managing the full-lifecycle recruiting process, from application through offer acceptance
* Screening and sorting inbound applicants and communicating with candidates promptly
* Proactively sourcing and attracting top passive talent
* Conducting initial screening calls to assess fit and educate candidates on Salesloft and our interview process

* Supporting interview scheduling, reporting, and related administrative tasks
* Building and maintaining talent pipelines for future openings, keeping candidates warm and engaged
* Driving DE&I recruitment initiatives and assessing their impact against company DE&I goals

* Continuously improving recruiting processes by identifying bottlenecks and using tools like Claude, Gemini, and Tines to automate and scale your work

In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to deliver a best-in-class candidate experience and help build the teams that drive Salesloft’s growth. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.
  
  
**WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR:**
We are seeking a data-minded, results-oriented recruiter with a passion for continuous process improvement and a track record of owning requisitions end to end, from passive candidate generation and hiring manager partnership through offer close. You will work with a robust tech stack, including Greenhouse (our ATS), CandidateFYI, Claude, Gemini, and Tines, and use it to work smarter, move faster, and keep raising the bar on how we hire.
  
  
If you’re looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Technical Recruiter is the career path for you!
  
  
**THE TEAM:**
Our Salesloft Talent Acquisition team is composed of hard-working, results-driven, and passionate people advocates who take pride in sourcing the best passive talent and delivering a white-glove candidate experience. We celebrate wins together and help each other through uncharted territory.
  
  
Our core values — Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, and Customer-Inspired — guide how we serve our candidates, new hires, and hiring managers.

**Required:**

* 6+ years of agency and in-house recruiting experience
* Strong cold-calling skills and a sales mindset
* Data-minded approach, with comfort using funnel, pipeline, and time-to-fill metrics to guide decisions and advise hiring managers
* Commitment to continuous process improvement, with curiosity about AI and automation tools
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills with all levels of an organization
* Ability to work effectively in a fast-paced tech environment and adapt quickly to changing priorities
* Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills
* High level of integrity and discretion in handling confidential information

**Preferred:**

* Experience as an internal recruiter at a SaaS company supporting Product or Engineering teams
* Experience with Greenhouse, LinkedIn Recruiter, and CandidateFYI
* Hands-on experience with AI and automation tools such as Claude, Gemini, and Tines

At Salesloft, we are committed to creating an inclusive and supportive workplace where everyone belongs and can thrive. We focus on culture add, not culture fit, and believe our teams are made stronger by the unique perspectives, experiences, and identities each person brings.
  
  
We are proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer and provide employment opportunities to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, pregnancy, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
If you’re excited about this role even though your experience may not perfectly match every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We are actively hiring across multiple geographies and would love to welcome passionate, curious, and mission-driven individuals to our growing team.
  
  
Explore our open roles and consider joining us!
  
  
  
  
Please note that all official communication regarding job opportunities at Salesloft will come from an @salesloft.com email address. If you receive messages on LinkedIn or other job platforms claiming to be from Salesloft, they may not be legitimate. description:
**Who are we?**
Join Xponentiate—a fast-growing healthcare recruitment firm redefining how top talent connects with leading healthcare organizations. Since 2022, we've placed 300+ executives, tech, marketing, and clinical professionals by leveraging deep industry expertise and a powerful network. At Xponentiate, you'll help shape the future of healthcare by matching exceptional candidates with companies that are reimagining the industry. **Role**
With 2-4 years of experience in talent acquisition, you will take ownership of hiring across multiple initiatives and work closely with candidates, hiring managers, and senior stakeholders.

Here is a snapshot of the responsibilities:
  
  
**Roles And Responsibilities**
Recruitment process management
  
  

* Job Description & Search Strategy: Translating hiring requirements into clear job descriptions, candidate profiles, and search strategies, while using data, market insights, and AI-enabled tools to make sourcing and hiring more targeted and efficient
* Candidate Assessment Reports: Preparing detailed assessment reports after interacting with them and going through their career journey in detail
* Reference Check Reports: Presenting in-depth reference check reports after talking to multiple references in the industry
* Formalizing compensation break-up reports to understand CTC calculations including Variable/Bonus and ESOP pay-out plans

Candidate management:
  
  

* Talent Sourcing: Identify and engage relevant candidates through LinkedIn, industry networks, referrals, research, and other sourcing tools. Experiment with new tools, AI-enabled sourcing approaches, and creative research methods to continuously improve the quality and efficiency of talent discovery
* Build and manage relevant candidate pipelines, using structured criteria and data-driven insights to prioritize profiles and improve conversion through the hiring funnel
* Comprehensive Interviews with candidates to understand their profile, career path, growth trajectory, motivators, areas of development, red flags if any
* Analysing the soft aspects of candidate's personality and its impact on his/her professional and personal decisions

Account Management
  
  

* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients and hiring managers, understand their evolving talent needs, and act as a trusted talent partner throughout the hiring process.
* Proactively identify opportunities to expand existing accounts, generate additional mandates, and engage relevant stakeholders on how Xponentiate can support their broader hiring needs

Strategic initiatives
  
  

* Recruitment Innovation & Automation: Identify repetitive or manual parts of the recruitment process and explore ways to automate or improve them using AI and technology. Stay curious about new recruitment tools and experiment with approaches that make sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and hiring workflows more efficient
* Talent Intelligence: Build and continuously strengthen a talent pool of digital health professionals in India. Track talent movements, emerging talent, relevant companies, and market trends
* Lead initiatives to create an ethical and fun working environment
* Help structure OKRs for the team and assist in quarterly assessment

**Requirements**
You should apply if:
  
  

* You have 2-4 years of overall experience in hiring
* You have worked in a tier-1 recruiting firm (Indian or global) or start-ups in a recruiting role
* You are a problem solver who looks beyond established processes and actively thinks about how sourcing, screening, candidate engagement, and other parts of recruitment can be done better
* You are comfortable using technology and AI tools to make recruitment more efficient, and are naturally curious about experimenting with new tools and workflows
* You have strong communication and people skills (we will be speaking with candidates and senior leaders everyday)
* You are a mid-career professional who can hire junior/mid roles and also navigate conversations with senior hires (CXO-level)
* Experience with recruiting for start-ups, healthcare companies, technology companies, VC funds, etc. is preferred

**Benefits**
Top Benefit: You work with Super-Smart people.
  
  
You get to work for different roles and not just one kind!
  
  
Industry competitive salary.

title: Client Services Manager
description:
**Team Lead, Client Services, MRA**

Konovo is a global healthcare intelligence company on a mission to transform research through technology- enabling faster, better, connected insights.

Konovo provides healthcare organisations with access to over 2 million healthcare professionals and patients—the largest network of its kind globally. With a workforce of over 300 employees across 5 countries: India, Bosnia and Herzegovina, the United Kingdom, Mexico, and the United States, we collaborate to support some of the most prominent names in healthcare. Our customers include over 300 global pharmaceutical companies, medical device manufacturers, research agencies, and consultancy firms.

As we grow our India delivery organization, we're looking for a Team Lead to own day-to-day delivery for a portfolio of Market Research Agency (MRA) clients. You'll lead a team of Project Managers executing quant and qual studies on behalf of our agency partners, and you'll be the person who turns a client's brief into a plan the team can actually run on. You'll report to the VP, Client Services. This is a great opportunity to shape the presence of Konovo's India Client Services team as it rapidly expands.

**How You'll Make an Impact**

* Lead and coach a team of Project Managers delivering MRA studies with speed and quality, meeting agency-partner expectations on every project.
* Serve as the primary delivery point of contact for MRA clients, translating study requirements into clear execution plans and measurable outcomes.
* As leader of your team you'll spearhead workforce efficiency initiatives driving speed, quality, and innovation.
* Build a culture of client-first execution: develop, coach, and retain PMs who meet Konovo's bar for service excellence.
* Remove blockers fast. Resolve feasibility gaps, delivery risk, and client escalations with sound judgment, so agency partners experience Konovo as an extension of their own team.
* Drive predictable execution across concurrent MRA studies by prioritizing effectively and managing dependencies in a high-volume environment.
* Improve delivery visibility using project management and CRM tools to track progress, risk, and outcomes, and flag patterns back to the VP, Client Services.
* Partner with sampling, programming, and commercial teams to protect quality, timelines, and project economics specific to the MRA book of business.
* Improve how delivery works day to day. Partner with Product and Technology on better delivery tools and practical automation, and bring ideas on shared standards back to the wider delivery team.

**What We're Looking For**

* 5+ years in healthcare, life sciences, or market research delivery. Direct experience serving market research agencies, not just end-client pharma, is a real advantage. You know how agency relationships, resale dynamics, and white-label delivery actually work.
* 3+ years of direct people leadership, coaching and developing PMs or similar client-facing researchers.
* Comfort with research delivery tooling (programming systems like Decipher, scheduling platforms, Salesforce or similar CRM) to run high-volume concurrent studies.
* A track record of growing and retaining agency relationships: spotting expansion opportunities and partnering across teams to deliver value over time.
* Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru, with the ability to work hybrid 2 or more days a week from our office.
* Ability to work a shift that covers our global clients and aligns with delivery leaders across time zones. Exact hours to be confirmed, expect regular evening or late-night overlap with the US and Europe.
* Comfortable leveraging, and helping to inform the development of AI-enabled tools to transform workflows, improve response quality and timeliness, and deliver growth at scale without compromising data integrity or customer experience.

**Why Join Konovo?**

* Be part of a mission-driven organisation that is empowering life science researchers and data scientists with the broadest ecosystem of healthcare audiences and an intelligent, AI-enabled platform — so insights aren't just collected, they're connected.
* Join a fast-growing global team with opportunities for professional growth and advancement.
* Enjoy a collaborative and hybrid work environment that fosters innovation and flexibility.
* Experience a workplace that puts employees first, offering a workplace designed for growth, well-being, and balance.
* Become a part of an organisation that prioritizes your well-being with comprehensive benefits, including group medical coverage, accident insurance, and a robust leave policy. Our employee-centric policies ensure a rewarding and fulfilling work experience.
* Make a real-world impact by helping healthcare organisations innovate faster.

If you’re eager to build a meaningful career in healthcare market research — and you’re smart, nice, and driven to make an impact — we’d love to hear from you!

**Apply now to be part of our journey.**
