title: Brand Solutions Manager
description:
**About Us**

Barcode Entertainment is a leading influencer marketing agency, known for collaborating with premium brands and creators to deliver creative campaigns. Now part of Ykone group, a global influencer marketing network, we are expanding our reach both nationally and internationally and redefining what brand-creator partnerships can achieve at scale.

**About the role**

We're looking for a sharp, proactive Brand Solutions Manager who leads with thinking and follows through with action. This is not a role for someone who waits for briefs. You will identify brands worth going after, find the gap or opportunity in their current marketing, build a compelling insight-led strategy around it. And then use that strategy to open the doors. The pitch is your introduction. The relationship is what you build from there.

If you're someone who reads a brand's campaign, immediately spots what's missing, and knows exactly what to tell the brand team to get a meeting, this role is for you.

**What you'll do**

***Primary - Identify & Strategise***

* Continuously scan the market to identify brands actively investing in influencer marketing in India
* Analyse their current marketing approach and identify gaps, whitespaces, or untapped opportunities
* Build sharp, insight-led influencer marketing strategies tailored to the brand unprompted, before any brief exists
* Stay deeply plugged into platform trends, creator culture, and pop culture to keep pitches relevant and timely

***Secondary - Outreach & open doors***

* Use your strategy as the hook to reach out to brand decision-makers. (Marketing heads, CMOs, founders, brand managers)
* Initiate conversations via LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp, calls, events, and your own network
* Pitch with confidence, handle objections, and convert initial interest into a defined brief or meeting
* Collaborate with internal strategy, creative, and influencer teams to develop the full campaign proposal
* Manage the conversation through to closure, ensuring alignment between client expectations and delivery

**What we're looking for**

* 2+ years of experience in brand solutions, business development, or partnerships, ideally within influencer marketing, digital marketing, or a creative agency
* A strategic thinker who can spot a brand opportunity before the brand does
* Strong understanding of Instagram, YouTube (TikTok is a plus), and the broader creator economy in India
* Excellent written and verbal communication, you can write a cold email or LinkedIn message that actually gets a reply
* Comfortable initiating conversations with senior decision-makers without a warm introduction
* Highly organised, self-directed, and comfortable working without a playbook
* Genuine passion for brands, culture, and the influencer space

**The one thing that matters most**

You should be able to look at a brand, identify what's missing in their influencer marketing, build a strategy around it, and get in front of the right person at the brand team.

All before anyone asks you to.

If that sounds like how you already think, we'd like to meet you.

title: Technical Account Manager
description:
**About the role**

Responsive is the leader in Strategic Response Management. Its AI-driven platform is trusted by more than 2,000 companies, including over 25 of the Fortune 100, to answer RFPs, RFIs, DDQs, security questionnaires and other buyer questions faster. The company reports more than $1 trillion in opportunities managed on the platform, and its AI agents now support teams across the pursuit lifecycle. The product range includes Response Projects, Requirements Analysis, LookUp, Trust Center and Request Projects, with native integrations to tools such as Salesforce and Microsoft 365.

For many of our enterprise customers, Responsive sits in the middle of revenue-critical deadlines. As a Technical Account Manager in Premium Support, you will be the named technical partner for a small portfolio of these customers and report to the Head of Premium Support. You will keep their deployments healthy and well configured, make sure every issue has one accountable owner from first report to resolution, and explain technical matters clearly to people ranging from system administrators to senior business sponsors. You will speak with customers every day and work closely with Customer Success, Support, Engineering and Product.

**Responsibilities**

**Own the technical relationship**

* Act as the named technical contact for 4 to 6 Premium accounts. Build trust with administrators, IT and security teams, and proposal operations leaders.
* Run the technical onboarding for each Premium account and maintain its technical profile and escalation matrix.
* Hold regular technical syncs and monthly service reviews with customers, and prepare and present the technical section of quarterly business reviews with the CSM & AM/CAE.

**Communicate clearly with customers and stakeholders**

* Give timely written and verbal updates on cases and escalations at the agreed rhythm, in plain language suited to the audience.
* Set honest expectations in alignment with Engineering: say what is known, what is not yet known, the next step and when the customer will hear from you.
* Prepare and lead customer calls and workshops with a clear agenda, record actions and send follow-ups within one business day.
* Handle frustrated stakeholders calmly, and engage the relevant stakeholders proactively when a relationship is at risk.

**Manage the portfolio and cross-team work**

* Prioritise across your accounts by severity, customer deadlines and business impact. Keep the account tracker, risks and open actions current.
* Monitor the Premium queue, check severity, and engage the right expertise in Support, Engineering, Product and Professional Services. Keep one clear thread of status for each case.
* Diagnose problems using logs, API responses and reproduction steps before escalating. Write escalation briefs for Engineering with evidence, business impact and deadline, and track each to closure.

**Keep deployments healthy**

* Run scheduled health checks on configuration, identity and provisioning, integrations, content library governance and AI features. Document findings and follow actions to completion.
* Assess the impact of upcoming releases on each account and brief customers ahead of time.
* Deliver enablement sessions and written guidance on best practices.

**Improve the product and the process**

* Analyse ticket patterns and open problem records for recurring issues.
* Submit structured product feedback with account impact and evidence, and close the loop with customers.
* Write runbooks, playbooks and articles. Share learning with peers.

**Support the commercial relationship**

* Flag renewal risk and expansion signals to the account manager, and provide technical input for renewals and security or architecture reviews.

**Requirements**

**Essential**

* 8+ years of experience, including at least 4+ years in a customer-facing technical role in B2B SaaS. Suitable backgrounds include technical account management, L2 or L3 support engineering, solution consulting and customer-success engineering.
* Strong written and spoken English. You can write a clear customer update and lead a call with both technical and business audiences.
* Experience handling escalations and difficult conversations with enterprise customers while keeping the relationship intact.
* Able to manage several accounts and competing priorities at once, with reliable follow-through and tidy records.
* Familiarity with major cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud, or Microsoft Azure, as well as SQL/NoSQL databases, vector stores for AI agents, agentic data architectures, and retrieval systems.
* Adept at technical troubleshooting and root cause analysis using application logs, API responses, developer tools, and diagnostic workflows to resolve complex enterprise platform issues.
* Working familiarity with SSO and provisioning standards (SAML 2.0, OpenID Connect, SCIM) and identity providers such as Okta or Microsoft Entra ID.
* Familiarity with enterprise integrations, for example Salesforce, Microsoft Dynamics or Microsoft 365.
* Degree in engineering, computer science or IT, or equivalent experience.

**Preferred**

* Experience with enterprise customers in financial services, healthcare, technology or telecoms.
* Experience with RFP, proposal, content-management, knowledge-management or GRC platforms.
* Deep functional understanding of GenAI/LLM architectures and frameworks (such as RAG, vector databases, and orchestrators like LangChain/LlamaIndex) from a Technical Account Manager perspective—focusing on system capabilities, troubleshooting data flow, evaluating retrieval accuracy, and guiding enterprise customers on best practices.
* Familiarity with incident and problem management (ITIL concepts). Certifications such as ITIL 4, a CRM administrator credential or an identity provider credential are a plus.
* Experience working across time zones especially with US customers.

**Behaviours**

* Communication: concise, accurate and calm, in writing and on calls.
* Customer focus: understands what the customer's deadline means to their business.
* Ownership: stays with a problem until the customer confirms it is solved.
* Composure and prioritisation under time pressure.
* Influence without authority across Support, Engineering and Product.
* Curiosity and evidence-based reasoning.
* Teamwork: acts as a strong team player, supporting colleagues and contributing positively to team culture.

Renesas is one of the top global semiconductor companies in the world. Our robust product portfolio includes world leading MCUs, SoCs, Analog and power products, plus Winning Combination solutions that curate these complementary products. We are a key supplier to the world’s leading manufacturers of electronics you rely on every day; you may not see our products, but they are all around you.
  
  
Renesas employs roughly 21,000 people in more than 30 countries worldwide. As a global team, our employees actively embody the Renesas Culture, our guiding principles based on five key elements: Transparent, Agile, Global, Innovative, and Entrepreneurial. Renesas believes in, and has a commitment to, diversity and inclusion, with initiatives and a leadership team dedicated to its resources and values. For over three decades, Altium has been pioneering next-generation electronics design by continuing to develop innovative PCB design software that supports the engineering workflow. Through continuous research and development efforts, Altium remains dedicated to bringing comprehensive design capabilities to the mainstream to help engineers to make the most of modern technologies, successfully manage projects, and deliver intelligent, connected products.

**A day in the life of our Account Manager:**

* Build and nurture relationships with new and existing customers, identifying opportunities for upselling and cross-selling Altium’s solutions.
* Ensure high post-sales satisfaction, driving renewals and long-term partnerships.
* Meet or exceed monthly, quarterly, and annual sales targets.
* With deep dive Account Mapping, should be able to Present Altium’s value proposition through presentations accordingly to various stakeholders' personas in an Account/ organisation.
* Maintain detailed and accurate records of sales activities in Altium’s CRM system.
* Execute specialized projects such as call-out campaigns and customer data updates.
* Develop and implement strategies to expand Altium’s customer base and enhance market penetration.
* Track and manage subscription renewal dates within the assigned territory to maximize retention.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders, including marketing and customer success teams, to drive customer engagement and revenue growth.
* Stay up to date with industry trends, competitor activities, and Altium’s evolving product offerings.
* Office based in Bangalore with potential travel within India

**Qualifications**
**Who We’re Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in business, communication, or a related field is desirable or a combination of equivalent education and experience.
* 10+ years of experience in SaaS software sales , preferably with a focus on annual subscriptions and maintenance contracts; ECAD, MCAD, or PLM experience is a strong plus.
* Proven leadership experience with a track record of successfully managing and coaching sales teams.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills with the ability to influence decision-makers at all levels.
* Self-driven and results-oriented with a passion for sales and business growth.
* Experience working with customers across PAN India is essential
* Proficiency in CRM systems such as Salesforce is highly desirable.
* Fluency in English is required; knowledge of additional Indian languages is a plus

**Additional Information**
Altium Limited, a part of the Renesas Group and headquartered in San Diego, California, is a global software company accelerating the pace of electronics innovation. We are redefining electronic product creation in a software-defined world with our industry-first cloud-based platform that unites every stakeholder and phase of electronics development.
  
  
From startups to world’s technology giants, our digital platforms give more power to PCB designers, supply chain, and manufacturing, letting them collaborate as never before. At Altium, our teams are empowered to innovate, collaborate globally, and help create the future of electronics development.
  
  
We believe in rewarding our employees with a competitive benefits package alongside their salary. More information will be provided during the hiring process.

title: Reseller Success Account Manager
description:
**Location:**
Bangalore

**Description**
**Position Overview**
The Reseller Success Account Manager (RSAM) at Brivo Inc. is not a traditional Customer Success role. Instead, it is a high-impact Strategic Advisor dedicated to the operational and commercial effectiveness of our partners. As an RSAM, you are the critical bridge between our sales teams and our resellers, focusing on training, product demonstrations, and operational support. Your mission is to help resellers understand the performance of their business and customers, drive business growth and retention by ensuring resellers are fully enabled and acting as their internal advocate to navigate complex account strategies and resolve roadblocks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Reseller Effectiveness & Enablement**

* Lead reseller training and conduct high-level product demonstrations.
* Provide tactical sales support, including assistance with quotes, orders, and technical support navigation.

**Strategic Advisory & Business Growth**

* Conduct regular business and strategy reviews to align partner goals with Eagle Eye solutions.
* Analyze performance data to develop success plans that drive new opportunity development, retention, and expansion.

**Internal Partnership**

* Act as the primary "bridge" between internal Sales teams and reseller partners to facilitate joint territory growth.
* Identify and resolve business roadblocks by collaborating cross-functionally with Product, Marketing, and Support teams.

**Skills, Knowledge & Expertise**

* 5–7 years in Channel Management, Reseller Success, or Account Management.
* Strong understanding of the channel sales model and experience supporting partners to drive results.
* Strong understanding of customer success methodology, including customer success lifecycle management and customer success planning.
* Expertise in conducting business reviews, strategic planning, and sales enablement.
* Demonstrated ability to act as an internal partner, navigating complex internal/external relationships to drive growth.
* Proficiency in CRM and partner management platforms.
* *Bonus: A strong desire to grow into Sales, Channel Sales, or Customer Success leadership roles.*

**About Brivo**
Brivo and Eagle Eye Networks have come together to create a category-defining, cloud-first platform at the intersection of AI and the physical world. Our mission is simple and ambitious: to make physical spaces safer, smarter, and more autonomous—from single-site businesses to global enterprises.
  
  
As the unified global leaders in cloud-based access control and video surveillance, we provide a comprehensive digital foundation for the built environment. By combining Brivo’s pioneering building access platform with Eagle Eye’s AI-powered video management system (VMS), we have created a system of intelligence that protects over 600 million square feet across 90+ countries. Every door, camera, and credential in our ecosystem acts as a real-time sensor, leveraging AI to prevent incidents, improve operations, and enable entirely new workflows across sectors, including commercial real estate, retail, healthcare, education, and critical infrastructure.
  
  
With a global footprint spanning headquarters in Bethesda, Maryland, and Austin, Texas, and international offices in Amsterdam, London, Bangalore, and Tokyo, we are leveraging our open APIs and cyber-secure cloud infrastructure to reshape the future of physical security. Join us as we build the world’s most robust platform for video intelligence and smart space automation. Learn more at www.brivo.com.
  
  
*Brivo is an equal employment opportunity employer and values diversity. Qualified candidates are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, military or veteran status, disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law. If you require reasonable accommodations during the application or interview process, please inform us.*

title: Key Account Manager
description:
Department: Strategic Partnerships / Growth & Alliances

Employment Type: Full-time

About the Role

Livspace is seeking a dynamic, result-oriented Key Account Manager (KAM) to own and scale a critical 0-to-1 growth channel in [Insert City]. In this high-impact role, you will build and manage strategic relationships with premier real estate developers/builders to secure exclusive access to new homeowners. You will be responsible for building a ₹50 Cr – ₹100 Cr business pipeline by driving end-to-end lead generation, executing co-branded campaigns, managing builder SLAs, and collaborating closely with internal design and sales teams to convert leads into realized revenue.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Account Management & Builder Alliances ●

Pitch Livspace's value proposition to top-tier real estate builders, C-level executives, and site marketing teams to secure exclusive partnerships.

● Serve as the single point of contact for builder accounts, maintaining long-term relationships and high stakeholder trust.

● Ensure all mutual commitments, SLAs, and commercial agreements between Livspace and builder partners are strictly honored.

2. Demand Generation & Campaign Execution

● Devise and execute innovative go-to-market (GTM) strategies and joint marketing campaigns (e.g., site branding, customer activation drives, exclusive builder design packages) by convincing and aligning builder leadership.

● Acquire homeowner databases and leads from partner builders and drive structured direct-outreach initiatives (calls, activation events, exclusive design expos).

3. Lead Conversion & Revenue Realization

● Seamlessly hand off acquired leads to Livspace's Design and Sales teams, ensuring high customer engagement and intent.

● Track the complete customer journey from initial outreach $\rightarrow$ design consultation $\rightarrow$ booking $\rightarrow$ final revenue realization.

● Unblock operational bottlenecks between internal teams (Design, Business Development, Operations) and external stakeholders to maximize conversion rates.

4. P&L & Channel Ownership (0-to-1 Scaling)

● Own the P&L and growth trajectory for the Builder Channel in the city, scaling revenue from scratch to ₹50–100 Cr.

● Track key business metrics: Partner acquisition rate, cost per lead (CPL), lead-to-conversion ratio, and gross merchandise value (GMV). Key Qualifications & Requirements

● Education: MBA is compulsory from a recognized institute.

● Experience: Minimum 2+ years of hands-on experience in P&L management, strategic alliances, key account management, or B2B2C business development.

● Track Record: Proven ability to build and scale a business channel from 0 to 1 in a fast-paced environment.

● Industry Preference: Background in Real Estate Alliances, PropTech, Interior Design, FMCG, or high-growth Tech Startups is a strong plus. Ideal Candidate Profile

● Go-Getter Execution: You don't wait for instructions; you hunt for opportunities, close deals, and make things happen on the ground.

● High Business Acumen: You understand unit economics, revenue realization, and strategic deal structuring.

● Master Persuader: Exceptional negotiation and communication skills to convince builder stakeholders and run joint initiatives effortlessly.

● Data-Driven & Structured: Ability to manage large-scale lead pipelines, track conversion funnels, and optimize campaign ROI.

What We Offer

● High Impact & Visibility: Direct ownership of a strategic ₹100 Cr growth lever for Livspace.

● Leadership Trajectory: Fast-track career growth in a rapidly expanding, market-leading organization.

● Competitive Compensation: Attractive fixed pay along with aggressive performance-linked incentives.

Days per week: 6 days Weekend Requirement: Compulsory working on Saturdays and Sundays (Non-negotiable). A weekday off will be provided.

title: Sr. Client Manager Sovereign Cloud
description:
We are Lenovo. We do what we say. We own what we do. We WOW our customers.
  
  
Lenovo is a US$83 billion revenue global technology powerhouse, ranked #153 in the Fortune Global 500, and serving millions of customers every day in 180 markets. Focused on a bold vision to deliver Smarter Technology for All, Lenovo has built on its success as the world’s largest PC company with a full-stack portfolio of AI-enabled, AI-ready, and AI-optimized devices (PCs, workstations, smartphones, tablets), infrastructure (server, storage, edge, high performance computing and software defined infrastructure), software, solutions, and services. Lenovo’s continued investment in world-changing innovation is building a more equitable, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. Lenovo is listed on the Hong Kong stock exchange under Lenovo Group Limited (HKSE: 992) (ADR: LNVGY).
  
  
This transformation together with Lenovo’s world-changing innovation is building a more inclusive, trustworthy, and smarter future for everyone, everywhere. To find out more visit www.lenovo.com, and read about the latest news via our StoryHub.
  
  
Role Summary
  
  
The Sovereign Cloud Client Manager will lead Lenovo’s growth agenda for sovereign, private, hybrid and disconnected cloud solutions across strategic enterprise and public-sector customers. The role will identify, shape and close complex opportunities where data control, jurisdictional requirements, security, operational authority, resilience and regulatory compliance are critical.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the primary customer-facing sales leader, engaging CXOs, technology leaders, risk and compliance stakeholders, and lines of business. The role will orchestrate Lenovo infrastructure, services, software, security, financing and partner capabilities to deliver end-to-end sovereign cloud outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Account Leadership
  
  

* Own the sovereign cloud strategy and sales plan for a defined portfolio of high-potential accounts and sectors.
* Develop account plans, stakeholder maps, opportunity roadmaps and executive engagement strategies.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CDOs, risk and compliance leaders, and business decision makers.
* Lead long-term transformation conversations rather than transactional infrastructure sales.

Sovereign Cloud Opportunity Creation
  
  

* Identify opportunities across sovereign private cloud, hybrid cloud, disconnected environments, data residency, regulated workloads, secure collaboration, sovereign AI and workload repatriation.
* Qualify customer requirements covering data location, access control, encryption-key custody, operational control, auditability, resilience and legal or regulatory exposure.
* Translate business, security and compliance challenges into measurable customer outcomes and compelling business cases.
* Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria and forecast discipline.

Solution Shaping Advisory
  
  

* Work with solution architects and services teams to define the customer’s target sovereignty posture and deployment model.
* Shape solutions spanning Lenovo ThinkAgile, compute, storage, networking, security, management, lifecycle services and as-a-service capabilities.
* Position hybrid and disconnected operating models based on workload criticality, regulatory needs, connectivity and operational requirements.
* Ensure the proposed architecture aligns infrastructure, software, services, governance and customer operating processes.

Pursuit Deal Management
  
  

* Lead pursuit strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder sovereign cloud opportunities.
* Orchestrate resources across ISG, SSG, product, pre-sales, security, finance, legal, delivery and business partners.
* Drive proposal development, bid governance, commercial negotiations, risk management and deal closure.
* Maintain opportunity hygiene, forecasting accuracy, review cadence and executive sponsorship.

Executive Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Create and execute CXO engagement plans, executive briefings, workshops and sovereignty discovery sessions.
* Position Lenovo as a strategic partner for secure, compliant and resilient cloud transformation.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and other cloud, software, security, networking and services partners to build differentiated solutions.
* Represent customer requirements internally and influence solution, go-to-market and investment priorities.

Success Measures
  
  

* Qualified sovereign cloud pipeline and progression through agreed sales stages.
* Revenue, margin and signings performance against assigned targets.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and expansion within priority accounts.
* Quality of account plans, executive relationships, forecast accuracy and cross-functional execution.
* Customer adoption outcomes and creation of repeatable references or use cases.

Education Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; full-time MBA preferred.
* 12-18 years of overall experience, including at least 10 years in enterprise technology sales.
* Minimum 3 years of consultative or value-based solution selling in cloud, data center, security, infrastructure, managed services or complex transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing large accounts and multi-party pursuits involving customers, OEMs, cloud providers, software partners and system integrators.
* Experience in regulated industries, government, critical infrastructure or customers with stringent sovereignty requirements is strongly preferred.

Skills Competencies
  
  

* Strong understanding of sovereign cloud principles, including data residency, jurisdictional control, access governance, key custody, auditability, resilience and disconnected operations.
* Working knowledge of hybrid/private cloud architectures, virtualization, containers, compute, storage, networking, security and lifecycle operations.
* Ability to connect technical and regulatory requirements with commercial value and business outcomes.
* Strong executive presence, strategic thinking, consultative selling and business storytelling.
* Proven influencing, negotiation, stakeholder management and pursuit leadership skills.
* High collaboration across functions, geographies and partner ecosystems.
* Strong account planning, opportunity management, pipeline hygiene and forecasting discipline.
* Comfort operating in an emerging market with evolving offerings, regulations and customer requirements.

*We are an Equal Opportunity Employer and do not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment because of race, color, sex, age, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, status as a veteran, and basis of disability or any federal, state, or local protected class.*

title: Senior Manager-Global Market Development (Beauty & Personal care)
description:
**About US**
Scimplify is a science-first manufacturing company for Advanced Materials: from specialty chemicals to the emerging building blocks of next-generation energy applications, life sciences, and crop sciences.
  
  
We scale process development and manufacturing as one continuous system, supported by world-class R&D infrastructure and executed across a global network of 500+ manufacturing partners and thousands of scientists and technical partners. The result: new materials go from molecule to commercial scale in months, not years. Scimplify operates offices and teams across 5 countries with 1,000+ innovator customers in 40+ countries.
  
  
We are backed by investors such as Accel, Bertelsmann, Omnivore, Hitachi Ventures and 3one4 Capital, having raised over $80M.
  
  
**About The Role**
Build international business for Scimplify’s care ingredients portfolio, beginning with MEA and LATAM. You will personally develop direct customers and distributor business while bringing a broad view of customer needs, competing offerings and gaps in the market. The role offers close partnership with the business leader as the portfolio develops.
  
  
**What You Will Own**

* Translate regional priorities into country and account plans, with an initial focus on MEA and LATAM and phased development of Europe and the USA.
* Personally build customer relationships, manage qualification projects and convert approved trials into commercial orders and repeat business.
* Activate the initial distributor network through joint development plans, technical engagement and disciplined opportunity follow-up; identify coverage gaps for discussion.
* Understand unmet application needs, supply gaps and weaknesses in current customer options, and propose promising ingredient opportunities to the business leader.
* Act as a thoughtful sounding board in product-opportunity discussions, grounding ideas in customer feedback and market evidence.
* Work with the application lead and established sourcing, regulatory, quotation and logistics teams to progress customer projects and resolve barriers to adoption.
* Own territory forecasts and opportunity visibility, negotiate within agreed authority and coordinate delivery and payment follow-up with support teams.

**What You Bring**

* Demonstrated success developing international B2B ingredient or specialty chemical business through direct customers and distribution partners.
* Typically 10–14 years of relevant commercial experience, including personal ownership of international accounts or territories.
* MEA or LATAM experience is especially relevant; exposure to both is preferred. Existing care or aroma customer and distributor relationships are an advantage.
* Commercial curiosity and practical judgment: you can identify why customers need a different product and discuss the opportunity clearly without overstating the evidence.
* Strong negotiation, cross-cultural communication and forecasting skills; independent execution and willingness to travel internationally for customers, distributors and industry events.

**Success measures**
Establish priority account and distributor plans, qualify launch opportunities and begin a regular discussion of
  
  
customer-led product gaps with the business leader. Success will be measured through customer conversion, repeat orders, distributor contribution, territory sales and the usefulness of market insights.

title: Manager, Data Support (IN)
description:

Rippling gives businesses one place to run HR, IT, and Finance. It brings together all of the workforce systems that are normally scattered across a company, like payroll, expenses, benefits, and computers. For the first time ever, you can manage and automate every part of the employee lifecycle in a single system.
  
  
Take onboarding, for example. With Rippling, you can hire a new employee anywhere in the world and set up their payroll, corporate card, computer, benefits, and even third-party apps like Slack and Microsoft 365—all within 90 seconds.
  
  
Based in San Francisco, CA, Rippling has raised $1.4B+ from the world’s top investors—including Kleiner Perkins, Founders Fund, Sequoia, Greenoaks, and Bedrock—and was named one of America's best startup employers by Forbes.
  
  
We prioritize candidate safety. Please be aware that all official communication will only be sent from @Rippling.com addresses.

We are building a world-class Support team - committed to helping customers realize the full potential of Rippling. Team members focus on getting our customers back on course when challenges arise and contribute to internal discussions around product enhancements. Our Support Organization is composed of product specific teams such as HR, IT and Finance.
  
  
If you are the type of person to look at a flight of 10,000 stairs, pause, get a bit excited, and then seize the moment - you have what it takes!
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Become a subject matter expert on our product through direct customer support and product/engineering interaction
* Lead a team of developer support specialists tasked with providing product support to customers
* Iterate on the onboarding program for team members as the team grows
* Ensure your team is set up with the tools and resources they need to help customers through the product release
* Own team performance and KPIs and drive improvements with data-driven experimentation
* Be the subject matter expert for support practices

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: Market Development Specialist
description:
🇺🇸 US Market Development & Field Sales Executive

Chennai, India + USA | 6 Months India / 6 Months USA

We are looking for highly articulate, commercially driven and research-oriented sales professionals to join our US healthcare business development team.

This is a unique opportunity for professionals who want to build a long-term career in US B2B sales and business development.

The role will be divided approximately equally between India and the USA:

6 months in India: Research, prospect identification, account intelligence, pre-sales and pipeline development.

6 months in the USA: In-person meetings, relationship building, field sales, conferences and business development.

🇮🇳 Your role in India – Pre-Sales & Pipeline Development

You will be responsible for doing the detailed groundwork before an opportunity reaches the US sales team.

You will:

* Research target US healthcare organizations
* Understand the company's business model, size, locations, services and estimated revenue
* Research the organization's current business challenges and potential areas of opportunity
* Identify the right decision-makers and influencers
* Research executives and their backgrounds
* Identify verified contact information
* Build detailed account/prospect profiles
* Identify potential buying signals and business opportunities
* Conduct LinkedIn, email and telephone outreach
* Qualify prospects
* Develop relationships with prospects before the sales team engages
* Schedule qualified meetings
* Maintain detailed CRM information
* Prepare account intelligence and briefing notes for the US sales team
* Continuously build a qualified pipeline

The objective is not simply to generate leads.

The objective is to deliver well-researched, qualified business opportunities to the US sales team.

🇺🇸 Your role in the USA – Field Sales & Business Development

During your US assignment, you will transition into a client-facing role.

You will:

* Meet prospects and decision-makers in person
* Visit healthcare organizations
* Conduct business development meetings
* Attend conferences and industry events
* Build executive relationships
* Follow up on opportunities developed during your India phase
* Identify new business opportunities
* Participate in discovery meetings
* Support presentations and proposals
* Work closely with the US sales leadership
* Develop opportunities through the sales cycle
* Represent Scintillate professionally in the US market

🎯 Strict Qualification Criteria

We are looking for a very specific profile. Please apply only if you meet most of the following requirements.

* Education
  Postgraduate degree is mandatory
* MBA / PGDM in Marketing, Sales, Business Development, International Business, Healthcare Management or a related discipline preferred
* Candidates with strong academic backgrounds and relevant postgraduate specialization will be preferred
* Experience
  3–7 years of relevant experience
* Prior experience in US-focused pre-sales, business development, inside sales, lead generation or market research is mandatory
* Experience selling into the US market is strongly preferred
* Experience dealing with US healthcare organizations, healthcare services, RCM, DMEPOS, medical billing, healthcare IT, BPO or SaaS will be a significant advantage
* Candidates must have experience independently researching US prospects and identifying decision-makers
* Experience using LinkedIn, Sales Navigator, Apollo, ZoomInfo, Crunchbase or similar sales intelligence/prospecting platforms preferred
* Hands-on experience working with a CRM such as HubSpot, Salesforce, Zoho, Nutshell or similar

🗣️ Communication — Critical Requirement

Excellent English communication skills are mandatory.

The candidate must be:

* Extremely articulate and confident in spoken English
* Comfortable speaking with US C-level executives, VPs, Directors and business owners
* Able to conduct a professional discovery conversation
* Able to ask intelligent business questions
* Able to understand and respond to different US accents
* Able to communicate clearly without excessive reliance on scripts
* Strong in business writing, including emails and LinkedIn communication
* Comfortable presenting information to senior executives
* Able to communicate professionally in person as well as virtually

Candidates with weak spoken English or limited experience communicating with US business executives will not be considered.

🔎 Research & Analytical Skills

This is equally important.

The candidate should be able to take a company name and independently answer:

Who are they?

What do they do?

How large are they?

What is their approximate revenue?

Where do they operate?

Who makes the decision?

What problems might they have?

Why would they potentially need our services?

Who else should we speak with?

You should enjoy researching companies and people, not just making calls.

* ✈️ Mobility & Travel

title: GTM Specialist
description:
Remote · Contract / Part-time

**About SimpliReply**

SimpliReply is a done-for-you WhatsApp follow-up system for businesses that run ads. We reply to every lead in 5 seconds, qualify them, and follow up for 14 days until they book.

Your ads bring leads. We follow up until they buy.

**The role**

We have the product. We need the go-to-market system. Your job is to build a repeatable way to find, convert and onboard customers, and to prove it works by landing our first 5 customers.

**What you’ll do**

* Pick the first niche with us and define the ideal customer
* Build the acquisition system: lead list → outreach → lead magnet (Secret Lead Test) → free pilot → paid plan
* Write outreach scripts, follow-up sequences and the sales call flow
* Set up simple tracking (pipeline, conversion at each step)
* Run it alongside the founder and coach him to own it after you leave
* Document everything as a playbook we can repeat

Success = 5 customers

Month 1: niche picked, system built, first conversations booked

Month 2: 3 pilots running, first paid conversion

Month 3: 5 customers (paid or converting) + documented playbook

**You’re a fit if you**

* Have built GTM or sales funnels for an early-stage B2B SaaS or service business
* Have taken a product from 0 to its first customers
* Are comfortable with cold outreach, LinkedIn, WhatsApp and Meta ads
* Think in systems, not one-off campaigns
* Like teaching as much as doing

**Bonus**

Experience with SMBs in India (clinics, real estate, coaching, D2C)

Familiarity with WhatsApp automation or chatbots

Compensation : fixed + performance-based

title: D&A MDG Solution Consultant
description:
**D&A MDG Solution Consultant**

**Position Overview:**

Join us as a SAP MDG (Master Data Governance) Solution Consultant for guiding our organization through the implementation and optimization of SAP MDG solutions. You’ll play a pivotal role in understanding business requirements related to master data management and translating them into technical solutions using SAP MDG. This role requires deep expertise in SAP MDG modules, data modeling, data governance best practices, and excellent communication skills to effectively collaborate with business stakeholders and technical teams.

**Typical Accountabilities**

Requirement Gathering: Collaborate with business stakeholders to understand master data management requirements, including data governance rules, data quality standards, and business processes.

Solution Design: Design comprehensive SAP MDG solutions tailored to meet business needs, ensuring alignment with industry best practices and compliance requirements.

Configuration and Customization: Configure SAP MDG modules to support data governance processes, including data modeling, workflows, data validation rules, and user interfaces,

**including:**

* Data Model Enhancement, Data Transfer (DIF/DEF), Data Replication Framework (DRF), Business Rules Framework plus (BRFplus)
* Configuration rule-based Workflow
* Integrating business process requirements with the technical implementation of SAP Master Data Governance
* User interface modelling (Design and Creation of UI, Value restriction, Define navigation elements of type Hyperlink or Push button, Data quality, Validation and Derivation rules)
* Process Modelling (Entity, Business Activity change, Request type, Workflow, Edition type,

Relationship, Data replication techniques, SOA service, ALE connection, Key value mapping, Data

transfer, Export import master data, Convert master data) Integration Management: Implement integrations between SAP MDG and other systems (such as ERP and BI) to ensure seamless data flow and consistency across the organization.

Data Quality Management: Define data quality metrics and implement data quality rules within SAP MDG to maintain high-quality master data.

Training and Documentation: Develop training materials and provide guidance to end-users on SAP MDG functionalities and best practices. Create documentation for configuration, customizations, and user guides.

Testing and Quality Assurance: Lead testing activities to validate the functionality, performance, and reliability of SAP MDG solutions. Collaborate with QA teams to identify and address any issues or defects.

Change Management: Facilitate change management processes to ensure smooth adoption of SAP MDG solutions within the organization. Provide ongoing support and guidance to stakeholders during and after implementation.

Continuous Improvement: Stay updated on latest SAP MDG developments, trends, and best practices.

Identify opportunities for process improvements and optimization of existing solutions.

**Education, Qualifications and Experience**

 Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or related field.

 Minimum of 3 years of experience in SAP MDG implementation and customization.

 Proficiency in SAP MDG modules such as Material, Customer, Vendor, or Financials.

 Strong understanding of data modeling concepts and data governance principles.

 Experience with SAP integration technologies (e.g., IDoc, RFC, BAPI).

 Certification in SAP MDG is preferred.

description:
**Description**
The Amazon Web Services Professional Services (ProServe) team is seeking a skilled Delivery Consultant to join our team at Amazon Web Services (AWS). In this role, you'll work closely with customers to design, implement, and manage AWS solutions that meet their technical requirements and business objectives. You'll be a key player in driving customer success through their cloud journey, providing technical expertise and best practices throughout the project lifecycle.
  
  
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
Possessing a deep understanding of AWS products and services, as a Delivery Consultant you will be proficient in architecting complex, scalable, and secure solutions tailored to meet the specific needs of each customer. You’ll work closely with stakeholders to gather requirements, assess current infrastructure, and propose effective migration strategies to AWS. As trusted advisors to our customers, providing guidance on industry trends, emerging technologies, and innovative solutions, you will be responsible for leading the implementation process, ensuring adherence to best practices, optimizing performance, and managing risks throughout the project.
  
  
The AWS Professional Services organization is a global team of experts that help customers realize their desired business outcomes when using the AWS Cloud. We work together with customer teams and the AWS Partner Network (APN) to execute enterprise cloud computing initiatives. Our team provides assistance through a collection of offerings which help customers achieve specific outcomes related to enterprise cloud adoption. We also deliver focused guidance through our global specialty practices, which cover a variety of solutions, technologies, and industries.
  
  
Are you an experienced Oracle/SQL Server Platform Specialist? Have you worked on Open source Database platforms like PostgreSQL, MySQL, MariaDB or Cassandra? Have you migrated Applications from one Database Engine to another? Do you like to engage with senior leadership and determine ways to optimize the IT Platforms & Infrastructure? Do you like to solve the most complex and high scale data challenges in the world today? Do you want to have an impact in the development and use of new platform technologies? Would you like a career that gives you opportunities to help organizations understand and use cloud computing web services to do big new things faster, at lower cost?
  
  
You will collaborate with our internal customers and partners in AWS ProServe India LLP on key engagements for internal customers and will assist in developing and delivering proof-of-concept projects, technical workshops, and support implementation projects in order to migrate Applications from Oracle/SQL Server databases to Aurora-PostgreSQL/MySQL or other Open Source platforms using latest GenAI tooling available
  
  
Our professional services engagements will focus on internal customer’s solutions such as high volume OLTP/OLAP environments, batch data processing, designing and deploying future state petabyte-scale data warehouse service and building and/or designing reference configurations to enable our customers and influence AWS RDS, Aurora, DynamoDB and Redshift adoption.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
As an experienced technology professional, you will be responsible for:
  
  
Designing and implementing complex, scalable, and secure AWS solutions tailored to customer needs
  
  
Providing technical guidance and troubleshooting support throughout project delivery
  
  
Collaborating with stakeholders to gather requirements and propose effective migration strategies
  
  
Acting as a trusted advisor to customers on industry trends and emerging technologies
  
  
Sharing knowledge within the organization through mentoring, training, and creating reusable artifacts
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job below, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS?
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon (diversity) conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Knowledge of the primary aws services (ec2, elb, rds, route53 & s3)
* Experience implementing AWS services in a variety of distributed computing environments
* Experience in advanced SQL & ability to write complex queries from scratch from multiple tables
* Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience in Postgres, or experience in software development and experience in SQL Server/MySQL
* Experience in written and verbal communication with the ability to present complex technical information in a clear and concise manner to executives and non-technical leaders

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 4+ years of database administration experience, or Bachelor's degree in engineering, technology, computer science, machine learning, robotics, operations research, statistics, mathematics or equivalent quantitative field
* Experience with the AWS platform, web services, software development, or related technologie
* AWS Professional level certification, or Bachelor's degree in business administration, finance, economics, computer science, data science, engineering, or other related field
* Experience scripting for automation (e.g., Python, Perl, Ruby)
* Knowledge of security and compliance standards including HIPAA and GDPR
* Experience in Database like NoSQL, or experience in any Bigdata architecture and experience in Hive/Spark/Hbase/Yarn
* Experience with massively parallel processing (MPP) databases - Redshift, Teradata etc.

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. title: Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth
description:
The Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth is part of the build-out of the Strategy team. This hire adds dedicated capacity across the team's strategy and growth agenda: sizing and prioritizing growth opportunities, evaluating portfolio and pricing performance, building business cases, and preparing executive materials.
  
  
The role sits at the threshold of manager. Projects of moderate complexity are run largely independently, with 80 to 90 percent ownership, and the most complex initiatives are supported alongside the Senior Director, Strategy and Growth, and the team. Exceptional candidates may be considered at Manager level.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Growth strategy and opportunity sizing. Size and prioritize growth opportunities across new products, adjacent markets, partner and channel models, and pricing, using top-down and bottom-up approaches with clearly stated assumptions.
* Project leadership. Run moderate-complexity strategy projects from scoping to final recommendation, and support the Senior Director, Strategy and Growth, and the team on the most complex initiatives.
* Portfolio and product performance. Analyze ARR, retention, bookings, packaging, and price across the product portfolio. Identify the drivers of performance and quantify the levers available to improve it.
* Business cases and scenario modeling. Build financial models and business cases for initiatives, investments, and strategic options, with sensitivities and a recommended path.
* Executive communication. Produce board, executive team, and cross-functional materials with an answer-first storyline, tight visuals, and precise language. Present findings to senior stakeholders.
* Cross-functional partnership. Work with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Pricing teams to gather inputs, test hypotheses, and carry recommendations into planning and execution.
* Strategic planning support. Contribute to annual and long-range planning cycles, offsite preparation, and the tracking of strategic initiatives.
* Market and competitive intelligence. Provide market and competitive perspective to growth work, using research platforms and AI tools to maintain a current view of the landscape.

**Preferred**
Required Skills
  
  

* Experience in enterprise B2B software or SaaS, including subscription metrics, pricing and packaging, and partner or channel models.
* Familiarity with document processing, workflow automation, RPA, or AP automation.
* Fluency with AI tools to compress research, analysis, and synthesis time, with specific examples.
* Experience with research platforms such as Gartner, IDC, Forrester, Capital IQ, PitchBook, or CB Insights is an asset.
* Prior experience in a CEO office, CxO office, or chief-of-staff style role, or in M&A diligence.

Competencies
  
  

* Structured thinking. Frames ambiguous problems into clear questions and tests them with evidence.
* Commercial judgment. Connects analysis to revenue, margin, and customer outcomes.
* Communication. Writes and presents with precision and gets to the point quickly.
* Ownership. Drives work to completion, checks accuracy, and raises risks early.
* Collaboration across time zones. Works effectively with US-based leaders and global colleagues.

**Qualifications**
Required Experience
  
  
**Required**

* 2 to 5 years of experience, including at least 3 years in management consulting, corporate strategy, strategy and operations, or a strategic insights function.
* Demonstrated market sizing and growth analysis, with an example of an analysis that informed a business decision.
* Advanced Excel and financial modeling skills, with working knowledge of SQL and Power BI to retrieve and analyze data independently.
* Strong PowerPoint and written communication skills, including experience presenting to director level and above.
* Hypothesis-driven approach to problem solving, and the ability to own projects with limited direction.
* MBA or equivalent master's degree preferred.
* Fluent business English, written and spoken.

title: Product Specialist and Onboarding Executive Intern
description:
**Company Description:**

Cravioo is a growing organization focused on delivering high-quality solutions and services to its clients. The company values collaboration, clear communication, and strong customer relationships to drive successful outcomes. Team members are encouraged to take initiative, contribute ideas, and support continuous improvement across processes. Cravioo offers an environment where individuals can develop their skills while working closely with clients and colleagues. The company is committed to maintaining an inclusive, respectful, and performance-driven workplace.

**Role Description**

The Onboarding Specialist at Cravioo is a part-time, on-site role based in the Greater Hyderabad Area.

In this role, the specialist guides new clients through the onboarding process, ensuring a smooth transition from initial sign-up to active use of Cravioo’s products or services.

Day-to-day tasks include conducting onboarding meetings, gathering client requirements, configuring accounts, and walking clients through product features and best practices.

The specialist also responds to client questions, identifies potential issues early, and coordinates with internal teams to resolve them. Maintaining accurate onboarding documentation, tracking progress, and providing clear status updates to clients and stakeholders are key aspects of this position.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Identify, contact, and visit local restaurant owners to introduce them to our platform.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of potential restaurant partners within assigned territories.
* Conduct outreach through calls, in-person visits, and relationship-building activities to onboard new merchants.
* Clearly explain the app’s features, pricing structure, and value proposition to restaurant owners.
* Demonstrate how the platform can help increase delivery sales and improve restaurant operations.
* Guide restaurant owners through the onboarding process, including account registration and profile setup.
* Assist in uploading menus, adding business information, setting banking details, and configuring operating hours.
* Train restaurant staff on how to use the merchant dashboard and manage incoming digital orders.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for new partners during their first 30 days to ensure a smooth launch.
* Track onboarding progress, resolve merchant issues, and maintain high conversion and activation rates.
* Collaborate with internal teams to improve merchant experience and support growth targets.

**Qualifications**

* Strong client-facing skills, including Customer Onboarding and Client Onboarding capabilities.
* Excellent Interpersonal Skills and Communication skills for engaging with clients and internal teams.
* Solid Analytical Skills to understand client needs, interpret data, and troubleshoot onboarding challenges.
* Ability to manage multiple onboarding processes, prioritize tasks, and maintain organized records.
* Experience in customer success, account management, or implementation roles is beneficial.
* Comfort working on-site in the Greater Hyderabad Area and collaborating with cross-functional teams.
* Proficiency with common office software and CRM or onboarding tools is an advantage.
* Relevant education in business, communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

**Mobility**

* Willingness to travel locally to meet restaurant owners face-to-face.
* Ability to work in a field-based role with frequent travel and on-site meetings.

**Pay Scale**

Performance Incentives

You will have opportunity to earn incentives up to ₹25,000 per month based on achievements.

**Minimum hours to work per week: 10 hours. 2hours per day. More hours you work more you get paid.**

title: RC FS-BT INS-P And C-Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Service line - Position Title:**
**Business Consultant -Senior**
At EY, we’re all in to shape your future with confidence.
  
  
We’ll help you succeed in a globally connected powerhouse of diverse teams and take your career wherever you want it to go.
  
  
Join EY and help to build a better working world.
  
  
**About Global Delivery Services**
Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.
  
  
Enablement Services provides cost-effective, high-skilled, and innovative services to support EY’s global and local enablement teams. Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.
* Define scope by providing innovative solutions and challenging all new client requirements and change requests but simultaneously ensuring that client gets the required business value.
* Elaborate and deliver clearly defined requirement documents with relevant dataflow and process flow diagrams.
* Work closely with product design development team to analyse and extract functional enhancements.
* Provide product consultancy and assist the client with acceptance criteria gathering and support throughout the project life cycle.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Product Knowledge – Guidewire, Duckcreek, Exigent, Majesco. (Preferred Guidewire/Duckcreek)
* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.
  
  
**Benefits**
: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.
  
  
**How to Apply**
: If you are passionate to join us and are aligned with our commitment to building a better working world, we invite you to apply by completing our user-friendly form with personal and professional information and by providing your consent to data privacy.
  
  
Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Sr. Application Architect
description:
**Description**
AWS Sales, Marketing, and Global Services (SMGS) is responsible for driving revenue, adoption, and growth from the largest and
  
  
fastest growing small- and mid-market accounts to enterprise-level customers including public sector.
  
  
Are you an experienced cloud architect/developer who can assist customers in designing and developing cloud-native, AI-integrated applications and/or re-engineering applications to fully leverage the AWS Cloud? Do you like working on game-changing projects at the forefront of application development, AI Agents, and cloud technology adoption?
  
  
AWS ProServe India LLP is looking for highly talented hands-on technical architects to accelerate our growing Professional Services business in India. You'll join Amazon's world-class technical teams, working on diverse projects including reimagining customer agent-enabled applications, modernization, Generative AI adoption, and AI-DLC application development.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Design and build well-architected, cloud-native applications leveraging AWS services (EC2, ECS, Elastic Beanstalk, Auto Scaling, etc.)
  
  
Architect AI/ML solutions using AWS AI services (Bedrock, SageMaker, Amazon Q, Rekognition, Comprehend)
  
  
Guide customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC) — from data readiness and model development to deployment and continuous improvement
  
  
Design Generative AI and Agentic AI architectures that are secure, scalable, and cost-optimized
  
  
Advise on responsible AI practices including governance, explainability, and bias detection
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
We are looking for hands-on architects/developers who are passionate about:
  
  

* Help internal customers make decisions on their cloud and AI journey, define scalable architecture, highly available solutions that leverage AWS services and AI capabilities
* Assisting internal customers to architect and develop applications that are cloud-optimized and AI-integrated, including Generative AI and Agentic AI solutions
* Working as a technical leader alongside customer business, development, and infrastructure teams
* Guiding customers through the AI Development Life Cycle (AI-DLC), from problem framing, data readiness, and model selection to deployment, evaluation, and continuous improvement
* Sharing deep software development knowledge with respect to cloud architecture, AI design patterns, and programming
* Advising and implementing AWS best practices for both cloud-native and AI-powered workloads
* Assisting internal customers in infrastructure, application development, and AI solution integration
* Assisting internal customers in agile software development and Implementation of DevOps practices
* Independently leading a team that delivers applications including AI-enabled features spanning the full software lifecycle: design, implementation, testing, deployment, and maintenance strategy
* Scoping development efforts, identifying risks, and prioritizing deliverables to meet organizational goals; providing guidance so your team designs solutions making the right trade-offs between innovation, speed, and operational excellence

**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve in the cloud.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
Here at AWS, it’s in our nature to learn and be curious. Our employee-led affinity groups foster a culture of inclusion that empower us to be proud of our differences. Ongoing events and learning experiences, including our Conversations on Race and Ethnicity (CORE) and AmazeCon conferences, inspire us to never stop embracing our uniqueness.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 10+ years of technical specialist, design and architecture experience
* 10+ years of consulting, design and implementation of serverless distributed solutions experience
* 10+ years of software development with object oriented language experience
* 10+ years of external or internal customer facing, complex and large scale project management experience
* Bachelor's degree in computer science, engineering, mathematics or equivalent
* Travel up to 30% of the time

**Preferred Qualifications**

* 6+ years of leading development of applications backed by AWS services or using other cloud based technologies and services experience
* Experience with designing and building application using AWS services such as Lambda, AWS Elastic Beanstalk, Kubernetes
* Experience in one of the following programming languages: Java, Python, Ruby, Node.js, C#, or C
* Experience in professional, non-internship software development, or experience in machine learning, data mining, information retrieval, statistics or natural language processing
* Experience with CloudFormation, Chef, Puppet, Salt, or Ansible in production environments
* Familiarity with AI-DLC data preparation, prompt engineering, model evaluation, and deploying Generative/Agentic AI solutions

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.
  
  
  
**Company**
- AWS ProServe IN - Karnataka
