title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Managed Services
description:
**Job Description**
About Outreach
  
  
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
  
  
**About The Team**
Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends.
  
  
Our Managed Service Consultants are trusted advisors. They drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You'll join our India-based Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.
  
  
You'll own a portfolio of our most strategic accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 3-5 years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
* 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
* Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

title: Management Trainee
description:
**About the Role:**

As a Management Trainee, you will support customer enquiries, cost estimation, quotation preparation, and business development activities in a fast-paced aerospace manufacturing environment. The role involves working with cross-functional teams to understand technical requirements, evaluate costs, and prepare accurate and competitive commercial proposals.

**Key Responsibilities:**



* Assist in reviewing customer enquiries, RFQs, engineering drawings, and technical specifications.

* Coordinate with Engineering, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain teams to gather inputs for cost estimation.

* Support costing activities by analysing material, manufacturing, tooling, and other applicable costs.

* Prepare cost sheets, quotations, and commercial proposals under the guidance of senior team members.

* Track customer enquiries, quotation submissions, and follow-ups to ensure timely responses.

* Assist in analysing cost structures, identifying cost optimisation opportunities, and maintaining estimation records.

* Support business opportunity tracking, MIS reports, and management presentations.

* Maintain accurate documentation and contribute to process improvement initiatives.

**Location:**
Hyderabad, India (On-site).
  

Requirements

**Required:**

* B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical, Aerospace, Industrial, or a related engineering discipline, along with an MBA in Finance or General Business Administration (Must be from 2025 graduating batch).

* Candidates with up to one year of relevant professional experience; relevant internships and academic projects will also be considered.

* Strong analytical, numerical, and problem-solving skills, with a sound understanding of financial concepts and cost analysis.

* Good communication, coordination, and stakeholder management skills.

* Proficiency in MS Excel and PowerPoint.

**Preferred:**
  

* Candidates from reputed management institutes, particularly Tier-2 IIMs, XIMB, and comparable institutions.

* Exposure to costing, estimation, business analysis, or commercial activities through internships or academic projects.

* Interest in manufacturing processes and technical-commercial analysis.

Benefits
  
  

**What You’ll Gain:**

* Hands-on exposure to customer enquiries, cost estimation, and quotation preparation in aerospace manufacturing.

* Cross-functional learning across Engineering, Production, Quality, and Supply Chain.

* Mentorship from experienced professionals to support your development.

* A foundation for future growth in business development, estimation, and commercial roles.

* Master’s degree in Business, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering or Applied Science, or a related field.
* 8 years of experience managing projects and working with analytics, software coding, or customer-side web technologies.
* Practical experience configuring, querying, or troubleshooting CRM architectures (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot, Klaviyo, or custom internal backends).
* Ability to absorb complex technical concepts and communicate them to a non-technical audience effectively.
* Ability to work independently and to manage multiple projects simultaneously, with effective problem-solving, analytical and project management skills.
* Demonstrated coding ability with Java or Python, and database knowledge with the ability to construct complex SQL queries.

**About The Job**
As a Technical Solutions Consultant, you will be responsible for the technical relationship of our largest advertising clients and/or product partners. You will lead cross-functional teams in Engineering, Sales and Product Management to leverage emerging technologies for our external clients/partners. From concept design and testing to data analysis and support, you will oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's online advertising platforms and/or product partnerships.
  
  
You will be able to balance business and partner needs with technical constraints, develop innovative, cutting edge solutions and act as a partner and consultant to those you are working with. You will also be able to build tools and automate products, oversee the technical execution and business operations of Google's partnerships, as well as develop product strategy and prioritize projects and resources.
  
  
The Product Deployment Engineering Team for Measurement Services, gTech Ads GCS, provides exceptional complex measurement implementation for Google’s top GCS advertising clients. This team serves as the critical bridge between GCS customer business requirements and gTech Ads’ service and engineering offerings.
  
  
The core objective of the team is to unlock data foundations, specifically driving the adoption of complex Google data strength products (e.g., ECL, GTG). Team members collaborate with high growth customers on non-standard, complex environments to unlock business growth and defend business. To achieve this, PDEs conduct comprehensive audits and deep-dive sessions to diagnose technical environments, identify customer pain points, and enable product adoption.
  
  
Google creates products and services that make the world a better place, and gTech’s role is to help bring them to life. Our teams of trusted advisors support customers globally. Our solutions are rooted in our technical skill, product expertise, and a thorough understanding of our customers’ complex needs. Whether the answer is a bespoke solution to solve a unique problem, or a new tool that can scale across Google, everything we do aims to ensure our customers benefit from the full potential of Google products.
  
  
To learn more about gTech, check out our video .
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with sales and product leads, evaluate client technical maturity and first-party data strategies to guide scalable solution adoption.
* Uncover custom technical opportunities while funneling critical product gaps and edge cases back to core Ads engineering.
* Translate client needs into clear system architectures, author prototype-grounded requirement documents and standardized deployment playbooks.
* Design durable, privacy-compliant data pipelines—including Google Ads API integrations—and enforce validation frameworks using real-world data subsets.
* Orchestrate cross-functional efforts across gTech and client teams to oversee smooth implementation and successful last-mile activation.

title: Consultant
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Join Veeva’s journey on building the industry cloud for life sciences. We are bringing to market a modern cloud solution designed to optimize laboratories with increased efficiency and productivity by streamlining processes. Join the team that will partner with our customers to implement one of Veeva’s newest products in Quality Cloud - Veeva LIMS.
  
  
Passionate about bringing disruptive technology to customers and have novel ideas for successful GxP software implementation? This role will allow you to help our clients to drive new product adoption through successful implementations.
  
  
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. For a candidate this is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement, if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet future travel requirements.
  
  
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in India. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visas for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Participate in projects at life sciences companies designing and deploying Quality & Manufacturing applications
* Support Functional Analysts in workshops and be part of customer discussions of the Vault Qualitysuite (Vault QMS, Vault QualityDocs, Vault Training)
* Quality/Content management solution design, prototyping, configuration, and documentation
* Solution and configuration of Veeva Vault Quality Suite per customer requirements, including workflows, document types, security, fields, page layouts, reports, dashboards, formatted output reports, and notifications
* Leveraging enablement of out-of-the-box or best practices configuration approach to solution strategy
* Assessing the impact of change on the current configuration and working with key stakeholders to make informed decisions in a timely manner
* Represent Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g., solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.)
* Ensure customer success from the beginning to the end of the engagement life cycle

**Requirements**

* 3+ years experience working with or for organizations in life sciences or healthcare
* Bachelor's Degree in Life science, computer science, or related degree
* Solid analytical and great interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* Strong attention to detail
* Highly organized
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements and willingness to "roll up your sleeves" to design and implement a solution
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements

****Nice to Have****

* Knowledge of Quality operations within the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotech industry, and/or equivalent

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: District Manager, Visakhapatnam
description:
At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the District Manager (DM) (Recon) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within the operating theatre environment and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of this environment and of the role as both a representative of Zimmer and a part of the operating theatre team. The DM is responsible for supporting current business in the Recon range of products, and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The DM (Recon) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the DM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, DM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  
Principal Duties & Responsibilities
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.
* Responsibility of primary and secondary sales in the designated territory and Key accounts.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers currently using competitor products, within targeted geographical & product areas.
* Present proposal to decision makers and convert customers to usage of Zimmer products.
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting(5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by NBM/GSM/SM (or others), including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.
* To liaise with Distributors for effective customer service, order procurement for primary sales and realization of receivables from Distributors/Hospitals of the territory in co-ordination with the Area/Regional Sales Manager and Finance Department.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and OT , where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  

* Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.

We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.
  
  

* Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.

We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.
  
  

* Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* Give back to our communities and people in need.

We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.
  
  
Your Background
  
  
**The Successful Candidate Must Possess The Following**

* Science Graduate with 3 – 5 yrs of work experience
* Preferred Qualifications in B.Pharma, Business, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in OR/OT surgical support experience, preferably in orthopedic
* Demonstrated sales abilities & a track record of successful selling to the medical profession

**Expected Areas of Competence (i.e. KSAs)**

* Working level of proficiency in the local language/English/Hindi.
* Product/Technical Knowledge
* Commercial Acumen
* Result Orientation
* Inter-personal and strong communication skills
* Tenacity

Travel Expectations
  
  
90% of the time
  
  
EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Finishing Engineer - Luxurious Residence Project
description:
Job Description – Finishing Engineer

Location: Mumbai, Santacruz

Department: Projects / Construction

Industry: Real Estate – High-Rise Residential Development

Experience: 10 -12 Years in Finishing

working for Luxurious Residential projects

Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Objective

We are looking for an experienced Finishing Engineer to manage and execute finishing works for premium high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

The candidate will be responsible for ensuring superior workmanship, adherence to drawings and specifications, timely completion, coordination between multiple agencies, systematic snagging and possession-ready delivery of apartments and common areas.

The role requires strong on-site execution capabilities and a keen eye for finishing quality and detailing.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Finishing Works Execution**

\* Plan, supervise and execute all internal and external finishing activities.

\* Manage works including:

\* Blockwork and internal plaster

\* Waterproofing

\* Screeding and flooring

\* Marble, granite and tile works

\* Gypsum/plaster and false ceilings

\* Internal and external painting

\* Doors, frames and hardware

\* Aluminium/windows and glazing

\* Railings and metal works

\* Sanitary and CP fittings

\* Kitchen and utility finishes

\* Carpentry and joinery

\* Façade finishing interfaces

\* Common areas, lift lobbies and staircases

\* Entrance lobby and other premium finishes

\* External development and landscape interfaces

**2. Quality Control**

\* Ensure finishing works are executed strictly as per approved drawings, specifications, material approvals and established quality standards.

\* Inspect workmanship at every stage instead of identifying defects only at completion.

\* Check line, level, plumb, alignment, joints, slopes, surface finish, shade variations and overall aesthetics.

\* Ensure proper protection of completed finishes to prevent damage by subsequent agencies.

\* Establish and maintain benchmark/mock-up standards before commencement of repetitive finishing works.

\* Identify defective workmanship and ensure timely rectification.

**3. MEP & Services Coordination**

\* Coordinate finishing works with electrical, plumbing, fire-fighting, HVAC, ELV and other service contractors.

\* Ensure all concealed services are inspected and approved before closing walls, ceilings, shafts or flooring.

\* Prevent rework arising from improper coordination between civil, finishing and MEP agencies.

**4. Planning & Contractor Management**

\* Prepare floor-wise and activity-wise finishing schedules in line with the overall project programme.

\* Monitor daily and weekly progress against targets.

\* Coordinate multiple contractors and vendors to maintain proper work sequence.

\* Assess manpower and material requirements in advance to avoid delays.

\* Conduct regular site coordination meetings and follow up on pending activities.

\* Verify contractor work quantities and assist in certification of bills where required.

**5. Drawings & Technical Coordination**

\* Study and implement architectural, interior, structural and MEP drawings.

\* Identify drawing discrepancies and constructability issues before execution.

\* Coordinate with architects, consultants and the project team for RFIs and technical clarifications.

\* Ensure only the latest approved drawings are being followed at site.

**6. Snagging & Possession Readiness**

\* Conduct systematic apartment-wise, floor-wise and common-area snagging.

\* Maintain snag lists with clear responsibility and closure timelines.

\* Carry out pre-handover inspections before units are offered for customer inspection.

\* Coordinate with CRM/Post-Sales teams for customer inspections and possession.

\* Ensure customer snags are attended to promptly and closed to the required quality standard.

\* Ensure flats are thoroughly checked, cleaned, functional and possession-ready before handover.

**7. Material Management**

\* Check incoming finishing materials for approved make, specification, shade and quality.

\* Monitor material consumption and minimise wastage.

\* Ensure appropriate storage and protection of high-value finishing materials.

\* Coordinate material requirements and delivery schedules with Procurement.

**8. Documentation & Reporting**

Maintain proper records of:

\* Daily progress

\* Quality inspections

\* Material approvals

\* Mock-up approvals

\* RFIs and drawing revisions

\* Snagging and closure status

\* Contractor performance

\* Floor-wise completion status

Provide regular progress and quality reports to the Project Manager/Management.

Candidate Profile

\* B.E./B.Tech Civil or Diploma in Civil Engineering

\* 10 + years of relevant experience, preferably with reputed developers or contractors executing high-rise residential projects in Mumbai.

\* Strong hands-on experience in premium residential finishing works.

\* Should have independently handled finishing of multiple floors/apartments through final possession.

\* Good understanding of architectural drawings, finishing details and MEP interfaces.

\* Strong knowledge of finishing materials, installation methodology and quality standards.

\* Ability to manage multiple contractors and large site teams.

\* Strong problem-solving and coordination abilities.

\* Extremely detail-oriented with a strong eye for workmanship, alignment, aesthetics and final presentation.

**Preferred Experience**

Preference will be given to candidates who have:

\* Worked on premium/luxury high-rise residential buildings

\* Managed finishing from bare shell through possession

\* Experience with sample/mock-up flats

\* Managed apartment and common-area snagging

\* Coordinated directly with architects and interior designers

\* Experience in customer handover and possession

\* Delivered projects with high-quality marble, stone, façade, lobby and interior finishes

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will primarily be measured on:

\* Finishing quality and workmanship

\* Floor-wise completion against schedule

\* Number of snags at internal inspection

\* Customer snags at possession

\* Snag closure turnaround time

\* Rework and material wastage

\* Contractor productivity

\* Protection of completed works

\* Readiness of apartments for possession

\* Quality of common areas and final project presentation

**Key Requirements:**

\* Strong experience in high-rise residential finishing

\* Expertise in flooring, marble/tiles, painting, gypsum, doors/windows, sanitary fittings & common-area finishes

\* Strong Civil–MEP coordination

\* Contractor & floor-wise execution management

\* Excellent eye for quality and detailing

\* Experience in snagging, possession readiness & customer handover

\* B.E./B.Tech/Diploma in Civil Engineering

Candidates who have independently handled finishing from civil completion to possession will be preferred.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹65,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Paid sick time
* Provident Fund

* How many years experience you have in Finishing?
* Where do you stay?
* What is your notice period?
* What is your current Salary?

description:
Are you commercially minded, analytical, and passionate about enabling business growth? Do you enjoy partnering with Sales and Finance to structure deals that balance
**client needs, competitiveness, profitability, and financial discipline**
?

If you have strong business acumen, a head for numbers, and the ability to influence stakeholders, this could be an opportunity for you.

**Your Role**

As a Deal Architect, you will serve as a trusted commercial partner to Sales, supporting opportunities across the deal lifecycle through deal structuring, pricing, financial analysis, commercial governance, and execution. You will collaborate cross-functionally to develop profitable solutions, manage risks, ensure financial controls, and help Sales navigate complex deals effectively.

**What You'll Do**

* Act as a trusted commercial advisor to Sales, partnering throughout the deal lifecycle to structure competitive, financially viable, and profitable deals.
* Perform rigorous pricing, cost, margin, profitability, discount, risk, and commercial analysis while ensuring strong financial governance and appropriate controls.
* Proactively manage the deal pipeline, prioritize critical and quarter-closing opportunities, drive timely approvals, and support accurate 30–60-day forecasting.
* Build strong product and commercial expertise to evaluate complex, multi-product and multi-service opportunities and their overall financial impact.
* Partner cross-functionally with Finance, Legal, Contract Management, Product, and other stakeholders to resolve deal complexities and improve speed to market.
* Enable Sales teams through guidance on pricing methodologies, commercial processes, approval requirements, new products, tools, and system enhancements.
* Drive process improvement, standardization, and automation to improve turnaround time, productivity, data quality, controls, and overall deal effectiveness.
* Support continuous transformation to create greater capacity for strategic, complex, and higher-value deal activities.

**Qualifications**

**Education**

* **Master's degree**
  , preferably in
  **Finance**

**Experience**

* **4-6 years of relevant experience**
  in areas such as:
* Deal Architecture / Deal Desk
* Commercial Structuring
* Pricing
* Financial Analysis
* Commercial Finance
* Sales Operations
* Revenue or Deal Management

**Skills & Capabilities**

* Strong financial & commercial acumen across pricing, margins, costs, and profitability.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with sound business judgment.
* Effective cross-functional collaboration across Sales, Finance, Legal, Product, and Contract Management.
* Strong communication, stakeholder management, negotiation, and influencing skills.
* Ability to balance business growth with financial controls and commercial discipline.
* Strong organizational skills to manage multiple deals and competing priorities.
* Proficiency in Excel, PowerPoint, pricing tools, CRM, dashboards, and automation solutions.
* Product and competitive landscape knowledge is an added advantage.
* Strong team collaboration and ability to support new business/product opportunities.

**What Success Looks Like**

A successful Deal Architect will:

* Enable Sales to move deals forward quickly and effectively while maintaining commercial discipline.
* Provide strong, data-driven recommendations on pricing, profitability, and deal structure.
* Build credibility as a trusted advisor to Sales and Finance stakeholders.
* Proactively identify commercial risks and opportunities.
* Contribute to automation, standardization, and continuous improvement of the deal process.
* Help improve deal turnaround time, pricing consistency, profitability, and overall stakeholder experience.

title: Travel Consultant
description:
About the Role

At
**Waari – Travel Uniquely Different**
, we believe luxury is not just about where you travel, but how you experience the world.

We are looking for a passionate, detail-oriented, and well-travelled
**Luxury Travel Consultant**
who can transform travel aspirations into extraordinary, tailor-made journeys. From handpicked luxury stays and private transfers to immersive cultural encounters and exclusive experiences, you will craft itineraries that reflect each traveller’s unique preferences, personality, and definition of luxury.

As the primary point of contact throughout the travel journey, you will combine destination expertise, creative itinerary design, and exceptional client service to deliver seamless, memorable experiences for discerning travellers.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Crafting Bespoke Luxury Experiences**

* Design highly personalised domestic and international itineraries tailored to clients’ interests, travel styles, budgets, and expectations.
* Curate premium and luxury experiences, including boutique and luxury hotels, private guided tours, exclusive excursions, fine dining, and unique local encounters.
* Develop in-depth knowledge of luxury destinations, emerging travel trends, exceptional properties, and offbeat experiences across Europe, the Americas, Asia, Africa, and beyond.
* Manage end-to-end travel arrangements, including flights, luxury accommodation, private transfers, rail journeys, curated activities, and destination experiences.

**2. Luxury Sales & Client Relationship Management**

* Engage with discerning clients, understand their travel aspirations, and convert enquiries into confirmed bookings through consultative selling.
* Recommend and upsell relevant premium services, room categories, exclusive experiences, private guides, and other value-added offerings.
* Build long-term relationships by understanding individual client preferences and delivering consistently personalised service.
* Drive repeat business, referrals, and revenue growth within the luxury FIT segment.

**3. Seamless Travel Operations**

* Ensure accuracy in bookings, travel documentation, confirmations, vouchers, visa information, and pre-departure communication.
* Coordinate effectively with international DMCs, hotels, airlines, and ground-handling partners to deliver seamless travel experiences.
* Provide timely on-tour assistance and resolve unexpected changes or travel disruptions with professionalism and composure.
* Maintain detailed client records, itinerary documentation, and sales pipelines using travel CRM systems.

**4. Destination Expertise & Continuous Learning**

* Stay updated on luxury travel trends, emerging destinations, premium hospitality offerings, and experiential travel.
* Build strong supplier relationships to access quality services, competitive commercial terms, and distinctive experiences.
* Continuously enhance destination knowledge to create itineraries that go beyond the conventional and deliver genuine value.

What We’re Looking For

* 3–7 years of relevant experience in tailor-made travel, luxury FIT, premium holiday planning, or customised international travel.
* Strong knowledge of international destinations, flight connectivity, seasonality, accommodation options, and ground logistics.
* A genuine appreciation for luxury hospitality, experiential travel, and personalised service.
* Excellent written and verbal English communication skills, with the ability to create compelling, well-presented itineraries.
* Strong sales, negotiation, client relationship management, and problem-solving skills.
* Proficiency in travel CRM systems and itinerary planning tools.
* Exceptional attention to detail, ownership, and the ability to manage multiple itineraries simultaneously.
* A customer-first mindset and the ability to remain calm and resourceful when plans change.

Who Will Thrive in This Role?

Someone who understands that luxury is personal. You enjoy discovering extraordinary places, have an eye for detail, think creatively, and take pride in making complex travel arrangements feel effortless. You are equally comfortable building client relationships, designing imaginative itineraries, and ensuring every detail is executed flawlessly.

Why Join Waari?

Be part of a growing travel company with a 22-year legacy, a customer-first philosophy, and an ambition to redefine personalised travel. At Waari, you will have the opportunity to create meaningful journeys, work with distinctive global experiences, and help shape the future of bespoke luxury travel.

**If you believe exceptional journeys begin with exceptional people, we would love to hear from you.**

**📩 Apply now or share your profile with us.**

* **Waari – Travel Uniquely Different.**

Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.
  
  
Client service is focused on providing Consulting, Assurance, Tax, Strategy & Transactions, and Knowledge support to our clients around the world. The teams enable account teams worldwide to provide seamless, high-quality, value-added support, helping deliver exceptional client service.

Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Worked on multiple Business transformation, upgrade and modernization programs.
* Requirements Gathering, Elicitation –writing BRDs, FSDs. Conducting JAD sessions and Workshops to capture requirements and working close with Product Owner.
* Work with the client to define the most optimal future state operational process and related product configuration.

* Strong skills in stakeholder management and communication.
* Should have end to end processes in P&C insurance domain.
* Data transformation, Business data modelling, Data mapping, transformation rules, data migration, data profiling, data visualisation, Tableau, Power-BI, Reporting, Basic understanding of SQL query
* AI and Gen AI use cases implementation, Understanding of AI architecture for AI Use cases
* Should be ready to work in flexible shifts (a good amount of overlap with US/UK hours).
* Good organizational and time management skills required.
* Should have good written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Industry certifications AINS 21 - Property and Liability Insurance Principles, AINS 22 - Personal Insurance, AINS 23 - Commercial Insurance and AINS 24 - General Insurance for IT and Support Professionals will be added advantage.
* Additional experience in Life or other insurance domain is added advantage.

We expect you to work effectively as a team member and build good relationships with the client. You will have the opportunity to expand your domain knowledge and skills and will be able to collaborate frequently with other EY professionals with a wide variety of expertise.
  
  
**What We Offer You**
At EY, we’ll develop you with future-focused skills and equip you with world-class experiences. We’ll empower you in a flexible environment, and fuel you and your extraordinary talents in a diverse and inclusive culture of globally connected teams.
  
  
To help create an equitable and inclusive experience during the recruitment process, please inform us as soon as possible about any disability-related adjustments or accommodations you may need.
  
  
**Our Commitment**
: As a commitment, we persistently endeavour to embody our values, fulfil our purpose, and champion inclusiveness. Our dedication is to cultivate EY into an environment where diverse perspectives are celebrated, creating a supportive atmosphere for individuals to authentically be themselves and contribute their utmost.
  
  
**Professional Development**
: From entry-level employees to senior leaders, we believe in continuous learning. We offer opportunities to build new skills, take on leadership roles, and connect and grow through mentorship.
  
  
**People and Culture**
: In our dynamic workplace, diversity, equity, and inclusiveness are ingrained in our culture. We're united by a commitment to create an environment where every individual's differences are valued, practices are equitable, fostering a sense of belonging. Our shared values include integrity, respect, teaming, inclusiveness, energy, enthusiasm, courage to lead, and building relationships based on doing the right thing.

: Embark on a transformative career journey with us and indulge in a suite of premium benefits, encompassing exclusive health and wellness packages, enticing rewards, and cutting-edge learning opportunities that empower you to continually grow and excel in your professional and personal development.

Successful candidates advance to a competency-based interview. If mutual interest persists, a job offer awaits.
  
  
“We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to Diversity, Equity & Inclusion”.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Senior Energy Market Analyst (Support)
description:
**About Energy Exemplar**

In an era where the world is rapidly advancing towards a cleaner future through decarbonization, Energy Exemplar’s mission lies in ‘Empowering Transformative Energy Decisions’. Founded in 1999 in Adelaide, Australia, our award-winning software portfolio encompassing the modeling and simulation platform PLEXOS®, Aurora, and Adapt2, is trusted by innovative organizations across the globe. Through our technology and people, we strive to enable stakeholders from across the entire energy value chain to revolutionize the energy ecosystem and to collaboratively plan and execute for a sustainable energy future with unprecedented clarity, speed, and innovation.

Our impact is global and is being recognized across the industry. Some of our recent accolades include:

* *SaaS Company of the Year (2025) – Global Business Tech Awards.*
* *Environmental Impact Award (2025) – E+E Leaders Awards.*
* *IPPAI (Independent Power Producers Association of India) Power Awards (2025) - Winners*
* *Finalist: Platts Global Energy Awards (2024) – Grid Edge category*
* *Finalist: Reuters Global Energy Transition Awards (2024) – Technologies of Change*
* *Top 50 Marketing Team (2024) – Voted by the public at the ICON Awards.*

**How We Work**

Energy Exemplar is growing fast around 30% year on year and, that growth is driven by how we work. We trust our team to deliver great results from wherever they work best, whether that’s at home, in the office, or on the move.

We’re a global team that values ownership, integrity, and innovation. You’ll be supported to balance work and life in a way that works for you, and empowered to take initiative, solve problems, and make an impact, regardless of your background, location, or role.

Our four core values, Customer Success, One Global Team, Integrity & Ownership, and Innovation Excellence aren’t just words. They show up in how we collaborate, how we solve, and how we grow together.

**About the Role**

Energy Exemplar is the leader in energy market/system simulation software, with its two platforms: PLEXOS and AURORA. These software platforms have a significant presence in global markets. We are seeking a confident, self-motivated and professional person for the role of
**Senior Energy Market Analyst**
in our Support Division. The company has consistently grown its global client base and the successful candidate will have many opportunities to interface with a diverse mix of clients with the goal of enhancing their software user experience.

**Responsibilities:**
•    Learn our software to an advanced level
  
•    Provide technical support to customers and track support cases from start to finish
  
•    Work with clients to resolve issues related to our SaaS/Cloud offerings and our Desktop version
  
•    Collaborate with Cloud Developers and Engine/GUI Developers to ensure issues are resolved and development requests are properly documented
  
•    Provide onsite and web-based trainings to existing and potential clients
  
•    Maintain and update training materials
  
•    Compose articles and produce videos to educate clients and to market our software.
  
•    Construct tools and examples that clients can utilize to more effectively utilize our software
  
•    Assist in maintaining software user documentation and help platforms
  
•    Maintain a high level of power market knowledge, news, trends and developments
  
•    Communicate market trends and customer requirements with the development team as needed
  
•    Assist Account Management with Retention calls and visits with clients
  
•    Assist in preparation and presentations for energy related tradeshows and conferences
  
•    Travel to client sites as required

**Qualifications, Skills & Experiences:**
•    Bachelor’s degree: Electrical Engineering, Another Engineering Degree, Statistics, Computer Science, Information Systems, Economics, Applied Math, Physics, or related field.
  
•    Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to research and learn new techniques
  
•    Ability to articulate the business problem to be analyzed, quickly identify the critical elements of the problem, achieve a high-quality answer in a timely fashion, and synthesize answers to resonate with decision makers
  
•    Excellent communication skills, including strong verbal, presentation, and technical writing abilities
  
•    Team player, with the ability to be a self-starter and work independently as needed.

**Education:**
•    4 to 7 years of demonstrated working knowledge of power plant operations, electricity and gas markets.
  
•    Knowledge of fundamental energy market analysis, capacity markets, environmental markets, demand side management/energy efficiency, electric utility resource planning approaches
  
•    Demonstrated working knowledge of SaaS products and experience troubleshooting issues with Cloud offerings
  
•    Demonstrated capability of effectively communicating complex ideas and analysis verbally, in document format (Word), and in presentation format (Power Point).
  
•    Experience with computer and database management languages such as VBA, Python and SQL
  
•    Working knowledge of the Microsoft Office suite (Excel, PowerPoint, Word, etc.)
  
•    Experience with power market production cost and expansion planning models.
  
•    Degree or certificate specializing in Power Markets.

**Key Stakeholder Relationships**
This role works collaboratively with all Energy Exemplar staff, particularly:

•    Indian Development Centre colleagues
  
•    Senior IDC Management
  
•    Chief Product Officer
  
•    Global Product Delivery Team
  
•    Global Product Development Team
  
•    Global Support Team

**Working Hours**

The support team operates across shifts including:

* 1:00 PM – 10:00 PM IST
* 7:00 PM – 3:00 AM IST

You will initially commence on the 1pm to 10pm shift pattern. Please note that shift schedules are expected to change from January, and we are looking for candidates who are flexible and open to working across all shift patterns as required.

Energy Exemplar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all team members. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds, experiences, identities, and abilities. Please let us know if you require accommodations at any stage of the recruitment process—we're here to support you in showcasing your full potential.

*Energy Exemplar respects your privacy and is committed to protecting the personal data you share during the recruitment process. This Candidate Privacy Notice explains how we collect, use, and protect your personal information when you apply for a role with us.*

title: Principal Specialist, Offer Engineering
description:
*At Konecranes, we believe that great customer experience is built on the people behind the Konecranes name. Everything we do, we do with passion and drive. We believe diversity drives business success and is the foundation for our growth. We welcome different backgrounds and skills that enrich our community and we promote a place where we can ALL be ourselves. This is what makes Konecranes a unique place to work.*

**Job Description**

Job Title: Principal Specialist – Offer Support

Employment type: KC Role, Demag Distribution India.

KPI:

1. Punctuality

1. Timely release of offer data.
2. Compliance with agreed offer turnaround time.
3. Timely response to Sales and distributor requirements.

2. Accuracy

1. Accuracy of technical offer data.
2. Compliance with customer requirements/RFE.
3. Accuracy of product selection, sizing and BOM.

3. Performance

1. Effective data maintenance.
2. Development of technically and commercially optimized solutions.
3. Effective support to Sales and distributors.
4. Contribution to continuous improvement initiatives.

4. Sales & Distributor Support

1. Response time, technical support, customer meetings and successful resolution of queries
2. Process improvements, standardization, product training
3. Commercial Optimization & Profitability
4. Improvement in margins
5. Optimized technical solutions, cost-effective component selection

Role and Responsibility:

Customer Requirement & Technical Solution

1. Understand the customer’s requirements, application and ultimate objective.
2. Recommend the most appropriate, feasible, simple and economical solution.
3. Provide alternative solutions wherever required.
4. Ensure the proposed solution complies with applicable technical standards and organizational capabilities.
5. Prepare detailed technical solutions covering the complete scope of supply.
6. Support branches/distributors by providing checklists and identifying the required technical inputs.

Offer Engineering & Commercial Support

1. Prepare and release accurate offer data within the agreed timeline.
2. Provide technical and commercial inputs for supply, transportation and service.
3. Support commercial optimization to improve project profitability and competitiveness.
4. Coordinate with the second-level Offer Support team for non-standard and complex enquiries.
5. Ensure timely submission of offers to the Demag Sales Front Line.
6. Handle spare-parts offering activities.

Cross-Functional Coordination

1. Coordinate with Engineering for high-value and customized solutions.
2. Participate in technical discussions with Sales, Engineering and Manufacturing teams.
3. Accompany Sales/branches during customer interactions whenever technical support is required.

SAP, BOM & Order Support

1. Create and update Bill of Materials (BOM) in SAP for non-standard projects.
2. Ensure BOM data is accurate and released within the required timeframe.
3. Review customer POs for technical and commercial requirements.
4. Participate in Project Kick-Off Meetings (KOMs).
5. Support order execution and resolve technical/offer-related issues during project execution.

Process & Continuous Improvement

1. Monitor and ensure adherence to defined SOPs and offering processes.
2. Identify gaps in the offer process and implement improvement actions.
3. Develop improvement plans to increase offer accuracy, efficiency and profitability.
4. Maintain relevant offer data and support data-driven decision making.
5. Contribute to standardization of technical solutions, checklists and offering practices.

Training & Knowledge Development

1. Conduct product and application training for Demag Sales Front-Line teams.
2. Conduct product training for Distributor Front-Line teams.
3. Share technical knowledge, product updates and application learnings with internal stakeholders.
4. Support development of technical documentation, guidelines and training material.

**Qualifications**

Education Required: BE Electrical/ Mechanical

Professional Experience Required (Max – Min.): 7-10 years

Gender: Male /Female

Competencies and Skills Required:

Technical Competencies

The candidate should have:

1. Strong knowledge of EOT and industrial crane applications.
2. Good knowledge of crane standards such as IS 3177, IS 4137, CMAA and FEM.
3. Experience in Hot Metal Handling Crane design/application.
4. Knowledge of mechanical and electrical component selection and sizing.
5. Understanding of crane duty classification and application requirements.
6. Ability to interpret technical specifications, drawings and customer requirements.
7. Knowledge of cranes, their components and application.
8. Understanding of techno-commercial offer preparation.
9. Experience in handling customized and non-standard crane requirements.

Software & Digital Skills

1. SAP – BOM creation/update and related activities.
2. Efecte – service/process-related system activities.
3. MS Excel – data analysis, calculations and data management.
4. MS Office / PowerPoint – technical presentations and documentation.
5. Ability to work with engineering/configuration and digital offering tools.

Behavioral Competencies

1. Customer-oriented approach.
2. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
3. Solution-oriented mindset.
4. Good communication and interpersonal skills.
5. Strong coordination and stakeholder-management capability.
6. Ability to work independently and take ownership.
7. Good team player.
8. Attention to detail and accuracy.
9. Ability to work under time pressure and meet deadlines.
10. Strong presentation and training skills.
11. Commercial awareness and profitability mindset.

Quality, Safety & Compliance

The candidate should have awareness of:

1. ISO 9001 – Quality Management
2. ISO 14001 – Environmental Management
3. ISO 45001 – Occupational Health & Safety
4. Applicable crane safety and technical standards

**Additional Information**

Work Environment (Hybrid): Office Primarily (Pune) and based on need may travel to distributor & customers location.

*With the Demag brand we are one of the world’s leading suppliers of industrial cranes, crane components and comprehensive service. We offer our customers a complete range of cranes, handling equipment and drives for every application – optimized by comprehensive sales and service support. The Demag crane experts always focus on the benefits for our customers – the greatest possible availability, optimum performance and maximum efficiency and reliability.*

title: Professional Services Consultant
description:
**About Druva**
Druva is the resilience foundation for the AI enterprise, helping organizations secure and recover from connected risk across data, cyber, identity, and AI. The Resilience Cloud is a fully managed, cloud-native SaaS platform that delivers air-gapped and immutable protection across cloud, SaaS, on-premises, endpoint, and edge environments. Powered by Dru MetaGraph, Druva’s graph-powered intelligence layer, the platform connects critical business context so customers can understand risk, respond faster, recover cleanly, and govern data with greater confidence.
  
  
Trusted by nearly 7,500 customers, including 75 of the Fortune 500, Druva helps safeguard the critical information and systems businesses depend on in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
Visit druva.com and follow us on LinkedIn, X and Facebook.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Professional Services Consultant has a responsibility to discover, design, consult, and implement Druva solutions for new and existing customers and provide best practices and guide the customer during the entire implementation cycle. In addition, this would also include providing technical consultation on Druva’s Data Security Services and Disaster Recovery Services and conducting Cyber Simulations, Security assessments, assistance with Ransomware Recovery and Disaster Recovery Playbooks and Runbooks, configuration and integration of SIEM/SOAR tools, etc. As a member of the Professional Services team, this role will engage and drive customer success. Candidates for this pivotal position are highly dynamic and seasoned professionals with soft and technical skills.
  
  
As a Professional Services Consultant, you will interact with peers around the globe and be a mentor to your team. The ability to effectively scale your interactions from highly technical I.T. staff to key stakeholders at the Executive level is a must. Flexibility in your current skill set and a demonstrable eagerness to learn new things are key criteria to any candidate for this position.
  
  
You will work in a team of individual contributors who are empowered to make decisions and run their daily business tasks.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Discover, Design, Deploy, and Optimize Druva Solutions to meet customer requirements
* Lead end to end product deployments and configurations for all lines of business in Druva related to Enterprise Workloads, End User Protection, SaaS Applications and Ransomware and Disaster Recovery practices
* Conduct Cyber Simulation exercises and Security assessments to test customer’s readiness to handle a cyber attack as well as identify gaps within existing security practices and provide recommendations to mitigate the same
* Conduct Security Penetration testings
* Assist with Incident Response Plans, Recovery Playbooks and Cyber Recovery.
* Assist with SIEM/SOAR integrations and configurations between the Customer and Druva’s environment
* Build Project Plans, and organize and manage all phases of a project to ensure successful implementation. This includes developing technical solutions and managing project plans, project schedules, success criteria, and milestones
* Consult with customers and internal teams on best practices and meet expectations
* Communicate status to key stakeholders on project status to drive the outcome
* Timely responsiveness to customer satisfaction
* Manage customer relationships and perform environmental health assessments of product adoption and data resiliency
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams on customer requests and feature/product enhancements

**Desired Skills And Experience**

* 8+ years in technical customer-facing roles with at least 2+ years as a Consultant
* Leading and assisting the team and driving large customer implementation across all customers for Enterprise Workloads, End User protection, SaaS Applications, Ransomware Recovery, Disaster Recovery practices
* Expert level knowledge of Operating Systems including MS Windows, Linux and Mac.
* Experience with IDP, SSO Tools, SCCM/Casper/Jamf/intune Deployment tools, Virtual environments (VMWare, VMC, HyperV, AWS, Azure, Nutanix), Storage Technologies (SAN/NAS)
* Knowledge of Networking concepts (TCP/IP, DNS, Bandwidth Management, Firewalls), Cloud Technologies using AWS/Azure/M365/Google Workspace as well as Security Solutions.
* Fast Learner in a dynamic environment with changing priorities
* Experience in conducting Cyber Simulation Exercises with multiple stakeholders
* Experience in conducting Risk Assessments
* Experience in curating IR playbooks and runbooks
* Experience in handling a cyber recovery process

title: Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
description:
**Job Description**
Our Purpose
  
  
Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.
  
  
Title and Summary
  
  
Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI)
  
  
**About The Team**
Mastercard's Business & Market Insights (B&MI) group empowers organizations to achieve growth and innovation goals by providing unparalleled data-driven insights and advanced analytics. By leveraging proprietary data and global expertise, B&MI helps businesses make smarter, more informed decisions that drive profitability and success. We turn complex data into actionable strategies that lead to better outcomes and sustained competitive advantage.
  
  
We are currently looking for a Lead Forward Deployed Engineer (AI) for the Operational Intelligence Program within the B&MI group. This role exists at the boundary between customer and product - /ou embed with clients before a single line of production code is written, validate whether an AI solution actually solves the business problem, and hand a scoped, evidence-backed brief to the product and engineering teams that build it. You are a builder first, but your deliverable is clarity, not code.
  
  
Roles and Responsibilities
  
  

* Embed directly with issuer and acquirer clients to understand their operational workflows, surface pain points, and identify where AI-driven automation or intelligence creates measurable business value.
* Design and build rapid proof-of-concept prototypes - agentic pipelines, conversational interfaces, analytical tools - scoped deliberately to test a specific business hypothesis, not to be production-ready.
* Translate ambiguous client requirements into concrete, testable problem statements; push back on requirements that are too broad to validate or too narrow to generalize.
* Run structured validation sessions with customers using working prototypes, gather qualitative and quantitative signal on whether the PoC addresses the stated need, and document what it does not.
* Synthesize field observations into product briefs: scoped requirements, edge cases discovered in the wild, constraints the platform team would not have known from a desk, and a clear go/no-go recommendation.
* Partner with product managers to ensure PoC findings directly inform roadmap decisions - requirements that survive validation become backlog items; those that do not get killed before investment is made.
* Maintain a working knowledge of the AI capability landscape (LLMs, agentic frameworks, retrieval-augmented generation, structured data reasoning) broad enough to know what is feasible in a six-week PoC versus

what requires a platform build.
  
  

* Identify patterns across client engagements that suggest platform-level investment - repeatable needs that should become product features rather than one-off prototypes.
* Represent technical feasibility in pre-sales and discovery conversations; give customers and internal stakeholders an honest read on what AI can and cannot do for their specific workflow today.
* Mentor engineers and analysts on the team on customer discovery craft - how to ask questions that reveal unstated requirements, how to scope a PoC to answer one question well, and how to present findings without overselling.

**All About You**

* Master's or bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, with significant experience delivering AI or data solutions to enterprise clients.
* Proven track record building working AI prototypes that directly influenced product or investment decisions - you can point to cases where your PoC changed what got built.
* Strong engineering foundation: you can write clean, working code quickly without over-engineering for production concerns that are irrelevant at the PoC stage.
* Fluent in Python and comfortable with SQL; experience with large-scale structured data and cloud data platforms is a strong plus.
* Hands-on experience with LLM APIs and agentic patterns - you understand the tradeoffs between what you can prompt, what you need to engineer, and what requires fine-tuning.
* Exceptional customer-facing communication: you can run a discovery session with a non-technical reconciliation analyst in the morning and write a technical scoping document in the afternoon.
* Strong product instinct: you can distinguish a business requirement from a solution assumption, and you know when a client is describing a symptom rather than a root cause.
* Comfort operating in ambiguity - you thrive when the problem statement is unclear and see scoping it as part of the job, not a blocker.
* Experience working in regulated industries (financial services, payments, healthcare) where data sensitivity, compliance constraints, and customer trust shape what can and cannot be prototyped.
* Track record of handing off well-scoped, evidence-backed briefs to product and engineering teams; you measure success by what gets built from your findings, not by the prototype itself.

Corporate Security Responsibility
  
  
**Responsibilities**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Technology Commercial Support - Growth
description:
**Who We Are**
VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
  
  
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
  
  
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
  
  
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
  
  
**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high-value opportunities during the pre-signature phase. This location-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market-specific Technology Account Manager.
  
  
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
  
  
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital & IT leaders and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Pricing and commercial design
  
  

* Shape end-to-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share models
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions

Bid support and governance
  
  

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi-tower bids
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business-as-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails

Stakeholder and customer engagement
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital & IT leaders
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions
* Communicate pricing strategies, commercial risks and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
* Guide commercial support colleagues working within bid teams

Measures of success
  
  

* Competitiveness of pricing and contribution to successful deal outcomes
* Protection of margin and realisation of value on signed opportunities
* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts
* On-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business-as-usual execution

**Who You Are**
Essential knowledge and capabilities
  
  

* You have expert capability in pricing, financial modelling and commercial analysis
* You demonstrate commercial acumen and a detailed understanding of deal economics, profitability and risk drivers
* You can design and communicate pricing strategies for complex technology opportunities
* You have advanced Microsoft Excel skills and can develop complex financial models, sensitivity analyses and commercial scenarios
* You apply a high level of attention to detail, structured governance and quality assurance
* You communicate clearly in writing and verbally with senior internal and customer stakeholders
* You use relevant market and competitor insight to inform pricing decisions
* You can prioritise effectively and manage concurrent work across multiple customers and opportunities
* You demonstrate Vodafone Spirit behaviours
* You apply independent judgement to create tailored commercial approaches rather than relying solely on standard pricing methods

**Experience**

* You have extensive pricing or commercial support experience in IT services, telecommunications or systems integration
* You will typically bring 15 to 18 years of overall professional experience, including 7 to 10 years in senior pricing, bid or commercial roles
* You have practical knowledge of time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share pricing constructs
* Experience acting as the pricing authority for large, complex, multi-tower deals is preferred
* A postgraduate qualification in Finance, Business, IT or Management is highly desirable

**Not a perfect fit?**
Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What's In It For You**

* The opportunity to shape the pricing and commercial strategy for complex, high-value technology deals
* Exposure to strategic opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, as well as larger multi-tower bids
* Collaboration with senior commercial, financial, technology and customer stakeholders across Vodafone and VOIS
* The opportunity to influence deal competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* A location-agnostic role with exposure to multiple customers and opportunity portfolios
* The ability to contribute to customer engagement, solution shaping and commercial decision-making

**What Skills You Will Learn**

* Advanced pricing strategy for complex technology and telecommunications opportunities
* Commercial design across time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share constructs
* Scenario modelling, sensitivity analysis and financial risk assessment
* Pricing governance and the preparation of approval and submission artefacts
* Commercial leadership across multi-disciplinary bid teams
* Customer engagement, senior stakeholder communication and deal-shaping techniques
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails into business-as-usual delivery

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.
