title: Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)
description:
**Job Description — Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

Y-Axis Overseas Careers · October 2026

**About Y-Axis and the opportunity**

Y-Axis is hiring one person to build and scale a new direct-to-consumer channel: service products that customers browse, choose and buy online without a sales call.

Y-Axis Overseas Careers is one of India's best-known migration and overseas career consultancies. For years our services have been sold through counsellors and branches. We are now packaging them as fixed-scope, fixed-price products, such as Work in Europe, Work in Germany and Work in Dubai for Nurses, sold through dedicated sales pages with a self-serve checkout.

Selling a service online is harder than selling a physical product. The buyer cannot touch it, the outcome is months away, and trust decides the sale. We need someone who has already solved that problem in a service business, not only in retail or FMCG e-commerce.

**The role: Growth Lead – D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**Experience**

6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, at least 3 in a service-based business

**Reports to**

Head of Digital / Business Head

**Works with**

Performance marketing, web development, design, CRM, content, sales and operations

**Role summary**

You will own the online sale of Y-Axis service products end to end: the product catalogue, the storefront and checkout, the traffic that reaches it, and the revenue it produces. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and do much of the work yourself, while directing existing marketing, web and CRM teams to execute.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and revenue ownership**

•    Own the growth plan and revenue target for online service products, with clear goals for customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS) and payback.

•    Decide which products, countries and customer segments to prioritise, using data on demand, margin and conversion.

•    Run a weekly growth review with clear owners, actions and results.

**Catalogue and offer**

•    Turn Y-Axis services into clear, buyable products: scope, inclusions, timelines, price points, tiers and bundles.

•    Write and maintain product pages, comparison tiles and FAQs that answer objections before they become sales calls.

•    Work with finance and operations on pricing, refunds, instalments and payment options.

**Storefront, checkout and conversion**

•    Own the sales-page and checkout journey on y-axis.com, from product tiles to payment and confirmation.

•    Brief design and development on new pages and features; write clear requirements and test before launch.

•    Build trust into every step: reviews, success stories, credentials, guarantees and a transparent process.

•    Run A/B tests on headlines, pricing display, trust signals, creatives and checkout steps.

**Acquisition and retention**

•    Direct paid acquisition across Google, Meta, YouTube and affiliates for product-led campaigns.

•    Work with SEO and content teams to build organic demand for each product page.

•    Set up abandoned-cart recovery and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp and SMS.

•    Design a hybrid path where high-intent buyers can move between self-serve checkout and a counsellor without friction.

•    Drive upsell and cross-sell to related services after the first purchase.

**Analytics and reporting**

•    Track the full funnel in GA4: sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts, payments and refunds.

•    Report weekly to leadership on revenue, conversion, CAC and drop-off points, with clear next actions.

**What we are looking for**

•    6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, with at least 3 in a service-based industry: edtech, immigration, study abroad, travel, healthcare, insurance, fintech or professional services.

•    Proven record of selling a service or digital product online, with numbers to show: revenue grown, conversion improved, CAC reduced.

•    Hands-on with GA4, tag management, A/B testing tools, landing-page builders and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar).

•    Has managed paid media budgets with a clear return.

•    Understands high-consideration buying: long decision cycles, trust building and the hand-off between digital and human sales.

•    Clear, persuasive product copywriting in English; can brief developers and designers precisely.

•    Comfortable working without a dedicated team, influencing other teams to get things done.

**Good to have**

•    Experience launching a D2C or self-serve channel inside a sales-led business.

•    Knowledge of international markets (Europe, Gulf, Canada, Australia) and NRI or migrant audiences.

•    Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and WhatsApp commerce.

**How we will measure success**

**Metric**

**What it tells us**

**Online service-product revenue vs target**

Is the channel delivering?

**Visit-to-purchase conversion rate**

Is the storefront doing its job?

**CAC and ROAS**

Is growth profitable?

**Average order value and cross-sell revenue**

Are tiers, bundles and upsells landing?

**Refund and cancellation rate**

Are we selling the right product to the right buyer?

**What we offer and how to apply**

**What we offer**

•    The chance to build a new revenue channel from the ground up, with leadership backing.

•    Direct impact on people's lives: every sale helps someone start an overseas career.

•    A strong brand, an established customer base and a large existing service catalogue to package and sell.

•    Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives.

**How to apply**

* Send your CV and a short note (no more than 300 words) to [email address]. In the note, tell us about one service or digital product you helped sell online: what you changed, and what happened to the numbers.

title: Technical Content Marketer
description:
**The Role:**

We write for researchers at frontier AI labs and for AI and ML leaders at large enterprises. They're technical readers, and they expect content that gets the details right without sounding like jargon soup.

You'll turn our research, product capabilities and customer outcomes into content these readers find useful. You'll work closely with product marketing, our research team and the founders, and you'll have room to carve a unique voice for us in the market.

**What You'll Own**

* **Distribution:**
  Every piece starts with a plan for who will see it and where. You'll map the channels before you write, adapt the piece for each one and track how it performs.
* **Long-form TOFU pieces:**
  Write blog posts, newsletters, explainers and research write-ups that make our work appeal to people evaluating AI model training and deployment.
* **BOFU content:**
  Create landing pages, one-pagers and pitch for our datasets across modalities (audio, languages, coding RL, physical AI and more), our RL environments and our agent observability suite. Write landing pages, one-pagers and product descriptions across STARK, Helix, VoxClash and our physical AI line.
* **SEO and AEO:**
  Plan content around what our buyers search for. Structure pages so search engines and AI answer engines can find and cite them.
* **Social media:**
  Plan and write content for our LinkedIn, X, and more.
* **Strategic case studies:**
  Work with customers and our sales team to write case studies that capture why each customer chose us and what it changed for them.
* **Launches and announcements:**
  Write for funding news, partnerships, product releases and conferences.

**You'll Do Well Here If You**

* **Shun AI slop:**
  You take your writing personally, and you can't stand content that reads like it came off an assembly line and recognize a technical subject is never an excuse for flat, generic content.
* **Pick up deep technical topics quickly:**
  You need curiosity and the patience to ask experts good questions until you understand the subject well enough to explain it.
* **Bring a point of view:**
  You enjoy forming opinions about the industry and backing them up in writing.
* **Obsess over quality:**
  You edit your own drafts closely and use feedback to improve the work.
* **Measure your work by results:**
  You want to know whether a piece brought in traffic, leads or conversations, and you use that to decide what to write next.
* **Use AI tools well:**
  You use LLMs for research and first drafts, and you know how to edit the output so it reads like a person wrote it.
* **Enjoy collaboration:**
  You're comfortable working with researchers, product managers, sales and design to get what a piece needs.

**Experience**

* 1–3 years in B2B content marketing, editorial, journalism or product storytelling, ideally at a dev tools SaaS/technology company.
* A portfolio of your published writing for different channels.
* Hands-on experience with SEO, and familiarity with how AI answers engines surface content.

**Bonus Points**

* You've written about AI, data or developer tools.
* You've written for formats beyond text, like video scripting or visual content.

**Why Join Us?**

* **High ownership:**
  You'll own how our story reaches the market across channels.
* **Flat hierarchy:**
  We act with urgency and clarity, and we're a small, collaborative team where good ideas move fast regardless of title.
* **A culture of learning:**
  We treat mistakes as stepping stones. There's real room to try things and get better from what didn't work.
* **Genuinely AI forward:**
  You'll have real room to experiment with AI tools in your own workflow. You'll never hear anyone tell you to stick to the old way of doing things.

title: Video Editor
description:
Make ancient wisdom impossible to scroll past.

Kitab turns the Bhagavad Gita and the Puranas into daily guidance for modern life. We're looking for a Story Architect to own our short-form video and social visuals: reels, carousels and cover frames that people stop for, finish and share.

Story Architect – Senior Video Editor & Visual Creative

Kitab · Full-time · On-site, Hyderabad · 3+ years · AI-native role

About Kitab

Kitab brings ancient wisdom into modern life, with clear, practical guidance for everyday problems: stress, relationships, purpose and decisions. Everything we build serves three pillars: Know Yourself, Grow Yourself, Free Yourself.

Kitab is backed by Sunera Group, led by founder Ravi Reddy Kaki, who has built and exited companies before. We're a new product, but not a first-time team.

Reports to: Ganesh Bende, Marketing & Branding Lead

What you'll do

• Edit short-form videos from raw footage, stock, AI voice, AI avatars and motion assets into finished, on-brand pieces

• Shape the story: hook, pacing, structure, music, sound design, captions and the final beat

• Design carousels, static posts, thumbnails and cover frames that match the reels

• Bring Kavi, our 2D pigeon guide, to life in simple animations

• Build video and visual templates so quality holds as volume grows

• Keep Kitab's dark, cinematic look consistent across everything

Leadership sets the content pillars and direction (about 80% of the brief). The craft and creative judgment that make it land are yours.

What you'll make

• Wisdom reels, 15–60 sec

• Talking-head and podcast clips, 30–90 sec

• AI-avatar and AI-voice pieces, 30–60 sec

• Motion-led explainers, 60–120 sec

• Carousels, statics, thumbnails and cover frames

Volume: around 30–50 short-form videos a month once settled, plus companion visuals. Quality comes first; volume grows as your workflows mature.

How AI fits this role

• Prompt Claude for alternate hooks, tighter cuts and caption variants, and judge which is strongest

• Direct ElevenLabs voice for pacing and pronunciation, and fix what sounds synthetic

• Make HeyGen avatar pieces feel human and on-brand, not uncanny

• Use Higgsfield, Midjourney or similar for backgrounds, B-roll and concepts, with respectful, accurate depictions of Indian culture and sacred imagery

• Speed up edits with auto-captions, transcript editing and AI clean-up, without lowering quality

• Spot AI artefacts and off-tone output before anything ships. A human signs off every frame.

What AI-native means here

You use AI every working day, not occasionally. You keep a prompt library for visuals, voice, captions and variations, you can show us the prompts behind your best work, and each piece gets faster than the last.

Must-haves

• 3+ years of professional video editing, with short-form vertical edits that hold attention

• Motion graphics and kinetic typography

• Carousel and static design with strong typography and layout

• Strong sound sense: music, mixing, sound design and voice clean-up

• Hands-on AI tools in a real editing workflow, including prompt engineering

• Visual taste and restraint: you know when an effect helps the message and when it's noise

Tools you must know

• Editing: Premiere Pro, DaVinci Resolve or Final Cut Pro, plus CapCut

• Motion: After Effects or equivalent

• Design: Figma, Photoshop or Canva

• AI: Claude or ChatGPT, ElevenLabs, HeyGen

• Workflow: ClickUp, Google Drive or Frame.io for reviews

Good to know: Higgsfield, Midjourney or Runway, Illustrator, Descript, 2D character animation

The creative thinking we admire

Co–Star's text-led restraint, Spotify Wrapped's shareable motion systems, CRED's cinematic storytelling, and Headspace and Finch's gentle characters. Tell us what you'd borrow for Kitab.

Who you are

Experience gets you the interview. Who you are gets you the role. We look for people who are grounded, curious, accountable, kind, humble and purpose-driven, and whose everyday life reflects what Kitab stands for:

• Know Yourself: you have a way to reflect, whether journaling, meditation, prayer, long walks or quiet time

• Grow Yourself: you read books, not just feeds, and keep learning

• Free Yourself: you create more than you consume, and you can switch off

• Conscious action: you wouldn't make work that misleads or harms people

• Discipline and balance: healthy rhythms of sleep, movement and routine

• Service: you give back in some way

This isn't about religion, diet, rituals or background. People of every faith and none belong at Kitab.

Compensation

Up to ₹50,000 a month for a strong portfolio with 3+ years. Experienced editors: 10–20% above current salary, based on portfolio and assignment.

Hiring process

1. Portfolio review

2. Timed editing assignment with assets provided: 24 hours for a talking-head edit, 24–48 hours for a motion-led piece

3. Craft interview with our video and design team

4. Culture conversation with Ganesh

5. Offer

How to apply

Apply here, then email 3–5 pieces (not a full showreel) to socials@kitab.com with the subject "Story Architect – [Your name]". Include at least 2 vertical edits, 1 motion piece, 1 carousel or static set, and 1 piece made with AI tools and the prompts behind it. For each, tell us your role and the tools you used. Add one habit that keeps you grounded.

* Privacy: we use your details only to assess your application for this role.

• Developing alternative thumbnail designs for testing.

• Analysing click-through rates and performance to understand what works and what doesn’t.

• Maintaining a recognisable visual identity while ensuring every episode has its own personality.

The goal is simple. Someone should understand why an episode is worth watching before they even read its title.

**Instagram & Short-Form Content Design**

You’ll also be responsible for how our content looks across social media.

This includes:

• Designing covers for Instagram Reels, YouTube Shorts, and social clips.

• Developing a consistent and recognisable visual language for our short-form content.

• Creating typography-led designs that communicate ideas clearly.

• Designing carousels that turn complex insights into simple, useful, and shareable content.

• Creating quote graphics, episode announcements, guest reveals, and promotional creatives.

• Designing Instagram Stories, countdowns, and launch announcements.

• Adapting designs for different platforms, formats, and screen sizes.

• Collaborating with video editors to ensure the visual packaging accurately represents the content.

We want people to recognise our content even when our logo isn’t visible.

**Brand Identity & Visual Systems**

We’re not just producing podcast episodes. We’re building a media brand. You’ll play an important role in shaping and maintaining its visual identity.

Your responsibilities will include:

• Maintaining and improving our overall brand identity.

• Developing typography systems, colour hierarchies, layouts, and reusable design templates.

• Creating consistent design principles across YouTube, Instagram, websites, and other digital platforms.

• Designing creative assets for campaigns, collaborations, merchandise, and special projects.

• Developing episode-specific visual identities wherever required.

• Organising and maintaining design files, templates, and brand assets.

• Ensuring that everything we publish meets our creative and quality standards.

The idea is to build a visual identity that remains recognisable as the brand grows.

**Creative Research & Concept Development**

We don’t want someone who waits for a brief, finishes the design, and moves on. We want the one who thinks about the work even before the brief arrives.

You’ll be expected to:

• Study some of the best-performing YouTube thumbnails and digital media brands in the world.

• Research visual trends across YouTube, Instagram, entertainment, and digital publishing.

• Understand how creators use facial expressions, framing, colour, typography, and curiosity to attract attention.

• Develop mood boards and visual references before major releases.

• Bring original creative ideas to brainstorming sessions.

• Question existing design approaches and suggest improvements.

• Build a reference library of successful designs, experiments, and creative concepts.

We want someone who can bring fresh ideas to the table rather than simply reproduce what’s already popular.

**THE SKILLS YOU’LL NEED**

**Technical & Design Skills**

You should be proficient in:

• Adobe Photoshop, including advanced image manipulation, compositing, masking, retouching, and colour correction.

• Adobe Illustrator for vector graphics, typography, and visual assets.

• Figma for layouts, design systems, and collaboration.

• Typography, including font selection, pairing, hierarchy, spacing, and readability.

• Colour theory, contrast, composition, and visual balance.

• Photo manipulation and creative visual storytelling.

• Designing for mobile-first viewing experiences.

• Preparing high-quality assets across different aspect ratios and resolutions.

Experience with After Effects, Blender, Cinema 4D, or other 3D and motion design tools would be an added advantage.

**Creative Thinking**

You should have a strong understanding of:

• Why some thumbnails get clicked while others are ignored.

• How to create curiosity without misleading the audience.

• How facial expressions communicate emotions.

• How to simplify complicated ideas into one powerful visual.

• How typography influences the way a message is perceived.

• How visual hierarchy directs attention.

• How to create premium-looking designs without unnecessary complexity.

• How to balance creative originality with content performance.

We care about your ability to explain why a design works, not just whether it looks good.

**Understanding of Content & Platforms**

You should be familiar with:

• YouTube and the creator ecosystem.

• Long-form podcasts and interview formats.

• Instagram Reels and YouTube Shorts.

• Digital storytelling and audience psychology.

• Content packaging and creative experimentation.

• Basic performance metrics such as impressions, click-through rates, reach, and engagement.

You don’t need to be a marketing expert.

But you should understand that good design has a purpose beyond aesthetics.

**HOW WE’LL MEASURE YOUR WORK**

We care about both the quality of your designs and the impact they create.

**Thumbnail Performance**

Are our thumbnails improving in terms of click-through rates, taking into account the audience, topic, title, and traffic sources?

**Creative Experimentation**

Are you consistently exploring meaningful alternatives instead of relying on the same design formula?

**Brand Recognition**

Are we developing a visual identity that people can recognise across platforms?

**Social Media Packaging**

Are our covers helping people understand, discover, and recognise our content?

**Quality & Execution**

Are you delivering thoughtful, high-quality work within agreed timelines?

**Collaboration**

Are you communicating effectively with researchers, editors, producers, and content strategists?

**Originality**

Are you bringing new ideas to the team rather than repeating existing templates?

**Creative Growth**

Are you learning from feedback, audience behaviour, and performance data?

We don’t expect every design to go viral. We expect you to learn, experiment, and improve consistently.

**These aren’t mandatory, but we’d love to hear about them if you have experience in:**

• Motion graphics and animation.

• AI-assisted image generation and editing.

• Photography and portrait retouching.

• YouTube thumbnail experimentation.

• Entertainment, documentary, or editorial design.

• Art direction for photography and video shoots.

• Website and landing-page design.

• Merchandise and physical brand applications.

• Designing for multilingual audiences.

**WHAT YOU CAN EXPECT FROM US**

• An opportunity to design content for a large and highly engaged digital audience.

• Creative ownership over meaningful, high-visibility projects.

• Exposure to extraordinary guests, ideas, and conversations.

• The freedom to experiment, learn, and improve your craft.

• An opportunity to help shape the visual identity of a growing media brand.

• Competitive compensation based on your experience, portfolio, and demonstrated capabilities.

**HOW TO APPLY**

We’d like to understand how you think, not just what software you know.

Please share the following:

**1. Your Portfolio**

Send us five to ten of your strongest designs.

We’re particularly interested in YouTube thumbnails, social media creatives, and brand identity projects.

**2. Your Best Thumbnail**

Share one thumbnail you’re especially proud of.

Tell us what the idea was, why you made the design decisions you did, and what you believe makes it effective.

**3. A Creative Breakdown**

Choose any YouTube thumbnail you admire.

Explain what makes it work. We’d love to understand how you think about attention, curiosity, composition, and storytelling.

**4. Your Resume**

Include your relevant work experience, software proficiency, current location, and availability.

**5. Compensation Expectations**

Let us know your expected compensation and, if you’re comfortable sharing it, your current compensation.

**Send your application to:**
tanieyakumari@zeroprotocol.in

**Email Subject:**
Graphic Designer Application | Zero Protocol

**ONE LAST THING**

We’re looking for someone who can understand a conversation, find the most interesting idea within it, and turn that idea into something people want to click on. Someone who understands that design isn’t just about how something looks.

It’s about what it makes people feel, think, and do.

If you believe a single image can make someone curious enough to spend two hours listening to a conversation, we’d love to see your work.

We are looking for an Manager, execution-focused SEO Manager to take complete end-to-end ownership of the search engine optimization and digital content ecosystem for Dononman.

In this dual-impact role, you will lead our organic growth strategy by combining technical webmastering, high-ranking blog creation, on-page optimization, and site performance optimization. You will bridge the gap between technical web development and strategic content, ensuring Dononman ranks at the top of search engine results pages (SERPs) while maintaining a fast, seamless user experience.

**Key Responsibilities**

1.⁠ ⁠Blog Strategy & Content Creation (Complete Blog Management)

Keyword Strategy: Conduct in-depth keyword research, intent analysis, and competitive gap assessments to identify high-converting content opportunities for Dononman.

End-to-End Blog Publishing: Write, edit, structure, and publish high-quality, engaging, and SEO-optimized blog posts using CMS platforms (e.g., WordPress, Webflow, or Shopify).

On-Page Optimization: Optimize all blog elements, including titles, meta descriptions, header structures (H1–H4), internal links, URL slugs, image alt text, and schema markup.

Content Lifecycles: Audit and update existing articles regularly to refresh decaying content, fix broken links, and keep rankings competitive.

2.⁠ ⁠Technical SEO & Webmastering

Site Health & Architecture: Conduct regular technical audits to maintain clean site architecture, crawlability, and indexability.

Core Web Vitals & Speed: Diagnose and optimize page speed, mobile usability, and Core Web Vitals performance across desktop and mobile devices.

Technical Fixes: Manage robots.txt, XML sitemaps, canonical tags, 301 redirects, HTTP status codes (404, 500), and structured data (JSON-LD).

Platform Management: Manage domain configurations, basic CMS maintenance, plugin updates, security monitoring, and coordination with web developers for complex structural modifications.

3.⁠ ⁠Link Building & Off-Page SEO

Execute high-quality link-building tactics, guest blogging outreach, digital PR, and competitor backlink acquisition strategies.

Monitor backlink profiles, manage toxic links, and execute disavow actions when necessary.

4.⁠ ⁠Analytics & Reporting

Track, analyze, and report on key organic metrics (organic sessions, keyword rankings, impressions, bounce rates, conversion rates) using Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), and third-party tools.

Translate raw search data into actionable growth initiatives for the Dononman brand.

Requirements & Qualifications

Experience: 2–4 years of experience as an SEO Analyst, Technical SEO Specialist, or Webmaster with a proven track record of growing organic search traffic.

Technical Proficiency:

Solid understanding of HTML5, CSS3, JavaScript principles affecting crawlability, and CMS management (WordPress/Webflow/Custom frameworks).

Hands-on expertise with Google Search Console, Google Analytics 4 (GA4), Screaming Frog, and Google Tag Manager.

Proficiency in SEO suites such as Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or Keyword Planner.

Content Skills: Exceptional written English skills with the ability to write clear, compelling, and search-optimized blog copy.

Problem-Solving: Analytical mindset capable of diagnosing complex indexing, crawling, or speed issues.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Increase in domain-wide organic traffic and keyword positions for high-intent keywords.

Blog traffic growth, reader engagement, and organic lead/conversion generation.

Improvement in Core Web Vitals scores and zero critical technical/crawling errors.

Acquisition of high-authority, relevant backlinks.

title: Advertising Ops Analyst, Amazon Ads
description:
**Description**
Traffic and set up advertising campaigns across Prime Video (PV) and 3P Video for the India marketplace. Own the pre-launch campaign lifecycle from IO/deal intake and line item setup to creative upload, QA, and go-live across Amazon's ad serving platforms (ADSP/Rodeo).
  
  
Ensure every campaign goes live accurately, on time, and in full compliance with deal terms, platform specs, and ad policies. Serve as the first line of quality control, catching setup errors before they impact delivery or advertiser experience.
  
  
Work closely with sales, CSM, and ad tech teams to ensure campaigns deliver on time, on budget, and in line with advertiser expectations. Proactively identify delivery risks, resolve operational issues, and contribute to process improvements that drive efficiency and revenue across India's video advertising business.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
Campaign Setup & Trafficking
  
  

* Receive IO/deal briefs from CSM and translate them into accurate campaign setups on ADSP and Rodeo
* Create and configure line items — targeting parameters, flight dates, budgets, frequency caps, dayparting, and deal IDs — as per the approved deal terms
* Set up programmatic guaranteed (PG) and direct-sold deals with precision across PV, AMXP, and 3P Video inventory
* Ensure correct mapping of advertiser, brand, and campaign hierarchy within the platform

Creative Upload & QA
  
  

* Upload 1P hosted video creatives and third-party tracking pixels/tags on Rodeo
* Validate creatives against platform specifications (format, resolution, duration, file size) and ad policy guidelines
* Flag non-compliant or missing creatives to CSM/sales before go-live deadlines
* Conduct end-to-end pre-launch QA — verify targeting, creative assignment, tracking, pacing settings, and deal linkage before activating campaigns

Go-Live & Handoff
  
  

* Activate campaigns on schedule and confirm successful ad serving within the first few hours of launch
* Perform launch-day health checks — verify impressions are delivering, creatives are rendering correctly, and tracking is firing
* Hand off live campaigns to CSM for ongoing pacing management, optimisation, and advertiser communication

Troubleshooting (Pre-Launch & Launch)
  
  

* Diagnose and resolve setup-related issues — including trafficking errors, creative rejection, targeting misconfigurations, and deal ID mismatches
* Escalate platform-level bugs or ad tech issues to the appropriate engineering teams with clear documentation

Process & Quality
  
  

* Follow established SOPs and trafficking checklists to maintain zero-error campaign setups
* Flag gaps in existing workflows and contribute to SOP updates and process improvements
* Maintain accurate trafficking logs and campaign setup documentation

A day in the life
  
  

* New campaign briefs awaiting setup
* Creative assets received from advertisers/agencies
* Urgent same-day go-live requests
* Escalations or flags from the previous evening
* Read the IO/deal brief — understand the advertiser, deal type (PG/direct), flight dates, budget, targeting requirements, and creative details
* Create the campaign shell — set up the campaign, line items, and deal IDs on the platform
* Configure targeting — geography, device, content genre, dayparting, frequency caps as per deal terms
* Map brand hierarchy — ensure correct advertiser → brand → campaign mapping for accurate reporting and brand repetition rules
* Link deal IDs — connect PG deal IDs to the correct line items so programmatic demand flows correctly
* Upload video creatives (1P hosted) and companion banners on Rodeo
* Attach third-party tracking pixels — impression trackers, click trackers, verification tags (MOAT, IAS, etc.)
* Validate creative specs — check format (MP4/MOV), resolution (1920×1080), duration (15s/30s), file size, and audio levels against platform requirements
* Flag rejections — if a creative doesn't meet specs or violates ad policy (e.g., restricted category, missing disclaimers), flag it back to CSM immediately with clear reasons
* Test rendering — preview the ad to ensure it renders correctly across devices (Fire TV, mobile, web)
* Send go-live confirmations to CSMs for campaigns activated during the day
* Flag pending items — creatives still awaited, IOs with missing information, campaigns blocked due to spec issues
* Prepare next-day queue — review what's coming up tomorrow and pre-read briefs if available

**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of sales experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree

description:

**Demand Generation Manager**

* MarTech & Automation: Manage and optimize our core marketing stack (CRM, Marketing Automation, ABM tools) for precise audience segmentation, automated nurture tracks, and lead scoring.
* Experimentation & Optimization: Continuously test ad creative, landing pages, copy, and audience targeting to lower customer acquisition costs (CAC) while scaling pipeline volume.

**What We're Looking For**

* Experience: 8-10 years of hands-on demand generation or growth marketing experience in a B2B SaaS environment.

* Tech Stack Proficiency: Strong operational experience with Salesforce/HubSpot, Marketo, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, Google Ads/GA4, and ABM/sourcing tools (e.g., Demandbase, 6sense, Apollo).
* Sales-Minded Alignment: Strong empathy for sales workflows with a clear understanding of enterprise sales cycles, deal stages, and ACV dynamics.
* Data-Driven: Ability to extract actionable insights from raw performance data and communicate key metrics clearly to executive leadership.

* Work-life balance and Well-being  - We offer time off when you need it, special leave days for life’s big moments, and a flexible hybrid work model tailored to local regulations.
* Career mobility - Your career is a journey. With internal mobility, upskilling, and mentorship, we help you shape your path.
* Professional development - Learning never stops. Onboarding, mentorship, and training programs help you grow - no matter where you start.
* International mobility - Ready to take your career global? Explore short and long-term opportunities in our Hubs worldwide.  While some benefits may vary by location, our goal remains the same: to support your growth, well-being, and success - wherever you are.  Diversity drives connection

Beyond executive operations, you will actively own and drive digital marketing strategies, content creation, brand positioning, and cross-functional growth projects.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

•
**Digital Marketing & Growth Strategy**

Lead and oversee digital marketing campaigns across Meta, Google Ads, SEO/SEM, and influencer networks to drive D2C customer acquisition and retain subscription users.

Partner with growth teams and agencies to optimize Performance Marketing spend, ROAS, Customer Acquisition Cost (CAC), and Customer Lifetime Value (LTV).

Direct email marketing campaigns, WhatsApp Business automation, push notifications, and app-based loyalty/retention workflows.

•
**Content Writing & Strategic Communication**

Draft compelling copy for website, mobile app landing pages, product announcements, email newsletters, and promotional messaging.

Own corporate communications, founder branding content (LinkedIn posts, industry thought leadership, media releases), and internal newsletter communications.

Review, refine, and maintain brand voice across all digital touchpoints, customer communication channels, and packaging/collateral copy.

•
**Strategic Business Operations & Cross-Functional Governance**

Act as a key strategic liaison between the Founder/Leadership and department heads (Logistics, Sales, Warehouse, Finance, Marketing, HR) to align project deliverables and monitor operational workflows.

Track company-wide OKRs/KPIs, ensure accountability across business units, and follow up proactively on critical corporate initiatives and milestone deliverables.

Lead high-priority ad-hoc strategic projects, market expansion studies, product launch readiness reviews, and process optimization initiatives.

•
**Executive Decision Support & MIS Management**

Consolidate daily, weekly, and monthly operational, sales, and financial performance metrics into actionable business intelligence dashboards and MIS reports.

Prepare high-level strategic decks, investor presentations, board meeting materials, and executive summaries (PowerPoint/Excel).

Analyze operational bottlenecks, unit economics, and last-mile delivery efficiencies to recommend actionable business improvements.

•
**Leadership Enablement & Workflow Oversight**

Manage complex schedules, prioritize appointments, organize leadership calendar, and ensure smooth daily time management for senior leadership.

Lead executive and cross-departmental reviews, document Minutes of Meetings (MoM) with clear owners, and rigorously track actionable points to closure.

Oversee executive communications, confidential records management, and strategic correspondence.

**REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS**

• 8–12 years of progressive experience in Founder’s Office, Strategy & Operations, Brand/Digital Marketing, or Business Management roles. Prior experience in FMCG, Dairy, D2C, E-commerce, or Food & Beverage is strongly preferred.

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Management, Commerce, or Strategic Communications.

• Solid understanding of performance marketing channels, D2C sales funnels, SEO/SEM, content strategy, and digital consumer engagement.

• High proficiency in Advanced Excel, PowerPoint, Google Workspace, and MIS/data analytics frameworks.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with a proven ability to write compelling copy and interface smoothly with senior stakeholders.

• Proven ability to manage cross-functional teams, push projects across the finish line, and operate with high autonomy, confidentiality, and sound business judgment.

title: Account Manager
description:
**ABOUT TIC**

Till It Clicks Studio Pvt. Ltd. (TIC) is a marketing and creative agency based in Sahakarnagar, Pune. AI plays a growing role across TIC's delivery functions. Account Management is deliberately kept fully human, because we believe our clients deserve people-to-people interaction. AI supports the backend, but the face of TIC to every client will always be a person. 

**ROLE SUMMARY**

Account Management is the backbone of every client relationship at TIC. It sits between the client and the delivery team, and between what was promised and what gets delivered. Its job is to keep clients retained, happy and growing. This is not a communication-relay role. As an Account Manager, you will think like a marketer, act like an owner, and be accountable for the health of every account you handle. You will typically own four to six client accounts at a time and work closely with the Account Management Lead, the Studio Head and the delivery team. 

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Client management**

Take full ownership of all deliverables across your assigned accounts (typically four to six clients). Respond to client messages promptly and proactively, with clear timelines rather than vague assurances, so clients always feel valued and heard. 

Keep all client communication in writing. Document any verbal brief, revision or instruction, share it with the client for confirmation, and only then act on it. 

Take notes in every client meeting and share them with the client and the delivery team after every interaction. 

Plan as many client tasks as possible before the start of each month. Share the next day's tasks with the Studio Head by the previous evening, or by 10:00 AM the same day. 

Build personal relationships with clients, down to acknowledging birthdays and important moments.
**Reporting & strategy**

 

Daily/weekly: Update the task tracking document daily and track all deliverables against the committed scope every week. 

Monthly: Send each client a qualitative and quantitative report, built from insights gathered from the relevant delivery team members. Attend a relationship-building meeting with every client alongside the Account Management Lead. 

Quarterly: Plan each client's strategy for the next quarter well in advance. Once it is approved, get full clarity on the quarter's deliverables. 

Take part in strategy reviews at the start and end of every month, contributing as a thinking partner who understands the strategy behind each account, not just the tasks. 

Never commit a timeline to a client without first confirming it with the relevant delivery team member.
**Delivery & process**

Give the delivery team written briefs that are detailed and unambiguous, to avoid costly reworks. Make sure every deliverable is quality-checked before it reaches the client. 

Run all tasks, briefs and updates through TIC's project management tool.

**Sales & growth**

Actively look for upselling opportunities to grow the scope of every account. Upselling is a major KPI for this role. 

Support the sales team with proposals and pitches when needed, especially with account context and client knowledge. 

Track payments for each client and, working with the Accounts team, proactively follow up on delayed payments. 

**AI-first ways of working**

Use TIC's AI-powered account management processes to cut the time spent on repetitive work (briefing, reporting, task planning) without lowering the quality of client communication or the depth of relationships. 

Update your client CIDs every month, in a meaningful and detailed way. 

Fill in timesheets accurately.

**REQUIREMENTS & SKILLS**

A client-first, ownership mindset, with a strong focus on long-term retention and relationships. The ability to think like a marketer and understand the strategy behind a client's account, not just the task list. 

Excellent written communication, including clear, detailed briefs, meeting notes and client reports. Strong planning and organisation skills, with the ability to plan work a month ahead and track scope weekly across several accounts. 

Proactiveness: spotting early signs of client distress and raising flags with solutions, not just problems. An eye for quality and the discipline to follow process (PM tool, trackers, timesheets). Commercial awareness to spot upsell opportunities and follow up on payments. 

Comfort working with AI tools to make repetitive work more efficient.

title: YouTube & Instagram Growth Strategist
description:
We’re looking for a
**YouTube & Instagram Growth Strategist**
to be the driving force behind our content and brand communication — 1.6M+ YouTube subscribers, 200K+ IG audience, and a fast-growing business in the Numerology space.

This is a seat at the creative table —to build a content machine that actually performs and scales.

If your idea of a good time is thinking about content, breaking down what works, and building systems that turn ideas into results — please read on 🙂

**Hours:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
New Delhi — This is essential. We not looking for someone remote. We’re looking for someone who works with the team IRL, closely and consistently.

**Salary:**
₹14 LPA – ₹18 LPA

**Experience:**
5-8 Years

**What You’ll Be Doing**

**Own the Creative Vision**

You are the CEO of this media product. You’ll set the strategic direction of the channel — drawing on channel data, competitor research, and platform trends — and translate it into clear weekly and monthly creative priorities. We should be able to ask almost any question about what we’re making and why, and get a confident, evidence-backed answer from you.

**Drive the Ideation Machine**

You’ll build a systematic, ever-evolving process for generating and evaluating video ideas. You’ll know what the audience wants, what’s trending, what’s working, what we should do next and you’ll bring consistency to how ideas are created and scaled. You’ll also translate these ideas into short-form formats for Instagram — understanding what works for Reels vs long-form, and how to adapt content without losing depth.

**Master the Packaging**

Title. Thumbnail. Hook. These are the things that determine whether a brilliant video reaches 100,000 people or 10 million. You’ll own these decisions with both creative instinct and systematic testing

**Structure the Content**

You won’t be writing full scripts. Your role is to take the core idea and design how the content flows:

* What comes first
* What hooks the viewer
* Where key points should land
* How the narrative builds and retains attention

You’ll work closely with us to understand the topic, then translate it into a clear, high-retention format that editors can execute.

**Run the Production Pipeline**

End-to-end ownership of long-form and short-form production (YouTube + Instagram) — from idea through to upload. You’ll manage video editors to a high standard, ensure filming days run effortlessly, and own upload hygiene down to the last pinned comment. The goal: a production machine that feels calm, repeatable, and world-class.

**Live in the Analytics**

Deep mastery of CTR, retention curves, watch time, and traffic sources — and the ability to translate all of it into clear creative decisions. You don’t just report what happened. You explain 
*why*
, and you tell us what we’re going to do about it. You’ll track performance across YouTube and Instagram, understanding how metrics differ across platforms and what to optimize for on each.

**What We’re Looking For**

**YouTube native**
 — You’ve spent years watching long-form YouTube. You have favourite creators. You think about the platform instinctively. Ideally you’ve grown a channel (or played a central role in one), but what matters more is that you 
*get*
 YouTube deeply.

**Short-form instinct**
— You understand how Instagram works. You know what makes someone stop scrolling, what formats work on Reels, and how to adapt long-form thinking into short-form content that performs.

**Packaging obsession**
 — You can look at any video concept and immediately generate compelling title/thumbnail ideas. You test systematically and your instincts sharpen over time.

**Systems thinker**
 — You build processes that scale. You document what matters. You don’t rely on heroics — you build repeatable systems that make high-volume publishing feel calm and sustainable.

**Data fluent**
 — You live in YouTube Studio and Instagram insights. You understand which metrics actually matter across platforms — CTR, retention, watch time on YouTube, and hooks, holds, shares, and saves on Instagram. Most importantly, you don’t just read numbers, you translate them into clear content decisions.

**AI-forward**
 — You’re genuinely excited about using AI tools to get an edge, and you implement them quickly. The more experience the better, but the willingness to learn and go deep matters even more.

**Proactive communicator**
 — We should never have to chase you. You surface problems before they escalate and deliver updates that are actually useful.

**High trust, high character**
 — We’re a small, tight team. We’d rather have someone with slightly less experience and extraordinary character than the other way around.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Meta Ads Operations Manager**

to manage and streamline the operational activities related to Meta advertising. The role involves managing ad accounts, Business Managers, access permissions, media buyer allocation, billing, advertiser verification, and account suspension tracking.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager, strong coordination skills, and the ability to troubleshoot operational issues while ensuring compliance with Meta's advertising policies and internal procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Ad Account & Asset Management**

* Coordinate with agencies and partners to request new Meta ad accounts, profiles, Pages, and Business Managers.
* Manage account access, permissions, and asset allocation for media buyers.
* Maintain accurate mapping of ad accounts, Pages, Business Managers, and assigned media buyers.
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of all advertising assets.

**2. Media Buyer Allocation & Coordination**

* Allocate ad accounts to media buyers based on business requirements and approved access.
* Maintain updated records of account assignments, access permissions, and asset ownership.
* Coordinate with media buyers to resolve account-related queries and operational challenges.
* Ensure smooth coordination between media buyers, agencies, and internal teams.

**3. Business Manager Setup & Management**

* Coordinate the setup and configuration of Meta Business Managers.
* Manage approved asset mapping, partner access, and user permissions.
* Monitor account and asset access to ensure appropriate authorization.
* Troubleshoot Business Manager access issues and coordinate resolutions.

**4. Technical Support & Issue Resolution**

* Monitor ad account functionality, ad delivery issues, and website-related technical concerns.
* Investigate operational issues reported by media buyers and coordinate with relevant technical teams.
* Track issues and ensure resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders when required.

**5. Account Suspension & Policy Compliance**

* Monitor and maintain records of suspended or restricted ad accounts and Pages.
* Coordinate legitimate appeals and follow up on account reviews through official Meta channels.
* Track the status of appeals, restrictions, and reinstatement requests.
* Ensure all operational activities comply with Meta advertising policies and applicable platform rules.
* Support the use of alternative eligible advertising assets only where permitted by Meta's policies.

**6. Payment & Advertising Spend Monitoring**

* Coordinate the addition and management of approved payment methods.
* Monitor advertising spend, payment status, billing activity, and account spending limits.
* Identify billing discrepancies, failed payments, and unusual spending patterns.
* Coordinate with the finance team, agencies, and relevant stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues.
* Maintain accurate payment and spend records for reporting and reconciliation.

**7. Advertiser Verification**

* Track advertiser verification and business verification status across relevant accounts.
* Coordinate the collection and submission of required business documents through official channels.
* Follow up on pending verification requests and document-related issues.
* Maintain records of verification progress, approvals, rejections, and pending actions.

**8. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date trackers for ad accounts, Business Managers, Pages, media buyer allocation, suspensions, payments, and verification.
* Prepare regular operational reports covering pending issues, account status, spend, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of escalations, follow-ups, and completed actions.
* Provide timely updates to management regarding operational risks and bottlenecks.

**9. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with agencies, media buyers, finance, technical teams, and management to improve operational efficiency.

The role combines three disciplines in a single senior owner: marketplace account management (catalog, pricing, promotions, operations), performance marketing (ad strategy, ACoS/TACOS, scale with efficiency), and client reporting and coordination on a day-to-day level. The ideal candidate has 3-4 years of hands-on marketplace experience, preferably from an agency background managing multiple brands simultaneously, with a demonstrated record of scaling revenues while holding or improving advertising efficiency. Prior experience in an e-commerce agency, marketplace management agency, or similar client-servicing role

title: Growth Business Manager- D2C

Nory For You is a direct-to-consumer brand that sells through its own website, Nory.com. As the business grows, we are looking for a commercially minded professional to own the website as a business and drive profitable, sustainable growth across acquisition, conversion and retention.

**About the Role:**

The D2C Growth Business Manager will own and scale revenue from Nory.com. This is not a pure performance-marketing or website-operations role. You will own the complete website growth funnel, from traffic quality and conversion to average order value, CRM revenue, repeat purchase and overall profitability, working closely with the Performance Marketing Manager and the Creative Strategist.

**Core mandate:**
own Nory.com as a business and continuously identify what is limiting faster, profitable revenue growth.

**What You Will Own**

**Revenue and Profitability**

* Website revenue, growth targets and overall D2C business performance, with monthly and quarterly revenue plans and early flags on gaps.
* Contribution margin and profitable revenue, including the impact of discounts and offers.

**Funnel and Conversion**

* The full funnel: Traffic → PDP → Add to Cart → Checkout → Purchase → Repeat Purchase.
* Conversion-rate optimisation across landing pages, PDPs, cart and checkout, with a structured, prioritised testing roadmap.

**Acquisition Economics**

* Traffic quality analysis by channel, campaign, product and customer segment.
* Guidance to the Performance Marketing Manager on where to scale, reduce or redirect spend, based on CAC, conversion and profitability.

* Bundles, cross-sell, upsell, multi-packs and offer architecture that lift AOV without eroding margin.

**Retention and Lifecycle**

* Email and WhatsApp journeys: abandoned-cart recovery, reactivation, cross-sell and repeat purchase.

* Joint work with the Creative Strategist to identify the messages, customer problems and creative concepts that drive high-quality traffic and conversion.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Website revenue growth
* Contribution margin / profitable revenue
* Blended CAC
* Website, PDP-to-cart and checkout conversion
* Average Order Value
* CRM revenue and abandoned-cart recovery
* Repeat purchase rate and customer LTV

* 4–8 years in D2C, e-commerce, digital commerce or growth, with experience owning website revenue or an e-commerce funnel.
* Strong analytical and commercial mindset; able to separate vanity metrics from real business performance.
* Sound understanding of paid acquisition economics, even if you do not run campaigns yourself.
* Hands-on experience with CRO, funnel analysis, cohort analysis and experimentation.
* Good grounding in CRM, lifecycle marketing and retention.
* Working command of Shopify, GA4, Meta and Google advertising data, and e-commerce analytics.
* A structured, action-oriented approach: analyse, diagnose, prioritise, execute and measure.

**Good to Have**

* Experience in consumer health, wellness, beauty or other education-led D2C businesses.
* Familiarity with CRM and engagement tools (for example Klaviyo or WebEngage) and A/B testing tools.

**Why This Role**

* End-to-end ownership of a D2C website as a business, not a single channel.
* A clear, measurable mandate with direct impact on revenue and profitability.

title: Delivery Manager
description:
**Delivery Manager**

Client Delivery & Operations • Digital Marketing

**Purpose of the Role**

Ensemble delivers digital marketing and AI services to a growing base of clinical and healthcare clients. The Delivery Manager owns the system that keeps that growth running smoothly — making on-time, on-scope delivery the standard across every account by owning intake, planning, capacity, cadence, and quality end to end.

This is a dedicated operations role focused on one outcome: consistent, reliable delivery. It is the foundation that lets clients trust us with more work and lets the team do its best work without friction.

**Reporting**

**Reports to:**
COO / Managing Director

**Works with:**
Account leads, the offshore (India) delivery team, and specialists across SEO, Paid Ads, Creative, Video, Web Development, Content, and AI.

**Core Responsibilities**
**1. Own on-time delivery across all accounts**

•  Hold end-to-end accountability for every client deliverable shipping on time and to standard.

•  Maintain one live view of all work in flight — status, owner, due date, and risk — so nothing stays invisible until it is already late.

**2. Plan capacity and resources**

•  Forecast team capacity against committed work and flag over-allocation
**before**
it causes slippage.

•  Balance workload across the offshore team and specialists; reassign to clear bottlenecks.

•  Translate client commitments into realistic timelines the team can actually hit — push back when they can’t.

**3. Control intake, priorities, and scope**

•  Run a disciplined intake process — no work starts without a clear scope, owner, and deadline.

•  Set and communicate priorities across accounts; resolve conflicts between competing client demands.

•  Catch scope creep early and escalate the trade-off rather than silently absorbing it into the timeline.

**4. Run the delivery cadence**

•  Lead a recurring delivery rhythm (daily standup + weekly account review) that surfaces risk early.

•  Coordinate across time zones so the offshore team stays unblocked and handoffs don’t stall overnight.

•  Track dependencies and escalations and drive them to resolution.

**5. Enforce quality**

•  Review deliverables before they reach the client — nothing ships below standard.

•  For healthcare and clinical clients, ensure work meets compliance expectations (HIPAA-aware handling, compliant tracking and reporting).

•  Reduce rework by catching issues internally, not at the client.

**6. Report to clients and leadership**

•  Give clients clear, consistent status updates — progress, what’s next, and any risks to the timeline.

•  Give leadership an honest, data-backed view of delivery health and where it is at risk.

**7. Build the delivery system**

•  Develop and maintain SOPs, checklists, and workflows so delivery is predictable, not heroic.

•  Continuously remove recurring blockers and improve throughput without simply adding headcount.

•  Mentor coordinators and the offshore team toward accountability and ownership.

**What Success Looks Like (KPIs)**

Delivery health is measured, reviewed monthly, and owned by this role:

**Metric Target**

1. On-time delivery rate ≥ 95% of deliverables shipped by the committed date
2. Rework rate < 10% of deliverables needing rework after internal review
3. Client-reported quality issues Trending down quarter over quarter
4. Team utilization 75–85% (productive, not overloaded or idle)
5. SLA / turnaround compliance ≥ 95% of requests handled within agreed timeframes
6. Delivery visibility 100% of active work tracked in one live source of truth
7. Escalation handling Risks flagged and resolved before the deadline, not after

**Qualifications**

•  Minimum 5+ years in project or delivery management, ideally in a digital or creative agency.

•  Proven track record improving or scaling on-time delivery across multiple concurrent accounts.

•  Working knowledge of SEO, Google Ads, Meta Ads, social, creative and video production, web development, content, and analytics — enough to judge quality and timelines, and to execute hands-on, if essential.

•  Experience coordinating distributed or offshore teams across time zones.

•  Familiarity with healthcare or clinical client requirements (HIPAA awareness) is a strong plus.

•  Strong on process design, prioritization, communication, and stakeholder management.

**Ideal Candidate**

An operations leader who makes delivery boringly predictable. Organized, calm under competing deadlines, hands-on and relentless about removing blockers and building the systems that let good quality work ship on time — every account, every time.

**CTC:**
As per market for the right fit candidate

title: Sales & Care Operations Manager
description:
Sales & Care Operations Manager at InGoodHands 🚀

🌱 Who we are

InGoodHands is an early-stage, funded startup in Bangalore making medically supervised weight loss and metabolic health care accessible to India.

India is in the middle of a metabolic health crisis, and most people who need real care either don’t know it exists or don’t trust it yet. We’re here to change that.

🎯 What you’ll do

* You’ll own the full patient journey, from the first conversation with an incoming lead to the care and support that keeps them with us.
* You’ll lead our small sales and support team, help them improve conversion and patient experience, and hire and build the team as we grow.
* You’ll manage our network of in-house and freelance nutritionists, health coaches, and doctors, making sure the right people, capacity, and coordination are in place to deliver great care.
* You’ll make the moving parts work together: diagnostics, consult scheduling, onboarding, medication delivery, patient support, and renewals.
* You’ll build the processes, playbooks, and dashboards that help us scale. You’ll know where leads drop off, where patients get stuck, and what the team needs to do better.
* We’re going from zero to one and growing fast. You’ll tackle a changing mix of problems, bring structure where it’s needed, and build things we haven’t figured out yet.
* You’ll work directly with the founders, so your ideas ship in days, not quarters.

✨ Who you are

* You’ve spent the last 5+ years in sales, operations, customer experience, or a similar role, ideally at a consumer startup.
* You’ve managed a team and can tell us how you helped people perform better.
* You’re comfortable with numbers and use them to make decisions, whether that’s improving conversion, planning team capacity, or understanding why patients don’t renew.
* You can turn a messy, recurring problem into a process that works—and get the team to follow it.
* You communicate clearly, handle difficult conversations with empathy, and follow through.
* You’re scrappy, you move fast, and you care about what happens to a patient after the sale.

⭐ Bonus points

Experience in healthtech, wellness, or consumer startups is a big plus, especially if you’ve worked with doctors, nutritionists, health coaches, or ongoing care programs.

💛 What you get

A seat at the table from day one, working directly with the founders. The chance to build sales and care operations from the ground up, with real ownership and equity in what we’re building.

📩 To apply

Email akshat@ingoodhands.co.in or DM me with a little about yourself and one or two examples of a team or operation you’ve led: what you owned, what you improved, and the results. We’d love to hear how you think and what you learned along the way.

title: Warehouse Manager - B2B Distribution & Fulfilment (5+ Years)
description:
**Role Summary**

We are a house of D2C brands (TMRW) scaling our B2B channels — marketplaces, quick-commerce platforms, modern trade, and general-trade distributors. This role owns the end-to-end movement of goods into these channels: from PO receipt to on-time, in-full, compliant delivery. You will be accountable for fill rates, freight economics, and channel SLA compliance, while building the systems and team to support multi-channel growth without compromising our consumer (D2C) operation.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Channel fulfilment & compliance**

* Own OTIF (On-Time, In-Full) performance across all B2B channels — marketplace vendor portals (Amazon, Flipkart), quick-commerce (Blinkit, Zepto, Instamart), modern trade chains, and warehouse.
* Ensure end-to-end PO-to-delivery compliance: ASN accuracy, vendor management, E-way bill management, appointment scheduling, and GRN reconciliation.
* Drive down channel chargebacks, debit notes, and SLA penalties through root-cause fixes, not just dispute management.

**Logistics & freight**

* Manage inbound/outbound freight across FTL, mostly LTL, and surface modes; optimise cost-per-unit and lane efficiency.
* Negotiate and manage 3PL and transporter contracts; build SLAs and performance scorecards.
* Own statutory and documentation compliance (e-way bills, invoicing, tax docs) for B2B movements.

**Inventory & planning interface**

* Partner with demand planning to allocate inventory movement (forward, reverse and RTO) based on the monthly plan
* Manage channel-specific inventory commitments, returns/RTV flows and documentation.

**Systems, process & team**

* Hands-on experience in managing TMS (Transport Management System) and WMS (preferably Unicommerce)
* Build SOPs and scalable processes for onboarding new B2B accounts and channels.
* Drive WMS/OMS and vendor-portal integrations with the Tech/Product team.

**KPIs You'll Own**

* Fill rate / OTIF % by channel
* Chargeback and SLA-penalty value (₹ and % of GMV)
* Freight cost as % of B2B revenue
* PO-to-dispatch and dispatch-to-delivery TAT
* Inventory accuracy and channel-wise performance

**Qualifications**

* 5+ years in supply chain/fulfilment, with at least 3–4 years in B2B distribution, channel logistics, or key-account operations.
* Hands-on experience with marketplace/quick-commerce vendor operations and/or modern-trade and distributor supply chains.
* Strong grasp of freight management, 3PL governance, and warehouse operations.
* Data-fluent (Excel is a must); comfortable owning a cost and service P&L view.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA or supply-chain certification (CSCP, Lean Six Sigma) a plus.

**What Sets a Strong Candidate Apart**

* Has scaled B2B channels inside a D2C or FMCG brand and knows where consumer-grade and trade-grade operations conflict.
* Treats compliance penalties as an ops-design problem, not a finance line item.
* Builds for scale — process and systems first, firefighting last.

Make your mark leading a high-impact settlements team with strong mobility, skill growth, and visible stakeholder partnership across the derivatives lifecycle.
  
  
As a Wash Account Management Lead Vice President within Derivative Settlements, you own end-to-end wash account management processing across rates, credit, equity, and commodities products. You lead an approximately seven-person team, drive timely break and exception resolution, and reduce aged and outstanding items through disciplined operating routines and escalation management. You ensure adherence to controls and regulatory requirements while delivering continuous process improvements and strategic initiatives across the settlements operating model.
  
  
**Job Responsibilities**

* Lead, coach, and develop an approximately seven-person wash account management team, setting goals aligned to business standards and performance targets.
* Act as the primary escalation point for stakeholders across front office, middle office, and derivatives partners.
* Manage team capacity, coverage, and queue health to reduce aged and outstanding breaks.
* Oversee daily workflow execution, ensuring timely investigation, resolution, and escalation of breaks and exceptions.
* Maintain strong derivatives product and lifecycle knowledge to self-serve investigations and reduce dependency on other teams.
* Ensure compliance with control frameworks and regulatory requirements, reinforcing a strong risk-and-controls culture and high-accuracy standards.
* Drive performance against daily and weekly metrics through reporting, trend review, root-cause analysis, corrective action plans, and workflow and process improvements.

**Required Qualifications, Skills, And Capabilities**

* Demonstrated people leadership experience, including team management, coaching, performance management, and goal setting.
* Proven stakeholder management and influencing skills across front office, middle office, and operations, including clear escalation to senior stakeholders.
* Client service mindset with professional, timely, solution-oriented engagement.
* Strong organizational and prioritization skills to manage multiple queues, deadlines, and competing priorities.
* Strong understanding of operational risk and controls with disciplined adherence to procedures and accuracy standards.
* Derivatives product knowledge and over-the-counter derivatives lifecycle expertise, including exception and break resolution.
* Analytical problem-solving capability with a root-cause approach and focus on preventative actions, with metrics-driven execution against daily and weekly targets.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Outlook, Excel, Word, and PowerPoint, with flexibility and adaptability in a fast-paced operating environment.

JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.

J.P. Morgan's Commercial & Investment Bank is a global leader across banking, markets, securities services and payments. Manager

Bangalore

Diversity – No

**Detailed Job Description**
**Role overview**
Minimum of 4 to 12 years of experience in managing complex public-markets workflows, investigate exceptions and coordinate resolution across internal teams, custodians and operational counterparties.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
Set up and maintain counterparties, SSIs, portfolios, accounts and approved static data.
  
  
Capture, enrich, amend and cancel trades, support matching, confirmation, settlement and daily status monitoring.
  
  
Process routine corporate actions, margin and collateral activities, pricing feeds, reconciliations and P&L data.
  
  
Maintain confirmations, settlement records, control checklists and audit evidence.
  
  
Identify missing data, unmatched trades, settlement breaks, pricing exceptions or recurring processing errors and escalate within defined thresholds.
  
  
Resolve complex trade, confirmation, position, cash, pricing and settlement breaks across listed, fixed-income and OTC instruments.
  
  
Independently manage derivative documentation, negative affirmations, failed settlements, transaction amendments and operational claims.
  
  
Analyse corporate-action impacts, support election processing against market deadlines and coordinate accurate downstream booking.
  
  
Review daily collateral valuations, margin calls, eligible collateral allocation and UMR movements.
  
  
Investigate pricing and P&L variances, support transaction-level explanations and ensure OTC static structures are established correctly.
  
  
Perform peer reviews, coach junior analysts and contribute to SOP, control and workflow improvements.
  
  
Oversee delivery across onboarding, trade capture, matching, settlement, corporate actions, collateral, market data, pricing, P&L support and OTC static data.
  
  
Set daily priorities around market deadlines, high-value or complex exceptions, failed trades, material breaks and critical corporate-action events.
  
  
Own service-provider SLA/KPI performance, quality reviews, control evidence, issue logs and operational reporting.
  
  
Coordinate complex escalations with CPP Investments, custodians and counterparties within approved engagement protocols.
  
  
Review exception trends and root causes, drive SOP, workflow, automation and data-quality improvements.
  
  
Provide technical oversight, workload management, cross-training and coaching for junior and middle-level staff.
  
  
**Core Competencies**
Familiarity with listed and OTC products such as equities, fixed income, FX, money-market instruments, derivatives and securities lending.
  
  
Exposure to Murex, SCD/SimCorp, Bloomberg, Quantum/Cash Master, CTM/GTSS or comparable trade-processing and reconciliation platforms.
  
  
Strong trade-lifecycle, corporate-actions, collateral, IBOR/ABOR, pricing and reconciliation knowledge.
  
  
Hands-on exposure to Murex, SCD, Bloomberg, CTM, GTSS, TradeServ, IceLink, AcadiaSoft, TriOptima, Apex/Clearstream and UDAs, as relevant.
  
  
**KEY SKILLS:**
Strong trade-lifecycle, corporate-actions, collateral, IBOR/ABOR, pricing and reconciliation knowledge.

title: Manager, Customer Experience, APAC
description:
**Why Harvey**
At Harvey, we’re transforming how legal and professional services operate. By combining frontier agentic AI, an enterprise-grade platform, and deep domain expertise, we’re reshaping how critical knowledge work gets done for decades to come.
  
  
This is a rare chance to help build a generational company at a true inflection point. We have strong product-market fit and world-class investor support. We’re scaling fast and defining a new category in real time. The work is ambitious, the bar is high, and the opportunity for growth — personal, professional, and financial — is unmatched.
  
  
Our team moves fast, takes ownership, and is deeply committed to the mission — operating with intensity, staying close to our customers, and pushing each other for excellence. We live by three values: Decisiveness, Simplicity, and Job's Not Finished. We act quickly on clear judgment over perfect information, we believe simplicity is what scales, and we're never satisfied with where we are. If you want to do the best work of your career alongside people who share that drive, we'd love to build with you.
  
  
At Harvey, the future of professional services is being written today — and we’re just getting started.
  
  
**Role Overview**
Harvey is looking for a Customer Experience (CX) Manager to lead a high-performing support team serving lawyers and professional services teams. Our customers hold their own work to a high standard of accuracy and timeliness, and expect the same from our support. How well your region runs is one of the biggest levers Harvey has on what customers actually experience when they need help. Reporting to the Head of CX, you'll drive operational excellence and accountability across Harvey's global support organization.
  
  
You'll balance strategic oversight with hands-on execution. This is a role for a leader who thrives in motion: proactive, decisive, and deeply motivated by achieving results through your team. You'll inherit a metric set and processes that need to be better, and we expect you to diagnose what's broken and fix it without being asked.
  
  
You'll also be one of five CX Managers across the globe, and that peer group is where our operating standard gets set. You're expected to trade what's working across regions and push for the changes you think we should make everywhere, shaping the culture and cadence of a growing support organization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Run day-to-day support delivery for your region: queue and coverage, triage and handoff, and escalation judgment, measured by First Response Time, Resolution Time, QA, and cSAT. When a number moves, you find the root cause and fix it or scale it.
* Set individual performance expectations and stay close enough to the work to spot drift early. Coach against QA results in the moment, and move to a documented plan only when coaching hasn't landed.
* Own escalations end to end: triage and severity judgment, customer communication through to resolution, and bug reports Engineering can act on without a follow-up thread. Partner with Product, Engineering, and Go-to-Market to turn recurring escalations into fixes.
* Take part in the on-call rotation for customer-impacting incidents, owning the coordination of response and customer communication strategy while an incident is live.
* Drive adoption of the AI tools and systems we provide across triage, drafting, deflection, and QA, and pressure-test what CX Ops ships against real queue conditions.
* Track how your region performs against the other four, bring what's working to your peers, adopt what's working in theirs, and propose the practices you think should apply globally.
* Forecast coverage and staffing against volume, and flag gaps before they have impact.
* Hire, onboard, and develop team members to ensure readiness for future growth and evolving support needs

**What You Have**

* 10+ years in customer support or customer experience, including 4+ years managing teams in a high-volume environment serving enterprise customers.
* Comfortable operating at Harvey's pace, not a typical enterprise pace. This is consistently the hardest bar for otherwise-strong support managers to clear.
* A deep focus on the customer, and real satisfaction in solving the problems that make their work harder than it needs to be.
* You are genuinely invested in developing your team, and you know a high bar is part of that.
* You manage close to the work. You know what your team's tickets actually look like, not just what the dashboard says.
* A change you made to how a support team works that produced a step change, not an incremental gain. You saw the leverage point others in the seat missed.
* Ownership of a metric set (FRT, TTR, cSAT, QA, backlog, deflection): what drives each one, what to change when one slips, and the ability to build your own reporting. We use Zendesk, Salesforce, Omni, and Snowflake.
* You understand enterprise escalations, from severity judgment through the customer conversation, and can work one yourself: reproduce the issue, read error logs, and troubleshoot API, authentication, and AI output quality issues well enough to brief Engineering accurately.
* You can take a process improvement from idea to shipped yourself, and you know which ones to handover to someone on your team instead.
* Day-to-day proficiency using AI tools in a production support workflow, not experimentation, and a concrete point of view on how AI is changing what a support team should look like.
* Admin-level fluency with Zendesk or an equivalent platform: views, triggers, macros, and routing logic.

**Additional Information**

* Work eligibility: Must be authorized to work in India. Visa sponsorship is not available for this role.
