title: Account Lead
description:
**What this job involves:**
As an Account Lead, you will serve as the strategic and operational lead for a key JLL client account, ensuring seamless delivery across the full spectrum of workplace and facilities services. This role combines high-level client relationship management with hands-on operational oversight, requiring a leader who can align business objectives with exceptional workplace and employee experiences. You will oversee integrated facilities management operations including workplace experience services, transport management, events support, food and beverage operations, soft services, and coordination with technical services teams to deliver a safe, efficient, and engaging environment. Acting as the primary liaison between JLL and the client, you will build trusted partnerships, drive operational excellence, and identify opportunities to enhance service delivery, employee engagement, and portfolio performance. At JLL, we are collectively shaping a brighter way — for our clients, ourselves and our fellow employees — and this role will play a critical part in delivering innovative, people-focused solutions that elevate the workplace experience. What sets JLL apart is our culture of collaboration, locally and across the globe, and you will work across multiple teams and partners to create integrated solutions that deliver measurable impact while fostering environments where people and businesses can thrive.
  
  
**What your day-to-day will look like:**

* Develop and execute strategic account plans that align operational performance with the client’s business objectives, workplace strategy, and long-term portfolio goals.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for the client, building strong stakeholder relationships through proactive communication, governance meetings, and trusted advisory support.
* Lead integrated workplace experience programs that enhance employee engagement, hospitality, wellbeing, and overall workplace satisfaction.
* Oversee day-to-day integrated facilities management operations including cleaning, landscaping, pest control, transport management, mailroom services, events support, reception services, and food and beverage operations.
* Partner with technical and engineering teams to oversee HVAC, electrical, plumbing, life safety systems, and general maintenance activities to ensure optimal facility performance.
* Drive workplace experience initiatives that create welcoming, efficient, and service-oriented environments for employees, visitors, and leadership teams.
* Manage vendor selection, onboarding, performance, and compliance to ensure all service providers consistently meet operational, safety, and customer experience standards.
* Develop and manage account budgets, financial forecasts, and reporting processes while identifying opportunities for cost optimization and operational efficiencies.
* Lead, coach, and develop high-performing teams while fostering an inclusive culture where everyone is empowered to thrive.

**Required qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s degree in facilities management, engineering, hospitality, business administration, or a related field, or equivalent industry experience.
* 8–10 years of progressive experience in facilities management, workplace experience, hospitality, corporate real estate, or integrated workplace services, including leadership responsibilities.
* Proven experience managing integrated facilities management and workplace experience operations within corporate or multinational environments.
* Strong operational knowledge across workplace experience services, soft services, transport management, events coordination, reception operations, and food and beverage services.

Our product portfolio encompasses wireless technologies (4G/5G based on 3GPP and O-RAN standards), fiber broadband (GPON/XGS-PON), carrier-grade optical transmission (DWDM/OTN), packet switching and routing (Ethernet, PTN, IP/MPLS) and Direct-to-Mobile and Satellite-IoT communication platforms. As an R&D-driven company, we recognize that human intelligence is a core asset that drives the organization’s long-term success. Over 60% of our employees are in R&D, we are reshaping telecom networks, one innovation at a time.

* Our goal is to build a workforce that reflects the diverse communities we serve and to ensure every employee feels valued and respected.

**About The Team**
At Tejas Networks, product development is driven by a comprehensive lifecycle approach that begins with understanding customer and network requirements, followed by competitive analysis, architectural design, and implementation. This process emphasizes performance, scalability, cost-efficiency, and environmental considerations, culminating in deployment and operational support. The technology portfolio spans diverse networking domains, including optical transport (DWDM, OTN), broadband access (GPON, XGSPON, CPON), service provider routing (IP/MPLS, Segment Routing, MPLS-TP), and enterprise switching (L2/L3). Products range from compact systems to complex, multi-terabit, chassis-based platforms designed for high availability, modularity, and scalability. Development involves specialized skills across hardware, firmware, FPGA, software, and synchronization, enabling teams to address multidisciplinary challenges effectively. Supporting these engineering efforts there is a centralized operational framework that provides strategic direction, governance, and essential services across the organization. This includes financial management, talent development, compliance, branding, innovation, risk management, and CSR. Together, these functions ensure seamless execution, alignment with business goals, and a culture of continuous improvement and excellence.

title: Production Lead-Trade,GCC
description:
**About Us**
At ANZ, we're shaping a world where people and communities thrive, driven by a common goal: to improve the financial wellbeing and sustainability of our customers. Our Institutional bank helps our largest customers move trade and capital around the region, providing our people with great opportunities to build their technical expertise and their careers.

As a Production Lead, you will be responsible for managing the issuance of Bank Guarantees and Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs), ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements and bank policies. The role focuses on delivering a seamless customer experience within agreed service timelines while maintaining high-quality output and adherence to Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  
  
Banking is changing and we’re changing with it, giving our people great opportunities to try new things, learn and grow. Whatever your role at ANZ, you’ll be building your future, while helping to build ours.
  
  
**Role Type:**
Permanent
  
  
**Role Location:**
Bengaluru
  
  
**Work Schedule:**
Flexible Shifts
  
  
**What will your day look like?**
As a Production Lead, you will be responsible for:
  
  

* Managing the issuance and processing of Bank Guarantees (BGs) and Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs), ensuring accuracy, compliance, and timely execution.
* Delivering exceptional customer service by collaborating with internal and external stakeholders to resolve queries and drive positive customer outcomes.
* Ensuring all customer communications are clear, professional, accurate, and completed within agreed service timelines.
* Monitoring and maintaining compliance with Service Level Agreements (SLAs), regulatory requirements, and internal control standards.
* Providing coaching, guidance, and on-the-job training to team members to enhance productivity, skills, knowledge, and overall capability.
* Effectively managing multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Building strong relationships across teams through effective communication, collaboration, and stakeholder engagement to achieve business objectives.

**What will you bring?**
To grow and be successful in this role, you will ideally bring the following:
  
  

* A minimum of 6 years' experience in Trade Finance Operations, with a strong understanding of trade finance products, processes, and controls.
* Hands-on experience in processing Bank Guarantees (BGs) and/or Standby Letters of Credit (SBLCs), including transaction lifecycle management.
* Proven ability to independently manage the end-to-end issuance, amendment, and servicing of Bank Guarantee transactions with a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively engage and collaborate with customers, stakeholders, and cross-functional teams.
* Sound knowledge of compliance, risk management, and regulatory requirements, ensuring adherence to internal policies, procedures, and industry standards.
* Proficiency in digital banking platforms, operational systems, and automation tools, along with the flexibility to support in all shifts and perform effectively in a fast-paced environment.

You’re not expected to have 100% of these skills. At ANZ a growth mindset is at the heart of our culture, so if you have most of these things in your toolbox, we’d love to hear from you.
  
  
**So why join us?**
ANZ is a place where big things happen as we work together to provide banking and financial services across more than 30 markets. With more than 7,500 people, our Bengaluru team is the bank's largest technology, data and operations centre outside Australia. In operation for over 33 years, the centre is critical in delivering the bank's strategy and making an impact for our millions of customers around the world. Our Bengaluru team not only drives the transformation initiatives of the bank, it also drives a culture that makes ANZ a great place to be. We're proud that people feel they can be themselves at ANZ and 90 percent of our people feel they belong.
  
  
We know our people need different things to be great in their role, so we offer a range of flexible working options, including hybrid work (where the role allows it). Our people also enjoy a range of benefits including access to health and wellbeing services.
  
  
We want to continue building a diverse workplace and welcome applications from everyone. Please talk to us about any adjustments you may require to our recruitment process or the role itself. If you are a candidate with a disability or access requirements, let us know how we can provide you with additional support.
  
  
To find out more about working at ANZ visit https://www.anz.com/careers/. You can apply for this role by visiting ANZ Careers and searching for reference number 125602.

title: Procurement Manager
description:
**About DATOMS**
DATOMS is an intelligent IoT software and hardware platform that streamlines asset management and operations for global enterprises. We leverage cutting-edge ML, AI, and IoT solutions to deliver scalable, customized hardware-to-cloud ecosystems. Our hardware and engineering teams build reliable, industrial-grade telemetry devices and gateways that operate in critical environments. We are a team of builders and problem-solvers, and we are looking for a dedicated SCM professional to scale our hardware delivery pipeline.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
We are looking for a proactive, results-oriented Procurement & Supply Chain Engineer to manage our hardware supply chain operations end-to-end—from early-stage New Product Introduction (NPI) through mass production and final delivery. In this role, you will bridge the gap between engineering, manufacturing, and global suppliers. You will be responsible for component sourcing, vendor onboarding, facility quality audits, demand planning, and international logistics. If you thrive in a fast-paced hardware environment, possess sharp negotiation skills, and know how to build a resilient, scalable supply chain, this role is for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* NPD, NPI & Sourcing Strategy
* NPD & NPI Integration: Collaborate early with R&D and Engineering during New Product Development (NPD) and New Product Introduction (NPI) to ensure design-for-

manufacturability, component availability, and target unit costs.
  
  

* Global Supplier & CM Onboarding: Identify, evaluate, and onboard global component

suppliers, distributors, OEMs, and Contract Manufacturers (CMs / EMS partners).
  
  

* Relationship Management: Build and maintain strategic, long-term relationships with

component manufacturers, semiconductor distributors, and assembly partners.
  
  

* Quality Assurance & Technical Audits
* Facility Audits: Conduct rigorous technical audits of supplier and contract manufacturer

facilities to ensure compliance with global quality standards (e.g., ISO 9001, IATF 16949
  
  
for automotive applications).
  
  

* Quality & Performance Monitoring: Monitor vendor performance, lead times, defect rates

(PPM), and drive corrective actions (CAPA/8D) alongside the Quality team.
  
  

* End-to-End Operations & Execution
* Full-Cycle SCM Ownership: Manage end-to-end supply chain operations from initial

PR/PO creation and raw material procurement to customer dispatch.
  
  

* Manufacturing & Logistics Coordination: Ensure smooth handoffs across PCBA

assembly, functional circuit testing (FCT), packaging, international customs/logistics, and
  
  
final dispatch.
  
  

* Cross-Border Logistics: Oversee international trade compliance, customs clearance,

import/export duty structures, and freight forwarder management.
  
  

* Planning, Risk Mitigation & Process Excellence
* Planning & Optimization: Drive demand forecasting, production scheduling, inventory

optimization, and safety stock modeling to ensure 100% material availability without
  
  
overstocking.
  
  

* Risk Management: Proactively identify supply chain bottlenecks, single-source

vulnerabilities, and component end-of-life (EOL) risks; develop actionable mitigation
  
  
strategies and second-sourcing plans.
  
  

* Process & Analytics: Develop scalable operational processes, establish key performance

indicators (KPIs), and produce regular executive MIS reports to drive continuous cost
  
  
optimization and efficiency.
  
  

* Cross-Functional Collaboration
* Work daily with Engineering, R&D, Quality, Sales, and Finance to align hardware

roadmaps with production schedules, cash flow, and customer fulfillment deadlines.
  
  
**What You'll Bring (Required Skills & Qualifications)**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree (B.Tech / B.E.) in Electronics, Electrical, Mechanical, Industrial Engineering, or Supply Chain Management.
* Experience: 3–6+ years of hands-on experience in electronics procurement, hardware supply chain management, or EMS/CM management.
* BOM & Planning Expertise: Solid grasp of multi-level BOM management, component specifications, production planning, and demand forecasting techniques.
* ERP & Software Proficiency: Hands-on experience with ERP/MRP software systems

(e.g., SAP, Oracle, Odoo) and advanced Excel-based modeling (VBA, pivot tables, dynamic dashboards).
  
  

* Quality Standards: Familiarity with quality management systems (ISO 9001, IATF 16949), supplier auditing methods, and electronics manufacturing processes (SMT, DIP, testing).
* Logistics & Trade: Exposure to cross-border import/export regulations, EXIM policies,

customs clearance, and international freight operations.
  
  

* Negotiation & Leadership: Outstanding negotiation, written and verbal communication,

and cross-functional stakeholder management skills.
  
  
Bonus Points For
  
  

* Direct experience in sourcing IoT hardware, telemetry modules, microcontrollers

(ESP32/STM32), or automotive electronics.
  
  

* Professional certifications such as APICS CSCP / CPIM, ISO 9001 / IATF 16949 Lead

Auditor, or Six Sigma Green Belt.
  
  

* An established network of regional and global component distributors and Tier-1 EMS

partners..
  
  
Skills: demand forecasting,vendor management,production planning,supply chain management,supplier quality audits,ems,negotiation,npi,iot,advanced excel skills,electronics procurement,bom management,strategic sourcing,inventory management,cost optimization

description:
**Description**
**Job Description:**
The
**Operations Manager – Finance**
is responsible for overseeing operational execution, service delivery, and team governance. This role manages end-to-end financial operations workflows—including attainment and bonus calculations, quarterly accruals, MIS reporting, forecast & budgeting, Purchase Order (PO) management, and invoice validation.
  
  
The Operations Manager serves as the primary operational leadership contact for various stakeholders including client, vendors and finance team, serving as the 1st Level Escalation Point and managing daily operational alignment, SLA adherence, quality assurance, and ongoing process improvements.
  
  

* Role Title: Operations Manager (Finance Operations)
* Primary Service Location: Bangalore, India
* Operating Hours: 9:00 AM to 6:00 PM local time. Should be flexible to work in a partial US/UK time zone to support clients as needed.

Core Responsibilities
  
  
1. Workflow Management & Service Delivery
  
  

* Invoice Validation Process: Ensure pre-invoices are validated against the contract. Drive resolution of vendor billing discrepancies, error reporting, creation of "invoice validation output packages" with CIV analysis, turnaround time (TAT) tracking, and defaulter list management.
* Attainment & Bonus Operations: Oversee consolidation of attainment numbers across vendor programs from the finance team. Supervise bonus calculations, formula verification against contracts, discrepancy reconciliations with vendors, vendor communication, and invoice validation
* Quarterly Accruals Estimation: Oversee quarterly bonus estimates per PO, run rate consolidation, spend reconciliation, and updates within the internal accruals tool. Lead resolution of ad-hoc clarification requests on invoices and billed charges.
* Commercial Reporting & Analytics: Maintain MIS reporting dashboards with accuracy, Spend tool reporting, Rate Card reconciliation, Vendor Scorecard, Oversee the generation and maintenance of the OPEX Spend Report.
* Purchase Order (PO) Lifecycle Management: Supervise bi-annual PO creation, estimate requisitions, ad-hoc PO additions/top-up, tracking PO utilization and PO closure.

2. Team Leadership & Resource Management
  
  

* Direct supervisory oversight of Team Leads and Senior Analysts performing core finance and invoice validation functions.
* Ensure all team members maintain the monthly target SLAs and Utilization.
* Manage onboarding and process training (4-week timeline target) for replacement personnel or team expansions without impact to service levels.
* Execute Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs) for non-performing personnel (capped at 30 days) and oversee immediate replacement for policy or security breaches.

3. Continuous Improvement & Governance
  
  

* Drive process re-engineering, automation, and Lean/Six Sigma methodology implementations to achieve a minimum 5% productivity improvement over the SOW term.
* Maintain and update standard operating procedures (SOPs) and training materials on a quarterly basis.
* Conduct weekly operational status updates, monthly reporting, MBRs, and QBRs with clients.

**Education**
:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in Science /Commerce. Preferably MBA/ Master's Degree in Finance

**Experience:**

* 4 - 5 years’ experience in Supervisory/ Managerial role and 12+ years of overall experience.

**Work Skills:**

* Detail oriented, well organized, and ability to multi-task in a results-oriented business environment
* Ability to work independently
* Strong analytical, problem-solving & decision-making skills
* Strong expertise in vendor financial management, contract rate analysis, financial analysis, accrual accounting, and invoice validation
* Hands-on experience or working knowledge of Enterprise ERP/Procurement tools including SAP Ariba, and spreadsheet analytical models
* Knowledge of Google workspace, Looker Studio and Gemini are added advantage
* Strong Communication (Verbal and Written) and interpersonal skills

Ability to work under pressure and meet tight deadlines

description:
**Who We Are Looking For**
Looking for AML KYC / Screening professional who understand and perform Ongoing Sanctions, AML, PEP and Negative News Screening to comply with Regulatory Requirements (i) SEC (Securities and Exchange Commission) requirements and (ii) investment guidelines stated in the Prospectus/Statement of Additional Information (SAI). Officer is responsible for the operational management of team. Officer has direct managerial responsibility, along with oversight for risk mitigation and responsibility for both day to day and ongoing performance management of their team.
  
  
**Why This Role Is Important To Us**
Ongoing Screening is automated matching of input records example clients, customers and accounts and sub-accounts (collectively “Customers”), of State Street, Securities, Brokers, etc., against lists State Street’s Corporate Minimum List Set as set forth by the Anti Money Laundering and Sanctions Business Unit Standard Operating Procedure using matching logic to determine if there are any potential matches to a list. As we continue to build and evolve our Robotics Customer Contact Center, you will transform the function into a key customer experience lever and growth engine. * Own operational performance, with accountability for productivity, cost, quality, service levels, customer satisfaction and employee engagement.
* Standardize and simplify processes and ways of working, moving from local solutions towards scalable global processes while balancing local requirements.
* Lead the team through change, building capabilities, ownership and confidence as responsibilities, technologies and ways of working evolve.
* Accelerate digitalization and continuous improvement, leveraging automation, analytics and emerging AI technologies to enhance customer experience and operational efficiency.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* University degree in Business Administration, Operations, Industrial Engineering, Customer Experience, or a related field.
* 7+ years of experience in contact center operations, including 3+ years leading a contact center team , in a global or multi-country environment.
* Proven experience building, scaling or transforming a contact center, with a strong track record in process improvement and standardization.
* Strong operational and people leadership skills, with experience managing performance and leading globally dispersed teams through change and evolving responsibilities, technologies and ways of working.
* Good understanding of modern customer service technologies, including CRM platforms such as Salesforce, automation, analytics and AI.
* Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills, with the ability to navigate a complex, matrixed organization. Fluent English required; additional languages are an advantage.

title: ServiceNow Engineering Operations Manager
description:
**What Success Looks Like In This Role**
We are looking for a ServiceNow Engineering Operations Manager to lead the design, delivery, and ongoing support of our ServiceNow platform, with a strong focus on IT Service Management (ITSM). This role blends hands-on technical work with team leadership: you'll spend roughly 60% of your time on technical engineering and platform work, and 40% on managing people, projects, and client relationships.
  
  
You'll work directly with clients and internal stakeholders to understand their needs, guide platform strategy, and ensure our ServiceNow environment runs reliably and efficiently. This is a good fit for someone who enjoys staying close to the technical work while also building and supporting a strong team.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  

* Lead the day-to-day engineering and operations of the ServiceNow platform, with particular emphasis on ITSM modules (Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge, CMDB)
* Design and oversee platform architecture, configurations, integrations, and customizations
* Manage upgrades, patches, and release cycles with minimal disruption to users
* Serve as a technical escalation point for complex issues and troubleshooting
* Act as a primary point of contact for client engagements, translating business requirements into technical solutions
* Manage and mentor a team of ServiceNow engineers and administrators, including hiring, performance reviews, and career development
* Plan and prioritize project roadmaps, balancing client requests, technical debt, and platform health
* Partner with cross-functional teams (security, infrastructure, business stakeholders) to align ServiceNow initiatives with broader organizational goals
* Establish and maintain best practices for development, testing, deployment, and documentation
* Monitor platform performance, security, and compliance, and drive continuous improvement

**You will be successful in this role if you have:**
**Required Qualifications**

* 10–15 years of overall IT experience, with substantial hands-on experience in ServiceNow engineering and administration
* Deep, demonstrated expertise in ITSM processes and their configuration within ServiceNow (Incident, Problem, Change, Request Management)
* Proven experience managing or leading a technical team, including performance management and mentoring
* Direct experience working with external or internal clients, including gathering requirements and presenting technical solutions to non-technical stakeholders
* Strong working knowledge of ServiceNow architecture, scripting (JavaScript, Glide API), workflows, and integrations (REST/SOAP APIs, MID Server)
* Experience managing ServiceNow upgrades, release management, and platform governance
* Solid understanding of ITIL framework and practices
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to move comfortably between technical and business conversations
* Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* ServiceNow certifications such as Certified System Administrator (CSA), Certified Implementation Specialist (CIS-ITSM), or Certified Application Developer (CAD)
* ITIL v4 Foundation certification or higher
* Experience with additional ServiceNow modules, such as CMDB/Discovery, HRSD, SecOps, or ITOM
* Familiarity with Agile or Scrum project delivery methods
* Experience working in a managed services or consulting environment with multiple concurrent clients
* Exposure to scripting or automation tools beyond ServiceNow (e.g., PowerShell, Python)
* Prior experience building out ServiceNow practices or teams from the ground up

As an Associate Clinical Operations Leader, you will take on Clinical Operations Leader responsibilities for assigned countries or selected tasks, supporting clinical research activities that advance new treatments for patients. You will join a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment focused on making a meaningful impact through study start-up, site performance, and timely, high-quality study delivery. **h.**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Coordinate and direct clinical project team members on small to midsize studies, providing productivity targets, performance feedback, and input to study-specific training
* Manage study start-up activities, including input to project plans, site selection strategy, monitoring plans, and patient recruitment and retention plans
* Monitor study timelines, patient recruitment, patient retention, and data cleaning to support a successful project outcome
* Address escalated site issues and drive them to closure, identifying potential problems early and supporting contingency planning
* Communicate effectively with internal and external customers, sponsors, investigational sites, and third-party vendors, prioritizing urgent requests
* Evaluate resourcing needs and monitor the use of resources across the project life cycle
* Prepare for and participate in audits and inspections, and support the maintenance and quality checks of central files
* Ensure compliance with ICH-GCP, local regulatory requirements, and Parexel SOPs, work instructions, and operational guidelines
* Collaborate on database lock, project close-out, and archiving activities with Project Leaders and Data Operations Leaders
* Support process improvement initiatives and contribute lessons learned at study close-out

**Candidate Profile**
**You Will Thrive In This Role If You Bring**

* Strengths in leading virtual teams across locations and cultures, negotiating and influencing with diplomacy, and root cause analysis
* Substantial experience in clinical research, with an understanding of cross-functional activities in data processing, data cleaning, and site management
* The ability to collaborate across teams, build trust with clients and colleagues, and communicate clearly in writing and in person
* A commitment to high-quality work, strong attention to detail, and a sense of urgency
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook) and WebEx, and the ability to become proficient with Parexel systems

**Required Qualifications**

* Degree in a life science or a nursing qualification, or relevant clinical or clinical management experience
* Substantial relevant work experience in clinical research operations, such as Clinical Research Associate (CRA) experience or equivalent
* Knowledge of International Council for Harmonisation (ICH) Good Clinical Practice (GCP), regulatory requirements, and clinical trial processes across the full project life cycle
* Strong command of written and spoken English, with local language proficiency as required
* Strong communication, organization, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize workload with attention to detail

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Coordinating experience, preferably gained in a Senior CRA or Senior CMA position
* On-site monitoring experience
* Local language proficiency for assigned countries
* Ability to travel as required

We believe in flexibility, growth, and creating space for people to do their best work. Join us and be part of a team where your contributions help shape the future of clinical research.

description:

---------------------

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. Reporting to the **Director of CX Insights & Analytics**, this leader will transform customer feedback, operational data, and market insights into actionable recommendations that improve the fan experience and influence business strategy.

This is a highly visible role that sits at the intersection of Customer Experience, Analytics, Product, Content, Marketing, Subscription, and Customer Support. You will be responsible for developing a comprehensive understanding of the APAC customer journey, identifying opportunities to improve satisfaction and loyalty, and championing the voice of the customer throughout the organization.

The ideal candidate combines strong analytical expertise, customer obsession, business acumen, and a deep understanding of the APAC market. They are equally comfortable diving into data, presenting executive-level insights, and leading high-performing teams.

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
**Who We Are**
Arcadia is the AI-powered energy intelligence platform for businesses. We replace fragmented tools and manual workflows with one platform to pay utility bills, buy energy, and advance sustainability — across every location, at enterprise scale.
  
  
Trusted by Fortune 2000 companies, Arcadia combines unified data, AI-powered analytics, and expert advisory to help enterprise teams save money, mitigate risk, and
****cut carbon****
.
  
  
**We Deliver This Through Three Comprehensive Solutions**

* Utility Bill Management: Automating the entire utility bill lifecycle — from data capture and validation to payment processing and auditing.
* Energy Procurement Advisory: Bringing together comprehensive data, AI-powered analytics, market expertise, and a strong partner network to make sophisticated procurement options accessible to all. .
* Sustainability Reporting — Verified emissions data with seamless integration into leading sustainability platforms.

Tackling the world's most complex energy challenges requires diverse thinking. We're building teams of people from different backgrounds, industries, and disciplines — united by a belief that energy management should be simple, intelligent, and a genuine driver of business value.
  
  
****Senior Product Manager, Platform****
**What We're Looking For**
We're seeking an experienced Senior Product Manager to join the Presentment value stream within Arcadia's Utility Data Platform (UDP) pillar. Presentment owns the customer-facing layer of the utility data pipeline, Plug, UDS, DELI, and DICE, that lets customers and downstream systems manage, retrieve, and consume utility data. This person will help define and drive product requirements for Plug's presentment capabilities — the APIs, delivery workflows, and customer-facing tools that make Arcadia's unified data model usable at scale — partnering closely with the Presentment product lead, who sets overall roadmap direction.
  
  
The ideal candidate is comfortable moving between an API spec, a front-end wireframe review, and a cloud architecture discussion, and can turn distinct customer and downstream-team needs into a coherent, well-documented presentment layer. This person should be comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to boost their own and their team's productivity.
****Note: this is not an AI-native product role****
— the mandate is data presentment and delivery, not building AI/ML product features.
  
  
The Presentment engineering team consists of 10+ engineers and 2 engineering managers, split across the US and India. This person will collaborate frequently with engineering (India and US), other Presentment and UDP product leads, and cross-functional teams like Customer Success and Operations to ensure the success of their product. The ideal candidate is a self-starter, detail-oriented, and a systems thinker who enjoys breaking complex problems into smaller steps that drive iterative delivery, and who can build and execute roadmaps while coordinating cross-team dependencies to completion.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Drive execution of the Plug presentment roadmap — the customer-facing APIs and interfaces that deliver utility data to internal and external consumers.
* Define, prioritize, and ship features that scale Plug across new and existing customer use cases.
* Partner with engineering to evolve the data delivery architecture, including cloud infrastructure (AWS) decisions that affect scale, reliability, and cost.
* Define and maintain clear, well-documented API contracts and specifications for downstream teams and external partners consuming Plug data.
* Collaborate with front-end engineering and design on customer-facing tools (delivery configuration, status/breadcrumb visibility, self-serve workflows).
* Partner with upstream Extraction, Auditing & Storage (EAS) teams to ensure presentment changes stay aligned with the canonical unified data model.
* Write clear product requirements and specs that are easily understood by both technical and non-technical audiences.
* Own day-to-day management of KTLO and balance run-the-business work and tech-debt reduction against new capability delivery, including evaluating where AI can reduce run-the-business load (without shifting the role's core mandate to AI product work).
* Use AI tools to improve personal and team productivity, and model good AI-assisted workflows for the squad.
* Monitor and communicate progress on initiatives to stakeholders and the leadership team.
* Collaborate cross-functionally with peers in Engineering, Operations, and other UDP value streams (Acquisition, EAS) to deliver on time.
* Contribute to public-facing API documentation (docs.arcadia.com) so external partners and customers can self-serve integration with Plug.

**What Will Help You Succeed**
****Must-Haves****

* 6+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time on cloud-based SaaS or data platform products.
* Solid data management fundamentals: familiarity with data models, storage systems (e.g., Snowflake), and how data moves through acquisition, storage, and delivery layers.
* Experience partnering with front-end engineering and design on customer-facing product surfaces (dashboards, configuration tools, self-serve workflows).
* Proven experience defining and documenting APIs, contracts, versioning, and developer-facing documentation, for consumption by multiple downstream teams or external partners.
* Working knowledge of cloud infrastructure (AWS or equivalent) and how architecture choices affect product scale, reliability, and cost.
* Comfortable using AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude) to increase personal and team productivity.
* Comfort with ambiguity and iterative delivery in a fast-changing environment.
* Experience working with globally distributed engineering teams across time zones (India/US).
* Demonstrated experience aligning and influencing cross-functional teams and diverse stakeholders.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, able to translate technical tradeoffs for both engineering and business audiences.

****Nice-to-Haves****

* Experience in energy, utilities, or fintech/expense-management software.
* Experience with legacy-to-modern platform migrations or system consolidation (relevant to the ongoing UDS → Plug migration).
* Experience with developer-facing APIs/SDKs or API-first product strategy.
* Experience with data governance, master data management, or data cataloging tools.
* Background in a regulated vertical (energy, finance, telecom, healthcare).

**Benefits**
****Compensation & Benefits****

* Competitive compensation based on market standards
* We are working on a hybrid model with remote first policy

+ Flexible Leave Policy

title: Builder Developer III
description:
**The Builder-3 Profile**

You are a systems engineer for non-deterministic systems. You are comfortable saying "no, not yet" to a working demo, and you can say exactly what would change your mind.

**1. Core DNA (shared foundation, at lead altitude)**

* **AI-Native Workflow.** You don't just use AI tools fast — you set the squad's bar for what "fast and safe" looks like, and you remove the bottleneck when someone hits one.
* **Agentic Architecture.** You still build end-to-end agents yourself, and you do. But your leverage comes from designing the state management, tool interfaces and failure semantics that everyone else builds inside.
* **Legacy-to-Modern Sequencing.** You decide *which* legacy modules get modernized first, based on blast radius, data gravity and how cheaply success can be measured — not on which one looks most fun.
* **Measured Reliability.** You define what "reliable enough" means for each workflow: acceptance thresholds, regression suites, human-in-the-loop checkpoints, rollback paths. You know that "100% accurate" is a marketing phrase, and that the engineering version is a measured error rate with a defined containment strategy.

**2. The Three Things You Own**

**a) The Guardrail Layer** Input and output validation, tool-permission scoping, financial and PII data handling, sandboxed execution, human approval gates on irreversible actions, kill switches, blast-radius containment. You assume the agent will eventually do the wrong thing, and you design so that it costs us a log line instead of a General Ledger.

**b) The Eval Framework** Golden datasets built from real ERP edge cases. Offline evals in CI as a merge gate, online evals in production. LLM-as-judge calibrated against human labels — and you know when that calibration has drifted. Regression detection when a model version, prompt or retrieval index changes underneath you. You move the squad from "prompt vibes" to a number that can fail a build.

**c) The Cost & Performance Envelope** Model routing, caching, context budgeting, latency budgets. You track token cost per *completed business transaction*, not per call, and you can tell the CFO why a workflow costs what it costs and where the next 40% comes from.

**3. Elective Depth (be deep in one, fluent in all six)**

* **Agentic Architect (Systems)** — state management and tool-calling interfaces for long-running business processes across complex ERP schemas.
* **UX/Interaction (Product)** — generative UIs and browser-use agents; designing where the human stays in the loop and where they don't need to be.
* **Data & Context (Data)** — RAG and knowledge-graph architecture: vector stores, chunking strategy, retrieval evals, and the relationship between a Purchase Order and a GL entry.
* **Reliability & Eval (QA)** — programmatic prompt optimization (DSPy), red-teaming agents, adversarial testing of financial logic.
* **Infra & Agent-Ops (DevOps)** — the factory where agents live: tracing, logging and monitoring the "thoughts" of the AI; deployment and rollback of prompts and models as versioned artifacts.
* **Domain Logic Translation (Business)** — turning 50 pages of accounting regulation into structured system prompts and agentic constraints.

**What You'll Actually Do**

* **Set the definition of shippable.** Write the standard for when an agent can touch production data, and enforce it in code, not in a wiki page.
* **Build the eval harness** and wire it into CI as a gate that can and does block merges.
* **Design the guardrails** around regulated and financial logic, including the human approval and rollback paths.
* **Run design reviews.** Kill bad agent architectures in week one instead of month four. Be specific about why.
* **Own agent incidents.** Pull the traces, find the root cause, and add the eval that makes that failure impossible to reintroduce.
* **Make build-vs-buy calls** on frameworks, vendors and models — and revisit them when the ground shifts, which it will.
* **Grow Builder 1s and 2s** through code review, design review and pairing. Not through ceremony.

**What Good Looks Like**

*(Targets to be agreed with the hiring manager — these are illustrative, not fixed.)*

* **90 days:** Eval harness running in CI on at least two live agentic workflows, with a published reliability baseline. A written, enforced guardrail standard.
* **6 months:** Every production agent has a regression suite, a cost-per-transaction number, and a rollback path. Agent-related incidents are down and post-incident evals exist for each.
* **12 months:** The squad ships agentic modules on a predictable cadence without you in the critical path of each one.

**The Stack**

Python, SQL (Postgres/SQL Server), TypeScript, OpenAI/Anthropic, pgvector/Qdrant, LangChain/LangGraph, DSPy, dbt, Apache Hop/Airflow, Docker, Weights & Biases, OpenTelemetry — plus the orchestration layer you'll live in: eval and tracing platforms (LangSmith / Langfuse / Braintrust or equivalent), policy and guardrail tooling, model routing and caching. And any other tool that helps us achieve greatness.

**Who You Are**

* **You've been burned.** You have shipped an agentic system to real users, watched it fail in a way you didn't predict, and changed your architecture because of it. This is the single strongest signal for this level.
* **Rigor over hype.** You love new models and you still ask for the eval numbers first. You know the difference between a cool demo and a production-grade agent handling financial data.
* **Agent-first thinker.** You think in capabilities and failure modes, not functions.
* **The manual-task hater.** If you do a task twice, you've already started drafting the workflow that kills it.
* **Technically fearless.** A 500-table undocumented legacy schema is a puzzle, not a threat.
* **A multiplier.** Your best week is one where the squad shipped three things and you wrote one design doc and two brutal, useful reviews.

**Why Join Us**

* **The Final Boss of complexity.** ERPs are the hardest problem in software for AI. Automate a General Ledger and you've mastered the game.
* **Agentic autonomy.** We don't do tickets. We do missions. You choose the models, frameworks and architectures you believe will win.
* **No red tape.** If the agent works and the evals pass, we ship. No Change Management Committee — a "Does It Work?" policy. Note that *you* are the person who defines what "works" means.
* **The Builder Tribe.** You will not be the only AI person in the room. You'll lead a squad of people as obsessed with moving 10x faster as you are.

title: Performance Marketing Manager
description:
**About Loanwalle**

Loanwalle is a fast growing financial services platform helping customers access the right lending and investment products, quickly and transparently. Personal Loan and Gold Loan are live today, and Fixed Deposits, Mutual Funds, and Insurance are on the roadmap for the next four to five months as Loanwalle grows from a single lending product into a full financial platform. This is a founding team hire. You'll work directly with Karan (CEO), Shurit (Chief Business Officer, previously at Birla Sunlife Insurance), and Saurabh Kanojia (CMO, 16+ years scaling growth at Viu/PCCW Media, IIM Kozhikode), not through layers of management. If you want the ownership, speed, and story of being early at a company aiming to become the next unicorn, this is that seat.

**About the Role**

As Performance Marketing Manager, you own paid acquisition end to end, from campaign strategy through daily execution, across Google Ads, Meta Ads, DSPs, and affiliate/CPA networks, and you build the tracking infrastructure that doesn't exist yet. You'll start by scaling Personal Loan and Gold Loan, then extend the same playbook to Fixed Deposits, Mutual Funds, and Insurance as each launches, so your campaign structure and reporting need to work across product lines from day one.

**What You'll Do**

Plan, launch, and optimize campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, programmatic DSPs, and affiliate/CPA networks to drive qualified leads for Personal Loan and Gold Loan, extending to new products as they launch.  
Own daily budget optimization using AI assisted tools, reallocating spend across channels close to real time based on performance signals (CPL, conversion rate, lead quality) instead of relying on weekly manual reviews alone.  
Set up GA4 and AppsFlyer attribution from scratch and keep data accurate across all campaigns and channels**.**   
Own weekly CAC and conversion funnel reporting (spend to leads to disbursals), structured so new products and channels can be added without rebuilding from scratch.  
Use AI tools daily to generate and test ad copy, headline variants, and creative angles for faster iteration and lower cost per test.  
Manage and negotiate affiliate/CPA network partnerships alongside Google, Meta, and DSP spend, balancing lead volume against lead quality.  
**Build a documented playbook for scaling spend as new products launch, so each new category ramps quickly using what's already been learned.**   
Work closely with the Creative & Video Content Creator and Social Media Manager on shared keyword research and messaging alignment across the growing product range.

**What We're Looking For**

3 to 5 years of hands on experience running performance campaigns across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and DSPs.  
Strong, practical understanding of lead generation funnels: what separates a high intent lead from a low quality one, and how to optimize for lead to disbursal conversion, not just cost per click.  
Direct experience managing affiliate or CPA network partnerships, including negotiating terms and monitoring traffic quality.  
Comfortable using AI tools for daily budget optimization and bid/spend reallocation, not just campaign reporting.  
Proven ability to set up attribution and tracking tools independently, without a dedicated data engineering team.  
Practical, daily experience using AI tools for ad copy and creative generation.  
Strong with numbers. Comfortable owning CAC, funnel conversion, and ROI reporting without hand holding.  
Able to work in a small team with limited resources, move fast, and take ownership without heavy oversight.  
Fintech, BFSI, or D2C lead generation experience is a strong plus, given how regulated and compliance sensitive lending marketing is.

**Why This Role Matters**

This is the fastest, most directly revenue linked hire on the marketing team right now. Loans are a high intent category, so performance here has an immediate, measurable line to business outcomes. As a founding team member working directly with the CEO, CBO, and CMO, the systems and channel relationships you build now across Google, Meta, DSPs, and affiliates are what every future product launch will run on as Loanwalle goes from two products to five.

Pay: ₹50,000.00 - ₹60,000.00 per month

That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operates under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) ("Crowe"). Crowe is seeking a candidate to support and assist the Commercial Transactions team within Crowe Advisory LLC’s Legal Department, the US-based parent of Crowe. This is a transaction-focused contracting role. It also involves support on data privacy, and, occasionally, general corporate matters. The Legal Advisor’s main job is to review, draft, and revise professional services, vendor, and technology-related agreements. The Legal Advisor will report to attorneys based in the United States of America. Regular working hours will need overlap with US business hours. The role’s duties and responsibilities may expand Legal Advisor learns Crowe’s business and shows sound judgment in managing business risk.

**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Review client and vendor contracts, terms and conditions of the Agreements, as well as requests for proposal documents (“RFPs”).
* Identify issues and areas of risks and propose modifications to the contract terms.
* Develop a detailed understanding of Crowe’s professional service lines and technology products, and the risks associated with them, so they can be reflected in contracts, terms and conditions, and RFP responses.
* Draft and negotiate professional services, vendor, and technology-related agreements, including master services agreements, engagement letters, confidentiality agreements, business associate agreements, SaaS agreements, data protection agreements, software licenses, subcontractor agreements, as well as related statements of work.
* Understand and apply the professional standards that are relevant to specific service lines, including independence and other standards that apply to US audit and tax services.
* Learn and apply international laws and regulations related to privacy, data protection, and information security and artificial intelligence laws and requirements when reviewing client and vendor contracts. This includes US federal and state privacy laws, the EU/UK GDPR, and others.
* Identify both apparent and hidden risks associated with the task presented and collaborate / discuss with reporting managers to manage the risk.
* Identify and advise on practical risk mitigation measures that may be adopted for the benefit of Crowe and the clients.
* Utilize contract lifecycle management (CLM) and legal AI review tools as a core part of daily contract review. This includes refining and maintaining the playbooks that guide automated and manual review processes
* Keep accurate matter records in the CLM system and meet internal service-level expectations for turnaround.
* This position will assist with managing Crowe’s contractual risk. Successful candidates must also commit to learning Crowe’s multiple business lines and products at a detailed level.

**Education Qualification:**

* LL.B. degree and qualification as a registered lawyer in India.
* Privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM) are also given priority.

**Key Qualifications:**

* At least five (5) years of relevant post-qualification experience at a reputable law firm, a Big Four or professional services firm, a global capability center, or an in-house legal department. Experience must include contract review, drafting, and risk management in a high-volume, fast-moving environment with rapidly shifting priorities.
* Candidate will be required to take initiative and manage a large volume of requests. Candidates must have the ability to multi-task, manage substantial workloads with changing priorities while staying focused on quality, clients, and teamwork.
* Candidate must be well organized and able to meet deadlines, while possessing sound business judgment, discretion, flexibility, and willingness to learn.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Must be comfortable communicating directly with US-based attorneys and business stakeholders.
* Candidate must have strong contract drafting and negotiation skills.
* Candidate must have the enthusiasm for learning new technology, including our contract management system and legal AI solutions. A strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office is also required.
* Candidates with additional experience in reviewing state or federal government contracts, working on governmental, accounting, or financial regulatory sectors, advising on international laws and regulations related to privacy and data protection, and on a range of intellectual property matters as they relate to marketing, trade secrets, licensing, patents, and copyright will be preferred.
* The selected candidate will report to the Associate General Counsel or Assistant General Counsel based on the United States of America.
* Willing to work hours that regularly overlap with US business hours.

**Preferred Experience**

* Reviewing US federal, state, or local government contracts, or public-sector RFPs.
* Working in the accounting or financial-services regulatory sectors.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

**Our Benefits:**  
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!  
  
**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**

Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Assistant Vice President Human Resources
description:
**WHO ARE WE?**

We are a bunch of super enthusiastic, passionate, and highly driven people, working to achieve a common goal! We believe that work and the workplace should be joyful and always buzzing with energy!

CloudSEK, one of India’s most trusted Cyber security product companies, is on a mission to build the world’s fastest and most reliable AI technology that identifies and resolves digital threats in real-time. The central proposition is leveraging Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning to create a quick and reliable analysis and alert system that provides rapid detection across multiple internet sources, precise threat analysis, and prompt resolution with minimal human intervention.

Founded in 2015, headquartered at Singapore, we are proud to say that we’ve grown at a frenetic pace and have been able to achieve some accolades along the way, including:

**CloudSEK's Product Suite**

* **CloudSEK XVigil**
  constantly maps a customer’s digital assets, identifies threats and enriches them with cyber intelligence, and then provides workflows to manage and remediate all identified threats including takedown support.
* **CloudSEK's BeVigil**
  is a powerful Attack Surface Monitoring tool that gives visibility and intelligence on customers’ attack surfaces. It uses a combination of Mobile, Web, Network and Encryption Scanners to map and protect known and unknown assets.
* **CloudSEK’s Contextual AI SVigil**
  identifies software supply chain risks by monitoring Software, Cloud Services, and third-party dependencies.

**Key Milestones**

* **2016:**
  Launched our first product.
* **2018:**
  Secured Pre-series A funding.
* **2019:**
  Expanded operations to India, Southeast Asia, and the Americas.
* **2020:**
  Won the NASSCOM-DSCI Excellence Award for Security Product Company of the Year.
* **2021:**
  Raised $7M in Series A funding led by MassMutual Ventures.
* **Awards & Recognition:**
  Won NetApp Excellerator's "Best Growth Strategy Award," CloudSEK XVigil joined NVIDIA Inception Program, and won the NASSCOM Emerge 50 Cybersecurity Award.
* **2025:**
  Secured $19 million in funding led by Tenacity Ventures, Commvault.

**About the job**

At CloudSEK, performance, culture, and happiness are not separate — they are deeply linked.

We are building a company where people do the best work of their careers, and we want someone who owns that outcome end-to-end.

The Chief Happiness Officer(Director/AVP HR) is accountable for keeping our teams engaged, motivated, focused, and performing at a high level — while ensuring we retain our best people and build a culture that compounds over time.

This is not a “feel-good HR” role. This is a systems + culture + performance role.

**What you will own**

1. Measure what matters

You will build the instrumentation to continuously track:

• Engagement, morale, burnout, and energy levels

• Manager effectiveness and team health

• Attrition risk, regretted exits, and retention of top performers

• Alignment to company mission, clarity of goals, and execution focus

You will turn these into dashboards, signals, and early-warning systems — not once-a-year surveys.

2. Build feedback and improvement loops

You will design and run:

• Continuous feedback systems (pulse surveys, 1:1 frameworks, skip-levels)

• Clear escalation and resolution loops for friction, conflict, and disengagement

• Manager coaching programs to improve leadership quality across the company

Your job is to detect problems early and fix them before they impact execution.

3. Identify, grow, and retain top performers

You will:

• Build a clear, fair system to identify high performers and high-potential talent

• Ensure top performers are recognized, rewarded, and developed faster than the rest

• Design retention strategies for critical talent

• Work with leadership on promotions, growth paths, and succession planning

Your outcome: our best people feel seen, valued, and challenged — not ignored or burned out.

4. Design a culture that scales

You will:

• Codify and reinforce our cultural values through rituals, stories, and behavior systems

• Ensure culture is consistent across geographies, teams, and growth stages

• Remove incentives and behaviors that create politics, fear, or low-trust environments

• Build a company where speed, ownership, integrity, and excellence are the norm

Culture is not posters — it’s what people do when no one is watching. You will shape that.

5. Partner with leadership on org design and people strategy

You will work closely with:

• The CEO and leadership team on org health and structure

• Managers on team effectiveness and leadership quality

• HR / People Ops on compensation, performance, and growth systems

You will bring data, insight, and perspective to leadership — not just execution.

**What success looks like**

• High engagement and energy across teams

• Low regretted attrition, especially among top performers

• Managers who are trusted, effective, and respected

• A culture that attracts strong talent and repels low-integrity behavior

• A company where people do great work and want to stay

**Who you are**

• 12+ years in people leadership, culture, org design, or performance roles (startup / tech preferred)

• Strong systems thinker — you can design feedback loops, metrics, and processes

• Deep empathy + high standards — you care about people, but you don’t tolerate mediocrity

• Comfortable with data, dashboards, and analytics

• Confident influencing senior leaders and holding them accountable

• High integrity, low ego, extremely trustworthy

• You genuinely care about helping people do their best work

**Benefits of Joining CloudSEK**

We provide an environment where you can develop and enhance your skills while delivering meaningful work that matters. You’ll be rewarded a competitive salary as well as a full spectrum of generous perks and incentives which include:

* Flexible working hours.
* Food, unlimited snacks and drinks are all available while at office.
* And, the finest part is yet to come! Every now and then we ensure to unwind and have a good time together, which involves games, fun, and soulful music. Feel free to show off your artistic side here!

**CloudSEK is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace. We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply.**

Preferred experience

* Experience strengthening HR processes in a growing local team. Mandarin language skills are a plus.

title: Senior Manager - Organisational Culture Assurance
description:
**Job Purpose:**
The Organizational Culture Assurance Analyst develops A&A’s behavioral and risk analytics capability, delivering data-driven insights that strengthen assurance planning, audit execution and enterprise risk oversight.
  
  
The role acts as the technical and analytical lead for Organizational Culture Assurance and wider A&A analytics initiatives, combining expertise in data analytics, visualization, behavioral indicators, organizational data and emerging AI-enabled analytical approaches.
  
  
Working across A&A, Human Resources, Compliance, Risk Management and business leadership teams, the role develops analytical products that identify organizational conditions, behavioral patterns and emerging risks which may impact business performance, governance effectiveness and risk management outcomes.
  
  
The role plays a central part in delivering A&A's Organizational Culture Assurance model through:
  
  

* Development of organizational Culture dashboards to support audit teams.
* Creation of enterprise behavioral and risk intelligence products for senior leadership and governance forums.
* Advanced analytics supporting targeted organizational culture assurance & Insights reviews.
* Integration of data-driven behavioral insights into assurance planning, testing and reporting.

The role serves as a center of excellence for behavioral and assurance analytics and helps position A&A as a leading-edge assurance function that combines traditional audit techniques with advanced analytics and organizational insight.
  
  
The role acts as the technical owner for organizational cultural analytics, dashboard architecture, culture and behavioral risk indicators and analytical methodologies used by the Organizational Culture Assurance team and wider A&A function.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
**Behavioral and Culture Analytics**

* Develop analytical models to identify behavioral patterns, cultural indicators and emerging organizational risks.
* Analyze large and complex datasets from multiple sources to identify trends, anomalies and relationships relevant to governance, risk management and organizational effectiveness.
* Interpret behavioral indicators associated with accountability, leadership effectiveness, collaboration, decision-making, challenge, escalation and psychological safety.
* Support development of methodologies that enable objective assessment of organizational behaviors.

**Dashboard Development and Reporting**

* Design, build and maintain a suite of behavioral and risk dashboards for A&A, leadership teams, RMCBs, ExCom and the ARC.
* Develop leading and lagging indicators that provide visibility of organizational and behavioral risk.
* Ensure dashboards are intuitive, evidence-based and aligned to strategic and enterprise risk priorities.
* Continuously enhance reporting capabilities through automation, visualization and advanced analytics techniques.

**Audit Enablement**

* Develop analytical products to support risk assessment, audit planning and assurance prioritization.
* Develop organizational Culture indicators relevant to key audit themes and enterprise risks.
* Provide specialist analytical support for complex or high-risk audit engagements.
* Support identification of audit targets and trigger points for dedicated Organizational Culture Assurance reviews.

**Data Integration and Insight Generation**

* Consolidate information from diverse data sources to develop enterprise-level insights.
* Analyze trends from workforce data, employee engagement surveys, speak-up reporting, compliance indicators, safety data, organizational structures, attrition metrics, performance measures and other relevant information sources.
* Identify themes that may signal emerging organizational vulnerabilities or opportunities.
* Translate analytical outputs into practical insights that support executive decision-making.
* Develop and maintain culture and behavioral risk models, trend analyses and predictive indicators that support identification of emerging organizational risks.
* Design and maintain data pipelines and analytical processes that consolidate information from multiple enterprise systems into consistent assurance products.
* Establish controls and quality assurance processes for behavioral and risk analytics outputs.

**AI and Innovation**

* Develop AI-assisted analytical techniques to identify behavioral patterns, cultural themes and potential risk indicators across large and complex datasets.
* Evaluate emerging analytical technologies and assess opportunities to improve assurance coverage, efficiency and effectiveness.
* Identify opportunities to improve assurance effectiveness through automation and advanced analytics.
* Monitor emerging developments in analytics, data science and assurance technology.
* Promote the responsible and effective use of analytics across A&A.

**Capability Development**

* Support development of analytical capability across A&A.
* Support auditors and Organisational Culture Assurance Managers in using analytical tools and interpreting behavioral indicators.
* Establish analytical standards, controls and good practices.
* Contribute to continuous improvement of A&A methodologies and assurance strategies

**Skills & Experience**

* Significant experience in data analytics, business intelligence, audit analytics, people analytics, risk analytics or related disciplines.
* Strong capability in analysing large and complex datasets and translating findings into actionable insights.
* 10 to 15yrs of experience in audit and assurance.
* Experience designing dashboards, visualisations and executive reporting products.
* Experience using modern business intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau or equivalent.
* Experience establishing analytics governance, controls and quality standards.
* Excellent problem-solving and critical-thinking capability.
* Strong communication skills with demonstrated ability to explain complex findings to non-technical audiences.
* Experience working within risk, assurance, audit, compliance, HR analytics or related environments.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills.
* Bachelor's degree in analytics, data science, statistics, mathematics, business, psychology, economics, information systems or a related discipline.

**Preferred skills:**

* Experience applying analytics within Internal Audit, Risk Management or Compliance functions.
* Experience working with organisational health, workforce, engagement or behavioural datasets.
* Knowledge of behavioural science, organisational psychology or organisational effectiveness frameworks.
* Experience applying machine learning or AI-enabled analytical techniques.
* Professional qualifications in analytics, audit or risk management.
* Experience supporting Board, Executive Committee or senior governance reporting.

**Skills**
Audit Risk Assessments, Business Compliance, Digital Fluency, Industry Knowledge, Influencing Without Authority, Insight Generation, International Standards on Auditing (ISA), PESTLE Analysis, Stakeholder Management, Tactical Questioning
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. title: Payroll Lead
description:
Sprinklr is the definitive, AI-native platform for Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM), empowering brands to deliver extraordinary experiences at scale — across every customer touchpoint.
  
  
By combining human instinct with the speed and efficiency of AI, Sprinklr helps brands earn trust and loyalty through personalized, seamless, and efficient customer interactions. Sprinklr’s unified platform provides powerful solutions for every customer-facing team — spanning social media management, marketing, advertising, customer feedback, and omnichannel contact center management — enabling enterprises to unify data, break down silos, and act on real-time insights.
  
  
Today, 1,900+ enterprises and 60% of the Fortune 100 rely on Sprinklr to help them deliver consistent, trusted customer experiences worldwide.
  
  
**Job Description**
**What You'll Do**
We are seeking an experienced
**Payroll Lead**
to oversee payroll operations across
**EMEA and India**
, ensuring accurate, compliant, and timely payroll delivery in a complex global environment. This role serves as the regional payroll subject matter expert and is responsible for the delivery, governance, compliance, and optimization of payroll operations across multiple countries.
  
  
**Payroll Operations**

* Partner with Tax, Legal, HR, and external advisors to assess regulatory changes and mitigate payroll-related risks.
* Support payroll audits, reconciliations, and ongoing compliance activities.

**Vendor Management**

* Manage relationships with third-party payroll providers and local payroll partners.
* Establish and monitor SLAs, KPIs, escalation processes, and service quality standards.
* Lead issue resolution and root-cause analysis for payroll-related challenges.
* Support payroll vendor assessments, implementations, transitions, and RFP processes.

**Stakeholder Leadership**

* Serve as the primary payroll SME for EMEA and India.
* Partner closely with HR, Finance, Accounting, Treasury, Tax, Benefits, HRIS, and IT teams.
* Communicate payroll risks, recommendations, and operational updates to key stakeholders.
* Build strong partnerships with regional business leaders to ensure alignment and compliance.

**Systems & Continuous Improvement**

* Support optimization of payroll technologies and integrations, including Workday, payroll platforms, time and attendance systems, and financial systems.
* Ensure payroll data integrity, controls, and interface accuracy across systems.
* Participate in payroll system implementations, upgrades, testing, and enhancements.
* Drive automation, standardization, reporting, and continuous improvement initiatives to improve payroll accuracy, efficiency, scalability, and employee experience.

**Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Human Resources, Business, or a related field preferred.
* 6+ years of progressive payroll experience, including multi-country payroll operations.
* Strong experience managing payroll across EMEA and India.
* Deep understanding of payroll legislation, taxation, social security, and statutory compliance requirements.
* Experience managing third-party payroll providers and complex vendor relationships.
* Experience working with payroll and HRIS systems and integrations.
* Strong analytical and Excel skills.
* Experience supporting payroll audits, controls, reconciliations, and compliance requirements.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
* Ability to work effectively across global teams, cultures, and time zones

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with Workday HRIS.
* Experience with NetSuite or other ERP platforms.
* Experience implementing or transitioning payroll providers.
* Experience with global payroll platforms such as ADP or similar solutions.
* Project management experience.
* Professional payroll certification (CPP, CIPP/E, or equivalent).
* Experience supporting payroll transformation, automation, or global payroll consolidation

**Working Hours**

* Standard schedule: Monday through Friday, 40 hours per week, generally from 11:00 AM IST to 8:00 PM IST.
* Flexibility to support EMEA and India time zones, including occasional early morning or evening meetings during payroll cycles and critical business periods.

**We focus on our mission**

Our vision was clear: to unify fragmented teams, tools and data — helping large organizations build deeper, more meaningful connections with the people they serve. Today, Sprinklr has a unified, AI-native platform for four product suites: Sprinklr Service, Sprinklr Social, Sprinklr Marketing, and Sprinklr Insights. Sprinklr is here to do three things:
  
  

* Lead a new category of enterprise software that we call Unified-CXM.

* Create a culture of customer obsession, with trust, teamwork, and accountability.

While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.
  
  
**EEO - Our philosophy**
: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.
  
  
Reasonable accommodations are available upon request during the interview process. To request an accommodation, please work directly with your recruitment coordinator or recruiter.
