title: Regional Workday Specialist
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As part of a wider HR transformation program and the spin-off of Siemens Energy from Siemens, Siemens Energy is in the process of standardizing and harmonizing its HR systems and services. We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Workday Consultant to join our team as a regional point of contact for all topics related to Workday. The ideal candidate will have expertise in configuring, deploying, and supporting our Workday solution across various modules such as HCM, Security, Compensation, Talent and Absence Management. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver efficient, scalable Workday implementations and enhancements. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment with a business in the forefront of the Energy Transition.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* As a regional Workday support specialist, you are the primary point of contact for all Workday related questions and issues for your supported region
* Analyse business requirements or change requests and translate them into Workday configurations and solutions for your specific region
* Acting as a liaison between the internal business partners and external vendors to support the Workday post-implementation and ongoing administration.
* Reviewing open cases/issues in the region with Application Management Service provider and ensure that all tickets are closed in a timely manner
* Provide functional and technical support to stakeholders and end-users including offering post-implementation support and ongoing maintenance of the Workday system.
* In addition to the regional responsibility, you may be assigned as a Global Functional Lead for one of Workday modules, such as HCM, Absence, Compensation, Reporting / Data and Security.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Workday, including system configuration and support.
* Workday Reporting Experience and Expertise.
* Workday certification in one or more modules (preferred Reporting).
* Strong understanding of HR/Payroll/Business processes (depending on module focus).
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Workday integrations (a plus).

**About The Team**
In this role you will be working within the Human Resources function – HR Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget adherence of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 92,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.

This role delivers strategic direction and coaching, support and solutions to meet senior business leadership’s medium- and long-term business and people issues.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Workforce Planning: Collaborate with business leaders to assess current and future talent needs, ensuring that workforce plans align with business strategies and succession planning.

* Change Management: Lead or support significant organizational changes, including restructurings, mergers, acquisitions, and cultural transformation efforts.
* Strategic Recruitment: Work in partnership with talent acquisition teams to create hiring strategies that align with the organization’s long-term business needs.
* Leadership Development: Offer coaching and mentoring to managers and senior leaders to enhance leadership capabilities across the organization.
* Data and Analytics: Leverage HR analytics to provide insights into workforce trends, engagement, and productivity, informing decision-making across all levels of the business.
* Employee Engagement: Drive initiatives to measure and enhance employee engagement, ensuring alignment with company culture and values.
* Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DE&I): Collaborate with CoEs to implement DEI strategies and foster inclusive workplace environments.
* Risk & Compliance Management: Ensure adherence to risk and compliance management protocols across all HR initiatives.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Building Relationships and Influencing: Experienced in building trusted relationships at all levels of the organization and managing senior stakeholders, with outstanding influencing skills.
* Strategically Minded: Excellent organizational skills to utilize the wider HR function for transactional support, enabling a focus on strategic outcomes.
* Leadership: Strong leadership skills to lead and manage a team of Strategic HRBPs, providing guidance, coaching, and support to ensure high-quality service to the business.
* Dynamic and Agile: Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment, challenge the status quo, and manage multiple priorities and stakeholders effectively.
* Tenacity: A driven individual passionate about making the HR agenda successful, contributing to real business outcomes.
* Commercial Acumen: Partners with the business to deliver commercially focused people strategies, possessing a solid understanding of company finances and operations.
* Adaptability: Ability to adjust to rapidly changing environments while applying a problem-solving mindset to address people challenges.
* Resilience: Maintains focus and capability during setbacks, challenges, and organizational change.
* Financial Acumen: Demonstrated experience in understanding company finances and the ability to align HR initiatives with business objectives to enhance profitability.
* Presentation & Communication: Ability to present the People & Culture vision across all levels in the organization combined with excellent communication skills.

**Senior Manager – HR Process Automation & Transformation**
**Location:**
India
  
  
**Scope:**
Global
  
  
**Reports to:**
Sr. Director – Global HR Operations
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Senior Manager – HR Process Automation & Transformation will lead the redesign, standardization, and automation of HR processes across the global employee lifecycle.
  
  
This role partners with HR functional leaders to understand how work is performed today, challenge unnecessary complexity and variation, and design scalable global processes that improve efficiency, service delivery, and the employee and manager experience.
  
  
The Senior Manager will bring a combination of HR process expertise, continuous improvement methodology, and hands-on technology capability. The successful candidate will be equally comfortable facilitating global process design, challenging existing ways of working, and personally building practical low-code automation solutions.
  
  
The role sits within HR Operations and works closely with HR Shared Services (HRSS), HCM/HRIS, HR Centers of Excellence, regional HR teams, and Enterprise Technology.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead end-to-end discovery, assessment, and redesign of HR processes across functions and regions, identifying opportunities to eliminate unnecessary steps, simplify work, and create scalable global standards. Begin with Talent Acquisition and work through entire employee life cycle.
* Facilitate current- and future-state process design, including workflows, ownership, handoffs, controls, regional variations, service expectations, and measures of success.
* Establish and apply consistent process improvement and documentation methodologies, ensuring redesigned processes can be successfully implemented, operationalized, and continuously improved.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual work, improve accuracy, increase self-service, and create capacity through automation and technology.
* Personally design, build, test, and implement appropriate low-code solutions using Microsoft Power Automate, Power Apps, SharePoint/Lists, Forms, and related enterprise technologies.
* Partner with HCM/HRIS to leverage native platform capabilities where appropriate and with Enterprise Technology when solutions require broader integration, architecture, security, or technical support.
* Evaluate emerging AI capabilities and identify practical opportunities to apply AI, agents, intelligent workflow, knowledge retrieval, and other technologies to improve HR processes and service delivery.
* Partner with HR functional owners, HRSS, HCM/HRIS, HRBPs, and regional HR teams to translate business needs into practical solutions and drive stakeholder alignment, implementation, and adoption.
* Use data and operational metrics to identify improvement opportunities and demonstrate measurable results in efficiency, quality, cycle time, experience, and capacity.

**Required Qualifications**

* 10+ years of progressive experience in HR Operations, HR transformation, HR Shared Services, HR technology, business process improvement, or a related field.
* Demonstrated experience leading end-to-end business process transformation, from current-state discovery through future-state design, implementation, and stabilization.
* Strong knowledge of HR processes across multiple areas of the employee lifecycle.
* Experience facilitating process-design sessions with functional leaders and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Demonstrated ability to challenge existing processes, identify root causes, and translate business requirements into practical future-state solutions.
* Experience designing processes across multiple countries, regions, business units, or other complex operating environments.
* Hands-on experience designing and building workflow automation using Microsoft Power Automate.
* Working knowledge of Microsoft Power Platform and related technologies, including Power Apps, SharePoint/Lists, Forms, or comparable enterprise automation tools.
* Experience working with enterprise HCM platforms and partnering with HRIS/HCM teams on technology-enabled process solutions.
* Strong analytical, communication, and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to influence without direct authority.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience transforming Talent Acquisition, onboarding, or other Hire-to-Retire processes.
* Experience working within or closely partnering with a global HR Shared Services or HR Operations environment.
* Understanding of HR service-delivery models, case management, service levels, operational metrics, and continuous improvement.
* Previous experience leading employees, project teams, or operational teams.
* Experience with Dayforce or another major enterprise HCM platform.
* Practical experience applying Microsoft Copilot, AI assistants/agents, or other generative AI capabilities to business processes.
* Lean, Six Sigma, continuous improvement, business process management, or similar training/certification.
* Experience within a Global Capability Center (GCC), multinational organization, or HR transformation/consulting environment.
* Change management and/or project management experience.

**Success Profile**
The successful candidate will be a
**process thinker first and a technologist second**
. They will be naturally curious about why work is performed a certain way and comfortable challenging established practices while building strong partnerships with functional experts.
  
  
They will balance global standardization with legitimate local requirements and understand that automation is not the objective—better business outcomes are.
  
  
The ideal candidate will be comfortable moving between strategy and execution and demonstrate the operational and leadership capabilities to take on broader HR Operations responsibilities as the organization and role evolve.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Along with competitive compensation, you will be eligible for the following benefits:
  
  

* Multiple medical plan for self and family
* Company paid Basic Life, AD&D, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance, and Employee Assistance Plan (EAP)
* Paid Time Off and Paid Holidays
* Commuter & Shift Benefits (US / APAC shifts)

**About The Role**
Responsible for driving the full learning cycle at Zeta – from detailed learning needs analysis and diagnosis through content design, facilitation, vendor partnering, and impact measurement – in close partnership with HRBPs and business leaders. The role also leads organization-wide, high-impact learning programs and oversees learning operations, including learning technology, compliance training, budgets, and policies. This role will require close collaboration with Business stakeholders, People Partners, and the larger People Success team.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Partner with HRBPs to conduct detailed learning needs analysis (LNA) using data insights, performance trends, and structured discussions with leaders, managers, and employees.
* Diagnose capability gaps at the individual, team, and organizational levels, and translate them into clear learning objectives and solution recommendations.
* Design and develop learning content and journeys across behavioral, functional, technical, and leadership areas, applying sound instructional design principles and blended formats.
* Facilitate learning sessions, workshops, and programs, creating engaging experiences for diverse audiences.
* Partner closely with HRBPs and business leaders to understand priorities, co-create learning solutions, and drive adoption within their teams.
* Identify, evaluate, and manage external vendors and consulting partners – from scoping and selection through delivery and quality oversight.
* Measure learning effectiveness and business impact using structured evaluation frameworks, and use insights to continuously improve programs.
* Lead organization-wide, high-impact learning programs end-to-end – from design and rollout through communication, adoption, and impact measurement.
* Drive capability-building initiatives such as manager and leadership development, role-level certifications, and function-specific training.
* Own learning policies and manage learning budgets, including planning, allocation, spend tracking, and reporting.
* Govern mandatory compliance training (e.g., Infosec, POSH, Code of Conduct), ensuring timely completion and audit-ready records.
* Oversee learning technology, including LMS administration, learning KPIs, and dashboards that give leaders actionable insights on learning.

**Skills**

* Learning Needs Analysis & Diagnosis
* Instructional & Content Design
* Facilitation
* Stakeholder & HRBP Partnering
* Program Management Vendor Management
* Learning Analytics & Learning Tech (LMS)

**Experience & Qualifications**

* 8+ years of experience in L&D, with hands-on ownership of the full learning cycle – LNA, diagnosis, content design, facilitation, and evaluation
* Qualification - MBA/ Master's in psychology from a reputed institute
* Experience with managing learning/ other talent programs/ processes (from design, delivery, execution, communication, logistics, follow through and closure)
* Strong analytical, interpersonal and communication skills
* Experience with managing LMS, related data and reporting
* Demonstrated experience in partnering with business leaders and teams
* Experience with application of L&D/OD concepts, principles, methodologies, and tools

title: Deputy General Manager - Talent Management & Leadership Development, ISEA
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

Deputy General Manager- Talent Management and Leadership Development

Head Talent Management, Leadership Development and Culture ISEAM

Bangalore/Pune

* Identify linkages between talent management and business strategy and build these into operational plans and actions.
* Operational Excellence:
* Embrace and contribute to best practices in talent management.
* Design, develop, and implement innovative talent management programs to strengthen leadership bench strength. Partnering closely with HRBPs to execute strategic talent actions.
* Onboarding Managers on talent management processes, governance, and key metrics.
* Evaluate outcomes of talent management processes within your area or function.
* Drive talent reviews, succession planning and development planning- governance and execution
* Designing Talent Management Initiatives:
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design and deliver learning and development initiatives.
* Leverage data and insights to identify skill gaps and tailor talent development programs accordingly.
* The person will drive local leadership development, based on Global, Local and personal directions and guidance.
* Research on and bring to SKF in collaboration with IT intuitive and simple digital solutions for Talent Management.

**Key Competencies**
:

* Consultative Approach: Consultative mindset to approach and address business needs.
* Leadership: Demonstrate potential to grow into leadership roles in future, basis SKF’s leadership expectations and values.
* Innovation: Ability to ideate novel solutions to meet business objectives
* Adaptability: Capacity to adapt to changing business needs and environments.
* Collaboration: Ability to work with matrixed organization, cross-functional teams and external stakeholders like vendors through influencing and solution focus
* Analytical: Capacity to see data patterns and derive insights from data

****Education & Experience****

* A master’s degree in human resources, Business, Psychology, Management, or related fields.
* 15+ years of Experience in Talent Management, HRBP
* Proven track record in talent development, talent management.
* Experience in leadership development, change management, and talent program management.
* Familiarity with organizational development or learning and development is a plus.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

description:
**Why UKG**
At UKG, the work you do matters. The code you ship, the decisions you make, and the care you show a customer all add up to real impact. Today, tens of millions of workers start and end their days with our workforce operating platform. Helping people get paid, grow in their careers, and shape the future of their industries. That’s what we do.
  
  
We never stop learning. We never stop challenging the norm. We push for better, and we celebrate the wins along the way. Here, you’ll get flexibility that’s real, benefits you can count on, and a team that succeeds together. Because at UKG, your work matters—and so do you.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Lead and mentor a team, ensuring the consistency and repeatability of project delivery across global engagements.
* Onboard, train, and develop team members while driving initiatives that enhance productivity and scalability.
* Serve as the primary escalation point for complex customer issues, developing and executing remediation plans to resolve challenges.
* Maintain high levels of customer satisfaction by proactively managing project health through quality assurance techniques, reporting, and consistent follow-ups.
* Accurately forecast project staffing needs and work closely with stakeholders to optimize resource utilization.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives, resulting in superior customer experiences, enhanced team productivity, and operational efficiency.
* Provide regular reporting on productivity, performance metrics, defect analysis, escalation root causes, and forecasting deliverables.
* Identify, propose, and implement key improvement initiatives to create efficiencies and innovations that benefit both internal teams and external stakeholders.
* Anticipate potential risks or situations that could impact project success, assess their implications, and implement effective solutions.
* Collaborate with senior leadership on strategy planning, resource allocation, and overall operational improvements.
* Participate in business planning discussions, both locally and internationally, including travel for team meetings and strategic alignment sessions.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree required; MBA preferred.
* 10 - 12 years of industry experience, including 4+ years in a managerial role.
* Proven expertise in Workforce Management (WFM) and Human Capital Management (HCM) solutions.
* Experience managing direct reports, including technical leadership and mentoring.
* Strong understanding of professional services operations, including resource deployment, staff development, and partner management.
* Analytical skills with a proven ability to drive change and process improvements.
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, capable of engaging stakeholders across all organizational levels.
* Ability to adapt to evolving technologies and dynamic environments.
* Executive-level presence with the ability to influence and build credibility with customers.
* Demonstrated leadership and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to travel domestically and internationally as needed.

**Your Background**

* Proven ability to manage multiple priorities, meet deadlines, and thrive in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.

At Hitachi Energy, we are advancing the world's energy system to be more sustainable, flexible, and secure. We foster an inclusive and collaborative culture where diverse perspectives are valued, innovation is encouraged, and continuous learning is supported.

title: Senior IT Recruitment Consultant (BBBH1270)
description:
**Senior IT Recruitment Delivery Consultant – Chennai**

Competitive Salary | Uncapped Commission | Career Growth

Join a business focused on quality recruitment delivery.

**About Project Foundry**

Project Foundry is an Irish strategy execution and transformation business that helps organisations bridge the gap between ambition and delivery. Since 2015, we have partnered with government departments, public sector organisations and private businesses that depend on technology to transform how they operate.

We bring together specialist resourcing, professional services, technology platforms and transformation expertise to help our clients turn their plans into practical, meaningful outcomes. We work alongside them as a trusted, long-term partner, combining deep expertise with practical thinking and taking the time to understand their business, challenge assumptions where needed and consistently deliver high-quality results.

Our culture is ambitious, collaborative and accountable, guided by five core values: Client First, Always; Humble Dedication; Own It; Make It Happen; and Win Together.

**The Opportunity**

As we continue to develop our IT Resourcing practice, we are looking for an experienced Senior IT Recruitment Delivery Consultant based in Chennai. This is a hands-on recruitment delivery role supporting our clients in Chennai, with a focus on understanding technical requirements, identifying suitable professionals and delivering high-quality shortlists.

You will manage assigned permanent, contract and project-based recruitment requirements from briefing through to successful placement. You will work closely with our team, candidates and client hiring managers, and attend client-site meetings in Chennai from time to time when required.

This is not a 360-degree recruitment or business development role. Client accounts and commercial relationships are managed by the wider business; your focus will be recruitment delivery, candidate quality, effective communication and ownership of the hiring process.

**What You'll Be Doing**

* Take ownership of assigned recruitment requirements, clarifying the technical brief, priorities, timelines and candidate expectations with the internal team and, where appropriate, client hiring managers.
* Manage the full recruitment delivery lifecycle: search strategy, sourcing, candidate engagement, screening, shortlisting, interview coordination, feedback, offers and placement.
* Use direct sourcing, Boolean searching, headhunting, referrals and talent mapping to reach strong candidates, including those with niche technical skills.
* Provide constructive feedback on briefs, candidate availability, market conditions and realistic hiring timelines; flag risks and challenges early.
* Build effective working relationships with existing client hiring managers and internal stakeholders; attend occasional client meetings and site visits in Chennai as required.
* Develop and maintain specialist candidate networks and talent pipelines relevant to current and future requirements.
* Conduct structured candidate interviews and assess technical experience, delivery background, communication skills and suitability beyond a keyword or CV match.
* Coordinate interviews, candidate feedback, salary or rate expectations and offers through to successful placement.
* Work closely with our Resourcing, Professional Services and Managed Services teams to ensure reliable delivery.
* Maintain accurate records in the recruitment CRM/ATS, communicate progress clearly and meet agreed delivery and quality objectives.
* Contribute to process improvements and consistent standards across the recruitment delivery function.

**Technology Markets**

Depending on client requirements, you may recruit across technology and transformation disciplines including:

* Software Engineering
* Cloud & Infrastructure
* Cyber Security
* Data & Analytics
* Artificial Intelligence
* ERP & Business Applications
* Digital Transformation
* Business Analysis
* Project & Programme Management
* PMO
* IT Service Management
* Enterprise Architecture
* Technology Leadership
* CIO, CTO and Executive Appointments

**What Success Looks Like**

Success will be measured by the quality and relevance of submitted shortlists, effective technical screening, candidate and client experience, speed and reliability of delivery, and successful placements. You will be expected to manage multiple requirements, communicate progress proactively, maintain accurate records and build strong candidate pipelines. Business development targets and new-client acquisition are not part of this role.

**What You Bring**

* Strong experience in IT and technology recruitment delivery, ideally in a senior recruiter or senior delivery consultant position.
* Experience sourcing and placing technology professionals in Chennai or the wider Indian market, with an understanding of local candidate availability and hiring practices.
* Demonstrable success delivering complex or niche technical recruitment assignments and producing well-qualified shortlists.
* Confidence engaging with hiring managers to clarify requirements, discuss candidates and coordinate recruitment processes for existing clients.
* Experience recruiting permanent, contract or project-based technology professionals.
* Excellent communication, stakeholder management and candidate interviewing skills.
* Sound judgement on salary expectations, candidate motivation, notice periods and offer management.
* A consultative and delivery-led approach, focused on the quality and suitability of candidates.
* High standards of integrity, professionalism, candidate care and confidentiality.
* A genuine interest in technology and the ability to learn and discuss technical requirements credibly.
* Strong direct sourcing capability, including Boolean search, LinkedIn and other relevant recruitment channels.
* Experience using recruitment CRM/ATS platforms; Bullhorn experience is an advantage.

**Why Join Us?**

* Competitive salary and performance-related reward opportunities, subject to the applicable scheme.
* Chennai-based role with occasional visits to local client sites as required.
* Ongoing professional development.
* The opportunity to recruit for an established portfolio of technology and transformation clients.
* Opportunity to work alongside experienced technology professionals.
* A supportive, collaborative and ambitious culture.
* The opportunity to contribute directly to the quality and growth of our recruitment delivery practice.

**Why This Role Is Different**

This is an opportunity to focus on what strong recruiters do best: understanding requirements, finding and assessing talent, and delivering successful placements. You will have the support of an established technology and transformation business while taking real ownership of your assigned recruitment requirements.

You will work directly with our team and with client stakeholders in Chennai when needed, without responsibility for sales prospecting, cold business development or building a client portfolio.

Join us and help clients secure exceptional technology talent through thoughtful, reliable recruitment delivery.

**Required Qualifications and Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Electronics, or a related discipline.
* Experience in IT infrastructure support, Windows Server administration, and troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of server hardware, storage, networking, databases, and Windows client operating systems.
* Good analytical, problem-solving, communication, and customer-handling skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**

title: HR Manager
description:
Anaqua is looking for an experienced HR Manager to lead day-to-day human resources operations for our India office, partnering closely with Regional HR leadership on people strategy, employee experience, and statutory compliance. This role also owns front-line office management for the site — including supplies, vendor coordination, and close collaboration with IT — making it a hands-on, high-visibility position for someone who enjoys both HR generalist work and keeping an office running smoothly. Given the size of the office, this role balances broad HR generalist ownership with practical operations responsibility, and works cross-functionally with global HR, Finance, IT, and Facilities.
  
  
**You'll Love This Job If You Like To**
HR & People Operations
  
  

* Serve as the primary HR point of contact for employees and managers at the India office, handling day-to-day queries, employee relations matters, and escalations.
* Manage the full employee lifecycle locally: onboarding and induction, confirmations, transfers, and offboarding/exit formalities.
* Administer and continuously improve local HR policies, ensuring alignment with global Anaqua policy while remaining compliant with Indian labor law.
* Ensure statutory compliance across Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), Gratuity, Professional Tax, Labour Welfare Fund, and the Shops & Establishments Act applicable to the state.
* Act as the designated coordinator for the Internal Committee (IC) under the POSH Act (Prevention of Sexual Harassment), including training, recordkeeping, and case handling in partnership with Legal.
* Partner with global Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate, timely monthly payroll inputs, including new hires, exits, leave, and statutory deductions.
* Own leave and attendance administration, and support performance management cycles, including goal-setting, review coordination, and manager guidance.
* Lead local employee engagement, wellness, and recognition initiatives, and support learning & development programs in coordination with regional L&D.
* Maintain accurate employee records and HRIS data; prepare HR metrics and reports for regional and global leadership.
* Support audits (statutory, internal, and customer/vendor security audits) with accurate HR documentation.

Office Management & Administration
  
  

* Manage day-to-day office operations, including ordering and tracking office supplies, pantry stock, stationery, and equipment within approved budgets.
* Work alongside IT to coordinate new-hire equipment provisioning, system access, and desk setup, and to support offboarding (equipment return, access deactivation).
* Serve as the primary liaison with building management/landlord, and manage vendor relationships for housekeeping, security, pantry services, courier, and office maintenance.
* Coordinate office health & safety practices and serve as the local point of contact for workplace safety and emergency preparedness.
* Support visiting leadership and colleagues from other offices with logistics, including local travel, meeting space, and site access.
* Track and manage office operations budget/vendor invoices in partnership with Finance.
* Coordinate space planning and seating logistics as the office headcount evolves

What you'll need to be successful:
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; a postgraduate degree or diploma in HR/IR is a plus, or related experience.
* 5-8 years of progressive HR generalist experience in India, ideally within a multinational technology, software, or professional services organization.
* Solid working knowledge of Indian labor and employment law, including PF, ESI, Gratuity, POSH, and state-level Shops & Establishments Act requirements.
* Prior experience with office administration or facilities coordination, or comfort taking on this scope alongside core HR duties.
* Experience working with an HRIS and strong proficiency with Microsoft Office.
* Comfortable partnering with global stakeholders and working across time zones with Regional/HQ HR leadership.
* Excellent communication, discretion, and judgment in handling confidential employee information.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities between strategic HR work and hands-on office needs.

What success looks like:
  
  

* Employees experience responsive, consistent HR support and a well-run, well-stocked office.
* The India office remains fully compliant with all applicable statutory HR requirements, with no audit findings.
* IT and office logistics for new hires and departures are seamless, with no gaps in equipment or access.
* Regional HR leadership has clear, timely visibility into India HR metrics, risks, and employee sentiment.

This is an on-site role based at the Anaqua India office. Occasional travel to other Anaqua offices in India may be required to support employees outside the primary location.
  
  
Anaqua is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to providing a work environment free of discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are based on business needs, job requirements, and individual qualifications.

title: Senior People and Culture Business Partner
description:
Senior People & Culture Business Partner

**VERTEX INDIA**

**Help Build the Organization Behind Vertex India’s Next Chapter**

Vertex is a Cloud SaaS software company that designs, builds, and operates solutions that help global enterprises manage tax determination, compliance, e-invoicing, reporting, filing, and audit readiness. Our products sit in the critical path of global commerce and are trusted by some of the world’s largest organizations.

We are looking for a Senior People & Culture Business Partner to help shape the talent, organization, leadership, and culture needed to support Vertex India.

This is a role for someone who wants to do more than support the business. You will work closely with senior leaders to translate strategy into workforce and organization decisions, strengthen leadership capability, navigate complex people challenges, and help build an organization positioned for sustained success.

***This is an opportunity to help build more than an organization. It is an opportunity to shape the leaders, talent, culture, and capabilities that will help define Vertex India’s future.***

What You Will Be Accountable For

* Serve as a trusted people advisor to senior leaders, bringing a strong point of view on talent, organization, leadership, workforce, and culture.
* Translate business strategy into integrated workforce, talent, organization, and culture plans with measurable outcomes.
* Lead complex talent reviews, succession planning, workforce planning, organizational design, and organizational change initiatives.
* Coach leaders and managers to strengthen leadership capability, accountability, decision making, and team effectiveness.
* Advise leaders on sensitive employee relations, performance, leadership, and organizational matters, partnering with specialist teams where needed.
* Bring together workforce analytics, external practices, and business insight to identify emerging talent and organizational risks and opportunities.
* Influence leadership decisions by turning complex people and organizational issues into clear choices, implications, and recommendations.
* Lead cross-functional people initiatives and help strengthen enterprise People & Culture programs through business insight and subject-matter expertise.
* Mentor and support other People & Culture professionals, providing leadership and expertise across projects and initiatives.

What Success Looks Like

* Senior leaders view People & Culture as a strategic partner in important business and organization decisions.
* Workforce and talent decisions are clearly connected to business priorities and outcomes.
* Leaders have stronger talent pipelines, succession plans, and organizational capabilities.
* Complex organizational and people challenges are anticipated early and addressed with sound judgment.
* Leaders and managers strengthen their ability to lead teams, navigate change, and drive accountability.
* Workforce insights and data lead to clearer decisions, not simply more reporting.
* People programs and practices become more effective because they reflect the realities and needs of the business.

What You Bring

* 6–8 years of progressive human resources experience, including significant HR business partnership experience.
* Advanced knowledge across multiple HR disciplines and deep expertise in HR business partnership.

* Demonstrated success influencing senior stakeholders and leading through change.

This role is for someone who wants more than a traditional business-partner assignment. *Vertex is committed to building inclusive teams where people can contribute their unique talents and perspectives.*

title: Compensation Benefits Analyst
description:
Compensation & Benefits Analyst

**VERTEX INDIA**

**Help Shape the Rewards Experience Behind Vertex India’s Growth**

Vertex is a Cloud SaaS software company that designs, builds, and operates solutions that help global enterprises manage tax determination, compliance, e-invoicing, reporting, filing, and audit readiness. Our products sit in the critical path of global commerce and are trusted by some of the world’s largest organizations.

We are looking for a Compensation & Benefits Analyst to help deliver the rewards programs and insights that enable Vertex to attract, retain, and reward talent as our organization continues to grow.

This is a role for someone who brings together analytical strength, Total Rewards expertise, and practical business judgment. You will work across compensation and benefits, using market, employee, and financial data to inform decisions while partnering with People & Culture, Finance, Payroll, and other teams to deliver programs employees and leaders can understand and trust.

***This is an opportunity to do more than analyze compensation and benefits. You will help turn data into decisions and programs into an employee experience that supports Vertex’s people and business.***

What You Will Be Accountable For

* Independently manage assigned compensation and benefits programs, processes, and client-group support.
* Conduct job evaluations, market pricing, pay analysis, plan modeling, and benefits cost and utilization analysis to support sound, data-driven decisions.
* Advise People & Culture partners and managers on pay decisions, job architecture, program provisions, and consistent application of Total Rewards practices.
* Lead defined workstreams across annual compensation, incentive, enrollment, renewal, and vendor-management cycles.
* Analyze employee, market, and financial data to identify trends, risks, root causes, and recommended actions.
* Translate complex Total Rewards concepts into clear program communications, manager guidance, training, and decision-support materials.
* Partner across Finance, Legal, Payroll, HRIS, Operations, and external providers to implement effective solutions.
* Monitor program effectiveness and compliance, identify opportunities for improvement, and recommend changes to program design or processes.

What Success Looks Like

* Compensation and benefits programs are executed accurately, consistently, and effectively.
* Leaders and People & Culture partners have clear data and guidance to make informed pay and rewards decisions.
* Market and workforce insights identify emerging issues and opportunities before they become problems.
* Annual compensation, incentive, benefits, and renewal processes are well managed across stakeholders.
* Employees and managers receive clear, practical information that helps them understand Total Rewards programs.
* Analysis goes beyond reporting data to provide meaningful insights and recommended actions.
* Total Rewards processes become simpler, more scalable, and more effective as Vertex grows.

What You Bring

* 4–6 years of progressive compensation, benefits, or Total Rewards experience.
* Broad working knowledge of compensation and benefits programs and how they interact across the employee lifecycle.
* Ability to independently perform market pricing, compensation analysis, plan modeling, and benefits analysis.
* Strong quantitative, spreadsheet, data-quality, and analytical skills.
* Working knowledge of job architecture, salary structures, incentive plans, and benefits delivery.
* Strong consulting and communication skills, with the ability to make technical Total Rewards concepts understandable to non-specialist audiences.
* Ability to solve moderately complex problems using data, policy, and sound judgment.
* Project and process-management skills with the ability to coordinate work across multiple stakeholders.
* The judgment and discretion required to work with sensitive employee and compensation information.
* A bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business, Finance, Analytics, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* CCP, CEBS, or a comparable certification is beneficial but not required.

Why Vertex, Why Now

Vertex sits at the intersection of technology, global commerce, tax, and compliance. As the company continues to grow and evolve, how we attract, reward, and retain great talent will be an important part of building the organization for the future.

This role is for someone who wants more than a traditional analyst position. It is an opportunity to combine analytics with business partnership, contribute to important rewards decisions, strengthen the employee experience, and help build scalable Total Rewards practices for a growing global organization.

*Vertex is committed to building inclusive teams where people can contribute their unique talents and perspectives.*

FedEx was built on a philosophy that puts people first, one we take seriously. We are an equal opportunity/affirmative action employer and we are committed to a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workforce in which we enforce fair treatment, and provide growth opportunities for everyone.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of age, race, color, national origin, genetics, religion, gender, marital status, pregnancy (including childbirth or a related medical condition), physical or mental disability, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.
  
  
Our Company
  
  
FedEx is one of the world's largest express transportation companies and has consistently been selected as one of the top 10 World’s Most Admired Companies by "Fortune" magazine. Every day FedEx delivers for its customers with transportation and business solutions, serving more than 220 countries and territories around the globe. We can serve this global network due to our outstanding team of FedEx team members, who are tasked with making every FedEx experience outstanding.
  
  
Our Philosophy
  
  
The People-Service-Profit philosophy (P-S-P) describes the principles that govern every FedEx decision, policy, or activity. FedEx takes care of our people; they, in turn, deliver the impeccable service demanded by our customers, who reward us with the profitability necessary to secure our future. The essential element in making the People-Service-Profit philosophy such a positive force for the company is where we close the circle, and return these profits back into the business, and invest back in our people. We care for their well-being, and value their contributions to the company.
  
  
Our Culture
  
  
Our culture is important for many reasons, and we intentionally bring it to life through our behaviors, actions, and activities in every part of the world. Randstad Enterprise Solutions — including Randstad Sourceright, Randstad Enterprise Group and Randstad RiseSmart — provides solutions and expertise that help enterprise clients position for growth, execute on strategy and improve business agility. **Position Overview**

The Director – Global Client Services & Operations Transformation Lead is a strategic leader responsible for driving world-class delivery, operational transformation, and commercial scaling across our global recruitment and scheduling operations.

Operating with an innovative, transformational mindset, this leader will oversee specialized outsourced talent acquisition services—including end-to-end RPO/MSP delivery and high-volume global scheduling operations—for premier enterprise tech clients. The primary mandate is to institutionalize a Delivery Excellence & Continuous Innovation Framework, leveraging AI-driven automation, data analytics, and continuous improvement methodologies to scale infrastructure, optimize P&L profitability, and elevate client partnerships from operational delivery to strategic management consulting.

Key Strategic Responsibilities

1. Strategic Client Leadership & Partnership

● Single Voice Governance: Serve as the primary liaison for global client stakeholders, presenting a unified narrative across internal Global Business Services (GBS) and regional delivery hubs.

● Consultative Value Creation: Move beyond standard status reporting by delivering high-level analytical insights, labor market trends, and predictive talent analytics to consult client leaders on talent strategy.

● Commercial Growth & Expansion: Partner with sales and commercial leads to drive cross-selling, upsell initiatives, and expansion into new revenue streams by establishing deep operational trust and exceeding SLAs.

2. Transformational Operational Excellence & Innovation

● Digital & AI Transformation: Spearhead operational modernization by integrating automation, AI-driven scheduling tools, and modern tech workflows to enhance process efficiency and service velocity.

● Workforce & Process Optimization: Standardize global SOPs and optimize workforce management metrics—including utilization, adherence, capacity forecasting, occupancy, and shrinkage—to eliminate delivery friction.

● Global Delivery Standardization: Institutionalize a "One Voice" service delivery model across APAC, NAM, and global execution hubs to ensure uniform "Premier" service experience regardless of geography.

● Enabling Function Accountability: Establish rigorous ROI tracking for operational enabling functions (e.g., Training, Quality Assurance) to maximize individual productivity and service consistency.

3. Financial & P&L Management

● P&L Responsibility: Oversee complete delivery budget and P&L across global accounts, ensuring targets for profitability, margin expansion, and cost-of-delivery ratios are achieved.

● Cost Efficiency & Contractual Rigor: Continuously evaluate SLA performance and operational delivery costs to identify savings, streamline workflows, and mitigate commercial risk.

4. People Leadership & Organizational Development

● Team Management: Lead, mentor, and inspire a large, multi-tiered global team (VPs, Directors, Managers, and Operational Specialists) across matrixed structures.

● Capabilities & Upskilling: Build a continuous learning ecosystem utilizing Individual Development Plans (IDPs), structured upskilling programs, and proactive succession planning.

● Culture & Engagement: Cultivate a high-accountability, inclusive, and agile workplace culture that encourages innovative problem-solving and high performance.

Core Competencies & Transformational Mindset

● Embracing Ambiguity & Change Leadership: Decisive leadership in uncertain, rapidly changing environments; skilled at building structured frameworks within newly consolidated or evolving entities.

● Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to translate complex operational datasets and statistical modeling into actionable strategic risk mitigation and process improvements.

● Strategic Vision & Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen combining deep understanding of financial P&Ls, client growth strategies, and enterprise talent acquisition trends.

● Agility & Execution Courage: Ability to balance competing multi-stakeholder priorities (global, regional, client) while maintaining rigorous operational control and driving long-term strategic needle-movers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

● Client Retention & NPS: Exceeding target client satisfaction scores and transforming account status to strategic consulting partner.

● Operational Efficiency & ROI: Measurable reduction in cost-to-serve and cycle time through automation, AI tools, and process optimization.

● Financial Growth: Portfolio profitability, revenue expansion, and strict adherence to target P&L margins.

● SLA & Delivery Rigor: 98%+ global adherence to contractual SLAs, quality benchmarks, and workforce management metrics.

● Talent Development: Employee retention, engagement metrics, and successful execution of upskilling IDPs across the team.

Required Qualifications & Experience

● Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Operations, Human Resources, or related field (Master’s Degree / MBA strongly preferred).

Experience:

● 15+ years of progressive corporate experience within RPO, MSP, BPO, or Global Talent Acquisition Delivery environments.

● 10+ years in leadership roles managing large-scale global or multi-country operations. ● Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios ($15M+) with direct P&L accountability.

● Transformation Expertise: Demonstrated expertise leading process transformations, implementing automation/AI technologies, and navigating complex matrix organizations.

● Travel: Willingness to travel locally and globally as required by business and client demands.

* Graduate or Post Graduate degree.

* Experience working with:

+ SAP HCM
+ SuccessFactors Employee Central

* Understanding of end-to-end employee lifecycle processes

title: Senior Executive - HR Operations
description:
**Key Responsibilities**

*1. Onboarding & Induction*

* Coordinate pre-joining formalities: offer/appointment letter issuance, document collection and joining schedules.
* Conduct joining formalities and the induction programme covering company overview, policies, safety norms, code of conduct and systems access.
* Coordinate with IT, Admin, Accounts and department heads for laptops, ID cards, email IDs, access and seating before Day 1.
* Track probation and confirmation timelines, and collect new-joiner feedback at 30/60/90 days.
* Maintain the joiner checklist and ensure complete, verified personnel files (including BGV coordination with the HR Manager).

*2. Attendance & Leave Management*

* Consolidate and validate daily/monthly attendance from biometric or HRMS systems.
* Track leaves, late marks, on-duty entries and regularisations, and resolve discrepancies with department heads.
* Share the finalised attendance and leave data with the payroll team by the cut-off date.

*3. Payroll Support*

* Prepare monthly payroll inputs: joiners, exits, attendance, leave encashment, incentives, reimbursements and deductions.
* Check payroll sheets/reports for accuracy before release and raise variances with the HR Manager.
* Support statutory compliance inputs (PF, ESI, PT, TDS) and coordinate with Accounts/Finance and auditors as required.
* Handle employee payroll queries and payslip-related requests.

*4. TA/DA Processing*

* Receive, verify and process employee travel claims (TA) and daily allowance (DA) against company policy and approvals.
* Check supporting documents, rate eligibility and grade entitlements, and flag policy deviations.
* Coordinate claim settlement with Accounts and maintain the monthly TA/DA tracker and reports.

*5. General HR Operations*

* Maintain the employee master data, HRIS records and HR MIS (headcount, attrition, joiners/exits, attendance summaries).
* Support the exit process: resignation acceptance, clearance, full & final inputs and issue of relieving/experience letters.
* Issue HR letters and certificates (confirmation, salary/employment verification, transfers, etc.).
* Assist with employee engagement activities, statutory displays/registers and audits.
* Support the HR Manager on policy updates, performance appraisal cycles and ad-hoc HR projects.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* MBA/PGDM in HR or a graduate degree with a specialisation in HR.
* 4–7 years of experience in HR operations, preferably in a manufacturing, steel, power or other industrial setup.
* Hands-on experience in onboarding, attendance management, payroll processing and reimbursement/TA-DA handling.

**Skills & Competencies**

* Working knowledge of payroll and labour compliance (PF, ESI, PT, Factories Act basics, Payment of Wages, etc.).
* Proficient in MS Excel (VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, pivot tables) and any HRMS/payroll software.
* Strong attention to detail, confidentiality and deadline discipline.
* Good communication and coordination skills across levels, from plant floor to senior management.
* Ability to conduct engaging induction sessions and handle multiple tasks at once.

**Key Performance Indicators**

* Onboarding completion and document accuracy (zero Day-1 gaps)
* Attendance and payroll input turnaround, with error rate
* TA/DA claim turnaround time and policy adherence
* New-joiner feedback and probation-completion tracking
* Timeliness and accuracy of HR MIS reports

title: Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation
description:
**About the Team**
At DoorDash, people are our most important asset. The People Technology Team helps to deliver and facilitate strategic technology projects within the People Team. This role will be focused on supporting our People Technology function as we continue to optimize the advancement of our organization. We're looking for Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation to help us scale Wolt + DoorDash's enormous growth. Come help shape a best in class People Technology team!
  
  
**About the Role**
Based in India, we are looking for a Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation with demonstrated HRIS ownership to assist with strategic initiatives across our organization. Experience with Workday is preferable for this role. You will work cross-functionally to achieve business goals through system configuration, testing and documentation. As a Sr. Business System Analyst, Compensation you will help deliver solutions to support business strategy, and assist in the implementation, maintenance and enhancement of people technology systems.
  
  
**You're excited about this opportunity because...**

* Configure and maintain Workday Compensation module elements, including compensation packages, grades, grade profiles, matrices, eligibility rules, and compensation review/merit cycles
* Partner with Total Rewards to translate compensation strategy (base pay, bonus, equity, allowances) into scalable Workday configuration
* Lead annual and off-cycle compensation events (merit, bonus, and stock cycles) end-to-end, including planning, testing, mass data loads via Enterprise Interface Builder (EIB), and validation
* Build and maintain compensation grades, guidelines, and eligibility rules to support pay equity and market-competitive pay decisions
* Partner with Payroll and Finance to ensure accurate downstream processing of compensation changes
* Provide global production analysis and support (break/fix analysis, reporting, business process administration, etc.) for Compensation
* Troubleshoot and resolve compensation-related issues, working cross-functionally with HRBPs and Payroll
* Manage Workday releases (bi-annual updates) by reviewing new compensation features, assessing impact, and coordinating regression testing
* Rigorously document compensation configuration and business processes to build operational excellence
* Ensure data integrity across compensation data, working closely with cross-functional teams to identify improvement opportunities
* Train end-users and peers on compensation processes and self-service functionality as needed
* Maintain the security groups and access policies tied to compensation data as a light, supporting part of the role

**We're excited about you because...**

* You have 5+ years of work experience in Workday Compensation maintenance/configuration
* Proven experience leading full compensation review cycles (merit, bonus, stock) within Workday
* You are passionate about system optimization and employee experience
* You are a strong business thinker, able to use 'first principles' to solve challenging business problems at their root level
* You are data-driven, able to analyze data with strong attention to detail and accuracy, and passionate about telling the story behind the data hence turning the data into configuration
* You are a self-motivated, rapid learner, excited about further developing your analytical and problem-solving skills
* Basic working knowledge of Workday security concepts (security groups, domain policies) as they relate to compensation data access
* You are results-oriented, always evaluating whether our team's activities are achieving the desired, measurable impact
* You are an owner, always looking for opportunities to learn and better your work product
* You are comfortable and thrive in a fast-paced, continually changing team-oriented environment and able to manage multiple deadlines simultaneously
* You have a BA/BS degree in quantitative or business fields, or equivalent work experience
* You have an analytical mindset and a "People First" mentality with demonstrated ability to work through complex, ambiguous problems using data and creating configuration solutions based on that data
* You have strong written/verbal communication
* Workday certified in Compensation preferred

**Next steps**
If you are excited about working in a high-growth environment, taking ownership, and being part of an extremely ambitious team, then click below to apply and get the conversation going!
  
  
We will be reviewing applications on an ongoing basis, so if this sounds like an opportunity you want to pursue, apply today!
  
  
Please note that we do not accept applications coming in via email. Please submit your application in English via our job portal.
  
  
**About DoorDash**

title: Workforce Planning Analyst
description:
We are Reckitt
  
  
Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.
  
  
Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.
  
  
Human Resources
  
  
Our HR Team are the force for good that bring Reckitt's ambition to life. We work together to ensure the delivery of sustained profitable growth by unleashing the power of our purpose, people and performance.
  
  
Now is an exciting time to be part of shaping the future of HR, influencing an exciting global organisation, while developing business and functional leadership skills, all at the same time.
  
  
Whatever your role in our HR community, you'll take ownership of your projects and workstreams. We focus on developing our leaders to spearhead our culture and growth, so you'll be supported and mentored to deliver the right plans to drive business performance - and we'll celebrate the results with you along the way.
  
  
**About The Role**
Step into the vibrant world of Reckitt as a Senior HR Analyst, where your expertise turns data into stories that shape our future. Here, your knack for numbers and insight will directly influence our evolving HR landscape. You'll uncover the patterns that drive strategic changes and bring forth ideas that resonate across global teams. Are you ready to be at the forefront of transformation, delivering insights that matter? Dive into a role that blends analytics with action and be part of our success story.
  
  
Your responsibilities
  
  

* A Workforce Planning Analyst will support strategic and operational workforce decisions through data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and workforce modelling. The role helps ensure the organisation has the right people, skills, and capacity to meet current and future business needs.
* Prior to each Workforce Planning Cycle/ review period, you will carry the necessary checks and audits within the system. Considering continuous improvement as the technology develops.
* Support the implementation and business-as-usual running of the Workforce Planning systems and process, answering any queries as and when required.
* Actively lead the review and generation of all information, e.g. rate cards to commence and review planning.
* Understand the interdependencies on the generation of rate cards / people cost.
* Writing and reviewing validation documentation, e.g. Validation Plans, Validation reports and other necessary SOP documents related to the process and quantification of data.
* Working with Finance, HR and business users to understand the system requirements, technical issues, and support IT developer/vendor in addressing the needs.
* Working with delivery partners to ensure that any functional designs they are delivering are in line with standardised templates.
* Supporting delivery partners and business users with the testing phase to ensure that system meets requirements.
* Analyse workforce data including headcount, attrition, hiring, productivity, utilisation, and capacity.
* Develop workforce forecasts and staffing models based on forecast.
* Create dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking for leadership.
* Identify workforce trends, risks, and gaps.
* Support budgeting and annual workforce planning cycles.
* Improve workforce planning processes and reporting automation.
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and planning tools.
* Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

Common KPIs Managed
  
  

* Headcount
* Rate Cards
* Attrition rate
* Time to hire
* Workforce utilization
* Capacity vs demand
* Productivity metrics
* Overtime trends
* Hiring forecast accuracy

The experience we're looking for
  
  

* Extensive experience working in an Analyst role
* Proven track record of expertise of suite of Finance solutions e.g. SAP (essential), Service Now (preferred), Azure Dev Ops(desirable).
* Experience of working with senior stakeholders to balance business needs with workforce planning standards and processes
* Enthusiastic about the use of technology, with a proven ability to provide a communication ‘bridge’
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Xlookup, data cleansing, large dataset handling)
* Strong data analysis & validation skills, including identifying errors, outliers, and data gaps
* Good understanding of workforce / financial data and organisational structures
* Ability to interpret and aggregate data into meaningful outputs (e.g. averages)
* Stakeholder communication / management, providing clear guidance and managing inputs from multiple markets
* Structured approach to end-to-end data processes with strong attention to detail and deadlines
* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud

Technical Skills
  
  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Data visualization tools:
* Power BI
* Tableau
* HRIS and workforce systems knowledge - SAP SuccessFactors
* SQL and basic data analysis skills preferred
* Forecasting and statistical analysis knowledge

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Attention to detail
* Communication and presentation skills
* Stakeholder management
* Business acumen
* Ability to work with large datasets

**Preferred Certifications (Optional)**

* Workforce Planning certification
* HR analytics certification
* Advanced Excel / BI certifications
* CIPD qualifications

The skills for success
  
  
Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Operational Excellence, Solutioning.
  
  
What we offer
  
  
With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.
  
  
We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.
  
  
Equality
  
  
We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Head of ER Advisory - GCN India
description:

If you’re looking for a career where you can make a real impression, join HSBC and discover how valued you’ll be. HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions. We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join our team in the role
**Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Global Capability Network India**
**Location- Hyderabad and Bengaluru**
**Overview Of The Team**

* HSBC is one of the largest banking and financial services organizations in the world, with operations in 62 countries and territories. We aim to be where the growth is, enabling businesses to thrive and economies to prosper, and, ultimately, helping people to fulfil their hopes and realize their ambitions.
* Employee Relations Advisory (ERA) team is accountable to deliver the Employee Relations strategy around Policies & Procedures, Conduct and Concerns Management, Business Change and Transformation, People Risk and Governance, Employment Law and Litigation & Industrial Relations by applying appropriate judgement in making decisions taken are compliant with local legislations and Group's guidelines that apply.
* This role will be part of the Employee Relations Advisory Team of Infrastructure that manages Employee Relations Advisory related aspects for Global Capability Networks across 8 countries supporting Global Capability Network in India comprising of c.30k employees and reports in Head of Employee Relations Advisory – Infrastructure.

**In This Role, You Will**

* Lead Employee Relations Advisory for Global Capability Network India, aligning the agenda with business strategy, workforce priorities, organisational culture, risk appetite and the broader People strategy. Provide strategic counsel and constructive challenge to HR and business leadership on complex employee, workforce and organisational matters, balancing employee experience, business needs, legal and regulatory considerations.
* Own the ER (Employee Relations) risk agenda by proactively identifying litigation, conduct and workforce risks; establish appropriate mitigation strategies and ensure risks remain within the organisation’s risk appetite.
* Lead the development, governance and continuous improvement of ER policies, frameworks and practices, ensuring alignment with Indian employment legislation, regulatory requirements, Group frameworks and evolving business needs.
* Own the governance and resolution of complex and high-risk ER matters, including disciplinary cases, grievances, whistleblowing, investigations and performance matters, ensuring consistency, fairness, procedural robustness and appropriate risk management.
* Lead the India approach to employment litigation and disputes, partnering with Internal Legal and external counsel on litigation strategy with clear accountability for outcomes. Provide strategic advice on workforce transformation and business change, outsourcing, operating-model changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Provide guidance on Industrial Relations and employee representation matters, including the management of emerging industrial relations risks where applicable. Anticipate and interpret changes in Indian employment legislation, regulatory expectations and market practice, translating these into implications, recommendations and proactive changes to strategy, policies and business practices.
* Establish robust governance and oversight, providing senior leadership with meaningful trends, risk indicators, case insights and recommendations to support informed workforce decisions. Ensure appropriate quality assurance, consolidation and reporting of India ER activity, including material cases, risk themes, litigation, workforce change and service delivery metrics.
* Drive an insight-led ER agenda using case data, ER metrics, employee trends and thematic analysis to identify systemic issues, emerging risks and opportunities for preventative interventions. Oversee, track and monitor Employee Relations Advisory service delivery metrics and provide trends and insights to Entity, Regional and Global Governance Forums.
* Own the effectiveness of the India ER operating model, ensuring appropriate prioritisation, capacity, service standards, escalation mechanisms, quality assurance and consistent delivery of ER advisory services. Lead continuous improvement and simplification of ER processes, leveraging technology, data and innovative approaches to improve manager and employee experience, strengthen controls and increase the effectiveness of ER delivery.
* Build and lead a high-performing Employee Relations team, developing capability in strategic advisory, employment law, investigations, workforce transformation, industrial relations, risk management and stakeholder influence. Coach and enable the ER Advisory Team, HRBPs and people managers to strengthen ER capability, improve manager effectiveness and promote consistent, fair and accountable practices. Build strong strategic partnerships with HRBPs (Human Resource Business partners), business leaders, Legal, Compliance, Risk, Reward and other specialist functions; represent Employee Relations in governance and leadership forums; embed ER considerations into organisational and workforce strategy; and role-model the organisation’s leadership behaviours and values to support high performance, responsible leadership, employee trust and sustainable business outcomes.

**To Be Successful You Will**

* Post Graduation in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Law or related disciple, with 15+ years of experience in progressive experience, including significant experience i.e., 10 years leading Employee Relations in a complex, large scale organization.
* Proven track record of leading an Employee Relations Advisory function, shaping ER strategy, policies, frameworks, and practices that enable business outcomes while maintaining appropriate employee, regulatory and reputational risk controls.
* Deep expertise in Indian employment, labor and industrial relations legislations, with the ability to translate evolving regulatory requirements into practical, commercially sound ER strategies, policies and interventions.
* Strong experience managing complex and high-risk ER issues, including investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, employee disputes, litigations, regulatory proceedings, industrial relations. Demonstrated expertise in advising on organizational transformation and workforce changes and other complex workforce interventions.
* Strong risk and governance mindset, with the ability to identify emerging people, legal, regulatory, employee relations risks to establish appropriate controls and provide clear recommendations for active risk mitigation.
* Exceptional influencing skills, with demonstrated ability to consult, challenge and influence stakeholders (across levels) across HR, Business Legal, Compliance, Risk and other control functions to achieve balanced and sustainable outcomes.
* Strong commercial and business acumen with ability to understand business strategy, operating models and workforce priorities and translating them into pragmatic ER solutions.
* Good communication, judgement and interpersonal skills, with the ability to handle highly sensitive and confidential matters with integrity, empathy and sound judgment.
* Strong leadership capability, including developing ER/ Advisory talent, building organizational capability, creating a high-performance culture and establishing consistent ER standards across a complex organization.
* Ability to operate effectively in ambiguity and navigate complex, competing priorities, making sound and timely decisions with limited precedent while maintaining appropriate risk discipline.

description:

Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day.
