**The Opportunity:**
The
**Operations Analyst**
will support the day-to-day operational excellence of the Mattel Technology & Innovation Center (MTIC). Working closely with the Country Head, MTIC leadership team and cross-functional stakeholders, this role will help drive operational planning, governance, reporting, business analytics and cross-functional coordination to ensure effective execution of strategic and operational priorities.
  
  
The role will also partner with the Head – Workplace Operations, Experience & Corporate Services to support governance, executive reporting, workplace analytics, procurement and vendor administration, budget tracking, contract governance and continuous improvement initiatives. Working collaboratively across HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, Workplace Operations and other partner functions, the role will contribute to operational excellence, employee experience and efficient workplace service delivery.
  
  
**What Your Impact Will Be**
**What We’re Looking For:**

* The Operations Analyst plays a key role in supporting the MTIC leadership team through effective operational governance, reporting and coordination. The role provides analytical and operational support across both MTIC Operations and Workplace Operations, Experience & Corporate Services, ensuring alignment of strategic priorities, operational initiatives and business processes.

The role works across multiple functional areas including
  
  

* MTIC Operations
* Workplace Operations
* Facilities & Workplace
* Security & Resilience
* Employee Mobility & Corporate Services
* HR
* Finance
* Procurement
* IT
* Communications
* Global Workplace

**Operational Planning & Execution**

* Support execution of MTIC strategic priorities and annual operating plans.
* Track key initiatives, milestones, risks, dependencies and action items to ensure timely execution.
* Maintain operational trackers and provide regular status updates to leadership.
* Coordinate follow-through on leadership decisions and operational commitments.
* Support operational planning across Workplace Operations initiatives including Facilities, Security, Employee Mobility and Workplace Experience.
* Governance & Cross-functional Coordination
* Coordinate governance meetings, leadership reviews and steering committee sessions.
* Prepare meeting agendas, capture minutes and track action items through closure.
* Coordinate cross-functional initiatives involving Technology, HR, Finance, Procurement, IT, Workplace Operations and other partner functions.
* Support planning and coordination of leadership visits, business reviews and strategic initiatives.
* Maintain governance documentation, operating procedures and action trackers.
* Executive Reporting & Communications
* Prepare executive dashboards, operational reports and leadership updates.
* Consolidate information from multiple stakeholders into concise, leadership-ready reports and presentations.
* Develop operational scorecards and KPI dashboards.
* Support preparation of executive briefings, business reviews and leadership presentations.
* Business Analytics & Operational Excellence
* Build and maintain dashboards using Excel, Power BI or similar analytics tools.
* Analyze operational metrics, workplace KPIs and identify trends, risks and improvement opportunities.
* Generate actionable insights that improve operational efficiency and decision-making.
* Support budget and expense tracking, variance reporting and financial analysis.
* Support procurement administration, vendor governance, contract tracking and operational reporting for Workplace Operations.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives through data-driven analysis.
* Workplace Operations Support
* Support governance across Facilities, Security, Employee Mobility and Workplace Experience.
* Track operational KPIs, service levels and vendor performance metrics.
* Coordinate procurement requests, contract administration and vendor documentation.
* Support workplace occupancy, utilization and sustainability reporting.
* Assist with audit readiness, compliance activities and policy documentation.
* Employee Engagement & Site Operations
* Support employee engagement initiatives, culture-building activities and workplace experience programs.
* Assist in planning and execution of leadership visits, town halls, employee events and site-wide operational initiatives.
* Coordinate operational logistics for meetings, workshops and special projects.
* Support initiatives that contribute to an exceptional employee experience across MTIC.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
  
  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
  
  
Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
  
  
Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

title: Talent Acquisition Manager
description:
JOIN is looking for a hands-on and business-oriented Talent Acquisition Lead to drive corporate hiring, manage a team of recruiters, and strengthen the organisation’s talent acquisition strategy.

The ideal candidate will have experience managing a recruitment team in a high-growth e-commerce or quick-commerce organisation, with a strong track record of corporate hiring across Growth, Marketing, Category, Finance, Operations, and other functions.

The role will also be responsible for market benchmarking, talent intelligence and employer branding initiatives to strengthen JOIN’s ability to attract and hire the right talent in a competitive market.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Corporate Talent Acquisition**

* Lead end-to-end recruitment across corporate functions, including Growth, Performance Marketing, Brand, Category, Finance, Operations and other business functions.
* Partner with business leaders and hiring managers to understand talent requirements, prioritise mandates and develop effective hiring strategies.
* Drive mid-level, senior, niche and business-critical hiring through proactive sourcing and talent mapping.
* Build and maintain talent pipelines through LinkedIn, referrals, professional networks and other relevant channels.
* Ensure timely hiring closures while maintaining candidate quality and a positive candidate experience.

**2. Team Management**

* Lead, manage and mentor a team of recruiters responsible for corporate hiring.
* Allocate hiring mandates, review progress and ensure accountability for recruitment outcomes.
* Monitor team productivity, hiring turnaround times and quality metrics.
* Coach recruiters on sourcing effectiveness, candidate assessment, stakeholder management and offer closure.

**3. Market Benchmarking & Talent Intelligence**

* Conduct market mapping and benchmarking to understand talent availability, competitor talent pools and industry hiring trends.
* Analyse compensation benchmarks, role structures and talent movement across relevant industries and organisations.
* Provide insights to business leaders on talent supply, compensation expectations and hiring feasibility.
* Identify emerging talent markets and alternative talent pools to support critical and niche hiring.
* Use market intelligence to inform hiring strategies, improve offer competitiveness and support workforce planning discussions.

**4. Employer Branding**

* Drive employer branding initiatives to strengthen JOIN’s positioning as an employer of choice.
* Partner with internal stakeholders to develop compelling employee value propositions and communicate culture, career opportunities and growth story.
* Leverage LinkedIn, employee advocacy, recruitment campaigns and relevant external platforms to improve talent reach and engagement.
* Collaborate with internal teams to create recruitment-focused content, employee stories and talent engagement initiatives.
* Track the effectiveness of employer branding initiatives through relevant measures such as candidate engagement, talent pipeline growth and application quality.

**5. Business & Stakeholder Partnership**

* Build strong partnerships with functional heads and hiring managers to align hiring priorities, role expectations and timelines.
* Provide regular updates on hiring progress, talent availability, market trends and recruitment challenges.
* Drive timely interview feedback and decision-making to minimise delays in the hiring process.
* Advise stakeholders on talent availability, compensation expectations and competitive hiring practices.

**6. Recruitment Analytics & Process Excellence**

* Track key recruitment metrics, including time-to-fill, offer-to-joining ratio, source effectiveness, cost per hire and quality of hire.
* Develop and maintain recruitment dashboards to monitor hiring performance and team productivity.
* Identify process bottlenecks and implement improvements to sourcing, assessment and selection practices.
* Strengthen candidate experience through a structured, transparent and responsive recruitment process.

**7. AI, Technology & Recruitment Innovation**

* Leverage AI-powered recruitment tools and technology to improve sourcing efficiency, candidate screening, talent mapping and recruitment turnaround times.
* Explore and implement AI-enabled solutions to automate repetitive recruitment activities, enhance recruiter productivity and improve the overall hiring experience.
* Use recruitment technology, talent intelligence platforms and market data tools to identify relevant talent pools, map competitors and strengthen sourcing strategies.
* Leverage AI tools to generate talent insights, analyse recruitment funnel performance and identify opportunities to improve hiring effectiveness.
* Drive the adoption and effective utilisation of Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment platforms and other digital tools to streamline hiring workflows and improve data accuracy.
* Continuously evaluate emerging AI and recruitment technology solutions that can improve hiring speed, quality and scalability.
* Ensure the responsible use of AI in recruitment, maintaining candidate data confidentiality, fairness, human oversight and consistency in hiring decisions.

**Desired Candidate Profile**

* 7–8 years of experience in Talent Acquisition, with demonstrated experience managing a team of recruiters.
* Prior experience in a high-growth e-commerce or quick-commerce organisation with proven track record in corporate hiring is strongly preferred.
* Strong exposure to mid-to-senior-level hiring, niche recruitment and business-critical positions.
* Experience in market mapping, compensation benchmarking and talent intelligence.
* Exposure to employer branding, talent engagement campaigns and employer value proposition initiatives.
* Strong stakeholder management skills and the ability to influence senior business leaders.
* Hands-on expertise in sourcing strategy, negotiation, candidate assessment and offer closure.
* Data-driven approach with the ability to translate recruitment metrics and market insights into actionable decisions.
* Demonstrated ability to leverage AI tools and recruitment technology to improve sourcing, screening, talent mapping and overall recruitment productivity.
* Strong communication, leadership and execution skills, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced business environment.
* Familiarity with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS), recruitment analytics dashboards and AI-enabled talent acquisition platforms.
* A technology-forward mindset, with the ability to identify opportunities for automation, process optimisation and data-driven decision-making.

**Key Success Measures**

* Timely closure and quality of corporate hiring.
* Recruitment team productivity and delivery against hiring plans.
* Offer acceptance and joining conversion rates.
* Quality and relevance of talent pipelines for critical roles.
* Actionable market benchmarking and talent intelligence to support hiring decisions.
* Effectiveness of employer branding initiatives in attracting relevant talent.
* Improved candidate experience and stakeholder satisfaction.

**About The Role**
We’re looking for an experienced HR Generalist, based in Mumbai, to own the full employee lifecycle and people programs across India and the Subcontinent. This is a true generalist role: you’ll run recruiting end to end, manage onboarding through offboarding, and drive the HR operations, compliance, and employee-experience work that keeps our teams thriving. You’ll be the local face of the APAC People team, making sure our ambitious growth is supported by a robust and effective people strategy. **What You’ll Do**

* Own full-cycle recruiting for a range of roles across departments - building search strategies, sourcing active and passive candidates, screening, interviewing, and guiding candidates through hiring and onboarding.

* Serve as the local representative of the APAC People team, enhancing employee experience across the full lifecycle from onboarding to offboarding.
* Lead local HR operations including data management, employee support, reporting and analytics, process improvement, payroll support, and policy development.
* Maintain accurate HRIS data in Workday, run audits, and resolve employee tickets.
* Leverage AI-powered tools to automate repetitive HR tasks, source and screen candidates faster, and surface insights from people data.
* Act as the local expert on HR policy and ensure HR compliance across the region.
* Take on additional projects from the global and regional People leadership team as needed.

**What You’ll Bring**

* A BA/BS degree and 6+ years of experience, including full-cycle recruiting at a search firm or fast-growing company.
* A strong track record of processing a wide range of HR transactions and a solid understanding of HR best practices across the APAC region.
* Proven ability to build rapport with hiring managers and cross-functional partners at all levels.
* A creative approach to finding great people, with the ability to build candidate networks and channel connections.
* A drive for results - you see processes through end to end and are motivated by data and metrics.
* Humility: no task is too big or too small.
* Excellent organizational skills and strong attention to detail.
* Hands-on experience with Workday (HCM, recruiting, or reporting) is strongly preferred.
* Comfort adopting AI-powered HR and recruiting tools, with curiosity about how AI can make people processes faster and better.

At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. title: NR-2026-0279 - US HR Operations Specialist/Associate Manager (India-based)
description:
**About Media.net**

Media.net is a leading online ad-tech company that develops innovative products for advertisers and publishers. Media.net has one of the most comprehensive portfolios of advertising technology in the industry across search, native, display, mobile, local, products and video. Media.net manages high-quality ad supply on over 500,000 websites and its platform and products are licensed by some of the largest publishers, ad networks and other ad tech companies worldwide.

Media.net is one of the largest contextual advertising company worldwide. Media.net has key operation centers across – North America, Europe and Asia. Media.net's US HQ is based in New York, and Global HQ in Dubai.

**Role Snapshot:**

* **Location:**
  Mumbai (Andheri East), India; on-site or hybrid.
* **Shift:**
  US overlap, roughly 6 PM–3 AM IST, with flexibility for US payroll and onboarding peaks.
* **Experience:**
  4–7 years in Global HR Operations, with at least 2 years supporting US employees.
* **Works With:**
  US employees and managers, third-party payroll/PEO vendor, US benefits and 401(k) providers, India HR and Finance.

**About the role:**

This person is the single operational point of contact for our US employees, run from India. They own the US employee lifecycle end to end — onboarding, benefits and 401(k) changes, offboarding — and keep the third-party payroll vendor and our employees in sync.

The role executes and coordinates; it does not set US policy or give legal or tax advice. Compliance judgment sits with the payroll vendor and US counsel, and this person knows when to escalate to them.

This role will closely work with the CxOs and other POCs from the New York Office on day to day basis

**Key responsibilities:**

**US onboarding**

* Run new-hire onboarding for US employees: offer-to-day-one checklist, document collection, and system setup with the payroll vendor.
* Coordinate Form I-9 completion and E-Verify (where used) within federal timelines, plus W-4 and state tax forms.
* Enrol new hires in benefits and 401(k) within plan eligibility windows; run a first-week orientation on pay, benefits and policies.

**401(k) and benefits administration**

* Process 401(k) enrolments, contribution changes, and employer-match updates with the plan provider and payroll vendor.
* Reconcile payroll deductions against 401(k) remittances each pay cycle and flag mismatches before they become late deposits.
* Support open enrolment, qualifying life events, and annual plan communications.

**Offboarding**

* Run exits end to end: final pay on time per state rules, PTO payout, asset and access recovery, and exit interviews.
* Coordinate COBRA notices, 401(k) separation options, and benefit terminations with the vendor.

**HR policy**

* Maintain the US employee handbook and policies, keeping them aligned with federal and applicable state requirements.
* Track US law and benefit changes flagged by the vendor or counsel, and drive the resulting policy updates.
* Field policy questions and apply policy consistently.

**Payroll vendor liaison**

* Act as the primary contact for the third-party payroll/PEO vendor: submit inputs (new hires, changes, exits, bonuses) ahead of each cutoff.
* Review payroll registers before approval and resolve errors with the vendor.
* Track vendor SLAs and escalate recurring issues.

**Employee queries and coordination**

* Resolve US employee queries on pay, tax forms, benefits, 401(k) and leave, with a ticket or log for every query.
* Translate vendor responses into clear answers for employees, and employee issues into clear asks for the vendor.
* Keep employee records and HRIS data accurate and audit-ready.

**Must-have qualifications:**

* Graduate; MBA/PGDM in HR preferred.
* 4–7 years in HR operations, including at least 2 years directly supporting US employees (in-house, GCC, or a US-payroll/PEO outsourcing firm).
* Hands-on knowledge of US onboarding and exit mechanics: I-9, W-4, state new-hire reporting, final-pay rules, COBRA.
* Working knowledge of 401(k) administration: enrolment, deferral changes, employer match, and payroll-to-provider reconciliation.
* Experience managing a payroll or PEO vendor (e.g. ADP, Gusto, Rippling, Justworks, TriNet, Paychex) and reviewing payroll registers.
* Strong written English for employee-facing communication; comfortable on calls with US staff.
* Willing to work a sustained US-overlap shift.
* High discretion with confidential pay and personal data.

**Good-to-have:**

* SHRM-CP or HRCI (PHR/aPHR) certification.
* Exposure to multi-state US employment (e.g. California, New York) and state-specific leave rules.
* Experience with an HRIS such as Workday, BambooHR or Darwinbox, plus a ticketing tool for query tracking.
* Has written or updated an employee handbook.
* Advanced Excel for payroll and 401(k) reconciliations.

**Success in the First 6 Months:**

* **Payroll Timeliness:**
  Submit 100% of payroll inputs before the vendor cutoff for every pay cycle.
* **Payroll Accuracy:**
  Maintain zero repeat errors attributable to our inputs.
* **401(k) Reconciliation:**
  Reconcile deductions against remittances during every pay cycle, with all mismatches resolved within the same cycle.
* **I-9 Compliance:**
  Complete I-9 documentation for 100% of new hires within the federally mandated deadlines.
* **Final Pay Compliance:**
  Ensure 100% of employee exits receive final pay in accordance with applicable state laws.
* **Employee Query Management:**
  Acknowledge employee queries within 1 business day and resolve them within 5 business days.
* **US Employee Handbook:**
  Review and update the US employee handbook by the end of Month 6.

description:

IceWarp is a global collaboration and communication platform that offers an integrated alternative to MS 365 and Google Workspace. The company enables streamlined business processes through real-time collaboration tools, easy file sharing, and a unified virtual office experience from a single window, without third-party applications. IceWarp serves over 50 million paid users and 50,000 customers across more than 50 countries, emphasizing security, efficiency, and ease of use. Founded in 2001, IceWarp is fully developed in-house, with ongoing innovation and product updates to meet evolving workplace needs.

**Role Description**
The Manager – Talent Management & Development is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai. This role is responsible for designing and implementing talent management strategies, including performance management frameworks, succession planning initiatives, and career development programs.

The role will own the employee learning journey from induction and onboarding through structured
**30, 60 and 90-day enablement plans**
, followed by ongoing development. The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience implementing an LMS, conducting assessments, managing training partners and working with business leaders to deliver measurable improvements in employee performance.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**New Joiner Onboarding & Enablement**

•⁠ ⁠Design and execute structured induction, onboarding and on-the-job training programmes across functions.

•⁠ ⁠Develop role-specific
**30, 60 and 90-day plans**
with clear learning objectives, milestones, assessments and readiness criteria.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate with reporting managers, subject matter experts and HR to ensure timely execution.

•⁠ ⁠Track new joiner progress, identify learning gaps and implement corrective interventions.

•⁠ ⁠Provide documented readiness recommendations to support probation and confirmation decisions.

**Training Needs Analysis & Learning Programmes:**

•⁠ ⁠Identify individual, team and organisational training needs through stakeholder discussions, performance data and competency assessments.

•⁠ ⁠Develop and execute a training calendar aligned with business priorities.

•⁠ ⁠Organise regular functional, behavioural and managerial workshops.

•⁠ ⁠Deliver or coordinate programmes covering communication, interpersonal skills, emotional intelligence (EQ), analytical thinking, problem-solving and cognitive abilities (IQ).

•⁠ ⁠Build structured learning paths for different roles and levels.

**Assessments & Learning Effectiveness:**

•⁠ ⁠Develop pre- and post-training assessments, practical evaluations and competency-based reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate appropriate behavioural, emotional intelligence and cognitive assessments, using qualified providers where required.

•⁠ ⁠Track knowledge retention, application on the job and progress against agreed capability standards.

•⁠ ⁠Evaluate training effectiveness through assessment outcomes, manager feedback and changes in employee performance.

•⁠ ⁠Maintain assessment records and ensure timely communication of results and development actions.

**LMS Implementation & Administration:**

•⁠ ⁠Lead or actively manage LMS implementation, including requirements gathering, vendor evaluation, configuration, testing and rollout.

•⁠ ⁠Create learning paths, upload content, configure assessments and manage training assignments.

•⁠ ⁠Drive LMS adoption among employees and managers.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor course completion, assessment results and learning engagement through LMS reports.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate with IT and vendors to resolve issues and improve platform usability.

**Stakeholder & Training Vendor Management:**

•⁠ ⁠Partner with business heads, reporting managers and HR to agree on learning priorities and expected outcomes.

•⁠ ⁠Establish clear ownership for training delivery, employee participation and progress reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Evaluate and manage external trainers, training institutes, assessment partners and content providers.

•⁠ ⁠Manage training proposals, commercials, schedules, delivery quality and vendor performance.

•⁠ ⁠Monitor training budgets and evaluate the value delivered by learning programmes.

**Employee Performance & Development:**

•⁠ ⁠Track employee development against agreed learning goals, competency requirements and performance milestones.

•⁠ ⁠Support managers in translating performance gaps into practical development plans.

•⁠ ⁠Facilitate regular development reviews and monitor completion of agreed actions.

•⁠ ⁠Identify high-potential employees and support career development and succession planning.

•⁠ ⁠Work with HR and business leaders to strengthen feedback, coaching and continuous learning practices.

**Performance Improvement Plans:**

•⁠ ⁠Partner with HR and reporting managers to develop and monitor structured
**Performance Improvement Plans (PIPs).**

•⁠ ⁠Define measurable improvement goals, review timelines, learning support and accountability.

•⁠ ⁠Coordinate relevant training, coaching and assessments during the PIP period.

•⁠ ⁠Document progress, review discussions and outcomes to support consistent, evidence-based decisions.

**Reporting & Governance:**

•⁠ ⁠Maintain dashboards covering onboarding milestones, training participation, LMS completion, assessment results and employee development progress.

•⁠ ⁠Track time to proficiency, overdue learning actions and PIP progress.

•⁠ ⁠Present regular updates to leadership, highlighting capability gaps, outcomes and recommended actions.

•⁠ ⁠Maintain accurate training records, assessment documentation and development plans.

**Required Experience & Qualifications**

•⁠ ⁠
**Minimum 10 years of relevant experience in Talent Management, Learning & Development or Employee Enablement within the IT industry.**

•⁠ ⁠Proven experience working as a Manager in the same domain, with ownership of learning programmes and employee development initiatives.

•⁠ ⁠Demonstrated experience designing and executing structured onboarding and 30–60–90-day enablement plans.

•⁠ ⁠Hands-on involvement in at least one LMS implementation, along with experience managing LMS administration, reporting and adoption.

•⁠ ⁠Experience conducting training needs analysis, competency assessments and learning effectiveness reviews.

•⁠ ⁠Experience facilitating workshops and managing external training vendors.

•⁠ ⁠Exposure to behavioural, EQ and cognitive assessments and their appropriate use in employee development.

•⁠ ⁠Experience supporting performance management, development planning and PIPs.

•⁠ ⁠Graduate or postgraduate qualification in HR, Psychology, Business Management or a related discipline.

**Key Competencies:**

•⁠ ⁠Stakeholder management and business partnering

•⁠ ⁠Training facilitation and coaching

•⁠ ⁠Programme planning and execution

•⁠ ⁠Interpersonal skills and emotional intelligence

•⁠ ⁠Vendor and budget management

•⁠ ⁠Data analysis and performance reporting

•⁠ ⁠Ownership, follow-through and attention to detail

**Success Measures:**

•⁠ ⁠Timely completion of onboarding and 30–60–90-day milestones.

•⁠ ⁠Improved new joiner readiness and reduced time to proficiency.

•⁠ ⁠Strong LMS adoption and timely completion of assigned learning.

•⁠ ⁠Measurable improvement in assessment results and on-the-job capability.

Professional

**Job Description**
At Johnson & Johnson, we believe health is everything. Our strength comes from the people who bring our purpose to life every day. We are committed to creating a workplace where employees feel respected, supported, and empowered to do their best work.
  
  
We are seeking an
**Employee & Labor Relations Leader, India**
to help us build a positive, inclusive, and high-performing work environment across India. In this leadership role, we will rely on your expertise to guide employee and labour relations strategy, support business transformation, and foster strong relationships across our workforce.
  
  
Working closely with business leaders, HR partners, managers, employees, and employee representatives, we will partner to address sophisticated workplace matters, strengthen organizational capability, and ensure our people practices reflect both our values and business priorities.
  
  
This is an exciting opportunity to influence people strategy at a national level, lead a team, and make a lasting impact on employee experience, organizational effectiveness, and business success.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
As Head of ERLR, India, you will help shape and deliver our Employee Relations (ER) and Labour Relations (LR) strategy while supporting a culture of trust, accountability, fairness, and inclusion.
  
  
You will partner with leaders and HR teams to proactively find opportunities and challenges across the employee lifecycle, providing guidance that supports both employees and strategic objectives.
  
  
**Key Areas Of Responsibility Include**
**Employee Relations**

* Guide the resolution of sophisticated employee relations matters, including grievances, investigations, disciplinary issues, and workplace concerns.
* Partner with leaders and HR teams to ensure consistent, fair, and respectful approaches to employee relations matters.
* Build confidence and capability among managers through coaching, training, and practical guidance.
* Help creates a positive employee experience by fostering open communication, trust, and constructive workplace relationships.

**Labour Relations**

* Lead labour relations strategy and provide oversight for unionized employee populations across India.
* Support the preparation, negotiation, and implementation of Collective Bargaining Agreements (CBAs).
* Foster constructive relationships with union representatives and employee groups.
* Provide guidance on labour relations implications related to business transformation activities, including restructuring, acquisitions, divestitures, outsourcing, and workforce changes.

**Strategy, Governance & Compliance**

* Partner with stakeholders to create and implement an Employee & Labour Relations strategy aligned with regional and global priorities.
* Assess employment and labour legislation trends, helping the organization adapt to a changing regulatory environment.
* Support governance activities and ensure workplace practices align with legal requirements, company values, and employee expectations.
* Use insights and data to identify trends, address risks, and improve workplace outcomes.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Find opportunities to improve processes, policies, and service delivery models.
* Champion innovative ways of working that improve employee experience and operational effectiveness.
* Support organizational change initiatives that help our workforce and business succeed in a vibrant environment.

**What We're Looking For**
We welcome candidates who bring a combination of employee relations expertise, business partnership, leadership capability, and a passion for creating positive workplace experiences.
  
  
**Qualifications & Experience**

* Post Graduate degree required; Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Employment Law, Legal Studies, or related fields preferred.
* Significant experience in Human Resources, Employee Relations, Labour Relations, Industrial Relations, or Employment Law.
* Experience leading and developing teams in complex, matrixed organizations.
* Solid knowledge of employee relations practices, labour relations frameworks, and employment legislation.
* Experience managing complex workplace matters, organizational change initiatives, and workforce transformation activities.
* Strong stakeholder management, influencing, communication, and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to balance employee needs, business priorities, and legal considerations while driving fair and sustainable outcomes.
* Proven track record to navigate ambiguity, tackle sophisticated problems, and make sound decisions.

**AI & Future Ways of Working**
We recognize the growing role of technology in the workplace and value leaders who are curious, adaptable, and open to new ways of working. Experience leveraging AI-enabled tools, understanding responsible AI practices, and using effective prompting techniques to improve productivity, decision-making, and collaboration will be an advantage.
  
  
**Key Capabilities**
We are particularly interested in leaders who:
  
  

* Build trusted relationships across all levels of an organization.
* Connect with empathy, clarity, and confidence.
* Foster inclusive, respectful, and collaborative workplaces.
* Use data and insights to support decision-making.
* Embrace innovation and continuous improvement.

Johnson & Johnson is an Affirmative Action and Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, colour, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, national origin, or protected veteran status and will not be discriminated against on the basis of disability.

**Preferred Skills:**

**4. HR Operations & Administration**

* Maintain accurate employee databases, personnel files, HR trackers, and HRMS records.
* Monitor attendance, leave records, late arrivals, and employee regularisation requests.
* Coordinate with the Finance and Accounts team for payroll inputs, salary processing, and employee-related data.
* Prepare and update daily, weekly, and monthly HR reports.
* Manage employee letters, HR documentation, background verification, and other administrative activities.
* Ensure timely completion of assigned HR tasks while maintaining data accuracy and confidentiality.

**5. HR Policies, SOPs & Compliance**

* Implement company HR policies, procedures, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs).
* Communicate HR policies to employees and clarify policy-related queries.
* Maintain employee documentation required for internal audits and compliance.
* Coordinate background verification and support applicable labour law and statutory compliance activities.
* Monitor adherence to company policies, code of conduct, and disciplinary procedures.
* Identify gaps in HR processes and recommend improvements to management.

**6. Performance Management & Training**

* Coordinate employee appraisal, performance review, and probation evaluation processes.
* Assist in preparing and updating KRAs, KPIs, and performance tracking sheets in coordination with reporting managers.
* Follow up with managers and employees to ensure timely completion of performance reviews.
* Maintain performance records and prepare reports for management review.
* Identify employee training requirements and coordinate training and development activities.
* Track employee performance and highlight concerns or improvement areas to management.

**7. HR Coordination & Process Improvement**

* Coordinate with department heads and reporting managers on recruitment, attendance, employee performance, and HR-related matters.
* Ensure timely follow-up on pending HR activities and management instructions.
* Maintain HR task trackers, process documentation, and status reports.
* Support the development and improvement of HR processes to enhance efficiency and employee experience.
* Handle employee information and sensitive HR matters with professionalism, integrity, and confidentiality.

**Required Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.

* Strong knowledge of HR operations, recruitment, payroll coordination, and compliance.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong leadership, people management, and decision-making abilities.
* Proficiency in Google Workspace and HR tools/software.
* Ability to handle sensitive information with integrity and confidentiality.
* Strong organisational and problem-solving skills.

**Preferred Attributes**

* Proactive and strategic mindset.
* Strong interpersonal skills and team orientation.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced work environment.

Our teams breed ambition, challenge ordinary thinking, push the pace of innovation, in-service of the exploding demand for accessible data.
  
  
Snowflake is growing fast and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We’re passionate about our people, our customers, our values and our culture! We’re also looking for people with a growth mindset and the pragmatic insight to solve for today while building for the future. And as a Snowflake employee, you will be accountable for supporting and enabling diversity and belonging.
  
  
**Summary**
Snowflake is looking for an experienced
**Payroll Analyst /Sr Analyst - EMEA**
. This position will be based in Pune, India. The position will support the
**EMEA region and hence working hours will be accordingly**
. You are versatile, motivated, creative, intellectually curious, analytical collaborator and a strong communicator.
  
  
Reporting into Payroll Lead / Manager, your main responsibility is to ensure smooth delivery of the day-to-day operations of the department. You will provide ideas and help brainstorm on process standardization, automation, and improvement in all aspects of payroll to ensure their scalability and continuing effectiveness amid all the changes that Snowflake has been undergoing. You are good at creating and maintaining robust process documentation. You adhere to the internal controls as specified by Company policies. You are expected to collaborate with cross functional business partners. This is the perfect opportunity for someone like yourself who is self-sufficient, possesses a keen attention to detail, and has an unwavering desire for continuous personal development.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Working closely with existing international payroll partners to ensure accurate and on-time payroll processing. Overall delivery of end-to-end payroll operations including:

+ Preparing and adhering to a schedule / payroll calendar and agree the timelines with payroll vendor and other internal stakeholders
+ Accurately capturing all inputs to be provided to the payroll vendors in a timely manner
+ Thorough review of the output. Includes but not limited to performing payroll analysis such as total gross payroll to net payment, average paid per headcount by country, and comparison of analysis to prior period
+ Support monthly/quarterly accounting close activities, account maintenance and reconciliations, financial reporting and variance analysis, etc.

* Providing standard and ad-hoc payroll reports as needed by various internal departments such as Finance, Accounting, Legal, Benefits, and People Operations.
* Creating and/or maintaining payroll documentation as it relates to processing, operational procedures, compliance, and other payroll-related matters.
* Providing support in various system implementation projects as needed.
* Provide support to external and internal audits for the area of payroll

**Requirements**

* Bachelor’s / master’s degree in business, Finance, or Accounting
* 5 to 10 years of relevant and progressive payroll experience; public company payroll experience required
* Preferred hands-on experience working on some of these payrolls – Poland, Israel, Spain and other EMEA countries.
* Experience working with international payroll platforms such as ADP, EY, Cloudpay, or other global payroll platforms preferred.
* Experience of other international payrolls will be an added advantage.
* Strong communication, analytical, and problem-solving skills
* Highly proficient in utilizing various computer applications such as Microsoft Excel (Pivots, V/H Lookups) and Google Suite apps (e.g. Google Sheets)
* Familiarity with Workday HCM and Workday Financials is a plus
* Understanding of accounting, taxation, and finance concepts as it relates to payroll
* Possesses in-depth knowledge of payroll-related compliance requirements
* Adaptable to a fast-changing work environment; able to deliver accurate and on-time payroll regardless of the circumstances
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team environment
* Ability to manage through change and to lead change when appropriate
* Attention to detail, organized and thorough with the desire for continuous improvement
* Proactive and problem-solving attitude
* Good command on English speaking and writing
* Adapts quickly to changes in a dynamic organizational structure and business processes
* Flexible with working hour changes.

Snowflake is growing fast, and we’re scaling our team to help enable and accelerate our growth. We are looking for people who share our values, challenge ordinary thinking, and push the pace of innovation while building a future for themselves and Snowflake.

title: Regional Workday Specialist
description:
**A Snapshot of Your Day**
As part of a wider HR transformation program and the spin-off of Siemens Energy from Siemens, Siemens Energy is in the process of standardizing and harmonizing its HR systems and services. We are seeking a knowledgeable and experienced Workday Consultant to join our team as a regional point of contact for all topics related to Workday. The ideal candidate will have expertise in configuring, deploying, and supporting our Workday solution across various modules such as HCM, Security, Compensation, Talent and Absence Management. This role involves collaborating with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to deliver efficient, scalable Workday implementations and enhancements. This is an excellent opportunity to work in a fast-paced environment with a business in the forefront of the Energy Transition.
  
  
**How You’ll Make An Impact**

* As a regional Workday support specialist, you are the primary point of contact for all Workday related questions and issues for your supported region
* Analyse business requirements or change requests and translate them into Workday configurations and solutions for your specific region
* Acting as a liaison between the internal business partners and external vendors to support the Workday post-implementation and ongoing administration.
* Reviewing open cases/issues in the region with Application Management Service provider and ensure that all tickets are closed in a timely manner
* Provide functional and technical support to stakeholders and end-users including offering post-implementation support and ongoing maintenance of the Workday system.
* In addition to the regional responsibility, you may be assigned as a Global Functional Lead for one of Workday modules, such as HCM, Absence, Compensation, Reporting / Data and Security.

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Information Technology, Business, or related field.
* 3+ years of hands-on experience with Workday, including system configuration and support.
* Workday Reporting Experience and Expertise.
* Workday certification in one or more modules (preferred Reporting).
* Strong understanding of HR/Payroll/Business processes (depending on module focus).
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and projects simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
* Experience with Workday integrations (a plus).

**About The Team**
In this role you will be working within the Human Resources function – HR Systems and Services, a truly global and diverse team of specialists with an open mindset, responsible for guaranteeing operational performance and budget adherence of HR Systems & Services, ensuring, and maintaining fit-for-purpose HR systems and processes, safeguarding end-to-end delivery while promoting Siemens Energy digital transformation. You will get all the trust and empowerment to be successful.
  
  
**Who is Siemens Energy?**
At Siemens Energy, we are more than just an energy technology company. We meet the growing energy demand across 90+ countries while ensuring our climate is protected. With more than 92,000 dedicated employees, we not only generate electricity for over 16% of the global community, but we’re also using our technology to help protect people and the environment.
  
  
Our global team is committed to making sustainable, reliable, and affordable energy a reality by pushing the boundaries of what is possible. We uphold a 150-year legacy of innovation that encourages our search for people who will support our focus on decarbonization, new technologies, and energy transformation.
  
  
Find out how you can make a difference at Siemens Energy: https://www.siemens-energy.com/employeevideo
  
  
**Our Commitment to Diversity**
Lucky for us, we are not all the same. Through diversity we generate power. We run on inclusion and compassion. Our combined creative energy is fuelled by at least 130 nationalities. Siemens Energy celebrates character – no matter what ethnic background, gender, age, religion, identity, or disability. We energize society. All of society.
  
  
**Rewards/Benefits**

* All employees are automatically covered under the Medical Insurance. Company paid considerable Family floater cover covering employee, spouse and 2 dependent children up to 25 years of age.
* Siemens Energy provides an option to opt for Meal Card to all its employees which will be as per the terms and conditions prescribed in the company policy.As a part of CTC, tax saving measure
* Flexi Pay empowers employees with the choice to customize the amount in some of the salary components within a defined range thereby optimizing the tax benefits. Job Title
  
  
HR Service Agent
  
  
**Job Description**
**HR Service Agent | Pune, India | Full-time**
If you are passionate about delivering an excellent employee experience, resolving HR queries, and continuously improving HR service delivery in a global organization, this could be the ideal opportunity for you.
  
  
**Your Role**
As an HR Service Agent, you will be part of Vanderlande’s Global HR Service Desk within the Regional HR & Services organization, based in Pune, India. You will report to the Regional HR Service Desk Lead APAC. Vanderlande’s Global HR organization comprises four main areas Business HR, Reward & Mobility, Talent Acquisition & Learning, and Regional HR & Services. The Regional HR & Services team provides local HR expertise while also supporting global HR service delivery through the Global HR Service Desk and Global HR Specialists team. As part of a team of nine HR Service Agents, you will serve as the first point of contact for employees based in the Netherlands. You will resolve first-line HR queries relating to policies, processes, and systems, execute basic HR transactions, and guide employees and managers in using employee and manager self-service tools. You will play a key role in delivering an efficient, consistent, and positive employee experience, with a strong focus on operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
HR Service Delivery & Operational Excellence
  
  

* Deliver a seamless and consistent employee experience while maintaining service efficiency and quality.
* Resolve first-line employee queries related to HR policies, processes, and systems, escalating complex cases to the relevant specialists when required.
* Record and document employee inquiries using the ticketing and case management system.
* Meet defined Service Level Agreement (SLA) targets by providing accurate, consistent, and timely support.
* Execute back-office HR processes and transactions in accordance with established policies and standard operating procedures.

description:
**Why do we exist? What do we do?**

The quality of school education available to students from low-income communities across India is abysmal. We run free and high-impact schools and an exceptional college-to-career program for the most disadvantaged students in Pune and Navi Mumbai. We are known for our world-class professional development, our result-oriented team culture, and our student-centric school design. Read more about us at
www.iTeachSchools.org
.

**Role Overview :**

The HR Payroll Associate will work closely with the HR Manager and coordinate closely with Finance to own end-to-end payroll processing, HRMS administration, and employee lifecycle documentation for iTeach Schools across Pune and Mumbai. This role is critical in ensuring that every employee is paid accurately and on time, that statutory compliance is never at risk, and that payroll data stays audit ready as the organization scales.

**Key Responsibilities:**

This role is for someone who enjoys working with numbers, solving payroll-related challenges, and ensuring employees are paid accurately and on time. As an HR Payroll Associate, you will manage key aspects of the employee lifecycle from onboarding and maintaining employee records to monthly payroll, salary revisions, exits, and full-and-final settlements. You will work closely with HR and Finance teams to ensure payroll accuracy, statutory compliance, strong controls, and smooth employee experience.

**1. Monthly Payroll & Data:**

* Collect and validate monthly payroll inputs such as attendance, leaves, reimbursements, deductions etc Audit attendance and leave data before payroll processing.
* Share all relevant data with the finance team to process payroll for employees, consultants and interns.
* Maintain any and all kinds of HR data pertaining to employees.

**2. Onboarding, Exit and Full-and-Final Settlement:**

* Complete joining formalities and verify PAN, bank details, address, ID and employment documents; set up accurate employee records in the HRMS/payroll system before the first salary cycle.
* Maintain confidential, audit-ready personnel and payroll records.
* Coordinate resignation documentation, notice-period records, asset clearance and no-dues confirmation.
* Prepare and validate full-and-final settlements (unpaid salary, bonus).

**3. Salary Revisions & Increments:**

* Implement approved increments, promotions, transfers and salary-structure changes in the HRMS.
* Verify effective dates, revised CTC, fixed/variable components, deductions and statutory impact.

**4. Compliance & Employee Support:**

* Support PF, ESIC, Professional Tax, LWF, TDS, gratuity and bonus processes.
* Maintain compliance calendars, challans, returns and payroll audit documentation.
* Resolve employee queries on salary, leave, tax and settlements.

**Prerequisites:**

* Graduate in HR, Commerce, Accounting or related fields.
* Min 2 years hands-on payroll and HR operations experience, having independently run at least 12 monthly payroll cycles.
* Working knowledge of PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, gratuity and bonus; experience with an HRMS/payroll platform. (e.g. Keka, SAP)
* Strong Excel skills.
* Clear communicator, comfortable managing stakeholders across HR, Finance and school teams.

**Compensation and Benefits:**

We take pride in offering competitive compensation and benefits commensurate with the candidate's education and work experience. The salary range for this position is ₹4.32 - 5.28 LPA CTC, and we are dedicated to providing a top-notch industry benefit. These benefits include PF, gratuity, medical insurance (up to 3 lakh PA), paid leaves, annual increments, and promotion opportunities.

**Location:**
Pune.

Through our industry-focused programs, corporate partnerships, placement initiatives and practical learning ecosystem, DIYguru connects education, industry and employment to build a future-ready workforce for the rapidly evolving mobility sector.

**About the Role**

DIYguru is looking for a Corporate Relations Lead – Industry Partnerships & Placements who can build, manage and grow relationships with corporate recruiters, HR professionals, hiring managers and industry stakeholders.

This is a partnership-heavy and placement-focused role. The candidate will be responsible not only for generating corporate leads but for converting relationships into tangible business and placement outcomes, including:

* Placement opportunities
* Internship opportunities
* OJT opportunities
* Recruitathon participation
* Corporate training opportunities
* Industry partnerships
* MoUs and strategic collaborations
* Repeat hiring relationships

Identify companies with recurring manpower and talent requirements.

Develop corporate accounts rather than one-time hiring relationships.

Understand workforce requirements, skill gaps and hiring challenges.

Develop long-term hiring and industry partnerships.

Conduct meetings and present relevant DIYguru solutions.

Maintain regular engagement with existing corporate partners.

Develop account-wise prospect lists and identify relevant decision-makers.

Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls, industry networks, referrals and events.

Schedule meetings with HR and business stakeholders.

Maintain a structured corporate sales/partnership pipeline.

Move prospects through defined stages from lead → meeting → requirement → partnership → hiring → repeat engagement.

Track conversion and follow-up activities consistently.

3. Placement & Recruitment Partnerships

Acquire new corporate hiring requirements and understand company manpower needs.

Study and interpret technical and non-technical Job Descriptions.

Coordinate with the placement team for candidate mapping and shortlisting.

Ensure candidate profiles are aligned with company requirements before sharing.

Coordinate assessments, interviews, hiring drives and recruitment activities.

Track candidate selection, offer and joining status.

Collect employer feedback after hiring processes.

Identify opportunities for repeat hiring and additional manpower requirements.

Maintain strong relationships with companies throughout the recruitment cycle.

4. Industry Networking & Representation

Attend industry events, HR conferences, EV and automotive events, seminars and networking forums.

Build professional relationships with industry leaders, HR professionals and business stakeholders.

Use LinkedIn strategically for corporate networking and relationship development.

Identify potential partnership opportunities through industry networks.

Represent DIYguru professionally in external meetings, events and discussions.

Maintain an active network of relevant industry contacts.

5. College & Institutional Partnerships

Develop relationships with TPOs, Placement Officers, HODs and institutional decision-makers.

Identify colleges, ITIs, diploma institutes and universities with relevant candidate pools.

Develop college-industry-placement opportunities.

Support campus hiring drives and Recruitathons.

Coordinate institutional outreach and partnership discussions.

Build and maintain a structured institutional database.

Identify opportunities for long-term college and industry collaborations.

6. Employer Branding & Corporate Communication

Work closely with the marketing/content team to support:

Corporate success stories

Hiring partner communications

Placement success stories

Industry collaboration announcements

LinkedIn outreach campaigns

Corporate newsletters

Employer partnership content

Ensure that all external communication reflects DIYguru's professional image and value proposition.

7. MIS, CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate and updated records for:

* Corporate database
* HR/POC database
* Target account list
* Active hiring requirements
* Corporate prospect pipeline
* Follow-up tracker
* Meeting tracker
* JD tracker
* Interview tracker
* Selection tracker
* Joining tracker
* Repeat hiring tracker
* Partnership/MoU tracker
* Prepare regular MIS reports covering new leads, meetings, requirements, conversions, active hiring, closures and repeat opportunities.

* Number and quality of new corporate accounts developed.
* Corporate meetings and qualified opportunities generated.
* New hiring requirements acquired.
* Placement, internship and OJT opportunities created.
* Conversion of prospects into active corporate partners.
* Successful candidate selections and joining.

Required Skills

* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills
* Recruitment and placement coordination skills
* Excellent follow-up and pipeline management

* Talent Acquisition
* Industry Partnerships
* EdTech Partnerships
* Staffing/Recruitment

title: Senior Recruitment Manager
description:
**Welcome! You made it to the job description page!**

At
**Josh Technology Group (JTG)**

You must deeply understand software engineering mindsets, tech stacks, and team dynamics to partner seamlessly with department heads, decode candidate behavior, and craft sharp, tech-fluent sourcing strategies. 6-12 years of progressive end-to-end Recruitment and Leadership experience, fostering a results-oriented and high-energy team environment. 

**Work Location:**

 

**Gurugram (WFO)**

Graduate/Postgraduate degree in any domain, preferably an MBA in HR or Master’s in Psychology from a college of repute 

**Who are we?**

Josh Technology Group is a 16+ year old product engineering company with 300+ engineers across 20+ countries, known for de-risking technology for businesses through AI-accelerated, outcome-accountable delivery — not staff augmentation. We have delivered 100+ projects with a client retention rate of over 90%. 

Our North America practice has been active for close to two decades, anchored in Texas and expanding across the East and West Coasts, serving Enterprises, Startups/VC-backed companies, Family-run businesses, and PE/Investment funds. 

Our deepest domain strength is in Healthcare and EdTech/HR-Tech (each ~25–30% of revenue). We engage across four models: Build from Scratch, Reinvent/Modernize, Product Engineering CoE, and Tech Due Diligence — primarily for North American and European clients. 

**What do we do?**

JTG is a bootstrapped organization that has multiple fully owned software products. JTG acts as a “Product Builder” for multiple US & UK-based startups. JTG has successfully created and launched more than 100 products, spread across various industries, and is working on many more exciting new ones. It has been 14+ years since its inception & JTG has been profitable from day 1 & aspires to reach new heights.

We work on only the latest & trending technologies & never shy away from inculcating the latest technologies in the organization. Currently, we are extensively working on the technologies like - NodeJS, Golang, Flutter, DotNet, Java, Python, Django, PySpark, DataBricks, ROR, PHP, Spark, Angular, Angular JS, React (JS and Native) DevOps: AWS, GCP (Google Firebase), Azure, Terraform, Ansible, etc.

Our very own software product, Pod.AI is in the recruitment & assessment industry and it has received an overwhelming response in the market.

**Core Responsibilities:**

* Take full ownership of the end-to-end recruitment process for suitable candidates across multiple domains and teams, as per the manpower requirements and business goals.
* Work closely with business stakeholders and department leads to understand their specific requirements and prepare the hiring strategy to ensure optimal productivity and timely closures.
* Utilize sourcing techniques on various job boards like Naukri, LinkedIn, etc, social media and lead campus hiring initiatives to find high-performing professionals.
* Handle the salary discussions and negotiations with the candidates. Use internal company guidelines to decide on compensation to be offered and lead further discussions.
* Design and execute a proactive Post-Offer Engagement Strategy to mitigate candidate drop-out. Maintain structured, multi-touchpoint communication throughout the notice period.
* Keep track of all hiring data (like time-to-hire, costs, and offer reject rates, etc) and lead recruitment strategy and execution discussions with senior management.
* Lead, coach, and develop a team of recruiters. Provide daily guidance on sourcing bottlenecks, negotiation tactics, and candidate management.
* Manage team bandwidth and resource allocation to ensure 100% fulfillment of the manpower plan.
* Lead the diversification of sourcing channels; evaluate the ROI of various job portals and social media platforms to optimize the recruitment spend.
* Act as a subject matter expert on industry hiring trends, salary benchmarking, and talent mapping to advise leadership on hiring strategy.
* Lead social media campaigns and campus engagement programs to build a robust pipeline of  talent.
* Promote and manage the internal employee referral to leverage the existing network for high-quality, culturally aligned candidates.
* Design candidate journey, ensuring every applicant has a professional and positive experience.

**What are we looking for in you?**

* 6-12 years of experience in lateral recruitment and coaching and developing junior recruiters, fostering a results-oriented and high-energy team environment.
* Graduate/Postgraduate degree in any domain, preferably an MBA in HR from a college of repute
* Expert knowledge of headhunting, and building talent pipelines.
* Ability to translate complex data into executive-level summaries and strategic recommendations.
* A self-starter who doesn't just identify problems but implements scalable solutions.
* Master-level negotiation and interpersonal skills to handle senior-level candidates and internal leadership.
* Ability to manage multiple recruitment projects simultaneously with a high sense of urgency and attention to detail.
* Good working knowledge of Microsoft & G Suite.
* Self-motivated and has an internal drive to produce high-quality work.
* Excellent communication & interpersonal skills.
* Excellent team player with strong skills in Research, Analysis, and Coordination.

**A stellar performer who:**

* Has the desire to make it BIG
* Is Self & Goal Driven, Quick Thinker, Action-Oriented, and Diligent
* Has good Interpersonal skills and a Go-Getter personality
* Has an eye for detail and good cognitive skills
* Maintains Integrity and Professionalism in work

**How will you grow here?**

* Work & interact directly with senior directors in an open and flat hierarchical structure
* Opportunity to source on multiple technologies
* You can own all aspects of leading HR processes
* Freedom & a plethora of opportunities to introduce new things in the organization
* Opportunity to Mentor the Best and Get Mentored by the Best

**JTG thanks you with**

* A stimulating and energetic work environment that encourages creativity
* Hackathons, Gaming Evenings, Poker Nights, and much more!
* Flexible Timings, Flexible Holiday Calendar
* Competitive salary (best in the industry)

title: Human Resources Lead
description:
**Company Description**
PACE Group is a diversified financial services organization founded in 1995 by first-generation entrepreneurs from premier management institutes in India. Evolving from an NSE stock broker into a full-scale financial group, PACE now operates across more than 300 locations in over 75 cities and serves clients in 34 countries. The group’s businesses span stock broking, high-frequency trading, discount broking services through Pocketful, and NBFC services through ShineStar. PACE manages a significant share of average daily turnover across major Indian exchanges and is recognized among India’s leading investment advisors by ICRA and CNBC. With deep market memberships and expertise across asset classes, PACE continues to focus on stock broking, technology, and trading for a diverse client base including institutions, corporate clients, and high-net-worth individuals.

This role is responsible for overseeing end-to-end HR operations, including workforce planning, hiring, onboarding, performance management, and employee engagement. The Human Resources Lead will design, implement, and maintain HR policies and procedures, manage employee benefits and compensation-related processes, and ensure compliance with relevant labor laws and organizational standards. Daily responsibilities include partnering with business leaders on personnel management decisions, resolving employee issues, supporting managers with HR best practices, and maintaining accurate HR documentation and reporting. The role also involves driving HR initiatives that support organizational growth, cultivating an inclusive workplace culture, and contributing to strategic HR planning for the group.

* Strong foundation in Human Resources (HR) and HR Management, with experience overseeing core HR functions.
* Ability to develop, implement, and review HR Policies that align with regulatory requirements and organizational goals.
* Experience managing Employee Benefits programs, including communication, administration, and vendor coordination.
* Proficiency in Personnel Management, including performance management, employee relations, and talent development.
* Bachelor’s or master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field.
* Experience in financial services or a fast-paced corporate environment is an advantage.
* Knowledge of Indian labor laws and compliance requirements, particularly relevant to Gurugram/Haryana.
* Strong interpersonal, communication, and conflict-resolution skills, with the ability to work collaboratively across teams.
* Proficiency with HRIS tools and MS Office; comfort with data analysis and HR reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to lead HR projects, manage multiple priorities, and support organizational change initiatives.
