title: Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)
description:
**Senior Associate / Assistant Manager, Strategic Initiatives (Founder's Office)**

**The Short version**

**Who we're looking for:**
A sharp, high-intensity problem solver with 3 to 6 years of experience, who cares deeply about education and is happiest when handed a messy problem with no playbook.

**What the role is about:**
You'll work directly with our CEO on the strategic priorities that will shape Kraftshala's next phase of growth, across admissions, training, placements, tech, partnerships, and scale, and you'll own each one from start to finish.

**Why you should apply:**
You'll work on some of the hardest and most critical problems in the company, alongside people with extraordinary expertise in skilling and training. There's a lot to learn here, and plenty of room to grow.

**About Us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing placements, with a 94% placement rate, and we are gunning to become the world’s largest career launchpad, across domains.

We’re backed by a number of eminent investors including ex-unicorn startup founders and CXOs of global giants like RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The Detailed Version**

Our goal is simple: drive placements. That takes stellar admissions, training and placement processes, strong technology and deep partnerships across the ecosystem, and keeping all of it stellar as our programs grow. This role exists to solve the cross-functional problems that get in the way of that, working alongside the founder as priorities shift.

**Responsibilities & Metrics to Measure:**

* Take ambiguous, high-priority problems from the founder, break them down, find root causes using data, and turn them into a clear plan with owners and timelines.
* Spot where our programs risk slipping into mediocrity as they scale, across learner outcomes, placement quality and delivery standards, and fix the gaps at a system level.
* Run small, quick experiments on problem areas as they come up, share what worked and what didn't, and change course when the data or priorities shift.
* Act as the founder's thinking partner through sharp analyses, decision memos and reviews, and turn solved problems into repeatable processes that teams can run on their own.

**Top Grading**

* **Proactiveness:**
  An A-Player spots the next problem before being told and moves on it, whereas a B-Player waits for direction and does well only once the task is clearly defined.
* **Intensity & Focus:**
  An A-Player attacks the most important problem with urgency until it's solved, whereas a B-Player spreads effort thin and lets momentum fade after the first push.
* **Structuring Ambiguity:**
  An A-Player turns a vague, messy problem into a clear problem statement, hypothesis and plan, whereas a B-Player either waits for clarity or jumps into action without a frame.
* **Iterative Learning:**
  An A-Player tests fast, learns from what didn't work and changes course without ego, whereas a B-Player sticks to the original plan even when the data says otherwise.
* **Cross-functional Influence:**
  An A-Player gets teams they don't manage to move by building trust and making a clear case, whereas a B-Player leans on the founder's name to get things done.
* **Adaptability:**
  An A-Player shifts gears calmly when priorities change and carries the learnings forward, whereas a B-Player treats every change as a disruption and loses pace.
* **Passion for Education:**
  An A-Player believes in the cause of education and finds ways to drive change, whether through learner outcomes, access to opportunity, better systems or shifting mindsets, whereas a B-Player sees education as just another sector to work in.

**Ideal Candidate**

You have 3 to 6 years of experience solving real problems end-to-end. You might come from consulting, strategy, a founder's office or business operations, or from any role where you've had to work through varied, unstructured problems with no fixed playbook.

* A clear, genuine interest in education is a must. Prior exposure to the sector, whether through edtech, skilling or teaching, is a strong plus.
* You've taken an ambiguous problem, given it structure, and delivered a measurable result, ideally while working across teams you didn't directly manage.
* You're looking to build deep context and grow with us over the long term, not a short stint.

**Location**

Delhi / Gurugram

Know more about Kraftshala's philosophy, culture and investors here.

title: Global Leave & Absence Specialist
description:
**Company Description**
**About Ramboll**
Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a foundation-owned people company. We have more than 18,000 experts working across our global operations in 35 countries. Our experts are leaders in their fields, developing and delivering innovative solutions in diverse markets including Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health, Energy, and Management Consulting. We invite you to contribute to a more sustainable future working in an open, collaborative, and empowering company. Combining local experience with global knowledge, we together shape the societies of tomorrow.
  
  
**Ramboll in India**
Ramboll has more than 1800+ experts working across five offices in India applying their passion to deliver innovative solutions in markets as diverse as Buildings, Transport, Planning & Urban Design, Water, Environment & Health and Energy. Founded in Denmark, Ramboll is a people company. We invite you to contribute to a sustainable future working in an open, collaborative and empowering culture.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team:**
You will be part of Ramboll's Global HR Operations team, which provides HR operations services to various countries across Ramboll using global HR applications (e.g., Workday).
  
  
As the
**Global Leave & Absence Specialist**
, you will be the specialist resource for leave and absence management within Global HR Operations. You will own the accuracy, consistency, and continuous improvement of leave and absence processes across the countries serviced, acting as the point of expertise for complex cases, process design, and Workday absence configuration — while also contributing to wider HR Operations service delivery linked to the employee lifecycle.
  
  
**Main Role Responsibilities**

* Leave & Absence Process Expertise: Act as the subject matter expert for leave and absence processes globally — including maternity/parental leave, sick leave, statutory and company-specific leave types, disability/medical leave, and other absence categories across multiple countries.
* Complex Case Resolution: Own and resolve complex or non-standard leave cases (e.g., extended medical leave, intermittent leave, leave-pay interactions, return-to-work scenarios), acting as the escalation point for the wider HR Operations team.
* Process Design & Standardization: Design, document, and continuously improve global leave and absence processes, identifying opportunities for standardization and automation across countries.
* Workday Absence Configuration: Partner with the HRIS/Workday team on absence plan configuration, testing, and troubleshooting; identify and raise system gaps or defects affecting leave processing, and support enhancement projects.
* Statutory & Policy Currency: Maintain up-to-date knowledge of statutory leave entitlements and regulatory changes across countries serviced, and translate these into updated processes, guides, and system configurations.
* Payroll Interface: Ensure leave data flows accurately into payroll, working closely with Global Payroll and in-country teams to coordinate statutory pay, unpaid-leave deductions, and return-to-work pay changes; validate absence data ahead of payroll cut-off dates and investigate and resolve leave-related payroll discrepancies.
* General HR Operations & Workday Support: Provide broader HR Operations process and Workday system support (service requests, data updates, change requests) as part of the team's day-to-day delivery.
* Query & Ticket Resolution: Handle and resolve leave and absence-related tickets and queries from employees, managers, and in-country HR teams, ensuring adherence to defined SLAs and turnaround times.
* Documentation & Training: Own the creation and maintenance of leave and absence SOPs, quick guides, step-by-step guides, and training materials for the wider HR Operations team to reference.
* Knowledge Sharing & Coaching: Act as the go-to resource for leave and absence questions across the HR Operations team, coaching colleagues on process nuances and edge cases.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Participate in weekly/monthly update calls with countries and the Global HR Operations team, representing leave and absence topics and providing status updates on ongoing initiatives.
* Benefits Coordination: Liaise with global and local benefits teams, insurers, and providers to ensure correct handling of benefits (e.g., income protection, disability, statutory entitlements) during leave, and keep employees informed of the benefit implications of their leave.
* Global Policy & Data Compliance: Support the harmonization of global and local leave and absence policies with People Advisory, legal, and payroll teams, and ensure all leave-related activities comply with data privacy and confidentiality requirements (including GDPR and local equivalents); support internal and external audits as needed.
* Vendor & Provider Liaison: Act as the primary point of contact for external vendors involved in leave administration, including payroll providers, benefit providers, insurers, and occupational health providers, coordinating on claims, certificates, and return-to-work arrangements.
* Reporting & Analytics: Prepare regular and ad hoc reporting on leave trends, absence utilization, and payroll-impacting leave; analyze the data to flag risks and provide insights that support workforce planning, policy review, and wellbeing initiatives.

**Qualifications**

* HR Operations experience gained in an international, multi-cultural organization.
* 5-7+ years of experience in Global HR Operations, with demonstrated depth in leave and absence management across multiple countries.
* Hands-on experience administering and/or configuring leave/absence processes in an HRIS tool (Workday strongly preferred; PeopleSoft, Oracle, SAP, or similar also considered).
* Working knowledge of how statutory leave entitlements and practices vary across jurisdictions; exposure to multiple countries/regions preferred.
* Service-minded, with a strong understanding of good customer service in a shared-services/global environment.
* Experience working in a complex, matrixed organization.
* Systematic and structured working style with strong attention to detail, given the compliance sensitivity of leave data.
* Strong self-starter, comfortable operating as an individual contributor and subject matter resource without formal line management responsibility.
* Excellent communication and coordination skills; fluent in English, both verbal and written.
* Innovative and problem-solving approach, particularly for ambiguous or non-standard cases.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment with a sense of urgency.
* Preferred Education & Certification: Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Employment Law, or a related field; a professional HR, payroll, or benefits certification is an advantage.
* Regional Breadth: Experience supporting countries across Europe, the Americas, the Middle East, and Asia-Pacific is highly advantageous.

**Personal Qualities**

* Strong communicator, open, transparent, and takes initiative.
* Excellent interpersonal and active listening skills.
* Strong critical thinking, able to balance case-level detail with the bigger picture.
* Sound judgement and decision-making; takes ownership and accountability for the accuracy and compliance of leave and absence outcomes.
* Well-structured, organized way of working.
* Good negotiation and stakeholder-management skills.
* Applies an EDI (Equality, Diversity, and Inclusiveness) mindset.
* Strong intercultural communication skills, comfortable working closely with different nationalities, cultures, and client groups.

**Success Measures**

* Accurate, compliant, and timely administration of leave and absence processes across all countries serviced.
* Reduction in payroll errors and discrepancies related to leave and absence.
* Improved employee and manager experience during leave processes.
* Reliable absence reporting and actionable insights delivered to HR leadership.
* Strong stakeholder satisfaction across HR, payroll, benefits, and business teams.

**Additional Information**
**What we can offer you**
Investment in your development
  
  
Leaders you can count on, guided by our Leadership Principles
  
  
Be valued for the unique person you are.
  
  
Never be short of inspiration from colleagues, clients, and projects.
  
  
The long-term thinking of a foundation-owned company
  
  
**Work at the heart of sustainable change**
Ramboll is a global architecture, engineering, and consultancy company. We believe that the purpose of sustainable change is to create a thriving world for both nature and people. title: Talent Acquisition Specialist
description:
**About Valiance**

Valiance is a deep-tech AI and analytics consulting firm working with enterprises on cutting-edge solutions across Artificial Intelligence, Generative AI, Data Science, Computer Vision, Data Engineering, and Cloud Engineering.

Our teams solve complex business problems for leading enterprises using modern AI technologies and data platforms. We are looking for a Technical Recruiter who can help us build exceptional engineering and AI teams by identifying, evaluating, and attracting high-quality technical talent.

**The Role**

We are looking for a recruiter who goes beyond sourcing resumes and matching keywords against job descriptions. Someone who understands technology, can recognize meaningful technical experience, distinguishes genuine expertise from superficial exposure, and exercises sound judgment when evaluating candidates.

You should be curious, proactive, analytical, and highly outcome-oriented. You should continuously learn from interview feedback, identify gaps in the recruitment process, and bring ideas to improve hiring quality and speed.

We value independent thinking, ownership, and the ability to make good decisions in ambiguous situations. AI tools should help you become more effective and productive, but your judgment, curiosity, and ability to identify talent must remain your own.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Screening & Talent Evaluation

* Evaluate resumes against job requirements by understanding the substance of a candidate's experience, not merely matching keywords or listed skills.
* Identify relevant projects, assess their complexity, understand the candidate's specific contributions, and evaluate the depth and duration of their hands-on experience.
* Distinguish between candidates who have genuinely built and deployed solutions and those with only academic exposure, superficial familiarity, or limited practical experience.
* Assess candidates for roles across Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Computer Vision, Data Engineering, and related technical disciplines.
* Identify relevant transferable skills and non-obvious talent that may not have an exact keyword match with the job description.
* Apply sound judgment to shortlist candidates who merit further technical evaluation, while avoiding both false positives and the rejection of promising profiles.

2. Candidate Fitment & Hiring Judgment

* Evaluate candidates across technical relevance, problem-solving ability, communication, learning agility, motivation, ownership, and role-specific expectations.
* Recognize signals that indicate whether a candidate is suited to the role, the nature of consulting work, client-facing environments, and Valiance's working culture.
* Understand the differences between profiles that look similar on paper but vary significantly in capability, experience, and potential.
* Ask thoughtful screening questions to validate experience, uncover gaps, and establish whether a candidate's claims are supported by concrete examples.
* Maintain a high bar for hiring quality without unnecessarily narrowing the talent pool.

3. Learning from Interview Outcomes

* Systematically analyze feedback from technical interviews, hiring managers, and rejected candidates to understand what worked and what did not.
* Identify patterns in rejected profiles, including recurring gaps in technical depth, project experience, communication, or role fit.
* Translate feedback into improved screening criteria, sharper questions, better sourcing strategies, and more accurate shortlisting decisions.
* Track the quality of shortlisted candidates and continuously refine the recruitment process based on actual outcomes.
* Demonstrate measurable improvement in screening accuracy and hiring effectiveness over time.

4. Ownership, Agency & Continuous Improvement

* Take end-to-end ownership of assigned hiring mandates, from understanding requirements and sourcing through screening, interview coordination, and offer closure.
* Proactively identify bottlenecks, hiring risks, and opportunities to improve candidate quality, turnaround time, and conversion rates.
* Bring recommendations and challenge ineffective approaches constructively instead of waiting for instructions.
* Collaborate closely with hiring managers, interviewers, and the broader talent acquisition team to align on role expectations and hiring priorities.
* Follow through on commitments, communicate issues early, and remain accountable for outcomes rather than activity alone.
* Show curiosity, energy, and a genuine hunger to improve personal effectiveness and the overall quality of hiring.

5. Effective Use of AI & Recruitment Tools

* Use AI tools to improve sourcing, resume analysis, candidate research, interview preparation, and recruitment workflow efficiency.
* Apply independent judgment to validate AI-generated assessments, challenge incorrect conclusions, and identify context that automated screening may miss.
* Avoid relying on AI-generated shortlists without independently evaluating candidate experience, project relevance, technical depth, and role fit.
* Experiment with better recruitment workflows and share practical ideas that improve productivity without compromising hiring quality.
* Use AI responsibly, protecting candidate information and complying with company data security policies.

**What We Are Looking For**

* 2–4 years of experience in technical recruitment, preferably hiring for Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, Data Engineering, or software engineering roles.
* Prior experience recruiting for an AI company, data consulting firm, deep-tech organization, or technology product company is strongly preferred.
* A working understanding of technical concepts, project lifecycles, and the practical differences between commonly used technologies and skill sets.
* Strong analytical thinking and the ability to interpret resumes beyond keywords, titles, and years of experience.
* Evidence of good candidate judgment and the ability to distinguish high-quality profiles from superficially suitable ones.
* A track record of taking initiative, solving problems independently, and improving recruitment processes.
* Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the confidence to engage technical hiring managers and ask clarifying questions.
* Comfort working in a fast-paced environment with multiple hiring priorities and evolving requirements.
* Familiarity with applicant tracking systems, sourcing platforms, LinkedIn Recruiter, and AI-enabled recruitment tools.

**We will place particular emphasis on:**

* **Talent intuition backed by evidence:**
  The ability to spot promising candidates by understanding what they have actually done, not simply what their resumes claim.
* **Independent thinking:**
  The willingness and ability to make reasoned decisions rather than blindly follow templates, keywords, or AI recommendations.
* **High agency:**
  Identifying what needs to be done, taking initiative, and driving it to completion without constant supervision.
* **Learning agility:**
  Converting feedback and mistakes into better screening decisions and stronger recruitment outcomes.
* **Outcome orientation:**
  Caring about the quality of candidates hired, not just the number of resumes sourced or calls completed.
* **Collaborative mindset:**
  Working as a partner to hiring managers and colleagues, sharing insights, and actively seeking feedback.
* **Continuous improvement:**
  Bringing ideas, testing new approaches, and raising the bar on recruitment effectiveness.

**How Success Will Be Measured**

* Quality and relevance of shortlisted candidates, measured through technical interview progression and hiring manager feedback.
* Screening accuracy, including the ability to identify suitable candidates and reduce avoidable mismatches.
* Improvement in interview-to-shortlist and interview-to-offer conversion rates, with appropriate role-level context.
* Hiring turnaround time and ability to maintain healthy candidate pipelines for priority positions.
* Candidate engagement, interview coordination, and offer conversion.
* Evidence of learning from feedback and sustained improvement in recruitment decisions.
* Proactive recommendations and measurable improvements to recruitment workflows and productivity.

**Why Join Valiance?**

* Work closely with experienced AI, Data Science, and Data Engineering professionals.
* Develop a deeper understanding of emerging technologies and the talent shaping enterprise AI.
* Take ownership of hiring outcomes in a growing deep-tech organization.
* Have the opportunity to influence and improve how a technology company identifies and attracts exceptional talent.

* Coordinate with vendors for office infrastructure, repairs, maintenance and administrative services.
* Maintain records of company assets, employee ID cards and access cards.

* Ensure office facilities are maintained in accordance with organisational standards.

**5. Vendor Management & Administrative Coordination**

title: HR Business Partner – Talent Acquisition
description:
**About LoglineAI**

LoglineAI is an AI-powered creative studio helping content studios, brands, and agencies go from pitch to fully packaged content — faster, smarter, and leaner. Part of the SVF ecosystem alongside hoichoi (India's leading Regional OTT platform) and Sooper (AI-led micro-drama OTT)

**The Opportunity**

LoglineAI is growing, and every new hire shapes how the studio works. In this role, you will own hiring from start to finish across creative, tech and client-facing teams — this is about 80% of the job. The other 20% is core people operations: onboarding, documentation, employee queries and exits.

You will work closely with founders and hiring managers, and you will be the person who makes sure we hire the right people, quickly and fairly.

**What you'll do**

* Own end-to-end hiring for creative, tech and client-facing roles, closing each role within an agreed time-to-hire target.
* Build a strong pipeline for every open role through LinkedIn, job portals, referrals, creative communities and direct outreach, so each role has a qualified shortlist within the first week.
* Run a clear intake with every hiring manager before sourcing starts — agree on must-haves, outcomes and the interview plan, so fewer roles need to be re-opened.
* Run structured interviews — screens, scorecards, panel scheduling and debriefs — so every hiring decision is backed by clear evidence.
* Track and share hiring metrics every week (time-to-hire, offer acceptance rate, source quality, pipeline health) and use them to fix slow stages.
* Manage offers and pre-joining, keeping candidates engaged until Day 1 to keep offer drop-offs low.
* Make sure every new joiner has access, tools, a buddy and a 90-day plan in their first week.
* Handle core people operations — employee records, letters, policy queries and exits — accurately and on time.
* Be the go-to partner for managers and team members on everyday people matters, raising issues early before they grow.
* Use AI tools to speed up sourcing, screening and documentation, cutting time spent on repeat task.

**Must-Have Qualifications**

* A track record of owning hiring for several roles at once, with numbers to show it — roles closed, time-to-hire, offer acceptance.
* Strong sourcing skills: you can find and engage passive candidates, not just post jobs and wait.
* Experience running structured interviews and working closely with hiring managers.
* Working knowledge of core HR operations — onboarding, employee documentation, lifecycle letters and exits.
* Clear, warm communication with candidates, managers and leadership.
* Uses AI tools to summarise data, draft documents, and explore process improvements — and knows how to verify and correct AI outputs.

**Good to Have**

* Experience hiring for creative roles (writers, designers, editors, producers) or AI/tech roles.
* Hands-on use of an ATS or async screening tools
* Basic understanding of Indian labour law and HR compliance.
* Experience building employer brand content for a young company.

**Culture & How We Work**

At LoglineAI, the best idea wins, not the biggest title. We operate in small, cross-functional teams where content, product, growth, and tech sit close together, argue productively, and occasionally steal each other's snacks. It's a lot like a kitchen during a house party: slightly chaotic, everyone's doing three things at once, but somehow the food comes out great.

Ownership here isn't a buzzword; it's the default setting. If something's broken, you don't file a ticket and wait. You're the person who notices the printer is jammed and just fixes it instead of pretending you didn't see it. We ship fast, measure what works, and iterate. Think less 'perfect deck' and more 'let's see if real viewers actually care.'

When big moments arrive, we stretch. But we're equally serious about keeping the pace sustainable, because burnt-out teams build neither great products nor great stories. If that sounds like your kind of chaos, we should talk.

title: Administrative Executive – HR, Procurement & General Administration
description:
Administrative Executive – HR & General Administration

**Company:**
Agile Bioscience Private Limited

**Location:**
Ahmedabad, Gujarat

**Job Type:**
Full-time, On-site

**Department:**
Administration & Human Resources

**Reporting To:**
Director / Management

1. Company Description

Agile Bioscience Private Limited is a specialized analytical services provider supporting the development and characterization of biopharmaceutical products across the protein lifecycle, from discovery to commercialization. The company provides comprehensive analytical services for proteins, monoclonal antibodies, peptides, antibody–drug conjugates (ADCs), and other complex biological molecules.

Its capabilities include higher-order structural characterization, physicochemical characterization, amino acid analysis, peptide mapping, glycosylation profiling, disulfide bond identification, intact molecular weight assessment, and advanced analytical techniques such as icIEF, CE-SDS, HPLC, DSC, CD, FT-IR, SEC-MALS, SV-AUC, and micro-flow imaging.

Agile Bioscience operates in a quality-driven scientific environment, supported by experienced scientists, advanced analytical instrumentation, and established quality management systems. The company is committed to delivering reliable analytical results and maintaining high standards of documentation, compliance, and operational excellence.

2. Role Description

The Administrative Executive will be responsible for managing day-to-day administrative operations, supporting HR activities, coordinating with vendors, maintaining procurement and invoice records, and monitoring administrative and compliance-related schedules.

The role will also involve coordinating recruitment activities, maintaining employee attendance and leave records, supporting onboarding and employee documentation, and tracking instrument calibration schedules in coordination with the Quality Assurance (QA) and concerned technical teams.

The ideal candidate should be proactive, well-organized, detail-oriented, and capable of managing multiple responsibilities while ensuring timely follow-ups, accurate documentation, confidentiality, and smooth functioning of office and laboratory support activities.

3. Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Human Resources (HR) Coordination**

* Maintain candidate databases and recruitment trackers to monitor hiring progress and closure timelines.
* Coordinate interview schedules and communicate with shortlisted candidates regarding interview details and feedback.
* Assist with employee onboarding, joining formalities, document collection, employee file maintenance, and induction coordination.
* Maintain employee attendance, leave records, late-coming records, and related trackers.
* Monitor daily attendance and prepare periodic attendance summaries for management and payroll processing.
* Coordinate with employees and reporting managers regarding attendance discrepancies, leave regularization, and missing attendance entries.
* Maintain employee records, including joining documents, personal information, appointment letters, and other HR-related documentation.
* Assist in coordinating employee engagement activities, internal announcements, celebrations, and employee recognition programs.
* Support HR-related administrative activities, including confirmation, appraisal, and exit formalities, as assigned.

**B. Vendor Management and Procurement Coordination**

* Coordinate with vendors and service providers for quotations, purchase requirements, delivery timelines, and service arrangements.
* Obtain quotations for office supplies, laboratory consumables, equipment services, maintenance, and other approved requirements.
* Prepare purchase orders (POs) in accordance with company procedures and approval workflows.
* Follow up with vendors for PO acknowledgements, order confirmation, dispatch, delivery, installation, and service completion.
* Maintain vendor databases, contact details, quotation records, purchase trackers, and correspondence.
* Coordinate with internal departments to understand and track their administrative and procurement requirements.
* Assist in identifying alternative vendors and obtaining comparative quotations when required.
* Ensure timely follow-up on pending orders, delayed deliveries, and unresolved vendor issues.

**C. Invoice Management and Payment Follow-ups**

* Receive and verify vendor invoices against approved purchase orders, quotations, delivery records, or service completion documents, as applicable.
* Maintain invoice registers and track invoice submission, verification, approval, and payment status.
* Coordinate with the Finance/Accounts team for invoice processing and payment scheduling.
* Follow up with vendors for missing invoices, supporting documents, credit notes, and other required records.
* Track outstanding vendor payments and escalate overdue or disputed invoices to the concerned department.
* Coordinate with internal teams to resolve invoice discrepancies and documentation gaps.
* Maintain organized records of purchase orders, invoices, delivery challans, service reports, and payment correspondence.

**D. General Office and Facility Administration**

* Manage routine office administration to ensure smooth day-to-day operations.
* Monitor office supplies, stationery, pantry requirements, housekeeping, and other general facility needs.
* Coordinate with housekeeping, maintenance, security, facility management, and other service providers.
* Ensure proper maintenance of administrative records, files, registers, and office documentation.
* Coordinate meetings, visitor arrangements, appointments, travel bookings, and logistics as required.
* Assist management with preparing letters, internal communications, presentations, reports, and administrative summaries.
* Monitor office equipment maintenance and coordinate repairs or servicing when required.
* Support employee communication, internal announcements, and general workplace coordination.
* Ensure timely reporting and resolution of routine administrative issues.

**E. Documentation, Record Keeping, and Reporting**

* Maintain accurate, updated, and easily retrievable administrative, HR, vendor, procurement, and attendance records.
* Prepare and maintain trackers for recruitment, employee attendance, calibration schedules, purchase orders, invoices, vendor follow-ups, and office requirements.
* Generate periodic status reports for management, highlighting pending activities, upcoming due dates, delays, and required actions.
* Ensure appropriate document filing, version control where applicable, and confidentiality of employee and company records.
* Support internal audits and administrative documentation requirements by retrieving and coordinating the required records.
* Follow established company policies, procedures, and document retention practices.

**F. Management and Cross-Functional Support**

* Provide administrative assistance to the Director and management team as required.
* Coordinate with HR, QA, Research & Development, laboratory operations, Finance, Procurement, and other internal stakeholders.
* Maintain effective communication and follow up on assigned tasks to ensure timely completion.
* Proactively identify pending activities, upcoming deadlines, and administrative bottlenecks.
* Support special projects and other responsibilities assigned by management.

4. Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration,Commerce, Office Management, or a related discipline.
* Approximately 2–3 years of relevant experience in administration, HR coordination, office management, or a similar role.
* Prior experience in backend office coordination, attendance management, vendor coordination, purchase orders, invoice tracking, and general administration is preferred.
* Familiarity with instrument calibration schedules, preventive maintenance coordination, and quality documentation in a regulated laboratory environment will be an added advantage.

5. Required Skills and Competencies

* Strong organizational, planning, and time-management skills.
* Good written and verbal communication skills.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, Outlook/email, and other routine office applications.
* Ability to maintain trackers, prepare reports, and manage documentation accurately.
* Strong follow-up, coordination, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to manage multiple tasks and prioritize work based on urgency and deadlines.
* Professional conduct and the ability to maintain confidentiality of employee, financial, and business information.
* Attention to detail and a proactive approach to identifying pending activities.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with employees, management, vendors, service providers, and external stakeholders.
* Willingness to work in a process-oriented, quality-conscious scientific organization.

6. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated against agreed targets, including:

1. **Recruitment Coordination:**
   Timely scheduling of interviews, candidate follow-ups, and maintenance of recruitment trackers.
2. **Attendance Management:**
   Accuracy and timely updating of employee attendance and leave records.
3. **Calibration Schedule Monitoring:**
   Timely reminders and follow-ups for upcoming calibration due dates, with prompt escalation of overdue activities.
4. **Vendor Coordination:**
   Timely procurement follow-ups, delivery coordination, and resolution of vendor-related issues.
5. **PO and Invoice Tracking:**
   Accurate maintenance of purchase order and invoice registers, with timely coordination for approvals and payment follow-ups.
6. **Administrative Efficiency:**
   Timely completion of office administration activities and resolution of routine facility-related issues.
7. **Documentation Accuracy:**
   Completeness, accuracy, and retrievability of HR and administrative records.
8. **Reporting and Communication:**
   Timely submission of trackers, status reports, and pending-activity summaries to management.

7. Work Environment

* This is a full-time, on-site position based at Agile Bioscience Private Limited, Ahmedabad, Gujarat. The role requires regular interaction with management, employees, laboratory personnel, QA, Finance, vendors, and external service providers.

The Talent Acquisition Specialist is responsible for managing the full lifecycle of the recruitment process. title: Manager, HUB – Legal Counsel (Employment)

Now it’s time to fully realise the full potential of our business and our people. We do this through our Win as One strategy. It puts our purpose – to deliver better everyday health with humanity – at the heart of everything we do. It unites us, inspires us, and challenges us to be better every day, driven by our agile, performance-focused culture.
  
  
**Purpose of the Role**
The Manager – Legal Counsel, Employment will provide legal support to Haleon’s Global Employment Legal team, with a focus on global employment contracts, employment policies, multi-country employment law research and employee DSAR support. The role will work closely with Global Employment Legal, HR and local Legal teams to support the development and maintenance of global employment documentation and policies, while ensuring appropriate consideration of local legal requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
Global Employment Contracts & Documentation
  
  

* Lead on legal aspects of the development and maintenance of employment contract, offer letter and related employment documentation templates across Haleon markets.
* Research and analyse relevant local employment law requirements and identify key country-specific requirements or variations.
* Work with Global Employment Legal, local Legal and HR teams to support the review and lead on the drafting and appropriate localization of employment documentation.
* Facilitate periodic updates to employment documentation in response to relevant legal, policy or business changes.

Employment Policies & Global Projects
  
  

* Provide employment law research and legal support for global employment policies, standards and projects.
* Support the review and updating of employment policies, guidance and related materials and lead on the drafting of updates.
* Work with local Legal and HR teams and Outside Counsel to understand relevant country-specific requirements and support appropriate implementation of global initiatives.
* Prepare practical legal research, summaries and comparative analysis where required.

Employment Legal Knowledge & Process Support
  
  

* Develop and maintain employment law templates, precedents, country guidance, research materials and playbooks.
* Monitor relevant employment law developments and support appropriate updates to existing guidance and documentation.
* Contribute to the standardisation and continuous improvement of repeatable employment legal work.
* Provide legal research and project support to the Global Employment Legal team on other employment matters as required.

Employee DSAR Support – As required
  
  

* Provide employment law support on employee Data Subject Access Requests (DSARs), as required, working with Employment Legal, Privacy and HR teams.
* Assist with the review of relevant information from an employment law perspective and identify matters requiring escalation to the appropriate counsel.

Stakeholder & Cross Functional Management:
  
  

* Work collaboratively with Global Employment Legal, local Legal, HR and other relevant stakeholders to support effective delivery of employment legal initiatives.
* Coordinate with relevant stakeholders to obtain local input, resolve queries and support timely completion of assigned work.

**Qualifications & Essential Skills**

* Bachelor of Law (LL.B) or equivalent legal qualification.
* Qualified lawyer with approximately 8–10 years of relevant legal experience.
* Strong experience in employment and labour law, including employment contracts, policies and employment-related advisory work.
* Proven track record of strong legal drafting skills.
* Strong legal research and analysis skills.
* Experience working with HR and Legal stakeholders.
* Ability to research and analyse employment law requirements across different jurisdictions.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred**

* Experience supporting multinational or multi-jurisdictional employment law matters.
* In-house experience within a multinational organisation and/or experience working in a legal shared services or global capability environment.
* Experience developing employment law templates, playbooks, policies or other standardised legal documentation.
* Exposure to employee privacy, DSARs, investigations, employee relations or employment litigation.

**Technical Skills**

* Employment and labour law research and analysis.
* Drafting and review of employment contracts, offer letters and employment policies.
* Multi-jurisdictional legal research and comparative analysis.
* Legal knowledge management and development of templates and playbooks.
* Proficiency in standard legal research and productivity tools.

2026-11-05

title: Founder's Office (Deal Desk)
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* This is a lawyer’s seat in the Founder’s Office at Dodo Payments, a merchant of record carrying compliance responsibility for merchants across global markets. The role brings legal and regulatory judgment to decisions on merchant acceptance, categories, and deal terms, especially for edge cases that don’t fit standard templates.
* The Deal Desk is being established to embed compliance into onboarding, escalation, and deboarding decisions alongside product and risk teams, enabling sales to get real-time compliance answers during calls rather than after.
* For the first three months, the role sits in the Founder’s Office to gather cross-functional input from sales, growth, risk, product, and founders before the desk evolves into a structured function under the Compliance team. Work is reviewed and signed off by the Head of Legal, Compliance & Partnerships.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Join sales and merchant calls to ensure compliance, acceptance, or contract promises are legally deliverable.
* Bring the regulatory compliance perspective to merchant onboarding, escalation, and deboarding meetings alongside product and risk teams.
* Work through edge cases: merchants with novel business models, categories, or markets; propose compliant paths or clear rejections with rationale for sign-off.
* Help define which new merchant categories and customer types can be supported and under what conditions.
* Handle contract-related aspects of deals and day-to-day commercial requests: negotiated merchant terms, partner term updates, vendor onboarding paperwork, etc., using standard legal documentation.
* Maintain the backend pricing table to ensure negotiated terms are accurately recorded and applied.
* Track regulatory and card scheme rule changes relevant to Dodo’s markets and flag operational impacts.
* Convert recurring compliance decisions into written positions to avoid repeated escalations.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Must-Have**

* Qualified lawyer with 1–2 years post-qualification experience in the general corporate team of an Indian or international law firm, or in an in-house legal team at a company with cross-border operations.

For well over a century, ExxonMobil has been at the heart of creating and growing a modern world. We embrace the power and promise of technology, pushing the boundaries of what's possible. For billions around the world, lives are better and last longer because of the innovative problem solving and reliable energy we provide. Real change begins with bold questions, drive, and ambition. Here, your talent, determination and contributions shape how far you'll go and the impact you'll make along the way.
  
  
Our future success depends on exceptional people. We invest in developing talent through meaningful work, challenging assignments, mentorship, and experiences that help build the next generation of leaders.
  
  
**Our Culture**
We are uniquely ExxonMobil. Integrity, care, excellence, resilience and courage, these core values determine how we work every day. At ExxonMobil, our values aren't just words— they're how we show up, focused on delivering the right answer, the right way, every day.
  
  
What role will you play in the team
  
  
The Buyer / Contracts Manager leads, develops, negotiates and executes contracts for goods and services across one or more procurement categories, including direct and indirect spend. The role ensures full compliance with corporate standards and regional requirements across APAC, Europe, Latin America and North America. It requires strong commercial acumen, legal and contractual awareness, and sound technical understanding of the categories managed, supporting upstream, midstream, downstream and manufacturing operations.
  
  
Working from India with global stakeholders and suppliers, you will use your language skills in Mandarin, Spanish and/or Portuguese to engage global suppliers and business partners.
  
  
What you do
  
  
Drive value, efficiency, and expanded market advantage via end-to-end category management phases, while ensuring operational integrity. Plan, organize and control sourcing activities, negotiations and contracts for the acquisition of goods and services. Develop comprehensive agreements for your categories and associated services for business clients on a timely basis. These agreements ensure all acquisitions are made on competitive terms, optimize total cost, maintain high standards of quality, safety and service, and build strong, reliable supplier relationships.
  
  
Categories in scope
  
  
Experience in one or more of the following categories (or comparable ones) is required:
  
  

* Equipment & Materials
* Craft Labor & Contracted Services:
* Chemicals & Chemical Products
* Engineering & Project Procurement
* Professional Services
* Transport & Logistics:
* Information Technology

Key responsibilities
  
  

* Understand market, industry and business drivers to provide fast, innovative and value-added commercial support to internal clients.
* Set the strategic vision for assigned categories, including supplier identification, evaluation, qualification, sourcing and ongoing supplier relationship management (SRM), to meet global requirements.
* Evaluate global suppliers and emerging players in APAC, Europe, Latin America and North America to support strategic sourcing decisions, including low-cost-country sourcing where appropriate.
* Own commercial actions and drive business value through RFx, bids, renewals and amendments with a focus on total cost of ownership (TCO). Negotiate medium- to high-complexity contracts, and draft or review Statements of Work, Master Service Agreements, Global Supply Agreements, rate schedules and other vendor contracts together with internal and vendor legal teams.
* Manage the end-to-end contract lifecycle, including award, mobilization, performance and KPI/SLA tracking, change orders, claims, renewal and close-out.
* Spend management: analyze spend and patterns to find opportunities for consolidation, supplier base rationalization, demand management, specification optimization and alternatives analysis.
* Monitor global markets to anticipate price changes (including index-linked mechanisms), supply disruptions, capacity constraints and technological changes.
* Communicate and collaborate proactively with Projects/Operations, Business Lines, functions (Legal, Finance/Controllers, HSE, Quality, Tax) and other procurement category teams to maximize commercial outcomes.
* Ensure all contracts meet regulatory, trade, labor, HSE, sustainability/ESG and compliance standards in each region, including anti-bribery, sanctions and export control.
* Ensure all documents and exhibits are complete and included in the final contract, and that all functional reviews and management approvals are completed or obtained as required.
* Handle Procure-to-Pay (P2P) activities and contract lifecycle management for assigned projects and categories, working with relevant partners across the organization.
* Bring industry expertise to category strategies that deliver savings, risk mitigation and business transformation.

**Required Qualifications And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in engineering / supply chain, Business or a related experience, with a minimum CGPA of 6.0 or equivalent
* Minimum 02 years of experience in procurement, contracts management or strategic sourcing, preferably in Oil & Gas, Power, Petrochemicals, Chemical Manufacturing, EPC or a similar industry.
* Proven experience managing global contracts and working across regions (APAC, Europe, Americas).
* Technical understanding of the categories managed, such as product specifications and manufacturing processes, labor productivity and rate structures, or chemical properties, handling and regulatory requirements.
* Knowledge of international trade, Incoterms, customs and logistics.
* Analytical skills and knowledge of TCO/TSC principles, cost modelling and should-cost analysis.
* Knowledge of the P2P process and ERP/e-sourcing systems (e.g., SAP, Ariba, Coupa).

Language requirements
  
  

* English: full professional proficiency, written and spoken (mandatory).
* Plus professional working proficiency in at least one of: Mandarin Chinese, Spanish or Portuguese. Ability to negotiate, review commercial documents and correspond with suppliers in that language. Proficiency in more than one is an added advantage.
* Recognized language certification (e.g., HSK, DELE, CELPE-Bras) or equivalent professional experience is preferred.

Skills and attributes
  
  

* Effective negotiation, advocacy and influencing skills
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Ability to work across cultures, time zones and organizations
* General industry and global market knowledge
* Fast learner, results- and customer-oriented
* Willingness to travel 5–10%

title: Insurance Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for an Insurance professional with 5–10 years of experience to lead the procurement and management of
**project insurance**
and
**construction insurance**
programmes for the company’s high-
**capex**
infrastructure projects, including GPU clusters,
**data centres**
, and associated power and cooling assets. The role will work closely with brokers, insurers, lenders, and project teams to secure bankable, cost-effective cover from construction through operations. Internally, the position will be part of the CFO organisation, working closely with senior management to ensure alignment with
**lender compliance**
requirements and
**APAC insurance**
market dynamics. The role also demands deep understanding of
**data center risk**
profiles and the ability to structure coverage that meets complex project finance and operational needs across jurisdictions.
  
  
The role is ideal for someone with strong
**insurance placement**
, contract review, and stakeholder management capabilities who wants exposure to
**project finance**
,
**lender requirements**
, and senior leadership interactions in a fast-growing environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Insurance Procurement & Placement**

* Procure and place project insurance programmes including construction / erection all risks, delay in start-up, marine cargo and transit, operational property damage and business interruption, and third-party liability, ensuring alignment with lender compliance and APAC insurance regulatory frameworks.
* Run broker and insurer selection, including RFPs, market sounding, quote comparison, and negotiation of terms, pricing, and deductibles—leveraging relationships with London/Lloyd’s and Asia insurance hubs for optimal coverage and pricing across APAC jurisdictions.
* Prepare underwriting submissions and risk information, including sums-insured and loss-of-profit assessments, in coordination with project, technical, and finance teams—ensuring robust risk transfer for capex projects.
* Place cover for specialist risks such as equipment breakdown, cyber, technology E&O, and political risk across APAC, incorporating data center risk considerations and lender compliance standards.
* Track renewals, premium payments, endorsements, and claims; maintain the insurance register and ensure full traceability for project finance due diligence and lender compliance reporting.

**Lender & Contract Compliance**

* Align insurance programmes with lender requirements under financing documents, including insurance covenants, loss payee and co-insured arrangements, and cancellation notice provisions—ensuring full lender compliance for capex projects.
* Coordinate with lenders’ insurance advisors and provide certificates, reports, and compliance confirmations during financing and thereafter—supporting timely drawdowns and ongoing covenant adherence.
* Review insurance and indemnity clauses in supply, colocation, customer, and lease contracts, and advise on risk allocation—ensuring alignment with APAC insurance best practices and project insurance standards.
* Coordinate contractor-procured and company-procured policies to avoid gaps and overlaps in cover, particularly for data center risk and high-value technology assets.

**Risk Assessment & Claims**

* Work with technical advisors and project teams to identify and quantify project and operational risks—including data center risk, GPU cluster exposure, and infrastructure resilience—and support risk transfer decisions for capex projects.
* Support risk engineering and loss-control surveys and track implementation of recommendations to mitigate exposure across construction and operational phases.
* Manage claims end to end, including notification, engagement of loss adjusters, documentation, and recovery follow-up—ensuring minimal business interruption for data centres and power infrastructure.

**Reporting & Strategic Support**

* Build insurance cost estimates and budgets for project financial models, investor presentations, and lender discussions—ensuring transparency and realism in capex planning.
* Provide insurance inputs for financing term sheets, information memorandums, and due diligence requests—ensuring comprehensive risk disclosure for APAC insurance and project insurance structures.
* Develop insurance policies, guidelines, and a group-wide programme as the business scales across geographies—ensuring consistency with lender compliance and APAC regulatory expectations.

**Candidate Profile**
**Experience**

* 5–10 years of experience in:
* Project or construction insurance broking—with hands-on involvement in capex projects and data centre risk assessment.
* Corporate insurance or risk management for infrastructure, energy, or real asset companies—particularly in APAC or multinational contexts.
* Property, engineering, or construction underwriting—with exposure to delay in start-up, erection all risks, and business interruption coverage.
* Insurance advisory for project finance transactions (e.g., as a lenders’ insurance advisor)—ensuring lender compliance and robust risk transfer structures.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, Insurance, Risk Management, Engineering, or related field—additional certifications (e.g., CPCU, CRMP, PRM) preferred.

**Technical Skills**

* Hands-on experience procuring insurance for large capex projects across construction and operational phases—especially for data centres, GPU clusters, and power infrastructure.
* Ability to read and negotiate policy wordings, endorsements, and contractual insurance clauses—including APAC insurance market conventions and lender compliance requirements.
* Working knowledge of sums-insured, PML / MFL, loss-of-profit assessment, and data center risk quantification methodologies.
* Proficiency in Excel and PowerPoint—especially for financial modeling, insurance cost analysis, and investor-grade reporting.

**Soft Skills**

* Strong negotiation, communication, and presentation skills—especially when interfacing with lenders, investors, and technical stakeholders.
* High attention to detail and follow-through on policies, renewals, and lender compliance documentation.
* Ability to work in fast-paced and entrepreneurial environments—balancing multiple capex projects across APAC.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously—ensuring seamless coordination between project teams, brokers, and insurers.

**Preferred Experience**

* Experience placing insurance for data centres, digital infrastructure, power, or renewable energy projects—especially with GPU clusters and high-density computing assets.
* Experience with high-value technology and IT equipment cover, including GPU or similar assets—understanding of technology E&O and equipment breakdown exposures.
* Experience with international insurance markets (London / Lloyd’s, Asia hubs) and APAC regulatory regimes—including cross-border policy structuring and lender compliance alignment.
* Exposure to lender insurance requirements and project finance due diligence—including preparation of insurance schedules for term sheets and financing close.

**What The Role Offers**

* Direct exposure to senior leadership, lenders, and investors—playing a pivotal role in project finance and capex strategy.
* Ownership of insurance across high-impact, multi-country infrastructure projects—especially in APAC and for data center risk mitigation.
* Broad exposure across project finance, risk management, and contract negotiation—with a focus on lender compliance and APAC insurance best practices.
* Fast learning curve in a high-growth environment—building expertise in construction insurance, data center risk, and capex project risk transfer strategies.

Regulatory Strategy & Compliance

title: Associate Director, Capital Risk Oversight (Bangalore)
description:
**Job Summary**

* The Capital Risk Oversight team reports into the Treasury CRO, in Enterprise Risk Management. The team’s mandate is to provide assurance to senior management and the Group regulator (Prudential Regulation Authority and Bank of England) on issues that could impact the Group’s regulatory capital position in a BAU environment and across the stress continuum. Areas of responsibility span across a variety of different regulatory submissions and touch on all principal risk types.
* The team provides second line review and challenge on all regulatory stress tests and recovery plans across the SC Group and Solo, HK & SG. The team is a dedicated second line function for the development of Treasury risk related Resolvability capabilities and provides holistic oversight across all Resolvability capabilities.
* The team provides ongoing review and challenge for capital planning purposes to ensure that capital metrics are managed within Risk Appetite and that any distribution plans are credible and affordable under plausible downside stress scenarios.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Stress Testing Oversight and Challenge**

* Support independent 2LOD oversight of regulatory and internal stress tests, including ICAAP, BCST, RPST, RST, climate stress tests, Management Stress Tests and relevant material legal entity exercises.
* Provide SME reviews on Treasury risk results, including the evolution of income and balance sheet amounts, including the determination of key judgements embedded therein.
* Challenge scenarios, methodologies, assumptions, judgments, results and management actions, ensuring outcomes appropriately reflect the scenario, risk profile and legal-entity dynamics.
* Provide independent conclusions on capital resilience, recovery capacity and material vulnerabilities, including the adequacy of remediation against regulatory, audit and 2LOD findings.

**Stress Testing Analytics**

* Provide analytical support to the team in summarising and reviewing the SBAP outputs, model results, overlays, management adjustments and key assumptions.
* Challenge model-use testing, data quality, reconciliations and in-house analytical controls to ensure outputs are complete, reliable and decision-useful.
* Explore automation opportunities in review and challenge of the results and dashboards for management information.

**Consolidation of second line Assurance and Governance**

* Consolidate input from Treasury Risk and other Risk Framework Owners into an integrated 2LOD assurance view.
* Assess compliance with applicable policies, standards, regulatory requirements, controls, attestations and approved dispensations.
* Produce formal assurance reporting for GRC and BRC, clearly escalating material observations, residual risks and unresolved actions.

**Recovery Planning and Management Actions Oversight**

* Support independent review and challenge of Recovery Plan Stress Tests, recovery scenarios and the associated management-action framework.
* Assess the credibility, quantification, timing, dependencies and execution constraints of management actions.
* Provide independent conclusions on total recovery capacity and the Group’s ability to restore capital and liquidity resilience.

**Policy Governance and Risk Frameworks**

* Maintain oversight of Treasury Capital Risk policies and supporting governance frameworks.
* Lead policy effectiveness reviews and challenge policy compliance across Treasury risk activities.
* Review horizon scanning of regulatory developments and assess impacts on capital and resolution frameworks.
* Manage policy dispensations, exceptions and remediation activities.
* Ensure policies remain aligned with regulatory expectations and enterprise risk management framework.

**Management of Process Universe and Control ownership**

* Act as SME for Capital Risk Oversight and stress-testing process architecture within Process Universe and ARIS.
* Define 2LOD processes, responsibilities, handoffs and dependencies, maintaining clear separation from first-line ownership and specialist validation.
* Drive improvements to process controls, operating models, governance, documentation and management information.

**Skills And Experience**
**Must-have Skills**

* Stress Testing and Scenario Analytics
* Risk Analysis and Analytical Support
* Policy Management and Monitoring

**Other Skills**

* Data Analytics
* Report writing
* Governance, Oversight and Control

**Qualifications**

* Prior experience in Stress Testing, Market Risk, Credit Risk, Operational Risk, ICAAP, Regulatory capital requirements etc.
* Good understanding of Financial, Risk and Capital metrics
* Language: Proficiency in verbal & written English

Collaborates
  
  
Customer Focus

title: Company Secretary (Fresher)
description:
**Role Overview:**
To build a strong foundation in corporate secretarial practice while ensuring timely, accurate, and effective execution of statutory and regulatory compliance requirements.

**Job Overview:**
We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Qualified Company Secretary (Fresher)**
to join our Secretarial & Compliance team. The candidate will support corporate governance, statutory compliance, regulatory filings, and secretarial activities across group entities, ensuring compliance with applicable provisions of the Companies Act, 2013, and other relevant laws and regulations.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1.
**Corporate Secretarial Compliance**

• Assist in convening Board Meetings, Committee Meetings, and General Meetings, including preparation of notices, agendas, and minutes.

• Assist in drafting Board Resolutions, Shareholders’ Resolutions, and other corporate documents.

• Maintain statutory registers, minutes books, and other records as prescribed under the Companies Act, 2013.

• Assist in monitoring statutory compliance requirements and maintaining compliance trackers.

• Support preparation of documents relating to private placements, preferential allotments and securities-related corporate actions.

• Assist in maintaining and updating corporate records for group companies and LLPs.

• Coordination with RTA/NSDL/CDSL for corporate actions and ISIN applications.

• Assist in maintaining records relating to shareholders, share capital, and dematerialisation of securities.

2.
**ROC and MCA Filings**

• Assist in preparation and filing of statutory forms with the Ministry of Corporate Affairs (MCA), including AOC-4, MGT-7/MGT-7A, DIR-12, PAS-3, MGT-14, and other applicable forms.

• Support annual filings, event-based filings, and maintenance of corporate records.

• Coordinate with external consultants and practising Company Secretaries for certification and filing requirements.

3.
**Coordination and Reporting**

• Coordinate with internal finance, legal, HR and other teams to obtain information required for statutory compliances.

• Track filing deadlines, documentation requirements, and pending action items.

• Assist in preparing periodic compliance status reports for management.

• Maintain organised digital and physical records of statutory documents.

**Required Skills and Competencies:**

• Qualified Company Secretary and Associate Member of ICSI.

• Basic knowledge of the Companies Act, 2013 and LLP Act and applicable rules.

• Familiarity with MCA portal filings and corporate secretarial documentation.

• Strong attention to detail and ability to manage multiple deadlines.

• Proficiency in MS Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and document management systems.

• Willingness to learn, take ownership of assigned responsibilities, and work collaboratively with cross-functional teams.

**Preferred Attributes:**

• Prior internship or practical training experience in a corporate secretarial department or with a practising Company Secretary.

• Basic understanding of LLP compliances, FEMA, SEBI regulations, and corporate governance practices.

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, growing organisation.

**Collaboration and communication:**
Proactive monitoring and collaboration with team members and internal departments are necessary to guarantee seamless operations at the Centre.

**How the role Interact with other teams or Individuals:**
Ensure effective communication and coordination between different cross functional teams to align the compliance function with overall business goals.

title: Sr Attorney
description:
**Job Description**
The Senior Attorney will work as part of a team of regional legal and compliance subject matter experts and will be expected to translate global compliance expectations into practical, locally relevant guidance. The role includes the following responsibilities:
  
  

* Lead regional anticorruption and fraud risk assessments and use the results to prioritize prevention, detection, and remediation activities.
* Provide timely, practical advice on anticorruption, antibribery, conflicts of interest, gifts and hospitality, charitable donations, sponsorships, travel, third-party engagements, and government interactions.
* Monitor compliance with company anticorruption, integrity, and fraud policies, and support the design and improvement of effective controls.
* Conduct and oversee third-party due diligence, including identifying, escalating, and resolving red flags for agents, distributors, consultants, intermediaries, suppliers, and other high-risk partners.
* Support compliance integration for acquisitions, joint ventures, and other strategic transactions, including post-acquisition reviews and remediation plans.
* Prepare and deliver risk-based integrity and compliance training for employees and relevant external parties.
* Conduct, manage, or support internal investigations involving potential corruption, fraud, conflicts of interest, policy violations, or related misconduct.
* Partner with the Regional Compliance Officer, Legal, Finance, Internal Audit, Human Resources, Procurement, Trade Controls, and business leaders to implement corrective actions and strengthen accountability.
* Evaluate internal and external compliance trends, enforcement developments, audit findings, and hotline data to identify emerging risks and program improvement opportunities.

The role requires strong familiarity with international anticorruption laws and standards, including the U.S. Foreign Corrupt Practices Act, the UK Bribery Act, and related books-and-records and internal-controls expectations. Experience with investigations, third-party risk management, compliance program assessment, and remediation is essential.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**

* Assess legal, regulatory, reputational, and operational compliance risks and recommend practical mitigation steps.
* Advise and influence senior business leaders on anticorruption, fraud, and integrity compliance matters.
* Lead cross-functional compliance initiatives, including training, monitoring, control enhancements, and remediation.
* Develop, improve, and standardize processes that support a risk-based compliance program.
* Serve as a trusted advisor and change leader who promotes ethical decision-making and accountability.
* Manage investigations, external counsel, and related budgets efficiently and effectively.
* Identify emerging risks from enforcement trends, business changes, audits, investigations, and data analytics.

**Qualifications**
**YOU MUST HAVE**

* At least 8 years of experience in anticorruption, antibribery, investigations, fraud, anti-money laundering, sanctions, compliance, ethics, or a related legal/compliance field.
* Fluency in written and spoken English.

**WE VALUE**

* Juris Doctor, equivalent non-U.S. law degree, or comparable legal training strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, sound judgment, and ability to work effectively with diverse teams and cultures.
* Ability to influence stakeholders at all levels, including senior management and cross-functional partners.
* Experience providing practical legal and compliance advice in a multinational company, law firm, or corporate legal department.
* Experience with FCPA, UK Bribery Act, third-party due diligence, investigations, training, internal controls, or compliance program remediation.
* Strong initiative, ownership mindset, and ability to drive priorities independently.
* Excellent analytical, problem-solving, communication, and project management skills.
* Ability to navigate ambiguity, manage competing priorities, and exercise sound judgment in complex situations.
* Credibility, discretion, and executive presence when handling sensitive matters.
* Ability to build strong relationships with business and functional partners while maintaining independence and appropriate challenge.

Same Posting Description for Internal and External Candidates

Honeywell Technologies is a global, pure-play automation company with a legacy of innovating to help solve the world’s most mission-critical challenges, enhancing the quality of life for people and communities around the world. title: Legal/ Corporate Compliance Operations Associate
description:
Who we are
  
  
**About Stripe**
Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.
  
  
**About The Team**
Stripe's global legal operations team is dedicated to delivering an exceptional support experience for legal entities, law firms, and government agencies reporting compliance violations and policy non-adherence. The team plays a vital role in managing and ensuring compliance with various legal requests and requirements that Stripe users must regularly follow.
  
  
What You’ll Do Stripe is launching Stripe Delivery Centers - a global team to design, implement and grow Stripe’s operations for the next decade. We are looking for dynamic and curious people that have a passion for solving global user issues, building operations, driving process improvements and want to play a front-line role in building this new operational capability for Stripe and accelerating Stripe’s growth. If you like challenging, scaled problems and are interested in helping users feel secure and supported while they navigate their complaints - let us know!
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Review and validate reports of violations flagged by various agencies while ensuring compliance to law and regulatory board.
* Support users' concerns and provide exceptional customer service.
* Analyze current processes and initiate changes aimed at scaling operations and enhancing user experience.
* Respond to reports submitted by legal and government entities via email.
* Collaborate closely with other Stripe teams to enhance product offerings and improve messaging around new products and features.
* Gather unique insights into how thousands of businesses using Stripe operate and scale.
* Gain a comprehensive understanding of Stripe's operations from the ground up and contribute to the organization's future impact.
* Play a key role in establishing a new team and fostering an operational culture at Stripe.
* Partner with global operations specialists or business process owners to manage critical workflows effectively.

Who You Are
  
  
We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.
  
  
**Minimum Requirements**

* You have a user first mindset and are energized by the challenge of solving difficult problems
* You have 2 - 4 yrs of experience in customer support and technical support.
* You have excellent communication skills, both written and verbally
* You excel in critical thinking and problem solving
* You might have close to 2 to 6 years of experience in customer service or internal/external user-facing operations
* You enjoy learning about products and processes, you are an organized, self-starter with passion for finding solutions to our user’s challenges
* You are able to identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency
* You have a process-oriented mindset and ability to get things done
* You enjoy working in an in-office environment with strong cross team collaboration and support
* You are able to prioritize and enjoy working in a dynamic space
* You are humble and have a proven track record for working well across teams and with external partners

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Prior experience or knowledge in user support
* Prior experience in troubleshooting
* Prior experience working on projects or process improvement initiatives

In-office expectations
  
  
Office-assigned Stripes in most of our locations are currently expected to spend at least 50% of the time in a given month in their local office or with users. This expectation may vary depending on role, team and location. For example, Stripes in Stripe Delivery Center roles in Mexico City, Mexico, Bengaluru, India, and Dublin, Ireland work 100% from the office. Also, some teams have greater in-office attendance requirements, to appropriately support our users and workflows, which the hiring manager will discuss. This approach helps strike a balance between bringing people together for in-person collaboration and learning from each other, while supporting flexibility when possible.
  
  
Pay and benefits
  
  
Stripe does not yet include pay ranges in job postings in every country. Stripe strongly values pay transparency and is working toward pay transparency globally.
  
  
We look forward to hearing from you.
  
  
At Stripe, we're looking for people with passion, grit, and integrity. You're encouraged to apply even if your experience doesn't precisely match the job description. Your skills and passion will stand out—and set you apart—especially if your career has taken some extraordinary twists and turns. At Stripe, we welcome diverse perspectives and people who think rigorously and aren't afraid to challenge assumptions. Join us.
  
  
Apply now

description:
**Work Schedule**

Standard (Mon-Fri)
