**Job Description**

Skills Development Specialist

*Job description*

Function: Human Resources | Experience: 0–3 years

**Role purpose**

Support the planning, delivery, and evaluation of learning initiatives that build employee capability and address business needs. Work with the Skills Development team, HR business partners, managers, subject-matter experts, and training partners to deliver well-organized programs and a positive learner experience.

The role welcomes MBA graduates entering Skills Development and professionals with relevant Skills Development or HR business partnering experience. Responsibility and independence will be aligned to experience, with opportunities to develop skills in learning needs analysis, content development, facilitation, and measurement.

**Key responsibilities**

**Learning program planning and delivery**

* Coordinate learning calendars, nominations, registrations, invitations, venues, virtual meeting arrangements, materials, attendance, and participant follow-ups.

* Support classroom, virtual, and blended learning programs, including onboarding, professional skills, manager development, and role-specific capability initiatives, as assigned.

* Maintain program plans and action trackers; monitor milestones, flag delivery risks, and follow through on outstanding actions.

**Learning needs and stakeholder coordination**

* Support surveys and discussions with managers, HR business partners, and employees to gather learning requirements and consolidate inputs for prioritization.

* Work with internal subject-matter experts and external trainers to confirm program objectives, participant requirements, session readiness, and delivery arrangements.

* Coordinate vendor documentation, proposals, and payment follow-ups with the relevant internal teams, where required.

**Content and learner engagement**

* Create or curate presentations, learning resources, assessments, feedback forms, and job aids under the guidance of the Skills Development team and subject-matter experts.

* Prepare clear program announcements and learner communications; encourage participation and support prework, post-session activities, and learning application.

* Support session hosting and facilitation, progressively taking on selected segments based on readiness and experience.

**Learning systems and reporting**

* Maintain accurate learning records and update the learning management system or other tracking tools; resolve routine learner queries and escalate technical issues.

* Track participation, completion, feedback, and assessment results. Prepare reports that highlight trends, gaps, and actions for improvement.

* Support follow-ups with learners and managers to understand how learning is applied at work; use findings to recommend practical program and process improvements.

Maintain organized program documentation and handle employee information with confidentiality and care.  



**Qualifications and experience**

**Freshers and early career candidates with 0–1 year of experience**

* MBA with a specialization in Human Resources is mandatory. Prior experience in Skills Development or HR is not required; candidates with unrelated prior work experience may also be considered within this experience range.

* Demonstrated interest in employee development, supported by curiosity, initiative, and willingness to learn the fundamentals of Skills Development.

* Evidence of communication, organization, teamwork, or problem-solving through academic projects, internships, campus responsibilities, volunteering, or other work.

Initial expectation: Execute assigned activities with guidance, maintain reliable records, and progressively take ownership of defined tasks and stakeholder follow-ups.

**Experienced candidates with 2–3 years of experience**

* MBA is mandatory; specialization in Human Resources is preferred.

* Relevant experience in Skills Development or an HR business partnering capacity is required.

* Practical experience coordinating initiatives, working with business or HR stakeholders, maintaining data, and delivering agreed activities within timelines.

* For candidates from Skills Development, exposure to program delivery, learning operations, content support, or evaluation is relevant. For HRBP candidates, exposure to learning needs, employee development plans, performance development, or capability initiatives is desirable.

Initial expectation: Independently manage defined programs or workstreams, anticipate routine delivery issues, and use data and feedback to improve execution, with guidance on design and complex stakeholder requirements.

**Core skills and capabilities**

* Communication: Write clear emails and learning communications, prepare structured presentations, and interact confidently with employees and stakeholders.

* Organization and ownership: Manage concurrent activities, prioritize deadlines, check details, and follow through on commitments.

* Collaboration: Build effective working relationships, respond constructively to feedback, and coordinate across teams.

* Data literacy: Maintain accurate trackers, interpret basic metrics, and translate findings into practical observations and actions.

* Digital proficiency: Working knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint, comfort with virtual collaboration tools, and ability to learn new systems. Experienced candidates should demonstrate practical use in their previous roles.

* Learning agility and judgment: Ask useful questions, understand the purpose behind requests, identify improvements, and escalate issues appropriately.

**Desirable exposure**

Experience with learning management systems, content curation, facilitation, surveys, Excel reporting, or digital learning tools is an advantage. Familiarity with AI tools for drafting, research, or administrative productivity is useful, with appropriate accuracy checks and adherence to company data policies. These are additional strengths, not prerequisites for freshers.

**What success looks like**

Programs run to agreed timelines with clear communications and reliable coordination. Learning records and reports are accurate and timely. Learner queries and stakeholder actions are followed through. Feedback and assessment data inform practical improvements, and ownership grows in line with experience and demonstrated capability.

title: Workforce Planning Analyst
description:
**We are Reckitt**
------------------

Home to the world's best loved and trusted hygiene, health, and nutrition brands. Our purpose defines why we exist: to protect, heal and nurture in the relentless pursuit of a cleaner, healthier world. We are a global team united by this purpose.

Join us in our fight to make access to the highest quality hygiene, wellness, and nourishment a right and not a privilege.

**Human Resources**
-------------------

Our HR Team are the force for good that bring Reckitt's ambition to life. We work together to ensure the delivery of sustained profitable growth by unleashing the power of our purpose, people and performance.

Now is an exciting time to be part of shaping the future of HR, influencing an exciting global organisation, while developing business and functional leadership skills, all at the same time.

Whatever your role in our HR community, you'll take ownership of your projects and workstreams. We focus on developing our leaders to spearhead our culture and growth, so you'll be supported and mentored to deliver the right plans to drive business performance - and we'll celebrate the results with you along the way.

**About the role**
------------------

Step into the vibrant world of Reckitt as a Senior HR Analyst, where your expertise turns data into stories that shape our future. Here, your knack for numbers and insight will directly influence our evolving HR landscape. You'll uncover the patterns that drive strategic changes and bring forth ideas that resonate across global teams. Are you ready to be at the forefront of transformation, delivering insights that matter? Dive into a role that blends analytics with action and be part of our success story.

**Your responsibilities**
-------------------------

* A Workforce Planning Analyst will support strategic and operational workforce decisions through data analysis, forecasting, reporting, and workforce modelling. The role helps ensure the organisation has the right people, skills, and capacity to meet current and future business needs.
* Prior to each Workforce Planning Cycle/ review period, you will carry the necessary checks and audits within the system. Considering continuous improvement as the technology develops.
* Support the implementation and business-as-usual running of the Workforce Planning systems and process, answering any queries as and when required.

• Actively lead the review and generation of all information, e.g. rate cards to commence and review planning.• Understand the interdependencies on the generation of rate cards / people cost.  

* Writing and reviewing validation documentation, e.g. Validation Plans, Validation reports and other necessary SOP documents related to the process and quantification of data.
* Working with Finance, HR and business users to understand the system requirements, technical issues, and support IT developer/vendor in addressing the needs.
* Working with delivery partners to ensure that any functional designs they are delivering are in line with standardised templates.
* Supporting delivery partners and business users with the testing phase to ensure that system meets requirements.
* Analyse workforce data including headcount, attrition, hiring, productivity, utilisation, and capacity.
* Develop workforce forecasts and staffing models based on forecast.
* Create dashboards, reports, and KPI tracking for leadership.
* Identify workforce trends, risks, and gaps.
* Support budgeting and annual workforce planning cycles.
* Improve workforce planning processes and reporting automation.
* Ensure data accuracy across HR systems and planning tools.
* Present insights and recommendations to stakeholders.

Common KPIs Managed  

* Headcount
* Rate Cards
* Attrition rate
* Time to hire
* Workforce utilization
* Capacity vs demand
* Productivity metrics
* Overtime trends
* Hiring forecast accuracy

**The experience we're looking for**
------------------------------------

* Extensive experience working in an Analyst role
* Proven track record of expertise of suite of Finance solutions e.g. SAP (essential), Service Now (preferred), Azure Dev Ops(desirable).
* Experience of working with senior stakeholders to balance business needs with workforce planning standards and processes
* Enthusiastic about the use of technology, with a proven ability to provide a communication ‘bridge’
* Advanced Excel (pivot tables, Xlookup, data cleansing, large dataset handling)
* Strong data analysis & validation skills, including identifying errors, outliers, and data gaps
* Good understanding of workforce / financial data and organisational structures
* Ability to interpret and aggregate data into meaningful outputs (e.g. averages)
* Stakeholder communication / management, providing clear guidance and managing inputs from multiple markets
* Structured approach to end-to-end data processes with strong attention to detail and deadlines
* Experience with SAP Analytics Cloud

Technical Skills  

* Advanced Microsoft Excel
* Data visualization tools:

o Power BI  
o Tableau  

* HRIS and workforce systems knowledge - SAP SuccessFactors
* SQL and basic data analysis skills preferred
* Forecasting and statistical analysis knowledge

Soft Skills  

* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
* Attention to detail
* Communication and presentation skills
* Stakeholder management
* Business acumen
* Ability to work with large datasets

Preferred Certifications (Optional)  

* Workforce Planning certification
* HR analytics certification
* Advanced Excel / BI certifications
* CIPD qualifications

**The skills for success**
--------------------------

Data and Analytics, HR Process Improvement; Process management; HR Process improvement, Storytelling; Data led storytelling, Digital literacy, HR Data Analsyis; Data management; Employee data management, Operational Excellence, Solutioning.

**What we offer**
-----------------

With inclusion at the heart of everything we do, working alongside our four global Employee Resource Groups, we support our people at every step of their career journey, helping them to succeed in their own individual way.

We invest in the wellbeing of our people through parental benefits, an Employee Assistance Program to promote mental health, and life insurance for all employees globally. We have a range of other benefits in line with the local market. Through our global share plans we offer the opportunity to save and share in Reckitt's potential future successes. For eligible roles, we also offer short-term incentives to recognise, appreciate and reward your work for delivering outstanding results. You will be rewarded in line with Reckitt's pay for performance philosophy.

**Equality**
------------

We recognise that in real life, great people don't always 'tick all the boxes'. That's why we hire for potential as well as experience. Even if you don't meet every point on the job description, if this role and our company feels like a good fit for you, we still want to hear from you.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, disability or medical condition; colour, ethnicity, race, citizenship, and national origin; religion, faith; pregnancy, family status and caring responsibilities; sexual orientation; sex, gender identity, gender expression, and transgender identity; protected veteran status; size or any other basis protected by appropriate law.

title: Associate Product Manager
description:
**About the company**

Keka is a modern people platform for growing enterprises. HR, payroll and talent live in one core system, so teams spend less time on admin and more time on their people. More than 12,500 companies trust Keka, from fast-growing small businesses to large enterprises and global companies with teams across borders.

We build software the way HR actually works. It feels human, sets up in days instead of months, and has AI built into every part of HR. With customers across India, the US and the Middle East, our Finance and Planning team is growing fast to keep up. That is where this role comes in.

**About the role**

We're hiring an Associate Product Manager to help own **US Payroll**. You'll work on the features that make sure every US employee and contractor is paid accurately and on time, and that taxes, deductions and benefits are handled correctly. It's a role for someone early in their product career who wants to go deep into a hard, high-stakes domain and grow fast.

**What you'll do**

  

* Own features across the US payroll run: pay schedules, regular and off-cycle payrolls, approvals, payroll funding and data checks that keep payroll on time.
* Work on tax setup, employee and contractor tax documents (W-2, 1099), deductions and garnishments.
* Help improve integrations with benefits providers (such as 401(k) and health insurance) and accounting tools (such as QuickBooks).
* Write clear PRDs, user stories and acceptance criteria, and work closely with Engineering and Design to ship reliable features.
* Talk to US payroll admins and customers. Understand their workflows and pain points and turn them into clear product priorities.
* Work with CX, Implementation and Support to understand escalations, find root causes, and fix recurring themes for good.
* Work with partner teams to understand their APIs and behaviour, and raise and track issues that affect our customers.
* Define success metrics for what you ship, track adoption and correctness, and improve based on data.

**What you'll bring**

  

* 1–2 years of experience in product management, product analysis, business analysis or a similar role in B2B SaaS. Strong freshers with relevant internships are welcome to apply.
* Any exposure to **finance, fintech, payments, accounting, payroll or HR tech** is a strong plus. So is any work with US customers or US-market products.
* A CA, CA-Inter, CPA, CFA or finance degree is a bonus but not required.

*Domain & customer*

* **Curious about money, tax and how payroll works:** you enjoy understanding the rules behind how people get paid, and you want to go deep, not just manage tickets.
* **Learns fast:** you've picked up something complex quickly before, and can explain it simply to others.
* **Customer-led thinking:** you're comfortable talking to users, asking good questions, and finding the real problem behind a request.

*Product craft*

* **Attention to detail:** in payroll, small mistakes matter. You think through edge cases and write clear acceptance criteria.
* **Structured thinking:** you can break a messy problem into clear parts, prioritise, and explain your reasoning.
* **Comfortable with data:** basic SQL, spreadsheets or dashboards. You like checking whether something actually worked after launch.
* **Clear communication:** you write crisply and can keep engineering, design, support and customers on the same page.

*Engineering partnership*

* **Technically curious:** you're comfortable reading API documentation and understanding how data moves between systems, or you're keen to learn quickly.
* **Owns quality:** you test what you ship, and when something breaks, you help find the root cause and push for a lasting fix.
* **A good partner to Engineering:** you work through disagreements with evidence and customer outcomes, and you're open to changing your mind.

*Ways of working*

* **Uses AI tools** to learn faster, research, and work more efficiently.
* **Open to working with US customers and partners,** including some calls in US hours when needed.

title: O+O Engineering lead
description:
Unleash Your Potential at L'Oréal's Beauty Tech!
  
  
Who Are We?
  
  
For 115 years, L’Oréal, the world’s leading beauty player, has devoted itself to one thing only: fulfilling the beauty aspirations of consumers around the world.
  
  
For more than a century, L’Oréal has devoted itself solely to one business: Beauty. Present in 150 countries across five continents and with €42 billion consolidated sales, L'Oréal is the global industry leader. With 37 global beauty brands across four divisions, L’Oréal offers beauty for each covering all beauty categories and catering to all beauty desires. With the acquisition of the Australian brand Aēsop in 2023, the Group continues to expand its portfolio through targeted acquisitions as part of its drive to create the future of beauty.
  
  
Today, L’Oréal includes more than 2,000 tech professionals and is constantly growing. Beauty Tech is changing the game and leading the shift towards new consumer realities and a digital disruption. Championing Beauty Tech, we invent the beauty of the future while becoming the company of the future.
  
  
Beauty Tech is how we know our consumers intimately, augmenting their beauty journeys with unparalleled diverse and sustainable experiences. Beauty Tech equips the Group with the key assets it needs to conquer this new world, where Tech has become strategic. With this ambition, L’Oréal continues to recruit diverse, innovative, skilled and passionate minds in different tech domains such as Data, Digital, Cloud, Cyber Security, IT Architecture, DevOps, Applications and Infrastructure.
  
  
A Day in the Life of O+O Engineering lead!
  
  
We are looking for an experienced and collaborative Engineering Lead to join the L'Oréal Hyderabad Tech Hub. In this strategic role, you will act as the key technical bridge between our global O+O CTO organization in Paris and the delivery teams in Hyderabad, while animating the platform engineering teams across zones in ITH.
  
  
Your core mission will be to contribute to, roll out, and drive the adoption of existing or in-progress O+O standards, platforms, and AISDLC …
  
  
You will collaborate closely with global teams to ensure successful implementation, continuous improvement, and local alignment.
  
  
Beyond driving these rollouts, you will be a hands-on leader responsible for building, recruiting, and mentoring a high-performing team (DevOps, Developers, and Engineers) based in Hyderabad to execute this transformation at scale.
  
  
In this role, You will..
  
  
**Be responsible for the following:**  
As O+O ITH Engineering lead, you will lead the software execution layer of our Beauty Tech and Online & OmniSales ambition for the programs delivered in India Tech Hub. Your role will be to turn project visions into robust, secure, scalable applications & platforms that can be activated globally by our brands, markets, and partners. You will directly contribute to accelerating our insourcing strategy, strengthening our engineering excellence, and building sustainable systems capable of supporting omnichannel, personalized experiences with strong business impact.
  
  
You will lead the implementation of the platform engineering spirit, tooling and patterns into our ITH squads, in alignment with our Global CTO technological strategy.
  
  
**In this position your main mission will be:**  

* Engineering mission and leadership:
* Contribute to the engineering vision in line with the Group’s business and technology strategy, and lead its implementation through a distributed, multicultural organization.
* As well as to the continuous improvement, deployment, and local enforcement of standardized delivery processes, tools, and best practices across all O+O (Online + Offline) programs.
* Platform Engineering:
* Drive the adoption and scaling of the AI SDLC framework within ITH, integrating AI-driven tools and automation across software development phases in alignment with global guidelines.
* Support innovation by leveraging generative AI and machine learning capabilities provided by global platforms to accelerate delivery cycles and improve code quality.
* Deploy Group solutions for End-to-end observability & Smart Ops
* Drive the roll-out, adoption, and local improvements of existing global platforms (such as the IDP - Internal Developer Portal ) for tracking and analyzing Value Creation.
* Architecture and industrialization:
* Contribute to architecture choices and engineering standards to ensure performance, resilience, security, scalability, and maintainability in modern, distributed cloud environments.
* Be the Gatekeeper for architectural decisions & tracking in partnership with the Global CTO team
* End-to-end delivery:
* Oversee the full software development lifecycle, from design to production release, accelerating the transformation of ideas, AI use cases, and product innovations into solutions deployed at scale.
* Monitor key engineering metrics, team velocity, and delivery efficiency using standard tooling, providing transparent insights to leadership in both Hyderabad and Paris.
* Transformation through GenAI: Make GenAI a concrete lever for engineering productivity and quality by scaling development copilots, test automation, documentation assistance, assisted refactoring, and the continuous improvement of delivery practices.
* Operational excellence: Strengthen DevSecOps, SRE, CI/CD, and infrastructure-as-code practices to ensure fast, safe, frequent deployments and a high level of availability for critical services.
* Culture and talent: Build a demanding engineering culture based on clarity, ownership, simplicity, and impact, while attracting, developing, and retaining technical talent as part of an insourcing and team scale-up strategy.
* Cross-functional partnership:
* Act as a strategic partner to Product, Architecture, Data, Design, and application domain teams to turn business needs into clear, well-arbitrated technical decisions that create value for brands and markets.
* Ensure seamless collaboration and alignment between local delivery execution in Hyderabad and global architectural standards defined by the O+O CTO team in Paris.

What are we looking for?
  

* Experience: 10+ years of overall experience in software engineering, with at least 3-5 years in a technical leadership or delivery management role within a matrix organization.
* Tech Skills
* Proficiency in GCP and Azure environments with ability to design & implement cloud native architectures
* Good knowledge of web development technologies & architectures (React, Vue, Node )
* DevSecOps : ability to design end-to-end CICD pipelines : tests, build, security audit (Checkmarx ), code quality audit (SonarQube ), Infra as Code ( Terraform )
* Vector, Hybrid and Graph RAG and their usual databases (Pinecone, Neo4j, TigerDB, GraphDB, PostgreSQL+pgvector). Re-ranking strategies, retrieval pipelines, Hybrid Symbolic & Neural systems
* Tool calling, agent orchestration ( LangGraph / Langchain / Langsmith, MCP / MCP-UI, DSPy, A2A, A2UI)
* Data Engineering (Delta Architectures, Lambda Architectures, Medaillon pattern, BigQuery, Databricks Lakehouse, Dagster / Airflow / Prefect)
* MLOps (VertexAI, MLFlow)
* Leadership style
* Ability to navigate a matrix organization, influence and collaborate with peers (Marketing, Product, Design, Advanced Engineering)
* Calm, clear, and demanding - in the best sense
* Able to simplify without being simplistic
* Respected by senior engineers and product leaders
* Comfortable making and explaining hard trade-offs
* Mindset
* You believe that simple systems are hard to build, but worth it
* You optimize for long-term leverage, not short-term heroics
* You care deeply about craft, but even more about impact
* Collaborative, structured, results-oriented, and adaptable.
* Communication & Stakeholder Management: Excellent English communication skills; capable of navigating a matrix organization with dual reporting lines between local management (India) and global leadership (Paris).

What’s In It for You?
  
  

* Working with cutting edge Technology, empowering employees with new age learning, global exposure, and opportunities to build future-ready careers.
* A flexible and modern workplace, enabling teams to perform at their best through a smart hybrid model that supports balance and autonomy. A 3 Day in Office, 2 Day Work from Home setup.
* Employee support at every life stage, with inclusive and progressive parental policies that help individuals and families thrive.
* Holistic wellbeing offerings - personalized health benefits and strong mental wellness support to ensure employees feel their best.
* Reward and Recognition opportunities, long-term incentives, and opportunities to share in L’Oréal’s collective success.
* L'Oreal is an Equal Opportunity Employer and takes pride in a diverse environment

**Good to know:** The Recruitment Process
  
  

* Interview with HR
* Technical Interview
* Interview with the hiring manager

We would love to find out more about you as a candidate and we do not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion, or other employment practices. The beauty we find in our differences gives us the freedom to go beyond. That’s the beauty of L’Oréal.

title: Director, Product Management
description:
**We're looking for a**

**Director, Product Management**
================================

**This role is** **Office Based, Hyderabad Office**

**Director, Product Management — Learning**

**About Cornerstone:**

Cornerstone powers the future of work by helping organizations develop, engage, and grow their people. Our learning and talent platform serves thousands of organizations and millions of learners worldwide, bringing together learning experiences, skills intelligence, content, and analytics so people can build the capabilities their organizations need most. We are investing heavily in the next generation of learning — including AI-assisted, skills-based, and outcome-driven experiences — and we are looking for product leaders who can turn that ambition into products customers love.

**About the Role:**

Cornerstone is seeking a Director of Product Management to lead a core area of our Learning product line. This is a senior product leadership role that combines product vision and strategy, people leadership, and disciplined execution. You will own the strategy and roadmap for your area, lead and grow a team of product managers, and be accountable for delivering learning experiences that drive measurable adoption, learner and administrator value, and commercial impact.

You will partner across engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, sales, and marketing to move capabilities from customer need through discovery, launch, adoption, and outcome realization. The ideal candidate brings deep enterprise SaaS product experience, a strong track record building products that customers adopt and love, and the judgment to balance long-term platform strategy with the operational rigor required to ship. Experience with AI-native and skills-based capabilities is a strong plus — AI is an increasingly central theme across the Learning portfolio.

**In this role you will...**

**Set vision & strategy**

* Own the product vision and multi-year roadmap for your area of the Learning portfolio, grounded in market trends, customer needs, and Cornerstone's strategy.
* Make and defend prioritization decisions with clear rationale, translating strategy into a sequenced roadmap and well-formed bets.
* Frame the business case for major investments — market sizing, opportunity, and expected outcomes — and align leadership and cross-functional partners behind it.
* Champion AI and skills-based innovation where it creates real learner and administrator value, integrating intelligent capabilities responsibly into the learning experience.

**Lead & grow the team**

* Hire, coach, and develop a team of product managers, setting a high bar for product craft, customer empathy, and accountability.
* Establish product standards and operating cadences for discovery, planning, release, and outcome review across your team.
* Create clarity and alignment across product, engineering, and design leadership, and represent your area to executives and customers.

**Discover, experiment & measure**

* Drive rigorous customer discovery, engaging directly with enterprise customers, learners, and administrators to validate problems and use cases before committing to solutions.
* Run a hypothesis-driven practice — define success metrics, instrument products, and use experimentation and A/B testing to learn quickly and de-risk decisions.
* Define and own the success metrics and North Star for your area (adoption, engagement, retention, time-to-value, and business outcomes), and use them to guide investment.
* Translate customer, field, and market feedback into clear requirements, prioritized backlogs, and release plans.

**Deliver with rigor**

* Drive cross-functional delivery across product, engineering, design, data science, content, customer success, services, and go-to-market teams.

title: Placement Manager
description:
**Corporate Linkages – Placements**

**Location - Mumbai**

**What You Are Signing Up For-**

TNS India Foundation (TNSIF) is a non-profit development organization dedicated to empowering youth through employability and livelihood programs. Through our flagship initiatives, we work closely with educational institutions, industry partners, and communities to bridge the gap between education and employment.

Our programs equip students with industry-relevant skills, career readiness, and access to meaningful employment opportunities across sectors, including IT/ITeS, Manufacturing, Engineering, BFSI, Retail, Logistics, Healthcare, Emerging Technologies, and other high-growth industries.

We are looking for passionate professionals who can build strong corporate partnerships, create employment opportunities, and support students in successfully transitioning from campus to careers.

More information can be found at www.tnsindiafoundation.org

**Role Overview-**

As a Corporate Linkages Professional, you will serve as the bridge between trained students and potential employers. You will be responsible for developing and managing corporate partnerships, identifying employment opportunities, facilitating placement activities, and supporting students throughout their career journey.

The role requires strong relationship-building skills, an understanding of evolving industry hiring trends, and the ability to work closely with students, training teams, educational institutions, and employers to achieve placement outcomes.

Your primary objective will be to maximize student placements and contribute to the overall employability success of the programs.

**Key Responsibilities-**

1. Corporate Engagement & Partnerships

* Identify, map, and connect with HR teams, recruiters, hiring managers, and industry leaders across sectors.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with employers to generate placement opportunities for trained students.
* Understand industry hiring requirements and workforce trends.
* Develop and manage a robust employer network to support ongoing placement activities.
* Represent TNSIF at industry events, networking forums, and employer engagement initiatives.

2. Student Placement & Career Support

* Understand students' career aspirations, skills, and employment preferences.
* Identify suitable job opportunities through corporate partnerships, professional networks, job portals, and recruitment platforms.
* Conduct placement readiness sessions, career counselling, and employability guidance.
* Support students in resume building, interview preparation, and professional communication.

3. Placement Drives & Recruitment Events

* Plan and execute placement drives, recruitment campaigns, job fairs, career fests, and hiring events.
* Coordinate with employers and educational institutions to ensure smooth execution of recruitment activities.
* Facilitate interviews, assessments, group discussions, and selection processes.
* Enable meaningful interactions between students and employers to improve placement outcomes.

4. Data Management & Reporting

* Maintain accurate records of employer engagement, job opportunities, interviews, selections, and placements.
* Update placement dashboards, trackers, and MIS reports regularly.
* Analyse placement performance metrics and identify improvement opportunities.
* Contribute towards achieving placement targets and program KPIs, including student joining and retention rates.

5. Post-Placement Support

* Provide support to students during onboarding and joining processes.
* Conduct regular follow-ups with placed students and employers.
* Track student retention and career progression.
* Address challenges related to onboarding, workplace adaptation, and job continuity.

6. Stakeholder Management

* Collaborate closely with program teams, trainers, colleges, universities, and corporate partners.
* Ensure alignment between student skill development initiatives and market requirements.
* Maintain strong communication with internal and external stakeholders to drive placement
* success.

**Preferred Skills & Experience-**

* 2–7 years of experience in Corporate Relations, Placements, Talent Acquisition, Recruitment, Business Development, Employer Engagement, or Industry Partnerships.
* Experience working with educational institutions, skilling programs, employability initiatives, or **workforce development programs is preferred.**
* Exposure to placements across sectors such as IT/ITeS, Manufacturing, Engineering, BFSI, Retail, Logistics, Healthcare, Emerging Technologies, or allied industries.
* Strong corporate networking and relationship management skills.
* **Proven ability to organize placement drives and recruitment events.**
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* **Strong data management, reporting, and analytical abilities.**
* Ability to work independently in a dynamic and target-driven environment.
* **Proficiency in MS Excel, PowerPoint, and placement tracking systems.**

Interested candidates can share their updated resume on skandalgaonkar@tnsif.org and rkumari@tnsif.org with the subject line: "Corporate Linkages".

Pay: ₹800,000.00 - ₹1,000,000.00 per year

* Flexible schedule
* Paid time off
* Provident Fund

title: Oracle Fusion HCM Application Consultant - Recruitment
description:

**Overview**
------------

### **About us**

We are the independent expert in assurance and risk management. Driven by our purpose, to safeguard life, property, and the environment, we empower our customers and their stakeholders with facts and reliable insights so that critical decisions can be made with confidence.

As a trusted voice for many of the world’s most successful organizations, we use our knowledge to advance safety and performance, set industry benchmarks, and inspire and invent solutions to tackle global transformations.

**About GSS**

  
As the internal support organization for DNV and DNV owned companies, we deliver shared services within Human Resources, Finance, IT and Real Estate & Procurement to DNV globally. Our mission is to enable DNV to grow, succeed with its business goals and improve competitiveness. Customer experience is at the core of everything we do. GSS is responsible for many of the tools, processes and daily routines that create the backbone of DNV.

### **About the role**

The focus of this role will be to support, maintain and continuously enhance DNV’s global HR application landscape and participate in GSS IT projects and initiatives related to HR processes.
  
As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will work closely with the HR community, IT teams and external partners, ensuring alignment between business requirements, application capabilities and the overall DNV system landscape.

DNV utilizes Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud across several HR processes, together with related PaaS services and other integrated HR solutions. For this position, we are particularly looking for strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), combined with broader hands-on experience across Oracle Fusion HCM.

The position combines application management, functional and technical consulting, configuration, integrations, operational support and continuous improvement. You will have the opportunity to contribute both to stable day-to-day operations and to initiatives further developing our global HR technology landscape.
  
Be part of our long-term journey to continuously develop and improve the global HR IT landscape at DNV.

As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will:

* Ensure stable, reliable and well-performing Oracle Fusion HCM applications and services.
* Provide functional and technical application support, including analysis, troubleshooting and resolution of complex application issues.
* Configure, maintain and continuously improve Oracle Fusion HCM functionality based on business requirements.
* Analyze HR business requirements and translate them into appropriate functional and technical solutions.
* Support integrations between Oracle Fusion HCM and other internal and external systems.
* Work with REST APIs, HCM Data Loader (HDL), SQL and other relevant Oracle HCM technologies for integrations, data management, troubleshooting and application maintenance.
* Coordinate with Oracle and other vendors on incidents, product issues, enhancements and technical topics.
* Communicate and collaborate with HR users, stakeholders and other IT teams across the organization.
* Provide consulting to the HR business regarding application capabilities, enhancements and future development of HR processes and IT solutions.
* Execute and manage configuration enhancements and technical changes based on new or evolving business requirements.
* Contribute to Oracle Fusion HCM release management, including impact assessment, regression testing and review of relevant release documentation.
* Participate in HR technology projects, implementations and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ensure alignment of solutions and services within the broader GSS IT application environment and DNV system landscape.
* Maintain appropriate functional and technical documentation and contribute to knowledge sharing within the HR Applications team.

**Why this role matters**

Our HR application landscape supports critical HR processes globally. As an Oracle Fusion HCM Consultant, you will contribute directly to the stability, development and continuous improvement of these solutions.

You will work at the intersection of HR processes, Oracle Fusion HCM and technology, helping translate business needs into sustainable solutions while supporting the continued evolution of DNV’s global HR technology landscape.

### **What we offer**

* Flexible work arrangements for better work-life balance
* Generous Paid Leaves (Annual, Sick, Compassionate, Local Public, Marriage, Maternity, Paternity, Medical leave)
* Medical benefits ( Insurance and Annual Health Check-up)
* Pension and Insurance Policies (Group Term Life Insurance, Group Personal Accident Insurance, Travel Insurance)
* Training and Development Assistance (Training Sponsorship, On-The-Job Training, Training Programme)
* Additional Benefits (Long Service Awards, Mobile Phone Reimbursement)
* Company bonus/Profit share.

\*Benefits may vary based on position, tenure/contract/grade level\*

DNV is an Equal Opportunity Employer and gives consideration for employment to qualified applicants without regard to gender, religion, race, national or ethnic origin, cultural background, social group, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, age or political opinion. Diversity is fundamental to our culture and we invite you to be part of this diversity.

### **About you**

**Must have:**

* Strong hands-on experience with Oracle Fusion HCM Cloud, including application configuration, support, maintenance and continuous improvement.
* Strong experience with Oracle Recruiting Cloud (ORC), including configuration and integrations with other systems.
* Hands-on experience with additional Oracle Fusion HCM areas such as Core HR, Compensation,
* Benefits, Security, Talent or other HCM modules.
* Hands-on experience with HCM Data Loader (HDL).
* Experience working with REST APIs and system integrations.
* Experience with SQL for analysis and troubleshooting.
* Good understanding of end-to-end HR business processes and their implementation within HR technology solutions.
* Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into effective functional and technical solutions.
* Experience with standard IT application support processes, including incident, request and change handling.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to independently take ownership of topics and drive them through to completion.
* Ability to manage and prioritize multiple activities and deliver against agreed timelines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Ability to collaborate effectively across cultures, functions and organizational boundaries.
* Willingness to continuously learn and keep up with changes within the Oracle Fusion HCM platform.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Oracle HCM reporting, extracts and related integration technologies.
* Experience with Oracle PaaS services and extensions.
* Experience participating in Oracle Fusion HCM implementations, rollouts or major enhancement initiatives.
* Experience working within a global HR technology or enterprise application environment.
    
  Personal qualities

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Is self-driven, proactive and well organized.
* Demonstrates a strong sense of ownership and accountability.
* Has a hands-on and pragmatic approach to problem solving.
* Is comfortable working independently while contributing actively to a global team.
* Is customer and business oriented and able to understand HR needs beyond purely technical requirements.
* Can communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Is collaborative and able to build strong working relationships across organizational and cultural boundaries.
* Is curious and motivated to continuously learn and develop.
* Can balance operational responsibilities, continuous improvement activities and project deliveries.

**Reasonable international travel must be expected.**

*Security and compliance with statutory requirements in the countries in which we operate is essential for DNV. Background checks will be conducted on all final candidates as part of the offer process, in accordance with applicable country-specific laws and practices.*

**Benefits**
------------

Please note that some benefits may vary depending on location, business area, and employment terms. Please confirm with your recruiter.

### **Profit Share**

You’ll be part of our global profit share scheme that means we all share in our success as a business. If we profit, so do you. This will be part of our Total Compensation approach each year and depends on our year-end results.

### **Professional Development**

We believe in the 70/20/10 learning model, where 70% of your learning comes from performing your everyday tasks and working on different projects, new areas and initiatives to gain new skills. 20% from working with others and mentoring and the rest from formal education.

### **Hybrid Work Model**

We work in a hybrid model (three days from the office) and have flexible starting hours. This means you can fit your work and life together in a way that works for you.

### **Global Opportunities**

We support you in exploring different career opportunities or shifting between teams, business areas, or geographies, so that you can shape your career according to what you find motivating.

### **Modern Office in Pune**

Our office in Pune has a modern look and feel and you’ll find zones for both focused work and team integration. Sit/stand desks, high-quality adjustable chairs and balance balls are just a few examples of what ergonomic office means at DNV.

### **Integration Events**

Depending on where you are located, you’ll have the opportunity to participate in offsite meetings as well as different initiatives and fun events at the office. We believe that a well-integrated team is a well-functioning team.

**Diversity, Equity and Inclusion**
-----------------------------------

At DNV, our commitment to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is not only an ethical choice, but also a business decision.

Diversity, fairness, and a sense of belonging are a source of strength for our people, our business, and our customers, and help us to deliver on our purpose, vision, and values.

Since 1864 we’ve been dedicated to safeguarding life, property and the environment. Today we remain at the forefront of new technologies and techniques to help our customers transform for a more sustainable future.

At DNV you can expect to deliver career and industry defining work. You’ll be given the time to build your network, the resources to support your development, and the freedom to satisfy your curiosity and desire to learn.

title: HR & BTL Corporate Tie-ups Executive
description:
**Job Title:** HR & BTL Corporate Tie-ups Executive  
**Department:** Human Resources & Business Development  
**Location:** Corporate Office, New Delhi  
**Job Type:** Full-Time

Job Objective

To manage day-to-day HR activities, including recruitment, employee coordination, attendance, and HR documentation, while simultaneously developing and executing BTL marketing initiatives and corporate tie-ups to increase brand visibility, generate leads, and drive business for Pachouli Wellness Clinic.

The role will be divided equally between **50% HR responsibilities and 50% BTL Corporate Tie-ups**.

1. Key Responsibilities – Human Resources (50%)

* **Recruitment & Talent Acquisition:** Coordinate with hiring managers and clinic heads to understand manpower requirements, source candidates, schedule interviews, follow up with candidates, and support timely closures.
* **Joining & Onboarding:** Manage joining formalities, document collection, employee records, induction, and coordination with respective departments.
* **Attendance & Leave Management:** Monitor employee attendance, biometric punch records, leave applications, shift compliance, and attendance reports.
* **Employee Coordination:** Handle employee queries, coordinate with clinic managers and regional heads, and support employee engagement and retention initiatives.
* **HR Documentation:** Maintain employee files, appointment letters, offer letters, salary revision letters, KRA records, and other HR documentation.
* **Payroll Coordination:** Coordinate with the payroll/accounts team regarding attendance inputs, salary discrepancies, salary slips, and full and final settlement documentation.
* **Compliance & Policy Implementation:** Follow up on mandatory employee documentation, including Police Clearance Certificates (PCC), and ensure timely completion of HR formalities.
* **MIS & Reporting:** Prepare daily and monthly reports on recruitment status, manpower requirements, employee attendance, joining updates, and pending HR activities.

2. Key Responsibilities – BTL Corporate Tie-ups (50%)

* **Corporate Tie-up Development:** Identify and approach corporates, offices, residential societies, gyms, salons, hotels, educational institutions, and other potential business partners for wellness and aesthetic service tie-ups.
* **Business Development:** Build and maintain relationships with HR managers, Admin Heads, facility managers, corporate decision-makers, and other relevant stakeholders.
* **Corporate Wellness Programs:** Plan and coordinate wellness camps, skin and hair consultation camps, wellness awareness sessions, and employee benefit programs.
* **Lead Generation:** Generate qualified leads through corporate visits, promotional activities, networking, and local-area business development.
* **BTL Marketing Activities:** Plan and execute offline promotional campaigns, society activations, corporate stalls, health camps, referral programs, and local outreach activities.
* **Partnership Proposals:** Prepare corporate tie-up proposals, service packages, promotional offers, and employee discount programs in coordination with management.
* **Execution & Coordination:** Coordinate with clinic teams to schedule consultations, manage campaign logistics, ensure service readiness, and follow up on leads generated through activities.
* **Revenue & Conversion Tracking:** Monitor leads, appointments, consultations, conversions, and revenue generated from corporate tie-ups and BTL activities.
* **Market Research:** Identify potential business opportunities, competitor activities, and new locations for corporate partnerships.
* **Reporting & Follow-up:** Maintain a database of corporate contacts, visits, proposals, meetings, tie-up status, and campaign performance. Submit regular progress reports to management.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)HR KPIs – 50%

* Timely closure of assigned vacancies as per approved recruitment timelines.
* Completion of joining formalities and employee documentation.
* Accuracy and timely submission of attendance and payroll inputs.
* Timely resolution and escalation of employee queries.
* Regular maintenance of HR MIS, employee records, and compliance trackers.

BTL Corporate Tie-ups KPIs – 50%

* Number of corporate prospects identified and contacted.
* Number of corporate meetings and field visits completed.
* Number of corporate tie-ups successfully established.
* Number of BTL campaigns, wellness camps, and promotional activities executed.
* Number of qualified leads and consultations generated.
* Lead-to-appointment and appointment-to-conversion ratios.
* Revenue generated through corporate tie-ups and BTL campaigns, against targets approved by management.

Required Skills & Qualifications

* Graduate in HR, Business Administration, Marketing, or a related field.
* Prior experience in HR operations, recruitment, field marketing, or business development is preferred.
* Strong communication, negotiation, coordination, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to manage HR responsibilities alongside field-based corporate marketing activities.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, MS Office, email communication, and reporting.
* Willingness to travel for corporate meetings, promotional activities, and BTL campaigns.
* Target-oriented approach with strong follow-up and relationship-building skills.

Reporting Structure

The candidate will report to the designated HR/Management Head for HR deliverables and the designated Business Development/Marketing Head for corporate tie-ups and BTL activities.

Important Expectations

* Maintain a clear **50:50 division of time and responsibilities** between HR and BTL corporate tie-ups.
* Submit regular reports covering both HR deliverables and business development activities.
* Ensure professional conduct, confidentiality of employee information, and appropriate representation of the company.
* Achieve mutually agreed HR and business development targets within the defined timelines.

**Note:** Specific monthly recruitment, corporate meeting, tie-up, lead generation, and revenue targets will be finalized by management based on business requirements.

Pay: ₹24,000.00 - ₹28,000.00 per month

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: In person

**Location:**

**The Roles:**

SiteRecon is hiring an Operations Manager to run our property-mapping production: 120+ cartographers and 6–8 Team Leads and Senior TLs, delivering to customers across the US and Canada.

You will sit between the business (Customer Success, Sales and the CEO) and a large delivery floor. You'll understand each project's requirements, align with Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on upcoming volume and priorities, convert it into manpower and shift plans, and make sure every project ships on time and at quality.

This role is a strong fit if you have led production at a GIS, mapping, geospatial or AI data-annotation company, and you are used to owning both the client-facing plan and the floor that delivers it.

**About SiteRecon**

SiteRecon helps property-maintenance contractors in North America map properties and plan site visits in minutes, so they win more bids and run more profitable jobs. We were founded by IIT Delhi alumni with backgrounds in satellite imaging, e-commerce and edtech. Learn more: https://order.siterecon.ai/about-us

**What you'll do:**

* Align with Customer Success, Sales and the CEO on project requirements, customer priorities, new deals in the pipeline and delivery timelines, and own the delivery plan for each.
* Forecast mapping volume for the next month and quarter using inputs from CSMs, the Sales pipeline and the CEO's growth plans, and turn it into a manpower plan: hiring batches, training ramp-up, shift allocation and overtime.
* Lead 6–8 Team Leads and Senior TLs, set their targets, and review their performance every week.
* Own delivery SLAs, turnaround time, productivity and mapping quality across shifts. When an SLA slips, find the root cause and fix it.
* Build and run daily, weekly and monthly reports on productivity, TAT, quality, rework, backlog and capacity, and use them to give feedback to TLs and the floor.
* Work with QA to cut rework and raise first-time-right output.
* Raise workflow bottlenecks with Product and Engineering, and help roll out tool and process changes on the floor.
* Develop strong TLs into a second line of leadership as the team grows.

**You must have:**

* 8+ years in operations, with at least 3 years managing 100+ people through Team Leads or Assistant Managers.
* Experience in project-based production work such as GIS or mapping, data annotation, image or document processing, or engineering KPO. Voice or call-centre-only backgrounds are not a fit for this role.
* A track record of converting client or account-team forecasts into headcount and capacity plans.
* Regular direct work with clients or account managers on requirements, timelines and escalations.
* Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills. You build your own MIS and dashboards, not just read them.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience with US or Canadian clients across time zones.
* Experience at a startup, SaaS or product company, or scaling an operation from an early stage.
* Hands-on familiarity with GIS tools or aerial imagery.

**What we Offer:**

* Full ownership of a core business function, working directly with the founders.
* A fast-growing AI-driven company where you will shape how operations scale.
  ﻿

**Location & Schedule:**

Noida, on-site, 6 days a week. The floor runs on tight daily SLAs for North American customers, so this role leads from the floor.

title: Accounts Payable Manager
description:
**Global Shared Services | Procure-to-Pay (P2P)**

**The Role**

The Accounts Payable Manager is responsible for leading the global Accounts Payable (AP) function supporting U.S. and European entities while serving as a key leader within the Global Shared Services organization. This role provides oversight of end-to-end AP operations, including invoice processing, payment execution, month-end close activities, supplier management, compliance, and audit readiness.

The successful candidate will lead and develop a high-performing AP team, including the AP Supervisor and AP Specialists, while driving operational excellence, service quality, and continuous process improvement across the Procure-to-Pay (P2P) lifecycle.

This role combines strategic leadership with hands-on operational support and serves as a trusted business partner to Procurement, Treasury, Corporate Accounting, FP&A, Internal Audit, and other stakeholders. The AP Manager will champion standardization, automation, digital transformation, and AI-enabled solutions to improve efficiency, strengthen controls, enhance the employee and supplier experience, and support the organization's broader finance transformation objectives.

The ideal candidate is a strong people leader, coach, and change agent who can balance operational execution with long-term organizational development, continuous improvement, and innovation.

**Essential Functions**

**Global AP Operations & Payments**

· Lead end-to-end Accounts Payable operations for U.S. and European entities, ensuring accurate and timely processing of PO and non-PO invoices, payments, and related activities.

· Oversee AP service delivery, ensuring compliance with established service levels, policies, and internal controls.

· Monitor invoice volumes, aging, exception queues, processing cycle times, and operational KPIs to drive efficiency and performance.

· Review and resolve complex invoice, supplier, tax, banking, and payment issues escalated by the AP team.

· Ensure compliance with company policies, purchasing requirements, accounting standards, internal controls, and global P2P procedures.

· Oversee payment processing activities, including ACH, wire transfers, SEPA, checks, virtual cards, and other regional payment methods, while maintaining appropriate approval workflows and segregation of duties.

· Partner with Treasury to optimize payment strategies, manage risk, and support cash flow objectives.

· Drive operational consistency and standardization across legal entities and regions.

**Vendor Management & Business Partnership**

· Serve as the primary escalation point for strategic supplier relationships and complex vendor disputes.

· Partner closely with Procurement to support purchasing compliance, supplier onboarding, and vendor master governance.

· Collaborate with business leaders, Controllers, FP&A, Treasury, and operational stakeholders to improve end-to-end P2P effectiveness.

· Ensure supplier inquiries are resolved professionally and within established service-level expectations.

· Drive improvements in supplier experience, communication, and self-service capabilities.

· Build strong partnerships with internal stakeholders while promoting policy compliance and process discipline.

**Month-End Close & Financial Reporting**

· Lead month-end AP close activities across multiple legal entities, ensuring timely and accurate completion of AP-related accounting activities.

· Review and approve AP accruals, un-invoiced liabilities, cutoff adjustments, and GR/IR account balances.

· Oversee AP account reconciliations, aging reviews, and resolution of outstanding items and exceptions.

· Partner with Corporate Accounting and Controllers to support accurate financial reporting and close execution.

· Ensure AP transactions are recorded accurately and in accordance with accounting policies and regulatory requirements.

· Support quarter-end and year-end financial reporting activities.

**Compliance, Controls & Audit**

· Ensure compliance with SOX requirements, internal controls, company policies, and regulatory obligations.

· Oversee vendor master controls, supplier banking validations, tax documentation, and payment security processes.

· Monitor compliance with 1099, VAT, e-Invoicing, and other applicable regulatory requirements.

· Identify, assess, and mitigate operational and compliance risks across AP processes.

· Support internal, external, and SOX audits, including audit testing, documentation, and remediation activities.

· Maintain a strong control environment while driving process efficiency and standardization.

**Process Improvement, Transformation & Innovation**

· Lead continuous improvement initiatives across the AP organization with a focus on simplification, standardization, automation, and scalability.

· Champion a culture of operational excellence, encouraging employees to identify opportunities to improve service, efficiency, controls, and stakeholder experience.

· Drive finance transformation initiatives and support the evolution of Global Shared Services operating models.

description:

**About cdmon**

Iridium Cloud Systems Private Limited (cdmon India) is part of cdmon Barcelona, a leading European provider of hosting, cloud infrastructure, domain registration, VPS, and digital services. We are expanding our global infrastructure capabilities and are looking for an experienced technology leader to drive the next phase of operational excellence, private cloud transformation, automation, reliability, and international growth.

**Position Overview**

The Director of IT Operations will be responsible for leading the organization's global IT Operations function, ensuring the reliability, security, scalability, and cost-efficiency of our hosting and cloud infrastructure platforms.

This role requires a unique blend of deep technical expertise, operational leadership, financial management, and strategic thinking. The successful candidate will lead the evolution of our infrastructure from traditional systems administration toward highly automated, cloud-native, Site Reliability Engineering (SRE) driven operations.

The ideal candidate has significant experience managing Linux-based infrastructure, Private Cloud environments built on OpenStack and Proxmox, large-scale hosting platforms, cybersecurity, data center operations, and globally distributed operations teams.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Strategic Leadership & Governance**

* Define and execute the IT Operations strategy aligned with company objectives and international growth plans.

* Drive infrastructure modernization initiatives focused on scalability, resilience, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Establish long-term technology roadmaps for hosting, cloud, virtualization, networking, storage, and security platforms.
* Lead strategic vendor relationships with hardware suppliers, connectivity providers, data centers, cloud technology partners, and open-source communities.
* Manage departmental CAPEX and OPEX budgets while ensuring optimal ROI on infrastructure investments.

* Proxmox VE

* Ceph Storage

* Service Operations

* Change Management
* Establish operational maturity models across:
* Monitoring

* Redundancy
* Disaster Recovery
* Security
* Software Lifecycle Management
* Lead root cause analysis for major incidents.
* Drive continuous service improvement programs.
* Implement best practices aligned with ITIL, SRE, and modern operations frameworks.

**SRE & Automation Transformation**

* Lead the transition from traditional SysAdmin operations to Site Reliability Engineering (SRE).
* Drive automation of repetitive operational tasks.
* Reduce operational toil through tooling, scripting, orchestration, and self-healing infrastructure.
* Promote Infrastructure as Code (IaC) practices using modern automation frameworks.
* Establish reliability engineering principles and Service Level Objectives (SLOs).

* Ensure security of infrastructure, systems, applications, and customer environments.

* Threat Mitigation

title: Construction Manager
description:
Hi,

Greetings from Peoplefy Infosolutions !!!

We are hiring for one of our reputed client based in
**Noida/ Pune/ Navi Mumbai**
.

We are looking for candidates with 14+ years of experience.

**Education: B.E./ B. Tech (Electrical/Mechanical)**

**Job Description:**

The Construction Manager will take the ownership of leading the project from inception till handover. He / She would lead a team of resources from varied technical backgrounds and also a team of other project stakeholders that would include architects, vendors, and contractors and manage the project throughout the complete lifecycle through seamless delivery of an end to end Project Management scope.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Project Charter**

* Understand the project requirements from the client and develop a detailed Project Charter that would include a broad strategy for delivering the Project Management Scope, identification of key stakeholders who would be required from the project inception till closure, define the procurement plan that is merged with the baseline schedule and spell out critical milestones that would be the guiding factor for successful project completion
* Align all the key stakeholders with the Charter and prepare a draft Project Execution Plan
* Collaborate with clients team and prepare a project matrix clearly defining the process for flow of information and internal approval process

**2. Project Planning**

* Provide inputs with regards to sequencing of activities in the master schedule to include design reviews, drawing delivery schedule, procurement, equipment delivery and installation, construction sequencing and testing & commissioning plans
* Guide the project Planning Manager / Engineer in finalizing the Master Schedule in the inception stage (after acceptance of Project Charter) and then finalizing the detailed project schedule in the final design concept stage (before commencement of Procurement activities)

**3. High level budgeting and costing**

* Develop high level budget based on available details and with support from planning, civil and MEP teams during the inception stage and update the costing during different stages of the project ie from concept stage to vendor / supplier finalization.
* Establish unit rates for materials and labor based on current market data and historical benchmarks
* Regularly update cost database to reflect trends and regional price fluctuations

**4. Tendering & Bid Support**

* Lead the tendering process by developing contractor / subcontractor scopes, bid assumptions, relevant tender clauses and risk allowances
* Analyze tender documents, drawings, and specifications to determine labor, material, and equipment requirements
* Suggest clients on tender clarifications, tender event schedule and evaluate technical submissions by vendors / suppliers in line with clients requirements
* Carry out vendor / supplier evaluation (with support from project teams) with respect to technical details and project delivery
* Take ownership of the Tender Event Schedule right up to the award of contract

**5**
.
**Value Engineering & Cost Optimization**

* Plan for Value Engineering workshop during the concept design and then before design finalization stage of the project
* Identify opportunities to reduce cost by suggesting alternate materials, or design modifications.
* Guide the planning and design management teams to update on schedule, delivery status and change management

**6. Coordination & Collaboration**

* Coordinate with team members during all the stages of the project to ensure plans are updated as per project status
* Proactively involve in the Risk Management scope and suggest mitigation measures as and when a risk is identified so as to keep the project timelines and cost intact
* Collaborate with the clients team through regular exchange of information, periodic updates and meetings, keeping them informed about the progress at different stages of the project and raising red flags as and when attention is required that needs early resolution
* Coordinate with design teams to ensure design / drawing delivery is as per agreed schedule and support the team in case their delivery is getting affected due to inputs and approvals from required stakeholders
* Collaborate with construction contractor right from their onboarding stage and through the construction process for a seamless execution as per plan, desired quality standards and within assigned project budget
* Conduct regular reviews with key stakeholders to ensure risks are identified proactively and mitigated, project delivery plans are intact and identification of bottlenecks and early resolution
* Conduct site visits, resolve RFIs, and ensure design intent during construction
* Provide support to the respective teams in Factory Acceptance Tests (FAT) and Site Acceptance Tests (SAT) if these activities are part of our scope

**7. Change Management**

* Prepare a detailed change management process that is defined at the beginning of the project, approved by client and accepted by all stakeholders
* Ensure the updates on change management are included as part of periodic report to the client
* Review the changes that arise during different project stages with regards to the impact on cost, quality and timelines and ensure if the impact can be minimized through any value engineering initiative before it is submitted for approval to the client

title: Senior Manager, AR Finance
description:
**Job Summary:**

The Senior Manager, AR Finance Americas provides Tenneco ownership of Accounts Receivable governance, controls, compliance, and performance across Powertrain (PT) and Clean Air (CA) in the Americas. The role combines PT North America operational oversight, CA control responsibilities, and hands-on governance of 3POs delivery and improvement projects. • Act as Tenneco’s primary point of contact for Accounts Receivable across the Americas.

• Lead AR process governance for CA and PT and ensure alignment with Tenneco Global Process Standards.

• Monitor past-due receivables and drive recovery actions to maintain performance within targets established by Tenneco leadership.

• Review and approve AR account reconciliations for CA and PT, including PT North America, and ensure timely resolution of reconciling items and risks.

• Lead projects assigned by Tenneco leadership, ensuring clear ownership, stakeholder alignment, timely execution, and measurable outcomes.

At least 7 years of experience in Accounts Receivable, finance operations, shared services, service-provider management, or related financial processes.

* Strong communication, stakeholder management, problem-solving, decision-making, change leadership, organization, and ability to work effectively across cultures and priorities.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**PURPOSE**

The Revenue Manager is responsible for driving total hotel revenue and profitability through strategic pricing, inventory management, demand forecasting, and market intelligence. The role focuses on maximising revenue across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage outlets, Banqueting and Events, and other ancillary revenue streams while preserving unit's luxury positioning and guest experience standards.

The incumbent will lead the hotel’s revenue management strategy by analysing market demand, competitor performance, booking trends, and distribution channels to optimise occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR). Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations, the Revenue Manager will support data-driven commercial decisions that enhance market share, profitability, and long-term business growth.

**KEY ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports To:**
Director of Sales & Marketing

**Direct Reports:**
Revenue Executive(s), Reservations Associate

**Interacts With:**

**External**

* Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)
* Corporate Travel Partners
* Revenue Management Consultants
* Market Benchmarking and Distribution Partners (STR, RateGain, etc.)

**Internal**

* General Manager
* Director of Sales & Marketing
* Reservations Team
* Front Office
* Finance
* Food & Beverage
* Banquets & Events
* Marketing
* IT
* Hotel Operations Teams

**Revenue Strategy & Optimisation**

* Develop and execute revenue management strategies to maximise ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and profitability.
* Monitor booking pace, pickup trends, market demand and competitor pricing to implement dynamic pricing strategies.
* Manage room inventory, room category availability, restrictions, controls, and overbooking strategies where appropriate.
* Optimise revenue opportunities across transient, corporate, wholesale, group and MICE segments.
* Collaborate with Sales and Events teams to evaluate group business opportunities and displacement analyses.
* Oversee banquet and event space inventory utilisation to maximise revenue contribution from Meetings, Conferences, Weddings and Social Events.
* Ensure optimal rate positioning across all direct and indirect distribution channels.

**Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and annual revenue forecasts for Rooms and total hotel revenue.
* Produce rolling forecasts by segment, channel to support strategic planning and budgeting.
* Monitor and analyse key performance indicators including ADR, RevPAR, Market Penetration Index (MPI), Revenue Generation Index (RGI) and occupancy performance.
* Provide actionable revenue insights through market trend analysis and business intelligence reporting.
* Support annual budgeting, strategic planning and long-range forecasting processes.
* Utilise STR, RateGain and internal reporting tools to identify opportunities and market risks.

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Maintain rate parity and inventory accuracy across all distribution channels.
* Monitor OTA performance, direct booking trends, channel costs and contribution margins.
* Manage rate loading, promotions, packages and strategic offers through PMS, CRS and channel management platforms.
* Evaluate distribution partnerships and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.

**Commercial Collaboration**

* Lead weekly Revenue Strategy Meetings to review pace, forecast accuracy, market demand and business mix.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to align promotional activities with demand forecasts.
* Support commercial decision-making through pricing recommendations and revenue impact assessments.
* Work closely with Operations to ensure revenue strategies are aligned with guest expectations and service standards.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Drive a revenue-focused culture throughout the hotel by promoting commercial awareness across departments.
* Coach and mentor revenue and reservations team members.
* Facilitate training on revenue management principles, forecasting methodologies, Best Available Rate (BAR) strategies, and distribution management.
* Establish performance objectives and development plans for team members.

**Work Experience**

* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Management within luxury hotels.
* Prior experience with luxury city hotels, luxury lifestyle hotels, or leading hospitality brands preferred.
* Proven track record in driving ADR, RevPAR and total revenue growth.
