title: Senior Solutions Engineer
description:
**Company Description**

PhonePe Limited (Formerly PhonePe Private Limited) is a technology company that builds digital platforms for Payments, Digital Distribution Services and Financial Services. Headquartered in India, the PhonePe digital payments app was launched in 2016. As of April 2026, PhonePe has over 70 Crore life-till-date registered users and a digital payments acceptance network spread across over 5 Crore merchants. PhonePe’s products and services include Consumer Payments (including Digital Distribution Services), Merchant Payments, Lending and Insurance Distribution services, and New Platforms, which comprise Share.Market (stock broking and mutual funds distribution platform), and Indus Appstore (Android-based mobile app marketplace). Culture:

At PhonePe, we go the extra mile to make sure you can bring your best self to work, Everyday!. And that starts with creating the right environment for you. We empower people and trust them to do the right thing. Here, you own your work from start to finish, right from day one. PhonePe-rs solve complex problems and execute quickly; often building frameworks from scratch. If you’re excited by the idea of building platforms that touch millions, ideating with some of the best minds in the country and executing on your dreams with purpose and speed, join us!

 **Job Description**

About The Role:

As a Senior Solutions Engineer, you will act as the crucial link between technical development teams and business stakeholders, ensuring the successful delivery of customized financial technology solutions. You will play a key role in supporting developers integrating with PhonePe products, ensuring their success. This role demands a combination of technical expertise, strategic business understanding, and problem-solving abilities to deliver solutions that meet client requirements, adhere to regulatory standards, and align with the organization’s objectives.

At PhonePe, we view the developer experience as a cornerstone of the overall merchant experience. When we excel in our role, merchants can seamlessly launch and expand their businesses on PhonePe, whether they are integrating payments for the first time or developing sophisticated payment systems.

Developers love PhonePe for the simplicity of our APIs, the clarity of our documentation, and our commitment to delivering an exceptional developer experience. The Solutions Engineering team plays a pivotal role in supporting developers and advocating for developer experience as a key element of the overall merchant experience.

Responsibilities:

* Understand client requirements and design customized solutions leveraging PhonePe products and services.
* Conduct feasibility studies and recommend appropriate products, solutions, and frameworks.
* Develop a deep understanding of the product suite.
* Manage merchant accounts during the integration phase
* Take ownership of reported customer issues and ensure resolution.
* Participate in meetings/con calls with merchants' tech/business teams.
* Define and deliver a comprehensive developer experience for developers integrating PhonePe
* Develop relationships across the entire organization at PhonePe to influence others in aiming for the best developer experience possible
* Define, implement, and monitor key metrics that ensure the future sustainability and quality of the developer experiences
* Define, document, and implement processes for integration to ensure compliance and standardization across stakeholders
* Improve API integrations by studying current market practices
* Responsible for on-time delivery and overall quality of deliverables
* Working closely with product managers on common goals to achieve best in the class developer and merchant experience for our merchants.

 **Qualifications**

* 5+ years of Techno functional experience with cross functional collaboration with tech and non-tech teams
* Background in software development in one or more programming languages, preferably PHP/Java/. Net
* Proficient in Rest APIs using JSON or SOAP UI/Postman tools.
* Capable of researching, diagnosing, and resolving merchant integration issues.
* Experience in the payments module is a plus.
* Direct experience as a user-facing engineer is highly desired
* Track record in successfully delivering complex, cross functional technology solutions

 **Additional Information**

Insurance Benefits - Medical Insurance, Critical Illness Insurance, Accidental Insurance, Life Insurance Wellness Program - Employee Assistance Program, Onsite Medical Center, Emergency Support System Parental Support - Maternity Benefit, Paternity Benefit Program, Adoption Assistance Program, Day-care Support Program Mobility Benefits - Relocation benefits, Transfer Support Policy, Travel Policy Retirement Benefits - Employee PF Contribution, Flexible PF Contribution, Gratuity, NPS, Leave Encashment Other Benefits - Higher Education Assistance, Car Lease, Salary Advance Policy

We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world’s toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.  
  
DESCRIPTION:  
Thermo Fisher is seeking a highly motivated individual to serve as Digital Product Specialist, Customer Content.

As a Product Specialist, you will be responsible for the management and evolution of the enterprise Customer Content platform used across Thermo Fisher Scientific. Together with the Senior Product Manager, own the product strategy, roadmap, backlog prioritization, and requirements definition for the Thermo Fisher Marketing Content DAM (AEM as a Cloud Service Assets) and the connected technologies comprising the Customer Content Supply Chain.

Your primary focus will be on defining and driving capabilities of our enterprise-wide platform to maximize value, including through the implementation of automations to enable production and management of on-brand Customer Content at scale.

The ideal candidate will possess a unique blend of Marketing and Digital Technology knowledge, as well as strong communication skills.

**Job Description:**

Product Development

* Define and document comprehensive product requirements, ensuring they are clear, complete, and aligned with business objectives and technical feasibility.
* Gather and evaluate inputs to develop Lean Business Cases and inform WSJF (Weighted Shortest Job First) value scoring
* Accurately and completely define capabilities and features in the Jira Align work planning tool.
* Contribute to the development and refinement of the Marketing Technology strategy and roadmap in collaboration with business stakeholders and the Senior Product Manager.
* Coordinate across internal stakeholders to ensure objectives remain aligned with broader company goals.

Delivery & Execution

* Partner with DCP team to guide and support the development process, providing direction, clarifications, and timely feedback.
* Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure initiatives are delivered on time, at high quality, and in alignment with business needs and technical constraints.
* Escalate risks and issues proactively, working with stakeholders to identify and implement effective solutions.
* Conduct thorough user acceptance testing (UAT) to validate that developed capabilities meet requirements and deliver a positive user experience.
* Partner with the Corporate Customer Marketing business-facing team to deliver product demonstrations highlighting new functionality, business value, and overall benefits; create and maintain user guides and documentation, ensuring instructions, screenshots, and references remain accurate and up to date.

Measurement & Optimization

* Track and analyze key performance indicators (KPIs) to measure the effectiveness and impact of Marketing Content initiatives, providing regular reporting.
* Continuously monitor product performance, making data-driven recommendations to refine features, optimize functionality, and enhance overall user experience.

Process Improvement

* Lead initiatives to improve processes and identify opportunities for automation that maximize business value delivery to stakeholders.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to identify, analyze, and redesign processes within the Content Supply Chain to increase efficiency, effectiveness, and performance.

Additional Responsibilities

* Provide product expertise and collaborate with internal and vendor Service and Support personnel to troubleshoot and resolve issues.
* Manage software access through processes related to license requests, usage tracking,  
  invoice reconciliations and chargebacks.
* Perform other assigned duties and contribute to initiatives as needed. **REQUIREMENTS:**

* 5+ years of Product Management experience supporting enterprise software or digital platforms.
* Demonstrated experience owning and prioritizing a product backlog.
* Proven ability to define detailed functional requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria.
* Experience managing mature products with large enterprise user communities.
* Experience partnering with Agile engineering teams.
* Strong stakeholder management across business and technical organizations.
* Experience making prioritization decisions using business value and customer outcomes.
* Experience using Jira, Azure DevOps, Jira Align, or equivalent product management tools.
* Experience defining KPIs and measuring product success.
* Experience with Adobe Experience Manager as a Cloud Service and Workfront preferred.

title: Data Management & Governance Program Lead
description:
**Data Management & Governance Program Lead**

**Job title:** Data Management & Governance Program Lead

**Engagement**: Enterprise data management programme for a life insurer: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI readiness and BAU handover

**Location**: Manila, Philippines (hybrid) – to confirm

**Reports to**: Engagement Director (vendor); works day to day with the client’s Deputy CTO

**Leads**: Project Manager, Project Coordinator and client EDO technical leads (BI, Snowflake, Power BI)

**Experience**: 12–15+ years in data and analytics; 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes

**Purpose of the role**

The Program Lead designs, gets approved and hands over a complete data management framework, so the business trusts its numbers and can run it without the vendor after Go-Live.

The role owns nine strategic deliverables, from KPI definitions to BAU transition, and steers the client’s EDO team on day-to-day data operations and dashboard delivery. Success means one agreed meaning for every KPI, a named owner for every data asset, proven data quality, and a client team that runs it all on its own.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and frameworks**

* Write and maintain the data management frameworks: KPI standardization, data governance, data quality and lineage, platform assessment, growth analytics, AI and automation readiness, handover, committee governance and BAU transition.
* Present frameworks and decision papers to the Steering Committee, the Data Management Committee and the Design Authority, and secure approval at each gate.

**KPIs and data governance**

* Run KPI definition workshops with each department; agree one definition, formula and owner per KPI; build the KPI Dictionary.
* Set up the governance operating model: Data Owners and Stewards, decision rights, policy, standards, data classification and committees.

**Data quality, lineage and platform**

* Identify critical data elements, define quality rules and thresholds, and set up monitoring, issue management and lineage.
* Assess the data platform (Snowflake, AWS, Power BI) for architecture, security, cost and environments; recommend a future state and remediation roadmap.

**Analytics and AI readiness**

* Map customer journeys and funnels; design reusable shared data sets for dashboards and reports.
* Assess AI readiness, rank automation and AI use cases, and set responsible AI and GenAI safety rules.

**Delivery and operations**

* Own the programme plan, RAID log, decision log, evidence repository and status reporting.
* Oversee the dashboard pipeline from BRD to UAT, Production and hypercare; unblock sign-offs with business owners.
* Guide the client EDO team on platform stability, incident and change processes, and the data request SOPs.

**Handover and BAU**

* Design BAU services, SOPs and service levels; train owners, stewards and the EDO team; lead handover acceptance and Go-Live readiness.

**Required experience and qualifications**

* 12–15+ years in data and analytics, including 5+ years leading data governance or data management programmes end to end.
* 5+ years in insurance or financial services; life insurance strongly preferred.
* Has set up a data governance operating model (owners, stewards, decision rights, committees) and taken it through executive approval.
* Has standardized KPIs across business units and built a KPI or business glossary used in production reporting.
* Has delivered a data quality programme with critical data elements, rules, thresholds and lineage.
* Has led a platform or architecture assessment and a remediation roadmap on a modern cloud data stack.
* Has handed a programme over to a BAU team, with SOPs, training and acceptance.
* Experience as a consultant or vendor lead working with client executives.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, statistics, business or a related field; a master’s degree is a plus.

**Behavioural competencies**

* **Executive influence:** gets decisions and sign-offs from senior leaders and busy business owners, and keeps approvals moving.
* **Plain-language communication:** turns frameworks into short material executives can read and act on.
* **Facilitation:** runs workshops where departments disagree, and brings them to one agreed definition.
* **Pragmatism:** balances good-practice governance with what a small team can actually run.
* **Ownership:** works without close supervision, and tracks commitments to closure.
* **Coaching:** builds capability in client teams so they can run the work after handover.

**Preferred certifications**

None is mandatory; proven delivery counts for more.

* CDMP (DAMA) or DCAM: data management
* PMP or PRINCE2: programme delivery
* SnowPro Core, or Microsoft Power BI Data Analyst: platforms
* ITIL 4 Foundation: BAU services
* An AI governance certification (for example IAPP AIGP): responsible AI

**Success in the first 6 months**

**By**

**Measure**

**Month 1**

Data Owners and Stewards named; access in place; plan, RAID and decision log running

**Month 2**

KPI, governance and data quality frameworks approved by the committees

**Month 3**

Platform roadmap approved; monthly data quality score live

**Month 4**

Growth blueprint and AI readiness plan approved

**Month 5**

Committee charter approved; handover items accepted by named owners

**Month 6**

Go-Live: BAU team runs the services without vendor support; Enterprise KPIs certified where a source exists

Work Location: In person

title: Lead Release Manager
description:
**As passionate about our people as we are about our mission.**
===============================================================

**Why Join Q2?**

Q2 is a leading provider of digital banking and lending solutions to banks, credit unions, alternative finance companies, and fintechs in the U.S. and internationally. Our mission is simple: build strong and diverse communities through innovative financial technology—and we do that by empowering our people to help create success for our customers.

**What Makes Q2 Special?**

Being as passionate about our people as we are about our mission. We celebrate our employees in many ways through our year-round Q2 ChangeMakers awards program and global moments of recognition and connection. We invest in the growth and development of our team members through ongoing learning opportunities, internal mobility, and meaningful leadership relationships. We also know that nothing builds trust and collaboration like having fun and giving back together. From company-wide volunteer days to events like our Q2 Homecoming Week—featuring learning, community service, and culture-building experiences—we create opportunities to connect, grow, and make an impact.

Q2 is seeking a **Lead Release Manager** to ensure software changes are delivered safely and predictably across our digital banking platform. You'll play a pivotal role in release governance and customer delivery while navigating complex environments and evolving technologies.

As part of our Software Delivery organization, you'll work across Engineering, Product, and customer-facing teams to drive informed decisions and effective coordination. We're looking for someone with sound judgment, exceptional organizational skills, and the curiosity to challenge existing practices and make software delivery simpler, safer, and more efficient.

**RESPONSIBILITIES**
--------------------

  

* Lead release readiness reviews, challenge unresolved risks, and ensure approval requirements are met.
* Co-lead the Change Advisory Board (CAB) as a regional champion, driving risk-based decisions and consistent change governance.
* Coordinate release readiness across multiple product lines, ensuring dependencies, documentation, and communications are addressed.
* Coordinate customer-specific software updates by validating scheduling data, identifying inconsistencies, and confirming dependencies with accountable teams.
* Deliver clear, timely communications to customers and internal stakeholders regarding releases and planned updates.
* Facilitate alignment between Support, Product, and Engineering on customer-impacting defect priorities and their implications for upcoming releases.
* Challenge existing release workflows and drive measurable improvements in delivery reliability and efficiency.
* Partner with Engineering and AI enablement teams to identify automation opportunities, define requirements, and validate solutions that reduce manual effort and improve accuracy.

**EXPERIENCE & QUALIFICATIONS:**

**Required**

  

* Typically requires a Bachelor's degree in a related field and 9–12 years of relevant experience in software release management, software engineering, product delivery, or related disciplines.
* Demonstrated success independently coordinating complex software releases or production delivery across multiple product teams and organizations.
* Strong understanding of the Software Development Life Cycle (SDLC), CI/CD pipelines, software testing, deployment workflows, and modern software delivery practices.
* Experience with Change Advisory Boards (CAB), production change approvals, and higher-risk changes, including risk assessment and mitigation.
* Strong stakeholder management and facilitation skills, with the ability to challenge assumptions, engage technical experts, and drive decisions and accountability across teams.
* Strong analytical skills with experience validating operational data, identifying inconsistencies, and managing competing schedules and priorities.
* Demonstrated success challenging existing processes, identifying inefficiencies, and driving measurable operational improvements.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey release risks, changes, and impacts to technical teams, customers, and executive leadership.

**Preferred**

  

* Experience with progressive delivery, phased rollouts, artifact promotion, or cell-based architectures.
* Experience with automated release controls, quality gates, or deployment governance.
* Familiarity with AI-enabled workflows, MCP integrations, or process automation.
* Knowledge of DORA metrics and software delivery performance measurement.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Jenkins, or similar tools.
* Experience in financial technology, digital banking, or regulated SaaS environments.

 **RESPONSIBILITIES:** • Coordinate with Engineering groups and monitor associated software release notes for all component parts of the Q2ebanking software solutions • Establish Engineering completeness criteria including component dependencies to gate the delivery of releases into QA for testing • Coordinate with QA group and monitor releases in testing • Establish QA completeness criteria for release of successfully tested software component and their dependencies to gate the delivery of releases to Implementation groups • Maintain release baselines (versions of all compatible solution components) and updates for new and existing external customers • Serve as a liaison between business units to guarantee smooth and timely delivery of software packages to our Implementations and Support teams • Promote updates to administrative Windows application in a Data Center environment • Maintain records to identify cross-module compatibility of software versions • Responsible for ensuring that all security, availability, confidentiality and privacy policies and controls are adhered to • Answer questions and serve as source of knowledge for application releases **EXPERIENCE AND KNOWLEDGE:** • Bachelor’s degree in related field and 9-12 years in a software release management role • Experience managing, controlling and tracking releases with successful delivery • Experience with and knowledge of the following concepts and technologies: • Software Configuration Management • Software Release Management • Release notes and documentation processes • Windows 7, Windows 2003/2008 Server • SVN (preferred), GIT, and other Source Repository tools • Salesforce or other Case Management software • General knowledge of the software development life cycle (SDLC) processes • Manage multiple product releases in a fast pace environment

*This position requires fluent written and oral communication in English.*

**Health & Wellness**

* Hybrid Work Opportunities
* Flexible Time Off
* Career Development & Mentoring Programs
* Health & Wellness Benefits, including competitive health insurance offerings and generous paid parental leave for eligible new parents
* Community Volunteering & Company Philanthropy Programs
* Employee Peer Recognition Programs – “You Earned it”

Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer.

We’re proud to foster a supportive, inclusive environment where career growth, collaboration, and wellness are prioritized. And our benefits go beyond healthcare—offering resources for physical, mental, and professional well-being. Click here to find out more about the benefits we offer. Q2 employees are encouraged to give back through volunteer work and nonprofit support through our Spark Program (see more). We believe in making an impact—in the industry and in the community.

title: Director of Product
description:
**Be at the Forefront of the Agentic AI Revolution**

At Skan AI, we are pioneering the context engine for human and agentic execution, bringing context from enterprise operators, systems, and processes to power how the world's largest organizations execute their most complex, mission-critical work.

**Why Skan AI**

We're in hyper-growth mode at exactly the right moment in history. As enterprises race to adopt agentic AI, we're uniquely positioned to deliver the clear signal they desperately need: a platform that trains and grounds AI Agents in trillions of real execution signals, enabling reliable, compliant automation of their most complex processes.

Backed by Dell Technologies Capital and other leading investors, we're the only company that can bridge the gap between AI's promise and enterprise reality, making us perfectly positioned to define the agentic era for modern enterprises.

Our diverse, collaborative team of 250+ innovators is solving category-defining challenges at the intersection of AI, process intelligence, and enterprise work. Diverse perspectives fuel breakthrough thinking, cross-functional collaboration is the norm, and our work directly transforms how Fortune 500 companies operate. We are shaping the future of work itself.

**Role Overview**

  

As Director of Product, you will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for Skan's process intelligence platform. This is the platform that helps the world's largest enterprises see how work actually happens inside their organizations, and act on that understanding. It is technically complex, data-intensive, and genuinely impactful at scale.

We are looking for someone who has spent meaningful time in process mining, process intelligence, or intelligent automation. Not just an awareness of the space, but real product experience in it. You know the gap between a compelling demo and something that actually works in a large enterprise environment. You have shipped products in this domain and have the scars to show for it.

With 12 to 15 years of product experience, including time at AI-native startups, you are comfortable making product calls with incomplete information, working without a lot of support structure around you, and keeping a team focused when everything feels urgent. You are also someone who uses AI tools every day in how you work, not just in what you build. That matters to us.

  

**Key Responsibilities**

**Product Vision and Strategy**

* Own the product roadmap for the process intelligence platform, from how we capture and model operational data through to the analytics and prescriptive insights we surface to customers.
* Make clear, defensible decisions on what we build next. You will get input from customers, from sales, from data, and from the competitive landscape. Your job is to synthesize all of that and land on a prioritized point of view.
* Keep the company aligned on product direction. That means being a consistent voice in leadership discussions, not just a person who maintains a roadmap document.
Know the competitive landscape well. Understand what Celonis, SAP Signavio, UiPath, and the broader BPM and automation ecosystem are doing. Use that knowledge to sharpen Skan's positioning and find the white space.  

  

**Product Execution and Delivery**

* Work closely with engineering, design, and data science to turn complex customer problems into product requirements teams can actually build from. Good PRDs, clear acceptance criteria, and regular communication matter here.
* Manage delivery across several workstreams at once, covering process discovery, analytics, conformance, and integrations. Help teams make smart trade-off decisions when timelines get tight.
* Stay engaged with architecture and data model decisions that affect the product. You do not need to write the code, but you need to understand what is being built and why certain technical choices matter at enterprise scale.
Hold a high bar for user experience. Process intelligence data is inherently complex. Making it feel accessible and actionable to both business users and technical users is one of the harder product challenges in this space.  

  

**Using AI in How You Work**

We are an AI company. We expect product leaders to work with AI tools every day, not just build products that use them. This is what that looks like in practice.

* Use LLMs and AI research tools to move faster in discovery. Summarize customer interviews, identify patterns across large volumes of feedback, and sharpen your hypotheses without spending days manually reviewing notes.
* Use generative AI to write better first drafts of PRDs and specifications. Spend your energy making judgment calls and refining thinking, not starting from a blank page every single time.
* Set up workflows to track what is happening in the market. Use AI tools to monitor competitor releases, analyst commentary, and community signals across the process mining and automation space so you are never behind.
* Bring your team along. Help your product managers develop real fluency with these tools, including knowing when to trust AI output and when to push back on it.
* Stay grounded in what AI can and cannot do reliably inside enterprise products. That practitioner perspective will directly shape how we build and talk about AI features in the platform.
Share what you learn. Recommend tools, document what works, and help build an internal culture of AI-augmented work across the product organization.  

  

**Team Leadership**

* Build and grow the product management team. That means hiring thoughtfully, giving people real ownership of meaningful problems, and being the kind of manager whose reports get better over time.
* Set up the operating model. Good product teams do not run themselves. Help establish the rituals, frameworks, and ways of working that let people move fast without losing sight of what matters.
Create an environment where people are honest about trade-offs, comfortable sitting with uncertainty, and focused on outcomes over activity.  

  

**Customer and Commercial Engagement**

* Spend real time with customers. Get into the detail of how they use the product, where it falls short, and what they actually need. Use those conversations to challenge your assumptions, not just confirm them.
* Show up in executive-level customer conversations and sales cycles as a credible product voice. You should be able to walk a customer through where the product is heading and why it matters to their specific business.
Work with Customer Success to track how customers are getting value from the platform and use those signals to sharpen what we build next.  

  

**Cross-Functional Alignment**

* Help Sales and Marketing tell a sharper product story. That means going beyond feature lists and helping them articulate what actually makes Skan different in a crowded market.
* Collaborate with Finance and leadership when business cases need product input, whether that involves pricing, packaging, or expansion opportunities.
Stay close to what Professional Services and Customer Success teams see on the ground. Some of the most useful product insights come from the people who spend the most time with customers post-sale.  

  

**Qualifications and Experience**

* 12 to 15 years of professional experience, with at least 8 years in product management in enterprise software or SaaS.
* You have worked at an AI-native startup. You know what it is like to build under pressure, make product calls without full information, and keep moving without a lot of infrastructure around you.
* Background in process mining, process intelligence, BPM, task mining, or RPA is strongly preferred. Candidates with this domain experience will stand out. If you have worked at companies like Celonis, UiPath, SAP Signavio, ABBYY, Minit, or similar, we want to hear from you.
* Real familiarity with process mining concepts: how event logs work, what conformance checking involves, how process discovery surfaces insights, and what makes process KPIs meaningful to an enterprise buyer.
* You understand how AI and ML get applied in operational intelligence products. Not just the theory. You have worked through the practical realities of model development, validation, and how insights actually reach end users.
* You have shipped products used by large enterprises. You understand procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and what it takes to get something adopted at scale inside a Fortune 500 organization.
* You have led product teams before. People grew under your management. You know how to give teams real ownership while keeping everyone pointed in the same direction.
* You are technically credible. You can have a substantive conversation with engineers and data scientists about architecture decisions, API design, and data pipeline trade-offs without needing someone to translate.
* You use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can speak specifically about what you use them for and what impact they have had. This is a real expectation, not a checkbox.
* You communicate clearly across very different audiences, from a technical spec reviewed by engineers to a roadmap presentation in front of a board.
You can operate in ambiguous situations without becoming paralyzed. Fast-moving, early stage environments energize rather than frustrate you.  

  

**Education**

A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or a related technical field is required. An MBA or advanced degree in a quantitative or business discipline is a strong plus.

  

**What Success Looks Like in the First 12 Months**

* You have built a product roadmap that the whole company believes in and that customers are genuinely excited about.
* You have shipped meaningful improvements to the process intelligence platform that customers are using, talking about, and renewing because of. • The product team is operating well. People have clear ownership, they are growing in their roles, and there is a culture of honest feedback and continuous learning.
* Skan's process intelligence story is sharper and more differentiated in the market. That is visible in customer conversations, analyst coverage, and competitive win rates.
* You have introduced AI-assisted ways of working into how the team runs discovery, writes specifications, and tracks the competitive landscape. It has made a measurable difference.
People across Sales, Customer Success, Engineering, and leadership come to you when they need the product perspective. You have earned that trust through good judgment and clear communication.  

  

Skan AI is an equal opportunity employer committed to building a diverse, inclusive, and respectful workplace around the world. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion or belief, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity, or gender expression), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, marital or family status, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws in the locations where we operate. We welcome people from all backgrounds and provide reasonable accommodations throughout the hiring process.

title: Senior Lead Data Management Analyst
description:
**About this role:**

Wells Fargo Wealth & Investment Management (WIM) Data Management is seeking a Senior Lead Data Management Analyst to serve functionally as the **Strategic Data & Intelligence Enablement Leader**. Reporting to the WIM Data & AI Strategic Enablement Leader, this senior individual contributor will translate priority business, data, and AI use cases into governed data and semantic capabilities.

The role will lead business-to-data translation, source decisioning, data mapping, semantic modeling, and data-product adoption. For AI-native initiatives, it will define the ontologies, metadata, knowledge representations, grounding context, provenance, and controls needed for reliable AI solutions. The role will partner with Data Product Designers, architects, engineers, governance teams, and business stakeholders while remaining focused on strategy, requirements, design direction, and adoption rather than product engineering.

**In this role, you will:**

Act as an advisor to leadership to develop or influence objectives, plans, specifications, resources, and long-term goals for highly complex business and technical needs

Design and conduct highly complex analysis to identify and remediate data quality or integrity issues and to identify and remediate process or control gaps

Lead the strategy and resolution of highly complex and unique challenges requiring in-depth evaluation across multiple areas or the enterprise, delivering solutions that are long-term, large-scale and require vision, creativity, innovation, advanced analytical and inductive thinking

Evaluate data quality metrics and data quality audits to benchmark the state of data quality

Provide vision, direction, and expertise to senior leadership on implementing innovative and significant business solutions

Recommend remediation of process or control gaps that align to management strategy

Strategically engage with all levels of professionals and managers across the enterprise and serve as an expert advisor to leadership

Represent client in cross-functional groups to develop companywide data governance strategies

Partner with groups companywide to coordinate and drive collaboration on solution design and remediation execution

Translate business and AI use cases into scalable data product solutions.

Analyze and evaluate data sources, mappings, transformations, and business rules.

Define data, semantic, grounding, and traceability requirements for AI applications.

Assess data quality, lineage, metadata, privacy, and governance readiness.

Identify and mitigate data, AI, and semantic risks.

Establish end-to-end data lineage and control frameworks.

Partner with business, technology, risk, compliance, privacy, and architecture teams to deliver governed data solutions.

**Required Qualifications:**

title: Analyst, Client Success (API, Payments, NPS, CSAT)
description:
**About Us**  
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.

At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.

Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Client Success Analyst is an individual contributor responsible for managing a portfolio of Pismo clients predominantly in card issuing and ensuring they achieve their desired business outcomes from the Pismo platform. Acting as the primary day-to-day customer contact, the Analyst drives customer satisfaction, customer health, product adoption, revenue realization, and overall client success.

This role will be based in Bangalore, India.

The role combines customer relationship management, technical coordination, operational oversight, and business consulting. The Customer Success Analyst works independently to manage customer engagements while collaborating closely with Product, Engineering, Operations, Support, and Commercial teams to deliver customer outcomes. For complex situations, strategic opportunities, and executive escalations, the Analyst will partner with Customer Success leaders and management.

The ideal candidate is customer-focused, technically competent, commercially aware, and capable of building trusted relationships with both operational and management-level stakeholders within client organizations and Pismo.

**Key Responsibilities**
------------------------

### **Customer Ownership & Business Outcomes**

* Serve as the primary owner for an assigned portfolio of customer accounts.
* Develop a deep understanding of each customer's business objectives, operating model, and strategic priorities.
* Ensure customers achieve their desired outcomes through effective use of Pismo's card issuing platform.
* Build trusted relationships with customer stakeholders across operational, technical, and management levels.
* Lead regular operational reviews and governance discussions with customers.
* Act as the customer's advocate within Pismo and ensure commitments are delivered.

### **Customer Health, Satisfaction & NPS**

* Own and continuously improve Customer Health Scores for assigned customers.
* Drive customer satisfaction and Net Promoter Score (NPS) improvements through proactive engagement.
* Monitor customer sentiment, platform usage, service performance, and support trends to identify success opportunities and risks.
* Establish and execute action plans for customers showing signs of declining health.
* Drive proactive communication and follow-up to prevent escalations and strengthen customer confidence.

### **Revenue Realization & Growth**

* Ensure customers realize the value of their investment in the Pismo platform.
* Drive adoption of contracted products, features, and capabilities.
* Identify opportunities to increase platform utilization and business value.
* Support account planning activities by identifying expansion opportunities and revenue realization initiatives.
* Partner with Commercial and Account Management teams to contribute to revenue growth and retention objectives.

### **Technical Coordination & Issue Management**

* Develop strong knowledge of Pismo's card issuing platform, payment processing flows, APIs, product capabilities, and operational processes.
* Act as the coordination point between customers and internal Product, Engineering, SRE, Operations, and Support teams.
* Manage customer-reported issues through investigation, follow-up, communication, and resolution.
* Translate customer business requirements into actionable internal discussions.
* Ensure timely customer communication during incidents, enhancements, and platform changes.

### **Stakeholder Management**

* Build productive relationships with customer operational teams, program managers, product owners, and business leaders.
* Engage confidently with middle-management stakeholders and participate in discussions with senior leadership when required.
* Coordinate effectively across multiple internal teams to drive customer outcomes.
* Escalate risks, opportunities, and customer concerns appropriately to Customer Success leadership.

### **Reporting & Insights**

* Monitor and analyze customer performance metrics, health indicators, and adoption trends.
* Prepare customer scorecards, operational reports, governance materials, and business reviews.
* Identify trends, risks, and opportunities through data-driven analysis.
* Provide recommendations to improve customer experience, adoption, and operational efficiency.

**Success Measures**
--------------------

The Customer Success Analyst will be accountable for:

* Customer Health Score improvement
* Net Promoter Score (NPS)
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT)
* Revenue realization against contracted commitments
* Product adoption and engagement metrics
* Customer retention and renewal readiness
* Reduction in customer escalations
* Timely resolution and management of customer issues
* Delivery of customer success plans and agreed outcomes
* Positive customer and stakeholder feedback

**Qualifications**

**Required Qualifications**
---------------------------

* Bachelor’s Degree or an Advanced Degree
* 3-6 years of experience in Customer Success, Client Services, Technical Account Management, Program Management, Payments Operations, Consulting, or related fields.
* Experience within payments, card issuing, fintech, banking, SaaS, or technology industries.
* Strong understanding of customer lifecycle management and customer success principles.
* Ability to independently manage customer relationships and workstreams.
* Strong analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Demonstrated ability to coordinate cross-functional teams and manage competing priorities.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

**Preferred Qualifications**
----------------------------

* Knowledge of card issuing, authorization processing, disputes, settlement, digital wallets, and payment network ecosystems.
* Experience working with API-based platforms and modern cloud technologies.
* Familiarity with Visa and Mastercard issuing environments.
* Experience managing customer health programs, adoption tracking, and business reviews.

**Visa is an EEO Employer**

Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

In this senior leadership role, you will be responsible for overseeing all sales activities within your zone, developing and executing strategies to achieve revenue targets, and driving growth through a high-performing sales team. You will work closely with senior management to ensure alignment with the company's broader goals and market objectives. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in real estate sales, strong leadership abilities, a deep understanding of market trends, and a proven track record of success in managing large teams and achieving sales targets.

Key Responsibilities:

 Sales Strategy Development & Execution: Develop and implement effective sales strategies for your zone, in alignment with company goals. Monitor and adjust strategies as needed to achieve revenue targets, maximize profitability, and expand market share.

 Team Leadership & Development: Lead, mentor, and inspire a team of sales managers, consultants, and support staff across multiple locations within your zone. Set performance expectations, conduct regular reviews, and ensure continuous training and development to enhance team skills and effectiveness.

 Sales Performance & Targets: Set clear sales targets for the team and monitor progress towards achieving them. Take proactive steps to address performance gaps, drive sales initiatives, and implement corrective actions as needed. Ensure the achievement of both individual and team targets.

 Market Research & Insights: Oversee market research to identify new opportunities and emerging trends. Analyze local market dynamics, competitive activity, customer needs, and preferences to inform sales strategies and improve offerings.

 Client Relationship Management: Establish and maintain strong relationships with key clients, investors, developers, and other stakeholders in the region. Serve as the primary point of contact for high value clients and ensure high levels of customer satisfaction throughout the sales cycle.

 Sales Process Management: Ensure that the sales process is followed consistently across all teams within the zone, from lead generation through to deal closure. Ensure that all documentation, contracts, and compliance requirements are met and handled efficiently.

 Collaboration with Marketing & Operations: Work closely with the marketing team to design and execute local marketing campaigns, promotional events, and advertising strategies that generate leads and drive sales in the region. Collaborate with operations and project management teams to ensure smooth project delivery and customer satisfaction.

 Budgeting & Reporting: Oversee the sales budget for the zone, ensuring cost-effective operations and resource allocation. Regularly report on sales performance, progress towards targets, market trends, and competitor activities to senior management.

 Training & Development: Identify skill gaps and provide ongoing coaching and training for sales teams. Foster a high-performance culture by encouraging continuous learning, development, and the adoption of best practices.

 Customer & Stakeholder Feedback: Collect and analyze feedback from clients, sales teams, and other stakeholders to continuously improve sales strategies, product offerings, and customer engagement. Ensure that all customer concerns are addressed in a timely and professional manner.

 Access to cutting-edge tools, resources, and professional development opportunities.

 A dynamic and supportive work environment with room for career growth.

 Collaborative team culture focused on success and achievement.

Upstox Insurance is building a B2B Employee Benefits (EB) business that helps corporates protect their employees through group insurance. As Manager – B2B Insurance Lead Generation, you’ll own the top of this funnel — building the lead management strategy, defining and building the list of target corporates, and leading a team of SDRs that consistently delivers the number and quality of leads the B2B sales team needs, month on month.

This is a player-coach role. Alongside managing the team, you’ll carry your own outreach target and personally call and engage decision-makers at target corporates. If you love building pipeline from scratch and leading from the front, this role is for you.

**What You’ll Own**
-------------------

**Lead Generation Strategy & Lead Management**

* **Lead management framework**: Design and own the end-to-end framework — sourcing, qualification criteria, lead scoring, handover to sales, follow-up cadences and recycling of cold leads.

* **Ideal customer profile**: Define the ICP by industry, employee strength, geography and current benefits set-up, and refine it based on conversion data.

* **Outreach playbooks**: Build multi-channel playbooks across cold calling, email, LinkedIn, referrals, partner channels and events.

* **Renewal-cycle planning**: Plan outreach around corporate policy renewal cycles so prospects are engaged well ahead of their group insurance renewal dates.

**Target Account List Building**

* **Target list**: Build, segment and continuously enrich a target list of suitable corporates, with mapped decision-makers across HR, Finance, Admin and leadership.

* **Research & data tools**: Use tools such as LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo and ZoomInfo to identify accounts and verify contact data.

* **Data hygiene & prioritisation**: Maintain data hygiene and prioritise accounts by size, fit and likelihood to convert.

**Pipeline Delivery to the Sales Team**

* **Qualified pipeline**: Ensure the B2B sales team receives the agreed number of qualified leads and meetings every month.

* **Monthly targets**: Agree monthly lead and meeting targets with B2B sales leadership, aligned to sales capacity and revenue goals.

* **Feedback loop**: Run a regular feedback loop with sales on lead quality and conversion, and adjust targeting, messaging and qualification accordingly.

**Team Leadership & Motivation**

* **Hiring & training**: Hire, onboard and train SDRs on prospecting, pitch, objection handling and Employee Benefits products (e.g., Group Health, Group Personal Accident, Group Term Life).

* **Targets & reviews**: Set clear daily, weekly and monthly activity and outcome targets for each team member, and review progress through huddles and dashboards.

* **Coaching & culture**: Coach the team through call audits, role-plays and one-on-ones; drive a high-energy, performance-oriented culture.

**Individual Contribution**

* **Personal target**: Carry a personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **CXO outreach**: Personally call and engage senior decision-makers (CHROs, CFOs, founders) at priority and large accounts, and set up meetings for the sales team.

* **Lead from the front**: Take the lead on strategic accounts and new segments to build playbooks the team can replicate.

**Tools, Reporting & Analytics**

* **Lead management stack**: Own the CRM, dialers and sales engagement tools, and ensure full and disciplined adoption by the team.

* **Dashboards & MIS**: Build dashboards and share weekly and monthly MIS with the Business Head on activity, pipeline, conversion and target achievement.

* **Data-led allocation**: Use data to identify what is working by channel, segment and message, and reallocate team effort accordingly.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* **Collaboration**: Work with Marketing on campaigns, content and inbound lead flow; with Sales on smooth handovers; and with Product and Operations to bring market feedback back into the EB offering.

**How Success Is Measured**
---------------------------

* **Qualified leads delivered**: Sales-qualified leads / meetings handed over to the B2B sales team each month vs. target.

* **Meetings held**: Share of scheduled meetings that take place with the right decision-maker.

* **Funnel conversion**: Lead meeting proposal conversion rates, tracked by industry, company size and channel.

* **Team productivity**: Calls, connects, emails and LinkedIn touches per SDR per day/week.

* **Self-outreach target**: The Manager’s personal monthly target for outreach, calls and meetings set.

* **Data quality**: Accuracy and completeness of the target account list and CRM records.

**Who You Are**
---------------

* 5+ years of experience leading a B2B SDR / lead generation team, with a proven track record of delivering monthly pipeline targets.

* Strong understanding of lead management: ICP definition, list building, qualification frameworks, lead scoring and sales handover.

* Hands-on with lead management and sales engagement tools — CRM, dialers, LinkedIn Sales Navigator and data platforms.

* Excellent cold calling and outreach skills, with the confidence to engage CXO and HR leadership directly.

* Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and retain a high-performing team.

* Data-driven, with comfort in building and reading dashboards and MIS.

* Excellent communication skills.

* Willing to work on-site from Bengaluru.

**Good to have**

* Experience in insurance, Employee Benefits or group health, or B2B selling to HR and Finance teams (e.g., HR-tech, payroll, fintech, SaaS).

* Familiarity with insurance distribution and the IRDAI regulatory environment.

* Graduate degree; MBA preferred.

**Why This Role Rocks**
-----------------------

* You’ll build the top of the funnel for a brand-new B2B Employee Benefits business at one of India’s fastest-growing fintech platforms.

* You’ll have high ownership and visibility — your pipeline directly drives the revenue of the B2B insurance business.

* You’ll be a true player-coach, building a high-performing SDR team while leading from the front with CXOs.

* You’ll work with a passionate, fast-moving team across insurance, sales, marketing and product.

* Every corporate you bring in helps protect thousands of employees and their families.

title: Solutions Architect | India
description:
#### **Why Cast AI?**

Cast AI is an automation platform that operates cloud-native and AI infrastructure at scale. By embedding autonomous decision-making directly into Kubernetes and cloud environments, Cast AI continuously optimizes performance, reliability, and efficiency in production.

The old way doesn't work. As Kubernetes and AI environments grow, manual decisions don't. Cast AI replaces tickets, alerts, and manual tuning with continuous automation that adapts infrastructure as conditions change. Efficiency and cost savings follow naturally from that automation.

Over 2,100 companies already rely on Cast AI, including Akamai, BMW, Cisco, FICO, HuggingFace, NielsenIQ, Swisscom, and TGS.

**Global team, diverse perspectives**  
We're headquartered in Miami, but our impact is international. We take a global and intentional approach to diversity. Today, Cast AI operates across 34 countries spanning Europe, North America, Latin America, and APAC, bringing a wide range of perspectives into how we build and lead.

**Unicorn momentum**  
In January 2026, we achieved unicorn status with a strategic investment from Pacific Alliance Ventures, the corporate venture arm of Shinsegae Group (a $50+ billion Korean conglomerate). Our valuation now exceeds $1 billion, and we're just getting started.

**Join us as we build the future of autonomous infrastructure.**

#### **About this role:**

We are hiring a Solutions Architect to join our Customer Success team and support strategic customers across APAC.

This is a hands-on, customer-facing technical role for someone with strong Kubernetes, SRE and DevOps experience. You will work alongside Technical Account Managers and Client Partners, becoming the escalation point when a customer conversation requires deeper technical expertise, stronger architecture guidance or support with a complex production issue.

You will work directly with customers to understand their Kubernetes environment, diagnose technical challenges, guide them towards the right Cast AI solution and help them realise more value from the platform. You will also identify and support expansion opportunities, including positioning Omni where it can solve a meaningful customer problem.

This is not a traditional post-sales support role. You need to be comfortable in front of senior technical stakeholders, able to explain complex Kubernetes topics clearly and willing to travel to customer sites when needed.

The role covers APAC.

#### **Requirements:**

* Six to twelve years of relevant experience in SRE, DevOps, Cloud Infrastructure, Platform Engineering, Solutions Engineering or a similar role.
* Strong hands-on Kubernetes experience. You need to understand how clusters, workloads, networking, scaling and resource management operate in production.
* Meaningful prior experience as an SRE or DevOps Engineer. This is essential. Candidates without a real operational background are unlikely to succeed in the technical interview or the role.
* Experience troubleshooting production incidents, including diagnosing root cause, resolving the issue and implementing improvements afterwards.
* Strong understanding of cloud infrastructure and modern cloud-native tooling.
* Able to communicate technical concepts in a logical, clear and customer-friendly way.
* Comfortable speaking with engineering leaders, platform teams, SREs, DevOps teams and senior technical stakeholders.
* Interested in a customer-facing role, whether you already work with customers or want to move from a deeply technical role into one.
* Comfortable operating in a fast-growing, less structured environment where ownership and initiative matter.
* Willing to travel to customer locations for a few days per month.

#### **Responsibilities****:**

* Act as the senior technical escalation point for strategic and complex customer conversations.
* Partner with Technical Account Managers on customer onboarding, adoption, technical risk and platform value.
* Work with Client Partners to identify and support expansion opportunities within existing customers.
* Lead technical discovery sessions with customers to understand their Kubernetes architecture, workloads, operational challenges and priorities.
* Advise customers on Kubernetes reliability, efficiency, scaling and platform best practices.
* Help customers diagnose and resolve complex production issues involving Kubernetes clusters, workloads, resource management, networking or platform reliability.
* Represent Cast AI in customer meetings, technical workshops and occasional on-site visits across APAC.
* Support the commercial adoption of Omni by connecting product capabilities to genuine customer needs.
* Share recurring customer feedback, technical blockers and product opportunities with Product and Engineering teams.
* Work closely with a team of SREs and cloud infrastructure specialists within Customer Success.

#### **What's in it for you?**

* Enjoy a flexible, remote-first global environment.
* Collaborate with a global team of cloud experts and innovators, passionate about pushing the boundaries of Kubernetes technology.
* Equity options.
* Get quick feedback with a fast-paced workflow. Most feature projects are completed in 1 to 4 weeks.
* Spend 10% of your work time on personal projects or self-improvement.
* Learning budget for professional and personal development - including access to international conferences and courses that elevate your skills.
* Team-building budget and company events to connect with your colleagues.
* Equipment budget to ensure you have everything you need.
* Extra days off to help maintain a healthy work-life balance.

#### **Hiring process**

* Screening call with Recruiter
* Hiring Manager interview

* Culture Check interview with an executive

title: Engineering Manager
description:
**Company Overview**
--------------------

  
  
  

Docusign brings agreements to life. More than 1.8 million customers and more than a billion people in over 180 countries use Docusign solutions to accelerate the process of doing business and simplify people’s lives. With intelligent agreement management, Docusign unleashes business-critical data that is trapped inside of documents. Until now, these were disconnected from business systems of record, costing businesses time, money, and opportunity. Using the Docusign AI-native IAM platform, companies can create, commit, and manage agreements with solutions created by the #1 company in e-signature and contract lifecycle management (CLM).

  
  

**What you'll do**
------------------

  
  
  

As the Manager of the Extensibility Platform team at Docusign, you will lead a high-performing, cross-functional engineering team focused on developing and scaling the Extensibility Platform, as well as building new Extension Types and first-party applications. The platform enables internal and external developers to create applications that integrate seamlessly with Docusign’s Intelligent Agreement Management (IAM) systems. Developers can publish their applications through the Developer Console, making them available in the Docusign App Center for customers to discover and install. You will bring hands-on technical leadership through coding, code reviews, and driving the design and evolution of engineering architectures. You will help ensure the platform remains scalable, configurable, and capable of supporting diverse business scenarios, while strengthening collaboration and communication across engineering, product, and other partner teams.

This position is a people manager role reporting to the Senior Director, Software Engineering.

**Responsibility**

* Conduct thorough code reviews to maintain code quality, reliability, security, and engineering standards
* Create, review, and drive engineering architectures that enable a scalable, configurable Extensibility Platform
* Provide technical guidance and mentorship to engineers on design decisions, implementation approaches, and best practices
* Partner with engineering, product, design, and other teams to align technical solutions with platform and customer needs
* Define and communicate a clear technical vision and strategic roadmap for the Extensibility Platform, emphasizing usability, performance, and scalability
* Work closely with product managers, architects, and other stakeholders to gather requirements and deliver features critical to business success
* Guide the team in producing high-quality, maintainable code, with a strong focus on best practices in testing, monitoring, and logging
* Promote best practices in DevOps, continuous deployment, and Agile methodologies to enhance development efficiency and product quality
* Mentor and develop engineering talent, fostering a culture of innovation, continuous learning, and collaboration
* Engage with external developers and partners to expand the ecosystem of integrations available through the Docusign App Center

**Hybrid:** Employee divides their time between in-office and remote work. Access to an office location is required. (Frequency: Minimum 2 days per week; may vary by team but will be weekly in-office expectation)

Preferred job designations are not guaranteed when changing positions within Docusign. Docusign reserves the right to change a position's job designation depending on business needs and as permitted by local law.

  
  

**What you bring**
------------------

  
  
  

**Basic**

* 5+ years of software development and management experience across multiple languages/frameworks (or equivalent)
* 5+ years of hands-on coding or equivalent
* 5+ years of leading software teams of 5+ people or equivalent
* Proven track record in building solutions that consume and expose APIs/web services
* Experience in SaaS or Cloud environments

**Preferred**

* Expertise with high-availability (99.99%+) distributed systems
* Familiarity with Git, CI/CD pipelines, and Agile methodologies
* Curiosity and adaptability in learning new tech stacks
* Experience building and scaling platform components for app marketplaces or similar ecosystems
* Prior involvement in designing secure, reliable integrations with third-party apps or services
* Experience in integrating with 3rd party enterprise systems
* Experience in building enterprise software and platforms

  

**Life at Docusign**
--------------------

  
  
  

**Working here**

Docusign is committed to building trust and making the world more agreeable for our employees, customers and the communities in which we live and work. You can count on us to listen, be honest, and try our best to do what’s right, every day. At Docusign, everything is equal.

We each have a responsibility to ensure every team member has an equal opportunity to succeed, to be heard, to exchange ideas openly, to build lasting relationships, and to do the work of their life. Best of all, you will be able to feel deep pride in the work you do, because your contribution helps us make the world better than we found it. And for that, you’ll be loved by us, our customers, and the world in which we live.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

title: Engineering - Systems Analyst
description:
**About Us:**

  
Barry-Wehmiller is a diversified global supplier of engineering consulting and manufacturing technology for the packaging, corrugating, sheeting and paper-converting industries. By blending people-centric leadership with disciplined operational strategies and purpose-driven growth, Barry-Wehmiller has become a $3 billion organization with nearly 12,000 team members united by a common belief: to use the power of business to build a better world.  
  

**Job Description:**

**Join Us. Build a Better World Through Business.**

At Barry-Wehmiller Companies, we believe business can be a powerful force for good. Headquartered in St. Louis, Missouri, we are a global leader in manufacturing technology and services. Since our founding in 1885 as a maker of brewing machinery, we’ve grown through the acquisition of more than 80 companies, serving industries such as packaging, paper converting, sheeting, corrugating, engineering, and IT consulting. In 2016, we ranked No. 10 on the St. Louis Business Journal list of the city’s Top 150 Privately Held Companies.

What truly sets us apart is our culture—rooted in Truly Human Leadership, a philosophy that prioritizes the well-being and growth of every individual. We measure success by the way we touch lives, not just by financial results.

In India, Barry-Wehmiller operates as a hub of innovation and collaboration through our Global Competency Center (GCC) and other strategic functions. The GCC houses centers of excellence in engineering, content management, sourcing, software development, global IT operations, and shared financial services—providing critical support to Barry-Wehmiller divisions worldwide.

**Our culture is built on:**

* Ownership – Drive features end-to-end, from design to deployment.

* Flexibility – A friendly, results-oriented environment that respects your time.

* Empowerment – Your ideas matter, and your work creates visible impact.

* Learning and Growth – Tackle complex challenges alongside passionate peers, with continuous support for your development.

**Career Development and Global Exposure**

At Barry-Wehmiller, your growth is our priority. You’ll have access to world-class learning programs, leadership development opportunities, and mentorship from industry experts. Our global footprint means you’ll collaborate with teams across continents, gaining exposure to diverse markets, cutting-edge technologies, and best practices from around the world. Whether you aspire to deepen your technical expertise or take on leadership roles, we provide the resources and support to help you thrive.

If you’re ready to bring your best thinking to a high-impact, future-focused environment—where long-term stability meets start-up agility—and be part of a company that cares deeply about people, we’d love to hear from you.

**Position Description:**

Under general direction, the Engineering Systems Analyst drives strategies to improve engineering processes and ensure systems and tools are efficient and optimized. The individual will provide functional and technical expertise in identifying, evaluating, and developing systems and procedures that are cost effective and meet user requirements while directly supporting engineering initiatives from the business. They will assist in designing the structure of our engineering systems and carry out programs to ensure the proper architecture is implemented. Provide hands-on experience in software development and be able to manage complex programs. They will also assist in designing, building, and updating database structures and SQL queries. You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. This role is responsible for providing technical assistance to other engineers. This role also frequently provides guidance to engineering staff, using extensive experience to manage the prioritization, development and completion of technology projects.

**Principal Duties and Responsibilities (Essential Functions):**

* Maintain and administer PDM and CAD systems, databases, and infrastructure. Optimize systems for efficiency and security.

* Partner with users to understand PDM, CAD, and drafting concerns, troubleshoot issues, and propose process improvements to increase user efficiency and experience.

* Troubleshoot PDM and CAD issues with the end user base. Perform root cause analysis to develop, test, and implement fixes that prevent recurrence.

* Develop and deliver training for PDM and CAD products. Establish and communicate PDM and CAD best practices. Standardize PDM and CAD environments across all workstations.

* Work with IT to develop and support communication protocols between PDM and other data systems as required.

* Manage licenses for PDM and CAD software and add-ons.

* Evaluate, maintain, and develop new tools to support the end user base.

* Evaluate operating systems and upgrades to manage impact on CAD servers and workstations

* Attends and participates, as an ‘ambassador’ for testing, in project meetings regarding solution of the requirements, design, and test plan review.

* Maintain a working knowledge of advancing technologies. Identify applicable solutions and implement with existing networks when appropriate.

* Identify creative ways to reduce cost by streamlining processes and systems (i.e. modification of responsibilities, consolidation or tasks, elimination of non-value added processes and re-engineering processes and systems).

* Drive continuous improvement through trend reporting analysis and metrics management leveraging PowerBI and other similar tools.

* Participate in blueprinting and mapping sessions with customers for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations.

* Analyze requirements and contribute to the design of CAD/PDM solutions to complex requirements

* Design and execute implementations for PDM, Change Management, and Migrations

* Mentor and collaborate with services team members on design, documentation, and implementations

* SQL queries and analysis

* Participate in large project support, system/application implementations and upgrades.

* Assist with the long term migration to standard engineering tools.

* Designing and maintaining custom applications.

* Collaborate with DBAs and Infrastructure teams.

**Job Specifications:**

* Extensive knowledge and experience in Engineering PDM and CAD applications including SolidWorks and Autodesk products

* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.

* Excellent team player.

* Strong logic, problem solving ability, takes initiative.

* Excellent oral and written communication skills

**Required Education and Experience:**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, IT, or related technical field required

* Typically has 4+ years’ engineering or IT experience

* BlueStar PLM experience preferred

**Supervisory/Responsibility:**

* Indicate if individual contributor w/no direct reports or if supervise direct reports & level of reports (individual contributors, supervisors, managers, etc.)

**Work Environment:**

Works in an office environment but may occasionally be exposed to manufacturing conditions to include noise, fumes, Odors, gases, dust, and hazards such as moving mechanical and electrical machinery. Required Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) will be provided to mitigate or eliminate these hazards and all employees will be trained on appropriate use of PPE.

**Position Type:**

This is a regular, full-time position with the understanding that a regular workweek will require extended days and hours as needed to meet business needs.

**Travel:**

No travel is expected for this position

**Physical Demands:**

OFFICE

The physical demands described here are representative of the those performed in the job duties. The employee sits at a desk and uses a computer for prolonged periods of time. Performing the role frequently uses close vision, speech, hearing, and dexterity to operate office equipment. The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 15 pounds.
