title: Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)
description:
**Job Description — Growth Lead, D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

Y-Axis Overseas Careers · October 2026

**About Y-Axis and the opportunity**

Y-Axis is hiring one person to build and scale a new direct-to-consumer channel: service products that customers browse, choose and buy online without a sales call.

Y-Axis Overseas Careers is one of India's best-known migration and overseas career consultancies. For years our services have been sold through counsellors and branches. We are now packaging them as fixed-scope, fixed-price products, such as Work in Europe, Work in Germany and Work in Dubai for Nurses, sold through dedicated sales pages with a self-serve checkout.

Selling a service online is harder than selling a physical product. The buyer cannot touch it, the outcome is months away, and trust decides the sale. We need someone who has already solved that problem in a service business, not only in retail or FMCG e-commerce.

**The role: Growth Lead – D2C E-commerce (Service Products)**

**Location**

Hyderabad (on-site / hybrid)

**Experience**

6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, at least 3 in a service-based business

**Reports to**

Head of Digital / Business Head

**Works with**

Performance marketing, web development, design, CRM, content, sales and operations

**Role summary**

You will own the online sale of Y-Axis service products end to end: the product catalogue, the storefront and checkout, the traffic that reaches it, and the revenue it produces. This is a hands-on leadership role. You will set the strategy and do much of the work yourself, while directing existing marketing, web and CRM teams to execute.

**Key responsibilities**

**Strategy and revenue ownership**

•    Own the growth plan and revenue target for online service products, with clear goals for customer acquisition cost (CAC), return on ad spend (ROAS) and payback.

•    Decide which products, countries and customer segments to prioritise, using data on demand, margin and conversion.

•    Run a weekly growth review with clear owners, actions and results.

**Catalogue and offer**

•    Turn Y-Axis services into clear, buyable products: scope, inclusions, timelines, price points, tiers and bundles.

•    Write and maintain product pages, comparison tiles and FAQs that answer objections before they become sales calls.

•    Work with finance and operations on pricing, refunds, instalments and payment options.

**Storefront, checkout and conversion**

•    Own the sales-page and checkout journey on y-axis.com, from product tiles to payment and confirmation.

•    Brief design and development on new pages and features; write clear requirements and test before launch.

•    Build trust into every step: reviews, success stories, credentials, guarantees and a transparent process.

•    Run A/B tests on headlines, pricing display, trust signals, creatives and checkout steps.

**Acquisition and retention**

•    Direct paid acquisition across Google, Meta, YouTube and affiliates for product-led campaigns.

•    Work with SEO and content teams to build organic demand for each product page.

•    Set up abandoned-cart recovery and lifecycle journeys across email, WhatsApp and SMS.

•    Design a hybrid path where high-intent buyers can move between self-serve checkout and a counsellor without friction.

•    Drive upsell and cross-sell to related services after the first purchase.

**Analytics and reporting**

•    Track the full funnel in GA4: sessions, product views, add-to-cart, checkout starts, payments and refunds.

•    Report weekly to leadership on revenue, conversion, CAC and drop-off points, with clear next actions.

**What we are looking for**

•    6–10 years in D2C, e-commerce or growth, with at least 3 in a service-based industry: edtech, immigration, study abroad, travel, healthcare, insurance, fintech or professional services.

•    Proven record of selling a service or digital product online, with numbers to show: revenue grown, conversion improved, CAC reduced.

•    Hands-on with GA4, tag management, A/B testing tools, landing-page builders and payment gateways (Razorpay, PayU, Stripe or similar).

•    Has managed paid media budgets with a clear return.

•    Understands high-consideration buying: long decision cycles, trust building and the hand-off between digital and human sales.

•    Clear, persuasive product copywriting in English; can brief developers and designers precisely.

•    Comfortable working without a dedicated team, influencing other teams to get things done.

**Good to have**

•    Experience launching a D2C or self-serve channel inside a sales-led business.

•    Knowledge of international markets (Europe, Gulf, Canada, Australia) and NRI or migrant audiences.

•    Familiarity with Salesforce, Salesforce Marketing Cloud and WhatsApp commerce.

**How we will measure success**

**Metric**

**What it tells us**

**Online service-product revenue vs target**

Is the channel delivering?

**Visit-to-purchase conversion rate**

Is the storefront doing its job?

**CAC and ROAS**

Is growth profitable?

**Average order value and cross-sell revenue**

Are tiers, bundles and upsells landing?

**Refund and cancellation rate**

Are we selling the right product to the right buyer?

**What we offer and how to apply**

**What we offer**

•    The chance to build a new revenue channel from the ground up, with leadership backing.

•    Direct impact on people's lives: every sale helps someone start an overseas career.

•    A strong brand, an established customer base and a large existing service catalogue to package and sell.

•    Competitive salary with performance-linked incentives.

**How to apply**

* Send your CV and a short note (no more than 300 words) to [email address]. In the note, tell us about one service or digital product you helped sell online: what you changed, and what happened to the numbers.

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

**What We Offer**

1. Fair, competitive compensation: Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability, and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.

2. Fast-track growth: You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.

3. Broad exposure: You see product, brand, events, retail, and operations, not one narrow slice.

4. Real ownership: Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.

2. You want a role with a fixed playbook already written.

3. You are not comfortable owning a P&L number.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

description:

Job Category
  
  
Customer Success
  
  
Job Details
  
  
******About Salesforce******
Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The world of work as we know it is changing and we're looking for Trailblazers who are passionate about bettering business and the world through AI, driving innovation, and keeping Salesforce's core values at the heart of it all.
  
  
Ready to level-up your career at the company leading workforce transformation in the agentic era? You’re in the right place! Agentforce is the future of AI, and you are the future of Salesforce.
  
  
**About Salesforce**
We’re Salesforce, the Customer Company, inspiring the future of business with AI+ Data +CRM. Leading with our core values, we help companies across every industry blaze new trails and connect with customers in a whole new way. And, we empower you to be a Trailblazer, too — driving your performance and career growth, charting new paths, and improving the state of the world. If you believe in business as the greatest platform for change and in companies doing well and doing good – you’ve come to the right place.
  
  
Cloud Success is a specialized team within Customer Success, bringing together customer support engineers, proactive monitoring, specialist product advisors and technical architects. This team not only resolves technical issues but also provides expert guidance on optimizing and leveraging Salesforce technology to drive long-term business success.
  
  
Success Architects, as part of Cloud Success, play a pivotal role in supporting Salesforce’s most critical and strategic customers. They provide expert guidance on solution design, ensuring scalability, security, and adherence to best practices. By assessing system performance, they help optimize efficiency and reliability while proactively identifying risks and recommending improvements to maintain technical health. Additionally, they offer strategic insights into application lifecycle management, enabling customers to plan, develop, and evolve their Salesforce implementations effectively. Through deep expertise, Success Architects empower businesses to maximize their Salesforce investment, aligning technology with business goals for long-term success.
  
  
The Success Architect collaborates closely with various teams across Customer Success and the Product organization to drive long-term solutions for customers. They work with support engineers to resolve immediate technical challenges while identifying root causes to prevent future issues. Partnering with customer success managers, they ensure customers receive strategic guidance on best practices and long-term technology health. Additionally, they liaise with Salesforce product teams, surfacing recurring challenges and customer feedback to influence product improvements. By bridging the gap between customers, support, and product development, Success Architects help create sustainable solutions that enhance the overall Salesforce experience.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities:****
As a Success Architect specializing in Service Cloud, you will:
  
  

* Drive Customer Impact – Partner with our most strategic and high-priority customers, assessing their Service Cloud implementations and delivering expert recommendations on technical architecture, solution design, application lifecycle management, reliability and feature adoption.
* Lead with Expertise – Serve as a trusted Service Cloud SME within the broader Success Architect organization, providing both proactive and reactive guidance on architecture, technology strategy, thought leadership and product best practices. You will help the team stay at the forefront of Service Cloud innovations, ensuring they are equipped with the latest product developments, best practices and emerging trends.
* Communicate with Clarity – Simplify complex technical concepts for diverse audiences, from technical teams to executive leadership, positioning yourself as a trusted advisor in key business and technology discussions.
* Innovate & Solve Problems – Identify capability gaps and design inefficiencies, recommending product enhancements or creative custom solutions that drive customer success and long-term adoption.
* Execute Proven Strategies – Leverage and tailor Success Architect playbooks to meet the unique challenges and opportunities of Service Cloud customers.
* Build Strong Relationships – Collaborate with internal and external partners, fostering connections that drive customer success, product improvement and overall business growth.
* Flexible to work in AMER hours (AMER EST/AMER PST)

****Basic Requirements:****

* Solution Design & Architecture
* 8+ years of experience in software, system or enterprise architecture.
* Expertise in Salesforce products, platform capabilities, technical governance and best practices.
* Experience with large-scale, complex implementations, including SaaS, PaaS multi-tenancy, and multi-tiered infrastructure.
* Strong knowledge of enterprise application integration, covering process orchestration, master data management, AI, analytics and security best practices.
* Familiarity with industry- or vertical-specific solutions (preferred).
* Communication & Leadership
* Ability to assess business objectives, propose solution options and drive stakeholder alignment.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to present complex technical concepts to both business and executive audiences.
* Skilled in creating clear, visually compelling design documents for diverse stakeholders.
* Proven ability to lead discussions, influence decision-making and advocate for best practices.
* High proficiency in English.
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Ability to identify design inefficiencies, recommend optimizations and drive customer transformation.
* Provide data-driven insights on customer success stories and industry trends.
* Passion for continuous learning and staying ahead of emerging technologies.

**Desired Technical Skills:**

* Expertise in Service Cloud - Strong knowledge of Salesforce Service Cloud features
* Ability to configure and optimize these features to meet business needs.
* Data Management & Integration
* Proficient in designing and managing data models, relationships (lookup/master-detail), validation rules and data governance best practices.
* Experience with data import/export strategies, deduplication, ETL tools, and integrating Salesforce with external systems via REST/SOAP APIs, middleware (MuleSoft, Informatica) and third-party connectors.
* Secure & Scalable Architecture
* Expertise in role hierarchy, sharing rules, profiles, permission sets and security configurations.
* Proven ability to design scalable, high-performance architectures aligned with Salesforce best practices, including Large Data Volume (LDV) considerations.
* Skilled in identifying and resolving common anti-patterns, including inefficient SOQL queries, improper bulk processing, excessive DML operations and suboptimal sharing and security model configurations.
* Salesforce Development
* Hands-on experience with APEX programming, Visualforce and Lightning Web Components (LWC).
* Ability to develop and optimize custom triggers, controllers, batch jobs and asynchronous processing.
* Familiarity with governor limits and best practices for efficient code execution.
* System Integration & Extensibility
* Strong understanding of integrating Salesforce with other enterprise systems using APIs, middleware and event-driven architectures.
* Experience working with OAuth, Platform Events, External Objects and tools like Salesforce Connect and Event Relay.

****Certifications:****

* Required: Salesforce Admin, Salesforce Advanced Admin, Service Cloud Consultant
* Desired: Platform App Builder, Platform Developer 1, Certified Architect Credentials (Application and System Architect)

Unleash Your Potential
  
  
When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and
*be your best*
, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can
*do your best*
. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.

title: Premier Service Manager
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Business Descriptor**
International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) helps deliver on HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing our customers with borderless banking and world-class wealth management through best-in-class, mobile-first capabilities, and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enable us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors, and entrepreneurs. International Wealth and Premier Banking provides a leading premium proposition through Premier Banking and, together with our Private Bank, are present across the world’s most important markets, booking centres, and corridors most valued by our clients. Our wealth offering is further enhanced through our best-in-class manufacturing capabilities in Asset Management and Insurance.
  
  
**Job Introduction**
The Premier Service Manager (PSM) role is a pivotal position within the International Wealth and Premier Banking (IWPB) branch network. IWPB is executing a multiyear growth strategy, pivoted on positioning as a global bank, committed to the long-term India growth story, and bringing to India its full scale of global capabilities. The business is poised for growth and is currently adding 20 more branches in phases to its existing fleet of 26 branches. This role is customer-facing, primarily servicing walk-in customers and managing their requirements to ensure satisfaction. The Premier proposition is a strategic priority for HSBC, and this role supports the Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) in achieving their objectives by enhancing client-facing time and providing outstanding customer experiences.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Provide high-quality support to a team of Premier Relationship Managers (PRMs) to achieve income plans through acquisition, cross-sales, retention, and growth.
* Act as the first point of contact for clients in the absence of PRMs, ensuring seamless service and relationship management.
* Build extensive knowledge of HSBC systems and procedures to effectively handle client needs and improve process efficiencies.
* Proactively identify opportunities to enhance customer service and process efficiencies.
* Ensure clients consistently receive professional, premium service that exceeds expectations.
* Maintain high standards of control and operational practices in line with HSBC’s expectations.
* Enhance customer confidence in HSBC’s Global Premier proposition through systematic and regular communication.
* Attain key performance indicators (KPIs) by acquiring new customers and promoting credit card and general insurance products.
* Meet KPIs for referrals and cross-selling opportunities.

**Education Qualifications / Certifications And Requirements**

* Graduate Degree
* Minimum of two to five years of experience in a customer service or banking environment.
* Holistic understanding of branch operations and processes.
* Sound understanding of the company’s customer service requirements.

**Other Requirements (Knowledge And Experience)**

* Exceptional and updated knowledge of banking products, systems, and processes.
* Well-organized with a professional image and extraordinary business focus.
* Strong customer orientation and ability to provide exemplary service.
* Self-motivated with the drive to overachieve on goals and targets.
* Ability to build close relationships with team members and skillful association with support group colleagues.

**Skills**

* Exceptional Communication Skills: Ability to convey information clearly and effectively across various channels.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Capable of building and maintaining positive relationships with colleagues and clients.
* Highly Organized: Demonstrates meticulous attention to detail and efficient task management.
* Collaborative Team Player: Works well within a team, contributing to collective goals and fostering a supportive environment.
* Proactive and Efficient: Acts swiftly and decisively to achieve objectives, ensuring timely completion of tasks.

**Regulatory Certifications**
FEDAI, NISM (Demat), and IRDA certifications are preferred or should be obtained / transferred to HSBC mapping within 3 to 6 months of onboarding.
  
  
**Additional Notes**

* Familiarity with AI-enabled tools is an advantage.
* Mandatory to successfully complete Anti-Money Laundering and Sanctions training and post-course assessment, as required.

As an employee, you are required to perform your duties in a professional capacity exercising independent judgement, discretion and decision-making authority in planning, organising, directing work, supervising and appraising the work of team members, as applicable; and taking accountability for delivery outcomes. You will represent the organization with relevant internal and external stakeholders. You will allocate and prioritize work, provide direction and feedback, manage team capacity and leave in line with policy as applicable.
  
  
You’ll achieve more at HSBC.
  
  
HSBC is committed to building a culture where all employees are valued, respected and opinions count. We take pride in providing a workplace that fosters continuous professional development, flexible working and opportunities to grow within an inclusive and diverse environment.
  
  
Personal data held by the Bank relating to employment applications will be used in accordance with our Privacy Statement, which is available on our website.
  
  
Issued by The Hongkong and Shanghai Banking Corporation Limited, India

title: Senior Relationship Manager
description:
**Company Description**
India Shelter Finance Corporation Ltd. (ISFC) is an affordable housing finance company with a 12-year track record, operating across 15 states in India. The organization focuses on providing housing and small-ticket loans against property to primarily self-employed customers with informal income documentation. Its products include financing for new home purchases, home expansion and upgrades, construction on previously owned land, and loans against property. ISFC has built a hassle-free loan management process designed to serve middle- and lower-income segments and supports home ownership dreams with loans up to Rs 30 lakhs. The head office is located in Gurugram, Haryana.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time, on-site Senior Relationship Manager role based in Hyderabad. The role involves acquiring and managing customers seeking affordable housing loans and loans against property, with a focus on self-employed and informally documented income profiles. The Senior Relationship Manager will meet prospective customers, understand their financial needs, explain product features, collect and verify documentation, and coordinate with credit and operations teams to ensure timely loan processing. Responsibilities include maintaining strong relationships with existing customers, monitoring repayment behavior, addressing service issues, and supporting portfolio quality and growth targets. The role also requires collaboration with local partners and internal stakeholders, regular field visits, and adherence to regulatory and company policies.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong relationship management and customer service skills, including the ability to build trust with diverse customer segments.
* Experience in retail lending or housing finance, preferably handling self-employed or informal income customers.
* Ability to assess basic financial information, understand credit risk, and work with documentation relevant to housing loans and loans against property.
* Effective communication and negotiation skills, with proficiency in local language(s) and clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Comfort with field-based work, including regular customer visits, local market engagement, and on-site verification.
* Working knowledge of standard office and loan management systems; ability to learn new digital tools quickly.
* Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, commerce, or a related field; relevant experience in financial services or housing finance is highly preferred.
* Demonstrated integrity, attention to detail, and a strong focus on responsible lending and regulatory compliance.

title: VP, Product Management - Applied Intelligence
description:
**Who We Are**

Finance leaders choose Billtrust to get paid faster, control costs, and maximize customer satisfaction. As the leader in B2B accounts receivable workflow and payment software, we provide the world's leading brands with AI-powered solutions across the full AR lifecycle—from invoice presentment and payment processing to cash application and collections. With over 2,600 global customers, more than $1 trillion in invoice dollars processed, and a proprietary network of 13 million buyers, Billtrust delivers business value through deep industry expertise and a culture relentlessly focused on meaningful customer outcomes.

We're an AI-first company, not just in what we build for our customers, but in how we work. Across every function, our teams use AI tools daily to work faster, make better decisions, and deliver higher-quality outcomes. We hire exceptional people, give them cutting-edge AI capabilities, and measure success by the impact they create. If you want to do the best work of your career at the frontier of AI and fintech, Billtrust is the place to do it.

**Our Values**

**Customers**

We relentlessly increase value for customer and do the right thing for them.

**Action**

We make 'thoughtfully fast' decisions, act quickly, cut through red tape, deliver progress not perfection, take ownership and accountability.

**Team Spirit**

We put the team ahead of ourselves, foster trust and respect, collaborate with passion, despise toxic politics, value our differences, and celebrate together.

**Innovation**

We challenge the status quo, experiment thoughtfully, and are novel and brilliant in what we create.

**Excellence**

We love to win, but we hate losing even more. We aspire to be the best and take pride in our work. When we fall short, we own it and come back stronger.

**About the Role:**

The VP, Applied Intelligence is a Senior leadership role accountable for setting the AI vision that defines Billtrust's next chapter. You will harness AI tools, co-worker agents, and frontier intelligence capabilities to architect a product strategy that reshapes how 2,600+ global customers experience the future of B2B finance — bringing the irreplaceable human judgment required to turn transformative technology into durable competitive advantage.

Reporting to the Chief Product Officer and operating as a key member of the Product leadership team, you will own Billtrust's Applied Intelligence agenda end-to-end: setting the multi-year roadmap, building and inspiring a world-class organization, and serving as the company's most senior external voice on AI-powered B2B finance. This role demands more than AI expertise alone. It requires a genuine understanding of how

money moves through complex B2B relationships, and what it takes to replace manual, error-prone financial workflows with intelligent automation that customers trust with their cash. This is an executive mandate to define what an AI-first AR platform looks like, and to make it real at scale.

**What You'll Do:**

**AI Strategy & Executive Leadership**

* Set Billtrust's Applied Intelligence vision and multi-year product roadmap, establishing the strategic framework that guides how AI shapes every layer of the AR lifecycle.

* Serve as a member of the Product leadership team, shaping company-wide product strategy and influencing investment priorities at the executive level.

* Define the operating model for how Applied Intelligence is built, deployed, and continuously improved — including governance, evaluation standards, and responsible AI principles.

* Other duties as assigned.

**Product Development & AI Innovation**

* Own the end-to-end product lifecycle for Billtrust's AI-powered capabilities — from opportunity identification and experimentation through scaled delivery and ongoing iteration — leveraging co-worker agents and AI tooling to compress timelines and raise quality.

* Establish rigorous frameworks for evaluating AI product performance, accuracy, reliability, and customer safety before and after deployment.

* Drive a culture of bold experimentation: define hypotheses, design tests, interpret results, and champion the learnings that most accelerate product-market fit.

* Partner with Engineering, Data Science, and Design to translate frontier AI capabilities into intuitive, production-grade customer experiences.

**Organization Building & Talent**

* Recruit, develop, and retain a high-caliber team of product managers and applied AI practitioners, building one of the most sought-after AI product organizations in B2B fintech.

* Champion AI-first ways of working across the entire Product organization, setting the standard for how leaders and ICs leverage AI tools to amplify impact.

* Create clear career pathways and a coaching culture that elevates team members into future leaders of AI product development.

**Market Presence & Commercial Impact**

* Serve as Billtrust's most senior external voice on Applied Intelligence — representing the company at industry events, in analyst conversations, and in strategic customer and partner engagements.

* Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Customer Success to ensure AI differentiation is clearly communicated and consistently converted into pipeline and retention.

* Engage directly with key customers to co-create AI solutions, gather strategic insight, and validate roadmap direction against real-world complexity.

  
**What You'll Bring:**

**Required Skills:**

* 12+ years of experience in product management, applied AI, or a related field, with significant tenure in executive or senior VP-level product leadership.

* Demonstrated experience setting AI strategy and driving AI-first transformation at scale across a product organization or business unit.

* Deep understanding of machine learning, large language models, agentic AI frameworks, and how these capabilities translate into production-grade B2B product experiences.

* Proven track record of building and scaling high-performing applied AI product teams in a fast-moving enterprise SaaS or fintech environment.

* Fluency in FinTech data: how financial data is structured, how it flows across ERP systems, payment networks, and AR workflows, and why data quality and latency matter differently in financial contexts than in general SaaS.

* Executive presence and communication skills that inspire confidence across the C-suite, board, customers, partners, and external audiences.

* Strong commercial acumen — able to connect AI product investment directly to revenue growth, retention, and competitive differentiation.

**Preferred Skills:**

* Direct experience in Order to Cash, accounts receivable, cash application, collections, or B2B payments — either building products in this space or operating within it at enterprise scale.

* Familiarity with the data structures and integration patterns common in AR automation: ERP connectors, remittance data, invoice line-item detail, payment status feeds, and buyer identity resolution.

* Hands-on familiarity with agentic AI architectures, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG), or multi-model orchestration in enterprise production environments.

* Track record of representing product vision externally — at conferences, in analyst briefings, or in strategic customer advisory settings.

* Experience co-creating AI solutions with enterprise customers and translating those partnerships into roadmap impact and revenue.

title: Customer Renewal Manager
description:
**Our Company**
At Teradata, we believe that people thrive when empowered with better information. Teradata Autonomous Knowledge Platform activates enterprise intelligence by unifying data, knowledge and business context to achieve tangible outcomes. With Teradata, organizations can provide agents with full context for impact when it matters. Our solution lets businesses connect and scale on premises, in the cloud, or through a hybrid approach. Teradata delivers real business value with AI.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
The Customer Renewal Manager (CRM) is responsible for driving the end-to-end renewal lifecycle for assigned customers in a defined Unit/Area. As part of Teradata’s Go-To-Market (GTM) organization, this position will serve as the primary role responsible for sustaining/renewing customers and growing our ARR baseline. The CRM will partner closely with the Account team including Customer Experience and Finance to ensure effective account collaboration and cancels and erosions prevention.
  
  
The CRM will be responsible for managing several customers to business objectives including recurring revenue retention and growth, on-time renewal execution, expansions, and outlook accuracy. The CRM will work with the account team on account planning to identify customer needs/risks and opportunities both in preparation for upcoming renewals as well as mid-term adjustments and Cloud opportunities. The CRM is responsible for being the expert in Teradata’s renewal/sustainment strategy and works directly with the customer to negotiate standard and custom renewals including terms, SLAs and penalties. The CRM will align the renewal strategy with the Account Executive (AE), Customer Solution Architect (CSA) and wider account team to achieve optimal results.
  
  
A key responsibility of the CRM is completing and executing preventive actions on Cancellations and Erosions, leveraging early insights and collaborating with Field Technology Management, Services Delivery Management and Customer Services Management. The CRM will be responsible for the development, application and delivery of cancel and erosion save plans alongside the Customer Services Architect (CSA), with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention; in addition to the identification of upsell and cross sell.
  
  
As an integrated member of the GTM account team, this role is primarily responsible for retaining recurring revenue across Teradata’s business through exceptional renewal sales execution. This includes building and maintaining strong partnerships with both internal and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**Renewal Scope Areas Include**
:
  
  

* Basic understanding of the components that make up a renewal in order to articulate the e2e solution.
* Understanding of sales process including managing account relationships and customer interaction.
* Renewals includes any revenue in Teradata that has been previously sold and should be retained through repeat contracting on a scheduled basis, including Term, Cloud, Maintenance and SWUR.
* Turn-key Renewals: CRM will own the oversight of the renewal process, managing customer engagement supported by the process from the back-office teams.
* Upsell/Cross-Sell/New-Sell: In certain circumstances the CRM will own the sales cycle for the generation of new revenue. This will be part of the normal renewal lifecycle in accounts, where there is opportunity to expand the scope of the renewal to new business, like increasing a customer support Success Tier and Cloud services.
* Customer Presentations: Prepare and deliver customer presentations to align with business objectives and ensure common understanding of scope of work and renewal strategy. Renewal Contract documentation: Be responsible for overseeing or/and preparation & development of renewal contract/SOW as necessary.
* Technical knowledge of database systems, operating systems (desirable)

**Account planning, selling and negotiating are core elements of success in this role. This role will focus on:**

* Effective account planning and renewal preparation, leveraging the entire Teradata portfolio to protect and drive recurring revenue growth
* Renewing Teradata's recurring revenue footprint with existing customers with on-time accuracy and oversight of all contract lifecycle management activities
* Creation and execution of Cancel and Erosion save plans, with the aim to increase customer retention and revenue retention.
* Maintaining forecast accuracy and participating in Sales Outlook cadence calls
* Participate in quarterly services delivery and operational excellence reviews
* Capable of understanding Teradata analytic technology, to find the customer value and competitive position that drives price in opportunities for customer use of Teradata products and services
* Creative thinker able to come up with alternatives that increase offer effectiveness and protect current and future price realization
* Ability to work closely with sales and sales management, and draw on other company resources
* The ability to professionally discuss business issues with management and offer advice and alternatives
* Ability to review and interpret complex contract/customer agreement detail

It will be vital for the CRM to build strong relationships and drive collaboration with other functions in the business.
  
  
**What Makes You a Qualified Candidate**

* BSc/BA degree or equivalent
* Minimum of 5 years related work experience

**What You Bring**

* Demonstrated sales success managing account relationships and developing new account opportunities
* Ability to work with multiple Customers at the same time including capturing each engagement’s discussions, notes, follow-up, issues, etc.
* Ability to work successfully at the intersection of business, technology and services and translate/communicate across both
* Presence: enthusiastic and high energy, but also poised, confident and extremely professional
* Innovative and assertive, with the ability to pick up new technologies and assess situations quickly
* Fluent in the following tools:
* Salesforce, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint, ERP, Install Base and Contract Lifecycle Management solutions
* Advanced interpersonal, listening and communication skills, including presentation and facilitation skills, and a track record of effectively communicating with and influencing at all levels
* Must possess excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Proven project and time management skills with ability to thrive in a fast-paced, team environment and handle multiple tasks simultaneously.
* Demonstrate personal and professional values consistent with Teradata’s values.
* Be highly collaborative, transparent, organised, detail oriented and a stickler for accuracy

**Why We Think You’ll Love Teradata**
We prioritize a people-first culture because we know our people are at the very heart of our success. We embrace a flexible work model because we trust our people to make decisions about how, when, and where they work. We focus on well-being because we care about our people and their ability to thrive both personally and professionally. We are an anti-racist company because our dedication to Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion is more than a statement. It is a deep commitment to doing the work to foster an equitable environment that celebrates people for all of who they are.
  
  
Teradata invites all identities and backgrounds in the workplace. We work with deliberation and intent to ensure we are cultivating collaboration and inclusivity across our global organization. ​ We are proud to be an equal opportunity and affirmative action employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, color, ancestry, religion, creed, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, breastfeeding, or related conditions), national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, medical condition, genetic information, gender identity or expression, military and veteran status, or any other legally protected status.

With offices across India, the USA, Singapore, UAE, and Bangladesh, Hansa combines global reach with deep consumer understanding to deliver actionable insights. It pioneered industry benchmarks such as the Indian Readership Survey, Household Potential Index, and Indian Outdoor Survey, and was the first Indian insights and consulting company to acquire a US-based firm, GCR. Backed by a group with nearly five decades of expertise, 1,500+ employees, and 250+ clients, Hansa Research delivers research, analytics, and integrated marketing solutions that help businesses make informed decisions.

**Roles & Responsibilities:**

**Client Servicing & Relationship Management**

* Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients and ensure effective communication throughout the engagement lifecycle.
* Understand client requirements, business objectives, research expectations, budgets, and timelines.
* Coordinate with internal research, operations, analytics, and project teams to address client queries and ensure timely responses.
* Maintain regular client communication, provide project updates, and proactively address concerns or escalations.
* Ensure a high level of client satisfaction through responsive service, solution-oriented communication, and consistent delivery standards.
* Gather client feedback and identify opportunities to improve service quality and strengthen long-term relationships.
* Support client presentations, project review meetings, and discussions on research findings and recommendations, in coordination with relevant internal teams.

**Business Development & New Client Acquisition**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across the Indian market across categories and sectors
* Proactively generate leads through email outreach, cold calling, professional networking platforms, industry events, conferences, referrals, and existing business networks.
* Identify key decisionmakers within client organizations, including insights managers, marketing heads, consumer research teams, brand managers, and strategic planning teams.
* Pitch Hansa Research's services, research capabilities, methodologies, and solutions to prospective clients.
* Develop and maintain a healthy sales pipeline, track opportunities, and ensure timely follow-ups to convert leads into business.
* Achieve agreed monthly, quarterly, and annual business development and revenue targets.

**Account Management & Revenue Growth**

* Manage and grow a portfolio of existing client accounts by developing strong, long-term business relationships.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, cross-selling, and upselling across research services, methodologies, and industry-specific solutions.
* Develop a thorough understanding of client businesses, research calendars, annual budgets, and upcoming research requirements.
* Prepare account development plans for key clients, with clear revenue growth objectives and engagement strategies.
* Monitor account performance, revenue contribution, project pipeline, and client satisfaction.
* Build relationships with multiple stakeholders within client organisations to expand Hansa Research's engagement across teams, brands, and business units.
* Work towards improving client retention, repeat business, account profitability, and overall wallet

**Proposal, Quotation & Commercial Management**

* Review and understand client briefs, Requests for Quotation (RFQs), Requests for Proposals (RFPs), and research requirements.
* Coordinate with internal research and operations teams to develop appropriate research designs, methodologies, sample plans, timelines, and cost estimates.
* Prepare and submit proposals, quotations, presentations, and commercial documents within agreed timelines.
* Ensure proposals clearly communicate the research approach, scope of work, deliverables, timelines, assumptions, exclusions, and commercials.
* Manage commercial negotiations with clients while ensuring alignment with internal pricing guidelines, project feasibility, and profitability objectives.
* Follow up on submitted proposals, address client queries, revise commercials where required, and track conversion rates.
* Coordinate internally on purchase orders, vendor registration, client documentation, invoicing requirements, and payment follow-ups, as applicable.

**ESSENTIAL SKILLS/COMPETENCIES**

1. Client servicing and relationship building
2. Business development
3. Strategic account management
4. Commercial and proposal management
5. Stakeholder and cross-functional coordination

Experience Required: 10-15 years

**Qualification: Graduate /Postgraduate**

**Note :**

Should have experience in Business development /Client Servicing role

Preferred work experience in Market Research agency

If interested, please share your CVs on nithya.velayudhan@hansaresearch.com

title: Corporate Partnerships Manager
description:
**Senior Manager, Corporate Partnerships & Tie-ups**

Maiz Hospitality is hiring a senior corporate partnerships lead to win corporate tie-ups and bulk orders for Maiz Mexican Kitchen and Harvest Salad Co outlets across cities.

**The role**

Our outlets sit next to tech parks, large offices, campuses and co-working spaces full of people who eat out every day. Today, corporate relationships depend on outlet teams on top of their day jobs.

You will own this full time. You open doors at companies, close recurring and bulk deals, and make sure our outlets deliver on every promise. Winning deals and bringing in bulk orders is the heart of this job.

**What you will do**

* **Build the target list.**

  Map companies around every Maiz and Harvest outlet, starting with tech companies, tech parks, co-working spaces and large offices.
* **Open the right doors.**

  Reach HR, admin, facilities, employee-engagement and procurement heads, and get meetings with decision-makers.
* **Close deals.**

  Win long-term corporate bulk deals, catering and event orders, and recurring employee meal programmes.
* **Set up tie-ups.**

  Build partnerships with meal-card and employee-benefit platforms and other organisations that bring us steady footfall.
* **Negotiate and price.**

  Agree prices and terms within our pricing guardrails, and protect margins on every deal.
* **Make delivery work.**

  Brief Area Managers and outlet managers on each deal, and make sure orders go out on time and to standard.
* **Follow through.**

  Keep every lead, deal and follow-up tracked, coordinate billing and collections with finance, and keep accounts ordering again.
* **Report.**

  Share a weekly view of pipeline, closed deals and billed sales with the Founder's Office team.
* **Travel.**

  Meet clients and visit outlets across the cities where we operate.

**Who we are looking for**

This is a senior role. It is not suited to freshers or to inside-sales and tele-calling profiles, because it runs on relationships you already hold.

**Must have**

* 4+ years in B2B sales, corporate partnerships or key-account roles.
* A record of closing recurring corporate deals or bulk orders. Be ready to tell us who the client was, how big the deal was and how long it ran.
* Existing relationships with decision-makers in tech companies and other large employers. You should be able to name the companies you can get us into in your first weeks.
* Well-spoken and confident in meetings with senior people, with clear written follow-up.
* Comfortable travelling often across cities.
* Comfortable with numbers: pricing, margins and order sizes.
* Self-driven, with a habit of following every lead through to a closed deal.

**Strong plus**

* Background in QSR, food and beverage, catering, corporate cafeterias, food-tech, meal cards or employee-benefit platforms.
* A network in more than one of the cities where we have outlets.
* Experience working with operations or outlet teams to deliver what you sold.

**What success looks like**

* **First 60 days:**

  a target list for every outlet area, meetings running with decision-makers, and your first corporate deals closed.
* **By 6 months:**

  several recurring corporate accounts live and ordering repeatedly, with a pipeline reviewed every week.
* **By 12 months:**

  corporate and bulk orders are a steady, growing share of dine-in sales across cities, and accounts are renewing.

We will measure you on billed sales from deals you bring in, the number of active recurring accounts, how often accounts reorder, and the strength of your pipeline.

title: Head– Wealth Advisory & Business Growth
description:
About Fintoo

Fintoo is a SEBI-registered Investment Adviser and a fee-based financial planning firm offering holistic financial planning, investment advisory, global investing and tax advisory services. Our philosophy is simple: planning comes before execution, and client interests come first. We combine professional advice with technology to help individuals make informed financial decisions and work towards their life goals.

Your Mandate

You will be accountable for building Fintoo’s Mumbai advisory business across four dimensions: business growth, advisory excellence, client relationships and team leadership. You will lead from the front, personally engage with key prospects and clients, establish a predictable business pipeline and create a high-performance culture focused on ownership, ethical advice and measurable outcomes.

Key Responsibilities

1. Business Building & Revenue Ownership

• Own the Mumbai business plan, revenue targets, growth strategy and profitability.

• Develop and execute a go-to-market strategy for affluent professionals, HNI clients and other relevant customer segments.

• Build a predictable pipeline through referrals, professional networks, chartered accountants, corporate relationships and strategic alliances.

• Personally lead key client conversations, business negotiations and high-value conversions.

• Manage the customer journey from prospecting and discovery to financial planning, paid engagement, onboarding and long-term advisory.

• Identify growth opportunities, improve conversion ratios and strengthen revenue productivity; present forecasts and quarterly plans to senior management.

2. Wealth Advisory & Financial Planning Excellence

• Champion a planning-led, fiduciary and client-first advisory approach.

• Understand clients’ goals, income, liabilities, risk profiles, liquidity needs and investment horizons to support comprehensive financial planning.

• Ensure recommendations are appropriate to clients’ circumstances and objectives, supported by suitable documentation and disclosures.

• Drive holistic financial planning and long-term advisory relationships rather than transactional, product-led selling.

• Lead periodic portfolio reviews, goal tracking and proactive client engagement, working with research, investment, product and technology teams to improve advice quality.

3. AUA Growth, Client Retention & Relationships

• Grow AUA sustainably through appropriate client acquisition, retention and deeper advisory engagement.

• Convert paid financial planning customers into ongoing advisory relationships wherever appropriate.

• Improve renewals, referrals, customer lifetime value and relationship longevity through consistent service and demonstrable advisory value.

• Establish client segmentation, engagement frequency, review and escalation frameworks.

• Personally manage key relationships and strategic prospects where senior-level engagement can accelerate business outcomes.

4. Team Leadership & Organisation Building

• Lead an initial team of six professionals across relevant advisory, relationship management and business development responsibilities.

• Set clear KRAs, revenue goals, productivity benchmarks and accountability mechanisms.

• Recruit, coach and develop professionals with financial planning capabilities, client orientation and commercial acumen.

• Build a high-performance culture based on ownership, collaboration, integrity and continuous learning.

• Conduct regular performance reviews, pipeline reviews and capability-building initiatives; identify and develop future leaders.

• Scale the team in line with approved budgets, business growth, revenue productivity and demonstrated performance.

5. Business Planning, Analytics & Profitability

• Translate annual objectives into actionable quarterly and monthly plans.

• Track revenue, conversion ratios, paid customer acquisition, AUA growth, client retention and individual productivity.

• Identify performance gaps early and implement corrective actions.

• Balance growth investment, acquisition costs, team capacity and profitability.

• Build dashboards and repeatable processes that support scale without compromising advisory quality. 6. Technology & Cross-Functional Leadership

• Partner with product and technology teams to improve advisory workflows, customer experience and advisor productivity.

• Use digital tools, analytics, automation and AI-enabled solutions to make financial advice more scalable and accessible.

• Collaborate with marketing on targeted campaigns, financial education and lead generation.

• Work with operations, finance and compliance teams to ensure efficient execution and robust governance.

• Share market and customer insights to inform advisory products and business strategy.

7. Governance, Ethics & Client Trust

• Uphold Fintoo’s fiduciary, fee-based and client-first advisory philosophy.

• Ensure activities comply with applicable SEBI requirements, internal policies and ethical standards. • Maintain high standards of client suitability, documentation, disclosures and transparency.

• Ensure business targets never compromise the quality or integrity of financial advice.

What We Are Looking For

• 8–12 years of relevant experience in wealth management, financial planning, investment advisory or a related BFSI business.

• At least four years of demonstrated experience leading teams and delivering measurable business results.

• A proven track record of building a business, acquiring clients and achieving revenue targets.

• Strong understanding of comprehensive financial planning, investment advisory, asset allocation and relationship management.

• Experience working with affluent professionals and HNI clients, with the ability to build credibility and long-term relationships.

• Commercial judgment, analytical ability and ownership of business performance.

• Demonstrated ability to hire, coach, motivate and scale teams in a growth-oriented environment. • Excellent communication, negotiation, presentation and stakeholder management skills.

• Both NISM Series X-A and Series X-B certifications are mandatory.

title: Manager/Sr. Manager- Corporate Relations
description:
**Job Summary:**

Role Overview: As the Corporate Relations Manager, you will play a critical role in bridging the gap between academia and the industry. Your primary responsibility is to cultivate and maintain relationships with corporate partners to enhance the employability of students. By understanding the needs of both students and employers, you will ensure the effective placement of students into internships and full-time roles, as well as secure opportunities for long-term partnerships with companies.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. **Corporate Engagement & Partnership Development:**
2. Develop and manage relationships with a broad range of companies, industries, and sectors to secure internship and job placement opportunities for students.
3. Proactively reach out to new employers and strengthen relationships with existing corporate partners to build a robust network of hiring organizations.
4. Organize regular industry networking events, career fairs, and campus recruitment drives to facilitate direct interaction between students and corporate representatives.
5. **Employer Needs Analysis & Collaboration:**
6. Understand and analyze employer needs, hiring trends, and skill demands across industries.
7. Collaborate with corporate partners to identify areas where students’ skills align with industry expectations, ensuring placements are aligned with both student interests and market needs.
8. Facilitate industry feedback on student performance to continuously improve training programs, bridging skill gaps for greater employability.
9. **Strategic Placements & Internship Programs:**
10. Create and implement strategies to ensure high student placement rates in internships and full-time employment.
11. Work closely with the placement team to match students with opportunities that align with their career goals and qualifications.
12. Oversee and coordinate summer internship programs, including communication between employers, faculty, and students to ensure the quality of internship experiences.
13. **Alumni & Industry Expert Engagement:**
14. Leverage alumni networks to create opportunities for mentoring, internships, and job placements for current students.
15. Engage with industry leaders and alumni to deliver guest lectures, panel discussions, and skill development workshops to enhance student-industry interaction.
16. **Corporate Communication & Branding:**
17. Promote the university and its talent pool to corporate partners, showcasing students' skills and achievements to increase brand recognition and trust in the university’s offerings.
18. Create and manage marketing materials, presentations, and newsletters to communicate student achievements and placement success to corporate partners.
19. **Placement Data & Impact Reporting:**
20. Maintain and track placement data, ensuring that accurate records are kept regarding students’ placements, feedback from employers, and overall success metrics.
21. Analyze data to assess placement trends and create reports for internal stakeholders, demonstrating the impact of corporate relations activities.
22. **Collaboration with Career Services Team:**
23. Collaborate closely with the training and career counseling teams to ensure students are well-prepared for placement opportunities.
24. Provide insights and suggestions to the training manager on emerging skills in demand, ensuring that training programs are aligned with industry needs.
25. Align corporate partnerships with the institution’s long-term vision, working with faculty to embed industry requirements into the curriculum.

**Key Result Areas (KRAs):**

* Corporate Partnership Growth: Increase the number of companies participating in placement and internship programs, expanding the diversity of industries represented.
* Placement Success: Ensure high placement rates for both internships and full-time roles by aligning student preparation with corporate needs.
* Industry Feedback & Collaboration: Maintain an active loop of feedback from corporate partners to continuously improve the career services program.
* Student-Alumni-Industry Engagement: Facilitate meaningful interactions between students and alumni/industry leaders to support career exploration and employment opportunities.
* Employer Branding & University Reputation: Enhance the institution's reputation within the industry by effectively communicating student success and skills.

* Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities effectively.

**Experience**

Role Summary
  
  
The Sovereign Cloud Client Manager will lead Lenovo’s growth agenda for sovereign, private, hybrid and disconnected cloud solutions across strategic enterprise and public-sector customers. The role will identify, shape and close complex opportunities where data control, jurisdictional requirements, security, operational authority, resilience and regulatory compliance are critical.
  
  
The incumbent will act as the primary customer-facing sales leader, engaging CXOs, technology leaders, risk and compliance stakeholders, and lines of business. The role will orchestrate Lenovo infrastructure, services, software, security, financing and partner capabilities to deliver end-to-end sovereign cloud outcomes.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Strategic Account Leadership
  
  

* Own the sovereign cloud strategy and sales plan for a defined portfolio of high-potential accounts and sectors.
* Develop account plans, stakeholder maps, opportunity roadmaps and executive engagement strategies.
* Build trusted-advisor relationships with CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, CDOs, risk and compliance leaders, and business decision makers.
* Lead long-term transformation conversations rather than transactional infrastructure sales.

Sovereign Cloud Opportunity Creation
  
  

* Identify opportunities across sovereign private cloud, hybrid cloud, disconnected environments, data residency, regulated workloads, secure collaboration, sovereign AI and workload repatriation.
* Qualify customer requirements covering data location, access control, encryption-key custody, operational control, auditability, resilience and legal or regulatory exposure.
* Translate business, security and compliance challenges into measurable customer outcomes and compelling business cases.
* Build and maintain a robust, qualified pipeline with clear next steps, decision criteria and forecast discipline.

Solution Shaping Advisory
  
  

* Work with solution architects and services teams to define the customer’s target sovereignty posture and deployment model.
* Shape solutions spanning Lenovo ThinkAgile, compute, storage, networking, security, management, lifecycle services and as-a-service capabilities.
* Position hybrid and disconnected operating models based on workload criticality, regulatory needs, connectivity and operational requirements.
* Ensure the proposed architecture aligns infrastructure, software, services, governance and customer operating processes.

Pursuit Deal Management
  
  

* Lead pursuit strategy for complex, multi-stakeholder sovereign cloud opportunities.
* Orchestrate resources across ISG, SSG, product, pre-sales, security, finance, legal, delivery and business partners.
* Drive proposal development, bid governance, commercial negotiations, risk management and deal closure.
* Maintain opportunity hygiene, forecasting accuracy, review cadence and executive sponsorship.

Executive Ecosystem Engagement
  
  

* Create and execute CXO engagement plans, executive briefings, workshops and sovereignty discovery sessions.
* Position Lenovo as a strategic partner for secure, compliant and resilient cloud transformation.
* Collaborate with Microsoft and other cloud, software, security, networking and services partners to build differentiated solutions.
* Represent customer requirements internally and influence solution, go-to-market and investment priorities.

Success Measures
  
  

* Qualified sovereign cloud pipeline and progression through agreed sales stages.
* Revenue, margin and signings performance against assigned targets.
* Conversion of strategic opportunities and expansion within priority accounts.
* Quality of account plans, executive relationships, forecast accuracy and cross-functional execution.
* Customer adoption outcomes and creation of repeatable references or use cases.

Education Experience
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree required; full-time MBA preferred.
* 12-18 years of overall experience, including at least 10 years in enterprise technology sales.
* Minimum 3 years of consultative or value-based solution selling in cloud, data center, security, infrastructure, managed services or complex transformation programs.
* Demonstrated experience managing large accounts and multi-party pursuits involving customers, OEMs, cloud providers, software partners and system integrators.

Skills Competencies

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Mumbai Factory

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

minimizing disruptions from the factory floor to the customer’s door.

excellence and expertise, and automation in areas of Finance, Freight Forwarding, Marine Services,

Engineering and Human Resources, helping accelerate DP World’s growth and business transformation. As

diversity and an inclusive culture, we empower and up-skill our people with opportunities to perform at

their best. Join us and be part of an amazing team that is transforming the future of world trade.

**Designation**: Assistant Manager - Automation & Innovation - Global Service Centre

To lead the technical design, development standards, mentoring, training, and delivery governance for RPA

/ automation platforms and related automation solutions.

This role is critical because the team will include junior external hires as well as internal resources who

need to transition into RPA delivery capability.

 Lead the design and development of solutions using approved RPA / automation platforms.

 Define automation development standards, including workflow structure, selectors, exception handling,

logging, retry logic, testing, and documentation.

 Guide Automation Engineers in workflow design, debugging, selector creation, and production-readiness.

 Train and mentor internal Senior Automation Specialists to develop hands-on RPA skills.

 Establish a structured upskilling path for internal resources from Power Automate / BI / macro capability

into RPA / automation platform workflow development and automation support.

 Review automation designs before UAT and production deployment.

 Support complex debugging across browser automation, desktop automation, Excel, files, APIs, and

application workflows.

 Support architecture decisions for RPA / automation platforms, workflow orchestration, Windows runtime

machines, Git-based delivery, and unattended execution.

 Work with IT teams on VM setup, robot accounts, browser extensions, permissions, and deployment

requirements.

 Provide guidance on when to use RPA / automation platform, Power Automate, macros, Python, API-based

automation, or other tools. Help build reusable components, templates, runbooks, and automation support practices.

 Ensure internal resources are not only process contributors but are progressively capable of building,

testing, and supporting automations.

**Skills & Competencies:**

 8-12+ years of experience in automation, RPA, software development, or enterprise application

automation.

 Strong hands-on experience in at least one major RPA platform such as major RPA / automation platforms,

desktop automation tools, or equivalent automation tools.

 Strong understanding of workflow design, exception handling, retry logic, logging, and production support.

 Good knowledge of selectors, including XPath, CSS selectors, and Windows UI Automation.

 Strong debugging and root-cause analysis skills.

 Experience with Git or structured version control.

 Ability to mentor junior developers and train non-RPA internal resources into structured automation

developers.

 Good stakeholder communication and documentation skills.

**Preferred / Good-to-Have Skills**

 Experience with RPA platforms and workflow orchestration tools.

 Python knowledge.

 C# / .NET exposure.

 Node-RED or JavaScript knowledge.

 Power Automate, Power BI, and Excel macro/VBA exposure.

 API integration and JSON handling experience.

 Docker or basic infrastructure understanding.

 Agentic AI or AI-assisted automation awareness.

**Success Measures**

 Automation Engineers become productive within 2-3 months.

 Internal Senior Automation Specialists develop basic RPA / automation platform capability within 3 months.

 Internal Senior Automation Specialists can support or modify simple automations within 3-6 months.

 Team follows consistent standards for workflow design, selectors, logging, error handling, and

documentation.

 Production issues reduce through better design and reusable components.

 Clear development, testing, deployment, and support practices are established.

title: Key Account Manager Healthcare Global Account Program, Mumbai
description:
It's more than a job
  
  
With a sales career at Kuehne+Nagel, you'll drive long-term business success by mastering sales strategies, nurturing customer relationships and identifying new opportunities. But you will also bring relief and peace of mind to pet owners around the world. Because when you do your job, your colleagues around the world are able to build reliable veterinary supply chains that ensure pets get the care they need. At Kuehne+Nagel, our work is about more than we imagine.
  
  
‎
  
  
The Key Account Manager (KAM) is responsible for the end-to-end commercial customer journey (any relationship management and business development activities) related to his/her dedicated portfolio of accounts in the assigned scope of responsibility (GKAM or Network KAM).
  
  
Acts in that scope as the leading KN representative towards the customer across all KN services and business units, who qualifies account intelligence and translates same into addressable business targets. All captured in an evolving and agreed account plan/customer strategy process. Maintains and develops direct and personal relations with key customer stakeholders, and conducts key account management activities in accordance with KN’s Key Account Program guidelines.
  
  
Has a strong reach across the KN network including business units and supportive functional units, expert ability to translate the customers' requirements into an achievable plan and align with the business units and supportive functional units to action such business opportunities.
  
  
How you create impact
  
  

* Directly manages Key Account, in accordance with agreed targets, goals and based on company guidelines, eliciting customer needs and selling KN offer portfolio
* Understands the customers organization and decision making process
* Understands the customers business model and business environment as well as the competitive environment of the customer
* Negotiates rates and service contracts with customers in alignment with the BU’s and ensures all commercial requirements are documented and maintained as needed by the BU’
* Understand, at an expert level, the vertical service offerings of KN
* Complies with KN sales management processes and systems and ensures correct and timely updates (CRM/CoreLog system)
* Monitors monthly performance (pipeline, wins, losses, RFP opportunities, consulting activities, financial related including Days Sales Outstanding and Credit) against set targets, and ensures immediate actions taken in case of deviations (incl. timely / accurate reporting)
* Ensures that account plan is in place based on the Key Account Planning Process and template and signed off by the respective sales manager
* Effectively hands over and transitions new business into operations to ensure that customer requirements and KN commitments are met
* Conduct regular and structured review sessions with assigned customers including; process for continuous improvement and innovation, review of customer strategy and priorities as well as operational excellence delivery

What we would like you to bring
  
  

* Minimum 5 years of Key Account Management experience.
* Healthcare or pharmaceutical industry exposure.
* Proven business development and revenue growth track record.
* Knowledge of international logistics and freight forwarding.
* Experience managing global or regional accounts.
* Exposure to APAC markets and international networks.
* Strong account planning, upselling and cross-selling skills.
* Experience in sales targets, pricing and contract negotiations.
* Strong stakeholder management and English communication skills.
* Ability to drive commercial opportunities and coordinate with global teams.

What's in it for you
  
  

* Work with a Global Leader – Join one of the world’s top logistics companies with a strong international presence and reputation.
* Career Development – Access structured growth opportunities, professional training, and internal mobility within a global organization.
* Attractive Compensation – Competitive salary with performance-based incentives and benefits.
* Collaborative Work Culture – Be part of a supportive, ethical, and compliance-driven team environment.
* Local Role, Global Impact – Influence regional business growth while working with global tools, systems, and best practices.

Who we are
  
  
Logistics shapes everyday life - from the goods we consume to the healthcare we rely on. At Kuehne+Nagel, your work goes beyond logistics; it enables both ordinary and special moments in the lives of people around the world.
  
As a global leader with a strong heritage and a vision to move the world forward, we offer a safe, stable environment where your career can make a real difference. Whether we help deliver life-saving medicines, develop sustainable transportation solutions or support our local communities, your career will contribute to more than you can imagine.
  
We kindly advise that placement agencies refrain from submitting unsolicited profiles. Any submissions of candidates without prior signed agreement will be considered our property and no fees will be paid.
