title: Territory Business Manager
description:
**Company Description**

Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because **Good Health Can’t Wait**.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

 **Job Description**

**Job Summary**  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Business Manger” to drive sales of pharmaceutical products in your assigned territory. You will gather market intelligence, conduct prescription audits, and implement sales strategies to achieve sales targets. Additionally, you will manage queries from doctors, maintain customer relationships, and ensure accurate territory data management.  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**  

* You will be responsible for understanding market trends and competition status by gathering information from stockists and chemists and relaying this data to the Sales Business Manager (SBM) or Regional Sales Manager (RSM).
* You will be responsible for conducting Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) on doctors in the assigned area to identify potential high-prescribers and providing the final list of doctors likely to prescribe large quantities to the SBM/RSM for sales forecasting purposes.
* You will be responsible for attending relevant training programs and staying updated on product literature.
* You will be responsible for obtaining sales targets and promotion budget details from SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for utilizing the allocated budget to plan launch activities for different doctors, camps, or Continuing Medical Education (CME) sessions in the assigned area.
* You will be responsible for conducting regular sales pitches and presentations with doctors to promote products.
* You will be responsible for submitting reimbursement bills to SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for implementing marketing plans provided by the Product Manager.
* You will be responsible for gathering Point of Business (POB) details from chemists and coordinating with stockists to ensure product delivery.
* You will be responsible for monitoring and tracking sales of new products with chemists to achieve sales targets.
* You will be responsible for collecting queries from doctors regarding both new and existing products.
* You will be responsible for entering queries into the system for review by the Infogini team.
* You will be responsible for utilizing email responses from Infogini to address doctors' queries and increase prescriptions per doctor.
* You will be responsible for maintaining regular interactions with doctors to understand their prescription trends.
* You will be responsible for communicating prescription trend data to SBM/RSM.
* You will be responsible for keeping track of specific customer needs and providing feedback to Area Sales Manager (ASM), SBM/RSM, or Head Office (HO).
* You will be responsible for preparing lists of doctors for all CME events and submitting them to SBM/RSM to foster strong relationships and loyalty among doctors.
* You will be responsible for maintaining and updating data on doctor lists, route maps, retailers, and other supply chain contacts in the internal database.
* You will be responsible for ensuring accurate management of sales activities to optimize sales volume and effectiveness.

 **Qualifications**

**Educational qualification-** Graduate with science background.  
  
**Minimum work experience-** 3-5 years of experience in pharmaceutical sales.  
  
**Skills & attributes**  
**Technical Skills**  

* Deep understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing.
* Understanding of key trends in Pharmaceutical Sales.
* Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
* Basic knowledge of Computers.

**Behavioural Skills**  

* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
* Good at building and leveraging relationship.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
* Strong decision-making skills.

  
  
**Additional Information**

**About the Department**  
**Global Generics India**  
Global Generics India business journey began in 1986. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast-growing organisation with double-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.  
  
**Benefits Offered**  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.  
  
**Our Work Culture**  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.  
For more details, please visit our career website at **https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

description:

This role will support software delivery teams, IT service management processes, business processes, AI-enabled knowledge discovery, and enterprise service management use cases by ensuring Atlassian platforms are scalable, secure, well-governed, and easy to use.

The ideal candidate will work closely with IT, development, operations, and business stakeholders to translate process requirements into effective Jira configurations, automation rules, dashboards, workflows, and service management solutions.

=============================

**Platform Administration & Configuration**
-------------------------------------------

* Configure and maintain Jira projects, boards, workflows, issue types, custom fields, screens, schemes, and project templates.
* Manage permissions, roles, groups, user access, notification schemes, and security models to ensure appropriate access control and governance.
* Maintain platform standards for configuration consistency, scalability, and ease of administration.
* Monitor instance health, configuration quality, platform performance, and administrative hygiene.

--------------------------------------

* Configure and support Jira Service Management projects, request types, queues, forms, customer portals, and service workflows.
* Design and maintain SLAs, escalation rules, approval workflows, and service dashboards to improve operational visibility and responsiveness.
* Enable knowledge base integration with Confluence to support self-service and reduce repetitive support requests.

**Automation, Integration & Reporting**
---------------------------------------

* Design, implement, and maintain Jira automation rules to streamline repetitive tasks, improve data quality, and reduce manual effort.
* Support integrations between Jira, Confluence, Bitbucket, CI/CD tools, APIs, webhooks, and approved third-party applications.
* Develop dashboards and reports to track Agile delivery metrics, SLA compliance, service performance, backlog health, and operational trends.
* Identify opportunities to improve workflows, reporting, AI-assisted search, knowledge discovery, and platform usability through automation, Rovo capabilities, and configuration enhancements.

**User Support, Governance & Documentation**
--------------------------------------------

* Provide end-user support, troubleshooting, onboarding, and guidance for Jira Software, Jira Service Management, and Confluence.
* Create and maintain documentation, training materials, standards, and best practices for users and administrators.
* Manage user onboarding, access provisioning, role changes, and support processes in alignment with governance requirements.
* Collaborate with stakeholders to review requirements, recommend platform solutions, and ensure sustainable adoption.

====================================

**Required Skills**
-------------------

* Strong hands-on experience administering **Atlassian Jira Software** and **Jira Service Management** in a cloud environment.
* Proficiency in configuring workflows, screens, schemes, issue types, custom fields, permissions, and notification settings.
* Experience supporting ITSM practices, including request management, incident management, service workflows, SLAs, queues, and escalation paths.
* Working knowledge of Jira Automation, dashboard creation, filters, reports, and operational metrics.
* Strong understanding of user management, access control, security models, and governance practices.
* Ability to troubleshoot Jira-related performance, access, workflow, automation, and configuration issues.
* Experience administering or supporting Confluence, including knowledge base and documentation use cases.
* Strong communication skills with the ability to work with technical and business stakeholders.

**Preferred Skills**
--------------------

* Scripting experience using Groovy, Python, or related technologies.
* Experience with Jira migrations, including cloud-to-cloud project or instance migrations.
* Atlassian certifications such as **ACP-100** or **ACP-420** are preferred but not mandatory.
* Familiarity with Agile delivery practices, DevOps workflows, CI/CD tool integrations, and enterprise service management models.

Senior Manager, Process Automation COE

title: Project Scheduler
description:
**Job Description**

**ABOUT VICTAULIC**

**Victaulic, headquartered in Easton, Pennsylvania, is the global leader in mechanical pipe joining solutions, delivering advanced technologies and engineering services to address complex piping challenges faced by engineers, site owners and contractors. Since 1919, our innovative solutions have improved construction productivity and reduced risks, ensuring projects are completed safely, on time, and within budget. With over 6,000 employees spanning 50+ locations worldwide, our teams are dedicated to delivering advanced technologies and engineering expertise that address real-world challenges across a wide range of industries.**

**Our sustainable solutions, made from high quality, graded scrap steel, promote circular construction by making piping systems infinitely reconfigured and minimizing environmental impact. Today, our high-quality products are used in more than 140 countries, supporting some of the world’s most critical and prestigious structures.**

**Project Scheduler:-**

Planning, Scheduling & Resource Coordination | Monitoring, Forecasting & Management Reporting

**Department:-** VDC Operations

**Reports to:-** Senior BIM Manager

**POSITION SUMMARY:-**

The Project Scheduler develops and maintains integrated project schedules, coordinates resources against priorities and capacity, and monitors progress to surface risks early. This role provides the planning discipline and reporting rigor that keeps VDC activities aligned with engineering, fabrication, construction, and customer timelines.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:-**

* Create and maintain integrated project schedules covering design, coordination, reviews, approvals, and

deliverables.

* Coordinate resource loading with project priorities, available capacity, and required skill sets.
* Identify dependencies, constraints, and critical activities before they affect project milestones.
* Align VDC activities with engineering, fabrication, construction, and customer timelines.
* Standardize scheduling methods, milestone definitions, and progress measurements across projects.
* Improve work allocation by providing clear short-term and long-term priorities to the team. Monitoring, Forecasting & Management Reporting
* Track planned versus actual progress and highlight schedule risks, delays, and recovery needs early.
* Prepare weekly look-ahead plans, milestone status updates, and management dashboards.
* Forecast workload, resource demand, and potential bottlenecks to support staffing decisions.
* Coordinate with project leads to develop practical recovery plans and revised priorities.
* Improve accountability through clear ownership, target dates, and follow-up on commitments.
* Provide reliable schedule data for leadership reviews, customer updates, and business planning.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE:-**

* Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Proven experience as a scheduler or planner in a VDC, construction, or engineering environment.
* Proficiency with scheduling software (e.g., Primavera P6, Microsoft Project) and reporting/dashboard tools.
* Strong understanding of resource loading, critical path methodology, and milestone tracking.
* Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple concurrent project schedules.
* Strong communication skills to coordinate across engineering, fabrication, construction, and customer teams.

**KEY SUCCESS MEASURES:-**

* Schedule accuracy and on-time milestone delivery across projects.
* Early identification and mitigation of schedule risks and bottlenecks.
* Consistency of scheduling methods and reporting across the project portfolio.
* Quality and reliability of forecasting used in staffing and business decisions.

Skills:

Education

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

title: Business Line Manager
description:
****About SKF****

SKF started its operations in India in 1923. Today, SKF provides industry leading automotive and industrial engineered solutions through its five technology-centric platforms: bearings and units, seals, mechatronics, lubrication solutions and services. Over the years the company has evolved from being a pioneer ball bearing manufacturing company to a knowledge-driven engineering company helping customers achieve sustainable and competitive business excellence.

SKF's solutions provide sustainable ways for companies across the automotive and industrial sectors to achieve breakthroughs in friction reduction, energy efficiency, and equipment longevity and reliability. With a strong commitment to research-based innovation, SKF India offers customized value-added solutions that integrate all its five technology platforms.

To know more, please visit: www.skf.com /in

**SKF Purpose Statement**

Together, we re-imagine rotation for a better tomorrow.

By creating intelligent and clean solutions for people and the planet

****JOB**
**DESCRIPTION****

**Position Title:**
Business Line Manager

**Reports To:**
Global Lubrication Business Development and Business Line Manager

**Role Type:**
Individual Contributor

**Location:**
Bengaluru/Pune

**Purpose of the role**

**The role**

As Business Line Manager for Lubricants in India, you will be responsible for defining and executing the regional business growth strategy and translating customer, application and market requirements into a competitive and value-added solution. You will lead India’s lubricants offer while acting as a vital link between the regional market and the global MPT team.

**Why we want you**

Your primary mission is to strengthen and grow SKF's lubricants business in India by creating a customer-focused and market-relevant offer. You will further develop the strategy, channel structure and commercial execution model required to drive sustainable and profitable growth.

We are looking for someone who combines commercial drive, market development expertise and technical curiosity. You understand how to develop industrial lubrication businesses through distributors, OEMs and end-users while building long-term competitive differentiation through application knowledge, technical support and portfolio positioning.

Your role is critical in building the link between local market needs and SKF's global lubrication competencies. By working closely with Sales, Marketing, Supply Chain, Product Development, Purchasing and global lubrication experts, you will contribute to positioning SKF as a trusted and recognized lubrication partner across priority industrial segments in India.

****Key Responsibilities****

* Build a long-term business roadmap for profitable growth across the Indian lubrication market
* Establish clear priorities regarding target industries, channels and applications
* Lead portfolio gap analysis and prioritization
* Translate local market requirements into solution development in itiatives
* Define positioning, value propositions and pricing strategy for priority products
* Build strategic customer relationships and develop reference cases
* Drive commercialization and scaling of new solutions
* Act as the primary interface between India and SKF's global lubrication organization
* Participate in the Europe-India Growth Cell to transfer knowledge and accelerate market development
* Ensure effective communication of market feedback and customer requirements into global development processes

****Qualifications****

* Bachelor's or Master’s degree in engineering in Mechanical or Chemical background
* Minimum 10 years of experience in the lubricants industry, with a strong preference for candidates from leading grease manufacturers, lubricant producers, or global industrial lubrication companies.
* Proven track record in business line management, product management, commercial leadership, or business development.
* Strong understanding of the global grease market, including competitive landscape, key industry players and distribution structures.
* Demonstrated experience working in multinational organizations across regions, functions, and stakeholder groups.
* Experience developing and executing market growth strategies in emerging markets, with India experience considered a significant advantage.
* Strong leadership and stakeholder management capabilities, with the ability to influence across global matrix organizations and lead cross-functional teams.
* Fluent in English; additional Indian languages are advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.

****About SKF****

SKF has been around for more than a century and today we are one of the world’s largest global suppliers of bearings and supporting solutions for rotating equipment. With more than 40,000 employees in around 130 countries, we are truly global. Our products are found everywhere in society. In fact, wherever there is movement, SKF’s solutions might be at work. This means that we are an important part of the everyday lives of people and companies around the world. See more, at www.skf.com.

Bring your curiosity for learning, bold ideas, courage and passion to drive life-changing impact to ZS.

  
:

ZS's CCoE (Cloud Center of Excellence) Team builds, maintains and helps architect the systems enabling ZS client-facing software solutions. We define and implement best practices to ensure performant, resilient and secure cloud solutions. The CCoE team at ZS is comprised of analytical problem solvers coming from diverse backgrounds while sharing a passion for quality delivery — whether our customer is a client or another ZS employee. The team has presence in ZS’s Evanston, Illinois and Pune, India offices”.

The CLOUD ADMINISTRATOR (LINUX) will be part of CCoE Compute Team Pune. As a Senior Cloud Administrator, you will manage AWS infrastructure in multiple regions and accounts. You will be actively engaged in planning, configuration, management, maintenance and upgrade of various components related to the Public cloud.

**What You'll Do:**

* Work on various activities related to planning, configuration and management of different distributions of Linux servers.
* Responsible for migration and upgrade of Linux instances, serverless resources and container infrastructure.
* Configure and Participate in Linux patching rollout, rollback and threat mitigation.
* Work on regular operations activities related to AWS and Linux.
* High level log analysis, monitoring alerts, performance reports, trend analysis, experience with process monitoring tools, Wireshark etc
* Audit IT infrastructure and publish report and manage access control
* Perform root cause analysis for escalated issues and provide resolution.
* Mentor and train newly joined team members.

**What You'll Bring:**

* BE/B.Tech or higher in CS, IT or EE.
* Linux server administration experience of 1-3 Years ( AWS Linux and RHEL), specifically in AWS cloud.
* Hands on experience with AWS services like CloudFormation, Systems Manager, CloudWatch
* Deep knowledge of OS Installation, upgrades, troubleshooting, patching etc.
* Good knowledge in IP Addressing, troubleshooting network issues.
* Experienced in day to day operational issues and runtime operations in a multi-domain, multi region environment
* Hands on experience in Bash, Python and Ansible
* Understanding concepts of enterprise data center technologies including Networking, Security, TCP/IP and Firewalls and how they work together.

* Knowledge of AWS VDI solutions like Workspace and Appstreams will be an added advantage.
* Should have good communication skills and a can-do attitude.
* Fluency in English
* Client-first mentality
* Intense work ethic
* Collaborative spirit and problem-solving approach

:

* Cross-functional skills development & custom learning pathways
* Milestone training programs aligned to career progression opportunities
* Internal mobility paths that empower growth via s-curves, individual contribution and role expansions

At ZS, your growth matters. We offer a comprehensive total rewards package that supports your health and well‑being, financial future, time away, and professional development. With robust skills‑building programs, multiple career progression paths, internal mobility, and a deeply collaborative culture, you’ll have the opportunity to do meaningful work, expand your capabilities, and thrive as part of a global community. For details on total rewards in India, visit ZS India office locations | Where we work | ZS.

We are committed to giving our employees a flexible and connected way of working. The magic of ZS culture and innovation thrives in both planned and spontaneous face-to-face connections.

Travel is a requirement at ZS for client facing ZSers; business needs of your project and client are the priority. While some projects may be local, all client-facing ZSers should be prepared to travel as needed. description:

title: E-Commerce Team Lead
description:
**Position: E-Commerce Team Lead**

**Location:**
Sector 23, Dwarka, New Delhi | Work from Office

**Experience:**
2–6 years

**Team:**
Lead a pod of 3–5 Analysts |
**Portfolio:**
2-4 client accounts

**Job Summary:**

This is
**not a task-management role**
. We are looking for someone who takes ownership of client outcomes —
**growth, account health, retention and expansion**
— while building a team of analysts into independent owners.

You will be the
**single point of accountability**
for your accounts, bringing together marketplace growth, quick commerce, Amazon DSP and AMC to become a trusted e-commerce growth partner to clients.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own 3-5
  **client accounts**
  end-to-end across GMV, advertising performance, profitability and account health.
* Build and drive quarterly growth plans covering marketplace strategy, media, promotions and launches.
* Lead full-funnel performance across
  **Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Blinkit, Zepto and Swiggy Instamart**
  .
* Lead
  **Amazon DSP & AMC**
  strategy — audience design, retargeting, measurement and incrementality.
* Own KPIs including
  **Revenue, ROAS, ACoS/TACoS, CVR, CTR, share of voice and new-to-brand growth**
  .
* Act as the senior day-to-day client partner, lead business reviews and own performance escalations.
* Lead and coach a
  **3–5 member pod**
  , improving both delivery quality and individual ownership.
* Own client
  **retention and renewals**
  , while identifying upsell and cross-sell opportunities.
* Use dashboards, automation and AI to make delivery smarter and more scalable.

**Key Skills & Experience:**

* **2–6 years**
  in e-commerce / quick commerce performance marketing, marketplace management or brand growth.
* Hands-on expertise in
  **Amazon Ads (AMS), Amazon DSP, Amazon Marketing Cloud (AMC) and Quick Commerce advertising.**
* Experience directly owning client relationships and business outcomes.
* Experience leading or mentoring at least one team member.
* Strong understanding of
  **Seller Central, Vendor Central, marketplace operations and account health**
  .
* Strong Excel/data fluency with confidence managing budgets and performance metrics.
* Clear communication and the maturity to handle senior clients and difficult conversations.

**What Will Set You Apart**

You’ve
**turned around an underperforming account, grown a client beyond its original scope, built something reusable**
such as a dashboard/SOP/automation, or worked across multiple marketplaces and categories.

**Growth at Nuvoretail**

This role sits at the
**Ownership → Leadership**
stage of Nuvoretail’s career path. You’ll get a named client portfolio, a team to lead, exposure across marketplaces, quick commerce and DSP/AMC, and a defined path toward
**Account Manager, Manager and Business Leadership**
roles.

**About The Company:**

Nuvoretail Enlytical Technologies Private Limited is an e-commerce analytics and automation company. Our proprietary digital shelf analytics and automation platform called Enlytical.ai helps e-commerce brands solve the complexities in today’s e-commerce landscape by offering a unified and all- encompassing business view on the various aspects of e-commerce business. Our platform leverages insights drawn from multiple data points that help our clients win in e-commerce by gaining a competitive edge with data-driven insights for sharper decision-making. The insights cover all aspects of e-commerce such as digital product portfolio analysis, supply chain analytics, e-commerce operations automation, pricing, and competitor benchmarking, and Amazon advertising automation using our proprietary algorithms.

As a leading e-commerce service provider, we offer the most comprehensive end-to-end

e-commerce solutions to brands, both in India and abroad. Right from preparing a road map to writing our client’s e- commerce success story to assisting them In increasing their online sales, we do everything via our diverse e-commerce services and bespoke strategies and technology. Our services span across the brand’s e-commerce enablement including content and digital asset creation for product listing, On Platform, and Off Platform marketing services with deep expertise in Amazon Marketing Services (AMS), Amazon SEO through keyword research, e-Commerce operations across various e-commerce platforms, website development, social media marketing, and AI-enabled e-Commerce MIS Dashboards.

**Awards & Recognition:**

Thanks to the faith reposed in us by our clients, NuvoRetail has been featured as
**“The Most Promising eCommerce Technology Service Provider in India 2020”**
by
*CIOReview India Magazine*
. Our leadership is frequently recognized across global e-commerce services, digital marketing, consulting, and industry programs. Further strengthening our credentials, NuvoRetail is an
**Amazon Ads Advanced Partner**
and has also been named a
**finalist at the APAC Amazon Awards**
, placing us among a select group of high-performing companies in the region.

title: Corporate Relation Lead
description:
***Corporate Relations Lead – Industry Partnerships & Placements***

* Company: DIYguru Mobility Pvt. Ltd.
* Industry: Electric Vehicles (EV), Mobility & Skill Development
* Department: Corporate Relations & Placements
* Location: Delhi – Sultanpur / Noida
* Employment Type: Full-Time
* Experience: 2–5 Years
* Education: MBA/PGDM in HR, Marketing, Operations or Management preferred. Graduates with relevant experience in corporate relations, placements or business development may also apply.

**About DIYguru**

DIYguru is India’s leading platform for upskilling students and professionals in Electric Vehicles (EV) and future mobility. We are focused on bridging the industry skill gap through hands-on, industry-relevant learning experiences that prepare individuals for emerging career opportunities across EV, battery technology, automotive electronics, connected mobility and sustainable transportation.

Through our industry-focused programs, corporate partnerships, placement initiatives and practical learning ecosystem, DIYguru connects education, industry and employment to build a future-ready workforce for the rapidly evolving mobility sector.

**About the Role**

DIYguru is looking for a Corporate Relations Lead – Industry Partnerships & Placements who can build, manage and grow relationships with corporate recruiters, HR professionals, hiring managers and industry stakeholders.

This is a partnership-heavy and placement-focused role. The candidate will be responsible not only for generating corporate leads but for converting relationships into tangible business and placement outcomes, including:

* Hiring requirements
* Placement opportunities
* Internship opportunities
* OJT opportunities
* Recruitathon participation
* Corporate training opportunities
* Industry partnerships
* MoUs and strategic collaborations
* Repeat hiring relationships

The ideal candidate will combine corporate relationship management, recruitment coordination and strong follow-up skills.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Corporate Partnership Development

Build relationships with HR Heads, Talent Acquisition Managers, Recruitment Heads and Hiring Managers.

Identify companies with recurring manpower and talent requirements.

Develop corporate accounts rather than one-time hiring relationships.

Understand workforce requirements, skill gaps and hiring challenges.

Develop long-term hiring and industry partnerships.

Conduct meetings and present relevant DIYguru solutions.

Maintain regular engagement with existing corporate partners.

2. Corporate Outreach

Identify and prioritize target companies across EV, automotive, manufacturing, engineering, software, electronics, battery, mobility and related sectors.

Develop account-wise prospect lists and identify relevant decision-makers.

Conduct outreach through LinkedIn, email, calls, industry networks, referrals and events.

Schedule meetings with HR and business stakeholders.

Maintain a structured corporate sales/partnership pipeline.

Move prospects through defined stages from lead → meeting → requirement → partnership → hiring → repeat engagement.

Track conversion and follow-up activities consistently.

3. Placement & Recruitment Partnerships

Acquire new corporate hiring requirements and understand company manpower needs.

Study and interpret technical and non-technical Job Descriptions.

Coordinate with the placement team for candidate mapping and shortlisting.

Ensure candidate profiles are aligned with company requirements before sharing.

Coordinate assessments, interviews, hiring drives and recruitment activities.

Track candidate selection, offer and joining status.

Collect employer feedback after hiring processes.

Identify opportunities for repeat hiring and additional manpower requirements.

Maintain strong relationships with companies throughout the recruitment cycle.

4. Industry Networking & Representation

Attend industry events, HR conferences, EV and automotive events, seminars and networking forums.

Build professional relationships with industry leaders, HR professionals and business stakeholders.

Use LinkedIn strategically for corporate networking and relationship development.

Identify potential partnership opportunities through industry networks.

Represent DIYguru professionally in external meetings, events and discussions.

Maintain an active network of relevant industry contacts.

5. College & Institutional Partnerships

Develop relationships with TPOs, Placement Officers, HODs and institutional decision-makers.

Identify colleges, ITIs, diploma institutes and universities with relevant candidate pools.

Develop college-industry-placement opportunities.

Support campus hiring drives and Recruitathons.

Coordinate institutional outreach and partnership discussions.

Build and maintain a structured institutional database.

Identify opportunities for long-term college and industry collaborations.

6. Employer Branding & Corporate Communication

Work closely with the marketing/content team to support:

Corporate success stories

Hiring partner communications

Placement success stories

Industry collaboration announcements

LinkedIn outreach campaigns

Corporate newsletters

Employer partnership content

Ensure that all external communication reflects DIYguru's professional image and value proposition.

7. MIS, CRM & Pipeline Management

Maintain accurate and updated records for:

* Corporate database
* HR/POC database
* Target account list
* Active hiring requirements
* Corporate prospect pipeline
* Follow-up tracker
* Meeting tracker
* JD tracker
* Interview tracker
* Selection tracker
* Joining tracker
* Repeat hiring tracker
* Partnership/MoU tracker
* Prepare regular MIS reports covering new leads, meetings, requirements, conversions, active hiring, closures and repeat opportunities.

**Key Performance Expectations**

Success in this role will be measured through both relationship quality and measurable business outcomes, including:

* Number and quality of new corporate accounts developed.
* Corporate meetings and qualified opportunities generated.
* New hiring requirements acquired.
* Placement, internship and OJT opportunities created.
* Conversion of prospects into active corporate partners.
* Successful candidate selections and joining.
* Repeat hiring from existing corporate accounts.
* New industry partnerships, Recruitathon participation and collaboration opportunities.
* Accuracy and consistency of CRM/MIS reporting.

Required Skills

* Strong corporate communication and relationship-building skills
* Excellent verbal and written communication
* Strong negotiation and persuasion skills
* Recruitment and placement coordination skills
* Excellent follow-up and pipeline management
* Professional LinkedIn networking skills
* Ability to understand and interpret Job Descriptions
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets and MIS skills
* Ability to communicate with senior HR and business stakeholders
* Ownership and accountability
* Ability to work with targets and measurable outcomes

**Candidate Profile**

The ideal candidate should have experience in one or more of the following areas:

* Corporate Relations
* Campus Recruitment
* Placement Cell
* HR Recruitment
* Talent Acquisition
* Industry Partnerships
* EdTech Partnerships
* Staffing/Recruitment
* College Relations

We are looking for someone who is proactive, commercially aware, confident in professional conversations and comfortable building relationships from the first interaction through long-term partnership

Why Join DIYguru?

* EV & Future Mobility Exposure: Work directly with companies and professionals across the rapidly growing EV and mobility ecosystem.
* Industry Partnerships: Gain hands-on experience building real corporate and institutional relationships.
* End-to-End Ownership: Work across lead generation, corporate meetings, hiring, placements, partnerships and repeat business.
* Cross-Functional Exposure: Collaborate with HR, Placement, Training, Marketing and Business Development teams.
* Career Growth: Build a strong professional network and develop skills across Corporate Relations, Recruitment and Industry Partnerships.

Application Process

Interested candidates can apply by sharing their updated resume highlighting relevant experience in corporate relations, recruitment, placements or industry partnerships.

Send your resume to hr@diyguru.org

* If you are someone who can open doors, build relationships and convert corporate conversations into long-term partnerships, we would like to hear from you.

title: GM/AVP Customer Service & Operations
description:
**Position:**
GM/AVP Customer Service & Operations

**Location:**
Delhi

**Department:**
Operations & Customer Experience

**Position Overview:**

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced leader to join our team as the Head of Customer Service at DocOnline. This senior role will be instrumental in shaping and enhancing the end-to-end customer experience across our Inbound & Outbound Call Centre and all consumer touchpoints, including physical branches. The ideal candidate will lead a high performing team, drive operational efficiency, and implement strategies to improve customer satisfaction, branch service standards, and service-led sales conversions.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. Leadership & Team Management:

* Provide strategic leadership to the customer service and branch operations teams.
* Build and manage a culture of performance, accountability, and continuous learning.
* Hire, train, and develop team members to drive excellence in customer interactions.
* Set and monitor KPIs for call centre, regional branches, and backend service operations.

2. Customer Experience Management:

* Own the customer journey across all service channels: inbound calls, walk-ins, digital, and backend support.
* Develop strategies to improve CSAT, NPS, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Average Handling Time (AHT).
* Identify service gaps and implement improvements to ensure seamless and consistent customer experiences.

3. Operations & Process Optimization:

* Lead initiatives to optimize internal processes and eliminate inefficiencies across the service ecosystem.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to streamline call flow, escalation handling, and ticketing systems.
* Utilize data insights to enhance workflows and track key performance indicators across call centre and branches.

4. Technology & CRM Integration:

* Work closely with IT to identify and implement CRM tools, IVRs, and AI-based service solutions.
* Ensure smooth integration of customer service platforms with core operations.
* Drive automation and self-service initiatives to reduce dependency on manual intervention.

5. Branch & Territory Service Oversight:

* Lead multi-location branch service teams, aligning them with the overall customer service vision.
* Standardize service protocols and performance measures across branches.
* Support sales enablement through service by training staff on service-to-sales interactions and upselling opportunities.

6. Quality Control & Feedback Systems:

* Define and enforce quality assurance standards across customer service teams.
* Roll out audits, call monitoring, and service feedback mechanisms to continuously raise service benchmarks.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions and refreshers to improve service delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in customer service leadership, preferably in digital healthcare, BFSI, telecom, or services sectors.
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale call centre operations and branch networks.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, call analytics, and ticketing systems.
* Strategic mindset with a strong focus on metrics, customer outcomes, and cross functional collaboration.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to work across levels and geographies.
* Experience in driving service-led sales, especially in B2C environments, is highly desirable.

**Key Metrics to Drive:**

* Net Promoter Score (NPS) – Gauge customer loyalty and overall experience.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) – Measure customer feedback post-interaction.
* Customer Effort Score (CES) – Assess ease of service interaction.
* First Contact Resolution (FCR) – Track issues resolved in the first interaction.
* Average Handling Time (AHT) – Optimize call time without compromising quality.
* Call Abandonment & Escalation Rate – Monitor dropped calls and unresolved escalations.
* Service Level Adherence (SLA Compliance) – Ensure timely response and resolution across touchpoints.
* Ticket Closure Turnaround Time (TAT) – Measure operational agility in resolving issues.
* Agent Utilization & Occupancy Rate – Improve efficiency and productivity of call centre staff.
* CRM Adoption Rate (Branch + Contact Centre) – Ensure all leads, queries, and follow-ups are logged and tracked effectively.
* CRM Hygiene & Data Accuracy Score – Track proper tagging, closure, and documentation of all customer records.
* Branch-wise Service & Sales Performance – Analyze branch productivity, service quality, and contribution to revenue.
* Walk-in to Resolution Time (Branch TAT) – Optimize branch turnaround and service delivery time.
* Cross-sell/Upsell % via Service Channels – Convert inbound service queries into revenue opportunities.
* Inbound vs. Outbound Call Volume Ratio – Maintain optimal call mix for efficiency and engagement.
* Repeat Interaction Ratio – Track recurrence of unresolved or follow-up queries.
* Customer Query to Fulfilment Conversion % – Ensure closure from initiation to outcome.
* Internal Transfer & Manual Escalation Ratio – Reduce non-value-adding transfers and touchpoints.
* Automation vs Manual Process Efficiency – Drive digital adoption and eliminate redundancy.
* Cost per Resolution / Contact – Optimize cost-effectiveness without compromising service quality.
* Referral Generation via Service – Leverage customer delight for brand advocacy.
* Churn Reduction Post-Service % – Retain customers through prompt, empathetic resolutions.
* Sales Through Service Closure % – Measure service-driven revenue contribution.
* Process SLA Breach Rate – Identify failure points and drive compliance.
* Customer Experience Index (composite metric) – Overall measurement of service perception and delivery.

DocOnline is committed to transforming digital healthcare access for millions. If you are passionate about building customer-first cultures, improving service efficiency, and scaling branch-based service excellence, we welcome you to apply.

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Lead - Insurance - Distribution and Partnerships
description:
**Lead - Distribution and Partnerships Risk and Continuity Practice**

**Reports to:**
Head, Risk Advisory & Continuity Practice

**Role Overview:**
This role owns origination through two partner channels that feed the Risk Advisory & Continuity Practice without depending on Client Associates' own relationship managers.The first is the professional-referral channel: law firms and consulting houses whose own client work puts them inside the moments that create capital gaps for UHNW families and promoters - a business sale, a buy-sell trigger, a generational handover, an estate or succession settlement. The job is to build standing, credible relationships with the partners at these firms, so that when such a moment surfaces in their client work, the practice is the first call. This is a relationship-capital role. Mandates are signed, not tickets closed.The second is the volume channel: DSA and MFD partners onboarded as referral partners and POSPs under Client Associates' Corporate Agent registration. The job here is to onboard partners, activate them, service them at volume, and manage churn so the channel stays productive.The two channels run on different rhythms. The professional channel is low-volume and high-trust, and revenue lags by design. The volume channel is activation-led and is measured on partners signed, POSPs activated and leads routed. Holding both credibly is the hard part of this role, and the profile below is written with that in mind.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Professional-referral channel: 
  Identify, approach and build relationships with senior partners at estate and succession law firms, M&A and corporate law firms, tax and succession advisory boutiques, and independent family-office and wealth consultants.
* Structure and formalise professional-referral mandates with each partner firm - cumulative, relationship-based, with no churn.
* Introduce the practice's Two-Gap diagnostic (Event Gap and Transmission Gap) into partner firms' own client conversations, without pitching product directly.
* Route live opportunities and gap conversations to the practice for diagnosis and structuring.
* Represent the practice externally in professional-services circles - conferences, firm briefings and partner events.
* Volume channel: 
  Identify, onboard and sign DSA and MFD partners on lead-supply and referral terms.
* Register and activate POSPs under the Corporate Agent registration, with documentation and compliance in order.
* Service high-volume referral partners - training, lead handling and response times - so that partners stay productive.
* Manage churn: track partner activity monthly and re-engage or exit inactive POSPs.
* Route qualified leads from volume partners to the relationship teams and the practice.
* Work with finance to keep partner payouts accurate and on time.
* Across both channels, o
  wn the commercial terms of each partnership within a mandate set by the Head of the practice.
* Maintain relationship governance - a tracked record of partners signed, firms engaged, active mandates and the conversion of referrals into mandates.
* Track the partnership pipeline with stage and value in the CRM and report to the Head monthly.
* What This Role Is Not: 
  Not a case-structuring or product-pitching role - diagnosis, quoting and solution design stay with the practice.
* Not a direct-selling role. Volume partners and POSPs sell; this role builds, activates and services the channel.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

Someone with existing standing in the professional-services and UHNW ecosystem, who has also run a partner network with discipline. Likely backgrounds: Business development or intermediary relationships at a private bank or wealth manager.

* Business development or client-relations leadership at a family-office consulting practice, or a boutique M&A or tax advisory firm.
* A law or consulting firm's own business-development lead, with an understanding of how partners think about referring clients externally.
* Head of channel partnerships or alliances at an insurer, broker or insurtech platform, with experience activating and servicing DSA, MFD or POSP networks.

Comfortable operating without a product to pitch in the professional channel, and comfortable with the operating detail of activation, servicing and churn in the volume channel.

**Qualifications and Experience:**
10 to 15 years in business development, channel partnerships or client-relationship roles within financial services, wealth management or professional services.

* Demonstrated ability to build and sustain senior relationships at partner or principal level over a multi-year, low-volume cycle.
* Hands-on experience onboarding, activating and servicing a partner or POSP network, including its documentation and compliance.
* Working familiarity with the Corporate Agent framework and with the limits of referral-for-a-fee arrangements.
* Working familiarity with UHNW and promoter wealth structures - succession, estate planning, buy-sell arrangements - sufficient to hold a credible conversation. Technical structuring is not this role's responsibility.
* An existing network in legal, consulting or family-office circles is a strong advantage.

**Reporting Line and Success Metrics:**

 
Reports directly to the Head of the Risk and Continuity Practice, as part of the practice's founding team alongside the General Insurance Lead and the Analyst.

**Professional-referral channel.**
Year one is not measured on revenue, because revenue lags relationship-building by design. Early metrics are: Number of professional-mandate relationships established.

* Number of firms actively engaged in ongoing conversation.
* Number of gap conversations routed to the practice through these relationships.

**Volume channel.**
Early metrics are: Number of DSA and MFD partners signed.

* Number of POSPs registered, and the share that become active.
* Number of qualified leads routed to the practice or the relationship teams.
* Churn held within the plan level.

description:

description:

Manager, Merchant Cloud Commercialization Support

Our people, technology, data, and brand provide the capabilities that drive our success. We believe in connecting people to priceless possibilities.

The Manager, Product Commercialization Support, Go-to-Market Enablement and Revenue Tracking will play a critical role in supporting the commercialization and go-to-market strategy for Merchant Cloud.
  
  
Role
  
  
This support role focused on market readiness, commercialization support, pipeline visibility, performance tracking, market penetration analysis, and go-to-market enablement under the directions of regional stakeholders. governance, and customer-facing collateral that support successful go-to-market execution.

performance.
  
  

* Skilled at solving complex business problems and developing compelling commercialisation strategies, value propositions, and go-to-

market materials.
  
  

* Experienced in tracking product roadmaps, developing business cases, and supporting investment decisions through data-driven analysis

and insights.
  
  

* Proven ability to manage pipeline reporting, commercial performance tracking, and growth initiatives that support product adoption and business outcomes.
* Passionate about enabling customer-facing teams through sales collateral, analytics, insights, and strategic narratives that enhance go-to-market effectiveness and customer engagement. We are looking for an energetic professional who is willing to jump into an ever-evolving team and hit the ground running.

The Manager will have a proven track record of working effectively in a team to drive successful outcomes, exceptional analytical skills, and a strong commercial mindset, along with impeccable communication skills to improve Merchant Cloud understanding and up take within the broader business.

* Creating comprehensive commercialization packages and go to market materials for newly launched products and features. Strong

**Influencing Skills Through Visualisation Of Data And Ideas Required.**

* Partnering closely with the Services organization at regional level to support the identication and, structuring of potential upselling and cross selling opportunities within new accounts.
* Managing and continuously updating the sales pipeline across various regions for regional team’s visibility regarding the ensure sustained

growth and prioritize high impact opportunities.
  
  

* Supporting the sales enablement initiatives of regional teams, delivering training, playbooks, and resources that keep teams hyper

focused on supporting the regional teams in their sales initiatives.
  
  

* Collaborating with regional teams and client facing groups to align commercialization strategies with local market needs.
* Leading KPI tracking and measuring the commercial impact of all launch and enablement efforts.
* Preparing business case inputs and analysis to support strategic investment and initiative decisions by regional teams

**All About You**

* Proven experience working in the Mastercard Services organization including BMI, Security Services, and Customer Acquisition and Engagement.
* In depth understanding and prior experience in the payments industry with a strong grasp of relevant market trends.
* Strong knowledge and experience in the Acquiring and Gateway ecosystem.
* Prior experience in dealing with the adoption of digital commerce solutions.
* A results-oriented professional able to drive outcomes, with proven experience in developing go to market strategies for new products and delivering scalable solutions.
* Entrepreneurial and commercial mindset able to adjust to changing demands of the market, customers, internal strategies, and build partnerships across the organization.
* Excellent communications and influencing skillset to support alignment of enablement strategies with business goals.
* Ability to lead cross functional and multi-location teams effectively.
* Organizational savviness to navigate a highly matrixed organization and resilience to thrive in a high pressure, goal-oriented environment.
* Strong problem solving and analytical skills, completely comfortable using data to support business cases and recommendations.
* Bachelor’s degree required
* English fluency is mandatory.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: VP Corporate Executive Relationship Manager
description:

If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
**Wealth and Personal Banking**
is our new global business combining Retail Banking and Wealth Management; and Global Private Banking, to become one of the world’s largest global wealth managers with USD1.4 trillion in assets. Across Asia, where wealth pools are growing faster than in any other region, HSBC’s wealth revenues grew 12% in 2019 (year-on-year) to USD5.7 billion. Our dedicated colleagues serve millions of customers worldwide across the entire spectrum of private wealth, ranging from personal banking individuals and families, through to business owners, investors and ultra-high-net-worth individuals. We provide products and services such as bank accounts, credit cards, personal loans and mortgages, as well as asset management, insurance, wealth management and private banking that best suit our customers’ needs.
  
  
We are currently seeking an experienced professional to join the WPB team.
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The PRM & SPRM role are client facing roles. Playing a integral part of HSBC RBWM flagship offering of ‘’Premier Banking’’ To grow and nurture HSBC Premier relationships (the HNI segment of the PLB customer base) and achieve business targets as laid down and in accordance with the business plan To facilitate a single point of contact for all Premier customers, anticipate needs and provide required banking/financial advisory services. The jobholder to ensure that high quality customer service is provided to customers in line with Global Premier Service Standards. The identification of opportunities for wealth reviews and delivering wealth solutions as an adviser are amongst the key activities to achieve your goals as complied with local regulatory requirement.
  
  
All this needs to be achieved by keeping the highest standards of integrity towards the bank and clients and the regulatory requirements.
  
  
**Principal Accountabilities**
**Impact on the Business / Function**

* Maximize profit and achievement of the growth of Premier clients portfolio
* Achieve agreed financial targets by development of existing and new relationships
* Build effective relationships with clients to retain and develop sustainable relationships
* Complete regular reviews with clients to understand their current and long term needs and advise them on the products and services that help them achieve their goals
* Effective use of tools and information to drive client service delivery and RBWM performance
* Maintain a minimum standard of qualifying Premier clients within portfolio as stated by Group
* Build a high personal and corporate profile in the community in which you are based. Develop network of Group and External professional contacts with the aim of introducing new business, enhancing technical knowledge and promoting the brand
* Monitor and act on daily sales activity management information and other internal information tools, using them to coach the wider Branch team in support of business goals
* Establish and agree client contact strategies in line with Group operating models
* Fully utilize and input to Client Relationship Management data, ensuring all client information is complete and kept up to date
* Demonstrate excellent understanding of client needs, recommend appropriate products and services, and achieve closure of sales

**Customers / Stakeholders**

* Own the client relationship with HSBC
* Maintain a deep understanding and technical knowledge of relevant products and services available from Group sources and elsewhere in order to provide the best solutions for clients and maximize revenues for Global Wealth and the Group
* Maintain highest standard of excellence in client service across the team and with individual portfolio - Ongoing analysis of client portfolios through marketing of ideas and researching clients
* Monitor client satisfaction data implementing portfolio level improvements
* Work with the broader branch, support and direct teams to ensure achievement of the business performance measures by delivering differentiated products and services to the client

**Leadership & Teamwork**

* To work as part of an integrated branch management team to ensure, standards and are met and operating models delivered
* Proactively support others through direct and indirect actions beyond activities particular to this role
* Collaborate with the wider team to deliver the Branch RBWM Performance measures and plan to support the multi-channel client journey
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with colleagues in the wider RBWM businesses and others as appropriate to service client needs

**Operational Effectiveness & Control**

* Ensuring that sales & operations are undertaken in accordance with HSBC Bank plc FIM, BIM and Credit Policy Manual appropriate lending guidelines
* Agree and manage lending facilities within any agreed Approval Authority (RAA)
* Manage operational risk, by using relevant MI to identify risk situations and take any appropriate action to minimize loss
* Adhere to selling process and sales quality requirements
* Comply with the applicable laws, regulations, Group and local guidelines related to Sanctions and AML policy of HSBC while undertaking various day to day operations
* Remain alert and promptly report to the Sanctions Officer/ INM FCC office/ Line manager ( As applicable and required by the AML and sanction Policy) if a customer is found to be engaging in sanction evasion activities or violations of AML policy or any other related procedures.
* Understand the legal responsibility to be vigilant for unusual activity and reporting of the unusual activities
* Support the Country or Regional FCC AML Office/ AML Investigations by providing additional information when required
* Responsible for attending and successfully completing the AML and Sanctions related assigned training in the mandated timeframe
* Understanding the consequences of failing to attend or successfully complete the training as mandated by the AML Education Lead FCC;
* Requesting additional AML training that you deem necessary or appropriate to perform your jobs through your entity manager
* Demonstrate an understanding of PEP acceptance, prohibition, CDD & EDD guidelines in order to ensure that the INM RBWM is fully compliant with the PEP LoBP.
* Understand the relatively high reputational risk that arises from any perceived weaknesses in controls in respect of substantial cash deposits or withdrawals activity, wire transfer, monetary instruments and pouch and mail
* To be aware and Identify high risk indicators for various products and Services offered by INM RBWM example Cash, insurance, credit cards products etc
* Ensure that all records are obtained in respect of INM RBWM customers or New to bank customer for any products and services provided by HSBC are as per the process laid down.
* Must ensure that the prescribed process is being followed while dealing with non HSBC customers request for monetary instruments and wire transfers
* Ensure Adherence to the regulatory guidelines and internal AML & Sanction Policy of HSBC, which includes pouch and mail, monetary instruments, cash services and payment transparency Line of Business Procedures
* To be aware of AML risk posed by pouch and mail, Monetary instruments, cash services and wire transfer services and should undergo the mandatory training for the same
* Necessary remediation steps needs to be undertaken in case if there is any breach or non-adherence to the policy laid down in the LoBP
* Must undertake necessary due diligence to ensure that the nature of the transaction is in sync with the customer profile , else raise it to line manager for further clarification
* The staff must be aware of the scope of services of various products and services that are offered and those which are prohibited because of the guidelines laid down in the line of Business procedures and must ensure the same is communicated to customer in a effective and polite manner
* Ensure adequate due diligence is undertaken by the Individual/team to ensure that the nature of the various transactions of wire transfer, cash services, monetary instruments are in sync with customer profile

**Major Challenges**
The bank seeks to grow its RBWM business through an efficient operation and the pursuit of providing clients with globally consistent experiences, excellent service, cross selling products and services appropriate to client needs in order to enhance that value. In the face of fierce competition in this segment the bank is seeking to grow the significance of this group in their contribution to our business.
  
  
The Premier segment typically comprises clients with Total Relationship Balances of 25lakhs or more.
  
  
We should also recognise our responsibility to the community in which we operate and improve the bank’s profile within those communities building economic value for the bank and its shareholders.

title: Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech)
description:
**About OneMetric**
OneMetric (formerly Growtomation) is a revenue enablement partner for B2B teams. We build revenue engines end to end: the systems and data teams run on, the GTM execution that drives demand, closed deals and retention, and the AI that makes the entire engine faster and smarter.
  
  
As an Elite HubSpot Partner, we work with high-growth companies across the US and globally. We start with the real revenue problem, not the tool. While most companies buy technology, GTM execution and AI solutions from separate vendors, we bring them together into one connected revenue engine.
  
  
**Who We're Hiring For**
We're looking for a Manager - Digital transformation (MarTech) who combines marketing operations expertise, technical depth and a strong understanding of how B2B companies run programs such as Account-Based Marketing (ABM) and demand generation.
  
  
This role sits at the intersection of business consulting, marketing technology and revenue operations. You'll work directly with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other senior stakeholders to understand the business challenges driving their need for technology, translate those challenges into executable game plans, and partner with our technology and delivery teams to bring those solutions to life.
  
  
This isn't a pure consulting or project management role. You'll need to understand how businesses operate, how their marketing and sales programs work, and how the right technology architecture and execution can drive measurable outcomes.
  
  
If you enjoy solving complex business problems, designing connected technology solutions and working closely with senior stakeholders, this role is for you.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Business Discovery & Consulting: Lead discovery conversations with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and other stakeholders to understand business goals, GTM motions, operational challenges and the underlying problems driving technology requirements.
* Solution Strategy & Planning: Translate business challenges into clearly defined problem statements, solution approaches and executable game plans, working with Solution Architects and the technology execution team to define scope, priorities and implementation plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Solutions: Design and implement technology setups across Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience (CX), ensuring systems, workflows and data connect to support business objectives.
* ABM & Demand Generation Enablement: Understand how B2B companies plan and execute ABM and demand generation programs, and translate these requirements into scalable technology solutions, workflows and measurement frameworks.
* Technology Stack & Integration: Work hands-on with marketing and revenue technology platforms, including HubSpot, Salesforce, and ABM and intent platforms such as Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level, to enable integrated GTM execution.
* Cross-functional Execution: Partner with Solution Architects, Delivery, Customer Success and other internal teams to translate the agreed game plan into technical requirements, implementation roadmaps and measurable outcomes.
* Client & Stakeholder Management: Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders, facilitate working sessions, communicate recommendations and manage expectations throughout solution design and delivery.
* Engagement Governance: Maintain visibility into project scope, timelines, dependencies and risks. Identify gaps early, resolve execution blockers and ensure the delivered solution addresses the original business problem.
* Continuous Improvement: Develop discovery frameworks, solution playbooks and repeatable approaches that improve consulting quality, implementation efficiency and client outcomes.

****What success looks like****

* Senior stakeholders trust you to understand their business challenges and recommend solutions beyond simply implementing a tool.
* Business problems are translated into clear, technically feasible execution plans.
* Marketing, Sales and CX technology setups work together to support ABM, demand generation and broader revenue objectives.
* Solution Architects and delivery teams have the business context and requirements needed to execute effectively.
* Client engagements remain aligned with business outcomes, with measurable improvements in operational efficiency, GTM execution and revenue performance.

****What we're looking for****

* Experience: 5–8 years in MarTech, Marketing Operations, Revenue Operations, solutions consulting or technology implementation, ideally within a B2B SaaS, MarTech or consulting environment.
* Business Consulting: Experience conducting discovery with senior stakeholders, identifying root causes and translating business challenges into actionable solution plans.
* MarTech & RevOps Expertise: Strong understanding of how B2B Marketing, Sales and Customer Experience teams operate, including their processes, data flows and technology requirements.
* ABM & Demand Generation: Practical understanding of B2B demand generation and ABM programs, including how technology enables targeting, campaign orchestration, engagement and performance measurement.
* Technology Implementation: Demonstrated experience implementing or architecting technology setups for Marketing, Sales and/or CX teams, including workflows, integrations, data structures and process automation.
* Platform Knowledge: Strong hands-on knowledge of HubSpot and familiarity with tools such as Salesforce, Clay, Demandbase, 6sense, Influ2 and Contact Level. Experience with multiple platforms across the MarTech and ABM ecosystem is a plus.
* Stakeholder Management: Confidence working with CMOs, CROs, CEOs and cross-functional teams, translating between business priorities and technical execution.
* Execution & Ownership: Ability to turn strategy into a practical implementation plan, manage competing priorities and stay accountable for outcomes.
* How you think: Curious about how businesses work, technically sound, commercially aware and comfortable navigating ambiguity without relying on a fixed playbook.

****Why join us****

* Solve real business problems: Work directly with senior leaders to address business challenges through technology and execution.
* Bridge strategy and implementation: Own the journey from discovery and solution planning to implementation alongside experienced technical teams.
* Work across the revenue ecosystem: Gain exposure to leading MarTech, CRM, ABM and AI platforms and complex B2B GTM environments.
* Join a top-tier ecosystem: As a HubSpot Elite Partner, we work with ambitious businesses and a strong technology ecosystem.
* Grow with the business: Be part of a growing team where ownership, problem-solving and impact create opportunities to take on more responsibility.
* Outcomes over hours: We care about the quality of your thinking, what you build and the outcomes you drive.
