title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you’ll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara is looking for an experienced
**Technical Support Engineer**
to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our
**Tier 2 support team**
within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. You understand the day-to-day aspects of customer support including managing tickets, building knowledge base articles, and providing product feedback to Engineering and PM teams.

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:**
  Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:**
  If you put in the work, this role won’t be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You’re energized by our opportunity:**
  The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:**
  At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Product Expertise**
  : Become an expert on Samsara’s product portfolio of complete Internet of Things (“IoT”) solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
* **Technical Troubleshooting**
  : Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
* **Responsiveness & Resolution**
  : Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
* **Documentation**
  : Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-servisablity for our end users.
* **Partnerships**
  : Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
* **Feedback Loop**
  : Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
* **Team Player**
  : Champion, role model, and embed Samsara’s cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.
* Fluent English is a must.
* Technical know-how - you’re comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, you can speak both Engineer and Human.
* Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
* Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours during nights and weekends is preferred.
* We are looking for someone with strong API/Mobile Apps experience

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
* Trilingual English, Spanish and French is a big plus.
* Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you’re ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual’s ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara’s Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Samsara is aware of scams involving fake job interviews and offers. Please know we do not charge fees to applicants at any stage of the hiring process. Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Engineer, NOC
description:
**About Consilio**
Consilio's consulting and services teams assist legal departments of multinational corporations and their outside counsel in responding to legal matters, reducing legal spend, minimizing risk, and operating more efficiently. Across eDiscovery, document review, and legal consulting services, Consilio is committed to delivering service excellence globally and applying proven knowledge and technology to help clients solve challenges with lower cost, lower risk, and improved speed.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The NOC Engineer provides first-line operational monitoring and incident response for Consilio's global technology environment. The role monitors infrastructure, networks, servers, storage, applications, and supporting services; validates and triages alerts; executes approved runbooks; and coordinates timely escalation and communication to minimize service disruption. The NOC Engineer contributes to reliable 24x7 operations through disciplined ticket documentation, shift handoffs, monitoring improvement, and collaboration with infrastructure, application, security, and service management teams.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Continuously monitor the health, availability, performance, and capacity of infrastructure, network, server, storage, cloud, application, and environmental services using approved monitoring and observability platforms.
* Validate, correlate, prioritize, acknowledge, and triage alerts based on business impact, severity, service dependencies, and documented operating procedures.
* Perform first-level troubleshooting and approved remediation, including service or job restarts, basic connectivity checks, log review, health validation, and execution of established runbooks.
* Create and maintain accurate incident and service tickets, including timestamps, affected services, troubleshooting performed, evidence collected, actions taken, escalation details, and final resolution.
* Escalate unresolved or high-impact incidents to the correct technical team, vendor, incident commander, or management contact in accordance with defined SLAs and escalation paths.
* Initiate or support major incident bridges, maintain a clear incident timeline, provide concise stakeholder updates, and ensure ownership remains clear through service restoration.
* Complete structured shift handoffs that identify active incidents, degraded services, pending follow-ups, maintenance activities, and operational risks.
* Coordinate with third-party vendors and internal support teams to resolve hardware, software, connectivity, and platform issues.
* Support planned maintenance and change windows by completing readiness checks, monitoring service health, documenting checkpoints, validating recovery, and communicating exceptions.
* Maintain and improve operational documentation, including SOPs, runbooks, escalation matrices, knowledge articles, monitoring inventories, and service ownership records.
* Assist with monitoring onboarding for new or changed services by validating dashboards, thresholds, routing, dependencies, ownership, and actionable alert content.
* Review false positives, duplicate alerts, missed detections, stale monitors, and recurring noise; recommend threshold, routing, suppression, or runbook improvements to reduce alert fatigue.
* Contribute incident data and timelines to problem management and post-incident reviews; track assigned corrective actions and knowledge updates to completion.
* Monitor operational performance indicators such as service availability, alert volume, mean time to detect, mean time to acknowledge, mean time to resolve, SLA compliance, and repeat incidents.
* Follow approved access control, data handling, change management, incident management, security, and audit requirements, and promptly escalate suspected security events to the appropriate response team.
* Participate in rotational shifts, weekend or holiday coverage, after-hours maintenance, and on-call support as required by business needs.

**Operational Tools and Technologies**

* Monitoring and observability: Grafana, Prometheus, and Uptime Kuma or comparable platforms.
* Incident alerting and coordination: JSM (Jira service management) or comparable on-call and incident management tools.
* IT service management and documentation: ServiceNow or another ITSM platform; SharePoint or Confluence for knowledge management.
* Operating systems and infrastructure: Windows and Linux fundamentals; server, virtualization, storage, network, and cloud concepts.
* Automation and configuration: Working knowledge of Windows PowerShell; familiarity with YAML syntax, PromQL (Prometheus Query Language) and API-based integrations is desirable.
* Core networking: TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, routing, switching, VPNs, firewalls, load balancers, latency, packet loss, and common connectivity diagnostics.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or diploma in Computer Science, Information Technology, Engineering, or a related discipline, or an equivalent combination of education, training, and relevant experience.
* At least one year of experience in NOC, infrastructure operations, Service Now, systems administration, network support, or another 24x7 technical support environment is preferred. Entry-level candidates with relevant internships, labs, or certifications may be considered.
* Foundational understanding of incident, request, problem, change, and knowledge management practices.
* Ability to interpret alerts, dashboards, logs, system events, and basic performance or capacity indicators.
* Ability to troubleshoot methodically, follow technical procedures, recognize operational risk, and escalate with complete and accurate context.
* Clear written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to provide concise technical updates to both technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, prioritization, and time management in a high-volume environment with shifting priorities.
* Ability to work independently within established procedures and collaborate effectively across global teams and time zones.
* Ability and willingness to work rotational shifts, weekends, holidays, and scheduled maintenance windows as business needs require.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Hands-on experience with enterprise monitoring, observability, event management, or incident response tools.
* Experience supporting network, Windows, Linux, virtualization, storage, cloud, or enterprise application environments.
* Experience with ITSM ticketing platforms, CMDB concepts, service mapping, and operational knowledge management.
* Experience using PowerShell or another scripting language to automate repetitive operational tasks.
* ITIL Foundation and (or) relevant monitoring-tool certification.
* Experience in a regulated, audited, legal technology, eDiscovery, or globally distributed services environment.

**Core Competencies**

* Operational ownership and accountability
* Analytical troubleshooting and sound judgment
* Calm, structured response during high-impact incidents
* Customer and service orientation
* Clear communication and active listening
* Collaboration across technical teams
* Documentation discipline and attention to detail
* Continuous improvement and learning agility

Client Experience | Listen for the “why." Clearly define success. Be accountable. Go the extra distance to create moments that matter.
  
  
Collaboration | Treat everyone with respect . Welcome diverse views . Partner across geographies, generations, and teams. Rally around final decisions.
  
  
Innovation | Always be curious (ABC) . Challenge the status quo . Experiment and fail forward . Build for the future.
  
  
Grit | Focus on what matters . Work with passion and persistence. Think like an owner . Deliver results you’re proud of.

description:
**About Us**
With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.
  
  
Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.
  
  
At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.
  
  
Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

IT Manager
  
  
What You Will Be Doing
  
  
As a Senior IT Administrator, you will own and operate critical IT infrastructure across one or more specialized domains — Microsoft 365, Okta, Kandji, Intune, and JumpCloud. You will work directly with the IT Manager to keep enterprise systems running, secure, and well-integrated across a global organization. This role operates on PST hours (night shift from India) to provide real-time coverage for ChargePoint’s US-based teams and end users.
  
  
Your day-to-day work spans hands-on administration, incident response, cross-team collaboration, and continuous improvement of the tools and processes that keep ChargePoint’s workforce productive. You will be based in the Bengaluru office, working on-site in night shift.
  
  
**Your Responsibilities Include**

* Administer and maintain enterprise platforms including Microsoft 365, Okta, Kandji, Intune, and JumpCloud — managing user lifecycle, access policies, device configurations, and compliance baselines.
* Serve as the escalation point for Tier 2/3 issues related to identity management, endpoint management, and SaaS tooling during PST business hours.
* Plan and execute software deployments, OS updates, security patches, and configuration changes with minimal end-user disruption.
* Monitor system health, performance metrics, and security alerts — proactively identifying and resolving issues before they affect users.
* Collaborate with Security, Engineering, and Help Desk teams to enforce IT policies, harden endpoints, and respond to security incidents.
* Automate repetitive administrative tasks using PowerShell, Bash, or platform-native scripting to reduce manual effort and improve consistency.
* Maintain documentation for configurations, runbooks, and standard operating procedures.
* Support onboarding and offboarding workflows, ensuring timely provisioning and de-provisioning of accounts, devices, and access.
* Evaluate and recommend improvements to existing tooling and workflows based on operational data and emerging best practices.

**What You Will Bring To ChargePoint**
We are looking for a Senior IT Administrator with at least 5 years of hands-on experience managing enterprise IT infrastructure. You should have deep working knowledge of one or more of the following: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID), Okta, Kandji, Intune, or JumpCloud. Experience operating in a global environment where you coordinate across time zones and work independently during off-hours coverage is important.
  
  
You are someone who takes ownership of problems end to end, communicates clearly with both technical and non-technical stakeholders, and stays current with evolving technologies. You are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where priorities shift and new challenges surface regularly.
  
  
**Requirements**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in IT administration, systems engineering, or a related role.
* Demonstrated expertise with one or more of the following: Microsoft 365 (Exchange Online, SharePoint, Teams, Entra ID/Azure AD), Okta, Kandji, Intune, JumpCloud.
* Strong troubleshooting skills across Windows, macOS, and cloud-based platforms.
* Experience with identity and access management (SSO, MFA, SCIM provisioning, conditional access policies).
* Working knowledge of endpoint management and MDM solutions for both macOS and Windows fleets.
* Familiarity with scripting and automation (PowerShell, Bash, Python, or equivalent).
* Ability to work PST hours (night shift from India) to provide real-time support for US-based operations.
* Available to work on-site in the Bengaluru office at least 4 days per week.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills; comfortable working across geographies and time zones.

Inputs can include an advertiser’s own data sets, as well as their Amazon Advertising campaign events, such as impressions, clicks, and conversions. AMC enables advertisers to perform campaign measurement, audience refinement, supply optimization, and more, enabling advertisers to make more informed decisions about their cross-channel marketing investments. Our services ingest billions of behavioral signals every day. Speed, scale, and accuracy are critical to our success.
  
  
Are you passionate about driving customer success? Interested in learning new technologies? Do you thrive in a dynamic, fast-paced environment? AMC is seeking a Sr Support Engineer to provide support to partners and external customers as they build business-critical applications on our platform. You'll also work directly with Amazon Advertising product and engineering teams to ensure that customer issues are resolved as expediently as possible.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
In this role, you will independently resolve customer issues and blockers by providing knowledgeable and responsive technical support on AMC. Our customers are large enterprises, direct and agencies.You would often interact with customers’ Data Analysts and other Data focused stakeholders. You would use advanced SQL skills to build confidence and solutions. You will have ownership for issue investigation, identifying root cause and software defects, conceive and provide workarounds if acceptable to customers for continuity. You will gather sufficient information that helps reproduce issues and contribute to building software fixes. This is a complex, and fast-paced environment as you will own the most critical part of the customer experience and delivering on our customers’ most basic need. While we obsess over issue resolution, in this role you will also develop tools to scale our support & service quality, and provide critical input for product prioritization to address root causes of why the customer experienced an issue in the first place. Our advertising customers are likely Amazon customers, and we take seriously maintaining the high customer service bar set by Amazon to be the level at which we need to operate.
  
  
A day in the life
  
  

* Track, investigate, and resolve customer questions and issues using appropriate communication channel including phone, email, and live as well as asynchronous at various levels of complexity and customer impact.
* Act as an escalation point for the most complex and in-depth issues that potentially span multiple external and internal organizations.
* Communicate directly with internal organizations to complete root cause analyses, issue investigation, workarounds and defect resolution.
* Develop and implement complex repro cases to identify potential software defects, mis-configurations, or issues in customer environments.

* Actively seeking solutions to customer needs, communicating trends to leadership, and suggesting innovative solutions on behalf of the customer experience.

title: Customer Engineer
description:
**Nexla, briefly**
Nexla is the data connectivity layer for enterprise AI. Over 1,000 bidirectional connectors give agents real-time access to data and actions over MCP. Nexla's Agentic Data Integration handles high-volume streaming ETL, CDC, and Document ETL. At the core of the platform is Helix, a context engine that continuously learns from metadata, schemas, telemetry, and documentation to give agents accurate context and keep pipelines reliable. Nexla processes over a trillion records a month for enterprises including DoorDash, LiveRamp, LinkedIn, and J&J. Honorable Mention in the Gartner Magic Quadrant™ for Data Integration Tools, and top-rated by customers on Gartner Peer Insights four years running.
  
  
**Role, briefly**
You would be the technical bridge between our customers and our engineering teams. When a customer’s pipeline breaks, or our Ops team spots something before the customer does, you take it: dig through logs and connectors, find the actual cause, and see it through to a fix. This is not ticket triage. You own the resolution, including the engineering conversations it takes to get there. Python, SQL, and REST APIs are the tools you reach for daily.
  
  
**What you’ll own**

* Technical resolution, end to end. Cases raised by customers and issues surfaced by our Ops and L1 team: first investigation, root cause, and the fix, including driving it with the engineering teams who own the code.
* The investigation itself. Logs, connectors, the Nexla environment, and whatever Python or shell you need to write to see what is actually happening. Written fast, often thrown away.
* What you learn, written down. Known and newly found solutions in the knowledge base so the next person does not start from zero, plus the Global Alerts and visibility updates that go to Sales and Customer Success when an issue reaches past one customer.
* The customer’s experience of all of it. Clear updates across email, tickets, Slack, and calls, and support through product releases.

**The hard problem**
Most of what lands on you will not be a bug in our code. It will be a third-party API that changed without telling anyone, a file that arrived malformed, an auth token that quietly expired, or a schema that moved. Across more than a thousand external systems, each with its own quirks, the hard part is working out which side of the boundary the problem sits on, and proving it, while the customer is waiting and reasonably assumes it is ours.
  
  
**Must-haves**

* 3 to 6 years in data engineering, technical support, or a closely related role.
* Strong Python. You write scripts quickly to debug something or set up an alert, and you are comfortable throwing them away afterwards.
* Solid SQL and hands-on with databases: Postgres, MySQL, Oracle, or SQL Server.
* REST APIs and the authentication around them: OAuth2, SSO, and token-based. You have debugged an auth failure that was not documented anywhere.
* Comfortable on both Linux and Windows, and with data formats including CSV, XML, JSON, and Parquet.
* You use AI tools in your actual work and can say specifically where they help and where they mislead you.

**Bonus points**

* Apache Airflow.
* You have worked a support or on-call rotation before and know what good looks like.
* Data integration, ETL, or iPaaS background.

**You’ll thrive here if**

* You can write a clear update to a frustrated customer and a clear one to a busy engineer, and you know those are different jobs.
* You like digging. Logs, traces, and the part where it finally makes sense.
* You do not handle a problem half-understood.
* You work well with people who are under pressure, without adding to it.

*One thing to be clear about: this role runs on a shift rotation with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts, but your week will not always be Monday to Friday. If that does not fit your life, this is not the right role, and it is better to know now.*
**The practical stuff**
Bengaluru preferred, and we are open to candidates working remotely elsewhere in India. The role runs on a rotational shift pattern with weekend coverage shared across the team. We do not run late-night shifts. Compensation includes base salary, bonus, and equity, set by depth and experience rather than by title.
  
  
**Worth a look before you apply**

* **What we are building now.**
  MCP Studio and Express, our two newest bets.
* **Who uses us, and why.**
  nexla.com/customers
* **The product you would be supporting.**
  docs.nexla.com
* **Our CEO on why we take "Remember to Relax" seriously.**
  Read the founder story
* **Everything else.**
  nexla.com
* Blog
* All open roles

Why Nexla? Why now?
  
  
A few large companies - DoorDash, SentinelOne, Johnson & Johnson, LinkedIn, Amex, Integrity Marketing, among them use Nexla for data integration. Connectors, runtime, transformations, scheduling, the parts of the stack where data has to move between systems reliably.
  
  
The reason this is an interesting moment to join is what the agent shift is doing to the category. Data integration used to mean "land this data in that warehouse so a human can look at it." That product is mature. What it's becoming is closer to "an agent asks a business question, and the platform figures out which data and what code and which APIs add up to a real answer." That's a much bigger problem, and most of the architecture for it hasn't been built yet by anyone.
  
  
A concrete example. A revenue team wants to ask "which enterprise customers are showing renewal risk" and get a real answer through whatever agent or app they work in. Today there is no clean way to answer that question, it requires CRM, usage, support, and billing data joined in org-specific ways, and the calling agent can't just invoke a tool that returns the right answer unless someone first establishes whether the underlying data is even capable of producing one.
  
  
That is the system we are building. A probe agent investigates the data plane whether the right fields are populated, whether freshness is adequate, whether the joins exist, whether credentials cover the required scope and returns a grounded feasibility answer. Where there are gaps, Express.dev composes the pipelines to close them. The capability is then exposed as an MCP server: "renewal risk" as a curated product, with the business logic correct and the query semantics described well enough that the calling agent uses it as intended. The MCP Gateway governs which agents can call which capabilities, with the policies, audit, and observability an enterprise control plane requires.
  
  
The bet is that ten years of connector work, an enterprise customer base, and a runtime that already moves real volume are the right foundation to define this layer from.

description:
**Strength in Trust**
OneTrust’s mission is to enable innovation through the responsible use of data and AI. We believe that ensuring data is trusted shouldn’t slow teams down—it should accelerate what’s possible. This led us to develop the first technology platform for responsible data use in 2016. Today, with AI representing the latest and most impactful expansion of data yet, OneTrust is once again redefining what responsible innovation looks like. OneTrust, the AI‑Ready Governance Platform™, unifies regulatory intelligence, automation, and connected governance workflows so businesses can continue to move at the speed of AI while ensuring good governance to prevent data misuse at scale. Trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide, OneTrust is shaping the future where trusted data becomes a transformative force for business and society.
  
  
**The Challenge**
Due to rapid growth and an increased demand for our platform, OneTrust is seeking a Technical Implementation Consultant. The Technical Implementation Consultant role is one of the key pieces of the OneTrust architecture. After the sales process, consultants are the key contact in driving and building the relationship, implementing the solution, and managing the expectations of the customer. Technical Implementation consultants work across the technical modules. As a Technical Implementation Consultant, you will be responsible for the customer relationship and will work directly with our customers to . The role is one of the most important as it is the bridge between OneTrust and the customer, helping the business grow by identifying product enhancements and relaying them between the customer and OneTrust Product teams.
  
  
**Our Team**
The Content Customization team is unique team with incredible talent. This team combines a fine-tuned project management discipline alongside superb technical acumen sprinkled with stunning design chops. Not only that, but we build on top of 2 world-class, customer-friendly CMS and LMS platforms. Furthermore, we operate like a boutique agency inside the OneTrust Ethics Professional Services Team.
  
  
**Your Mission**
**As a Technical Implementation Consultant, You Will**
Oversee the technical implementation and platform adoption for customer projects from start to finish.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing web-based portals and pages based on customer assets and brand guidelines on our CMS tool.
  
  
Provide creative insight and execution for customers while implementing branding and creating custom courses with customer assets and brand guidelines on our learning authoring tool.
  
  
Use your experience across a broad range of front-end technologies including HTML and CSS.
  
  
Use your design experience using wireframing tools like Figma and storyboarding in tools like Fig-jam.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with the Adobe suite of products to create assets to use in creative projects.
  
  
Use or deepen your knowledge of Instructional Design.
  
  
Use or deepen your experience with web accessibility standards (ADA &WCAG).
  
  
Work closely with UI/UX design, marketing, product management and engineering on project goals and requirements.
  
  
Prioritize and drive resolution on escalated customer issues.
  
  
Complete internal and project documentation.
  
  
Seek opportunities in day-to-day workflow to improve quality and efficiency from ideation to deployment.
  
  
Document processes and workflows in shareable documents for future use and adoption.
  
  
Document project progress in our CRM tool (Salesforce)
  
  
Be an advocate for our customers by representing their issues to Product Management and Software Engineering with a focus on steering the OneTrust roadmap.
  
  
Monitor and analyse the customer’s adoption of our solution features and functionality to provide leadership with an understanding of their overall business needs as they relate to our products.
  
  
Provide strategic and tactical support for Sales, Professional Services, and Business Development
  
  
You will also act as system and regulatory best practice expert, drawing from a plethora of consulting experience to advise customers on optimization of privacy & ethics program(s). Act as the customer advocate. Seamlessly transition ownership and action plan back to involved teams. Show ownership of issues, engage customers, establish urgent priorities, and implement resolution plan. Able to resolve simple to moderate issues with minimal management intervention. Ability to interpret and deliver on custom SOW customer projects.
  
  
**Your Experience Includes**
BA/BS OR MS in Computer Science, Web Design/Development [Bootcamp friendly], Engineering Management or Information Technology/Systems
  
  
2 – 5 years of relevant experience in software development, professional services, solution engineering, design, technical consulting; with expertise in architecting, supporting and/or rolling out new technology and solution initiatives.
  
  
Experience working with front-end technologies and design frameworks.
  
  
Effective customer-facing relationship building skills. Proven success in and genuine enthusiasm for working directly with customer(s).
  
  
Proven ability to engage across corporate functions (Professional Services, Support and Product Management).
  
  
Previous end-to-end implementation experience, ideally on a SAAS platform/product or creative agency.
  
  
Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to chair meetings or host trainings.
  
  
An understanding of the following tech/tools: HTML, CSS, Figma (or any wireframing tool), Acquia (or any CMS), Gomo (or any learning authoring tool), Salesforce, Jira – a plus, SSO, Domain Management.
  
  
Ability to build relationships across stakeholders in marketing, product, sales, and engineering.
  
  
Proficiency in Microsoft suite of products.
  
  
**Extra Awesome**
Knowledge of HTTP, SSO, SCORM packages, domain management.
  
  
Knowledge of Learning Management Systems.
  
  
Functional experience in the field (Privacy, Ethics or GRC)
  
  
Industry Certifications (CIPP/E, CIPM, GRCP, CPA, CISA, LPEC, etc.)
  
  
Experience dealing with senior management (C-Level) across multiple customers.
  
  
Language skills (German, French, Spanish, or Italian)
  
  
Where we Work
  
  
We are embracing an office-first culture, encouraging three days a week in office for most roles, with meaningful opportunities to collaborate and celebrate in person.
  
  
Each role may have specific requirements or flexibility depending on the scope of the position, so we encourage you to verify this with your recruiter during your first interview.
  
  
**Benefits**
As an employee at OneTrust, you will be part of the OneTeam. That means you’ll receive support physically, mentally, and emotionally so that you can do your best work both in and out of the office. This includes comprehensive healthcare coverage, flexible PTO, equity RSUs, annual performance bonus opportunities, retirement account support, 14+ weeks of paid parental leave, career development opportunities, company-paid privacy certification exam fees, and much more. Specific benefits differ by country. For more information, talk to your recruiter or visit onetrust.com/careers.
  
  
Resources
  
  
Check out the following to learn more about OneTrust and its people:
  
  

* OneTrust Careers on YouTube
* @LifeatOneTrust on Instagram

Your Data
  
  
You have the right to have your personal data updated or removed. You also have the right to have a copy of the information OneTrust holds about you. Further details about these rights are available on the website in our Privacy Overview
**.**
You can change your mind at any time and have your personal data removed from our database. In order to do this you must contact us and let us know you wish to be removed. The request should be made on the Data Subject Request Form.
  
  
Recruitment fraud warning: OneTrust is aware of scams involving false offers of employment with our company. The fraudulent jobs, interviews and job offers use fake websites, email addresses, group chat and text messages. Be aware that we never ask candidates for personal information, IDs or bank information during the interview process. We do not interview prospective candidates via instant message or group chat, and do not require candidates to purchase products or services, or process payments on our behalf as a condition of any employment offer. Please note that any legitimate interview availability requests will come directly from a OneTrust recruiter with an "@onetrust.com" email address. You may also receive legitimate emails from "@us.greenhouse-mail.io". Recruiters will only reach out to candidates who have applied for a role through our ATS (Greenhouse) or prospects via LinkedIn InMail. Job offers will come from a recruiter and may have a "@docusign.net" email address. For more information or if you have been targeted please reach out to askrecruiting@onetrust.com.
  
  
**Our Commitment to You**
When you join OneTrust you are stepping onto a launching pad — the countdown has begun. The destination? A career without boundaries working alongside a diverse and inclusive crew who is passionate about doing meaningful work. As a pioneer, your voice and expertise will help chart the direction of an entirely new category. Our commitment to putting people first starts with you. Your growth is part of the mission. Our goal is to give you the power to embark on the next phase of your uniquely, unique career.
  
  
OneTrust provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by local laws.

title: Platform Administrator
description:
**Position Summary**
The Platform Administrator serves as a trusted advisor and technical administrator for ServiceChannel customers, ensuring platform configurations are maintained, optimized, and aligned to business requirements. This role partners closely with customers, Facility Coordinators, Customer Success, Product Management, and Support teams to implement configuration changes, support platform enhancements, and drive adoption of ServiceChannel capabilities. This position is responsible for administrative configuration, user management, customer-requested updates, and communication regarding platform performance and enhancements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Customer Platform Administration**

* Configure and maintain ServiceChannel platform settings based on customer requirements.
* Modify and manage user access, permissions, and administrative settings.
* Implement customer-requested updates within approved platform modules.
* Maintain dashboard settings, workflows, and issue list configurations.

**Customer Consultation & Support**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for platform administration requests.
* Review customer enhancement requests and collaborate with internal stakeholders to evaluate solutions.
* Provide customers with updates on enhancement requests and platform initiatives.
* Communicate ServiceChannel system performance issues and platform updates to customers and internal stakeholders.

**Configuration Management**
**Support Configuration And Administration Within**

* Locations & Provider Assignments
* Asset Management
* Refrigerant Tracking
* Site Planning
* Inventory
* Projects
* Supply Manager
* Preventative Maintenance configuration
* Business Hours settings
* Invoice and Proposal workflows
* Auto Invoice Approval processes
* Dashboard administration
* Issue List configuration

**Cross-Functional Collaboration**

* Partner with Customer Success Managers, Product teams, Support teams, and Facility Coordinators to deliver customer solutions.
* Participate in customer meetings related to platform administration and optimization.
* Document platform changes and maintain configuration records.
* Escalate issues and risks appropriately to leadership and technical teams.

**Qualifications**
**Required**

* 2+ years of experience in SaaS administration, customer support, system administration, facility management technology, or related fields.
* Experience managing customer-facing technology solutions.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and customer requests simultaneously.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Experience working with cross-functional stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* ServiceChannel platform experience.
* Zendesk experience.
* Knowledge of facilities management workflows.
* Experience with workflow automation and business process optimization.
* Experience supporting enterprise customers.

**Success Measures**

* Customer satisfaction and platform adoption
* Configuration accuracy and quality
* Request turnaround time
* SLA adherence
* Reduction in configuration-related escalations
* Customer retention and expansion support
* Stakeholder satisfaction

**Fortive Corporation Overview**
Fortive's essential technology makes the world safer and more productive. We accelerate transformation in high-impact fields like workplace safety, build environments, and healthcare.
  
  
We are a global industrial technology innovator with a startup spirit. Our forward-looking companies lead the way in healthcare sterilization, industrial safety, predictive maintenance, and other mission-critical solutions. We're a force for progress, working alongside our customers and partners to solve challenges on a global scale, from workplace safety in the most demanding conditions to advanced technologies that help providers focus on exceptional patient care.
  
  
We are a diverse team 10,000 strong, united by a dynamic, inclusive culture and energized by limitless learning and growth. We use the proven Fortive Business System (FBS) to accelerate our positive impact.
  
  
At Fortive, we believe in you. We believe in your potential—your ability to learn, grow, and make a difference.
  
  
At Fortive, we believe in us. We believe in the power of people working together to solve problems no one could solve alone.
  
  
At Fortive, we believe in growth. We're honest about what's working and what isn't, and we never stop improving and innovating.
  
  
Fortive: For you, for us, for growth.
  
  
**About ServiceChannel**
ServiceChannel empowers many of your favorite brands to take care of their brick and mortar locations. Our customers are market leaders in the retail, restaurant, grocery, convenience store, fitness, banking, education and health industries. The facilities and store operations teams at CVS, Trader Joe’s, Adidas, Louis Vuitton and Chipotle, among 500 other brands in over 70+ countries, rely on us to deliver the best possible guest and employee experience. We are the leader in our space, and we continue to earn that position by driving innovation around IOT, AI and data with our software and services.In 2021, we joined the Fortive family of leading technology companies, united by a common purpose to make the world stronger, safer and smarter. Fortive is a Fortune 500 company and has been named by Fortune as one of the world’s most admired companies. title: Application Support Engineer
description:
LSEG offers essential platforms, financial data services and trading venues for various clients such as businesses, governments, and investors around the globe.
  
  
The real-time market data, indices, analytics, and news services LSEG supplies allows traders and investors understand market conditions and trends. We deliver the infrastructure, data, and analytics that market participants rely on to make confident, informed investment decisions.
  
  
LSEG is dedicated to empowering economies and enabling sustainable growth by incorporating environmental, social, and governance (ESG) factors into its operations and offerings.
  
  
**Our People:**
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our culture of connecting, creating opportunity and delivering excellence shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential.
  
  
We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and exciting experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise.
  
  
As a global organisation spanning 70 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with significant careers.
  
  
**Role Summary:**
In this role, you will be joining our Service Excellence team within Application Operations, Corporate Technology (CT) as a Support Engineer
  
  
**What You Will be Doing:**

* Take end-to-end Ownership of Application Support for Production issues resolution.
* Possess hand-on experience in ServiceNow, including incident management, problem resolution and workflow automation to enhance IT service delivery.
* Raises complex problems to the L3 level of expertise within organization, along with observations from investigative and diagnostic assessments.
* Co-ordinating in the investigation of repeated technical issues affecting user system and seeing through to resolution.
* Ensuring an acceptable level of IT operations performance and error risk in line with service level agreements (SLAs).
* Provide some periodical and/or emergency support (i.e. on-call support), as may be needed from time-to-time.
* Advance incidents/failures to Level 3 Support or Capability in line with the defined escalation process and drive the closure within the SLAs.
* Provide regular and high-quality updates to the customer on the progress on the incidents, including SLA breaches.
* Continuously review operating metrics and data to see opportunities to improve.

**What You will Bring:**
**Preferred Skills And Experience**

* 4+ years of hands-on experience providing support and maintenance for Salesforce environments.
* Experience with Salesforce CPQ and Sales Cloud is preferred.
* Salesforce CPQ support is a core responsibility of this position. Candidates must be willing to undergo training and invest time in learning CPQ processes and functionality. The successful candidate will be expected to develop sufficient expertise to independently handle CPQ-related tickets, user requests, and support activities.
* One or more Salesforce.com certifications (e.g., CPQ, Administrator, Advanced Administrator, Community).
* Knowledge and experience with both Salesforce Classic and Lightning UI's.
* Experience integrating and maintaining salesforce with third-party systems.
* Knowledge of Salesforce platform standard and custom capabilities (e.g., standard, and custom fields, validation rules, formulas, page layouts and record pages, custom object and relationships, approvals, and security).
* Knowledge of Salesforce platform automation abilities and practical application of Process Builders, Flows, Visualforce, APEX programming, Force.com APIs, REST API's and Web Services.
* Experience conducting QA Tests on changes to Salesforce.com deployment including handling multiple sandbox instances.
* Understanding of the SDLC and agile delivery methodology.
* Experience working with databases and data, performing data cleanup, and/or data manipulation and migration to and from Salesforce.com.
* Have stayed ahead of new SFDC features and functionality and have provided. recommendations for process improvements.
* 2+ Years of experience in a Support Technical role.
* 1 year experience in Salesforce CPQ cloud would be advantage.
* The team provides support coverage to clients across multiple regions on a 24/5 basis. This role is primarily aligned to US business hours and will participate in an on-call rotation, including occasional weekend support as required.

**Detailed Responsibilities**

* Work closely with senior and junior engineers in Service Excellence Team and coordinate the efforts with lead and manager of the team.
* Must interact with global teams in time zones spanning UK, US, APAC areas.
* Resolve customer service issues and thoughtfully handle complex customer service problems.
* Lead customers: expectations and experience in a way that results in high customer satisfaction.
* Assist with the design and delivery of product and other technical training.
* Review support cases for technical and troubleshooting accuracy.
* Define and describe technical standard processes.

description:
We are looking for a CCTV and Networking Engineer to take ownership of surveillance and ELV installations from site survey through commissioning and long-term support. You will handle IP network integration, run preventive and corrective maintenance, and coordinate with clients, vendors, and internal teams to keep systems reliable and SLAs met.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Installation & Commissioning**

* Conduct site surveys and recommend camera placement, cabling routes, and network design.
* Install, configure, and commission IP/analog cameras, NVRs/DVRs, VMS, and PoE switches.
* Supervise cabling (CAT6/fibre), termination, labelling, and testing.
* Complete installations to drawings and BOQ, and prepare as-built documentation.

**2. Network Integration & Configuration**

* Configure IP addressing, VLANs, routing, and basic switching for surveillance networks.
* Integrate CCTV with access control, fire alarm, intercom, and other ELV systems as required.
* Set up remote viewing, port forwarding/VPN, and mobile/VMS client access.
* Troubleshoot bandwidth, latency, packet loss, and PoE issues.

**3. Maintenance & Support**

* Perform scheduled preventive maintenance (PM) visits and health checks.
* Diagnose and resolve faults on cameras, recorders, storage, switches, and cabling.
* Handle service tickets within SLA and maintain accurate service reports.
* Manage firmware updates, backups, and storage/retention checks.

**4. Site Ownership & Coordination**

* Experience with managed switches (Cisco, D-Link, TP-Link, Netgear, or similar).
* Knowledge of structured cabling (CAT6, fibre splicing/OTDR basics) and testing tools.
* Familiarity with VMS platforms, NVR/storage sizing, and video analytics basics.
* Comfortable using laptop, crimping/testing tools, and network diagnostic utilities.

**Good to have:**

* CCNA, CompTIA Network+, or OEM certifications.
* Exposure to access control, biometrics, fire alarm, or PA systems.
* Experience with ticketing/CRM tools.
* Basic understanding of cybersecurity hygiene for IP cameras (password policies, firmware, port hardening).

**Soft skills:**

* Strong troubleshooting and ownership mindset.
* Clear communication with clients and vendors.
* Ability to work independently and manage multiple sites.
* Willingness to travel and handle on-call or after-hours support.

Key Performance Indicators

* First-time-fix rate

title: Technical Support Engineer II
description:
**Who we are**

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you'll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that's shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. As part of a recently public company, you'll have the autonomy and support to make an impact as we build for the long term.

**About the role:**

Samsara is looking for an experienced **Technical Support Engineer** to provide world-class hardware and software support experience to our customers. You will be a part of our **Tier 2 support team** within the umbrella of the Global Technical Support organization. You will be responsible for resolving complex customer problems and improving support across all teams. Your work will be collaborative in nature, working together with other support engineers in multiple support locations to serve our customers and troubleshoot complex issues.

The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background with experience in a technical support role, proven customer-facing skills, and strong communication skills. You understand the day-to-day aspects of customer support including managing tickets, building knowledge base articles, and providing product feedback to Engineering and PM teams.

**You should apply if:**

* **You want to impact the industries that run our world:** Your efforts will result in real-world impact—helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.
* **You are the architect of your own career:** If you put in the work, this role won't be your last at Samsara. We set up our employees for success and have built a culture that encourages rapid career development, countless opportunities to experiment and master your craft in a hyper growth environment.
* **You're energized by our opportunity:** The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.
* **You want to be with the best:** At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

**In this role, you will:**

* **Product Expertise**: Become an expert on Samsara's product portfolio of complete Internet of Things ("IoT") solutions combining hardware, software, and cloud to bring real-time visibility, analytics, and AI to operations across multiple industries.
* **Technical Troubleshooting**: Use your technical knowledge and product expertise to troubleshoot and resolve customer issues with medium to high complexity.
* **Responsiveness & Resolution**: Respond to customers and resolve their inquiries in a timely and helpful manner with a primary focus on meeting our SLA goals.
* **Documentation**: Partner with Enablement to author and maintain customer-facing knowledge base articles to help improve the self-servisablity for our end users.
* **Partnerships**: Work closely to develop partnerships with our Engineering and Product teams in order to reproduce bugs and build testbeds as necessary.
* **Feedback Loop**: Provide direct feedback to Support Management for product and process improvements to help enhance the customer experience.
* **Team Player**: Champion, role model, and embed Samsara's cultural principles (Focus on Customer Success, Build for the Long Term, Adopt a Growth Mindset, Be Inclusive, Win as a Team) as we scale globally and across new offices.

This is a hybrid position based in our Bengaluru office, requiring you to participate in an on-call rotation schedule to triage and manage high-severity issues and outages.

**Minimum requirements for the role:**

* B.S. in Computer Science, Engineering (Mechanical/Electrical), or other technical fields.
* Minimum 5 years of experience in support, engineering, or other technical roles.
* Fluent English is a must.
* Technical know-how - you're comfortable interfacing with engineers, translating complex technical concepts into everyday language, and working with SaaS systems.
* Excellent customer service and interpersonal skills coupled with the ability to influence individual contributors and leaders across the company.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, you can speak both Engineer and Human.
* Strong bias for action, ability to dive deep, and insistence on the highest standards.
* Ability to work in a hyper-growth environment with shifting priorities.
* Willingness to work flexible hours during nights and weekends is preferred.
* We are looking for someone with strong API/Mobile Apps experience

**An ideal candidate also has:**

* Experience with industrial systems, electronics, tinkering with cars or IoT devices, or similar hands-on work is a big plus.
* Trilingual English, Spanish and French is a big plus.
* Strong familiarity with using CRMs like Zendesk or Salesforce.

#LI-hybrid

**Total Rewards**

At Samsara, we build for the people who keep the global economy moving. We want owners, not passengers, which is why our rewards are designed to fuel high-impact builders. Our compensation program delivers above-market total compensation through a combination of base salary, performance-based bonus/variable pay, and equity (for eligible roles) in a high-growth public company. We meaningfully differentiate pay for our top performers, who have the opportunity to earn above-market compensation that can outpace the broader market over time.

Beyond compensation, we provide the foundations that enable long-term success: a flexible, employee-led remote model, a professional development stipend, comprehensive health and parental leave plans, and more. If you're ready to build for the long term and own the outcome, your journey starts here.

**Flexible Working**

At Samsara, we embrace a flexible working model that caters to the diverse needs of our teams. Our offices are open for those who prefer to work in-person and we also support remote work where it aligns with our operational requirements. For certain positions, being close to one of our offices or within a specific geographic area is important to facilitate collaboration, access to resources, or alignment with our service regions. In these cases, the job description will clearly indicate any working location requirements. Our goal is to ensure that all members of our team can contribute effectively, whether they are working on-site, in a hybrid model, or fully remotely. All offers of employment are contingent upon an individual's ability to secure and maintain the legal right to work at the company and in the specified work location, if applicable.

**Belonging at Samsara**

At Samsara, we welcome everyone regardless of their background. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, national origin, sex, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, protected veteran status, disability, age, and other characteristics protected by law. We depend on the unique approaches of our team members to help us solve complex problems and want to ensure that Samsara is a place where people from all backgrounds can make an impact.

**Accommodations**

Samsara is an inclusive work environment, and we are committed to ensuring equal opportunity in employment for qualified persons with disabilities. Please email accessibleinterviewing@samsara.com or click here if you require any reasonable accommodations throughout the recruiting process.

**Our Commitment to Authenticity**

We use Tofu, a fraud detection tool, to validate the authenticity of applications and protect against identity fraud. This ensures we are connecting with real people and allows us to prioritize genuine candidates. Please see Samsara's Candidate Privacy Notice for more information.

**Fraudulent Employment Offers**

Official communication about your application will only come from emails ending in @samsara.com, @us-greenhouse-mail.io or @mail3.guide.co. For more information regarding fraudulent employment offers, please visit our blog post here.

title: Mainframe zOS Systems Administrator
description:
**Who We Are**

At Kyndryl, we run and reimagine the mission-critical technology systems that drive advantage for the world’s leading businesses. We are at the heart of progress; with proven expertise and a continuous flow of AI-powered insight, enabling smarter decisions, faster innovation, and a lasting competitive edge. For our people—Kyndryls—that means doing purposeful work that powers human progress. Join us and experience a flexible, supportive environment where your well-being is prioritized and your potential can thrive.

**The Role**

**Your Role**

  

As a System Administrator at Kyndryl, you’ll solve complex problems and identify potential future issues across the spectrum of platforms and services. You’ll be at the forefront of new technology and modernization, working with some of our biggest clients-which means some of the biggest in the world.

  

**What You Will Do**

  

* Install, configure, maintain, and upgrade **DB2 for z/OS** environments, ensuring platform stability, performance, and availability.
* Plan and execute DB2 version migrations, maintenance activities, and recovery strategies, including SMP/E, PTF, and APAR implementations.
* Administer DB2 subsystems, DSNZPARM configurations, buffer pools, storage resources, catalogs, and directories.
* Monitor, analyze, and optimize DB2 performance through tuning of subsystem parameters, SQL access paths, buffer pools, and resource utilization.
* Design and support high-availability, disaster recovery, and data-sharing environments to meet business continuity and recovery objectives.
* Manage DB2 utilities including REORG, RUNSTATS, COPY, LOAD/UNLOAD, RECOVER, and REBUILD INDEX operations while ensuring optimal execution and reliability.
* Partner with security teams to implement DB2 security controls, authorization strategies, compliance requirements, and vulnerability remediation.
* Perform capacity planning, growth forecasting, and infrastructure optimization to support evolving business and application demands.
* Develop and enhance automation using REXX, JCL, and monitoring tools to improve operational efficiency and proactive system health management.
* Lead root cause analysis and resolution of critical incidents, acting as the highest level of technical escalation for complex DB2 issues.
* Collaborate with application development teams on SQL tuning, database design reviews, migrations, and onboarding of new workloads.
* Drive modernization initiatives including DB2 upgrades, DevOps integration, automation, observability enhancements, cloud connectivity, and mainframe transformation programs.
Provide technical leadership, mentorship, operational governance, and strategic guidance to ensure a secure, highly available, and high-performing DB2 infrastructure.  

  

**Your future at Kyndryl**

  

Every position at Kyndryl offers a way forward to grow your career, from Junior System Administrator to Architect. We have opportunities for Cloud Hyperscalers that you won’t find anywhere else, including hands-on experience, learning opportunities, and the chance to certify in all four major platforms. One of the benefits of Kyndryl is that we work with clients in a variety of industries, from banking to retail. Whether you want to broaden your knowledge base or narrow your scope and specialize in a specific sector, you can find your opportunity here.

**Who You Are**

You’re good at what you do and possess the required experience to prove it. However, equally as important – you have a growth mindset; keen to drive your own personal and professional development. You are customer-focused – someone who prioritizes customer success in their work. And finally, you’re open and borderless – naturally inclusive in how you work with others.
  
  
**Required Technical and Professional Expertise**

* 8+ years of experience in Mainframe z/OS system programming, with extensive hands-on expertise in z/OS installation, configuration, maintenance, and support.
* Skills in applying patches, managing third-party software and ensuring system reliability.
* Hands-on expertise in SYSRES builds, applying PTFs, performing disaster recovery drills and updating license keys.
* Proficiency in product maintenance, upgrades and compatibility checks for z/OS 3.1 and IBM z16 hardware.
* Adept at troubleshooting any system failures, freeze, job abends and performance issues.
* Willingness to provide 24/7 oncall support to resolve any system issues.
* Working knowledge of mainframe GDPS.
* Good understanding of flip and stay disaster recovery model.
* Experience of working on many migration projects as part of mainframe modernization.
Should provide recommendations on optimizing system performance.  

**Preferred Technical and Professional Experience**

* Experience in z/OS administration.
* Experience in mainframe modernization initiatives.
* Experience of supporting the IBM z16 and IBM z17 mainframe systems.
Any leadership and mentoring experience will be an added plus.  

**Being You**

The “Kyn” in Kyndryl means kinship, which represents the strong bonds we have with each other, our customers and our communities. We focus on ensuring all Kyndryls feel included and we welcome people of all cultures, backgrounds, and experiences. Even if you don’t meet every requirement, we encourage you to apply. We believe in growth, and we’re excited to see what you can bring. At Kyndryl, employee feedback has told us that our number one driver of employee engagement is belonging. That sense of belonging — being a valued, respected, trusted member of the team — is fundamental to our culture and fueling great experiences for our customers. This dedication to welcoming everyone into our company means that Kyndryl gives you the ability to thrive and contribute to our culture of empathy and shared success. That’s The Kyndryl Way.

**What You Can Expect**

Your career with us isn’t just a job—it’s an adventure with purpose. We offer a dynamic, hybrid-friendly culture that supports your well-being and empowers you to grow. Our Be Well programs are thoughtfully designed to support your financial, mental, physical, and social health—because we know that when you feel your best, you do your best.

****Senior IT Support Technician****

****automate manual tasks****
and leverage
****AI and Jira****

* Problem Solving: Strong analytical skills with a focus on "root cause" resolution and a desire to automate away repetitive tasks.
* Communication: Excellent interpersonal skills for collaborating with cross-functional teams and supporting junior staff.

**Benefits**

* Competitive Compensation: Based on market standards.
* Onsite Role: Based full-time at the Chennai office during night shift hours.
* Commute Support: Company-provided cab facility for night-shift travel.
* Health & Wellness: Medical Insurance (1+5 Family Members) and Flexible Benefit Plan.
* Culture: A supportive engineering culture that values diversity, empathy, and technical efficiency.
* Impact: A chance to work for a $1.5B valuation company dedicated to a clean energy future.

description:

Are you a highly skilled technical professional ready to bridge the gap between complex software solutions and seamless operations? As a TechOps Engineer, you will play a crucial role in the successful implementation and deployment of Application solutions on hosted and on-premise customer servers. Working closely with cross-functional teams, you will provide critical technical expertise, troubleshooting assistance, and vital user support during the deployment process.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. We provide industry-leading digital construction and enterprise lifecycle solutions that increase precision, reduce costly errors, and promote seamless collaboration throughout the asset management lifecycle.
  
  
**What Makes This Role Great**
In this role, you will have a massive impact by owning the success of infrastructure deployments and system rollouts for our global clients. You will blend cloud-based platform orchestration with hands-on systems engineering, giving you full technical autonomy across diverse server environments. You will interface directly with stakeholders, product teams, and end-users, quickly becoming the ultimate product expert while driving automation and optimization strategies across our deployment pipeline.
  
  
Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Deployment Planning & Coordination: Collaborate with cross-functional teams and stakeholders to plan deployment activities. Develop deployment strategies, timelines, and resource requirements while coordinating across groups to ensure smooth execution.
* Technical Architecture & Guidance: Understand the technical deep-dive aspects of deployed systems or software. Provide ongoing guidance and support to teams involved in the deployment process while identifying technical risks and proposing workarounds.
* User Support & Training: Assist end-users in understanding and utilizing the deployed software. Provide training sessions to familiarize users with new functionalities, address user queries, and provide timely, high-quality resolutions.
* Documentation & Progress Tracking: Create and maintain comprehensive deployment documentation, including procedures, user guides, and troubleshooting resources. Prepare deployment progress reports and track issues for future reference.
* Continuous Improvement: Identify opportunities to optimize the deployment process and enhance efficiency. Propose and implement process improvements, automation workflows, or tools to systematically streamline deployments.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Education & Background: Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, combined with proven experience in deployment support, software implementation, or a similar role.
* Cloud Platform Mastery: Strong knowledge and hands-on experience with cloud platforms such as Amazon Web Services (AWS), Microsoft Azure, or similar providers, including compute, storage, networking, databases, and deployment models (IaaS, PaaS, SaaS).
* Systems Administration & Networking: Proficient in system administration tasks (server provisioning, configuration management, and troubleshooting) and networking concepts (IP addressing, subnets, routing, load balancing, firewalls). Familiarity with virtualization technologies like VMWare, Hyper-V, or KVM.
* Cloud Security Infrastructure: Solid understanding of cloud security best practices, including identity and access management (IAM), encryption, network security groups, and data protection.
* Professional Competence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, active listening capabilities, a highly organized and self-directed approach to problem-solving, and the ability to maintain absolute professionalism, discretion, and accuracy.

**Bonus Points For**

* Automation Capabilities: High proficiency in scripting languages like Python, Bash, or PowerShell for automation scripting and system integration.
* Cross-Functional Domain Knowledge: Foundational understanding of Business Accounting (analyzing financial statements, invoice processing in accounts payable/receivable) and basics of Payroll Management.
* Product Knowledge: Ability to quickly develop and maintain a high level of knowledge of Viewpoint software products and remain an expert from both an internal and user perspective.

We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.

* Support and troubleshoot CI/CD pipelines across Non‑Production environments, including build failures, deployment issues, rollback scenarios, and promotion defects.

* Ensure logging, alerting, storage, and archiving procedures are implemented and functioning correctly.

Act as a technical liaison between business users, developers, infrastructure teams, and third‑party vendors.

* 7+ years of experience in QA / Testing, Application Support, Production Support, or Technical Operations roles.
* Strong experience supporting Non‑Production environments in fast‑paced delivery models.
* Hands‑on experience with Linux operating systems.
* Proficiency with databases (Oracle, SQL Server, MongoDB).
* Experience supporting web and middleware platforms (WebSphere, WebLogic, MQ, NDM, SFTP).
* Working knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps delivery practices.
* Experience using monitoring and logging tools (Geneos, Splunk, Kibana or equivalent).
* Experience with Autosys or enterprise scheduling tools.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and problem‑management skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with ability to explain technical issues to non‑technical stakeholders.

**Preferred / Added Advantage**

* Exposure to Cloud technologies and container platforms (ECS / Kubernetes – support perspective).
* Experience working in Agile / DevOps operating models.

* Modern enterprise network design, implementation and troubleshooting, including DNS, DHCP, spanning tree, network access control technologies, including 802.1X, IGRP routing protocols and remote access technologies including IPSec and/or SSL VPN.

You will then deploy engineering solutions assuring its implementation, effectiveness, adaptability, responsiveness, quality, governance, and the continuous improvement. **Job Specifications:**

* Broad understanding of the engineering new product development process and how CAD and PDM/PLM play a role within that process.
