title: Technical Incident Manager
description:
**Technical Incident Manager | SRM Tech | 24/7 Rotational shift**

**About SRM Tech**

SRM Technologies is a global digital and engineering partner delivering capabilities across data and AI, enterprise platforms, embedded and platform engineering, supply chain, and design-to-manufacturing services.

We work across high-impact industries such as Mobility, Life Sciences, Healthcare, and Logistics, supporting enterprises across North America, APAC, and Europe in building intelligent, future-ready ecosystems and driving transformation at scale.

As a Great Place to Work®-certified organization, we are committed to creating an environment where people can learn, grow, and thrive. We believe empowered individuals drive innovation, deliver value to customers, and play a meaningful role in shaping our collective success.

At SRM Tech, every contribution matters, and we are always looking for passionate individuals who are eager to shape their careers with us.

**Work Mode**
: Rotating 4-day on / 3-day off shift, 32 hrs/week, part of 24/7 coverage across three 8-hour shifts

Work location : Chennai , WFO.

**Preferred Experience**
: 5 - 10 years

**What You'll Do**

* Serve as Incident Commander for Sev 1–4 incidents, owning coordination,
* communication, and resolution from declaration to closure.
* Perform initial triage — gather basic diagnostics, follow runbooks — then escalate to the
* right owner with a clear summary of findings and impact.
* Own the incident retro process: scheduling, facilitating blameless postmortems, and
* driving action items to closure.
* Debrief with engineering teams each shift to capture lessons learned and flag process
* gaps.
* Create and maintain incident playbooks with SMEs, keeping documentation current.
* Lead monthly dry runs and readiness exercises across teams.

* Report incident metrics (MTTR, retro completion time) to leadership on a regular
* cadence.
* Support operational governance, including change management reviews.

**What You Bring**

* Experience leading incident response as an Incident Commander or Major Incident
* Manager during high-severity outages.
* Strong composure and decision-making under pressure, able to direct SMEs without
* being the deepest technical expert.
* Excellent communication skills, translating technical situations for engineers and
* executives alike.
* Experience running structured postmortems or root-cause analysis.
* Strong organizational skills to track multiple action items and deadlines.
* Ability to follow documented playbooks and exercise judgement regarding the need for
* escalation.
* Experience with Jira/Confluence for incident tracking and documentation.
* Ability to work rotating shifts, including nights/weekends.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in IT service management, operations, or program management.
* Familiarity with basic monitoring/dashboard concepts.
* Experience facilitating cross-functional meetings or change initiatives.
* Data analysis or reporting experience for leadership updates.
* ITIL certification or equivalent incident/problem management training

*SRM Tech is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, inclusion, and belonging. We make all hiring decisions based on merit, without bias or discrimination, in line with applicable laws.*

title: BI Developer
description:
**Your role**
What We Need
  
  
Corpay is currently looking to hire a Business Intelligence (BI) Analyst. This position falls under our lodging line of business but will also support other areas such as airline and insurance. In this role, you will create and maintain Tableau dashboards—both internal dashboards for senior leadership to gain insights into business performance and external dashboards for our clients to analyze their travel expense patterns. You will directly contribute to improving business insights, operational efficiencies, and client satisfaction.
  
  
**What You'll Be Doing**
**How We Work**
As a BI Analyst, you will be expected to work based out of our Chennai office location. Corpay will set you up for success by providing the necessary resources and collaboration opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Dashboard Development & Maintenance**

* Build, deploy, and maintain Tableau dashboards to visualize key business metrics and trends.
* Leverage data from diverse sources (e.g., lodging, airline, and insurance) to provide meaningful insights for both internal stakeholders and external clients.
* Ensure that dashboards adhere to best practices in data visualization and are easily interpretable by non-technical audiences.

**Data Analysis & Reporting**

* Gather requirements from various business units to understand reporting needs and identify potential data sources.
* Translate raw data into clear insights and actionable recommendations.

**Data Quality & Dashboard Management**

* Oversee data acquisition and enrichment processes, ensuring accuracy and compliance with relevant regulations.
* Manage and maintain dashboards on Tableau Server, ensuring high availability and performance.
* Monitor dashboards regularly and address issues related to data integrity or performance.

**Collaboration & Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work closely with cross-functional teams—including product, marketing, client management, sales, and IT—to ensure data insights align with overall business objectives.
* Communicate findings to leadership in a clear, concise manner, tailoring the level of detail to the audience.

**Qualifications & Skills**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree (Master’s desirable but not essential) in a quantitative field (e.g., Statistics, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related discipline).
* Experience: 2 –5 years of hands-on experience in business intelligence, data analytics, or a similar role.

title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**About Team**
Transactional System provides core transactional systems to enable
  
  
segment and technology partners in creating wonderful omni experiences with speed and leverage. We are a highly motivated group of engineers, working in an agile group to solve sophisticated and high impact problems. This role is part of Cloud Powered Checkout team and will build the next generation multi-tenant, client agnostic, highly scalable, omnichannel checkout solution to seamlessly enable a frictionless customer checkout experience across all sales channels globally. We process millions of orders daily through our high-performance checkout services running in Edge and Cloud.
  
  
As a Site Reliability Engineer in the CPC Team, you will work with L2, Other dependent Applications, Platform team, DevOps and Engineering practitioners to proactively maintain mission-critical infrastructure, cloud platforms, microservices, tools, and processes that will ensure the highest levels of availability and reliability of CPC applications.
  
  
Our team works closely with our US stores and eCommerce business to better serve customers by empowering team members, stores, and merchants with technological innovation. From groceries and entertainment to sporting goods and crafts, Walmart U.S. offers an extensive selection that our customers value, whether they shop online at Walmart.com, through one of our mobile apps, or in-store. Focus areas include customers, stores and employees, in-store service, merchant tools, merchant data science, and search and personalization.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
Incident triage, Escalation and Resolution: Triage site-impacting production issues by quantifying impact, severity and urgency, analyzing systems for quick remediation, engaging the right teams for recovery [Reduce MTTE Mean Time to Engage], and focusing on immediate restoration [ Reduce MTTR Mean Time to Restore] of large-scale enterprise systems.
  
  
Alert, Monitoring, Log analysis: Detect and analyze monitoring graphs and alerts to identify systems causing production impacts with various tools like Grafana, Prometheus, MMS, Service Now, JIRA, Dynatrace, Splunk etc [Reduce MTTD Mean Time to Detect].
  
  
Enhance Alerting solutions: Design and implement JavaScript for the integration of alerting tool with service API endpoints with various tools like ServiceNow, Spotlight, Splunk, and xMatters. Requires knowledge of: Monitoring and alerting tools; Monitoring metrics and key performance indicators (for example, availability, MTBF, MTTR); SLIs and SLOs (for example, request latency, availability, error rates, saturation); Distributed tracing; Alerting logic. To demonstrate awareness of the metrics used to monitor software or system performance. Monitors current performance data to ensure adherence to defined SLOs and SLIs for simple applications/systems. Demonstrates awareness of the different types of alerts generated by the monitoring tools. Demonstrates awareness of infrastructure and application metrics.
  
  
Disaster Recovery Planning: Requires knowledge of: Disaster recovery procedures and processes; Enterprise disaster recovery systems. To work with business partners to identify and document critical applications.
  
  
Performance and Optimization : Requires knowledge of: Unix/Linux performance optimization tuning; Java/NodeJS/Tomcat/Apache tuning and optimization; Chaos tools to utilize established criteria (for example, probability of failure, frequency of failure) to measure site reliability. Monitors site reliability conditions and new reliability requirements.
  
  
Work on Product Enrichment ; Content Services projects at Walmart: Develop enterprise monitoring and utilize tooling software solutions such as Grafana, Splunk etc, to improve visibility, pro-actively detect issues and restore system availability.
  
  
Develop Tools and support: Design and develop solutions for widespread internal communications for cloud applications support or workflows for infrastructure availability issues with various internal applications with multiple programming languages like Java, JavaScript (React, Node JS), Python and Shell programming technologies like Prometheus, Database Query languages. Design and develop a UI tool to display Item Content Quality data on a dashboard using AngularJS, ReactJs, HTML5 ; CSS3 etc
  
  
To create and maintain Playbooks.
  
  
Steps to perform correct analysis on the issues and engage correct teams for CPC, Dependent downstream services and Platform teams.
  
  
To handle Deployments. Streamline the deployments process and handle the responsibility as a single team. Understand and explore Post validations and back out steps to make app more resilient.
  
  
Coordinate with platform teams for non-app releases like VM upgrades, DB Maintenance, and other component environment related tasks.
  
  
Participate in rotating on-call duties and work across different time zone with a multi-national team
  
  
Responsible for timely root cause analysis [RCA] of production issues.
  
  
Develop reusable tooling and processes to drive and improve customer experience and lower operational costs.
  
  
Understand DevOps Industry best practices
  
  
Help teams to build highly Observable and Resilient systems
  
  
Collaborate with developers to capture requirements and understanding pain points
  
  
Build reusable tools, library, dashboards which can be used across DevOps/SRE teams
  
  
**What You'll Bring**
Bachelors degree in Computer Science, Engineering or related discipline
  
  
5+ years of hands-on related to Site Reliability Engineer, Operations ; Development experience with Java Script, Java, Restful services, Git, Maven, Jenkins, DevOps, Containerization, Docker, Kubernetes, Azure, Google cloud, Kafka, Azure Cosmos, Azure SQL, Mega cache CI/CD ,Prometheus, Grafana, Splunk etc.
  
  
Automation and Self-healing: Demonstrate knowledge of scripting and software development for automation and self-healing of multi-cloud environments. Help enhance existing solutions by developing automation with Docker, Kubernetes and working with DevOps and Engineering partners.
  
  
Excellent end to end technical understanding of core infrastructure, cloud services, platforms, and micro-services.
  
  
Ability to effectively triage be able to detect and determine symptom vs cause.
  
  
Identify and drive continuous improvement efforts to reduce waste (eliminate, automate or streamline).
  
  
Influence the design of system architecture and tactical solutions.
  
  
Familiar with log centric tooling. Produce time series data and reusable dashboards for use both during and post event.
  
  
**About Walmart Global Tech**
Imagine working in an environment where one line of code can make life easier for hundreds of millions of people. That’s what we do at Walmart Global Tech. We’re a team of software engineers, data scientists, cybersecurity expert's and service professionals within the world’s leading retailer who make an epic impact and are at the forefront of the next retail disruption. People are why we innovate, and people power our innovations. We are people-led and tech-empowered.
  
  
We train our team in the skillsets of the future and bring in experts like you to help us grow. We have roles for those chasing their first opportunity as well as those looking for the opportunity that will define their career. Here, you can kickstart a great career in tech, gain new skills and experience for virtually every industry, or leverage your expertise to innovate at scale, impact millions and reimagine the future of retail.
  
  
Walmart’s culture sets us apart, and we know being together helps us innovate, learn and grow great careers. This role is based in our [Bangalore/Chennai] office for daily work, with the flexibility for associates to manage their personal lives.
  
  
**Benefits**
Beyond our great compensation package, you can receive incentive awards for your performance. Other great perks include a host of best-in-class benefits maternity and parental leave, pto, health benefits, and much more.
  
  
Belonging
  
  
We aim to create a culture where every associate feels valued for who they are, rooted in respect for the individual. Our goal is to foster a sense of belonging, to create opportunities for all our associates, customers and suppliers, and to be a Walmart for everyone.
  
  
At Walmart, our vision is "everyone included." by fostering a workplace culture where everyone is—and feels—included, everyone wins. Our associates and customers reflect the makeup of all 19 countries where we operate. By making Walmart a welcoming place where all people feel like they belong, we’re able to engage associates, strengthen our business, improve our ability to serve customers, and support the communities where we operate.
  
  
Equal opportunity employer
  
  
Walmart, inc., is an equal opportunities employer – by choice. We believe we are best equipped to help our associates, customers and the communities we serve live better when we really know them. That means understanding, respecting and valuing unique styles, experiences, identities, ideas and opinions – while being inclusive of all people.

Option 1: Bachelor's degree in computer science, computer engineering, computer information systems, software engineering, or related area and 3 years’ experience in site reliability engineering, site and system administration, infrastructure management, or related area.
  
  
Option 2: 5 years’ experience in site reliability engineering, site and system administration, infrastructure management, or related area.

**Who We Are:**

Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. ***Job Family Definition:***

The job family spans across multiple engineering disciplines. Work consists of designing, developing, analyzing, troubleshooting and debugging systems, software and solutions for research and/or research development of product, services, and solutions for HPE’s portfolio. Requires a broad knowledge and application of engineering disciplines, methodologies and tools.

Job Family Definition for Executive Levels only: Directs and manages a diverse team of engineering professionals performing research, development, design and/or implementation of products, services, solutions for the company’s portfolio. Responsible for creating and communicating technical strategy within the organization and/or across the function.

***Management Level Definition:***

Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to manage staff activities in solving common and complex business/technical issues within established policies. Manages exempt individual contributors and/or supervisors. Has accountability for results of a major program in terms of cost, direction and people management. Provides guidance on process improvements and recommends changes in alignment with business tactics and strategy for area of responsibility. Plans, manages and monitors operational/tactical activities of Staff. Staff members' work may involve strategic issues. Recruits and supports development of direct staff members. Typically reports to MG2 or Director.  
  
Additional guidance/criteria: Manages and controls activities within a single country or a sub-region which is part of a larger geographical Region; Manages at least 4 employees and typically between 8 and 15 direct reports. Span of Control guidelines may differ from these numbers.

***What you'll do:***

* Provides direct and ongoing leadership for a team of individual contributors designing and developing engineering solutions and coordinating projects utilizing multiple engineering disciplines for products, systems, software, and solutions.
* Manages headcount, deliverables, schedules, and costs for multiple ongoing projects, ensuring that resources are appropriately allocated and that goals, objectives, timelines, and budgets are met in accordance with program and organizational roadmaps.
* Communicates project status and escalates issues to direct managers, program managers, and internal and external development partners.
* Manages relationships with outsourced partners and suppliers, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, product quality, schedules, and costs; ensures that team members are effectively communicating and collaborating with outsourced resources.

* Provides people-care management for assigned team members, including hiring, setting and monitoring of annual performance plans, coaching, and career development; ensures that proper knowledge and career development tools are in place to support ongoing team member and process development.

***What you need to bring:***

* First level university degree or equivalent experience required. May have advanced university degree.
* Typically 5 or more years of related work experience, including 0 -2 years of people management experience.

***Knowledge and Skills:***

* Strong leadership skills, including coaching, team-building, and conflict resolution.
* Advanced project management skills including time and risk management, resource prioritization, and project structuring.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to manage human capital across geographies to drive workforce development and achieve desired results.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation, presentation, and influence skills.
* Advanced business acumen, technical knowledge, and industry experience encompassing one or more engineering, technology, and product domains.
* Strong multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
* Strong communication skills (e.g. written, verbal, presentation); mastery in English and local language.
* Good understanding of the company's policies and processes.

time while developing the judgment needed to deliver high-quality, customer-focused
  
  
support.

responsiveness

* Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues beyond scripted resolutions,

including root cause investigation
  
  

* Required experience supporting customers across phone, chat, and ticketing

channels in a professional environment
  
  

* Experience working directly with customers to diagnose issues (not solely

internal IT or infrastructure support)

Technical and Analytical Capability

**Job Description**
Position title: ERP Second Level Support (RUN) – Senior Analyst

Role Statement
  
  
The ERP Second Level Support (RUN) Senior Analyst is accountable for ensuring advanced functional support and deep root-cause analysis for complex issues escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, acting as the subject-matter expert for a specific Oracle EBS module.
  
  
This role contributes to stable operations by driving effective resolution, implementing preventive measures, and supporting continuous improvement of Oracle EBS processes. The Senior Analyst takes end-to-end ownership of complex tickets, designs and validates functional fixes and workarounds, and ensures structured ticket handover within the Follow-the-Sun model to deliver uninterrupted support coverage.
  
  
As a qualified first line of defense within the ERP Second Level Support team, this role partners with the Shift Manager, Domain Head, Junior Analysts, ERP Tech Factory, and ERP Product Specialists to ensure seamless escalation paths, high-quality resolution, and consistent service delivery aligned with the organization’s Run operating model.
  
  
Key Duties
  
  
Ticket Resolution & Backlog Management
  
  

* Take end-to-end ownership of complex tickets escalated from Triage and Junior Analysts, ensuring thorough analysis and resolution within SLA targets.
* Support prioritization and backlog management, especially for high-severity incidents, ensuring alignment with business impact and SLA requirements.
* Design, validate, and implement functional fixes and workarounds, confirming solution effectiveness with key business stakeholders.
* Generate structured ticket handover materials to ensure continuity in the Follow-the-Sun model.

Root-Cause Analysis & Continuous Improvement
  
  

* Perform in-depth root-cause analysis for complex or non-standard incidents, accurately identifying underlying functional and process failures.
* Define corrective actions and drive preventive measures to reduce recurring incidents and improve process stability.
* Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by identifying patterns, proposing configuration or process enhancements, and sharing findings with the broader team.

Escalation & Collaboration
  
  

* Promptly engage the ERP Product Specialist when additional expertise is required or challenges arise beyond functional scope.
* Escalate unresolved issues to ERP Tech Factory, providing comprehensive documentation of analysis performed and resolution attempts.
* Provide updates on solution design and technically resolved tickets to the Shift Manager and relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in cross-functional stand-ups to remove blockers and accelerate cross-module resolution.

Governance & Knowledge Management
  
  

* Maintain and enhance knowledge assets, including functional documentation, troubleshooting guides, and known-error records.
* Support regression, UAT, and hypercare testing to ensure operational readiness for releases.
* Drive the adoption of enabling technologies (ServiceNow, Oracle EBS, SharePoint) for efficient ticket tracking and resolution documentation.

**Required**

* 3–5 years of experience in Oracle EBS functional roles with exposure to complex incident management.
* Established specialization in at least one Oracle EBS module (e.g., Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Finance, Services).
* Proven experience in handling complex, unstructured, or cross-module incidents.
* Deep understanding of end-to-end business processes related to the assigned Oracle EBS module.
* Advanced capability in conducting root-cause analysis and translating findings into actionable corrective measures.
* Proficiency in executing low-risk functional configurations following fit-to-standard principles.
* Strong analytical thinking and structured problem-solving skills.
* High sense of ownership and end-to-end accountability.
* Effective communication and stakeholder management, including in international contexts.

**Preferred**

* Experience working in Follow-the-Sun or shift-based global support models.
* Familiarity with ITIL-aligned incident management frameworks and tools (ServiceNow).
* Background in ERP support environments within manufacturing or industrial organizations.
* Knowledge of continuous improvement methodologies and preventive maintenance approaches.

* SLA compliance rate
* Mean Time to Resolve (MTTR)
* First Contact Resolution rate (FCR)
* ERP incident recurrence rate
* Ticket re-open rate
* Knowledge base contribution rate

title: Sr. Service Operations Engineer
description:
Lead Support Operations Engineer
  
  
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology & Ancillary Clinical Systems**
**About The Role**
Providence Global Center is seeking an experienced Lead Support Operations Engineer to lead reliable, secure and efficient support for
**Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and other ancillary clinical applications**
. The role combines hands-on L2/L3 technical ownership with operational leadership, service governance, major-incident coordination, problem management, change oversight and team capability development. The engineer will partner with clinical stakeholders, product teams, infrastructure teams, vendors and senior engineers to maintain application availability, protect patient-care workflows and drive continual service improvement across on-premises and Azure Cloud environments.
  
  
**Role Outcomes The Role Is Accountable For**

* Stable and resilient clinical application services with effective monitoring, incident response and recovery.
* Consistent SLA performance, clear operational ownership and timely stakeholder communication.
* Reduced recurring incidents through root cause analysis, problem elimination, automation and knowledge reuse.
* Controlled delivery of patches, upgrades, interface changes and production deployments.
* Strong team readiness through work allocation, technical coaching, documentation and succession coverage.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Service Operations Leadership**

* Lead day-to-day support operations across Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology and ancillary clinical applications.
* Provide technical direction for L2/L3 incidents, complex service requests, application defects and workflow disruptions.
* Prioritise work based on clinical impact, urgency, risk and agreed service levels; coordinate workload across the support team.
* Maintain operational readiness, support coverage, escalation paths, runbooks and handover practices.
* Review service performance, ageing work, repeat incidents, backlog, availability risks and improvement actions with relevant stakeholders.

**2. Clinical Workflow & Application Support**

* Support end-to-end clinical workflows, including laboratory order-to-result processes, medication-management workflows, imaging order-to-report processes and associated ancillary-service workflows.
* Translate clinical and operational impact into clear technical investigation, restoration and follow-up actions.
* Partner with clinical SMEs and business stakeholders to validate workflow behaviour, configuration changes and recovery outcomes.
* Ensure support decisions consider patient-care continuity, data integrity, operational safety and downstream system dependencies.

**3. Integrations, Interfaces & Data Exchange**

* Lead troubleshooting of integrations among clinical applications, medical devices or instruments, middleware, interface engines, EHR platforms and downstream systems.
* Investigate HL7 message failures, queue backlogs, interface interruptions, data mismatches and mapping issues using logs and monitoring tools.
* Support clinical terminology, coding and mapping where applicable, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Coordinate with interface, infrastructure, network, database, security, vendor and application teams to restore and stabilise services.

**4. Incident, Major Incident & Problem Management**

* Own or coordinate high-impact incidents from triage through service restoration, validation, communication and closure.
* Provide concise technical updates, impact statements, recovery status and decision points during major incidents.
* Lead root cause analysis for recurring or significant issues and track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
* Identify opportunities to automate, correct or eliminate repeat work and reduce avoidable support demand.

**5. Change, Release & Environment Management**

* Assess operational readiness and risk for application changes, patches, upgrades, cloud migrations and integration releases.
* Coordinate implementation plans, validation steps, rollback plans, support coverage and post-deployment verification.
* Support environment health, configuration consistency and production-readiness checks across on-premises and Azure Cloud services.
* Ensure changes follow applicable ITIL, security, compliance and change-management controls.

**6. Monitoring, Reliability & Continual Improvement**

* Strengthen proactive monitoring, alert quality, service dashboards and early-warning indicators for critical clinical applications.
* Analyse incident trends, recurring failure patterns and operational bottlenecks; recommend measurable improvements.
* Promote automation, self-service, standardisation and knowledge-centred support to improve reliability and team efficiency.
* Contribute to service continuity, disaster recovery testing and operational resilience activities.

**7. Team Leadership & Collaboration**

* Coach support engineers on technical troubleshooting, clinical workflows, incident ownership, documentation and stakeholder communication.
* Delegate work with clear accountability; review technical quality and support the team during complex escalations.
* Build cross-training and backup coverage across supported applications and domain workflows.
* Work closely with SMEs, product owners, developers, vendors and cross-functional teams across geographies.
* Create and maintain SOPs, knowledge-base articles, known-error records, support models and troubleshooting guides.

**Required Qualifications**

* 8-12 years of application support or service operations experience, including ownership of complex or business-critical applications.
* Strong experience supporting one or more clinical domains such as Laboratory, Pharmacy, Radiology or ancillary clinical systems, with the ability to build cross-domain knowledge.
* Demonstrated L2/L3 troubleshooting experience across applications, interfaces, middleware, logs, infrastructure dependencies and data flows.
* Working knowledge of HL7 messaging, interface support and integrations among clinical applications, devices or instruments, middleware and EHR systems.
* Understanding of clinical terminology, coding or mapping standards where relevant, including LOINC, SNOMED, ICD and CPT.
* Experience with incident, major incident, problem, change and release management in an ITIL-aligned environment.
* Exposure to Azure Cloud and on-premises application environments, including monitoring, availability and operational support concepts.
* Experience leading technical investigations, coordinating cross-functional teams and communicating clearly with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical, prioritisation, documentation and decision-making skills.
* Ability to mentor engineers, distribute work, manage competing priorities and operate effectively in a 24x7 support environment.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience supporting multiple clinical application domains or enterprise healthcare platforms.
* Familiarity with interface engines, clinical middleware, medical-device integrations, PACS/RIS, pharmacy platforms or LIS/LIMS solutions.
* Experience with scripting, workflow automation, observability tools or service-management reporting.
* Participation in application upgrades, cloud migrations, disaster-recovery exercises or major clinical go-lives.
* ITIL, Azure, healthcare interoperability or relevant vendor/product certification.
* Experience working with distributed teams and external vendors in a regulated healthcare environment.

**Core Competencies**
**Technical & Domain**
**Operational Leadership**
**Ways of Working**

* Clinical application support
* HL7 and integration troubleshooting
* Cloud and on-premises operations
* Monitoring and reliability
* Major-incident coordination
* Problem elimination
* Change and release oversight
* Risk-based prioritisation
* Clinical stakeholder partnership
* Coaching and delegation
* Clear executive communication
* Knowledge sharing and collaboration

**Success Measures**

* Service availability, SLA achievement and timely restoration of clinically significant incidents.
* Reduction in repeat incidents, ageing backlog and avoidable support demand.
* Quality and completion of root cause, corrective action, change validation and operational-readiness activities.
* Improved monitoring coverage, documentation quality, automation adoption and cross-training readiness.
* Stakeholder confidence in service ownership, communication and operational follow-through.

**Note:**
The 8-12 year experience range is recommended to reflect the expanded lead-level scope and should be aligned with the organisation's approved job architecture before publication. Product-specific requirements may be added based on the final application portfolio.

**About Opella**
Opella is the self-care challenger with the purest and third-largest portfolio in the Over-The-Counter (OTC) & Vitamins, Minerals & Supplements (VMS) market globally.
  
  
Our mission is to bring health into people’s hands by making self-care as simple as it should be, for half a billion consumers worldwide and growing.
  
  
At the core of this mission are our 100 loved brands, 11,000 employees, 13 best-in-class manufacturing sites, and 4 specialized science and innovation development centers. Headquartered in France, Opella is the proud maker of many of the world’s most trusted brands, including Allegra, Buscopan, Doliprane, Dulcolax, Enterogermina, Essentiale, and Mucosolvan.
  
  
**Mission & Tasks**
Lead the development, maintenance, and optimization of systems supporting the end-to-end Global Medical Information (GMI) process, from content development through management and response to unsolicited medical information requests from Healthcare Professionals, consumers, and internal stakeholders.
  
  
As the Global Medical Information (GMI) Systems Lead, you will serve as the key liaison between local system users and global teams for all aspects of the GMI system, including platform updates, enhancements, maintenance, user training, and system support.
  
  
**Scope of Responsibility**
The GMI Systems Lead will be responsible for all system-related activities and serve as the primary interface between local users and global stakeholders. Key responsibilities include gathering business requirements, managing system enhancements, overseeing administration activities, conducting testing, collaborating with Digital teams, and providing training and user support.
  
  
The GMI system supports the complete medical information process, including:
  
  

* Content authoring
* Content management
* Inquiry management
* Reporting and analytics

This role requires close collaboration across countries, functions, and stakeholder groups while ensuring compliance with all activities related to the GMI platform, including quality documentation and training materials.
  
  
**Management Responsibilities**

* Collaborate closely with system stakeholders and Digital teams to define requirements and support system enhancements.
* Support, develop, and review test cases during User Acceptance Testing (UAT) activities.
* Ensure system compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements.
* Deliver and maintain training for internal and external system users.
* Manage business administration activities, including product updates, email templates, surveys, and user configurations.
* Support end-user issues and partner with Digital teams for issue resolution.
* Participate in evaluating and implementing innovative digital solutions and new technologies for GMI.

**Latitude of Action**

* Responsible for all GMI system-related activities and operations.

**Role Impact**

* Act as the primary interface between the GMI organization, Digital teams, and system users.
* Support system enhancements, maintenance, training, and user adoption activities.
* Drive operational efficiency and continuous improvement across the medical information process.

**Scope**

* Global responsibility for all GMI system activities.
* Collaboration with internal and external stakeholders across multiple regions and functions.

**Reporting Line**
Works directly with the GMI Head and serves as the primary interface between GMI, Digital teams, and the user community.
  
  
**Required**
**Required Skills and Experience**

* 3-5+ years of experience in CRM-related roles within the pharmaceutical or life sciences industry.
* Proven track record of managing CRM systems and improving customer engagement.
* Experience managing escalations and resolving complex customer issues.
* Familiarity with data privacy regulations, including GDPR, CCPA, or similar requirements.

**Preferred**

* Experience configuring and optimizing CRM workflows for Medical Affairs and/or Medical Information functions.
* Experience working in an international and multicultural environment.
* Ability to analyze operational data to identify trends, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement.

**Knowledge, Skills And Experience**

* Strong ability to troubleshoot CRM issues and optimize workflows.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong project management and organizational capabilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a matrix environment.
* Experience working with cross-functional teams and external vendors.
* Analytical mindset with a customer-centric and science-driven approach.

**Our Values**
**All In Together**
We keep each other honest and have each other's backs.
  
  
**Courageous**
We break boundaries and take thoughtful risks with creativity.

title: CMDB - ITIL Analyst
description:
**CREATIVITY IS OUR SUPERPOWER.**
It’s our heritage and it’s also our future. Because we don’t just make toys. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire fans, entertain audiences and develop children through play. Mattel is at its best when every member of our team feels respected, included, and heard—when everyone can show up as themselves and do their best work every day. We value and share an infinite range of ideas and voices that evolve and broaden our perspectives with a reach that extends into all our brands, partners, and suppliers.
  
  
Location Hyderabad, India
  
  
Expected Hours PST hours (AM into Early Afternoon)
  
  
Team I&O Technology Support Services – ITSM Team
  
  
Reports To CMDB & HAM Process Manager
  
  
**Overview**
The CMDB & HAM Analyst is responsible for supporting the execution and operational maturity of the Configuration Management Database (CMDB) and Hardware Asset Management (HAM) processes within a global ITSM environment. This role ensures data accuracy, lifecycle management, and compliance through structured execution, monitoring, and continuous improvement. Working closely with the CMDB & HAM Process Manager and cross-functional teams, the role supports data governance, audit readiness, and process adherence while helping maintain a trusted system of record across the enterprise.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Support execution of CMDB and HAM processes, ensuring adherence to defined standards and governance.
* Maintain CMDB data accuracy, completeness, and integrity through validation and reconciliation activities.
* Support hardware asset lifecycle activities including procurement, deployment, tracking, and disposal.
* Assist in software asset tracking and alignment with SAM requirements.
* Monitor and report on CMDB and HAM KPIs, trends, and data quality metrics.
* Identify data discrepancies, compliance gaps, and support remediation efforts.
* Ensure alignment between CMDB, HAM, Incident, Change, Release, and Problem processes.
* Support audit activities, including data certification and physical inventory validation.
* Work with ServiceNow teams to support discovery, automation, and reporting enhancements.
* Assist in maintaining documentation, standards, and process artifacts.
* Highlight gaps or areas where improvement or automation are possible.

**Required Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong knowledge of CMDB and Hardware Asset Management concepts within ITIL frameworks.
* Hands-on experience with ServiceNow CMDB and HAM modules.
* Understanding of data governance, data quality, and configuration management principles.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with attention to detail.
* Ability to manage data accuracy in complex environments.
* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* Able to enforce governing policies and / or escalate when necessary.
* Able to manage and organize audits and audit requirements.

**Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 6+ years of experience with CMDB & HAM processes in an enterprise ITIL-based or equivalent IT Service Management processes
* 8+ years of hands-on experience with ServiceNow in an enterprise environment.
* ITIL v3 or ITIL 4 certification required.

**Preferred Qualifications & Skills**

* Experience supporting audits, compliance, or data certification activities.
* Exposure to asset discovery tools and automated reconciliation.
* Experience with reporting tools such as ServiceNow, PowerBI, or similar.
* Knowledge of SAM tools such as Flexera or equivalent.
* Experience supporting continuous improvement initiatives.
* Experience in setting up inventory audit and metric guidelines.
* Experience in managing MIM bridges for occasional backup support

**What We’re Looking For**

* Demonstrated a growth mindset by staying curious and continuously learning, embracing challenges, and improving themselves.

Don’t meet every single requirement? At Mattel, we are dedicated to an inclusive workplace and a culture of belonging. If you’re excited about this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly with every qualification in the job description, we still encourage you to apply. You may be just the right candidate for this or other roles.
  
  
**How We Work**
We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors
  
  

* We collaborate Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
* We innovate At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
* We execute We are a performance-driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best-in-class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

**Our Approach to Flexible Work:**
We embrace a flexible work model designed to empower a culture of growth, optimism, and wellbeing, where every employee can reach their full potential. Combining purposeful in-person collaboration with flexibility, our focus is to optimize performance and drive connection for moments that matter.
  
  
**Who We Are**
Mattel is a leading global toy and family entertainment company and owner of one of the most iconic brand portfolios in the world. We engage consumers and fans through our franchise brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO, Masters of the Universe, Matchbox, Monster High, MEGA and Polly Pocket, as well as other popular properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include toys, content, consumer products, digital and live experiences. Our products are sold in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering generations to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.
  
  
Mattel’s award-winning workplace culture has been recognized by Forbes, Fast Company, Newsweek, Great Place to Work, TIME, and more.
  
  
Visit us at https //jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers .

title: Senior Service Delivery Consultant
description:
Senior Service Delivery Consultant
  
  
**What Makes Us, Us**
Join some of the most innovative thinkers in FinTech as we lead the evolution of financial technology. If you are an innovative, curious, collaborative person who embraces challenges and wants to grow, learn and pursue outcomes with our prestigious financial clients, say Hello to SimCorp!
  
  
At its foundation, SimCorp is guided by our values — Caring, Customer success-driven, Collaborative, Curious, and Courageous. Our people-centered organization focuses on skills development, relationship building, and client success. We take pride in cultivating an environment where all team members can grow, feel heard, valued, and empowered.
  
  
If you like what we’re saying, keep reading!
  
  
**WHY THIS IS IMPORTANT TO US**

* Senior Service Delivery Consultants are skilled professionals who form part of our SaaS Operations team delivering services to our clients. The main purpose of the role is to contribute to the effective support and maintenance of SimCorp Dimension and to all aspects of service delivery around SimCorp Dimension.
* Senior Service Delivery Consultants support our clients by providing solutions and deploying services related to the usage of SimCorp Dimension. They work closely with local and global teams within SimCorp.
* In this key role you will work in APAC/EMEA shift to provide support & solutions to overcome issues encountered by the customer and to optimise usage of the systems for them. This interesting job offers you a unique opportunity to increase your knowledge and get experience on a variety of disciplines. You will find yourself working in a diverse and fast-growing environment for an international company with a significant growth potential and career opportunities. If you want to contribute to our growth and develop in a professional environment - grow with us!

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* You will be the key contact for our clients regarding production support and ensure and maintain the relationship.
* Analyze problems and issues which occur in the solutions and the system operations of SimCorp services at clients’ production environment on a wide range of topics on your own to provide convincing and timely solutions to our client within agreed SLAs
* Advise and service our client users with minimal supervision on configuration maintenance and enhancement by providing solutions related to the usage of SimCorp services and beyond to ensure that the client uses SimCorp services in an optimal, future-oriented way
* Co-operate closely with other professionals within SimCorp on a global level by way of specialist roles to share knowledge and ensure efficient solutions for the client
* You will be required to work on APAC/EMEA shift. Weekend/Public Holiday works are required on occasion. Working extended hours might also be required on occasion.

**What We Value**

* A degree in finance/economics/mathematics/computer science. Knowledge in financial issues - theoretical as well as practical
* Minimum 5 years’ experience within asset management, funds management or custodian.
* Familiar with Simcorp Dimension
* Experience in the operation and support of front-to back investment management solutions
* You are good at working on & prioritizing multiple tasks at the same time.
* Self-motivated, service-minded and a natural desire for problem solving, enthusiastic, committed, result-oriented, and able to thrive in a time-sensitive situation
* Other requirements
* APAC / EMEA shift hours (May change depending on business needs)
* Hybrid working arrangement (2x a week in office)

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.
  
  
  
  
If you are interested in being a part of SimCorp but are not sure this role is suitable, submit your CV anyway. SimCorp is on an exciting growth journey, and our Talent Acquisition Team is ready to assist you discover the right role for you. The approximate time to consider your CV is three weeks.
  
  
We are eager to continually improve our talent acquisition process and make everyone’s experience positive and valuable. Therefore, during the process we will ask you to provide your feedback, which is highly appreciated.
  
  
**WHO WE ARE?**
For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.
  
  
SimCorp is an independent subsidiary of the Deutsche Börse Group. Following the recent merger with Axioma, we leverage the combined strength of our brands to provide an industry-leading, full, front-to-back offering for our clients.
  
  
SimCorp is an equal opportunity employer and welcome applicants from all backgrounds, without regard to race, gender, age, disability, or any other protected status under applicable law. We are committed to building a culture where diverse perspectives and expertise are integrated into our everyday work. We believe in the continual growth and development of our employees, so that we can provide best-in-class solutions to our clients.

title: MFT / SFTP Support Engineer – Mainframe || 5+ Years || Hyderabad Only
description:
**MFT / SFTP Support Engineer – Mainframe**

**Experience:**
5+ Years

**Location:**
Hyderabad (HYD)

**Role:**
Managed File Transfer (MFT) / SFTP Support

Job Summary

Looking for an experienced MFT / SFTP Support Engineer with hands-on experience in Managed File Transfer (MFT), Secure File Transfer Protocol (SFTP), and mainframe navigation. The candidate will be responsible for monitoring file transfers, troubleshooting transfer failures, supporting mainframe operations, and ensuring secure and reliable data exchange across enterprise systems.

Key Responsibilities

* Monitor and support MFT and SFTP file transfer operations.
* Troubleshoot file transfer failures, connectivity issues, authentication errors, and file delivery delays.
* Perform mainframe navigation and basic operational activities.
* Monitor batch jobs and file processing workflows, where applicable.
* Coordinate with application, infrastructure, network, security, and mainframe teams to resolve incidents.
* Perform incident analysis, root-cause investigation, and issue resolution.
* Ensure secure file transfers and adherence to operational procedures and SLAs.
* Manage file transfer schedules, job dependencies, and failed-file reprocessing, as applicable.
* Maintain operational documentation and support incident, change, and problem management processes.
* Provide production support and participate in shift-based or on-call support, if required.

Required Skills

* 5+ years of relevant IT experience.
* Hands-on experience with Managed File Transfer (MFT) and SFTP.
* Experience with mainframe navigation and related operational activities.
* Knowledge of file transfer monitoring, troubleshooting, and failure recovery.
* Understanding of secure file transfer protocols, authentication, permissions, and connectivity.
* Experience in production support, incident management, and SLA-based operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, communication, and coordination skills.

title: macOS Administrator
description:
**Job Title:**
macOS Administrator
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Location**
: Hyderabad, India
  
  
**Experience:**
5+ Years
  
  
**Joining:**
Immediate to 15 Days
  
  
**Work Model:**
4 Days Work From Office, 1 Day Work From Home.
  
  
**About NationsBenefits:**
At NationsBenefits, we are leading the transformation of the insurance industry by developing innovative benefits management solutions. We focus on modernizing complex back-office systems to create scalable, secure, and high-performing platforms that streamline operations for our clients. As part of our strategic growth, we are focused on
**platform modernization**
— transitioning legacy systems to modern, cloud-native architectures that support the scalability, reliability, and high performance of core back-office functions in the insurance domain.
  
  
We are seeking a macOS Administrator to own the implementation, maintenance, monitoring, and operation of our Mac fleet and the Apple device management stack behind it. This role serves as a high-level technical expert on macOS and Apple platforms and acts as L3 escalation support for issues with MacOS devices.
  
  
If you have a passion for
**enterprise Apple device management, endpoint automation, and secure, compliant infrastructure**
, this opportunity is for you!
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**

* macOS Device Management & Deployment:
* Administer and maintain the macOS fleet using Jamf Pro and Microsoft Entra, including zero-touch enrollment, configuration profiles, policies, scripts, device inventory and application packaging.
* Deploy macOS updates, security patches, and third-party software on a controlled, tested rollout schedule.
* Enforce established secure configuration baselines (FileVault, firewall, Gatekeeper, compliance policies) on all Mac endpoints.
* Build and maintain scripts (Bash, Zsh, PowerShell) to automate deployment, remediation, and reporting tasks.
* Experience with standard enterprise configurations for Jamf/Apple (Platform SSO with Entra, Jamf Connect, etc)
* Support, Escalation & Troubleshooting
* Act as L2/L3 escalation support for the Help Desk and Desktop Support teams, working issues through the ticketing queue from outreach to resolution.
* Troubleshoot hardware, software, identity, and network issues on macOS, including Entra ID, Platform SSO, and ZScaler client connectivity.
* Open and manage vendor tickets, coordinating with vendor technical teams to keep Apple-related platforms fully functional.
* Security, Compliance & Change Management
* Coordinate with InfoSec on vulnerability and CVE-driven remediation, ensuring fixes are tested and rolled out in phases.
* Support IT certifications and audits (PCI, HITRUST) through documentation and evidence gathering.
* Participate in Change Management (CRM) and perform maintenance on impacted technology during change windows, including outside of production hours when required.
* Maintain accurate IT SOP documentation and respond to alerts from monitoring systems.
* Familiarity and experience implementing secure endpoint configuration baselines compliant with PCI, HITRUST, NIST, etc.

**Requirements:**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* Experience:
* 5+ years in IT, with at least 3+ years administering macOS in an enterprise environment.
* Hands-on experience with macOS workstation maintenance, deployment, and automation.
* Experience working in a team-oriented, collaborative environment supporting end users and IT personnel.
* Technical Expertise:
* Enterprise MDM solutions: Jamf Pro (required), Microsoft Intune, and Apple Business Manager / Automated Device Enrollment.
* Proficiency in scripting and automation (Bash/Zsh, PowerShell) and enterprise RMM and EDR tools (N-able, ManageEngine, SentinelOne).
* Working knowledge of Microsoft 365, Entra ID, Active Directory administration.
* Communication & Professionalism:
* Strong written and oral communication skills, with the ability to present ideas in professional, user-friendly language.
* Self-motivated, with proven analytical and problem-solving abilities and a strong customer service orientation.
* Ability to prioritize, document, and execute assigned tasks effectively.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Certifications:
* Jamf Certified Tech (JCT), Jamf Certified Admin (JCA), or Apple Certified Support Professional (ACSP).
* Jamf 300
* Microsoft Certified: Endpoint Administrator Associate (MD-102) is a plus.

**Why Join Us?**

* Work with Modern Apple Infrastructure – Own the Mac fleet end to end on Jamf and Intune.
* Technical Growth – Collaborate with infrastructure, security, and network engineers on enterprise-scale projects.
* Innovation & Collaboration – Be part of a dynamic, fast-paced IT environment.
* Career Progression – Expand your expertise in endpoint management and Apple enterprise administration.

title: Professional, Integrations
description:
**When you join Accurate Background, you’re an integral part of making every hire the start of a success story. Your contributions will help us fulfill our mission of advancing the background screening experience through visibility and insights, empowering our clients to make smarter, unbiased decisions.**
**Job Description**
As an Integration Support Professional at Accurate, you will drive Accurate's future growth engine by assisting Accurate’s Onboarding Team and clients through the onboarding/integration process and turning them into happy users. Additionally, you will collaborate with multiple internal departments to ensure clients and Accurate are positioned for short and long term success.
  
  
A full degree of creativity and latitude are expected in this role to facilitate delivery of results to our business. Being consultative and solutions-oriented are critical for this position.
  
  
**This Role Is For You If**

* You have an in-depth understanding of integrated solutions using different methods of communication (i.e., API’s, periodic files, etc.).
* You have worked with cross-functional teams to problem solve and provide ideal solutions to achieve client objectives.
* You thrive on the urgency and importance of working with our clients and are capable of independently triaging reported issues/bugs related to their integrated solution and leading the effort to resolve.
* You want to actively increase a client’s overall satisfaction with their integrated solution and help Accurate understand the benefits of client requested changes/improvements.
* You have the passion and drive to change the job applicant/candidate and recruiter experience for the better.
* You can engage in business-level and technical conversations with internal and external clients.

At Accurate, we're transforming the background screening experience through innovative technology, industry expertise, and a commitment to client success. As a fast-growing organization, we partner with leading employers to deliver seamless screening and credentialing solutions that help build safer, more trusted workplaces. We foster a collaborative, results-driven culture where new ideas are welcomed, learning is encouraged, and career growth opportunities are plentiful. If you're looking to make an impact while working alongside a talented team in a dynamic environment, Accurate could be the place for you.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
In this role, you will triage client reported issues in relation to their ATS (Applicant Tracking System) or API integrations. Additionally, you will assist clients and the Accurate Onboarding Team in integration configuration and testing, as well as answer open client questions in relation to integrations, provide clarification on solutions, etc.
  
  

* Act as an initial point of contact for all client reported integration issues or concerns through ticketing system.
* Troubleshoot complex data flow issues between Accurate and third-party ATS, HRIS, and recruiting platforms.
* Analyze API requests, responses, error logs, and webhook deliveries to identify root causes of integration issues and either offer potential solutions OR escalate accordingly.
* Maintain communication with stakeholders regarding resolution of reported issues.
* Understand client integration requirements and system capabilities and be able to translate accordingly.
* Serve as a subject matter expert for platform-specific integration capabilities, limitations, and best practices.
* Work closely with clients and ATS representatives to identify account setup and integration requirements.
* Work closely with Onboarding to properly configure clients for specific integrations, considering any client specific initiatives/requirements.
* Provide support for integration testing.
* Translate technical concepts into business-friendly language for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

**Qualifications**

* A familiarity with integrated API solutions and ability to explain technical solutions to clients.
* Ability to understand, evaluate, and translate complex client requirements into practical integration solutions.
* Strong critical thinking and communication skills combined with a commitment and proven ability to succeed within a fast-paced organization.
* Strong overall interpersonal skills and a history exceeding client expectations.
* Time-management skills and the ability to establish reasonable and attainable deadlines for resolution.
* Self-motivated professional with the ability to work independently, manage competing priorities, and deliver results in a fast-paced environment.
* Basic knowledge of XML and JSON required.
* Basic knowledge of SQL and databases required.
* Experience with Microsoft Office Suite required.
* Experience with related tools such as Postman, SOAP UI, etc., a plus.
* Background Screening experience a plus.

**The Accurate Way**
We offer a fun, fast-paced environment, with lots of room for growth. We have an unwavering commitment to diversity, ensuring everyone has a complete sense of belonging here. To do this, we follow four guiding principles – Take Ownership, Be Open, Stay Curious, Work as One – core values that dictate what we stand for, and how we behave.
  
  
**Take ownership.**
Be accountable for your actions, your team, and the company. Accept responsibility willingly, especially when it’s what’s best for our customers. Give others every reason to trust you, believe in you, and count on you. Rise to every occasion with your personal best.
  
  
**Be open.**
Be open to new ideas. Be inclusive of people and ways of doing things. Make yourself accessible and approachable, and communicate with genuineness, transparency, honesty, and respect. Embrace differences.
  
  
**Stay curious.**
Stay curious even as you move forward. Tirelessly ask questions and challenge the status quo in your pursuit of new ideas, ways to solve problems, and to continually grow and improve.
  
  
**Work as one.**
Work together to create the best customer and workplace experience. Put our customers and employees first—before individual or departmental agendas. Make sure they get the help they need to succeed.
  
  
**Equal opportunities**
Accurate is an equal-opportunity employer and is committed to hiring talented and qualified individuals with diverse backgrounds. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to sex, gender identity, sexual orientation, race, color, religion, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, age, or any other characteristic protected by law.
  
  
Accurate will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws.
  
  
You must have a right to work in Australia indefinitely that does not involve sponsorship by the Company.
  
  
**Special Notice**
Accurate is aware of schemes involving fraudulent job postings/offers and/or individuals or entities claiming to be employees of Accurate. Those involved are offering fabricated employment opportunities to applicants, often asking for sensitive personal and financial information. If you believe you have been contacted by anyone misrepresenting themselves as an employee of Accurate, please contact humanresources@accurate.com.
  
  

* Please be advised that all legitimate correspondence from an Accurate employee will come from "@accurate.com" email accounts.
* Accurate will not interview candidates via text or email. Our interviews are conducted by recruiters and leaders via the phone, Zoom/Teams or in an in-person format.
* Accurate will never ask candidates to make any type of personal financial investment related to gaining employment with the Company.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:
NVIDIA is looking for a Network Operations Engineer to support and maintain our cloud network infrastructure. This network serves the needs across the whole software stack for NVIDIA, from Graphics Drivers to Autonomous Vehicles and Artificial Intelligence. In this role, the Network Operations Engineer will remediate critical alerts within defined SLAs, triage production impacting network incidents, and interact with internal customers on network related issues. They will also be responsible for engaging with external vendors to remediate hardware and software issues, and participate in project related work such as network device upgrades and capacity augmentations. An ideal candidate will possess a wide range of skills, including alert monitoring & resolution in large-scale networks and CSP environments, outstanding troubleshooting skills, understanding of L3 underlay networks, and network protocol knowledge in large multi-vendor infrastructures.
  
  
**What You Will Be Doing**

* Engage in 24/7 global shift rotations to provide remote support for network repairs and changes while collaborating across teams and updating customers on status and ticket information.
* Drive operational improvements in change management and daily operations by following procedures.
* Manage and operate large scale IP network technologies and infrastructures.
* Utilise your skills in Peering and Datacenter interconnect technologies: PNI, Transit, Exchange, Passive DWDM, Wave circuits.
* Monitor and support the network health of on-premises and cloud infrastructures.
* Collaborate and develop workflow enhancements while documenting best practices.

**What We Need To See**

* Deep knowledge and experience of TCP/IP, BGP, OSPF, MPLS, IS-IS, VxLAN, EVPN, QoS, GRE, IPsec, DNS, and MACsec.
* Over 4 years of experience in network operations.
* Skilled in network troubleshooting techniques and leveraging creative problem-solving abilities.
* Strong track record of alert response within defined SLAs and Incident management.
* Experience with one or more of the following CSP environments: AWS, Azure, GCP, OCI.
* Familiarity with Arista, Fortinet and Juniper.
* Hands-on experience with contributing to tooling and automation for provisioning, monitoring, and managing complex network infrastructures.
* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, related technical field, or equivalent experience.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.

**Ways To Stand Out From The Crowd**

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.
  
  
NVIDIA is committed to fostering a diverse work environment and proud to be an equal opportunity employer. As we highly value diversity in our current and future employees, we do not discriminate (including in our hiring and promotion practices) on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability status or any other characteristic protected by law.
