title: Forward Deployed Engineer, Managed Services
description:
**Job Description**
About Outreach
  
  
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.
  
  
**About The Team**
Managed Services sits within Professional Services. We're Outreach, CRM, and GTM technology experts who help customers get full value from the platform once implementation ends.
  
  
Our Managed Service Consultants are trusted advisors. They drive adoption, flag risk, and grow usage, so customers keep exceeding their goals.
  
  
The Role
  
  
You'll join our India-based Managed Services team, chartered with building our customers' AI Agents beyond what was set up during implementation: opening new use cases and growing Amplify credit and product consumption.
  
  
You'll own a portfolio of our most strategic accounts and guide customers through best practices and hands-on configuration to drive outcomes and deepen adoption. You'll stay technically fluent in Outreach's evolving capabilities, AI included, so you can configure and troubleshoot in real time.
  
  
The role mixes technology and business consulting with solution design and project management. You'll work closely with Customer Success and Account Executives, build rapport fast, and influence customer outcomes.
  
  
You'll own results for your book of business against Managed Services KPIs, and report to a Practice Manager, Managed Services.
  
  
Key Performance Indicators: Manage a book of business with an average QoQ utilization rate of 70%, with a focus on Amplify credit and product consumption — ultimately supporting renewal rates and the minimization of churn and contraction.
  
  
Location: This is a remote role, based in Hyderabad. There may be occasional in-person or team events and if asked to attend, it will be during local IST hours.
  
  
Working Hours: This is a customer-facing role and will require working US-based hours (night-shift allowance provided).
  
  
Your Daily Adventures Will Include
  
  

* Build, configure, and tune new AI Agents (Revenue, Deal, Research, Conversation, Forecasting) beyond initial implementation to expand automation and drive credit consumption
* Design and manage context-aware prompts for each customer's AI Agent use cases
* Be the subject matter expert on Outreach's AI Agents and embed them into customer workflows and sales processes
* Apply and refine agent playbooks, prompt libraries, and implementation frameworks so the practice grows without losing consistency
* Manage configuration for onboarded customers: identify gaps and opportunities, then design, configure, and troubleshoot solutions in real time as their needs evolve
* Train client admins and keep them current on platform use, best practices, and functionality
* Be the Outreach Admin's main point of contact and trusted advisor, and surface value and risk before they ask
* Partner with GTM Account Teams on expansion, renewal, and delivery needs, and share client health insights
* Resolve escalations and at-risk accounts fast; share trends with your Practice Manager to prevent repeat issues
* Stay current on Generative AI and LLM developments relevant to Outreach's Agents
* Track your KPIs and adjust quickly to stay on target
* Mentor and share knowledge with fellow consultants

Our Vision of You
  
  

* 3-5 years in a technical, customer-facing role at a mid-to-large business, ideally SaaS
* Technical and AI fluency with Outreach or a comparable SaaS platform: you configure and apply the AI features yourself
* Experience with prompt engineering, LLM-based tools, and applying generative or agentic AI to real sales workflows
* Proven ability to influence AI and technology adoption inside customer organizations and turn new capabilities into solutions for real business problems
* Track record hitting utilization, consumption, or renewal-linked KPIs
* Experience building trust and client relationships remotely
* Handles tight deadlines and multiple concurrent engagements
* Self-starter, comfortable with ambiguity and autonomy, quick to pick up complex concepts
* Passionate about solving client problems and turning customer vision into results in the product
* Sharp written and verbal communicator
* Embodies our core values: Trusted Advisor, Win as One Team, and Take Ownership

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Background in Sales strategy, renewals, or account expansion is a plus
* Knowledge of sales processes such as lead generation, pipeline management, and KPIs
* Experience with the software delivery lifecycle or application implementation
* Skilled at coaching others on sales process best practices
* Skilled at learning a customer's business strategy, processes, and solutions
* Experience delivering Managed Services at a software company

Why You’ll Love It Here
  
  

* Highly competitive salary
* 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
* Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
* OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
* Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
* 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
* Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
* Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military
* Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
* Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work

Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
  
  
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

title: Workforce Software consultant II
description:
**Company Description**
At Nielsen, we are passionate about our work to power a better media future for all people by providing powerful insights that drive client decisions and deliver extraordinary results. Our talented, global workforce is dedicated to capturing audience engagement with content - wherever and whenever it’s consumed. Together, we are proudly rooted in our deep legacy as we stand at the forefront of the media revolution. When you join Nielsen, you will join a dynamic team committed to excellence, perseverance, and the ambition to make an impact together. We champion you, because when you succeed, we do too. We enable your best to power our future
  
  
**Job Description**
A Senior Analyst focuses specifically on the configuration, maintenance, and optimization of the organization's Workforce Software (WFM) system. They bridge the gap between IT and Operations, ensuring the software accurately models business rules and delivers actionable data for scheduling, capturing, forecasting, and calculating time data for payroll processes..
  
  
The Workforce Software Senior Analyst is the subject matter expert responsible for the technical administration, configuration, and data integrity of the Workforce Software (WFM) system. This role ensures the WFM platform accurately reflects business logic, supports efficient staffing and scheduling, and provides reliable data for operational and financial analysis.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* WFM System Administration & Configuration: Maintain and update core WFM system settings, policy profiles, employee profiles, time-off policies, quota calculations and timesheet calculations.
* Data Integrity: Ensure the accuracy of data integrations between the WFM system and upstream HR/Payroll systems (e.g., SAP Employee Central Payroll). Troubleshoot and resolve data flow errors.
* User Management: Manage user access, roles, and permissions within the WFM application.
* System Upgrades & Testing: Participate in testing and validation for WFM system upgrades, patches, and feature rollouts to ensure seamless performance and compliance.
* Optimization & Analysis: Monitor jobs for review and correction of errors.
* Rule Engine Optimization: Analyze current scheduling models and configuration settings to identify opportunities for improved forecasting accuracy, adherence, and efficiency.
* Business Requirements: Translate complex business requirements (e.g., new labor agreements, regulatory changes) into functional specifications and configure them within the WFM platform.
* Reporting & Dashboards: Develop, modify, and manage custom reports and dashboards within the WFM system to provide operational leaders with visibility into key metrics (e.g., compliance, productivity, utilization).
* Support & Collaboration: Problem resolution with business partners, SAP/WFS, support contractors, and internal IT staff.
* Technical Support: Serve as the Tier 2 or Tier 3 technical contact for WFM system issues, diagnosing problems related to the mobile app and WorkforceHub, integration with SuccessFactors, quota calculations, and timesheet calculations.
* Training & Documentation: Create and deliver training materials and support documentation for end-users, WFM schedulers, and new administrators.
* Cross-Functional Liaison: Collaborate closely with IT, HRIS, Payroll, and Operations teams to ensure system alignment with organizational policies and technical infrastructure.

**Qualifications**

* Any Graduate
* 3-4 years of hands-on experience administering, configuring, or supporting a major Workforce Software platform.
* Workforce Time Level 1 - Configuration Specialist
* Workforce Time Level 2 - Configuration Specialist
* Strong technical aptitude for system logic, relational databases, and data interfaces.
* Experience with SAP Employee Central integration data points with WFM.
* Proficiency in Advanced Excel for data analysis and validation.
* Preferred Skills : Knowledge of time and attendance, payroll processing, and labor law compliance as it relates to system configuration.
* Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Certifications from WorkForce Software permitting system modifications and report creation.

**Additional Information**
Please be aware that job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by scammers seeking personal data or money. Nielsen recruiters will only contact you through official job boards, LinkedIn, or email with a nielsen.com domain. Be cautious of any outreach claiming to be from Nielsen via other messaging platforms or personal email addresses. Always verify that email communications come from an @nielsen.com address. If you're unsure about the authenticity of a job offer or communication, please contact Nielsen directly through our official website or verified social media channels.

title: AGM - OSS & Tools
description:
**Role**
**AGM - OSS & Tools (Automation)**
**Job Level/ Designation**
M2/AGM
  
  
**Function / Department**
SNOC/OSS & Tools
  
  
**Location**
Pune/Hyderabad
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The purpose of this role is to manage, maintain, and enhance in-house developed automation tools, web portals, and reporting platforms that support critical business and operational functions. The role is responsible for ensuring high availability, performance, security, and reliability of applications built using Python, Node.js, and React.js, running on Linux environments with backend databases such as MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle.
  
  
**Key Result Areas/Accountabilities**
The position involves troubleshooting application and database issues, implementing enhancements, optimizing system performance, automating operational tasks, and ensuring adherence to coding, deployment, and operational standards. The role also collaborates with operations, infrastructure, and development teams to support ongoing improvements, ensure system stability, and deliver scalable and efficient automation and reporting solutions aligned with business requirements.
  
  
**Core Competencies, Knowledge, Experience**

* Strong troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
* Python for Advanced Automation
* Ability to manage and support automation tools, portals, and reports
* Good understanding of application support and production environments
* Ability to automate manual tasks and improve operational efficiency
* Strong ownership and ability to work independently

**Must Have Technical / Professional Qualifications**
**Technical Knowledge:**

* Hands-on experience in Python, Node.js, React.js, html, CSS and Linux Advance Level
* Strong Coding and Troubleshooting skills
* Good working knowledge of Linux systems and shell commands
* Strong database knowledge in MySQL, PostgreSQL, and Oracle
* Experience in SQL queries, database support, and performance tuning
* Basic knowledge of web servers, APIs, and application deployments
* Automation Skills are preferred

**Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in application support, automation, or development
* Experience managing in-house portals, automation tools, and reports
* Experience working in Linux production environments
* Telecom / OSS / enterprise application experience is preferred

title: Consultant
description:
Veeva Systems is a mission-driven organization and pioneer in industry cloud, helping life sciences companies bring therapies to patients faster. As one of the fastest-growing SaaS companies in history, we surpassed $3B in revenue in our last fiscal year with extensive growth potential ahead.
  
  
At the heart of Veeva are our values: Do the Right Thing, Customer Success, Employee Success, and Speed. We're not just any public company – we made history in 2021 by becoming a public benefit corporation (PBC), legally bound to balancing the interests of customers, employees, society, and investors.
  
  
As a Work Anywhere company, we support your flexibility to work from home or in the office, so you can thrive in your ideal environment.
  
  
Join us in transforming the life sciences industry, committed to making a positive impact on its customers, employees, and communities.
  
  
The Role
  
  
Join Veeva’s journey on building the industry cloud for life sciences. We are bringing to market a modern cloud solution designed to optimize laboratories with increased efficiency and productivity by streamlining processes. Join the team that will partner with our customers to implement one of Veeva’s newest products in Quality Cloud - Veeva LIMS.
  
  
Passionate about bringing disruptive technology to customers and have novel ideas for successful GxP software implementation? This role will allow you to help our clients to drive new product adoption through successful implementations.
  
  
This is a remote, full-time permanent role with Veeva. For a candidate this is a customer-facing role and we have no work location requirement, if you are in close proximity to an airport and able to meet future travel requirements.
  
  
Qualified candidates must be legally authorized to be employed in India. Veeva does not provide sponsorship for employment visas for this position.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Participate in projects at life sciences companies designing and deploying Quality & Manufacturing applications
* Support Functional Analysts in workshops and be part of customer discussions of the Vault Qualitysuite (Vault QMS, Vault QualityDocs, Vault Training)
* Quality/Content management solution design, prototyping, configuration, and documentation
* Solution and configuration of Veeva Vault Quality Suite per customer requirements, including workflows, document types, security, fields, page layouts, reports, dashboards, formatted output reports, and notifications
* Leveraging enablement of out-of-the-box or best practices configuration approach to solution strategy
* Assessing the impact of change on the current configuration and working with key stakeholders to make informed decisions in a timely manner
* Represent Professional Services across multiple engagements and workstreams (e.g., solution design and configuration, data migration, systems integration, etc.)
* Ensure customer success from the beginning to the end of the engagement life cycle

**Requirements**

* 3+ years experience working with or for organizations in life sciences or healthcare
* Bachelor's Degree in Life science, computer science, or related degree
* Solid analytical and great interpersonal skills
* Excellent communication skills (written and verbal)
* Strong attention to detail
* Highly organized
* Ability to act with speed to understand business requirements and willingness to "roll up your sleeves" to design and implement a solution
* Exposure to life sciences compliance and computer systems validation requirements

****Nice to Have****

* Knowledge of Quality operations within the Life Sciences, Pharmaceutical, Biotech industry, and/or equivalent

**Perks & Benefits**

* Health & wellness programs
* Life Assurance
* Veeva charitable giving program
* Additional annual leave over Christmas break

Veeva’s headquarters is located in the San Francisco Bay Area with offices in more than 15 countries around the world.
  
  
Veeva is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, religion, national origin or ancestry, age, disability, marital status, pregnancy, protected veteran status, protected genetic information, political affiliation, or any other characteristics protected by local laws, regulations, or ordinances.

title: Sr. Security Operations Analyst
description:
**Job Description IAM Operations Analyst / Engineer Position Summary**
We are seeking an experienced Identity and Access Management (IAM) Operations Analyst to support day-to-day IAM operations across enterprise applications and identity platforms. The role is responsible for user access provisioning and deprovisioning, application access management, Active Directory (AD) and Microsoft Entra ID administration, group management, and ensuring adherence to security, compliance, and operational standards.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Application Access Management**

* Process application access requests, modifications, and removals in accordance with approved procedures.
* Perform user provisioning and deprovisioning across enterprise applications.
* Validate approvals and ensure appropriate authorization before granting access.
* Support role-based access control (RBAC) and entitlement management activities.
* Investigate and resolve access-related incidents and service requests.
* Maintain accurate records of user access and access changes.

**Identity Lifecycle Management**

* Execute Joiner, Mover, and Leaver (JML) processes.
* Ensure timely onboarding and offboarding of workforce members.
* Support automated and manual provisioning workflows.
* Monitor provisioning failures and perform corrective actions.
* Coordinate with application owners and HR teams to maintain access accuracy.

**Active Directory Administration**

* Manage user, group, and service accounts within Active Directory.
* Create, modify, and remove security groups and distribution groups.
* Perform password resets, account unlocks, and user account maintenance.
* Support Group Policy administrative activities as required.
* Troubleshoot AD operational issues and escalate complex incidents.

**Microsoft Entra ID Administration**

* Manage users, groups, licenses, and administrative roles in Microsoft Entra ID.
* Support identity synchronization and hybrid identity operations.
* Perform Entra ID group creation, modification, and membership management.
* Support MFA, Conditional Access, and Privileged Identity Management (PIM) operational activities.
* Monitor and resolve Entra ID-related incidents and service requests.

**Compliance and Governance**

* Participate in periodic access reviews and certification campaigns.
* Support audit evidence collection and compliance activities.
* Ensure adherence to security policies, standards, and regulatory requirements.
* Maintain operational documentation, SOPs, and knowledge articles.
* Identify process improvement opportunities and automation use cases.

**Required Qualifications**
  
  

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.
* 3-6 years of experience in IAM Operations, Identity Administration, or Access Management.
* Hands-on experience with:

+ Active Directory
+ Microsoft Entra ID (Azure AD)
+ User and group administration
+ Identity lifecycle management (JML)
+ Access provisioning and deprovisioning
+ ServiceNow or similar ticketing platforms

* Strong understanding of RBAC and access governance concepts.
* Experience working within defined SLAs and operational support environments.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Experience with SailPoint, One Identity, Saviynt, or similar IGA solutions.
* Experience supporting PAM platforms such as CyberArk or BeyondTrust.
* Knowledge of MFA, Conditional Access, and PIM.
* Understanding of SOX, HIPAA, ISO 27001, or other compliance frameworks.
* Scripting experience using PowerShell for IAM automation.

**Key Skills**

* Identity & Access Management
* Active Directory Administration
* Microsoft Entra ID
* Application Access Management
* User Provisioning & Deprovisioning
* Group Management
* RBAC Administration
* Access Governance
* ServiceNow
* PowerShell
* Incident & Request Management
* Audit & Compliance Support

**Success Measures**

* Access requests fulfilled within SLA.
* Timely completion of provisioning and deprovisioning activities.
* Zero unauthorized access incidents due to operational errors.
* Successful completion of access reviews and audit requirements.
* High customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

title: Senior BI Developer
description:
Join ABC Fitness and become part of a culture that’s as ambitious as it is authentic. Let’s transform the future of fitness—together!
  
  
Our Values
  
  
**Best Life**
We believe great work begins with great people. That’s why our culture is built on respect, trust, and belonging. We create an inclusive environment where every team member can bring their authentic self to work—because diverse perspectives drive innovation and meaningful impact.
  
  
**Growth Mindset**
We are doers, thinkers, and dreamers. At ABC Fitness, your growth is our investment. Through continuous learning, mentorship, and professional development opportunities, we empower you to reach new heights—personally and professionally.
  
  
**One Team**
From day one, you’ll be part of a team that collaborates, celebrates, and cares. We move fast, support one another, and have fun along the way. Because when you thrive, we all thrive.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Design, develop, test, deploy, and maintain Power BI dashboards, interactive reports, paginated reports, semantic models, and reusable BI assets.
* Partner with business and product stakeholders to translate reporting needs into scalable, governed, and user-friendly analytical solutions.
* Build and optimize semantic models, DAX measures, Power Query transformations, SQL queries, views, and stored procedures.
* Integrate data from multiple platforms, databases, APIs, warehouses, or lakehouse environments into consistent reporting layers.
* Improve dashboard performance, refresh reliability, usability, accessibility, security, and maintainability.
* Validate data, calculations, reports, and end-to-end BI solutions through testing, reconciliation, automation, and peer review.
* Troubleshoot data accuracy, report functionality, refresh failures, access, security, and query performance issues.
* Use AI-assisted tools responsibly to speed up requirements analysis, development, documentation, testing, code review, and support while validating outputs for accuracy, security, and maintainability.
* Contribute to BI standards, documentation, release practices, reusable templates, and continuous improvement across the analytics environment.
* Mentor junior developers and share practical BI, automation, and responsible AI practices with the team.

**What You’ll Need**

* 4–6 years of experience in business intelligence, analytics, database development, or a related field.
* 4+ years of hands-on experience building solutions in Power BI.
* Strong Power BI Desktop, Power BI Service, Power BI Builder, DAX, Power Query, semantic modeling, and report-design skills.
* Strong SQL skills, including experience developing and optimizing complex queries, views, stored procedures, and transformations.
* Solid understanding of dimensional modeling, star schemas, data warehousing, semantic layers, and BI performance optimization.
* Experience in testing data, calculations, dashboards, reports, and source-to-report logic before production release.
* Working knowledge of Git-based source control, branching, pull requests, peer reviews, CI/CD, and environment promotion.
* Understanding of BI security, row-level security, access controls, governance, and production support practices.
* Comfort using generative AI, coding assistants, or AI-enabled development tools to improve productivity while independently validating results.
* Clear communication skills and the ability to collaborate with business stakeholders, product teams, engineering teams, and leadership.

AND IT’S GREAT TO HAVE
  
  

* Experience with Microsoft Fabric, Azure, Power BI Embedded, Azure Synapse, Databricks, or similar cloud data and analytics platforms.
* Experience with embedded analytics, deployment pipelines, Direct Lake, lakehouses, warehouses, or dataflows.
* Experience with Python, PowerShell, C#, APIs, or metadata-driven automation for BI development and operations.
* Knowledge of automated testing, data-quality frameworks, observability, capacity planning, workload optimization, or refresh management.
* Experience creating AI-assisted workflows, agents, copilots, or reusable accelerators for software, data, or BI development.

**What Success Looks Like**

* Dashboards, reports, and semantic models are accurate, reliable, performant, and easy for stakeholders to use.
* BI delivery becomes faster and more consistent through reusable assets, standards, documentation, and automation.
* Data validation, release quality, and production support improve through disciplined testing and clear ownership.
* AI-assisted development is used responsibly to reduce manual effort while maintaining strong human review, security, and quality guardrails.
* Business users have clearer, more trusted access to the insights they need to make decisions.

**WHAT’S IN IT FOR YOU:**

* Purpose led company with a Values focused culture – Best Life, One Team, Growth Mindset
* Time Off – competitive PTO plans with 15 Earned accrued leave, 12 days Sick leave, and 12 days Casual leave per year
* 11 Holidays plus 4 Days of Disconnect – once a quarter, we take a collective breather and enjoy a day off together around the globe. #oneteam
* Group Mediclaim insurance coverage of INR 500,000 for employee + spouse, 2 kids, and parents or parent-in-laws, and including EAP counseling
* Life Insurance and Personal Accident Insurance
* Best Life Perk – we are committed to meeting you wherever you are in your fitness journey with a quarterly reimbursement
* Premium Calm App – enjoy tranquility with a Calm App subscription for you and up to 4 dependents over the age of 16
* Support for working women with financial aid towards crèche facility, ensuring a safe and nurturing environment for their little ones while they focus on their careers

At ABC Fitness, we don’t just build technology—we build communities and transform lives. Your work matters here, your growth is supported, and your voice is heard. We welcome diverse talent and encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every requirement.
  
  
**ABC’S COMMITMENT TO DIVERSITY, EQUALITY, BELONGING AND INCLUSION**
:  ABC is an equal opportunity employer committed to diversity, equity, and inclusion. We strive to create a workplace where every employee, client, and partner feels valued, inspired, and empowered to reach their full potential. For us, inclusion isn’t just the right thing to do—it’s a business imperative. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**
.
  
  
**About ABC Fitness**
ABC Fitness is the #1 software provider for fitness businesses of any size, all around the world. Supporting 30K clubs, 650K coaches, 40M members, and processing more than $12B in payments every year, ABC Fitness provides scalable, data-driven solutions to simplify club management and engage members and clients.
  
  
From personal trainers, boutique studios, and gyms, to international franchise health clubs, ABC Fitness will move your business forward through technology and industry insights. Innovation is at the center of everything we do, across ABC Glofox, ABC Ignite, ABC Trainerize, and ABC Evo. Let's make your fitness vision a seamless reality, together. Learn more at
**abcfitness.com**

title: Technical Support, Associate Specialist
description:
Job Posting Description

As a Technical Support agent, you will work as part of our Customer Support team to

solve complex customer issues by combining technical troubleshooting with a strong

understanding of customer context and impact. You’ll build technical capability over

time while developing the judgment needed to deliver high-quality, customer-focused

support.

Work Location: Skytech, Hyderabad

Work Schedule:

This role supports internal customers, partners, and stakeholders who primarily operate

during U.S. business hours.

* Ability to work a schedule aligned with U.S. business hours, generally 9:00 AM to

5:00 PM Eastern Time (ET), including participation in meetings, consultations,

and other business-critical activities during that time.

* Limited holiday coverage may be required based on business needs.

What You’ll Do

Case Ownership and Technical Troubleshooting

* Investigate and resolve complex customer issues, understanding both the

customer experience and the underlying technical cause

* Troubleshoot using tools such as browser developer tools, API clients (e.g.,

Postman), and log analysis

* Apply knowledge of authentication concepts such as SSO and MFA during

diagnosis

* Build working knowledge of product behavior, integrations, and common failure

patterns

* Develop a strong foundation in troubleshooting across web applications and

integrated systems over time

* Own cases end to end, ensuring clear, structured documentation of investigation

steps, findings, and outcomes

* Escalate issues with concise, well-structured summaries that enable faster

resolution by senior team members

* Identify recurring issues, trends, and patterns to improve support efficiency and

product outcomes

Knowledge Application and Continuous Learning

* Create and maintain knowledgebase articles based on real customer issues and

case patterns

* Apply Knowledge-Centered Service (KCS) practices as part of daily work
* Continuously build technical capability through hands-on troubleshooting and

feedback

* Strengthen analytical thinking to connect issues across technical and functional

areas as knowledge develops

* Stay current on product updates, new features, and evolving customer needs

Deliver Customer Support Across Channels

* Provide support across phone, chat, and ticketing channels, adapting your

approach to each

* Guide customers through solutions clearly and confidently, including live

troubleshooting scenarios

* Manage multiple chat conversations while maintaining accuracy, quality, and

composure

* Provide timely, meaningful updates with a clear path to resolution for every case
* Prioritize work based on customer impact and urgency, balancing speed with

quality of resolution

Work in a Global Support Model

* Align to US business hours to support North American customers
* Operate within a follow-the-sun model across North America, UK, India, and

Australia

* Maintain reliability and consistency in coverage, including select holidays based

on business needs

* Participate in after-hours support rotations as required by product, region, or

team size

Use Tools, AI, and Resources Effectively

* Leverage internal tools, automation, and AI-enabled resources to improve

efficiency and response times

* Apply sound judgment when using AI and tools to ensure accuracy, relevance,

and a strong customer experience

* Use these tools to support problem-solving and learning, not replace critical

thinking

* Manage workload effectively while maintaining quality, accountability, and

responsiveness

What You’ll Bring

Experience

* 2–3 years in B2B SaaS or enterprise technical support (not high-volume

transactional or retail support)

* Proven experience troubleshooting complex issues beyond scripted resolutions,

including root cause investigation

* Required experience supporting customers across phone, chat, and ticketing

channels in a professional environment

* Experience working directly with customers to diagnose issues (not solely

internal IT or infrastructure support)

* Experience using case management or CRM tools (e.g., Salesforce, Zendesk)
* Strong written and verbal communication skills
* Familiarity with KCS, or willingness to adopt it quickly
* Experience in high-volume, primarily transactional support environments alone

will not be sufficient for success in this role

Technical and Analytical Capability

* Foundational understanding of troubleshooting across web applications, cloud

platforms, or integrations

* Comfort using diagnostic tools to investigate issues, even when the path to

resolution is not immediately clear

* Basic understanding of authentication concepts (SSO, MFA)
* Strong analytical thinking with the ability to connect technical and functional

issues as knowledge is built

* Ability to learn new technologies quickly and apply them in a customer-facing

context

Preferred Exposure

* Exposure to or interest in:
* CRM and engagement platforms
* Financial systems or payment processing
* Education software or student systems
* APIs, integrations, or email deliverability

Why This Role

* Build strong technical troubleshooting and problem-solving skills in a customerfacing environment
* Gain exposure to global support operations and enterprise customers
* Grow into more advanced technical, product-aligned, or specialized support

roles

title: IT Support Specialist (L1)
description:
Position Overview

Palmiq is a fast-growing technology and managed services company delivering enterprise-grade IT, cloud, and cybersecurity solutions globally. We are seeking a customer-focused **Level 1 IT Support Specialist** to provide technical helpdesk and operational support to our international clients during US operational hours.

What You’ll Be Doing

* **Help Desk Support:** Provide L1 support via phone, email, and remote tools for hardware, software, connectivity, and access requests (MFA, password resets) while maintaining ticket logs in our PSA system.
* **Google Workspace Administration:** Manage user lifecycle (onboarding/offboarding, permissions) and perform data operations in Google Sheets using complex formulas (VLOOKUP, IF, time-based functions).
* **MacOS & Endpoint Support:** Troubleshoot MacBooks and iMacs, configure software/peripherals, and support MDM device enrollment.
* **Networking & Security:** Diagnose core connectivity issues (LAN, Wi-Fi, VPN, DNS, DHCP) and follow security protocols for endpoint protection, identity verification, and incident escalation.

What We’re Looking For

* **Experience:** **2+ years** of required MSP (Managed Service Provider) experience.
* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. / Undergraduate degree in a relevant field.
* **Technical Expertise:** Hands-on experience with Google Workspace administration, advanced Google Sheets, MacOS troubleshooting, and core networking concepts.
* **Tools & Systems:** Familiarity with PSA/ticketing systems, remote access tools, and identity providers (Okta, Microsoft Entra ID).
* **Skills:** Strong English communication skills and ability to handle multiple support tickets efficiently.
* **Certifications (Preferred):** CompTIA A+, Network+, or Google Workspace certifications.

What We Offer

* Competitive base salary
* Direct experience supporting international US client environments.
* Clear internal career growth path into L2/L3 engineering and leadership roles.
* Collaborative and high-performance company culture.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: IT Service Desk QA & Project Coordinator (L1)
description:
About Palmiq

Palmiq is a fast-growing technology and managed services company delivering enterprise-grade IT, cloud, cybersecurity, and SOC/NOC operations globally. We specialize in helping businesses scale through tailored technical solutions, operational excellence, and high-standard service delivery.

Position Overview

We are seeking a dedicated **IT Service Desk Quality Analyst & Project Coordinator (L1)** to join our Technical Service Delivery team in Hyderabad. In this role, you will ensure the highest standards of service delivery across our MSP operations. You will act as an independent auditor of our operational workflows, ensuring our technical teams consistently meet Palmiq’s standards for quality, client satisfaction, and project health.

What You’ll Be Doing

* **MSP Process Integrity & Project Management:** Serve as the primary checkpoint for operational workflows, ensuring execution of standard operating procedures (SOPs) and tracking professional project health through to completion.
* **Workflow & Data Auditing:** Independently audit case documentation, ticket creation, and priority assignments to guarantee data integrity across the lifecycle of an incident.
* **Escalation Audits & Quality Control:** Review high-level escalations to ensure smooth, ITIL-compliant ticket transitions between tiers and partners, focusing on systemic process improvements.
* **ITIL Standards & Continual Improvement:** Enforce best practices across Incident, Problem, and Change Management while identifying trends to implement continuous service improvements.
* **Client Pulse & Survey Analysis:** Analyze client feedback (DSATs & Mid-SATs) to find improvement opportunities, provide constructive feedback to support groups, and maintain client-facing meeting cadences.

What We’re Looking For

* **Experience:** Minimum **1–2 years** of experience as an L1 / Quality Analyst within a technical MSP or IT Service Desk environment.
* **Education:** B.Tech / B.E. in any specialization.
* **Frameworks & Tools:** Solid understanding of ITIL v4 frameworks and experience with ITSM tools (SuperOps, Zoho, ServiceNow, etc.) and workflow management.
* **Technical Foundations:** Foundational understanding of core enterprise IT technologies (MS 365, Microsoft Intune, Active Directory, Cybersecurity basics) to evaluate technical workflows effectively.
* **Analytical & Communication Skills:** Strong root-cause analysis skills (5 Whys, Pareto, FMEA) and exceptional communication skills to deliver process-focused feedback.

What We Offer

* Competitive compensation package (₹6,00,000 to ₹9,00,000 per year).
* Direct experience in international MSP operations, quality governance, and project coordination.
* Defined career advancement opportunities within Service Delivery Management and Quality Operations.
* Collaborative, supportive, and quality-driven workplace environment.

Pay: ₹600,000.00 - ₹900,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Paid time off
* Work from home

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Hyderabad, Telangana

title: Technical Support Engineer
description:

Allot is an established industry leader in network intelligence and security solutions for service providers and enterprises around the world. We believe in delivering real value to our Tier-1 customers by offering cutting-edge solutions that make their networks smarter and their users more secure. At Allot, you will have the opportunity to grow professionally in a dynamic environment with like-minded people who go the extra mile to succeed.

A Technical Support Engineer to remotely support our CSP clients. This is an opportunity to join the Global Customer Services team of a leading DPI/network devices vendor providing solutions for Tier-1 global telcos.

* Support and troubleshoot application issues running on Linux-based systems and clusters.
* Perform incident triage, troubleshooting, provide best-practice guidance for customers
* Manage support cases to ensure issues are recorded, tracked, updated, and followed through in a timely manner.

* Certifications such as CKA, CCNA, or Red Hat , Kubernetes (K8s)
* Understanding of ISP networks, Diameter Protocol, and 4G/5G call flows.
* Experience working with ISPs, mobile operators, or cable operators.

title: L3 Product IT Support Engineer

Preferred Qualifications

* Experience in handling enterprise IT/product environments

description:

www.johncockerill.com

* Use scripting, automation and available platform capabilities to simplify repeatable operational activities.
* Maintain clear technical documentation, knowledge articles, runbooks and user guidance.
* Contribute to shift-left and knowledge transfer, enabling L1 support and peers to resolve appropriate scenarios independently.
* Monitor relevant Digital Workplace ecosystem changes, usage and adoption, and help translate them into appropriate technical or user-facing actions.
* Collaborate with colleagues, partners and vendors to resolve issues and continuously improve Digital Workplace services.
* Apply appropriate security, data-access, governance and responsible-AI principles.
* Continuously develop your skills and adapt to new technologies, services and team priorities.

**Expected Profile**

* Bachelor’s degree in IT, Engineering, Computer Science or a related discipline, or equivalent practical experience.
* Typically 2–4 years of relevant professional experience, with hands-on exposure to Microsoft 365 support or administration.
* Practical experience with Microsoft 365 Copilot and Agent Builder.
* Working knowledge of SharePoint Online, Teams, OneDrive and Microsoft 365 administration.
* Basic PowerShell knowledge and an interest in automation.
* Good analytical, troubleshooting and documentation skills.
* Clear written and verbal communication in English.
* Customer-focused, collaborative and comfortable working in a multicultural, distributed environment.
* Curious, accountable and willing to learn beyond an initially assigned technology or area of responsibility.

Experience or knowledge in one or more of the following is an advantage:
  
  

* Copilot Studio and Power Platform
* Power Automate
* Microsoft Graph, PnP PowerShell or SharePoint Management Shell
* Entra ID and Microsoft 365 security concepts
* Exchange Online and other Microsoft 365 workloads
* Jira Service Management or similar ITSM platforms
* Microsoft 365 migration tooling such as ShareGate or Quest
* Agile/Scrum environments
* User training, demonstrations or technology-adoption activities

Microsoft certifications such as
**MS-900, PL-900, AZ-900 or relevant Copilot credentials**
are welcome but are not a substitute for practical capability, curiosity and willingness to learn.
  
  
John Cockerill offers you career and development opportunities within its various sectors in a friendly working environment.
  
  
Do you want to work for an innovative company that will allow you to take up technical challenges on a daily basis?
  
  
We look forward to receiving your application and to meeting you!

title: IT Applications Support
description:
**Job Description**
**About TaskUs:**
TaskUs is a provider of outsourced digital services and next-generation customer experience to fast-growing technology companies, helping its clients represent, protect and grow their brands. Leveraging a cloud-based infrastructure, TaskUs serves clients in the fastest-growing sectors, including social media, e-commerce, gaming, streaming media, food delivery, ride-sharing, HiTech, FinTech, and HealthTech.
  
  
The People First culture at TaskUs has enabled the company to expand its workforce to approximately 60,000 employees globally. Presently, we have a presence in twenty-three locations across twelve countries, which include the Philippines, India, and the United States.
  
  
It started with one ridiculously good idea to create a different breed of Business Processing Outsourcing (BPO)! We at TaskUs understand that achieving growth for our partners requires a culture of constant motion, exploring new technologies, being ready to handle any challenge at a moment's notice, and mastering consistency in an ever-changing world.
  
  
**What We Offer:**
At TaskUs, we prioritize our employees' well-being by offering competitive industry salaries and comprehensive benefits packages. Our commitment to a People First culture is reflected in the various departments we have established, including Total Rewards, Wellness, HR, and Diversity. We take pride in our inclusive environment and positive impact on the community. Moreover, we actively encourage internal mobility and professional growth at all stages of an employee's career within TaskUs. Join our team today and experience firsthand our dedication to supporting People First.
  
  
**IT Application Support**
**Role Overview**
As an
**IT Application Support**
specialist, you serve as the Level II Support bridge connecting end-users, IT Service Desk (L1), and core technical teams (Developers, DBAs, ETL Data Engineers, and Workforce Management). You will solve complex application challenges, monitor SQL database jobs, modify SQL scripts, collaborate on outage escalations, and propose continuous system enhancements. This role supports round-the-clock global operations and requires flexibility for a
**24/7 rotating shift schedule**
.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* L2 Escalation & Support: Serve as the primary L2 escalation point for internal and cloud corporate applications (HCM, Financials, Recruiting, Payroll, Leave Accruals) using ServiceNow and Jira.
* Dev, DBA & Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with L3 Developers, DBAs, ETL Data Engineers, and Workforce Management (WFM) to investigate system issues, monitor data feeds, execute/verify stored procedures, modify SQL scripts, and resolve incidents.
* ETL & WFM Integrations: Partner with ETL teams to troubleshoot data pipelines and reporting workflows. Collaborate with WFM teams on shift/leave accrual syncs, timekeeping integrations, and automated feed files.
* Database Operations & Job Monitoring: Actively check SQL Server job executions, inspect automated tasks/feedfiles, and modify SQL scripts to resolve data sync errors or backend issues.
* Outage & Incident Management: Partner directly with Incident Management (NOC IM) during production outages. Participate in comms bridges, provide regular escalation updates (every 30 mins to 4 hours based on severity), and draft Initial Root Cause Analysis (RCA) documents.
* L1 Support Enablement: Conduct regular sync calls and coaching sessions for Level 1 Service Desk reps to improve initial troubleshooting, intake requirements, and ticket escalation quality.
* Continuous Improvement: Track recurring issue trends and propose continuous improvement (CI) application enhancements to Business Analysts and Product teams.
* Knowledge Base & Documentation: Author and maintain Knowledge Base (KB) articles and SOPs in ServiceNow to empower L1 teams and end-users to resolve common issues independently.

**Technical Competencies**

* ETL & WFM Data Integrations: Understanding of ETL pipeline workflows, data transformation, and system integration with WFM platforms and timekeeping tools.
* SQL & Database Support: Direct experience inspecting SQL Server environments, checking job executions, modifying SQL scripts, executing/verifying stored procedures, and performing data fixes.
* Debugging & Dev Collaboration: Technical capability to collaborate with L3 developers in investigating backend code errors, debugging system logs, and verifying technical hotfixes.
* Incident Response: Experience collaborating with Incident Management teams during outages, participating in comms bridges, sending stakeholder notifications, and drafting RCA reports.
* Ticketing & Tooling: Hands-on experience using ServiceNow (Incident/Service Request Management) and Jira (Bug Tracking/Dev Escalations).

**Requirements**

* Shift Flexibility: Must be amenable to working on a 24x7 rotating shift schedule (including nights, weekends, and holidays).
* Experience: 1-2 years in IT application support, IT service desk, or product support utilizing enterprise ITSM tools like ServiceNow and Jira.
* Cross-Team Experience: Hands-on experience collaborating with ETL engineers, WFM teams, Devs, DBAs, and NOC/IM outage teams.
* Technical & Analytical Skills: Proven ability to run/modify SQL scripts, check database jobs, execute/verify stored procedures, research root causes, and resolve backend incidents.
* Communication & Mindset: Strong technical communication skills to articulate issues clearly across all technical and non-technical stakeholders, paired with a proactive drive to improve support workflows.

****How We Partner To Protect You:****
TaskUs will neither solicit money from you during your application process nor require any form of payment in order to proceed with your application. Kindly ensure that you are always in communication with only authorized recruiters of TaskUs.
  
  
****DEI:****
In TaskUs we believe that innovation and higher performance are brought by people from all walks of life. We welcome applicants of different backgrounds, demographics, and circumstances. Inclusive and equitable practices are our responsibility as a business. TaskUs is committed to providing equal access to opportunities. If you need reasonable accommodations in any part of the hiring process, please let us know.
  
  
We invite you to explore all TaskUs career opportunities and apply through the provided URL
**https://www.taskus.com/careers/ .**
TaskUs is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We celebrate and support diversity; we are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. TaskUs people first culture thrives on it for the benefit of our employees, our clients, our services, and our community.

title: Data Center Operations Technician, Data Center Operations (DCO)
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is growing rapidly, and we are looking for Data Center Technician to join our expanding Infrastructure Operations team.
  
  
Data Center Operations designs, installs and maintains the world’s largest Computing Infrastructure. Our scope of work includes systems, repairing, dealing with issues, handling and tracking parts and assisting in Data Center maintenance. Amazon Data Centers are large-scale high-density centers where you will help change the face of Technology in the region.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As Data Centre Operations Engineer, you will be the primary point of contact for internal customers. There is never a dull moment as each day presents itself with different challenges. Some of the key responsibilities you will undertake are:
  
  

* You will troubleshoot technical issues on advanced hardware, ranging from servers, storage and networking devices on a 24/7 basis.
* You will maintain a high level of system reliability and availability.
* You will participate in projects to enhance operational efficiencies with opportunities to share experiences and knowledge with our global network of technical experts.
* You will share knowledge and help train less technical staff on the best practices related to all service owner issues
* You will contribute towards building a great team by getting involved in the Amazon hiring process/candidate interviews

A day in the life
  
  
As a successful Data Center Operations engineer, your day-to-day work will include:
  
  

* Installation and configurations on Data center Servers and Network systems
* Installation, troubleshooting and replacement of internal and external hardware parts of Servers and Network devices
* Work within a ticket-based environment and work on systematic problem resolution
* Work on rotational shift-based schedule to maintain high system reliability
* Collaborate with internal teams and share ideas and contribute in innovative projects to improve DC work environment and overall efficiencies.
* This is a physically active role, we are always on the move onsite.

**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* 1+ years of computer networking experience
* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or a related field

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Can work in cramped spaces or in elevated locations while adhering to health & safety guidelines
* Experience dealing effectively with customers during problem resolution and operating efficiently under pressure
* Experience managing work and priorities through a ticketing system
* Experience with cabling infrastructure best practices and methodologies
* Experience working in a data center environment (racking and stacking gear, cable management, hot/cold aisle containment)

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.

description:
**Brennan. Where true performance thrives.**
At Brennan, we believe that
*how*
technology is delivered is every bit as important as
*what*
the technology is. We focus on creating real and relevant value for customers with solutions that fit their specific needs and always reflect their true interests.
  
  
It’s a claim backed by our
**True Performance System**
- a way of working engineered to get us closer, and deliver better, for our customers and their actual experience of technology.
  
  
**Why join Brennan**
True performance for our customers starts with a true belief in our people.
  
  
It’s why we’ve structured our business to help our teams, and their talents, shine bright. It's why we’ve created a workplace where people of all backgrounds, beliefs and experiences are welcomed and empowered. And it’s why we’ve built an organization where real innovation makes a genuine impact and generates true rewards for our team members.
  
  
**True rewards**
In addition to competitive remuneration, Brennan offers extensive benefits, including:
  
  

* Training and certification bonuses
* Culture Awards that recognize excellence
* Brennan Daredevils - our annual, all-expenses paid trip awarded to our top performers and outstanding contributors
* Vibrant, fun social activities
* Discounted hardware and software
* An environment that embraces learning and development

**The Role:**
The Portfolio Support Specialist supports Brennan’s Digital Group professional services business across the Cloud, Data & AI and Business Applications practices. Reporting to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager, the role improves portfolio visibility, PPM adoption, data quality and operational discipline across Brennan’s project and portfolio management processes.
  
  
The role is expected to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across PPM support, reporting, analysis, training material maintenance and continual improvement activities. This is not a traditional manual administration role; the successful candidate will proactively reduce repetitive effort, identify patterns, streamline tasks and use AI to deliver faster, more reliable portfolio support outcomes.
  
  
**Role Responsibilities**
**Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) Tool End-user Support**

* Provide first level support to end users of Brennan’s Project & Portfolio Management (PPM) tool, including how-to guidance, navigation support and assistance with day-to-day usage queries.
* Support onboarding of new starters by delivering basic PPM tool training and helping users understand required processes, data entry standards and project information hygiene expectations.
* Own, maintain and continually improve PPM training materials, including user guides, FAQs, work instructions and training handbooks.
* Troubleshoot level 1 PPM tool issues, triage user queries, capture recurring problems and escalate system or process issues where additional support is required.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring PPM support issues, improve guidance materials and reduce repetitive user support effort.

**Service Pack Coordination**

* Coordinate a portfolio of small, simple service packs that do not require client-facing project management, ensuring delivery information remains accurate and current.
* Maintain service pack updates in Brennan’s PPM tool, including status, key dates, assigned resources, progress notes and closure information.
* Ensure resource planning tools are updated to reflect resource allocation, planned effort and delivery timing against each service pack.
* Monitor service pack progress and follow up with delivery resources or internal stakeholders to confirm updates, identify blockers and support timely completion.
* Maintain consistent information hygiene across service pack records so portfolio reporting, resource planning and operational visibility remain reliable.

**Digital Group Portfolio Manager Support**

* Provide ad-hoc support to the Digital Group Portfolio Manager across portfolio reporting, data analysis, administration and operational follow-up activities.
* Assist with preparing portfolio reports, dashboards, summaries and analysis using information from PPM, resource planning and other delivery management tools.
* Use available AI tools to identify recurring support themes, data quality gaps, reporting inconsistencies and process inefficiencies, then translate insights into practical improvement actions.
* Proactively identify continual improvement opportunities and maintain a backlog of initiatives to improve ways of working, system usage, data quality and portfolio support processes.
* Maintain all project management guidelines, playbooks and templates, ensuring the latest versions are available and accessible to all PMs.

**Stakeholder Engagement & Communication**

* Communicate clearly with PPM users, delivery teams, project managers and practice stakeholders to support accurate tool usage and timely updates.
* Respond to PPM user queries, provide simple guidance and escalate issues where further support is required.
* Follow up with internal stakeholders to keep service pack status, resource allocation and delivery information current.
* Use available AI tools to summarise support activity, service pack progress, blockers, data quality issues and recurring stakeholder themes into clear updates for the Digital Group Portfolio Manager.
* Maintain clear records of requests, actions, decisions and outcomes to support reporting and follow-up.

**Key Competencies And Qualifications Required**

* 5+ years’ experience working in portfolio, PMO, project coordination, project administration or professional services support environments, preferably within a technology services business.
* Demonstrated exposure to portfolio-level ways of working, including project governance, status reporting, data quality, resource planning, templates, playbooks and operational follow-up.
* Experience supporting users of project, portfolio or resource planning tools, including responding to how-to queries, assisting new users, maintaining training materials and troubleshooting basic issues.
* Experience maintaining accurate project, portfolio or operational data in tools and trackers, with strong attention to data quality, status updates, information hygiene and reporting accuracy.
* Exposure to resource planning, scheduling, capacity tracking or allocation management across multiple small work packages, projects or service activities.
* Experience working with geographically distributed stakeholders, with the ability to follow up actions, communicate clearly, manage competing priorities and escalate issues when required.
* Mandatory Skills and Technology
* Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Project Operations is mandatory, including project setup, project records, tasks, resource assignments, time or effort visibility, status information, reporting inputs and data quality management.
* Strong administration, coordination and follow-up skills, with the ability to maintain accurate records, track actions and keep portfolio information current.
* Confident supporting business users with project, portfolio and resource planning tools, including providing simple guidance, basic training and level 1 troubleshooting.
* Strong attention to detail and data quality, with the ability to identify gaps, inconsistencies or missing updates in PPM and resource planning tools.
* Proven ability to consistently use available AI tools to improve speed, accuracy and efficiency across reporting, analysis, support triage, documentation maintenance and continual improvement activities.
* Ability to own, maintain and continually improve user guides, FAQs, work instructions, training handbooks, PM guidelines, artefacts, playbooks and templates.

**Highly Desired Skills and Technology**

* Confident using Microsoft 365 tools, including Teams, Excel, PowerPoint, SharePoint and Planner, to support communication, reporting, tracking and administration.
* Intermediate Excel skills, with the ability to work with lists, filters, tables and basic reporting outputs to support portfolio analysis and data quality checks.
* Basic exposure to reporting or dashboard tools, such as Power BI, to support portfolio reporting, analysis and data quality checks.
* Ability to log, prioritise, track and follow up support requests through to resolution or escalation.
* Basic understanding of project lifecycle, resource planning, scheduling and reporting concepts required to support service pack coordination and portfolio visibility.

is an equal opportunity employer.

title: Technical Support Specialist - BioPharma
description:
**About Kerry**
Kerry is the world's leading taste and nutrition company for the food, beverage and pharmaceutical industries. Every day we partner with customers to create healthier, tastier and more sustainable products that are consumed by billions of people across the world. Our vision is to be our customers' most valued partner, creating a world of sustainable nutrition. A career with Kerry offers you an opportunity to shape the future of food while providing you opportunities to explore and grow in a truly global environment.
  
  
**About the role**
The Technical Support Specialist provides exceptional support for our BioPharmaceutical and Life Sciences product portfolios. This role involves offering expert technical support and guidance to customers, troubleshooting product issues, and ensuring customer satisfaction. Reporting to the GTS Manager - Pharma, the specialist is responsible for resolving internal and external customer technical queries promptly and effectively. The role requires prioritizing activities in a dynamic environment, allocating resources to critical projects, and assisting the global business team in driving sales and capturing new opportunities. The Specialist will play a crucial role in maintaining high levels of customer satisfaction and loyalty by delivering exceptional support and service.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Customer Inquiries Promptly address technical customer inquiries regarding the BioPharma and Life Sciences Product Portfolio, gathering appropriate responses from internal technical collateral, literature searches, and consultations with internal subject matter experts (SMEs). Recommendations provided will include product application details, product-specific technical information, and general end-use application knowledge.
* Communication Effectively communicate with Account Managers, Product Managers and other stake holders to clearly understand and meet customers’ needs.
* Collaboration Collaborate cross-functionally (with sales, RD&A, product management, marketing, process technology, regulatory, quality, etc.) to develop appropriate, customized technical responses. The candidate will communicate and work closely with product development teams to provide feedback and insights from customer interactions. Interact with a wide array of SMEs and stakeholders to aid the sales team.
* Resource Utilization Utilize available resources strategically to support account directors with technical information specific to BioPharma and Life Sciences portfolio end-uses.
* Customer Calls Support technical customer calls as needed, capturing, and sharing meeting notes; over 90% of customer calls are virtual meetings.
* Documentation Document and track customer issues using a ticketing system, ensuring accurate and detailed records. Maintain comprehensive logs of customer interactions and technical issues.
* Troubleshooting Support troubleshooting activities when application issues arise at customers, working collaboratively and cross-functionally. Activities may include, but are not limited to supporting customer calls, scheduling internal debriefs and brainstorming meetings, capturing meeting notes, requesting and submitting samples for testing, gathering data from other departments, analyzing data and preparing reports, presenting summaries to internal stakeholders and on customer calls. Conduct root cause analysis in collaboration with relevant departments to resolve technical issues, ensuring minimal disruption to customer operations.
* Training Assist in preparing and delivering training presentations to the Sales Team.
* Market Intelligence Capture Voice of Customer (VOC), capture market/industry intelligence, monitor technical queries for trends, and bring these insights forward to relevant stakeholders.
* Technical Documentation & Tools Develop and maintain technical documentation and tools for the sales team (e.g., develop/maintain FAQ list, product info tools, product matching tool, etc.).
* Industry Knowledge Stay up-to-date with the latest industry trends and technologies to provide informed support. Continuously enhance technical knowledge through training and professional development.
* Multitask Ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously while maintaining high levels of accuracy and efficiency.
* Technical Writing Create, review, and update technical documents, including user manuals, product specifications, and troubleshooting guides. Ensure clarity, accuracy, and consistency in all technical documentation.
* Marketing Support Collaborate with the marketing team to develop technical content for marketing materials, such as brochures, application notes, papers, and case studies. Provide technical insights and support for marketing campaigns and initiatives.

**Qualifications and skills**
**Qualifications**

* Education Bachelor's or Master's in Biology, Chemistry, Pharmacy, Engineering, or a related field.
* Location - Mumbai/Gurgaon/Bangalore
* Experience Minimum of 5 years of relevant experience in technical service or support within the Pharmaceutical and/or Biopharmaceutical industry. Demonstrated ability to troubleshoot and resolve technical issues.
* Customer Relationship Management Proven track record in managing customer relationships and driving technical service excellence.
* Technical Knowledge Strong understanding of pharmaceutical products and their applications. Knowledge of unit operations and practices relevant to pharmaceutical customers and cGMP processes.
* Problem-Solving Skills Excellent problem-solving and troubleshooting skills. Ability to think critically and analytically to resolve complex technical issues.
* Communication Skills Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical users. Proficiency in written and verbal communication.
* Tools and Systems Experience with ticketing systems and remote support tools. Proficiency in using software and tools for technical support and documentation. Experience working in an SAP environment is desirable.
* Teamwork Ability to work independently and as part of a team in a fast-paced environment. Strong collaboration skills and a proactive approach to problem-solving.
* Travel Ability to travel up to 10% of the time.
* Skills
* Broad scientific knowledge base with a focus on microbial and biopharmaceutical manufacturing.
* Comfortable bridging R&D and Commercial enterprises to help reach organizational goals.
* Collaborative individual, adept at working with cross-functional teams within a matrix organization.
* Strong organizational and multi-tasking skills to meet delivery on competing priorities.
* Strong interpersonal, oral, and written communication, and presentation skills.

description:
Experience: 0–2 years in API support, application support, integration support, or a similar technical role.

Job Location: Mumbai or Pune

Job Type: Full-time

Job Summary: We are looking for an API Support Engineer responsible for monitoring, troubleshooting, and supporting APIs and system integrations with clients, suppliers, and third-party service providers.

The candidate will work closely with the Development, QA, Product, Database, and Infrastructure teams to identify API issues, analyze technical problems, coordinate resolutions, and ensure stable operation of production systems.

Experience in Travel / OTA / Hotel Booking / APIs will be an added advantage.

Key Responsibilities

1. API Monitoring & Support

Monitor API performance, availability, response time, error rates, and transaction failures. Monitor production APIs and identify abnormal behavior or service interruptions. Investigate API failures, timeouts, slow responses, incorrect responses, and connectivity issues. Ensure critical API issues are identified and escalated promptly. Perform regular health checks of APIs and integrations.

2. API Troubleshooting

Analyze API requests and responses to identify the root cause of issues.

Troubleshoot REST APIs, JSON, XML, HTTP/HTTPS, authentication, headers, parameters, and response codes. Check request/response logs and application logs. Identify whether an issue is related to the client, supplier, application, database, network, or infrastructure. Coordinate with development teams for code-level issues. Coordinate with suppliers/third parties for external API issues.

5. Logs & Database Analysis

Analyze application and API logs to identify errors and transaction failures. Perform basic SQL queries to investigate transaction and booking-related issues. Verify data consistency between API responses, application databases, and supplier systems.

Work with senior developers/DBAs for complex database-related issues.

6. Client & Supplier Coordination

Communicate with clients and suppliers regarding API connectivity and transaction issues. Collect complete technical information before escalating an issue. Share request/response details, timestamps, booking references, error messages, and relevant logs with the concerned team. Follow up with external suppliers until the issue is resolved. Provide clear technical updates to internal teams and clients.

7. Incident Management

Prioritize incidents based on business impact and severity. Immediately escalate major issues affecting bookings, revenue, API availability, or multiple clients. Maintain incident timelines and resolution details. Perform basic root-cause analysis and prepare incident reports for major issues. Identify recurring problems and recommend permanent solutions.

Required Technical Skills.

Good understanding of REST APIs and API integration. Strong knowledge of JSON and XML. Understanding of HTTP/HTTPS and HTTP status codes. Experience with Postman / Swagger. Basic to good knowledge of SQL and relational databases. Ability to analyze application and API logs.

Soft Skills

Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills. Good communication skills. Ability to work under pressure during production incidents. Good coordination with Development, QA, Product, Infrastructure, clients, and suppliers. Travel Domain Knowledge – Preferred

Qualification

Bachelor's degree / Diploma in Computer Science, IT, Engineering, or a related field.

Preferred Experience.

0–2 years of experience in API Support, Application Support, Production Support, Integration Support, or a similar technical role.

Candidates with experience in Travel Technology / OTA / Hotel Booking Systems / API Integration will be given preference.

description:

The role will be responsible for overall coordination and facilitation of technical and other resources through service restoration and recovery efforts for escalated incidents.
  
  
**Role Responsibility**
**Incident Management [40%]**
Own and manage the end-to-end lifecycle of P1/P2 incidents with minimal business impact.

Escalate risks and service-impacting issues as required.
  
  
Support a 24x7 operational environment and major incident response activities.

Create, track, and manage Problem Records through to closure.
  
  
Facilitate problem review meetings and ensure corrective actions are assigned and completed.
  
  
Monitor known errors and maintain the Known Error Database (KEDB).

Track corrective and preventive actions to completion.
