title: Infrastructure Engineer II – Reporting & Analytic Capabilities
description:
**Company Overview**
We exist to make food the world loves. But we do more than that. Our company is a place that prioritizes being a force for good, a place to expand learning, explore new perspectives and reimagine new possibilities, every day. We look for people who want to bring their best — bold thinkers with big hearts who challenge one another and grow together. Because becoming the undisputed leader in food means surrounding ourselves with people who are hungry for what’s next.
  
  
**Overview**

* Support the global Enterprise Reporting and Analytics team in managing and enhancing enterprise-supported reporting platforms, including Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI.
* This role carries primary ownership of one or two reporting platforms, covering application maintenance, configuration, support, and roadmap planning.
* The individual will help deliver reliable reporting capabilities, partner with infrastructure and data teams, guide internal users, and drive adoption of standards and best practices across the reporting ecosystem.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Required to support and maintain enterprise reporting platforms, including Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI and own the operational health and stability of assigned platforms.
* Configure platforms, manage users and security, support licensing, and resolve break-fix issues and performance improvements.
* Deliver reporting-platform work in projects while coordinating with Enterprise Applications, BASIS, OS, hardware, and network teams.
* Plan, execute, and validate Tableau Server administration tasks including version upgrades and patch deployments. Manage site configurations, data source connections, extract refresh schedules, and subscription management.
* Perform pre-upgrade assessments and compatibility checks and coordinate with infrastructure teams for underlying OS and middleware upgrades.
* Design, build, and maintain CI/CD pipelines for automated deployment of Tableau content, platform configurations, and infrastructure changes.
* Manage release packaging, change preparation, deployment to QA and Production, and post-deployment validation.
* Coordinate and execute periodic OS-level security patching, middleware upgrades, and application-server updates for reporting-platform hosts.
* Enhance platform monitoring capabilities by creating alerting policies and building dashboards to track platform health, usage trends, extract performance, and capacity utilization.
* US business hours support - The role requires providing extended off-office hours shift coverage and overnight and weekends/holidays on-call support on a weekly rotational basis.

**Minimum Qualifications**

* Hold a full-time graduation from an accredited university.
* Bring a total minimum of 6 years of IT experience with a relevant minimum of 4 years of experience in supporting reporting, analytics, or other enterprise application platforms.
* Support and maintain enterprise reporting platforms, including Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Having experience with multiple reporting and analytics tools for maintenance and support including Tableau, Metric Insights, SAP BusinessObjects, Power BI, or Looker will be a preferred advantage
* Have exposure to tools such as CDSW and R-Studio Connect.
* Familiarity with GitOps practices, ArgoCD, Helm, or Kubernetes-based deployment patterns.
* Develop and maintain Terraform modules for Infrastructure as Code (IaC) to host reporting platforms.
* Knowledge of certificate lifecycle management, secrets management, and identity and access management.
* Experience in scripting and automation using Python, Bash, or PowerShell for operational task automation, data processing, and platform management.
* Ability to leverage AI capabilities where they deliver business value to improve support, operations, and user productivity.
* Certification in reporting platform administration in any of - Tableau, Looker, SAP BusinessObjects, Metric Insights, and Power BI.

**ELIGIBILITY**
Applicants must meet minimum age qualifications in the country in which the job is located.

title: Senior IT Service Desk Analyst
description:
We are a global consultancy group, combining multi-disciplined expertise to deliver marine, engineering and technical services that drive safety and sustainability in maritime, oil & gas and renewable energy sectors.
  
  
With a legacy dating back to 1856 – to the world’s first marine surveying organisation, The Salvage Association – Aqualis continues to evolve to provide the deepest pool of technical expertise across marine and engineering disciplines in more locations worldwide, to best support our clients and markets in keeping the world moving today, whilst managing the challenges of tomorrow.
  
  
The Senior IT Service Desk Analyst will provide technical support and assistance to staff across various regions and time zones. With strong technical skills and a customer-oriented mindset, you will act as an escalation point for the most complex incidents and service requests. Your role is crucial in ensuring the smooth operation of IT services and delivering a high-quality customer experience.
  
  
**What will you be doing?**

* Deliver an exceptional customer experience by managing service desk interactions professionally and efficiently.
* Provide technical support in accordance with service desk policies, procedures, and service level agreements (SLAs).
* Triage, diagnose, troubleshoot, and resolve hardware, software, system, network, and user account issues for both local and remote users.
* Gather information through effective questioning to identify root causes and implement appropriate solutions.
* Guide users through issue resolution via phone, email, chat, and remote support tools.
* Keep users informed with timely updates and escalate unresolved or complex issues to the appropriate teams when required.
* Manage and prioritise multiple incidents and service requests to ensure agreed response and resolution targets are achieved.
* Accurately document incidents, requests, resolutions, and customer interactions within service management systems.
* Install, configure, maintain, and support Windows operating systems, end-user devices, and business applications.
* Research, identify, and implement workarounds and permanent solutions to technical issues.
* Collaborate with internal teams and third-party vendors to resolve hardware, software, and infrastructure-related issues.
* Maintain and contribute to the service desk knowledge base, ensuring information remains accurate and up to date.
* Promote adherence to service desk processes, policies, and best practices to ensure consistent service delivery.
* Act as an escalation point for complex incidents, providing technical guidance and support to colleagues.
* Monitor service trends, identify recurring problems, and recommend proactive improvements to reduce future incidents.
* Work closely with IT Service Desk leadership to support continuous improvement initiatives and the effective operation of the service desk.
* Identify training needs and support the delivery of technical and customer service development programmes.
* Coach and mentor team members to enhance their technical expertise, service quality, and customer support skills.
* Foster a collaborative team environment and maintain strong working relationships with stakeholders across the business.
* Promote awareness and adoption of IT products and services available to the organisation.

**What are we looking for?**

* Minimum 3 years' experience in an IT Service Desk environment.
* Familiarity with ITIL best practices or IT Service Management (ITSM) frameworks.
* Advanced knowledge of Windows operating systems and Windows Server administration.
* Administration and support of Microsoft 365, including Teams, OneDrive and SharePoint Online.
* Experience with Microsoft Entra ID (Azure Active Directory), Intune, and Microsoft Azure.
* Strong understanding of network infrastructure and technologies, including routers, switches, firewalls, DHCP, DNS and VPNs.
* Experience with backup, recovery and restoration processes.
* Knowledge of audio-visual and conferencing technologies.
* Fluent in English.

**Further Information**
*This position will be based at our office in Govandi East, Mumbai.*
*You must have the right to live and work in India.*
*You must be able to work on a shift rotation, including 06:00-14:00,14:00-22:00 and 22:00-06:00. You must also be able to work public holidays on occasion.*
*You can learn more about our team and what we do here:*
*https://aqualis-group.com/*
*To ensure your application is considered, please submit it using the link provided on this page.*
*NO RECRUITMENT AGENCIES.*

At Aqualis Group, we are committed to building a diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace where everyone feels respected, valued, and empowered to thrive, regardless of background, identity, or role. title: Customer Support Associate - Technical 2nd Line
description:
**About ZDHC**
The ZDHC Foundation develops and implements the Roadmap to Zero Programme with a focus on reducing the chemical footprint of the Fashion Industry. We are the leading sustainability organisation driving sustainable chemistry, innovations and best practices in textile, apparel, leather and footwear manufacturing to protect consumers, workers and the environment. Through collaborative engagement, alignment and large-scale implementation, we take a holistic approach to sustainable chemical management and enable tangible progress in the wider industry through the delivery of guidelines, platforms and solutions, including capacity-building and innovation projects. For more information about ZDHC, see www.roadmaptozero.com and follow us on LinkedIn.
  
  
**ZDHC Vision and Mission**
The ZDHC Vision is a World in which better chemistry leads to the protection of life, land, air and water. The ZDHC Mission is to lead our global value chain to achieve the highest standard for sustainable chemical management, driving resource efficiency and circularity.
  
  
**Job Purpose**
The
**Customer Support Associate – Technical 2nd Line**
provides specialised technical support within the Customer Support Team, acting as the link between first-line Customer Support and the Platform Development Team.
  
  
The role investigates and resolves technical issues escalated by first-line support or other internal teams, ensuring that issues are accurately analysed, documented, prioritised and followed through to resolution. Working closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team, the role supports effective bug management, platform testing and the successful release of new functionalities and enhancements.
  
  
Through hands-on investigation, structured testing and close collaboration across teams, the role contributes to a reliable, user-friendly platform and a high-quality customer experience. The role is intended for candidates who combine strong customer-support capabilities with a genuine software development mindset.
  
  
**Key Roles And Responsibilities**
**Second-Line Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide second-line technical support for platform-related questions and issues escalated by first-line Customer Support and other internal teams.
* Investigate reported technical issues to understand and reproduce problems, distinguish between user-related issues and potential platform bugs, and identify possible root causes.
* Resolve technical support cases independently where possible and escalate issues requiring development support to the appropriate team.
* Identify recurring technical issues and patterns and proactively flag opportunities to improve platform functionality, user experience or support processes.

**Technical Skills & Platform Development Capabilities**

* Apply a strong technical understanding of modern web-based applications, including APIs, databases, authentication flows, application architecture and common integration patterns.
* Use practical development skills and experience with at least one modern programming language or web development framework to support technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including reading and understanding source code.
* Investigate complex technical issues using browser developer tools, application logs, API requests and responses, database queries and other relevant debugging tools.
* Work closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team to clarify technical issues and support effective prioritisation and resolution.

**Bug Management, Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Create clear and complete technical tickets, including issue descriptions, reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, supporting evidence and relevant user information.
* Track technical issues and bugs through to resolution and ensure relevant stakeholders are kept informed of progress and outcomes.
* Support the testing of new platform functionalities, features, enhancements and bug fixes before and after release.
* Conduct structured functional and regression testing and clearly document testing results, issues and observations.
* Verify resolved bugs and fixes before tickets are closed and confirm that the expected functionality is working correctly.

**Knowledge Sharing & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Translate technical findings into clear and understandable information for first-line Customer Support and other non-technical colleagues.
* Support the development and maintenance of internal troubleshooting guidance, technical support documentation and relevant Knowledge Base content.
* Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Platform Development and other relevant teams to ensure an effective flow of information between users and technical teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in customer support, technical support, IT, digital platforms or a related field.
* Previous experience in customer support, technical support, application support, software testing or a comparable role.
* Experience working with web-based platforms, software applications or digital products.
* Experience investigating and troubleshooting technical issues and translating findings into clear, actionable tickets.
* Experience with ticketing, issue-tracking or development tools; experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Asana or similar is an advantage.
* Experience with functional software testing, bug reproduction and/or regression testing is an advantage.
* Strong digital literacy and the ability to quickly understand new systems, functionalities and technical processes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues and translate between customer/user issues and technical requirements.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is an advantage.

**Competencies**

* Accountability — Take responsibility for actions and results, stay accountable for successes and failures, and ensure commitments and standards are met.
* Attention to Detail — Produce and review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency to ensure high standards.
* Communication — Share information, ideas, and expectations clearly and persuasively, and adapt style and content to the audience for understanding and impact.
* Customer Orientation — Understand, anticipate, and meet customer needs through empathy, effective communication, and responsiveness aligned with customer priorities.
* Problem-Solving — Anticipate and define problems, analyse root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical, timely actions to resolve issues effectively.
* Software-Specific Competencies — Learn and apply relevant software and digital tools effectively to support processes, data management, and decision-making.
* Teamwork — Work cooperatively with others, communicate openly, support colleagues, manage conflict constructively, and focus on shared goals for collective results.

**What We Offer**
At ZDHC, we believe that a fulfilling career goes beyond a competitive salary. We are committed to creating a supportive and inspiring workplace where you feel valued, energised, and empowered to do your best work. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, help you achieve your goals, and encourage strong connections with your team.
  
  

* 30 holidays a year, based on 40 hours a week
* Gym membership allowance - for your physical wellbeing
* Access to Open Up - for your mental wellbeing
* Hybrid and flexible working environment
* Support in setting up your workstation at home (if needed)
* High-speed internet costs reimbursed
* Working abroad development experience - the opportunity to work abroad from one of our offices for 1-3 months (after 1 year)
* MacBook and iphone

In addition, there are regional benefits, depending on the location of hire. Those will be discussed during the interview process.
  
  
Want to make an impact? Join a small, multicultural and purpose-driven team at a pivotal moment for ZDHC. You’ll help shape the evolution of the Roadmap to Zero Programme and drive meaningful change across the global textile and footwear sector, working collaboratively with colleagues across cultures, locations and time zones through remote and online ways of working.
  
  
**IMPORTANT NOTE**
**Our preference is for a candidate living and working in Thane/Mumbai. This hiring process does not include visa sponsorship or a relocation package.**
**To apply: Please submit your CV and a 1-page motivation letter in PDF.**

title: Technical Customer Support Professional II
description:

**Tekla Structures**
, specifically focusing on the Concrete, Precast, and Rebar modules. Your immediate technical expertise will ensure engineering and detailing teams around the world minimize downtime and achieve structural precision.
  
  
**About Us**
Dedicated to the world’s tomorrow, Trimble is a technology company delivering solutions that enable our customers to work in new ways to measure, build, grow and move goods for a better quality of life. Core technologies in positioning, modeling, connectivity and data analytics connect the digital and physical worlds to improve productivity, quality, safety, transparency and sustainability. Tekla software solutions are the global standard for advanced Building Information Modeling (BIM) and structural engineering. From massive cast-in-place concrete structures to complex precast components and high-density reinforcement detailing, Tekla drives structural lifecycle efficiency from design to the job site.

In this role, you will transition from a day-to-day detailer or modeller into a highly valued structural subject matter expert. Operating within our state-of-the-art hubs in Chennai or Navi Mumbai, you will have the technical autonomy to reverse-engineer software anomalies, troubleshoot localized configurations, and configure cross-platform cloud integrations. Key Exciting Responsibilities
  
  

* Complex Modeling Resolution: Provide clear, step-by-step technical guidance to resolve advanced structural modeling and parametric geometry issues faced by global engineering accounts.

**Essential Skills & Experience**

* Professional Experience: 4+ years of direct, hands-on experience utilizing or supporting Tekla Structures. Highly preferred experience operating within an RCC, Precast detailing, or high-fidelity BIM production environment.
* Technical Deep-Dive Mastery: Complete mastery of Tekla Structures software functionality, system configurations, directory folders, detailing standards, and reinforcement modules.
* Diagnostic Capabilities: Strong analytical and diagnostic skills with a proven capability to investigate system logs, reverse-engineer software errors, and troubleshoot severe system crashes under pressure.
* Communication & Deadline Focus: Exceptional, patient, and highly professional written and verbal communication skills to deliver technical solutions clearly to users working under strict engineering deadlines.
* Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Civil Engineering, Structural Engineering, or Mechanical Engineering.

**Bonus Points For**

* Workflow Automation Tooling: Practical knowledge or script exposure to Tekla Open API, C#, or Grasshopper for parametric workflow automation.
* Advanced Component Customization: Direct experience developing complex parametric Custom Components and custom software macros.
* Cross-Domain Competency: Prior structural background or foundational workflow knowledge in structural steel detailing and fabrication logic.

**Logistics**

* Locations: Chennai or Navi Mumbai, India
* Department: Customer Support / Technical Services
* Job Type: Full-Time

Why You'll Love Working With Us
  
  
At Trimble, we're not just a company that "does good"—we are a team dedicated to making a tangible, positive Real-World Impact. We build innovative solutions designed to solve the world's most critical challenges. From construction sites to transportation hubs, our work tangibly improves how people live, build, move, and grow.
  
  

* You'll work on projects that truly matter: Our purpose-driven culture means you'll be helping to build and deliver solutions that make work faster, safer, and more sustainable for millions of people worldwide.
* Collaborate with like-minded people: Our strong internal culture is a "hidden gem." You will work with a collaborative, supportive team that shares your purpose and fosters a genuine sense of belonging.
* Be an owner: Trimble thrives on individuals who take initiative and embrace ownership. You'll find an entrepreneurial spirit where success is often "self-authored," empowering proactive "doers."
* Enjoy true flexibility: We offer flexible work arrangements, which are a significant driver for employees joining and staying with us.

**How to Apply:**
Please submit an online application for this position by clicking on one of the Apply buttons located in this posting.
  
  
**Join a Values-Driven Team: Belong, Grow, Innovate.**
At Trimble, our core values of Belong, Grow, and Innovate aren't just words—they're the foundation of our culture. We foster an environment where you are seen, heard, and valued (Belong); where you have an opportunity to build a career and drive our collective growth (Grow); and where your innovative ideas shape the future (Innovate). We believe in empowering local teams to create impactful strategies, ensuring our global vision resonates with every individual. Become part of a team where your contributions truly matter.

title: Senior Manager – CFT Kyriba Finance Support
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  
**Service Ownership, Environment Management & Availability**

* Own the Finance support operating model for Kyriba, including service health, environment governance, operational readiness and escalation.
* Be accountable for Kyriba environment management and coordinate production and non-production activities with Kyriba Support, implementation partners and internal technology teams.
* Take responsibility for Kyriba environment availability, ensuring service interruptions are assessed, communicated and progressed through the appropriate incident and problem-management channels.
* Maintain clear operational ownership, support contacts, dependencies, recovery expectations and evidence required for service governance.

**Integration Ownership & Operational Resilience**

* Own Finance-side support and coordination for various integration applications e.g. Kyriba–Bridger and Kyriba–Adjuto payment integrations and the Kyriba–Sonata integration via FADS for forecasting.
* Coordinate investigation of interface failures, missing or delayed files, rejected transactions, scheduling issues and upstream or downstream data exceptions.
* Work with FinOps, Treasury, other M&G systems, Kyriba Support and implementation partners to restore service, validate outcomes and address recurring integration risks.
* Maintain functional knowledge of interface purpose, control points, business impact, dependencies and recovery procedures.

**Access Governance, Logs & Recertification**

* Be accountable for controlled access to Kyriba application logs, ensuring access is appropriately authorised, traceable and aligned with support requirements.
* Be accountable for quarterly user recertification, coordinating evidence, exceptions, remediation and completion with IDAM/SailPoint, supervisors and relevant business owners.
* Provide Finance consultation for ARC role management, user-access management and SCIM setup and management, ensuring the proposed access model supports business responsibilities and control expectations.
* Remain informed on API-key management and assess Finance impact where credential changes could affect Kyriba services or integrations.

**Bank Connectivity & Market Data Support**

* Provide Finance consultation for monitoring payment and statement connectivity, helping assess business impact, prioritise exceptions and coordinate remediation.
* Support the Finance assessment of bank acknowledgements, rejected or delayed flows, statement availability and related operational dependencies.
* Provide Finance consultation for the input integration status information on IDP-to-Kyriba FX-rate process, including business validation of rates, exception assessment and coordination with the responsible support teams.

**Release, Change & Control Assurance**

* Remain informed of Kyriba release-note assessments and opt-in regression-testing outcomes, identifying Finance impacts, risks and required stakeholder actions.
* Ensure material changes affecting Finance-owned integrations, controls or service availability are supported by appropriate impact assessment, testing evidence and operational readiness.
* Support incident, problem, change and release governance, including root-cause follow-up, risk tracking and audit evidence.

**Stakeholder, Vendor & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as the Finance support contact across FinOps, Treasury, RDM FinOps Kyriba Business Management, Corporate Functions Technology, Kyriba Support and implementation partners.
* Translate Finance priorities and business impacts into clear actions for technical teams and vendors, and provide concise updates through resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, automate controls, simplify support processes, strengthen knowledge articles and reduce repeat incidents.
* Promote disciplined ownership, effective hand-offs and sustainable service improvements across the Kyriba support ecosystem.

**Application Support & Incident Management**

* Provide expert technical support for finance applications, ensuring incidents and service requests are triaged, prioritised and progressed in line with agreed service levels.
* Investigate application and integration issues, perform initial diagnosis, gather technical evidence and coordinate resolution with software vendors, infrastructure teams and business stakeholders.
* Maintain clear ownership of issues through to closure, including timely stakeholder updates, root-cause follow-up and verification that service has been restored.
* Support problem management by identifying recurring issues, contributing to root-cause analysis and tracking preventive actions.

**Integration & Interface Support**

* Actively support system integrations and interfaces connecting finance applications with upstream and downstream platforms.
* Monitor scheduled feeds, jobs and interfaces; identify failures, data exceptions or processing delays and coordinate recovery with relevant application teams.
* Work across internal technology teams and external vendors to resolve interface dependencies, connectivity issues and data-flow failures.
* Maintain operational knowledge of interface schedules, dependencies, support contacts, control points and recovery procedures.

**User Onboarding & Experience**

* Coordinate user onboarding, access enablement and application readiness in line with approved controls and defined operating procedures.
* Provide practical guidance to users, improve support documentation and help reduce avoidable incidents through clear communication and knowledge sharing.
* Identify opportunities to enhance user experience, simplify support journeys and improve the quality and responsiveness of application services.

**Vendor & Service Management**

* Act as a key technical contact for application vendors and business stakeholders during incident investigation and service improvement activity.
* Plan and conduct regular service review meetings with application vendors, covering incidents, service levels, recurring issues, risks, upcoming changes and improvement actions.
* Track agreed actions to completion and challenge vendors constructively where service quality, responsiveness or technical outcomes require improvement.
* Support operational governance, audit evidence and service reporting for the applications in scope.

**Release, Upgrade & UAT Support**

* Support application version upgrades, patches and technical lifecycle activities by coordinating impact assessment, readiness checks, implementation support and post-release validation.
* Plan and conduct user acceptance testing for small enhancements and bug fixes, including test preparation, execution, defect logging, retesting and evidence retention.
* Collaborate with business users, vendors and change teams to ensure releases are appropriately tested and introduced with minimal service disruption.

**Security Credentials & Technical Administration**

* Manage application certificates and integration keys throughout their lifecycle, including inventory, renewal coordination, secure implementation and validation.
* Monitor expiry dates and dependencies to prevent avoidable service disruption, ensuring changes are completed through approved security and change-control processes.
* Maintain accurate technical and operational documentation for certificates, keys, interfaces, configurations and support procedures.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Propose and implement innovative ideas to improve monitoring, automation, support efficiency, service resilience and user experience over time.
* Use incident trends, vendor performance and operational feedback to identify improvement opportunities and prioritise sustainable fixes.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, knowledge sharing, control discipline and continual service improvement.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Associate, Production Finance - India
description:
Netflix is one of the world's leading entertainment services, with over 300 million paid memberships in over 190 countries enjoying TV series, films and games across a wide variety of genres and languages. Members can play, pause and resume watching as much as they want, anytime, anywhere, and can change their plans at any time.
  
  
Behind every great story is a team of people enabling creators to do their best work. Our Production Finance team partners with filmmakers and production partners to bring Netflix Originals to life while ensuring financial excellence, operational rigor, and responsible stewardship of production investments.
  
  
If you're passionate about storytelling, love solving complex business problems, and thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments, we'd love to meet you.
  
  
The Opportunity
  
  
As an Associate – Production Finance, you'll be a key business partner supporting Netflix's growing slate of original productions in India.
  
  
This is much more than a finance role. You'll work at the intersection of finance, production, and strategy—partnering with internal teams and production companies to help productions make informed financial decisions from development through delivery.
  
  
You'll gain exposure to every stage of the production lifecycle while helping ensure our productions are financially sound, operationally efficient, and positioned for success.
  
  
What You'll Do
  
  
**Partner with Productions**

* Work closely with production companies, line producers, production accountants, production auditors and internal Netflix teams throughout the lifecycle of a production.
* Build trusted relationships with creative, production, legal, business affairs, tax, accounts payable, and external stakeholders to ensure smooth financial operations.
* Support production partners by providing guidance on Netflix's financial policies, reporting expectations, and production finance processes.

**Drive Financial Excellence**

* Review and analyze production budgets, cost reports, cash flows, and forecasts.
* Monitor production spend against approved budgets and identify financial risks, trends, and opportunities early.
* Partner with productions to develop accurate Estimates to Complete (ETCs) and final cost projections.
* Perform variance analysis and communicate meaningful insights that support business decisions.
* Review invoices, funding requests, and production payments for accuracy and compliance.

**Deliver Meaningful Insights**

* Go beyond validating numbers by identifying cost optimization opportunities and operational efficiencies.
* Analyze production schedules, resource utilization, and spending patterns to proactively highlight financial risks and recommendations.
* Prepare concise financial summaries and presentations for internal stakeholders to support investment decisions.

**Strengthen Financial Operations**

* Map production costs to Netflix's Chart of Accounts and maintain accurate financial records.
* Update production data across Netflix's internal systems and reporting tools.
* Partner with auditors and production accountants to ensure timely, accurate, and compliant financial reporting.
* Help improve reporting processes, financial controls, and operational efficiencies across productions.

What We're Looking For
  
  
We're looking for someone who enjoys working with people just as much as they enjoy working with numbers. You are someone who is naturally curious, asks thoughtful questions, and isn't satisfied with simply reconciling numbers—you want to understand the story behind them.
  
  
**You'll Be Successful In This Role If You Have**

* 7+ years of experience in Production Finance, Production Accounting, Production Management, or a similar role within the film, television, or media industry.
* Strong understanding of production budgeting, cost reporting, forecasting, and production accounting.
* Experience working with production companies, studios, line producers, or production accountants.
* Excellent financial analysis and problem-solving skills with strong business judgment.
* Advanced Excel skills and proficiency in Google Workspace; experience with production accounting software is an advantage.
* Working knowledge of Tally or similar accounting systems is preferred.
* Excellent communication skills with the ability to influence and collaborate across multiple teams.
* Exceptional attention to detail while maintaining the ability to see the bigger picture.
* Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Commerce, or a related discipline. CA or equivalent professional qualification is preferred.

Who You Are
  
  

* You thrive in fast-moving environments and enjoy solving new challenges every day.
* You are proactive, resourceful, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.
* You build strong relationships and enjoy partnering with diverse teams.
* You balance analytical thinking with practical decision-making.
* You have high standards, strong integrity, and a commitment to excellence.
* You're passionate about entertainment and excited to help bring incredible stories to audiences around the world.

Why Netflix?
  
  
At Netflix, you'll have the opportunity to work on some of the most exciting productions in the industry while partnering with exceptionally talented people across creative, production, and business teams.
  
  
You'll be trusted with meaningful responsibility from day one, encouraged to challenge conventional thinking, and empowered to make an impact on how world-class stories are produced.
  
  
If you're excited by the idea of combining finance, strategy, and storytelling, we'd love to hear from you.
  
  
Inclusion is a Netflix value and we strive to host a meaningful interview experience for all candidates. If you want an accommodation/adjustment for a disability or any other reason during the hiring process, please send a request to your recruiting partner.
  
  
We are an equal-opportunity employer and celebrate diversity, recognizing that diversity builds stronger teams. We approach diversity and inclusion seriously and thoughtfully. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, ancestry, national origin, caste, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity or expression, age, disability, medical condition, pregnancy, genetic makeup, marital status, or military service.

title: CA Finance & Acc Manufacturing
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* This role is for a Chartered Accountant to manage and support the end-to-end finance and accounting function for a manufacturing business, ensuring accurate financial reporting, robust controls, statutory and income-tax compliance, and timely financial insights. The role requires a hands-on finance professional who understands manufacturing operations, plant-level costs, inventory, working capital and business performance.

**Role & Responsibilities**

* Oversee day-to-day accounting, general ledger, journal entries, provisions, accruals, prepayments and balance-sheet reconciliations.
* Support monthly, quarterly and annual closing, preparation of trial balance, schedules and financial statements in accordance with applicable accounting standards.
* Prepare and review MIS, management reports, variance analysis and key financial dashboards for management.
* Ensure accuracy, completeness and proper documentation of accounting records and financial transactions.
* Monitor plant-wise and product-wise costs, including raw materials, consumables, labour, utilities, overheads and production variances.
* Support standard costing, actual costing, BOM/routing cost reviews, cost-sheet preparation and analysis of material, yield and overhead variances, as applicable.
* Reconcile inventory records with the general ledger; review raw material, work-in-progress, finished goods, scrap and slow/non-moving inventory.
* Coordinate physical stock counts and investigate inventory discrepancies, wastage, process losses and abnormal costs.
* Work with plant, production, procurement and supply-chain teams to identify cost-saving opportunities and improve cost visibility.
* Coordinate computation and review of advance tax, self-assessment tax and corporate income-tax provisions.
* Ensure timely preparation and filing support for income-tax returns, tax audit requirements and related schedules, in coordination with internal teams or external tax advisors.
* Handle tax reconciliations, including books versus tax returns and tax-credit statements such as Form 26AS/AIS, as applicable.
* Support TDS compliance, including review of applicability, deduction, deposit, returns, certificates and reconciliations.
* Assist in responding to income-tax notices, assessments, audits and departmental queries; maintain supporting documentation and track due dates.
* Monitor changes in direct-tax laws and assess their impact on the business in consultation with the Finance Head or tax advisors.
* Coordinate GST return data, reconciliations of books with GSTR-1, GSTR-3B and GSTR-2B, input-tax-credit checks and follow-up on mismatches.
* Support e-invoicing, e-way bill controls and GST documentation, where applicable.
* Coordinate other applicable statutory, regulatory and financial reporting requirements with relevant teams and advisors.
* Coordinate statutory, internal, tax and cost audits, including preparation of schedules, reconciliations and audit evidence.
* Ensure adherence to accounting policies, approval matrices, delegation of authority and internal financial controls.
* Track audit observations, root causes and closure of corrective actions within agreed timelines.
* Maintain an organised audit trail and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable laws.
* Monitor receivables, payables, inventory and other working-capital drivers; highlight overdue items and unusual movements.
* Support annual budgeting, periodic forecasts and actual-versus-budget analysis.
* Assist in preparing financial data and reports for internal cash-flow planning and working-capital analysis, as required.
* Coordinate with internal departments to improve working-capital efficiency and reporting accuracy.
* Maintain and reconcile the fixed-asset register, depreciation schedules, additions, disposals and transfers.
* Support capital expenditure tracking, project-cost documentation, capitalisation reviews and physical verification of assets.
* Coordinate with plant and engineering teams to ensure timely and accurate recording of capital projects.
* Use ERP/accounting systems and advanced Excel to analyse financial data, prepare reconciliations and generate reports.
* Improve finance processes, documentation, reporting timelines and compliance trackers.
* Coordinate effectively with plant finance, procurement, stores, production, sales, HR, auditors and external consultants.

**Skills & Qualifications**
**Must-Have**

* Qualified Chartered Accountant with 2–5 years of post-qualification experience.
* Relevant experience in a core manufacturing, industrial, engineering, chemicals, packaging, printing or similar plant-based organisation is strongly preferred.

• Maintain an ageing report categorising outstanding amounts into 0–30, 31–60, 61–90, and above 90 days.

• Identify overdue, disputed, and high-risk customer accounts and report them to the MD.

• Ensure that every overdue payment has a follow-up date and a responsible person.

• Obtain customer payment commitments and track whether payments are received as promised.

• Escalate repeatedly overdue accounts to the MD for decisions on credit limits, order dispatch, or further credit sales.

• Reconcile customer ledgers and resolve payment allocation disputes.

• Submit a daily collection report showing target, actual collection, shortfall, and reasons.

• Work with Sales to reduce overdue receivables and improve the company’s working capital.

B. Cash Flow & Financial Management

• Prepare daily bank balance and cash position reports.

• Prepare weekly cash flow forecasts for the next 7–14 days.

• Monitor expected collections against upcoming payments.

• Alert the MD in advance about cash shortages and major financial commitments.

• Prepare monthly Profit & Loss statements and financial summaries.

C. Supplier Payments & Accounts Payable

• Maintain supplier-wise outstanding reports.

• Prepare a weekly supplier payment plan based on cash availability and business priorities.

• Verify invoices, purchase orders, and goods receipt records.

• Obtain the required approval before releasing payments.

• Avoid duplicate, incorrect, and unauthorised payments.

D. Expense Control & Product Costing

• Monitor expenses against the approved budget.

• Analyse rent, salaries, electricity, overtime, wastage, and other major expenses.

• Analyse product-wise manufacturing costs and profitability.

• Identify unnecessary expenses and recommend cost-saving measures.

• Coordinate with Production and Purchase to improve cost efficiency.

E. Accounts & Reconciliation

• Supervise daily accounting entries and ledger maintenance.

• Ensure regular bank reconciliation.

• Reconcile customer and supplier accounts.

• Maintain accurate sales, purchase, receipt, and payment records.

• Ensure timely month-end accounting closure.

F. Taxation & Statutory Compliance

• Monitor GST, TDS, and other applicable statutory compliance.

• Coordinate with the company’s CA and external auditors.

• Maintain proper financial documentation and filing records.

G. Team Management

• Supervise and allocate work to the Accounts Team.

• Establish daily reporting and follow-up procedures.

• Review collection performance of responsible team members.

• Ensure that customer follow-ups are completed on schedule

title: Store Ingestion Specialist
description:
Believe is a global artist development company. We empower local artists, labels and publishers to grow their audiences at each stage of their careers with expertise, respect, fairness and transparency.

Operating in 50+ countries, with more than 2,000 employees, Believe offers a full range of services including audience development, publishing, marketing and distribution, with a tailor-made approach to fit any artist, label or publisher.

Believe champions independence and innovation through a unique model that combines local expertise with a global tech platform, delivering exclusive solutions for artists to promote and monetize their music thanks to strategic partnerships with leading global digital service providers.

With a leading portfolio of brands that includes Nuclear Blast, naïve, TuneCore, Groove Attack, Sentric, AllPoints and Byond, Believe artists generated more than 800 billion streams worldwide in 2024 across all genres, and were recognized with more than 70 leading industry awards.

Learn more at www.believe.com

**Job Description**

As a Store Ingestion Specialist, you will play a key role in managing the ingestion, validation, reconciliation, and posting of financial and royalty data received from digital service providers (DSPs) and other delivery channels. You will be responsible for ensuring the accuracy and completeness of raw financial files, supporting timely royalty postings, resolving data discrepancies, and maintaining data integrity throughout the ingestion process.

You will work closely with Finance, Accounting, BI, Tech/Data teams, DSPs, and other internal and external stakeholders in an international environment to ensure accurate and timely processing of financial and royalty data.

You will be reporting to the Head of Customer Finance and Legal Operations based in Mumbai and will work closely with the broader Revenue Invoicing, Ingestion and Customer Finance teams in an international environment.

Key Responsibilities:

* Receive and process raw financial and royalty files from various DSPs and delivery channels through email, SFTP/FTP, and backend portals, across formats including Excel, PDF, and TXT.
* Review incoming raw files for completeness and accuracy, identifying incorrect templates, missing information, data inconsistencies, and discrepancies between summary and detailed data.
* Maintain accurate records of raw files by ensuring files are stored in designated S3 buckets in accordance with internal processes.
* Manage the ingestion and posting of royalty and financial reports, including the upload of FX rate files and success files through FileZilla.
* Monitor ingestion processes and identify errors or issues, coordinating with relevant Tech, BI, Data, and Finance teams to ensure timely resolution.
* Review ingested reports for accuracy and perform reconciliation of financial data, including cross-checking AR invoices and payments.
* Export data to Retool and apply relevant foreign exchange rates as part of the ingestion and posting process.
* Perform appropriate validation and second-level reviews before obtaining Finance approvals and facilitating data posting.
* Manage regular SR/SIP report postings, ensuring postings are completed accurately and within defined timelines.
* Coordinate with DSPs to obtain corrected or updated raw files where required and follow up on data discrepancies until resolution.
* Work closely with Tech and Data teams during posting activities to monitor progress, troubleshoot issues, and ensure timely completion.
* Review postings against invoices and receipts created in Oracle and investigate discrepancies and variances.
* Perform detailed analysis of complex or exceptional cases and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve differences.
* Communicate changes in split percentages or other relevant business inputs in advance to ensure appropriate accounting adjustments.
* Support monthly financial closing activities by ensuring ingestion, posting, reconciliation, and supporting financial data are complete and accurate.
* Prepare, maintain, and export relevant reports and documentation for financial reporting, audit, and record-keeping purposes.
* Collaborate with Finance, Accounting, BI, Tech/Data, and other internal stakeholders to resolve data, posting, reconciliation, and accounting-related queries.
* Identify recurring data and process issues and contribute to improvements in data quality, automation, and operational efficiency.
* Ensure adherence to internal controls, procedures, data management standards, and applicable financial policies throughout the ingestion and posting processes.
* Prioritize daily activities effectively and manage multiple ingestion, reconciliation, and posting activities within defined timelines.
* Work closely with the Royalty Ingestion Lead and other revenue and customer finance specialists to ensure consistent and efficient execution of store ingestion activities.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum 5 years of experience in finance operations, financial data processing, revenue operations, royalty operations, or related finance processes, preferably in an international environment.
* Strong understanding of financial data processing, reconciliation, revenue recognition, and financial operations.
* Experience working with digital platforms, marketplaces, DSPs, or media companies is a plus; experience in the music industry or royalty operations is a strong advantage.
* Strong analytical and data management skills, with the ability to identify discrepancies, investigate root causes, and ensure data accuracy.
* Experience working with large volumes of financial data and maintaining a high level of accuracy and attention to detail.
* Proficiency in Excel/Google Sheet and experience working with financial or data management tools; knowledge of SQL, Retool, FileZilla, and Amazon S3 is an advantage.
* Experience with ERP, accounting, reporting, or financial systems such as Oracle is an advantage.
* Ability to independently manage operational activities, prioritize tasks, and follow through on issues until resolution.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to collaborate effectively with Finance, Tech/Data, BI, DSPs, and other stakeholders.
* Fluent in English, both spoken and written; additional languages are a plus.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, agile, and international environment.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and a strong sense of ownership.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet operational deadlines while maintaining data quality.
* Demonstrated interest in process improvement, automation, data quality, and the optimization of finance operations.
* Knowledge of royalty management, contract management, or digital music distribution is a plus.
* Good understanding of the digital music ecosystem and the role of DSPs is preferred.

**Additional Information**

title: Procure to Record (P2R) Finance Analyst
description:
**Role: Procure to Record (P2R) Finance Analyst**

**Location: Mumbai (Hybrid) (Romania working hours)**

**Job type: Full time, Permanent**

**This position offers a hybrid work model, allowing flexibility between working from home and our office. Typically, employees are expected to work 2 days in the office per week**

**Why QS?**

At QS, we believe that work should empower you. That’s why we foster a flexible working environment that encourages every employee to own their career whilst flourishing personally and professionally. Our commitment to people development is recognised globally: QS is a Gold-accredited Investors in People organisation, placing us among the top 28% of workplaces worldwide. Our company values underpin everything we do – we collaborate, respect and support each other.

It’s our mission to empower motivated people around the world to fulfil their potential through higher education, ensuring that everyone has access to opportunities that change lives.

Our diversity makes us stronger. By sharing our experiences, we learn from one another and achieve more together, driving progress across the sector.

At QS, you’ll be responsible for implementing real change in the international higher education landscape. You’ll take on meaningful challenges that see a positive impact across the business and the wider sector.

We’re confident you’ll feel right at home here. QS was named as one of Newsweek’s Top 100 Most Loved Workplaces® in the UK (October 2023), recognising the respect, trust and appreciation that drive our culture every day.

**The role**

We are seeking a detail oriented Procure to Record (P2R) Finance Analyst to support day-to-day transactional finance operations. This role is primarily responsible for purchase order processing and billing within NetSuite, maintaining vendor data, and ensuring timely and accurate payments. The position also supports month-end activities and helps the Finance team with accounting processes up to Trial Balance level.

This role is ideal for someone with a strong foundation in Accounts Payable who is looking to broaden their exposure to core accounting processes and month-end activities.

**Role responsibilities**

**Procure-to-Pay (P2P) Processing**

* Manage end-to-end processing of purchase orders, invoices and supplier billing in NetSuite.
* Ensure accurate matching of PO, invoice and receipt data.
* Independently assess and apply correct GL coding based on understanding of budgets, actuals and nature of spend.
* Liaise with internal stakeholders and suppliers to resolve discrepancies.

**Vendor Management**

* Maintain accurate vendor master data and ensure compliance with onboarding requirements.
* Support onboarding of new vendors, including documentation checks.

**Payments, Expenses & Travel**

* Prepare and process supplier payment runs in line with payment terms and controls.
* Review and process employee expense claims in accordance with company policy.
* Handle queries related to payments, travel and expenses.

**Month End, AP Control & Accruals**

* Prepare accruals for open purchase orders and unsubmitted expenses.
* Accrue for unsubmitted contractor costs based on available data.
* Assist with month-end close activities and reconciliations.
* Monitor and manage AP ageing, highlighting risks or overdue balances.
* Investigate and resolve aged items and discrepancies.

**Finance Support (Up to TB Level)**

* Support posting of journals and maintaining general ledger accuracy.
* Assist with account reconciliations.
* Provide support to ensure completeness and accuracy of financial data up to TB.
* Ad-hoc projects, including automation and efficiency initiatives.

**Process Improvement & Automation**

* Identify opportunities for automation and efficiency within procurement-to-record processes.
* Support and contribute to process improvement initiatives across AP, finance operations and procurement workflows.
* Proactively highlight gaps in controls, policies or systems and drive practical solutions to close them.
* Promote continuous improvement in accuracy, speed and efficiency of financial processing

**Key skills and experience**

**Technical**

* Transactional Finance roles expertise, proven extensive experience of Accounts Payable through professional experience.
* Strong understanding of cost allocation, GL coding and core accounting principles, ideally backed with Finance qualification (part-qualified studiers highly desirable).
* NetSuite or similar ERP system.
* Excel and emerging technologies with clear evidence of adaptation in work activities.

**Personal & Strategic**

* Highly organised with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Demonstrates a strong drive for productivity, focusing on outcomes and timely achievement of objectives.
* Comfortable working independently, taking ownership of tasks and making informed decisions with confidence.
* Exercises sound judgement - able to balance autonomy with awareness of when to seek input or escalate matters appropriately.
* Strong problem-solving skills with a practical, solutions-focused mindset.
* Confident stakeholder management skills with the ability to handle challenge and resolve issues constructively.
* Process and compliance oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset

**So, who are we and what do we do?**

QS is the world leader in higher education services, analytics, insights and intelligence. From consultancy to student mobility, academic partnerships to branding solutions, our services power both institutional and individual success.

We’re behind the world’s most widely read university rankings (Meltwater 2023). Our QS World University Rankings® reach hundreds of millions, shaping decisions and guiding futures.

Since launching in 1990, our impact and influence have only grown. Today, we work with more than 2,000 of the world’s leading higher education institutions, over 12,000 employers, and governments seeking change and socioeconomic development through higher education.

Join QS and you’ll join an 800-strong community of problem-solvers, creators, collaborators and change-makers based in 40+ countries and 11 international offices, including Australia, Malaysia, India, Romania, Singapore, France, Germany, the USA and our headquarters in London.

With every talented new hire, business acquisition and bold initiative, we’re strengthening our reach and delivering even greater value to institutions and learners worldwide. Are you ready to shape the future of higher education?

**We take investing in our people very seriously.**

**As standard you will have:**

* Competitive base salary
* Access to an annual bonus scheme (for qualifying roles only)
* 21 days annual leave – increasing to 23 days after 5 years’ service + 8 days casual leave
* 15 days holiday for the year 2026
* Enhanced maternity and paternity leave
* Access to Provident Fund and Pension Fund Scheme
* Group Medical Insurance
* A vibrant social environment and multicultural and multinational culture

But that’s not all. Outside of these standard benefits we also offer resources to allow professional growth and wellness initiatives to nurture a healthy mindset:

* Free subscription to the Calm App – the #1 app for sleep, meditation, and relaxation
* A focus on welfare which is led by our global wellness team, with mental health first aiders globally
* Access to a variety of diversity and inclusion initiatives and groups
* Strong recognition and reward programs – including a peer-to-peer recognition platform, quarterly and annual QS Applaud Awards, Connect with your Career annual personal development event
* Support for volunteering and study leave
* Free subscription to LinkedIn learning – with over 5,000 courses and programmes at your fingertips
* Options to join our outstanding global Mentorship programme

**Like what you’ve heard? Great, apply now!**

As a candidate, we know the application and interview process can be daunting and so it’s important that you have a great experience with us. Our dedicated Talent Team will work hard to ensure you are fully informed at all stages, and you are really excited by this opportunity to do meaningful work in the education space.

**Equal opportunities**

QS Quacquarelli Symonds is proud to be a fair and equal organisation where everyone has the same opportunity to achieve their full potential, irrespective of their background or personal attributes. We celebrate our diversity and believe through sharing our experiences we can learn from one another, be stronger together, and enable our business to thrive.

title: Associate, Credit Risk Manager, Risk Management Group
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Policy Manager for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) is responsible for designing, formulating, and lifecycle-managing the credit policies, risk acceptance criteria (RAC), and underwriting guidelines for secured asset portfolios (specifically Loan Against Property / PLAP) within Consumer Banking Group (CBG) Credit.
  
  
The role ensures that the portfolio growth aligns with the bank's approved Risk Appetite Framework while balancing aggressive business expansion goals with prudent credit risk controls, regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines), and fraud mitigation.
  
  
**Job Duties & Requirements**

* Policy Formulation and Framework Design
* Credit Policy Architecture: Own, review, and periodically update the credit policies, Product Programs (CPP), and underwriting guidelines for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) in coordination with business units and senior management.
* Risk Acceptance Criteria (RAC): Calibrate and refine RAC parameters (such as LTV caps, debt-to-income ratios, collateral eligibility, property valuation metrics, and negative area/pincode restrictions) based on macroeconomic trends, portfolio performance, and stress-testing results.
* Standardization: Ensure clear alignment of PLAP policies with overarching Group Core Credit Policies, Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), and local regulatory mandates (e.g., RBI Master Directions).
* Portfolio Monitoring, Analytics & Quality Assurance
* Portfolio Health Tracking: Continuously monitor portfolio metrics (delinquencies, early-stage flow rates, bounce rates, LTV migration, and Concentration Risk thresholds) to identify emerging credit risks or asset quality deterioration.
* Trigger Management: Implement and monitor Management Action Triggers (MAT) and portfolio caps for PLAP and broader secured lending portfolios.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) and Credit Fraud Risk Management (CFRM) teams to review control parameters, address policy/process vulnerabilities, and ensure audit readiness.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Expansion
* New Product Programs (NPP): Collaborate with Business, Product, and Technology & Operations (T&O) teams to evaluate and structure new product variants, digital/phygital journey integration (e.g., automated appraisal workflows, API-driven verification), and alternative scoring models.
* Process Alignment: Work closely with Credit Operations (CBO) and underwriting teams to ensure seamless policy translation into system rules (e.g., One Risk Workbench/ORWB, IBPM workflows) and operational execution manuals.
* Exception & Escalation Governance: Review and decide on complex policy exception frameworks, setting clear delegation of authority (DoA) matrices for credit managers.

**Required Experience**
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  
  
Professional risk certifications (e.g., FRM, CFA) are an added advantage.
  
  
**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
Graduate / Post Graduate in relevant field.
  
  
****Core Competencies****
****Technical Competencies****
Deep Regulatory & Product Knowledge: Strong understanding of secured lending products, property valuation methodologies, legal title checks, CERSAI regulations, and RBI guidelines governing commercial and retail banks in India.
  
  
Data-Driven & Analytical: Strong command over portfolio analytics, credit risk modelling metrics (PD, LGD, EAD), and performance tracking dashboards.
  
  
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders, risk committees, and operational teams.
  
  
Governance Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance business growth objectives with robust risk controls and rigorous compliance standards.
  
  
****Work Relationship****
8 years of overall banking experience, with at least 5–7 years specialized experience in Retail/Consumer Credit Risk, Credit Policy, or Portfolio Management—specifically focused on Secured Lending, Mortgages, or Loan Against Property (LAP)

title: Customer Support Associate - Technical 2nd Line
description:
**About ZDHC**

The ZDHC Foundation develops and implements the Roadmap to Zero Programme with a focus on reducing the chemical footprint of the Fashion Industry. We are the leading sustainability organisation driving sustainable chemistry, innovations and best practices in textile, apparel, leather and footwear manufacturing to protect consumers, workers and the environment. Through collaborative engagement, alignment and large-scale implementation, we take a holistic approach to sustainable chemical management and enable tangible progress in the wider industry through the delivery of guidelines, platforms and solutions, including capacity-building and innovation projects. For more information about ZDHC, see www.roadmaptozero.com and follow us on LinkedIn.

**ZDHC Vision and Mission**

The ZDHC Vision is a World in which better chemistry leads to the protection of life, land, air and water. The ZDHC Mission is to lead our global value chain to achieve the highest standard for sustainable chemical management, driving resource efficiency and circularity.

**Job Purpose**

The **Customer Support Associate – Technical 2nd Line** provides specialised technical support within the Customer Support Team, acting as the link between first-line Customer Support and the Platform Development Team.

The role investigates and resolves technical issues escalated by first-line support or other internal teams, ensuring that issues are accurately analysed, documented, prioritised and followed through to resolution. Working closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team, the role supports effective bug management, platform testing and the successful release of new functionalities and enhancements.

Through hands-on investigation, structured testing and close collaboration across teams, the role contributes to a reliable, user-friendly platform and a high-quality customer experience. The role is intended for candidates who combine strong customer-support capabilities with a genuine software development mindset.

**Key Roles and Responsibilities**

**Second-Line Technical Support & Troubleshooting**

* Provide second-line technical support for platform-related questions and issues escalated by first-line Customer Support and other internal teams.
* Investigate reported technical issues to understand and reproduce problems, distinguish between user-related issues and potential platform bugs, and identify possible root causes.
* Resolve technical support cases independently where possible and escalate issues requiring development support to the appropriate team.
* Identify recurring technical issues and patterns and proactively flag opportunities to improve platform functionality, user experience or support processes.

**Technical Skills & Platform Development Capabilities**

* Apply a strong technical understanding of modern web-based applications, including APIs, databases, authentication flows, application architecture and common integration patterns.
* Use practical development skills and experience with at least one modern programming language or web development framework to support technical troubleshooting and root-cause analysis, including reading and understanding source code.
* Investigate complex technical issues using browser developer tools, application logs, API requests and responses, database queries and other relevant debugging tools.
* Work closely with the Platform Product Owner and Development Team to clarify technical issues and support effective prioritisation and resolution.

**Bug Management, Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Create clear and complete technical tickets, including issue descriptions, reproduction steps, expected versus actual behaviour, supporting evidence and relevant user information.
* Track technical issues and bugs through to resolution and ensure relevant stakeholders are kept informed of progress and outcomes.
* Support the testing of new platform functionalities, features, enhancements and bug fixes before and after release.
* Conduct structured functional and regression testing and clearly document testing results, issues and observations.
* Verify resolved bugs and fixes before tickets are closed and confirm that the expected functionality is working correctly.

**Knowledge Sharing & Cross-Team Collaboration**

* Translate technical findings into clear and understandable information for first-line Customer Support and other non-technical colleagues.
* Support the development and maintenance of internal troubleshooting guidance, technical support documentation and relevant Knowledge Base content.
* Collaborate closely with Customer Support, Platform Development and other relevant teams to ensure an effective flow of information between users and technical teams.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Relevant education or equivalent professional experience in customer support, technical support, IT, digital platforms or a related field.
* Previous experience in customer support, technical support, application support, software testing or a comparable role.
* Experience working with web-based platforms, software applications or digital products.
* Experience investigating and troubleshooting technical issues and translating findings into clear, actionable tickets.
* Experience with ticketing, issue-tracking or development tools; experience with tools such as Jira, Linear, Confluence, Notion, Asana or similar is an advantage.
* Experience with functional software testing, bug reproduction and/or regression testing is an advantage.
* Strong digital literacy and the ability to quickly understand new systems, functionalities and technical processes.
* Ability to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical colleagues and translate between customer/user issues and technical requirements.
* Strong written and verbal English communication skills.
* Experience working in an international and cross-functional environment is an advantage.

**Competencies**

* Accountability — Take responsibility for actions and results, stay accountable for successes and failures, and ensure commitments and standards are met.
* Attention to Detail — Produce and review work carefully for accuracy, completeness, and consistency to ensure high standards.
* Communication — Share information, ideas, and expectations clearly and persuasively, and adapt style and content to the audience for understanding and impact.
* Customer Orientation — Understand, anticipate, and meet customer needs through empathy, effective communication, and responsiveness aligned with customer priorities.
* Problem-Solving — Anticipate and define problems, analyse root causes, evaluate alternatives, and implement practical, timely actions to resolve issues effectively.
* Software-Specific Competencies — Learn and apply relevant software and digital tools effectively to support processes, data management, and decision-making.
* Teamwork — Work cooperatively with others, communicate openly, support colleagues, manage conflict constructively, and focus on shared goals for collective results.

**What We Offer**

At ZDHC, we believe that a fulfilling career goes beyond a competitive salary. We are committed to creating a supportive and inspiring workplace where you feel valued, energised, and empowered to do your best work. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your growth, help you achieve your goals, and encourage strong connections with your team.

* 30 holidays a year, based on 40 hours a week
* Gym membership allowance - for your physical wellbeing
* Access to Open Up - for your mental wellbeing
* Hybrid and flexible working environment
* Support in setting up your workstation at home (if needed)
* High-speed internet costs reimbursed
* Working abroad development experience - the opportunity to work abroad from one of our offices for 1-3 months (after 1 year)
* MacBook and iphone

In addition, there are regional benefits, depending on the location of hire. Those will be discussed during the interview process.

Want to make an impact? Join a small, multicultural and purpose-driven team at a pivotal moment for ZDHC. You’ll help shape the evolution of the Roadmap to Zero Programme and drive meaningful change across the global textile and footwear sector, working collaboratively with colleagues across cultures, locations and time zones through remote and online ways of working.

**IMPORTANT NOTE**

**Our preference is for a candidate living and working in Thane/Mumbai. This hiring process does not include visa sponsorship or a relocation package.**

**To apply: Please submit your CV and a 1-page motivation letter in PDF.**

title: Senior Technical Support Engineer
description:
Come work at a place where innovation and teamwork come together to support the most exciting missions in the world!
  
  
Qualys, a leading cybersecurity firm, is seeking an experienced Senior Technical Support Engineer for Security Applications to resolve global customer and partner service requests promptly. Collaborate across teams for high customer satisfaction in a secure environment. Ideal for security enthusiasts with solid networking skills. Lead in resolving technical issues, provide top-tier support, and contribute to world-class assistance.
  
  
Responsibilities:
  
  

* Promptly resolve global customer and partner service requests in a highly secured environment. Collaborate with cross-functional teams for high customer satisfaction. Provide support via phone, email, and MS Teams for Product modules over the SaaS platform. Ensure friendly and professional customer interactions throughout the service life cycle. Act as the main point of contact for technical issues, collaborating directly with Development and QA teams. Thrive in a challenging and dynamic environment, delivering world-class support and technical solutions.

Qualifications:
  
  

* 5+ years of technical support experience. Experience in Vulnerability Management and Web Application Security/Firewall application support. In-depth TCP/IP understanding and LAN/WAN infrastructure knowledge. Strong foundation in Windows and/or solid Linux/Unix experience in an enterprise environment. Familiarity with common OS services (IIS, BIND, Apache, AD, WINS, Samba, SSH). Knowledge of firewalls, Intrusion Detection System technologies, and Network Vulnerability Scanners. Outstanding troubleshooting and analytical skills. Excellent written and verbal communication skills. Bachelor of Science in Computer Science or equivalent experience.

Preferred:
  
  

* Experience with packet capture review and diagnosis. Previous API support and Regex knowledge. Scripting experience (Bash, Python). Knowledge of major web server software, UNIX/Windows web services, and diverse platforms. Oracle and Microsoft SQL knowledge. CCNA, MCSE, CISSP, CompTIA Security+, and CEH certifications are highly desirable. Experience with Customer Support and Development Tools (Salesforce, Jira, etc.).

**Preferred Candidates With a CDAC Background.**
Willing to work in 24/7 rotational shifts.
  
  
Networking:
  
  

* OSI Layer understanding. Knowledge of broadcast domain vs. collision domain. Familiarity with different records zones in DNS and how it works. Understanding of SSL Handshake and TCP/IP Handshake. Proficiency in ARP, DHCP, proxy servers, and DNS cache clearing. Differentiation between TCP and UDP, and protocols & their workings.

Linux/Unix:
  
  

* Understanding of the boot process and run levels. Various ways to assign an IP address to a Unix/Linux/Debian machine. Proficient in checking running processes, hidden files, and installing packages. Knowledge of sudo, permissions, file systems, and SSH banner.

Windows:
  
  

* Insight into the Windows boot process and control panel basics. Understanding of UAC, registry hives, and remote registry manipulation tools. Knowledge of kernel mode vs. user mode, Active Directory, and Group Policies. Familiarity with Kerberos and NTLM authentication, Procmon, and service control manager.

Security:
  
  

* Understanding of vulnerabilities, the vulnerability cycle, and exploits. Knowledge of malware types (virus, trojan, worm) and False/True Positive/Negative concepts. Understanding of False Positive, False Negative, True Positive, and True Negative in the security context.

description:

At Toll, we do more than just logistics - we move the businesses that move the world. Our 16,000 team members can help solve any logistics, transport, or supply chain challenge – big or small.
