* Identify continuous improvement opportunities for application support and business processes to increase operational efficiency.
* Develop functional specifications for application enhancements, configuration changes, and business requirements.
* Safeguard the quality of transition from application build and deployment into production support.
* Work closely with Local Applications & Deployment teams, broader IT teams, business stakeholders, and offshore support providers to ensure agreed commitments are delivered.
* Share knowledge and proactively upskill offshore support providers with specialist CW1 module expertise.
* Review, enhance, and maintain support processes, documentation, and knowledge articles.
* Leverage and enhance technical support tools to improve service quality and operational efficiency.
* Continuously develop expertise in the CW1 application portfolio, including country-specific configurations and core modules such as Air & Sea, Customs, Customer Service, Sales, Finance, and Warehouse Management.

**About you to be successful in this role, you will need:**

* At least 5 years' experience working with CW1 (or similar freight forwarding enterprise application suites).
* At least 5 years' experience working within freight forwarding and logistics organizations.
* Wisetech Global Certifications (CCO, CCS, CCP) are a Prerequisite.
* Demonstrated knowledge of SQL Query Writing.
* Working knowledge of PAVE workflow configuration & setup is favourable.
* At least 5 years' experience providing IT application support in a multinational enterprise environment.
* Strong knowledge of freight forwarding operational processes and CW1 business workflows.
* Demonstrated experience supporting global IT environments comprising both onshore and offshore support teams.
* Experience in CW1 implementations, deployments, upgrades, and production support.
* Strong analytical, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis skills.
* Experience preparing functional specifications for application enhancements and changes.
* Excellent customer service orientation with the ability to manage and meet SLA commitments.
* Excellent written and verbal communication and presentation skills in English.
* Strong stakeholder management, collaboration, and knowledge-sharing abilities.
* A proactive mindset with a passion for continuous improvement, operational excellence, and delivering high-quality application support.

**What moves you?**
At Toll, you can help play a vital role in delivering what matters. From food, fuel, medicine and rescue services, we keep businesses and communities thriving. Every day brings change. We see that as an opportunity. To be curious. To ask the right questions. And build meaningful connections. Because finding new ways to solve problems is what we do. With a bold vision to expand our global reach, our 16,000+ people bring a passion for progress. We collaborate in friendly, caring teams, supported by approachable leaders who give us the autonomy to quickly make decisions with impact. Learn and grow with industry-leading training, alongside talented experts. Feel empowered to take on diverse challenges and new responsibilities to move you, our customers, and our world further.

We know that some people hesitate to apply for jobs unless they meet every single qualification. At Toll, we value a diverse, inclusive and authentic workplace, so if you’re interested in this role but your past experience doesn’t align perfectly then please talk to us – you may be just the right candidate for this or other roles we have coming up.
  
  
At Toll everyone is welcome including those of all ages, ethnicities, genders and abilities.
  
  
To find out more about us visit www.careers.tollgroup.com

title: Advanced Services Engineer
description:
**Description**
**Shape the Future of Cybersecurity at Forescout**
Every day cyberattacks threaten to disrupt hospitals, power grids, financial systems, and the infrastructure we all depend on. At Forescout, we build defenses that keep civilization running smoothly in an increasingly connected world.
  
  
For more than 25 years, Fortune 100 organizations, government agencies, and large enterprises have trusted Forescout as their foundation to manage cyber risk, ensure compliance, and mitigate threats. From power grids and healthcare systems to financial networks and transportation hubs, Forescout protects the critical infrastructure of our modern world.
  
  
**What Will You Do**
At Forescout, we seek customer driven individuals who thrive on collaboration, embrace innovation, and are passionate about delivering exceptional customer experiences. Working as one team, we anticipate emerging threats and create forward-thinking solutions that shape the future of cybersecurity. Join us and make a meaningful impact through your unique talents and perspective.
  
  
The Advanced Services Engineer (ASE) position at Forescout Technologies offers the opportunity to assist customers with technical issues to ensure optimal performance of our products and solutions within large and complex customer environments. You will need a solid understanding of Forescout products and basic knowledge of the environments in which they are deployed. You will take ownership of assigned projects and support configurations to address and resolve customer issues. Competencies essential to your success in this role include customer service, problem-solving, organization, time management, combined with agility of learning and technical aptitude, and operating Forescout solutions in real-world customer environments. The ASE will troubleshoot the Forescout solutions, provide upgrade and deployment best practices to the base Forescout Solution, as well as integrate the Forescout product with other customer third-party software, such as remote access and SIEM technologies.
  
  
**In This Role, You Will**

* Develop a deep understanding of Forescout products and in-depth knowledge of environments in which they are deployed.
* Provide complex product support, in a collaborative team environment, to customers, other Forescout employees, and partners.
* Participate in knowledge transfer with teammates, attend formal team training sessions, brown bags, and formal mentoring.
* Routinely monitor and develop knowledge assets to enable customer self-sufficiency.
* Monitor and manage Support Services cases.
* Achieve a high level of expertise in all areas of the product.
* Capable of completing assigned duties, handling cases, and escalations within guidelines with minimal direction from Support Services Leadership.
* Routinely act independently while researching and developing solutions to customer issues.
* Liaison to Engineering on product issues, including design, features, and defects.
* Acts as a technical point of contact and is repeatedly sought by others to provide specialty knowledge to assist them in their problem-solving.
* Administer and mature a customer enterprise deployment of the Forescout solution.
* Interface with Forescout Support and/or R&D to resolve issues that may impede success.
* Analyse and optimize polices in accordance with customers’ business requirements.
* Manage equipment installation and configuration at all locations, to include lab environments.
* Assist customers with planning and executing Forescout software and hardware upgrades.
* Create customer reports to achieve project alignment and unity of effort.

**What You Will Bring To Forescout**

* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Expertise in debugging and root-cause analysis in complex systems and large environments
* Understanding of enterprise computing environments, distributed applications, and strong knowledge and understanding of TCP/IP networks to include ASA, Palo Alto firewalls, Cisco, Juniper, and Brocade switches.
* Experience with the configuration of Forescout products.
* Hands-on experience in both Windows and Linux, Mac OSX platforms, with a solid understanding of networking principles and security best practices
* Computer Networking Systems Administrator level knowledge of all protocol layers
* Strong knowledge of enterprise networking environments
* Industry Certifications such as CASP+, Security+, CEH, CCNA, SANS (GCIA, GCIH, GREM, GPEN) is a plus.
* Advanced Administrator’s level of understanding of Operating Systems (Linux, Windows, Macintosh, and UNIX) is a plus.
* Experience installing, implementing, and debugging network access control security solutions is a plus.
* Desired skills: VMware -vSphere, Microsoft Hyper-V, and PGSQL
* Understanding of programming languages: C, Java, Bash, and Python is a plus
* Minimum 3 years of experience with network hardware configuration.
* 3 years of significant experience with Windows-based operating systems and Unix systems, specifically Linux.
* Expertise in deploying large-scale enterprise deployments/data centers.
* Experience deploying and/or supporting enterprise security software products such as firewalls, IPS, Anti-Virus solutions, application firewalls, high availability solutions, network management systems, and virtual systems.
* Experience implementing complicated software products that involve multiple components.
* Experience in working and troubleshooting in heterogeneous environments.
* Ability to clearly document complicated steps and procedures.
* Working knowledge of shell, Perl, and XML scripting.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, strong customer orientation, good organizational skills, self-driven with the ability to multi-task on various projects, and aptitude to learn new technologies.
* Knowledge/experience utilizing Salesforce.com or similar CRM tools.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and experience working in demanding and challenging environments.

**About Role:**

**Experience Level:**
Associate level, 1–3 years of relevant experience in the AI-Enabled Care Engineer is responsible for maintaining, improving, and supporting live production software by understanding client needs, identifying root causes, and delivering reliable solutions using AI-powered development tools. The role involves end-to-end ownership of client issues, from understanding business requirements to implementing, testing, and communicating solutions.

**Role Overview:**
Strong logical reasoning, problem-solving, product understanding, business awareness, and client communication skills. The engineer is expected to investigate issues independently, understand the impact of changes, use AI tools effectively, and take responsibility for the quality and correctness of delivered solutions.

**What You'll Do**

**As part of the job**

* Build product and domain knowledge continuously through client interactions, product documentation, system exploration, and previous issue resolutions.
* Investigate client issues, identify root causes, clarify requirements, and distinguish between defects, maintenance requests, and new features.
* Use AI-powered development tools to analyze existing code, implement fixes and enhancements, and validate solutions against business requirements and acceptance criteria.
* Review AI-generated code critically and perform testing, regression checks, and edge-case validation to ensure production quality.
* Resolve issues independently wherever possible and involve developers only when specialist technical expertise is required.
* Challenge unclear or potentially harmful requirements constructively, recommend better solutions, and escalate complex issues with evidence and specific technical questions.
* Build client confidence through clear communication, sound judgment, timely updates, and reliable follow-through.
* Maintain accurate and detailed records of investigations, decisions, implementations, and validations in Harmony to ensure resolutions are traceable.
* Collaborate with developers when specialist expertise is required, follow security guidelines, and access production systems only with explicit authorization.
* Continuously strengthen product knowledge, technical skills, AI tool proficiency, and client relationships through sound decision-making and reliable follow-through.

**Requirements:**

**Must have technical skills**

* Strong logical reasoning, analytical thinking, and problem-solving skills to investigate unfamiliar issues and identify practical solutions independently.
* Good understanding of product workflows, business rules, user requirements, application architecture, and system dependencies.
* Working knowledge of software development, APIs, databases, debugging, and relevant technology stacks.
* Proficiency in using AI-assisted development tools to investigate issues, understand existing code, implement solutions, and develop enhancements.
* Ability to critically review AI-generated code and validate solutions through testing, regression checks, and edge-case analysis.
* Familiarity with application maintenance, production troubleshooting, issue resolution, and assessing the impact of changes on existing functionality.
* Strong ownership and decision-making skills to manage issues from investigation to resolution while ensuring solution quality.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to interact with clients and internal teams, clarify requirements, and define acceptance criteria.
* Ability to conduct product demonstrations, explain technical solutions, and communicate business outcomes effectively.
* Ability to challenge unclear requirements constructively, recommend suitable alternatives, and recognize when specialist engineering support is required.
* Understanding of security boundaries, data protection, and authorized access to production systems.
* Willingness to learn new technologies, understand unfamiliar applications, and adapt to project-specific technologies, including Firebase or the applicable backend framework.

**What This Role Is Not:**

* A ticket-logging or ticket-routing role.
* A conventional support role that escalates every unfamiliar issue to developers.
* A role that blindly follows client instructions without understanding their intent.
* A role that accepts AI-generated code without reviewing and testing it.
* A replacement for specialist engineers when deep architectural, infrastructure, security, or complex engineering expertise is required.

**Experience and Qualifications:**

* 1-3 years of relevant experience in software development, application support, QA, or client-facing delivery.
* Degree or equivalent practical experience in software engineering, computer science, or a related technical discipline.
* Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving, and learning abilities.
* Familiarity with AI-assisted development tools is preferred.
* Relevant domain experience is an advantage.

**Hiring principle:**

* Prioritize problem-solving, product understanding, ownership, and communication over advanced theoretical programming knowledge. Technical proficiency should be sufficient to use AI tools responsibly, understand their output, and recognize when specialist assistance is necessary.

**Why it’s worth it:**
At ReliaQuest, we do things differently. We do not limit your professional growth with outdated job titles and responsibilities. Why be just a “Security Analyst”, “Detection Developer”, or “Security Engineer” when you can be all three? As a GreyMatter Specialist, you will do all of that and more. This role is uniquely designed to combine skills of threat detection, engineering, and incident response. On our team, we give you the opportunity to make an impact starting
  
  
from day one.
  
  
In this role, you’ll develop a diverse skill set which normally takes years to learn—all within your first year. Our industry-leading security operations platform, GreyMatter and immersive training will afford you the tools, experience, and opportunities to grow your career. Whether you’re conducting advanced investigations, troubleshooting technical challenges or providing customer recommendations, you’ll be solving real-world challenges and driving impact daily for our enterprise customers.
  
  
As part of the ReliaQuest team, you will receive mentorship and hands-on experiences while working alongside world-class teammates who share a high-performance mindset. In this environment, your expertise will propel you years ahead of your peers limited to traditional SOC roles. If you are looking for the monotony of manually working security alerts, this job is not for you; but if you are ready to be challenged, we are ready to invest in you.
  
  
**The everyday hustle:**

* Be a trusted technical advisor, resolving customer challenges from start to finish.
* Provide analysis and recommendations to customers based on alert activity, response playbook availability, and investigations.

* Integrate and configure log sources for existing customers.

* Deploy and fine-tune detection rules using GreyMatter Detect.

* Spend 75% of your day in front of the customer

* Bachelor's degree in a related field

* Knowledge of TCP/IP Protocols, network analysis, and network/security applications
* Basic knowledge of Linux/Unix operating systems
* Ability to blend your technical and communication skills to advise the customer
* Must demonstrate great attitude, energy, and effort
* Must be adaptable, focused, accountable, and helpful
* Must demonstrate excellent verbal and written communication skills (English language)

**What makes you uncommon? (not required)**

* Certifications such as Network+, Security+, CySA+
* 1-3 years' experience as a Security/Network Administrator or equivalent knowledge
* Prior SIEM experience and/or administration
* Hands-on experience with parsing data, log formats, regular expressions
* Scripting experience (bash, PowerShell, python)
* Multiple OS experience (mac, windows)
* Knowledge of various security methodologies and processes, and technical security solutions (SIEM, IDS/IPS, Firewall Solutions, Offensive Security tools)

**Description**
**About Northern Trust**
As a global leader in innovative wealth management, asset servicing, asset management and banking services, Northern Trust (Nasdaq: NTRS) is proud to guide the world's most successful individuals, families, corporations and institutions.
  
  
Since 1889, we have aligned our efforts with our three guiding Principles That Endure: Service, Expertise, and Integrity. Together, they reflect the three cornerstones of business conduct which we strive to instill in our employees, whom we call partners, and to provide to our clients and the communities we serve worldwide.
  
  
With more than 135 years of financial experience and over 24,000 partners, we serve the world's most sophisticated clients using leading technology and exceptional service.
  
  
For more than a century, Northern Trust has worked hard building our legacy of outstanding service, expertise and integrity. From a Chicago-based bank founded in 1889, we now have more than 20 international locations and 18,500 employees globally. We serve the world's most-sophisticated clients - from sovereign wealth funds and the wealthiest individuals and families, to the most-successful hedge funds and corporate brands.
  
  
We burnished our reputation as a global leader delivering innovative investment management, asset and fund administration, fiduciary and banking solutions enabled by sophisticated, leading technology. And through it all, we continually laid a solid, forward-looking foundation on which future generations can continue growing and achieving greater.
  
  
Northern Trust is looking for an Associate to join its Technology Development Center in Pune, India.
  
  
**Job Description AND Principal Responsibilities**
The Vulnerability Management Associate is a technical support role within the Vulnerability Management function, providing day-to-day platform administration, technical analysis, data validation, integration monitoring, testing, reporting, and support for enterprise Vulnerability Management technologies.
  
  
This role works closely with VM Engineers to provide day-to-day technical support across the Vulnerability Management technology ecosystem, with a focus on platform monitoring, troubleshooting, data quality, integration support, testing, reporting, and continuous improvement.
  
  
The role will support technologies including Qualys, Zafran Security, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow integrations, Policy Compliance, and Attack Surface Management capabilities.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities/Requirements**

* Provide day-to-day technical and platform support for Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, and associated integrations.
* Monitor platform health, scanning activity, integrations, data feeds, API jobs, asset coverage, and data completeness.
* Perform initial troubleshooting of scanner, agent, authentication, API, integration, and data-ingestion issues and escalate complex engineering issues to VM Engineers.
* Support Qualys scanner and agent operations, including scan status, authentication results, failed scans, coverage, and troubleshooting.
* Support Qualys Policy Compliance activities, including policy/profile maintenance, control mapping, authentication issues, configuration assessments, and reporting.
* Support Wiz cloud-security and configuration-compliance capabilities, including validation of findings, coverage, data feeds, and integrations.
* Support Aqua and Kubernetes/container security platforms, including monitoring scanning coverage, image/registry/cluster data, integrations, and platform issues.
* Monitor Zafran data ingestion and enrichment from connected security technologies and identify missing, stale, or inconsistent data.
* Validate that vulnerability, asset, threat, exposure, and compensating-control information is flowing correctly into Zafran.
* Support and test Zafran AI agent use cases and automation opportunities identified by VM Engineering.
* Assist VM Engineers with testing and validation of Python/API automation and ServiceNow workflow changes.
* Monitor ServiceNow integrations to ensure vulnerability records, assignments, enrichment, status updates, and closure information are flowing correctly between systems.
* Investigate integration failures, incorrect assignments, missing enrichment, duplicate records, asset-matching issues, and other data-quality problems.
* Support Attack Surface Management by validating discovered assets, investigating ownership and attribution data, and ensuring ASM information flows appropriately into downstream VM platforms.
* Perform UAT/testing and validation for platform upgrades, configuration changes, integrations, new automation, and new security capabilities.
* Assist VM Engineers with POCs, implementations, platform migrations, and integration testing.
* Produce platform-support reporting covering scanner health, coverage, integration status, failed jobs, data quality, enrichment, and other engineering metrics.
* Maintain platform inventories, configurations, support documentation, knowledge articles, procedures, and runbooks.
* Work closely with VM Engineering to identify recurring support issues that should be permanently resolved through engineering or automation.
* Work with VM Operations when platform or data issues affect their remediation processes, while leaving vulnerability remediation ownership with the existing VM Operations team.

Skill / Experience
  
  
**Minimum**

* Experience supporting Vulnerability Management, Security Engineering, Security Platforms, or Cybersecurity Operations technologies.
* Working knowledge of Qualys, Zafran, Wiz, Aqua Security, ServiceNow, ASM, or comparable technologies.
* Understanding of vulnerability scanning, authenticated scanning, agents, asset inventory, and Policy Compliance/configuration assessment.
* Familiarity with cloud, Kubernetes, containers, Linux, Windows, networking, and enterprise infrastructure.
* Basic knowledge of REST APIs, JSON, scripting, and automation concepts; Python experience is preferred.
* Ability to troubleshoot data feeds, integrations, authentication, scanning, coverage, and platform issues.
* Understanding of ServiceNow/CMDB integrations and vulnerability workflows.
* Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate large datasets and identify coverage, enrichment, integration, and data-quality issues.
* Ability to work closely with engineers and learn complex enterprise security technologies.
* Experience supporting security technologies within a large enterprise environment preferred.

**Preferred**

* 5-8 years of relevant experience
* Any infosec certifications or related (desired, not a compulsion)

**Working with Us**
As a Northern Trust partner, you will be part of a flexible and collaborative work culture, which has a strong history of financial strength and stability. Movement within the organization is encouraged, senior leaders are accessible, and you can take pride in working for a company committed to an inclusive workplace and assisting the communities we serve.
  
  
Philanthropy is deeply rooted in Northern Trust's history and is an essential element of our culture. Employees around the world give their time and talent to work for the greater good of their communities.
  
  
**Reasonable Accommodation**
Northern Trust is committed to working with and providing adjustments to individuals with health conditions and disabilities. If you need a reasonable accommodation for any part of the employment process, please email our HR Service Center at MyHRHelp@ntrs.com , or alternatively you can discuss your individual requirements with the recruiter you are working with.
  
  
**About Our Pune Office**
The Northern Trust Pune office, established in 2016, is now home to over 3,000 employees. The office handles various functions, including Operations for Asset Servicing and Wealth Management, as well as delivering critical technology solutions that support business operations across the globe.
  
  
Our Pune team takes our commitment to service to heart. In 2024, they volunteered more than 10,000+ hours into the communities where they live and work. Learn more.

**About This Role**
We are seeking an experienced application operations professional to manage the day-to-day operational health, availability and performance of Oracle WebLogic-hosted Telecom Order Management services in Pune.
  
  
This hands-on role focuses on platform reliability, customer order-fulfilment integrity, SLA adherence, incident and problem resolution, observability, operational automation and continual service improvement. * You have practical expertise in Oracle WebLogic Server administration and production support, including domains, clusters, managed servers, Node Manager, JVM, JDBC, JMS, threads and heap analysis
* You understand Telecom Order Management or Oracle OSM operations, including COM/SOM/TOM concepts, order orchestration, order states, fallout and recovery
* You understand order capture, decomposition, fulfilment, provisioning and service activation

* You understand Incident, Major Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request management, alongside ITIL practices and SLA/KPI management
* You have contributed to automation, observability or continual-improvement initiatives
* You can communicate clearly when coordinating technical activities, service restoration and operational governance
* Practical exposure to AIOps, anomaly detection, intelligent alert correlation, AI-assisted RCA or incident summarisation is beneficial
* ITIL Foundation certification and exposure to Oracle SOA/OSB/AIA, Oracle OSM, UIM, ASAP and SRE practices are preferred
* Experience supporting high-availability telecom order-fulfilment services is advantageous

If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
  
  
**What’s In It For You**

* The opportunity to work hands-on with business-critical, high-availability telecom Order Management services
* Exposure to complex customer-order journeys spanning CRM, middleware, Order Management, provisioning and activation platforms
* Opportunities to contribute to SRE-based reliability improvements, observability and operational automation
* Practical involvement in approved AI/AIOps use cases, including anomaly detection, incident summarisation, probable-cause analysis and order-fallout classification
* The opportunity to influence measurable improvements in service availability, MTTD, MTTR, order fulfilment and operational efficiency

Building on your existing production-support expertise, the role provides opportunities to further develop:
  
  

* Advanced WebLogic and Telecom Order Management troubleshooting
* End-to-end analysis of integrated telecom order-fulfilment journeys
* Observability, event correlation and proactive service monitoring
* WLST, Shell and SQL/PLSQL-based operations automation

This includes, but is not limited to, discrimination based on race, colour, age, veteran status, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, pregnancy, maternity or parental status, ethnicity, disability, religion or belief, political affiliation, trade union membership, nationality, citizenship, indigenous status, medical condition, HIV status, neurodiversity, social origin, cultural background, marital or civil partnership status, or socio-economic background.

With us, you can be truly be yourself and belong, share inspiration, embrace new opportunities, thrive, and make a real difference.

The role is focused on providing hands-on production support, troubleshooting and operational ownership for applications hosted on Google Cloud Platform (GCP), with strong emphasis on Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE), containerised workloads, PostgreSQL/Postgres-backed services and related cloud-native technologies. You will be expected to lead incident recovery, perform deep technical analysis across application, infrastructure, database and platform layers, improve observability, and drive automation to enhance service stability, resilience and operational efficiency.
  
  

* Lead technical and functional troubleshooting for production incidents, user requests and platform issues across GCP-hosted applications, including GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, IAM, networking, PostgreSQL/Postgres databases and database connectivity.
* Drive end-to-end incident recovery for P3H and above incidents by analysing logs, metrics, traces, deployment history, configuration changes, infrastructure events and application behaviour.
* Use GCP observability tools such as Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, dashboards, uptime checks and alert policies to identify root cause, reduce mean time to detect and improve service reliability.
* Partner with application, infrastructure, SRE, security and engineering teams to troubleshoot cloud networking, container runtime, IAM, quota, performance, scaling and availability issues.
* Drive automation, toil reduction, platform hygiene, monitoring improvements and operational controls for cloud-native applications and supporting infrastructure.
* Prepare and distribute clear incident communications, technical updates, recovery timelines and service restoration summaries for senior stakeholders.
* Participate in CAB, change validation and post-change support activities to assess operational risk, ensure rollback readiness and support safer change delivery.
* Collaborate with Global Incident Management, L2/L3 support, SRE and platform teams to orchestrate recovery of major incidents and implement preventive actions.

* Troubleshoot PostgreSQL/Postgres production issues, including connection failures, query performance, locks, replication or failover symptoms, storage growth, backup/restore readiness and application-to-database connectivity.
* Build technical and functional subject matter expertise across supported applications, business flows, cloud architecture, service dependencies and infrastructure configuration.
* Identify proactive opportunities for automation, self-healing, alert rationalisation, toil reduction and improved operational resilience.
* Drive service requests and incidents to resolution within L2 scope, ensuring timely escalation to L3, SRE, infrastructure or vendor teams where deeper engineering intervention is required.
* Review monitoring coverage for critical services, SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, availability, latency, throughput, saturation and business-critical transaction flows.
* Maintain and continuously improve runbooks, KEDB articles, support procedures, troubleshooting guides and operational readiness documentation.
* Participate in BCP, DR, EDR, SSRTO and component failure tests for cloud and application services, validating recovery procedures and operational readiness.
* Understand data flow, request flow and service dependencies across cloud infrastructure to provide effective operational support during incidents and changes.
* Own managed risk, operational controls, production hygiene and continuous improvement initiatives for supported services.
* Mentor and coach global support team members on GCP troubleshooting, incident handling, observability and production support best practices.
* Apply an SRE mindset with practical understanding of SLIs, SLOs, error budgets, incident learning and reliability improvement.

**Your Skills And Experience**
**Must Have**
: -
  
  

* 12+ years of IT experience in large corporate environments, with strong exposure to controlled production support environments, preferably within Financial Services Technology.
* Strong hands-on experience supporting and troubleshooting production workloads on Google Cloud Platform, with deeper focus on GKE, Cloud Run, Compute Engine, Cloud Storage, Cloud SQL/PostgreSQL, IAM, VPC networking, load balancers and service accounts.
* Proven ability to investigate incidents using Cloud Logging, Cloud Monitoring, Error Reporting, dashboards, alerts, log-based metrics and application traces. Strong troubleshooting skills across application, infrastructure and platform layers, including container failures, scaling issues, latency, memory/CPU saturation, network connectivity, DNS, certificates, secrets, IAM permissions and deployment failures.
* Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes concepts and GKE operations, including pods, deployments, services, ingress, node pools, namespaces, autoscaling, config maps, secrets, health checks, cluster events, workloads, logs and kubectl-based diagnostics.
* Working knowledge of cloud-native application architecture, microservices, REST APIs, service-to-service communication, event-driven flows and enterprise integration patterns.
* Strong understanding of UNIX/Linux operating systems, shell commands, process analysis, file systems, logs, network utilities and infrastructure troubleshooting.
* Working knowledge of scripting and automation using UNIX shell, Python, PowerShell, Perl or similar tools for diagnostics, reporting, remediation and toil reduction.
* Understanding of middleware and messaging platforms such as MQ, Kafka or similar, including operational troubleshooting of connectivity, message flow and performance issues.
* Understanding of web and application server environments such as Apache, Tomcat, WebLogic or equivalent cloud-hosted runtimes.
* Strong understanding of relational databases, especially PostgreSQL/Postgres and Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL, including connectivity, query performance, locks, indexing concepts, backup/restore, storage growth, availability and operational troubleshooting.
* Experience with enterprise monitoring tools such as Geneos, AppDynamics, New Relic, Dynatrace, Grafana or equivalent, alongside GCP observability tools. Strong understanding of ITIL Service Management practices, including Incident, Problem, Change, Request and Major Incident Management.
* Experience in securities services, asset management or trade finance domains will be an advantage.

title: Site Reliability Engineer
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Title. -**
Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)
  
  
**Department -**
Employee Services Technology & Operations – CIO RUN Function
  
  
**Experience Level -**
4 – 8 Years
  
  
**Location -**
Pune, India (Hybrid)
  
  
**Shift Pattern -**
APAC and EMEA Shift
  
  
**Reporting Manager -**
Yashwant Sinha
  
  
**Role Overview**
We are seeking an experienced
**Site Reliability Engineer (SRE)**
with 4 to 8 years of technical expertise to join our SRE and observability team within the CIO RUN function. In this role, you will act as a critical bridge between engineering and operations, driving system stability, proactive detection, and rapid incident mitigation across enterprise systems.
  
  
You will be responsible for hands-on configuration of observability platforms, triaging system alerts and user reports, managing incident response workflows, and enforcing end-to-end ITIL lifecycles (Incident, Problem, and Change Management).
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Partner and collaborate with end users to understand administrative needs, resolve issues and meet business requirements.
* Handle both end user tickets and monitoring tickets from ITIL perspective with end to end ownership maintaining required response and resolution SLA targets.
* Liaise with the problem manager to identify repeated incidents and engage with level 2 or domain teams for permanent fixes.
* Able to manage high impact major incidents P1/P2 and able to perform initial level troubleshooting and triaging.
* Develop and mentor others around application customization via custom objects, validation rules, workflows, flows, process builder, etc
* Implement, own and optimize internal processes to improve efficiency.
* Document procedures, policies, and systems in Runbooks, SOPs and KEDBs/KB Articles.
* Manage and own system administration and help streamline business functionality including: profiles/permissions, role hierarchy, security models, application customization, reports and dashboards, etc

**Proactive Monitoring & Observability**

* Perform hands-on configuration and tuning of synthetic monitors, application performance monitoring (APM), dashboards, and alert rules in platforms such as Datadog and Dynatrace.
* Drive continuous reduction of alert noise and fatigue by establishing alert correlation rules and actionable threshold triggers.
* Assist in application onboarding to ensure proper logging, tracing, and metric standards are enforced prior to operational go-live.

**Triage & Incident Management**

* Actively triage incoming system alerts and user-reported issues, minimizing Mean Time to Detect (MTTD) and Mean Time to Restore (MTTR).
* Participate in incident swarming and real-time operational response utilizing modern collaboration and ITSM tools such as Incident.io, Datadog, Jira, and Slack.
* Oversee the lifecycle of monitoring tickets, maintaining strict adherence to SLA compliance and response metrics.

**Problem & Change Management**

* Conduct thorough Root Cause Analysis (RCA) and facilitate Post-Incident Reviews (PIR) to eliminate recurring incidents.
* Maintain and expand the Known Error Database (KEDB) and runbook documentation to mitigate Single Point of Failure (SPOF) risks across operational workflows.
* Review and govern change requests, verifying risk assessments and rollback plans to maintain operational continuity.

**Tooling & Integration Management**

* Monitor, troubleshoot, and support bi-directional SaaS integrations and data pipelines (e.g., Salesforce-to-Zuora, Workato, AWS Lambda, and EHC/Zendesk platforms).
* Ensure seamless data flow across ticketing and incident management ecosystems, collaborating with engineering leads to resolve integration breaks.

**Required Qualifications**

* Experience: 4 to 8 years of experience in Site Reliability Engineering (SRE), IT Operations, System Engineering, or NOC environments.
* Observability Mastery: Hands-on experience configuring observability stacks, including log aggregation, metric creation, APM tracing, and visual dashboards using tools like Datadog, Dynatrace, or New Relic.
* ITIL Proficiency: Strong working knowledge of ITIL frameworks, specifically Incident, Problem, and Change Management integration.
* Cloud & Architecture: Technical experience with cloud platforms (AWS/GCP), API integrations, payload troubleshooting, and database querying via SQL.
* Scripting & Automation: Familiarity with scripting languages (Python, Go, PowerShell, or Bash) for automating tasks, processing telemetry data, or building operational reports.
* Operational Drive: Proven track record in reducing alert fatigue, managing complex system environments, and maintaining composure during high-priority outage events.

**Nice to Have**

* ITIL 4 Foundation certification or specialized certifications in Incident/Problem Management.
* Prior experience in service-based or consulting environments with broad, multi-client operational exposure.
* Background in a global technology company supporting enterprise-grade, business-critical SaaS systems and distributed topologies.

Please note that Zendesk can only hire candidates who are physically located and plan to work from Karnataka or Maharashtra. Please refer to the location posted on the requisition for where this role is based.

This role must attend our local office for part of the week. The specific in-office schedule is to be determined by the hiring manager.

title: Senior Manager – CFT Kyriba Finance Support
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.
  
  
**Service Ownership, Environment Management & Availability**

* Own the Finance support operating model for Kyriba, including service health, environment governance, operational readiness and escalation.
* Be accountable for Kyriba environment management and coordinate production and non-production activities with Kyriba Support, implementation partners and internal technology teams.
* Take responsibility for Kyriba environment availability, ensuring service interruptions are assessed, communicated and progressed through the appropriate incident and problem-management channels.
* Maintain clear operational ownership, support contacts, dependencies, recovery expectations and evidence required for service governance.

**Integration Ownership & Operational Resilience**

* Own Finance-side support and coordination for various integration applications e.g. Kyriba–Bridger and Kyriba–Adjuto payment integrations and the Kyriba–Sonata integration via FADS for forecasting.
* Coordinate investigation of interface failures, missing or delayed files, rejected transactions, scheduling issues and upstream or downstream data exceptions.
* Work with FinOps, Treasury, other M&G systems, Kyriba Support and implementation partners to restore service, validate outcomes and address recurring integration risks.
* Maintain functional knowledge of interface purpose, control points, business impact, dependencies and recovery procedures.

**Access Governance, Logs & Recertification**

* Be accountable for controlled access to Kyriba application logs, ensuring access is appropriately authorised, traceable and aligned with support requirements.
* Be accountable for quarterly user recertification, coordinating evidence, exceptions, remediation and completion with IDAM/SailPoint, supervisors and relevant business owners.
* Provide Finance consultation for ARC role management, user-access management and SCIM setup and management, ensuring the proposed access model supports business responsibilities and control expectations.
* Remain informed on API-key management and assess Finance impact where credential changes could affect Kyriba services or integrations.

**Bank Connectivity & Market Data Support**

* Provide Finance consultation for monitoring payment and statement connectivity, helping assess business impact, prioritise exceptions and coordinate remediation.
* Support the Finance assessment of bank acknowledgements, rejected or delayed flows, statement availability and related operational dependencies.
* Provide Finance consultation for the input integration status information on IDP-to-Kyriba FX-rate process, including business validation of rates, exception assessment and coordination with the responsible support teams.

**Release, Change & Control Assurance**

* Remain informed of Kyriba release-note assessments and opt-in regression-testing outcomes, identifying Finance impacts, risks and required stakeholder actions.
* Ensure material changes affecting Finance-owned integrations, controls or service availability are supported by appropriate impact assessment, testing evidence and operational readiness.
* Support incident, problem, change and release governance, including root-cause follow-up, risk tracking and audit evidence.

**Stakeholder, Vendor & Continuous Improvement**

* Act as the Finance support contact across FinOps, Treasury, RDM FinOps Kyriba Business Management, Corporate Functions Technology, Kyriba Support and implementation partners.
* Translate Finance priorities and business impacts into clear actions for technical teams and vendors, and provide concise updates through resolution.
* Identify opportunities to improve monitoring, automate controls, simplify support processes, strengthen knowledge articles and reduce repeat incidents.
* Promote disciplined ownership, effective hand-offs and sustainable service improvements across the Kyriba support ecosystem.

**Application Support & Incident Management**

* Provide expert technical support for finance applications, ensuring incidents and service requests are triaged, prioritised and progressed in line with agreed service levels.
* Investigate application and integration issues, perform initial diagnosis, gather technical evidence and coordinate resolution with software vendors, infrastructure teams and business stakeholders.
* Maintain clear ownership of issues through to closure, including timely stakeholder updates, root-cause follow-up and verification that service has been restored.
* Support problem management by identifying recurring issues, contributing to root-cause analysis and tracking preventive actions.

**Integration & Interface Support**

* Actively support system integrations and interfaces connecting finance applications with upstream and downstream platforms.
* Monitor scheduled feeds, jobs and interfaces; identify failures, data exceptions or processing delays and coordinate recovery with relevant application teams.
* Work across internal technology teams and external vendors to resolve interface dependencies, connectivity issues and data-flow failures.
* Maintain operational knowledge of interface schedules, dependencies, support contacts, control points and recovery procedures.

**User Onboarding & Experience**

* Coordinate user onboarding, access enablement and application readiness in line with approved controls and defined operating procedures.
* Provide practical guidance to users, improve support documentation and help reduce avoidable incidents through clear communication and knowledge sharing.
* Identify opportunities to enhance user experience, simplify support journeys and improve the quality and responsiveness of application services.

**Vendor & Service Management**

* Act as a key technical contact for application vendors and business stakeholders during incident investigation and service improvement activity.
* Plan and conduct regular service review meetings with application vendors, covering incidents, service levels, recurring issues, risks, upcoming changes and improvement actions.
* Track agreed actions to completion and challenge vendors constructively where service quality, responsiveness or technical outcomes require improvement.
* Support operational governance, audit evidence and service reporting for the applications in scope.

**Release, Upgrade & UAT Support**

* Support application version upgrades, patches and technical lifecycle activities by coordinating impact assessment, readiness checks, implementation support and post-release validation.
* Plan and conduct user acceptance testing for small enhancements and bug fixes, including test preparation, execution, defect logging, retesting and evidence retention.
* Collaborate with business users, vendors and change teams to ensure releases are appropriately tested and introduced with minimal service disruption.

**Security Credentials & Technical Administration**

* Manage application certificates and integration keys throughout their lifecycle, including inventory, renewal coordination, secure implementation and validation.
* Monitor expiry dates and dependencies to prevent avoidable service disruption, ensuring changes are completed through approved security and change-control processes.
* Maintain accurate technical and operational documentation for certificates, keys, interfaces, configurations and support procedures.

**Continuous Improvement & Innovation**

* Propose and implement innovative ideas to improve monitoring, automation, support efficiency, service resilience and user experience over time.
* Use incident trends, vendor performance and operational feedback to identify improvement opportunities and prioritise sustainable fixes.
* Contribute to a culture of ownership, knowledge sharing, control discipline and continual service improvement.

We have a diverse workforce and an inclusive culture at M&G Global Services, regardless of gender, ethnicity, age, sexual orientation, nationality, disability or long term condition, we are looking to attract, promote and retain exceptional people. We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

* Managing Financial Planning and forecasting: Business-wise yearly financial planning, forecasting for rest of the year (revenue and all cost lines including headcount, compensation grid, capacity optimization, efficiency targets, utilization levels etc.) and drive it through Performance reviews.
* Conduct and analyze monthly/quarterly financial performance against forecast and budget, investigate variances, pipeline analysis, prepare graphical summaries of entity’s financial performance and communicate findings and make recommendations.

* Corporate functions planning and forecasting as part of annual corporate-wide planning processes.

* Work closely with HQ FP&A team in providing inputs on Headcount reconciliation, rolling forecasts and any ad-hoc requests.

* Support initiatives targeted at financial processes improvement and the implementation of changes to achieve efficiencies and the company’s objectives in the areas of project billing, contract compliance and reporting, cost recovery, financial reporting and analysis

* Education: MBA - Finance, M-COM with 6-8 years of experience

* Strong analytical skills
* Interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to interact with various management levels
* Ability to influence and work in a support role
* Ability to prioritize work and meet
* Ability to work independently and under high pressure

* Work in a culture of collaboration and innovation
* Opportunities for personal development and career progression
* Chance to collaborate with a multinational and multidisciplinary team

description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Strategy & Transactions | Valuation & Modeling | Complex Securities Valuation | Consultant**
Join our team of Strategy & Transactions professionals to help guide Deloitte client service teams through some of the critical moments and transformational initiatives. From strategy to execution, this team helps deliver integrated support covering valuation modeling, cost optimization, restructuring, strategy, business design and transformation, infrastructure and real estate, M&A, and sustainability. Work alongside teams every step of the way, helping them navigate new challenges, avoid financial pitfalls, and support in providing practical insights at certain stages of their journey—before, during, and after any major transformational projects or transactions.
  
  
Position Summary
  
  
**Level: Senior or equivalent**
As a Consultant at Deloitte Consulting, you will be responsible for reviewing the valuation analysis/ models assisting client with their taxation planning and compliance; financial reporting in accordance with ‘US GAAP’ or ‘IFRS’ accounting standards . You will build, review, and validate quantitative models, interpret outputs in the context of applicable accounting standards, and draft client-ready deliverables. You will collaborate with cross-functional, global teams to translate functional requirements into effective deliverables, independently guiding and mentoring junior team members. Your role spans the full project lifecycle, including estimation, planning, execution, and tracking key metrics for analysis, ensuring high-quality and timely delivery of solutions.
  
  
**The team:**
The Complex Securities Valuation team, part of Deloitte Consulting Services, provides services relating to the full life cycle of Valuation, including policy and process assessments, and quantitative solutions to support the valuation of all types of financial instruments under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, ASC 842 and other financial reporting standards including complex derivatives, convertible securities, contingent consideration, contingent claims analysis, stock compensation, incremental borrowing rates, equity securities and other investment products. Valuation service offering also provides advisory services to financial institutions, governmental agencies and other private and public companies.
  
  
**Work you’ll do / Key Responsibilities:**
The key job responsibilities will be to:
  
  

* Conduct 409A common stock valuations and complex capital structure analyses using OPM (Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo), PWERM, and hybrid methodologies; document DLOM/DLOC assumptions with appropriate support
* Apply and document fair value measurement methodologies under ASC 820, ASC 718, ASC 815, ASC 480, and ASC 842; ensure deliverables are defensible to external auditors
* Support Deloitte US and Deloitte India (Offices of the US) project teams in providing financial consulting services relating to preparing and auditing complex security valuations. Assist in the valuation of financial instruments for regulatory, financial, and 409A purposes.
* Create/assist in creating financial models, analyzing financial statements, conducting industry research, and writing reports
* Draft client-ready valuation reports and memos including methodology rationale, model assumptions, sensitivity analyses, and concluded fair values; respond substantively to auditor and client review comments
* Deliver high-quality valuation work products and assist other team members in India (Offices of the US), when required; and interact with internal clients and communicate with stakeholders in the US
* Supervise and review work of junior analysts; provide structured, technical feedback to build team capability and maintain quality standards across the engagement portfolio
* May need to work on other Deloitte Consulting engagements
* Support business development through proposal preparation, pitch materials, and thought leadership on emerging topics in financial instrument valuation

**Qualifications**
**Must Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* Strong background in mathematical finance at the Master's level - degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, or a related technical discipline.
* Understanding financial valuation concepts is required. Applicants are expected to have strong analytical and computer skills. Quantitative analysis technical skills and experience with modeling and valuation theory (Monte-Carlo Simulations, Binomial Lattice, Black Scholes, Options Theory, Geometric Brownian Motion), and tools (Bloomberg, and S&P Capital IQ) are a plus.
* 1-4 years of relevant Complex Securities Valuation experience

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

* CFA Level II cleared or appeared
* Ability to explain difficult financial modeling/valuation concepts to diverse client contacts
* Conceptual and quantitative depth in valuation methodologies and concepts and underlying markets and models.

**Education:**

* Master's level - degree in Mathematical Finance, Mathematics of Finance, Financial Engineering or Quantitative Finance, Business Administration in Finance

#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture

We are seeking an experienced technology pricing professional to lead the commercial design and pricing of complex, high-value opportunities during the pre-signature phase. This location-agnostic role sits within Technology Commercial Support, Growth, and reports to a Senior Technology Account Manager or market-specific Technology Account Manager.
  
  
You will act as the pricing lead for strategic opportunities, typically valued at €10 million to €30 million in total contract value, or support larger and more complex bids. You will develop value-led, competitive and governable commercial constructs while protecting margin, addressing commercial risk and aligning pricing decisions with market conditions.
  
  
Working across defined strategic accounts, sub-accounts or opportunity portfolios, you will collaborate with Technology Account Managers, pricing teams, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments, Digital & IT leaders and customer stakeholders.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
Pricing and commercial design
  
  

* Shape end-to-end commercial constructs for new technology opportunities, aligning the pricing approach with deal strategy, customer requirements and risk profile
* Define pricing strategies that balance competitiveness, margin protection and long-term value
* Build, review and approve complex pricing models, including sensitivity, scenario and profitability analysis
* Apply relevant pricing constructs, including time and materials, Managed Services, output-based and gain-share models
* Clearly document and govern pricing assumptions, commercial risks, dependencies and guardrails
* Set pricing strategies and commercial constructs within Growth governance, escalating material risks or deviations where required
* Provide commercial analysis, market insight and competitor perspectives to support informed pricing decisions

Bid support and governance
  
  

* Lead pricing activity within bid squads for opportunities typically valued at €10 million to €30 million, or provide pricing leadership within larger, multi-tower bids
* Coordinate commercial inputs for requests for information, requests for proposal and customer submissions
* Create detailed pricing models, submission packs, proposal artefacts and governance documentation
* Assure the quality, consistency, accuracy and completeness of all pricing deliverables
* Coordinate with solution, pricing and commercial support teams to meet bid timelines and quality requirements
* Support opportunity and pipeline qualification, together with pricing approval processes, in line with Growth governance
* Maintain disciplined delivery across multiple customers and concurrent opportunities
* Enable an effective transition from Growth to business-as-usual teams by documenting pricing assumptions and commercial guardrails

Stakeholder and customer engagement
  
  

* Build collaborative relationships with key VOIS stakeholders, customer service owners and service leads
* Work closely with Senior Technology Account Managers, Finance, solution specialists, VOIS, Vodafone Commercial Investments and Digital & IT leaders
* Participate in customer engagement activities and contribute commercial insight to the shaping of deals and solutions
* Communicate pricing strategies, commercial risks and recommendations clearly to senior stakeholders
* Guide commercial support colleagues working within bid teams

Measures of success
  
  

* Competitiveness of pricing and contribution to successful deal outcomes
* Protection of margin and realisation of value on signed opportunities
* Quality and governance of pricing models, submissions and supporting artefacts
* On-time delivery of pricing inputs for bids and proposals
* Effective transition of pricing assumptions and guardrails into business-as-usual execution

**Who You Are**

description:

* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3000 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EYP practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. title: Finance Executive
description:
Numbers tell the story of a business — and at Aistra, we want someone who can own that story end to end. We're hiring a Finance Executive to run the daily engine of our finance function: the invoices, the reconciliations, the closings, the compliance — all of it, done right and done on time. If you like clean books, sharp deadlines, and being the person people trust to have the numbers straight, this is your seat.

**What You'll Own**

* Day-to-day accounting — journal entries, transaction records, expense claim reviews, and audit-ready documentation.
* Finance operations — monitoring finance mailboxes and queries and keeping finance trackers current.
* Accounts payable & vendor management — invoice processing and review, payment approvals, initiating payments through the banking platform, and resolving vendor queries.
* Accounts receivable & billing — updating client contract trackers, raising sales invoices, preparing ageing reports, and following up on overdue balances.
* Banking, treasury & cash — daily cash position reports, bank reconciliations against the general ledger, and a rolling 3-month cash flow forecast.
* Payroll — monthly processing and disbursements, payroll accounting entries, tax declaration collection, and Form 16 support.
* Month-end close & reporting — P&L, Balance Sheet, intercompany reconciliations, and resolving unusual balances before books close.
* Tax & statutory compliance — GST return preparation and filing, timely TDS payments, and coordinating with auditors and consultants on FEMA and transfer pricing filings.
* Controls & documentation — approval workflows, the IT/asset register, and spotting opportunities to automate routine work.

**What You Bring**

* A degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance. Qualified CA/ CPA will be preferred.
* 3–5 years in a hands-on finance role covering accounting, AP/AR, banking, reconciliations, and month-end closing.
* Solid grip on GST, TDS, Softex, and other applicable statutory compliances.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles and bookkeeping, including P&L, Balance Sheet, and cash flow.
* Working knowledge of Excel and hands-on experience with Zoho Books or a similar ERP/accounting platform.
* Sharp attention to detail, strong ownership, and the discipline to hit deadlines without being chased.
* Good analytical and problem-solving instincts, with the confidence to flag issues before they become problems.
* A collaborative streak — you'll work closely with vendors, clients, banks, auditors, and internal teams.
* Comfort managing multiple priorities independently in a fast-paced, deadline-driven environment.
* High integrity and discretion when handling confidential financial information.

**Why Aistra**

You'll get real ownership from day one, direct cross-border exposure across our India, US, and UK entities, and a team that values precision as much as pace. It's a role with room to grow — as you build a track record here, there's a clear path toward more senior finance and reporting responsibilities. If you want your work to matter and your numbers to be the ones the business runs on — let's talk.

title: Senior Analyst - Lease Accounting
description:
**Job Description**

**Role Summary**

The R2R Senior Analyst – Lease is accountable for technical judgement and policy guidance across lease accounting under IFRS 16 / ASC 842, acting as a quality checkpoint between lease preparation and tower-level close governance.

This role ensures that:

* Lease master data, ROU asset & lease liability accounting, remeasurements/modifications, and tool-to-GL reconciliations are

* Complete

* Accurate

* Independently supported

* SOX / IPE compliant

The role owns resolution of non-standard and complex lease cases, ensures consistent interpretation of SOP 10.3.x, and drives disciplined ageing closure, evidence sufficiency, and exception resolution.

**Role Purpose**

To ensure accurate, compliant, and defensible lease accounting outcomes by:

* Acting as the technical SME for lease accounting and policy interpretation

* Resolving complex lease scenarios and judgement-heavy cases

* Driving cross-tower alignment and audit readiness

* Strengthening controls, governance, and consistency across entities

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Technical Accounting & Policy Interpretation

* Own interpretation and application of IFRS 16 / ASC 842 standards

* Provide guidance on:

* Lease classification and recognition

* ROU asset and lease liability accounting

* Discount rates and assumptions

* Ensure consistent application of lease accounting policies across entities

2. Complex Case Resolution & Judgement

* Resolve non-standard and complex lease accounting scenarios, including:

* Lease modifications and remeasurements

* Contract interpretation issues

* System or accounting discrepancies

* Provide defensible accounting conclusions with documented rationale and evidence

3. Certification & Control Gatekeeping

* Certify lease accounting outputs, including:

* ROU asset and liability balances

* Amortization and interest postings

* Lease tool-to-GL reconciliations

* Ensure:

* Compliance with SOX / IPE standards

* Adherence to maker-checker discipline

* Audit-ready documentation prior to close

4. Exception Handling & Close Governance

* Drive exception resolution and break management

* Perform and enforce:

* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)

* Ageing closure discipline

* Ensure timely escalation of:

* High-risk items

* Systemic issues

* Support close governance and risk management

5. Cross-Tower Alignment & Integration

* Collaborate with:

* Fixed Assets (FA)

* IDSW

* Intercompany (IC)

* Ensure consistency in:

* Accounting treatment

* Data flows and integration

* Resolve cross-functional dependencies impacting lease accounting

6. Controls, Compliance & Audit Readiness

* Ensure compliance with:

* SOX / ICFR controls

* IPE evidence standards

* Maintain audit-ready documentation, approvals, and evidence trails

* Support internal and external audits, including:

* Lease accounting validation

* Policy interpretation discussions

7. Documentation & Technical Positioning

* Prepare technical accounting memos and judgement documentation

* Ensure traceability of:

* Accounting decisions

* Approvals

* Supporting evidence

* Maintain consistency across:

* Regions

* Entities

* Reporting outputs

8. Continuous Improvement & Standardization

* Reduce repeat issues through:

* Standardized policy interpretations

* Preventive guidance

* Clear escalation frameworks

* Improve:

* Documentation quality

* Process consistency

* Control effectiveness

9. Stakeholder Collaboration

* Work with:

* Lease Tower Lead / Reviewer

* Controllers / Regional Finance teams

* Real Estate / Contract owners

* Compliance & Controls teams

* Fin-Tech / Systems teams

* Cross-tower SMEs (FA, IDSW, IC)

* Provide technical guidance and resolution support

Top Skills for Success

* Lease accounting expertise (IFRS 16 / ASC 842)

* Technical accounting judgement and policy interpretation

* Remeasurements and modification accounting

* Controls, Compliance & Audit (SOX / ICFR / IPE)

* Problem solving (RCA / CAPA)

* Reconciliation quality and exception handling

* ERP and lease systems (SAP, lease tools, OneStream)
* Cross-functional collaboration

Key Outcomes / Success Measures

* Audit-ready lease controls with certified reconciliations and traceable evidence

* Predictable lease close with:

* Disciplined ageing

* Clear resolution tracking

* Reduced repeat exceptions

* Consistent technical judgement aligned to IFRS 16 / ASC 842 standards

* Faster resolution of complex cases with:

* Documented rationale

* Cross-tower alignment

Tools & Systems

* Lease Accounting Tool (ROU / liability calculations, remeasurements) — High

* SAP GL (postings, extracts, reporting) — High

* OneStream (reconciliation submission / certification, if applicable) — Medium–High

* Microsoft Excel (amortization schedules, remeasurement models, tie-outs) — High

* Contract repositories / master data systems — Medium–High

* Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or related field

* CA / CPA / ACCA (preferred or in progress)

* 5–8 years of experience in R2R / Lease Accounting / Financial Accounting

* Strong expertise in:

* Lease accounting standards (IFRS 16 / ASC 842)

* Complex accounting scenarios and policy interpretation

* Experience with:

* ERP systems (SAP)

* Lease accounting tools (preferred)

* Strong analytical and technical accounting skills

**Additional Information**

**Our Benefits**

* Volunteer time off
* LinkedIn Learning

**The Role**

As a Lead, you will work with US healthcare payer clients to identify opportunities that reduce medical and administrative costs, improve payment accuracy, and strengthen operational performance. You will help clients understand business issues, dig into the data, and develop recommendations that can be put into action. We are looking for someone who is comfortable going deep on unfamiliar payer topics, knows how to research quickly and thoughtfully, and can connect the dots across claims, operations, reimbursement, and client priorities.

* Research payer topics, industry trends, regulations, operating models, and client-specific business issues.
* Review and analyze medical, eligibility, provider, pricing, reimbursement, and other healthcare data to find trends, issues, and opportunities.
* Use SQL and other tools to work through large datasets and evaluate utilization, cost drivers, reimbursement patterns, payment accuracy, and operational performance.
* Check data quality, test assumptions, document the logic behind the analysis, and make sure the work can stand up to client review.
* Develop recommendations, business cases, and implementation plans tied to cost savings, process improvement, medical cost management, and operational efficiency.
* Build practical points of view on payer topics such as claims, provider networks, reimbursement, payment integrity, utilization management, prior authorization, medical management and payer operations.
* Take loosely defined problems and turn them into a clear workplan by identifying the right questions, data sources, research sources, and decision points.
* Create presentations, summaries, dashboards, and reports that clearly explain what the analysis shows and what actions the client should consider.
* Lead workstreams, manage day-to-day analysis, and coordinate with client stakeholders, vendors, and internal AArete teams.
* Explain technical findings in plain business language during client meetings and internal working sessions.
* Identify related client needs and bring them to leadership when additional AArete support may be useful.
* Bring sound judgment, ownership, curiosity, and a hands-on problem-solving mindset to each engagement.
* Other duties as assigned

**Requirements**

* 10+ years of experience in healthcare analytics, payer operations, claims analytics, healthcare operations, or a similar client-facing role.
* Bachelor’s degree required, or equivalent experience.
* Strong understanding of healthcare claims data, health plan data, payer processes, provider data, reimbursement concepts, and claims data structures.
* Good SQL skills and experience working with large datasets. Experience with Snowflake, Excel, or similar tools is helpful.
* Advanced Excel with the ability to create clean, client-ready analysis.
* Strong analytical skills and the ability to move from data to insights, recommendations, and business cases.
* Excellent research skills, including the ability to learn unfamiliar payer topics, evaluate sources, pull out what matters, and explain the business implications clearly.
* Ability to contribute across a broad payer agenda, including claims, benefits, provider data, contracting, reimbursement, payment integrity, medical cost management, utilization management, prior authorization, risk adjustment, quality, Stars, member/provider experience, and operational transformation.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to explain complex analysis to both business and client audiences.
* Comfort working in fast-moving project environments with internal teams, clients, and vendors.
* High ownership, curiosity, accountability, and openness to feedback.

**Preferred Requirements**

* Direct payer experience is strongly preferred.
* Experience with claims analytics and/or network analytics, including payer/provider contracts, reimbursement language, and common contract terms.
* Exposure to medical management, utilization management, prior authorization, clinical operations, or related payer/provider functions.
* Experience with healthcare platforms such as provider data management systems, claims adjudication systems
* Familiarity with healthcare coding systems, including CPT, HCPCS, ICD, DRG, and APC.
* Strong knowledge of Medicare and Medicaid policies, regulations, and operating considerations.

Job Summary:
  
We are looking for a sharp, proactive Finance & Operations Executive to run the day-to-day engine of our business. In this role, you will keep the machine moving—managing books, vendor pipelines, field executive support, and compliance—so leadership can focus on high-stakes strategic work.

Finance & Accounting (:60%)

Taxation & Audit Support: Assist senior leadership with GST filings, TDS processing, and year-end audit preparation (assisting role, not ownership).

Vendor Onboarding: Manage vendor communications, documentation, and onboarding paperwork.
  
Petty Cash & Logistics: Oversee petty cash registers and coordinate end-to-end travel logistics and reimbursements.

General Office Ops: Address ad-hoc operational bottlenecks to keep the office and team running smoothly.

Qualified: Educational background in B.Com, M.Com, or Inter-CA.

Prior experience in a fast-paced startup or SME environment.
  
Prior exposure to basic GST and TDS compliance.

* Provide end-to-end support for Finance and Accounting around the card to account product.

* Payment reconciliation
* Requests for expense account funding
* Manage bank queries
* Journal entry support
* Reconciliation of Cash/AR/AP
* Review of unreconciled transactions
* Exception management over bank activity
* Ensure accurate and timely reporting (domestic and foreign) in accordance with regulatory requirements.
* Facilitate inquiries from internal and external stakeholders
* Lead and support requirements during examinations, as required.
* Support enhancements of internal controls set-up and on-going management
* Complete special projects and other duties as needed.

* Manage the statutory audit process, ensuring timely and successful closure, and addressing audit queries and recommendations.
* Work closely with controllership and finance teams to implement audit findings and recommendations.
* Drive process improvements based on audit insights to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.
* Foster effective communication and collaboration with regional finance teams to understand local statutory nuances.

* Build and lead a high-performing Statutory COE team, providing mentorship and guidance.

* Proven track record of successfully managing and closing statutory audits for complex entities.
* Hands on experience with AI tools/ AI enabled transformation preferred.
* Excellent leadership and team management skills with the ability to inspire and guide a diverse team.
* Exceptional communication skills with the ability to interact effectively with auditors, cross-functional teams, and leadership.

* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.
