title: Services Support Engineer
description:
**ETAP empowers customers to make informed decisions throughout the life cycle of their projects with innovative software solutions for electrical systems. By applying ETAP solutions, customers experience continuous intelligence during design and engineering and into operations and maintenance using a unified electrical digital twin platform. ETAP supports customers in their digital transformation and sustainable energy transitions for a green and smart future, helping them to prioritize safety, maximize reliability, and stay resilient.**
**Our employees' passion for excellence, innovation, and customer satisfaction is our most-prized resource. If you share that passion — and want to be part of a company that leads the energy transition towards a cleaner and more resilient world for future generations — we invite you to join us!**
**ETAP is committed to creating a diverse work environment and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer.**
**Job Description – Services Support Engineer**
**Location:**
ETAP – Delhi, India
  
  
**Employment Type:**
Full-time
  
  
**Experience:**
2–5 years preferred
  
  
**Initial Deployment:**
Bokaro Steel Limited (BSL)
  
  
**Job Summary**
ETAP is seeking a skilled Services Support Engineer to support SCADA, DMS/ADMS, RTU, industrial automation, and power system automation activities. The role involves system engineering, configuration, maintenance, troubleshooting, integration, testing, commissioning, and customer support.
  
  
The selected candidate will initially be deployed at Bokaro Steel Limited (BSL) for SCADA and RTU Annual Maintenance Contract (AMC) activities. Based on business requirements, the engineer may subsequently support other AMC sites and SCADA/automation projects across India or other locations.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintain and troubleshoot SCADA servers, applications, databases, workstations, ABB RTUs, and associated infrastructure.
* Configure, test, and troubleshoot RTU/PLC communication with IEDs, numerical relays, meters, and field devices.
* Diagnose communication failures, missing or stale data, alarms, events, and DI/DO/command/AI signal issues.
* Work with IEC 60870-5-104, Modbus TCP/IP, and other relevant substation communication protocols.
* Maintain industrial Ethernet networks, managed Layer 2/Layer 3 switches, routers, VLANs, and related OT connectivity.
* Perform SCADA database configuration, tag mapping, HMI/SLD updates, system integration, and feeder/substation integration.
* Support installation, testing, commissioning, FAT/SAT, and troubleshooting of SCADA/DMS/ADMS and automation systems.
* Maintain configuration backups, conduct preventive maintenance, and implement approved software and configuration changes.
* Prepare maintenance reports, technical documentation, test procedures, configuration logs, and root cause analysis (RCA) reports.
* Coordinate with customers, internal engineering teams, site managers, and OEMs to resolve technical issues.

**Essential Skills And Qualifications**

* Diploma or bachelor’s degree in electrical, Electronics and Communication, Instrumentation, Automation, Computer Science, or Information Technology Engineering.
* Relevant experience in SCADA, RTU/PLC, industrial automation, or power system automation.
* Working knowledge of RTU/PLC systems, IEC 60870-5-104, DNP3, IEC 61850, Modbus TCP/IP, TCP/IP networking, and managed Ethernet switches.
* Understanding of SCADA databases, signal configuration, Windows Server, and system backup procedures.
* Basic understanding of electrical substations, power systems, protection relays, and field communication.
* Good troubleshooting, analytical, documentation, and customer communication skills.

**Preferred Skills**

* Experience with SCADA/DMS/ADMS projects, commissioning, and substation automation.
* Knowledge of IEC 60870-5-101, IEC 61850, OPC, SQL/MongoDB, and historian systems.
* Familiarity with Python, C#, PowerShell, Wireshark, VLANs, and industrial network security.
* Knowledge of NMS, SAN/storage, fibre-optic communication, and GPS/NTP time synchronization.
* CCNA or other relevant technical certifications will be an advantage.

**Other Requirements**

* Willingness to work initially at BSL, Bokaro, and travel to other customer sites as required.
* Ability to work independently with minimal supervision while following site lead instructions.
* Flexibility to support commissioning, planned maintenance, and critical breakdowns outside normal working hours when required.

Career Opportunity
  
  
The role offers exposure to SCADA maintenance, power automation, system integration, engineering, testing, and commissioning, enabling long-term technical growth within ETAP.
  
  
**ETAP requires all successful applicants to undergo and pass a comprehensive background check before they start employment. Background checks will be conducted in accordance with local laws and may, subject to those laws, include proof of educational attainment, employment history verification, proof of work authorization, criminal records, identity verification, credit check. Certain positions dealing with sensitive and/or third party personal data may involve additional background check criteria.**
**ETAP is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We are committed to being an exemplary employer with an inclusive culture, developing a workplace environment where all our employees are treated with dignity and respect. We value diversity and the expertise that people from different backgrounds bring to our business.**
**Come and join ETAP to create the transformative technology that enables our customers to engineer a better world.**

The Command Center provides end-to-end support to a worldwide customer base, requiring high technical expertise to remain fully self-sufficient.

* Drive customer satisfaction by delivering high-quality support.

* Support integrations with Cloud Service Providers (Genesys, Microsoft, etc.).

**Qualifications**
**EXPERIENCE**

* Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Data Communications, Engineering, or equivalent.
* 2+ years of operational experience in a 24x7 environment.
* Certifications: CCNA/CCNP Collaboration, Networking (preferred).
* Strong knowledge of Cisco ISR G2/G3 VG/CUBE.
* Good knowledge of SIP, H.323, MGCP, SCCP, ISDN.
* Experience with VMware ESXi and Cisco UCS-C servers.
* Good knowledge of Genesys Cloud, Microsoft voice services, and Cisco Unified Communications.
* Knowledge of Cisco switches, routers, and firewalls.
* Basic to intermediate knowledge of Linux SSH, SFTP, TFTP, FTP, DHCP, NTP.
* ITIL framework knowledge and operational best practices.
* Strong customer-focused attitude, problem-solving, and root cause identification skills.
* Excellent communication skills at all levels, both internally and externally.
* Team-oriented with the ability to influence and drive common goals.

title: Senior Network Infrastructure Engineer
description:

* Strong background of Mellanox/Cumulus OS.
* Working knowledge of Infiniband technology.
* Skilled in Unix/Linux system administration, with the ability to write and understand Python/Shell scripts to enhance productivity in hyperscale environments.
* Familiarity with leveraging tools such as Netbox/Nautobot, Prometheus, Grafana, Panoptes to monitor and manage a global network.
* Passionate about innovating and investing in ground breaking technologies.

NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hard-working people in the world working for us. Are you creative and autonomous? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you.

title: Zoho CRM & Integration Specialist
description:

Location: Janakpuri, New Delhi

We are looking for a technically proficient CRM professional who can independently implement, integrate, automate, and troubleshoot business systems. The ideal candidate must have hands-on experience connecting CRM platforms with lead-generation sources, WhatsApp, dialers, telephony systems, and other business applications.

This is not a basic CRM data-entry, CRM administration, or campaign-execution role. We need someone who understands integrations at a technical level and can diagnose and resolve real-world issues.

* Building customer-matching logic using mobile numbers, email addresses, or unique customer IDs.

2. Dialer & Telephony Integration — Mandatory

* Hands-on experience integrating CRM with dialers or telephony platforms.

title: Technical Account Engineer I
description:
**Technical Account Engineer - I**

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

**About the Role**

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

**What You Will Actually Do**

* **Own your named accounts technically.**
  Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.
* **Get customers using the platform extensively.**
  Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.
* **Craft success plans that can be measured.**
  Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.
* **See trouble coming.**
  Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.
* **Run the cadence.**
  Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.
* **Help the accounts grow.**
  Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.
* **Make the team better.**
  Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

**Where and When**

* This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.
* Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.
* You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

**What You Will Bring**

* 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.
* Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.
* Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).
* SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.
* A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.
* Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.
* A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.
* A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

**The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See**

* Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).
* A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.
* Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.
* Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.
* Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.
* Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.
* Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

At SimCorp, delivering reliable and high-quality services is essential to maintaining the trust of our clients and supporting their critical business operations.
  
  
As a Service Delivery Consultant, you will be part of a global service delivery environment responsible for supporting business-critical applications and ensuring smooth day-to-day production operations. You will play an important role in monitoring services, responding to alerts and client requests, troubleshooting production issues, and working with internal teams to restore and improve services.
  
  
This role provides an opportunity to combine technical problem-solving, service management and client communication while working with colleagues and clients across different geographies. Experience within banking, financial services or capital markets will be an advantage.
  
  
**What You Will Be Responsible For**

* Monitor production applications, emails, system alerts, service requests and support tickets, ensuring timely investigation and follow-up
* Troubleshoot and resolve application and production support issues, escalating to relevant technical or functional teams when required
* Use PL/SQL for troubleshooting, data analysis and investigation of application-related issues.
* Develop, maintain or execute PowerShell scripts to support operational activities, monitoring and process automation.
* Support service delivery activities in line with agreed SLAs and service management processes.
* Work within an ITIL-based service management environment, including areas such as Incident, Problem, Change and Service Request Management.
* Collaborate with internal technical, functional and infrastructure teams to investigate and resolve production issues.
* Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders regarding incidents, service requests, progress and resolution.
* Maintain accurate documentation, support records, operational procedures and client-facing information.
* Review recurring operational issues and contribute to root-cause analysis and continuous service improvement.
* Participate in client and internal service meetings, provide operational updates and follow up on agreed actions.
* Support implementation of service improvements, application changes and new or enhanced services.
* Work effectively in a global delivery environment, collaborating with teams and stakeholders across multiple geographies.

**What We Value**
We are looking for someone who combines a production-support mindset, technical capability and strong communication skills.
  
  
**Technical And Service Capabilities**

* Hands-on experience with PL/SQL, including the ability to investigate and troubleshoot application/data-related issues.
* Experience with PowerShell scripting for operational support or automation.
* Practical understanding of production/application support, including monitoring, incident investigation, service requests and ticket management.
* Understanding of ITIL principles and service management processes. ITIL certification is beneficial but not mandatory.
* Experience supporting business-critical applications in a production environment.
* Experience with monitoring and ticketing/service-management tools is an advantage.

**Business And Industry Experience**

* Previous experience in banking applications or financial services technology is highly desirable.
* Exposure to capital markets, investment management or financial services would be an advantage.
* Experience working within large IT/service organizations, consulting firms or similar global delivery environments is valuable.
* Experience supporting clients or teams across multiple countries or geographies is preferred.

**Personal qualities**

* Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to communicate technical issues clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills with a structured approach to problem solving.
* A strong customer and service-oriented mindset.
* Ability to take ownership of issues and drive them toward resolution while involving the appropriate teams when necessary.
* Comfortable working collaboratively within a global and multicultural environment.
* Proactive approach to identifying recurring issues and opportunities to improve service quality and operational efficiency.

**Other Requirements**

* Flexibility to work in rotational shifts (6AM-3 PM IST & 2-11 PM IST)
* Willing to work on weekends and holidays
* Hybrid working arrangements (at least 2x a week in the office)

**Benefits**

* Global hybrid work policy - We ask you to work 2 days a week from the office. If you choose you can work remotely the other days. Of course, you are welcome at the office if that is your preference.
* Culture – Inclusive and diverse company culture.
* Work-life balance – We believe that an equilibrium between professional responsibilities makes us all the best version of ourselves, both in private life and as colleagues in the workplace.
* Empowerment – We believe that all voices are valuable and must be heard. You will be involved in shaping our work processes.
* Career & Growth – Simcorp does offer opportunities for professional development: there is never just only one route - we offer an individual approach to professional development to support the direction you want to take.

**NEXT STEPS**
Please send us your application in English via our career site as soon as possible, we process incoming applications continually. Please note that only applications sent through our system will be processed. At SimCorp, we recognize that bias can unintentionally occur in the recruitment process. To uphold fairness and equal opportunities for all applicants, we kindly ask you to exclude personal data such as photos, age, or any non-professional information from your application. Thank you for aiding us in our endeavor to mitigate biases in our recruitment process.

For over 50 years, we have worked closely with investment and asset managers to become the world’s leading provider of integrated investment management solutions. We are 3,000+ colleagues with a broad range of nationalities, education, professional experiences, ages, and backgrounds.

title: Sr IO Engineering Consultant - SCCM or MECM Admin and MS Intune
description:
Optum is a global organization that delivers care, aided by technology to help millions of people live healthier lives. The work you do with our team will directly improve health outcomes by connecting people with the care, pharmacy benefits, data and resources they need to feel their best. Here, you will find a culture guided by inclusion, talented peers, comprehensive benefits and career development opportunities. Come make an impact on the communities we serve as you help us advance health optimization on a global scale. Join us to start
**Caring. Connecting. Growing together.**
As an I&O Engineering Consultant or Senior I O Engineering Consultant, you will deliver reliable and secure device management services in a Dual UEM environment built on Microsoft Endpoint Configuration Manager (MECM/SCCM) and Microsoft Intune. You will own day-to-day endpoint engineering and operational outcomes such as OS and patch compliance, client health, vulnerability remediation, and endpoint configuration. The role is execution-focused with solid troubleshooting depth and disciplined ITSM practices utilizing both on-premise server infrastructure as well as cloud services through Microsoft Entra. As necessary, you will routinely participate in major incident bridges/war rooms, ensuring service restoration within agreed SLAs and contributing to measurable MTTR reduction. You will also contribute to AI adoption by proposing and piloting practical ideations (e.g., ticket triage assist, automated log parsing, runbook generation) to improve reliability, speed, and user experience, while adhering to organizational security, privacy, and data handling standards.
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities**

* Patching, Vulnerability Remediation & Compliance

+ Operate software update and patching operations via SCCM (ADRs, maintenance windows, deployment schedules, compliance reporting) and coordinate exception handling
+ Track and improve patch compliance posture across the endpoint estate; identify and remediate non-compliant devices; support compliance dashboards and executive reporting
+ Drive client health compliance. Monitor and remediate endpoint SCCM/Intune client health, enrollment success, policy/app deployment success, and content distribution health

* Platform Engineering & Operations, Application Support

+ Administer SCCM components (collections, boundaries, deployments, content distribution, client health monitoring, reporting)
+ Administer Intune capabilities (enrollment, configuration profiles, compliance policies, app assignments, RBAC) and support coexistence with SCCM
+ Monitor platform health and availability: enrollment success, policy/app success rates, client health, content distribution health, and remediation backlogs
+ Drive device inventory accuracy and operational hygiene; perform routine health checks and standard validations

* Application Lifecycle, OS Servicing & Operations

+ Support SCCM OS deployment and servicing (OSD, Task Sequences, feature updates, in-place upgrades), driver/BIOS packaging coordination, and rollback plans
+ Execute post-deployment validation and remediation for failed installs, policy conflicts, and provisioning issues

* Troubleshooting, ITSM & War Rooms

+ Troubleshoot endpoint deployment and client issues using logs and diagnostics (e.g., AppEnforce/AppDiscovery, WUAHandler, CAS, CCMExec)
+ Work within ITSM processes (Incident/Problem/Change) including change documentation, risk assessment, and post-change validation
+ Participate in major incident war rooms/bridges; provide technical inputs, implement mitigations, and document restoration actions
+ Track and drive SLA adherence; contribute to MTTR reduction via faster triage, known error documentation, and repeat-incident prevention

* Automation & AI Adoption / Ideation

+ Create and maintain PowerShell-based operational automations (health checks, compliance reporting, remediation scripts)
+ Propose AI-assisted improvements (e.g., Copilot-assisted draft runbooks, KB articles, ticket summarization, and log pattern identification)
+ Pilot small-scale AI/automation ideations with measurable success criteria (time saved, reduced rework, improved compliance)
+ Ensure AI usage adheres to organizational security, privacy, and data handling policies (no sensitive data leakage)
+ Leverage enterprise-approved AI tools to enhance productivity and innovation by streamlining workflows and automating repetitive tasks. Evaluate emerging trends to drive continuous improvement and strategic innovation.

* Comply with the terms and conditions of the employment contract, company policies and procedures, and any and all directives (such as, but not limited to, transfer and/or re-assignment to different work locations, change in teams and/or work shifts, policies in regards to flexibility of work benefits and/or work environment, alternative work arrangements, and other decisions that may arise due to the changing business environment). The Company may adopt, vary or rescind these policies and directives in its absolute discretion and without any limitation (implied or otherwise) on its ability to do so

**Required Qualifications**

* 6+ years of hands-on administrative experience using SCCM
* 3+ years of hands-on administrative experience using Intune
* Operations, Health and Availability experience

+ Health monitoring and remediation: client health, enrollment success, policy/app deployment success, content distribution health
+ Service reliability ownership: stability, availability, and operational hygiene

* Patching and Vulnerability Operations experience

+ MECM patching operations: ADRs, deployment rings, maintenance windows, compliance reporting
+ Vulnerability remediation support: execute remediation plans and validate compliance within required timelines

* Automation and Scripting experience

+ PowerShell scripting for automation and remediation; familiarity with scheduled tasks and basic safe rollout practices
+ Ability to create repeatable runbooks and operational checklists

* ITSM and Operational Excellence

+ Experience working in war rooms and providing concise technical updates for rapid restoration
+ Working knowledge of Incident/Problem/Change management; ability to write clear change plans and validation steps
+ Ownership mindset for SLA adherence and MTTR reduction

* Proven Core Technical Skills (Primary)

+ Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM: 1+ years; administrative depth (profiles, Smart Groups, app distribution, compliance policies, device troubleshooting)
+ MECM/SCCM: application model, collections, deployments, boundaries, content distribution, client health, reporting
+ Microsoft Intune: enrollment methods, configuration/compliance policies, Win32 app deployment, troubleshooting, RBAC
+ Dual UEM operations: support coexistence, minimize policy conflicts, and ensure consistent end-user experience

* Proven AI Adoption and Continuous Improvement

+ Comfort using approved AI tools to accelerate documentation, analysis, and knowledge management
+ Ability to identify repetitive tasks suitable for automation or AI assistance and propose improvements

* Solid understanding of packaging and deployment of applications (MSI/EXE/MSIX/Win32) using SCCM/Intune using detection methods, dependencies, supersedence, and phased ring deployments

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering/Computer Science or equivalent experience
* ITIL Foundation, Microsoft endpoint-related certifications, Workspace ONE training/certification
* 2+ years of hands-on administrative experience with Omnissa Workspace ONE UEM (formerly AirWatch)

**Success Measures**

* Endpoint platform health and availability maintained with sustained reduction in unhealthy clients/devices
* Patch compliance and vulnerability remediation achieved within agreed windows; improved deployment success rates
* Reduced repeat incidents through better RCA documentation, known error articles, and proactive remediation

**Job Summary**
The DLP Security Analyst will support the day-to-day operation, administration, and enhancement of the enterprise Data Loss Prevention (DLP) environment. Working under the guidance of senior team members, the role will assist with monitoring alerts, troubleshooting technical issues, maintaining policies and workflows, coordinating with vendors, and preparing clear operational documentation. * Monitor DLP alerts, perform initial analysis, document findings, and escalate incidents in accordance with established procedures.

* Support incident response activities by collecting relevant information, following escalation paths, and coordinating with appropriate teams.
* Maintain accurate operational documentation, including standard operating procedures, troubleshooting guides, policy records, and activity reports.
* Communicate clearly with technical teams, business stakeholders, and vendors, and provide timely updates on issues, changes, and assigned activities.
* Use approved AI-enabled tools responsibly to support analysis, documentation, knowledge management, and process improvement while following security and data-handling requirements.

* Understanding of DLP concepts, information security principles, and incident handling.
* Familiarity with DLP administration activities such as alert monitoring, policy configuration, troubleshooting, upgrades, patching, and reporting.
* Develop and fine-tune policies, rules, exceptions, and automated workflows.
* Familiar with DSPM (Data Security Posture Management) concepts.
* Hands-on experience with DLP and DSPM tools, particularly Forcepoint DLP and Varonis DSPM, will be considered an advantage.
* Familiarity with practical uses of AI and automation in DLP operations, documentation, and process improvement.

Bachelor’s degree in computer science, Information Systems, Cybersecurity, Engineering, or a related field.

3–5 years of relevant experience in DLP, IT security operations, security monitoring, or technical support, with practical exposure to administering and supporting enterprise security technologies.

Entry-level certifications such as CompTIA Security+, Microsoft Security fundamentals, Microsoft SC - 400 or an equivalent information security certification are desirable but not mandatory.

The **Change & Incident Management – ServiceDesk Plus L2** resource serves as the **central governance authority** for managing the end-to-end IT change and incident management lifecycle within the organization's ITSM framework, leveraging the **ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus** platform.

The primary objective of this role is to **govern, control, and optimize** all changes to IT systems, infrastructure, and services — ensuring every change is implemented in a controlled, risk-mitigated, and business-aligned manner. The individual acts as the **Single Point of Contact (SPOC)** for all RFCs (Requests for Change), responsible for evaluating impact, prioritizing changes, and driving structured decision-making through **CAB (Change Advisory Board)** governance — with the ultimate goal of minimizing service disruption, reducing operational risk, and ensuring full compliance with **ITIL-aligned processes**.

**What you will do:**

* **Standardization & Enforcement** — Develops, implements, and enforces change management plans and processes consistently across the organization for all system updates, infrastructure changes, and new process rollouts.
* **Stakeholder Coordination & Communication** — Acts as the bridge between technical teams, business units, and stakeholders to evaluate, approve, schedule, and communicate changes transparently throughout the change lifecycle.
* **Risk Assessment & Mitigation** — Proactively identifies and assesses risks associated with proposed changes and formulates mitigation strategies to protect service continuity.
* **Documentation, Tracking & Audit Readiness** — Maintains accurate and complete records of all change requests, approvals, and outcomes within **ManageEngine ServiceDesk Plus**, ensuring the organization remains audit-ready at all times.
* **Post-Change Review & Continuous Improvement** — Evaluates the success of changes post-implementation, analyzes outcomes, and recommends process refinements to enhance efficiency and minimize future disruptions.
* **Cross-Functional Collaboration** — Collaboration is a core component of this role. The Change Manager (L2) works closely with **L1** (providing guidance and oversight), **L3** (for escalation of complex changes and incidents), application owners, infrastructure teams, and vendors to ensure seamless execution, coordination, and resolution across all change and incident activities.

In the **incident management** capacity, the role additionally supports rapid identification, escalation, and resolution of IT incidents, ensuring service continuity in alignment with defined SLAs.

**The Change Manager (L2) ultimately ensures that every IT change delivers measurable business value while maintaining system stability, operational efficiency, and regulatory compliance — making it a critical governance and service delivery function within the IT infrastructure organization**

) involves providing clinical training, application support, and subject matter expertise to customers, both on-site and remotely.
  
  
The Radiation Therapist will ensure safe and effective use of Varian technologies, enabling customers to optimize clinical workflows and leverage the full capabilities of our advanced solutions to meet their operational and patient care goals.
  
  
**Major Responsibilities**

* Train, counsel, and support customers in adapting their work procedures and propose new approaches following the installation or implementation of new or upgraded products.
* Develop tailored training programs for customers on the appropriate use of Varian hardware and software products.
* Deliver high-quality on-site or remote training to customers, instructing them on newly installed products, upgrades to existing systems, or other product developments.
* Provide application support for internal product testing activities and participate in ‘Customer Satisfaction Phase’ testing as needed.
* Offer occasional application support for Education, Sales, or Marketing teams, such as Clinical School assistance or customer demonstration support.
* Provide demonstration support at local, regional, and national customer trade events as required.
* Support and participate in the internal training of colleagues when necessary.
* Maintain up-to-date records and handle day-to-day administrative tasks, including timesheets, expense reports, and training reports (as applicable), to ensure accurate and current company data on customer-oriented activities.
* Continuously maintain competencies and complete organizational training in a timely manner, such as Learn4U certifications, internal or external training courses, or on-site hospital visits.
* Attend Health & Safety training to acquire and maintain a strong understanding of national laws and organizational regulations related to workplace health and safety, with a particular focus on travel safety, radiation safety, and electrical safety, and apply this knowledge systematically.

* Fluency in English (both spoken and written).
* Willingness to travel extensively within India, Bangladesh, Nepal, and Sri Lanka, including during normal and non-standard hours and days as required to provide optimal support.
* Excellent communication skills; teaching or training experience is a plus.
* 4–8 years of professional clinical experience in radiotherapy, with expertise in Varian Products, such as Oncology Information Systems (ARIA), SGRT, Motion Management and Treatment Delivery.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Windows and Office applications.
* Strong understanding of customers’ clinical needs and requirements.
* Exceptional communication and organizational skills, coupled with a mature and professional approach.
* In-depth knowledge of modern radiotherapy techniques and their underlying principles.
* Solid understanding of processes and methodologies related to Varian product areas, including product specification, development, expansion, security, and safety.
* High level of self-motivation and the ability to work independently with minimal supervision while maintaining effective collaboration with the broader team.
* Comfort with working within a horizontal organizational structure.
* Graduation (BSc) in Radiotherapy Technology or a Postgraduate Diploma in Radiotherapy Technology, with 4–8 years of relevant experience.

* Programming skills in SQL Database.
* Ability to interpret customer concerns and translate them into technical machine-related issues.
* Understanding of the escalation process and ability to effectively utilize it with Senior Application Specialists and Product Managers Basic knowledge of accelerator theory.
* Contribution to team efficiency through high-quality personal work and by positively influencing teammates to meet required standards.
* Strong understanding of team collaboration, paired with effective networking skills.
* Ability to work independently within established guidelines and policies while adhering to corporate procedures.
* Capability to manage workload independently, with excellent communication and relationship-building skills at all levels, both within and outside the organization.
* Agility in being proactive, analytical, results-oriented, and decisive within the scope of the role.
* Ability to actively problem-solve and propose realistic innovations to processes to enhance the customer experience.

title: Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer
description:
**Role Description**
**Position Overview**
We are seeking an experienced Server Patch & Vulnerability Remediation Engineer to join our centralized Patch Management team.
  
  
The successful candidate will be responsible for identifying, analyzing, prioritizing, and remediating security vulnerabilities across Windows and Unix server environments. This role requires strong operating system administration skills, hands-on experience with vulnerability remediation, knowledge of third-party and open-source software vulnerabilities, and the ability to develop, test, and deploy automated remediation solutions.
  
  
The engineer will work closely with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and software vendors to ensure vulnerabilities are addressed within established remediation timelines while maintaining system stability, availability, and compliance with organizational security standards. Key Responsibilities
**Required Qualifications**
**Preferred Qualifications**

* Windows and Unix Operating System Administration
* Strong hands-on experience administering Windows Server and Unix/Linux operating systems.
* Knowledge of Group Policy Objects (GPOs), shared file systems, user and access management, software installation, configuration, and system administration.
* Ability to troubleshoot operating system, application, and patch installation issues.
* Understanding of server dependencies, system services, permissions, and configurations that may affect patch deployment and remediation.
* Experience supporting enterprise server environments and performing security updates with minimal operational disruption.
* Vulnerability Analysis and Third-Party Software Remediation
* Experience investigating vulnerabilities identified through Software Composition Analysis (SCA), software scanning, and vulnerability assessment tools.
* Ability to analyze vulnerability findings affecting operating systems, third-party applications, open-source components, and installed software.
* Knowledge of software installation paths, package dependencies, vulnerable libraries, application versions, and other factors required to determine the root cause of vulnerabilities.
* Ability to identify appropriate remediation options, including vendor patches, software upgrades, configuration changes, component replacement, or removal of vulnerable software.
* Experience coordinating with software vendors, opening support cases, reviewing release notes, validating remediation recommendations, and implementing tested solutions.
* Ability to develop remediation plans and coordinate with application and infrastructure owners to complete remediation within SLAs.
* Scripting, Automation, and BigFix
* Proficiency in scripting and automation using PowerShell, shell scripting, and other relevant automation technologies.
* Hands-on experience with BigFix or similar enterprise patch management platforms.
* Ability to develop, test, and maintain automation scripts for vulnerability remediation, patch deployment, software upgrades, and compliance validation.
* Experience automating repetitive operational activities to improve remediation efficiency, consistency, and scalability.
* Ability to troubleshoot failed deployments and automate post-remediation verification wherever feasible.
* Application Packaging and Software Deployment
* Knowledge of application packaging, software installation, configuration, and deployment processes is a plus.
* Experience preparing, testing, and deploying third-party and open-source software updates across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to analyze application installation requirements, dependencies, compatibility considerations, and potential operational impacts.
* Understanding of software versioning, package management, installation parameters, and silent installation techniques.
* Experience with BigFix or similar tools for software distribution and deployment is desirable.
* Vulnerability Remediation, Change Management, and Troubleshooting
* Experience executing security patching and vulnerability remediation activities across enterprise server environments.
* Ability to prioritize remediation based on vulnerability severity, exploitability, asset criticality, and organizational remediation timelines.
* Knowledge of change management processes, maintenance windows, implementation plans, rollback procedures, and post-deployment validation.
* Ability to investigate failed patches, installation errors, application compatibility issues, and other remediation blockers.
* Experience coordinating with application owners, infrastructure teams, security teams, and other stakeholders to resolve remediation challenges.
* Ability to maintain accurate remediation records, provide status updates, and support security compliance and audit reporting.
* Analyze vulnerability and software scanning findings affecting Windows and Unix/Linux servers.
* Investigate reported vulnerabilities to determine the affected software, installation locations, vulnerable components, and appropriate remediation approach.
* Develop and execute remediation plans for operating system, third-party, and open-source software vulnerabilities.
* Identify applicable vendor fixes, security updates, software upgrades, and alternative treatment options.
* Coordinate with software vendors and application owners to obtain remediation guidance and resolve technical dependencies.
* Test patches and software updates in non-production environments, validate results, and coordinate production deployment through approved change management processes.
* Develop and maintain PowerShell, shell, and BigFix automation to improve patch deployment and vulnerability remediation efficiency.
* Troubleshoot patch failures, software installation issues, compatibility problems, and post-deployment incidents.
* Perform post-remediation validation to confirm that vulnerabilities have been addressed and systems remain operational.
* Track remediation progress, maintain evidence, document exceptions and blockers, and provide accurate status updates to management and security stakeholders.
* Partner with infrastructure, application, security, and operations teams to meet remediation SLAs and maintain compliance with organizational security requirements.
* Identify opportunities to improve patching processes, automation, deployment reliability, and overall vulnerability remediation effectiveness.
* Relevant experience in Windows and Unix/Linux server administration, enterprise patch management, vulnerability remediation, or infrastructure operations.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
* Experience working in a large enterprise IT environment with established change management and security compliance requirements.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to coordinate effectively across technical teams and application stakeholders.
* Ability to manage multiple remediation activities and meet defined deadlines in a fast-paced operational environment.
* Hands-on experience with BigFix for patch management, software deployment, and automation.
* Experience with vulnerability assessment and Software Composition Analysis (SCA) tools such as Qualys or equivalent platforms.
* Knowledge of security advisories, CVEs, vulnerable software components, and vendor remediation guidance.
* Experience with application packaging and third-party software lifecycle management.
* Familiarity with enterprise vulnerability management processes, remediation SLAs, and security compliance requirements.

**Skills**
UNIX / Windows, Patch Management, Vulnerability Management

Our high-performance culture is driven by our values.  We move with
**speed**
,
**passion**
and
**purpose**
— as one team. We are bold in our ideas, accountable in our actions, and committed to doing the right things right. 
  
  
Our Senior Financial Analyst is a core member of a tight-knit FP&A team, reporting to the Manager, FP&A with direct exposure to the VP of FP&A and CFO on board materials, operating reviews, and strategic planning. You'll own a high-impact territory across COGS, Product & Engineering, Facilities, IT, & Information Security — leading budgeting and forecasting cycles, owning monthly variance analysis, and identifying the process improvements that scale with us. It's a role built for someone who wants the next step on the ladder: strong performers here grow into finance leadership.
  
  
The talent and drive of our team members are key to our continued success.
  
  
About NAVEX: We're the global leader in integrated risk and compliance management software, trusted by more than 10,000 customers — including most of the Fortune 1000 — to power their ethics hotlines, policy management, and risk programs. We're PE-backed, profitable, and investing aggressively in the next phase of growth.
  
  
**You’ll thrive in this hybrid role surrounded by an engaged, collaborative team deeply committed to your success.  Join us and help shape what’s next!**
**What you’ll get:**

* **Meaningful Purpose.**
   Your work helps organizations operate with integrity and protect their people—at a scale few companies can match.
* **High-Performance Environment.**
   We move with urgency, set ambitious goals, and expect excellence. You’ll be trusted with real ownership and supported to do the best work of your career.
* **Candid, Supportive Culture.**
  We communicate openly, challenge ideas—not people—and value teammates who embrace bold thinking and continuous improvement.
* **Growth That Matters.**
   You can count on authentic feedback, strong accountability, and leaders invested in your success so you can achieve real growth.
* **Rewards for Results.**
   We provide clear, competitive compensation designed to recognize measurable outcomes and real impact.

**What you’ll do:**

* Drive the financial story behind a high-impact FP&A territory — including COGS, Product & Engineering, IT, Information Security, & Facilities — owning budgeting, forecasting, and monthly analysis end-to-end
* Sit at the table with business leaders, translating their priorities into financial plans and pushing back where the numbers tell a different story
* Build the models that drive real decisions — driver-based forecasts, scenario analysis, ROI cases, and resource plans that shape where the company invests next
* Turn variance into action — connect actuals vs. budget into clear recommendations that change how the business operates, not just how it reports
* Move at the speed of the business during forecast, budget, and close cycles — Planful, NetSuite, and Excel are your toolkit for delivering answers with pace, urgency, and accuracy
* Get in front of senior leadership — author the financial narratives, risk/opportunity callouts, and operating review materials that the CFO and FP&A leadership take into board and executive forums
* Own CapEx strategy for R&D and technology investments — project-level analysis, forecast updates, and the cross-functional alignment that keeps spend tied to outcomes
* Upgrade the FP&A function itself — sharpen models, modernize reporting tools, and bring structure to a fast-moving environment where your improvements stick

**What you’ll bring:**

* A Bachelor’s degree in related field required
* 5+ years of Salesforce Administration experience
* Advanced Excel and strong financial modelling skills; experience with NetSuite, Planful, or similar planning / ERP tools is a plus
* Insatiable curiosity about the business behind the numbers, and the judgment to know which variances matter
* High ownership and pace — you prioritize ruthlessly, move work forward without being asked, and deliver with precision under tight timelines
* **Culture Agility.**
  Comfort working in a fast-paced, candid environment that values innovation, healthy debate, and follow-through
* **AI Readiness.**
  Curiosity and willingness to use AI and emerging technologies to elevate your work and deliver smarter outcomes
* **Fuel performance and outcomes.**
  Leverage your job competencies and champion NAVEX’s core values

**Our side of the deal:**

* We’ll be clear, we’ll move fast, and we’ll invest in your success. You deserve to be supported, challenged, and rewarded for the impact you make—and we commit to doing that every step of the way.
* The starting pay for this role is 2,184,000 INR per annum with 5% MBO. Shifts ending between 12:00 AM IST and 07:00 AM IST are eligible for a night shift differential of 500 INR/day. Discover how you can grow, lead, and make an impact by visiting our career page to learn more. NAVEX is an equal opportunity employer committed to including individuals of all backgrounds, including those with disabilities and veteran status.

title: Financial Planning and Analysis - Assistant Manager
description:
**About The Opportunity**
Westbury Sportswear is seeking an Assistant Manager - FP&A to own the P&L and balance sheet for an assigned business unit, drive performance analytics, and build robust, defensible forecasts. This role is critical for ensuring financial accuracy, providing actionable insights to leadership, and supporting strategic planning within the Finance department.
  
  
**Role & Responsibilities**

* Own the monthly P&L and balance sheet for the assigned business/unit, ensuring accuracy and completeness.
* Partner with accounting to close the books and validate that numbers tie out.
* Maintain balance sheet / P&L schedules and flag anomalies proactively.
* Drive analytics on revenue, cost, and margin drivers to surface trends early.
* Own variance analysis (actual vs. budget vs. forecast) with clear, defensible explanations.
* Build dashboards and MIS that give leadership a real-time view of performance.
* Build and maintain rolling forecasts with sound assumptions.
* Support annual budgeting and periodic re-forecasts.
* Stress-test forecast assumptions against actual trends and business inputs.
* Work closely with business and operations teams to understand drivers behind the numbers.
* Present findings and recommendations to the CFO and business stakeholders.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* CA or equivalent qualification.
* 5+ years of experience in FP&A, financial reporting, or a related finance function.
* Strong grasp of P&L and balance sheet mechanics.
* Advanced Excel and dashboarding/MIS skills.
* Sharp analytical ability.
* Forecasting and financial modelling capability.

**Preferred**

* Preference for candidates from the e-commerce industry.

Skills: advanced excel,forecasting,financial modelling,balance sheet analysis,p&l analysis,variance analysis,mis,dashboarding

title: AI Value Realization Manager
description:
**About Company:**

Quantiphi is an award-winning Applied AI and Big Data software and services company, driven by a deep desire to solve transformational problems at the heart of businesses. Our signature approach combines groundbreaking machine-learning research with disciplined cloud and data-engineering practices to create breakthrough impact at unprecedented speed.

Some company highlights:

● Quantiphi has seen 2.5x growth YoY since its inception in 2013.

● Winner of multiple awards from leading cloud providers like AWS and GCP; and market research agencies including IDC and Forrester

For more details, visit: our
Website o
r our
LinkedIn Page

**Job Description**

**Title:**
Value Realization Finance Analyst, AI Advisory

**Experience:**
4–9 years in FP&A, benefits realization, business finance or transformation finance

**Type:**
Full Time Employment

**Location:**
India — Mumbai or Bangalore

**Work hours:**
Flexible for overlap with US Eastern time required

**Education:**
Chartered Accountant (CA) or CMA, or an MBA in Finance

**Role Overview**

As part of Quantiphi's AI Advisory practice, you will be the finance specialist behind our AI value realization work. Clients' CFOs, COOs and P&L owners want to know what their AI costs, what it produces, and what has actually reached the P&L. You will build the numbers that answer that.

You'll define how each AI initiative's value is calculated, separate potential value from realized value, and give our engineering and BI team the metric logic, data sources and evidence rules to build Value Bridge and portfolio dashboards.

You'll work with the US engagement team, who lead the client and CFO conversations. Your job is to make every number they present defensible, traceable and ready for Finance certification.

**Role & Responsibilities**

**Build the value case**

* Build pre-AI baselines and counterfactuals from client data: overtime, contractor spend, hiring plans, cycle time, cost-to-serve.
* Model the value equation for each AI solution: eligible volume × adoption × successful assist × time saved × economic rate.
* Tag each initiative with a value type: cost avoidance, capacity, contribution margin, working capital, or risk/SLA.

**Separate created value from realized value**

* Count capacity as realized only when evidence shows what happened to it: overtime cut, contractor spend reduced, approved hires avoided, or extra throughput, etc.
* Build the evidence behind avoided-hiring claims, tied to the approved workforce plan and specific positions not opened.
* Track uncaptured capacity at $0 realized so value leakage stays visible.
* Check for double counting across initiatives, business units and value levers.

**Define the dashboards with engineering**

* Own the calculation logic for the Value Bridge, from investment and adoption through value created, value captured and Finance-validated value.
* Write metric specs engineers can build from: formula, grain, source field, refresh cadence and owner.
* Specify the four dashboard levels: portfolio, Value Bridge, drivers and evidence.
* Build the AI economics view: total cost of ownership, unit cost, ROI, payback, forecast versus realized.
* Test dashboard outputs against finance actuals before anything reaches a client.

**Run the evidence and reporting cycle**

* Maintain the AI Value Ledger for each initiative: owner, baseline, hypothesis, investment, attribution method, evidence grade, forecast, realized value and status.
* Collect and grade evidence from client HR, Procurement, Operations and Engineering data owners.
* Produce the monthly value pack and the quarterly Finance certification pack, flagging exceptions.
* Prepare the analysis behind quarterly Scale / Fix / Hold / Stop recommendations.

**Work across time zones**

* Work day to day with the onshore Senior Manager, who leads the client and CFO conversations.
* Raise weak value claims and data gaps early, so the US team isn't waiting overnight.
* Build the templates, metric library and evidence checklists the practice reuses.

**Skills & Experience Required**

* 4–9 years in FP&A, benefits realization, business finance or transformation finance.
* CA, CMA or MBA in Finance.
* A track record of building business cases and then proving realized benefits against actuals, not just forecasting them.
* Comfort with baselines, counterfactuals and attribution. You can explain why hours saved × salary is capacity, not savings.
* Working knowledge of workforce costs: payroll, overtime, contractor and vendor spend, headcount plans, loaded cost rates.
* Experience writing metric or KPI definitions for data and BI teams, and checking the dashboards they build.
* Strong SQL or advanced Excel modeling; able to read a data model and challenge a calculation.
* Clear written English and the confidence to challenge a number, including a senior colleague's.
* Willingness to be flexible for overlapping with US Eastern time.

**What Sets You Apart**

* Experience in a global capability center, Big Four or consulting firm supporting US or global clients.
* Prior work in a value realization office, transformation office or PMO.
* Knowledge of US payroll, contractor and hiring-plan practices.
* Exposure to cloud or AI cost management (FinOps): usage costs, unit economics, total cost of ownership.
* Familiarity with A/B tests, control groups or cohort analysis.

title: Senior Associate - Finance
description:
**About the Company**

The Founders Finance is a Bangalore-based finance partner for founder-led businesses that have outgrown spreadsheets. The team runs Virtual CFO, Accounting and Taxation, Fundraising, Company Secretarial and Advisory functions for companies across consumer and D2C, food and beverage, fashion, SaaS and financial services, working to a disciplined monthly rhythm rather than year-end scrambles. Clients get their books closed early in the month, a clear read on their cash runway, and a compliance calendar where nothing slips through. The team is built entirely from finance professionals who have worked inside operating businesses, so the problems they solve are ones they've faced firsthand — from unreconciled accounts to inventory leakage to blocked GST credits. The team is made up of chartered accountants and finance professionals who've sat inside founder-led companies before, not just advised them from the outside. That mix means every engagement is led by people who've closed books under pressure, built models for a live fundraise, or managed compliance without a safety net — and who bring that judgment to each client relationship. We leverage commercial awareness and professional expertise, along with using the skills and expertise of others, to deliver the best possible experience and outcomes
  
  
Capabilities of an M&A practitioner will include the following:
  
  

* Developing an M&A strategy

* Optimizing the operating model and organization design
* Targeting synergies, developing a roadmap to help realize those synergies and measuring synergies

* Developing communications for culture and change management

**Good to Have Skills/Project Experience/Certifications:**

title: Senior Strategic Finance Professional
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a senior Strategic Finance professional with 7-10 years of experience to lead the company’s project-level debt and equity transactions, own project structuring, and provide commercial leadership across all negotiations, while also supporting equity raises at the parent level, investor relations, and strategic projects.
  
  
The role is ideal for a seasoned transaction leader with deep financial modelling, structuring, and negotiation capabilities who wants to own fundraising and corporate finance outcomes, working closely with the CFO and the senior leadership in a fast-growing environment.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
Transaction Leadership - Project Debt & Equity
  
  

* Lead execution of project-level equity transactions including co-investors, preferred equity, private equity, strategic investors, and institutional capital.
* Lead and structure project debt financing including project finance, structured finance, working capital facilities, venture debt, leasing, and acquisition financing, through to financial close.
* Own the structuring of each project, including capital stack, SPV and holding structures, security packages, covenants, and risk allocation.
* Oversee preparation of financial models, valuation analyses, investor presentations, teaser materials, information memorandums, and due diligence materials.
* Lead negotiations with banks, investors, and counterparties, directing financial advisors, legal counsel, and internal teams during financing processes.
* Own financing process timelines, deliverables, and investor interactions, escalating key decisions and risks to the CFO.
* Oversee data room preparation and management for financing transactions.
* Direct benchmarking analysis on comparable companies, transactions, valuation multiples, and financing structures.

Commercial Leadership
  
  

* Provide commercial leadership across all negotiations, including term sheets, financing documents, offtake and customer contracts, and partnership agreements.
* Assess commercial terms for bankability and financing compatibility, and resolve issues with counterparties early.
* Take and defend negotiating positions on behalf of the company, with clear recommendations to leadership.

Parent-Level Equity Raise Support
  
  

* Support the CFO and leadership on equity raises at the parent company, including investor strategy, valuation, materials, and due diligence.
* Ensure alignment between parent-level equity raises and project-level financing structures.

Investor Relations Support
  
  

* Assist in preparation of board materials, investor updates, quarterly reporting packs, and shareholder presentations.
* Support management of investor queries and information requests.
* Help prepare materials for investor meetings, roadshows, and strategic discussions.
* Support ongoing communication with existing investors and lenders.

Strategic Finance & Corporate Development
  
  

* Build and own detailed financial models including operating models, project-level waterfalls, scenario analysis, and liquidity forecasting.
* Lead/ support strategic initiatives including M&A evaluations, partnership analysis, market research, and business case development.
* Partner with leadership on budgeting, long-range planning, and capital allocation decisions.
* Assist with preparation of internal management reporting and KPI tracking.
* Mentor and develop junior finance team members as the function scales.

Candidate Profile
  
  
**Experience**

* 7-10 years of experience in:o Investment bankingo Structured finance/ Project finance / infrastructure financeo Transaction advisoryo Private equity

**Educational Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Engineering, or related field.
* CA / CFA / MBA preferred.

Technical Skills
  
  

* Expert financial modelling (including project finance models) and valuation skills.
* Deep understanding of debt and equity financing structures, including project finance, preferred equity, and hybrid instruments.
* Command of investor reporting and transaction execution processes.
* Ability to negotiate and mark up term sheets, facility agreements, and security documents.
* Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills.
* Ability to analyze complex financial and operational data.

Soft Skills
  
  

* Strong communication and presentation skills, including at board and investor level.
* Strong negotiation skills and commercial judgement; credible with banks, investors, and senior counterparties.
* High attention to detail and execution capability.
* Ability to work in fast-paced and entrepreneurial environments.
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to manage multiple workstreams simultaneously.

**Preferred Experience**

* Track record of leading and closing project debt and equity transactions.
* Exposure to infrastructure, technology, AI, data centers, renewable energy, or digital infrastructure sectors is a plus.
* Experience negotiating with investors, banks, or senior management teams.
* Familiarity with data rooms and transaction documentation.

What the Role Offers
  
  

* Direct access to senior leadership and investors.
* Opportunity to lead high-impact financing and strategic initiatives.
* Broad mandate across project finance, corporate fundraising, and investor relations.
* Fast learning curve in a high-growth environment.

description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 1–3 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom
