title: Finance & Accounting Manager
description:
**About The Role**
We are looking for a hands-on Finance & Accounting Manager to join our Bangalore team. This role impacts core accounting operations for India and supports our global finance and accounting operations — general ledger, statutory compliance, payroll accounting, and audit support — with partnership with global finance, HR, and payroll teams. The ideal candidate has grown up in technology or semiconductor company environments and is comfortable operating through rapid scaling.
  
  
**What You'll Do**
****Accounting & Financial Operations****

* General ledger accounting, month-end and year-end close
* Prepare and review balance sheet reconciliations, accruals (including gratuity and leave accruals), and journal entries
* Payroll accounting: reconciliation of payroll registers to GL, statutory remittance accounting, and full & final settlement accounting
* Support intercompany accounting, transfer pricing documentation, and cross-entity cost allocations

****Statutory Compliance & Audit****

* Timely and accurate statutory filings and remittances (PF, ESI, PT, LWF, TDS, GST as applicable)
* Coordinate statutory, internal, and SOX audits; audit schedules, walkthroughs, and remediation of findings
* Internal controls over financial reporting and payroll processes

****Business Partnering & Projects****

* Partner with HR/Payroll on compensation and benefits accounting
* Drive automation and process improvement across accounting and reporting workflows
* Support budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting

**What You Bring**

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce/Finance; CA (Inter or qualified), CMA, or MBA (Finance) preferred
* 7–12 years of progressive experience in accounting and finance operations, ideally within technology, semiconductor, or engineering R&D (GCC/captive) environments, including at least 3 years owning month-end close and statutory compliance independently
* Strong working knowledge of Indian statutory compliance: direct and indirect tax, labor-law-linked remittances (PF, ESI, PT, LWF), and Companies Act requirements
* Hands-on experience with payroll accounting and reconciliations
* Experience supporting SOX compliance and external audits (Big 4 exposure a plus)
* ERP proficiency: SAP (FI/CO or HCM-Payroll integration), Oracle, NetSuite, or Workday Financials; advanced MS Excel

****Note****
: Candidates currently serving notice or with notice periods < 60 days
****preferred**
. Bangalore-based or willing to relocate.
  
  
**About TylSemi, Inc.**
The Opportunity
  
  
The AI infrastructure market is exploding. Every hyperscaler, every cloud provider, every AI company is building custom silicon. But they all face the same problem:
****how do you connect hundreds of chips, deliver clean power at scale, and move terabits of data without melting the package?****
That's what we solve. TylSemi builds the
****chiplet infrastructure IP****
— the IO, power delivery, and interconnect building blocks — that makes AI/HPC systems actually work at scale.
  
  
****This isn't a nice-to-have. It's the critical path.****
Why Now
  
  
The Market Window
  
  
The semiconductor industry is going through its biggest architectural shift in 40 years:
  
  

* Moore's Law is dead. 2nm and beyond delivers marginal performance gains. The future is chiplets, not monolithic dies.
* Custom silicon is now mainstream. Google, Microsoft, Amazon, Meta, OpenAI — they're all designing their own ASICs. The $50B custom silicon market is growing 30% annually.
* IO and power are the bottleneck. Solve hard problems and provide something which is a category in itself.

****Translation:****
We're entering the market at exactly the moment when every major AI/HPC player needs what we're building, and their alternatives are disappearing.
  
  
Culture & Team: How We Work
  
  
No Politics, No Bureaucracy
  
  
There are no layers, no approval chains, no corporate theater.
  
  

* If you have an idea, we test it. If it works, we ship it.
* No endless meetings, no PowerPoint presentations to convince middle management.

Remote-Friendly, Global Team
  
  

* US team: Bay Area preferred, but we hire the best people regardless of location
* India team: Building a world-class design center in Bangalore

Move Fast, Ship Real Products
  
  
We're not a research project. We have paying customers, committed capital, and aggressive timelines.
  
  
This is a company, not a lifestyle business. We're building to win.
  
  
What We Value
  
  

* Ownership mindset. You're not here to execute someone else's roadmap. You're here to define it.
* Bias for action. We move fast. Analysis paralysis doesn't fly here.
* Deep technical expertise. This is hard engineering. We need people who've shipped real silicon and debugged real hardware.
* Low ego, high standards. We don't care about titles or politics. We care about results.

The Ask
  
  
If you're reading this, you're probably comfortable. You have a good job at a stable company with all the benefits.
  
  
We're asking you to walk away from that and bet on us.
  
  
**Here's Why You Should**

* The market is real. AI infrastructure spending is $200B+ annually and growing 40% YoY. Every hyperscaler needs what we're building.
* The team has done this before. We've built and exited semiconductor companies at scale. This isn't our first rodeo.
* The traction is de-risked. We have LOIs, strategic investors, and a clear path to revenue.
* The work is consequential. You're not optimizing someone's ad click-through rate. You're building the silicon infrastructure that powers AI.

****This is the bet.****
Join us and build something that matters.
  
  
Or stay comfortable. No judgment.
  
  
But if you're the kind of person who wants to take the shot, we'd love to talk.
  
  
****READY TO JOIN?******

title: Associate - Financial Analysis
description:
**Job Description**
**Job Description:**
The Chase Consumer & Community Bank Operations organizations provide support for businesses serving more than 61 million consumers and 4 million small businesses across Consumer, Business, and Mortgage Banking, Card Services, Auto Finance, and U.S. wealth management. The Operations Finance team partners with senior Operations management and plays a central role in executing financial processes, analysis, and reporting while maintaining strict governance across a large matrixed organization. Strong technical abilities, knowledge of financial reporting and process workflows, and the ability to simplify and analyze large data sets to tell the story behind the financials are critical for this role.
  
  
As a
**Financial Analysis**
professional within the
**Chase Consumer & Community Bank Operations Finance team**
, you will support month-end and ongoing financial processes including actuals, budget, and forecast reporting, as well as headcount and resourcing scenario development and variance analysis. You will deliver recurring management reporting and prepare monthly senior management materials that clearly articulate financial performance and strategy. You will also drive reporting and process efficiency improvements while ensuring data integrity, accuracy, timeliness, and adherence to internal compliance policies and business reporting requirements.
  
  
Job responsibilities
  
  

* Support all financial processes and reporting including month end, actuals, budget, forecast of various financial and headcount/resourcing metrics and scenarios/views and variance analysis for the Operations PxT function of Operations business
* Provide headcount reporting for the CCB Operations PxT business and manage the cost center hierarchy and changes requested to the same
* Specific focus on Headcount Location strategy reporting for actual and budget
* Create financial review decks for senior management that clearly articulate the financial story/strategy to the F&BM and operations stakeholders (monthly Product owner / CTO-1 decks)
* Ability to identify and leverage best practices from other Ops F&BM groups
* Create dynamic financial management reporting and partner with Finance & Business Management teams to track and report various financial results and metrics
* Provide ad-hoc financial analysis to stakeholders on a frequent basis
* Identify opportunities and recommend improvements for increased process and reporting efficiencies
* Ensure data integrity, accuracy, and timeliness in all financial reporting and presentations
* Adhere to internal compliance policies and other business reporting requirements

**Required Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Bachelor's degree required or CA/MBA degree required
* For Bachelor's degree: 5–7 years' experience in planning and analysis, financial management, or an accounting environment
* For CA/MBA: 3–5 years' experience in planning and analysis, financial management, or an accounting environment
* Basic knowledge of Excel and PowerPoint
* Ability to present information in a clear and concise manner that tells the story behind financials in a compelling way
* Confident and personable attitude with the ability to face off stakeholders at different locations at all levels, influence/handle difficult messages, and problem solve
* Detail oriented, able to complete reporting and analytics accurately, on a timely basis, and in a presentable manner
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Ability to work independently as well as in a team situation
* Excellent time management skills and ability to multi task and handle competing priorities under pressure
* Self-motivated team player who goes beyond immediate responsibilities

**Preferred Qualifications, Capabilities, And Skills**

* Degree in Finance, Accounting, or Economics
* Keen to learn visualization and reporting tools such as Tableau/QlikView

Additional role details
  
  

* Timing: 2:00pm to 11:00pm (may change for budget periods, ad hocs and projects)

**About Us**
JPMorganChase, one of the oldest financial institutions, offers innovative financial solutions to millions of consumers, small businesses and many of the world's most prominent corporate, institutional and government clients under the J.P. Morgan and Chase brands. Our history spans over 200 years and today we are a leader in investment banking, consumer and small business banking, commercial banking, financial transaction processing and asset management.
  
  
We recognize that our people are our strength and the diverse talents they bring to our global workforce are directly linked to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and place a high value on diversity and inclusion at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of any protected attribute, including race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, marital or veteran status, pregnancy or disability, or any other basis protected under applicable law. We also make reasonable accommodations for applicants' and employees' religious practices and beliefs, as well as mental health or physical disability needs. Visit our FAQs for more information about requesting an accommodation.
  
  
**About The Team**
Our Consumer & Community Banking division serves our Chase customers through a range of financial services, including personal banking, credit cards, mortgages, auto financing, investment advice, small business loans and payment processing. We're proud to lead the U.S. in credit card sales and deposit growth and have the most-used digital solutions – all while ranking first in customer satisfaction.
  
  
Global Finance & Business Management works to strategically manage capital, drive growth and efficiencies, maintain financial reporting and proactively manage risk. By providing information, analysis and recommendations to improve results and drive decisions, teams ensure the company can navigate all types of market conditions while protecting our fortress balance sheet.

title: Finance Controlling Analyst - CP&O
description:
**The Opportunity**
Join the Controlling Practice and Operations (CP&O) team as a Finance Analyst based in Bengaluru. In this role, you will support manufacturing sites and business units by driving costing, financial planning and analysis, and controlling activities, providing insights that drive operational performance and achieve business objectives. This role offers the opportunity to work at the intersection of finance, operations, and business partnering, with broad exposure to global manufacturing finance and collaboration across Hitachi Energy. Ideal for an analytical and self-driven finance professional, the position provides opportunities to deepen expertise in SAP FICO, FP&A and performance management, while contributing to continuous improvement initiatives within the Controlling Capability Centers
  
  
**How You'll Make An Impact**

* Analyse business performance against budget and forecast, identify key drivers and trends, and provide value-adding insights to local factory, business, and hub controllers.
* Review orders received, order gross margin, backlog, and backlog gross margin, including reconciliations and monthly reporting.
* Assess monthly income statement performance before closing and explain deviations in revenue, margins, overhead absorption, and other key results.
* Apply revenue recognition principles for point-in-time and over-time scenarios, including an understanding of RA key logic in SAP S/4HANA.
* Deliver actionable profitability analysis at product and customer levels through SAP CO-PA (KE24/KE30), enabling performance evaluation and decision support within MTO (Make to Order) and MTS (Make to Stock) business models
* Analyze balance sheet movements, inventories, networking capital, capital expenditure, and cash flow, and recommend actions where required.
* Prepare recurring management and corporate reports in line with the reporting calendar and support planning, budgeting, and forecasting activities.
* Validate financial data through reconciliations and exception reviews, and support internal controls, SOX, statutory audits, and internal audits.
* Cashflow – Analysis of Cash in and Cash Out Direct Method and Indirect method – Gap analysis b/w actual and forecast
* Support preparation of relevant organization financial reporting, business planning, budgeting, and forecasting
* Validate accuracy of financial data and business information and reports by performing reconciliation and review of exceptions
* Improve productivity and service quality by automating solutions, eliminating duplicate work, standardizing reports and processes, and adhering to Controlling Capability Centers KPIs
* Any other Ad Hoc work/assignment/job given, based on urgency and requirement, from time to time which are not listed above
* Living Hitachi Energy’s core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and business

**Your Background**

* Bachelor's degree in accounting, together with CMA, CA, or MBA qualification.
* 2 to 4 years of experience in financial planning and analysis; manufacturing industry experience is preferred.
* Working knowledge of standard costing, management reporting, budgeting, forecasting, and financial analysis.
* Hands-on experience with SAP FICO and CO-PA, understanding of SAP SD, PP, MM, and PS is preferred.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office tools, particularly Excel and PowerPoint.
* undefined
* Strong analytical and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to solve problems independently and meet strict deadlines.
* Effective communication and presentation skills, with proficiency in spoken and written English.
* Demonstrated ability to use AI and digital tools to improve problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity while ensuring accuracy, compliance, sound judgment, and accountability for outcomes

**More About Us**

* Hitachi Energy offers exposure to diverse business units and opportunities to advance process standardization, automation, continuous improvement, and service quality across the organization.
* Willingness to adjust working hours in line with business and operational requirements
* Hitachi Energy is committed to fostering an inclusive workplace and advancing a sustainable energy future.

*Demonstrates effective use of AI and digital tools to enhance problem-solving, decision-making, and productivity,*
*while applying sound judgment, ensuring accuracy and compliance, and maintaining accountability for outcomes*

title: Finance Business Partner
description:
We are looking to expand our team in India and looking to onboard a Financial Planning and Analysis professional who will work as a Finance Business Partner. The resource will act as the commercial and strategic advisor to delivery, sales, and practice leadership. This role blends financial expertise helping the business optimize utilization, improve project profitability, strengthen pricing discipline, and scale sustainably. You will influence decisions that shape revenue growth, margin performance, and long-term competitiveness in a rapidly evolving market. This role is in Hybrid mode and works 2pm - 11pm shift.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Strategic & Commercial Partnership
* Advise Enablement functions Leads, Delivery Directors, and Sales on financial implications of business decisions
* Support development of new businesses with pricing, ROI, and profitability modeling
* Provide commercial insight into pipeline health, win rates, backlog, and capacity planning
* Challenge assumptions and guide leaders toward data-driven decisions that improve financial outcomes
* Project & Engagement Financial Management
* Oversee financial performance of enablement functions, including fixed-fee, T&M, and retainer models
* Monitor project margins, delivery efficiency, and scope-change impacts
* Identify underperforming engagements early and drive corrective actions
* Utilization, Capacity & Workforce Planning
* Analyze consultant utilization, billable mix, and productivity trends
* Support workforce planning: hiring, subcontractor strategy, and bench management
* Model capacity scenarios to ensure alignment between demand, skills, and delivery capability
* Financial Planning and Analysis
* Lead budgeting, forecasting, and long-range planning for the enablement functions
* Provide variance analysis with clear commentary on revenue, margin, and cost drivers
* Build dashboards and KPIs tailored to professional services (e.g., utilization, bill rates, realization, backlog burn)
* Pricing, Bids & Commercial Governance
* Partner with Sales on pricing strategy, discount governance, and deal shaping
* Review SOWs for financial soundness, risk exposure, and margin expectations
* Support competitive pricing analysis and rate-card optimization
* Reporting & Insights
* Deliver monthly business reviews with actionable insights for senior leadership
* Provide analysis on customer profitability, offering performance, and market trends
* Develop models to evaluate new service lines, partnerships, and go-to-market investments
* Controls, Compliance & Process Improvement
* Ensure adherence to revenue-recognition policies for professional services
* Strengthening financial controls around time entry, project setup, and billing
* Drive automation and process improvements across forecasting, reporting, and project financials

**Required Skills**

* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, or related field required; MBA or Master’s degree preferred
* Professional certification preferred (CPA, ACA, ACCA, CIMA, or equivalent)
* 8-10+ years of progressive finance experience, including significant experience as a Finance Business Partner in a technology, professional services, or consulting services environment
* Proven experience of operating and partnering with senior executives and business line leaders
* Strong background supporting professional services economics, including complex client engagements and multi-service delivery models
* Demonstrated experience with pricing strategy, deal structuring, and commercial decision support in a consulting or tech-enabled services context
* Experience in high-growth, matrixed, or global organizations strongly preferred

**Technical & Financial Expertise**

* Deep expertise in professional services financial drivers, including utilization, billable rates, realization, margin management, backlog, and pipeline forecasting
* Advanced financial modeling, scenario analysis, and long-range planning capabilities
* Strong working knowledge of revenue recognition and engagement economics for consulting services
* Advanced Excel and financial analysis skills; experience with ERP, planning, and reporting tools strongly preferred

**Commercial & Strategic Capabilities**

* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance growth, profitability, and risk
* Demonstrated ability to influence pricing, investment decisions, and go-to-market strategy through insight-led analysis
* Comfort challenging assumptions and providing independent, objective financial counsel

**Leadership & Stakeholder Management**

* Executive presence with the ability to communicate complex financial insights clearly to senior leaders
* Strong relationship-management skills with Sales, Delivery, Operations, and Technology leaders
* Ability to influence outcomes without direct authority and operate effectively in ambiguity

**Ways of Working**

* Action-oriented, collaborative, and solutions-driven mindset
* Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced consulting environment
* Commitment to continuous improvement, scalable processes, and data-driven decision making

**About Kroll**
In a world of disruption and increasingly complex business challenges, our professionals bring truth into focus with the Kroll Lens. Our sharp analytical skills, paired with the latest technology, allow us to give our clients clarity—not just answers—in all areas of business. We value the diverse backgrounds and perspectives that enable us to think globally. As part of One team, One Kroll, you’ll contribute to a supportive and collaborative work environment that empowers you to excel.
  
  
Kroll is the premier global valuation and corporate finance advisor with expertise in complex valuation, disputes and investigations, M&A, restructuring, and compliance and regulatory consulting. Our professionals balance analytical skills, deep market insight and independence to help our clients make sound decisions. As an organization, we think globally—and encourage our people to do the same.
  
  
In order to be considered for a position, you must formally apply via careers.kroll.com.
  
  
*Kroll is committed to equal opportunity and diversity, and recruits people based on merit.*

title: Decision Analysis Consultant
description:
**Chevron ENGINE Decision Analysis Consultant (Bengaluru)**
**About Us**
The Chevron Engineering and Innovation Excellence Center (ENGINE) in Bengaluru India brings together the resources and expertise of the Chevron global network with talent in India to enhance agility and technological innovation to optimize solutions for the world’s current and future energy challenges. As one of the leading energy providers worldwide, Chevron is involved in the production of crude oil and natural gas, manufacturing of transportation fuels, lubricants, petrochemicals, and additives, and the development of enabling technologies.
  
  
Chevron's vision is to be the global energy company most admired for its people, partnerships, and performance. With a clear purpose to develop affordable, reliable, ever-cleaner energy that enables human progress, we believe human ingenuity has the power to solve any challenge and overcome any obstacle. Meeting the world’s growing energy needs requires the pursuit of innovations and advancements that deliver a better future for all.
  
  
**About The Position**
Chevron ENGINE has an exciting opportunity for
**Decision Analysis Consultant to**
join the ENGINE Innovation team; this role will be based in Chevron’s office in Bengaluru.
  
  
Chevron ENGINE supports global operations, and work hours are aligned to business needs. Standard working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM or 1:30 PM to 10:30 PM, Monday to Friday. These may evolve based on operational or business requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Provide direct Decision and Economic Analysis consulting to support investment decisions and commercial negotiations across the globe in all parts of our business; ranging from upstream oil and gas to liquified natural gas (LNG), midstream, refining and lower carbon.
* Support globally based Decision Analysis (DAs) Consultants working on investment decisions by helping them frame opportunities, develop and refine decision and economic analysis models (ensuring accuracy & reliability), perform analysis, and develop communication materials.
* Application of DA Principles: Apply key principles, processes, and tools related to Decision Analysis, Investment Analysis, Framing, and Chevron Project Management requirements.
* Economic and Cash Flow Modeling: Conduct detailed economic and cash flow modeling, ensuring robust and insightful financial analyses. Update, adapt and build decision models, with limited assistance, of medium complexity for different fiscal regimes while applying good DA/ economic modeling standards and best practices. Will require modeling of different fiscal and tax regimes such as production sharing contracts (PSC) and Joint Venture Agreements (JV’s); may require engagements with tax and legal departments.
* Framing: Lead framing and decision-structuring sessions, ensuring all relevant factors are considered and integrated into models and decision-making tools. Utilize a variety of framing tools. Actively leads/ supports development, updating and customization of frame to specific opportunity.
* Facilitation: Effectively facilitate complex and vague engagements with multifunctional participants to help shape outputs for understanding and application. Not just framing, but facilitation of any discussions required to help solve a complex challenge. This includes developing appropriate summaries & communication.
* Data Elicitation and Coordination: Perform data elicitation, de-biasing, and coordinate information flow to support the data required for building and incorporating into models. This includes multiple sets of data to account for key uncertainties. Proactively identifies, communicates, obtains, QCs, and facilitates discussions to gain alignment on information needed. Helps coordinate flow of information from various SMEs and departments.
* Analytical Skills: Perform qualitative, deterministic, and probabilistic analyses to generate insights for project teams and decision-makers. Will need to structure a DA evaluation and effectively select from and apply a variety of qualitative, deterministic and probabilistic tools and techniques to generate insights. This may include specialized analytical tools such as cumulative probability curves, tornado diagrams and value of information (VOI) studies.
* Communication of Findings: Extract findings, insights and effectively communicate those insights, including presentations and project documentation, to ensure decision-makers have a clear understanding of the analysis and the tradeoffs important for the decision. Clarify the value of the minimum investment required and the incremental value of the enhancements.
* Decision Quality Assurance: Participate in Decision Quality (DQ) assurance activities, including Model Reviews, to ensure the accuracy and reliability of the analysis. Challenges assumptions, inputs, values & trade-offs, and decisions when needed to ensure high DQ.

**About You**

* Education: Prefer a higher education degree in business, economics or finance with an undergraduate degree in a technical area (such as engineering).
* Work Experience: Minimum of 5 years, 10 years preferred.
* The ideal candidate will have experience in the upstream oil and gas industry.
* Excellent communication skills; including verbal, written and presentation.
* Experience and comfort using AI tools, developing agents is a plus.
* Advanced skills in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Word. Prefer experience writing complex formulas and equations into Excel. Basic knowledge of decision tree concepts and software is advantageous.
* High proficiency in Excel, including development of complex formulas and equations. Strong understanding of economics, cash flow modeling, tax, and depreciation. Capability to structure and manipulate data for analyses and apply decision principles and tools effectively. Good understanding of basic framing concepts and consideration of uncertainty and risk in analyses. Exposure to various analytical tools is a plus, such as cumulative probability curves (S-curves), Investment Efficiency Charts, and Tornado Diagrams. Able to synthesize complex analysis and results into clear insights for leadership discussions and decision making. Able to utilize communication tools such as MS PowerPoint to summarize and present insights.
* Able to identify problems, view them from different angles, and figure out possible solutions. Must be able to facilitate discussions and solicit inputs from various technical and business functions to perform the necessary analysis to identify and recommend solutions.
* Team-work is essential for this role. Must be able to work between diverse teams and departments across the organization. This includes engineering, scientists, legal, tax, finance and commercial roles.
* Ability to develop detailed action plans and work independently with minimal supervision. Capability to collect, summarize, and structure information. Competence in developing resolution options within the framework of professional duties.
* Ability to assess personal strengths and weaknesses and take practical steps for personal development.
* Willingness to share work experience and information with colleagues to achieve corporate goals.
* Clear and structured communication, both in written and verbal form, is vital for success in this role. Being comfortable in a dynamic environment where assignments can vary and change on a regular basis.

**What We Can Offer You**
Everything we do at Chevron is guided by our values and our commitment to The Chevron Way.
  
  
Have the opportunity to take part in world-leading energy projects, advance your professional development and expand your career within an inclusive and collaborative workplace.
  
  

* Join a workplace where innovation, collaboration and safety are at the core of how we work.
* Work in thoughtfully designed environments that support focus, well-being, and innovation enhanced by digital tools that enable seamless collaboration.
* Grow through structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities to contribute to impactful projects that align with Chevron’s values and business priorities.
* Access comprehensive benefits that support your health, well-being, and work-life balance.
* Engage with emerging technologies and digital solutions that are shaping the future of energy and enterprise.

title: EYP-Restructuring-Assistant Manager
description:

**Assistant Manager**

The EY global network of restructuring professionals, along with our transaction and sector professionals, have experience with some of the largest and most complex in and out-of-court restructuring situations. We work with a variety of stakeholders to provide leadership and actionable advice to identify financial and operational strategies to generate liquidity, improve earnings and extract value across underperforming, stressed and distressed businesses.

This is a fantastic opportunity to be part of a leading firm and develop your career through a broad scope of engagements, mentoring, and learning & development.

* Conduct operational diagnostics, benchmarking analyses and root-cause assessments to identify areas of underperformance and improvement.
* Support large-scale transformation programmes, including operating model design, organization design, workforce optimization and cost reduction initiatives.
* Assist clients in delivering sustainable improvements in profitability, liquidity, productivity and operational efficiency.
* Perform market, industry and competitor analysis to support strategic reviews and transaction-related assignments.
* Collaborate with FSO leadership on go-to-market initiatives, opportunity identification and business development activities across financial institutions and stressed asset situations.
* Prepare client-ready reports, presentations and executive-level recommendations while managing engagement teams and ensuring high-quality delivery.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Experience in turnaround and restructuring, performance improvement, operating model transformation, organization design, value creation, cost optimization, transaction support or financial services transformation.
* Strong understanding of financial statements, business performance drivers, profitability analysis and operational improvement methodologies.
* Experience conducting quantitative and qualitative analysis, including business case development, financial modelling and benchmarking.
* Ability to identify risks and opportunities, synthesize findings and develop practical, data-driven recommendations.
* Strong project management and stakeholder management skills, with experience working across cross-functional and global teams.
* Demonstrated ability to engage with senior client stakeholders and present complex findings in a clear and concise manner.
* Excellent problem-solving, analytical and critical-thinking skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills with experience preparing executive presentations and board-level materials.

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Chartered Accountancy/ MBA in Finance from a premiere institute
* 5-7 years of PQE in:
* Management Consultancy firms, preferably Big 4 or financial analytics firms
* Large Indian corporates with exposure in restructuring activities, analytics, financial modelling and corporate finance role

**What You Can Look At**

* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market-leading, multi-disciplinary team of 3,400 + professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.
* Opportunities to work with EY SaT practices globally with leading businesses across a range of industries

**What Working At EY Offers**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, the Philippines, Poland and the UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  
EY is committed to being inclusive in all dimensions of diversity to ensure every employee is able to be and bring their authentic self to work, every day.
  
  
**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Process Specialist - Product Costing
description:

The Product Costing process specialist oversees the end-to-end Product Costing operations for the Food (NA or EMEA) business. **Minimum Qualifications**

* 5 - 8 Years of total experience and minimum 3 years of Product Costing experience.
* Expert level knowledge of SAP controlling module (CO), strong understanding of Material Ledger and Inventory Valuation.
* Advanced data analytical skills for using spreadsheets, business intelligence tools.
* Experienced leveraging financial and business systems to monitor business activities and aid in decision making.
* Experienced working with multiple businesses or international business experience.
* Shift timings - 12:30 PM to 09:30 PM (flexible to extend during month end)

title: Senior Finance Manager - Taxation
description:
**Role Overview**

We are seeking a proactive and detail-oriented Tax Manager to own the group's indirect and direct tax

compliance, litigation, and advisory functions. The role combines hands-on GST and TDS compliance with

strategic responsibilities such as structuring advisory, tax implementation within products and invoicing systems,

and representation before tax and government authorities. The ideal candidate should be a strong

communicator who can partner with business, product, and other stake holders to embed tax correctness into

processes end to end.

**Key Responsibilities**

***Indirect Taxation (GST)***

• Manage end-to-end GST compliances across the group — timely and accurate filing of GSTR-1, GSTR-3B,

GSTR-9/9C, and reconciliations (GSTR-2A/2B vs. books, ITC reconciliation).

• Handle GST litigation — draft and file replies to notices, SCNs, audit queries, and appeals; coordinate with

consultants and counsel where required.

• Maintain and update litigation trackers for indirect taxation — monitor notices, due dates, hearing

schedules, appeal status, and demand/refund positions.

• Provide structuring and advisory support on GST implications of transactions, contracts, new business

models, and place/time/value of supply issues.

• Manage GST registrations, amendments, refunds, and department correspondence across states.

• Accounting of the GST output and Input in cross functional enterprise structure.

***Direct Taxation (TDS)***

• Working knowledge of direct taxation with hands-on ownership of TDS — correct deduction, timely deposit

to the department, and filing of quarterly TDS returns (Forms 24Q/26Q/27Q).

• Support broader direct tax compliance and assessments as required.

• Working knowledge in litigation and advisory for Direct Tax Matters.

***Product & Systems Implementation***

• Drive tax implementation within products, billing, and invoicing systems — ensure correct GST rates,

HSN/SAC mapping, place-of-supply logic, and e-invoicing / e-way bill compliance.

• Design and validate product logic for TDS deduction and deposit workflows, ensuring accurate computation

and remittance to the department.

• Partner with product and engineering teams to translate tax rules into system requirements, test changes,

and prevent compliance gaps.

***Representation & Advisory***

• Represent the group before GST Officers, Income Tax Officers, and other government authorities on matters

related to these functions.

• Prepare submissions, documentation, and case files for hearings, assessments, and audits.

• Advise internal stakeholders on tax-efficient structuring and the tax impact of business decisions.

Required Skills & Attributes

• Strong technical command of GST law, procedures, and litigation practice.

• Working knowledge of direct taxation and practical TDS compliance.

• Experience implementing tax logic in products, ERP, or invoicing/billing systems.

• Proven ability to draft replies, appeals, and represent before tax authorities.

• Proactive, ownership-driven, and organized — able to manage trackers, deadlines, and multiple matters

simultaneously.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills; effective in cross-functional collaboration.

***Qualifications & Experience***

• Chartered Accountant

• 5–8 years of post-qualification experience in indirect and direct taxation.

• Prior exposure to product/tech-driven businesses and system-level tax implementation preferred.

• Prior experience handling taxation related to derivatives transactions is preferred.

• Strong understanding of applicable tax laws, regulatory compliance, and tax reporting requirements.

• Excellent analytical, problem-solving, and stakeholder management skills

title: AD/Lead Consultant- Data Strategy and Operations
description:
At Lilly, the work is demanding because patients are waiting. We unite caring with discovery to help make life better for people around the world, knowing that every decision, every detail, and every day matters. Headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana, our over 50,000 employees around the globe take on complex challenges to discover and deliver life-changing medicines, strengthen how health is understood and managed, and support the communities we serve. This is hard, urgent, selfless work—but it’s work worth doing. If you’re driven by purpose and ready to bring your best to work that truly matters for patients, we invite you to join us.
  
  
Company Overview
  
At Lilly, we unite caring with discovery to make life better for people around the world. We are a global healthcare leader headquartered in Indianapolis, Indiana. Our employees work to discover and bring life-changing medicines to those who need them, improve disease management, and give back to our communities through philanthropy and volunteerism. We bring our best to our work — and we put people first. We’re looking for individuals who are determined to make life better for people around the world.
  
Responsibilities
  
The GOSO Data Strategy & AI Lead will report to the GOSO DSO Lead and play a critical role in defining and operationalizing GOSO’s centralized data and AI strategy. This role will architect the AI-ready data foundation required for agentic AI systems, machine learning pipelines, and advanced analytics across GOSO — with particular attention to the complexity and scale of US and International Business Unit (IBU) markets, affiliate data ecosystems, and cross-market harmonization challenges. This role will also lead and mentor a small team — developing talent across data engineering, applied ML, and AI operations.
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Define and operationalize the GOSO-wide data and AI strategy in partnership with Tech@Lilly and GOSO Functional Teams (SFO, IC, DT), ensuring the platform supports next-generation AI/ML workloads including agentic AI, RAG, and semantic reasoning layers — while accounting for IBU-specific multi-market data heterogeneity and varying data maturity across geographies.
* Translate functional and business requirements into scalable Data Spine implementations on AWS/Databricks that support feature stores, semantic layers, and data contracts required by downstream ML and agentic AI systems — designing for IBU scalability with repeatable, templatized onboarding of new affiliate markets without bespoke rework.
* Architect data structures, semantic ontologies, and API-accessible data services that enable agentic AI capabilities — prioritizing use cases that address IBU-specific pain points like multi-market reconciliation and cross-geography performance benchmarking.
* Drive the design and deployment of production ML pipelines — from feature engineering and model training through deployment, monitoring, and continuous improvement — establishing MLOps patterns (experiment tracking, model versioning, drift detection, automated retraining) that scale across both HQ and IBU workloads.
* Lead the design of multi-agent architectures where specialized AI agents operate within an orchestrated ecosystem with well-defined tool-use patterns, memory management, and human-in-the-loop escalation — ensuring agent designs are adaptable to US/IBU contexts where business rules and decision thresholds vary by market.
* Serve as the primary point of contact for T@L on all data and AI-related initiatives, ensuring aligned priorities, transparent execution, and a unified roadmap that accounts for platform evolution, emerging AI capabilities, and enterprise MLOps standards — while representing IBU requirements in enterprise-level planning.
* Drive AI literacy and adoption enablement across GOSO functional stakeholders — including IBU affiliate teams where AI readiness may vary significantly — ensuring predictable onboarding of new data assets, ML models, and agentic workflows into the GOSO ecosystem.
* Identify opportunities to reduce manual interventions and accelerate insight generation through ML-driven data quality monitoring, self-healing pipelines, and intelligent automation — with particular focus on eliminating repetitive market-by-market manual processes common in US/IBU operations.
* Develop, mentor, and coach a small team of analysts, data engineers, and AI practitioners — ensuring capability development across data engineering, applied ML, and AI operations, with cross-functional exposure to data and AI domains.

Basic Qualifications / Technical Skills
  
  

* Bachelor’s Degree (preferably in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, AI/ML, or related fields); advanced degree preferred.
* 10+ years of experience in pharmaceutical commercial data engineering, data platforms, analytics ecosystems, and/or applied AI/ML.
* Strong understanding of cloud-based data architectures and pharma commercial ecosystems — with a clear grasp of how data foundations enable ML and agentic AI at scale.
* Practical experience with Databricks (including Unity Catalog, MLflow, Feature Store, and/or Agent Bricks), AWS services (S3, EC2, RDS, Redshift), and modern data engineering/AI best practices.
* Expertise in SQL; proficiency in Python (including ML libraries such as scikit-learn, PyTorch, or LangChain/LangGraph for agentic frameworks).
* Strong understanding of ETL/ELT processes, semantic layer design, and experience with orchestration platforms such as AWS Glue or Databricks workflows.
* Hands-on MLOps experience — model versioning, experiment tracking, deployment pipelines, monitoring, and drift detection.
* Experience designing or deploying agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestration, or tool-use agent architectures in a production or near-production setting.
* Ability to quickly assess upstream/downstream impacts for data, model, and system changes across interconnected analytics and AI workloads.
* Strong stakeholder management and prior experience operating in a matrixed global environment.

Additional Skills / Preferences
  
  
**IBU / International Commercial Domain (Strongly Preferred):**  

* Prior experience with International Business Unit or multi-affiliate pharma commercial operations — understanding of how data flows, vendor ecosystems, and commercial models differ across US and ex-US markets (Japan, Europe, Emerging Markets).
* Familiarity with IBU-specific data challenges: multi-vendor sourcing (IQVIA, local vendors), cross-country definition variability, affiliate-level sales/demand structures and market-specific compliance requirements.
* Experience with IBU/US commercial analytics domains such as incentive compensation, sales force operations, dynamic targeting, or demand forecasting in a multi-market context.
* Understanding of global vs. local data ownership models in a matrixed IBU environment — and how to design AI systems that respect affiliate context while enabling centralized intelligence

title: Sr. Risk Manager, Finance Operations, Finance Operations Risk, Governance, & Experience
description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Amazon is seeking a Senior Risk Manager to support the Finance Operations (FinOps) Controllership team at Amazon. We’re looking for someone who can take lead in understanding complex FinOps processes and identify the full range of risks related to processes, regulatory compliance, organization, policy, and technology. This individual will ensure FinOps processes stay ahead of risks associated with process design, internal control effectiveness, computer system integration, and other relevant areas.
  
As a Senior Risk Manager on the FORGE team, you won't just find problems, you'll architect solutions. You will lead high-impact audits and risk programs across Finance Operations (FinOps), with a primary focus on Global Real Estate & Facilities. Your work will directly strengthen the control environment, protect Amazon from material risk, and drive the kind of operational excellence that lets Finance scale with confidence.  
  
In this role, you will lead and oversee projects, such as inspections, risk assessments, and advisory services, that shape process and control design to mitigate risk and drive a continuous controllership culture. Responsibilities will also include preparation of findings and engagement with stakeholders to complete action items. Your subject matter expertise is critical to develop strong working knowledge of processes, current initiatives, and organizational changes.  
  
This role requires strong leadership skills to influence others and/or self-serve in order to achieve critical inspection objectives. You will be expected to identify risks in our processes and work with the appropriate owners to mitigate risks. You will need to dive deep to understand Amazon’s disparate and complex processes and related applications and work through ambiguity to deliver results.  
  
Key job responsibilities  
Successful candidates must be eager to dive deep into processes and have a proven record of delivering meaningful risks and recommendations to the business. The candidate should have strong auditing skills, problem solving skills, systems and process knowledge, and a passion for customer service. Specific core responsibilities are below:
  

* Perform risk assessments of the organization
* Perform end to end audits, including scoping, fieldwork, and reporting
* Evaluate design and effectiveness of FinOps controls
* Evaluate policy and process exceptions
* Prepare clear, compelling audit reports, executive narratives, and leadership-ready communications. Present findings, recommendations, and risk trade-offs to senior leaders (Director and above) with precision and confidence
* Provide training that improves and raises the bar on controllership with respect to policies and other requirements
* Support ad hoc inspections, deep dives, and reviews across broader FinOps and upstream business processes as new risks emerge or business needs evolve
* Provide strategic perspective on risk-related business and technology decisions. Help stakeholders see around corners, prioritize the right mitigation investments, and avoid building risk into new processes

  
A day in the life  

* Lead scoping, planning, and execution of complex audits and risk assessments across FinOps processes.
* Own end-to-end lifecycle of high-impact, cross-functional risk programs.
* Identify control gaps, evaluate control effectiveness, and drive sustainable remediation plans.
* Define project objectives, success criteria, and risk reduction metrics.
* Partner with cross-functional stakeholders to prioritize risk initiatives, influence decisions, and drive execution.
* Develop data-driven audit reports and executive communications presenting findings and recommendations to senior leadership.
* Influence stakeholders to implement scalable, automated controls and eliminate recurring risks.
* Leverage data, automation, and technology to improve risk detection and audit efficiency.

  
About the team  
Finance Operations Risk, Governance & Experience (FORGE)’s mission is to improve controllership across Finance Operations (FinOps) by identifying risks, protecting assets, designing to-be controls, testing existing controls, and as appropriate, assisting process owners with risk mitigation or remediation. In addition, FORGE collaborates with teams within and beyond FinOps on risk assessments, compliance, corporate social responsibility, regulatory, and governance matters. FORGE also serves as FinOps's program manager for the global external audit, provides controllership support for non-integrated subsidiaries, and is the contact for FinOps owned Internal Audit findings.

------------------------

* 7+ years of compliance, audit or risk management experience
* Knowledge of Microsoft Office products and applications at an advanced level
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Master's degree or equivalent
* Experience at consulting firms or equivalent
* Experience working across teams and influencing teams that are not your own
* Experience in relevant finance roles, or experience in identifying, leading, and executing opportunities to improve, automate, standardize or simplify finance or business tools and processes

title: Analyst, Accounting Shared Services Centers
description:
Job Description:

**Job Summary**

The Intercompany Accountant is responsible for managing and reconciling intercompany transactions across group entities, ensuring timely month-end close, accurate financial reporting, and compliance with accounting policies. The role involves ownership of intercompany balances, Goods in Transit (GIT), Netting and Allocation Processes (NAP), Hold Accounts, AP/AR reconciliations, and GRIR analysis while collaborating with global stakeholders.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Intercompany Accounting**

* Manage end-to-end intercompany accounting processes across multiple legal entities.
* Ensure timely recording, validation, and settlement of intercompany transactions.
* Prepare and post intercompany journal entries in compliance with accounting standards and company policies.
* Investigate and resolve intercompany mismatches and reconciliation differences.
* Coordinate with regional finance teams to clear aged outstanding balances.

**Goods in Transit (GIT)**

* Perform monthly review and reconciliation of Goods in Transit balances.
* Analyze aging items and collaborate with logistics, supply chain, and business teams for timely resolution.
* Ensure accurate recognition of inventory and corresponding intercompany entries.
* Monitor open transit transactions and support period-end reporting requirements.

**NAP (Netting and Allocation Process)**

* Execute intercompany netting activities and settlement processes.
* Validate netting positions and ensure proper allocation of balances between entities.
* Investigate exceptions and discrepancies in netting cycles.
* Support cash settlement and treasury teams during intercompany settlements.

**Hold Account Management**

* Review and reconcile hold/suspense accounts on a periodic basis.
* Analyze unidentified transactions and coordinate with stakeholders for proper classification.
* Ensure timely clearance of outstanding hold balances and maintain supporting documentation.
* Drive reduction of aged items through regular follow-up and escalation.

**Accounts Payable & Accounts Receivable Reconciliation**

* Perform monthly AP and AR intercompany reconciliations.
* Reconcile sub-ledger balances with general ledger accounts.
* Investigate and resolve invoice, payment, and booking discrepancies.
* Work with global counterparts to achieve intercompany balance alignment before close.
* Ensure compliance with account reconciliation policies and SOX/internal control requirements.

**GRIR (Goods Receipt Invoice Receipt)**

* Review and reconcile GRIR accounts on a monthly basis.
* Analyze aged GRIR items and coordinate with Procurement, Operations, and AP teams for resolution.
* Monitor unmatched goods receipts and invoices.
* Ensure accurate accruals and timely clearing of open GRIR balances.
* Support audit requests by providing detailed reconciliation and supporting documents.

**Month-End Close Activities**

* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual close processes.
* Prepare balance sheet reconciliations and review schedules.
* Ensure all reconciliations are completed within agreed timelines.
* Provide variance analysis and commentary on key balance sheet accounts.
* Support internal and external audits.

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Accounting, Finance, or related field.
* CA Inter, CMA, MBA Finance, ACCA, or equivalent qualification preferred.

* Experience working in a shared services/BPO/Global Capability Center environment.

title: Marine Superintendent
description:

Executive Ship Management (ESM), part of the Executive Group of Companies headquartered in Singapore, is a trusted partner to leading global ship owners and major industry players who demand high standards, quality, and professionalism. The company operates a world-class maritime institute in India, the Samundra Institute of Maritime Studies (SIMS), to ensure that its vessels are managed by specially trained officers and crew. ESM maintains a robust, in-house recruitment, training, and vetting process, building a strong pool of skilled seafarers for advanced and specialized vessels. With resource centers across India and support offices in Houston, Rotterdam, and Tokyo, ESM leverages advanced information technology and innovative ship management solutions to enhance performance at sea and on shore. Guided by a strong quality culture, ESM is committed to safety, security, and the holistic development of its people, assets, and long-term partnerships.
  
**Role Description**
The Marine Superintendent is a full-time, on-site role based in Chennai, responsible for overseeing the safe, efficient, and compliant operation of assigned vessels. This role involves monitoring day-to-day vessel performance, guiding shipboard teams on marine operations, and ensuring adherence to company policies, international regulations, and industry best practices. The Marine Superintendent will coordinate with ship management and technical teams on voyage planning, incident prevention, audits, and inspections, including vetting and port state control requirements. The role includes reviewing operational reports, conducting ship visits, supporting crew in the implementation of safety management systems, and driving continuous improvement in vessel operations. The Marine Superintendent will also collaborate with stakeholders, including owners and charterers, to maintain high standards of professionalism and operational reliability.
  
**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess strong expertise in Marine Operations and Vessel Operations, including navigation, cargo handling, and safety procedures.
* Candidates should possess solid experience in Ship Management, covering compliance, maintenance oversight, and coordination with technical and crewing teams.
* Candidates should possess proven Supervisory Skills to guide shipboard personnel, conduct performance reviews, and support training and development.
* Candidates should possess hands-on knowledge of Vetting processes, audits, inspections, and alignment with oil major and industry requirements.
* Candidates should ideally have a Class 1 or Class 2 certificate of competency (deck or engine) with relevant sea-going experience.
* Candidates should possess strong understanding of international maritime regulations (ISM, ISPS, MARPOL, SOLAS) and quality, health, safety, and environmental standards.
* Candidates should possess effective communication, report-writing, and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work in a multicultural environment.
* Candidates should possess good analytical and problem-solving abilities, familiarity with fleet management or maritime software, and a commitment to continuous improvement.

description:
**Team Leadership & Capability Development**

* Build, lead, and develop a Body Process Simulation team supporting BIW manufacturing engineering activities.
* Define team structure, technical responsibilities, engineering standards, work processes, deliverables, and performance expectations.
* Lead, mentor, and coordinate a multidisciplinary team of engineers, simulation specialists, controls engineers, contractors, and supplier resources.
* Recruit, develop, and retain technical talent in process simulation, robotics, offline programming, virtual commissioning, automation, and digital manufacturing technologies.
* Establish competency frameworks, mentoring programs, training plans, and career development pathways.
* Manage resource planning, project workloads, budgets, supplier support, and delivery performance across multiple manufacturing programs and locations.
* Foster a culture focused on safety, collaboration, innovation, quality, continuous improvement, and standardization.

**Process Simulation & Digital Manufacturing**

* Lead the application of Siemens Process Simulate, Tecnomatix, or similar digital manufacturing tools to validate body shop manufacturing processes prior to equipment installation.
* Establish standard methodologies for:
* Robot reach and accessibility studies
* Collision detection and avoidance
* Cycle time validation
* Tooling and weld gun accessibility validation
* Ergonomic assessments
* Robot path optimization
* Station layout verification
* Ensure simulation activities support manufacturing feasibility reviews, equipment design validation, tooling development, and process planning.
* Develop and maintain simulation models, robot libraries, tooling standards, process libraries, work instructions, and best practices.
* Improve simulation quality, model accuracy, data management practices, and process validation efficiency.
* Identify and communicate manufacturing risks, design concerns, capacity constraints, automation challenges, and process issues early during program development.

**Virtual Commissioning**

* Develop organizational capability in virtual commissioning technologies and methodologies.
* Lead validation of robot sequences, programmable logic controller (PLC) logic, safety interlocks, equipment interfaces, and automated manufacturing processes in a virtual environment.
* Define virtual commissioning standards, test procedures, acceptance criteria, and deployment methodologies.
* Collaborate with Controls Engineering, equipment suppliers, and plant teams to ensure an effective transition from virtual to physical commissioning.
* Support issue resolution related to robotics, controls, automation systems, simulation models, commissioning activities, and production support.

**Automation & Digital Transformation**

* Drive automation and digital manufacturing initiatives to improve simulation efficiency, engineering productivity, and manufacturing validation processes.
* Identify opportunities to automate model creation, reporting, data validation, engineering analysis, and repetitive simulation activities.
* Support the adoption of advanced digital tools, data analytics, digital twins, and AI-enabled engineering solutions to improve:
* Engineering productivity
* Manufacturing risk identification
* Root-cause analysis
* Knowledge management
* Decision support
* Partner with Manufacturing IT, Controls Engineering, Product Development, and Data & Analytics teams to evaluate and implement scalable digital manufacturing solutions.

title: Adoption Manager Content & Channel
description:
**Summary**
The Adoption Manager is responsible for driving hands-on adoption of Guided Buying across priority Layer-4 taxonomy sub-categories and rollout markets. The role converts category strategy into practical buying journeys, activates super-user networks, coordinates targeted enablement, and uses adoption data to improve user behavior and channel conversion. Success in this role means users are guided to the right buying channels because the experience is clear, relevant, and easier than off-channel alternatives.
  
 
  
**Job Responsibilities:**

* **Adoption planning:**
  Develop sub-category adoption plans with category managers, defining the target buying channel, user groups, buying scenarios, adoption risks, and intervention plan for each wave.
* **Buying journey design:**
  Map how users buy today and define the future-state buying journey across catalogues, contract-linked purchase orders, preferred suppliers, tactical sourcing, or other approved routes.
* **Super-user activation:**
  Identify, engage, and manage super users by market, location, or user group; establish feedback loops and ensure user issues are captured, prioritised, and resolved.
* **Enablement and communications:**
  Partner with Change & Enablement and Experience teams to deliver targeted walkthroughs, Q&A, quick reference material, and nudges that address specific buying behaviours.
* **Data-led intervention:**
  Monitor adoption signals including Guided Buying usage, channel utilisation, free-text buying, off-channel activity, catalogue usage, contract operationalisation, and recurring user issues.
* **Issue resolution:**
  Work with C&C Operations, Local Procurement, category owners, supplier enablement, and BAU teams to resolve root causes such as content gaps, channel design issues, supplier readiness, data quality, or unclear ownership.
* **Governance and reporting:**
  Maintain the adoption tracker, manage actions and risks, provide progress updates to the Adoption Lead, and escalate decisions or blockers that put adoption targets at risk.

 
  
**Required Skills:**

* **P2P/S2P and procurement-channel adoption:**
  Approximately seven or more years in procurement or transformation, including direct work with guided buying, catalogues, contract-linked buying, or preferred-supplier routes to drive measurable change in adoption.
* **Hands-on adoption delivery:**
  Owned adoption plans, user segmentation, buying journeys, interventions, super-user networks, and issue resolution—not only communications or training.
* **Data-led problem solving:**
  Used channel-utilisation, free-text, off-channel, catalogue, contract, or user-issue data to diagnose causes and prioritise action to drive adoption metrics.
* **Influence across functions and markets:**
  Secured delivery from category, procurement operations, suppliers, technology, change, and local-market teams without direct authority.
* **Transformation delivery and ambiguity:**
  Delivered in a complex rollout, managed dependencies and risks, and converted unclear requirements into an actionable plan with governance.

 
  
**Preferred Skills:**

* **SAP Ariba ecosystem exposure:**
  Practical exposure to SAP Ariba Guided Buying, SLP, Supplier Business Network, or a comparable procurement platform.
* **BAU transition and repeatability:**
  Built a playbook, governance cadence, exit criteria, and named ownership to sustain adoption after rollout.

description:

**Who We Are**
Hewlett Packard Enterprise is the global edge-to-cloud company advancing the way people live and work. We help companies connect, protect, analyze, and act on their data and applications wherever they live, from edge to cloud, so they can turn insights into outcomes at the speed required to thrive in today’s complex world. Our culture thrives on finding new and better ways to accelerate what’s next. We know varied backgrounds are valued and succeed here. We have the flexibility to manage our work and personal needs. We make bold moves, together, and are a force for good. If you are looking to stretch and grow your career our culture will embrace you. Open up opportunities with HPE.
  
  
**Job Description**
***Job Family Definition:***
The job family spans across multiple engineering disciplines. Work consists of designing, developing, analyzing, troubleshooting and debugging systems, software and solutions for research and/or research development of product, services, and solutions for HPE’s portfolio. Requires a broad knowledge and application of engineering disciplines, methodologies and tools.
  
  
Job Family Definition for Executive Levels only: Directs and manages a diverse team of engineering professionals performing research, development, design and/or implementation of products, services, solutions for the company’s portfolio. Responsible for creating and communicating technical strategy within the organization and/or across the function.
  
  
**Management Level Definition**
Applies advanced subject matter knowledge to manage staff activities in solving common and complex business/technical issues within established policies. Manages exempt individual contributors and/or supervisors. Has accountability for results of a major program in terms of cost, direction and people management. Provides guidance on process improvements and recommends changes in alignment with business tactics and strategy for area of responsibility. Plans, manages and monitors operational/tactical activities of Staff. Staff members' work may involve strategic issues. Recruits and supports development of direct staff members. Typically reports to MG2 or Director.
  
  
Additional guidance/criteria: Manages and controls activities within a single country or a sub-region which is part of a larger geographical Region; Manages at least 4 employees and typically between 8 and 15 direct reports. Span of Control guidelines may differ from these numbers.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Provides direct and ongoing leadership for a team of individual contributors designing and developing engineering solutions and coordinating projects utilizing multiple engineering disciplines for products, systems, software, and solutions.
* Manages headcount, deliverables, schedules, and costs for multiple ongoing projects, ensuring that resources are appropriately allocated and that goals, objectives, timelines, and budgets are met in accordance with program and organizational roadmaps.
* Communicates project status and escalates issues to direct managers, program managers, and internal and external development partners.
* Manages relationships with outsourced partners and suppliers, including setting expectations regarding deliverables, product quality, schedules, and costs; ensures that team members are effectively communicating and collaborating with outsourced resources.
* Proactively identifies opportunities for process improvement and cost reductions opportunities.
* Provides people-care management for assigned team members, including hiring, setting and monitoring of annual performance plans, coaching, and career development; ensures that proper knowledge and career development tools are in place to support ongoing team member and process development.

**What You Need To Bring**

* First level university degree or equivalent experience required. May have advanced university degree.
* Typically 5 or more years of related work experience, including 0 -2 years of people management experience.

**Knowledge And Skills**

* Strong leadership skills, including coaching, team-building, and conflict resolution.
* Advanced project management skills including time and risk management, resource prioritization, and project structuring.
* Strong analytical and problem solving skills.
* Ability to manage human capital across geographies to drive workforce development and achieve desired results.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills, including negotiation, presentation, and influence skills.
* Advanced business acumen, technical knowledge, and industry experience encompassing one or more engineering, technology, and product domains.
* Strong multi-tasking and prioritization skills.
* Strong communication skills (e.g. written, verbal, presentation); mastery in English and local language.
* Good understanding of the company's policies and processes.

title: Squad Lead - Oncology
description:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters.
  
  
The Position
  
  
**Squad Lead –Oncology**
**Location- Chennai**
The Squad Lead is responsible for setting and executing the Outcome Based Plan. Oncology in India is a critical component of the India portfolio priorities today and in the future and our ambitions for positive patient outcomes are extensive.
  
  
The Squad Lead is the accountable person for delivering on our therapy area ambition(s) in the cluster and this role requires strong Visionary, Architect, Catalyst and Coaching capabilities.
  
  
**Key responsibilities:**
The Squads will focus on system shaping, partnership priorities and driving execution excellence which will in turn define what work needs to be delivered. Squad leads are empowered with, and E2E accountable for, creating and delivering value propositions to our customers, including defining work packages (incl. start & end date, resource & investment requirements), optimal working models (e.g. commissioning of work vs. execution within squad) & for executing/overseeing work in alignment with Disease Area Strategy and close collaboration with Disease Area Squad and Key Account Managers under the supervision of Cluster Heads.
  
  

* Preferred oncology & Hematology therapy area experience as well as a track record of effective people leadership in functional and/or network teams
* Customer experience in pharmaceutical healthcare (ideally in oncology & hematology)
* Providing inspirational leadership in setting the vision and strategic ambition for the cluster and assuming overall accountability for the delivery for this vision/ambition
* Creating an environment where diverse technical disciplines can align, develop and execute in order to pursue the cluster/affiliate/disease area North Star ambition
* Leadership coaching of PJPs, peers and more broadly as required, to ensure individuals and teams are developing and growing in line with their passion and the needs of the Organization
* Acting as a guardian for high standards of compliance, ethics and safety; putting patients at the Center of all actions by consistent business behavior that complies with applicable laws, industry codes and Roche’s Code of Conduct
* Responsible for co-creating and executing strategic partnerships to improve penetration of Roche innovation in corporate accounts and other important regional accounts
* Ensuring PJP’s purpose/vision, goals, strategy, planning and execution (including investment) are aligned to both DA squad AND Cluster Priorities
* Partnering with the broader affiliate (including Disease Area Squad, Key Account Managers, Cluster Enabling functions etc.) to ensure appropriate strategic alignment and required customized modifications
* Fostering collaboration and expertise-sharing across the organization to remove silos and duplication, ensure efficient use of similar skill sets, and to ultimately support common pursuit of the North Star

Who we are
  
  
A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact.
  
  
Let’s build a healthier future, together.
  
  
**Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.**

title: Editorial Manager – Books
description:
**Company:**
Thomson Digital

**Location:**
Chennai, Tamil Nadu

**Experience:**
5–7 Years

**Role Overview:**

Thomson Digital is looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Editorial Manager – Books**
to manage editorial activities for book publishing projects. The candidate will be responsible for overseeing editorial quality, coordinating with internal production teams, managing schedules, and ensuring that editorial deliverables meet the required quality standards and deadlines.

The candidate should have a strong academic background, excellent command of written and spoken English, a sound understanding of book editorial workflows, and the ability to coordinate with multiple stakeholders to ensure smooth execution of projects.

**Key Responsibilities:**

**1. Editorial Operations & Workflow Management**

* Manage editorial activities across book publishing projects, ensuring adherence to established workflows, schedules, and quality standards.
* Oversee editorial processes, including manuscript assessment, copyediting, language editing, proofreading, reference checking, and author query management, as applicable to project scope.
* Ensure consistency in language, grammar, style, formatting, and adherence to client-specific style guides.
* Review editorial deliverables and ensure that they meet customer specifications and publishing standards.
* Monitor project progress, identify bottlenecks, and take corrective action to ensure timely completion.

**2. Team Management & Coordination**

* Coordinate with editors, proofreaders, editorial coordinators, project managers, and book production teams.
* Allocate and prioritise editorial work based on project requirements, deadlines, and available resources.
* Guide team members on editorial standards, style requirements, and quality expectations.
* Monitor team performance, productivity, and turnaround time.

**3. Quality Assurance**

* Ensure high standards of editorial accuracy, consistency, readability, and language quality.
* Conduct quality reviews and audits to identify errors, inconsistencies, and deviations from client requirements.
* Analyse recurring errors and implement corrective and preventive measures.

**5. Project Planning & Delivery**

* Plan and monitor editorial schedules to ensure timely completion of assigned titles and projects.
* Track milestones, pending activities, author queries, and dependencies.
* Prepare and maintain project status reports, quality reports, and productivity trackers.

**6. Process Improvement**

* Identify opportunities to improve editorial workflows, productivity, and quality.
* Support the implementation of standard operating procedures and best practices.
* Stay updated on developments in book publishing, editorial tools, digital publishing, and AI-assisted editorial workflows.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* 5–7 years of relevant experience in book publishing, editorial services, publishing production, or a publishing services organisation.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in English, Literature, Journalism, Publishing, Mass Communication, or a related discipline.
* Postgraduate qualification preferred.
* Strong academic record, preferably from a reputed college or university.
* English-medium educational background preferred.
* Strong understanding of book editorial workflows and publishing standards.

Work from Office (6 days a week)

Interested candidates can send their CVs to anunay.garg@thomsondigital.com

title: Principal Data Center Facilities Development Manager
description:
