title: Director of Recruiting Operations
description:
**Director, Talent Solution Delivery, Enterprise**

**Location : Hyderabad only**

**Shift : India IST- 12:00 pm - 9:00 pm (India)**

**Minimum 15+ years expertise in recruiting experience in any of the roles: recruiting, sourcing, screening, recruitment operations, etc.**

Randstad Enterprise Solutions — including Randstad Sourceright, Randstad Enterprise Group and Randstad RiseSmart — provides solutions and expertise that help enterprise clients position for growth, execute on strategy and improve business agility. Working across the broad spectrum of Randstad Enterprise Solutions, the collective experience of the teams encompasses all facets of the global talent spectrum, from the acquisition of talent to skilling and coaching to outplacement solutions. Enabled by innovative technologies, key offerings include HR and recruitment solutions, recruitment process outsourcing (RPO), managed services programs (MSP), statement of work (SOW), outplacement, coaching and total talent solutions.

**Position Overview**

The Director – Global Client Services & Operations Transformation Lead is a strategic leader responsible for driving world-class delivery, operational transformation, and commercial scaling across our global recruitment and scheduling operations.

Operating with an innovative, transformational mindset, this leader will oversee specialized outsourced talent acquisition services—including end-to-end RPO/MSP delivery and high-volume global scheduling operations—for premier enterprise tech clients. The primary mandate is to institutionalize a Delivery Excellence & Continuous Innovation Framework, leveraging AI-driven automation, data analytics, and continuous improvement methodologies to scale infrastructure, optimize P&L profitability, and elevate client partnerships from operational delivery to strategic management consulting.

Key Strategic Responsibilities

1. Strategic Client Leadership & Partnership

● Single Voice Governance: Serve as the primary liaison for global client stakeholders, presenting a unified narrative across internal Global Business Services (GBS) and regional delivery hubs.

● Consultative Value Creation: Move beyond standard status reporting by delivering high-level analytical insights, labor market trends, and predictive talent analytics to consult client leaders on talent strategy.

● Commercial Growth & Expansion: Partner with sales and commercial leads to drive cross-selling, upsell initiatives, and expansion into new revenue streams by establishing deep operational trust and exceeding SLAs.

2. Transformational Operational Excellence & Innovation

● Digital & AI Transformation: Spearhead operational modernization by integrating automation, AI-driven scheduling tools, and modern tech workflows to enhance process efficiency and service velocity.

● Workforce & Process Optimization: Standardize global SOPs and optimize workforce management metrics—including utilization, adherence, capacity forecasting, occupancy, and shrinkage—to eliminate delivery friction.

● Global Delivery Standardization: Institutionalize a "One Voice" service delivery model across APAC, NAM, and global execution hubs to ensure uniform "Premier" service experience regardless of geography.

● Enabling Function Accountability: Establish rigorous ROI tracking for operational enabling functions (e.g., Training, Quality Assurance) to maximize individual productivity and service consistency.

3. Financial & P&L Management

● P&L Responsibility: Oversee complete delivery budget and P&L across global accounts, ensuring targets for profitability, margin expansion, and cost-of-delivery ratios are achieved.

● Cost Efficiency & Contractual Rigor: Continuously evaluate SLA performance and operational delivery costs to identify savings, streamline workflows, and mitigate commercial risk.

4. People Leadership & Organizational Development

● Team Management: Lead, mentor, and inspire a large, multi-tiered global team (VPs, Directors, Managers, and Operational Specialists) across matrixed structures.

● Capabilities & Upskilling: Build a continuous learning ecosystem utilizing Individual Development Plans (IDPs), structured upskilling programs, and proactive succession planning.

● Culture & Engagement: Cultivate a high-accountability, inclusive, and agile workplace culture that encourages innovative problem-solving and high performance.

Core Competencies & Transformational Mindset

● Embracing Ambiguity & Change Leadership: Decisive leadership in uncertain, rapidly changing environments; skilled at building structured frameworks within newly consolidated or evolving entities.

● Data-Driven Decision Making: Ability to translate complex operational datasets and statistical modeling into actionable strategic risk mitigation and process improvements.

● Strategic Vision & Commercial Acumen: Strong business acumen combining deep understanding of financial P&Ls, client growth strategies, and enterprise talent acquisition trends.

● Agility & Execution Courage: Ability to balance competing multi-stakeholder priorities (global, regional, client) while maintaining rigorous operational control and driving long-term strategic needle-movers.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

● Client Retention & NPS: Exceeding target client satisfaction scores and transforming account status to strategic consulting partner.

● Operational Efficiency & ROI: Measurable reduction in cost-to-serve and cycle time through automation, AI tools, and process optimization.

● Financial Growth: Portfolio profitability, revenue expansion, and strict adherence to target P&L margins.

● SLA & Delivery Rigor: 98%+ global adherence to contractual SLAs, quality benchmarks, and workforce management metrics.

● Talent Development: Employee retention, engagement metrics, and successful execution of upskilling IDPs across the team.

Required Qualifications & Experience

● Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Business Administration, Operations, Human Resources, or related field (Master’s Degree / MBA strongly preferred).

Experience:

● 15+ years of progressive corporate experience within RPO, MSP, BPO, or Global Talent Acquisition Delivery environments.

● 10+ years in leadership roles managing large-scale global or multi-country operations. ● Proven track record of managing multi-million-dollar portfolios ($15M+) with direct P&L accountability.

● Transformation Expertise: Demonstrated expertise leading process transformations, implementing automation/AI technologies, and navigating complex matrix organizations.

● Travel: Willingness to travel locally and globally as required by business and client demands.

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

title: Mfg Process Ops Assoc Leader
description:

This position is responsible for working with Business Units, Functional teams, and IT support teams on various IDOC message types related to Supply Chain operations. The role involves monitoring, analyzing, and resolving IDOC failures related to Master Data, OTC (Order to Cash), Sales & Distribution, and other supply chain processes.
  
  
In addition to core responsibilities, the role actively contributes to process improvements, automation initiatives, stakeholder management, and operational governance to ensure smooth business operations and system reliability.
  
  
The position also supports incident resolution, root cause analysis, and continuous monitoring of IDOC flows to ensure business continuity and SLA adherence across supply chain processes.

* Work closely with Business Units, field users, and IT support teams to understand operational requirements and deliver efficient and innovative solutions to support supply chain processes.
* Monitor and manage high volumes of IDOC transactions, ensuring timely resolution of failures within defined SLAs while minimizing operational disruptions.
* Act as a key coordination point between Business and IT teams for resolving complex system issues related to SAP Master Data, OTC processes, and Sales & Distribution transactions.
* Drive process improvements and automation initiatives to reduce manual work and enhance operational efficiency using tools such as Power BI, Power Query, Excel automation, and Winshuttle.
* Design and maintain operational dashboards to monitor process performance, track incidents, and provide real-time visibility to stakeholders.
* Lead root cause analysis discussions for recurring IDOC failures and collaborate with IT teams to implement permanent solutions rather than temporary fixes.
* Manage and execute Winshuttle scripts to automate PID document posting and settlement processes, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.
* Monitor operational dashboards and reporting systems to ensure smooth process flow and proactive issue identification.
* Act as a Single Point of Contact (SPOC) for business escalations, supporting urgent operational queries from Business Units and stakeholders.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) for system changes, automation tools, and new functionality implementations within supply chain systems.
* Develop and deliver process documentation, SOPs, and training materials to support knowledge transfer and operational standardization.
* Coordinate team activities and provide operational guidance, ensuring effective collaboration and seamless shift handovers.
* Ensure clear communication between teams during operational transitions, maintaining continuity of critical supply chain activities.
* Identify opportunities for innovation and process optimization, contributing ideas that improve productivity, reduce turnaround time (TAT), and enhance reporting transparency.
* Support governance, compliance, and audit readiness activities by maintaining process documentation and operational records.
* Ensure proactive monitoring and resolution of incidents affecting supply chain operations, minimizing business impact.
* Maintain strong collaboration with cross-functional teams including Planning, Supply Chain, IT, and Business stakeholders to support operational goals.

**Qualifications**

* Strong knowledge of SAP systems including SAP ECC / SAP S4 HANA and IDOC processing
* Experience in Supply Chain processes including Order Management, Master Data, and OTC flows
* Strong working knowledge of Excel, Power Query, Power BI, VBA automation, and reporting tools
* Hands-on experience with automation tools such as Winshuttle for transaction automation
* Ability to manage high transaction volumes and ensure SLA adherence
* Strong stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration skills
* Ability to communicate technical and operational issues clearly to both business and IT teams
* Experience in process optimization, automation initiatives, and operational efficiency improvements
* Leadership capabilities including team coordination, knowledge sharing, and operational guidance
* Strong documentation and process governance skills
* Ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining high accuracy and quality standards
* Proactive mindset with a focus on innovation and continuous improvement

The Corporate Strategy Team at Providence is responsible for building a blueprint of growth and value acceleration for the Center, including building technology transformation roadmaps, strategic growth initiatives and driving a rigor-oriented run of the business. KEY RESPONSIBILITES

As the AVP for Strategy and Enterprise Transformation you will:

• Build the blueprint of enterprise transformation: identify and drive high-priority initiatives across the organisation, translating strategic priorities into defined programs, workstreams, owners and measurable outcomes. Act as the single-threaded owner for critical transformation programs, across capability and Corp function teams

• Drive business impact: partner with capability teams to identify AI, automation, data and tech / engineering opportunities that transform business processes and deliver top line and bottom-line impact for the organization with a global delivery model including efficiency, and value.

• Solve ambiguous, high-impact problems: work directly with senior leadership in India and US to evaluate opportunities for driving efficiency and better health outcomes with technology. Drive the overall change and transformation agenda for the organization.

• Lead with a Builder Mindset: mentor a small, high-performing strategy team working across Initiatives and capabilities.

• Establish ways of working: establish ownership, analytical rigour, speed and

Providence accountability and develop enterprise transformation frameworks that can be replicated across the organization.

LEADERSHIP CHARACTERISTICS

• Collaboration and Influence: The executive must be able to build strong and enduring relationships across the organization and facilitate collaborations, transparent communications, and alignment between diverse constituents. S/he must have the ability to move seamlessly between various stakeholders, gaining support for key initiatives.

• Driving Results: Knows how to get things done in the organization; successfully mobilizes people, processes, culture and technology. Effectively navigates relationships and organizational politics within a matrixed organization.

• Inspirational Leader: Demonstrates emotionally intelligent leadership and interactions. Courageously communicates and inspires an ever evolving and changing organization. Is action-oriented; consciously and effectively urges others toward the goal.

• People Focused: Clearly sets direction and expectations for direct reports and holds them accountable for results. Provides feedback and coaching to both good-performers and under-performers. Conscientiously builds a diverse talent pipeline of highly capable caregivers. Demonstrates the value of diversity and inclusion in leadership efforts.

• Thought Leader: Knowledgeable about current business and healthcare practices. Capable of critical operational and financial analytics. Leverages best business practices to solve problems. Leverages strategies that grow and develop the organization. Stays on top of emerging business and healthcare trends. Thinks innovatively and facilitates creativity in others. Is mentally agile; “thinks well on their feet.” Introduces break - through thinking, enabling new mental models to emerge.

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE/QUALIFICATIONS

title: IT Manager – Systems & Administration
description:
**About us**

At Gameopedia, our journey began in Norway with a simple mission: to be the geeky gamer friend who helps people discover great games and have better gaming experiences. From humble beginnings, we quickly made our mark, landing our first major customer just a year later, one of Norway’s largest news publications. That milestone led us to expand to India, where five passionate gamers began building Gameopedia around a dining table in a small apartment.

Today, with offices in Oslo and Hyderabad, we provide industry-leading video game data, metadata and insights to some of the world’s biggest companies, powering experiences and decisions for millions of gamers every day.

Over more than 15 years, we have built deep gaming expertise and one of the industry’s richest and most structured sources of video game data. As technology and AI transform how games are discovered, understood and experienced, we believe trusted, comprehensive and high-quality data will become more important than ever.

Our ambition is to make Gameopedia the
**data truth for gaming**
: the trusted foundation that companies, products and AI systems rely on to understand the world of games. Our vision is to empower businesses across the gaming ecosystem to create extraordinary experiences for a billion gamers every day.

If you want to help build the data foundation powering the future of gaming, we’d love to have you on the journey.

**The Role: IT Manager**

We’re looking for an IT Manager to lead and scale our IT operations globally. You’ll design, build, and manage a secure, robust, and efficient IT infrastructure, ensuring seamless support for a growing, multi-location organization. As both a strategist and a hands-on leader, you’ll help us achieve operational excellence and empower our teams to innovate.

**What We Are Looking For:**

**Technical Skills:**

* Strong practical experience in several of the following:
* Google Workspace administration
* Windows and macOS administration
* Identity and access management
* Endpoint/device management
* Networking, Wi-Fi, firewalls and VPNs
* SSO and MFA
* SaaS administration
* Backup and recovery
* Endpoint security
* IT asset management
* IT ticketing/service management tools
* Basic automation of IT administration
* Experience with cloud-first technology organizations is preferred.
* Working Style and Capabilities

**We are looking for someone who:**

* Takes ownership and follows issues through to resolution
* Can work independently without constant technical supervision
* Is hands-on and technically curious
* Can research unfamiliar technologies and form a recommendation
* Solves root causes rather than repeatedly fixing symptoms
* Creates clear, structured documentation
* Has strong written and spoken English
* Communicates effectively with vendors and internal stakeholders
* Is comfortable challenging vendors when necessary
* Can prioritize effectively
* Is proactive rather than reactive
* Understands when to solve something internally and when specialist help is required
* Uses data and evidence when making recommendations

**Qualifications**

* Relevant degree, diploma or equivalent professional experience
* 6-8 years of relevant IT / system administration experience
* Strong Google Workspace administration experience
* Experience managing junior IT resources and/or vendors
* Relevant Google, Microsoft, networking, security or cloud certifications are preferred but not mandatory
* Practical capability, independent problem-solving and demonstrated ownership of real-world IT environments will be valued more highly than certifications alone.

**Benefits:**

* Competitive salary.
* Health insurance.
* Casual dress code.
* Dynamic, collaboration-friendly office environment.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
As an Engineering Manager, you will provide delivery governance across multiple engineering pods building an enterprise-grade SaaS platform in the data privacy, data governance and AI governance space. You will own delivery outcomes, team health, staffing and continuity, and act as the main point of contact for client and leadership on delivery, risk and reporting. The role needs strong technical credibility combined with people management and engineering operations discipline.

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Own delivery governance across multiple pods: sprint commitments, release plans, milestones and quality outcomes.
* Manage staffing, onboarding, knowledge transfer, continuity planning and timely replacements so teams stay fully productive.
* Track and manage risks, dependencies and issues across pods, and drive escalations to closure with client and internal stakeholders.
* Define, track and report engineering metrics (velocity, predictability, defect leakage, cycle time, test coverage) and drive improvement actions.
* Prepare regular status reports and steering-committee updates for client and Kanerika leadership.
* Support timesheet management, effort tracking and invoicing reconciliation.
* Partner with Tech Leads and the AI Architect on technical direction, capacity planning and engineering best practices.
* Coach and mentor Tech Leads and engineers, and drive performance management, career growth and team engagement.
* Ensure adherence to SDLC, security, compliance, CI/CD and definition-of-done standards across pods.

**What You’ll Bring:**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
* 8+ years of software engineering experience, including at least 3 years as an Engineering Manager or Delivery Manager.
* Proven experience managing multiple agile teams (20+ engineers) on enterprise software or SaaS engagements.
* Technical background in Java, Python or full-stack development, enough to engage credibly in architecture and design discussions.

**Mandatory Skills:**

* Strong expertise in Agile/Scrum delivery at scale, including multi-team planning, dependency management and release governance.
* Experience with staffing, resource planning, onboarding and people management.
* Hands-on experience defining and reporting engineering KPIs and delivery metrics.
* Working knowledge of Java/Spring Boot, Python, Angular, microservices and AWS/Azure cloud.
* Understanding of CI/CD, DevOps, test automation and quality engineering practices.
* Experience with Jira, Confluence and delivery reporting tools such as Excel or Power BI.
* Familiarity with Time & Material engagements, timesheets and invoicing processes.
* Excellent stakeholder management, communication and escalation-handling skills.

**Good to Have:**

* Experience delivering AI/ML, GenAI or data platform programs.
* Domain exposure to data privacy, governance, security or compliance products.
* Certifications such as PMP, CSM, SAFe or PMI-ACP.

HVAC Project Manager

7 to 15 Years

We are seeking an experienced

* 8-15+ years of experience in HVAC project execution and project management.
* Strong hands-on experience in chiller installation, testing, and commissioning.
* Proven experience managing large commercial, industrial, healthcare, data center, or infrastructure HVAC projects.
* Experience in handling multiple projects simultaneously.

**Technical Skills**

* Chiller Installation & Commissioning
* HVAC Systems
* Pumps & Hydronic Systems
* Cooling Towers
* HVAC Controls Integration
* Project Scheduling and Planning
* Site Execution Management
* Testing & Commissioning
* Vendor & Contractor Management
* Cost Control & Budget Management

**Key Competencies**

* Project Leadership
* Stakeholder Management
* Customer Relationship Management
* Problem Solving & Decision Making
* Team Management
* Communication & Negotiation Skills

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Demonstrated experience in successfully delivering HVAC projects with a focus on chiller systems.
* Strong technical expertise in installation, testing, troubleshooting, and commissioning of chillers.
* Ability to lead cross-functional teams and manage multiple stakeholders.

title: Manager, Process Excellence (India)
description:
**Why Ryan?**

* Global Award-Winning Culture
* Flexible Work Environment
* Generous Paid Time Off
* World-Class Benefits and Compensation
* Rapid Growth Opportunities
* Company Sponsored Two-Way Transportation
* Exponential Career Growth

**Job Summary**
The Manager – Process Excellence and Transformation is responsible for leading strategic and operational initiatives including technology enabled solutions that improve operations across GCC locations. This hands-on transformation role requires a leader who can translate business problems into practical automation, artificial intelligence, workflow, integration, and analytics solutions; personally build solutions or direct their delivery; and demonstrate measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cycle time, capacity, cost, risk, client experience, and adoption. The role partners with Service Delivery, Technology and Global Shared Services teams to deliver measurable business outcomes and strengthen GCC capabilities.
  
  
**People**
**Duties and Responsibilities**

* Build and lead a high-performing AI, Automation, and Transformation team by fostering a culture of innovation, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.
* Provide guidance and support to Process Excellence team members on project execution, process analysis, documentation, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Build organizational capability by driving training, knowledge-sharing, and adoption of process, quality, and transformation best practices.
* Promote a data-driven mindset and encourage teams to identify opportunities for operational improvement and business transformation.
* Establish and reinforce standards for process documentation, quality management, and knowledge management to ensure consistency and compliance across the organization.

**Client**

* Partner with GCC and practice leaders to understand business priorities, surface high-value automation opportunities, and build an outcome-based transformation roadmap.
* Lead discovery workshops, process walkthroughs, and data analysis to identify manual effort, bottlenecks, rework, control gaps, and customer or team members pain points.
* Design, prototype, build, or lead the delivery of solutions using current technologies such as Microsoft Power Platform, AI agents, workflow automation, APIs, integrations, analytics, and low-code or pro-code services.
* Translate complex technical possibilities into clear business cases and delivery options and communicate associated risks and decisions to leadership.
* Develop and execute adoption and change-management plans, including communications, role-based enablement, stakeholder alignment, and transition to business ownership.
* Lead executive stakeholder engagement and communicate progress, decisions, dependencies, risks, and realized benefits with clarity.

**Value**

* Lead process excellence projects to deliver measurable improvements in productivity, quality, cycle time, and cost efficiency.
* Define, track, and report KPIs to evaluate the effectiveness of process improvements, QMS/DMS, automation, and AI initiatives.
* Develop dashboards and reporting mechanisms to monitor performance, trends, and business impact.
* Identify risks and implement mitigation strategies to ensure successful project execution and sustained outcomes.
* Conduct audits to ensure compliance with quality standards and governance requirements.
* Design and manage Process Knowledge Tests (PKTs) to assess capability gaps and drive continuous learning.
* Collaborate with technology teams to enhance system integration, governance, and knowledge management.
* Partners with technology and business teams to evaluate, implement, and scale AI and automation opportunities while ensuring appropriate governance, adoption, and measurable impact.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on quality enhancement, cycle time reduction, and productivity gains.
* Establishes process excellence dashboards, scorecards, and reporting mechanisms to monitor project progress, efficiency gains, quality trends, adoption levels, and business impact.

**Education And Experience**

* Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field.
* At least eight years of experience in automation, digital transformation, AI, technology-enabled operations, consulting, shared services, or related roles.
* A demonstrable track record of personally building, deploying, or leading production automation and AI solutions, supported by examples of the technologies used and business outcomes achieved.
* Evidence of measurable transformation outcomes such as productivity or capacity gains, cycle-time reduction, cost avoidance, quality improvement, risk reduction, or improved client and employee experience.

**Key Skills And Competencies**

* Hands-on, outcome-oriented approach to AI, automation, digital transformation, and operational problem-solving.
* Strong business acumen with the ability to connect technology choices to value, risk, feasibility, and adoption.
* Executive communication, influencing, negotiation, and cross-functional stakeholder management.
* Structured analytical thinking, data interpretation, business-case development, and KPI design.
* Change leadership and adoption discipline, including training, communications, operating-model transition, and reinforcement.
* Sound judgment on responsible AI, data governance, security, controls, and human-in-the-loop design.
* Lean Six Sigma or continuous-improvement experience is helpful where it supports automation and transformation delivery.

**Technical Skills**

* Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Automate, Power Apps, Power BI, and related governance capabilities.
* AI agents, prompt and evaluation practices, retrieval or knowledge integrations, and responsible AI controls.
* Workflow automation, RPA or task automation, APIs, system integrations, web services, and data pipelines.
* Analytics, dashboards, SQL or equivalent data skills, and value tracking.
* Solution documentation, source control or release practices, testing, monitoring, support transition, and access management.
* Proficiency with Microsoft 365 and collaboration tools. Familiarity with cloud services, low-code and pro-code development patterns is an advantage.

**Supervisory Responsibilities**

* Manage and develop Automation, Transformation, or Process Excellence Analysts and project contributors.
* Lead cross-functional delivery teams and coordinate business, technology, risk, data, and change stakeholders.
* Set clear delivery expectations, review solution quality, and create accountability for adoption and realized business value.

**Work Environment**

* Standard 40+ hour workweek in a professional office environment.
* Hybrid work model with a minimum of three days per week in the Hyderabad office.

* Monitor multiple projects through the entire program cycle, Manage the daytoday detailed aspects of multiple projects, Coordinate and utilize resources for multiple projects in the program
* Communicate program objectives, goals, and progress to program directors, executives, upper management, and stakeholders

* While the individual will be based at our Bangalore office, the role requires the person to travel to other countries on a short or long-term basis for client engagements.

* PMP Certifications or equivalent certification
* Scrum Product Owner or Scrum Master Certifications

title: Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering
description:
ABOUT US:
  
  
LSEG (London Stock Exchange Group) is more than a diversified global financial markets infrastructure and data business. We are dedicated, open-access partners with a dedication to excellence in delivering the services our customers expect from us. With extensive experience, deep knowledge and worldwide presence across financial markets, we enable businesses and economies around the world to fund innovation, manage risk and create jobs. It’s how we’ve contributed to supporting the financial stability and growth of communities and economies globally for more than 300 years. Through a comprehensive suite of trusted financial market infrastructure services – and our open-access model – we provide the flexibility, stability and trust that enable our customers to pursue their ambitions with confidence and clarity.
  
  
LSEG is headquartered in the United Kingdom, with significant operations in 65 countries across EMEA, North America, Latin America and Asia Pacific. We employ 25,000 people globally, more than half located in Asia Pacific. LSEG’s ticker symbol is LSEG.
  
  
OUR PEOPLE:
  
  
People are at the heart of what we do and drive the success of our business. Our values of Integrity, Partnership, Excellence and Change shape how we think, how we do things and how we help our people fulfil their potential. We embrace diversity and actively seek to attract individuals with unique backgrounds and perspectives. We break down barriers and encourage teamwork, enabling innovation and rapid development of solutions that make a difference. Our workplace generates an enriching and rewarding experience for our people and customers alike. Our vision is to build an inclusive culture in which everyone feels encouraged to fulfil their potential.
  
  
We know that real personal growth cannot be achieved by simply climbing a career ladder – which is why we encourage and enable a wealth of avenues and interesting opportunities for everyone to broaden and deepen their skills and expertise. As a global organisation spanning 65 countries and one rooted in a culture of growth, opportunity, diversity and innovation, LSEG is a place where everyone can grow, develop and fulfil your potential with meaningful careers.
  
  
ROLE PROFILE:
  
  
The Senior Manager - Reliability Engineering is accountable for the reliability, resilience, and operational effectiveness of critical enterprise applications and platforms throughout the service lifecycle.
  
  
The role will drive the evolution of the L2/SRE function from reactive production support towards proactive reliability engineering, using automation, observability, operational learning, and strong engineering partnerships to reduce toil, incidents, and operational risk.
  
  
Working across engineering, product, infrastructure, security, and support, the role will promote shared ownership of production reliability and ensure services are continuously improved to meet agreed levels of availability, performance, resilience, and customer experience.
  
  
What you'll be doing
  
  

* Lead the L2/SRE function and its continuous improvement, with accountability for improving service reliability, resilience, operational efficiency, and engineering maturity.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing L2/SRE team, fostering accountability, technical capability, operational excellence, and continuous improvement.
* Define and mature Service Level Objectives (SLOs), Service Level Indicators (SLIs), and error budgets to support clear, data-led reliability and engineering decisions.
* Reduce operational toil through automation, improved tooling, self-service capabilities, and simplification of repetitive support activities.
* Establish strong observability and alerting standards across logging, metrics, tracing, dashboards, and telemetry to improve detection, diagnosis, and recovery.
* Define operational readiness standards, ensuring services are supportable, resilient, appropriately monitored, well documented, and have clear recovery and escalation procedures before entering production.
* Lead effective Incident Management within L2/SRE, including response, escalation, post-incident review, and identification of recurring issues. Partner with L3 on Problem Management and RCA, ensuring corrective actions and reliability improvements are tracked through to completion.
* Champion strong ITSM practices and operational hygiene across Incident, Problem, Change, service ownership, documentation, and continuous improvement.
* Oversee proportionate, risk-based Change Management and approval processes, ensuring changes are appropriately assessed, dependencies and conflicts are understood, implementation and rollback plans are robust, and higher-risk activity receives the right level of scrutiny while avoiding unnecessary overhead for well-understood, low-risk change.
* Partner with L3 engineering and other technology teams to ensure production learnings, recurring incidents, support trends, and reliability concerns are reflected in engineering priorities and addressed at source.
* Drive resilience improvements through disaster recovery and failover testing, capacity planning, dependency analysis, and clear ownership of reliability-related technical debt.
* Define, monitor, and report on service health and reliability measures, including availability, performance, SLO attainment, incident trends, recovery times, operational risk, and improvement outcomes.
* Apply strong technical judgement, risk assessment, prioritisation, and conflict-resolution skills when making decisions in high-pressure operational situations.

What you'll get in return:
  
  
At LSEG, we invest in excellence. You’ll be part of a high-performing team where your expertise is valued and your impact is visible. We offer:
  
  

* Competitive compensation with performance-based rewards.
* A flexible hybrid work model that supports work-life balance.
* Access to cutting-edge tools and infrastructure to do your best work.
* Opportunities for continuous learning, including certifications, conferences, and internal mobility.
* A collaborative culture that values technical mastery, ownership, and innovation.
* The chance to work on a globally critical system that powers secure financial transactions across markets.

Working with us means that you will be part of a dynamic organisation of 25,000 people across 65 countries. However, we will value your individuality and enable you to bring your true self to work so you can help enrich our diverse workforce.

title: Director, Project Management
description:
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is a privately held, specialty pharmaceutical company that focuses on innovative products that meet the needs of underserved patients. As an industry leader in providing unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, Azurity leverages its integrated capabilities and vast partner network to continually expand its broad commercial product portfolio and robust late-stage pipeline. The company’s patient-centric products span the cardiovascular, neurology, endocrinology, gastro-intestinal, institutional, and orphan markets, and have benefited millions of patients. For more information, visit www.azurity.com.
  
  
Azurity Pharmaceuticals is proud to be an inclusive workplace and an Equal Opportunity Employer. Azurity's success is attributable to our incredibly talented, dedicated team that focuses on benefiting the lives of patients by bringing the best science and commitment to quality into everything that we do. We seek highly motivated individuals with the dedication, integrity, and creative spirit needed to thrive in our organization.
  
  
**Brief Team/department Description**
Azurity develops unique, accessible, and high-quality medications, to serve overlooked patients. This role is with Azurity R&D project management team, which coordinates cross-functional planning, development and tracking of project plans, considering time, cost, quality and strategy. As we grow and expand, we are building new capabilities to make our processes simpler, faster, and more efficient. We are looking for a dynamic, change-inspired leader, to lead R&D project management, and process improvement initiatives.
  
  
This role will report to the R&D head and act as an internal consultant operating from Azurity’s Hyderabad development center. The role holder provides input on resource (budget, headcount) strategy and support in setting the yearly product delivery KPI. This role will be responsible for managing the R&D Project Management department, defining, and implementing R&D Project Management processes. Holds the overall responsibility in the R&D PM team for ensuring Project Plans, Budgets, Timelines are tracked against baseline and updated as per the Program Management process. Ensure project plan alignment with portfolio and product lifecycle management (PLM) goals.
  
  
The role holder will lead cross-functional initiatives to enhance R&D productivity and streamline product development processes through targeted process improvements, tool evaluation, and vendor coordination. This role acts as the functional lead to ensure that technology-enabled solutions align closely with evolving R&D needs, leveraging a strong working knowledge of pharmaceutical R&D workflows, data and applicable concepts to effectively coordinate with external vendors, internal data science and digital teams. This role focuses on functional leadership and facilitation, responsible for working with the Chief Scientific Officer and science department heads to ensure streamlined processes are in place for meeting yearly KPIs, identifying process improvement & simplification opportunities.
  
  
The scope includes financial governance, reporting, resource planning, and process improvement. An ideal candidate will have experience with leading complex programs within the pharmaceutical development lifecycle, in addition to experience with CMO/CRO/lab operations. A deep understanding of project plans, budgeting / forecasting is a key attribute. This is a collaborative role involving significant engagement with cross-functional heads (such as Quality, finance, accounting, legal and IT), to drive programs and ensure adoption. This role will have the exciting and unique opportunity to drive Management System excellence and adoption within our growing Hyderabad organization. The ideal candidate will be a quick learner who can work in an extremely fast paced organization and pivot from one objective to the next quickly.
  
  
**Principle Responsibilities**

* A) Lead project management
* Enable preparation and management of CSO-R&D budget, yearly KPIs and project plans. Enable project managers to identify, document and manage critical path activities. Review project plans, challenge project schedule baseline and assumptions. Ensure project managers have defined all activities with appropriate timelines, costs, risks and mitigation plans aligned with the project stakeholders.
* Through the project managers, prepare month-on-month project forecasts and manage CSO-level variance between forecast vs. actual within thresholds. Facilitate budget decisions and deliverables throughout the yearly cycle. Support the R&D head and science department heads in articulating decisions required, risks and layout options at appropriate level of depth to enable decisions.
* Enable project plan updation in A3 templates for all projects. Support the Franchise Portfolio Management and finance leadership with timeline, and cost evaluations when requested. Responsible for project status reporting to R&D scientific leadership team (SLT), Strategic Portfolio Management and other project stakeholders as required. Maintain management information systems on budget, timelines, key risks, and decisions.
* Partner with the finance leadership and co-own the Long-Range Budget forecast, responsible for R&D opex, capex, and product-level development cost. Align science department leadership on the stage-wise Probability of Technical & Regulatory success.
* B) Management systems & processes:
* Continuously improve the contract and purchase order (PO) management process for R&D, through a periodic review of SLA and goals with the legal and finance teams Facilitate regular and ad hoc project team meetings, ensuring documentation of agendas, minutes, and actions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams (internal/external) to track key performance indicators
* Develop/maintain collaboration and nurture relationships with internal partner functions and external entities as required, to support business and strategic goals. Serve as the point person for initial escalation, conflict resolution, project risk mitigation for issues that cannot be resolved in the Project Teams, requiring liaising with department leaders
* Oversight, mentoring, training of PM team members on policies and procedures
* Support R&D operational planning - Lab space management, capex & support internal preparedness for QA audits, leadership visits.
* Responsible for drafting the R&D sections in management presentations, working with the department heads and the Chief Scientific Officer.
* C) Digital enablement initiatives:
* Lead a small team of PMs and manage the R&D digital budget, including annual subscriptions for off-the-shelf solutions as well as custom built solutions (external as well as in-house).
* Champion the evaluation of cutting-edge data tools and data-enabled solutions by working alongside internal digital, data science and technical teams to ensure deliverables meeting R&D’s strategic goals
* Lead end-to-end digital transformations from vendor selection to rollout, engaging with IT, cross functional teams and external vendors. Wherever optimal, lead in-house workflow creation and execution through the IT team.
* Serve as the internal business owner to the Azurity IT team, on R&D / laboratory systems such as E-Lab Notebook, Document mgmt. system. Drive functional oversight on integration projects involving lab systems, ensuring alignment with R&D workflows
* Build and manage vendor relationships through screening, onboarding and on-premises engagements. Define and monitor service expectations from external vendors via functionally aligned SLAs based on R&D user needs. Provide continuous feedback to vendors to ensure tools evolve with R&D processes, without taking direct ownership of the digital systems

**Qualifications/Educational Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Pharmacy, Pharmaceutical Sciences, Life Sciences, Chemistry, Biotechnology, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* Master's degree preferred:
* MBA (Strategy, Operations, General Management, or Finance)
* MS/M.Pharm in a relevant scientific field
* Certifications (preferred, not mandatory)
* PMP
* PgMP
* Lean Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt

**Preferred Experience**
15-20 years of pharmaceutical industry experience, including:
  
  
**Project and Portfolio Management**

* At least 7-10 years managing cross-functional development programs.
* Experience with R&D portfolios rather than isolated projects.
* Experience leading governance meetings and stage-gate reviews.

**Budget Management**

* Ownership or co-ownership of departmental budgets.
* Experience reviewing forecasts prepared by analysts or PMs.
* Experience presenting budget updates to senior leadership.

**Process and Organizational Change**

* Designing new departmental processes.
* Simplifying complex workflows.
* Implementing systems such as Veeva, TrackWise, Planisware, Smartsheet, Clarity, Microsoft Project, etc.
* Creating governance models and decision-making frameworks.
* Driving organizational adoption of new ways of working.

By applying for this role, you confirm that you are mentally and physically capable of fulfilling the job responsibilities detailed in the job description without any restrictions. If you have any concerns or even the slightest disability that may affect your ability to perform the job, please inform HR in advance.

**Description:**

A global consumer goods company is building its finance operations centre in Hyderabad, and Tribera is running the search.   billing, cash application, credit and collections, disputes and deductions, AR reporting

* Strong financial accounting. You know why an entry is made as well as how to post it.

* Clear written and spoken English with stakeholders across countries



**Education:**
CA, CA Inter, MCom or any master’s in finance. CIMA or ACCA is an advantage for manager roles.

Email your CV to careers@tribera.ai with your tower and level in the subject line, for example “RTR – Team Leader”. Include your total experience and years in that tower, your team size if you lead one, your current and expected CTC in lakhs per annum, and your notice period.

title: Business Portfolio Partner - Biosimilars
description:
Dr. Reddy’s Laboratories Ltd. is a leading multinational pharmaceutical company based across global locations. Each of our 24,000 plus employees comes to work every day for one collective purpose: to accelerate access to affordable and innovative medicines because
**Good Health Can’t Wait**
.

We started in 1984 with a modest investment, 20 employees and a bold vision. Today, we have research and development centres, manufacturing facilities or a commercial presence in 66 countries.

For nearly four decades, we have stood for access, affordability and innovation based on the bedrock of deep science, progressive people practices and robust corporate governance. As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).

‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose-driven, future-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1.5 Bn+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency

Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ & nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.

**Job Description**

**Job summary**
  
We are looking for an individual in the portfolio analytics role that would support product ideation and selection process. The role involves detailed quantitative and qualitative evaluation of pipeline attributes such as disease area, epidemiology, competitive intelligence, asset valuation. The role also involves custom database development and utilization of visualization tools for senior leadership interaction to drive decision making.
  
  
  
  
**Roles & Responsibilities**

1. Product and Market Analytics

Conduct qualitative and quantitative market analysis for biologics across geographies to assess therapy, pricing, patient populations, unmet needs, and competitive dynamics. Leverage internal and external data sources (e.g., IQVIA, GlobalData, ASP, DRG, IPD) to generate insights on price erosion, biosimilar penetration, and competition impact. Support the analytics through design and maintenance of customized databases to enable senior leadership level visualization.

2. Financial Modeling & Valuation

Develop and maintain financial models incorporating key assumptions such as market share, price erosion, competition, and biosimilar uptake. Build long‑term forecasts using both bottom‑up (patient‑based) and top‑down approaches, accounting for regulatory, market, and geopolitical factors. Evaluate product viability through NPV, IRR, and scenario analysis to support make‑vs‑buy and investment decisions. Work with frontend markets to develop consolidated business case for the products.

3. Integrated Product Strategy

Define the objectives of a program to towards definition of the Product Requirement Document, a product development road map through considerations technical aspects of product development and life cycle management such as - CMC, Clinical etc.

4. Stakeholder Management

Collaborate closely with Business Development, Finance, Strategy, Product Management, R&D, IP, and Market teams to integrate inputs and enable informed decision‑making.

**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification:**
Masters in Pharmacy, Life Sciences, Biotech, or similar fields, with an MBA with specialization in any of Finance, Operations, Strategy, Analytics
  
  
  
  
**Minimum work experience**
: 4 to 7 years of experience in portfolio management, product management or business development
  
  
  
  
**Skills & attributes:
  
  
  
  
Technical Skills**
  
• Hands-on work experience in designing and developing financial models, including expertise in financial modelling related to licensing, cost analysis, and evaluation of financial accounts.
  
  
• Strong proficiency in MS Office Suite, particularly Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  
  
• General understanding of Portfolio Management principles.
  
  
• Solid understanding of drug product development processes, including the various stages involved in bringing a pharmaceutical product to market.
  
  
• Knowledge of healthcare databases, routine financial reporting, and a strong ability to handle analytical data within the healthcare context.
  
  
• Expertise in financial analysis, including the use of visualization tools for data interpretation.
  
  
• Understanding of the global regulatory framework in the pharmaceutical and healthcare industries.
  
  
• Knowledge and experience in conducting program and stage gate reviews, with a focus on evaluating business cases.
  
  
• Fundamental knowledge of Quality principles, Formulation Development, Manufacturing processes, and Supply Chain management within the pharmaceutical industry.
  
  
  
  
**Behavioural skills**
  
• Demonstrates proficiency in negotiations and sensitivity to cross-cultural dynamics.
  
  
• Maintains objectivity and effectively works in ambiguous situations.
  
  
• Possesses a strong blend of strategic thinking and execution skills, aligning cross-functional teams for successful outcomes.
  
  
• Exhibits self-initiative and resilience, proactively addressing challenges.
  
  
• Communicates effectively and engages with senior leaders, showcasing strong communication skills.

**Additional Information**

**About the Department
  
  
Biologics**
  
Currently operates in the Global Biosimilars business - a segment that is poised for attractive and sustained growth over the next 10–15-year time horizon.
  
  
With a robust portfolio of biosimilar products across key therapeutic areas, covering ~US$80+ Bn in innovator sales – future business pipeline covers a variety of product classes and therapy areas, and new modalities. Fully integrated organization with over two decades of experience in developing, manufacturing and commercializing multiple biosimilar products.
  
  
With a Product Development engine that has end-to-end capabilities – in-house clone development, upstream and downstream process development, bioanalytical development and proprietary formulation.
  
  
Supported by a Clinical and Regulatory team with experience in executing complex biosimilar programs with innovative global trial designs.
  
  
We have a proven experience in commercial-scale manufacturing across a variety of technology platforms with global quality standards and a highly competitive cost structure
  
  
Rich experience of commercializing high-quality biosimilars in multiple markets with over 900,000 patients having benefited from our products till date.
  
  
  
  
**Benefits Offered**
  
At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
  
  
The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining & relocation support, family support (Maternity & Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
  
  
  
  
**Our Work Culture**
  
Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
  
  
For more details, please visit our career website at
**https://careers.drreddys.com/#!/**

title: Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth
description:
The Senior Associate, Strategy and Growth is part of the build-out of the Strategy team. This hire adds dedicated capacity across the team's strategy and growth agenda: sizing and prioritizing growth opportunities, evaluating portfolio and pricing performance, building business cases, and preparing executive materials.
  
  
The role sits at the threshold of manager. Projects of moderate complexity are run largely independently, with 80 to 90 percent ownership, and the most complex initiatives are supported alongside the Senior Director, Strategy and Growth, and the team. Exceptional candidates may be considered at Manager level.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  

* Growth strategy and opportunity sizing. Size and prioritize growth opportunities across new products, adjacent markets, partner and channel models, and pricing, using top-down and bottom-up approaches with clearly stated assumptions.
* Project leadership. Run moderate-complexity strategy projects from scoping to final recommendation, and support the Senior Director, Strategy and Growth, and the team on the most complex initiatives.

* Cross-functional partnership. Work with Finance, Product, Sales, Marketing, and Pricing teams to gather inputs, test hypotheses, and carry recommendations into planning and execution.

Competencies
  
  

* Structured thinking. Frames ambiguous problems into clear questions and tests them with evidence.

* Communication. Writes and presents with precision and gets to the point quickly.
* Ownership. Drives work to completion, checks accuracy, and raises risks early.
* Collaboration across time zones. Works effectively with US-based leaders and global colleagues.

Required Experience
  
  
**Required**

title: Fellowship - Healthtech, Medtech & LifeSciences - 2026 cohort SucSEED
description:
**Fellow – Healthtech, Medtech & LifeSciences**

* Location: Hyderabad (Work From Office – CIE, IIIT-H Campus, Gachibowli)
* Duration: 12-Month (Full-Time Fellowship) onsite
* Stipend: Paid Fellowship

**About SucSEED**
SucSEED is the Investment Manager of SEBI-regulated SucSEED Indovation Fund, an AIF Category-I Venture Capital Fund. We partner with ambitious founders and build long-term institutional platforms in India’s early-stage ecosystem. We have also set up a Fund Management Entity in GIFT City Gujarat to launch our Fund-III in USD denomination.
  
  
We nurture entrepreneurial talent through capital — and venture talent through ownership and responsibility.
  
  
**About The Role**
The full-time fellowship program is for a year and is aimed at giving the fellows a full taste of what happens in a VC fund. For deserving candidates, the program provides a full-time offer from SucSEED or its associated firms.
  
  
Working within the Healthtech, Medtech, Lifesciences and Wellness sectors requires evaluating opportunities across the entire ecosystem- providers, payers, patients, regulators, and technology enablers. Fellows will develop a sector-wide perspective, analyzing companies at various stages of maturity through both clinical and commercial lenses. The role requires evaluating clinical validation, regulatory pathways, reimbursement dynamics, hospital adoption cycles, and scientific defensibility- making this fellowship uniquely analytical and impact-driven.
  
  
In this Fellowship, you will be expected to learn & understand the progress in the sector, build & maintain valuation-related analysis, prepare write-ups, present investment ideas to the Sectoral Committee, Investment Mgmt Team, Partners & Investment Committees, in order to take an informed call on early-stage deals. Once invested, grow the PortCo and create value for Investors through a healthy Exit.
  
  
**Role Mandate & Key Responsibilities**

* Buy-side Sectoral Research leading to Pre-Deal discovery
* Responsible for conducting primary & Secondary market research around Technology Innovation in various Sectors of SucSEED's Investment thesis to identify opportunities for growth & innovation and convert into Annual Buy-side Sectoral Research.
* Evaluate scalable healthtech, medtech opportunities with faster time-to-market and revenue realization, in the areas of diagnostic technologies, remote monitoring, digital care models, preventive medicine, etc.
* Map the healthcare value chain to identify whitespace tech-driven opportunities and unmet clinical needs.
* Track Healthcare regulatory developments (CDSCO, FDA, CE, etc.) and assess their impact on investment viability.
* Benchmark business models, pricing structures, and reimbursement dynamics across geographies.
* Assess capital intensity, time-to-market, and risk-adjusted return profiles of healthcare segments.
* Attend various events in the sector and analyse Industry trends/ data to identify patterns & Partners to work with
* Build Community
* Create a Community of various stakeholders (Incubators, Accelerators, Funds, Regulators, Institutions, Investors, Corporations, etc) to create value in that sector and use them effectively to conduct Sectoral Research
* Create a platform for Startup founders to pitch their solutions & discover deals more proactively.
* Discover more Sectoral Curators from this community to help shape the Fund's roadmap.
* Deal Discovery
* Work with various Incubators & Sourcing Partners such as CCMB, IIHMR, IITM, IIITH, IIMB and other Accelerators to discover innovations matching our investment themes (inbound & outbound)
* Filter, Screen & interact with founders to appreciate their solutions.
* Collaborate with Sectoral Curators to help shape Fund roadmaps & discover deals accordingly.
* Investment Mgmt & Deal Execution
* Conduct Investment analysis based on product features, market size & business projections to build a case to invest.
* Work with the Investment committee to identify investment interest and ensure the Investment Memo covers all the salient points to get approval from the committees & LPs, delivered on time, as per the scope.
* Portfolio Management & Value Creation / Scaling of PortCos
* Work with Portfolio company Founders and develop an implementation plan to achieve Business Plans & GTM.
* Track & report on key performance metrics to senior management. You will be expected to conduct in-depth benchmarking of valuation & operational metrics (vs. peer groups), and learn how other analyses could be helpful in Early-stage investments.
* Develop Outreach, presentations & other materials to communicate with clients, partners & investors about the sector.
* Identify Clients, Partners & Investors who can bring value towards the growth of our PortCos, with regular engagements through Portfolio Showcases.
* Sell-side Sectoral Research & Create Exits
* Relationship & Engagement: Lead day-to-day execution of complex engagement with CorpDev/ Client Teams and Private Equity players across Pre-Deal phase, Deal Execution phase & Value Creation / Scaling of PortCos.
* Business Development: Identify & convert client opportunities by building relationships with Global PE/M&A Leadership, Client Account Teams, & Client stakeholders in PE/Corp across geographies. Harness extensive knowledge combined with an integrated suite of methods, people & assets to help the Fund create Value for Investors.
* Practice Development: Contribute to the development of new assets / IP, thought capital & POVs, raising the profile of the team & the PortCo, leading to demand generation.
* Collaboration with Institutional Partners
* You’ll get the exposure to handle responsibilities by working closely on Investor Relationship (retail, institutional and Family offices)
* Develop deeper relationship with Partners of SucSEED (Incubators, Accelerators, Investment Bankers, network with other fund houses, Service Providers, Large Technology providers, and so on)
* Work on Events and Collaborations to create better outreach, and create sell-side opportunities towards exits and work on Marketing and Communication strategy to have better brand recall with the external world at every level. And help our Portfolio companies with various Partnership outreach.

**Program Structure**

* 12-month full-time Fellowship
* Work From Office (minimum 5 days in a 6 day week)
* Hyderabad-based (relocation required if not local)
* Strong preference for candidates committed to completing the full term

**The Program Is IDEAL For a Person**
At SucSEED, we believe that diversity of experiences & backgrounds drives the quality of decision-making. We expect our Fellows to come from all walks of life. Beyond hard skills, we place emphasis on core attributes that define the way of working at SucSEED.
  
  
People who feel MBA programs in the next 12-24 months shall give a boost to their professional journey & are open to INSTEAD explore alternative approaches to learn & grow, WITHOUT going through the MBA route.
  
  
Who needs a new challenge & wants to get a taste of the VC industry, before they switch careers.
  
  
**Ideal Candidate Profile**
We require performance-oriented accountability and constant learning. We believe in building Venture Partners in the next few years, from within by encouraging our team to challenge themselves and explore their deep potential.
  
  
**Educational Background**

* Bachelor’s or Master’s in Medicine, Dental, Biotech, Pharma, Life Sciences, Healthcare, Bioinformatics, or related fields
* Working knowledge of healthcare regulations and compliance (is not mandatory but highly preferred)

**Experience & Skillset**

* 0–3 years of experience in the healthcare industries, health IT, Medtech, Lifesciences, Health automation, or business analysis
* Strong interest in business, finance, accounting, valuation, and equity research
* Exposure to M&A, PE, CorpDev, consulting, or startup ecosystems is a plus
* Strong project management and ability to manage multiple initiatives

**Core Attributes**

* Clear, confident communicator across technical and non-technical stakeholders
* Curious, entrepreneurial, and highly performance-driven
* Passionate about technology-led disruption in healthcare
* Collaborative team player with a bias for ownership and execution
* Based in Hyderabad or willing to relocate; open to WFO (6 days/week)

SucSEED provides a unique platform for accelerated learning & fast-tracking your career. Whilst we take our work seriously, we also love creating fun and fond memories.
  
  
Please apply on this link or email us with your cover letter & resume. Use the same email for any questions you might have before your application
  
  
**What You Will Gain**

* Build a career in the VC ecosystem, with Rich, hands-on learning experience
* Access to our network of world-class founders, curators & operators
* An opportunity to act alongside entrepreneurs within a leading venture Capital ecosystem. Get a stipend paid, doing what you love.

Top performers may be considered for extended roles within SucSEED or associated ecosystem entities.

title: Accounting Manager
description:
**Accounting Manager**

**Designation:**
Accounting Manager

**Experience:**
8 - 10+ Years

**Industry:**
IT Services / IT Staffing

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time

**Location:**
Hyderabad

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced and detail-oriented
**Accounting Manager**
to manage end-to-end accounting operations for an IT Services company. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in general accounting, financial reporting, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliations, taxation, statutory compliance, and month-end and year-end closing activities.

The role requires hands-on accounting knowledge, strong analytical skills, and the ability to ensure accurate financial records, timely reporting, compliance with applicable regulations, and effective financial controls.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. End-to-End Accounting Operations**

* Manage day-to-day accounting operations, including journal entries, ledger maintenance, and general bookkeeping.
* Oversee general ledger scrutiny and ensure accurate recording of all financial transactions.
* Manage month-end and year-end closing activities.
* Prepare and review trial balances, profit and loss statements, balance sheets, and other financial statements.
* Maintain proper accounting records, supporting documents, and audit trails.
* Ensure accounting practices comply with applicable Indian Accounting Standards and statutory requirements.
* Experience in a Shared Services environment is preferred, with the ability to manage centralized accounting operations, standardize financial processes, and ensure accuracy, efficiency, and compliance across multiple business units or entities.

**2. Accounts Payable and Accounts Receivable**

* Manage vendor invoices, payment processing, expense booking, and vendor reconciliations.
* Oversee customer invoicing, billing accuracy, outstanding receivables, and collections follow-ups.
* Monitor debtor and creditor ageing reports and resolve discrepancies.
* Reconcile customer and vendor accounts regularly.
* Track employee reimbursements, advances, and other business expenses.
* Ensure timely processing of payments and accurate recording of receipts.

**3. Bank and General Ledger Reconciliation**

* Perform and review bank reconciliations on a regular basis.
* Reconcile general ledger accounts, vendor accounts, customer accounts, and intercompany balances, where applicable.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies, unidentified transactions, and unreconciled balances.
* Ensure all financial transactions are properly supported and recorded in the accounting system.

**4. Billing and Revenue Accounting – IT Services**

* Manage client billing, invoice preparation, and revenue-related accounting entries.
* Verify billing inputs against approved contracts, Statements of Work (SOWs), timesheets, and project records, wherever applicable.
* Coordinate with delivery, HR, recruitment, and operations teams to validate billing and payroll-related inputs.
* Track unbilled revenue, outstanding invoices, and customer payment status.
* Ensure appropriate revenue recognition in accordance with applicable accounting principles and contractual terms.

**5. Taxation and Statutory Compliance**

* Handle and monitor GST compliance, including GST returns, input tax credit reconciliation, and related documentation.
* Manage TDS calculations, deductions, payments, returns, and reconciliations.
* Support income tax compliance and preparation of relevant financial information.
* Maintain records for applicable Professional Tax, Provident Fund (PF), Employee State Insurance (ESI), and other statutory obligations in coordination with the respective teams.
* Ensure timely filing of applicable returns and payment of statutory dues.
* Coordinate with tax consultants and statutory authorities, wherever required.

**6. Payroll Accounting and Expense Management**

* Review payroll inputs and ensure accurate accounting of salary expenses, deductions, reimbursements, and employee-related liabilities.
* Reconcile payroll reports with accounting records.
* Coordinate with HR and Finance teams for payroll accounting, employee advances, and final settlement entries.
* Monitor operating expenses and ensure proper expense classification and supporting documentation.
* Maintain records of fixed assets, depreciation, and other applicable accounting adjustments.

**7. Financial Reporting and MIS**

* Prepare monthly financial statements and management reports.
* Generate monthly Profit & Loss statements, Balance Sheets, Trial Balances, and cash and bank summaries.
* Prepare accounts receivable and payable ageing reports.
* Assist in budgeting, expense monitoring, and variance analysis.
* Provide accurate financial data and accounting insights to management for decision-making.
* Maintain entity-wise financial records and reporting, wherever applicable.

**8. Audit and Internal Controls**

* Coordinate with internal and external auditors during financial and statutory audits.
* Prepare schedules, ledgers, reconciliations, and supporting documents required for audits.
* Ensure compliance with accounting policies, financial procedures, and approval workflows.
* Identify accounting discrepancies and recommend corrective actions.
* Strengthen internal controls and maintain proper documentation for all financial transactions.

**9. Accounting Systems and Team Coordination**

* Work with accounting software such as Tally, Zoho Books, or other ERP/accounting systems.
* Maintain accurate accounting data and ensure timely updates in the financial system.
* Identify opportunities to streamline accounting processes and improve reporting efficiency.
* Coordinate with HR, Operations, Delivery, Sales, and Management teams on finance-related matters.
* Guide and review the work of accounts team members, wherever applicable.

**Required Skills and Qualifications**

* CA Inter, CMA Inter, MBA Finance, or equivalent professional qualification would be an advantage.
* 8–10+ years of relevant experience in accounting and finance operations, preferably in IT Services, IT Staffing, or a service-based organization.
* Strong knowledge of general accounting, journal entries, ledger scrutiny, and financial statement preparation.
* Practical experience in GST, TDS, income tax, and applicable statutory compliance.
* Hands-on experience in accounts payable, accounts receivable, bank reconciliation, and month-end closing.
* Knowledge of revenue accounting, client billing, and timesheet-based billing processes in IT Services.
* Proficiency in Tally, Zoho Books, or other accounting/ERP systems.
* Advanced MS Excel skills, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP, and financial data analysis.
* Strong attention to detail, analytical ability, problem-solving skills, and organizational skills.
* Ability to manage multiple accounting activities and meet strict reporting and compliance deadlines.

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Experience working in an IT Services, IT Staffing, consulting, or other service-oriented organization.
* Strong hands-on accounting and reconciliation skills.
* Ability to independently manage routine accounting operations and monthly financial closing.
* Experience coordinating with auditors, tax consultants, banks, vendors, and customers.
* Strong ownership, accuracy, confidentiality, and commitment to financial discipline.

title: Insights Scaling Lead, Google Cloud
description:

.

Google Cloud accelerates every organization’s ability to digitally transform its business and industry. We deliver enterprise-grade solutions that leverage Google’s cutting-edge technology, and tools that help developers build more sustainably. Customers in more than 200 countries and territories turn to Google Cloud as their trusted partner to enable growth and solve their most critical business problems.

Google is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace and is an affirmative action employer. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity or Veteran status.
