title: Product Planning Manager
description:
Global NPU Business | Secure Connected Edge Processing
  
  
Are you a strategy‑driven problem solver with a passion for shaping long‑term business direction in fast‑moving technology markets? Join us as
**Product Planning Manager**
and play a critical role in defining and driving the long‑term strategy for NXP’s Global NPU business within the Secure Connected Edge Processing Business Line.
  
  
In this highly visible role, you will work closely with executive leadership, product management, engineering, finance, and sales to help define where we play, how we win, and how we allocate investment to maximize long‑term growth and competitive advantage.
  
  
**What You’ll Do**
As Product Planning Manager, you will lead
**strategic analysis, portfolio planning, and executive decision support**
for the NPU business. You will translate complex market, customer, and competitive signals into clear insights, structured recommendations, and actionable plans that guide portfolio strategy, roadmap priorities, and investment decisions.
  
  
You will operate at both the
**30,000‑foot strategy level**
and the
**ground‑truth execution level**
, ensuring that long‑term strategy is tightly connected to product roadmaps, go‑to‑market plans, and financial outcomes.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Lead strategic planning initiatives for the Global NPU business, including multi‑year growth strategy, portfolio prioritization, and investment frameworks
* Conduct deep market, customer, and competitive analysis to identify strategic opportunities, risks, and white spaces
* Partner closely with Product Management to influence roadmap direction, build business cases, and assess tradeoffs across performance, power, software enablement, and ecosystem strategy
* Support annual and multi‑year planning processes (strategic plans, LTP, OP, portfolio reviews) with structured analysis and executive‑ready narratives
* Develop clear, compelling materials for executive leadership, including strategy decks, decision memos, and scenario analyses
* Drive cross‑functional alignment by working with engineering, marketing, finance, and sales to ensure strategy translates into execution
* Evaluate inorganic growth, partnerships, and ecosystem opportunities in collaboration with corporate strategy and business development
* Establish and track key strategic metrics and KPIs to assess progress and inform course corrections
* Act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders on strategic questions, tradeoffs, and prioritization decisions

**What You Bring**
**Education**

* Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, computer engineering, computer science, business, economics, marketing, or a related discipline required.
* MBA and/or advanced technical degree strongly preferred.
* Combination of technical education and business strategy experience highly valued

**Experience/Knowledge**

* 8–12+ years of experience in strategic planning, strategy, management consulting, product strategy, or corporate development, ideally in technology‑driven industries

* Strong cross‑functional leadership skills, with experience influencing without direct authority
* Comfort operating in fast‑paced, high‑ambiguity environments with multiple stakeholders
* High ownership mindset, intellectual curiosity, and bias for action
* Experience working at the intersection of strategy and execution, not just strategy formulation

**Nice to Have**

* Direct exposure to AI silicon, edge computing, or platform businesses
* Experience supporting C‑level or GM‑level strategic reviews

title: Manager / Sr. Manager
description:

title: Team Lead II, Accounting
description:
**Job Summary**
Are you passionate about service excellence? Would you love to work for a global organization that is doing more good for people and planet?
  
  
IFF is a global leader in flavors, fragrances, food ingredients and health & biosciences. We deliver sustainable innovations that elevate everyday products.
  
  
Food Ingredients: Innovating improved nutritional profiles, better taste and texture, and greater cost efficiency to meet the needs of global food and beverage manufacturers.
  
  
The role is based in Hyderabad, India(hybrid role). Be part of a creative, solution-oriented team where together we can achieve greatness and make a real impact. Your potential is our inspiration.
  
  
The Team Lead II, Accounting oversees the delivery and performance of services within the Record-to-Report subprocess, ensuring efficient and high-quality processes and compliance with relevant regulations and policies. Responsible for managing a medium-sized team (direct reports only).
  
  
**How You Will Contribute**

* Oversee the Record-to-Report (RTR) subprocess, ensuring all financial transactions are accurately recorded, reported, and compliant with accounting standards, company policies, and regulatory requirements.
* Lead and coordinate month-end and year-end close activities, ensuring timely, accurate, and complete financial reporting, including management of journal entries, accruals, provisions, and adjustments in line with internal controls.
* Perform and review balance sheet reconciliations to ensure the integrity, accuracy, and reliability of financial data.
* Ensure adherence to SOX/internal controls and support internal and external audits through timely resolution of audit queries and remediation of identified issues.
* Manage optimal utilization of team resources by balancing workloads, driving productivity, and delivering against established KPIs, SLAs, and performance targets.
* Identify process inefficiencies, root causes, and operational risks, implementing corrective and preventive actions while driving continuous improvement initiatives across the RTR function.
* Collaborate with cross-functional partners, including AP, AR, FP&A, Tax, and Treasury teams, to ensure seamless end-to-end process alignment and effective issue resolution.
* Build and maintain strong stakeholder relationships, ensuring high levels of service satisfaction while supporting transition activities, knowledge transfer, and stabilization in a shared services environment.
* Lead, coach, and develop team members through ongoing training, performance management, and career development initiatives, fostering an inclusive, high-performing, and engaged team culture focused on talent retention.

**What You Will Need To Be Successful**

* Qualified professional (CA, CPA, CMA, ICWA) or Post graduation in Accounting, Finance, Business Administration, or a related field.
* 4-8 years of progressive experience in Finance and Accounting, with strong exposure to the Record-to-Report (RTR) process with minimum 1-3 years of people management experience, with a proven ability to lead, coach, develop, and engage high-performing teams.
* Demonstrated experience managing month-end and year-end close activities, balance sheet reconciliations, journal entries, accruals, provisions, and financial reporting.
* Strong understanding of accounting principles, internal controls, SOX compliance requirements, and audit support processes.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with stakeholders across multiple functions and levels.
* Proven ability to manage priorities, balance workloads, monitor KPIs/SLAs, and deliver results in a fast-paced shared services or global business environment.

**How Would You Stand Out?**

* Strong problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making skills.
* Continuous improvement mindset with experience driving process optimization and operational excellence.
* Strong SAP and RTR process expertise within a shared services environment.

**Why Choose Us?**

* Drive operational excellence, innovation, and continuous improvement while creating measurable business value.
* Be part of a transformative journey, shaping a global business services organization with enterprise-wide impact.
* Internal Training opportunities.

**Important Information Regarding This Position**
For your awareness, IFF has announced its intention to sell its Food Ingredients Business to CVC Capital Partners. The sale is presently expected to close in the first half of 2027, pending regulatory approvals and other closing conditions. The Food Ingredient business unit will remain a part of IFF until close and, at such time, it will transition to CVC Capital Partners. In applying for this position, you acknowledge your awareness that the position is a part of the Food Ingredient business unit and has been identified to transition to CVC Capital Partners.
  
  
We are a global leader in taste, scent, and nutrition, offering our customers a broader range of natural solutions and accelerating our growth strategy. At IFF, we believe that your uniqueness unleashes our potential. We value the diverse mosaic of the ethnicity, national origin, race, age, sex, or veteran status. We strive for an inclusive workplace that allows each of our colleagues to bring their authentic self to work regardless of their religion, gender identity & expression, sexual orientation, or disability.
  
  
Visit IFF.com/careers/workplace-diversity-and-inclusion to learn more

title: IT&DATA Sr. Product Analyst Finance Accounting
description:
This is a senior functional product role requiring proven hands-on SAP Finance implementation and deployment experience. The role is not a configuration position. The Senior Product Analyst must use previous delivery experience to challenge, validate and guide the work performed by delivery and AMS partners, translate business process needs, protect the Finance core model and resolve issues with a high level of autonomy. The depth of experience and independent judgement required justify the L8 seniority. Must Have - Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP Finance experience gained through implementation, integration or deployment projects, not only theoretical knowledge or support coordination. - Strong SAP FI/CO functional and configuration background, with the ability to understand how a solution is configured, assess proposed changes and identify functional or integration risks. - Strong understanding of Finance and Accounting processes, including Record to Report, financial closing, postings, controls and master-data dependencies. - Proven ability to review, challenge and validate functional designs, configuration choices, test evidence and deployment deliverables produced by internal or external delivery teams. - Experience translating complex business requirements into functional solutions and explaining solution constraints, impacts and trade-offs to Finance stakeholders. - Experience identifying end-to-end dependencies across SAP Finance and integrated modules or applications. - Ability to work autonomously, make recommendations, escalate material risks and act as a credible bridge between business stakeholders, Product Owners, project teams, AMS and external partners. - Strong stakeholder management, facilitation, structured problem solving and clear written and verbal communication.
  
  
Core responsibilities - Partner with the squad Product Owner to understand and prioritise business needs for Finance Consolidation, statutory and management reporting, and Central Finance evolution. - Translate complex reporting and accounting requirements into clear functional expectations, user stories, acceptance criteria and validation guardrails. - Challenge and validate CFIN and SAP FI/CO functional designs, data structures, mappings, replication or integration choices and test evidence produced by project, delivery or AMS teams. - Assess how proposed changes affect the global Themis model, organisational structures, General Ledger, controlling objects, Finance Master Data and downstream reporting. Provide senior functional guidance on Record to Report, financial closing, accounting, consolidation and reporting dependencies. Delivery / operational responsibilities - Validate that delivered solutions meet business requirements, design principles, control expectations, data-quality needs and agreed acceptance criteria before release. - Lead end-to-end impact assessments across CFIN, Themis, SAP S/4HANA environments, source systems, master data and reporting or analytics solutions. - Review defects, incidents and enhancement proposals, identify root causes and recommend scalable solutions that protect the global model. - Support implementation and deployment work through design review, test strategy, reconciliation, cutover readiness, knowledge transfer and post-go-live stabilisation. - Maintain decision records and functional documentation so critical CFIN and Finance reporting knowledge remains inside the organisation Stakeholder & collaboration responsibilities - Act as the bridge between Finance stakeholders and chapter functional/technical teams, ensuring that accounting and reporting requirements are translated into sustainable SAP solutions. - Facilitate design and validation discussions with Finance, Product Teams, programme teams, architecture, data and external delivery partners. - Challenge external experts constructively, make risks and trade-offs visible and support the Product Owner and Senior Product Owner with evidence-based recommendations. - Coach Product Analysts and contribute to stronger internal SAP Finance and CFIN validation capability.
  
  
Total experience: 7+ years in SAP Finance delivery, functional consulting, Finance transformation or product roles. Relevant experience: Minimum 5 years of hands-on SAP FI/CO experience in implementation, integration or deployment projects, including direct involvement in configuration, functional design, testing and go-live activities. Previous Central Finance or SAP S/4HANA experience is an advantage. Education: Bachelor degree or equivalent experience in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, Business, Engineering or a related discipline. Certifications (if any): SAP FI/CO, SAP S/4HANA Finance, SAP Central Finance, business analysis, product management or Agile certification is an advantage, but not mandatory.

title: Business Lead – Smart Kiosk
description:
**About Roligt Foods**

Roligt Foods is building a next-gen, clean-label beverage brand in Hyderabad. We make drinks with short, honest ingredient lists and nothing we cannot defend. We are pre-launch. We are expanding through smart, automated beverage kiosks across corporate campuses and other high-footfall locations. As we scale, we are building a small team that owns outcomes, not tasks.

**Role Description**

The Business Lead owns our smart vending kiosk channel end to end. Based in Hyderabad, you decide where machines go, how much each one sells, and whether the network makes money. You work with the founder, the machine vendor, maintenance, and the brand team. This role suits someone who likes building a channel from zero and being judged on its numbers.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Identify, negotiate, and secure kiosk locations across tech parks, gyms, hospitals, colleges, and residential societies.

2. Own the P&L of each machine, including daily sales, uptime, wastage, rent, revenue sharing, and profitability.

3. Coordinate with the machine vendor for timely deployment, preventive maintenance, servicing, and spare parts availability.

4. Plan and optimise restocking routes, inventory levels, and replenishment schedules with the maintenance team.

5. Review sales and CRM data weekly, identify underperforming machines, and take corrective action, including relocation or withdrawal where necessary.

6. Develop and execute a scalable rollout plan, growing the network from the first 10 machines to 100.

7. Prepare and present monthly network performance reports to leadership, highlighting achievements, challenges, and action plans.

**The Ideal Candidate Will Have**

1. 2–5 years of experience in vending, quick commerce, FMCG distribution, or B2B location sales.

2. A proven track record of identifying, negotiating, and closing location agreements with facility managers, property owners, or landlords.

3. A strong understanding of unit economics, P&L management, and proficiency in spreadsheets and data analysis.

4. Good knowledge of Hyderabad's commercial areas and business hubs. Proficiency in Telugu and Hindi is preferred.

5.
High ownership and a bias for action

**What We Offer**

1. Fair, competitive compensation: Pay is in line with industry standards and based on your experience, capability, and track record. Strong performers grow faster than a standard annual cycle.

2. Fast-track growth: You work directly with the leadership team and see how a consumer brand is built from zero. Good people grow into bigger roles as the business scales.

3. Broad exposure: You see product, brand, events, retail, and operations, not one narrow slice.

4. Real ownership: Small team, fast decisions. Your work shows up in the numbers.

**Please Do Not Apply If**

1. You are not based in, or willing to relocate to, Hyderabad.

2. You want a role with a fixed playbook already written.

3. You are not comfortable owning a P&L number.

*We are selective about who we hire. If you do not hear back within three weeks of applying, please assume your application has not been taken forward this time.*

title: Facility Manager
description:
We are looking for an experienced and responsible **Facility Manager** to manage the complete day-to-day operations of a premium Villa Community. The candidate will be responsible for ensuring **safe, smooth, efficient, and well-maintained community operations**, with strong focus on technical maintenance, resident satisfaction, vendor management, safety, and cost control.

Key Responsibilities

**Facility & Technical Operations**

* Take overall responsibility for the operation and maintenance of the Villa Community.
* Monitor and maintain all **MEP systems**, including electrical, plumbing, HVAC, DG, pumps, STP/WTP, lifts, fire-fighting and other utility systems.
* Ensure timely preventive and breakdown maintenance.
* Conduct regular inspections of common areas, equipment, utilities, and infrastructure.
* Ensure minimum downtime and quick resolution of technical issues.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

* Coordinate and manage all facility-related vendors and contractors.
* Supervise AMC and service providers for electrical, plumbing, lifts, DG, fire & safety, pest control, housekeeping, landscaping, STP/WTP, etc.
* Monitor vendor performance, manpower, service quality and SLA compliance.
* Obtain quotations, coordinate approvals and ensure timely execution of services.

**Maintenance & Work Order Management**

* Manage daily maintenance requests, complaints, work orders and breakdown calls.
* Prioritize critical issues and ensure timely closure.
* Maintain preventive maintenance schedules and service records.
* Track AMC renewals, equipment servicing and statutory inspections.

**Housekeeping & Community Upkeep**

* Supervise housekeeping and ensure high standards of cleanliness across common areas.
* Monitor landscaping, gardening and waste management activities.
* Coordinate pest control services and ensure scheduled treatments are completed.
* Regularly inspect clubhouses, roads, common areas, amenities and other community facilities.

**Purchase & Inventory Control**

* Identify requirements for maintenance materials, spares, tools and consumables.
* Coordinate procurement and ensure materials are available when required.
* Maintain proper inventory and asset records.
* Monitor consumption and control unnecessary maintenance expenses.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with safety procedures and applicable statutory requirements.
* Monitor fire-fighting systems, emergency equipment and safety installations.
* Ensure periodic inspections, testing and maintenance of critical safety systems.
* Maintain all required certificates, AMC documents, inspection reports and compliance records.
* Handle emergency situations effectively and coordinate appropriate response.

**Resident & Community Management**

* Handle and resolve facility-related resident complaints professionally.
* Coordinate with residents regarding maintenance activities, shutdowns and service interruptions.
* Maintain good communication with residents and community representatives.
* Ensure facility services are delivered with minimum inconvenience to residents.

**Team Management**

* Supervise technicians, housekeeping staff, gardeners and other facility support teams.
* Plan manpower deployment and allocate daily responsibilities.
* Monitor attendance, discipline, productivity and service quality.
* Conduct regular team briefings and ensure SOPs are followed.

**MIS & Management Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly facility management reports.
* Track maintenance activities, breakdowns, complaints, preventive maintenance and vendor performance.
* Prepare reports on **AMC status, inventory, purchases, utility consumption, manpower, expenses and safety incidents**.
* Provide regular operational updates and recommendations to management.

Candidate Profile

* **Qualification:** Diploma / B.E. / B.Tech in Electrical, Mechanical, Civil or related engineering discipline.
* **Experience:** 5–10 years of relevant Facility Management experience.
* Experience in **Villa Communities / Gated Communities / Premium Residential Projects** will be preferred.
* Strong technical knowledge of MEP and facility systems.
* Good vendor and contractor management skills.
* Strong leadership, communication and problem-solving abilities.
* Good knowledge of **MS Office, Excel and MIS reporting**.
* Ability to manage multiple activities and handle emergency situations.
* Strong focus on **safety, service quality, resident satisfaction and cost control**.

Key Competencies

**Technical Knowledge | MEP Management | Vendor Management | Resident Handling | Preventive Maintenance | Safety & Compliance | Team Management | Inventory Control | Cost Management | MIS Reporting**

Key Performance Areas

* Smooth and uninterrupted facility operations
* Timely preventive and breakdown maintenance
* Resident complaint resolution
* Vendor & AMC performance
* Safety and statutory compliance
* Housekeeping and community cleanliness
* Utility and maintenance cost control
* Inventory and asset management
* Overall resident satisfaction

title: Data Center Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Description**
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
You will be a proven manager with experience managing teams of high performers. You will have the ability to refine and develop processes to optimize operational excellence in every area of your role. You will be able to drive performance levels to achieve the pace at which we build and operate Data Centers in India for Amazon Data Services India Private Limited (“ADSIPL”). You will have previous experience in Data Centers, either building or managing (or both) along with exposure to developing great relationships with both internal teams and external vendors.
  
  
You will also have a passion for technology along with a desire to be the best at your job every day!
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  
**About The Role**
As a Data Center Manager in ADSIPL, you will get to manage the world’s largest Cloud Computing Infrastructure in India. We encounter interesting, challenging & complex problems every day, being a technical manager in ADSIPL means that you can innovate to solve these issues and help drive Operations Excellence in all areas of your role.
  
  
Your day job at ADSIPL will include (but not limited to):
  
  

* Managing and developing teams of engineers, providing both technical and leadership expertise and ensuring highest levels of performance.
* Maintaining existing co-located and in-house Data Centers
* Helping build and bring online new Data Centers
* Constantly improving all our processes and procedures. We believe there is nothing we cannot improve
* Assisting & managing relationships with external vendors & contractors
* Liaising with internal teams & management groups
* Ensuring we adhere to and exceed local Health & Safety standards in all our Data Centers
* Creating and maintaining metrics on all aspects of our Data Centers and utilizing those metrics to drive positive changes
* Assisting in implementing service methodologies including incident management, problem management, change management, capacity management, etc.

What are we looking for in a successful AWS Returner Data Centre Manager (DCM) candidate along with the technical knowledge and experience.
  
  
People Management.
  
  
As a successful candidate you will have managed a team of at least 5 individuals, over a period of at least 3 years. You will be able to demonstrate how you have continued to improve performance of an existing team along with displaying skills in creating or growing a team. Experience managing both high & low performing employees will be of advantage along with conflict management.
  
  
Incident Management.
  
  
You will have a lot of experience dealing with high severity situations, show a clear understanding of the wider blast implications of any issue/outage and potential consequences of differing outcome scenarios. You will also have experience in Change Management & Fault Management.
  
  
Vendor Management.
  
  
An Amazon, individual has to deal with vendors, contractors & security companies. You will be able to prove you have experience dealing with external vendors and be able to display incidents of both problem & conflict management when dealing with same.
  
  
Process Improvement.
  
  
You will be able to demonstrate an ability of taking both a good working process & a bad process and improving. You will have experience in processes mapping, implementing remediation steps and how this affected the overall business you were working in. Experience in Kaizen/Lean/Six Sigma is preferable
  
  
Health & Safety.
  
  
Health & Safety should be at the forefront of every manager's mind. Managers should be able to positively influence the Safety culture of the Data Center organization.
  
  
**About The Team**
About AWS
  
  
Diverse Experiences
  
  
Amazon values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS
  
  
Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion events foster stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship and Career Growth
  
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience that includes strong analytical skills, attention to detail, and effective communication abilities
* 4+ years of data center engineering or operations experience
* 3+ years of managing technical teams with significant personnel management experience and examples of developing engineers and building successful teams experience

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Bachelor's degree or above in engineering or equivalent STEM (Science, Technology, Engineering and Mathematics) field, or 4+ years of network and operating system support experience
* 1+ years of Agile methods and processes experience
* Experience in capacity planning, operations planning, business analysis or similar
* Knowledge of Lean, Kaizen, Six Sigma concepts
* Experience implementing change management successfully transitioning programs into large-scale operations

title: Manager – Production Planning & Control
description:
**Role Overview**

Lead central production planning, material planning and plant inventory management across the company’s FMCG portfolio. Ensure timely product availability, optimum inventory levels and efficient coordination across manufacturing locations, while leading the Production Planning and Plant Inventory & Stores teams.

**1. Production Planning & Scheduling**

* Lead production planning from based on sales forecasts, confirmed orders, inventory levels and business priorities across brands, categories and SKUs.
* Prepare and monitor monthly, weekly and daily production plans in coordination with manufacturing plants and third-party manufacturers, wherever applicable.
* Incorporate seasonal demand, festive requirements, promotional activities and new product launches into production plans.
* Monitor plan adherence and revise schedules to address demand changes, material availability and manufacturing constraints.

**2. Material & Inventory Planning**

* Plan raw materials (RM), packaging materials (PM) and consumables to ensure uninterrupted production.
* Translate production plans and bills of materials (BOMs) into material requirements, considering procurement lead times, minimum order quantities and safety stock.
* Coordinate with Procurement to ensure timely material availability and proactively address shortages.
* Maintain optimum RM, PM and finished goods inventory while minimising excess, slow-moving, obsolete and near-expiry stock.
* Plan packaging transitions and product discontinuations to minimise residual material and write-offs.

**3. Plant Inventory & Stores Management**

* Lead the Plant Inventory & Stores teams across manufacturing locations.
* Ensure timely and accurate receipt, storage, issuance, returns and reconciliation of materials.
* Maintain appropriate storage conditions, identification and segregation based on category requirements, including food ingredients, fragrances, chemicals and packaging materials.
* Ensure adherence to approved SOPs, batch traceability and FIFO/FEFO practices, as applicable.
* Coordinate with Quality for the segregation, release and disposition of materials under inspection, rejected stock and expired inventory.

**4. Production & Supply Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Manufacturing, Procurement, Sales, Demand Planning, Quality and Logistics teams to align production with business requirements.
* Proactively resolve material shortages, production delays, quality holds and supply gaps.
* Align finished goods availability with dispatch plans, customer commitments and distribution requirements.
* Support new product launches through material readiness, packaging availability and production scheduling.

**5. Inventory Accuracy & Control**

* Ensure accurate and timely recording of inventory transactions in ERP systems.
* Drive regular cycle counts, physical stock verification and reconciliation of system and physical inventory.
* Investigate inventory variances and implement corrective actions with relevant teams.
* Monitor material consumption against BOMs and approved norms to identify abnormal usage, wastage and process losses.
* Strengthen controls to reduce damages, expiry, pilferage and inventory write-offs.

**6. Capacity & Resource Planning**

* Assess production capacity, manpower, machine availability and material constraints across plants and production lines.
* Balance production requirements with available capacity, considering batch sizes, changeovers, cleaning requirements and maintenance schedules.
* Identify bottlenecks and coordinate corrective actions to support delivery commitments.
* Recommend capacity adjustments, alternate production arrangements or outsourcing requirements based on business needs.

**7. Process & Cost Optimisation**

* Improve inventory turns, stock availability, storage utilisation and production planning efficiency.
* Optimise production batch sizes and schedules to reduce unnecessary changeovers, material wastage and carrying costs.
* Drive standardisation of planning and stores processes across manufacturing locations.
* Strengthen ERP usage, master data accuracy and reporting to improve planning visibility and control.

**8. Team Leadership & Governance**

* Lead, develop and review the performance of the Production Planning and Plant Inventory & Stores teams.
* Establish clear responsibilities, operating processes and performance measures across both functions.
* Conduct regular reviews of production adherence, material availability, inventory ageing and stock accuracy.
* Provide timely MIS, highlight risks and track corrective actions to closure.
* Support internal audits and ensure compliance with company policies and applicable quality, hygiene and safety requirements in coordination with relevant teams.

title: Voyage Manager
description:
**About Our Client**

Navora, under the aegis of
**MaritimeSolutionsLtd**
, is hiring a
**Voyage Manager (Dry Bulk)**
for its client, a service-driven organization specialising in integrated commercial management solutions for the maritime industry.

**Overview**

We are seeking an experienced
**Voyage Manager (Dry Bulk)**
to oversee the commercial operations of dry bulk vessels, covering the entire voyage lifecycle from pre-fixture support to post-fixture execution and financial analysis.

This role sits at the intersection of
**commercial shipping, voyage optimization, stakeholder management, and financial performance**
. You will work closely with Chartering, vessel owners, charterers, brokers, port agents, and internal teams to ensure seamless voyage execution, optimize cargo intake and bunker consumption, manage claims, and maximize voyage profitability.

**What Will You Do?**

**Pre-Fixture Planning & Commercial Support**

* Support the Chartering Department during pre-fixture negotiations by providing accurate vessel specifications, cargo-carrying capabilities, and vessel performance history.
* Assess vessel suitability for proposed trades, considering vessel schedules, cargo requirements, port restrictions, and operational feasibility.
* Evaluate cargo hold readiness and provide relevant port-specific information to support fixture decisions.
* Assist in estimating voyage costs and assessing commercial feasibility to support informed chartering decisions.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate information is available throughout the pre-fixture process.

**Voyage Execution & Performance Management**

* Manage the end-to-end execution of dry bulk voyages, ensuring compliance with charter-party terms and agreed voyage instructions.
* Prepare detailed voyage plans and voyage orders for Masters, optimizing cargo intake, bunker requirements, vessel scheduling, and operational efficiency.
* Coordinate with brokers, charterers, vessel owners, port agents, and internal departments to facilitate smooth voyage execution on a 24/7 basis.
* Monitor vessel performance at sea, identifying deviations, delays, and operational issues, and implement timely corrective actions.
* Liaise with the accounting team to monitor outstanding receivables and support timely collections to improve cash flow.
* Handle, contest, defend, and negotiate commercial claims in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor voyage profitability and develop a thorough understanding of voyage Profit & Loss (P&L), including cost control and revenue optimization.

**Bunkering & Voyage Optimization**

* Optimize vessel cargo intake while ensuring compliance with vessel limitations, port restrictions, and operational requirements.
* Plan bunker requirements to ensure adequate fuel availability throughout the voyage, considering consumption, fuel grades, trading areas, and cost efficiency.
* Coordinate with weather-routing service providers to support optimal route selection, fuel efficiency, and vessel performance.
* Monitor voyage progress and identify opportunities to improve operational efficiency and reduce avoidable costs.

**Commercial Coordination & Stakeholder Management**

* Negotiate and appoint port agents, ensuring reliable service delivery and cost-effective port operations.
* Plan bunker stems in accordance with vessel requirements, fuel specifications, and trading-area restrictions.
* Coordinate freight invoicing, other charterer-related billings, and post-fixture activities with the relevant teams.
* Provide accurate and timely voyage information to Claims Coordinators to support the resolution of commercial disputes.
* Review and approve Port Disbursement Accounts (PDAs), ensuring accuracy and appropriate cost control.
* Work closely with Finance, Chartering, Operations, and Post-Fixture teams to maintain seamless information flow across the voyage lifecycle.
* Maintain accurate voyage records, operational data, and documentation within company systems, ensuring data integrity and traceability.

**The Must-Haves**

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Minimum
  **5–6 years of experience in commercial shipping operations**
  , preferably in dry bulk vessel operations.
* Previous seagoing experience in a
  **management-level position aboard dry bulk vessel**
  .
* Strong understanding of pre-fixture operations, voyage execution, and post-fixture processes.
* Demonstrated experience in voyage planning, vessel performance monitoring, bunker planning, and voyage cost management.
* Experience with commercial claims, charter-party matters, freight collection, and voyage P&L analysis.
* Hands-on experience with
  **IMOS or a comparable integrated maritime operations system**
  .

**Knowledge & Skills**

* Strong commercial understanding of the dry bulk shipping industry and voyage management practices.
* Sound knowledge of charter-party terms, cargo operations, port procedures, and vessel trading requirements.
* Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with cross-functional teams and external stakeholders.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to interpret voyage performance data, assess costs, and identify opportunities for optimization.
* Proactive, solution-oriented approach, with the ability to anticipate challenges and take timely corrective action.
* Ability to manage competing priorities and respond effectively in a dynamic, 24/7 operational environment.

**Ready to Chart Your Course?**

If you have a strong background in dry bulk commercial operations and are passionate about optimizing voyage performance and profitability, we would love to hear from you.

title: Senior Manager - NPI
description:
Castrol is one of the world’s leading lubricant brands, serving customers and consumers in the automotive, marine, industrial and energy sectors. Castrol brands are recognised globally for their premium quality and high performance, shaped by the company’s commitment to innovation and cutting-edge technology. With products sold in more than 150 countries, Castrol has helped keep things moving on roads and racetracks, air, sea, and space for over 125 years.
  
  
Whether you're just starting out or ready for your next big move, you're in the right place to explore an exciting career with Castrol.
  
  
**Job Description**
**About the team**
Own the end-to-end New Product Introduction (NPI) process, from design transfer to stable commercial production. Lead cross-functional stage-gate reviews, ensuring products progress only when readiness criteria for cost, quality, supply, and operational execution are met, delivering successful launches on time and in full.
  
  
This role provides leadership and governance for the NPI portfolio, owning launch outcomes, stakeholder alignment, and stage-gate decisions. While the NPI Planner manages operational execution across materials, capacity, builds, and inventory, this role is accountable for overall NPI success and commercialization readiness.
  
  
**Key Tasks**
NPI process ownership
  
  

* Define, run and continuously improve the stage-gate NPI process (concept, design, prototype, pilot, ramp, release to mass production), including gate criteria, templates and governance.
* Run the NPI portfolio: intake, prioritization and resource allocation across concurrent projects.
* Own the handover from Technology to Operations and the transition to steady-state manufacturing.

Cross-functional evaluation and gate decisions
  
  

* Chair NPI gate reviews with R&D, Quality, Regulatory, Manufacturing Engineering, Sourcing, Supply Chain, Finance and Commercial.
* Assess each product for manufacturability, test and quality readiness, supplier readiness, compliance, cost and launch risk.
* Make or escalate go / no-go / conditional-go recommendations with documented risks and mitigations.

NPI delivery
  
  

* Own schedule, budget, scope and risk for each project; maintain the master NPI plan and critical path.
* Drive risk management and resolve cross-functional conflicts quickly.
* Manage contract manufacturers and key suppliers for pilot builds and ramp, where applicable.

Cost, quality and supply readiness
  
  

* Agree target cost, yield and first-pass quality with Finance, Quality and Manufacturing; track the gap to target at every gate.
* Ensure the NPI Planner’s material, capacity and build plans support each gate date and launch volume.
* Ensure change control, BOM and documentation are complete and released before production.

Lead NPI Portfolio & Performance Management
  
  

* Maintain the consolidated NPI roadmap and publish dashboards covering project health, milestone adherence, launch readiness, action closure, and post-launch performance.

Lead Export Readiness for NPI PLanning
  
  

* Lead cross-functional alignment and close coordination with Export teams to establish inventory strategies, distribution networks, capacity plans, and market-specific supply requirements for successful export launches.
* Govern the transition of NPI projects into business-as-usual export operations, ensuring seamless handover, supply continuity, and service reliability across all destination markets.

Leadership and stakeholder management
  
  

* Lead, coach and develop the NPI team; set objectives and manage performance.
* Report on project status, risks and decisions to senior leadership and the executive team.
* Capture lessons learned after each launch and feed them back into the process.

**Experience Required**

* Graduate degree in Engineering, Supply Chain, Operations, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Post Graduate Degree or MBA in Supply Chain, Operations Management, or Business Management will be an added advantage
* 10-12 years of Supply Chain experience with strong exposure to NPI, Planning, Product Lifecycle Management, Project Management, or Supply Chain Transformation.
* Proven experience in leading cross-functional NPI, commercialization, innovation, or product-transition programs.
* Strong understanding of Demand Planning, Supply Planning, Inventory Management, Capacity Planning, S&OP, and phase-in/phase-out processes.
* Demonstrated ability to influence stakeholders and drive accountability across Marketing, Sales, Procurement, Manufacturing, Logistics, Finance, Quality, and Regulatory teams.
* Strong project management, risk management, analytical, and problem-solving capabilities, with the ability to manage multiple concurrent launches.

title: Plant Manager - Plastic Pyrolysis
description:
**1. Role Overview**

The Plant Manager is the single-point owner of the entire plastic pyrolysis plant — accountable for safe, continuous, cost-efficient conversion of mixed plastic waste into pyrolysis oil, carbon black and non-condensable gas. The role combines hands-on process engineering with full P&L, EHS and team-management responsibility. The incumbent will drive uptime, yield, quality and compliance while building the operational culture of a growing circular-economy enterprise.

**2. Key Responsibilities**

**A. Plant Operations & Production**

• Own the end-to-end pyrolysis process: feedstock preparation, shredding, reactor charging, controlled heating cycle, condensation train, oil collection, char discharge and gas handling / flare / power generation.

• Drive key operating KPIs — reactor availability (target ≥ 85%), oil yield (target ≥ 55% on dry feed basis for mixed PE/PP/PS, ≥ 40% for mixed MSW plastic), carbon black and non-condensable gas yields, batch cycle time, specific energy consumption (kWh/MT feed).

• Monitor and optimise reactor temperature profile (typical 350–450 °C), residence time, catalyst loading (if used), condenser temperatures and vacuum/pressure control.

• Oversee daily, weekly and monthly production planning, feedstock scheduling and batch sheet closure.

**B. Safety, Health & Environment (SHE)**

• Enforce zero-tolerance safety culture — pyrolysis is a high-hazard operation (flammable vapours, high temperature, hydrocarbon gas inventory). Target: zero LTI.

• Implement and audit HAZOP, Permit-to-Work (PTW), LOTO, hot-work, confined-space and emergency response procedures.

• Ensure full compliance with CPCB / SPCB norms (air emissions, water discharge, hazardous waste handling under HWM Rules 2016), Factory Act 1948, PESO (if LPG/diesel storage > threshold), and Fire NOC.

• Lead monthly mock drills, SHE committee meetings, incident investigation and CAPA closure.

**C. Quality & Product**

• Ensure pyrolysis oil meets agreed buyer specifications — density, calorific value (typical 38–42 MJ/kg target), flash point, water content, sulphur, viscosity, solids content.

• Oversee in-house QC lab or external testing arrangements; sign off every tanker COA before dispatch.

• Drive upgrading initiatives — distillation, de-chlorination, de-sulphurisation if required by customer specs or regulatory norms.

**D. Feedstock, Supply Chain & Costs**

• Secure daily feedstock requirement in coordination with Procurement; vet aggregators and MRFs on quality, moisture, chlorine (PVC) content and heavy metals.

• Own the plant P&L — monthly budget vs. actual on feedstock cost, utilities, consumables, labour, maintenance, logistics.

• Drive cost-per-MT-feed and cost-per-litre-oil improvement; identify yield and energy recovery projects.

**E. Maintenance & Reliability**

• Lead preventive maintenance program for reactor shell, agitator seals, condensers, pumps, blowers, scrubbers, DG sets and material-handling equipment.

• Plan annual turnaround / shutdown — reactor coke removal, refractory inspection, pipe-flange integrity, PRV testing.

• Maintain MRO inventory within budgeted norms and critical-spares list.

**F. Team Leadership & Culture**

• Lead a team of 10-20 people across operations, maintenance, QC, logistics and admin (depending on plant size and shift pattern).

• Build shift supervisor capability, drive on-the-job training and SOP adherence, run daily shift handover meetings.

**G. Regulatory, Reporting & Stakeholder Management**

• Interface with CPCB/SPCB, Factory Inspector, Pollution Control Board auditors, EPR authorities and local administration.

• Submit timely monthly/quarterly compliance returns, EPR reporting under Plastic Waste Management Rules. & ISCC data

• Report weekly operations dashboard to Director/CEO (production, safety, quality, costs, HR, deviations).

**3. Required Qualifications & Experience**

• B.E. / B.Tech in Chemical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Petroleum Engineering or Polymer Engineering from a recognised institute. M.Tech or MBA (Operations) a plus.

• 3–10 years' total experience in process plant operations, with minimum 2 years in a Plant Manager / Deputy Plant Manager role.

• Direct hands-on experience in pyrolysis, waste-to-energy, refinery/distillation, bitumen, carbon black, rubber recycling, biomass gasification, or similar thermal process plant preferred.

• Demonstrated P&L accountability for a plant of ≥ 20 MT/day throughput or equivalent.

• Thorough working knowledge of HAZOP, PSSR, MOC, and IS/OSHA safety frameworks.

• Working knowledge of CPCB, PCB, PWM Rules 2016 (and amendments), EPR regulations, and ISO 9001/14001/45001 & ISCC implementation.

• Experience managing unionised or semi-skilled workforce in a plant environment.

• Computer-literate —ERP (production module), MS Excel modelling, basic DCS/SCADA familiarity.

**4. Preferred / Nice-to-Have**

• Prior exposure to continuous or semi-continuous pyrolysis reactor designs (rotary kiln, auger, fluidised bed).

• Experience in product quality upgradation (fractional distillation, hydrotreatment, catalytic cracking) for pyrolysis-derived oil.

• Experience selling or qualifying pyrolysis oil to industrial end-users (cement kilns, steel re-rolling mills, boilers, co-processing).

• Exposure to Carbon Credit / Plastic Credit / EPR trading mechanisms.

• Published or filed patents / papers in plastic pyrolysis or waste-to-energy space.

**5. Core Competencies**

• Hands-on, floor-walking leadership style — minimum 60% time on the shop floor expected.

• First-principles process engineering thinking — ability to diagnose yield drops, deviations and reactor upsets without external support.

• Strong commercial instinct — understands that every rupee saved per MT feedstock or per litre of oil flows to the P&L.

• Cool-headed in crisis — can run an emergency shutdown or incident response without escalation.

• Clear, concise written and verbal communication; confident with regulators and buyers alike.

• Builder's mentality — comfortable working in an entrepreneurial, resource-constrained early-growth environment.

**6. Success Metrics (First 12 Months)**

• Reactor availability raised to ≥ 85% from baseline.

• Pyrolysis oil yield improved by at least 3 percentage points vs. baseline.

• Zero reportable safety incidents (LTI = 0, fire incidents = 0).

• 100% CPCB/SPCB compliance — no show-cause notices, no closure notices.

• Plant conversion cost (₹ per MT feed) reduced by ≥ 8% vs. baseline.

• Shift-supervisor team upskilled: 100% certified on SOPs; one supervisor identified as successor-track.

• Reporting location: VASAI , Mumbai

• Working pattern: general shift with on-call responsibility; plant runs 24×7 on 3-shift pattern.

**7. How to Apply**

Interested candidates may share their updated CV, current CTC and notice period with Bioplastica Energy Pvt. Ltd.( Group company of Emco Dyestuff Pvt Ltd ) via the  contact point

description:

**About Kabuni**

Kabuni is a sports technology company combining AI, biomechanics and sports science to make high-quality coaching more accessible. Starting with cricket, we’re building tools and pathways to help players develop their skills and reach their potential.

Through the Kabuni Premier League (KPL), we’re creating opportunities for young cricketers to progress through auditions, training camps and franchise teams, connecting grassroots talent with structured player development.

**About Role**

You’ll lead the planning and delivery of a safe, well-run and engaging KPL tournament, bringing together cricket competition, participant logistics, venues, staffing and event operations.

Your responsibility starts well before tournament week: building the team, securing resources, managing the budget and ensuring everything is ready before participants arrive. You’ll lead live delivery through to safe departures and post-event review.

The tournament is being planned for up to 12 franchises, each with 15 selected players—180 players at full scale—alongside coaches, support staff and other attendees.

**Key Responsibilities**

* **Plan and prepare the tournament:**
  Develop the timetable, budget, staffing model and operating plan. Appoint delivery partners, agree responsibilities and lead readiness reviews and rehearsals.
* **Ensure child safety and welfare:**
  Work with safeguarding specialists to establish qualified safeguarding, welfare and medical provision, appropriate staffing checks, supervision, consent and emergency procedures across all tournament activities.
* **Coordinate participant logistics:**
  Manage agreed travel arrangements, transfers, accommodation where required, meals, hydration and equipment movements. Ensure clear communication and safe participant handovers.
* **Deliver the cricket competition:**
  Work with cricket leadership to coordinate fixtures, venues, pitches, practice facilities, officials, scoring, equipment and coach availability.
* **Manage event operations:**
  Coordinate accreditation, security, spectators, accessibility, facilities, ceremonies and agreed guest and sponsor commitments. Work with specialists on permissions, insurance and supplier requirements.
* **Plan promotion and production:**
  Develop costed proposals for photography, filming, streaming or broadcasting. Deliver the approved scope with Marketing and production partners, ensuring appropriate permissions, child-image consent and content handling.
* **Lead live delivery:**
  Run daily briefings, event communications and operational decisions. Maintain contingency plans for weather, transport disruption, medical incidents and other delivery issues.
* **Control budgets and suppliers:**

title: Head of Execution India
description:
**Role Overview**

This is a key opportunity to join ED&F Man Commodities’ cotton trading business as
**Head of Execution India - Cotton**
, leading and continuously improving the domestic operations and trade execution function. Through close commercial partnership with the front office, global trading teams and external logistics providers, you will drive efficient, reliable and cost-effective execution across trucking, warehousing, inventory and delivery operations.

The role will focus on building and strengthening back office processes, leveraging data and digital tools, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement to enhance operational performance, visibility and control. You will also lead and develop a high-performing operations team that plays an integral role in supporting the seamless, compliant and commercially effective movement of cotton.

**Position Title:**
Head of Execution India - Cotton

**Location:**
Mumbai, India

**Position Type:**
Full-time

**Schedule:**
Office based

**Business Overview**

**ED&F Man Cotton**
driven by an ambition to become a leading trader of raw cotton, serving customers around the world. The breadth of ED&F Man Commodities existing operations provides ED&F Man Cotton with offices in major cotton producing regions and expertise in operating sustainable containerised supply chains, underpinned by robust risk management procedures.

ED&F Man is owned by
**Hartree Partners, LP**
a leading global merchant commodities firm facilitating the flow of energy, metals, agriculture, and environmental products across the full commodity supply chain, connecting producers and consumers. Hartree was founded in 1997, is jointly owned by senior management and funds managed by Oaktree Capital Management, LP, and employs around 5,000 individuals worldwide.

**Key Accountabilities**

* Oversee the end-to-end domestic execution of cotton trades, including trucking, warehousing, inventory movements, delivery scheduling and documentation.
* With support from the Head of Cotton India, build middle and back office resources to enable execution of significant volumes of Indian raw cotton.
* Coordinate with trading, contracts, finance and commercial teams to ensure efficient and timely contract fulfilment.
* Manage trucking, warehousing and third-party logistics providers, ensuring agreed service, cost and performance standards are met.
* Monitor operational performance, resolve delivery and inventory issues, and proactively identify and mitigate operational risks.
* Maintain appropriate operational controls, governance and auditable records across domestic logistics activities.
* Develop strong relationships with key service providers and drive accountability against agreed KPIs and service levels.
* Collaborate with global and regional operations teams to share best practice and leverage existing capabilities.
* Ensure the operations team, processes and capabilities remain fit-for-purpose as the business develops.
* Optimise existing systems and digital workflows across trucking, warehousing, inventory and trade execution, reducing manual intervention and operational errors.
* Develop and enhance data-driven dashboards and KPIs covering transport performance, warehouse utilisation, inventory, costs, service levels and exceptions.
* Use data, root-cause analysis and benchmarking to identify and deliver measurable improvements, ensuring benefits are sustained.
* Foster a culture of continuous improvement, encouraging simplification of processes, better use of technology and stronger cross-functional collaboration.

**Skills and Experience:**

* 7-12 years’ operations management experience within agricultural commodities, with strong preference for experience in the cotton trading industry.
* Proven experience managing domestic logistics operations, including trucking, warehousing, inventory movements, delivery execution and third-party service providers.
* Strong understanding of commodity trade operations, contract fulfilment, operational controls and risk management.
* Demonstrated track record of continuous improvement, with the ability to identify inefficiencies, analyse root causes and deliver measurable improvements to processes, cost and service.
* Experience using data, systems and digital tools to improve operational visibility, automate workflows and enhance performance management.
* Strategic and commercially minded, combined with a hands-on, pragmatic and problem-solving approach in a fast-paced trading environment.
* Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively across trading, finance, operations and external logistics providers.
* Strong analytical skills, commercial acumen and attention to detail, with confidence working with operational KPIs and performance data.
* Proficiency in Excel and supply chain/commodity management systems; experience with ITAS or similar trade execution systems is highly desirable.
* Cotton industry experience and knowledge of the specific operational challenges of cotton trading, storage and domestic distribution would be highly advantageous.

*We recognise that talent comes in many forms, and we value potential just as much as experience. If this role excites you but you don’t meet every requirement, we still encourage you to apply.*

**Our Offer**

We provide a fast-paced, stimulating and truly global environment, which will stretch your abilities and channel your talents. We also offer competitive salary and benefits combined with outstanding career development opportunities in one of the global leaders in soft commodity trading.

**Our Values**

**Respect, Integrity, Meritocracy, Client Focus, Entrepreneurship**

Our values define who we are. They are the fundamental beliefs that determine our actions and guide our behaviour. They influence the way we communicate and collaborate, and define the way we engage with our clients, partners, and communities. Our values are underpinned by a set of essential behaviours, which form part of our performance management approach. Delivering on our objectives is very much about ‘what’ we do, but these essential behaviours also provide a guide and measure for ‘how’ we do things. Our performance essentials are Take Initiative, Self‐Management, Deliver Results and Collaboration.

**Our Commitment**

We are committed to creating and sustaining an inclusive and diverse work environment where all employees are treated with dignity and respect. We are committed to promoting equal opportunities in employment and are focussed on actively building and developing diverse teams. All qualified applicants will receive equal treatment without regard to race, colour, sex, gender, age, religion or belief, ethnic or national origin, marital or civil partner status, physical or mental disability, military or veteran status, sexual orientation, gender reassignment (identity, gender expression), genetic information or any characteristic protected by local law.

title: Senior Manager, Data Center Operations
description:
**Job Description**
Oversees Data Center Operations across multiple data centers, managing and integrating team performance, operations metrics, and capacity analysis into the broader business line strategy. Directs multiple teams in supporting escalated technical issues, crisis management, and root cause analysis, while standardizing processes and maintaining an accurate knowledge base. Leads new region builds and expansion activities, acting as a senior liaison with project and engineering teams to manage timelines, capacity, and ensure adherence to world-class standards. Guides teams responsible for installations, repairs, inventory, and logistics, enforces standards for component replacements and upgrades, recommends significant purchases, and implements advanced maintenance strategies to optimize data center efficiency and stability.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Key Responsibilities**
**Data Center Site Portfolio Management:**

* Oversees Data Center Operations team across multiple data centers.

**Performance Monitoring and Analysis:**

* Oversees multiple teams, integrates operations metrics into broader business line strategy.
* Directs performance evaluations for multiple teams, integrates findings into broader business line strategy.
* Supervises analysis of physical, power, and cooling capacity for multiple teams, integrates findings into broader business line strategy.
* Leads Guides collaboration across functions to support continuous improvement efforts in alignment with industry best practices, and mentors team members.

**Issue Management and Automation:**

* Directs multiple teams providing support for escalated complex technical issues.
* Proposes and implements advanced strategies for issue triage and leverages automation, scheduling, and monitoring tools to prevent and resolve potential problems.
* Identifies, documents, and standardizes issues, processes, and solutions, ensuring consistency and accuracy in the data center knowledge base, tailored to departmental requirements.
* Guides team members to implement strategy for incident or crisis management protocols in alignment with business continuity plans.

**Data Center Expansion Support:**

* Acts as a senior liaison with project teams and data center engineering, ensuring comprehensive timelines and capacity needs are strategically managed for a broad array of expansion projects and site builds.

**Installation and Maintenance:**

* Creates and enforces standards for component replacements and upgrades.

* Directs high-level planning and coordination of rack deployments, installations, and network infrastructure upgrades/changes.

**Continuous Learning:**

Leverages feedback to drive personal and team skill improvements. Identifies skill gaps across teams, and empowers team members to pursue learning and knowledge sharing opportunities that build their expertise in new areas and coaches them to apply learnings to advance the organization.

**Continuous Improvement:**

Guides team to adopt new ideas for alternative approaches and methods and encourages feedback for continued improvement.

**Performance and Development:**

Discusses development goals with team members, shares opportunities to facilitate career development, and ensures individual goals are aligned with broader organizational goals. Develops and manages talent acquisition pipeline by leading candidate interviews, monitoring promotion eligibility, and/or orchestrating talent resources.

title: AVP Operations
description:
**Some Careers Open More Doors Than Others.**
If you’re looking for a career that will unlock new opportunities, join HSBC and experience the possibilities. Whether you want a career that could take you to the top, or simply take you in an exciting new direction, HSBC offers opportunities, support and rewards that will take you further.
  
  
International Wealth and Premier Banking helps deliver HSBC’s purpose of opening up a world of opportunity by providing customers with borderless banking and wealth management through mobile-first capabilities and exceptional people. Our international network and breadth of expertise enables us to support individuals, families, business owners, investors and entrepreneurs across key markets and corridors.
  
  
**Role purpose**
The Assistant Vice President – Fund Operations will manage end-to-end fund and broking operations, including client pay-in and payout, exchange clearing and settlement, treasury, banking, reconciliations, operational accounting, regulatory reporting, audit support and process improvement.
  
  
The role will ensure accurate and timely processing of client and firm funds, exchange obligations and settlement activities while maintaining strong controls, appropriate segregation of duties and compliance with applicable SEBI, exchange, clearing corporation, depository and internal requirements.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Fund settlement and client operations
* Manage daily client fund pay-in and payout activities across applicable products and segments.
* Process client transfers through NEFT, RTGS, CMS and other approved channels within prescribed cut-off times.
* Validate payment instructions, approvals, beneficiary details and supporting documentation.
* Post transactions accurately to client ledgers and operational systems.
* Monitor and resolve rejected, returned, delayed or failed payments.
* Process monthly and quarterly settlement payouts from preparation through approval and release.
* Support client transactions including dividend payments, buy-back, OFS, margin movements and NRI client pay-in and payout.
* Ensure appropriate segregation and utilisation of client funds.
* Maintain maker-checker evidence, payment records and audit trails.
* Resolve operational queries relating to fund transfers, payouts, demat charges, account opening, penalties and settlement status.
* Exchange clearing and settlement
* Prepare daily exchange obligations and arrange funds for timely pay-in and settlement.
* Manage exchange pay-in, payout and settlement activities across relevant segments.
* Post exchange obligation entries in the appropriate segment and accounting systems.
* Monitor exchange calendars, settlement timelines and payment cut-offs.
* Coordinate with Treasury, Finance, banks, exchanges and clearing corporations to meet obligations.
* Investigate shortages, unmatched items, failed payments and delayed confirmations.
* Maintain settlement trackers, exception logs and escalation reports.
* Support margin and exchange requirements, including appropriate use of available funds and fixed deposits.
* Prepare or review weekly bank-balance submissions and weekly/monthly SEBI and exchange reports.
* Treasury and banking operations
* Support treasury activities covering funding, disbursements, investments, concentration and inter-account transfers.
* Review daily cash and bank positions across client, settlement, operational and firm accounts.
* Arrange funding based on exchange obligations, client payouts and business requirements.
* Coordinate with bank relationship managers on payment issues, confirmations and account matters.
* Support investment of surplus funds in approved instruments, including mutual funds and fixed deposits where permitted.
* Maintain accurate records of investments, redemptions, transfers and funding transactions.
* Process vendor, exchange, clearing corporation, depository and service-provider payments through approved channels.
* Monitor unusual, unauthorised or delayed fund movements and escalate promptly.
* Reconciliations and financial controls
* Oversee daily reconciliations for client and settlement bank accounts, firm accounts, client ledgers, exchanges, depositories, mutual funds and dividends.
* Investigate reconciliation breaks, identify root causes and complete corrective action within agreed timelines.
* Escalate aged or recurring breaks through the appropriate governance channels.
* Validate bank entries, charges, interest, reversals, unidentified receipts and payment confirmations.
* Post correction entries in accordance with approved procedures.
* Perform AMC-wise mutual fund accounting and reconciliation where applicable.
* Reconcile dividend records, payments and client ledger postings.
* Maintain accurate daily, weekly and monthly reconciliation summaries.
* Ensure effective maker-checker, access and segregation-of-duties controls.
* Accounting, tax and management reporting
* Ensure accurate posting of client receipts, payouts, exchange obligations, bank transactions and settlement entries.
* Reconcile operational records to general ledger and accounting systems.
* Support month-end closing, accruals, provisions, trial balances, income statements and balance-sheet schedules.
* Prepare or review expense reconciliations, prepaid expenses, vendor payment schedules, debit notes, credit notes, fixed-asset records and group-company workings.
* Support accounts payable, accounts receivable, employee reimbursements, payroll-related payments and petty cash.
* Prepare daily, weekly and monthly MIS covering settlement, liquidity, reconciliations, payouts and exceptions.
* Support preparation of GST, TDS and stamp-duty data.
* Arrange TDS payments and support quarterly TDS return filing.
* Coordinate TDS refund claims with exchanges and maintain follow-up records.
* Validate vendor invoices and investigate higher-than-expected charges.
* Regulatory reporting and audit
* Prepare daily client-fund segregation reports accurately and within prescribed timelines.
* Validate balances between bank accounts, client ledgers, settlement records and reporting outputs.
* Support compliance with SEBI, exchange, clearing corporation, depository, banking and internal requirements.
* Provide data for exchange enhancement, bank-balance, margin and other operational reports.
* Coordinate responses to internal, statutory and exchange audits and regulatory inspections.
* Prepare audit evidence including bank statements, reconciliations, client-fund reports, exchange reports, payment records, approvals, SOPs and exception logs.
* Track audit observations, action owners, remediation plans and closure dates.
* Ensure SOPs and process notes reflect current regulatory and operational requirements.
* Systems and process improvement
* Support implementation and stabilisation of fund-settlement processes in live environments.
* Participate in UAT for new products, system changes, settlement processes and regulatory updates.
* Prepare test scenarios, validate results and coordinate resolution of defects.
* Work with Technology and Product teams on back-office, settlement, accounting and production issues.
* Identify opportunities to automate reconciliations, payouts, reporting and settlement tracking.
* Monitor operational SLAs, recurring issues and incidents.
* Drive improvements while preserving control effectiveness, segregation of duties and auditability.

**Governance, risk and stakeholder management**

* Operate within HSBC’s risk-management framework, internal policies and approved procedures.
* Identify, assess and escalate operational risks, incidents, control weaknesses and potential segregation issues.
* Maintain incident logs, root-cause analyses, corrective-action plans and audit trails.
* Protect confidential client, financial and business information.
* Support business continuity and operational resilience activities.
* Maintain effective relationships with Finance, Treasury, Compliance, Risk, Technology, Product, Client Service and Front Office teams.
* Coordinate with exchanges, clearing corporations, depositories, banks, asset-management companies, auditors and vendors.
* Ensure issues are assigned clearly, followed through and closed with supporting evidence.

**Team leadership**

* Lead day-to-day fund-operations activities and allocate work according to volumes, deadlines, skills and risk.
* Review team outputs and ensure that critical controls are completed consistently.
* Coach team members on settlement, reconciliation, payment and regulatory processes.
* Maintain cross-training and back-up coverage for critical activities.
* Set objectives and monitor performance against agreed service levels.
* Promote ownership, collaboration, inclusion and continuous improvement.
* Support team development and succession planning.

**Qualifications And Experience**
**Education**

* Graduate degree in Commerce, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting or a related discipline.
* MBA in Finance or an equivalent qualification preferred.

**Experience**

* Minimum 7 years’ relevant experience in fund operations, stock broking operations, clearing and settlement, treasury, depository operations or back-office accounting.
* Experience supervising client-money, exchange-settlement or fund-operation activities.
* Strong experience in:

+ Client pay-in and payout

Lead - Security Automation & Loss Prevention is responsible for leading and managing the day-to-day operations of the security automation and loss prevention team. This involves maintaining of security equipment with highest availability and adherence to maintenance strategy. The role requires design evaluation, implementing and maintaining security system and technologies, optimizing processes to prevent revenue leakage, and ensuring compliance with established security protocols. The Lead also drives team performance, supports investigation and risk management efforts, and works closely with the Security Head to meet regulatory, financial and operational objectives.

Oversee the deployment and evaluation of design parameters of security systems like surveillance, , radio communication, screening system (CTiX, XBis, FBS, DFMD, ETD, EVD, LED etc.) access controls and attendance system, video management, radio active detection equipment's, QRT equipments, BDDS equipment and intrusion detection.
  
  
Ensure highest availability of Airport security control room like SOCC (Security Control Centre), AHCR (Anti Hijack Control Room) for smooth operation and optimum vigilance of the Airport.
  
  
Ensure maintenance (preventive, corrective and predictive) and up gradation of the installed security automations systems, applications, equipment and other technology assets, ensuring the highest availability and maintenance standards for security technologies and systems.
  
  
Regularly evaluate the effectiveness of implemented technologies and suggest improvements to meet operational needs.
  
  
Ensure implementation of regulatory orders, audit points for enhancing the deployed security system in Airport.
  
  
Ensure implementation of visitor access card management system, CACS system and the Airport Entry Permit System (AEP) in coordination with pass section teams.
  
  
**Team Leadership And Development**
Lead the security automation and loss prevention team, ensuring the successful implementation of security technologies and processes.
  
  
Develop and update operational policies, procedures, and protocols to improve team performance and security standards.
  
  
**Loss Prevention And Technology Integration**
Collaborate with business operations and IT teams to deploy security solutions aimed at preventing revenue leakage / loss prevention and improving operational efficiency.
  
  
Ensure seamless integration of technology-driven solutions, such as data analytics and intelligent video management to monitor and reduce incidents.
  
  
Lead/ assist in security automation Project implementation at airports in coordination with respective stakeholders.
  
  
**Incident And Risk Management**
Monitor security risk assessments and ensure that mitigation strategies are effectively implemented to address emerging threats and risks.
  
  
Lead investigations into security breaches, fraud, and theft, ensuring timely action and reporting to senior management.
  
  
**Budget And Resource Management**
Assist in the preparation and monitoring of the security automation and loss prevention budget, ensuring financial resources are optimally allocated.
  
  
Work with the Head of Security Automation to address any budgetary discrepancies and ensure adherence to financial goals.
  
  
**Performance Monitoring And Reporting**
Track and report on the performance of security systems and loss prevention initiatives to ensure KPIs and objectives are met.
  
  
Conduct regular reviews with the team to assess progress, resolve issues, and implement necessary corrective actions.
  
  
Employ a analytics driven approach to identify incidence trends and implement security technology measures for mitigation.

IT Department

Security Technology Providers
  
  
Contractors and Implementation Partners
  
  
External Auditors
  
  
Regulatory Bodies

**Educational Qualification:**
Bachelor of Technology/Engineering in Electronics or related field
  
  
Preferable to have Certifications including Certified Information Systems Security Professional (CISSP/CCNA), CMRP (Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional), Project Management Professional and other related certifications.
