title: Operations Governance Manager
description:
Want to be a part of Asia Pacific & Middle East's (APME) largest, most innovative, and rapidly growing data centre company?
  
  
AirTrunk is a hyperscale data centre company with a powerful purpose - to scale and sustain the relentless growth of the region’s digital future. We do this by continuously redefining and delivering the digital infrastructure that meet the needs of our customers - the world’s most transformational companies. And we’re doing so sustainably, for today and tomorrow.
  
  
Having opened Australia’s first and largest hyperscale data centres in 2017, we set our eyes on rapid expansion and now operate a platform of hyperscale data centres across the APME region. With backing from our investors, including Blackstone, this is just the beginning…
  
  
Come join the A-Team at AirTrunk, where the cloud meets the ground.
  
  
**A Snapshot**
As Operations Governance Manager, you will report to the Director of Operations Governance and work closely with various teams and leadership across the Asia Pacific region, making your mark in a number of ways:
  
  

* You will work closely with key business teams to drive, structure, and deliver key data centre operational excellence, governance and compliance initiatives across the APJ region.
* You will advise on and shape data centre operational excellence and assurance throughout AirTrunk, including the initiation and delivery of new build sites, ensuring compliance from a risk management perspective to enable the rapid expansion of AirTrunk data centre developments across APJ.
* You will be able to hone new skills and expertise in related workstreams as required, including risk management, business continuity, and emergency response, developing an in-depth knowledge of AirTrunk’s operations and providing strategic operational initiatives.

**Duties And Responsibilities**

* Management of data centre operational excellence, governance and controls.
* Support the development and implementation of consistent operational practices across regions and sites.
* Identify opportunities to improve operational processes, procedures, controls and supporting tools.
* Monitor recurring findings and trends to determine whether broader organisational improvements are required.
* Assist and support assurance activities for all operating sites including; external, internal, client, certification and insurer assurance.
* Management of DC sites’ assurance, measuring and monitoring adherence to operational process and procedures.  Give feedback to sites on common shortcomings and risk consequence.
* Coordinate and undertake Severity 1 drills for DC sites, following up on identified lessons learnt and improvements.
* Lead or support improvement initiatives arising from assurance findings, incidents, drills, controlled self-assessments and lessons learned.
* Monitor and support site teams in the delivery of their Business Continuity, Emergency response and any other required resiliency planning.
* Monitor nominated document owners and managers, in timely review and update of their business unit relevant documentation and keep the Governance owned frameworks and policies up to date for review in consultation with stakeholders.
* Support Operations teams in identifying and understanding relevant regulatory, statutory, certification and internal compliance obligations.
* Work with relevant subject matter experts to assess changes in regulatory or compliance requirements that may impact Data Centre Operations.
* Assessment and tracking of DC sites operational risk, working with site teams to effectively manage, control and/or mitigate these risks.

**Requirements**

* Relevant tertiary qualification or equivalent professional experience in operations, engineering, risk, compliance, governance, quality or a related discipline.
* Demonstrated experience in operational governance, assurance, compliance, risk management or operational excellence.
* Experience working within a critical infrastructure, data centre, engineering, utilities, facilities management or similarly high-reliability operational environment.
* Strong understanding of operational risk and control principles.
* Demonstrated ability to analyse complex operational issues and identify systemic risks and improvement opportunities.
* Ability to travel regularly across operational sites within the APAC region.
* Excellent stakeholder management skills, attention to detail, and the ability to create and direct cross-functional group forums for managing risks.

**The AirTrunk Culture**
Working at AirTrunk is a once in a lifetime opportunity to fast-track your career and amplify your impact. Whilst you’re helping scale our region’s digital future, we’ll help you Grow@Hyperscale and unleash your full potential.
  
  
The pace in which we operate means you’ll feel an electric atmosphere at AirTrunk. We are a team of challengers and collaborative problem solvers who break new ground every day. We do this by living our values, going above and beyond, and being dynamic, transparent, and responsive.
  
  
Every AirTrunker brings their own unique background and diverse perspective to find solutions to problems that matter. We make sure you have everything you need to make your mark and thrive in a flexible and safe working environment, where everyone feels welcome. Our benefits empower AirTrunkers to stay positively charged.
  
  
Now’s your chance to Grow@Hyperscale.

Service Request Manager

**Location:**
India, Mumbai

The Agfa-Gevaert Group develops, manufactures and distributes an extensive range of analogue and digital imaging systems and IT solutions, mainly for the printing industry and the healthcare sector, as well as for specific industrial applications. Although the company generates its entire turnover in business-to-business markets, it also contributes to everyday life around the world. Agfa is seeking a service-oriented and process-driven
**Service Request Manager**
to join its Global ICS (Information & Communication Systems) organization. In this role, you will be responsible for the end-to-end management and continuous improvement of the Service Request Management process, ensuring that users receive standard IT services efficiently, consistently, and within agreed service levels.

You will work closely with internal stakeholders, managed service providers, and technical teams to optimize request fulfillment, enhance user experience, and improve operational efficiency through governance, automation, and process excellence. As part of the global IT Service Management organization, you will help ensure that service requests are delivered in a scalable, compliant, and customer-focused manner.

About You (Skills Required)

You are highly organized, customer-focused, and passionate about delivering efficient IT services. You enjoy improving processes, collaborating across teams, and leveraging data to enhance service performance and user satisfaction.

You possess:

* Strong communication and coordination skills.
* A customer-centric mindset with a focus on service quality and user experience.
* Strong analytical and reporting capabilities.
* Excellent stakeholder and supplier management skills.
* Strong process governance and organizational capabilities.
* A continuous improvement mindset with an interest in automation and service optimization.

 What You'll Do (Duties & Responsibilities)

* Own and continuously improve the global Service Request Management process.
* Ensure efficient and timely fulfillment of service requests in accordance with agreed service levels.
* Manage and maintain the IT Service Catalogue, ensuring services remain accurate, relevant, and easy to consume.
* Coordinate the resolution and fulfillment of complex service requests involving multiple teams and service providers.
* Monitor service request performance, identify trends, and drive service improvements through reporting and analytics.
* Collaborate with suppliers and internal stakeholders to optimize service delivery and request fulfillment processes.
* Drive automation initiatives to improve efficiency, reduce manual effort, and enhance user experience.
* Establish and maintain governance controls to ensure compliance with IT Service Management standards and policies.
* Develop and maintain process documentation, service request workflows, and operational procedures.
* Act as backup for the Change Manager when required.

 What You'll Bring (Experience & Qualifications)

* Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Business Information Systems, or a related discipline.
* Proven experience in Service Request Management.
* Strong knowledge of ITIL Service Request Management principles and best practices.
* Experience in service management, process governance, and operational excellence initiatives.
* Experience working with outsourced service providers and vendor-managed environments.
* Strong stakeholder and supplier management skills.
* Excellent customer service orientation and ability to balance user expectations with operational requirements.
* Experience with service catalog management, request fulfillment processes, and workflow optimization.
* Strong analytical skills with experience in reporting, KPI monitoring, and performance management.
* Experience driving process improvement and automation initiatives.
* ITIL Foundation certification or equivalent Service Management certification is considered an asset.

 Why Join Us

* Work in a global, multicultural, and collaborative team environment.
* Opportunity to contribute to a digital transformation initiatives.
* Competitive compensation and benefits.
* Long-term learning and career development opportunities.
* Be part of a global IT organization committed to delivering high-quality services to users worldwide.
* Collaborate with international teams, business stakeholders, and strategic technology partners.
* Drive innovation through automation and process excellence initiatives.
* Play a key role in improving employee experience and service delivery effectiveness across Agfa's global IT landscape.

If you are passionate about service management, customer experience, process improvement, and operational excellence, we invite you to join Agfa and contribute to the evolution of our global IT services.

title: Spa Executive
description:

Fairmont Hotels & Resorts is where the intimate equally coexists with the infinite – an unrivaled portfolio of more than 90 extraordinary hotels where grand moments of life, heartfelt pleasures and personal milestones are celebrated and remembered long after any visit. Since 1907, Fairmont has created magnificent, meaningful and unforgettable hotels, rich with character and deeply connected to the history, culture and community of its destinations – places such as The Plaza in New York City, The Savoy in London, Fairmont San Francisco, Fairmont Banff Springs in Canada, Fairmont Peace Hotel in Shanghai, and Fairmont The Palm in Dubai. **Job Description**
The Spa & Wellness Executive will play a key role in the development, management, and delivery of our spa services and wellness programs. This position requires a dynamic individual with a strong background in spa and wellness management, excellent organizational skills, and a commitment to providing exceptional guest experiences.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities:**
**Program Development & Management:**

* Design and implement wellness and spa programs that align with our vision of longevity and holistic well-being.
* Develop and maintain a diverse range of spa treatments, services, and packages that cater to different guest needs and preferences.
* Stay informed about industry trends and best practices to continually enhance our offerings.

**Guest Experience:**

* Ensure that all guests receive exceptional service from their initial contact through to the completion of their spa experience.
* Address guest inquiries, feedback, and concerns in a professional and timely manner.
* Personalize guest interactions and recommendations to enhance their overall spa experience.

**Team Leadership & Training:**

* Lead, motivate, and support spa staff, including therapists and wellness practitioners, ensuring high standards of service and professionalism.
* Conduct regular training sessions and workshops to keep the team updated on new treatments, techniques, and wellness trends.
* Evaluate staff performance and provide constructive feedback to foster continuous improvement.

**Operational Management:**

* Oversee daily spa operations, including scheduling, inventory management, and facility maintenance.
* Ensure that all spa equipment, products, and facilities are maintained to the highest standards of safety and hygiene.
* Monitor and manage the spa budget, including tracking expenses, managing inventory, and maximizing revenue.

**Marketing & Promotions:**

* Collaborate with the marketing team to develop and execute promotional strategies, special offers, and events that drive spa traffic and enhance guest engagement.
* Assist in creating engaging content for social media and other marketing channels to promote spa services and wellness programs.

**Quality Control & Compliance:**

* Ensure that all spa treatments and services are delivered in accordance with Fairmont’s quality standards and regulatory requirements.
* Implement and monitor procedures to ensure compliance with health, safety, and hygiene regulations.

qualification

title: Asset Management - Life Investment Operations - Third Party Oversight - Vice President
description:
**About M&G India**
We are M&G India, the strategic innovation and digital hub for M&G. Established in 2003, we have offices in Mumbai and Pune.
  
  
Our teams work closely with colleagues across the Group worldwide to drive transformation, build digital capability, and support sustainable growth. By leveraging technology, AI, automation, and process excellence, we bring new ways of thinking to improve outcomes for both customers and colleagues.
  
  
Grounded in a vibrant culture with strong foundations, we are central to how M&G is transforming as a business.
  
  
**About M&G**
Our purpose is to give everyone real confidence to put their money to work. With a heritage dating back more than 175 years, we have a long history of innovation in savings and investments, combining asset management and insurance expertise to offer a wide range of solutions.
  
  
Our two distinct operating segments, Asset Management and Life, work together to provide access to balanced, long-term investment and savings solutions.
  
  
Through telling it like it is, owning it now, and moving it forward together with care and integrity; we are creating an exceptional place to work for exceptional talent.

* Lead the end to end oversight cycle, including onboarding of third party suppliers and asset managers, conducting periodic suppliers reviews, ongoing monitoring, and exit/transition management

We also welcome those who take part in military service and those returning from career breaks.

title: Assistant Manager - Machine Shop Production
description:
**Company Description**
Inled Technologies LLP is a diversified manufacturing company operating across LED lighting, high pressure die-casting, and gear cutting tools, with each division managed as an independent cost center. The Lighting Division, certified to ISO 9001:2015, specializes in LED light manufacturing and has supplied over 225,000 street lights in Goa using state-of-the-art facilities and an in-house testing lab. The High Pressure Die Casting division, IATF certified, offers end-to-end component solutions with comprehensive in-house processes and serves clients in Germany and India while expanding its global presence. The Gear Cutting Tool division, also ISO 9001:2015 certified, exports to over 45 countries and manufactures precision tools with accuracy up to 0.001 microns. Inled has additionally invested in drone manufacturing through Ikran Aerospace and Technologies Pvt. Ltd., strengthening its role in advanced engineering for the aeronautical industry.
  
**Role Description**
The Assistant Manager – Machine Shop Production will oversee day-to-day production operations in the machine shop, ensuring delivery targets, quality standards, and safety requirements are consistently met. Responsibilities include planning and scheduling machining activities, allocating resources, monitoring workflow, and coordinating with maintenance and quality teams to minimize downtime. The role requires supervising and guiding shop-floor personnel, resolving production issues, implementing process improvements, and maintaining accurate production records and reports. The Assistant Manager will collaborate with senior management on continuous improvement initiatives, cost optimization, and adherence to company standards and customer specifications. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Khandala.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong production planning and production management skills, with experience in scheduling, resource allocation, and meeting output targets.
* Hands-on expertise in machining processes, machine shop operations, and tooling relevant to high-precision manufacturing.
* Knowledge of quality management, including quality systems, process control, and continuous improvement methodologies.
* Proficiency in inspection techniques, use of measuring instruments, and interpretation of engineering drawings and tolerances.
* Diploma or degree in Mechanical Engineering, Production Engineering, or a related discipline.
* Experience in machine shop or manufacturing environments, ideally within automotive, tooling, or metal components industries.
* Ability to lead teams, communicate clearly, and collaborate with cross-functional departments.
* Familiarity with safety standards, 5S, lean manufacturing concepts, and basic computer skills for production reporting.

title: Senior Maintenance Engineer - Plant Maintenance (Heavy Engineering & Fabrication)
description:
**About Zeeco**
Zeeco is a global leader in advanced combustion and environmental solutions, providing innovative products and services to the oil & gas, petrochemical, refining, power, and process industries. With manufacturing and engineering operations across the globe, Zeeco offers an opportunity to work on world-class industrial equipment while driving operational excellence and continuous improvement.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced
**Plant Maintenance professional**
to lead maintenance operations at our heavy fabrication manufacturing facility. This role is ideal for candidates passionate about equipment reliability, preventive maintenance, team leadership, and improving plant performance.
  
  
**Experience:**
10 to 12 years of experience
  
  
**Qualification**

* Diploma / B.E. in Mechanical Engineering
* Additional certifications in Maintenance Management, TPM, Reliability Engineering, or Safety will be an added advantage.
* Proven hands-on experience with fabrication plant machinery, including welding/cutting setups, hydraulics, pneumatics, and cranes. Skilled in both mechanical and electrical preventive maintenance.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Maintenance Operations:**

* Plan, organize, and supervise preventive, predictive, corrective, and breakdown maintenance activities to ensure uninterrupted production.
* Maximize machine availability while minimizing equipment downtime and maintenance costs.
* Prioritize maintenance activities based on production requirements and equipment criticality.
* Lead daily maintenance planning meetings and ensure timely execution of maintenance schedules.
* Conduct Root Cause Analysis (RCA) for recurring equipment failures and implement sustainable corrective and preventive actions.

**Preventive & Predictive Maintenance**

* Develop, implement, and continuously improve Preventive Maintenance (PM) schedules for all critical manufacturing equipment.
* Monitor PM compliance and identify opportunities to improve equipment reliability.
* Establish equipment maintenance history and reliability improvement programs.

**Equipment & Utilities Maintenance**
Lead maintenance activities for:
  
  

* Welding and cutting machines
* Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
* Gearboxes, motors, pumps, compressors, and blowers
* EOT cranes and material handling equipment
* Fabrication machinery and production equipment
* Industrial utilities and supporting infrastructure
* Electrical systems associated with plant machinery

**Reliability & Continuous Improvement**

* Drive TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and Lean Maintenance initiatives across the plant.
* Improve equipment reliability through predictive maintenance and condition monitoring.
* Identify opportunities to reduce downtime, maintenance costs, and energy consumption.
* Recommend and implement equipment modifications to improve productivity and operational efficiency.

**Planning & Coordination**

* Coordinate closely with Production, Quality, Purchase, Stores, Projects, and Engineering teams.
* Plan shutdown maintenance and annual maintenance activities.
* Ensure availability of critical spare parts, maintenance consumables, and specialized tools.
* Coordinate with external vendors for AMC, inspections, repairs, calibration, and servicing.

**Projects & Plant Expansion**

* Support installation, commissioning, relocation, and modification of machinery and utilities.
* Participate in plant expansion, automation, and capacity enhancement projects.
* Provide technical support during equipment procurement and commissioning.

**Cost & Budget Management**

* Prepare and manage annual maintenance budgets.
* Monitor maintenance expenditure and optimize maintenance costs without compromising reliability.
* Manage CAPEX proposals related to equipment upgrades and new machinery.

**Documentation & Compliance**

* Maintain maintenance records, equipment history, SOPs, PM checklists, drawings, manuals, and calibration records.
* Ensure compliance with statutory regulations, company standards, LOTO procedures, and safety requirements.
* Drive timely closure of internal and external audit observations.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

* Machine Availability ≥ 95%
* Reduction in equipment breakdown hours
* Improvement in Mean Time Between Failures (MTBF)
* Reduction in Mean Time To Repair (MTTR)
* Preventive Maintenance Compliance
* Maintenance Cost Optimization
* Critical Spare Parts Availability
* Reduction in Repeat Equipment Failures
* Energy Efficiency Improvement
* Safety Compliance and Zero Lost Time Incidents

**Technical Competencies**
The ideal candidate should possess strong hands-on knowledge of:
  
  

* Preventive, predictive, and breakdown maintenance
* Mechanical and electrical maintenance practices
* Hydraulic and pneumatic systems
* Welding and cutting machinery
* Gearboxes, motors, pumps, compressors, and rotating equipment
* EOT cranes and material handling systems
* Fabrication machinery maintenance
* Maintenance planning and scheduling
* Spare parts planning and inventory management
* Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
* TPM, 5S, Kaizen, and Lean Manufacturing
* Machine installation and commissioning
* Equipment reliability and condition monitoring

**Preferred Industry Background**

* Heavy Engineering
* Pressure Vessel Manufacturing
* Process Equipment Manufacturing
* Oil & Gas Equipment
* Boiler Manufacturing
* Industrial Burners & Combustion Systems
* Steel & Metal Fabrication
* EPC Manufacturing
* Process Plants
* Industrial Machinery Manufacturing

**Position:** CHA Operations Assistant Manager  
**Department:** Customs Clearance & Operations  
**Industry:** Logistics, Freight Forwarding & Customs Brokerage  
**Job Location:** Mumbai / Nhava Sheva / Navi Mumbai  
**Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹55,000 per month (depending on experience and skills)  
**Experience:** 3–10 years preferred  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

1. Job Summary

Shin Logistics Pvt. Ltd. is looking for an experienced and result-oriented CHA Operations Assistant Manager to manage day-to-day customs clearance operations, coordinate with customs authorities, shipping lines, port officials, transporters, and clients, and ensure the smooth and timely clearance of import and export shipments.

The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of customs clearance procedures, import/export documentation, ICEGATE, EDI systems, and port operations, particularly at Nhava Sheva.

2. Key Responsibilities

**A. Import & Export Customs Clearance**

* Handle day-to-day import and export customs clearance operations.
* Supervise filing and processing of Bills of Entry (BOE) and Shipping Bills.
* Ensure timely customs clearance and delivery of shipments.
* Coordinate examination, assessment, queries, and out-of-charge (OOC) procedures.
* Monitor export documentation, Let Export Order (LEO), and shipment status.
* Ensure compliance with applicable customs regulations and procedures.

**B. Documentation & Compliance**

* Verify import/export documents, including invoices, packing lists, Bills of Lading, and other shipping documents.
* Coordinate with documentation teams for accurate and timely filing.
* Follow up on customs queries, examination reports, and assessment-related issues.
* Maintain proper shipment records and operational reports.
* Coordinate with relevant agencies for applicable certificates, permits, and regulatory clearances.

**C. Port & Transport Coordination**

* Coordinate with customs officers, shipping lines, CFS/port personnel, transporters, and other service providers.
* Monitor container movement, cargo examination, delivery orders, and cargo release.
* Follow up on container detention, port storage, and CFS charges to minimize avoidable costs.
* Ensure timely transportation and delivery of cleared cargo.

**D. Team Management**

* Supervise and guide customs clearance executives and operational staff.
* Allocate daily operational activities and monitor team performance.
* Resolve operational issues and ensure adherence to company procedures.
* Train team members on documentation, customs procedures, and compliance requirements.

**E. Client Coordination**

* Maintain regular communication with clients regarding shipment status and clearance requirements.
* Provide timely updates on delays, customs queries, and additional documentation requirements.
* Resolve customer complaints and operational issues promptly.
* Coordinate with the sales and customer service teams to maintain customer satisfaction.

**F. Reporting & Cost Control**

* Prepare daily shipment status reports and operational MIS.
* Monitor clearance timelines and identify operational bottlenecks.
* Control unnecessary operational expenses, detention, and demurrage wherever possible.
* Coordinate with the accounts team for job costing, vendor bills, and operational expense verification.

3. Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline; logistics or supply chain qualifications preferred.
* 5–10 years of experience in CHA operations, customs clearance, or freight forwarding.
* Previous experience handling import and export shipments at Nhava Sheva/JNPA is preferred.
* Good working knowledge of ICEGATE, EDI systems, Bills of Entry, and Shipping Bills.
* Knowledge of customs clearance procedures and relevant regulatory requirements.
* Strong coordination, communication, problem-solving, and team management skills.
* Proficiency in MS Excel, email communication, and operational reporting.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The candidate will be evaluated on:

* Timely customs clearance and cargo delivery.
* Accuracy of import/export documentation.
* Reduction in avoidable detention, demurrage, and storage charges.
* Customer satisfaction and response time.
* Team productivity and operational efficiency.
* Compliance with customs procedures and company policies.
* Timely submission of operational reports.

5. Salary & Benefits

**Monthly Salary:** ₹20,000 – ₹55,000, depending on relevant experience and operational expertise.

* Salary negotiable for suitable candidates.
* Opportunity to work with an established logistics and customs brokerage company.
* Career growth based on performance and operational capabilities.

6. How to Apply

Interested candidates with relevant CHA operations and customs clearance experience may share their updated CV with Shin Logistics Pvt. Ltd.

**Subject:** Application for CHA Operations Assistant Manager – Shin Logistics

**Join Shin Logistics Pvt. Ltd. and become part of our growing logistics and customs brokerage operations team.**

description:
Summary of This Role
  
  
Manages the operation, maintenance and administration of the organization's operating and management systems so that they function reliably, meet the organization's business needs, and use the organization's IT resources effectively. Oversees activities relating to technical guidance for planning, directing, and monitoring operating systems. Plans and recommends operating system modifications or additional equipment to increase the capacity of the system. Prepares operational cost estimates for current and proposed plans. Evaluates vendor proposals for purchases of hardware.
  
  
What Part Will You Play?
  
  

* Provides leadership for all aspects of a global multi-data center environment. Coordinates the planning, acquisition, implementation, and support of systems deployed globally. Evaluates new technologies for optimal operational value and quality of service. Ensures compliance with regulatory and audit standards set forth by the Statement on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE) No.16, Service Organization Controls Report (SOC1), Federal Financial Institutions Examination Council (FFIEC), client contracts and other relevant standards. Ensures system security standards to protect customer data against unauthorized access.
* Plans and directs global capacity management activities to ensure systems are appropriately sized and configured to support customer needs. Establishes and supervises the collection of analytics used for capacity analysis to accurately forecast future resource utilization requirements. Produces annual capacity plan and contribute to budget development, to support required infrastructure enhancements. Ensures scalability and accessibility of applications or services.
* Leads infrastructure change process for a global card authorizations environment. Ensures that change is consistently-executed, with no interruptions to service. Provides technical leadership of group incident resolution process and root cause analysis. Facilitates large changes and other high-risk activity. Manages monitoring of other teams' changes when requested.
* Leads the development and support of a disaster recovery and business continuity solution, to support a critical business service. Evaluates new technology to decrease recovery times and simplify recovery solutions. Executes recovery of the production environment to an out of region facility, within contractual time frames.
* Facilitates vendor relationships with major hardware and software providers, including problem management, enhancements, and support. Monitors vendor performance, products, and services. Participates in vendor events which focus on future products and services, industry trends, vendor strategic direction and similar topics. Meets regularly with internal staff to keep apprised of strategic direction and how it would be supported by current and future vendor relationships.
* Collaborates and provides recommendations to executive leadership on technology related issues. Engages global internal business partners to understand their support needs and coordinate the development of infrastructure to maintain relevant services as the payments environment evolves. Communicates effectively with current and prospective clients to align business needs with technical solutions. Coaches team members to effectively engage clients and to provide industry-best technical solutions.

title: Manager, Supply Chain Planning & Operations
description:
Our team members are at the heart of everything we do. At Cencora, we are united in our responsibility to create healthier futures, and every person here is essential to us being able to deliver on that purpose. If you want to make a difference at the center of health, come join our innovative company and help us improve the lives of people and animals everywhere. Apply today!
  
  
**Job Details**
**Summary**
The Supply Chain Network Modeling Manager is responsible for leading the development and application of advanced supply chain network models that support operational decision-making across the enterprise. This role combines hands-on modeling expertise with people leadership responsibilities, managing a team of supply chain modelers and analysts while ensuring delivery of high-quality network design, transportation optimization, capacity planning, inventory optimization, and business continuity initiatives.
  
  
The Manager translates business challenges into analytical solutions that optimize cost, service, capacity, inventory, risk, and growth objectives. The role is accountable for developing team capabilities, establishing modeling standards and best practices, and ensuring successful execution of a portfolio of modeling projects aligned with organizational priorities.
  
  
**Primary Duties And Responsibilities**
People Leadership & Talent Development
  
  

* Lead, coach, mentor, and develop a team of Supply Chain Modelers and Analysts.
* Conduct performance management, career development planning, and succession planning activities.
* Support hiring, onboarding, training, and capability development of modeling resources.
* Establish technical competency standards and promote continuous learning across the team.
* Foster collaboration, innovation, and a high-performance culture.

**Project & Portfolio Leadership**

* Manage a portfolio of network modeling, transportation optimization, simulation, and supply chain strategy projects.
* Prioritize initiatives based on business value, resource availability, and organizational objectives.
* Provide project oversight, quality assurance, and governance throughout project lifecycles.
* Ensure project deliverables are completed on schedule and align with stakeholder expectations.
* Present recommendations and business cases to senior leadership and executive stakeholders.

**Supply Chain Modeling & Optimization**

* Lead the design, development, maintenance, and enhancement of end-to-end supply chain network models.
* Evaluate scenarios including network expansion, consolidation, facility location, inventory positioning, manufacturing footprint changes, transportation strategies, and capacity investments.
* Analyze tradeoffs between cost, service levels, inventory, risk, resilience, sustainability, and growth.
* Develop transportation optimization and cost-to-serve models.
* Support long-range planning, annual operating planning, and capital investment decisions through scenario analysis.
* Drive adoption of advanced analytics, optimization, simulation, AI, and emerging technologies.

**Stakeholder Management & Consulting**

* Partner with business leaders to identify opportunities for analytics-driven decision making.
* Translate complex business problems into quantitative analyses and actionable recommendations.
* Facilitate workshops to define objectives, assumptions, constraints, and decision criteria.
* Communicate findings through executive presentations, dashboards, visualizations, and storytelling.
* Build strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders.

**Process & Capability Development**

* Establish and maintain modeling methodologies, governance processes, and best practices.
* Improve data quality, model documentation standards, and model validation procedures.
* Develop reusable templates, tools, and frameworks to improve efficiency and consistency.
* Support the evolution of Network Modeling as a Service (NMaaS) and consulting capabilities.
* Identify opportunities for automation and process improvement.

**Work Experience**

* 5+ years of experience in Supply Chain Analytics & Optimization.
* 2+ years of team management/leadership experience.
* Expertise translating business rules into modeling requirements and scenarios
* Expertise in network modeling, optimization, transportation, and operations research.
* Experience with supply chain network modeling tools, data analytics and visualization.
* Hands-on with network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, PowerBI, Alteryx, Databricks).
* Strong knowledge of supply chain design, inventory, warehousing, and capacity planning.
* Exposure to Operations and different supply chain strategies (store, crossdock, import, buy/lease, etc)
* Experience coaching and training modelers

**Education Qualification**
Bachelor’s Degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or any other related discipline or equivalent related experience.
  
  
Technical Skills
  
  

* Network optimization tools (Optilogic, Llamasoft, Coupa, or similar)
* Supply chain simulation and modeling tools
* Advanced Excel, SQL, Python, Power BI, and analytics platforms
* Statistical analysis, optimization, and scenario planning
* Supply chain design, inventory, transportation, warehousing, and capacity planning

Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Strategic thinking
* Influencing without authority
* Executive communication
* Coaching and talent development
* Project and portfolio management
* Change leadership
* Analytical problem-solving

Success Measures (KPIs)
  
  

* On-time delivery of modeling projects
* Stakeholder satisfaction
* Team engagement and capability growth
* Business value from recommendations
* Cost savings, service improvements, and capacity optimization
* Adoption of modeling tools and best practices
* Reduced analysis cycle time through automation and standardization

Key Improvements
  
  

* Removed repetitive wording for brevity.
* Simplified KPI descriptions while retaining meaning.
* Standardized terminology and formatting for a more professional job description.

******What Cencora offers******
Benefit offerings outside the US may vary by country and will be aligned to local market practice. The eligibility and effective date may differ for some benefits and for team members covered under collective bargaining agreements.
  
  
Full time

Pune

Hybrid

**About the department:**

Our CFO support service team provides a range of finance and accounting services, including ERP implementation, legacy accounting, audit assistance, global outsourcing, GAAP advisory, finance transformation, and health checks / clean-up of books of accounts. By partnering closely with our clients, we take a practical, hands-on approach to strengthen financial operations, improve controls and support long-term compliance and stability. Within the finance transformation business, we work with forward-looking organizations to optimize financial operations, enhance decision-making and align finance with business objectives. Our services span organization structure, technology enablement and process improvement.

**What’s in it for you?**

An opportunity to lead a combined finance operations team while working closely with clients and international stakeholders. You will gain exposure to global finance processes across Cash Applications and P2P, ERP systems, team management and opportunities to improve and streamline existing processes.

**Role Description**
Lead the day-to-day delivery of Cash Applications and Procure-to-Pay activities for a global client, ensuring service quality, timely delivery and effective issue resolution. The role will be responsible for team management, SLA and KPI performance, stakeholder management, month-end support and continuous improvement across both processes.

**Key Result Areas:**

1. **Operational Leadership & Service Delivery:**
   Lead day-to-day operations across Cash Applications and P2P, including workload allocation, prioritisation, capacity planning and team coverage. Monitor agreed productivity, quality and SLA / KPI measures across both processes and proactively address operational risks, bottlenecks and service issues.
2. **Cash Applications & P2P Oversight:**
   Provide operational oversight of customer receipt application, unidentified and unapplied cash, reconciliations and foreign-currency items, as well as PO / non-PO invoices, matching and vendor reconciliations. Review complex or aged exceptions and act as the first level of escalation for accounting, transaction and process-related issues.
3. **Stakeholder Management & Query Resolution:**
   Work closely with clients, onshore stakeholders, collections, credit control, procurement, business users, vendors and finance teams to resolve queries and operational issues. Provide timely and professional communication on open items, escalations, risks and action plans, maintaining appropriate documentation.
4. **Controls, Reporting & Month-End Support:**
   Oversee month-end activities across Cash Applications and P2P, including ageing reviews, reconciliations, reporting and audit support. Ensure adherence to defined controls, SOPs and accounting processes, with appropriate review of key outputs and exceptions.
5. **People Management & Development**
   : Coach and support team members, identify training needs and promote cross-training across Cash Applications and P2P to build a flexible and capable team. Conduct regular quality and performance reviews and support effective feedback, knowledge sharing and performance improvement.
6. **Process Improvement & Continuous Improvement:**
   Identify recurring issues, lead root-cause analysis and implement corrective actions across both processes. Drive process standardisation, automation and other continuous improvement initiatives and support transitions or ramp-up of new activities.

**Required Competencies, Skills, and Experience**

**Skills / Experience:**

Strong experience in Cash Applications / Accounts Receivable / O2C and P2P / Accounts Payable operations, with hands-on understanding of receipt allocation, unapplied / unidentified cash, reconciliations, PO / non-PO invoices, two-way / three-way matching, GRN and vendor reconciliation. Strong English communication skills, with experience managing international stakeholders, team members and operational escalations.

**Competencies**
:

Leadership, stakeholder management, accounting and process knowledge, analytical and problem solving ability, ownership and follow-through, SLA and deadline orientation, escalation management, coaching and team development, continuous improvement mindset.

**Preferred Experience**

• Experience supporting EMEA clients; international exposure desirable.

• Experience managing high-volume transaction-processing environments across Cash Applications and P2P.

• Hands-on experience with SAP, Oracle or similar ERP / finance systems and relevant banking or procurement platforms.

• Experience with KPI / SLA reporting, month-end activities, root-cause analysis, process improvement and team coaching.

**Hiring Process:**

Your interaction with us will include, but not be limited to,

- Technical / HR Interviews

-Assessment

title: Assistant Peer Review Performance Manager
description:
We believe in bold ideas, diverse perspectives, and the drive to transform knowledge into impact. Here, your curiosity fuels progress, your voice shapes innovation, and your ambition helps redefine what’s possible within science and learning. We are a culture that obsesses over impact, challenges, and drives what’s next to power infinite possibilities for our customers, colleagues and society at large.
  
  
**About The Role**
The Assistant Peer Review Performance Manager oversees day-to-day business-as-usual peer review performance for a segment of the Research Publishing journal portfolio. The role assesses editor and editorial office performance across assigned journals, monitors progress against expected behaviours and key performance indicators (KPIs), and drives improvements that support best practices and a positive author experience throughout the author lifecycle. The role receives direction from the manager, along with guidance and coaching from senior peers.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Oversee the day-to-day management of peer review and journal editorial office services.
* Oversee and evaluate editor and editorial office administrator performance across the assigned segment of the Research Publishing portfolio.
* Drive continuous improvement, workflow optimization, and the adoption of peer review best practices and standards across the portfolio.
* Focus on value-added strategies and tactics that support the delivery of editorial decisions, including speed to decision, the quality of the author experience, and the integrity of manuscripts and the workflows underpinning the peer review process.
* Seek guidance on remedial action plans, as appropriate.

Peer Review Management
  
  

* Provide journal-level oversight of the manuscript peer review process, from submission through final editorial decision and export to Content Operations, for a portfolio of Research Publishing journals, using best-practice principles and effective time-management practices.
* Maintain oversight of accurate documentation for the peer review management process.
* Identify and escalate integrity concerns, and implement outcomes from investigations as needed.
* Adopt new services and tools when introduced, and implement enhanced workflows as they are rolled out.

Editor and Editorial Office Performance Management
  
  

* Monitor and manage the performance of editors, editorial office administrators, and vendor-partner editorial assistants, and provide feedback.
* Communicate and manage expected behaviours and KPIs against established benchmarks.
* Handle performance-related queries and escalations.
* Assess insights from self-service reports and analyses provided by editorial data analysts to continuously improve performance.
* Ensure that editors and administrators follow established best practices and workflows.
* Ensure that editors demonstrate expected behaviours, including adherence to the code of conduct.
* Implement remedial actions or retraining for editors who do not meet performance expectations.
* Implement remedial actions or initiate retraining for editorial office administrators or vendor-partner editorial assistants when expectations are not consistently met.
* Share insights about consistently poor editor performance with Publishing Development and/or Partner Publishing colleagues.
* Seek guidance on remedial action plans and support with enforcing alignment, as appropriate.

Optimization and Harmonization
  
  

* Review and optimize journal workflows, ensuring alignment with peer review best practices and standards, and implement changes that improve efficiency and standardization.
* Communicate and implement opportunities identified through audits or data-driven improvement projects led by Publishing Operations or Editorial Excellence.
* Implement journal-level changes.
* Support transitions between editorial office models and onboard new partners moving to Wiley Peer Review Management.
* Contribute to accurate product data masters by recording journal-level changes.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Collaborate with internal colleagues to achieve departmental and customer-focused goals and objectives.
* Partner with editorial data analysts to advance improvements based on data-driven approaches and insights.
* Work with Research Publishing colleagues on journal-specific strategic initiatives and relationship management, and provide information and data to support improvements at the journal level.
* Contribute to relevant projects, as required.

**Qualifications**

* Experience supporting peer review, editorial operations, journal publishing, or a related environment.
* Ability to monitor performance against KPIs, interpret data and reports, and translate insights into practical improvements.
* Knowledge of peer review workflows, publishing integrity requirements, and editorial best practices.
* Strong organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple journals and priorities.
* Effective communication, stakeholder management, and cross-functional collaboration skills.
* Ability to address performance concerns, manage escalations, and support remedial actions with appropriate guidance.
* Commitment to delivering an efficient, consistent, and positive author experience.

**We power infinite possibilities.**
For more than 200 years, we've transformed knowledge into discoveries that shape the world. Today, our global team of innovators, creators, and experts is driving what's next in science, education, and publishing—creating impact that reaches everywhere.
  
  
We're not just observers of progress. We're the ones accelerating scientific breakthroughs, advancing learning, and sparking innovation that redefines entire fields and improves lives.
  
  
Here, your talent matters. Your ideas have room to grow. And your work creates breakthroughs that can change everything.

+ Well versed with MS Excel and PowerPoint

**Data Preparation**
:

* Exposure to Transfer Pricing and intercompany processes is preferred
* Advanced Excel skills; experience with S4H and Power BI/Power Query
* Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in a global environment
* Prior experience in team handling / people management preferred
* Experience in FMCG / Manufacturing / Global Business Services (GBS) environment, transformation projects or finance transitions.
* Ability to translate complex financial data into actionable business insights
* Strong problem-solving mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and automation
* Strategic thinking with the ability to translate business goals into operational execution, underpinned by digital technology deployments.
* Data-driven mindset, leveraging analytics to measure, predict and improve performance.

title: Product Trialing Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Syngenta Seeds is one of the world’s largest developers and producers of seed for farmers, commercial growers, retailers and small seed companies. Syngenta seeds improve the quality and yields of crops. High-quality seeds ensure better and more productive crops, which is why farmers invest in them. Advanced seeds help mitigate risks such as disease and drought and allow farmers to grow food using less land, less water and fewer inputs.
  
  
Syngenta Seeds brings farmers more vigorous, stronger, resistant plants, including innovative hybrid varieties and biotech crops that can thrive even in challenging growing conditions.
  
  
Syngenta Seeds is headquartered in the United States.
  
  
**Job Description**
**Role purpose**
Lead the planning, execution and delivery of vegetable-seed trials
*(includes PLC 6.1, agronomy trials, satellite demos, demo day fields)*
across India to generate robust, high-quality data that supports product advancement, positioning and successful commercial launch. The role connects breeding, product specialists, agronomy and commercial teams, ensuring trials reflect diverse Indian growing environments and customer needs.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Develop and execute annual trialing plans for assigned vegetable crops, including varietal evaluation, product placement and agronomic practices
* Identify and manage trial locations across key agro-climatic zones, ensuring representative testing for season, disease pressure, soil type and grower practice.
* Lead trial protocol development & execution, plot design, data standards and timely execution through internal teams, external partners and contract growers.
* Ensure accurate collection, validation and analysis of trial data covering yield, quality, maturity, disease tolerance, plant habit, shelf life and marketable traits as per the product profile. Effective use of the internal tools like Ez Capture
* Translate trial results into clear recommendations on advancement, positioning, target geographies and product claims.
* Work closely with Product specialist, Breeding & TPP teams to support pipeline decisions and hybrid advancement with trial execution, PAT execution, data collection and data consolidation for proposal to the product meetings
* Partner with commercial, Product specialist, customer experience teams to establish satellite demo & demo days field demonstrations and build compelling evidence for launches and demand generation activities around CPIs with CX and Commercial team
* Manage trialing budgets, seasonal resource plans, vendors and compliance requirements.
* Lead, coach and develop the trialing team, setting clear objectives, managing performance, building technical and operational capability, and ensuring effective deployment of people and resources across trial locations and seasons.
* Ensure adherence to company stewardship, safety, quality, phytosanitary and data-integrity standards.
* Support to the commercial team for the mass scale customer complaints validation and RCA process

**Qualifications**
**Qualifications and experience**

* Master’s degree in Agriculture, Horticulture, Plant Breeding, Agronomy or a related discipline
* Around 15 years of relevant experience in vegetable-seed trialing, product development, agronomy or field trial management
* Demonstrated experience managing multi-location trials in India, preferably across multiple vegetable crops and seasons.
* Strong understanding of vegetable production systems, crop agronomy, hybrid evaluation and market requirements.
* Experience in experimental design, statistical analysis and digital trial-data systems.
* Proven ability to lead field teams and external partners across geographically dispersed locations.
* Fluency in English; working proficiency in Hindi and/or regional languages is preferred.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India during key trialing periods.

**Key competencies**

* Strong scientific and agronomic judgement
* Rigorous data quality and attention to detail
* Planning and execution discipline
* Stakeholder management and cross-functional collaboration
* Commercial awareness and customer orientation
* People leadership and capability building
* Clear, evidence-based communication

**Success measures**

* Timely completion and quality of planned trials
* Reliable, decision-ready data for pipeline and launch decisions
* Effective product recommendations by crop and region
* Trial budget and resource efficiency
* Strong adoption of trialing standards, stewardship and data governance
* Successful support for priority product launches in India

**Additional Information**
Syngenta is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate in recruitment, hiring, training, promotion or any other employment practices for reasons of race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, marital or veteran status, disability, or any other legally protected status.

title: Vice President, Platform Engineering
description:
**Our Purpose**
*Mastercard powers economies and empowers people in 200+ countries and territories worldwide. Together with our customers, we’re helping build a sustainable economy where everyone can prosper. We support a wide range of digital payments choices, making transactions secure, simple, smart and accessible. Our technology and innovation, partnerships and networks combine to deliver a unique set of products and services that help people, businesses and governments realize their greatest potential.*
**Title And Summary**
Vice President, Platform Engineering
  
  
Role Overview
  
  
This is a senior site and technology leadership role. This role will provide visible leadership for Mastercard (Vocalink) colleagues in Pune and drive culture, growth, prioritisation and effectiveness of Vocalink Pune capability through influence and is accountable for the connection between Pune execution and UK leadership, architecture, engineering, programme and business priorities.
  
  
The successful candidate will bring enterprise-level technology leadership, executive presence and the ability to align a broad technical community via matrix management authority. This is not a software engineering leadership role. It requires experience influencing multidisciplinary infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture and enterprise technology stakeholders.
  
  
Key Accountabilities
  
  

* Act as the visible technology leadership and escalation point for Mastercard (Vocalink) colleagues in Pune, creating clarity and momentum without direct line-management authority.
* Drive Vocalink culture in Pune by leading town halls, leadership forums and large colleague events, engaging and influencing audiences of 100 or more people.
* Maintain an effective UK–Pune operating link, influencing People Leaders and technical stakeholders to align local execution with UK strategy, architecture, governance and business accountability.
* Translate technology strategy, roadmaps and programme direction into a clear, sequenced and achievable portfolio of work.
* Facilitate and influence prioritisation across strategic change, regulatory commitments, operational resilience, technical debt and service improvement, securing agreement from accountable leaders.
* Provide matrix leadership across multidisciplinary teams, using technical fluency to challenge assumptions, expose dependencies and shape sound decisions.
* Establish governance for demand, capacity, delivery health, risks, dependencies and escalation.
* Identify and remove systemic blockers, including unclear ownership, decision delays, skills gaps, environmental constraints and cross-team dependencies.
* Influence UK and Pune leaders to grow the volume and complexity of work delivered from Pune by aligning demand, capacity, capability and realistic delivery plans.
* Drive measurable efficiency through automation, standardisation, simplification, reuse and improved ways of working.
* Coach, connect and influence local leaders to drive talent retention, strengthen leadership depth, succession and technical capability while reinforcing an inclusive and accountable culture.
* Build effective relationships with senior leaders, architects, engineers, programme teams, support functions, partners and vendors.

Expected Outcomes
  
  

* A unified UK–Pune operating model achieved through strong relationships, shared priorities, clear ownership and effective escalation routes.
* A transparent and prioritised portfolio aligned to business outcomes and technology strategy.
* Pune Tech Hub strategy to create a high-performing, increasingly productive workforce, underpinned by robust quality, resilience and controls.
* Faster removal of blockers and more effective management of cross-functional dependencies.
* Measurable improvements in productivity, automation, deployment lead time and operational efficiency.
* A confident and increasingly self-sufficient Pune organisation, enabled through influence, coaching and stronger local leadership depth.

Candidate Profile
  
  
**The Ideal Candidate Will Demonstrate**

* Significant senior leadership experience in a complex, multinational technology, payments or critical-infrastructure environment.
* Executive presence and gravitas, with evidence of commanding large audiences and remaining credible under challenge.
* Experience providing matrix leadership across multidisciplinary infrastructure, platform, operations, architecture or enterprise technology teams. A career focused primarily on software engineering will not provide the breadth required.
* A track record of connecting offshore or remote technology capability with onshore leadership, strategy and accountability without relying on direct reporting lines.
* Strong programme and portfolio leadership covering direction-setting, prioritisation, sequencing, dependencies, risk and benefits delivery.
* Technical fluency across infrastructure, platforms, architecture, operations, resilience and security, with the ability to challenge technical positions without being the deepest subject-matter expert.
* Proven success in diagnosing delivery blockers, resolving ambiguity and establishing clear ownership and governance.
* Evidence of scaling workload and capability through effective demand, capacity and skills planning.
* Measurable delivery of efficiency through automation, standardisation, simplification or operating-model change.
* Exceptional influencing, facilitation and stakeholder-management skills, with evidence of securing commitment and resolving conflict without formal authority.
* Commercial and financial discipline in managing resources, budgets and investment priorities.
* A people-centred leadership style that builds trust, accountability, inclusion and capability across cultures and locations through coaching, credibility and relationships.
* High personal integrity and a leadership approach aligned with Vocalink and Mastercard values.

What Success Looks Like
  
  
The successful leader will establish Pune as an integrated and trusted part of Mastercard (Vocalink) technology organisation through influence rather than hierarchy. They will convene stakeholders, create a sustainable pipeline of valuable work, resolve barriers and secure commitment to clear priorities, effective governance and measurable outcomes.
  
  
**Essential Screening Summary**

* Broad enterprise technology leadership, not solely software engineering.
* Proven executive presence and large-audience communication.
* Cross-location matrix leadership connecting Pune or offshore delivery with UK or onshore accountability.
* Programme direction, portfolio prioritisation and technical fluency.
* Evidence of influencing accountable leaders to remove blockers, scale workload and deliver measurable efficiencies.

**Corporate Security Responsibility**
All activities involving access to Mastercard assets, information, and networks comes with an inherent risk to the organization and, therefore, it is expected that every person working for, or on behalf of, Mastercard is responsible for information security and must:
  
  

* Abide by Mastercard’s security policies and practices;
* Ensure the confidentiality and integrity of the information being accessed;
* Report any suspected information security violation or breach, and
* Complete all periodic mandatory security trainings in accordance with Mastercard’s guidelines.

title: Sourcing Manager
description:
**Position Summary**
Identify and develop supplier base for existing and plan for new products for local & overseas divisional requirement. Provide guidance to the SCM/quality team in MSDI.
  
  
Shape the strategy for Sourcing and analytics of key commodities across all value streams/products in a cost-effective way that enhance product value to support divisions AIP objectives.
  
  
THIS ROLE IS BASED IN PUNE.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
**Supplier Sourcing & Selection**

* Conduct market and vendor research to identify potential suppliers across required commodities (casting, machining, sub‑assembly, C‑class).
* Compare and evaluate supplier proposals using total cost of ownership criteria (price, lead time, quality, capacity, risk).
* Lead supplier selection and onboarding, ensuring alignment with product specifications and commercial objectives.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, Incoterms, and other commercial conditions to secure competitive, sustainable agreements.

**Supplier Development & Quality Assurance**

* Establish and validate manufacturing processes at supplier locations to meet product quality and specification requirements.
* Conduct supplier capability assessments and drive corrective actions to raise quality to expected standards.
* Own PPAP and supplier acceptance activities and remain accountable for new‑part stabilization through PPAP + 3 months.
* Collaborate with suppliers to implement process controls (machining, tooling, heat treatment, grinding, lapping, casting) and continuous improvement initiatives.

**Category & Commodity Strategy**

* Define and execute commodity strategies for key categories in alignment with market trends and divisional AIP/growth objectives.
* Segment suppliers (strategic / preferred / transactional) and deploy appropriate governance, risk‑mitigation and supplier development approaches.
* Implement long‑term sourcing roadmaps including supplier consolidation, localization and strategic partnerships.

**Cost Optimisation & Value Engineering (VAVE)**

* Lead value engineering (VAVE) initiatives and product cost analyses to identify opportunities for cost reduction and value enhancement.
* Analyse material, labour and overhead cost drivers; implement initiatives to reduce total supply chain cost via price, volume aggregation, lead‑time reduction or quality-driven savings.
* Drive VAVE projects from conception to implementation and monitor adherence to budget and timelines.

**Capacity Planning & Supply Continuity**

* Monitor supplier capacity and utilisation to ensure uninterrupted supply and manage contingency plans for peak demand or disruptions.
* Work with suppliers and internal planning teams to forecast demand and align capacity, buffer inventories or alternate sources as needed.

**Contracting & Commercial Management**

* Lead contract negotiations and finalization of strategic supply agreements, VMI arrangements, rebates/discounts and periodic price agreements.
* Manage and optimise key commercial attributes (price, payment terms, MoQs, lead times, penalty terms) to support business needs.

**Project & New Product Sourcing**

* Lead purchasing strategy for new products and customer projects, developing suppliers in parallel with product development.
* Manage supplier development of new parts through launch and stabilization (responsible for new parts until PPAP + 3 months).

**Spend & Supplier Performance Management**

* Monitor and analyse spend and supplier base performance; create and implement plans to optimise price, lead‑time, service levels and supplier capabilities.
* Drive supplier performance reviews and corrective actions; escalate chronic issues and implement improvement plans.

**Financial Control & Performance**

* Control and manage budgeted procurement spend; identify and address adverse trends to meet business objectives and priorities.
* Drive year‑on‑year cost savings and contribute to Deflation Plan / Price Performance metrics.
* Deliver at least the defined productivity savings target (e.g., 1% productivity savings of total supplier spend) and continually identify further opportunities.

**Technical Expertise & Continuous Improvement**

* Apply deep technical knowledge of manufacturing processes (machining, tooling, heat treatment, grinding, lapping, casting) to enable supplier discussions, troubleshooting and capability development.
* Conduct periodic product and process analyses to identify cost and value improvement opportunities and embed continuous improvement into supplier relationships.

**Risk Management & Market Intelligence**

* Analyze market trends, commodity price drivers and supplier capabilities to anticipate risks and unlock sourcing opportunities that support profitable growth.
* Recommend hedging, sourcing diversification or alternative material/tech solutions where appropriate.

**Qualifications**

* B.Tech/M.Tech Degree with Supply Chain or Management discipline.
* 8-12 years of experience
* Six sigma green belt will be added advantage.

title: Service Assurance Manager
description:
**About GTT:**

GTT is a leading global provider of secure cloud networking solutions for multinational organizations. We design and deliver solutions that leverage advanced cloud, networking and security technologies. We complement our solutions with a suite of professional services and exceptional sales and support teams in local markets around the world. We serve thousands of national and multinational companies with a portfolio that includes SD-WAN, security, Internet, voice and other connectivity options. Our services are uniquely enabled by our top-ranked, global, Tier 1 IP backbone, which spans more than 260 cities on six continents. The company culture is built on a customer-first service experience reinforced by our commitment to operational excellence and continuous improvement in our business, environmental, social and governance practices. For more information, visit gtt.net.

**Role Summary:**

Third level technical support for the GTT client base – Network Services & Security fields.

**Job Scope/Supervision:**

The team represents a highly skilled, intelligent, and efficient break/fix organisation, with a customer centric focus, serving GTT’s international customer base and multi-vendor network. The team has a strong focus on consistency and process, working in conjunction with other areas of the GTT business, to deliver a world-class customer experience. The team is responsible for the overall technical & operational quality and handling of incidents, problems, and change requests. The team holds the responsibility for technical validation and analysis, communication with customers and third parties, including both vendors and suppliers, and ultimately the customer satisfaction of GTT’s customer base.

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Break/fix support for customer services, across GTT’s international network.
* Own incidents, resolve them swiftly and drive through to final fix, while working with customers and other internal and external teams as appropriate.
* Escalation to vendor support and other internal teams, to ensure prompt and satisfactory resolution of issues.
* Provide concise and relevant action plans for teams, to resolve network and customer issues efficiently.
* Communication and documentation of customer and service-specific support information.
* Pro-active problem management, based on technical and trend analysis, to ensure service stability. Taking preventative actions where possible.
* Configuration of network & security elements and migration of services.
* Ensure operational processes are followed and deliver best-in-class technical support, while maintaining a stable and resilient network.

**Required Experience/Qualifications:**

* Minimum 4 years of experience, within operations of a Telco, Service Provider, Managed Services Provider or other similar environment.
* Excellent knowledge of the Telecom/SP/MSP industry, standards and products – DIA & IP Transit services, MPLS, L2VPN & L3VPN solutions, Managed Security services, etc.
* Excellent fault diagnostics and troubleshooting abilities.
* Strong understanding and demonstrable experience with routing protocols (BGP, ISIS, OSPF, EIGRP).
* Strong understanding and demonstrable experience with L2 technologies (VLANs, Q-in-Q, Trunks, VTP, Spanning-Tree Protocols, Aggregation/LACP).
* Strong understanding of network security technologies and experience with NGFWs (NAC, VPNs, DPI, IPS/IDS, Application control, Content filtering, etc.).
* General knowledge and experience with other network & security related protocols and technologies is a benefit (FHRPs, DHCP, NAT, QoS, ACLs, SNMP, AAA, Tunneling/VPN solutions, VoIP, WLANs).
* General knowledge of Linux/Unix based tools and operations.
* Strong Cisco / Juniper knowledge & experience is a must.
* Strong knowledge & experience with other Network/Security oriented vendors is a benefit – Fortinet, Palo Alto, Checkpoint, etc.
* Experience with scripting, for performing and automating network related tasks, is a benefit.

**Desirable Experience/Qualifications:**

* Cisco CCS/CCNP, Juniper JNCIS/JNCIP, Fortinet FCP/FCSS, Palo Alto PCNSE/PCCSE, or other similar training & certification, for this level of qualification, is an advantage.

**Hours/Travel/Shift:**

Standard 8 working hour shifts, covering extended European business hours (08:00 – 20:00 EEST).

**Core Competencies**
*(Talent management will add)*

**Universal Competencies**
*(Talent management will add)*

* **Continuous Improvement:**
  Knowledge of transformation initiatives to drive fundamental changes, enhance responsiveness and efficiency to core business practices. Ability to drive cultural changes from best effort to results oriented.
* **Customer First (Non-Customer Facing):**
  Knowledge of internal customer interactions, creating a culture of accountability, collaboration, and partnership. Ability to build an environment supporting internal customer value creation at every level.
* **Operational Excellence:**
  Understanding the system-driven processes for consistency and scalability. Ability to re-focus processes and systems from integration activity to maximizing a positive customer impact and anticipating future trends.

description:

**Job Description**

About the Role

We are looking for an experienced
**Cost Manager – Procurement**
to drive procurement strategy, cost optimization, vendor management, and commercial controls across projects. The incumbent will be responsible for ensuring timely procurement of materials and services while maintaining budget adherence, quality standards, and contractual compliance.

The ideal candidate should have strong experience in procurement planning, commercial negotiations, cost management, contract administration, and stakeholder management within the Construction, Real Estate, Infrastructure, Data Center, EPC, PMC, or Interior Fit-out sectors.

Key Responsibilities

Procurement Management

* Manage end-to-end procurement activities for materials, equipment, and subcontractor packages.
* Develop procurement plans aligned with project timelines and budgets.
* Prepare RFQs/RFPs and conduct tendering processes.
* Evaluate technical and commercial bids and recommend vendor selections.
* Ensure timely procurement to avoid project delays.

Cost Management & Commercial Control

* Prepare procurement budgets and cost estimates.
* Monitor procurement spend against project budgets.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and implement value engineering initiatives.
* Analyze market trends and benchmark pricing for key procurement categories.
* Prepare comparative statements and procurement cost reports.

Vendor & Contract Management

* Develop and maintain strategic relationships with suppliers and subcontractors.
* Lead commercial negotiations to achieve favorable pricing and contractual terms.
* Manage vendor performance and compliance.
* Review, negotiate, and administer procurement contracts and purchase orders.
* Resolve contractual and commercial issues with suppliers.

Project & Stakeholder Coordination

* Collaborate with Project Managers, Engineering, Finance, and Commercial teams to understand procurement requirements.
* Participate in project planning and procurement review meetings.
* Provide regular procurement status updates to internal stakeholders.

Risk, Compliance & Governance

* Ensure adherence to company procurement policies and procedures.
* Mitigate procurement and supply chain risks.
* Monitor supplier compliance with quality, safety, and contractual obligations.
* Support internal and external audits by maintaining procurement documentation.

**Qualifications**

Qualifications

Education

* Bachelor's Degree in Engineering, Supply Chain Management, Procurement, Quantity Surveying, Commerce, or related discipline.
* MBA/Postgraduate qualification in Procurement, Supply Chain, Finance, or Operations will be an added advantage.

Experience

* 8-10 years of experience in Procurement and Cost Management.
* Experience in Construction, Data Centers, Real Estate, Infrastructure, EPC, PMC, or Interior Fit-out projects preferred.
* Proven experience handling high-value procurement contracts and negotiations.

Our inspired people share our vision and mission. We provide a great place to work, where each person has the opportunity and voice to affect change.
