title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Pune Factory

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Project Manager
description:
**About the Company**

Kirloskar Solar is propelled by a leading multi-engineering conglomerate, backed by 133 years of glorious legacy and undisputed leadership in giving cutting edge technology – The Kirloskar Group. We offer turn-key solar solutions, products, and services to all segments, from residential to large scale commercial and industries. We have an extensive portfolio of customers in all segments like Residential, Commercial, Industries, SMEs across sectors like Health care, Hospitality, Automotive, Commercial, Education, Agriculture and Manufacturing. We provide sustainable energy efficient solution to serve the entire spectrum of electricity consumers from those who have zero power cuts to those who have frequent power cuts. Product basket consists of solar PV modules, On-Grid String Inverters, On-Grid Central Inverters, Off-Grid Inverters, Off-Grid and On-Grid Power Packs.

**About the Role:**

We are seeking a highly experienced, result-oriented, and dynamic AGM/DGM – Project Management to lead the execution of multiple rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects across India. The ideal candidate must have strong experience in a Solar EPC organization, with proven capabilities in project planning, execution, resource management, cost control, quality assurance, safety, and timely project delivery. The role requires strong leadership, excellent stakeholder management, and the ability to manage multiple projects and geographically distributed site teams simultaneously, ensuring compliance with contractual commitments, technical specifications, quality standards, and project timelines.

Key Roles and Responsibilities

**A. Project Planning and Management:**
Lead end-to-end execution of multiple rooftop and ground-mounted solar EPC projects across various locations. Develop and monitor detailed project schedules, milestones, critical-path activities, and resource plans. Establish project baselines and track progress against approved schedules, budgets, and contractual deliverables. Identify project risks, anticipate execution bottlenecks, and implement timely corrective and preventive actions. Ensure effective coordination between design, engineering, procurement, SCM, construction, testing, commissioning, and O&M teams.

**B. Solar Project Execution:**
Manage simultaneous execution of multiple solar projects, including rooftop installations and ground-mounted solar power plants. Drive site mobilization, civil works, MMS installation, module mounting, DC/AC electrical works, inverter installation, cabling, earthing, lightning protection, and associated infrastructure. Oversee grid connectivity, statutory approvals, inspections, synchronization, testing, commissioning, and project handover. Ensure timely resolution of technical issues, site constraints, material shortages, contractor performance issues, and client-related challenges. Monitor project progress through regular site reviews, field visits, and performance reports.

**C. Project Scheduling and Software:**
Prepare, review, and update detailed project schedules using Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project. Develop WBS, Gantt charts, critical-path analysis, resource loading, progress curves, and look ahead schedules. Establish project monitoring dashboards, MIS reports, and early-warning systems for schedule deviations. Conduct periodic project review meetings and ensure timely reporting of progress, risks, delays, and recovery plans. Use project management software to drive accountability, coordination, and data-based decision-making.

**D. Cost, Budget and Commercial Control:**
Monitor project budgets, cost-to-complete, resource utilization, productivity, and overall project profitability. Control project costs while maintaining quality, safety, and contractual compliance. Review BOQs, subcontractor work orders, billing milestones, variations, and extra-work requirements in coordination with commercial and finance teams. Identify opportunities for value engineering, productivity improvement, and cost optimization. Support contractual correspondence, claims management, extension-of-time submissions, and resolution of project-related commercial issues.

**E. Resource and Contractor Management: Plan**
and deploy project managers, site engineers, supervisors, skilled and unskilled manpower, equipment, and subcontractors. Ensure adequate manpower and material availability in line with project schedules. Monitor contractor performance, site productivity, work quality, and adherence to execution plans. Coordinate with procurement, SCM, logistics, design, and central engineering teams to eliminate execution bottlenecks. Build a strong project execution team with clear responsibilities, performance targets, and accountability.
**F. Quality, Safety and Compliance: Ensure**
adherence to approved drawings, technical specifications, quality plans, inspection and test plans, and applicable standards. Enforce stringent EHS requirements, safe working practices, and statutory compliance across all project sites. Conduct project audits, site inspections, quality reviews, and safety assessments. Ensure timely closure of non-conformities, punch points, and commissioning observations. Promote a zero-accident culture and continuous improvement in execution practices.

**G. Client and Stakeholder Management:**
Act as the key project interface with clients, consultants, project management consultants, utilities, DISCOMs, subcontractors, and internal management. Conduct periodic project review meetings and provide transparent updates on progress, risks, and recovery actions. • Resolve project escalations proactively and maintain strong client relationships. Coordinate for approvals, inspections, grid connectivity, statutory clearances, and project acceptance. Ensure timely completion of contractual milestones, performance testing, documentation, and final handover.

**H. Leadership and Performance Management: Lead**
, mentor, and develop project managers and multidisciplinary site execution teams. Establish project-wise KPIs for schedule adherence, cost performance, quality, safety, and productivity. Drive accountability, disciplined reporting, and timely decision-making across project teams. Provide regular updates to senior management on project status, resource requirements, critical issues, and business risks. Implement standardized project management systems and best practices across the organization.

**Essential Qualifications and Experience**

• B.E. / B.Tech. in Electrical, Electronics, or Mechanical Engineering from a recognized institution.

• 10–15 years of relevant experience, with strong hands-on experience in a Solar EPC company.

• Demonstrated experience in executing both rooftop and ground-mounted solar projects.

• Proven capability to manage multiple projects and geographically dispersed sites simultaneously. • Mandatory working knowledge of Primavera P6 and Microsoft Project, including project scheduling, monitoring, critical-path analysis, and progress tracking.

• Strong understanding of solar EPC engineering, construction, testing, commissioning, grid connectivity, and project handover.

• Experience in managing project teams, subcontractors, vendors, budgets, and client interfaces.

• Willingness to travel extensively across India, approximately 50–60% of working time.

**Preferred Skills and Competencies**

• PMP certification will be an added advantage.

• Strong leadership, team building, delegation, and conflict-resolution capabilities.

Leadership Profile:
  
  
Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.
  
  
Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.
  
  
**Learn & Grow**
Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an advantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.
  
  
**Foster a Culture of Care**
Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.
  
  
**Adapt and Thrive with Change**
Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.
  
  
**Achieve Results**
Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback.At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

2. Customer Experience Management:

* Develop strategies to improve CSAT, NPS, First Contact Resolution (FCR), and Average Handling Time (AHT).
* Identify service gaps and implement improvements to ensure seamless and consistent customer experiences.

3. Operations & Process Optimization:

* Lead initiatives to optimize internal processes and eliminate inefficiencies across the service ecosystem.
* Collaborate with internal stakeholders to streamline call flow, escalation handling, and ticketing systems.
* Utilize data insights to enhance workflows and track key performance indicators across call centre and branches.

4. Technology & CRM Integration:

* Work closely with IT to identify and implement CRM tools, IVRs, and AI-based service solutions.
* Ensure smooth integration of customer service platforms with core operations.
* Drive automation and self-service initiatives to reduce dependency on manual intervention.

5. Branch & Territory Service Oversight:

* Lead multi-location branch service teams, aligning them with the overall customer service vision.
* Standardize service protocols and performance measures across branches.
* Support sales enablement through service by training staff on service-to-sales interactions and upselling opportunities.

6. Quality Control & Feedback Systems:

* Define and enforce quality assurance standards across customer service teams.
* Roll out audits, call monitoring, and service feedback mechanisms to continuously raise service benchmarks.
* Conduct regular coaching sessions and refreshers to improve service delivery.

**Qualifications:**

* 10–15 years of progressive experience in customer service leadership, preferably in digital healthcare, BFSI, telecom, or services sectors.
* Proven expertise in managing large-scale call centre operations and branch networks.
* Hands-on experience with CRM platforms, call analytics, and ticketing systems.
* Strategic mindset with a strong focus on metrics, customer outcomes, and cross functional collaboration.
* Strong interpersonal and communication skills with an ability to work across levels and geographies.
* Experience in driving service-led sales, especially in B2C environments, is highly desirable.

**Key Metrics to Drive:**

* Net Promoter Score (NPS) – Gauge customer loyalty and overall experience.
* Customer Satisfaction (CSAT) – Measure customer feedback post-interaction.
* Customer Effort Score (CES) – Assess ease of service interaction.
* First Contact Resolution (FCR) – Track issues resolved in the first interaction.
* Average Handling Time (AHT) – Optimize call time without compromising quality.
* Call Abandonment & Escalation Rate – Monitor dropped calls and unresolved escalations.
* Service Level Adherence (SLA Compliance) – Ensure timely response and resolution across touchpoints.
* Ticket Closure Turnaround Time (TAT) – Measure operational agility in resolving issues.
* Agent Utilization & Occupancy Rate – Improve efficiency and productivity of call centre staff.
* CRM Adoption Rate (Branch + Contact Centre) – Ensure all leads, queries, and follow-ups are logged and tracked effectively.
* CRM Hygiene & Data Accuracy Score – Track proper tagging, closure, and documentation of all customer records.
* Branch-wise Service & Sales Performance – Analyze branch productivity, service quality, and contribution to revenue.
* Walk-in to Resolution Time (Branch TAT) – Optimize branch turnaround and service delivery time.
* Cross-sell/Upsell % via Service Channels – Convert inbound service queries into revenue opportunities.
* Inbound vs. Outbound Call Volume Ratio – Maintain optimal call mix for efficiency and engagement.
* Repeat Interaction Ratio – Track recurrence of unresolved or follow-up queries.
* Customer Query to Fulfilment Conversion % – Ensure closure from initiation to outcome.
* Internal Transfer & Manual Escalation Ratio – Reduce non-value-adding transfers and touchpoints.

title: Revenue Manager
description:
**PURPOSE**

The Revenue Manager is responsible for driving total hotel revenue and profitability through strategic pricing, inventory management, demand forecasting, and market intelligence. The role focuses on maximising revenue across Rooms, Suites, Food & Beverage outlets, Banqueting and Events, and other ancillary revenue streams while preserving unit's luxury positioning and guest experience standards.

The incumbent will lead the hotel’s revenue management strategy by analysing market demand, competitor performance, booking trends, and distribution channels to optimise occupancy, Average Daily Rate (ADR), Revenue per Available Room (RevPAR). Working closely with Sales, Marketing, Reservations, Finance, and Operations, the Revenue Manager will support data-driven commercial decisions that enhance market share, profitability, and long-term business growth.

**KEY ORGANISATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports To:**
Director of Sales & Marketing

**Direct Reports:**
Revenue Executive(s), Reservations Associate

**Interacts With:**

**External**

* Online Travel Agencies (OTAs)
* Corporate Travel Partners
* Revenue Management Consultants
* Market Benchmarking and Distribution Partners (STR, RateGain, etc.)

**Internal**

* General Manager
* Director of Sales & Marketing
* Reservations Team
* Front Office
* Finance
* Food & Beverage
* Banquets & Events
* Marketing
* IT
* Hotel Operations Teams

**Revenue Strategy & Optimisation**

* Develop and execute revenue management strategies to maximise ADR, RevPAR, occupancy and profitability.
* Monitor booking pace, pickup trends, market demand and competitor pricing to implement dynamic pricing strategies.
* Manage room inventory, room category availability, restrictions, controls, and overbooking strategies where appropriate.
* Optimise revenue opportunities across transient, corporate, wholesale, group and MICE segments.
* Collaborate with Sales and Events teams to evaluate group business opportunities and displacement analyses.
* Oversee banquet and event space inventory utilisation to maximise revenue contribution from Meetings, Conferences, Weddings and Social Events.
* Ensure optimal rate positioning across all direct and indirect distribution channels.

**Forecasting, Analytics & Reporting**

* Prepare daily, weekly, monthly and annual revenue forecasts for Rooms and total hotel revenue.
* Produce rolling forecasts by segment, channel to support strategic planning and budgeting.
* Monitor and analyse key performance indicators including ADR, RevPAR, Market Penetration Index (MPI), Revenue Generation Index (RGI) and occupancy performance.
* Provide actionable revenue insights through market trend analysis and business intelligence reporting.
* Support annual budgeting, strategic planning and long-range forecasting processes.
* Utilise STR, RateGain and internal reporting tools to identify opportunities and market risks.

**Distribution & Channel Management**

* Maintain rate parity and inventory accuracy across all distribution channels.
* Monitor OTA performance, direct booking trends, channel costs and contribution margins.
* Manage rate loading, promotions, packages and strategic offers through PMS, CRS and channel management platforms.
* Evaluate distribution partnerships and recommend initiatives to improve revenue and profitability.

**Commercial Collaboration**

* Lead weekly Revenue Strategy Meetings to review pace, forecast accuracy, market demand and business mix.
* Partner with Sales and Marketing teams to align promotional activities with demand forecasts.
* Support commercial decision-making through pricing recommendations and revenue impact assessments.
* Work closely with Operations to ensure revenue strategies are aligned with guest expectations and service standards.

**Leadership & People Development**

* Drive a revenue-focused culture throughout the hotel by promoting commercial awareness across departments.
* Coach and mentor revenue and reservations team members.
* Facilitate training on revenue management principles, forecasting methodologies, Best Available Rate (BAR) strategies, and distribution management.
* Establish performance objectives and development plans for team members.

**Work Experience**

* Minimum 5-7 years of experience in Revenue Management within luxury hotels.
* Prior experience with luxury city hotels, luxury lifestyle hotels, or leading hospitality brands preferred.
* Proven track record in driving ADR, RevPAR and total revenue growth.

We are proud to have the support of the best investors in the game who believe in our mission, solutions and people. Ready to tackle global challenges that impact business, society, and the environment? Come join us.
  
  
Help our customers improve their global supply chains
  
  
The Opportunity:
  
  
As an Assistant Manager, Air Operations, you’ll play a key role in ensuring smooth and timely air freight movements for our customers. You’ll coordinate daily with airlines, trucking partners, terminals, and internal teams to keep shipments on track.
  
  
This role combines hands-on operations, customer service, and documentation work - helping deliver seamless supply chain execution while driving efficiency, volume growth, and profitability.
  
  
What You’ll Do:
  
  

* Execute end-to-end air shipments :

+ Receiving booking, contact with shipper/consignee and agent to arrange the shipment within SOP’s provided.
+ Input data into system to create file, completing Mawb and Hawbs, ensure correct & on time handling of files, file AMS or submit EDI (FHL/FWB) as required
+ Timely invoicing to clients/ agents as well as checking and confirming incoming invoices of sub-contractors on time & correctly.
+ Customer service by following up on customer advices/request or claim and feedback to customer and overseas and make respective shipment arrangement
+ Inform senior/manager if any irregularities or problems that require assistance and to feedback on subcontractors’s standards and services.
+ Ensure all operational activities comply with international shipping regulations, company policies, and customer SOPs.
+ Handle customers statistics and reports or any special request for improving the system.

* Support data and system accuracy: Keep Flexport systems updated to meet KPIs and maintain high-quality data.
* Collaborate across teams: Work closely with account managers and customs teams to ensure smooth operations and a great customer experience.
* Drive improvement: Identify and suggest process enhancements to increase efficiency and quality.
* Take ownership: Support teammates and take on additional tasks when needed/ required.

What We’re Looking For:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree in logistics, supply chain, business, or related fields.
* 5+ years of experience in air operation or related roles in freight forwarding/logistics.
* IATA Certification
* Good communication of written and spoken English.
* Detail-oriented, structured, and eager to learn global supply chain operations.
* Customer-focused mindset: respond promptly and professionally to customer needs, answering calls and dealing with customer queries, providing first-class customer service at all times.

What You’ll Gain:
  
  

* Deep expertise in air freight operations (imports, exports, intermodal).
* Hands-on exposure to international logistics systems (carriers, customs, warehouses).
* Opportunity to grow into Senior Associate, Team Leader, or Account Management roles.
* Be part of a fast-growing international company with training and development from global experts.

Commitment to Equal Opportunity
  
  
At Flexport, our ability to fulfill our mission of making global commerce easy and accessible relies on having a diverse, dedicated and engaged workforce. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, physical and mental disability, health status, marital and family status, sexual orientation, gender identity and expression, military and veteran status, and any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Depending on your location, the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA) may regulate the way we manage the data of job applicants. By submitting your application, you are agreeing to our use and processing of your data as required. Please see our Privacy Notice available at www.flexport.com/privacy for additional information.

title: (Associate) Director, Expansion & Partnerships, AI Access Initiative (EAII)
description:
This position is with EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India.
  
  
**About EAII**
EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, supports state governments in delivering evidence-based public health programs, including safe drinking water initiatives and school and Anganwadi-based National Deworming Day and iron and folic acid supplementation. Operating across 10 states, EAII Advisors provides technical assistance to ministries of health, education, water, and women and child development, reducing health burdens in impoverished communities and improving the long-term wellbeing of children and families.
  
  
For more information, read about our work here: About Evidence Action and EAII
  
  
**About The AI Access Initiative (2AI)**
We're at an inflection point in artificial intelligence - presenting both tremendous potential opportunity and risk for people in developing countries. AI capabilities are improving on a timescale measured in months, while development systems often move on timescales measured in decades. Much of the technology needed for positive impact exists today, but few organizations exist to bridge research, deployment, and scaled implementation: we must act now to ensure AI's benefits reach people in poverty in LMICs.
  
  
Incubated at Evidence Action, we're scaling The AI Access Initiative, an organization focused on scaling AI-enabled 'big bets' to benefit tens or hundreds of millions of people in poverty in low- and middle-income countries (LMICs). We operate at the intersection of global development actors, top AI labs, and leading researchers to drive meaningful access to AI's benefits for the 3.5 billion people living in poverty globally. We create "public good," open-sourced playbooks, toolkits, and insights that define how to design and launch tractable and impactful AI-enabled programs. Given the scale of opportunity, we expect our portfolio to expand substantially, but to start, we're scaling two programs focused on AI in Agriculture and AI in Health.
  
  
We are led by former Evidence Action CEO Kanika Bahl, a founding member of Anthropic's Long-Term Benefit Trust, and advised by Nobel Laureate Michael Kremer; Dario Amodei, CEO of Anthropic; and Kent Walker, President, Global Affairs for Alphabet and Google. This work builds on Evidence Action's track record reaching 530M+ people with cost-effective, evidence-based programs across 9 countries in Africa and Asia, with a focus on last-mile delivery.
  
  
**The Role**
2AI is building fast. We have a founding team, two live program portfolios, and a pipeline of opportunities that will drive significant expansion. The programs we are running have credible pathways to 100s of millions of people. While incubated at Evidence Action, we plan to spin out in Q4 '26.
  
  
Our Agriculture portfolio is scaling AI-enabled weather forecasting services to reach tens of millions of smallholder farmers, in close partnership with state and national governments in India. The next phase is to expand this work: deciding which countries we move into next and building what it takes to operate there. We are seeking a rigorous, high-ownership Associate Director or Director, Expansion & Partnerships to own that expansion end to end, from market selection and government and telco partnerships through to standing up offices and teams in new markets.
  
  
This role is based in India and sits on 2AI's global team, reporting into the VP, Agriculture. It includes people leadership, managing at least one senior manager across the program. You will work closely with our India country team and other in-country team members to scope and expand programming.
  
  
**You Will:**

* Identify new markets for forecast delivery: In conjunction with the VP, Agriculture, develop the criteria for market selection and prioritize countries to expand into
* Stand up new markets: Once a new market is confirmed, support the set-up of offices and the hiring of high-quality staff with the requisite skills to implement large-scale forecast delivery
* Oversee development of forecasts for new regions: Collaborate with academics to ensure forecasts are developed, tested, and ready to disseminate in new countries. This could include hiring and managing post-doctoral students to support in model benchmarking or dataset support
* Lead telco partnerships: Identify target telcos and lead engagement, negotiation, and relationship management to set up sustainable telco-based dissemination systems
* Hire and manage in-country scoping support: Where staff on the ground are needed to determine whether there is an opportunity in a new market, hire and oversee them, for example short-term consultants
* Build and maintain government relationships: Create new and nurture existing relationships with the government bodies needed to operate and disseminate forecasts in a new market, including agriculture departments and meteorological agencies
* Partner with stakeholders: Create new and nurture existing relationships with academic institutions, delivery partners, and other agriculture organizations.
* Develop best practices and thought leadership: Across all of the above, build best practices and replicable toolkits that can be applied elsewhere by others. Share key learnings with the sector through toolkits, blogs, and other public-good resources

**Requirements**
The ideal candidate is an exceptional builder with the ability to drive outcomes in a fast-moving, high-stakes environment. Given the startup nature of this work, we seek contributors with high throughput, strong work ethic, and willingness to lean in and work extended hours.
  
  
You will likely have:
  
  

* 7-10+ years' experience as a builder in international development, consulting, or an agriculture adjacent organization
* Strong communication skills in English with experience working with international teams
* A proven track record of significantly scaling organizations and/or programs to deliver impact at scale, preferably in close partnership with national governments. Direct experience taking a program or organization into a new region is a plus
* Demonstrated success building and negotiating partnerships with governments and the private sector. Experience with telcos, mobile network operators, or platform partners is a strong plus
* Training or early career experience in a high-rigor environment (e.g., top-tier management consulting, high-growth NGO program leadership, strategy/econ research) and the ability to rapidly get up to speed in new technical areas including AI/ML forecasting concepts
* A track record as a strong people manager and builder: able to set clear standards, empower others, and cultivate a high-performance culture across distributed and field-based teams
* Experience working with Asian and/or African governments to drive large-scale change, with a strong preference for direct experience working with ministries of agriculture or national meteorological agencies
* High EQ and the ability to influence across diverse partners, from AI/forecasting researchers to frontline delivery staff to senior government officials
* Strong fluency with AI tools, and eager to experiment, learn, and adapt to emerging technologies
* Comfort with ambiguity and fast iteration; can define and test hypotheses, adapt quickly, and maintain focus on impact
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to synthesize complex technical ideas (e.g., AI/ML weather forecasting language) into crisp narratives for different audiences
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively internationally (:40-50%) to prospective and current markets across low-and-middle income countries
* Passion for the mission of ensuring that the benefits of frontier AI reach the world's poorest populations, while mitigating its downside risks

**Position Location**
This role is based in India, with flexibility on location within the country. The role sits on 2AI's global team rather than within a single country program, and requires significant international travel (:40-50%) to prospective and current markets. Evidence Action is an Equal Opportunity Employer with a commitment to diversity. All individuals, regardless of personal characteristics, are encouraged to apply.
  
  
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in India. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time.
  
  
**Benefits**
EAII provides a comprehensive benefits package for employees . Benefits include:
  
  

* Comprehensive health insurance with IPD and OPD provisions,
* Life and Accidental insurance,
* PF, ESIC and Gratuity as per statutory requirements,
* Generous leave,
* Mental and physical wellbeing benefits
* Learning & Development benefits
* Avenues for engagement and recognition

Compensation: Pay will be competitive and commensurate with the individual's credentials, experience and previous pay scale.
  
  
This role will initially be housed at EAII Advisors, Evidence Action's technical partner in India, with the explicit plan to transfer with the AI Access Initiative as a founding member of the team when that project is spun out as a new entity later this year. At that point, benefits and policies may change.

title: Teaching Coordinator (Adults)
description:
We support peace and prosperity by building connections, understanding and trust between people in the UK and countries worldwide. For over 90 years we have shaped brighter futures through education, arts, culture, language, and creativity.
  
  
*We work with people in over 150 countries and reach over 700 million people.*
**We connect. We inspire.**
**Pay Band:**
Higher Teacher payband
  
  
**Country/Location:**
Delhi, India
  
  
**Department:**
English Language Services
  
  
**Contract Type:**
Fixed Term Contract, 2 years
  
  
**Closing Date:**
Wednesday, 4th November 2026 - 23:59 Malaysia Time (GMT +8)
  
  
**Role Purpose**
The role is responsible for promoting high-quality English language teaching and effective learning while supporting the British Council’s wider objectives and cultural relations mission. It involves guiding, supporting, and developing teachers in delivering a full range of courses, providing training, coordinating and developing teaching materials, and contributing to the management of teaching quality, academic programme content, and day-to-day operations.
  
  
**Role Accountabilities**
The role is responsible for delivering high-quality English language teaching in line with British Council Global Teaching Standards, meeting learner needs and supporting the organisation’s global English strategy. Key responsibilities include teaching across various course types, developing teaching and assessment materials, supporting teacher development through training and lesson observations, line-managing teachers, assisting with teacher recruitment and talent retention, and deputising for Senior Teachers when required. The role also involves contributing to teaching centre operations, administrative duties, continuous professional development, and the sharing of best practices, while promoting the British Council’s reputation in English language teaching and ensuring compliance with safeguarding, equality, diversity and inclusion (EDI), and health and safety policies.
  
  
**Essential Requirements**
**Role specific skills, knowledge and experience**
**Qualifications**

* Cambridge DELTA/DipTESOL or Trinity Cert TESOL.
* At least one further specialist qualification, such as YL extension to CELTA, IELTS examiner status, e-moderator certificate.
* Undergraduate degree or equivalent.

Knowledge and Skills
  
  
As appropriate within Global British Council Teaching Standards at a HIGHER level
  
  

* Demonstrate subject knowledge.
* Engage and motivate learners.
* Create a positive and inclusive learning environment.
* Plan and deliver coherent lessons.
* Make use of assessment and feedback.
* Manage teaching and learning resources.
* Uphold professional responsibilities and values.

Evidence of high performance in class (from evaluations, observation reports, feedback)
  
  
Ability, or demonstrable interest in at least some of the following:
  
  

* syllabus design, teacher timetabling, class scheduling, course planning, teacher observations, teacher training, line management and professional development of teachers.

Working with Children and Vulnerable Adults
  
  

* Ability to work in a way that promotes the safety and well-being of children and vulnerable adults.
* Effective communication and engagement with children/protected adults and their families.
* Knowledge and understanding of child development and its impact on learning and behaviour.
* Experience of supporting learners to meet Equality, Diversity and Inclusion principles.

**Experience**
4 years post-certificate i.e. CELTA/Trinity cert TESOL experience including substantial experience in all of the following
  
  

* Young learners aged 800+ hours
* Adults English 1500+ hours, including IELTS
* At least 2 years experience in training and mentoring teachers
* Experience in materials development
* At least 2 years experience in managing quality to formal standards frameworks
* Line management experience, preferably academic/teacher
* At least 2 years experience in managing the classroom/customer services interface for business objectives (for example dealing with complaints, re-registrations, parent/student engagement, contracts, client meetings, school partners)

Desirable Requirements
  
  

* Experience of structured teacher development programmes from initial teacher training to advanced levels.
* IELTS Examiner and training status
* Online teaching qualification and experience Problem based learning
* Masters level qualifications in applied linguistics, ELT, management

**Important Information**

* Language: Strong English proficiency is crucial for this role, requiring fluency in both written and spoken communication to effectively navigate British Council systems and international operations.
* Work schedule: Teaching is conducted throughout the week, with teachers working five days per week, including weekends as required. Flexibility and maximum availability on Saturdays and Sundays are expected, as these are the busiest teaching days. Weekend working days are generally consecutive, although this cannot be guaranteed. Classes may be scheduled in the mornings or evenings, and while split shifts are uncommon, they may occasionally be required to meet operational needs.
* Locally recruited: Applications are welcomed from candidates currently in this location with a natural right to work. Relocation support is not provided for this role.
* Overseas Citizen of India (OCI) card holders will need have, or be able to obtain, a valid special work permit issued from Government of India (GOI) to work in the British High Commission (BHC). BHC will not be able to sponsor work visas or obtain/ assist with the special work permit from GOI. Offers of employment made to OCI card holders will be conditional upon candidates obtaining a special work permit.
* Note: For requisite special permission to take up employment in any foreign Diplomatic Missions in India, OCI Cardholder must visit https://ociservices.gov.in

A connected and trusted UK in a more connected and trusted world.
  
  
**Equality, Diversity and Inclusion Statement**
We are committed to equality, diversity and inclusion and we welcome applications from all sections of the community as we believe that a diverse workforce gives added depth to our work. The British Council is a Disability Confident Employer. The Disability Confident scheme helps challenge attitudes, increase understanding of disability, and ensure staff are drawn from the widest possible pool of talent and we guarantee an interview for disabled applicants who meet the minimum role requirements. We welcome discussions about specific requirements or adjustments to enable participation and engagement in our work and activities.
  
  
**Safeguarding Statement**
The British Council is committed to safeguarding children, young people, and adults who we work with. We believe that all children and adults everywhere in the world deserve to live in safe environments and have the right to be protected from all forms of abuse, maltreatment and exploitation as set out in article 19, UNCRC (United Nations Convention on the Rights of the Child) 1989. Appointment to positions where there is direct involvement with vulnerable groups will be dependent on thorough checks being completed in line with legal requirements and with the British Council’s Safeguarding policies for Adults and Children.

title: Meta Ads Operation Manager
description:
**Job Description: Meta Ads Operations Manager**

**Location:**

Kirti Nagar, New Delhi, India

**Work Mode:**

Work From Office

**Department:**

Ad Operations

**Job Type:**

Full-Time

**About the Role**

We are looking for a detail-oriented and proactive
**Meta Ads Operations Manager**

to manage and streamline the operational activities related to Meta advertising. The role involves managing ad accounts, Business Managers, access permissions, media buyer allocation, billing, advertiser verification, and account suspension tracking.

The ideal candidate should have hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager, strong coordination skills, and the ability to troubleshoot operational issues while ensuring compliance with Meta's advertising policies and internal procedures.

**Key Responsibilities**
**1. Ad Account & Asset Management**

* Coordinate with agencies and partners to request new Meta ad accounts, profiles, Pages, and Business Managers.
* Manage account access, permissions, and asset allocation for media buyers.
* Maintain accurate mapping of ad accounts, Pages, Business Managers, and assigned media buyers.
* Ensure proper documentation and tracking of all advertising assets.

**2. Media Buyer Allocation & Coordination**

* Allocate ad accounts to media buyers based on business requirements and approved access.
* Maintain updated records of account assignments, access permissions, and asset ownership.
* Coordinate with media buyers to resolve account-related queries and operational challenges.
* Ensure smooth coordination between media buyers, agencies, and internal teams.

**3. Business Manager Setup & Management**

* Coordinate the setup and configuration of Meta Business Managers.
* Manage approved asset mapping, partner access, and user permissions.
* Monitor account and asset access to ensure appropriate authorization.
* Troubleshoot Business Manager access issues and coordinate resolutions.

**4. Technical Support & Issue Resolution**

* Monitor ad account functionality, ad delivery issues, and website-related technical concerns.
* Investigate operational issues reported by media buyers and coordinate with relevant technical teams.
* Track issues and ensure resolution within defined Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
* Escalate critical issues to the appropriate stakeholders when required.

**5. Account Suspension & Policy Compliance**

* Monitor and maintain records of suspended or restricted ad accounts and Pages.
* Coordinate legitimate appeals and follow up on account reviews through official Meta channels.
* Track the status of appeals, restrictions, and reinstatement requests.
* Ensure all operational activities comply with Meta advertising policies and applicable platform rules.
* Support the use of alternative eligible advertising assets only where permitted by Meta's policies.

**6. Payment & Advertising Spend Monitoring**

* Coordinate the addition and management of approved payment methods.
* Monitor advertising spend, payment status, billing activity, and account spending limits.
* Identify billing discrepancies, failed payments, and unusual spending patterns.
* Coordinate with the finance team, agencies, and relevant stakeholders to resolve payment-related issues.
* Maintain accurate payment and spend records for reporting and reconciliation.

**7. Advertiser Verification**

* Track advertiser verification and business verification status across relevant accounts.
* Coordinate the collection and submission of required business documents through official channels.
* Follow up on pending verification requests and document-related issues.
* Maintain records of verification progress, approvals, rejections, and pending actions.

**8. Reporting & Documentation**

* Maintain accurate and up-to-date trackers for ad accounts, Business Managers, Pages, media buyer allocation, suspensions, payments, and verification.
* Prepare regular operational reports covering pending issues, account status, spend, and resolution timelines.
* Ensure proper documentation of escalations, follow-ups, and completed actions.
* Provide timely updates to management regarding operational risks and bottlenecks.

**9. Process Improvement & Stakeholder Management**

* Coordinate with agencies, media buyers, finance, technical teams, and management to improve operational efficiency.
* Identify recurring issues and recommend process improvements.
* Establish consistent tracking and follow-up practices for account provisioning and issue resolution.
* Ensure adherence to internal processes, access-control requirements, and Meta policies.

**Required Skills & Competencies**

* Hands-on knowledge of Meta Ads Manager and Meta Business Manager.
* Understanding of Meta ad accounts, Pages, business portfolios, user roles, partner access, and permissions.
* Experience handling ad account restrictions, suspension tracking, appeals, and advertiser verification.
* Understanding of advertising billing, payment methods, spend monitoring, and reconciliation.
* Proficiency in Google Sheets and Microsoft Excel.
* Strong troubleshooting, analytical, reporting, and documentation skills.
* Excellent coordination, communication, and follow-up abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple accounts and operational tasks simultaneously.
* Strong attention to detail and a process-oriented approach.
* Understanding of Meta advertising policies and platform compliance requirements.

**Qualifications & Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Marketing, Digital Marketing, or a related field is preferred.
* Relevant experience in Meta Ads operations, digital advertising support, Business Manager management, or advertising account operations is preferred.
* Practical experience coordinating with media buyers, agencies, and internal teams will be an advantage.
* Candidates with strong operational knowledge and hands-on experience managing Meta advertising assets are encouraged to apply.

**Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)**

Performance will be evaluated based on the following parameters:

* Timely provisioning of ad accounts and allocation to media buyers.
* Compliance with defined SLAs for issue resolution and escalation.
* Accuracy of ad account, Business Manager, Page, and media buyer mapping.
* Effective tracking and follow-up of suspensions, appeals, and verification requests.
* Accuracy of payment, billing, and advertising spend reports.
* Timely maintenance of operational trackers and documentation.
* Efficient coordination with agencies and internal stakeholders.
* Adherence to Meta policies, approved access procedures, and internal compliance standards.

title: Field Application Manager – Robotics
description:
Location for this opening: Delhi region

Field Application Manager – Robotics

Lead field applications at the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. It is a priceless opportunity to shape robotics in India.

Own applications, demos and commissioning for cobots, industrial robots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoids and robot dogs, including Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree.

Location: Openings at Mumbai Factory, Pune Factory and Delhi region (HQ: Navi Mumbai, Koparkhairane), with regular travel to customer sites

Employment Type: Full-time

Experience: 6–10 years

The Role

You will lead Luna's Field Application Engineers and own the technical success of every robotics project across our Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree range: industrial robots and cobots, AMRs, AGVs, humanoid robots and quadruped robot dogs. You will be the senior technical partner for key accounts and the sales team, and set the standards our field team works to.

What You Will Do

• Lead, coach and plan the work of the FAE team across sites.

• Own application success by validating feasibility, cycle time, cell layouts and AMR/AGV fleet concepts before commitment.

• Plan and deliver high-impact demos and proof-of-concept projects for robot arms, mobile robots, humanoids and robot dogs.

• Set and enforce standards for commissioning, programming, service, documentation and handover.

• Act as the senior technical contact for key accounts, and lead escalations to fast resolution.

• Build training programs for FAEs, sales engineers, partners and customer teams.

• Feed field insight to our in-house robot design team, principals and management.

Must Have

• BE/BTech in Mechatronics, Robotics, Electrical, Electronics, Instrumentation, Mechanical or Automation Engineering.

• 6–10 years in robotics or automation applications, including at least 2 years leading engineers or projects.

• Hands-on robot/cobot or mobile robot commissioning, with PLC, servo and machine vision integration.

• Proven experience delivering demos, technical presentations and customer training.

• Strong customer-handling skills and willingness to travel to customer sites.

Good to Have

• Experience with ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, Universal Robots or similar robots is a plus.

• AMR/AGV fleet deployment, mapping and navigation; ROS experience is a plus.

• Robot cell layout, simulation or offline programming.

• Exposure to safety standards and risk assessment for robot cells and mobile robots.

Why Luna

• Be part of an India first: Luna designs, manufactures and assembles robots and AMRs in-house. Work directly with our design and manufacturing teams, plus Fairino, Yasaka and Unitree platforms. A priceless opportunity.

• Real ownership: build your team, set the standards and make fast calls, with direct access to leadership.

• Grow as we grow: as the robotics vertical scales, your role grows into senior technical and business leadership.

• Keep learning: principal and OEM trainings, manufacturer certifications, and new tech in mobile robotics, vision and motion control.

• High-impact projects: lead flagship deployments in factories, warehouses and new applications for key customers.

• Get rewarded: competitive compensation, performance incentives and a supportive, growing team.

About Luna Technologies

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd., headquartered in Navi Mumbai (Koparkhairane), is the first company in India to design, manufacture and assemble robots and AMRs in-house. We also deliver industrial automation, motion control and mechatronics solutions with global technology partners.

How to Apply

Email your resume to recruitment3@luna.co.in and recruitment1@luna.co.in with the subject "FAM – Robotics" and your preferred location (Mumbai, Pune or Delhi).

Luna Technologies Pvt. Ltd. is an Equal Opportunity Employer.

title: Account Director
description:
**About Us**

Humour Me is a creative agency that is built for the here and now. We’re a contemporary creative services and content marketing agency with an expertise in driving relevance for our clients and delivering high impact business results. The independently-owned agency was founded in 2012 and has its office in the capital city of the country. Humour Me has been recognised as a global honouree at The Webby Awards and has won over 16 global creative awards for excellence in storytelling, filmmaking, animation and new media disruption.

The Account Director will be the senior point of contact for the day-to-day management of the business and the ability to sell new ideas and solutions to existing/new business opportunities

**Role Overview**

The Account Director is a senior business leader responsible for the overall health, direction and growth of multiple client accounts. The role sits between Account Management and senior business leadership, with a strong focus on strategic client leadership, commercial growth and team development.

**Responsibilities:**

* Own the overall health and direction of a portfolio of client businesses, ensuring strong client relationships, quality of work and commercial performance.

* Build trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders and act as a strategic partner beyond day-to-day account requirements.

* Develop a strong understanding of the client’s business, category, marketing priorities and competitive landscape, and use this to identify opportunities for the agency.

* Provide strategic direction to Account Managers and account teams, ensuring businesses are being managed proactively and not simply driven by incoming briefs.

* Review the health of accounts regularly across client relationships, revenue, profitability, scope, quality of work and growth potential.

* Identify opportunities to deepen existing relationships through upselling, cross-selling and expanding the agency’s role within the client’s business.

* Develop account growth plans and work with Account Managers and senior leadership to convert identified opportunities.

* Own the commercial health of the portfolio, including revenue, scope, budgets, resource requirements and profitability.

* Lead senior-level client reviews and conversations, bringing recommendations, insights and a clear point of view to the table.

* Challenge client briefs and internal thinking where required, ensuring the agency is solving meaningful business and brand problems.

* Work closely with Creative and Strategy leadership to ensure the work across the portfolio is strategically strong, relevant and aligned with client objectives.

* Lead and mentor Account Managers and wider account teams, setting clear expectations around client management, business growth and ownership.

* Build strong second-line leadership within accounts, ensuring Account Managers are empowered to independently manage their businesses.

* Identify capability and resource gaps across the portfolio and work with leadership to build the right team structure.

* Act as the senior escalation point for significant client, commercial or team-related issues and drive them towards resolution.

* Partner with the AVP on larger business opportunities, key client relationships, strategic decisions and portfolio-level priorities.

* Support new business development and identify opportunities emerging from existing client relationships.

* Track performance across the portfolio through regular reviews, identifying risks early and driving corrective action.

* Contribute to improving account management standards, processes and ways of working across the wider business.

* Swift decision making and driving outcomes will always trump effort in our eyes.

**Requirements**

* 8+ years of experience in Account Management, Brand Management, Digital Marketing, Advertising or related fields, with significant exposure to creative agency environments.

* Prior experience in managing large businesses like P&G, HUL, Reckitt Benckiser preferred.

* Proven experience in managing multiple client accounts and independently leading sizeable or strategically important businesses.

* Strong experience in building and maintaining senior client relationships. • Demonstrated ability to grow existing client relationships and identify commercial opportunities.

* Strong understanding of brand strategy, content marketing and integrated communication.

* Experience in leading, mentoring and developing Account Managers and account teams.

* Strong commercial understanding, including account revenue, budgets, scope and profitability.

* Excellent communication, presentation and stakeholder management skills. • Strong strategic thinking and business acumen, with the ability to operate independently in a fast-paced environment.

title: Manager, Product Support Incident Management
description:
Every day, tens of millions of people come to Roblox to explore, create, play, learn, and connect with friends in 3D immersive digital experiences– all created by our global community of developers and creators.
  
  
At Roblox, we’re building the tools and platform that empower our community to bring any experience that they can imagine to life. Our vision is to reimagine the way people come together, from anywhere in the world, and on any device. We’re on a mission to connect a billion people with optimism and civility, and looking for amazing talent to help us get there.
  
  
A career at Roblox means you’ll be working to shape the future of human interaction, solving unique technical challenges at scale, and helping to create safer, more civil shared experiences for everyone.
  
  
The Trust and Safety Operations team is focused (ok, maybe obsessed) on scaling Roblox’s Operations organization and transforming our customer experience through our multi-year vision and strategy execution.
  
  
You will be reporting to the Trust & Safety India Operations Manager. The team provides support to Roblox’s global players, developers, and advertisers. As a Manager of Product Support Incident management, you’ll be focused on managing the team that manages technical escalations, supports product reliability, process improvement and design along with playing a critical role in managing and resolving escalations and high-impact incidents affecting our Roblox users and platform.
  
  
You will coordinate across multiple teams to ensure rapid response to minimize the impact on customers and business operations, identifying trends, enhancing support processes, improving agent efficiency, and reducing operational costs while maintaining high reliability and service quality.
  
  
This role requires participation in a shift rotation to maintain 24/7 operations, which includes on-call duties and weekend coverage.
  
  
**You Will**

* Lead and Mentor: Manage a high-performing team of Specialists responsible for incident response and technical escalations, providing coaching, development, and performance management.
* Drive Issue Management: Oversee the end-to-end incident management lifecycle within support operations, ensuring the team meets SLAs for critical and high-severity issues while serving as the final point of escalation for complex issues.
* Incident Management Strategy: Coordinate the incident response activities, gather the response team, and set up a virtual command center for communication and collaboration. Due to its potential impact, critical decisions must be made to classify the incident, and be willing to participate in on-call support for incident management issues. Along with this, you will be responsible for providing regular updates and reports to upper management on the status of operations, including performance metrics and any issues encountered.
* Cross Function Collaboration - Collaborate with Knowledge Management, Training and Quality Assurance teams to ensure process adherence, identify areas for improvement in support workflows, and implement quality control measures.
* Strategic Partner to Product Support - Is a strategic thought partner to product support, aligning on goals and objectives for launch readiness and building in quality escalation and issue management principals to readiness initiatives.

**You Have**

* Management Experience: 10+ years of experience in technical support or operations, with at least 2+ years in a people management role, preferably within a high-growth tech environment..
* Advanced Problem Solving: Strong ability to translate complex data sets into actionable business strategies. Proficiency in SQL or Python to audit team dashboards and validate data-driven decisions is highly preferred.
* Process Improvement: Demonstrated success in reducing operating costs and improving Automation Rate/ Contact Rate/CSAT/Quality scores.
* Systems Fluency: Deep familiarity with the architecture of CRM tools (Zendesk), Jira, and automated ticketing workflows.

**You Are**

* Innovative: You proactively identify emerging risks and execute on out of the box ideas to achieve goals.
* A Strategic Leader: You look beyond the immediate incident to solve for the root cause and prevent future friction at scale.
* Growth-Oriented: You are invested in your team’s success, fostering an inclusive environment that encourages continuous learning.
* A Master Communicator: You can distill highly technical incidents into concise "so-what" summaries for non-technical stakeholders and executives.
* Data-Driven: Uses data to identify trends, measure results, and drive decision-making.

Roles that are based in an office are onsite Tuesday, Wednesday, and Thursday, with optional presence on Monday and Friday (unless otherwise noted).
  
  
Roblox provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws. Roblox also provides reasonable accommodations to candidates with qualifying disabilities or religious beliefs during the recruiting process.
  
  
For US based roles only, please note the Company may not be able to employ candidates for this role who have United States work authorization related to certain U.S. visa categories, or support future H-1B sponsorship at this time.

title: Jewellery Brand Operations & Production Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Kritika Khurana Jewels is an emerging jewellery brand focused on contemporary, fashion-forward designs that blend style with everyday wearability. The brand emphasizes high-quality craftsmanship, attention to detail, and a curated customer experience across online and offline channels. Based in Gurugram, the team works closely with artisans and suppliers to deliver well-finished, trend-led pieces. Joining Kritika Khurana Jewels offers the opportunity to contribute to a growing label and shape its operational and production standards.

**Role Description**

**Product and production tracker**

Maintain one tracker for every active design and SKU, including:

* Product name, SKU or temporary product code and collection
* Design owner and design status
* Vendor and contact person
* CAD, sample and production status
* Quote, approved cost and purchase order status
* Sample, production and delivery dates
* QC status and correction notes
* Quantity ordered, received and sellable
* Photography, listing and launch status
* Current blocker, next action, owner and due date

Use clear statuses such as Not started, In progress, Waiting on vendor, Waiting for approval, Blocked, QC hold, Ready for shoot, Ready for listing and Complete.

**New product and sampling process**

1. Receive a design brief from Kritika or the jewellery designer, including the reference, specifications and intended use.

2. Create a product code and add the product to the tracker.

3. Confirm with the jewellery designer what technical information the vendor needs.

4. Request quotes and timelines from vendors.

5. Send costs and purchase commitments to Kritika for approval.

6. Once approved, confirm the specifications, cost, quantity and timeline in writing with the vendor.

7. Follow up on CAD, sample and production milestones and record updates in the tracker.

8. Record sample receipt and arrange QC.

9. Route technical questions to the jewellery designer and commercial or launch decisions to Kritika.

10. Do not mark a product ready for production, photography or launch until the required approvals are recorded.

**Vendor coordination**

* Own routine vendor communication about samples, production status, corrections, quantities and delivery dates.
* Keep written records of agreed specifications, timelines, costs and changes.
* Send a written recap after calls where a decision or deadline was agreed.
* Follow up before due dates if an update is missing and flag overdue items early.
* Coordinate technical feedback with the jewellery designer so vendors receive one clear design direction.
* Escalate cost increases, missed deadlines, quality disputes or requests for unapproved payment to Kritika.
* Do not commit to new costs, quantities, design changes or public delivery dates without approval.
* Send approved invoices and payment details to Jessica for accountant coordination.

**Quality control**

Check pieces when samples or production arrive and record the result against the SKU. Check:

* Finishing, plating or oxidation consistency
* Stones, pearls and other components
* Clasps, hooks, closures and moving parts
* Sizing and fit against the approved specification
* Colour and material consistency across the batch
* Design accuracy against the approved reference or sample
* Visible damage, sharp edges, loose components or other defects

If a piece fails QC, mark it QC hold, keep it separate from sellable stock, photograph and record the issue, and coordinate a correction or replacement. Ask the jewellery designer to review design or technical issues. Recheck corrected pieces and record the outcome before releasing them.

**Inventory and dispatch coordination**

* Check stock with the internal team on agreed days each week.
* Compare physical stock information with the inventory tracker and Shopify availability.
* Flag low or inconsistent stock and prepare reorder recommendations.
* Track incoming stock against the purchase order and record discrepancies.
* Coordinate which pieces are needed for shoots, PR gifting, stylist requests or campaigns.
* Keep a product loan and gifting log with item, quantity, recipient, dispatch date, expected return and return condition.
* Coordinate dispatch priorities with Deepak. Deepak remains responsible for physical stock handling, packing and dispatch.
* Escalate lost, damaged, missing or returned items that affect sellable stock.

**Photography and e-commerce readiness**

* Prepare a shoot list with product name, SKU, quantity, styling notes and required angles.
* Confirm pieces are QC-approved and available before the shoot.
* Coordinate dates and logistics with the photographer, model, stylist and creative team.
* Track products photographed, edits pending and final images received.
* Match final images to the correct SKU and confirm samples are returned to Deepak.
* Coordinate product listings with the website team, including the correct SKU, approved price, specifications, materials, size information, images and stock availability.
* Check product pages against approved information before launch. Do not make unsupported material or quality claims.
* Coordinate sold-out and restock updates with Deepak and the website team.

**Social, PR and campaign coordination**

* Share approved product details, pricing, availability and launch timing with the social media team.
* Make sure pieces requested for campaigns, stylists, celebrities or PR activity are available and logged.
* Coordinate product dispatches and returns with Deepak.
* Flag stock shortages or production delays to Kritika, PR and social as early as possible.
* PR owns outreach and relationship management; social owns the content calendar and publishing. The operations manager ensures products and logistics are ready.

**Workflow:**

**Daily:**
Review due and overdue tasks, check expected deliveries and stock issues, update the tracker after confirmations, and flag urgent blockers or approvals to Kritika.

**Weekly:**
Share completed work, overdue items, upcoming deadlines, stock risks and decisions needed. Review sampling and production with the jewellery designer, stock and dispatch with internal, and readiness for upcoming shoots and launches.

**Monthly:**
Review the product pipeline, propose the next month’s production and shoot calendar, and flag recurring delays or process issues.

**Qualifications**

* Candidates should possess skills in Jewelry Design and a strong understanding of fashion jewelry trends and aesthetics.
* Candidates should possess skills in Communication, with the ability to communicate professionally with clients and internal stakeholders.
* Candidates should possess skills in Polishing and quality inspection to ensure consistent finishing and craftsmanship.
* Candidates should possess skills in Training, including the ability to guide and coach production staff or artisans on processes and standards.
* Experience in jewellery production, operations management, or fashion accessories is highly beneficial.
* Strong organizational and time-management abilities, with proficiency in basic digital tools (spreadsheets, inventory or order-tracking software).
* Ability to work independently in a hybrid environment, collaborate with a small team, and manage multiple orders or projects simultaneously.
* Relevant education or certification in design, fashion, jewellery, or operations management is an advantage.

**Work pattern: On-site, Mon-Fri | 10:30 AM to 06:30 PM**

**Your Impact**
You will lead the strategy and delivery of workplace and administrative services for the MGCS Center India Gurugram, creating a safe, efficient, sustainable, and engaging workplace for more than 2,000 firm members and external workers.
  
  
You will also champion technology, automation, AI and GenAI to modernize operations, enhance employee experience, and improve service delivery.
  
  
Based in Gurugram, India, as part of the MGCS Center India location management team, you will have end-to-end responsibility for real estate and space management, facilities and café services, travel and transportation, safety and security, crisis management and business continuity, and events and conferences. You will work closely with location, MGS, India and global firm leaders, as well as key external partners, to ensure these services meet business needs and firm standards.
  
  
As a key member of the location leadership team, you will develop and execute the workplace and administrative services strategy—including real estate, workplace utilization, space planning, and service improvements—in close partnership with location and global functional leaders, while collaborating with Finance to manage Opex and Capex budgets, monitor performance, and identify opportunities to improve efficiency. You will oversee office service providers to ensure strong performance against contract standards, lead negotiations and service improvements, and establish operational, utilization, and employee experience metrics to drive data-informed decisions and continuous growth. Embracing innovation, you will reimagine services through a digital and AI-first lens—leveraging technology, analytics, automation, and GenAI to simplify work and enhance productivity—while collaborating with teams across India and global locations to pilot, scale, and share these cutting-edge solutions. Additionally, you will partner with Security and other stakeholders on crisis and emergency management, risk preparedness, business continuity, regulatory compliance, and sustainable workplace practices. Finally, you will lead and develop a team of approximately 10 colleagues and external contractors, building strong relationships across the Center and broader firm to drive operational excellence, ensure safety, and continuously evolve workplace services to meet the dynamic needs of the firm and its people.
  
  
**Your Qualifications and Skills**

* Graduate/Postgraduate degree

title: Manager - Golf Course Maintenance
description:
**PURPOSE**

To manage the overall management, maintenance, repair, and operational readiness of all golf course machinery, equipment, utility vehicles, and workshop facilities. The role ensures that all turf maintenance equipment is maintained in optimal working conditions to support efficient golf course operations while maintaining safety, quality, and cost control standards.

**KEY ORGANIZATIONAL RELATIONSHIPS**

**Reports to**
: Golf Course Superintendent

**Reporting Roles: Finance**
Executives, Supervisor, Associates

**Interacts with**
:

* **External:**
  Vendors, Auditors, Statutory Authorities, Consultants, Service Providers
* **Internal:**
  Golf Course Team, Procurement Team, Department Heads, Store & Receiving Teams, HR, Senior Management

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Equipment Maintenance & Repair**

* Oversee preventive and corrective maintenance of all golf course machinery and equipment.
* Ensure timely repair and servicing of mowers, tractors, utility vehicles, sprayers, aerators, and other turf equipment.
* Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to maximize equipment lifespan and minimize breakdowns.
* Diagnose mechanical, hydraulic, electrical, and engine-related issues and ensure prompt resolution.

**Workshop Management**

* Manage day-to-day operations of the workshop and maintenance facilities.
* Maintain cleanliness, organization, and safety standards within the workshop.
* Ensure availability of tools, equipment, spare parts, and consumables required for maintenance activities.
* Monitor fuel, lubricants, and inventory consumption.

**Inventory & Asset Management**

* Maintain accurate records of all machinery, service history, breakdown reports, and maintenance schedules.
* Manage procurement and inventory of spare parts and workshop supplies.
* Conduct periodic audits of equipment and workshop inventory.
* Recommend replacement or refurbishment of aging equipment.

**Team Leadership**

* Supervise workshop technicians, mechanics, welders, and support staff.
* Allocate work assignments and monitor team productivity.
* Provide technical guidance and training to workshop personnel.
* Conduct performance reviews and identify development opportunities for team members.

**Cost Control & Budgeting**

* Prepare annual workshop operating budgets.
* Monitor maintenance expenses and ensure cost-effective utilization of resources.
* Negotiate with vendors and service providers for parts and equipment repairs.
* Track and report maintenance costs and equipment performance metrics.

**Safety & Compliance**

* Ensure compliance with all workplace health, safety, and environmental regulations.
* Conduct regular safety inspections and risk assessments.
* Ensure proper handling, storage, and disposal of oils, lubricants, batteries, and hazardous materials.
* Maintain adherence to organizational policies and industry best practices.

**Vendor & Contractor Management**

* Coordinate with external service providers for specialized repairs and warranty services.
* Evaluate vendor performance and maintain effective supplier relationships.
* Ensure completion of annual maintenance contracts and statutory inspections.

**JOB REQUIREMENTS / HIRING PROFILE**

**QUALIFICATIONS**

· Diploma/bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, Automobile Engineering, or related field.

· Certification in Heavy Equipment Maintenance or Automotive Systems preferred

**WORK EXPERIENCE**

· 8-12 years of experience in equipment maintenance, workshop operations, or mechanical engineering.

· Minimum 3-5 years in a supervisory or managerial role.

· Experience managing turf equipment, golf course machinery, agricultural machinery, or heavy equipment preferred.

title: Process Lead - Personal Independence
description:
