And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**Job Description – GDS Independence | Process Lead**
**Role title GDS Independence Process Lead**
**Position Summary**
The Process Lead is accountable for the governance, quality, and overall health of an assigned GDS Independence process portfolio. Acting as the process steward and independent quality oversight leader within the operating model, the role provides a consolidated view of process performance, recurring issues, control effectiveness, emerging risks, and improvement opportunities across the portfolio.
  
  
The role establishes process priorities, directs and supports Process SMRs, and drives assurance, remediation, and capability initiatives to strengthen consistency, compliance, and operational effectiveness. Working closely with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Leaders, and other stakeholders, the Process Lead ensures global standards are effectively embedded, risks are proactively managed, and process improvements are implemented in a controlled and sustainable manner.
  
  
Through strong governance, data-driven insights, and continuous improvement, the Process Lead enables consistent execution, strengthens process maturity, and supports the delivery of high-quality Independence services across GDS.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Process Governance & Portfolio Leadership:**

* Lead the governance agenda for assigned GDS processes.
* Maintain an integrated view of process health, quality, risks, capability, and improvement opportunities.
* Establish portfolio priorities and determine focus areas for assurance, remediation, and process improvement.
* Drive consistent application of Global standards and approved process requirements.
* Partner with Global and Regional Process Owners to support effective process governance and decision-making.

**Quality, Assurance & Risk Oversight:**

* Approve and oversee risk-based quality and assurance coverage across the portfolio.
* Review significant findings, recurring issues, control weaknesses, and emerging risks.
* Determine when additional review, remediation, or escalation is required.
* Oversee thematic reviews, trend analysis, and quality assessments to identify systemic risks.
* Ensure assurance outcomes lead to meaningful and sustainable improvements.

**Issue Resolution & Continuous Improvement:**

* Analyse recurring issues, root causes, assurance findings, and process risks across the portfolio.
* Establish remediation priorities and monitor progress to closure.
* Hold designated owners accountable for delivering corrective actions.
* Confirm remediation activities address underlying causes and reduce future risk.
* Identify opportunities to simplify, standardize, and improve process effectiveness.

**Process Change & Knowledge Management:**

* Oversee implementation of approved process improvements and changes across GDS.
* Maintain process documentation, SOPs, playbooks, controls, job aids, and knowledge repositories.
* Translate approved Global changes into practical guidance and readiness actions.
* Ensure process standards remain current, accessible, and consistently applied.
* Support successful adoption through effective communication and learning strategies.

**Stakeholder & Process Stewardship:**

* Partner with Global Process Owners, Geo Leads, Regional/Country Independence Leaders and other stakeholders to strengthen process performance and governance.
* Provide clear recommendations on process risks, quality concerns, and improvement opportunities.
* Influence decisions through data-driven insights and objective process oversight.
* Represent the process portfolio in governance forums and strategic discussions.
* Foster strong collaboration between process, service, and delivery teams.

**People Leadership & Capability Development:**

* Lead, coach, and develop assigned Process SMRs.
* Establish clear expectations, ownership, and accountability for portfolio outcomes.
* Drive calibration and consistency of technical judgment across teams and locations.
* Strengthen succession planning, knowledge continuity, and leadership readiness.
* Build a sustainable pipeline of process stewardship capability to support future organizational needs.

**Success measures**

* Quality: Quality at source, rework, Second-line review themes, business escalations, independent QA themes and sustained remediation
* Experience: RIL pulse, Voice of Customer, communication quality.
* People: Capability, engagement, retention, coaching, succession and primary/secondary coverage
* Risk & Assurance: Reduced systemic risks and recurring quality issues through effective assurance and independent oversight.
* Improvement & Transformation: Measurable improvements in process effectiveness, efficiency, standardization, and user experience.
* Capability & Succession: A strong pipeline of capable Process SMRs supported by effective coaching, knowledge continuity, and succession planning.
* Stakeholder Engagement: Strengthen stakeholder confidence through effective governance, strategic insights and Global alignment.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong Independence or risk and compliance knowledge, with the ability to link process decisions to regional and business outcomes.
* Experience in quality management, assurance, root cause analysis, risk assessment, control effectiveness reviews, and remediation oversight. Able to identify recurring and systemic issues, assess risks, and drive practical, sustainable improvements.
* Proven leadership of multi-location teams, with clear accountability for capacity, performance, risk and people outcomes.
* Strong executive communication and influencing skills, with the ability to build trusted stakeholder relationships.
* Sound judgment, using service, quality, demand, people and stakeholder insights to set priorities and improve performance.
* Inclusive and culturally aware leadership, with a strong focus on coaching, talent development and succession.
* Proven ability to lead change, drive technology adoption and deliver sustained service improvements.

**To qualify for the role**

* A university degree (master’s or post-graduate degree) or equivalent professional experience in business, accounting, finance, risk, compliance, operations or a related area.
* 12-14 years of relevant experience in professional services, global delivery, Independence, risk or another controlled service environment.
* Demonstrated people leadership, stakeholder management, Quality and controls and change implementation.
* Excellent written and spoken English and confidence operating across time zones and cultures.
* Evidence of portfolio leadership, senior stakeholder credibility and cross-process judgment appropriate to Rank 62 or aspiring Rank 62.

**What You Can Look For**

* A team of people with technical experience, business acumen and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast-moving environment.
* A team of professionals driven by growth and client enablement mindset, while safeguarding EY’s brand name.
* A team which focuses on supporting its colleagues to excel in their respective domains and provides avenues to help acquire and demonstrate new skills.
* A team that functions with One-Team mindset and values diversity and inclusiveness.
* Opportunities to work with regional teams and stakeholders on strengthening the compliance framework.
* A team that thrives on continuous improvement and bringing in efficiency to processes.

**What We Offer**
EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. We work across six locations – Argentina, China, India, Philippines, Poland and UK – and with teams from all EY service lines, geographies and sectors, playing a vital role in the delivery of the EY growth strategy. From accountants to coders to advisory consultants, we offer a wide variety of fulfilling career opportunities that span all business disciplines. title: Assistant Facility Manager- Soft Services
description:
AFM - Soft Services
  
  
Assistant Facilities Manager - Soft Services
  
  
Position Overview
  
  
The Assistant Facilities Manager for Soft Services supports the delivery of non-technical facilities management services, ensuring high-quality cleaning, catering, security, reception, waste management, and other hospitality-related services within commercial properties.
  
  
Key Responsibilities
  
  
**Service Delivery Management**

* Oversee daily operations of soft services including cleaning, catering, security, reception, mailroom, and waste management
* Monitor service delivery against SLAs and KPIs, ensuring compliance with contractual obligations
* Conduct regular site inspections and quality audits to maintain service standards
* Coordinate with service providers and contractors to resolve issues promptly

**Vendor and Contract Management**

* Manage relationships with soft services vendors and subcontractors
* Monitor vendor performance, conduct regular reviews, and implement improvement plans
* Assist in procurement processes, contract negotiations, and renewals
* Ensure compliance with health, safety, and environmental regulations

**Client and Stakeholder Relations**

* Serve as primary point of contact for soft services inquiries and issues
* Build strong relationships with clients, tenants, and building occupants
* Conduct regular client meetings to review service delivery and gather feedback
* Respond to service requests and complaints in a timely, professional manner

**Budget and Financial Management**

* Assist in preparing and managing soft services budgets
* Monitor expenditures, identify cost-saving opportunities, and control costs
* Process invoices, track expenses, and maintain accurate financial records
* Prepare regular financial reports and variance analyses

**Health, Safety, and Compliance**

* Ensure all soft services operations comply with health and safety legislation
* Conduct risk assessments and implement control measures
* Maintain compliance with environmental and sustainability standards
* Ensure all contractors hold appropriate certifications and insurance

**Reporting and Documentation**

* Maintain accurate records of service delivery, incidents, and performance metrics
* Prepare regular reports on service levels, KPIs, and operational performance
* Document processes, procedures, and best practices
* Utilize CAFM/CMMS systems for work order management and reporting

**Required Qualifications**
**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree in Facilities Management, Business Administration, or related field preferred
* 3-5 years of experience in facilities management with focus on soft services
* Experience managing multiple service contracts and vendors
* Background in commercial real estate or corporate facilities environment

**Technical Skills**

* Strong knowledge of soft services operations and industry best practices
* Proficiency with CAFM/CMMS systems and MS Office Suite
* Understanding of health and safety regulations and compliance requirements
* Familiarity with sustainability and environmental management practices

**Competencies**

* Strong organizational and multitasking abilities
* Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
* Problem-solving mindset with attention to detail
* Customer service orientation with professional demeanor
* Ability to work independently and as part of a team
* Financial acumen and budget management capabilities

**Preferred Qualifications**

* IWFM (Institute of Workplace and Facilities Management) certification
* IOSH Managing Safely or equivalent health and safety qualification
* Experience with integrated facilities management
* Knowledge of CAFM systems (e.g., Planon, Archibus, FM:Systems)

Working Conditions
  
  

* Office-based with regular site visits across portfolio
* Standard business hours with occasional evening/weekend coverage required
* Some physical activity including site inspections and walkthroughs

This role offers the opportunity to develop expertise in soft services management while contributing to the operational excellence of commercial properties within JLL's portfolio.

title: Technical Manager solar
description:
Designation: Technical Manager – Solar
  
Department: Solar PV Testing Laboratory
  
Location: Faridabad
  
Experience: 7+ Years
  
Qualification: B.Tech/B.E./Diploma in Mechanical Engineering or relevant technical
  
discipline,ECE
  
About the Role
  
We are looking for an experienced Technical Manager – Solar to lead and supervise Solar
  
PV module testing, certification, laboratory operations, technical documentation, quality
  
systems, audits and compliance activities.
  
The candidate should have strong experience in Solar PV testing, IEC standards, BIS
  
requirements, NABL laboratory systems, audits, certification activities, and client
  
coordination. The profile should also have experience in managing end-to-end testing
  
workflows and technical teams.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
 Lead and supervise Solar PV module testing and certification activities.
  
 Ensure testing is carried out as per IEC 61215, IEC 61730 and IS 14286 standards.
  
 Manage day-to-day technical operations of the Solar PV testing laboratory.
  
 Plan and monitor the complete sample lifecycle, from sample receipt and testing to
  
final reporting.
  
 Review and approve technical reports, test results and relevant technical
  
documentation.
  
 Prepare and review datasheets, BOMs, drawings and compliance documents.
  
 Coordinate with clients, certification bodies and external agencies for testing and
  
certification requirements.
  
 Handle technical queries and provide appropriate technical support to clients and
  
internal teams.
  
 Ensure proper maintenance of test records, calibration records and document-
  
control systems.
  
 Ensure compliance with NABL requirements and laboratory quality management
  
systems.
  
 Coordinate and support NABL assessments, internal audits, external audits and
  
other certification/quality audits.
  
 Prepare required documents and records for audits and ensure timely closure of audit
  
observations/non-conformities.
  
 Monitor compliance with laboratory SOPs, testing procedures and quality
  
standards.  Coordinate with cross-functional teams for troubleshooting, technical issues and
  
process improvements.
  
 Identify opportunities to improve testing processes, laboratory efficiency and
  
documentation practices.
  
 Guide and support technical team members in carrying out testing and certification
  
activities.
  
 Ensure proper calibration and maintenance status of laboratory equipment.
  
 Maintain effective technical documentation and ensure proper document control.
  
 Support management in technical planning, laboratory development and quality
  
improvement initiatives.
  
Required Technical Skills
  
 Solar PV Module Testing
  
 Solar PV Testing & Certification
  
 IEC 61215
  
 IEC 61730
  
 IS 14286
  
 BIS Compliance
  
 NABL Requirements
  
 ISO/IEC 17025 Laboratory Quality Management System
  
 Internal & External Audits
  
 NABL Assessment & Audit Preparation
  
 Technical Report Review
  
 Calibration & Equipment Records
  
 Document Control
  
 Testing Procedures & SOPs
  
 Client & Certification Body Coordination
  
 Technical Troubleshooting
  
 Team Management
  
Audit & Quality Responsibilities
  
 Manage laboratory readiness for NABL assessments and other quality/certification
  
audits.
  
 Coordinate with auditors and certification agencies during assessments.
  
 Review audit findings and coordinate corrective and preventive actions.
  
 Ensure timely closure of NCs, observations and audit-related actions.
  
 Maintain required quality records, test records, calibration records and controlled
  
documents.

Education:
  
 B.Tech/B.E. in Mechanical Engineering or relevant engineering discipline.

considered. Experience:

title: Deputy Boutique Manager
description:
**Job Title: DEPUTY BOUTIQUE MANAGER**

**Location:**
Gurugram

**Company:**
ABPR Jewels Pvt Ltd

**About AMARIS**

AMARIS is one of the fastest-growing luxury jewellery maisons, created for the neo-luxe woman - bold, expressive, and unapologetically herself. Loved and trusted by leading Bollywood celebrities and global clientele, AMARIS has quickly established itself as a statement-making brand in the fine jewellery space.

Blending global design sensibilities with Indian craftsmanship, AMARIS creates fine jewellery that moves effortlessly across every facet of her life. With a strong digital-first approach and a deeply engaged global community, the brand is redefining how modern women experience and wear luxury.

Currently present across 4 flagship stores, AMARIS is on a strong growth trajectory with a vision to expand to 20 stores across India over the next 5 years - building a truly pan-India luxury brand.

At its core, AMARIS is not just about jewellery - it’s about confidence, individuality, and making a statement every day.

**Job Description**

We are seeking a dynamic and customer-focused Assistant Store Manager to support the Store Manager in driving store sales, team performance, operational excellence, and an exceptional luxury client experience.

The ideal candidate will have strong leadership skills, a passion for luxury retail, and a proven ability to drive sales and build meaningful relationships with clients. The Assistant Store Manager will play a critical role in ensuring the smooth functioning of the boutique while actively contributing to revenue growth, team development, clienteling, and brand experience.

This is a hands-on leadership role for someone who is comfortable being on the shop floor, leading by example, coaching the team, engaging with clients, and taking ownership of day-to-day store performance.

**Responsibilities**

**1. Store Operations**

* Support the Store Manager in managing end-to-end boutique operations and ensuring adherence to brand SOPs.
* Take ownership of day-to-day store functioning in the absence of the Store Manager.
* Ensure the store is always client-ready, well-maintained, and aligned with AMARIS brand standards.
* Support staff rostering, attendance, shift planning, and daily operational requirements.
* Conduct daily team briefings and ensure clear communication of priorities and targets.
* Ensure adherence to store opening and closing procedures.
* Coordinate with internal teams including Marketing, VM, CRM, Operations, and Finance for store-related requirements.
* Ensure timely execution of store initiatives, campaigns, launches, and events.

**2. Sales & Business Performance**

* Support the Store Manager in achieving monthly and annual store sales targets.
* Drive daily sales performance and ensure consistent achievement of individual and team targets.
* Monitor sales performance and identify gaps and opportunities for improvement.
* Actively participate in client interactions and lead by example on the sales floor.
* Drive key retail performance indicators including conversion, ATV, UPT, repeat business, and client acquisition.
* Ensure effective follow-up on leads, enquiries, trials, appointments, and pending sales.
* Support the team in converting high-potential prospects and walk-ins into customers.
* Assist in implementing sales strategies and initiatives to maximize store revenue.

**3. Client Experience & Clienteling**

* Deliver a best-in-class luxury experience to every client visiting the boutique.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with existing and prospective clients.
* Develop and nurture relationships with HNI and high-value clients.
* Support the team in developing strong clienteling practices and maintaining meaningful client relationships.
* Ensure timely follow-ups with clients through calls, WhatsApp, and other approved CRM channels.
* Track important client occasions, preferences, purchase history, and follow-up opportunities.
* Drive repeat business and customer referrals through strong relationship management.
* Monitor customer feedback and proactively address client concerns.
* Support the Store Manager in improving CSAT, NPS, customer retention, and repeat business.

**4. Team Management & Development**

* Support the Store Manager in leading, motivating, and developing the store team.
* Conduct regular floor huddles, product briefings, and sales discussions.
* Coach team members on product knowledge, selling skills, client engagement, and luxury service standards.
* Track individual performance and provide regular feedback to team members.
* Identify performance gaps and work with team members to improve productivity.
* Ensure 100% completion of mandatory product, process, and service training.
* Foster a high-energy, collaborative, client-first, and performance-driven culture.
* Lead by example in professionalism, grooming, punctuality, client engagement, and sales behaviour.

**5. CRM & Client Data Discipline**

* Ensure the team maintains accurate and updated client information.
* Drive disciplined usage of CRM systems and ensure all client interactions are recorded appropriately.
* Monitor lead follow-ups, client appointments, trials, and pending opportunities.
* Ensure timely updating of customer interactions and sales pipeline information.
* Work with the CRM and Marketing teams to execute client engagement campaigns.
* Identify opportunities for reactivation of dormant clients and engagement of high-value customers.

**6. Visual Merchandising & Brand Standards**

* Ensure the boutique consistently reflects AMARIS's premium visual and brand standards.
* Support the Store Manager in maintaining product presentation, displays, counters, and client areas.
* Ensure adherence to VM guidelines during launches, campaigns, and collection changes.
* Coordinate with the VM and Marketing teams for execution of new campaigns and visual updates.
* Ensure all team members maintain appropriate grooming and professional presentation standards.

**7. Inventory & Operational Controls**

* Support the Store Manager in maintaining accurate inventory and stock movement records.
* Ensure adherence to jewellery handling, stock movement, transfer, and security protocols.
* Support periodic stock audits, inventory verification, and reconciliation activities.
* Ensure proper documentation for billing, deliveries, dispatches, and stock transfers.
* Maintain strict adherence to internal controls, audit requirements, and security protocols.
* Escalate discrepancies, operational issues, or control concerns to the Store Manager and relevant teams promptly.

**8. Reporting & Compliance**

* Maintain accurate daily and periodic store performance reports.
* Track sales, conversion, ATV, UPT, footfall, leads, appointments, and other relevant KPIs.
* Ensure timely submission of reports and store updates to the Store Manager.
* Monitor attendance, punctuality, and team discipline.
* Ensure compliance with all AMARIS policies, SOPs, and operational guidelines.
* Support the Store Manager during internal and external audits.

**9. Leadership & Business Support**

* Act as the Store Manager's key support in driving overall store performance.
* Take charge of the boutique in the Store Manager's absence.
* Serve as a role model for sales excellence, customer service, and professional conduct.
* Work closely with senior leadership and cross-functional teams on store initiatives.
* Proactively identify operational and business improvement opportunities.
* Contribute ideas that improve customer experience, team productivity, and store profitability.

**Requirements**

* Graduate in any discipline; degree/diploma in Fashion, Retail, Luxury Management, Business, or a related field will be preferred.
* 5+ years of experience in luxury retail, premium retail, jewellery, fashion, lifestyle, or related industries.
* Prior experience in a supervisory, senior sales, team lead, or assistant management role will be preferred.
* Strong experience in direct sales and client relationship management.
* Proven ability to engage with HNI and high-value clients.
* Strong understanding of luxury selling and customer experience.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve sales targets and drive team performance.
* Excellent communication, interpersonal, and relationship-building skills.
* Strong leadership and people management abilities.
* Good understanding of CRM practices and customer lifecycle management.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with an understanding of retail KPIs.
* Excellent attention to detail and operational discipline.
* Ability to multitask, prioritize, and perform effectively in a fast-paced retail environment.
* Strong grooming and professional presentation appropriate for a luxury retail environment.
* Flexibility to work evenings, weekends, and holidays as required.

**Why Join AMARIS Jewels**

AMARIS is building one of India’s most exciting luxury jewellery brands - loved by Bollywood, trusted by a discerning global clientele, and growing at speed.

With 4 flagship stores already operational and a clear vision to scale to 20 stores in the next 5 years, we are in a defining phase of expansion and looking for people who want to build, not just participate.

At AMARIS, performance, ownership, and creativity are non-negotiable. If you thrive in high-growth environments, take pride in your craft, and want your work to be seen, valued, and rewarded - this is where you accelerate.

**What Sets Us Apart**

**Fast-Track Growth**

* Exceptional performers don't wait years for recognition. Growth here is merit-driven, visible, and fast.

**Real Ownership**

* You don't simply manage a floor - you help build a store, a team, and a customer experience that represents the AMARIS brand.

**Lead from the Front**

* Be on the floor, engage with clients, coach your team, and directly influence store performance.

**Build Exceptional Customer Experiences**

* Every interaction matters. Your work directly influences how clients experience and remember AMARIS.

**High Performance Culture**

* We operate with ambition and accountability. The bar is high; and so are the rewards.

**Interested Candidates**

Interested candidates can mail their resume to hr@amarisjewels.com

title: Senior Manager / Manager – Health & Benefits Consulting - RxPharmacist
description:
We are seeking a talented individual to join our Health Operations team at Marsh
  
  
This role will be based in GGN. This is a hybrid role that has a requirement of working at least three days a week in the office.
  
  
**H&B Consulting - RxPharma**
**What can you expect?**
The Senior Pharmacy Clinical Pharmacy Consultant will lead accurate and timely compilation of data and financial analysis on mid-sized and large, complex pharmacy projects
  
  
A significant part of this role is to be a key contributor for projects while developing and growing intellectual capital and driving operational efficiencies
  
  

* Manages the scope, quality, timeliness of multiple client deliverables in researching, analyzing, and evaluating drug therapies, disease states, and pharmacy benefit plans and programs in the US.
* Learn and understand high level financials related to pharmacy benefit offerings, plan designs and assist with contract reviews.
* Reviews RFP outputs of clinical and formulary information gathered by the team, analyzes and interprets the results, edits and finalizes the executive summary report, and sends this report to the US team.
* Supports pharmacy and medical medication focused assessments and plan design diagnostics.
* Assists in developing/writing Summary Plan Documents for US based employers based on program decisions made by employers (crosswalk to be provided by US based colleagues).
* Assists with evaluation model development and maintenance for projects that involve both medical and pharmacy claim data.
* Organizes and maintains databases for employer clients and industry vendors.
* Develop and maintains personal and working relationships with key US team stakeholders facilitate the sharing of advice and information relevant to the client, developing new and expanded business.
* Creates or supports written industry points of view/blog posts/whitepapers/clinical reviews.
* Supports written responses for US based clients seeking information about Mercer’s US Pharmacy Team - Request for Proposal (RFP) response support.
* Continually evaluates processes looking for opportunities to automate or improve upon current workflow.
* With a growing understanding of the US healthcare system, provide clinical guidance on PBM/carrier programs and services.
* Helps to draft points of view and assist other clinicians with clinical reviews.
* Advises on the implication for plan sponsors on the release on new clinical studies, drug approvals, and guideline changes.
* Keeps up with US industry happenings, news, and new vendor offerings.
* Performs other research and analysis as related to the US prescription drug marketplace and industry.
* Guides and trains other local pharmacy team members and peer review their work.
* Acts as an advisor to junior staff for problem resolution and guidance on appropriate ways to deal with challenges.
* Possesses an active pharmacy license (does not need to be licensed in the US).

**We will count on you to**

* Manage the day-to-day project management and support with the key members of the US pharmacy team
* Prepare project results for US pharmacy colleagues supporting clients, carriers, managed care entities and other related entities
* Work with the US based pharmacy colleagues to initiate projects. This may include meetings with the internal Mercer pharmacy team and in some occasions the client team from time to time, understand project scope, timelines and deliverables. You will develop and propose essential project documents, including the strategy, budget and work plans.
* Maintaining project documents and produce documents stating project results, including reports, charts and analyses
* Manage data and analytical work, summarizing claim experience and providing recommendations for employers

**Note: Applicants should be flexible working in shifts (3:00 pm - 12:00 am) and most work will be during normal local business hours.**
**What you need to have:**
  
  

* Doctorate of Pharmacy (PharmD) or Bachelor of Science in Pharmacy degree
* Licensed pharmacist in country/state of residence
* Excellent project management and interpersonal skills
* Strong English oral and written communication skills
* Proficient in Microsoft suite of programs (Outlook, Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Teams, OneNote)
* Minimum 8 years of relevant experience

**What makes you stand out?**

* Adaptable communicator, facilitator, influencer and problem solver
* High attention to detail
* Good relationship skills, Proven ability to work on own initiative as well as in a team
* Ability to multi-task and prioritize time effectively
* Masters in Business Administration (MBA)
* Pharmacy benefit management (PBM) or managed health care experience
* Understanding of the US healthcare industry, including pharmacy claim payment systems

**Why join our team?**

* We help you be your best through professional development opportunities, interesting work and supportive leaders.
* We foster a vibrant and inclusive culture where you can work with talented colleagues to create new solutions and have impact for colleagues, clients and communities.
* Our scale enables us to provide a range of career opportunities, as well as benefits and rewards to enhance your well-being.

With annual revenue of over $27 billion and more than 95,000 colleagues, Marsh helps build the confidence to thrive through the power of perspective. For more information, visit marsh.com, or follow us on LinkedIn and X.
  
  
Marsh is committed to embracing a diverse, inclusive and flexible work environment. We aim to attract and retain the best people and embrace diversity of age, background, caste, disability, ethnic origin, family duties, gender orientation or expression, gender reassignment, marital status, nationality, parental status, personal or social status, political affiliation, race, religion and beliefs, sex/gender, sexual orientation or expression, skin color, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.
  
  
Marsh is committed to hybrid work, which includes the flexibility of working remotely and the collaboration, connections and professional development benefits of working together in the office. All Marsh colleagues are expected to be in their local office or working onsite with clients at least three days per week. Office-based teams will identify at least one “anchor day” per week on which their full team will be together in person.

description:

We’re proud to have been helping our clients build better financial futures for over 50 years. How have we achieved this? By working together - and supporting each other - all over the world. So, join our team and feel like you’re part of something bigger.
  
  
**About Your Team**
You will be part of our Global Procurement function which has c.130 staff based across the UK, India, Continental Europe, and Asia Pacific, managing $800m of spend across 26 countries.
  
  
The Procurement Operational Performance team is responsible for driving operational excellence across Procurement by leading, supporting and delivering strategic performance objectives through two specialist teams:

Together, these teams enable Procurement to operate efficiently today while building the capabilities required for the future.
  
  
**About Your Role**
As the Senior Manager for Procurement Change Delivery, you will be responsible for managing change and delivering key projects across Global Procurement.
  
  
The role will require an understanding of end-to-end Procurement functions and processes, Procurement systems and tools, experience in change and project management, and a proven track record in successfully deploying and embedding new and enhanced processes and technology to achieve defined benefits and outcomes.

+ Lead the execution of Change Impact assessments and ensure that robust and effective business readiness plans are in place and executed
+ Represent projects at various governance forums within Procurement and across the broader FIL organisation
+ Own, maintain and enhance Procurement Change Management tools developed using PowerApps, PowerBI and Power Automate

**About You**
You are a collaborative individual with a positive can-do attitude. You can work independently and as part of a team, with proven organisation skills and an ability to multitask by managing projects and activities concurrently.
  
  
You’ll bring;
  
  

* MBA/BBA and/or B-Tech Graduate
* 8+ years of experience in the Procurement domain with a good knowledge of Procurement related processes and functions that may include Sourcing, Supplier Management, Contract Management, Purchase to Pay, Third Party risk management, Due diligence, Supplier onboarding

* Ability to positively challenge stakeholders when necessary, and to identify alternative solutions when needed

* Willingness to learn, and evidence of building and applying knowledge

title: Delivery Manager

You'll play a key role in developing delivery capability and continuously improving how we plan, deliver, and scale technology solutions.

* Own delivery performance across a portfolio of teams and strategic initiatives, driving alignment to quarterly and annual commitments.
* Establish and evolve delivery governance, planning standards, forecasting processes, and delivery best practices.

title: ITSM Manager

title: District Manager, North & East India
description:
At Crocs, Inc., every career offers a chance to make a real impact. No two journeys look the same. And that's exactly how we like it. Whether you’re welcoming customers into our stores, collaborating with global teams at our headquarters, or keeping operations moving at our distribution centers, your impact is real and valued. At Crocs, Inc. you’re not expected to fit a mold. You’re encouraged to break it and create something better.
  
  
**Overview**
The
**District Manager, North + East India**
for Crocs is responsible for leading end-to-end operational execution across Retail DTC and Wholesale Partner Monobrand stores in the assigned geography, reporting to the National Retail Operations Manager (skip level: Commercial Director). The role drives regional business delivery, store and partner operating standards, inventory productivity, replenishment effectiveness, talent hiring and capability, and network expansion readiness, partnering closely with Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, Visual Merchandising, Retail, Human Resources, Real Estate, franchisee and wholesale partner teams.
  
  
****What You'll Do****

* Own sell-out, profitability and operational performance across DTC and Partner Monobrand stores in North + East India, driving achievement of the regional annual operating plan, comp growth and productivity targets through weekly and monthly operating reviews.
* Ensure consistent execution of retail operating standards, SOPs, store visit discipline, performance review completion, DTC audit compliance and VM compliance, building scalable regional processes for operating cadence, governance and action tracking.
* Drive regional inventory productivity through effective stock deployment, replenishment discipline and stock balancing, monitoring WOH, ageing, sell-through, shrinkage and store-level gaps with Planning and Supply Chain.
* Jointly own DTC store expansion, including market mapping, catchment assessment and property scouting with Commercial and Real Estate teams, and ensure new store operational readiness across hiring, training, VM, stock and launch checklists.
* Establish a structured review cadence with franchise, Partner Monobrand and wholesale partners covering sell-out, inventory health, replenishment, store standards and action closure, ensuring adherence to commercial and brand standards.
* Own Store Manager hiring and coordinate end-to-end store team hiring for existing and new DTC stores in partnership with Human Resources, and influence partner staffing quality for Partner Monobrand stores.
* Lead, coach and develop Store Managers and field operations teams, building a performance-oriented culture focused on accountability, execution excellence, succession planning and talent retention.
* Act as the regional operating link across Commercial, Product, Marketing, Planning, Supply Chain, Finance, VM, HR, Real Estate and partners, ensuring timely closure of priorities, escalations and corrective actions with clear, data-led updates.

****What You'll Bring to the Table****

* MBA preferred; Bachelor’s degree in Business, Retail Management, Operations, Supply Chain or a related discipline – or equivalent years of relevant and related experience.
* Minimum 8–12 years of experience in Retail Operations, Wholesale Operations, Franchise Management or Commercial Operations, with multi-state exposure preferred.
* Background knowledge in retail hiring, new store openings and property/site evaluation.
* Strong understanding of retail operations, store P&L, inventory productivity, replenishment processes and partner governance.
* Highly influential across cross-functional stakeholders and external partners, including situations without direct authority.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multi-location operations and Store Managers, identify business risks early and drive corrective action.
* Ability to attract, select and build strong Store Manager and frontline teams, with strong analytical, stakeholder management, communication and people leadership skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across North + East India, with a field-oriented, process-driven and data-led approach.

The Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to a diverse and inclusive work environment.
  
  
All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, or disability, or any other protected classification.
  
  
At Crocs, Inc. we believe in the power of a blend of in-person and virtual collaboration to drive creativity and strengthen relationships. Your participation in this flexible schedule plays a key role in building a connected and successful team. In-office requirements vary by our work personas: Resident (5 days), Collaborator (4 days), Connector (2-3 days), Explorer (fully remote). This role has been aligned to the Collaborator persona.

title: Founder's Office - Fulfillment Lead
description:
Every company knows how to generate pipelines. Very few know how to deliver consistently at scale.

At SalesMonk, we're building AI-native GTM systems that help customers turn events and outbound into predictable revenue. As we grow, the biggest challenge isn't shipping more work- it's building the operating system that ensures every customer engagement is executed consistently, efficiently, and repeatedly.

That's where this role comes in.

**Why This Role Exists**

Today, our delivery works because smart people are solving problems every day.

Tomorrow, it needs to work because we've built systems that make great execution repeatable.

We're looking for someone who can build the processes, operating rhythms, and delivery playbooks that allow us to scale without adding operational chaos.

This isn't a project management role, this is a systems-building role.

You'll work directly with the founders to create the delivery engine that supports the next stage of the company.

**What You Will Own**

**Build the Delivery Operating System**

Design how delivery should work- from customer kickoff to successful execution.

Build repeatable workflows, SOPs, templates, governance, and playbooks that reduce dependency on tribal knowledge.

**Drive Delivery Excellence**

Own delivery health across all customer engagements.

Identify bottlenecks, eliminate operational friction, and continuously improve execution quality.

Ensure delivery standards remain high as the team scales.

**Cross-functional Execution**

Work closely with Product, GTM Engineers, Customer Success, and the founders to ensure priorities move quickly.

Bring structure, accountability, and visibility across teams.

**Process & Automation**

Identify manual workflows that should be standardized or automated.

Help build scalable systems that improve speed, quality, and consistency.

**Metrics & Continuous Improvement**

Define what great delivery looks like.

Build dashboards and operating metrics around delivery quality, turnaround time, customer outcomes, and execution efficiency.

Use data to continuously improve the way we operate.

**What We're Looking For**

* MBA from a Tier 1 or Tier 2 business school.
* 3-4 years of post-MBA experience in Management Consulting, Strategy, Business Transformation, or Operations Consulting.
* Experience designing operating models, improving business processes, or leading transformation initiatives.
* Strong structured problem-solving and analytical thinking.
* Excellent stakeholder management and communication skills.
* Comfortable working in ambiguity and creating structure from scratch.
* High ownership with a bias towards execution.

**Brownie Points**

* Experience in a B2B SaaS or AI startup.
* Exposure to customer delivery, implementation, or GTM operations.
* Experience building operational dashboards and business metrics.
* Familiarity with Notion, ClickUp, Jira, Linear, Airtable, or similar tools.
* Experience driving automation using AI or no-code workflows.

**Why This Seat**

You'll build the operating backbone of an AI-native GTM company.

Instead of maintaining existing processes, you'll design them.

You'll work directly with the founders, influence how the company scales, and solve problems that don't have predefined answers.

If you enjoy building systems, simplifying complexity, and creating leverage across teams, you'll have an outsized impact here.

title: TRC Supervisor

title: AI Project Manager
description:
**JOB DESCRIPTION: Project Manager – AI**

*Enterprise Technology & Digital Transformation Lifecycle*

**Strategic Objective**

The AI-PM is a strategic, execution-focused leader driving the company's AI transformation journey. This individual bridges the gap between business leadership, technical teams, and external vendors to deploy company-wide automation, save time, reduce costs, and dramatically improve organizational output quality.

**Key Success Metrics**

* **Processing & Time Savings:**
  Measurable reduction in manual processing time per department and total corporate hours saved.
* **Financial Impact:**
  Positive, systematically tracked ROI achieved within defined product and project timelines.
* **Adoption & Velocity:**
  High active adoption rates of automated tools across business units and consistent quarterly AI deployments.
* **Quality & Satisfaction:**
  Improved pre- vs. post-implementation quality parameters and verified employee satisfaction indexes.

**2. Core Responsibilities**

**AI Strategy & Roadmap Development**

* **High-Impact Strategy:**
  Define and execute a phased, high-impact AI roadmap aligned with overarching business objectives across Finance, HR, Operations, Sales, Marketing, and Customer Support.
* **Prioritization:**
  Assess and prioritize technical initiatives based on operational feasibility, pipeline impact, and financial ROI potential.
* **Market Awareness:**
  Monitor global technology shifts, benchmark competitor ecosystems, and deliver a quarterly 'State of AI' landscape report to the executive leadership team.

**Workflow Automation & Platform Architecture**

* **System Integration:**
  Design and oversee end-to-end automation workflows that integrate smoothly with existing enterprise applications (CRM, HRMS, Legacy Databases, etc.).
* **Platform Mastery:**
  Demonstrate strong hands-on mastery of modern enterprise workflow tools such as n8n, Make, Zapier, or Microsoft Power Automate.
* **Governance & Compliance:**
  Establish robust AI governance, data privacy parameters, continuous model-monitoring controls, and ethical compliance frameworks from day one.
* **Build vs. Buy Analysis:**
  Evaluate complex commercial build vs. buy solutions with structured technical and financial risk analysis.

**Vibe Coding, Prototyping & Technical Translation**

* **Rapid Prototyping:**
  Utilize 'vibe coding' principles using natural language inside AI development shells (Cursor, Replit AI, GitHub Copilot, v0) to accelerate prototype deployment without engineering bottlenecks.
* **Discovery Engineering:**
  Lead discovery workshops with business heads to translate practical pain points into crisp system requirements, user stories, and precise technical briefs.
* **Quality Assurance Check:**
  Evaluate early low-code/vibe-coded prototypes for production readiness before passing them to core developer lines.

**ROI Analytics & Financial Case Development**

* **Financial Modeling:**
  Build data-grounded financial models projecting cost optimizations, capacity release, and structural quality returns to capture leadership approval.
* **KPI Dashboards:**
  Monitor and distribute detailed monthly dashboards reporting target vs. actual ROI performance benchmarks.

**Vendor, Client & Management Communication**

* **Vendor Optimization:**
  Serve as the master point of contact for external AI software companies, SaaS vendors, and specialized system integrators; negotiate precise SLAs.
* **Executive Advisory:**
  Translate complex, multi-layered algorithmic and machine learning engineering terms into simplified, accessible strategic vocabulary for non-technical stakeholders.
* **Culture Catalyst:**
  Champion a data-driven, AI-first work culture through internal continuous learning series, lunch-and-learn presentations, and proactive change management strategies.

**Engineering Oversight & Architecture (Added Advantage)**

* **Velocity Protection:**
  Partner directly with engineering lines, data scientists, and DevOps specialists to break execution blockers and maintain delivery timeline momentum.
* **Technical Foundation:**
  Maintain a functional, operational literacy in database structures (MySQL, PostgreSQL, NoSQL architectures) and foundational programming frameworks (Python, JavaScript, REST APIs, JSON data maps) to effectively guide core product decisions.

**Team Leadership & Personnel Management**

* **Cross-Functional Operations:**
  Directly coordinate, mentor, and track performance across a cross-functional Agile unit comprising developers, data analysts, system architects, UI/UX engineers, and QA assets.
* **Psychological Safety:**
  Construct a highly collaborative, innovative, and safe team environment that incentivizes experimentation, speed, and learning from failure.
* **Resource Optimization:**
  Control tactical resource allocation patterns to avoid personnel burnout while defending roadmap velocity commitments.

**3. Qualifications & Competencies**

**Required Qualifications**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor's or Master's university degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Business Administration, or a heavily analytical engineering field.
* **Professional Background:**
  5–9 years of structural project management experience, with a validated minimum of 3 years strictly dedicated to AI deployment, complex workflow automation, or enterprise-scale digital transformations.
* **Delivery Execution:**
  Proven, end-to-end portfolio tracking product evolution from conceptual design phase through to live enterprise rollout using Agile, Scrum, or hybrid workflow methods.
* **Integration Literacy:**
  Verifiable hands-on track record using cloud workflow orchestration engines (n8n, Make, Zapier, or Power Automate).
* **Commercial Competence:**
  Documented background creating financial case summaries, tracking cost-mitigation parameters, and proving tech investments ROI.

**Core Competency Matrix**

* AI Strategy & Roadmap Design
* Executive-Level Communication
* Workflow Automation Platforms
* Team Building & Mentorship
* ROI Modeling & Financial Analysis
* Vendor & Stakeholder Management
* AI Platform Architecture
* Change Management & Empathy
* Vibe Coding & Low-Code Deployment
* Strategic Thinking
* Business Requirements Analysis

Leadership Profile:

  

Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.

Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.

  

**Learn & Grow**

Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an advantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.

  

**Foster a Culture of Care**

Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.

  

**Adapt and Thrive with Change**

Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.

  

**Achieve Results**

Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Position Purpose

The Senior Manager - Student Experience will be responsible for driving student experience, residential quality, student engagement, student support coordination, feedback management, grievance resolution, and continuous improvement across the student housing environment.
  
  
The role will serve as an important link between students, Wardens, Student Housing Operations, University stakeholders, support teams, and service partners, ensuring that student concerns are identified proactively, addressed professionally, and converted into measurable service improvements.

**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

Own and drive the overall student experience and quality agenda across student residences.
  
  
Establish and monitor quality standards for student housing services.
  
  
Conduct regular student interactions, floor visits, feedback sessions, and quality audits.
  
  
Identify recurring student concerns and develop corrective and preventive action plans.
  
  
Monitor service quality across Housekeeping, Security, Maintenance, Food Services, and other residential services.
  
  
Ensure student-facing services are delivered consistently across all residential blocks.
  
  
Develop and implement initiatives to improve student satisfaction, participation, and engagement.

Work closely with Student Council and student representatives.
  
  
Create mechanisms through which students can safely provide feedback and suggestions.
  
  
Develop initiatives that promote a positive, inclusive, and respectful residential community.
  
  
Proactively identify emerging student concerns before they become major grievances.
  
  
**\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_\_**

* Quality Audits & Compliance

Conduct periodic quality audits of student residences.
  
  
Develop checklists and measurable quality parameters for residential services.
  
  
Monitor compliance with Student Housing SOPs and University policies.
  
  
Conduct surprise inspections and student experience audits.

University Wardens
  
  
Student Support Teams
  
  
Security
  
  
Housekeeping
  
  
Engineering / Technical Services
  
  
University Medical Centre
  
  
University Departments

Student Experience & Engagement
  
  
Customer Experience / Service Quality
  
  
Hospitality

Student-centric approach
  
  
Strong interpersonal and communication skills
  
  
Student support coordination and student experience awareness
  
  
Quality management
  
  
Grievance management
  
  
Conflict resolution
  
  
Data analysis and problem-solving
  
  
Stakeholder management
  
  
Professional judgment and stakeholder sensitivity
  
  
Confidentiality and discretion

title: Warehouse Shift In-charge
description:
At Maersk, we have big plans. Our aspiration is to become the global expert in integrated logistics, offering a truly end-to-end service that makes daily trade simpler and easier than ever.

As a key member of our frontline team, you'll be supported by leading-edge technology and innovative solutions that will help you to meet the diverse needs of our clients. Join us and be part of a dynamic environment where your skills and expertise will be valued and rewarded. Go big, join Maersk!

The
**Warehouse Shift In-Charge**
is responsible for supervising and coordinating warehouse activities during assigned shifts to ensure smooth inbound and outbound operations. The role focuses on maintaining inventory accuracy, ensuring adherence to SOPs and customer SLAs, and managing day-to-day operational activities related to storage, handling, and dispatch of goods.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Operations Management:**

* Manage bulk inventory including onion, potato, garlic, and imported chilled items.
* Ensure accurate daily stock records of fruits and vegetables.

title: Senior Manager – Operations

deliveries. This is a hands-on, high-ownership role combining team leadership, vendor management, fast

escalation resolution and customer retention. You will build SOP-led ways of working, improve service

to prevent missed appointments.

Yolojet Internet Services Pvt. Ltd. Senior Manager - Operations | 2

existing customer accounts.

frontline feedback into clear improvement actions.

What we value

High ownership, clear communication and calm judgment under pressure. Someone who stays close to daily

operations, supports the team and closes the loop with customers and vendors, while building processes that

prevent the same problems from repeating.

**COMPANY PROFILE**

Pulse Magnetic and Power Electronics Pvt. Ltd. (PMPE) is an engineering and manufacturing company based in Gurugram, Haryana. The company manufactures transformers, inductors, chokes and other magnetic components for industrial and electronic applications. Production activities include winding, assembly, cleaning, finishing, inspection, testing and packing.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

PMPE is looking for an experienced Production Manager to lead day-to-day manufacturing operations for transformers, inductors, chokes and other magnetic components. The role is responsible for production planning, team supervision, delivery schedules, product quality, resource utilisation and safe, efficient shop-floor operations.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

· Plan daily and weekly production schedules based on customer orders, delivery commitments, available capacity, manpower and material availability.

· Oversee shop-floor activities including winding, assembly, varnishing/impregnation, finishing, inspection, testing and packing, as applicable to each product.

· Allocate jobs and resources, supervise production operators and helpers, and monitor output, productivity, attendance and work discipline.

· Ensure products are manufactured according to approved drawings, specifications, work instructions and quality requirements; coordinate with the Quality team on inspections and defects.

· Track daily production targets, work-in-progress, rejections, rework and delays; maintain accurate production records and report deviations promptly.

· Coordinate with Stores, Purchase, Quality, Engineering and Dispatch teams to ensure material readiness, resolve production issues and meet delivery commitments.

· Monitor material consumption, yield, scrap and wastage; promote efficient use of manpower, materials, tools and equipment.

· Ensure compliance with standard operating procedures, safety rules, PPE requirements, chemical-handling procedures, fire safety and workplace organisation (5S).

· Identify bottlenecks and implement practical improvements to increase productivity, reduce cycle time, improve quality and control manufacturing costs.

· Coordinate preventive maintenance of production machines, tools and equipment with the concerned team, and promptly address breakdowns affecting output.

· Train and guide team members on work methods, quality expectations, safe practices and process changes; identify skill gaps and training needs.

· Investigate production non-conformities, recurring defects and customer complaints with the relevant teams, and follow through on corrective and preventive actions.

· Prepare production status updates for management and support internal/customer audits and other manufacturing-related tasks as required.

title: Senior Manager - Risk Management (Merchant Operations)
description:
**You Lead the Way. We’ve Got Your Back.**

At American Express, our culture is built on a long history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviours, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. We operate with a strong risk mindset while continuously improving how we serve merchants and manage critical business processes.

Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together we help define the future of American Express.

**How Will You Make Impact in this Role.**

Merchant Account Operations & Resilience supports critical merchant-data, operational-risk, remediation, and transformation activities. Accurate merchant data and effective operational processes are essential to pricing, servicing, risk management, reporting, and decision-making.

The Senior Manager, Risk Management will lead a team focused on **Merchant Hierarchy process transformation, enterprise remediation, and strategic program delivery** .

The role will identify opportunities to simplify and uplift hierarchy review processes using AI, automation, analytics, workflow solutions, and operating-model improvements. It will also lead or support complex remediation and cross-functional programs by bringing strong governance, execution discipline, change management, and leadership visibility.

The successful candidate will combine operational experience, program leadership, analytical fluency, transformation thinking, stakeholder management and people leadership. The role will partner closely with teams responsible for ongoing Merchant Hierarchy governance and day-to-day hierarchy reviews.

  

**Minimum Qualifications:**

* Experience leading complex, cross-functional programs in a global or highly matrixed organization.
* Strong program-governance capability across planning, ownership, dependencies, risk management, escalation, and outcome measurement.
* Experience within operations, servicing, risk, controls, remediation, transformation, or another operationally intensive environment.
* Demonstrated ability to identify and shape process improvements involving AI, automation, analytics, workflow redesign, simplification, or operational efficiencies.
* Strong analytical fluency and the ability to translate complex or ambiguous challenges into structured recommendations and executable plans.
* Strong executive presence, credibility, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate and influence senior partners without direct authority.
* Proven people-leadership experience, including setting direction, coaching talent, and building team capability.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.
Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.  

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Experience within merchant operations, onboarding, account maintenance, servicing, pricing, payments, or a related function.
* Knowledge of merchant account structures, hierarchy processes, data enrichment, or Know Your Customer processes.
* Experience delivering operational transformation, AI, automation, workflow, analytics, or technology-enabled process improvements.
* Experience supporting operational-risk events, corrective-action plans, remediation, or control-enhancement programs.
* Familiarity with analytical and visualization tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau, Power BI, or comparable platforms.
Experience working across multiple markets or global teams.  

**Critical Factors to Success:**

* Apply strong program governance and execution discipline across transformation and remediation initiatives.
* Convert AI, automation, analytics, and process-improvement opportunities into scalable and sustainable operational capabilities.
* Deliver measurable improvements in efficiency, data quality, controls, and operational outcomes.
* Bring structure, transparency, and accountability to complex cross-functional programs.
Build trusted partnerships and influence decisions without direct authority.  

**Leadership Behaviors:**

The successful candidate should consistently demonstrate the American Express Leadership Behaviours by:

* **Defining What Winning Looks Like:** Establishing clear priorities, outcomes, delivery plans, and success measures.
* **Putting Enterprise Thinking First:** Balancing business value, merchant and customer outcomes, colleague impact, operational feasibility, and the control environment.
* **Making Collaboration Essential:** Building trusted partnerships while maintaining clarity on ownership, accountability, and decision rights.
* **Seeking and Providing Coaching and Feedback:** Strengthening team capability through regular, candid, and actionable development conversations.
* **Communicating Frequently, Candidly, and Clearly:** Providing transparent information on progress, risks, issues, dependencies, benefits, and required actions.
* **Making Decisions Quickly and Effectively:** Evaluating alternatives and balancing speed, business value, data, implementation effort, risk, and sustainable outcomes.
* **Demonstrating Courageous and Authentic Leadership:** Raising concerns proactively, challenging assumptions, and creating an environment where colleagues can speak up.
* **Leading with a Digital and Improvement Mindset:** Challenging how work is performed and identifying scalable opportunities to simplify, automate, and improve operational outcomes.

  

At American Express, our culture is built on a 175-year history of innovation, shared values and Leadership Behaviors, and an unwavering commitment to back our customers, communities, and colleagues. From delivering differentiated products to providing world-class customer service, we operate with a strong risk mindset, ensuring we continue to uphold our brand promise of trust, security, and service.

As part of Team Amex, you’ll experience our powerful backing with comprehensive support for your holistic well-being and many opportunities to learn new skills, develop as a leader, and grow your career. Here, your voice and ideas matter, your work makes an impact, and together, you will help us define the future of American Express.

  

We back you with benefits that support your holistic well-being so you can be and deliver your best. This means caring for you and your loved ones' physical, financial, and mental health, as well as providing the flexibility you need to thrive personally and professionally:

* Competitive base salaries
* Bonus incentives

* Free and confidential counseling support through our Healthy Minds program
* Career development and training opportunities

American Express is an equal opportunity employer and makes employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran status, disability status, age, or any other status protected by law.

description:

PROENERGY is an engineering, R&D, and manufacturing powerhouse. The company addresses every need for fast-start power generation: turbine and package manufacturing, turnkey project execution, power purchase agreements, and asset lifecycle care for turbines and plants. Where others see impossible energy challenges, PROENERGY provides innovative aeroderivative solutions.
  
  
**Our Footprint**
PROENERGY delivers fast-start, dispatchable power solutions from worldwide centers for aeroderivative excellence. We are investing more than $1 billion through 2028 in infrastructure to serve our customers.
  
  
**In Sedalia, Missouri,**
our 600,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Manufacturing—a world-class investment in fast-start power and the only campus of its kind in the world—is growing by 40 percent.
  
  
**In Houston, Texas,**
our 500,000 sq ft Center for Excellence in Lifecycle Care features a Level-IV depot and aero repair facility, which executes comprehensive services for aeroderivative engines under one roof.
  
  
In
**Kansas City**
, we have an office with an Engineering team that supports our sought-after solutions for turnkey projects and contracted power.
  
  
And our
**worldwide service centers**
ensure local service expertise near our customers. Our expanding service footprint includes Phoenix, Buenos Aires, New Brunswick, and additional locations in Europe, Australia, and Southeast Asia.
  
  
**Our Philosophy**
We take care of our people and strive to make a positive difference for the world. We offer competitive pay, excellent benefits that include Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life/Disability Insurance at minimal cost to the employee, 10 paid holidays, paid time off, and a 401K plan. If you are looking for a rewarding career and possess specialized knowledge and quality-oriented problem-solving skills, we encourage you to apply today.
  
  
**Position Summary**
The Plant Superintendent serves as the interface between the asset owner (Origin Mine) or their agent, ProEnergy Services, and the plant O&M team to accomplish the safe operation of the asset while achieving reliability and availability goals. The Plant Superintendent is fully accountable for financial planning and control, provision of resources, compliance with regulatory requirements, and various communication and reporting requirements within the contractual terms of the O&M Agreement. Additionally, the plant Superintendent will manage the daily operations of the plant, directs the implementation of the Operating Plan, identifies those areas which may need improvement or further development, and is responsible for overseeing the maintenance and repair of plant facilities and equipment.
  
  
**Reports To:**
Director O&M
  
  
**Work Location:**
PJM Area
  
  
**Position Responsibilities**

* Develop long term operation plans and align daily activities to these objectives.
* Achieve safety, financial, reliability, availability and efficiency goals.
* Establish effective and sustainable operations.
* Establish a culture of compliance with contractual and regulatory requirements.
* Establish effective maintenance and outage planning and execution.
* Establish a culture of innovation and continuous improvement.
* Provide excellent customer satisfaction.

**Essential Job Functions**

* Build a strong team of motivated people to achieve business goals.
* Establish and maintain effective relationship with contacts to include the owner, the public and co-workers.
* Manages contract compliance requirements to include plant permits and related data collection and record keeping.
* Manages compliance with federal, state and local regulations, laws and practices.
* Interprets company policies to workers and enforces safety regulations.
* Reads, understands, and ensures compliance with all plant safety and regulatory procedures.
* Initiates plans to motivate workers to achieve work goals.
* Establish work management practices and monitor KPIs to ensure the process achieves plant goals.
* Establish budgets and control operating costs within budgetary constraints.
* Coordinate site activities with commercial function to optimize financial performance and risk.
* Collaborate with other PES plant Superintendents, Plant Managers, and company subject matter experts to coordinate activities and identify and spread best practices.
* Provide and utilize various financial, production, process and performance reports.
* Reviews purchase orders for parts, ensuring budgetary constraints are maintained.
* Establish procedures to procure and protect spare parts
* Contract services appropriate to achieve reliability and availability goals.
* Implements changes in working conditions and use of equipment to increase efficiency of plant or work crew.
* Reads, understand and assist staff with the use of technical manuals and system piping and instrumentation diagrams.
* Prepares or reviews work orders for required preventative and corrective maintenance.
* Assists workers in proactively identifying failing equipment and diagnosing malfunctions in machinery and equipment.
* Interprets specifications, blueprints, and job orders to workers, and assigns duties.
* Establishes or adjusts work procedures to meet maintenance schedules.
* Recommends and implements measures to improve methods, equipment performance, and quality of service.
* Analyzes and resolves work problems or assists workers in solving work problems.
* Directs workers engaged in dismantling, assembling, and installing industrial machinery.
* Develop schedules and estimates worker hour requirements for completion of job assignment.
* Create and maintain monthly production and performance report for owner
* Leads recruitment effort for Operations employment candidates and assures complete and proper professional safety training and orientation for the OMT members.
* Takes the lead in investigating and resolving all forced outages and operating irregularities. Reviews and makes recommendations to improve equipment availability, performance, and reliability.
* Develops and oversees training and qualification programs to maximize the effectiveness of the Operational staff. Provides overall coordination for Operational departments training and development including budgeting and scheduling.
