About the Role

Fawrit Technologies is looking for an **Operations Manager Intern** to support and coordinate day-to-day operations across our laundry partners, riders, customers, and internal technical team.

The role involves managing operational communication through WhatsApp and other communication channels, monitoring orders, coordinating pickups and deliveries, following up with laundry partners and riders, assisting customers, and ensuring operational issues are followed up and resolved efficiently.

This is a people-facing operations role that requires strong communication, responsiveness, ownership, problem-solving ability, and the ability to manage multiple tasks and follow-ups simultaneously.

Key Responsibilities1. Order & Operations Coordination

* Monitor incoming orders and ensure they move smoothly through the service process.
* Track orders from customer pickup through laundry processing to final delivery.
* Follow up on pending, delayed, or problematic orders.
* Coordinate with partners and riders to ensure timely order completion.
* Keep order information and status updates accurate in the system.
* Identify operational issues and take timely action or escalate them when required.

2. Estimates, Invoices & Payments

* Assist with preparing and sharing estimates with customers when required.
* Share invoices and payment links after confirming the necessary order details.
* Follow up on pending payments when required.
* Ensure payment and order-related information is accurately recorded.

3. Partner Coordination

* Communicate with laundry partners regarding orders, service progress, and operational requirements.
* Build and maintain professional relationships with existing partners.
* Understand partner concerns, requirements, and operational challenges.
* Coordinate with relevant internal teams to address partner issues.
* Communicate customer requirements and special instructions to partners.
* Assist with the coordination and onboarding of new partners when required.

4. Customer & Rider Coordination

* Communicate with customers regarding pickups, deliveries, order updates, and service-related queries.
* Coordinate with riders regarding pickup and delivery schedules.
* Communicate customer requests, changes, and important order information to riders.
* Follow up with riders to ensure pickups and deliveries are completed on time.
* Assist in resolving routine customer and rider concerns.
* Ensure customers receive timely updates regarding order status and delays.

5. Internal & Technical Coordination

* Coordinate with the internal technical team regarding operational or system-related issues.
* Clearly communicate reported issues, requirements, and customer or partner concerns.
* Follow up with the relevant team until the issue is addressed.
* Keep the manager updated on important operational issues.
* Escalate customer complaints, partner concerns, payment issues, rider problems, or unusual situations when necessary.

6. Communication & Follow-Up

* Manage multiple WhatsApp conversations and operational requests efficiently.
* Respond to customers and partners in a timely and professional manner.
* Maintain proper follow-up on unresolved issues.
* Ensure important conversations, customer requests, and operational requirements are not missed.
* Maintain accurate records of relevant operational activities.
* Provide regular updates on pending orders, operational challenges, and unresolved issues.

What We're Looking For

* Good verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills.
* Good organizational and time-management abilities.
* Ability to manage multiple conversations and tasks simultaneously.
* Basic computer and application-handling skills.
* Good attention to detail.
* Problem-solving ability and willingness to take ownership.
* Ability to remain calm and professional while handling operational issues.
* Ability to communicate professionally with customers, riders, and business partners.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced startup environment.
* Willingness to communicate through WhatsApp and other business communication channels.
* Ability to follow up on tasks independently and ensure issues are addressed.
* Willingness to work primarily from the office in Kalamassery, Kochi.

Internship Details

* **Duration:** 6 months.
* **Work Mode:** Hybrid, with work primarily conducted on-site at the Kochi office.
* **Working Hours:** 10:00 AM – 7:00 PM.
* **Monthly Stipend:** ₹5,000 – ₹10,000, determined based on the candidate's skills and performance during the interview.
* **Joining:** Immediate.

Full-Time Opportunity

Based on individual performance and business requirements, successful interns may be considered for a full-time opportunity upon completion of the internship, with a potential monthly compensation package of **₹20,000 – ₹40,000**.

Full-time conversion is not guaranteed and will depend on the intern's performance, demonstrated ownership, ability to handle the role independently, and the company's business requirements at that time.

Role Objective

The **Operations Manager Intern** will serve as a central coordination point between customers, riders, laundry partners, and the internal team.

The primary objective is to ensure that day-to-day operations run smoothly, communication is handled effectively, operational issues are followed up, and orders move efficiently from pickup to final delivery.

The intern is expected to demonstrate accountability, maintain clear communication, and proactively follow up on operational tasks to support a reliable customer experience.

description:
**Description**
Are you passionate about solving business challenges at a global scale? Amazon Retail Business Services is looking for an experienced Business Analyst to join our team and help unlock insights which take our business to the next level. The candidate will be excited about understanding and implementing new and repeatable processes to improve our employee global work authorization experiences. They will do this by partnering with key stakeholders to be curious and comfortable digging deep into the business challenges to understand and identify insights that will enable us to figure out standards to improve our ability to globally scale this program. They will be comfortable delivering/presenting these recommended solutions by retrieving and integrating artifacts in a format that is immediately useful to improve the business decision-making process. This role requires an individual with excellent analytical abilities as well as business acumen. The candidate knows and values our customers (internal and external) and will work back from the customer to create structured processes for global expansions of work authorization, and help integrate new countries/new acquisitions into the existing program. They are experts in partnering and earning trust with operations/business leaders to drive these key business decisions.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Design, develop, and maintain scalable dashboards, reporting systems, and automated data pipelines that support business reviews (WBR/MBR/QBR), pilot launches, and ongoing program governance.
* Own data infrastructure end-to-end—partner with tech, analytics, and operations teams to establish and maintain required tables, data lakes, and data structures that enable accurate and timely insights for APIE and related stakeholders.
* Retrieve, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple sources to produce actionable insights, KPI frameworks, and escalation deep dives that inform feature expansion, defect identification, and strategic decision-making.
* Develop and maintain SQL queries and analytical models to support APIE feature performance, ad-hoc requests, and dive-deep investigations for operational or customer/vendor escalations.
* Enable data-driven decision making by converting large datasets into digestible narratives, financial/CX estimates, and recommendations for pilots, experiments, and global expansions.
* Partner with cross-functional teams to understand requirements, build KPIs, automate processes, and drive data-aligned solutions that meet evolving business needs.
* Prepare and deliver business reviews and written narratives for senior leadership, highlighting progress, insights, risks, and decision points.
* Participate in strategic and tactical planning discussions, providing analytical input that shapes long-term product and operations strategy across global regions.

**About The Team**
About Amazon
  
  
Amazon strives to be Earth’s most customer-centric company, where customers can find and discover anything they want to buy online. Through continuous innovation in selection, convenience, and low prices, Amazon has grown from an online bookstore into a global e-commerce and technology leader. Our teams build solutions that improve how customers shop, how sellers grow, and how our global supply chain operates.
  
  
**About Retail Business Services (RBS)**
RBS strengthens Amazon’s retail engine by driving standardization, improving process quality, and reducing defects across global marketplaces. RBS operates at the intersection of retail, operations, technology, and finance, ensuring Amazon’s systems and processes scale reliably while maintaining a high-quality customer and selling-partner experience.
  
  
**About RBS IES**
RBS International Emerging Stores (IES) is a specialized organization within RBS focused on improving Amazon’s per-unit economics across the emerging countries supply chain. The team builds mechanisms that improve cost predictability, strengthen upstream defect visibility, and enable consistent governance across high-impact cost categories, contributing directly to improved Free Cash Flow and scalable business growth.

* 3+ years of business analyst, data analyst or similar role experience
* 5+ years of Excel (including VBA, pivot tables, array functions, power pivots, etc.) and data visualization tools such as Tableau experience
* 3+ years of business or financial analysis experience
* Experience defining requirements and using data and metrics to draw business insights
* Experience making business recommendations and influencing stakeholders
* 2+ years of Tableau Desktop, Quicksight or other relevant data visualization software experience
* Experience in tax, finance or a related analytical field, or experience in financial modeling, P&L management or analysis
* Knowledge of writing and optimizing SQL queries in a business environment with large-scale, complex datasets

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in business or analytical discipline

title: Executive - Financial Reporting
description:
**ABOUT XAPADS MEDIA**

Xapads Media is a global AdTech company providing programmatic and digital advertising solutions to brands, agencies, and app developers across international markets. https://www.xapads.com

**ABOUT THE SEGMENT**

The Accounts & Finance function at Xapads operates as an integrated team managing accounting, taxation, financial reporting, payroll, and financial controls across domestic and international operations. The Financial Reporting segment is responsible for turning accurate financial records into structured financial statements, period-end closures, management analysis, and statutory compliance documentation to ensure financial integrity, control, and visibility.

**THE ROLE**

The Executive - Financial Reporting will assist in the preparation of period-end and year-end financial statements, supporting schedules, and account reconciliations. This role ensures timely books closure, accurate financial disclosures, and reliable data analysis for management reporting and statutory audit support.

**WHAT YOU'LL OWN**

* Preparation and accuracy of year-end financial statements, financial schedules, reconciliations, and supporting working papers.
* Execution of tasks supporting month-end and year-end books closure and the finalization of accounts.
* Maintenance and updating of financial dashboards, analysis reports, and management documentation.
* Statutory and external audit support through complete, accurate audit schedules and financial documentation.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Assist in preparing period-end and year-end financial statements along with related supporting schedules and reconciliations.
* Support month-end and year-end books closure and the finalization of accounts.
* Analyze financial data to identify trends, variance drivers, discrepancies, and unusual account movements.
* Maintain and regularly update financial dashboards, management reporting schedules, and financial analysis files.
* Apply fundamental accounting principles and IFRS guidelines to financial reporting activities and working papers.
* Assist statutory auditors and external consultants by providing financial statements, schedules, reconciliations, and supporting documents.
* Identify continuous improvement opportunities within financial reporting processes to enhance reporting accuracy and controls.

**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**

* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in Commerce (B. Com), Master’s degree (M. Com), MBA in Finance, or CA Inter / CA IPCC qualification.
* **Experience:**
  3 – 4 years of hands-on experience in financial reporting and accounting.
* **Core Skills:**
  Experience in month-end and year-end books closure and financial statement compilation.
* **Reconciliation & Analysis:**
  Strong analytical capability with a track record of owning financial reconciliations and balance sheet schedules.
* **Tools & Software:**
  Working knowledge of MS Excel or Google Sheets, including formulas, Pivot Tables, and financial data analysis.
* **Domain Knowledge:**
  Proficiency in understanding of core financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet, Cash Flow) and accounting principles.
* **Execution & Accuracy:**
  Good attention to detail, accuracy, and the ability to meet strict period-end reporting deadlines.
* **Communication:**
  Good verbal and written communication skills to coordinate effectively with internal finance teams and external auditors.

**GOOD TO HAVE**

* Basic understanding or working knowledge of IFRS.
* Direct experience interacting with statutory auditors, consultants, or external accounting advisors.
* Hands-on experience developing or maintaining financial dashboards and MIS reports.
* Prior experience with international financial reporting will be an added advantage.
* Knowledge of statutory filings in the US, UK, Dubai or Singapore will be viewed favourably.

**WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE**

* Timely and accurate preparation of period-end and year-end financial statements, closure schedules, and ledger reconciliations.
* Seamless coordination with statutory auditors resulting in smooth audit cycles with complete documentation.
* Consistent delivery of reliable financial analysis and updated management dashboards to support finance leadership.

**LIFE AT XAPADS MEDIA**

At Xapads Media, we place a strong emphasis on employee growth and continuous development. Individuals are encouraged to build expertise, take ownership of their work, and explore areas that align with their interests over time.

Our culture supports collaboration, knowledge sharing, and open communication. Teams engage in ongoing discussions, exchange ideas, and contribute to broader conversations across the business.

We also value moments that bring teams together-recognising achievements, sharing progress, and building a sense of collective momentum.

To learn more about our culture and ways of working, visit: https://www.xapads.com/life-at-xapads

Noida, Uttar Pradesh

To apply for this position, send an email to our careers mailbox (careers@xapads.com). In the email make sure to include your resume and any additional information you would feel relevant for this role.

title: Senior Analyst - Credit Analytics
description:
**ABOUT US**

At OakNorth, we're on a mission to empower the UK's most ambitious businesses. Since 2015, we've lent over $21 billion across the UK and US, helped create more than 58,000 new homes and 36,000 new jobs, and supported hundreds of thousands of personal savers — all while fuelling the UK economy.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**

The Credit Analytics team sits at the heart of OakNorth's lending business, providing rigorous financial analysis and credit assessment across a diverse portfolio of commercial loan opportunities. We work closely with Debt Directors, Risk, and client-facing teams in the UK to ensure every lending decision is underpinned by deep analytical insight and a thorough understanding of the borrower's operating environment.

**ABOUT THE ROLE**

We're looking for a Senior Associate to join our Credit Analytics team, taking ownership of detailed loan analysis across sectors and geographies. You'll build financial models, draft concise and well-structured credit reports, conduct sensitivity and stress testing, and engage directly with clients to discuss data and analytical frameworks. This is a high-impact role for someone who combines strong financial acumen with sharp communication skills and a genuine curiosity for business and markets.

**WHAT YOU'LL DO**

* Conduct detailed analysis of loan opportunities across various sectors and geographies, developing a thorough understanding of each borrower's business and operating environment.
* Draft concise, well-structured credit reports with clear key takeaways for Credit and Risk to review and comment on.
* Build detailed financial models covering transaction details, financial statement analysis, projections, ratio analysis, and credit metrics.
* Conduct sensitivity analysis and stress testing on projections to assess loan serviceability under adverse scenarios.
* Identify deal-specific covenants that can serve as early warning signals for loan monitoring purposes.
* Conduct detailed industry and market studies to understand the operating environment of borrowers.
* Interact with clients to discuss data gaps, inconsistencies, and analytical frameworks; liaise with Debt Directors and other UK stakeholders throughout the credit process.

**YOU'LL BE A GREAT FIT IF YOU HAVE…**

* 1-3 years of relevant experience in credit analysis, financial analysis, or a related role within financial services.
* Strong financial analysis skills with a thorough understanding of accounting and financial concepts, including the ability to build and interrogate detailed financial models.
* Proven ability to draft clear, concise, and well-reasoned credit reports for senior stakeholders.
* Strong communication skills with confidence interacting with Debt Directors, clients, and other stakeholders across geographies.
* A proactive, results-driven mindset — curious, flexible, hands-on, and comfortable operating at pace in an environment where change is part of daily work.

**Nice to Have**

* MBA, PGDM, CA, or CFA from a reputed institute.
* Experience conducting industry or market studies across multiple sectors.
* Prior exposure to covenant structuring or loan monitoring frameworks.

**WHAT WE OFFER**

* **Health & Protection:** Comprehensive medical cover for you, your family, and parents, along with life and accidental insurance cover at a multiple of your salary.
* **Wellbeing:** Annual health check-ups, online doctor consultations, pharmacy discounts, nutritionist support, and Employee Assistance Program (EAP) services — all sponsored by OakNorth.
* **Time Off:** Earned leave, casual/sick leave, public holidays, maternity leave, and paternity leave.
* **Life Milestones:** Financial support for important life events such as marriage, childbirth, and bereavement.
* **Flexible Benefits:** Tax-efficient allowances for internet, fuel, meals, leave travel, and National Pension System (NPS) contributions.
* **Growth & Development:** Support for professional certifications, learning and development opportunities, childcare benefits, and paid volunteering days.
* **Our Workplace:** Modern, centrally located offices, weekly business updates, team events, and great coffee. We work hard to build a culture worth showing up for.

title: Corporate Strategy Analyst
description:
ERM is the world’s largest specialist sustainability consultancy, with more than 50 years of experience helping organisations navigate complex environmental, social, and governance (ESG) challenges. We bring together a diverse and inclusive community of experts across regions and disciplines, fostering collaboration, professional growth, and meaningful global exposure. As a people-first organisation, ERM values well-being, career development, and the power of collective expertise to drive sustainable impact for our clients — and the planet.
  
  
**ERM Global Delivery Centre (GDC)**
We Deliver. We Synergise. We Innovate.

Ready to help shape the strategic direction of a global market leader? Join ERM's newly established Corporate Strategy team and work alongside senior leaders to evaluate growth opportunities, assess investment priorities, and deliver insights that influence executive and Board-level decision-making. * Experience in corporate development, M&A, private equity, or transaction advisory environments.
* Exposure to global organizations and matrixed operating environments.

**Key Responsibilities:**

title: Controllership Transformation - Core - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**EY GDS FAAS (Controllership Transformation) - Senior position**
**The opportunity**
Financial Accounting Advisory Services (FAAS) professionals provide advisory services including Accounting and regulatory support for accounting change and special matters; accounting processes and controls support.
  
  
Within EY FAAS practice, the Finance Transformation Experts team build and develop client relationship with our regional stakeholders. We are part of an integrated global network of professionals who develop, design and optimise client service business processes for efficiency and high performance. We leverage and improve various frameworks, methodologies, solutions specific to our offerings and articulate presentations that communicate proposals, strategies, plans and outcomes.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Delivery and Subject Matter Expertise -**

* Drive transformation initiatives across Record-to-Report (R2R) processes by leveraging deep techno-functional expertise. Lead end-to-end process improvements and strategic interventions, beyond system implementation, acting as a transformation lead (not PMO).
* Own and lead transformation across key R2R process areas, including:

+ Revenue Recognition
+ Accruals
+ Intercompany Reconciliation
+ Manual Journal Entries and Automation
+ Asset Accounting
+ Chart of Accounts & Accounting Master Data
+ Account Reconciliation (e.g., Cash & Bank, Sales)
+ Subledger Accounting
+ Consolidation
+ Financial Statement Preparation and Filing
+ Notes and Disclosures
+ Cost Accounting & Inventory
+ Profitability Analysis

* Provide subject matter expertise and lead delivery teams in R2R transformation and implementation programs, ensuring alignment with business objectives and regulatory requirements.
* Support the design and integration of ERP platforms with AI-based solutions, including defining and implementing AI use cases within R2R processes (especially within SAP-based environments).
* Drive consolidation process design and execution, including:

+ Defining consolidation data structures
+ Managing mapping between operational COA and Group COA / FS items
+ Ensuring effective use of tools such as SAP Group Reporting, SAP BPC, Oracle FCCS

* Lead the workstreams or delivery teams within large transformation programs, ensuring timely delivery, quality outcomes, and stakeholder alignment.
* Define and implement AI-driven solutions and automation opportunities in R2R processes, evaluating available tools and driving their practical application in enterprise environments.
* Responsible for decision-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.

**Business Development & Solution Development -**

* Lead pursuit teams to understand client problem statements & formulate that in solutions
* Lead developing client specific solutions for the engagement team
* Lead proposal development or lead proposal teams
* Lead collaboration with market teams to develop relationship and drive business growth for EY
* Collaborate cross service lines to ensure smooth execution of the project.
* Lead development of internal capability development and lead training sessions to coach internal teams to develop capability
* Lead operational initiatives within the practice areas.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**
**Subject Matter and Technical Skills -**

* Deep knowledge in Record to report, invoice to pay and Order to cash areas
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in ERPs like SAP S/4 HANA FI/CO/COPA, SAP Central Finance, Oracle Fusion Finance, Oracle Netsuite
* Certification and/or sound experience based knowledge in digital finance solutions like Blackline, Trintech, High Radius, Different RPA solutions
* Knowledge about AI/ML/Gen-AI & Analytics solution in finance space particularly in Record to Report areas.
* Knowledge of consolidation, reporting, inter-company and ERP data structures
* Have experience in current state analysis (As is), future state analysis (To be), process optimization, data optimization, data analytics, data management

**Business Skills And Knowledge –**

* Strong business development skills
* Very strong solution conceptualization/ideation skill
* Strong solution/product build skills
* Strong project management skills

**Human Skills –**

* Excellent written & oral communication & articulation
* Flexible work attitude
* Proven ability to lead diverse team over multiple geographies
* Strong collaboration skills
* Ability to comprehend complexity quickly & apply solutions
* Comfort in dealing with ambiguity
* Strong entrepreneurial skills in terms of ownership of problem & solutions
* Strong problem solving skills
* Ability to perform effectively under pressure and deliver results
* Willingness to travel for short or long duration at short notice

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* CA, MBA (Finance) with Commerce Background, CWA, CMA, CFA, M.Com
* 2-4 Years of relevant consulting experience in record to report transformation (not Industry user experience)
* Experience of working with international clients preferred
* Experience with previous multinational consulting firms or Big4 firms

**What Working At EY Offers**
At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
  
  
You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
  
  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you

**EY | Building a better working world**
EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
  
  
Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
  
  
Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Strategy Associate- Clinical
description:
Strategy Associate – Clinical Services,

Research & Evaluation

Department: CEO’s Office

Location: Kolkata, West Bengal

Employment Type: Full-Time

Experience: Minimum 5 years

Compensation: Up to ₹10 LPA

Qualification: MA/MSc in Psychology

Role Overview

India Autism Center (IAC) is building an integrated ecosystem of clinical services, vocational

development, research, training, and residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families.

We are looking for a Strategy Associate with a background in psychology, research, and

programme evaluation to strengthen strategic performance monitoring across IAC, with a

specialist focus on clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy, learning and

development, and research.

You will play a key role in evaluating programme effectiveness, service quality, implementation

progress, resource utilisation, and outcomes. The role will combine quantitative and qualitative

analysis with structured performance reviews to identify gaps, assess underlying causes,

recommend improvements, and monitor follow-through.

Key Responsibilities

1. Strategic Performance Monitoring

● Monitor departmental plans, programmes, and organisation-wide strategic priorities

against agreed objectives, deliverables, quality standards, resource requirements,

budgets, and timelines.

● Review progress across clinical services, vocational programmes, the training academy,

learning and development, and research.

● Monitor relevant indicators such as programme milestones, service quality, participant

outcomes, staff training effectiveness, research deliverables, and implementation

progress.

● Identify deviations from planned outcomes, analyse underlying causes, and track agreed

corrective actions.

2. Strategic Evaluation & Review

● Develop or apply monitoring and evaluation frameworks, performance indicators,

evaluation criteria, and reporting mechanisms across departments, programmes,

projects, and strategic initiatives.

● Assess programme implementation, service quality, participant outcomes, training

effectiveness, research progress, and adherence to established standards, as

applicable.

● Review relevant workflows, documentation, assessment processes, referral pathways,

follow-up mechanisms, and service continuity within the scope of established protocols.

● Identify recurring gaps, implementation bottlenecks, and opportunities for improvement;

prepare evidence-based findings and recommendations.

● Coordinate internal reviews and audits where required, document observations, and

track agreed corrective actions through closure.

3. Policies, Systems & Process Implementation

● Identify gaps in organisational and programme systems and support the development of

appropriate structures, policies, SOPs, workflows, indicators, and accountability

mechanisms.

● Map and evaluate programme workflows, participant journeys, research processes,

training pathways, and service-delivery mechanisms.

● Monitor the adoption and effectiveness of established processes across relevant

departments.

● Evaluate the implementation of evidence-based practices and staff development

initiatives, where applicable.

4. Risk Monitoring & Management

● Monitor risks relating to programme implementation, service quality, documentation,

research milestones, staff capacity, resource constraints, and delivery timelines.

● Maintain relevant risk registers and track mitigation plans in collaboration with

accountable teams.

● Identify emerging risks, recurring quality concerns, and deviations from established

standards.

● Escalate material concerns to the leadership and monitor agreed mitigation actions

through closure.

● Respect confidentiality, ethical research requirements, and responsible handling of

participant and organisational data.

5. Research, Data Analysis & Leadership Reporting

● Consolidate quantitative and qualitative data from relevant departments and assess its

completeness, consistency, and usefulness for decision-making.

● Analyse participant feedback, programme outcomes, service-quality indicators, training

results, research milestones, and other relevant evidence.

● Prepare dashboards, evaluation reports, management summaries, and presentations for

departmental and organisation-wide reviews.

● Translate findings into clear insights and practical recommendations for leadership.

6. Cross-functional Coordination & Accountability

● Work with clinical, vocational, training, research, learning and development, and

operational teams to review performance and understand implementation challenges.

● Facilitate periodic reviews, document agreed actions, identify accountable owners, and

monitor completion against deadlines.

● Identify dependencies between programme teams and other organisational functions

that may affect delivery.

● Escalate persistent performance gaps, unresolved actions, and material risks through

the established reporting structure.

Key Outcomes

● Reliable evidence on programme effectiveness, service quality, research progress, and

organisational performance.

● Stronger visibility into departmental progress against agreed objectives, quality

standards, resource requirements, and timelines.

● Early identification of implementation gaps, risks, and recurring performance issues.

● More consistent use of monitoring and evaluation frameworks and evidence-based

recommendations.

● Stronger implementation of organisational systems, documentation standards, and

improvement actions.

● Timely, accurate reports that support leadership decisions and continuous improvement.

Must-have Requirements

● 5 years of relevant experience in monitoring and evaluation, programme evaluation,

research, quality assurance, clinical or educational operations, or service-quality

management.

● MA/MSc in Psychology or a related discipline.

● Demonstrated ability to interpret quantitative and qualitative data and evaluate

programme or organisational performance.

● Experience preparing reports, reviewing processes, documenting findings, and

recommending improvements.

● Strong analytical, research, documentation, communication, and

stakeholder-coordination skills.

● Proficiency in spreadsheets, data analysis, and reporting tools.

● Ability to work collaboratively with multidisciplinary teams and follow through on agreed

actions.

● Understanding of confidentiality and ethical handling of sensitive information.

Preferred Skills

● Experience with monitoring and evaluation frameworks, logic models, outcome

measurement, or programme evaluation.

● Familiarity with clinical, educational, vocational, psychosocial, or disability-service

settings.

● Exposure to research methodologies, statistical analysis, and qualitative data analysis.

● Knowledge of quality assurance, service standards, assessment protocols, or

evidence-based practices.

● Experience evaluating training, competency development, or programme

implementation.

● Experience working in healthcare, education, research, non-profit, or social-impact

organisations.

About India Autism Center

India Autism Center is a not-for-profit organisation building a comprehensive ecosystem of

support, training, research, and lifelong residential living for individuals on the autism spectrum

and their families. IAC works towards greater independence, dignity, belonging, and quality of

life for individuals and families across India.

title: Senior Tax Associate
description:
**Company Description:**
US Tax Experts LLC is a specialized tax advisory and compliance firm focused on delivering accurate, timely, and client-centered tax services. The organization supports individuals and businesses with a range of U.S. tax filing, planning, and advisory solutions. Team members collaborate to interpret complex tax regulations and apply them to real-world client situations. The firm values integrity, professional growth, and continuous learning to keep pace with evolving tax laws and compliance requirements.

**Role Description:**
This role involves preparing and reviewing U.S. tax returns for individuals and businesses, ensuring accuracy and adherence to current tax laws and regulations. The Senior Tax Associate will analyze financial information, identify tax-saving opportunities, and provide clear guidance to clients on tax obligations and planning strategies. Daily responsibilities include managing client documentation, coordinating with internal teams, resolving tax-related queries, and staying current with changes in tax legislation and compliance standards. The role also includes mentoring junior team members and supporting process improvements to increase efficiency and service quality.

**Key Requirements:**

**•       Strong experience in U.S. individual & business tax preparation/review**

**•       Hands-on experience with Forms 1040, 1040NR, 1116, 2555, FBAR, 8938, 8858, 8621 & 5471**

**•       Knowledge of Forms 5472, 8865, 3520 & 3520-A**
preferred

•       Strong understanding of U.S. tax laws and international/expatriate taxation

•       Excellent analytical, communication, and problem-solving skills

•       Ability to review work and mentor junior team members.

•       Experience with
**ProSeries, CCH, or similar tax software**
is a plus

•       EA/CPA/CA/ACCA qualification is an advantage.

📍
**Location:**
Kolkata | Bengaluru | Surat

💼
**Position:**
Full-time | On-site

🎯
**Experience:**
5–8 years

* If you’re passionate about U.S. taxation and looking for an opportunity to work on complex international tax matters,
  **we’d love to hear from you!**

title: Purchasing Manager
description:
Location, Newtown Kolkata

We are looking for an experienced
**Purchase Manager**
to manage procurement activities across departments, build reliable vendor relationships, negotiate competitive pricing, and ensure timely and cost-effective purchasing.

Key Responsibilities

* Manage and coordinate purchase and procurement activities across departments.
* Collect and consolidate purchase requirements from the Accounts team and other departments.
* Identify, evaluate, and onboard vendors based on quality, pricing, reliability, and delivery timelines.
* Negotiate pricing, payment terms, credit periods, and delivery schedules.
* Prepare and manage purchase orders, quotations, comparative statements, and procurement documents.
* Coordinate with Accounts for budget availability, invoice verification, payment processing, and financial documentation.
* Track purchase orders, deliveries, pending supplies, and vendor commitments.
* Ensure compliance with company policies, approved budgets, and authorization procedures.
* Maintain accurate records of vendors, purchase orders, invoices, and procurement expenses.
* Identify cost-saving opportunities and improve procurement processes.
* Prepare regular reports on expenditure, pending orders, vendor performance, and cost savings.

Requirements

* Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related field.
* Relevant experience in purchase management, procurement, or vendor management.
* Strong negotiation, communication, coordination, and analytical skills.
* Working knowledge of purchase orders, quotations, invoices, GST documentation, and vendor payments.
* Proficiency in MS Excel or Google Sheets; knowledge of ERP or accounting software is an advantage.
* Ability to manage multiple requests and prioritize requirements across departments.
* High attention to detail, integrity, and financial accountability.

Preferred Candidate Profile

* Experience managing procurement for multiple departments.
* Familiarity with coordinating purchases across Accounts, Administration, Engineering, Inventory, and Operations.
* Ability to establish structured procurement processes, maintain transparency, and ensure value for money.

title: Area Manager-RCU
description:

Education

title: Oracle Fusion - Tax Technology Services II
description:
**Summary**
**Position Summary**
**Oracle Fusion Tax – Consultant, Tax Technology Services**
**Deloitte Tax Services India Private Limited**
commenced operations in June 2004. Since then, nearly all the Deloitte Tax LLP (“Deloitte Tax”) U.S. service lines have obtained support through Deloitte Tax in India. Deloitte Tax in India offers you opportunities to learn and support U.S. and other countries (such as the Netherlands, United Kingdom etc.) taxation practice, a popular career option.
  
  
**At Deloitte**
, we are leading clients through the tax transformation taking place in the marketplace. We offer a broad range of fully integrated tax services and
**add greater impact to clients**
by
**combining technology and tax technical**
resources to uncover insights and smarter solutions for navigating an increasingly complex global environment.
  
  
**Work you’ll do**
We are looking for dynamic professionals that are looking to broaden their careers in Tax and Oracle. As you build your career with us in Oracle within our Tax ERP team, you will be helping our clients to design, develop and implement systems architecture that best meets their business needs, in the rapidly changing tax and legal landscape.
  
  
You will be working alongside an experienced and growing team, to support our clients in ensuring that they have the right data, business processes and systems set-up for the future. You would be required to coordinate with the UK engagement leaders and clients to implement ERP Tax solutions in Oracle.
  
  
To be successful in this role, you should be able to align the global Tax and Legal landscape with the business’ activities and proposed wider business processes. You will be the lynchpin between the Tax Function and IT Function, ensuring that we build the best Oracle design for Tax for the client. This will require the ability to explain complex terms to a variety of different stakeholders, and in a way that is relevant to each stakeholder group.
  
  
**Your Team**
Within Tax Technology Consulting sits our NSE USI Tax ERP team who specialize in implementing tax requirements within finance transformation programmes or system remediation programmes. We are a fast-growing team with a super-growth ambition. We undertake Oracle Cloud implementations in ERP, and these need a combination of Tax knowledge and Oracle solution design capabilities. Tax in Finance Transformations is a key differentiator for our practice globally.
  
  
As a Tax-focused Oracle Consultant, you will be part of the tax workstream on our engagements. You will have plenty of opportunities to work on large-scale projects as part of complex business transformations. You will work with a wide range of colleagues and clients around the world, exposing you to cutting edge tax technology work in a strategic, commercial, and business context. You will find opportunities to apply an impressive range of broad consulting and functional skills that will enhance your career.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Knowledgeable about the Oracle applications functionality, with experience in Oracle Tax, in Cloud and/or eBS
* Familiar with Oracle Cloud tools, templates and methods, and finance transformation delivery models (e.g., Waterfall, Agile)
* Work as part of the project team to analyse the client’s tax and business requirements and build the optimal Oracle Tax design or supplement with the right mix of alternative technology solutions such as indirect tax determination engines, indirect tax compliance technology, or offline processes
* Work alongside the project team to assess the key tax touchpoints across the end-to-end business processes and address the client’s particular tax requirements
* Work with the project team to document new requirements, finalize system design, complete system integration testing and support user acceptance testing
* Able to think logically while solving problems and present clear recommendations to our clients as part of suggested resolution
* Work with Oracle Support to address system issues/ bugs and present a workable solution which addresses the client’s requirement
* Provide regular updates to key stakeholders on product development processes, costs and budgets, achievements against plan etc.
* Mentor and train junior colleagues in the team
* Participate in development and delivery of training sessions either to the client or internally across the team
* Work effectively in diverse teams within an inclusive team culture where people are recognized for their contribution
* Continually research current and emerging functionality (Oracle or others) and propose changes as part of Deloitte’s Oracle offering
* Help build internal efficiencies and accelerators for the proposition

**Required-**

* MBA or Chartered Accountant or bachelor’s in finance/ technology from reputed University with overall experience in Finance, Accounting and/ or Taxation
* Proficient in Oracle Fusion (experience of 4-7 years in Fusion & eBS combined) and/ or Oracle eBusiness Suite for Tax
* Experience in project implementation lifecycle (requirements gathering, design, build, test, go-live and support) with at least 2-3 end-to-end implementations of Oracle ERP for tax
* Client-facing experience required i.e., experience in handling clients on day-to-day basis during requirement gathering to User Acceptance Testing phase
* Basic accounting knowledge
* Ability to understand client requirements, develop and suggest appropriate solution or workarounds in Oracle
* Able to work with Oracle support to flag/fix issues – raising SRs and conducting OWC to explain problems and discuss workarounds
* Proficient in preparing client-ready project deliverables i.e., requirement framework documents, key design decision documents, configuration documents, functional specification documents, test scripts and training guides
* Has knowledge of configuration migration through “Rapid Implementation Spreadsheet” and data migration through Oracle tools like ADFDi, Desktop Integrator, FBDi templates
* Proficient in planning work as per deadline and coordinating with the team to complete work within stipulated deadline
* Comfortable communicating with members from other workstreams and able to collaborate to discuss and test solutions which has cross-workstream dependencies
* Equipped with basic presentation skills, has an analytical approach to issues and able to analyse queries and respond to questions
* Superior verbal and written communication skills in English

**Preferred**

* Some knowledge of SQL script, OTBI and/ or BI Publisher would be preferable
* Experience of other Oracle modules and processes, and knowledge of tax touchpoints in other Oracle modules e.g., Payables, Receivables, Fixed Assets, General Ledger, Consolidation

**Our purpose**
Deloitte’s purpose is to make an impact that matters for our people, clients, and communities. At Deloitte, purpose is synonymous with how we work every day. It defines who we are. Our purpose comes through in our work with clients that enables impact and value in their organizations, as well as through our own investments, commitments, and actions across areas that help drive positive outcomes for our communities.
  
  
**Our people and culture**
Our inclusive culture empowers our people to be who they are, contribute their unique perspectives, and make a difference individually and collectively. It enables us to leverage different ways of thinking, ideas and perspectives, and bring more creativity and innovation to help solve our clients’ most complex challenges. This makes Deloitte one of the most rewarding places to work.
  
  
**Professional development**
At Deloitte, professionals have the opportunity to work with some of the best and discover what works best for them. Here, we prioritize professional growth, offering diverse learning and networking opportunities to help accelerate careers and enhance leadership skills. Our state-of-the-art DU: The Leadership Center in India, located in Hyderabad, represents a tangible symbol of our commitment to the holistic growth and development of our people. Explore DU: The Leadership Center in India .
  
  
**Benefits To Help You Thrive**
At Deloitte, we know that great people make a great organization. Our comprehensive rewards program helps us deliver a distinctly Deloitte experience that helps that empowers our professionals to thrive mentally, physically, and financially—and live their purpose. To support our professionals and their loved ones, we offer a broad range of benefits. Eligibility requirements may be based on role, tenure, type of employment and/ or other criteria. Learn more about what working at Deloitte can mean for you.
  
  
**Recruiting tips**
From developing a stand out resume to putting your best foot forward in the interview, we want you to feel prepared and confident as you explore opportunities at Deloitte. Check out recruiting tips from Deloitte recruiters.

title: Lead Anaplan Model Builder
description:
As the global leader in high-speed connectivity, Ciena is committed to a people-first approach. Our teams enjoy a culture focused on prioritizing a flexible work environment that empowers individual growth, well-being, and belonging. We’re a technology company that leads with our humanity—driving our business priorities alongside meaningful social, community, and societal impact.
  
  
Ciena’s Business Financial Data Modeler role contributes to digital transformation initiatives by enabling business planning and financial insight through Anaplan. The role connects data, processes, and business requirements across functional teams to support integrated planning and business decision-making. Collaboration with global stakeholders is central to delivering scalable planning solutions.
  
  
**How You Will Make An Impact**

* Design and document Anaplan models, including process maps, user guides, and solution design documentation.
* Translate business requirements, Excel models, and user stories into scalable Anaplan solutions using appropriate dimensions, hierarchies, and line items.
* Build Hub-Spoke and ALM model structures and develop user experience pages using the New UX (NUX).
* Identify and define data requirements with subject matter experts to enable new and enhanced planning capabilities.
* Collaborate with business architects, solution architects, Anaplan team members, and functional stakeholders to align solution design with business needs.
* Develop test cases and execute user acceptance testing (UAT) and functional validation activities.
* Apply Ciena and Anaplan model-building best practices while managing stakeholders across multiple business functions.

**The must haves**

* Education: Bachelor’s degree or higher.
* Total Experience: 7+ years of overall professional experience, preferably in data analysis, business analysis, financial planning, or related fields.
* Anaplan Modelling: 5+ years of hands-on Anaplan modelling experience or experience completing at least 5 end-to-end Anaplan implementations.
* Data Analysis / Business Analysis: Relevant experience translating business requirements into analytical or planning solutions.
* Database Experience: 3+ years of experience working with databases.
* Excel: 3+ years of experience working with Excel, including data analysis, modelling, and working with complex spreadsheets.
* Certification: Anaplan Solution Architect certification or higher.
* Business and Functional Knowledge: Experience with forecasting processes and business functions, including Sales, Operations, and Finance.
* Core Competencies: Critical thinking, analytical problem-solving, stakeholder management, collaboration, attention to detail, and familiarity with Agile methodologies.
* Work Schedule: Willingness to work in UK business hours (UK shift).

**Nice to haves**

* Demonstrated initiative while working with limited direction and aggressive deadlines.
* Ability to make decisions and manage competing and changing priorities.
* Ability to communicate effectively and tailor messaging to different audiences.
* Ability to work independently and within multidisciplinary teams.
* Ability to build trusted working relationships across multiple locations.
* Interest in innovation, market developments, and problem-solving.
* Interest in coaching and mentorship.

At Ciena, we are committed to building and fostering an environment in which our employees feel respected, valued, and heard. Ciena values the diversity of its workforce and respects its employees as individuals. We do not tolerate any form of discrimination.
  
  
Ciena is an Equal Opportunity Employer, including disability and protected veteran status.
  
  
If contacted in relation to a job opportunity, please advise Ciena of any accommodation measures you may require.

title: Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory
description:

Your impact
  
  
The Specialist - Aviation Strategic Advisory will lead the development and delivery of strategic advisory services for airports, governments, investors, airport operators, and infrastructure developers. The role will support clients in making informed decisions on airport development, expansion, investment, commercialization, privatization, airport city development, and long-term aviation growth strategies.
  
  
The position will work closely with Jacobs' Aviation Planning, Infrastructure, Urban Development/Cities, and Solution Center teams to provide integrated solutions across the airport development lifecycle while supporting the growth of Jacobs' Aviation Advisory business.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Strategic Advisory**

* Lead aviation strategy, airport development, and business planning assignments.
* Advise clients on airport growth, capacity expansion, and long-term development strategies.
* Develop airport city, aerotropolis, and land development strategies.
* Support aviation policy, market assessment, and infrastructure planning studies.
* Provide strategic recommendations to airport operators, governments, and investors.

**Commercial & Investment Advisory**

* Support airport privatization, PPP, concession, and transaction advisory assignments.
* Develop business cases, investment assessments, and growth strategies.
* Evaluate commercial opportunities, land monetization, and non-aeronautical revenue initiatives.
* Conduct strategic due diligence and investment attractiveness assessments.

**Market & Economic Analysis**

* Lead aviation market studies, traffic forecasts, catchment assessments, and benchmarking exercises.
* Assess airport competitiveness, connectivity, and economic impact.
* Support scenario planning and long-term demand assessments.

**Client Engagement & Business Development**

* Develop and maintain relationships with key aviation stakeholders.
* Support proposal preparation, pursuits, and client presentations.
* Identify and develop new aviation advisory opportunities.
* Represent Jacobs at client workshops, industry forums, and strategic engagements.

**Project Leadership**

* Manage multidisciplinary project teams and advisory assignments.
* Ensure quality, commercial performance, and timely delivery of projects.
* Mentor and support the development of junior team members.

**Key Clients**

* Airport Operators and Developers
* Government and Civil Aviation Authorities
* Infrastructure Funds and Investors
* Airport City and Real Estate Developers
* Airlines and Aviation Stakeholders
* Multilateral Agencies and Financial Institutions

Here's what you'll need
  
  
**Experience**

* 10-15+ years of experience in aviation consulting, airport planning, infrastructure advisory, strategy consulting, or airport development.
* Demonstrated experience delivering airport strategy, business planning, investment, or development advisory projects.
* Proven ability to engage with senior stakeholders, clients, and multidisciplinary teams.

Core Competencies
  
  

* Aviation Strategy & Airport Development
* Airport Economics & Business Planning
* Commercial & Investment Advisory
* Airport City & Land Development
* Market Analysis & Forecasting
* Business Development & Client Management
* Strategic Thinking & Problem Solving
* Team Leadership & Stakeholder Engagement

**Essential**
Bachelor's degree in Aviation, Engineering, Transport Planning, Urban Planning, Economics, Business, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Preferred**
Master's degree in Aviation Management, Transport Planning, Economics, Urban Development, Infrastructure Finance, or MBA.
  
  
At Jacobs we value people. Having the right balance of belonging, career and lifestyle enables us to consistently deliver and exceed clients’ expectations.
  
  
Working alongside industry leaders, you will have the opportunity to develop your career working on key projects in an environment which encourages collaboration, knowledge sharing and innovation. We empower employees with our hybrid working policy, allowing them to split their work week between Jacobs offices/projects and remote locations enabling them to deliver their best work.
  
  
Your application experience is important to us, and we’re keen to adapt to make every interaction even better. If you require further support or reasonable adjustments with regards to the recruitment process (for example, you require the application form in a different format), please contact the team via Careers Support.

title: SAP FI - Senior
description:

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

**Consulting – FI Senior Consultant**

Global Delivery Services refers to EY's worldwide network of service delivery centers. The GDS team plays an important role in EY’s strategy by ensuring effective support to EY’s growth agenda.
  
  
Our journey started in 2002 with approximately 200 people. Today we stand at 80,000+ professionals in ten locations around the world. We operate in Argentina, China, Hungary, India, Philippines, Poland, Sri Lanka, Mexico, Spain and the United Kingdom.

Markets, BMC, AWS, Finance and Accounting, Risk Management, Procurement, People Shared Services, IT Service Delivery and IT Global Infrastructure services, are among the services offered by Enablement Services.
  
  
Our innovation specialists serve the GDS Client Service and Enablement Services teams, along with Service Lines, Core Business Services and Sectors. The team brings the desired environment, technologies and skilled teams together for facilitation, rapid prototyping and innovative thinking. The competencies offered include analytics, digital, user experience, mobile technology, infrastructure, Microsoft technologies and open innovation.
  
  
**The Opportunity**
EY Consulting is a fast-moving, high-growth area with huge potential. We are currently recruiting for a Seniors to join our team. This team offers variety, challenge, responsibility and the opportunity to realize your leadership potential. Being a member of our Consulting team means you will specialize in a particular competency - Risk, Technology Consulting, or IT Risk & Assurance. Our Technology Consulting team is focused on helping clients improve operational efficiency and security, while also reducing costs and managing risk.
  
  
In this role we are looking for an experienced
**SAP FI Senior Consultant**
to join our growing SAP Finance team. In this role, you will lead and support SAP FI design, configuration, and implementation activities across a range of projects. **Job Title:**
Principal Officer – GIFT City

**Location:**
Gandhinagar

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced professional to lead and oversee the operations of our GIFT IFSC entity, a fintech-led broker-dealer business focused primarily on providing access to US-listed equities and Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).

The Principal Officer will be responsible for overseeing business operations, ensuring adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, maintaining robust governance and internal controls, and coordinating with regulatory authorities and key business partners. The role requires a strong understanding of securities markets, brokerage operations, regulatory requirements, and cross-border trading arrangements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Operations & Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee the overall operations of the GIFT IFSC entity and ensure adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, guidelines, circulars, and directions.
* Establish and maintain robust operating procedures, governance frameworks, and internal controls.
* Ensure timely completion of applicable regulatory filings, reporting, disclosures, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with senior management, compliance, risk, finance, technology, and operations teams to ensure effective business functioning.

**2. US Equities & ETF Brokerage**

* Oversee operational processes supporting access to US-listed equities and ETFs.
* Monitor trade execution arrangements, trade confirmations, clearing and settlement, custody, reconciliation, and corporate actions, as applicable to the business model.
* Manage coordination with overseas brokers, custodians, banking partners, and other intermediaries.
* Ensure appropriate controls around client accounts, transaction processing, operational exceptions, and service delivery.

**3. Risk Management & Internal Controls**

* Identify and manage operational, regulatory, counterparty, settlement, and business risks.
* Monitor adherence to internal policies, approved procedures, escalation protocols, and risk controls.
* Drive resolution of operational issues, control gaps, audit observations, and regulatory findings.
* Support business continuity planning and periodic reviews of operational effectiveness.

**4. Compliance & Client Protection**

* Work closely with the designated Compliance Officer to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and legal requirements.
* Oversee operational support for client onboarding, KYC, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and customer due diligence.
* Ensure effective grievance management, incident escalation, record maintenance, and appropriate reporting.
* Promote a strong compliance culture across the organisation.

**5. Regulatory & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a key point of coordination with IFSCA and other relevant stakeholders in relation to the Principal Officer's responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, information requests, and remediation activities.
* Track regulatory developments affecting the GIFT IFSC entity and ensure appropriate implementation.
* Provide periodic updates to senior management on business operations, regulatory matters, risks, and control effectiveness.

**Candidate Profile**

* Relevant professional or postgraduate qualification in finance, law, accountancy, business management, commerce, economics, capital markets, banking, insurance, actuarial science, fintech, science, technology, engineering, or mathematics, or another qualification permitted under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Experience in financial services, capital markets, securities brokerage, or a regulated financial-services business, meeting the applicable IFSCA eligibility requirements.
* Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, operational governance, risk controls, and securities-market processes.
* Exposure to US equities, ETFs, international brokerage, global market access, or cross-border securities operations is highly desirable.
* Experience managing external stakeholders, audits, regulatory reporting, and operational teams.
* Strong ownership, decision-making, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to work from GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

**Preferred Background**

* Principal Officer or senior operations professional from a GIFT IFSC-registered broker-dealer or global-access business.
* Professionals from international brokerages, securities-market intermediaries, or fintech platforms offering global investment access.
* Candidates with hands-on experience in regulatory oversight, international trading operations, and coordination with overseas market intermediaries.

**At Angel One, our thriving culture is rooted in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).**

*As an Equal opportunity employer, we wholeheartedly welcome people from all backgrounds irrespective of caste, religion, gender, marital status, sexuality, disability, class or age to be part of our team.*

*We believe that everyone's unique experiences and viewpoints make us stronger together.*

*Come and be a part of #OneSpace\*, where your individuality is celebrated and embraced.*

TigMaan is a growing organization focused on building efficient, customer-centric operations for e-commerce marketplaces such as Amazon. The company emphasizes reliable order fulfillment, accurate product listing, and strong customer support to help partner brands succeed online. Team members are encouraged to take ownership of their work, collaborate across functions, and contribute ideas to improve processes.

**Role Description

TigMaan is seeking an experienced Amazon Marketplace Specialist to manage marketplace operations, advertising campaigns, product listings, competitive pricing, sales performance, and profitability.

* Minimum educational qualification: high school diploma or equivalent; a degree in business, commerce, or a related field is beneficial.

title: Sr. Associate, Global Treasury Risk
description:
**The Opportunity**
Under moderate supervision, provide support to finance function. Responsible for daily transactions, including expenses and payroll. Process payments, maintain cost reports and manage invoices. Update financial spreadsheets with daily transactions, prepare balance sheets and track and reconcile bank statements.
  
  
Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced
**Sr. Associate**
**with solid experience to manage various Credit Management and Supplier Management-related activities within the Treasury group.**
This role will be a full-time position based out of our Coimbatore office. Sr. Associate, Global Treasury Risk manages daily Credit Evaluations for Avantor global customer base, approve and assign appropriate credit limit and risk classification, facilitate payment terms approvals and changes in line with Delegation of Authority Matrix, ensure SOX Compliance to the objectives, evaluate legitimate bank change requests from suppliers, perform voice verification for new and existing vendors, identify and prevent fraudulent attempts, publish necessary weekly or monthly reports, approve customer and supplier account changes as necessary and perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Education: Any bachelor’s or master’s degree with finance background will be an added advantage.
* Experience: 2+ years of treasury / Credit Management, Accounts Payable or Accounts Receivables Experience in a multinational corporate environment is preferred.
* Should be Flexible to work in night shifts and working from the office in a hybrid model.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, and other relevant software
* Understanding of basic accounting, financial statements analysis, risk management and vendor management.
* Prior experience in process transition, stabilization and change management preferred.
* Ability to work as a part of a team, while providing a strong individual contribution.
* Ability to clearly communicate issues and recommend solutions to both Avantor associates and external parties in order to facilitate risk assessment and voice verification processes.
* Excellent attention to detail, judgment, flexibility, accountability, and dependability.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Live up to ICARE values.

**Credit Management**
**How you will thrive and create an impact**

* Responsible for assigning Risk Classifications and Credit Evaluations for the Avantor Global customer base.
* Approve customer account reviews on a daily basis and assign risk classification at a customer level.
* Ensure appropriate credit and financial information is obtained and reviewed as part of the customer account review.
* Ensure the “Delegation of Authority” for approving Credit Limits is being adhered to.
* Ensure that “Security Instruments” are obtained in high risk situations to mitigate risk, including Letters of Credit, UCC’s and Guarantee’s.
* Ensure that SOX compliance for the Risk objectives are being met on an ongoing basis.
* Responsible for Risk Management Receivable Reporting which includes daily, weekly and monthly reporting:
* On a weekly basis create the weekly “Risk Management Receivable Trending Reports” for Sales, Finance, Risk and Accounting.
* On a monthly basis create and review the Bad Debt Assessment report which is used as the basis for deriving the Bad debt reserve.
* Perform quarterly financial reviews of VWR’s Top Vendors and post the report on the Risk Department Intranet Site for other departments viewing.
* Perform ongoing financial reviews and approve customer requests for special terms requests. This calls for evaluating the financial strength of the company making the terms request coupled with the profitability of the account and then obtaining Senior Management Approval as well.
* Perform financial reviews for customers with consignment Inventory as well as customer facing inventory making sure contract language is in place to protect VWR in the event of a termination of contract.
* Review and monitor all Avantor Global customers who have filed bankruptcy or have been placed for 3rd party collections.
* Approving customer account changes including name changes as a result of the customer being bought, sold, divested or changing the entity name.
* Responsible for collecting accounts receivable on accounts that are in Bankruptcy and are being sold as a Debtor in Possession.
* Responsible for locating and maintaining the “Risk Watch List” report which includes customers that are unable to pay VWR and additional bad debt reserve is taken.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Supplier Voice Verifications**

* Validate the legitimacy of the request to ensure it is not a fraudulent attempt.
* Facilitate voice verification calls with legitimate supplier contact, Avantor relationship manager to blind confirm the bank details.
* Evaluate and submit the requests through Workflow for necessary approvals with 100% accuracy.
* Monitor and close the request with master data changes in ERP system.
* Maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

**Customer Refunds**

* Validate the legitimacy of the request to ensure it is not a fraudulent attempt.
* Facilitate voice verification calls with legitimate customer contact, engage key stakeholders as required to blind confirm the bank details.
* Evaluate and submit the requests through Workflow for necessary approvals with 100% accuracy.
* Monitor and close the request with master data changes in ERP system.
* Maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement improvements to treasury risk processes and systems.
* Continuously monitor industry trends and market changes to ensure credit management risk mitigation strategies remain up-to-date and relevant.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and implement improvements to reduce bad debt exposure.

**Collaboration And Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work closely with key stakeholders across finance, accounting, treasury, Commercial, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Operations teams to gather necessary information to execute the tasks.

**Ad-hoc Financial Analysis**

* Provide ad-hoc financial analysis as requested by senior management to support decision-making.

title: Associate Process Manager
description:
**Specialism –**
Reference Data

Job Location - Coimbatore

As part of our Reference Data leadership team, you will be working with our client partners to improve processes and controls that build capacity and scale. Your role will contribute to analyse complex problems and come up with lateral solutions using tools like Bloomberg, Reuters etc. To classify and categorize data, identify security pricing, capture data which is required and used while making a trade.

The candidate must possess in-depth functional knowledge of the process area and apply it to operational scenarios to provide effective solutions. He/she must be able to identify discrepancies and propose optimal solutions by using a logical, systematic, and sequential methodology. It is vital to be open-minded towards inputs and views from team members and to effectively lead, control, and motivate groups towards company objects. Additionally, he/she must be self-directed, proactive and seize every opportunity to meet internal and external customer needs and achieve customer satisfaction by effectively auditing processes, implementing best practices and process improvements, and utilizing the frameworks and tools available. Goals and thoughts must be clearly and concisely articulated and conveyed, verbally and in writing, to clients, colleagues, subordinates, and supervisors.

The ideal candidate should possess strong business understanding of finance industry with special focus on Data Management, Operational Security Pricing, Data Quality Management. He/She should be good with numbers and ability to derive information from data with excellent multi-tasking and creative problem solving. He/She should have strong capabilities in PowerPoint, MS Word and MS Excel and should be able to build domain expertise and lead from the front with the ability to work under pressure, handle multiple priorities and work as part of the team.

**Reference Data- Associate Process Manager- Responsibilities**

* Review and analyse trade data between risk and finance systems
* Check for completeness, accuracy and consistency to identify the set of genuine breaks
* Investigate the genuine breaks for root cause and facilitate resolution and decision support, wherever necessary
* Provide support on the change and new business requests received from various RFDAR/non-RFDAR teams by assessing the business requirements, performing testing, providing SME support
* Apply data normalization methods such as filtering, standardization, enrichment, aggregation
* Lead discussions with the internal teams to highlight breaks
* Lead and take appropriate action post liaising with the respective stakeholder
* Create reports / metrics / analysis to cover the Daily / Weekly / Monthly requests
* Mailbox Management / Queue Management
* Build domain expertise and lead from the front.
* Independently handle clients and client calls– establish self as a valued partner.
* Escalate issues to client and internal managers to bring issues to their attention in a short span of time to avoid client escalation
* Help knowledge management endeavour by sharing process knowledge and best practices within the teams

**Minimum Qualifications-**

* Graduation (Bcom, BBA, BBM, BCA) / Post Graduation (Mcom, MBA, PGDM)
* 3 to 10 years of experience in handling team of minimum 10 members and has good experience and knowledge of Data Management, Security Pricing, and Quality Management.
* Conceptualize, design and deliver high-quality solutions and insightful analysis on a variety of projects ranging in both complexity and scope
* Knowledge of / prior experience with offshoring processes and methodologies highly preferred
* Seeking a challenging new position in a dynamic high growth company and industry.
* Should be good with logical and quantitative abilities.

**Preferred Qualifications-**

* Ability to manage and complete specific tasks with minimal direction
* Should be able to act fast and decisively when dealing with critical situations – ability to read situations and act in minutes
* Willingness to continuously learn, upgrade skills and stay relevant to business demands
* Excellent interpersonal skills – ability to network and earn confidence of diverse Client personnel plus interaction with and management of eClerx India based operations team.

eClerx provides critical business operations services to over fifty global Fortune 500 clients, including some of the world’s leading companies across financial services, cable & telecom, retail, fashion, media & entertainment, manufacturing, travel & leisure, software, and high-tech. Incorporated in 2000, eClerx is one of India’s leading process management and data analytics companies and is today traded on both the Bombay and National Stock Exchanges of India. eClerx employs 9,500-plus people across its global sites in the US, UK, India, Italy, Germany, Singapore, Thailand.

For financial organizations across the world, eClerx Markets offers consulting, technological innovation, and process management expertise to uniquely solve operational challenges. With nearly two decades of industry experience complemented by the application of smart automation and robotics, our team of experts deliver holistic solutions across the trade life cycle, change management, data analytics, compliance, cash securities operations, document digitization and generation, and outreach.

title: Financial Analyst
description:
Position: Financial Analyst – Finance Products & ERP

**Experience:** 1–5 Years  
**Location:** Coimbatore  
**Employment Type:** Full-time

Job Summary

We are looking for a **Financial Analyst** with relevant experience in Accounting, Finance, Audit or Taxation to join our **Finance Product and ERP implementation team**.

The role involves working on **Financial Reporting, Financial Consolidation, Intercompany Reconciliation & Elimination, GST, E-Invoicing and D365 Business Central** solutions, with a focus on automating finance processes through ERP and financial software products.
