* Analyse accounting and finance processes and understand business requirements.
* Work on **Financial Reporting and Financial Consolidation** requirements.
* Understand **Intercompany Reconciliation, Intercompany Elimination** and consolidation processes.
* Support **D365 Business Central Finance** implementation and functional activities.
* Understand **GST Returns and E-Invoicing** processes, including automation through ERP and reconciliation between ERP and statutory returns.
* Perform financial data validation, reconciliation and reporting analysis.
* Prepare functional requirements, process documentation and test cases.
* Support functional testing, UAT and issue resolution.
* Work with product and technical teams to convert finance requirements into software solutions.
* Support product enhancements and implementation of finance-related solutions.

Required Skills

* Good understanding of **Accounting and Finance** concepts.
* Practical experience in **bookkeeping, journal entries, ledger scrutiny, financial statements, GST, taxation, audit or financial reporting**.
* Good understanding of **P&L, Balance Sheet, Trial Balance and reconciliations**.
* Understanding of **Intercompany Reconciliation and Elimination**.
* Good analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Good proficiency in **MS Excel**.
* Good communication and documentation skills.
* Interest in **ERP, Financial Reporting, Financial Consolidation and Finance Technology**.

Optional / Added Advantage

Experience or knowledge in any of the following will be an added advantage:

* **D365 Business Central / Microsoft Dynamics NAV**
* **Power BI** or other reporting/BI tools
* GST and **E-Invoicing automation**
* ERP-to-GST reconciliation
* Financial Consolidation / EPM
* **ROC Compliance**, including MGT-7/7A, AOC-4, MGT-14, SPICe+, e-MOA, e-AOA, INC-9, AGILE-PRO-S, etc.
* Income Tax, TDS and other statutory compliance
* Financial projections / CMA data
* Tally Prime, Zoho Books or other accounting/ERP applications

Qualification

**CMA / CA Inter / CA / M.Com / equivalent Finance or Accounting qualification.**

Candidates from **Accounting, Audit, Taxation or CA/CMA firms** with practical finance experience are encouraged to apply.

Pay: ₹268,000.00 - ₹1,190,000.00 per year

title: Manager – Revenue (Kochi)
description:
**About The Team**
We are building a high-performance Revenue & Marketing pod — a geography-focused business unit that owns end-to-end top-line and bottom-line delivery for an assigned state or cluster. The pod operates like an autonomous business unit: defining local strategy, executing marketing and growth plans, running platform operations, and generating the consumer insights that drive every commercial decision.
  
  
This is not a support function. Every person in this pod owns outcomes — revenue, margin, platform health, or market intelligence. If you are commercially driven, data-fluent, and thrive in a fast-moving execution environment, this team is built for you.
  
  
**What You Will Do**

* Revenue & P&L
* Own and deliver revenue and gross margin targets for an assigned geography or function within the pod
* Track P&L on a weekly and monthly basis — identify gaps early and course-correct with data
* Drive revenue growth through a mix of new user acquisition, base reactivation, and improved margin per transaction
* Identify and unlock new revenue opportunities — brand partnerships, channel monetisation, and promotional levers
* Marketing, Growth & Campaigns
* Plan and execute user acquisition campaigns to drive installs and first-order conversions at efficient CAC
* Own reactivation marketing for lapsed and install-not-transacted user cohorts
* Design and run CRM, push notification, and in-app messaging campaigns to improve repeat purchase frequency
* Execute on-app promotions, deal constructs, offer panels, and sale events — end-to-end, accurately and on time
* Build and manage hyperlocal BTL activation plans tied to regional events, festivals, and seasonal demand peaks
* Promote high-margin SKUs and categories to improve the overall GM profile of the geography
* Market Intelligence & Consumer Insights
* Build and maintain a revenue intelligence framework covering consumer spending patterns, competitive pricing, and category growth
* Lead quantitative research: cohort analysis, pricing elasticity studies, and transactional data mining
* Conduct qualitative research: consumer focus groups, in-depth interviews, and retailer feedback sessions
* Produce competitive intelligence reports — share of wallet, competitor activity, and whitespace opportunities
* Generate data-backed demand signals for new SKUs and assortment decisions
* Platform Health & Fulfilment
* Own platform revenue health KPIs: availability rate, catalogue fill, listing quality, order completion, and RTO
* Identify and plug revenue leakage — stock-outs during campaign periods, broken listings, and fulfilment failures
* Coordinate with Supply Chain and Inventory teams to ensure stock availability ahead of activations
* Escalate platform issues — broken listings, payment failures, checkout drop-offs — with revenue-impact quantification
* Own fulfilment SLAs; work with logistics partners to reduce TAT, RTO, and delivery failures
* Analytics & Reporting
* Maintain a real-time revenue dashboard and weekly health scorecard accessible to the entire pod
* Run weekly sales trend and insights analysis to identify performance gaps and activation opportunities
* Report on key metrics: installs, CAC, reactivation rate, traffic, GM impact, and channel revenue contribution
* Translate complex data into clear, commercially actionable narratives for business decisions

**Who We Are Looking For**
Must Have
  
  

* Engineering degree from a Tier 1/2 institution [IIT (Bombay/ Delhi/ Madras/ Kanpur/ Kharagpur/ Roorkee/ Guwahati/ Hyderabad/ Indore/ Gandhinagar/ Bhubaneswar/ Ropar), BITS Pilani (Pilani/ Goa/ Hyderabad), NIT (Trichy/ Warangal/ Surathkal/ Calicut/ Rourkela), DTU, VIT, NSIT, IIIT (Hyderabad/ Bangalore)]
* 2–6 years of experience in one or more of: revenue management, performance marketing, trade sales, consumer insights, e-commerce operations, or P&L-owning commercial roles
* Strong commercial acumen — ability to connect marketing and operational actions directly to revenue and margin outcomes
* Data fluency: comfortable with Excel, SQL, BI tools (Tableau, Looker, or equivalent), and building dashboards or revenue models
* Experience working cross-functionally across Brand, Supply Chain, Product, and Marketing teams
* Proven track record of execution in a fast-paced, high-accountability environment

Good to Have
  
  

* Prior experience in a geography or zonal business role in e-commerce, Q-commerce, FMCG, or consumer tech
* Exposure to CRM platforms, push notification tools, or on-app promotion management dashboards
* Experience with qualitative research methodologies: FGDs, in-depth interviews, ethnographic observation
* Knowledge of trade economics: margins, sell-through rates, distributor ROI, and channel profitability
* Basic knowledge of Python or R for data processing and analysis
* Proficiency in regional language(s) of the assigned state — advantage for primary research and on-ground activation

**What We Offer**

* Competitive compensation — reviewed based on role level, experience, and fitment
* Direct ownership of business outcomes from Day 1 — revenue, margin, or market intelligence
* Mentorship from senior P&L leaders and a clear pathway to leadership roles
* High-velocity, commercially focused culture built on ownership, experimentation, and speed
* Work at the intersection of marketing, technology, and commerce — in a category with significant growth headroom

title: FP And A - Global Managed Services - Supervising Associate EY GDS

And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
  
  
**FP&A | Global Managed Services – Supervising Associate EY GDS**
Let us introduce you the job offer by EY GDS – a member of the global integrated service delivery center network by EY.
  
  
The Business Analysis sub-function of FP&A brings together people and teams focused on business leadership support, including cohesive strategic analytics and insights on management and performance reporting, enabling strategic decision making.
  
  
**The opportunity**
EY Managed Services empowers clients by transforming noncore yet essential activities into streamlined efficient processes. Our easy-to-integrate solutions and deep expertise alleviate the burdens faced in critical areas such as tax, risk, compliance, and finance. By leveraging managed services, clients can achieve significant operational efficiencies and gain a competitive edge in increasingly challenging markets.
  
  
We are seeking an experienced and dynamic Supervising Associate to join our Global Managed Services team. This role supports strategic and operational decision making through data and insightful business analysis. The role has to understand business needs and collaborate with other Finance team members to bring best in class analytical support and solutions. The ability to understand and curate large data sets, present analysis and results through storytelling and problem solving is vital.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**

* Supporting financial and business analysis while supporting Managed Services Leaders and act as a trusted business adviser. Develop effective working relationships with the extended Finance team and leadership.
* Focus on traditional performance management while also contributing to establishing "next generation" reporting frameworks.
* Support the development, management, and delivery of comprehensive performance reporting and financial analysis related to Managed services initiatives.
* Analyze business performance by creating and maintaining dashboards, reports, and presentations that enable business leaders to quickly understand performance and underlying drivers.
* Provide ad-hoc financial modeling and analysis services to GMS leadership in support of business planning and strategic and operational decision-making
* Collaborate across EY (Super Regions, Service Lines, Finance, and Markets) to deliver one source of truth for Global Managed services performance.
* Support the development of a suite of short and medium-term forecasting activities
* Utilize EY’s Opportunity and Engagement data to identify trends, risks, and opportunities that impact business growth and client delivery.
* Support continuous improvement in data quality, reporting tools, and analytical methodologies.
* Support issue management and resolution, ensuring delivery of exceptional client service to stakeholders.
* Ensure compliance with EY’s financial policies and governance standards.

**Skills And Attributes For Success**

* Strong analytical skills, focused on analysis, advice, and solutions that drive achievement of goals.
* Strong understanding of EY’s business model, finance processes, and tools.
* Ability to interpret data, assess its value, and present concise findings to stakeholders
* Comfortable supporting new business models and innovative views into the business.
* Demonstrates the ability to challenge assumptions and decisions appropriately.
* Highly team-oriented with flexibility to prioritize conflicting demands and meet deadlines.
* Advanced Excel, data modelling, Power BI & PowerPoint skills - ability to understand and curate large data sets, present analysis and results through story-telling and problem solving is vital.
* Strong interpersonal skills - can work alongside and gain the trust and respect of stakeholders
* Global mindset – ability to work effectively as a virtual team member and ability and willingness to work in a multicultural and diverse environment and flex style as appropriate
* Good communication skills – written and verbal;

**To qualify for the role, you must have**

* Graduate and/or professional certification in a business-related subject matter (e.g., Accounting, Finance).
* A minimum of 4 years of relevant experience in finance or business analysis, preferably within professional services.
* Advanced skills in financial/markets reporting, data analysis, and performance measurement.
* Experienced in data visualization and reporting tools (e.g., Power BI, Analysis Servers, Excel).

EY Global Delivery Services (GDS) is a dynamic and truly global delivery network. In GDS, you will collaborate with EY teams on exciting projects and work with well-known brands from across the globe. We’ll introduce you to an ever-expanding ecosystem of people, learning, skills and insights that will stay with you throughout your career.
  
  

* Continuous learning: You’ll develop the mindset and skills to navigate whatever comes next.
* Success as defined by you: We’ll provide the tools and flexibility, so you can make a meaningful impact, your way.
* Transformative leadership: We’ll give you the insights, coaching and confidence to be the leader the world needs.
* Diverse and inclusive culture: You’ll be embraced for who you are and empowered to use your voice to help others find theirs.

description:
**Role Purpose**

The Company Secretarial - Legal Contract Management & Data Privacy will be responsible for managing the organisation's end-to-end commercial contracting requirements and supporting the development and implementation of its data privacy and protection framework.

The role will provide practical legal advice to business teams, negotiate complex commercial arrangements, establish contract governance standards, identify and mitigate contractual and privacy risks, and ensure compliance with applicable data protection requirements.

The position requires a commercially oriented legal professional capable of partnering independently with senior business stakeholders while maintaining appropriate legal and regulatory safeguards.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Contract Drafting, Review & Negotiation**

* Independently draft, review, negotiate and finalize a wide range of commercial agreements, including:
* Master Service Agreements (MSAs)
* Service / Vendor Agreements
* Software and SaaS Agreements
* Technology and IT Agreements
* Software Licensing Agreements
* Professional Services Agreements
* Non-Disclosure Agreements (NDAs)
* Data Processing Agreements (DPAs)
* Consultancy Agreements
* Procurement and Outsourcing Agreements
* Statements of Work (SOWs)
* Business Partnership / Collaboration Agreements
* Amendments and termination arrangements.
* Lead negotiations on key contractual provisions relating to:
* Limitation of liability
* Indemnities
* Intellectual property rights
* Confidentiality
* Data protection and information security
* Representations and warranties
* Service levels
* Insurance
* Audit rights
* Business continuity
* Termination and exit management
* Dispute resolution.
* Identify legal and commercial risks and recommend practical risk-mitigation measures to business stakeholders.
* Develop appropriate negotiating positions and escalation thresholds for high-risk contractual provisions.

**2. Contract Lifecycle Management & Governance**

* Manage and strengthen the organisation's
  **Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM)**
  framework from contract initiation through execution, renewal and termination.
* Establish and periodically update:
* Standard contract templates
* Clause libraries
* Contracting playbooks
* Deviation matrices
* Approval matrices
* Delegation of authority requirements
* Standard negotiation positions.
* Implement mechanisms for tracking contractual obligations, renewals, expiries, notice periods and key deliverables.
* Maintain effective contract repositories and ensure appropriate documentation and audit trails.
* Drive improvements in contract turnaround times and contracting efficiency without compromising legal safeguards.
* Support implementation and optimisation of contract management technology and workflow automation.

**3. Data Privacy & Data Protection**

* Support and/or lead implementation of the organisation's privacy compliance framework, including compliance with applicable Indian data protection requirements and, where relevant to the organisation's operations, international privacy requirements.
* Advise business, technology, procurement, HR, marketing and other functions on privacy implications associated with:
* Collection and processing of personal data
* Employee data
* Customer and vendor information
* Data sharing
* Cross-border data arrangements
* Technology platforms
* New products and business initiatives.
* Draft, review and periodically update:
* Privacy policies and notices
* Consent language
* Data Processing Agreements
* Data-sharing arrangements
* Vendor privacy clauses
* Employee privacy documentation
* Internal privacy procedures and standards.
* Facilitate
  **Privacy Impact Assessments / Data Protection Impact Assessments**
  for new initiatives, products, systems and processing activities, as applicable.
* Partner with Information Security and Technology teams to ensure alignment between contractual privacy obligations and technical/security controls.

**4. Privacy Governance & Compliance**

* Support maintenance of inventories or records relating to personal-data processing activities.
* Coordinate with relevant internal functions for handling data principal/data subject requests in accordance with applicable requirements.
* Establish and monitor privacy compliance processes relating to data retention, deletion, access, sharing and third-party processing.
* Conduct periodic privacy compliance reviews and identify remediation requirements.
* Monitor regulatory developments relating to privacy, technology, digital regulation and data protection and assess their potential impact on the organisation.
* Develop and deliver privacy and contracting awareness/training programmes for relevant employees.

**5. Third-Party & Vendor Risk Management**

* Conduct legal and privacy reviews of vendors, service providers and other third parties handling organisational or personal data.
* Review vendor privacy, cybersecurity and data-processing commitments in collaboration with Information Security, Procurement, IT Risk and business teams.
* Ensure appropriate contractual safeguards are incorporated based on the nature and risk of the engagement.
* Assist in establishing risk-based vendor contracting and privacy due-diligence standards.

**6. Data Breach & Incident Management**

* Provide legal and privacy support in relation to potential or actual data-security incidents.
* Coordinate with Information Security, IT, Compliance and senior management in assessing legal and contractual implications arising from incidents.
* Review contractual breach-notification obligations and support regulatory/customer notification assessments where applicable.
* Assist with post-incident remediation and strengthening of contractual and privacy controls.

**7. Business & Stakeholder Advisory**

* Act as a trusted legal partner to business teams on commercial contracting and data privacy matters.
* Provide clear, commercially practical advice rather than purely theoretical legal opinions.
* Engage with senior stakeholders to resolve complex contractual negotiations and risk issues.
* Collaborate closely with:
* Procurement
* Information Technology
* Information Security
* Compliance
* Risk
* Finance
* Human Resources
* Sales / Business teams.
* Manage external counsel, where required, including matter allocation, quality of advice and legal spend.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

The ideal candidate should demonstrate:

* Strong commercial contract drafting and negotiation skills.
* Thorough understanding of contract law and commercial transactions.
* Working knowledge of data privacy and protection frameworks.
* Ability to interpret privacy requirements in the context of practical business processes.
* Strong understanding of technology/SaaS/vendor contracts.
* Good appreciation of cybersecurity and information-security issues from a legal and contractual perspective.
* Strong legal risk-identification and mitigation capabilities.
* Ability to independently negotiate with sophisticated counterparties.
* Excellent stakeholder-management and influencing skills.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Sound commercial judgement and solution-oriented approach.
* Ability to manage multiple transactions and competing priorities.
* Strong attention to detail while maintaining a broader business perspective.

**Specifications**

* Bachelor's degree in Law (
  **LL.B.**
  ) from a recognized institution.
* Approximately
  **10–15 years of post-qualification experience**
  in a corporate legal department of an insurance company and/or reputed law firm.
* Significant hands-on experience in commercial contract drafting and negotiation.
* Experience handling technology, vendor, outsourcing and/or service-related agreements.
* Demonstrable exposure to privacy and data-protection matters.
* Experience working directly with senior business stakeholders.

**Preferred**

* LL.M. or specialization in Technology Law / Data Privacy.
* Professional certification in data privacy or protection.
* Experience implementing or managing a Contract Lifecycle Management platform.
* Prior experience working in regulated sectors, technology-intensive businesses, financial services, manufacturing or large multinational/corporate environments.
* Exposure to cross-border commercial contracts and international privacy requirements.

title: AVP/VP - Master Agreements
description:
**Primary Role Responsibilities**

1. Work on legal analysis and provide documentation solutions to relevant internal stakeholders in connection with OTC derivatives master agreements and ancillary credit support / security agreements for counterparties onboarded or to be onboarded for OTC derivatives trading and securities financing transactions (including both cleared and uncleared trading, and flow as well as structured transactions).

2. Work on financing transactions with a hedging component, security packages and inter-creditor arrangements; provide legal analysis of transaction terms that deviate from the bank’s preferred positions and deliver documentation solutions to relevant internal stakeholders to facilitate deal closure.

3. Provide proactive support to the Head of MA LEGAL, APAC. Provide comprehensive legal risk analysis and recommendations on non-product specific derivatives issues to business, management and relevant internal stakeholders.

4. Draft and negotiate OTC derivatives master agreements (both financing and non-financing linked) with counterparties in the Asia Pacific region based on requests received, following the playbooks, guidelines, approval frameworks and procedures prescribed by the relevant LEGAL team in Hong Kong or Singapore.

5. Draft and negotiate execution agreements and other ancillary agreements and addenda which may be required where OTC derivatives transactions are traded on a cleared basis, following the playbooks, guidelines , approval frameworks and procedures prescribed by the relevant LEGAL team in Hong Kong or Singapore.

6. Draft and negotiate margining agreements and other ancillary agreements which may be required where OTC derivatives transactions are traded on an uncleared basis, following the playbooks, guidelines, approval frameworks and procedures prescribed by the relevant LEGAL team in Hong Kong or Singapore.

7. As part of the process of negotiating OTC derivatives master agreements: (i) review, comment on and assist in drafting, as appropriate, ancillary credit support and other security documents, including parental guarantees; (ii) maintain relevant legal data for the agreements in applicable systems used by the APAC LEGAL Master Agreements team.

8. Review legal issues pertaining to OTC derivatives master agreements (including counterparty capacity and authority, enforceability of netting and collateral arrangements, and Asian jurisdiction specific issues), liaise with external legal advisers where and as directed by the relevant LEGAL team in Hong Kong or Singapore, and keep legal opinions and template documents updated in reference libraries.

9. Follow developments in Europe and Asia Pacific jurisdictions in relation to OTC derivatives related regulatory topics, contribute to derivatives regulatory projects and work with internal lawyers to conduct impact analysis with a view to devising and implementing related documentation solutions.

**Other contributions**

10. Participate in identifying process automation and improvement opportunities, and building, testing and implementing solutions.

11. Participate in the collection and compilation of information in response to internal surveys and regulatory / audit enquiries in relation to the use of OTC derivatives master agreements in the Asia Pacific region.

12. Provide inputs into projects relating to master agreements, as directed by the relevant LEGAL team in Hong Kong or Singapore.

13. Contribute to knowledge management and training programmes and the sharing of know-how in relation to derivatives and securities financing agreement within LEGAL.

14. Liaise with the LEGAL team in Hong Kong and Singapore on deviations and exception issues.

Working closely with the India business leadership and the role delivers the C&E program across the India business, including conducting risk assessments, advising stakeholders on compliance requirements, operationalizing global policies and procedures in the local (India) context, and designing and delivering compliance training. At a global level, the role supports and manages the conflict-of-interest process end-to-end, ensuring it remains effective, consistently applied, and fit for purpose across CFA Institute's global operations.
  
  
The role also carries responsibility for India regulatory compliance, serving as the first line of defense for risk and compliance matters within CFAIIPL and acting as the organization's liaison with Indian regulatory authorities. This includes managing statutory obligations, supporting the Board and AGM processes, and working closely with local stakeholders on non-financial compliance reporting and record-keeping.
  
  
CFA Institute is a not-for-profit organization and is not financially regulated. This is a compliance and ethics role, not a financial or investment compliance role. We are not looking for candidates whose experience is primarily in banking, investment, or other financial services compliance.
  
  
The responsibilities of this position include, but are not limited, to the following:
  
  
**Compliance & Ethics Program - India**

* Serve as the primary compliance resource and advisor for CFA Institute's India entity, engaging proactively with local business teams to ensure compliance with applicable local laws, regulations, and organizational policies.
* Conduct compliance risk assessments for India operations and use outputs to inform program priorities and advise stakeholders.
* Support the implementation and operationalization of global compliance policies and procedures within the India business context, adapting approaches to meet local regulatory and operational realities.
* Monitor India regulatory developments, assess potential impacts on the operations, and advise leadership on necessary adjustments to policies, controls, and procedures.
* Design and deliver compliance and ethics training programs for India employees, ensuring relevance to both local requirements and global CFA Institute compliance standards.
* Advise India business leadership and stakeholders on Indian compliance requirements, governance expectations, and the practical application of organizational policies.
* Build and maintain productive relationships across CFA Institute's India business lines and functions, serving as a trusted compliance advisor.

**Global Conflict of Interest Program**

* Support and manage CFA Institute's global conflict of interest process end-to-end, including disclosure management, review, escalation, and reporting.
* Support maintaining and enhancing COI policies, procedures, and related guidance, ensuring they remain current, practical, and aligned with organizational and regulatory requirements.
* Support development and delivery of COI-related training and awareness communications across the organization.
* Monitor COI disclosures, support identify and escalate potential issues, and maintain accurate records and reporting metrics.

**Regulatory Compliance**

* Responsible for implementing the First Line of Defense for Risk & Compliance for CFAIIPL in India.
* Record, assess, and report all non-financial compliance matters related to CFAIIPL operations; implement and monitor changes to compliance requirements arising out of internal or local external changes as applicable to CFAIIPL.
* Work closely with other local internal stakeholders to complete filing, reports, and record keeping of all non-financial compliance.
* Monitor changes to local compliance requirements and keep requirements updated and completed.
* Collaborate with the local Compliance team member(s) to implement and report on CFAIIPL compliance standards.
* Arrange and monitor mandatory and necessary regulation-required compliance training for CFAIIPL staff.
* Manage the end-to-end conduct of Board Meetings and the AGM, including statutory compliances as applicable to CFAIIPL.
* Policy documentation wherever necessary for CFAIIPL.

* Collaborate with Legal, People & Culture, ERM, and Internal Audit to support consistent compliance practices and issue resolution across the organization.
* Contribute to compliance reporting and preparation of materials for India leadership and governance discussions.
* Promote a strong culture of integrity, accountability, and ethical conduct through proactive stakeholder engagement

**Job Description**
PRIMARY FUNCTIONS AND ESSENTIAL RESPONSIBILITIES:
  
  
**LP Transfer Administration**

* Serve as the primary coordinator for LP transfer requests across Ares-managed funds.
* Act as the central point of contact for transferring investors, transferees, fund administrators, legal counsel, tax, fund accounting, and internal stakeholders.
* Receive, review, and log incoming transfer requests.
* Maintain transfer request trackers and workflow dashboards, ensuring accurate status reporting and timely follow-up.
* Coordinate the collection and review of required transfer documentation and supporting materials.
* Source, prepare, and distribute standard transfer documentation and ancillary forms.
* Monitor transaction progress and proactively manage outstanding action items to facilitate timely completion.

**Transaction Coordination**

* Coordinate the end-to-end transfer process from initiation through execution and recording.
* Liaise with internal and external legal counsel regarding transfer documentation, comments, and negotiated changes.
* Coordinate AML/KYC onboarding requirements with Compliance and third-party service providers.
* Facilitate delivery of completed transfer documentation to fund administrators and other stakeholders for processing and record updates.
* Escalate complex or non-standard transfer requests to appropriate stakeholders for review and approval.

Process Management & Reporting
  
  

* Develop, maintain, and enhance policies, procedures, workflows, and operating manuals relating to LP transfer activity.
* Identify opportunities to streamline transfer processes and improve operational efficiency.
* Maintain detailed records and audit trails supporting transfer activity.
* Produce regular management reporting on transfer activity, including active, completed, pending, and cancelled transfers.
* Monitor key performance indicators and service levels for transfer processing.
* Support implementation of workflow tools, automation initiatives, and reporting solutions.

Stakeholder Management
  
  

* Build effective working relationships with Investor Relations, Legal, Compliance, Finance, Fund Administration, and external service providers.
* Provide timely and professional communication to investors and counterparties throughout the transfer process.
* Support internal stakeholders with information requests and status updates.
* Assist with special projects and process improvement initiatives relating to fund operations.

**Qualifications**
**Education:**
Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, Law, or a related discipline.
  
  
**Experience Required**

* 6–10 years of relevant experience within private equity, private credit, fund administration, investor services, transfer agency, fund operations, legal operations, or financial services.
* Experience supporting investor onboarding, subscription processing, LP transfers, fund administration, or related operational activities.
* Understanding of private fund structures, partnership agreements, and investor lifecycle events.
* Experience coordinating activities across multiple internal and external stakeholders.
* Experience maintaining operational trackers, workflow management tools, and management reporting.
* Strong proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Experience with CRM, investor servicing, fund administration, or workflow management platforms preferred.
* Prior experience within alternative asset management, private markets, or fund administration strongly preferred.

General Requirements
  
  

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong organizational and project management capabilities.
* Exceptional attention to detail and commitment to accuracy.
* Ability to manage multiple concurrent transactions and competing priorities.
* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently while maintaining strong collaboration with global teams.
* Professional and client-service-oriented approach to stakeholder interactions.
* Sound judgment and ability to appropriately escalate issues.
* Process-oriented mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Comfortable working across multiple jurisdictions and time zones.
* Ability to handle confidential and sensitive information with discretion.

title: Company Secretary
description:
**Company Description**
S K Dwivedi & Associates is a professional services firm specializing in corporate compliance, secretarial services, and advisory support for businesses of varying sizes. The firm focuses on helping clients meet statutory and regulatory requirements efficiently while maintaining high standards of governance and transparency. Team members collaborate closely with clients to provide practical, timely solutions tailored to specific industry and organizational needs. The work environment emphasizes integrity, accuracy, and continuous learning to keep pace with evolving corporate laws and regulations.

**Role Description**
The Company Secretary will be responsible for managing corporate secretarial functions, including preparing and filing statutory forms, maintaining registers and records, and ensuring compliance with applicable company laws and regulations. Daily responsibilities include drafting board and general meeting notices, agendas, minutes, and resolutions, and coordinating with directors, auditors, and regulatory authorities. The role involves advising on corporate governance practices, monitoring changes in relevant legislation, and supporting incorporation, restructuring, and other corporate actions. The Company Secretary will also assist in preparing compliance reports, handling ROC and other regulatory filings, and responding to client queries in a timely, professional manner. This is a full-time, on-site role based in Mumbai.

**Qualifications**

* Professional qualification as Company Secretary (CS) from ICSI; additional degrees in Law, Commerce, or Business Administration are an advantage.
* Strong knowledge of Companies Act and related corporate laws, secretarial standards, and regulatory compliance requirements.
* Experience in drafting minutes, resolutions, notices, and maintaining statutory registers and records.
* Proficiency in MS Office and commonly used compliance/secretarial software; ability to manage documentation in an organized manner.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with attention to detail and accuracy in legal and corporate documentation.
* Ability to manage multiple assignments, meet deadlines, and work collaboratively with clients and internal teams on-site in Mumbai.
* Prior experience in a practicing Company Secretary firm or corporate secretarial department is preferred.

The
**Claims Manager**

title: AVP - Tax
description:
Join us as a AVP -Tax at Barclays, where you'll spearhead the evolution of our digital landscape, driving innovation and excellence. You'll harness cutting-edge technology to revolutionize our digital offerings, ensuring unapparelled customer experiences. To provide data-led expert oversight and check and challenge on business and compliance matters to evidence that the organization is operating in a compliance with Barclays legal, regulatory and ethical responsibilities.

* Qualified Chartered Accountant.
* Good experience in the field of taxation.
* Experience of working in MNC or Big 4 covering GSC clients in the field of taxation advisory.
* In-depth knowledge of tax matters.
* Good networking skills and people management skills.
* Thorough understanding of facts and tax issues within offshoring Business.

**Some Other Highly Valued Skills May Include**

* Good networking skills and people management skills.
* Thorough understanding of facts and tax issues relevant for GSC within offshoring Business.

You may be assessed on the key critical skills relevant for success in role, such as ad-hoc tax advisory, tax reporting and tax compliance as well as job-specific skillsets.
  
  
This role will be based out of Mumbai.
  
  
**Purpose of the role**
To provide both corporate and indirect advisory and compliance tax services to business areas in a specific jurisdiction(s).
  
  
**Accountabilities**

* Management of tax risks arising from the bank's business activities, investments, and financial transactions and development of tax risk management strategies to mitigate potential tax liabilities and protect the bank's financial interests and reputation.
* Analysis of complex tax issues to support tax planning strategies, compliance matters, and risk management initiatives.
* Liaising, with tax authorities and resolving legacy tax risks.
* Identification and assessment of potential tax risks associated with complex transactions (including potential mergers, acquisitions, and restructuring) and development and implementation of tax risk mitigation strategies to minimise the potential impact.
* Stakeholder management to ensure that tax requirements and the associated risks are understood and appropriately managed, including reputational risks with tax authorities and external stakeholders.
* Analysis of relevant developments in tax law to ensure the impact on Barclays is understood and appropriately managed.
* Preparation or review of relevant tax returns in accordance with applicable tax law and agreeing compliance positions with the tax authorities.
* Preparation or review of tax accounting calculations and disclosures in accordance with applicable accounting standards for group forecasting, reporting and stress testing.
* Design and operation of tax process controls to ensure tax risk is appropriately managed and tax treatments can be supported.

**Assistant Vice President Expectations**

* To advise and influence decision making, contribute to policy development and take responsibility for operational effectiveness. Collaborate closely with other functions/ business divisions.
* Lead a team performing complex tasks, using well developed professional knowledge and skills to deliver on work that impacts the whole business function. Set objectives and coach employees in pursuit of those objectives, appraisal of performance relative to objectives and determination of reward outcomes
* If the position has leadership responsibilities, People Leaders are expected to demonstrate a clear set of leadership behaviours to create an environment for colleagues to thrive and deliver to a consistently excellent standard. The four LEAD behaviours are: L – Listen and be authentic, E – Energise and inspire, A – Align across the enterprise, D – Develop others.
* OR for an individual contributor, they will lead collaborative assignments and guide team members through structured assignments, identify the need for the inclusion of other areas of specialisation to complete assignments. They will identify new directions for assignments and/ or projects, identifying a combination of cross functional methodologies or practices to meet required outcomes.
* Consult on complex issues; providing advice to People Leaders to support the resolution of escalated issues.
* Identify ways to mitigate risk and developing new policies/procedures in support of the control and governance agenda.
* Take ownership for managing risk and strengthening controls in relation to the work done.
* Perform work that is closely related to that of other areas, which requires understanding of how areas coordinate and contribute to the achievement of the objectives of the organisation sub-function.
* Collaborate with other areas of work, for business aligned support areas to keep up to speed with business activity and the business strategy.
* Engage in complex analysis of data from multiple sources of information, internal and external sources such as procedures and practises (in other areas, teams, companies, etc).to solve problems creatively and effectively.
* Communicate complex information. 'Complex' information could include sensitive information or information that is difficult to communicate because of its content or its audience.
* Influence or convince stakeholders to achieve outcomes.

All colleagues will be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Values of Respect, Integrity, Service, Excellence and Stewardship – our moral compass, helping us do what we believe is right. They will also be expected to demonstrate the Barclays Mindset – to Empower, Challenge and Drive – the operating manual for how we behave.

title: GFC Transaction Monitoring, Associate, Oversight, Monitoring and Testing
description:
We're seeking someone to join our team as an Associate in the Legal and Compliance division.
  
  
In the Legal & Compliance division, we assist the Firm in achieving its business objectives by facilitating and overseeing the Firm's management of legal, regulatory and franchise risk. This is an Associate position within the Oversight, Monitoring and Testing, this team continuously monitored to detect unusual or potentially suspicious activities. The exceptions generated are reviewed or investigated by applying a risk-based approach, which involves considering available information pertaining alongside the risk tolerance of the Firm with respect to money laundering.
  
  
Since 1935, Morgan Stanley is known as a global leader in financial services, always evolving and innovating to better serve our clients and our communities in more than 40 countries around the world.
  
  
**What You'll Do In The Role**

* Review surveillance items flagged as potentially suspicious transactions or exceptions in accordance with the guidelines set forth in the GFC Procedures Manual.
* Review account activity of Morgan Stanley clients using client info, transactional activity and perform a review of account documentation to resolve alerts of any such clients in accordance with the GFC Procedures Manual.
* Perform outreach to client relationship/sales teams or other areas within Morgan Stanley in accordance with the GFC Procedures Manual to determine whether there is an explanation for the activity that triggered the alert.
* Escalate any questions or potentially suspicious activity found to the Morgan Stanley contact designated in the GFC Procedures Manual for further investigation.
* Review and analyze surveillance items identified as part of "below-the-line" testing, risk engine tuning and lookback activities.
* Draft dispositions summaries that support the alert review outcomes, ensuring documents are clear and concise while complying with regulatory expectations.
* Ensure a high-quality work product and that the level of documentation adheres to procedural expectations.
* Ensure daily operational processing is completed according to established program SLAs and regulatory requirements.
* Proactively identify risks to the GFC program and day-to-day; escalate on a timely basis.
* Provide process improvement to increase efficiency and effectiveness.
* Adhere to Morgan Stanley’s core values and drive the same within the team.
* Adopt the firm’s Gen AI agenda and implement the relevant tools within the process and implement the relevant tools within the process

**What You'll Bring To The Role**

* Typically, 2+ years’ experience of AML, Due Diligence, Transaction Monitoring, Regulatory environment; experience in the financial or professional services industries.
* Solid track record working in a professional environment.
* Bachelor’s degree from an accredited college / university.
* Strong oral and written communication skills.
* Excellent interpersonal skills and ability to work effectively with colleagues across regions and Business Units.
* Ability to use various PC, MS Office and internet applications and tools to support the processes.
* Foundational understanding of the financial markets and banking, including broker-dealer product-based knowledge and the ability to learn concepts quickly.
* Should exhibit comfort in working with technology and the ability to learn and display proficiency on technical systems and programs.

title: Associate, Credit Risk Manager, Risk Management Group
description:
**Job Purpose**
The Policy Manager for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) is responsible for designing, formulating, and lifecycle-managing the credit policies, risk acceptance criteria (RAC), and underwriting guidelines for secured asset portfolios (specifically Loan Against Property / PLAP) within Consumer Banking Group (CBG) Credit.
  
  
The role ensures that the portfolio growth aligns with the bank's approved Risk Appetite Framework while balancing aggressive business expansion goals with prudent credit risk controls, regulatory compliance (RBI guidelines), and fraud mitigation.
  
  
**Job Duties & Requirements**

* Policy Formulation and Framework Design
* Credit Policy Architecture: Own, review, and periodically update the credit policies, Product Programs (CPP), and underwriting guidelines for Prime Loan Against Property (PLAP) in coordination with business units and senior management.
* Risk Acceptance Criteria (RAC): Calibrate and refine RAC parameters (such as LTV caps, debt-to-income ratios, collateral eligibility, property valuation metrics, and negative area/pincode restrictions) based on macroeconomic trends, portfolio performance, and stress-testing results.
* Standardization: Ensure clear alignment of PLAP policies with overarching Group Core Credit Policies, Risk Appetite Statements (RAS), and local regulatory mandates (e.g., RBI Master Directions).
* Portfolio Monitoring, Analytics & Quality Assurance
* Portfolio Health Tracking: Continuously monitor portfolio metrics (delinquencies, early-stage flow rates, bounce rates, LTV migration, and Concentration Risk thresholds) to identify emerging credit risks or asset quality deterioration.
* Trigger Management: Implement and monitor Management Action Triggers (MAT) and portfolio caps for PLAP and broader secured lending portfolios.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Partner with Quality Assurance (QA) and Credit Fraud Risk Management (CFRM) teams to review control parameters, address policy/process vulnerabilities, and ensure audit readiness.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration & Product Expansion
* New Product Programs (NPP): Collaborate with Business, Product, and Technology & Operations (T&O) teams to evaluate and structure new product variants, digital/phygital journey integration (e.g., automated appraisal workflows, API-driven verification), and alternative scoring models.
* Process Alignment: Work closely with Credit Operations (CBO) and underwriting teams to ensure seamless policy translation into system rules (e.g., One Risk Workbench/ORWB, IBPM workflows) and operational execution manuals.
* Exception & Escalation Governance: Review and decide on complex policy exception frameworks, setting clear delegation of authority (DoA) matrices for credit managers.

**Required Experience**
Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Finance, Economics, Business Administration, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  
  
Professional risk certifications (e.g., FRM, CFA) are an added advantage.
  
  
**Education / Preferred Qualifications**
Graduate / Post Graduate in relevant field.
  
  
****Core Competencies****
****Technical Competencies****
Deep Regulatory & Product Knowledge: Strong understanding of secured lending products, property valuation methodologies, legal title checks, CERSAI regulations, and RBI guidelines governing commercial and retail banks in India.
  
  
Data-Driven & Analytical: Strong command over portfolio analytics, credit risk modelling metrics (PD, LGD, EAD), and performance tracking dashboards.
  
  
Stakeholder Management: Excellent communication and collaboration skills with the ability to influence senior business leaders, risk committees, and operational teams.
  
  
Governance Mindset: Demonstrated ability to balance business growth objectives with robust risk controls and rigorous compliance standards.
  
  
****Work Relationship****
8 years of overall banking experience, with at least 5–7 years specialized experience in Retail/Consumer Credit Risk, Credit Policy, or Portfolio Management—specifically focused on Secured Lending, Mortgages, or Loan Against Property (LAP)
  
  
****DBS India - Culture & Behaviors****

* Performance through Value Based Propositions
* Ensure customer focus by delighting customers & reduce complaints
* Build pride and passion to protect, maintain and enhance DBS’ image and reputation
* Enhance knowledge base, build skill sets & develop competencies
* Execute at speed while maintaining error free operations
* Maintain the highest standards of honesty and integrity

================

To provide enterprise-level leadership and subject-matter expertise for labour and employment compliance across all Indian business entities, offices, project sites and contractor workforces. The role will establish governance, provide strategic advice to management, oversee statutory and contractor compliance, lead inspections and complex industrial-relations matters, and drive implementation of labour-law reforms and digital compliance systems.

**Key Responsibilities**
========================

**1. Compliance Governance and Strategic Advisory**
---------------------------------------------------

* Own and continuously improve the organisation-wide labour compliance framework, policies, standard operating procedures, controls and annual compliance calendar.
* Advise senior management, Legal, HR, Procurement, Operations and project teams on material labour-law risks, business decisions and remediation priorities.
* Interpret legislative and regulatory developments, assess their business impact and lead timely implementation across multiple states and entities.
* Provide functional guidance to site teams, compliance personnel, consultants and service providers, and ensure consistent standards across the organisation.

**2. Statutory Compliance Management**
--------------------------------------

* Oversee compliance with applicable central and state labour and employment laws, including provident fund, employee state insurance, contract labour, building and construction workers, factories, shops and establishments, professional tax, labour welfare fund, wages, bonus, gratuity, maternity benefits and related requirements.
* Ensure accurate and timely statutory filings, contributions, registers, notices, records and disclosures, supported by appropriate maker-checker controls.
* Conduct periodic compliance certifications and escalate material exceptions, repeat defaults and potential financial or reputational exposure.

**3. Registrations, Renewals and Licensing**
--------------------------------------------

* Provide end-to-end oversight of registrations, renewals, amendments, surrender and closure of statutory licences and registrations.
* Manage principal-employer registrations, contractor labour licences, provident fund and employee state insurance registrations, factory licences, construction-worker registrations, professional tax, labour welfare fund and other approvals.
* Maintain a centralised tracker with clear ownership, document repositories, advance alerts and escalation protocols.

**4. Contractor and Vendor Compliance**
---------------------------------------

* Establish and lead a risk-based contractor labour compliance programme covering onboarding, mobilisation, monthly monitoring, audits and exit controls.
* Review wage records, attendance, social-security remittances, licences, insurance, workforce records and subcontracting arrangements.
* Drive corrective and preventive actions, contractual remedies and closure of high-risk or recurring non-compliances in coordination with Procurement, HR, Legal and site leadership.
* Periodically review contractor-compliance clauses, evidence requirements and governance mechanisms in contracts and purchase orders.

**5. Audits, Risk Management and Management Reporting**
-------------------------------------------------------

* Lead internal, external and site-level statutory compliance audits, including audit planning, sampling methodology, root-cause analysis and closure validation.
* Maintain labour-law risk registers, dashboards, management information reports, heat maps and exception reports for leadership review.
* Support legal, compliance, governance and management-system audits, and ensure audit-ready records across entities and locations.

**6. Government Liaison, Inspections and Disputes**
---------------------------------------------------

* Lead engagement with labour authorities, provident fund and employee state insurance authorities, factory inspectorates and other regulators.
* Manage inspections, notices, inquiries, investigations and statutory proceedings; coordinate fact-finding and prepare or review responses with internal and external counsel.
* Maintain centralised trackers for notices, disputes, litigation and regulatory commitments, with clear strategy, ownership and reporting.
* Represent or support the organisation in conciliation proceedings, labour-court matters and other employment-related forums, as authorised.

**7. Industrial Relations and Employee Relations**
--------------------------------------------------

* Provide strategic support on union engagement, collective bargaining, wage and bonus settlements, strikes, conciliation, workforce restructuring and grievance resolution.
* Advise on disciplinary matters, domestic inquiries, standing orders, misconduct and workplace investigations in coordination with HR and Legal.
* Anticipate industrial-relations risks and support management in maintaining stable and lawful employee relations across locations.

**8. Labour Codes and Change Management**
-----------------------------------------

* Lead organisational preparedness for implementation of the labour codes and related central and state rules.
* Assess impact on wage structures, benefits, contracts, policies, operating models, systems and budgets, and drive cross-functional implementation plans.
* Design and deliver management briefings, stakeholder workshops and practical guidance on regulatory changes.

**9. Compliance Technology and Digitisation**
---------------------------------------------

* Own functional implementation and governance of labour-compliance management tools, document repositories, dashboards, alerts and workflow automation.
* Define data and evidence standards, access controls, review protocols and reporting requirements to maintain reliable, audit-ready records.
* Use compliance analytics to identify trends, repeat exceptions and areas requiring management intervention.

**10. Training and Capability Building**
----------------------------------------

* Develop role-based training, standard operating procedures, toolkits, checklists, guidance notes and awareness material for employees, contractors and site teams.
* Mentor team members and build internal capability to interpret requirements, maintain evidence and address non-compliance promptly.

**Experience and Qualifications**
=================================

* 9 - 13 years of relevant post-qualification experience in labour and employment compliance, industrial relations, statutory governance and contractor workforce compliance.
* Degree in Law strongly preferred; alternatively, a postgraduate qualification in Human Resources, Industrial Relations, Labour Welfare or a related discipline with substantial labour-law compliance experience.
* Demonstrated experience independently leading multi-state compliance for a complex, distributed organisation with offices, industrial operations, construction or project sites.
* Proven experience handling government inspections, regulatory notices, audits, contractor defaults, union or industrial-relations matters and senior-management reporting.
* Experience in renewable energy, infrastructure, engineering, construction, EPC, manufacturing or another contractor-intensive sector is preferred.
* Hands-on experience with compliance-management software, dashboards, document-management systems and data-driven reporting.

**Skills and Leadership Competencies**
======================================

* Expert knowledge of Indian central and state labour laws, social-security requirements and contractor labour compliance.
* Strong legal and commercial judgement, with the ability to prioritise risk and provide practical, business-oriented solutions.
* Ability to influence senior stakeholders and drive accountability across functions, entities, sites, contractors and external advisers.
* Excellent drafting, regulatory correspondence, investigation, negotiation and dispute-management skills.
* Strong programme management, analytical, digital, documentation and management-reporting capabilities.
* High integrity, discretion, ownership and ability to operate independently in complex or sensitive situations.

**Key Deliverables / Success Measures**
=======================================

* Effective compliance governance with no material statutory breaches attributable to control failure.
* All statutory filings, contributions, registrations and renewals completed accurately within prescribed timelines.
* Material and repeat contractor non-compliances identified early, escalated appropriately and closed within agreed action plans.
* Audit and inspection findings resolved within agreed timelines, with sustainable corrective and preventive actions.
* Accurate, timely and decision-useful reporting to management on key obligations, risks, disputes and emerging regulatory changes.
* Successful implementation and adoption of compliance systems, standard operating procedures and labour-law reform initiatives.
* Measurable improvement in compliance maturity, evidence quality and stakeholder capability across business locations.

**Our Commitment**

At ENGIE, every talent has a role to play in accelerating the energy transition. Make a difference and enjoy a fulfilling professional experience. Take on exciting challenges and build a career path that reflects who you are. Join us and be part of the adventure of the century.

ENGIE is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applications from all individuals regardless of age, gender, origin, religion, disability, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic. We are committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can contribute and thrive.

Our core practice areas include Property & Real Estate Laws, Corporate & Commercial Laws, Wills & Succession Planning, Legal Documentation, Dispute Resolution, and Legal Advisory Services. We also advise on banking, educational, regulatory, and compliance-related matters.

Our experience spans traditional sectors such as real estate, land transactions, manufacturing, and automobiles, as well as evolving sectors including e-commerce, redevelopment, and emerging business ventures.
  
  
At Spectrum Legal Solutions, we believe that effective legal counsel goes beyond resolving disputes — it involves anticipating risks, safeguarding interests, and preventing legal complications before they arise. We combine legal knowledge, industry understanding, and a client-centric approach to develop solutions that are legally sound, commercially practical, and implementable.
  
  
Why Join Spectrum Legal Solutions?
  
  
We offer aspiring legal professionals an opportunity to gain hands-on exposure to diverse legal assignments, develop strong research and drafting capabilities, interact with varied legal and commercial matters, and learn through practical experience and professional mentorship.
  
  
Our work culture emphasises integrity, continuous learning, attention to detail, professional responsibility, and client-focused problem-solving.

WE ARE HIRING | LEGAL ASSOCIATE
  
  
  
  
Experience: Minimum 2 Years

Work Location: Pune | Work from Office
  
  
About the Role
  
  
Spectrum Legal Solutions is seeking a dedicated, detail-oriented, and professionally driven Legal Associate to join our growing legal team.
  
  
The ideal candidate should possess strong legal research, drafting, documentation, and analytical skills, along with the ability to manage assignments independently while collaborating effectively with the team.
  
  
This position offers exposure to diverse legal matters, particularly Property & Real Estate Laws, Conveyancing, Corporate & Commercial Laws, Wills & Succession, Legal Documentation, and Dispute Resolution.
  
  
Key Roles & Responsibilities
  
  
1. Legal Drafting, Documentation & Conveyancing
  
  
- Draft, review, vet, and finalise legal documents, deeds, instruments, and conveyancing documentation.
  
- Conduct property-related due diligence, including searches and verification of records through relevant government portals and authorities.
  
- Prepare Search Reports, Title Investigation Reports, and Legal Opinions.
  
- Identify legal risks, discrepancies, and documentation deficiencies, and recommend appropriate corrective measures.
  
  
2. Agreements, Contracts & Commercial Advisory
  
  
- Draft, review, and vet commercial agreements, business contracts, MOUs, and other legal instruments.
  
- Assist startups, SMEs, businesses, and institutions with legal documentation and contractual requirements.
  
- Examine contractual obligations, potential liabilities, and compliance-related risks.
  
  
3. Legal Notices & Client Communication
  
  
- Draft and issue legal notices, replies, representations, and other legal correspondence.
  
- Assist in client consultations, legal discussions, and matter-related communications.
  
- Communicate professionally and clearly with clients, authorities, and other stakeholders.
  
- Ensure timely follow-ups and updates on assigned matters.
  
  
4. Legal Research, Analysis & Case Assessment
  
  
- Conduct comprehensive legal research on statutes, rules, regulations, judicial precedents, and emerging legal developments.
  
- Prepare legal research notes, case summaries, opinions, and issue-based assessments.
  
- Support litigation, dispute resolution, and advisory assignments through research and documentation.
  
  
5. Matter Management, Coordination & Record Keeping
  
  
- Maintain accurate physical and digital records of client matters, legal documents, correspondence, and assignments.
  
- Manage calendars, deadlines, appointments, follow-ups, and assignment trackers.
  
- Coordinate with clients, government departments, registration offices, and other relevant stakeholders.
  
- Ensure proper documentation, confidentiality, and timely completion of assigned work.
  
  
Qualifications & Eligibility
  
  
Essential Requirements
  
  
- LL.B. degree from a recognised university.
  
- Enrolment with a State Bar Council.
  
- Minimum 2 years of relevant professional experience in legal practice, documentation, or advisory work.
  
- Strong proficiency in legal drafting, vetting, conveyancing, and legal research.
  
- Sound understanding of applicable laws, legal procedures, and documentation requirements.
  
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  
- Strong organisational skills and the ability to manage multiple assignments and deadlines.
  
- High standards of professional ethics, confidentiality, accuracy, and accountability.
  
  
Preferred Skills & Experience
  
  
- Practical experience in Property & Real Estate Laws, Corporate & Commercial Laws, Succession Laws, Intellectual Property Rights, or Dispute Resolution.
  
- Experience preparing property Search and Title Reports and conducting due diligence.
  
- Familiarity with Maharashtra land and property records, registration procedures, and relevant government portals.
  
- Proficiency in MS Office, Google Workspace, and digital document management.
  
- Ability to use AI-assisted legal research and drafting tools responsibly, with independent verification of legal accuracy.
  
  
What We Value
  
  
At Spectrum Legal Solutions, we particularly appreciate professionals who demonstrate:
  
  
- Ownership: Taking responsibility for assignments from initiation to completion.
  
- Precision: Delivering thoroughly researched, accurate, and carefully drafted work.
  
- Initiative: Anticipating requirements and proactively identifying solutions.
  
- Integrity: Upholding confidentiality, ethical standards, and professional responsibility.
  
- Learning Mindset: Remaining curious, adaptable, and committed to continuous professional development.
  
- Teamwork: Collaborating effectively while maintaining individual accountability.
  
  
Employment Details
  
  
- Position: Legal Associate
  
- Job Type: Full-Time
  
- Work Schedule: Day Shift
  
- Location: Pune, Maharashtra
  
- Experience Required: Minimum 2 Years
  
- Annual Salary: ₹2,00,000 – ₹3,00,000
  
- Commute/Relocation: Candidates must be able to reliably commute to Pune or relocate before joining.
  
  
Join Spectrum Legal Solutions
  
  
We believe that a good legal professional does more than interpret the law — they understand the client's concerns, anticipate risks, and deliver practical solutions.
  
  
If you are passionate about the legal profession, committed to quality, and eager to develop your skills through meaningful, hands-on assignments, we welcome your application.
  
  
Spectrum Legal Solutions
  
Combining Reputation, Skills and Experience to Deliver Results.

title: Principal Associate
description:
**ABOUT THE FIRM**

Stride AMC manages multiple Alternative Investment Funds across India (SEBI Cat 2 AIF), GIFT City (IFSCA AIF), ADGM / Abu Dhabi (FSRA Cat 3) and London (FCA-regulated). We invest across debt / equity / credit strategies and partner with high-growth companies across sectors. The legal team is central to everything we do — from regulatory compliance to deal execution to investor management.

The legal team operates as a true business partner — advising the investment team, management and board on the full spectrum of fund, transaction and corporate legal matters.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is a senior, high-impact role for an accomplished lawyer with 6–8 years of post-qualification experience. The Principal Associate will independently lead complex multi-jurisdictional transactions, regulatory compliance and AMC-level strategic legal matters. The role involves significant interaction with senior management, the board, investors, regulators and external counsel. The successful candidate will be a trusted legal advisor within the organisation and will play a key role in building institutional legal processes and managing the broader legal team.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**1. Investor Management & Complex Fund Documentation**

* Lead drafting, review and negotiation of contribution agreements, side letters, limited partnership agreement (LPA) amendments, co-investment agreements and related documents across all fund structures.
* Drive PPM updates, fund rules amendments and constitutional document revisions independently; ensure regulatory alignment across all jurisdictions.
* Advise on complex investor structuring queries, including nominee / custodian arrangements, FDI / ODI considerations, FEMA structuring, tax treaty implications and FATCA / CRS compliance.
* Manage LP disputes, complaints, escalations and redemption/transfer requests, including coordination with the investment team and compliance.
* Lead fund lifecycle events: first close, interim closes, final close, fund extensions, GP-led restructurings, successor fund formation and wind-down processes.

**2. Strategic Transactions, Acquisitions & Structuring**

* Lead the legal workstream on key strategic transactions: fund platform acquisitions, GP stake sales, mergers of fund structures, spin-offs, co-investment platform formation and secondary market transactions.
* Advise on and execute AMC-level transactions: acquisitions of AMC stakes or businesses, joint ventures, management buy-ins/buy-outs and change of control arrangements.
* Structure and execute complex equity transactions: control buyouts, leveraged acquisitions, structured equity, convertible instruments (CCDs, OCDs, OFCDs), rights offerings and exit structures (drag-along, tag-along, put/call options).
* Lead complex debt transactions: structured / mezzanine debt, syndicated facilities, listed NCD issuances (on BSE / NSE), securitisation / ABS transactions, inter-creditor and security trustee arrangements.
* Manage external legal counsel across jurisdictions on complex transactions; review and control external counsel costs against budget.
* Advise the investment team on deal structuring, risk allocation and transaction documentation strategy.

**3. AMC Structuring, Governance & Corporate Legal**

* Advise on AMC-level structural and ownership matters: entity reorganisations, holding company arrangements, regulatory capital requirements, SEBI registration amendments and change of control approvals.
* Support SEBI / IFSCA registration and in-principle approval matters, licence amendments and new product / scheme launches.
* Draft and review internal AMC policies, board papers, governance frameworks, committee charters, conflict of interest policies, code of conduct and related party transaction policies.
* Advise on FEMA / ODI / FDI implications of AMC investments, fund structuring and offshore fund flows.
* Manage complex regulatory enquiries, arbitrations, disputes and litigation with external counsel.

**4. General Counsel Support & Cross-Functional Advisory**

* Act as a senior legal advisor to the investment team, CFO, COO and board — providing timely, high-quality legal advice on cross-functional matters including competition law, ESG / sustainability disclosures, insurance, IP and technology.
* Advise on senior employment matters: key management employment agreements, ESOP, carry structuring and grant processes, retention schemes, non-compete / non-solicitation arrangements and senior employee disputes.
* Lead DPDP Act 2023 (India), UK GDPR and ADGM data protection compliance; manage data processing agreements and privacy incident response.
* Lead complex vendor and technology negotiations: IT infrastructure, fund administration, custody, data and analytics agreements.
* Mentor and supervise the Legal Associates and other junior team members; support capacity building, knowledge management and precedent development.

**QUALIFICATIONS & EXPERIENCE**

* LLB / LLM from a recognised institution.
* 6–8 years of post-qualification experience, with significant time at a Tier 1 / Tier 2 law firm in fund formation, structured finance or M&A practice, or in-house at an AMC, fund, NBFC or financial services company.
* Deep expertise in SEBI AIF regulations and fund documentation — this is a mandatory requirement.
* Significant hands-on experience in debt transaction documentation (NCDs, debentures, structured finance, security creation) and equity transaction documentation (SSA, SHA, control deals).
* Demonstrated experience advising on complex or strategic transactions (acquisitions, structuring, fund mergers or GP-led transactions) is strongly preferred.
* Prior exposure to offshore fund structures (GIFT City IFSCA, ADGM / FSRA, FCA-regulated) is a strong advantage.
* Experience advising on AMC structuring, SEBI licence matters or regulatory approvals is a plus.

**KEY SKILLS & COMPETENCIES**

* Independent legal judgment: confident in providing definitive advice without routine escalation.
* Strong commercial acumen: ability to understand business priorities and translate them into pragmatic legal solutions.
* Excellent negotiation skills: able to negotiate effectively with sophisticated counterparties including institutional investors, PE funds, banks and large corporates.
* Stakeholder management: comfortable engaging with board-level stakeholders, regulators, external counsel and international counterparts.
* Leadership and mentoring: able to delegate, guide and develop junior team members.
* Ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams under tight timelines.
* Resilient and adaptable in a fast-paced, multi-jurisdictional environment.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

title: Compliance Executive
description:
Key Responsibilities – Quality & Compliance (Secretarial and FEMA)

1. Quality Review of Documents

* Review secretarial and regulatory documents before filing to ensure accuracy, completeness, and compliance with applicable laws and regulations.
* Review incorporation documents, including SPICe+, e-MoA, e-AoA, AGILE-PRO-S, INC-9, DIR-2, registered office proofs, and LLP incorporation forms.
* Review annual ROC filings such as AOC-4, MGT-7/MGT-7A, ADT-1, DIR-3 KYC, DPT-3, MSME-1, and LLP Forms 8 and 11.
* Review event-based ROC filings, including INC-20A, INC-22, DIR-12, PAS-3, SH-7, MGT-14, CHG-1, BEN-2, STK-2, and relevant LLP forms.
* Verify board and general meeting notices, minutes, resolutions, statutory registers, and share issue documentation.
* Review FEMA-related filings, including FC-GPR, FC-TRS, LLP-I, LLP-II, Form DI, Form ODI, APR, ECB-2, and FLA returns.
* Verify names, DIN/DPIN, capital details, shareholding, dates, authorised signatories, supporting documents, and attachments against source records.
* Conduct 100% quality checks for high-risk filings, particularly FEMA reporting, share allotments, and charge-related filings, along with defined sampling checks for routine filings.
* Monitor statutory filing deadlines and identify discrepancies that may lead to resubmissions, penalties, or additional fees.

2. Quality Reporting and Founder Coordination

* Report directly to the Founder on quality, compliance risks, and recurring filing errors.
* Prepare weekly quality reports covering filings reviewed, error rates by team and form, resubmissions, and late fees.
* Escalate critical errors or compliance risks promptly and recommend corrective actions.
* Maintain an error log to track discrepancies by team, form type, and root cause.

3. Team Training and Development

* Conduct induction training for new joiners on incorporation, ROC compliance, and FEMA processes.
* Organise monthly refresher sessions based on recurring errors and process gaps.
* Communicate relevant regulatory updates issued by the MCA, RBI, and ICSI, and ensure checklists are updated accordingly.
* Assess team members’ readiness before authorising them to independently handle specific filing types.

4. SOPs, Checklists, and Regulatory Compliance

* Develop and maintain standardised quality-checking checklists for each form and service line.
* Create, review, and update SOPs, templates, and internal quality-control procedures.
* Track amendments to the Companies Act, 2013, LLP Act, 2008, applicable FEMA regulations, and Secretarial Standards.
* Ensure internal processes remain aligned with applicable statutory and regulatory requirements.

5. Process Improvement and Automation

* Identify recurring errors and implement preventive measures to address their root causes.
* Collaborate with delivery teams to improve filing accuracy and operational efficiency.
* Work with the product and technology teams to convert manual checklists into system validations and automated pre-filing checks.
* Exercise quality-control authority to hold or escalate filings that do not meet the required accuracy and compliance standards until the issues are resolved.
