title: Analyst – CLM Configuration
description:
**About Sirion**
Sirion is the world’s leading AI-native Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform, transforming the way global enterprises manage their contracting journey. Powered by generative AI, Sirion delivers intelligent extraction, conversational search, and AI-driven negotiation capabilities for some of the world’s most valuable brands. With over 7M+ contracts worth nearly $800B under management and recognition from Gartner, IDC, and Spend Matters, Sirion continues to set the benchmark for innovation in CLM.
  
  
www.sirion.ai
  
  
**Power the Future of SaaS Delivery & Why This Role Matters**
As an Analyst – CLM Configuration, you will play a key role in configuring and automating legal contract templates within Sirion’s Contract Lifecycle Management (CLM) platform. You will transform approved legal documents and clause libraries into dynamic, reusable templates that enable clients to generate accurate contracts based on predefined business rules and requirements.
  
  
Working closely with clients, legal teams, business stakeholders and internal implementation teams, you will configure template logic, validate contract outputs and ensure high-quality delivery within agreed timelines. This role requires strong attention to detail, logical thinking and an understanding of contract structures, with a focus on accuracy, automation and client satisfaction.
  
  
**How You’ll Make an Impact**
**Contract Template Configuration & Automation**

* Configure approved legal contract templates and clause libraries, including NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, DPAs, purchase agreements and service agreements, within Sirion’s CLM platform.
* Map contract fields, variables and data points to enable automated contract generation.
* Configure clause assembly, conditional logic and fallback clauses based on predefined business rules, contract requirements and approved legal language.
* Support template configuration across different languages, governing laws and jurisdictions, ensuring the appropriate clauses and provisions are applied.

**Template Testing & Quality Assurance**

* Conduct User Acceptance Testing (UAT) to validate template configurations and ensure contracts are generated accurately across different scenarios and combinations of business rules.
* Identify, troubleshoot and resolve configuration issues, inconsistencies and defects in contract outputs.
* Validate template functionality against approved requirements and coordinate with relevant stakeholders to resolve issues before production deployment.
* Maintain quality standards and ensure templates are ready for production within agreed timelines.

**Client Engagement & Delivery Management**

* Participate in client kick-off meetings, template discussions and requirement-gathering sessions to understand business and legal requirements.
* Collaborate with client legal teams, business stakeholders and internal implementation teams to clarify requirements, validate approved clauses and translate business needs into configuration rules.
* Estimate effort and manage assigned templates independently, ensuring timely delivery against agreed project milestones.
* Manage multiple templates and concurrent client engagements, prioritising work effectively while maintaining accuracy and quality.

**Skills & Experience You Bring to the Table**
**Experience & Education**

* 2–5 years of relevant experience in CLM implementation, contract template configuration, document automation or legal technology.
* Hands-on experience configuring contract templates, clause libraries, conditional rules or automated document-generation solutions.
* Experience working with CLM platforms such as Sirion, Icertis, Conga or other comparable contract management solutions is preferred.
* Familiarity with legal contract structures and documents such as NDAs, MSAs, SOWs, DPAs and purchase or service agreements.
* A legal or paralegal background is an advantage.

**Functional & Technical Skills**

* Understanding of contract structures, clause libraries, contract variables and document-generation logic.
* Ability to translate business and legal requirements into configurable template rules.
* Experience with UAT, test scenarios, defect identification, troubleshooting and quality assurance.
* Familiarity with different governing laws, jurisdictions and language-specific contract requirements is an advantage.

**Core Competencies**

* Strong attention to detail and a commitment to accuracy and quality.
* Analytical thinking and problem-solving skills, with the ability to interpret requirements and troubleshoot configuration issues.
* Effective written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to collaborate with clients and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Strong organisational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple templates and meet delivery commitments.
* A client-focused mindset and the ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with the wider team.

**Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion**
Sirion is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse and inclusive workplace. We do not discriminate based on race, color, gender, religion, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, medical condition, genetic information, military or veteran status, marital status, pregnancy, gender identity, sexual orientation, or any other protected characteristic. Reasonable accommodations are provided as required by law.
  
  
**Excited about this opportunity?**
We’d love to hear from you! To apply, simply visit our Careers at Sirion page and follow the steps to submit your application.

Brown-Forman, a longstanding leader in promoting the responsible enjoyment of premium beverage alcohol products, seeks to retain a Public Affairs professional to assist in implementing its strategies to enhance and protect Brown-Forman’s commercial and and marketing freedoms, and promote alcohol responsibility in India.

* Assessing the cultural and political environment affecting the distilled spirits industry in India and providing sound strategic and tactical advice to the company

* Strategically inform, identify and advise Brown-Forman on public policy initiatives to promote industry self-regulation, alcohol education, and alcohol responsibility throughout India
* Contribute to the development of a comprehensive strategy and consistent practice for Brown-Forman government relations for India
* Work closely with B-F local management to develop and implement a proactive agenda to advance Brown-Forman’s commercial interests in India

**This Will Involve**

* Working to protect Brown-Forman’s interests from threats that would worsen the commercial environment for the responsible sale and marketing of distilled spirits
* Identifying and working (most often collectively with others in the beverage alcohol industry) to reform existing laws, policies and regulations that unreasonably impede Brown-Forman’s business in India
* Spokesperson for Brown-Forman on political and alcohol responsibility matters with governments, politicians and regulators
* Advise and provide support on strategic and policy matters in the areas of alcohol responsibility and Public Affairs in India
* Collaborate with the General Manager, India and South Asia and the leadership team to ensure the commercial imperatives for the India business are reflected in India public policy and regulation
* Serve as Brown-Forman’s primary representative on day-to-day matters involving trade associations of which Brown-Forman is a member in India, including ISWAI working groups (International Spirits and Wine Association of India)
* Work closely with and under the guidance and direction of the VP, Director of Public Affairs EAA in determining policy and involvement in all these and other discussion forums
* Support the General Manager, India and South Asia in their capacity as Brown-Forman’s representative on the board of ISWAI
* Coordinate lobbying on behalf of Brown-Forman, including ensuring compliance with the highest ethical standards and all applicable laws and governmental regulations
* Collaborate with internal colleagues in India and abroad (including the General Manager, India and South Asia, legal, supply chain, marketing, commercial and finance) regarding regulatory issues in India
* Coordinate the Responsibility agenda within Brown Forman India
* Drive and monitor policy and program interventions with government & industry bodies across the states, monitoring their progress and follow-up in furtherance of the company's growth plans and business objectives
* Provide timely information on any policy change with its implications to all regions
* Working with the Legal Manager, India, ensures the company’s policy positions are designed and implemented in compliance with relevant laws and company policies
* Keep a watching brief and communicate regularly on competitor positions and policy approaches with government
* Ensure all issues related to State Excise, Licensing, land matters and environment are timely anticipated and resolved
* Establishing, maintaining and developing healthy relationships with the central and state government authorities, Embassy contacts and apex trade bodies (example FICCI, CII, CCPA, ASCI, AmCham) for strategic engagement
* Overseeing all applications for permission / approvals/License / registration
* Working closely with the functional heads and managers, and keeping them well informed on relevant public policy issues, debates and trends; extend guidance and advice on issues involving clearance from Central/State government and statutory/regulatory authorities

**What You Bring To The Table**

* Public Affairs professional with a graduate degree and at least 10 years of applicable experience
* Experience sitting on or working for an industry trade association
* Familiarity with navigating the state and central government political systems in India
* Excellent oral and written communication skills. The successful candidate will be an organized thinker, a good planner and a strong advocate. The candidate must be able to communicate, even on highly complex matters, in short, readable memos
* Ability to influence and lobby successfully for company and industry positions. Brown-Forman places great emphasis on the ability to strategize and persuade; these qualities are fundamental to this position
* Dealing with Ambiguity - handles risk and uncertainty comfortably and has good judgment on how new ideas will play out in the market
* Multicultural mindset
* Team player
* Highest reputation for integrity
* Good judgment. Brown-Forman recognizes that public policy, particularly in the beverage alcohol area, can be sensitive and controversial. The successful candidate will recognize these sensitivities and have demonstrated the ability to use common sense and exhibit balanced thinking
* Ability to set priorities, identify opportunities, and see matters through to successful completion. The successful applicant will be a self-starter capable of managing a variety of projects efficiently with minimal supervision

**What Makes You Unique**

* Experience in the spirits / alcobev industry strongly preferred
* Experience working in a heavily regulated industry within the region
* Understanding of:

○ the operation of excise, tax and customs laws and regulations in India
  
  
○ Food Safety Standards Association of India (FSSAI) labeling requirements
  
  
○ ASCI marketing guidelines and operation of the CCPA

We believe great people build great brands. And we know there is Nothing Better in the Market than a career at Brown-Forman. title: Case/Contract Management Services Associate IV
description:
Through our dedicated associates, Conduent delivers mission-critical services and solutions on behalf of Fortune 100 companies and over 500 governments - creating exceptional outcomes for our clients and the millions of people who count on them. You have an opportunity to personally thrive, make a difference and be part of a culture where individuality is noticed and valued every day.
  
  
**Position Overview**
:
  
  
This position requires significant in-depth knowledge and understanding of organizational operations around platforms and services supporting LCA’s solution offerings. An extensive amount of interface with multiple organizations is imperative - most importantly through interactions with the Finance, Billing & Pricing and Contracts, Systems and Client Services team. This includes participation in client services related activities such as attending meetings and discussions regarding new client matters and/or changes to client service agreements.
  
  
This multifaceted role requires continuous collaboration and acting as liaison across critical teams for verification of relevant client contracts and billing. Such teams include Contracts, Finance, Pricing, Billing, Human Resources, Systems and Business Development. In addition to billing and invoicing, this position will also track information on all client contract service provisions, pricing, billing, and any additional compliance measures dictated by the contract and/or service agreement.
  
  
The individual will be required to:
  
  

* Develop and maintain a thorough and solid understanding for billable activities and invoicing related to the multiple service offerings around all LCA’s eDiscovery solutions: OmniX, Viewpoint and Relativity services offerings, as well as, Managed Review, Consulting and Analytics, Compliance and other related legal services (e.g., scanning, audio files support, etc.) where appropriate;
* Develop and maintain a thorough understanding of the pricing parameters and guidelines of existing and newly executed client agreements;
* Have the ability to understand any contractual changes, updates and expirations, then to translate those changes into system updates to ensure there is no interruption within the invoicing mechanisms;
* Review system generated billing data intended for invoice generation on a regular and timely basis. Verify accuracy of billing data, and report and resolve any billing problems, issues, or discrepancies to stakeholders;
* Verify and validate against established data points, and for the purpose of invoicing, identify items that are out of scope and determine as billable or non-billable;
* Work with designated client service manager and/or account manager to finalize invoices for submission to client. Develop expertise in billing issues for assigned group of clients and interface with stakeholders for full understanding of contractual matters that impact invoicing a particular client and/or contract;
* Confirm information captured as being outside of the parameters of client agreements and verify the accuracy of said services and/or provisions (i.e., confirmation of a change order, verification of additional billable services, etc.).

title: Legal Advisor
description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**
At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.
  
  
**Job Description:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operates under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) ("Crowe"). Crowe is seeking a candidate to support and assist the Commercial Transactions team within Crowe Advisory LLC’s Legal Department, the US-based parent of Crowe. This is a transaction-focused contracting role. It also involves support on data privacy, and, occasionally, general corporate matters. The Legal Advisor’s main job is to review, draft, and revise professional services, vendor, and technology-related agreements. The Legal Advisor will report to attorneys based in the United States of America. Regular working hours will need overlap with US business hours. The role’s duties and responsibilities may expand Legal Advisor learns Crowe’s business and shows sound judgment in managing business risk.
  
  
**Role and Responsibilities:**

* Review client and vendor contracts, terms and conditions of the Agreements, as well as requests for proposal documents (“RFPs”).
* Identify issues and areas of risks and propose modifications to the contract terms.
* Develop a detailed understanding of Crowe’s professional service lines and technology products, and the risks associated with them, so they can be reflected in contracts, terms and conditions, and RFP responses.
* Draft and negotiate professional services, vendor, and technology-related agreements, including master services agreements, engagement letters, confidentiality agreements, business associate agreements, SaaS agreements, data protection agreements, software licenses, subcontractor agreements, as well as related statements of work.
* Understand and apply the professional standards that are relevant to specific service lines, including independence and other standards that apply to US audit and tax services.
* Learn and apply international laws and regulations related to privacy, data protection, and information security and artificial intelligence laws and requirements when reviewing client and vendor contracts. This includes US federal and state privacy laws, the EU/UK GDPR, and others.
* Identify both apparent and hidden risks associated with the task presented and collaborate / discuss with reporting managers to manage the risk.
* Identify and advise on practical risk mitigation measures that may be adopted for the benefit of Crowe and the clients.
* Utilize contract lifecycle management (CLM) and legal AI review tools as a core part of daily contract review. This includes refining and maintaining the playbooks that guide automated and manual review processes
* Keep accurate matter records in the CLM system and meet internal service-level expectations for turnaround.
* This position will assist with managing Crowe’s contractual risk. Successful candidates must also commit to learning Crowe’s multiple business lines and products at a detailed level.

**Education Qualification:**

* LL.B. degree and qualification as a registered lawyer in India.
* Privacy certifications (e.g., CIPP/E, CIPP/US, CIPM) are also given priority.

**Key Qualifications:**

* At least five (5) years of relevant post-qualification experience at a reputable law firm, a Big Four or professional services firm, a global capability center, or an in-house legal department. Experience must include contract review, drafting, and risk management in a high-volume, fast-moving environment with rapidly shifting priorities.
* Candidate will be required to take initiative and manage a large volume of requests. Candidates must have the ability to multi-task, manage substantial workloads with changing priorities while staying focused on quality, clients, and teamwork.
* Candidate must be well organized and able to meet deadlines, while possessing sound business judgment, discretion, flexibility, and willingness to learn.
* Excellent written and spoken English. Must be comfortable communicating directly with US-based attorneys and business stakeholders.
* Candidate must have strong contract drafting and negotiation skills.
* Candidate must have the enthusiasm for learning new technology, including our contract management system and legal AI solutions. A strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office is also required.
* Candidates with additional experience in reviewing state or federal government contracts, working on governmental, accounting, or financial regulatory sectors, advising on international laws and regulations related to privacy and data protection, and on a range of intellectual property matters as they relate to marketing, trade secrets, licensing, patents, and copyright will be preferred.
* The selected candidate will report to the Associate General Counsel or Assistant General Counsel based on the United States of America.
* Willing to work hours that regularly overlap with US business hours.

**Preferred Experience**

* Reviewing US federal, state, or local government contracts, or public-sector RFPs.
* Working in the accounting or financial-services regulatory sectors.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.
  
  
**Our Benefits:**
At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We value our people and offer employees a comprehensive benefits package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!
  
  
**How You Can Grow:**
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!
  
  
**More about Crowe:**
Crowe Capability Center – India, operating under the legal entity C3 India Delivery Centre LLP (formerly known as Crowe Horwath IT Services LLP) is a wholly owned subsidiary of Crowe LLP (U.S.A.), a public accounting, consulting and technology firm with offices around the world. Crowe LLP is an independent member firm of Crowe Global, one of the largest global accounting networks in the world. The network consists of more than 200 independent accounting and advisory firms in more than 130 countries around the world.
  
  
Crowe does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.
  
  
We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

title: Senior Data Protection Consultant
description:
**Job Description**
**About Us**
Tsaaro’s prime focus is on Data Privacy and Security. Our team of specialist data privacy consultants, information security consultants, and penetration testers help and advise our clients to make running a secure business easier, with high efficiency. Everything we do is tailored to the individual organizational requirements, aligned with their budget and resource challenges. We take a pragmatic, risk-based approach to provide our clients with real-world, workable advice, guidance, and support that helps them to deal with a wide range of security and privacy-related challenges.
  
  
**Responsibilities**
As a Senior Data Protection Consultant, you will be entrusted with the following key responsibilities:
  
  

* Design and implement data protection and privacy programs that cater to our clients' specific business needs, ensuring their sensitive information is well safeguarded.
* Evaluate and assess our clients' data protection and privacy practices, offering valuable insights and actionable recommendations for continual improvement.
* Demonstrate expertise in various standards, such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, ISO 27701, etc., to assist clients in compliance and governance.
* Provide guidance and support to clients in adhering to a complex web of national and international laws and regulations, including the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and other privacy laws.
* Assist in preparing policies, reports, and schedules for clients and relevant stakeholders, ensuring clear communication and alignment with industry best practices.
* Conduct thorough audits of Privacy controls to monitor program effectiveness and compliance, ensuring data protection is at its optimal level.
* Utilize online tools to facilitate Incident Management and Data Subject Rights processes, ensuring efficient and timely responses to potential data incidents.
* Foster and maintain productive working relationships with client personnel, promoting effective collaboration and understanding of their specific needs.
* Demonstrate a strong commitment to adhering to workplace policies and procedures, maintaining the highest standards of professionalism and confidentiality.
* Contribute to cybersecurity engagements, developing cybersecurity strategies, governance, risk, and compliance activities, and cybersecurity policies in line with ISO 27001 and ISO 27701.
* Perform Gap Assessments, Risk Assessments, ISMS Documentation, Internal Audits, and support during Certification Audits to strengthen overall security frameworks.

**Requirements**
To be considered for this role, the candidate must meet the following requirements:
  
  

* Possess a sound knowledge of fundamentals of information security systems.
* Have 4+ years of relevant experience in the field.
* Demonstrate proficiency in standards such as ISO 27001/2, ISO 22301, ISO 27018, NIST standards on Cyber Security, HITRUST, ISO 27701, etc.
* Exhibit a good understanding of GDPR, CCPA, or other privacy laws.
* Display competence in governance and reporting, as well as a strong grasp of cyber and privacy risks.
* Hold relevant qualifications such as CIPM, CIPT, CIPP/E.
* Showcase excellent communication skills, both written and verbal.

**Benefits**

* Competitive salary and performance-based bonuses.
* Professional development opportunities, including training and certifications.
* Flexible working hours.
* Collaborative and inclusive work environment.
* Opportunity to work with a passionate team dedicated to making a difference in data privacy and security.

Join and hustle with the India's fastest privacy and information security consulting company.

Our team helps clients manage their risk/return trade-offs to support them with better decision-making around financing and capital efficiency.
  
  
Whether clients are preserving, optimizing, raising or investing, our Connected Capital Solutions (CCS) are our five go-to-market offerings that help drive competitive advantage and increased returns through improved decision-making. The CCS include Strategy, Corporate Finance, Buy and Integrate, Sell and Separate and Reshaping Results, and are underpinned by our Connected Capital Technologies.
  
  
Our key focus areas are - Investment Banking Advisory, Valuations, Modeling and Economics, Transaction Diligence, Restructuring and Turnaround Services, Project Finance and infrastructure, EY Parthenon - Strategy and EY Parthenon - Execution.
  
  
**Your Key Responsibilities**
**Technical Excellence**

* Games Energy Master Plan
* Hour-by-hour demand model for all venues, Athletes’ Village, IBC/MPC, and ancillary facilities identifying peak loads, supply-demand gaps, and grid connection upgrade requirements with GUVNL and DISCOMs
* Assessment of grid connection adequacy and upgrade requirements for each venue cluster
* Emergency backup and redundancy planning ensuring zero diesel dependency 3.2.2 RE Portfolio Design and Optimization
* Optimize RE mix: on-site rooftop/canopy solar PV using Gujarat Solar Atlas and NASA POWER irradiance data; utility-scale solar via GUVNL open-access (Dholera Solar Park, Gujarat RE zones); wind procurement; short-term RE procurement options for construction and Games operational periods
* Green hydrogen pilot for backup power and process heat applications
* Financial modelling of RE portfolio options with LCOE, IRR, and payback analysis
* 24/7 hourly matching optimisation: design the RE portfolio to achieve 15-minute interval demand-supply matching as verified through the Green Power Verification Instrument Registry 3.2.3 PPA Structuring and Procurement
* Design direct open-access PPAs, GUVNL green tariff, and virtual PPAs
* Assess GERC rules: wheeling charges, banking provisions, cross-subsidy surcharges
* Prepare competitive RFP with bid evaluation criteria, negotiation support, and PPA execution support 3.2.4 I-REC and Green Power Strategy
* Design I-REC procurement for residual consumption specifying additionality, vintage (2029+), technology, and geographic criteria
* Manage acquisition and registry retirement
* Establish Green Power Verification Instrument Registry for MRV 3.2.5 BESS, Backup, and Smart Grid
* Size BESS for peak shaving, RE firming (24/7 clean supply), and ancillary services
* Design battery/green hydrogen fuel cell backup for critical systems replacing diesel gensets
* Venue Energy Management System (VEMS) functional specification with smart metering and sub-metering design

**Skills And Attributes**
**To qualify for the role you must have**
**Qualification**

* B-Tech and M-Tech

**Experience**

* Project Management (6+ years)

**What We Look For**
People with the ability to work in a collaborative manner to provide services across multiple client departments while following the commercial and legal requirements. You will need a practical approach to solving issues and complex problems with the ability to deliver insightful and practical solutions. We look for people who are agile, curious, mindful, and able to sustain positive energy, while being adaptable and creative in their approach.
  
  
**What We Offer**
Fuelled by the brilliance of our people, EY has emerged as the strongest brand and the most attractive employer in our field, with market-leading growth over competitors. Our people work side-by-side with market-leading entrepreneurs, game-changers, disruptors, and visionaries. title: Principal Officer
description:
**About Angel One:**

For nearly three decades, Angel One has been making investing and wealth creation more accessible and engaging for Indians. Today, 3.7+ crore customers trust Angel One across investing, trading, wealth creation, and credit.

We are one of the best fintech platforms, building simple, intelligent and seamless financial experiences for millions of users across the country. From investing and trading to wealth creation and credit, everything we build is focused on making financial journeys easier, faster, more accessible and engaging.

We believe strong fundamentals matter—in investing, in technology and in the way we build our teams. Trust, simplicity, speed and long-term thinking shape how we work and what we build.

Here, people work on real problems at real scale. Millions of users interact with our platform every day, and every team plays a role in shaping that experience.

We move fast, take ownership and keep learning along the way. No matter the role, people here are encouraged to share ideas, challenge the usual and build things that create real impact.

If you're excited to solve meaningful problems, build at scale, and shape the future of financial services, you'll fit right in.

Be part of our team that’s scaling sustainably, thinking big, and building for the billion!

**Job Title:**
Principal Officer – GIFT City

**Location:**
Gandhinagar

**Role Overview**

We are looking for an experienced professional to lead and oversee the operations of our GIFT IFSC entity, a fintech-led broker-dealer business focused primarily on providing access to US-listed equities and Exchange-Traded Funds (ETFs).

The Principal Officer will be responsible for overseeing business operations, ensuring adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, maintaining robust governance and internal controls, and coordinating with regulatory authorities and key business partners. The role requires a strong understanding of securities markets, brokerage operations, regulatory requirements, and cross-border trading arrangements.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Operations & Regulatory Oversight**

* Oversee the overall operations of the GIFT IFSC entity and ensure adherence to applicable IFSCA regulations, guidelines, circulars, and directions.
* Establish and maintain robust operating procedures, governance frameworks, and internal controls.
* Ensure timely completion of applicable regulatory filings, reporting, disclosures, and operational requirements.
* Coordinate with senior management, compliance, risk, finance, technology, and operations teams to ensure effective business functioning.

**2. US Equities & ETF Brokerage**

* Oversee operational processes supporting access to US-listed equities and ETFs.
* Monitor trade execution arrangements, trade confirmations, clearing and settlement, custody, reconciliation, and corporate actions, as applicable to the business model.
* Manage coordination with overseas brokers, custodians, banking partners, and other intermediaries.
* Ensure appropriate controls around client accounts, transaction processing, operational exceptions, and service delivery.

**3. Risk Management & Internal Controls**

* Identify and manage operational, regulatory, counterparty, settlement, and business risks.
* Monitor adherence to internal policies, approved procedures, escalation protocols, and risk controls.
* Drive resolution of operational issues, control gaps, audit observations, and regulatory findings.
* Support business continuity planning and periodic reviews of operational effectiveness.

**4. Compliance & Client Protection**

* Work closely with the designated Compliance Officer to ensure compliance with applicable regulatory and legal requirements.
* Oversee operational support for client onboarding, KYC, AML/CFT, sanctions screening, transaction monitoring, and customer due diligence.
* Ensure effective grievance management, incident escalation, record maintenance, and appropriate reporting.
* Promote a strong compliance culture across the organisation.

**5. Regulatory & Stakeholder Management**

* Serve as a key point of coordination with IFSCA and other relevant stakeholders in relation to the Principal Officer's responsibilities.
* Coordinate regulatory inspections, audits, information requests, and remediation activities.
* Track regulatory developments affecting the GIFT IFSC entity and ensure appropriate implementation.
* Provide periodic updates to senior management on business operations, regulatory matters, risks, and control effectiveness.

**Candidate Profile**

* Relevant professional or postgraduate qualification in finance, law, accountancy, business management, commerce, economics, capital markets, banking, insurance, actuarial science, fintech, science, technology, engineering, or mathematics, or another qualification permitted under applicable IFSCA regulations.
* Experience in financial services, capital markets, securities brokerage, or a regulated financial-services business, meeting the applicable IFSCA eligibility requirements.
* Strong understanding of regulatory frameworks, operational governance, risk controls, and securities-market processes.
* Exposure to US equities, ETFs, international brokerage, global market access, or cross-border securities operations is highly desirable.
* Experience managing external stakeholders, audits, regulatory reporting, and operational teams.
* Strong ownership, decision-making, communication, and problem-solving skills.
* Willingness to work from GIFT City, Gandhinagar.

**Preferred Background**

* Principal Officer or senior operations professional from a GIFT IFSC-registered broker-dealer or global-access business.
* Professionals from international brokerages, securities-market intermediaries, or fintech platforms offering global investment access.
* Candidates with hands-on experience in regulatory oversight, international trading operations, and coordination with overseas market intermediaries.

**At Angel One, our thriving culture is rooted in Diversity, Equity, and Inclusion (DEI).**

*As an Equal opportunity employer, we wholeheartedly welcome people from all backgrounds irrespective of caste, religion, gender, marital status, sexuality, disability, class or age to be part of our team.*

*We believe that everyone's unique experiences and viewpoints make us stronger together.*

*Come and be a part of #OneSpace\*, where your individuality is celebrated and embraced.*

title: Sr. Associate, Global Treasury Risk
description:
**The Opportunity**
Under moderate supervision, provide support to finance function. Responsible for daily transactions, including expenses and payroll. Process payments, maintain cost reports and manage invoices. Update financial spreadsheets with daily transactions, prepare balance sheets and track and reconcile bank statements.
  
  
Avantor is looking for a dynamic, forward-thinking, and experienced
**Sr. Associate**
**with solid experience to manage various Credit Management and Supplier Management-related activities within the Treasury group.**
This role will be a full-time position based out of our Coimbatore office. Sr. Associate, Global Treasury Risk manages daily Credit Evaluations for Avantor global customer base, approve and assign appropriate credit limit and risk classification, facilitate payment terms approvals and changes in line with Delegation of Authority Matrix, ensure SOX Compliance to the objectives, evaluate legitimate bank change requests from suppliers, perform voice verification for new and existing vendors, identify and prevent fraudulent attempts, publish necessary weekly or monthly reports, approve customer and supplier account changes as necessary and perform other duties as assigned.
  
  
**What We’re Looking For**

* Education: Any bachelor’s or master’s degree with finance background will be an added advantage.
* Experience: 2+ years of treasury / Credit Management, Accounts Payable or Accounts Receivables Experience in a multinational corporate environment is preferred.
* Should be Flexible to work in night shifts and working from the office in a hybrid model.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite, particularly Excel, and other relevant software
* Understanding of basic accounting, financial statements analysis, risk management and vendor management.
* Prior experience in process transition, stabilization and change management preferred.
* Ability to work as a part of a team, while providing a strong individual contribution.
* Ability to clearly communicate issues and recommend solutions to both Avantor associates and external parties in order to facilitate risk assessment and voice verification processes.
* Excellent attention to detail, judgment, flexibility, accountability, and dependability.
* Excellent communication skills in English, both verbal and written.
* Live up to ICARE values.

**Credit Management**
**How you will thrive and create an impact**

* Responsible for assigning Risk Classifications and Credit Evaluations for the Avantor Global customer base.
* Approve customer account reviews on a daily basis and assign risk classification at a customer level.
* Ensure appropriate credit and financial information is obtained and reviewed as part of the customer account review.
* Ensure the “Delegation of Authority” for approving Credit Limits is being adhered to.
* Ensure that “Security Instruments” are obtained in high risk situations to mitigate risk, including Letters of Credit, UCC’s and Guarantee’s.
* Ensure that SOX compliance for the Risk objectives are being met on an ongoing basis.
* Responsible for Risk Management Receivable Reporting which includes daily, weekly and monthly reporting:
* On a weekly basis create the weekly “Risk Management Receivable Trending Reports” for Sales, Finance, Risk and Accounting.
* On a monthly basis create and review the Bad Debt Assessment report which is used as the basis for deriving the Bad debt reserve.
* Perform quarterly financial reviews of VWR’s Top Vendors and post the report on the Risk Department Intranet Site for other departments viewing.
* Perform ongoing financial reviews and approve customer requests for special terms requests. This calls for evaluating the financial strength of the company making the terms request coupled with the profitability of the account and then obtaining Senior Management Approval as well.
* Perform financial reviews for customers with consignment Inventory as well as customer facing inventory making sure contract language is in place to protect VWR in the event of a termination of contract.
* Review and monitor all Avantor Global customers who have filed bankruptcy or have been placed for 3rd party collections.
* Approving customer account changes including name changes as a result of the customer being bought, sold, divested or changing the entity name.
* Responsible for collecting accounts receivable on accounts that are in Bankruptcy and are being sold as a Debtor in Possession.
* Responsible for locating and maintaining the “Risk Watch List” report which includes customers that are unable to pay VWR and additional bad debt reserve is taken.
* Performs other duties as assigned

**Supplier Voice Verifications**

* Validate the legitimacy of the request to ensure it is not a fraudulent attempt.
* Facilitate voice verification calls with legitimate supplier contact, Avantor relationship manager to blind confirm the bank details.
* Evaluate and submit the requests through Workflow for necessary approvals with 100% accuracy.
* Monitor and close the request with master data changes in ERP system.
* Maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

**Customer Refunds**

* Validate the legitimacy of the request to ensure it is not a fraudulent attempt.
* Facilitate voice verification calls with legitimate customer contact, engage key stakeholders as required to blind confirm the bank details.
* Evaluate and submit the requests through Workflow for necessary approvals with 100% accuracy.
* Monitor and close the request with master data changes in ERP system.
* Maintain documentation for internal and external audits.

**Process Improvement**

* Identify and implement improvements to treasury risk processes and systems.
* Continuously monitor industry trends and market changes to ensure credit management risk mitigation strategies remain up-to-date and relevant.
* Identify opportunities to automate manual tasks and implement improvements to reduce bad debt exposure.

**Collaboration And Stakeholder Engagement**

* Work closely with key stakeholders across finance, accounting, treasury, Commercial, Accounts Receivable, Accounts Payable and Operations teams to gather necessary information to execute the tasks.

**Ad-hoc Financial Analysis**

* Provide ad-hoc financial analysis as requested by senior management to support decision-making.
* Work on adhoc reports to support revenue acceleration for the organization.

**Ensuring Compliance**

* Maintaining strong internal controls and adhering to relevant regulations such as SOX.
* Monitor the potential risk and raise red flags in case of any possible fraud threats.
